Dialogue Text/0x01000054000011D3.english: "Thank you, dear. You've already done so much, but if your investigation happens to take you to the other side of the coast, please do keep an eye out for my husband..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000054000011D3.polish: „Dziękuję, złotko. Tyle już zrobiłeś, ale jeśli twoje śledztwo zawiedzie cię przypadkiem na drugą stronę wybrzeża, pamiętaj o moim mężu...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000054000011D3.belarusian: "Дзякуй, даражэнькі. Ты і так ужо зрабіў шмат, але калі тваё расследаванне выпадкова завядзе цябе на другі бок узбярэжжа, калі ласка, паглядай па баках, ці няма там майго мужа..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000054000011DA.english: "If I see him, I'll let him know you're here -- when or *if* I get there." (Accept task.)
Dialogue Text/0x01000054000011DA.polish: „Jeśli go spotkam, dam mu znać, że jest pani tutaj. *O ile* kiedykolwiek tam trafię”. (Przyjmij zadanie).
Dialogue Text/0x01000054000011DA.belarusian: "Калі ўбачу яго, перадам, што вы тут - калі ці *як толькі* я туды дабяруся". (Прыняць заданне.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100005400001276.english: "I'd really like to hear about more cryptids."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005400001276.polish: „Bardzo chciałbym dowiedzieć się więcej o kryptydach”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005400001276.belarusian: "Я б вельмі хацеў пачуць пра іншых крыптыдаў."

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000025C.english: "Oh, forgive me for not introducing myself. My name is Lena. My husband and I are staying with our friend Gary just down the street, but I come here for tea when they're away."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000025C.polish: „Och, przepraszam, że się nie przedstawiłam. Jestem Lena. Mój mąż i ja zatrzymaliśmy się u naszego przyjaciela, Gary'ego, który mieszka dalej przy tej ulicy. Przychodzę tu na herbatę, kiedy ich nie ma”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000025C.belarusian: "Ох, прабачце, што не прадставілася. Мяне завуць Лена. Мы з мужам спыніліся ў нашага сябра Гэры тут, далей па вуліцы, але я прыходжу сюды на гарбату, калі іх няма."

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000026E.english: "Wait, what's wrong with the phone line?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000026E.polish: „Zaraz, a co jest nie tak z linią telefoniczną?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000026E.belarusian: "Пачакайце, а што не так з тэлефоннай лініяй?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800000274.english: "What did you need the phone for anyway?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800000274.polish: „Po co w ogóle potrzebuje pani telefonu?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000027C.english: "The manager was vague about it." She frowns.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000027C.polish: „Kierownik nie był zbyt wylewny” – marszczy brwi.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000027C.belarusian: "Кіраўнік не сказаў нічога канкрэтнага", - яна хмурыцца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800000295.english: She's agitated, judging from the way she keeps pulling at the frayed edge of her blanket.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800000295.polish: Sądząc po tym, jak podskubuje wystrzępiony brzeg swojego koca, jest podenerwowana.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800000295.belarusian: Яна ўсхваляваная, мяркуючы па тым, як яна тузае пацёрты край свайго пледа.

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000002D4.english: "Lieutenant Kitsuragi." He shakes her hand brusquely. "May I ask what you needed to use the phone for, ma'am?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000002D4.polish: „Porucznik Kitsuragi” – szorstko ściska jej dłoń. „Czy mogę zapytać, po co potrzebny pani telefon?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000002D4.belarusian: "Лейтэнант Кіцурагі", - ён скупа паціскае яе руку. - "Ці магу я спытаць, для чаго вам спатрэбіўся тэлефон, спадарыня?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000030D.english: "What did you need the phone for anyway?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000030D.polish: „Po co w ogóle potrzebuje pani telefonu?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800000315.english: "To let the young woman who's house-sitting for us know that we may be delayed. Morell -- my husband -- and our friend Gary were supposed to get back by Monday night, but they're still missing and I haven't heard from them..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800000315.polish: „Chcę zawiadomić młodą kobietę, która zajmuje się naszym domem, że wrócimy później. Morell – mój mąż – i nasz przyjaciel Gary mieli być z powrotem w poniedziałek przed zmrokiem, a nadal ich nie ma i nie wiem, co się z nimi dzieje...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800000315.belarusian: "Каб папярэдзіць маладую жанчыну, якая даглядае наш дом, што мы можам затрымацца. Марэль — мой муж — і наш сябар Гэры павінны былі вярнуцца да вечара панядзелка, але іх усё яшчэ няма, і я нічога пра іх не чула..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000031C.english: "That's just it! This isn't like him at all. He always plans his expeditions so carefully..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000031C.polish: „Właśnie w tym rzecz! To całkiem nie w jego stylu. Zawsze tak dokładnie planuje swoje ekspedycje...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000031C.belarusian: "Вось менавіта! Гэта зусім на яго не падобна. Ён заўсёды так старанна плануе свае экспедыцыі..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000033B.english: “But you have more important things to worry about.” She glances out the window toward the bay.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000033B.polish: „Ale ty masz ważniejsze sprawy na głowie” – spogląda przez okno w kierunku zatoki.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000033B.belarusian: "Але ў цябе ёсць больш важныя рэчы, пра якія трэба турбавацца", - яна глядзіць у акно ў бок заліва.

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000003E5.english: "To let the young woman who's house-sitting for us know that we may be delayed. Morell, my husband, and Gary were supposed to get back by Monday night, but they're still missing and I haven't heard from them..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000003E5.polish: „Chcę zawiadomić młodą kobietę, która zajmuje się naszym domem, że wrócimy później. Mój mąż Morell i Gary mieli być z powrotem w poniedziałek przed zmrokiem, a nadal ich nie ma i nie wiem, co się z nimi dzieje...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000003E5.belarusian: "Каб папярэдзіць маладую жанчыну, якая даглядае наш дом, што мы можам затрымацца. Марэль, мой муж, і Гэры павінны былі вярнуцца да вечара панядзелка, але іх усё яшчэ няма, і я нічога пра іх не чула..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000004C6.english: "Oh, you're such a dear! Thank you, sweetie."
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000004C6.belarusian: "Ой, ты такі добры! Дзякуй табе, сэрцайка".

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000004E5.english: A cold breeze hisses through dense thickets of reeds.... Something sweet in it, somnolent. A damp chill goes down your spine. When you look around, you're still in the Whirling-in-Rags.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000004E5.polish: Zimny powiew przemyka z sykiem wśród gęstwy trzcin... Niesie ze sobą coś słodkiego, sennego. Po plecach przebiega ci zimny dreszcz. Rozglądasz się, ale wciąż jesteś w Whirling-in-Rags.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000004E5.belarusian: Халодны ветрык з шыпеннем праносіцца скрозь густыя зараснікі трыснягу... Нешта салодкае ў ім, усыпляльнае. Вільготны мароз прабягае па спіне. Калі ты азіраешся, ты ўсё яшчэ ў Whirling-in-Rags.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800000509.english: You hear that? Someone's *missing*. There could be *foul play* afoot!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800000509.belarusian: Чуў гэта? Нехта *знік*. Тут можа пахнуць *крыміналам*!

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800000591.belarusian: Люблю справы аб зніклых без вестак.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800000597.english: Missing persons aren't really my style.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800000597.polish: Szukanie zaginionych nie jest za bardzo w moim stylu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800000597.belarusian: Зніклыя людзі — не зусім мой стыль.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000059D.english: You don't have a *style*, you have a *duty*. Now start asking questions, like a real law enforcement official.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000059D.polish: Nie masz czegoś takiego jak *styl*. Masz za to *obowiązek*. A teraz zacznij zadawać pytania, jak przystało na funkcjonariusza służb porządkowych.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000059D.belarusian: У цябе няма *стылю*, у цябе ёсць *абавязак*. А цяпер пачынай задаваць пытанні, як сапраўдны афіцэр праваахоўных органаў.

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000005CC.english: That's right. Now skip the foreplay. Time to dive into the dark alleys, start shaking down the usual suspects -- you know, *legwork*.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000005CC.polish: Właśnie tak. I daruj sobie całą tę grę wstępną. Czas ruszać w ciemne zaułki, zacząć przepytywać standardowych podejrzanych. Rozumiesz, *praca w terenie*.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000005CC.belarusian: Вось менавіта. Цяпер прапусці папярэднія ласкі. Час нырнуць у цёмныя завулкі і пачаць трэсці звыклых падазраваных — ну, ты разумееш, *папрацаваць нагамі*.

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000005E1.english: "I was also hoping she'd heard from Morell..." She looks down.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000005E1.polish: „Miałam też nadzieję, że Morell się do niej odezwał...” – wbija wzrok w podłogę.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000005E1.belarusian: "Я таксама спадзявалася, што яна нешта чула ад Марэля..." - яна апускае вочы.

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000005EA.english: "Okay, I'll bite. Has your husband gone missing before?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000005EA.polish: „No dobrze, połknę ten haczyk. Czy pani mąż kiedykolwiek wcześniej zaginął?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000005EA.belarusian: "Добра, здаюся. Ваш муж калі-небудзь знікаў раней?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800001016.english: "Of course, dear. Is there a particular cryptid that you're interested in learning about?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800001016.polish: „Oczywiście, złotko. Interesuje cię jakaś konkretna kryptyda?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800001016.belarusian: "Вядома, даражэнькі. Ці ёсць нейкі канкрэтны крыптыд, пра якога ты хацеў бы даведацца?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000010FD.english: "I've changed my mind. I'll help you find your husband after all."
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000010FD.polish: „Zmieniłem zdanie. Jednak pomogę pani w poszukiwaniu męża”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000010FD.belarusian: "Я перадумаў. Я ўсё ж дапамагу вам знайсці мужа".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800001178.polish: „I nie ma w pobliżu innych telefonów?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000117F.english: "The closest phone booth is down the coast. Sorry for the inconvenience, ma'am." The cafeteria manager appears genuinely apologetic.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000117F.polish: „Najbliższa budka telefoniczna znajduje się dalej przy wybrzeżu. Przepraszam za tę niedogodność” – kierownik baru wydaje się szczery w swych przeprosinach.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000117F.belarusian: "Найбліжэйшая тэлефонная будка далей па ўзбярэжжы. Прабачце за нязручнасці, спадарыня", - выглядае так, што кіраўнік бара шчыра шкадуе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800001186.english: "It's fine, I understand. Thank you anyway." She turns back to you with a weary smile. "I'm glad to see you again, dear."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800001186.polish: „W porządku, rozumiem. Mimo wszystko dziękuję” – zwraca się ku tobie ze zmęczonym uśmiechem. „Dobrze znów cię widzieć, złotko”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800001186.belarusian: "Усё добра, я разумею. Дзякуй у любым разе", - яна паварочваецца да цябе са стомленай усмешкай. - "Рада бачыць цябе зноў, даражэнькі."

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000118F.english: She's agitated and keeps pulling at the frayed edge of her blanket.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000118F.polish: Jest podenerwowana i wciąż skubie wystrzępiony brzeg swojego koca.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000118F.belarusian: Яна ўсхваляваная і ўсё тузае пацёрты край свайго пледа.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800001195.english: "The closest phone booth is down the coast. Sorry for the inconvenience, ma'am." He appears to be genuinely apologetic.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800001195.polish: „Najbliższa budka telefoniczna znajduje się dalej przy wybrzeżu. Przepraszam za tę niedogodność” – wydaje się szczery w swych przeprosinach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800001195.belarusian: "Найбліжэйшая тэлефонная будка далей па ўзбярэжжы. Прабачце за нязручнасці, спадарыня", - выглядае так, што ён шчыра шкадуе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000119B.english: "It's fine, I understand. Thank you anyway." She turns back to you with a weary smile. "Now, then."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000119B.polish: „W porządku, rozumiem. Mimo wszystko dziękuję” – zwraca się ku tobie ze zmęczonym uśmiechem. „Słucham”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000119B.belarusian: "Усё добра, я разумею. Дзякуй у любым разе", - яна паварочваецца да цябе са стомленай усмешкай. - "Так, слухаю."

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000011A1.english: She turns back to the cafeteria manager. "And there's no public phones nearby?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000011A1.polish: Odwraca się w stronę kierownika baru. „I nie ma w pobliżu innych telefonów?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000011A1.belarusian: Яна зноў паварочваецца да кіраўніка бара: "І паблізу няма ніякіх грамадскіх тэлефонаў?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00000855.english: "This sounds like police business. I'll help you find your husband." (Accept task.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00000855.polish: „To wszystko brzmi jak zadanie dla policji. Pomogę pani znaleźć męża”. (Przyjmij zadanie).
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00000855.belarusian: "Гэта гучыць як паліцэйская справа. Я дапамагу вам знайсці мужа". (Прыняць заданне.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000085A.english: "That's too bad. I hope your husband comes back soon." (Decline task.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000085A.polish: „Ciężka sprawa. Mam nadzieję, że pani mąż wkrótce wróci”. (Odrzuć zadanie).
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000085A.belarusian: "Шкада. Спадзяюся, ваш муж хутка вернецца". (Адхіліць заданне.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000088B.english: "Turns out the water lock was broken, so your husband is probably just stuck further down the coast. He should return now that it's fixed."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000088B.polish: „Okazuje się, że śluza uległa uszkodzeniu, więc pani mąż utknął zapewne po prostu na dalszej części wybrzeża. Już ją naprawili, więc powinien niedługo wrócić”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000088B.belarusian: "Аказваецца, шлюз быў зламаны, таму ваш муж, верагодна, проста затрымаўся далей уздоўж узбярэжжа. Цяпер, калі яго паправілі, ён мусіць вярнуцца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800003791.english: "I think it would be good to take a break from the hanged-man for a little while."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800003791.polish: „Dobrze byłoby chyba zrobić sobie chwilę przerwy od wisielca”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800003791.belarusian: "Думаю, было б някепска трохі адпачыць ад павешанага".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800003797.english: A sigh. He takes off his glasses and wipes the lenses on his jacket before replacing them.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800003797.polish: Wzdycha, po czym zdejmuje okulary i wyciera szkła w kurtkę, a następnie zakłada je ponownie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800003797.belarusian: Уздых. Ён здымае акуляры і працірае шклы аб куртку, перш чым надзець іх назад.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000379D.english: "Well, the man's already been dead more than a week..." He concludes. "I suppose a *small* diversion won't hurt too much."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000379D.polish: „Fakt, że człowiek nie żyje już od ponad tygodnia...” – podsumowuje. „*Krótka* przerwa wiele chyba nie zmieni”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000379D.belarusian: "Што ж, чалавек ужо мёртвы больш за тыдзень... - робіць выснову ён. - Мяркую, *невялікае* адхіленне ад справы не надта зашкодзіць".

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000037B5.english: "I've already given my word. I'm honour-bound to uphold it."
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000037B5.polish: „Dałem już słowo. Honor nakazuje mi go dotrzymać”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000037B5.belarusian: "Я ўжо даў слова. Гонар абавязвае мяне яго трымаць".

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000037BB.english: He sighs. "I sincerely doubt it. Still, I suppose it won't hurt to keep an eye out."
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000037BB.polish: Wzdycha. „Szczerze wątpię. Ale pewnie nie zaszkodzi mieć oczy szeroko otwarte”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000037BB.belarusian: Ён уздыхае. "Я шчыра сумняваюся. Аднак мяркую, не зашкодзіць глядзець па баках".

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000037C1.english: "I've got a *premonition* that this missing scientist is connected to our main case."
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000037C1.polish: „Mam *przeczucie*, że ten zaginiony naukowiec ma związek z naszą sprawą”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000037C1.belarusian: "У мяне ёсць *прадчуванне*, што гэты зніклы навуковец звязаны з нашай асноўнай справай".

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000037DD.english: "Oh, thank you officers, truly. I'll be right here if you come across any sign of Morell."
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000037DD.polish: „Dziękuję wam, serdecznie dziękuję. Będę tutaj, gdybyście mieli jakieś informacje o Morellu”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000037DD.belarusian: "Ох, дзякуй вам, афіцэры, шчыра. Я буду тут, калі вы натрапіце на хоць які след Марэля".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800003802.english: "Yes, well, thank you for your time, officer. I'm probably just worrying for no reason. I'm sure they'll return before long..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800003802.polish: „Cóż, dziękuję za poświęcony czas, komisarzu. Pewnie niepotrzebnie się zamartwiam. Na pewno niebawem wrócą...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800003802.belarusian: "Так, што ж, дзякуй за ваш час, афіцэру. Напэўна, я проста хвалююся без прычыны. Упэўненая, яны хутка вернуцца..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800003808.english: There's a note of disappointment in her voice that she can't quite suppress.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800003808.polish: W jej głosie pobrzmiewa rozczarowanie, którego nie jest w stanie zbyt dobrze ukryć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800003808.belarusian: У яе голасе гучыць нотка расчаравання, якую яна не можа цалкам схаваць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000382C.english: "Are you sure we have time to go chasing after bug-hunters just now?" The lieutenant taps his foot impatiently.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000382C.polish: „Jesteś pewny, że mamy teraz czas uganiać się za jakimiś łowcami robaków?” – porucznik niecierpliwie potupuje nogą.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000382C.belarusian: "Вы ўпэўненыя, што ў нас ёсць час ганяцца за лаўцамі жукоў проста зараз?" - Лейтэнант нецярпліва пераступае з нагі на нагу.

Alternate1/0x010000580000382C.polish: „Jesteś pewny, że mamy teraz czas uganiać się za jakimiś łowcami robaków?” – porucznik zwraca głowę w kierunku samozwańczych mścicieli obecnych w barze. „Sugerowałem, żeby wyluzować, ale...”
Alternate1/0x010000580000382C.belarusian: "Вы ўпэўненыя, што ў нас ёсць час ганяцца за лаўцамі жукоў проста зараз? - Лейтэнант паварочвае галаву ў бок мсціўцаў у кафэтэрыі. - Я прапаноўваў захоўваць спакой, але..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800005C66.english: "You know... to hell with it, let's have more cryptids."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800005C66.polish: „Tak właściwie... do diabła z tym wszystkim. Więcej kryptyd, a co tam”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800005C66.belarusian: "Ведаеце... да д'ябла ўсё, давайце яшчэ пра крыптыдаў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800005C6E.english: "Of course, officers." She smiles politely. "Is there a particular cryptid you two are interested in learning about?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800005C6E.polish: „Oczywiście” – uśmiecha się uprzejmie. „Interesuje was jakaś konkretna kryptyda?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800005C6E.belarusian: "Вядома, афіцэры", - яна ветліва ўсміхаецца. - "Ці ёсць нейкі канкрэтны крыптыд, пра якога вы ўдваіх хацелі б даведацца?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B8D9.english: "I've really spent too much time on this side-case as it is." (Reject task.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B8D9.polish: „I tak zmarnowałem już na tę poboczną sprawę więcej czasu, niż powinienem”. (Odrzuć zadanie).
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B8D9.belarusian: "Я і так змарнаваў зашмат часу на гэтую пабочную справу". (Адхіліць заданне.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B8E0.english: "Oh, of course, sweetie. I understand." She smiles brightly to mask her disappointment.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B8E0.polish: „Och, oczywiście, skarbeńku. Rozumiem” – uśmiecha się szeroko, próbując ukryć swoje rozczarowanie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B8E0.belarusian: "Ох, вядома, сэрцайка. Я разумею", - яна светла ўсміхаецца, каб схаваць сваё расчараванне.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BC94.english: "I restocked the empty trap... Where's Morell?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BC94.polish: „Uzupełniłem przynętę w pustej pułapce... Gdzie jest Morell?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BC94.belarusian: "Я паклаў прынаду ў пустую пастку... Дзе Марэль?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BC9C.english: "Thank you for doing that, dear." She manages a smile for you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BC9C.polish: „Dziękuję ci, złotko” – sili się dla ciebie na uśmiech.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BC9C.belarusian: "Дзякуй, што зрабіў гэта, даражэнькі", - яна выціскае з сябе ўсмешку.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCA4.english: "It's probably for the best. It's awfully cold out there in those reeds."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCA4.polish: „Tak pewnie będzie lepiej. W tych trzcinach jest okropnie zimno”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCA4.belarusian: "Мабыць, так будзе лепш. Там у тым трыснігу страшэнны холад".

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCAA.english: "Only the hard core players left, huh?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCB6.english: Her smile is weary. Her earlier ebullience has left her.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCB6.polish: Sili się na zmęczony uśmiech. Opuściła ją wcześniejsza żywiołowość.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCB6.belarusian: Яе ўсмешка стомленая. Былая жвавасць пакінула яе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCC1.english: "Morell still isn't feeling well. I convinced him to stay at Gary's to get some rest." She looks down at her hands. "I'm afraid the cold has really gotten to him."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCC1.polish: „Morell nie czuje się jeszcze dobrze. Przekonałam go, żeby został u Gary'ego i odpoczywał” – spogląda w dół, zawieszając wzrok na swoich dłoniach. „Niestety, zimno mocno dało się mu we znaki”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCC1.belarusian: "Марэлю ўсё яшчэ блага. Я ўгаварыла яго застацца ў Гэры і адпачыць, - яна глядзіць уніз на свае рукі. - Баюся, холад яго зусім падкасіў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCE7.english: "So... who's going to check the traps?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCED.english: "Something tells me it's up to me again."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCED.polish: „Coś mi mówi, że znów muszę to zrobić ja”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCED.belarusian: "Нешта мне падказвае, што гэта зноў мая справа".

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCFC.english: "Morell will eventually. Or we'll talk Gary into going back out, perhaps..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCFC.polish: „Morell w końcu to zrobi. Albo może namówimy Gary'ego, żeby tam wrócił...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BCFC.belarusian: "Марэль у рэшце рэшт праверыць. Ці мы ўгаворым Гэры выправіцца туды зноў, мабыць..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BD02.english: "No." She says -- insisting now. "You don't have to do that. Enough of this fool's errand, Morell will do it. Or Gary. You have work to do, I've wasted enough of everyone's time."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BD02.polish: „Nie” – tym razem jest stanowcza. „Nie musisz tego robić. Dość już tego biegania na posyłki. Morell się tym zajmie. Albo Gary. Ty masz swoją pracę, a ja zabrałam już wszystkim dość czasu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BD02.belarusian: "Не, - кажа яна цяпер ужо настойліва. - Табе не трэба гэтага рабіць. Досыць ужо бессэнсоўнай бегатні, Марэль сам зробіць. Ці Гэры. У цябе ёсць праца, а я і так змарнавала зашмат чужога часу".

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000BD11.english: "I'll take care of it." (Take it on.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A5CD.english: They were just props. Why return to them?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A5CD.polish: To były zwykłe rekwizyty. Po co do nich wracać?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A5CD.belarusian: Гэта быў проста рэквізіт. Навошта да яго вяртацца?

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A5DF.english: That's understandable. Fantasies are serious things. The mind is the drawing board of history.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A5DF.polish: Zrozumiałe. Fantazje to poważne rzeczy. Umysł jest deską kreślarską historii.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A5DF.belarusian: Гэта зразумела. Фантазіі — рэч сур'ёзная. Розум — гэта кульман гісторыі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A5E7.english: Something strains her face, before she looks up again:
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A5E7.polish: Na jej twarzy pojawia się napięcie. Po chwili znów podnosi wzrok.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A5E7.belarusian: Нешта напружвае яе твар, перш чым яна зноў падымае вочы:

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A5EF.english: The result is 1. On a 20-sided die.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A5F7.english: The dice is black and filled with little silvery flakes, like snowfall.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A5F7.polish: Kostka jest czarna, pełna przypominających śnieg małych, srebrzystych płatków.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A5F7.belarusian: Костка чорная і запоўненая дробнымі серабрыстымі шматкамі, падобнымі да снегападу.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A618.english: The temperature has dropped in the cover of the night; you see frost on the windows.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A618.polish: Temperatura spadła wraz z nadejściem nocy. Na szybach widzisz malunki mrozu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A618.belarusian: Пад покрывам ночы тэмпература ўпала; ты бачыш марозныя ўзоры на вокнах.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A61F.english: Little sparkling embers under the window...

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A629.english: Outside it's light. Light scatters from the low hanging cloud cover. There's always the threat of snow.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A629.polish: Na zewnątrz jest jasno. Nisko zawieszone chmury rozpraszają światło. Zawsze istnieje groźba spadnięcia śniegu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A629.belarusian: На вуліцы светла. Святло рассейваецца скрозь нізкія хмары. Заўсёды ёсць пагроза снегу.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A631.english: "Anything else? Another failed business perhaps? I've been here for a long time..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A631.polish: „Interesuje pana coś jeszcze? Może kolejny upadły biznes? Działam tu od dawna...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A631.belarusian: "Нешта яшчэ? Можа, яшчэ які збанкрутаваны бізнес? Я тут ужо вельмі даўно..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A63E.english: His disdain for pinball could not be clearer.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A63E.polish: Jego niechęć do pinballa nie może być bardziej oczywista.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A63E.belarusian: Яго пагарда да пінбола не магла быць больш відавочнай.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A646.english: If the Whirling is part of the same building then it's part of the Doomed Commercial Area. The darkness of this place is there too...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A646.polish: Jeśli Whirling jest częścią tego samego budynku, to należy do Zgubionej Strefy Handlowej. Mrok tego miejsca istnieje również tam...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A646.belarusian: Калі Whirling — частка таго ж будынка, значыць, ён частка гандлёвай зоны. Цемра гэтага месца ёсць і там...

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A66C.english: That's all she has to say on the subject. She *has* been thorough -- and truthful -- as far as we can see.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A66C.polish: To wszystko, co ma do powiedzenia na ten temat. O ile możemy stwierdzić, *była* dokładna i prawdomówna.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A66C.belarusian: Гэта ўсё, што яна можа сказаць на гэтую тэму. Яна *была* грунтоўнай — і шчырай, наколькі мы бачым.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A672.english: Plaisance needs to hear about this. Perhaps if you combine your *psychic energies* you'll make sense of the situation.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A672.polish: Plaisance powinna się o tym dowiedzieć. Może jeśli połączycie swoje *psychiczne energie*, sytuacja stanie się jaśniejsza.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A672.belarusian: Плезанс мусіць пачуць пра гэта. Магчыма, калі аб'яднаць вашы *псіхічныя энергіі*, вы зможаце разабрацца ў сітуацыі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A67A.english: Plaisance is not going to like what you have to tell her.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A67A.polish: Plaisance nie spodoba się to, co masz jej do powiedzenia.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A67A.belarusian: Плезанс зусім не спадабаецца тое, што ты ёй раскажаш.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A67F.english: That's all she has to say on the subject. She's been thorough and truthful as far as we can see.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A67F.polish: To wszystko, co ma do powiedzenia na ten temat. O ile możemy stwierdzić, była dokładna i prawdomówna.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A67F.belarusian: Гэта ўсё, што яна можа сказаць на гэтую тэму. Яна была грунтоўнай і шчырай, наколькі мы бачым.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A694.english: Aside from getting naked, you're not sure what else to do. The building holds no more answers for you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A694.polish: Nie wiesz, co możesz zrobić, pomijając rozebranie się do naga. Budynek nie ma dla ciebie już żadnych odpowiedzi.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A694.belarusian: Акрамя таго, каб распрануцца дагала, ты не ведаеш, што яшчэ зрабіць. Будынак больш не мае для цябе адказаў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A6A0.english: A tool to get the zipper open?

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A6A8.english: No. The old coal plant that used to be here was subsumed into the new venture, its ruins swallowed up -- yet it has a different address in the heart of the city.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A6A8.polish: Nie. Stara elektrownia węglowa, która tu była, została przekształcona w inny biznes, a jej ruiny zostały wchłonięte przez budynek obok. Mimo to jednak ma inny adres, w samym sercu miasta.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A6A8.belarusian: Не. Старая вугальная электрастанцыя, якая тут была, была паглынута новым праектам, яе руіны ўвабраныя ў сябе — і ўсё ж яна мае іншы адрас у сэрцы горада.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A6C5.english: The bookstore closes starting 21.00. You'll have to do that tomorrow.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A6C5.polish: Księgarnia zamyka się o 21:00. Będziesz musiał zrobić to jutro.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A6C5.belarusian: Кнігарня зачыняецца а 21:00. Табе давядзецца зрабіць гэта заўтра.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7A3.english: "How did I *become* one? It was a business decision. I was a regular jeweller at first, but that's an unfocused field -- with too much competition."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7A3.polish: „Jak nią *zostałam*? To była decyzja biznesowa. Byłam zwykłą jubilerką, ale to mało wyspecjalizowana profesja – i panuje w niej zbyt duża konkurencja”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7A3.belarusian: "Як я ёй *стала*? Гэта было бізнес-рашэнне. Спачатку я была звычайнай ювеліркай, але гэта занадта размытая галіна — і з велізарнай канкурэнцыяй."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7AE.english: "Some of my friends were role-players. They asked me to make some polyhedral dice out of cobalt. That was my first order. I grew it from there."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7AE.polish: „Miałam wśród znajomych miłośników gier fabularnych. Poprosili mnie o wykonanie wielościennej kości z kobaltu. To było moje pierwsze zamówienie. Od tego wszystko się zaczęło”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7AE.belarusian: "Некаторыя мае сябры захапляліся ролевымі гульнямі. Яны папрасілі мяне зрабіць некалькі шматгранных костак з кобальту. Гэта была мая першая замова. Адтуль усё і пайшло."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7C9.english: "Not especially. I like working with rare materials and a steady pay. And role-players as customers -- they're nice people."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7C9.polish: „Niespecjalnie. Lubię pracę z rzadkimi minerałami i regularną wypłatę. I graczy jako klientów – to mili ludzie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7C9.belarusian: "Не асабліва. Мне падабаецца працаваць з рэдкімі матэрыяламі і мець стабільны заробак. Ды і ролевікі як кліенты — вельмі прыемныя людзі."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7D7.english: She's thankful for the security they provide her.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7D7.polish: Jest wdzięczna za finansowe bezpieczeństwo, jakie jej zapewniają.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7D7.belarusian: Яна ўдзячная за фінансавую стабільнасць, якую яны ёй забяспечваюць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7DD.english: Some of those nice people have big bucks to spend on novelty items.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7DD.polish: Niektórzy z tych miłych ludzi są gotowi wydać kupę forsy na nowinki.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7DD.belarusian: Некаторыя з гэтых прыемных людзей маюць кучу грошай, якую гатовыя спускаць на незвычайныя рэчы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7EF.english: "I've grown crafty over the years. You'll like your dice, if you get them from me. Be sure of it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7EF.polish: „Nabrałam wprawy przez te wszystkie lata. Spodoba się panu kość, którą pan u mnie zamówi. Zapewniam”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7EF.belarusian: "З гадамі я набіла руку. Вам спадабаюцца вашы косткі, калі замовіце іх у мяне. Будзьце пэўныя."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7FD.english: "I've grown crafty over the years. You'll like your dice, I'm sure of it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7FD.polish: „Nabrałam wprawy przez te wszystkie lata. Jestem pewna, że spodoba się panu pańska kość”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A7FD.belarusian: "З гадамі я набіла руку. Вам спадабаюцца вашы косткі, я ў гэтым упэўненая."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A806.english: She doesn't let it show, but there's anger in there -- she doesn't like jewellers. Thinks they're a mob.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A806.polish: Nie okazuje tego po sobie, lecz drzemie w niej złość. Nie lubi jubilerów. Uważa ich za mafię.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A806.belarusian: Яна не падае выгляду, але ўнутры яе кіпіць злосць — яна не любіць ювеліраў. Лічыць іх мафіяй.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB7A.english: It feels icy. Just holding this die in your hand sends a jolt of cold down your spine. Through the dark resin, you can make out a nugget of bone hewn from an alligator's jaw.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB7A.polish: Jest zimna w dotyku. Od samego trzymania jej w dłoni przeszywa cię lodowaty dreszcz. W mrocznej żywicy dostrzegasz kawałek kości wyciętej ze szczęki aligatora.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB7A.belarusian: Яна ледзяная навобмацак. Ад аднаго толькі трымання яе ў руцэ па спіне бягуць дрыжыкі холаду. Скрозь цёмную смалу можна разгледзець кавалак косткі са сківіцы алігатара.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB93.english: Dazzling! It's like you have a pair of tiny disco balls in your hand.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB93.polish: Olśniewające! Jak para dyskotekowych kul spoczywających w twojej dłoni.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB93.belarusian: Асляпляльна! Нібы трымаеш у руцэ пару мініяцюрных дыска-шароў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001ABA2.english: It's a handsome red die with a mix of plant symbols diligently engraved on its faces.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001ABA2.polish: To piękna zielona kość, na której ściankach starannie wygrawerowano roślinne symbole.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001ABA2.belarusian: Гэта прыгожая чырвоная костка, на гранях якой старанна выгравіраваны розныя раслінныя сімвалы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001ABB9.english: There appears to be a small fly embedded within. It's like looking into a lost little world...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001ABB9.polish: W bursztynie dostrzegasz uwięzionego małego owada. To jak zaglądanie do małego zaginionego świata…
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001ABB9.belarusian: Здаецца, унутры застыла маленькая муха. Нібы зазіраеш у маленькі згублены свет...

Dialogue Text/0x010000350000013E.english: "That's why people like role-playing games. You can be whoever you want to be. You can try again. Still, there's something inherently violent even about dice rolls."
Dialogue Text/0x010000350000013E.polish: „To dlatego ludzie lubią gry fabularne. W nich człowiek może być kim tylko chce. Może spróbować raz jeszcze. Mimo to jest coś nieodłącznie brutalnego nawet w rzucie kością”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000350000013E.belarusian: "Вось чаму людзі любяць ролевыя гульні. Ты можаш быць кім заўгодна. Ты можаш паспрабаваць зноў. І ўсё ж нават у кідках костак ёсць нешта па сваёй сутнасці гвалтоўнае."

Dialogue Text/0x0100003500000144.english: "It's like every time you cast a die, something disappears. Some alternative ending, or an entirely different world..." She picks up a pair of dice from the table and examines them under the light.
Dialogue Text/0x0100003500000144.polish: „Zupełnie jakby z każdym rzutem kostki coś znikało. Jakieś alternatywne zakończenie lub zupełnie inny świat...” – podnosi parę kości ze stołu i przygląda im się pod światło.
Dialogue Text/0x0100003500000144.belarusian: "Гэта нібыта кожны раз, калі ты кідаеш костку, нешта знікае. Якісьці альтэрнатыўны фінал ці зусім іншы свет..." Яна бярэ са стала пару костак і разглядае іх на святле.

Dialogue Text/0x010000210000289E.english: Why is *everyone* doing drugs in this place -- even the *taxidermist*?!
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000289E.polish: Czemu *wszyscy* biorą tu narkotyki? Nawet *wypychacz zwierząt*?!
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000289E.belarusian: Чаму ў гэтым месцы *ўсе* ўжываюць наркотыкі — нават *таксідэрміст*?!

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002A1D.english: She sighs. "I guess the least I can do is check up on Soona, see how she's doing."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002A1D.polish: Wzdycha. „W takim razie powinnam chyba sprawdzić, jak radzi sobie Soona”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002A1D.belarusian: Яна ўздыхае. "Мабыць, найменшае, што я магу зрабіць, гэта праведаць Суну і паглядзець, як яна там."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021FD4.english: Looks like someone tried to *reconceptualize* their business here.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021FD4.polish: Zdaje się, że ktoś próbował tu stworzyć *nową koncepcję* swojego interesu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021FD4.belarusian: Здаецца, нехта спрабаваў *рэканцэптуалізаваць* тут свой бізнес.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021FEC.english: Look: The skis and rotor blades both bear the same "Slipstream" logo. It seems likely that they started out making one, failed to turn a profit, and then pivoted to producing the other.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021FEC.polish: Popatrz: narty i łopaty wirników mają to samo logo „Slipstream”. Wygląda na to, że zaczęli od produkcji jednego towaru, nie zdołali na nim zarobić, po czym zajęli się produkcją czego innego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021FEC.belarusian: Паглядзі: на лыжах і лопасцях вінта стаіць аднолькавы лагатып "Slipstream". Вельмі імаверна, што яны пачалі вырабляць адно, не здолелі выйсці ў плюс і пераключыліся на вытворчасць другога.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021FF3.english: What a strange leap of imagination... And yet they still failed. How sad. [Finish thought.]
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021FF3.polish: Co za dziwaczna zmiana... A mimo to nic im nie dała. To smutne. [Zakończ myśl].
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021FF3.belarusian: Які дзіўны палёт фантазіі... І ўсё адно яны прагарэлі. Як сумна. [Скончыць думку.]

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021FFF.english: That's just speculation. We don't know anything for sure. [Finish thought.]
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021FFF.polish: To tylko spekulacja. Niczego nie wiemy tu na pewno. [Zakończ myśl].
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021FFF.belarusian: Гэта ўсяго толькі здагадкі. Мы нічога не ведаем напэўна. [Скончыць думку.]

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700022006.english: Not quite. You *do* know that there's something unusual about this company's business model...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700022006.polish: Poniekąd. *Wiesz* bowiem, że w modelu biznesowym tej firmy jest coś dziwnego...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700022006.belarusian: Не зусім. Ты *ведаеш*, што ў бізнес-мадэлі гэтай кампаніі ёсць нешта дзіўнае...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005CAE.english: But the question is -- which did they start with, and which did they pivot to?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005CAE.polish: Pytanie jednak brzmi: od czego zaczęli, a na co przeszli później?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005CAE.belarusian: Але пытанне вось у чым — з чаго яны пачалі і на што пераключыліся?

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00002173.english: A large table with two huge vacuum-insulated thermal coffee dispensers. Someone has forgotten a small plastic card next to the stacks of cups.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00002173.polish: Duży stół z dwoma próżniowo izolowanymi, termalnymi podajnikami kawy. Ktoś zostawił przy stosach kubków małą plastikową kartę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00002173.belarusian: Вялікі стол з двума вялізнымі тэрмадыспенсерамі для кавы з вакуумнай ізаляцыяй. Побач са стосамі кубкаў нехта забыўся на невялікую пластыкавую картку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000022E9.english: You snatch up the red plastic card. It features a black contour of a crane lifting a container. The name 'Etienne Hogarth' is written in the middle, below it in smaller text: 'Member of the board'. It comes with a magnetic strip -- meant to open electronic doors.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000022E9.polish: Bierzesz czerwoną, plastikową kartę. Widnieje na niej zarys podnoszącego kontener żurawia. Pośrodku widnieje imię „Etienne Hogarth”, poniżej zaś drobnym drukiem napisano „Członek rady nadzorczej”. Na karcie jest pasek magnetyczny służący do otwierania drzwi elektronicznych.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000022E9.belarusian: Ты хапаеш чырвоную пластыкавую картку. На ёй намаляваны чорны контур крана, які падымае кантэйнер. Пасярэдзіне напісана імя 'Etienne Hogarth', ніжэй меншым шрыфтам: 'Член Праўлення'. На ёй ёсць магнітная стужка — прызначаная адмыкаць электронныя дзверы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005C90.english: Look into one of the old coffee cups.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005C90.polish: Zajrzyj do jednego ze starych kubków na kawę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005C90.belarusian: Зазірнуць у адзін са старых кубкаў з-пад кавы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005C95.english: Peer into a discarded coffee cup!
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005C95.polish: Zajrzyj do wyrzuconego kubka na kawę!
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005C95.belarusian: Зазірні ў выкінуты кубак з-пад кавы!

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CA1.english: You see nothing exceptional. It's a dirty cup, smudged brown, with old ground coffee stuck to the bottom... slowly getting mouldy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CA1.polish: Nie widzisz nic wyjątkowego. To stary, poznaczony brązowymi smugami kubek, do dna którego przylgnęła stara zmielona kawa. Powoli pleśnieje.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CA1.belarusian: Ты не бачыш нічога незвычайнага. Гэта брудны кубак, запэцканы брунатным, са старой молатай кавай, што прыліпла да дна... і паволі цвіце.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CA8.english: What am I supposed to see here?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CA8.polish: Co ja mam tu niby zobaczyć?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CA8.belarusian: І што я павінен тут убачыць?

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CAE.english: Huh, okay. Thanks, this certainly wasn't a waste of time.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CAE.polish: Hm, okej. Dzięki, to ani trochę nie była strata czasu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CAE.belarusian: Гм, добра. Дзякуй, гэта дакладна не было марнаваннем часу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CB5.english: You throw the cup back into the trash bin.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CB5.polish: Wrzucasz kubek z powrotem do śmietnika.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CB5.belarusian: Ты кідаеш кубак назад у сметніцу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CC9.english: If you squint your eyes enough the coffee grounds almost seem to make up two letters: F... and K.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CC9.polish: Jeśli zmrużysz odpowiednio oczy, zmielona kawa wydaje się niemal układać w dwie litery: K... A.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CC9.belarusian: Калі моцна прыжмурыць вочы, здаецца, нібыта кававая гушча ўтварае дзве літары: Ф... і К.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CD0.english: Yeah. Of course. It's certainly not just an example of *paréidolie*, noticing patterns in noise. Worth it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CD0.polish: Tak, oczywiście. To, rzecz jasna, nie jest bynajmniej zwykły przykład *paréidolie*, dostrzegania wzorców w szumie. Warto było.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CD0.belarusian: Ага. Вядома. Гэта ж дакладна не проста прыклад *paréidolie*, распазнавання вобразаў у шуме. Яно таго варта было.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CE5.english: A clue about the person behind all the murders.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CE5.polish: Osoby, która jest odpowiedzialna za te wszystkie morderstwa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CE5.belarusian: Зачэпка наконт таго, хто стаіць за ўсімі забойствамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CFA.english: It's meaningful, I *swear*! You just wait... I've got the case nearly busted wide open.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CFA.polish: To coś znaczy, *przysięgam*! Tylko poczekaj... Już mam prawie rozpracowaną całą tę sprawę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005CFA.belarusian: Гэта нешта значыць, *клянуся*! Вось пачакай... Я ўжо амаль раскрыў усю справу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D04.english: Uh-huh, great. I somehow doubt old coffee is how the police solve investigations.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D04.polish: Ehe, świetnie. Jakoś wątpię, żeby policja prowadziła śledztwa na podstawie starej kawy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D04.belarusian: Ага, цудоўна. Неяк я сумняваюся, што паліцыя раскрывае справы па старой каве.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D0B.english: It *is* a sign! Just like a remote viewer would operate. Signs hidden inside the mundane...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D0B.polish: Ale to *jest* znak! Tak właśnie działają zdalni obserwatorzy. Dostrzegają znaki ukryte wśród niepozornego...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D0B.belarusian: Гэта *сапраўды* знак! Менавіта так працуюць далёказорцы. Знакі, схаваныя ў звыдзёншчыне...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D11.english: You got it, pal. I would *never* make such a thing up.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D11.polish: No właśnie, stary. *W życiu* nie przyszłoby mi do głowy coś takiego zmyślić.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D11.belarusian: Вось менавіта, дружа. Я б такога *ніколі* не прыдумаў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D18.english: If you can't trust your own eyes, who can you trust...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D18.polish: Jeśli nie możesz ufać własnym oczom, to komu...?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D18.belarusian: Калі нельга давяраць уласным вачам, то каму давяраць...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D3A.english: If you can't trust your own eyes, who can you trust? Certainly not Kim. He's so... suspicious.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D3A.polish: Jeśli nie możesz ufać własnym oczom, to komu? Na pewno nie Kimowi. Jest bardzo... podejrzany.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005D3A.belarusian: Калі нельга давяраць уласным вачам, то каму давяраць? Дакладна не Кіму. Ён такі... падазроны.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF38.english: Is that an Insulindian phasmid? It looks like an Insulindian phasmid. Quick -- catch it before it scuttles away!
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF38.polish: Czy to insulindiański straszyk? Tak wygląda. Szybko, złap go, zanim ucieknie!
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF38.belarusian: Гэта што, Інсуліндыйскі Фазмід? Падобна на Інсуліндыйскага Фазміда. Хутчэй — лаві яго, пакуль не ўцёк!

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF44.english: Creep up to the phasmid quietly.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF44.polish: Podkradnij się do straszyka po cichu.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF4A.english: Wait a moment. Is that really the phasmid? You don't want to make a fool out of yourself.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF4A.polish: Ale chwila, czy to naprawdę ten straszyk? Wolałbyś nie zrobić z siebie durnia.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF4A.belarusian: Пачакай хвілінку. Гэта сапраўды фазмід? Ты ж не хочаш выставіць сябе дурнем.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF50.english: Beautiful leap! But this isn't a phasmid in your hand -- it is a fishing rod.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF50.polish: Przepiękny skok! Ale to, co trzymasz w ręce, nie jest straszykiem. To wędka.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF50.belarusian: Прыгожы скачок! Але ў тваёй руцэ не фазмід — гэта вуда.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF57.english: You're a master of stealth. But look what you've caught -- not a phasmid, but a fishing rod!
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF57.polish: Jesteś mistrzem skradania się. Ale popatrz tylko, co złapałeś – to nie straszyk, a wędka!
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF57.belarusian: Ты майстар схаванасці. Але паглядзі, што ты схапіў, — не фазміда, а вуду!

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF5E.english: Definitely not a phasmid. Definitely a fishing rod.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF5E.polish: To zdecydowanie nie straszyk, a po prostu wędka.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF65.english: "What are you trying to accomplish, Harry?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF6C.belarusian: "Э-э, гэта такі наватарскі спосаб рыбнай лоўлі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF73.english: "Sorry, I thought the fishing rod was... something else."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF73.polish: „Przepraszam, myślałem, że ta wędka to... coś innego”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF73.belarusian: "Прабачце, я падумаў, што гэтая вуда... нешта іншае".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF7A.english: "I was just trying to surprise you. To throw you off, you know."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF7A.polish: „Próbowałem cię zaskoczyć. No wiesz, zbić z tropu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF7A.belarusian: "Я проста спрабаваў вас здзівіць. Збіць з панталыку, ведаеце".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF81.english: "Perhaps we should try it out in the wild sometime."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF81.polish: „Może powinniśmy się kiedyś wybrać na łono natury”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF81.belarusian: "Можа, неяк варта выпрабаваць яго на прыродзе".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF88.english: His great belly ripples with laughter. "A skinny, shy young girl? Never mind."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF88.polish: Jego imponujący brzuch faluje pod wpływem śmiechu. „Nieśmiałym szczupłym dziewczęciem? A nie, nic”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF88.belarusian: Ягоны вялікі жывот калышацца ад смеху. "Хударлявай сарамлівай дзяўчынкай? Ды не, нічога".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF8F.english: "Well, you certainly succeeded, Harry." He adjust himself in the chair. "You are a very surprising police officer indeed."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF8F.polish: „Winszuję, udało ci się” – poprawia się w fotelu. „Taki już zaskakujący z ciebie milicjant”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF8F.belarusian: "Што ж, табе дакладна гэта ўдалося, Гары". Ён папраўляецца ў крэсле. "Ты і праўда вельмі нечаканы афіцэр паліцыі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF99.english: "I see you're admiring my fishing gear. Are you by any chance a fisherman yourself?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF99.polish: „Widzę, że podziwiasz mój sprzęt wędkarski. A może przypadkiem sam wędkujesz?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AF99.belarusian: "Бачу, ты любуешся маімі рыбалоўнымі снасцямі. Ты выпадкова сам не рыбак?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFA0.english: "Fisherman? Totally. It's all I do for fun."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFA0.polish: „Czy wędkuję? Wiadomo. To moja ulubiona rozrywka”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFA0.belarusian: "Рыбак? Яшчэ які. Гэта мая адзіная забава".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFA7.english: "I think maybe I used to be the Fisher King..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFA7.polish: „Tak sobie myślę, że mogłem być kiedyś wędkarskim królem...”

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFAE.english: "Nah, I'm just sizing you up. Studying your strengths and weaknesses."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFAE.polish: „Nie, obserwuję cię tylko. Sprawdzam twoje słabe i mocne strony”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFAE.belarusian: "Не, я проста прыглядаюся да вас. Вывучаю вашыя моцныя і слабыя бакі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFB5.english: "I thought so, Harry, I thought so. We should go out together sometime. Bond like men of worth and value."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFB5.polish: „Tak właśnie myślałem, Harry. Musimy się kiedyś wybrać razem. Dwaj wartościowi ludzie na męskiej wyprawie. To łączy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFB5.belarusian: "Я так і думаў, Гары, я так і думаў. Трэба неяк выбрацца разам. Пасябраваць, як годныя і паважаныя мужчыны".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFC3.english: "I doubt you'll learn anything from that fishing rod."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFC3.belarusian: "Сумняваюся, што ты нешта даведаешся ад гэтай вуды".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFD4.english: You shout at what you thought to be a phasmid, but turns out to be a fishing rod.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFD4.polish: Krzyczysz do czegoś, co, jak sądzisz, jest straszykiem. Okazuje się jednak, że to tylko wędka.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFD4.belarusian: Ты крычыш на тое, што лічыў фазмідам, але гэта аказваецца звычайнай вудай.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFE3.english: It's gotta be the phasmid this time. Look -- it moved!
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFE3.polish: Tym razem to musi być straszyk. Patrz – poruszył się!
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AFE3.belarusian: Гэтым разам гэта дакладна фазмід. Глядзі — варухнуўся!

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B00C.english: Is that an Insulindian phasmid? It looks like an Insulindian phasmid. Quick -- catch it before it scuttles away!
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B00C.polish: Czy to insulindiański straszyk? Tak wygląda. Szybko, złap go, zanim ucieknie!
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B00C.belarusian: Гэта што, Інсуліндыйскі Фазмід? Выглядае як Інсуліндыйскі Фазмід. Хутка — лаві яго, пакуль не ўцёк!

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B018.english: Creep up to the phasmid quietly.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B018.polish: Podkradnij się do straszyka po cichu.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B01E.english: Wait a moment. Is that really the phasmid? You don't want to make a fool out of yourself.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B01E.polish: Ale chwila, czy to naprawdę ten straszyk? Wolałbyś nie zrobić z siebie durnia.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B01E.belarusian: Пачакай хвілінку. Гэта сапраўды фазмід? Не хочацца выстаўляць сябе дурнем.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B024.english: Beautiful leap! But this isn't a phasmid in your hand -- it is a fishing rod.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B024.polish: Przepiękny skok! Ale to, co trzymasz w ręce, nie jest straszykiem. To wędka.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B024.belarusian: Прыгожы скачок! Але ў тваёй руцэ не фазмід — гэта вуда.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B02A.english: His great belly ripples with laughter. "A skinny, shy young girl? Never mind."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B02A.polish: Jego imponujący brzuch faluje pod wpływem śmiechu. „Nieśmiałym szczupłym dziewczęciem? A nie, nic”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B02A.belarusian: Яго вялізны жывот колышацца ад смеху. "Хударлявай сарамлівай дзяўчынкай? А, не звяртай увагі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B030.english: You're a master of stealth. But look what you've caught -- not a phasmid, but a fishing rod!
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B030.polish: Jesteś mistrzem skradania się. Ale popatrz tylko, co złapałeś – to nie straszyk, a wędka!
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B030.belarusian: Ты майстар схаванасці. Але паглядзі, што ты схапіў — гэта не фазмід, а вуда!

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B036.english: "Perhaps we should try it out in the wild sometime."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B036.polish: „Może powinniśmy się kiedyś wybrać na łono natury”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B036.belarusian: "Магчыма, нам варта неяк выпрабаваць яго на прыродзе".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B03C.english: Definitely not a phasmid. Definitely a fishing rod.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B03C.polish: To zdecydowanie nie straszyk, a po prostu wędka.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B042.english: "I doubt you'll learn anything from that fishing rod."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B042.belarusian: "Сумняваюся, што ты нечаму навучышся ў гэтай вуды".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B048.english: "What are you trying to accomplish, Harry?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B04E.english: "Fisherman? Totally. It's all I do for fun."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B04E.polish: „Czy wędkuję? Wiadomo. To moja ulubiona rozrywka”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B04E.belarusian: "Рыбак? Яшчэ які. Толькі гэтым і забаўляюся."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B054.belarusian: "Э-э, гэта такі наватарскі метад рыбнай лоўлі."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B060.english: "Sorry, I thought the fishing rod was... something else."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B060.polish: „Przepraszam, myślałem, że ta wędka to... coś innego”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B060.belarusian: "Прабачце, я падумаў, што гэтая вуда... нешта іншае."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B066.english: "Well, you certainly succeeded, Harry." He adjust himself in the chair. "You are a very surprising police officer indeed."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B066.polish: „Winszuję, udało ci się” – poprawia się w fotelu. „Taki już zaskakujący z ciebie milicjant”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B066.belarusian: "Што ж, табе гэта пэўна ўдалося, Гары". Ён папраўляецца ў крэсле. "Ты і праўда вельмі непрадказальны афіцэр паліцыі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B06C.english: "I was just trying to surprise you. To throw you off, you know."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B06C.polish: „Próbowałem cię zaskoczyć. No wiesz, zbić z tropu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B06C.belarusian: "Я проста хацеў вас здзівіць. Збіць з панталыку, ведаеце".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B077.english: You shout at what you thought to be a phasmid, but turns out to be a fishing rod.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B077.polish: Krzyczysz do czegoś, co, jak sądzisz, jest straszykiem. Okazuje się jednak, że to tylko wędka.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B077.belarusian: Ты крычыш на тое, што лічыў фазмідам, але гэта аказваецца вудай.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B07D.english: "I thought so, Harry, I thought so. We should go out together sometime. Bond like men of worth and value."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B07D.polish: „Tak właśnie myślałem, Harry. Musimy się kiedyś wybrać razem. Dwaj wartościowi ludzie na męskiej wyprawie. To łączy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B07D.belarusian: "Я так і думаў, Гары, я так і думаў. Нам варта неяк выбрацца разам. Зблізіцца, як паважаныя і вартыя людзі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B083.english: "Nah, I'm just sizing you up. Studying your strengths and weaknesses."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B083.polish: „Nie, obserwuję cię tylko. Sprawdzam twoje słabe i mocne strony”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B083.belarusian: "Не, я проста прыглядаюся да вас. Вывучаю вашыя моцныя і слабыя бакі."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B089.english: It's gotta be the phasmid this time. Look -- it moved!
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B089.polish: Tym razem to musi być straszyk. Patrz – poruszył się!
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B089.belarusian: Гэтым разам гэта дакладна фазмід. Глядзі — ён варухнуўся!

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B08F.english: "I see you're admiring my fishing gear. Are you by any chance a fisherman yourself?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B08F.polish: „Widzę, że podziwiasz mój sprzęt wędkarski. A może przypadkiem sam wędkujesz?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B08F.belarusian: "Бачу, ты любуешся маёй рыбалоўнай снасцю. Ты часам сам не рыбак?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B095.english: "I think maybe I used to be the Fisher King..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B095.polish: „Tak sobie myślę, że mogłem być kiedyś wędkarskim królem...”

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AAD.english: Now *this* place seems promising from an ideological angle...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AAD.polish: No, *to miejsce* wygląda bardzo obiecująco z ideologicznego punktu widzenia...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AAD.belarusian: Вось *гэтае* месца выглядае шматабяцальна з ідэалагічнага пункту гледжання...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AC9.english: An important place. One of the last bastions of the left in Martinaise. Perhaps here you'll find the man who'll help you get organised?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AC9.polish: W ważnym miejscu. Jednym z ostatnich bastionów lewicy w Martinaise. Może to tu znajdziesz kogoś, kto pomoże ci się zorganizować?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AC9.belarusian: У важным месцы. Адным з апошніх аплотаў левых у Марцінэзе. Можа, тут ты знойдзеш чалавека, які дапаможа табе арганізавацца?

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002ADE.english: We're getting crates and pallets calling to mind vast stands of winter pines, a swirl of ancient odours absorbed by heavy carpet fibres, but also a pervasive, treacly *sweetness* that somehow reminds you of kola nuts...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002ADE.polish: Czuję skrzynie i palety przywołujące na myśl rozległe place pełne zimowych sosen, mieszankę bardzo starych aromatów wchłoniętych przez włókna ciężkiego dywanu, ale także wszechobecną, lepką *słodycz* kojarzącą ci się z jakiegoś powodu z orzeszkami kola...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002ADE.belarusian: Адчуваюцца скрыні й паддоны, якія нагадваюць бязмежныя масівы зімовых соснаў, вір даўніх пахаў, увабраных цяжкімі валокнамі дывана, але таксама і ўсёпранікальная цягучая *салодкасць*, якая неяк нагадвае арэхі кола...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AE9.english: ... an office? Something officious? Is that a word? There's a bit of dust in the air that may be triggering your allergies.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AE9.polish: Gabinet? Jakieś miejsce na oficjalności? Mówi się tak? W powietrzu unosi się nieco kurzu, który może przyprawiać cię o uczulenie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AE9.belarusian: ...кабінет? Нешта кабінетнае? Ці ёсць такое слова? У паветры лунае трохі пылу, што можа правакаваць тваю алергію.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AEF.english: Meanwhile, Evrart Claire clatters away on his typewriter, wilfully indifferent to your presence.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AEF.polish: Tymczasem Evrart Claire stuka w swoją maszynę do pisania, rozmyślnie ignorując twoją obecność.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AEF.belarusian: Тым часам Эўрар Клэр стукае на сваёй пісьмовай машынцы, наўмысна ігнаруючы тваю прысутнасць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AF5.english: But you can't just come out and *ask* him. You should make your introduction first. Pay homage. This is a man of *stature*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AF5.polish: Nie możesz jednak tak po prostu wyjść i zadać mu *pytania*. Powinieneś się najpierw przedstawić. Złożyć mu hołd. To *nie byle kto*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002AF5.belarusian: Але ты не можаш проста так выйсці і *спытаць* яго. Спачатку варта прадставіцца. Выказаць павагу. Гэта *важкі* чалавек.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002B03.english: Meanwhile, the man of stature clatters away on his typewriter, wilfully indifferent to your presence.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002B03.polish: Tymczasem mężczyzna słusznej postury stuka w swoją maszynę do pisania, rozmyślnie ignorując twoją obecność.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002B03.belarusian: Тым часам гэты важкі чалавек стукае на сваёй пісьмовай машынцы, наўмысна ігнаруючы тваю прысутнасць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002B53.english: Yes, *of course*. Now we're on the right track...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002B53.belarusian: Так, *вядома ж*. Цяпер мы на правільным шляху...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002B77.english: The lieutenant gives you a sharp sideways look.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002B77.polish: Porucznik rzuca ci z ukosa ostre spojrzenie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002B77.belarusian: Лейтэнант скоса кідае на цябе востры позірк.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002B7C.english: "Well? Smelling much *communism* around the Union boss's office?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002B7C.polish: „No i co? Bardzo pachnie *komunizmem* w gabinecie przewodniczącego Związku?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002B7C.belarusian: "Ну што? Моцна пахне *камунізмам* у кабінеце боса Прафсаюза?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002D0F.english: Meanwhile, the man behind the desk clatters away on his typewriter, wilfully indifferent to your presence.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002D0F.polish: Tymczasem mężczyzna za biurkiem stuka w swoją maszynę do pisania, rozmyślnie ignorując twoją obecność.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002D0F.belarusian: Тым часам чалавек за сталом стукае на сваёй пісьмовай машынцы, наўмысна ігнаруючы тваю прысутнасць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002D28.english: The whole place could probably use a good deep cleaning, you think.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002D28.polish: Myślisz sobie, że przydałoby się tu chyba porządnie posprzątać.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002D28.belarusian: Гэтаму месцу, мабыць, не завадзіла б добрая грунтоўная ўборка, думаеш ты.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00029DC1.english: "Why is it written with three T-s?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0002AEC8.english: "Welcome to Frittte! Feel free to look around or something, everything is out on the shelves." She returns to her magazine.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0002AEC8.polish: „Witam we Frittte! Proszę się rozejrzeć czy coś, wszystko jest wystawione na półkach” – wyjaśnia, po czym wraca do czytania swojego magazynu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0002AEC8.belarusian: "Вітаем у Frittte! Можаце агледзецца ці што, усё выстаўлена на паліцах." Яна вяртаецца да свайго часопіса.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0002AED7.english: "You mean this?" She looks at the cover boasting a colourful photo of two girls kissing.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0002AED7.polish: „Chodzi o to?” – pyta, spoglądając na okładkę z kolorowym zdjęciem dwóch całujących się dziewczyn.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0002AED7.belarusian: "Вы пра гэта?" Яна глядзіць на вокладку з яскравым фотаздымкам дзвюх дзяўчат, якія цалуюцца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0002AEF1.english: Looks like it also has something called 'Police De La Mode' featured on page 34. This speaks to you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0002AEF1.polish: Wygląda na to, że na stronie 34 jest artykuł o nazwie „Police De La Mode”. Przemawia to do ciebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0002AEF1.belarusian: Падобна, што на 34-й старонцы таксама ёсць рубрыка пад назвай "Police De La Mode". Гэта знаходзіць водгук у тваёй душы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0002AF05.english: "Forget about all that -- what this is *fashion police* feature?" (Point at the cover.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0002AF05.polish: „Mniejsza o to – co to jest za artykuł o *policji modowej*?” (Wskaż na okładkę).
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0002AF05.belarusian: "Забудзься пра ўсё гэта — што гэта за рубрыка пра *паліцыю моды*?" (Паказаць на вокладку.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00050A94.belarusian: Што гэта за часопіс яна чытае?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086561.english: "Can you tell me anything about the dead body?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086561.belarusian: "Ці можаш ты распавесці што-небудзь пра нябожчыка?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086568.english: "Uhm, I don't really know anything? I mean, I know it's there? But I haven't seen it, so..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086568.polish: „Yyy... Właściwie nic na ten temat nie wiem? Znaczy... Wiem, że tam wisi? Ale nie widziałam go, więc...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086568.belarusian: "Э-эм, я насамрэч нічога не ведаю? У сэнсе, я ведаю, што ён там? Але я яго не бачыла, так што..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086575.english: "Can you tell me anything about this reality we're in?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086575.polish: „Możesz powiedzieć mi cokolwiek o rzeczywistości, w jakiej się znajdujemy?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086575.belarusian: "Ці можаш ты мне распавесці што-небудзь пра гэтую рэчаіснасць, у якой мы знаходзімся?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008657C.english: "Reality? You mean... what reality? Economic reality? Or..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008657C.polish: „O rzeczywistości? Znaczy... jakiej rzeczywistości? Ekonomicznej? Czy może...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008657C.belarusian: "Рэчаіснасць? У сэнсе... якую рэчаіснасць? Эканамічную рэчаіснасць? Ці..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086589.english: "Yes, tell me about the economic reality."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008658F.belarusian: "Не, я меў на ўвазе фізічную рэчаіснасць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086596.english: "I don't really know anything? I mean, I'm fifteen."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086596.polish: „Właściwie to ja nic nie wiem. Znaczy... mam piętnaście lat”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086596.belarusian: "Я насамрэч нічога не ведаю? У сэнсе, мне пятнаццаць гадоў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008659D.english: "Fifteen is an *excellent* time to learn about the economic reality."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008659D.polish: „Piętnaście lat to *doskonały* wiek na naukę o rzeczywistości ekonomicznej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008659D.belarusian: "Пятнаццаць гадоў — *выдатны* час, каб даведацца пра эканамічную рэчаіснасць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000865A3.polish: „A możesz w takim razie powiedzieć mi coś o rzeczywistości fizycznej?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000865AA.english: "Yeah." She looks at the clock on the wall. "That's why I'm working my ass off in Frittte. So I guess, like, that's economic."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000865AA.polish: „Taa...” – odpowiada i zerka na wiszący na ścianie zegar. „Właśnie dlatego haruję we Frittte. Więc to jest, no... ekonomiczne”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000865AA.belarusian: "Ну так." Яна глядзіць на гадзіннік на сцяне. "Вось чаму я гну спіну ў Frittte. Так што, мабыць, гэта і ёсць эканоміка."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000865E7.english: "The Coalition -- what's that? Someone told me there is one."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000865E7.polish: „Koalicja – co to jest? Ktoś mi coś o niej mówił”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000865E7.belarusian: "Кааліцыя — што гэта? Хтосьці казаў мне, што яна існуе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000865F8.english: "I won't bother you with this non-sense anymore."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000865F8.polish: „Nie będę ci już zawracał głowy tymi bzdurami”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000865F8.belarusian: "Я больш не буду даймаць цябе гэтым глупствам."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000865FF.english: "Cool." She seems happy to return to her reading.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000865FF.polish: „Fajnie” – odpowiada i z radością wraca do czytania.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000865FF.belarusian: "Выдатна." Здаецца, яна рада вярнуцца да чытання.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086615.english: "No, I meant -- where *are* we, on a larger scale?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086615.polish: „Nie, mam na myśli... gdzie my jesteśmy, tak na *większą* skalę?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086615.belarusian: "Не, я маю на ўвазе — дзе мы знаходзімся ў больш *шырокім* маштабе?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086622.english: "As mankind or... as a nation or..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086636.english: "I don't know, look at the clock. It's right behind you on the wall."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086636.polish: „Nie wiem, sprawdź na zegarze. Wisi na ścianie za tobą”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086636.belarusian: "Не ведаю, паглядзіце на гадзіннік. Ён проста за вамі на сцяне."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086661.english: "We're in Revachol? Like, on the Insulindian isola?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086661.belarusian: "Мы ў Рэвашолі? Ну, на Інсуліндыйскай ісоле?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008667C.english: "That wasn't very hard." She folds her magazine back.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008667C.polish: „To nie było trudne” – odpowiada i znowu rozkłada swój magazyn.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008667C.belarusian: "Гэта было не надта складана." Яна зноў разгортвае часопіс.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086689.english: "In a good place?"  She rubs her face, thinking.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086689.polish: „W dobrym miejscu?” – odpowiada pytaniem i w zamyśleniu pociera swoją twarz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086689.belarusian: "У нядрэнным становішчы?" Яна трэ твар, разважаючы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086690.english: "Uhm, we're in a.... we're in a..." She rubs her face, thinking.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086690.polish: „Yyy... Jesteśmy w... jesteśmy w...” – w zamyśleniu pociera swoją twarz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086690.belarusian: "Э-эм, мы ў.... мы ў..." Яна трэ твар, разважаючы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008669E.english: "I think science still doesn't know? There's only speculation."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008669E.polish: „Nauka chyba wciąż tego nie wie? Są tylko spekulacje”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008669E.belarusian: "Здаецца, навука дагэтуль не ведае? Ёсць толькі здагадкі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000866CF.english: "Did you know the man who died?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000866F9.english: "Uh-uh." She brushes a strand of hair off her face and tries to return to her magazine.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000866F9.polish: „Aha” – odgarnia kosmyk włosów z twarzy i próbuje wrócić do przeglądania swojego magazynu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000866F9.belarusian: "Угу." Яна прыбірае пасму валасоў з твару і спрабуе вярнуцца да свайго часопіса.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086720.english: "No need to worry." The lieutenant's voice is soothing and professional. "It's just standard procedure for us to ask around. If you hear anything, let us know. Okay?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086720.polish: „Nie ma powodów do obaw” – głos porucznika jest kojący i profesjonalny. „Standardowa procedura wymaga, abyśmy zadawali takie pytania. Jeśli dowie się pani czegoś, proszę dać nam znać. Dobrze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086720.belarusian: "Не хвалюйцеся." Голас лейтэнанта гучыць заспакаяльна і прафесійна. "Гэта проста стандартная працэдура апытання. Калі вы нешта пачуеце, паведаміце нам. Добра?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086739.english: "Not that they would know anything about being high, it's just an expression." The girl adjusts her hat.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086739.polish: „Nie, żeby wiedzieli cokolwiek o haju. To tylko takie powiedzenie” – tłumaczy się, poprawiając swój kapelusz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086739.belarusian: "Не тое каб яны хоць нешта ведалі пра кайф, гэта проста выраз такі." Дзяўчына папраўляе шапку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867A0.english: "Mhmh, right behind you." She nods towards the buzzing machine in the corner.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867A0.polish: „Mhm, stoi za tobą” – odpowiada, wskazując kiwnięciem głowy brzęczące urządzenie w kącie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867A0.belarusian: "Мгм, проста за вамі." Яна ківае ў бок гудучага агрэгата ў кутку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867AD.english: "I need to store a corpse there."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867BB.english: "Uhm..." She keeps chewing on her gum. "You're joking, right?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867BB.belarusian: "Э-эм..." Яна працягвае жаваць гумку. "Вы ж жартуеце, так?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867C2.english: "No, I'm not joking. I need to store the corpse of the hanged man in your fridge."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867C2.polish: „Nie, nie żartuję. Muszę przechować w waszej lodówce ciało wisielca”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867C2.belarusian: "Не, я не жартую. Мне трэба пакласці труп павешанага ў ваш халадзільнік."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867C8.english: (Measure the fridge with your fingers, one eye closed.) "Never mind... It would never fit."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867C8.polish: (Przymknij jedno oko i zmierz lodówkę za pomocą palców). „Nieważne. Nie zmieści się do niej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867C8.belarusian: (Прыжмурыўшы адно вока, вымераць халадзільнік пальцамі.) "Забудзься... Ён усё адно не змесціцца."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867D2.english: "Yes, this was just a joke." (Cough.) "A bad joke."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867D2.polish: „Tak, to był tylko żart”. (Kaszlnij). „W dodatku kiepski”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867D8.english: "Yeah..." She's not really paying attention to you anymore.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867D8.polish: „Taa...” – przestała już zwracać na ciebie uwagę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867D8.belarusian: "Ага..." Яна ўжо не звяртае на цябе асаблівай увагі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867E8.english: She's playing with her hair, engrossed in a magazine.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867E8.polish: Bawi się swoimi włosami, pogrążona w przeglądaniu magazynu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867E8.belarusian: Яна круціць у пальцах пасму валасоў, паглыбіўшыся ў часопіс.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867F5.english: "Uhm, okay..." she looks at the fridge. "It wouldn't even fit you know."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867F5.polish: „Yyy... Okej...” – zerka na lodówkę. „Nie zmieści się tam”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867F5.belarusian: "Э-эм, добра..." Яна глядзіць на халадзільнік. "Ён туды нават не змесціцца, ведаеце."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867FB.english: "Yeah, super funny." She returns to her magazine, seemingly not impressed by the joke.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867FB.polish: „Taa, strasznie śmieszne” – wraca do przeglądania swojego magazynu. Zdaje się, że żart nie zrobił na niej żadnego wrażenia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000867FB.belarusian: "Ага, вельмі смешна." Яна вяртаецца да часопіса — жарт, відаць, яе зусім не ўразіў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008680B.english: "Now that I'm looking at it... maybe a glass-doored fridge in a public grocery store isn't the best option for storing a corpse."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008680B.polish: „Gdy tak na nią teraz patrzę... to lodówka ze szklanymi drzwiami ustawiona w sklepie spożywczym nie jest chyba najlepszym miejscem do przechowywania zwłok”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0008680B.belarusian: "Калі прыгледзецца... мабыць, халадзільнік са шклянымі дзвярыма ў грамадскай краме — не найлепшае месца для захоўвання трупа."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086812.english: Maybe a glass-doored fridge in a public grocery store really isn't the best option for storing a corpse.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086812.polish: Być może lodówka ze szklanymi drzwiami ustawiona w ogólnodostępnym sklepie spożywczym nie jest najlepszym miejscem do przechowywania zwłok.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086812.belarusian: Мабыць, халадзільнік са шклянымі дзвярыма ў грамадскай прадуктовай краме сапраўды не найлепшае месца для захоўвання трупа.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086820.english: "I guess you're right, plus the fridge is too small anyway."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086820.polish: „Chyba masz rację. Zresztą i tak jest za mała”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086820.belarusian: "Мабыць, ты маеш рацыю, дый халадзільнік усё адно замалы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086826.polish: „No dobrze, dziękuję ci, sprzedawczyni z Frittte”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00086832.polish: „Okej...” – odpowiada i wraca do swojego magazynu.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000898B.english: "Does Frittte have a warehouse in the back of the Whirling-in-Rags?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000898B.polish: „Czy Frittte ma magazyn na tyłach Whirling-in-Rags?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000898B.belarusian: "Ці ёсць у Frittte склад з тыльнага боку Whirling-in-Rags?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000899C.english: "A warehouse? I don't know. Maybe. I don't really care what Frittte does."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000899C.polish: „Magazyn? Nie wiem. Może. Naprawdę mało mnie obchodzi, co robi Frittte”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000899C.belarusian: "Склад? Не ведаю. Можа быць. Мне наогул усё роўна, што робіць Frittte."

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000089A3.english: "Come on, give me something to work with here."

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000089B1.english: She looks up from under her brow.

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000089B8.english: She scrunches up her face into an expression of consummate adolescent scepticism.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000089B8.polish: Jej twarz wykrzywia wyraz młodzieńczego sceptycyzmu.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000089B8.belarusian: Яе твар скрыўляецца ў грымасе непадробнага падлеткавага скептыцызму.

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000089BF.english: "Fine -- Frittte doesn't have a warehouse. Just a little back room here. M'kay?" She turns back to her magazine without waiting for you to respond.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000089BF.polish: „No dobra – Frittte nie ma magazynu. Tylko mały pokój na zapleczu. Okej?” – wraca do przeglądania swojego czasopisma, nie czekając nawet na twoją odpowiedź.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000089BF.belarusian: "Добра — няма ў Frittte ніякага склада. Толькі невялічкая падсобка тут. Ясна?" Яна вяртаецца да свайго часопіса, не чакаючы твайго адказу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700022CFB.english: "Uhm, it's where they rate different outfits famous people wear? It's kinda funny. They're kinda mean." She stops to think. "It's about who's the most stylish."
