Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000910D.english: "Nah... I'm just a sorry sack of a man, a positively shitty cop."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000910D.polish: „Nie. Jestem po prostu żałosnym ludzkim workiem i gównianym policjantem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000910D.belarusian: "Не... я проста жаласнае нікчэмнае стварэнне, абсалютна хрэнавы паліцыянт".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009114.english: "Maybe I am? Never thought of that."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009114.polish: „Może i tak? Nigdy się nad tym nie zastanawiałem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009114.belarusian: "Можа, і так? Ніколі пра гэта не думаў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000911C.english: "Ha... live and learn, lawman. Get out there and blossom into a flower! Go figure things out! Meanwhile, I'm getting bored... how about we change the subject?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000911C.polish: „Ha... Żyj i ucz się. Rusz w świat i rozkwitnij! Dowiedz się więcej o życiu! Tymczasem ja zaczynam się nudzić... Może zmienimy temat?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000911C.belarusian: "Ха... век жыві — век вучыся, ахоўнік закону. Ідзі ў свет і расцвітай, як кветачка! Разбярыся ў сабе! А пакуль мне робіцца нудна... як наконт змяніць тэму?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009131.english: "From your perspective... I'm a Mysterious Pair of Eyes, boo!!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009131.polish: „Z twojej perspektywy... Jestem tajemniczą parą oczu! Buu!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009131.belarusian: "З твайго пункту гледжання... я Таямнічная Пара Вачэй, бу-у!!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009140.english: "Know what? Fine... no point in getting riled up by some clown trying to be abusive."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009140.polish: „Wiesz co? Dobra tam. Nie ma sensu irytować się jakimś przygłupem, który próbuje być dupkiem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009140.belarusian: "Ведаеш што? Добра... няма сэнсу заводзіцца праз нейкага блазна, які спрабуе хаміць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009148.english: "Ha ha. Okay, you've got me *cornered* there, good sir officer. Anyway, this is really boring... change the subject, why don't we?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009148.polish: „Ha, ha! Dobra, przycisnąłeś mnie *do ściany*, panie policjancie. Strasznie to nudne... Może zmienimy temat?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009148.belarusian: "Ха-ха. Добра, ты прыціснуў мяне *да сцяны*, пане афіцэру. Карацей, гэта ўжо вельмі нудна... мо зменім тэму?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009161.english: "I don't know if that's completely accurate..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009161.polish: „Nie wiem, czy to tak do końca trafne...”

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009167.english: "Exactly. That's what being a police officer is all about."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009167.polish: „Dokładnie. O to właśnie chodzi w byciu policjantem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009167.belarusian: "Менавіта. У гэтым і ёсць сутнасць паліцэйскай службы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000917E.english: "Good joke, man." (Do a slow sarcastic clap.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000917E.belarusian: "Добры жарт, чалавеча". (Павольна, саркастычна папляскаць у ладкі.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000918D.english: "Ha ha. It was funny enough to me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000918D.polish: „Ha, ha! Dla mnie to było wystarczająco zabawne”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009194.english: "Good use of sarcasm there, man." You hear a faint clapping sound, brimming with caricature.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009194.polish: „Dobre użycie sarkazmu, stary” – słyszysz cichy odgłos oklasków przepełniony szyderstwem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009194.belarusian: "Добра скарыстаны сарказм, чалавеча", - ты чуеш слабыя воплескі ладак, поўныя здзеку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000919B.english: "None of your business. Ooh, so spoo-ooky!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000919B.polish: „Nie twój interes. Uuu! Jaki jestem straszny!”

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091A7.english: "The gate is broken as shit. Someone absolutely destroyed the access panel in the control tower above."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091A7.polish: „Brama jest całkiem zepsuta. Ktoś totalnie zniszczył panel dostępowy w wieży kontrolnej powyżej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091A7.belarusian: "Вароты зламаныя ў хлам. Нехта ўшчэнт раскурочыў панэль доступу на дыспетчарскай вежы наверсе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091B8.english: "Probably a docker, aiming to block these loud-ass scab fucks from getting in. The guys get panicky sometimes..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091B8.polish: „Pewnie jakiś robotnik portowy, który chciał powstrzymać tych wrzeszczących, zjebanych łamistrajków przed dostaniem się do środka. Chłopaki czasem panikują...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091B8.belarusian: "Відаць, якісьці докер, каб не пусціць гэтых гарлапаністых штрэйкбрэхерскіх ёлупаў. Хлопцы часам панікуюць..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091C6.english: "Most likely, Mr. *Amazing Investigator*. Aren't you a sharp-ass pencil! Maybe someone should write a novel about you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091C6.polish: „Najprawdopodobniej, panie *Niesamowity Śledczy*. Intelekt ostry jak brzytwa! Ktoś powinien chyba napisać o tobie książkę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091C6.belarusian: "Хутчэй за ўсё, спадар *Дзівосны Следчы*. Ну і востры ж у цябе розум! Можа, камусьці варта напісаць пра цябе раман".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091E7.english: "Of course! Amazing! If a little girl says so, it absolutely should happen!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091E7.polish: „Oczywiście! Wspaniale! Skoro mała dziewczynka tak mówi, to absolutnie trzeba dopilnować, żeby tak się stało!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091E7.belarusian: "Вядома ж! Цудоўна! Калі маленькая дзяўчынка так кажа, дык гэта абавязкова павінна адбыцца!"

Alternate1/0x0100002F000091F5.polish: „Tak! Dokładnie to mówiła dziewczynka z księgarni”.
Alternate1/0x0100002F000091F5.belarusian: "Так! Менавіта тое, што раней казала малая дзяўчынка з кнігарні".

Alternate2/0x0100002F000091F5.polish: „Tak! Dokładnie to mówiła młoda Annette z księgarni”.
Alternate2/0x0100002F000091F5.belarusian: "Так! Менавіта тое, што казала юная Анэта раней".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091FD.english: "Step right up, folks! Read all about the Incredible Adventures of Flop the Wonder-Cop! Able to solve the *most dastardly* of plots and ploys. Ha ha ha."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091FD.polish: „Zapraszamy, ludzie! Czytajcie o niesamowitych przygodach gliny cud, co robi ciągle smród! Rozpracowuje *najgorsze spiski*, choć standard ma raczej niski. Ha, ha, ha!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000091FD.belarusian: "Падыходзьце, шаноўныя! Чытайце ўсё пра Неверагодныя прыгоды Флёпа, Дзіва-Копа! Здольнага раскрываць *найбольш падступныя* змовы і інтрыгі. Ха-ха-ха".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000920D.english: "Whatever, it's not really my thing anyway."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000920D.polish: „Nie ma takiej potrzeby, to i tak nie w moim stylu”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009214.english: "Oh no, certainly not! Who would ever dare such a thing."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009214.polish: „O nie! Wykluczone! Kto by się ośmielił na coś takiego!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009214.belarusian: "О не, ні ў якім разе! Хто б наогул пасмеў такое зрабіць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009222.english: "Not a learned type? Sure is a shocker!" The eyes gleam brightly in the darkness of the void.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009222.polish: „Nie jesteś wykształciuchem, co? A to ci niespodzianka!” – oczy połyskują jasno w mroku pustki.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009222.belarusian: "Не з навукоўцаў? Ну і сюрпрыз!" — вочы ярка блішчаць у цемры нябыту.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009235.english: "I'm a cop, it sure is my business!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009235.polish: „Jestem gliną, oczywiście, że to mój interes!”

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000924F.english: "Indeed... oh yes. We know who you are, we do! Don't you worry about that."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000924F.polish: „W rzeczy samej... O tak. Wiemy, kim jesteś, o tak! Możesz być o to spokojny”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000924F.belarusian: "Сапраўды... о так. Мы ведаем, хто ты, яшчэ як ведаем! Пра гэта можаш не хвалявацца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009259.english: "Looking. Peeking. Gazing. Staring. Watching. Ogling. Gawking."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009259.polish: „Patrzymy. Zaglądamy. Wypatrujemy. Obserwujemy. Łypiemy. Oglądamy. Spozieramy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009259.belarusian: "Глядзім. Зазіраем. Углядаемся. Вылупліваемся. Сочым. Паглядаем. Зырым".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009267.english: "Okay, who or what are you looking at?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009267.polish: „No dobra, na kogo albo na co patrzysz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009267.belarusian: "Добра, на каго ці на што ты глядзіш?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000926D.english: "Nice going, Detective Thesaurus! You do know a few words, ha ha ha! Yeah, *spying* as well."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000926D.polish: „Dobra robota, Detektywie Tezaurus! Znasz kilka słów! Ha, ha, ha! Taa, *szpiegujemy* także”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000926D.belarusian: "Малайчына, дэтэктыў Тэзаўрус! Ведаеш пару слоўцаў, ха-ха-ха! Ага, *шпіёнім* таксама".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009284.english: "Just look at the guy, come on."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009284.belarusian: "Ды ты проста зірні на яго, кінь".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000928B.english: There's something twitching in the back of your mind... a connection hidden between the numbly aching folds of your brain.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000928B.polish: Coś dygocze w głębi twojego umysłu. Jakieś powiązanie ukryte wśród boleśnie odrętwiałych zakamarków mózgu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000928B.belarusian: Нешта тузаецца ў глыбіні твайго розуму... сувязь, схаваная між здранцвела ныхлівых зморшчын тваіх мазгоў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009293.english: "Honest, my ass. Just look at the guy, geez!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009293.polish: „Uczciwych... Takiego wała. Rety, wystarczy spojrzeć na tego faceta!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009293.belarusian: "Сумленных, ага, чорта з два. Ты проста зірні на яго, блін!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092B0.english: "Look at you, Super-Constable on his way to solve a suspicious case! Seems like that's going to take a long fucking while, ha ha."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092B0.polish: „Spójrz tylko na siebie – Superposterunkowy w drodze do rozwiązania podejrzanej sprawy! Zdaje się, że potrwa to cholernie długo... Ha, ha!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092B0.belarusian: "Паглядзіце на яго, Суперканстэбль на шляху да раскрыцця падазронай справы! Здаецца, на гэта пойдзе да хера часу, ха-ха".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092BE.english: "No, I meant... don't scare people like that."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092BE.polish: „Nie, mam na myśli... Nie strasz tak ludzi”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092BE.belarusian: "Не, я пра тое... не палохай так людзей".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092CC.english: "We are the eyes, we cannot be closed... if one pair shuts, another takes its place, ha ha!" The eyes grow wide and ominous.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092CC.polish: „Jesteśmy oczami, nie możemy się zamknąć... Gdy jedna para się zamyka, na jej miejscu pojawia się kolejna. Ha, ha!” – oczy stają się wielkie i złowieszcze.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092CC.belarusian: "Мы — вочы, нас нельга заплюшчыць... калі адна пара заплюшчваецца, яе месца займае іншая, ха-ха!" — вочы пашыраюцца і выглядаюць злавесна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092D4.english: The mysterious pair of eyes attentively follow your every move.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092D4.polish: Tajemnicza para oczu bacznie śledzi każdy twój ruch.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092D4.belarusian: Таямнічая пара вачэй уважліва сочыць за кожным тваім рухам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092ED.english: The eerie pair of blue eyes is still here, gazing out from the dark void between the gates.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092ED.polish: Upiorna para niebieskich oczu wciąż tu jest i przygląda się ci z mrocznej pustki między skrzydłami bramy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092ED.belarusian: Вусцішная пара сініх вачэй усё яшчэ тут — глядзіць з цёмнага нябыту між варотамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092F4.english: "Boo! The eyes of Martinaise are upon you, piggy!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092F4.belarusian: "Бу! Вочы Марцінэза сочаць за табой, парсючок!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092FC.english: "You're the one sticking your nose where it doesn't belong, coppola." The eyes blink at you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092FC.polish: „To ty wtykasz nos w nie swoje sprawy, coppola” – oczy mrugają w twoim kierunku.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000092FC.belarusian: "Гэта ты суеш свой нос куды не трэба, легавы", - вочы міргаюць у твой бок.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009313.english: You know very well she did not talk about how someone should write a book about you. *You* are the one who brought the topic up.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009313.polish: Bardzo dobrze wiesz, że nie twierdziła, jakoby ktoś powinien napisać o tobie książkę. To *ty* poruszyłeś taki temat.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009313.belarusian: Ты выдатна ведаеш, што яна не казала нічога пра тое, што пра цябе трэба напісаць кнігу. Гэта *ты* сам падняў гэтую тэму.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000932B.english: "Fine, if you won't take this seriously, I'm going to ask about something else."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000932B.polish: „Dobra, skoro nie chcesz potraktować sprawy poważnie, to spytam cię o coś innego”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000932B.belarusian: "Добра, калі ты не хочаш успрымаць гэта сур'ёзна, я спытаю пра іншае".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009332.english: "Try not to hurt yourself, old man, ha ha." The pair of eyes beams impishly at you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009332.polish: „Postaraj się nie zrobić sobie krzywdy, staruszku! Ha, ha!” – para oczu wpatruje się w ciebie szelmowsko.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009332.belarusian: "Глядзі не пакалечся, дзядок, ха-ха", - пара вачэй гарэзліва паблісквае на цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009355.english: "Go think-man, go. Find some clues, put two and two together. That's how the magic happens, ha ha."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009355.polish: „Dalej, dalej mózgu myśliciela! Znajdź kilka wskazówek, dodaj do siebie fakty. Tak właśnie działa magia! Ha, ha!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009355.belarusian: "Ідзі, мысліцель, ідзі. Знайдзі зачэпкі, складзі два плюс два. Вось як творыцца магія, ха-ха".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000936B.english: "You know what you've done, don't start denying it now."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000936B.polish: „Wiesz, co zrobiłeś – nie próbuj temu teraz zaprzeczać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000936B.belarusian: "Ты ведаеш, што зрабіў, не пачынай цяпер адмаўляць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009387.english: "Look at you, little authoritarian. Bet it also makes you feel good and strong to discriminate against any disenfranchised people that get in your way. Makes you feel all *manly*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009387.polish: „Spójrz tylko na siebie, mój ty mały despoto. Założę się, że dyskryminowanie pozbawionych praw ludzi, którzy staną ci na drodze, sprawia, że poprawia ci się nastrój, i daje ci poczucie siły. Czujesz się dzięki temu taki *męski*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009387.belarusian: "Паглядзіце на яго, маленькі аўтарытарый. Біцца аб заклад, табе так прыемна і магутна дыскрымінаваць бяспраўных людзей, што трапляюцца на тваім шляху. Адчуваеш сябе такім *мужным*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000938E.english: "I sincerely doubt it. You're supposed to help people and handle actual crime. Not walk around like an oppressive tyrant, passing punishments however you feel."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000938E.polish: „Szczerze w to wątpię. Masz pomagać ludziom w rozwiązaniu sprawy prawdziwego przestępstwa. A nie bawić się w ciemiężącego tyrana, który każde wszystkich, jak mu się podoba”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000938E.belarusian: "Я вельмі сумняюся. Ты мусіш дапамагаць людзям і разбірацца з сапраўднай злачыннасцю. А не хадзіць тут дэспатычным тыранам, раздаючы пакаранні, як табе заманецца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000939C.english: "It's easy and comfortable to side with the ignorant, the arrogant, the condescending, isn't it? Hide away in the soft, secure existence of perceived superiority, a vapid fantasy of your mind."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000939C.polish: „Łatwo i wygodnie stanąć po stronie ignorantów, arogantów i wywyższających się, prawda? Ukryć się w miękkiej, bezpiecznej egzystencji postrzeganej wyższości, banalnej fantazji umysłu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000939C.belarusian: "Лёгка і зручна быць на баку невукаў, нахабнікаў, зверхнікаў, так? Хавацца ў мяккім, бяспечным існаванні ўяўнай перавагі — бязглуздай фантазіі твайго розуму".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093A3.english: "Well, we know what you're up to. We observe your every move. Take care and watch your back." The eyes suddenly disappear from sight, only emptiness remains, floating in the lacuna between the gates.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093A3.polish: „Wiemy, co zamierzasz. Obserwujemy każdy twój ruch. Bądź ostrożny i uważaj na siebie” – oczy nagle znikają z twojego pola widzenia i pozostaje tylko pustka unosząca się w luce między skrzydłami bramy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093A3.belarusian: "Што ж, мы ведаем, што ты задумаў. Мы сочым за кожным тваім рухам. Сцеражыся і азірайся", - вочы раптам знікаюць з віду, застаецца толькі пустэча, што плавае ў шчыліне між варотамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093B4.english: In the shadowy depths of the gap between the gates... there is nothing. Not even a single pair of blue eyes, vigilantly observing your every move. Whoever it was, he is gone.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093B4.polish: Mroczna otchłań szczeliny między skrzydłami bramy... jest pusta. Nie ma w niej nic, nawet jednej pary niebieskich oczu, bacznie obserwujących każdy twój ruch. Kimkolwiek był ten człowiek, już go tu nie ma.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093B4.belarusian: У змрочнай глыбіні шчыліны між варотамі... нічога няма. Нават адзінокай пары сініх вачэй, якія пільна сочаць за кожным тваім рухам. Кім бы ён ні быў, яго ўжо няма.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093BF.english: "Oh. I don't do that... I think. As far as I remember."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093BF.polish: „O, ja tak nie robię... Chyba. O ile pamiętam”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093BF.belarusian: "Ой. Я так не раблю... здаецца. Наколькі я памятаю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093CD.english: "Isn't that what the judicial system is all about? The rules of law are developed and set for a reason. Well, this turned boring quickly... it's time to change the subject."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093CD.polish: „Czy nie od tego właśnie jest system sądowniczy? Zasady prawa opracowano i wdrożono nie bez przyczyny. Ale zaczyna mnie to nudzić... Pora na zmianę tematu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093CD.belarusian: "Хіба судовая сістэма не для гэтага? Прававыя нормы ствараюцца і ўводзяцца не проста так. Ну, гэта хутка стала нудным... пара змяніць тэму".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093D4.english: "Aren't we the lucky ones then? But I'm getting *real* bored with this... maybe it's time to change the subject."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093D4.polish: „W takim razie dopisało nam szczęście, prawda? Zaczyna mnie to *naprawdę* nudzić... Chyba pora na zmianę tematu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093D4.belarusian: "Ці ж не пашанцавала нам тады? Але мне гэта *зусім* надакучыла... можа, час змяніць тэму".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093E1.english: "Rotten luck. I guess I'll find another way."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093E1.polish: „Pech. No to muszę znaleźć inny sposób”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093E1.belarusian: "Не пашанцавала. Што ж, знайду іншы шлях".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093E8.english: "Yeah? I got a suggestion, you should go try knock the guard above us out. Ha ha, that would be fuckin' priceless."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093E8.polish: „Tak? Proponuję, abyś spróbował znokautować strażnika, który pilnuje przejścia nad nami. Ha, ha! To by było widowisko!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093E8.belarusian: "Так? Маю прапанову: схадзі паспрабуй вырубіць ахоўніка над намі. Ха-ха, гэта было б проста бясцэнна".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093F4.english: "I don't actually remember much of what I've done."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093F4.polish: „Szczerze mówiąc, to nie pamiętam za dużo z tego, co robiłem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000093F4.belarusian: "Я насамрэч мала што памятаю з таго, што нарабіў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009402.english: "A rallying cry for coppers everywhere! *We haven't done anything, we are never of any use*, ha ha."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009402.polish: „Okrzyk bojowy każdego gliniarza na świecie! *Niczego nie zrobiliśmy, nie ma z nas żadnego pożytku*! Ha, ha!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009402.belarusian: "Баявы кліч легавых па ўсім свеце! *Мы нічога не зрабілі, ад нас ніякай карысці*, ха-ха".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009409.english: "A serious bout of denial? Or perhaps the result of the incessant stream of alcohol you've been pouring down your throat?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009409.polish: „Ostry przypadek wyparcia? A może to wpływ niekończącego się strumienia alkoholu, który lałeś sobie do gardła?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009409.belarusian: "Цяжкі прыступ адмаўлення? Ці, можа, вынік бясконцай плыні алкаголю, якую ты заліваў сабе ў горла?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009416.english: "It's the booze, definitely. For certain. No doubt."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009416.polish: „To zdecydowanie przez picie. Na pewno. Bez wątpienia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009416.belarusian: "Гэта праз бырла, дакладна. Напэўна. Без сумненняў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009425.english: "O-ho! I wonder what *harrowing mystery* lies behind this feat of self-destruction."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009425.polish: „Oho! Ciekawe, jaka *przerażająca tajemnica* kryje się za tą próba samozniszczenia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009425.belarusian: "О-хо! Цікава, якая *жахлівая таямніца* хаваецца за гэтым подзвігам самазнішчэння".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000942B.english: "An intriguing mystery! I wonder what *terrible secrets* lie behind this dark and ominous veil, ha ha."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000942B.polish: „Intrygująca tajemnica! Ciekawe, jakie *straszliwe sekrety* kryją się za tym mrocznym i złowieszczym woalem... Ha, ha!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000942B.belarusian: "Інтрыгоўная таямніца! Цікава, якія *жахлівыя сакрэты* хаваюцца за гэтай цёмнай і злавеснай заслонай, ха-ха".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009431.english: "Your life sounds like an immeasurable clusterfuck. Something's gone *really wrong*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009431.polish: „Twoje życie brzmi jak niewiarygodnie wielkie spierdolenie. Coś w nim poszło *naprawdę źle*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009431.belarusian: "Тваё жыццё гучыць як бяздонны піздзец. Нешта пайшло *вельмі не так*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000943A.english: "I don't actually want to talk about my personal life with a stupid voice behind a wall."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000943A.polish: „Nie chcę za bardzo rozmawiać o swoim życiu osobistym z głupim głosem zza ściany”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000943A.belarusian: "Я насамрэч не хачу абмяркоўваць сваё асабістае жыццё з дурным голасам з-за сцяны".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000944C.english: "A good thing, too! I am not one of your fatuous Königstein neurosis analyst fucks, cashing in on the anxieties of nice ordinary folk. So, what now, Mr. Sensational Sleuth, sir?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000944C.polish: „I bardzo dobrze! Nie jestem jednym z tych waszych głupkowatych speców od nerwic z Königsteinu, trzepiących kasę na niepokojach zwykłych miłych ludzi. Więc co teraz, panie Sensacyjny Szpiclu?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000944C.belarusian: "І добра! Я не адзін з тых прыдуркаватых кёнігштайнскіх аналітыкаў неўрозаў, што нажываюцца на трывогах добрых простых людзей. Ну дык што цяпер, пане Сенсацыйны Шпік?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009452.english: "Mm, the delights of existence. A constant anguish and concern over horrible things you don't even know about, but can *imagine* so vividly. Ha ha."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009452.polish: „Mmm... Rozkosze istnienia. Nieustanna udręka i strach przed okropnymi rzeczami, o których nie ma się żadnego pojęcia, ale które potrafimy *wyobrazić* sobie tak szczegółowo. Ha, ha!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009452.belarusian: "М-м, асалода існавання. Пастаянная пакута і трывога праз жудасныя рэчы, пра якія ты нават паняцця не маеш, але здольны так ярка *ўявіць*. Ха-ха".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009466.english: "Oh whatever, I'm not going to give you the satisfaction."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009466.polish: „A dobra tam, nie zamierzam dać ci satysfakcji”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009466.belarusian: "Ай, няважна, не збіраюся рабіць табе такую ласку".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000946E.english: "Aw, shucks! And here I was, getting ever so hopeful. Does the ardent cop-man want to ask *more questions* then?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000946E.polish: „A niech to! A taką miał człowiek nadzieję. Czy w takim razie żarliwy glina chce zadać *kolejne pytania*?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000946E.belarusian: "Ах, чорт! А я ўжо так спадзяваўся. Дык ці хоча заўзяты коп задаць *яшчэ пытанні*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000947A.english: "Nothing, sir, oh nothing at all! Please don't arrest me, I'm just a poor, honest man, trying not to make a mistake. Ha ha!" The sarcastic laughter effortlessly makes it's way through the thick gates. There's no stopping it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000947A.polish: „Nic, proszę pana – nic a nic! Proszę mnie nie aresztować! Jestem tylko biednym, uczciwym człowiekiem, który próbuje nie popełniać błędów. Ha, ha!” – sarkastyczny śmiech bez trudu przenika przez grubą bramę. Nic nie może go powstrzymać.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000947A.belarusian: "Нічога, пане, зусім нічога! Калі ласка, не арыштоўвайце мяне, я проста бедны, сумленны чалавек, які спрабуе не схібіць. Ха-ха!" — саркастычны смех лёгка прабіваецца скрозь тоўстыя вароты. Яго не спыніць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009480.english: "Until doom comes and liberates us from all our woes."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009480.polish: „Dopóki nie nadejdzie zagłada i nie uwolni nas od wszystkich naszych cierpień”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009480.belarusian: "Пакуль не прыйдзе пагібель і не вызваліць нас ад усіх нашых бедаў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000948C.english: "Okay, enough already, this is making me feel even worse."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000948C.polish: „Dobra, dosyć już, czuję się od tego jeszcze gorzej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000948C.belarusian: "Добра, годзе ўжо, ад гэтага мне толькі горш".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009493.english: "You've really fallen off the rocker, haven't you? This is getting boring, it's time to change the subject."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009493.polish: „Naprawdę całkiem ci odbiło, co? To zaczyna się robić nudne. Pora zmienić temat”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009493.belarusian: "У цябе рэальна дах паехаў, ці не так? Гэта робіцца нудным, час змяніць тэму".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000949C.english: "Good plan, I was kinda getting bored of this topic already. What's next on the menu, Inspector Repression?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000949C.polish: „Dobry plan, ten temat zaczynał mnie już trochę nudzić. Co następne w menu, Inspektorze Wyparcie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000949C.belarusian: "Добры план, гэтая тэма мне ўжо трохі надакучыла. Што наступнае ў меню, Інспектар Выцясненне?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094A5.english: "There's no way you could *fit* inside all those nooks and gaps."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094A5.polish: „Nie ma mowy, żebyś *zmieścił* się w tych wszystkich zakamarkach i szczelinach”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094A5.belarusian: "Ніяк вы не маглі б *змясціцца* ва ўсіх тых кутках і шчылінах".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094BB.english: "We saw you kick the mailbox. That's kind of a jerk thing to do, you know."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094BB.polish: „Widzieliśmy, jak kopiesz skrzynkę pocztową. To głupie zachowanie, wiesz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094BB.belarusian: "Мы бачылі, як ты пнуў паштовую скрыню. Гэта неяк па-казлінаму, ведаеш".

Alternate1/0x0100002F000094BB.polish: „Widzieliśmy, jak kopiesz skrzynkę pocztową i lornetkę na monety. Jesteś jakimś maniakiem mającym problemy z gniewem?”
Alternate1/0x0100002F000094BB.belarusian: "Мы бачылі, як ты пнуў паштовую скрыню і манетны бінокль. Ты якісьці маньяк з праблемамі кантролю гневу?"

Alternate2/0x0100002F000094BB.polish: „Widzieliśmy, jak kopiesz lornetkę na monety. Bogata historia przemocy wobec przedmiotów nieożywionych, co?”
Alternate2/0x0100002F000094BB.belarusian: "Мы бачылі, як ты пнуў манетны бінокль. Цягне да гвалту над неадушаўлёнымі прадметамі, га?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094CD.english: "We've had our eye on you for some time now. And I can tell you straight... goddamn, you're one *boring fuckin' cop*!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094CD.polish: „Mieliśmy cię na oku od jakiegoś już czasu. I mogę powiedzieć ci jedno... Cholera jasna, *kurewsko nudny z ciebie glina*!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094CD.belarusian: "Мы сочым за табой ужо пэўны час. І я магу сказаць табе наўпрост... чорт пабяры, ты *піздзец які нудны коп*!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094D3.english: "Yeah, you piss off, you self-righteous, lecturing ass-goblin!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094D3.polish: „Taa, spieprzaj, zadufany w sobie, przemądrzały goblinie wyjęty z dupy!”

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094D8.english: "Hey, come back! Where are you going?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094DD.english: There is no reply. Only silence lurks in the cavernous depths of the darkness beyond.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094DD.polish: Brak odpowiedzi. Tylko cisza czająca się w przepastnych głębiach ciemności za bramą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094DD.belarusian: Ніякага адказу. Толькі цішыня тоіцца ў пячорных глыбінях цемры за варотамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094EC.english: "Try not to get too cocky, you might get that eye poked out."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094EC.polish: „Lepiej za mocno nie fikaj, bo ktoś ci może to oko wydłubać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094EC.belarusian: "Глядзі не задавайся занадта, а то могуць і вока выбіць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094F4.english: "Umm, what? That's not... *literal* -- there are not people actually stuffed into various tiny holes. You get that, right?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094F4.polish: „Eee... Co? Nie mówiłem... *dosłownie* – w tych wszystkich małych otworach nie ma poupychanych ludzi. Chyba to łapiesz, tak?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000094F4.belarusian: "Э-э, што? Гэта ж не... *літаральна* — людзі насамрэч не панапіхваныя па розных маленечкіх дзірках. Ты ж разумееш гэта, так?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000950A.english: "We've had our eye on you for quite some time. We saw you stumble out of the hostel, all messed up and stinking of booze."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000950A.polish: „Mamy cię na oku od jakiegoś już czasu. Widzieliśmy, jak wytaczasz się z hostelu – cały potargany i śmierdzący gorzałą”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000950A.belarusian: "Мы сочым за табой ужо даволі даўно. Мы бачылі, як ты вываліўся з хостэла — увесь разбіты і смярдзючы ад пойла".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009518.english: "Ooh, so *spooky*. Anyone could have seen this."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000951F.english: "Okay, a bit suspicious, but still not particularly menacing."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000951F.polish: „No dobra, trochę to podejrzane, ale nie jakieś strasznie złowrogie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000951F.belarusian: "Добра, крыху падазрона, але ўсё адно не надта пагрозліва".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000953A.english: Holy shit! A disembodied voice! Have cursed void-phantasms come to haunt us for misdeeds done in the past?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000953A.polish: O ja walę! Bezcielesny głos! Czyżby przeklęte fantazmaty pustki przybyły, aby dręczyć nas za zło wyrządzone w przeszłości?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000953A.belarusian: Маці божая! Бязведамасны голас! Ці гэта праклятыя фантомы нябыту прыйшлі пераследаваць нас за грахі мінулага?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009549.english: "That's way more boring than I imagined."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009549.polish: „To o wiele nudniejsze, niż się spodziewałem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009549.belarusian: "Гэта значна больш нудна, чым я ўяўляў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009551.english: How can they fit into all the holes and gaps? Are they very tiny people? Or are they... eyes, separated from the body?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009551.polish: Jak oni mieszczą się w tych wszystkich dziurach i szczelinach? To jacyś bardzo mali ludzie? A może to tylko... oddzielone od ciała oczy?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009551.belarusian: Як яны могуць змяшчацца ва ўсіх дзірках і шчылінах? Яны што, вельмі маленечкія людзі? Ці гэта... вочы, аддзеленыя ад цела?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009562.english: "Right. Good. You get it. We are watching you, ever vigilant. Nothing you do escapes our vision."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009562.polish: „Jasne. Dobrze. Łapiesz. Obserwujemy cię i jesteśmy zawsze czujni. Nie umknie nam żadne z twoich działań”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009562.belarusian: "Добра. Выдатна. Разумееш. Мы сочым за табой, няўсыпна пільныя. Нішто з зробленага табой не схаваецца ад нашага погляду".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000956E.english: "Boring?! That you are always being watched and judged? Nothing you do escapes our grasp, we are ever vigilant."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000956E.polish: „Nudne?! To, że jesteś nieustannie obserwowany i osądzany? Nie umknie nam żadne z twoich działań, bo jesteśmy wiecznie czujni”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000956E.belarusian: "Нудна?! Тое, што за табой заўсёды сочаць і судзяць цябе? Нішто з зробленага табой не выслізне ад нас, мы вечна пільныя".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009576.english: "Watch all you want, I don't mind."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009576.polish: „Obserwujcie, ile chcecie, nie przeszkadza mi to”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000957D.english: "Ha ha, you won't take us seriously? You will yet -- and you will rue that day."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000957D.polish: „Ha, ha! Nie zamierzasz brać nas na poważnie? Jeszcze zmienisz zdanie – i pożałujesz tego dnia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000957D.belarusian: "Ха-ха, не хочаш успрымаць нас усур'ёз? Яшчэ пачнеш — і пашкадуеш аб гэтым дні".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000959C.english: "Think you're some kind of a nice, clean, up-standing citizen? Don't worry, we'll get you yet... you can't keep your nose out of the gutter forever."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000959C.polish: „Myślisz, że jesteś jakimś miłym, czystym i porządnym obywatelem? Nie martw się, jeszcze cię dorwiemy... W końcu wrócisz do rynsztoka”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000959C.belarusian: "Думаеш, ты такі прыемны, чысценькі, добрапрыстойны грамадзянінам? Не хвалюйся, мы да цябе яшчэ дабяромся... ты не зможаш вечна трымаць нос далей ад канавы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000095CF.english: "It's a beginning, copper! You consider yourself a clean-cut, up-standing citizen? Don't worry, we'll get you yet... no keeping your nose out of the gutter forever."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000095CF.polish: „To początek, gliniarzu! Uważasz się za uczciwego i porządnego obywatela? Nie martw się, jeszcze cię dorwiemy... W końcu wrócisz do rynsztoka”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000095CF.belarusian: "Гэта толькі пачатак, легавы! Лічыш сябе чысценькім, добрапрыстойным грамадзянінам? Не хвалюйся, мы да цябе яшчэ дабяромся... вечна трымаць нос далей ад канавы не атрымаецца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000095E9.english: "She is a demon begging for release from this mortal coil."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000095E9.polish: „Jest demonem błagającym o uwolnienie z tego padołu łez”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000095E9.belarusian: "Яна дэман, які моліць аб вызваленні з гэтага тленнага свету".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000095F0.belarusian: "Нічога такога не было. Я ўсё адмаўляю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000095F7.english: "It was just a joke, come on. I was teaching her a lesson."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000095F7.polish: „No już, to był tylko żart. Chciałem dać jej nauczkę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000095F7.belarusian: "Гэта быў проста жарт, кінь. Я правучыў яе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000095FE.english: "No, no. That's... like... a super fucked-up thing to do. Seriously, I can't believe you still have your job. Everything else pales compared to this shit..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000095FE.polish: „Nie, nie. To... to było... naprawdę pojebane. Poważnie, nie mogę uwierzyć, że jeszcze nie wyrzucili cię z roboty. Wszystko blednie w porównaniu z tym gównem...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000095FE.belarusian: "Не, не. Гэта... ну... суперпаябаны ўчынак. Сур'ёзна, не веру, што цябе яшчэ не выперлі з працы. Усё астатняе блякне ў параўнанні з гэтым дзярмом...".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009618.english: "And we saw you got the body down. Oh, such wonderful progress! Hold the applause, ladies and gents."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009618.polish: „I widzieliśmy też, jak zdjąłeś zwłoki na ziemię. Och, jakie wspaniałe postępy! Wstrzymajcie się z oklaskami, panie i panowie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009618.belarusian: "А яшчэ мы бачылі, як ты зняў цела. О, які цудоўны прагрэс! Прытрымайце апладысменты, пані і панове".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009622.english: "And we saw your attempt to shoot the dead guy down from the tree. That was an... exceptionally impressive failure, if I say so myself."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009622.polish: „I widzieliśmy twoją próbę zestrzelenia wisielca z drzewa. To była... wyjątkowo imponująca porażka, jeśli wolno mi zauważyć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009622.belarusian: "А яшчэ мы бачылі тваю спробу збіць мерцвяка стрэлам з дрэва. Гэта быў... выключна ўражальны правал, калі дазволіце заўважыць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000096CE.english: "Getting too hot for you? Ha ha! Yeah, skitter off, find some actual criminals."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000096CE.polish: „Robi się za gorąco dla ciebie? Ha, ha! Tak, uciekaj – znajdź jakichś prawdziwych przestępców”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000096CE.belarusian: "Стала занадта горача? Ха-ха! Ага, драпай адсюль, пашукай сапраўдных злачынцаў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000996E.english: Holy fuck! It's coming to get us!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000996E.belarusian: Тваю ж маць! Яно ідзе па нас!

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000997F.english: Don't be ridiculous. It's just a regular person, probably a worker from the harbour.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000997F.polish: Nie gadaj bzdur. To zwykły człowiek, pewnie jakiś robotnik z portu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000997F.belarusian: Не вярзі глупства. Гэта проста звычайны чалавек, напэўна, рабочы з порта.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009DC5.english: "Right now? You! Ha ha. We've got our eyes on you, believe you me!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009DC5.polish: „W tej chwili? Na ciebie! Ha, ha! Mamy na ciebie oko, uwierz mi!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00009DC5.belarusian: "Проста зараз? На цябе! Ха-ха. Мы сочым за табой, павер мне!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000A044.english: "Alright, you want more? We saw you try to punch that kid. A grown man, a *police officer* trying to punch a snot-nosed punk kid! A kid, for fuck's sake!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000A044.polish: „W porządku, chcesz więcej? Widzieliśmy, jak próbowałeś uderzyć pięścią tego dzieciaka. Dorosły facet, *funkcjonariusz policji* próbujący uderzyć zasmarkanego dzieciaka! Dzieciaka, na litość boską!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000A044.belarusian: "Добра, хочаш яшчэ? Мы бачылі, як ты спрабаваў ударыць таго малога. Дарослы мужык, *супрацоўнік паліцыі* спрабуе ўдарыць смаркатага пацанка! Дзіця, чорт пабяры!"

Alternate1/0x0100002F0000A044.polish: „W porządku, chcesz więcej? Widzieliśmy, jak uderzyłeś dziecko. Dorosły facet, *funkcjonariusz policji* uderzył małego zasmarkanego dzieciaka. W twarz! Czy ty rozumiesz, jak bardzo jest to popieprzone, maniaku?”
Alternate1/0x0100002F0000A044.belarusian: "Добра, хочаш яшчэ? Мы бачылі, як ты ўдарыў дзіця. Дарослы мужык, *супрацоўнік паліцыі* ўдарыў маленькага смаркатага пацанка. У твар! Ты разумееш, наколькі гэта паябана, маньяк?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000A05F.english: "Sorry, things just got out of... hand."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000A05F.polish: „Przykro mi, sprawy... wymknęły się spod kontroli”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000A066.english: "Oh, sure, think up any justification you can for your fucked up, vicious deeds. Seriously, what a psychopath. You can't cover that up..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000A066.polish: „Och! Jasne – wymyślaj sobie usprawiedliwienia dla swoich popieprzonych, podłych czynów. Prawdziwy z ciebie psychopata. Tego nie ukryjesz...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000A066.belarusian: "О, вядома, выдумляй сабе любыя апраўданні сваім паябаным, гнюсным учынкам. Сур'ёзна, ну і псіхапат. Такога не схаваеш...".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000A072.english: "Yeah? Does that happen to you often, Officer Heavyhands? Seriously, what a psychopath. You can't cover that up..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000A072.polish: „Tak? Często ci się to zdarza, funkcjonariuszu Ciężka Ręka? Prawdziwy z ciebie psychopata. Tego nie ukryjesz...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000A072.belarusian: "Так? З табой гэта часта бывае, афіцэр Цяжкарукі? Сур'ёзна, ну і псіхапат. Такога не схаваеш...".

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000022E1.english: "Are you the company lookout Joyce hinted at?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000022E1.polish: „Jesteś tym obserwatorem z firmy, którego istnienie sugerowała Joyce?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000022E1.belarusian: "Ты той даглядчык кампаніі, на якога намякала Джойс?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000022F1.english: "Yes, I would like to. Very much."

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000022F6.english: "Can you please not call me names?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000022FF.english: "Sure thing, pisspig, ha ha ha." The eyes blink rapidly. "Oh, and no, I'm not some fuckin' 'lookout' for the *leeches*."
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000022FF.polish: „Jasne, zaszczana świnio! Ha, ha, ha!” – oczy mrugają szybko. „I nie, nie jestem jakimś pieprzonym »obserwatorem« na usługach *pijawek*”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000022FF.belarusian: "Без пытанняў, свінтус зассаны, ха-ха-ха, - вочы хутка міргаюць. - А, і не, я не які-небудзь ёбаны 'назіральнік' на гэтых *п'явак*".

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000230A.english: The eyes blink rapidly. "No, I'm not, ha ha ha."
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000230A.polish: Oczy mrugają szybko. „Nie, nie jestem. Ha, ha, ha!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000230A.belarusian: Вочы хутка міргаюць. "Не, не ён, ха-ха-ха".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002314.english: Oh-oh, you know who's got things to hide!?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002314.polish: Ojoj. Wiesz, kto ma tutaj coś do ukrycia!?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002314.belarusian: Ой-ёй, а ты ведаеш, каму ёсць што хаваць!?

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000232C.english: Don't be an idiot and say it. In this day and age, of all times. It won't end well.
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000232C.polish: Nie bądź cymbałem i to powiedz. Zwłaszcza w dzisiejszych czasach. To się nie skończy dobrze.
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000232C.belarusian: Не будзь ідыётам, не кажы гэтага. Асабліва ў наш час. Гэта добрым не скончыцца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002337.english: "It's gotta be something *big* and *deep* and *important*. Because certainly you aren't some regular asshole avoiding the fact that he goes around fucking up everyone's lives with their self-serving, egotistical arrogance?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002337.polish: „To musi być coś *dużego*, *głębokiego* i *ważnego*. Bo z pewnością nie jesteś jakimś zwykłym dupkiem unikającym faktu, że kręci się w kółko i rozpieprza wszystkim życie swoją wyrachowaną, egoistyczną arogancją!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002337.belarusian: "Гэта мусіць быць нешта *вялікае*, *глыбокае* і *важнае*. Бо ты ж дакладна не нейкі звычайны мудак, які хаваецца ад таго факту, што ходзіць кругом і ламае ўсім жыцці сваёй карыслівай эгаістычнай нахабнасцю?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002340.english: "I'm sure your story is very *unique* and not a stereotype-ridden re-hash of tired ideas."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002340.polish: „Jestem przekonany, że historia twojego życia jest bardzo *unikalna* i nie stanowi przesyconej stereotypami powtórki zgranych pomysłów”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002340.belarusian: "Я ўпэўнены, твая гісторыя вельмі *ўнікальная*, а не напханая стэрэатыпамі перажоўка збітых ідэй".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002350.english: "Sure thing, you pretty flower, you. Go and discover your *exciting* backstory. I'm sure it'll be one-of-a-kind."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002350.polish: „Oczywiście, mój ty cudowny kwiatuszku. Śmiało, odkryj swoją *ekscytującą* historię. Jestem przekonany, że okaże się jedyna w swoim rodzaju”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002350.belarusian: "Вядома, кветачка ты мая ненаглядная. Ідзі ды адкрывай сваю *захапляльную* перадгісторыю. Упэўнены, яна будзе адзінай у сваім родзе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002358.english: "Is this one of those homo things that keeps coming up?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002358.polish: „Czy to jedna z tych homorzeczy, które ciągle wyłażą na światło dzienne?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002358.belarusian: "Гэта адна з тых гома-штук, што ўвесь час усплываюць?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000235F.english: "Ah, but of course! It's all a huge part of the secret homo-sexual underground."
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000235F.polish: „Ach, oczywiście! To wszystko bardzo ważny element sekretnego homoseksualnego podziemia”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000235F.belarusian: "Ах, ну вядома! Гэта ўсё вялікая частка таемнага Гомасексуальнага Падполля".

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000236B.english: "I'm still not sure that's an actual thing..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000236B.polish: „Wciąż nie jestem pewien, czy ono faktycznie istnieje...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000236B.belarusian: "Я ўсё яшчэ не ўпэўнены, што такое насамрэч існуе..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002374.english: "Of course it's not, you numbnuts!" A groan comes from the other side. "Unbelievable."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002374.polish: „Oczywiście, że nie, głąbie!” – zza bramy dobiega jęk. „Niewiarygodne”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002374.belarusian: "Вядома ж не, ёлуп ты! - з таго боку даносіцца стогн. - Неверагодна".

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000237A.english: "No." A groan comes from the other side. "You're a complete tool, aren't you."
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000237A.polish: „Nie” – zza bramy dobiega jęk. „Jesteś tępym młotem, prawda?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000237A.belarusian: "Не, - з таго боку даносіцца стогн. - Ты ж поўны ёлуп, праўда?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002388.english: "You can fucking say that again. God, yes, the power!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002388.polish: „No kurwa, jasna sprawa. Boże, tak! Ta władza!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002388.belarusian: "Тваю ж маць, яшчэ б не! Божа, так, гэтая ўлада!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002398.english: "Oh yeah, him. He's a mercenary posing as a worker, yeah."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002398.polish: „A tak, on. Najemnik udający robotnika, tak”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900002398.belarusian: "Ага, ён. Ён найміт, які прыкідваецца рабочым, так".

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000023A6.english: "What, did your brain shut off or something?" He grunts. "I don't understand how you get anything done. Well, whatever."
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000023A6.polish: „Co, mózg ci się wyłączył czy coś?” – prycha. „Nie rozumiem, jakim cudem udaje ci się cokolwiek zrobić. Ale to nieważne”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000023A6.belarusian: "Што, мазгі адключыліся ці як? - ён бурчыць. - Я наогул не разумею, як ты нешта робіш. Ай, няважна".

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000023AE.english: "That so? Well I'll be damned..." He snorts. "Guess you ain't all shit-for-brains after all."
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000023AE.polish: „Poważnie? A niech mnie...” – prycha. „Wygląda na to, że nie jesteś zupełnie skończonym idiotą”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000023AE.belarusian: "Вось як? Каб мяне чэрці ўхапілі... - ён хмыкае. - Выходзіць, твае мазгі не зусім з гною злепленыя".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003303.english: "Shit or get off the crapper, assholes!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003309.english: "I came all the way from Olduwai to work here!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003309.polish: „Przyjechałem tu do pracy aż z Olduwai!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003309.belarusian: «Прыехаў сюды на працу аж з Олдувая!»

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000345A.english: "C'mon, guys! I gotta feed my kids!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000345A.belarusian: «Хлопцы! У мяне ёсць дзеці, якіх трэба карміць!»

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003327.english: "You can't win this, just let us work!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003327.polish: „Nie wygracie tutaj! Po prostu dajcie nam pracować!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003327.belarusian: «Вы тут не пераможаце! Проста дайце нам працаваць!»

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003339.english: "You're taking food out of our mouths!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000333F.english: "Please, I'll come on half-time, work night-shifts!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000333F.polish: „Proszę! Będę pracować na pół etatu! Na nocnych zmianach!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000333F.belarusian: «Калі ласка! Я буду працаваць на палову стаўкі! На начных зменах!»

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003351.english: "I thought it'd be over by now."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003351.polish: „Myślałem, że do tej pory będzie już po strajku”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003351.belarusian: «Думаў, што да гэтага часу страйк ужо скончыцца».

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003357.english: "Let's just sit down and talk this out!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003357.polish: „Usiądźmy ze sobą i porozmawiajmy o tym!”

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000335D.english: "Seems like it ain't getting any better..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000335D.polish: „Wygląda na to, że się nie poprawia...”

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003363.belarusian: «Я нават набыў свой уласны рабочы камбінезон!»

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000336F.english: "We're all so tired out here, have mercy!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000341E.english: "Why don't you fucking come down here!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000342A.english: "You think you're better than us?! You're not!!!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000342A.polish: „Myślicie, że jesteście lepsi od nas? Nie jesteście!!!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000342A.belarusian: «Думаеце, што вы лепшыя за нас? Не, вы не!!!»

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000337B.actor: Very Hard to Exploit Handicapped Person
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000337B.english: "We're workers, just like you! Let us in!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000337B.polish: „Jesteśmy robotnikami takimi jak wy! Wpuśćcie nas!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000337B.belarusian: «Мы рабочыя, такія ж, як і вы! Упусціце нас!»

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003381.actor: Very Hard to Exploit Handicapped Person
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003381.english: "We're all working stiffs here! You're fuckin' 'yer own!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003381.polish: „Wszyscy tu jesteśmy zwykłymi robotnikami! Szkodzicie swoim!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003381.belarusian: «Усе мы тут звычайныя працаўнікі! Вы шкодзіце сваім!»

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003387.actor: Very Hard to Exploit Handicapped Person

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000339F.english: "You're just afraid, cause we're better than you!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000339F.polish: „Boicie się, bo jesteśmy od was lepsi!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000339F.belarusian: «Вы баіцеся, бо мы лепшыя за вас!»

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033A5.english: "Fuck politics! Let's just all work! Together!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033A5.polish: „Pieprzyć politykę! Po prostu idźmy do pracy! Razem!”
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033A5.belarusian: «Нахрэн тую палітыку! Проста пайшлі на працу! Разам!»

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033AB.english: "I will fight any one of you to work. One on one, let's go!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033AB.polish: „Będę walczył z każdym z was, aby zdobyć pracę. Jeden na jednego, do dzieła!”
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033AB.belarusian: «Я буду змагацца з кожным з вас, каб атрымаць працу. Адзін на аднаго, да справы!»

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033B1.english: "You don't even know what work means!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033B1.polish: „Nie macie nawet pojęcia, co to jest praca!”
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033B1.belarusian: «Вы нават паняцця не маеце, што такое праца!»

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033CF.english: "I haven't had a job for years!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033D5.english: "Did you hear that? They're secretly working in there!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033E1.english: "We had a deal we can work here!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033E1.polish: „Obiecali nam, że będziemy mogli tu pracować!”
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033E1.belarusian: «Паабяцалі нам, што мы зможам тут працаваць!»

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033E7.english: "Look, look here! I signed a six month contract!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033E7.polish: „Patrzcie! Mam podpisany kontrakt na pół roku!”
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033E7.belarusian: «Глядзіце! Я маю падпісаны кантракт на паўгода!»

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000033FA.english: "You're fucking with the wrong worker here!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003400.english: "Just let me work a little, I'm really good!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003400.polish: „Dajcie mi trochę popracować – jestem naprawdę dobry!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003400.belarusian: „Дайце мне крыху папрацаваць – я сапраўды добры!”

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003406.english: "I'd leave, but I don't wanna get beaten up..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003406.polish: „Poszedłbym stąd, ale nie chcę, żeby mnie pobili...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003406.belarusian: «Я б пайшоў адсюль, але не хачу, каб мяне пабілі...»

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003418.english: "I wouldn't do this if I didn't have to!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003460.english: "I spent all my money getting here!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003460.belarusian: «Я выдаткаваў усе грошы, каб сюды прыехаць!»

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003466.english: "C'mon, there's plenty of work for everyone!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003466.polish: „Dajcie spokój, pracy nie zabraknie dla nikogo!”

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003489.english: "You have no idea how bad I need this!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003489.polish: „Nie macie pojęcia, jak bardzo tego potrzebuję!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003489.belarusian: «Вы не ўяўляеце, наколькі мне гэта патрэбна!»

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000348E.english: "Let me work! I'm gonna start drinking if I don't!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000348E.polish: „Dajcie mi pracować! Bez pracy zacznę pić!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000348E.belarusian: „Дайце мне працаваць! Без працы пачну піць!”

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000198D0.english: "Look alive back there! LET US WORK!!!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000198D0.polish: „Z życiem tam z tyłu! DAJCIE NAM PRACOWAĆ!!!”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000070CD.english: There it is again! There's a spectral smell haunting this industrial harbour. And it smells like...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000070CD.polish: Znowu jest! Ten port nawiedza jakiś upiorny zapach. Czuć tu...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000070CD.belarusian: Вось зноў! У гэтым індустрыйным порце лунае нейкі прывідны пах. І пахне ён як...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000070DB.english: Heavy fuel oil, mostly. Because it's an industrial harbour.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000070DB.polish: Głównie ciężkim olejem napędowym. W końcu to port przemysłowy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000070DB.belarusian: Дызельнае паліва, пераважна. Бо гэта ж індустрыйны порт.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000070E2.english: Years of turmoil, of hopes and dreams ground beneath the inexorable tides of capital.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000070E2.polish: Lata niepokojów, nadziei i marzeń obróconych w proch uderzeniami niezmordowanych fal kapitału.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000070E2.belarusian: Гады бязладдзя, надзей і мараў, разбітых у пыл ударамі нястомных хваляў капіталу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000070F9.english: Can you not detect that inimitable *whiff* of dissatisfaction and restlessness, that sense that the world is in need of dramatic, even *violent* re-ordering?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000070F9.polish: Naprawdę nie wyczuwasz tego niemożliwego do podrobienia *aromatu* niezadowolenia i niepokoju? Poczucia, że świat potrzebuje dramatycznej, *brutalnej* wręcz zmiany w swoim porządku?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000070F9.belarusian: Няўжо ты і праўда не адчуваеш гэтага непараўнальнага *водару* незадаволенасці і неспакою? Гэтага пачуцця, што свет патрабуе драматычнай, нават *гвалтоўнай* перабудовы свайго парадку?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007109.english: (Close your eyes and take a deep breath.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007110.english: Does that mean there's a communist nearby?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007110.polish: Czy to oznacza, że w pobliżu jest komunista?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007118.english: You inhale. The cilia along your olfactory epithelium tingle with excitement as they sift through the swirling morass of industrial odours...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007118.polish: Bierzesz wdech. Rzęski na twojej tkance nabłonkowej nosa drżą z ekscytacji, racząc się wirującą mieszaniną przemysłowych zapachów...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007118.belarusian: Ты ўдыхаеш. Раснічкі твайго нюхальнага эпітэлію дрыжаць ад хвалявання, захапляючыся вірам індустрыяльных пахаў...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007127.english: First come the smells of the agitated strikebreakers, layers of body oil and sweat, over-buttered meals pulled from bakelite lunch pails, the biting stench of lye soap. And then there's the slowly oxidizing metal gates, the scent of stale grease emanating from every crack...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007127.polish: Pierwszy dociera do ciebie zapach podnieconych łamistrajków – potu i ludzkiego łoju, zbyt tłustych posiłków wyciągniętych z bakelitowych pudełek śniadaniowych, gryzący odór ługowego mydła. Później pojawia się aromat powoli utleniającej się metalowej bramy i zastałego smaru, jakiego pełne są wszystkie jej szczeliny...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007127.belarusian: Спачатку даносяцца пахі ўзрушаных штрэйкбрэхераў: пласты скурнага тлушчу і поту, прамасленых абедаў, выцягнутых з бакелітавых скрынак, і едкі смурод шчолачнага мыла. А потым — пах металічнай брамы, якая павольна акісляецца, і застаялай змазкі, што прасочваецца з кожнай шчыліны...

Alternate1/0x0100000F00007127.polish: Choć łamistrajki śpią już w swoich domach, w powietrzu wciąż czuć ich zapach – potu i ludzkiego łoju, zbyt tłustych posiłków wyciągniętych z bakelitowych pudełek śniadaniowych, gryzący odór ługowego mydła. Później pojawia się aromat powoli utleniającej się metalowej bramy i zastałego smaru, jakiego pełne są wszystkie jej szczeliny...
Alternate1/0x0100000F00007127.belarusian: Хоць штрэйкбрэхеры ўжо разышліся, у паветры ўсё яшчэ адчуваецца іх пах: пласты скурнага тлушчу і поту, прамасленых абедаў, выцягнутых з бакелітавых скрынак, і едкі смурод шчолачнага мыла. А потым — пах металічнай брамы, якая павольна акісляецца, і застаялай змазкі, што прасочваецца з кожнай шчыліны...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000712D.english: No, actually. In fact, you can't smell much of *anything*. Perhaps your allergies are acting up?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000712D.polish: Tak naprawdę to nie. W gruncie rzeczy, to nie czujesz za bardzo *niczego*. Może alergia ci się odzywa?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000712D.belarusian: Насамрэч, не. Шчыра кажучы, ты наогул амаль *нічога* не адчуваеш. Можа, гэта разыгралася твая алергія?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007152.english: "Everything in order, detective?" The lieutenant gives you a quizzical look.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007152.polish: „Wszystko w porządku, detektywie?” – porucznik spogląda na ciebie ze zdziwieniem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007152.belarusian: "Усё ў парадку, дэтэктыве?" — лейтэнант запытальна глядзіць на цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007159.english: In a word, exactly what you would expect to find at any harbour in the industrialized world...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007159.polish: Słowem – czujesz dokładnie to, czego spodziewałbyś się w każdym porcie uprzemysłowionego świata...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007159.belarusian: Адным словам — менавіта тое, што ты і спадзяваўся б знайсці ў любым порце індустрыялізаванага свету...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007160.english: Nonsense. The reek of communism is unmistakable, and it's coming... from that railing over there!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007160.polish: Bzdura. Smrodu komunizmu nie da się pomylić z niczym innym. I dobiega on... z tamtej balustrady!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007160.belarusian: Глупства. Смурод камунізму не пераблытаеш ні з чым, і нясе ім... ад тых парэнчаў!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007166.english: Undoubtedly. And the scent is coming... from that railing over there!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007166.polish: Bez wątpienia. A zapach dociera... z tamtej balustrady!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007166.belarusian: Бясспрэчна. І пах ідзе... ад тых парэнчаў!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007185.english: You mean from the skinny guy in the red hat?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007185.polish: Znaczy się, od tego chudego w czerwonej czapce?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007185.belarusian: Думаеш, ад таго худога ў чырвонай шапцы?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000718C.english: Yes. Now's your chance to *establish contact*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000718C.polish: Tak. To twoja szansa na *nawiązanie kontaktu*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007198.english: But be easy about it. Communists have been known to charge when startled.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007198.polish: Ale zrób to z wyczuciem. Komuniści znani są z tego, że zaskoczeni przypuszczają atak.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007198.belarusian: Але будзь асцярожным. Камуністы ідуць у атаку, калі іх напалохаць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071AA.english: "I'm working on developing my political consciousness."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071AA.belarusian: "Я працую над развіццём сваёй палітычнай свядомасці".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071AF.english: "Just taking in the fresh air, like a normal detective."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071AF.polish: „Cieszę się świeżym powietrzem, jak każdy normalny detektyw”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071AF.belarusian: "Проста дыхаю свежым паветрам, як звычайны дэтэктыў".

Alternate1/0x0100000F000071AF.polish: „Cieszę się świeżym porannym powietrzem, jak każdy normalny detektyw”.
Alternate1/0x0100000F000071AF.belarusian: "Проста дыхаю ранішнім паветрам, як звычайны дэтэктыў".

Alternate2/0x0100000F000071AF.polish: „Cieszę się świeżym popołudniowym powietrzem, jak każdy normalny detektyw”.
Alternate2/0x0100000F000071AF.belarusian: "Проста дыхаю пасляабедзенным паветрам, як звычайны дэтэктыў".

Alternate3/0x0100000F000071AF.polish: „Cieszę się świeżym wieczornym powietrzem, jak każdy normalny detektyw”.
Alternate3/0x0100000F000071AF.belarusian: "Проста дыхаю вячэрнім паветрам, як звычайны дэтэктыў".

Alternate4/0x0100000F000071AF.polish: „Cieszę się świeżym nocnym powietrzem, jak każdy normalny detektyw”.
Alternate4/0x0100000F000071AF.belarusian: "Проста дыхаю начным паветрам, як звычайны дэтэктыў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071BE.english: "There's a lot to take in, isn't there?" The lieutenant wrinkles his nose.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071BE.polish: „Dużo tu powodów do radości, co?” – mówi porucznik, marszcząc nos.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071BE.belarusian: "Шмат усяго трэба ўдыхнуць, ці не так?" — лейтэнант моршчыць нос.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071EF.english: "You know what? I'll just leave you to it. Carry on, detective."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071EF.polish: „Wiesz co? Rób sobie, co chcesz, detektywie. Nie przeszkadzaj sobie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071EF.belarusian: "Ведаеце што? Я проста пакіну вас з гэтай справай. Працягвайце, дэтэктыве".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071F4.english: "I'm struggling to see the connection with our investigation, but I'm sure *all will be revealed* in time."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071F4.polish: „Nie umiem dostrzec, jak wiąże się to z naszym śledztwem, ale nie wątpię, że *wszystko się z czasem ujawni*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071F4.belarusian: "Мне цяжка ўбачыць сувязь з нашым расследаваннем, але я ўпэўнены, што з часам *усё праясніцца*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071FB.english: "In the interest of our investigation, I suggest you focus on the case at hand. You can pursue your *political projects* after hours."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071FB.polish: „Z uwagi na nasze śledztwo radziłbym ci skupić się na naszym zadaniu. Swoje *polityczne projekty* możesz realizować po godzinach pracy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F000071FB.belarusian: "У інтарэсах нашага расследавання я прапаную вам засяродзіцца на справе, якую мы вядзем. Сваімі *палітычнымі праектамі* зможаце заняцца ў вольны час".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007201.english: It is a mark of the lieutenant's respect for you that he does not press you on this decidedly *extra-curricular* errand.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007201.polish: Fakt, że porucznik nie naciska cię w sprawie tych zdecydowanie *pozazawodowych* działań, świadczy o jego szacunku dla ciebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007201.belarusian: Тое, што лейтэнант не дапытваецца наконт гэтай відавочна *пазаслужбовай* справы — знак яго павагі да цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007206.english: Nota bene: The lieutenant is not at all convinced that anything will be revealed.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007206.polish: Tak naprawdę porucznik wcale nie jest przekonany, że cokolwiek zostanie ujawnione.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007206.belarusian: Nota bene: лейтэнант зусім не ўпэўнены, што хоць нешта праясніцца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000720B.english: The lieutenant is not pleased with this turn of events, but it's unlikely that he'll move to intervene to stop them.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000720B.polish: Porucznik nie jest zadowolony z takiego obrotu spraw, wątpliwe jednak, aby interweniował.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000720B.belarusian: Лейтэнант не ў захапленні ад такога павароту падзей, але наўрад ці ён стане ўмешвацца, каб гэта спыніць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007219.english: The lieutenant lacks your *highly developed* politico-olfactory cortex. The reek of communism is undeniable. And it's coming... from that railing right there!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007219.polish: Porucznik nie posiada twojej *wysoce rozwiniętej* kory polityczno-węchowej. Smród komunizmu jest ewidentny. I dobiega on... z tamtej balustrady!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007219.belarusian: Лейтэнанту не хапае тваёй *высокаразвітай* палітычна-нюхальнай кары. Смурод камунізму бясспрэчны. І нясе ім... ад тых парэнчаў!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007246.english: "Well, I'll be over here when you've finished." The lieutenant nudges something on the ground with his foot.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007246.polish: „Dobrze, poczekam tutaj, aż skończysz” – mówi porucznik, trącając czubkiem buta coś leżącego na ziemi.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007246.belarusian: "Ну што ж, я буду вунь там, калі вы скончыце", — лейтэнант падштурхоўвае наском бота нешта на зямлі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007250.english: "No offence, detective, but you're not particularly *subtle*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007250.polish: „Bez urazy, detektywie, ale nie jesteś szczególnie *subtelny*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007250.belarusian: "Без крыўды, дэтэктыве, але вы не тое каб вельмі *далікатны*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007261.english: His impatience is feigned. He's curious to see how this *personal errand* shakes out.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007261.polish: To udawana niecierpliwość. Jest ciekaw, jak się ta twoja *sprawa osobista* zakończy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007261.belarusian: Яго нецярплівасць — толькі для выгляду. Яму цікава, як утрасецца гэтая твая *асабістая справа*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007266.english: He'll tolerate this *personal errand*, but his patience is wearing thin.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007266.polish: Toleruje twoją *sprawę osobistą*, ale jego cierpliwość jest na wyczerpaniu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007266.belarusian: Ён знясе гэтую *асабістую справу*, але яго цярпенне ўжо станчаецца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000726F.english: The lieutenant issss not persuaded, sssssire.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000726F.polish: Porucznik nie jesssst przekonany, ssssszanowny panie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000726F.belarusian: Мы не ссссхілілі лейтэнанта на свой бок, васссспане.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007276.english: The lieutenant's right. It's sort of amazing how un-subtly you're sniffing the air around you, almost like you're *trying* to call attention to yourself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007276.polish: Porucznik ma rację. To aż niesamowite, jak niesubtelnie węszysz wokół. Jakbyś nieomal *próbował* ściągnąć na siebie uwagę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007276.belarusian: Лейтэнант мае рацыю. Нават здзіўляе, як недалікатна ты ўцягваеш паветра носам — быццам *наўмысна* спрабуеш прыцягнуць да сябе ўвагу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000727D.english: What the lieutenant thinks is irrelevant. Your politico-olfactory cortex is lighting up like a holiday display. Look, it's pointing you right... to that railing over there!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000727D.polish: To, co myśli porucznik, jest bez znaczenia. Twoja kora polityczno-węchowa rozpędziła się niczym lokomotywa. I kieruje cię prosto... do tamtej balustrady!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000727D.belarusian: Думкі лейтэнанта не маюць значэння. Твая палітычна-нюхальная кара палае, як святочная ілюмінацыя. І накіроўвае цябе проста... да тых парэнчаў!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000728E.english: (Close your eyes and take a deep breath.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007298.english: I can *kind of* smell dreams being ground down by capital.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007298.polish: Czuję *odrobinę* zapach marzeń ścieranych na proch przez kapitał.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F00007298.belarusian: Я *амаль* адчуваю гэты пах — як капітал перамолвае мары.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000F9F6.english: On the table you see a bowl of water, a rough soap, and next to it a small hand mirror. A straight razor soaks inside the wash basin.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000F9F6.polish: Na stole widzisz miskę z wodą, szorstkie mydło i kieszonkowe lusterko. W wodzie moczy się brzytwa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000F9F6.belarusian: На стале бачыш міску з вадой, шурпаты мыла і кішэннае люстэрка. У вадзе замочана небяспечная брытва.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000FA0B.english: The water reflects back a vague image of your face -- nose bulbous and red, hair unkempt, wrinkles lining the eyes and forehead. The 'stache is gigantic.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000FA0B.polish: W wodzie odbija się niewyraźnie twoja twarz – kartoflowaty, czerwony nos, rozczochrane włosy, zmarszczki na oczach i czole. Gigantyczne wąsy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000FA0B.belarusian: У вадзе невыразна адбіваецца тваё аблічча — картаўнаватны, чырвоны нос, растрапаныя валасы, маршчыны на вачах і на ілбе. Гіганцкія вусы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DB17.english: Time to shave. Get these mutton chops off.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DB17.polish: Czas się ogolić. Pozbądź się tych bokobrodów.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DB25.english: Like an artist with a brush or a master swordsman, you use the small mirror and the straight razor -- with some soap -- to remove all that unkempt hair from below the nose-line.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DB25.polish: Niczym artysta z pędzlem w ręce lub mistrz szermierczy wykorzystujesz lusterko i brzytwę – a także mydło – aby pozbyć się wszystkich tych niechlujnych włosów poniżej linii nosa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DB25.belarusian: Як мастак з пэндзлем у руцэ або майстар фехтавання, ты выкарыстоўваеш люстэрка і брытву — а таксама мыла — каб пазбавіцца ад усіх гэтых неахайных валасоў ніжэй за лінію носа.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DB2B.english: Your hand trembles as you scratch at your cheek... oh no, that's not how a grown man shaves!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DB2B.polish: Dłoń ci drży, kiedy drapiesz się po policzku... O nie, nie tak goli się dorosły mężczyzna!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DB2B.belarusian: Рука ў цябе дрыжыць, калі чухаеш шчаку... О не, не так голіцца дарослы чалавек!

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E0D7.english: They feel so smooth, surprisingly so. A feeling of freshness overcomes you, as if you just came from a cold bath.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E0D7.polish: Wydają się niesamowicie, aż zaskakująco gładkie. Ogarnia cię poczucie świeżości, jakbyś właśnie wyszedł z zimnej kąpieli.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E0D7.belarusian: Яны здаюцца неверагодна, нават дзіўна гладкімі. Ахоплівае адчуванне свежасці, як быццам вы толькі што выйшлі з халоднай ванны.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E0DD.english: This isn't sharp enough. Scrape harder.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E0DD.polish: Nie jest wystarczająco ostra. Drap mocniej.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E0E2.english: Stop, for crying out loud! You're gonna cut your own throat.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E0E2.polish: Przestań, na litość! Poderżniesz sobie gardło.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E0E2.belarusian: Спыніся, дзеля літасці! Перарэжаш сабе горла.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E0EF.english: You'll be lookin' like a pansy without the chops! A fuckin' pansy!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E0EF.polish: Bez bokobrodów będziesz wyglądał jak laluś! Jebany laluś!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E0EF.belarusian: Без бакоў будзеш выглядаць як лалусь! Чортаў лалусь!

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E0F4.english: A fresh start looms ahead. Clean yourself up and be born anew.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E0F4.polish: Widzisz na horyzoncie nowy początek. Doprowadź się do porządku i naródź się na nowo.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E0F4.belarusian: Ты бачыш на гарызонце новы пачатак. Прыведзі сябе ў парадак і нарадзіся нанова.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E113.english: The water reflects back a vague image of your clean-shaven face. Despite the bulbous nose, unkempt hair and persistent swelling, you look... a little younger, maybe?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E113.polish: W wodzie odbija się niewyraźnie twoja ogolona na gładko twarz. Mimo kartoflowatego nosa, rozczochranych włosów i nieschodzącej opuchlizny wyglądasz... może nieco młodziej?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E113.belarusian: У вадзе невыразна адбіваецца твар, акуратна паголены. Нягледзячы на картоплеападобны нос, растрэпаныя валасы і не схадзячую пухліны, выглядаеш... можа крыху маладзей?

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E120.english: You almost look like a professional.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E125.english: Your face, such as it is. A regular human face. Sans expression.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E125.polish: Twoja twarz, jaka by nie była. Zwykłe ludzkie oblicze. Bez wyrazu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E125.belarusian: Тваё твар, які б ён ні быў. Звычайны чалавечы выгляд. Без выразнасці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E136.english: The beardless nature of your cheeks makes The Expression seem even more like a terrifying grimace.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E136.polish: Bezbroda natura twoich policzków sprawia, że *mina* wygląda jeszcze bardziej jak przerażający grymas.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E136.belarusian: Бязбрадная прырода тваіх шчок робіць *міны* яшчэ больш падобнымі на палохаючы скрыўленні.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1A8.english: There's no way to salvage this.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1A8.polish: Nie da się już tego uratować.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1AE.english: Drop the razor in the water basin.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1AE.polish: Upuść brzytwę do miski z wodą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1AE.belarusian: Апусціце брытву ў міску з вадой.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1B3.english: Your hand refuses to move another millimetre. A small trickle of blood runs down your cheek.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1B3.polish: Twoja ręka nie chce się już poruszyć ani o milimetr. Po policzku spływa ci mała strużka krwi.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1B3.belarusian: Твая рука ўжо не хоча варушыцца ні на міліметр. Па шчацэ цячэ маленькая струменьчык крыві.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1B8.english: The razor lands with a *clang*. A red trickle begins to spread in the water.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1B8.polish: Brzytwa upada z *brzęknięciem*. W wodzie rozpuszcza się powoli czerwona strużka.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1B8.belarusian: Брытва падае з *брэнчаннем*. У вадзе павольна раствораецца чырвоная цурка.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1BD.belarusian: Дакраніся да сваіх выголеных гладкіх шчок.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1C2.english: Hope this was the right decision.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1C2.polish: Mam nadzieję, że to była dobra decyzja.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1C2.belarusian: Спадзяюся, што гэта было добрае рашэнне.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1C7.english: Beneath the doubt sprouts a new vigour, like you've discarded some bad decisions. It feels as though you've passed through a ritual. Emerged from cold water, even...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1C7.polish: Pod warstwą wątpliwości rodzi się nowa werwa, jakbyś odrzucił jakieś dawne złe decyzje. Czujesz się, jakbyś przeszedł jakiś rytuał. Wynurzył się wręcz z zimnej wody...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1C7.belarusian: Пад пластом сумненняў нараджаецца новая энэргiя, быццам ты адкінуў нейкія даўнія дрэнныя рашэнні. Адчуваеш сябе, быццам прайшоў нейкі рытуал. Узнік проста з халоднай вады...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1E2.english: The sharp blade chafes against your skin, producing a scratching sound. The surface underneath the beard feels tender, the air brushing against it chilly.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1E2.polish: Ostry metal drapie cię z chrzęstem po brodzie. Skóra pod włosami wydaje się delikatna; czujesz na niej chłód powietrza.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E1E2.belarusian: Вострая металічная паверхня драпае вас з хрустам па падбародку. Скура пад валасамі здаецца далікатнай; вы адчуваеце на ёй холад паветра.

Dialogue Text/0x010000950000028D.english: The sharp blade chafes against your skin, producing a scratching sound. The surface underneath the beard feels tender, the air brushing against it chilly.
Dialogue Text/0x010000950000028D.polish: Ostry metal drapie cię z chrzęstem po brodzie. Skóra pod włosami wydaje się delikatna; czujesz na niej chłód powietrza.
Dialogue Text/0x010000950000028D.belarusian: Востры метал драпае цябе з рыпаннем па падбароддзі. Скура пад валасамі здаецца далікатнай; ты адчуваеш на ёй халадок паветра.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000200005ADE.english: On the table you see a bowl of water, a rough soap, and next to it a small hand mirror. A straight razor soaks inside the wash basin.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000200005ADE.polish: Na stole widzisz miskę z wodą, szorstkie mydło i kieszonkowe lusterko. W wodzie moczy się brzytwa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000200005ADE.belarusian: На стале ты бачыш міску з вадой, шурпаты кавалак мыла і кішэннае люстэрка. У вадзе намакае брытва.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000200005AE4.english: Please attend to personal hygiene on your own time.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000200005AE4.polish: Zajmuj się, proszę, higieną osobistą w czasie wolnym.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000200005AE4.belarusian: Калі ласка, займайцеся асабістай гігіенай у свой вольны час.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000200005AEC.english: The lieutenant throws you an embarrassed glance as you consider the washbasin.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000200005AEC.polish: Kiedy przyglądasz się misce, porucznik rzuca ci zakłopotane spojrzenie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000200005AEC.belarusian: Калі ты глядзіш на міску, лейтэнант кідае табе збянтэжаны погляд.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002900001F06.english: Your hand shakes so hard you can't even muster up the courage to *try*. Maybe you're just too *wild* at heart?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002900001F06.polish: Dłoń trzęsie ci się tak bardzo, że nie umiesz nawet zebrać się na odwagę, żeby *spróbować*. Może w twoim sercu drzemie zbytnia *dzikość*?
