Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004FB9.english: "Good morning, comrade! Yeaaaaaah!" He waves his hand in the air. "Harder core!" The words echo magnificently throughout the nave.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004FB9.polish: „Dzień dobry, towarzyszu! Taaaak!” – woła, wymachując ręką. „Mocniejszy hardkor!” – jego słowa odbijają się w nawie wspaniałym echem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004FB9.belarusian: "Добрай раніцы, камрад! Е-е-е-е-е!" Ён махае рукой у паветры. "Яшчэ больш хардкору!" Гэтыя словы велічным рэхам разносяцца па ўсёй наве.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004FBE.english: "Welcome to Revachol! Yeaaaaaah!" He waves his hand in the air. "Harder core!" The words echo magnificently throughout the nave.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004FBE.polish: „Witam w Revacholu! Taaaak!” – woła, wymachując ręką. „Mocniejszy hardkor!” – jego słowa odbijają się w nawie wspaniałym echem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004FBE.belarusian: "Ласкава просім у Рэвашоль! Е-е-е-е-е!" Ён махае рукой у паветры. "Яшчэ больш хардкору!" Гэтыя словы велічным рэхам разносяцца па ўсёй наве.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004FC3.english: "Eat the poor! Yeaaaaaah!" He waves his hand in the air. "Harder core!" The words echo magnificently throughout the nave.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004FC3.polish: „Pożreć biednych! Taaaak!” – woła, wymachując ręką. „Mocniejszy hardkor!” – jego słowa odbijają się w nawie wspaniałym echem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004FC3.belarusian: "Жры беднату! Е-е-е-е-е!" Ён махае рукой у паветры. "Яшчэ больш хардкору!" Гэтыя словы велічным рэхам разносяцца па ўсёй наве.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004FC8.english: "A better deal! Yeaaaaaah!" He waves his hand in the air. "Medium core!" The words echo magnificently throughout the nave.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004FC8.polish: „Lepszy interes! Taaaak!” – woła, wymachując ręką. „Średni hardkor!” – jego słowa odbijają się w nawie wspaniałym echem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004FC8.belarusian: "Больш выгадная ўгода! Е-е-е-е-е!" Ён махае рукой у паветры. "Сярэдні хардкор!" Гэтыя словы велічным рэхам разносяцца па ўсёй наве.

Alternate1/0x0100006B00004FF7.polish: „Dzień dobry, towarzyszu! Taaaak!” – krzyczy, najwyraźniej nie mając pojęcia, jaką mamy porę dnia.
Alternate1/0x0100006B00004FF7.belarusian: "Добрай раніцы, камрад! Е-е-е-е-е!" — крычыць ён, відавочна не маючы ўяўлення, якая цяпер пара дня.

Alternate1/0x0100006B00004FFC.polish: „Dzień dobry, potentacie! Taaaak!” – krzyczy, najwyraźniej nie mając pojęcia, jaką mamy porę dnia.
Alternate1/0x0100006B00004FFC.belarusian: "Добрай раніцы, магнат! Е-е-е-е-е!" — крычыць ён, відавочна не маючы ўяўлення, якая цяпер пара дня.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100001EC0.english: He furrows his brow as his very large head traces the sublime invisible movement of the music in the very real air of the stuffy tent...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100001EC0.polish: Marszczy brwi, a jego głowa odwzorowuje wysublimowany, niewidzialny ruch muzyki w bardzo realnym powietrzu dusznego namiotu...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100001EC0.belarusian: Ён моршчыць лоб, пакуль ягоная вялізная галава сочыць за ўзвышаным нябачным рухам музыкі ў вельмі рэальным паветры душнага шатра...

Alternate1/0x0100007100001EC0.polish: Marszczy brwi, a jego głowa odwzorowuje wysublimowany, niewidzialny ruch muzyki w bardzo realnym powietrzu kościoła...
Alternate1/0x0100007100001EC0.belarusian: Ён моршчыць лоб, пакуль ягоная вялізная галава сочыць за ўзвышаным нябачным рухам музыкі ў вельмі рэальным паветры царквы...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A0F1.english: Or maybe it's not Gottwaldian, maybe it's *Oranjese* -- probably an homage to Oranje, where Arno van Eyck is from, judging by his name. Could you be listening to an Arno van Eyck creation *right now*?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A0F1.polish: A może nie gottwaldzko, a *oranjesko*? Chce zapewne oddać hołd Oranje, skąd, sądząc po imieniu, pochodzi Arno van Eyck. Czyżbyś *właśnie słuchał* jego dzieła?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A0F1.belarusian: Ці, можа, не готвальдскі, а *араньезскі* — імаверна, даніна павагі Аранье, адкуль, мяркуючы па імені, паходзіць Арно ван Эйк. Ці можа быць, што ты слухаеш тварэнне Арно ван Эйка *проста зараз*?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000009.english: Isn't that what *real* artists do? Make it up as they go along?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000009.polish: Czy nie to właśnie robią *prawdziwi* artyści? Wymyślają wszystko na bieżąco?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000009.belarusian: Хіба не гэта робяць *сапраўдныя* мастакі? Прыдумляюць усё на хаду?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000010.english: Whereof one cannot speak, one ought to remain silent.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000010.polish: Tam, gdzie nie ma się nic do powiedzenia, należy milczeć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000010.belarusian: Пра што немагчыма гаварыць, пра тое варта маўчаць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000016.english: Just make it up. No way this speedfreak can tell the difference.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000016.polish: Nazmyślaj coś. Ten speedziarz i tak się nie połapie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000016.belarusian: "Проста выдумай нешта. Гэты хуткарэз усё адно не заўважыць розніцы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000025.english: The young man bobs his head to the music, much as before.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000025.polish: Młody człowiek kiwa głową w rytm muzyki tak jak do tej pory.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000025.belarusian: Юнак ківае галавой у такт музыцы, як і раней.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000002E.english: You scrape the mouldy recesses of your brain for some technological sounding jargon. It'll impress the large-headed speedfreak.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000002E.polish: Sięgasz w zapleśniałe zakątki swojego mózgu w poszukiwaniu technicznie brzmiącego żargonu. Zaimponujesz nim wielkogłowemu speedziarzowi.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000002E.belarusian: Ты шкрабешся па заплеснелых закутках свайго мозгу ў пошуках тэхналагічнага жаргону. Гэта ўразіць велікагаловага хуткарэза.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000037.english: "You should crank up the, uh, oscillator matrix."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000003E.english: "Dude, you gotta reroute the sound juice through the fluxifier!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000003E.polish: „Stary, musisz przefiltrować sok dźwiękowy przez fluksyfikator!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000003E.belarusian: "Чувак, табе трэба перанакіраваць гукавы сок праз флуксіфікатар!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000045.english: "The fluxifier?" The man's brow furrows with concern. "Where is that?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000045.polish: „Fluksyfikator?” – mężczyzna marszczy z przejęciem brew. „A gdzie to jest?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000045.belarusian: "Флуксіфікатар?" Мужчына заклапочана ссоўвае бровы. "А дзе гэта?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000004C.english: "Oscillator matrix?" The man's brow furrows with concern. "Where is that?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000004C.polish: „Macierz oscylatora?” – mężczyzna marszczy z przejęciem brew. „A gdzie to jest?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000004C.belarusian: "Матрыцу асцылятара?" Мужчына заклапочана ссоўвае бровы. "А дзе гэта?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000005A.english: "Oh, you don't *have* one? Maybe it's just top-secret cop-tech."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000005A.polish: „Och, *nie macie* go? Może to jakaś ściśle tajna technologia policyjna”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000005A.belarusian: "О, у вас яе *няма*? Можа, гэта проста звышсакрэтныя копаўскія тэхналогіі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000060.english: "It's nowhere. I just made it up."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000066.english: "Here, let a pro show you how it's done." (Turn some knobs at random.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000066.polish: „Daj, pokażę, jak robią to zawodowcy”. (Pokręć kilkoma losowymi gałkami).
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000066.belarusian: "Дай прафесіянал пакажа табе, як гэта робіцца". (Папакручваць нейкія выпадковыя ручкі.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000078.english: "You gotta bring us some, Big Sheriff! The future of hard sine depends on it!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000078.polish: „Musisz nam ją skombinować, wielki szeryfie! Zależy od tego przyszłość hardkorowej fali!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000078.belarusian: "Ты мусіш прынесці нам такое, Вялікі Шэрыф! Будучыня хард-сінуса залежыць ад гэтага!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000082.english: As you fiddle with the knobs on the mixer, the young man stares with amazement...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000082.polish: Młody mężczyzna z zachwytem przygląda się, jak gmerasz przy pokrętłach miksera...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000082.belarusian: Пакуль ты круціш ручкі на мікшары, юнак глядзіць на цябе з захапленнем...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000089.english: "Cop-man can ride the knobs! SO COOL." He gives you a thumbs up.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000089.polish: „Glina zna się na ujeżdżaniu gałek! FAJNIE!” – woła i pokazuje kciuki w górę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000089.belarusian: "Дзядзька мент умее кіраваць ручкамі! ТАК КРУТА". Ён паказвае табе вялікі палец.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000090.english: Whatever it is you did, it seems to have helped slightly. Maybe now you'll be able to make sense of it?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000090.polish: Cokolwiek zrobiłeś, wydaje się, że nieco to pomogło. Może teraz uda ci się coś z tego zrozumieć?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000090.belarusian: Што б ты ні зрабіў, гэта, здаецца, трохі дапамагло. Можа, цяпер ты здолееш нешта ў гэтым зразумець?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000097.english: The large-headed youth gives you a sorely disappointed look...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000097.polish: Młodzian o wielkiej głowie rzuca ci bardzo rozczarowane spojrzenie...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B00000097.belarusian: Велікагаловы юнак глядзіць на цябе з глыбокім расчараваннем...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000009E.english: An innocent soul, unaccustomed to acts of wanton guile.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000009E.polish: Niewinna dusza, nienawykła do aktów nieokiełznanej przebiegłości.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B0000009E.belarusian: Нявінная душа, нязвыклая да праяў беспадстаўнай хітрасці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B000000A5.english: A cruel joke to play on an earnest torque dork.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B000000A5.polish: Okrutny żart kosztem pełnego zapału mechanicznego szura.

Alternate1/0x0100008B000000A5.polish: Okrutny żart kosztem brata w mechanicznym szurstwie.
Alternate1/0x0100008B000000A5.belarusian: Жорсткі жарт з брата па аўтазадроцтве.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008B000000AE.english: It's hard to say for sure, but the digital throbbing seems ever so slightly louder than before.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B000000AE.polish: Ciężko powiedzieć to z całą pewnością, ale cyfrowe pulsowanie wydaje się minimalnie głośniejsze niż wcześniej.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008B000000AE.belarusian: Цяжка сказаць напэўна, але лічбавая пульсацыя здаецца ледзь-ледзь гучнейшай, чым раней.

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000045BF.english: "Now... if only we had the melody for the *full effect*!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000045BF.belarusian: "А зараз... каб жа ў нас была мелодыя для *поўнага эфекту*!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000045CD.english: "Now if only we had the beat for the *full assault*. It would be unbelievably hyper!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000045CD.polish: „Gdybyśmy mieli jeszcze bit, który *dopełniłby dzieła*... To by było niewiarygodnie hiperowe!”
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000045CD.belarusian: "Каб жа ў нас цяпер яшчэ быў біт для *поўнага штурму*. Гэта было б неверагодна гіпер!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000045DD.english: "Don't listen to him," the man yells over the music. "He's making shit up. There's no top-secret cop audio tech -- there's other top-secret-spying-on-people tech most likely, but cops don't care about *music*."
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000045DD.polish: „Nie słuchaj go” – przekrzykuje muzykę jego towarzysz. „On to zmyśla. Nie żadnej ściśle tajnej policyjnej technologii dźwiękowej – na pewno są jakieś inne ściśle tajne technologie do szpiegowania ludzi, ale gliny mają gdzieś *muzykę*”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000045DD.belarusian: "Не слухай яго, — крычыць хлопец скрозь музыку. — Ён выдумляе херню. Няма ніякіх звыхсакрэтных паліцэйскіх аўдыётэхналогій — хутчэй за ўсё, ёсць іншыя сакрэтныя тэхналогіі для сачэння за людзьмі, але копам пляваць на *музыку*"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001BDE.english: Like that guy from the pawnshop, what was his name? The Bird's Nest Roy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001BDE.polish: Jak ten gość z lombardu. Jak mu było? Roy z Gniazda.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001BDE.belarusian: Як той хлопец з ламбарда, як яго звалі? Птушынае Гняздо Рой.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000000A8.english: "There's a record store in Jamrock, but that's a bit far away... Maybe some local shopkeeper or handyman can help you fix it?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000000A8.polish: „W Jamrock jest sklep z nagraniami, ale to trochę daleko stąd... Może jakiś miejscowy sklepikarz albo złota rączka będzie w stanie ją dla pana naprawić?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000000A8.belarusian: "У Джэмроку ёсць крама кружэлак, але гэта трохі далёка... Можа, нейкі мясцовы крамнік ці майстар на ўсе рукі дапаможа вам яе паправіць?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000001E7.english: "Maybe Arno van Eyck lives around here and just threw a part of his song away, because he thought it was shit?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000001E7.polish: „Może Arno van Eyck mieszka gdzieś w okolicy i po prostu wyrzucił fragment numeru, bo uznał, że jest gówniany?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000001E7.belarusian: "Можа, Арно ван Эйк жыве недзе паблізу і проста выкінуў частку сваёй песні, бо палічыў яе лайном?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000001EE.english: "Intriguing. The way I see it... van Eyck based his remix on some famous original piece. Like, a folk song? Something local. Seems you found an initial part with the main melody."
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000001EE.polish: „Intrygujące. Według mnie... van Eyck oparł swój remiks na jakiejś słynnej oryginalnej melodii. Może na ludowej piosence? To musiało być coś miejscowego. Zdaje się, że znalazł pan początkowy fragment z główną melodią”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000001EE.belarusian: "Цікава. Як на мяне... ван Эйк узяў за аснову рэміксу нейкі вядомы арыгінал. Кшталту народнай песні? Нешта мясцовае. Выглядае, што вы знайшлі пачатковы фрагмент з галоўнай мелодыяй".

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000001F5.english: "I think it's just happenstance. Chaos in action. Contingencies of our limited existence. That and Egg Head's fantastic talent." He nods to his friend behind the turntables.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000001F5.polish: „Ja myślę, że to po prostu szczęśliwy zbieg okoliczności. Działanie chaosu. Ewentualność naszej ograniczonej egzystencji. Oraz fantastyczny talent Jajkogłowca” – stwierdza, kiwając głową w kierunku swojego przyjaciela za konsolą.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000001F5.belarusian: "Я лічу, гэта проста выпадковасць. Хаос у дзеянні. Непрадказальнасць нашага абмежаванага існавання. Ну і фантастычны талент Яйкагаловага". Ён ківае свайму сябру за мікшарам.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000001FC.english: "Andre's got it. Sounds like a local song re-mixed."
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000001FC.polish: „Andre trafił w sedno. To brzmi jak remiks miejscowej piosenki”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000001FC.belarusian: "Андрэ мае рацыю. Гучыць як рэмікс мясцовай песні."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000203.english: "I agree with Noid, it's just luck -- *and* Egg Head's incredible mixing skills."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000203.polish: „Zgadzam się z Noikiem. To łut szczęścia. *I* niesamowite umiejętności remikserskie Jajkogłowca”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000203.belarusian: "Я згодны з Ноікам, гэта проста ўдача — *і* неверагодныя навыкі міксавання Яйкагаловага."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000213.english: "But it's all blocked with that stupid traffic jam right now! Anyway..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000213.polish: „Ale w tej chwili cała ta ulica jest zapchana ciężarówkami! Więc...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000213.belarusian: "Але зараз там усё заблакавана тым дурным заторам! У любым выпадку..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000210000023A.english: "Basically what you need to find here is a tape with some banging music on it, so that Egg Head could use it to remix van Eyck's jam."
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000023A.polish: „Musi pan po prostu znaleźć taśmę z jakąś wypasioną muzyką, żeby Jajkogłowiec mógł użyć jej do zremiksowania kawałka van Eycka”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000023A.belarusian: "У прынцыпе, усё, што вам трэба тут знайсці, — гэта стужка з нейкай афігеннай музыкай, каб Яйкагаловы мог выкарыстаць яе для рэміксу трэка ван Эйка".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000241.english: "Yeah. Maybe that streethawker across the pawnshop has got some tapes to sell? That's just an idea."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000241.polish: „Taa... Może ten uliczny handlarz stojący naprzeciw lombardu ma jakieś taśmy na sprzedanie? Warto sprawdzić”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000241.belarusian: "Ага. Можа, той вулічны гандляр насупраць ламбарда мае нейкія стужкі на продаж? Гэта проста ідэя".

Dialogue Text/0x010000210000024F.english: "Anyway... That's all yours to figure out, cop-man."
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000024F.polish: „W każdym razie... To pan to musi ogarnąć, panie policjancie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000024F.belarusian: "У любым выпадку... Гэта вам разбірацца, дзядзька мент".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000265.english: "What about the bass? Do you have any ideas for that?" Andre looks back at you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000265.polish: „A co z basem? Jakieś pomysły?” – pyta Andre, spoglądając na ciebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000265.belarusian: "А што з басам? У вас ёсць нейкія ідэі на гэты конт?" — Андрэ азіраецца на цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000279.english: "What if... we used that crazy sound assault from Soona's experiment, but contained, tamed it -- made it pulse?" (Proceed with task.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000279.polish: „A gdybyśmy... użyli tego wariackiego szturmu dźwięku z eksperymentu Soony, ale go okiełznali, opanowali? Zrobili z niego puls?” (Kontynuuj zadanie).
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000279.belarusian: "А што калі... мы выкарыстаем той шалёны гукавы штурм з эксперыменту Суны, але стрымаем яго, утаймуем — зробім пульсам?" (Працягнуць заданне.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000280.english: "Honestly, nothing springs to my mind right now. But I'll see if I can come up with a solution down the lane." (Proceed with task.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000280.polish: „Szczerze mówiąc, nic nie przychodzi mi do głowy. Ale spróbuję znaleźć jakieś rozwiązanie później”. (Kontynuuj zadanie).
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000280.belarusian: "Шчыра кажучы, зараз нічога ў галаву не прыходзіць. Але я пагляджу, ці змагу знайсці рашэнне пазней". (Працягнуць заданне.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000286.english: "I think it's good enough the way it is. Adding that melody has already been a *massive* improvement. It's pretty hard core now." (Finish task.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000286.polish: „Wydaje mi się, że to już wystarczająco dobry numer. Dodanie melodii *ogromnie* go poprawiło. Jest już nieźle hardkorowy”. (Zakończ zadanie).
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000286.belarusian: "Думаю, ён і так дастаткова добры. Дадаць гэтую мелодыю ўжо было *велічэзным* паляпшэннем. Цяпер гэта даволі хардкорна". (Скончыць заданне.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000210000028C.english: "Yeah, I remember -- you said it needs more bass!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000028C.polish: „No tak, pamiętam – mówiłeś, że ten kawałek potrzebuje więcej basów!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000028C.belarusian: "Ага, я памятаю — ты казаў, што трэба больш басу!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000298.english: "Ooh. Ooh!" Egg Head's puzzled face turns into a wicked grin. "But how?!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000298.polish: „Och... Ooooch!” – na początkowo zdezorientowanej twarzy Jajkogłowca pojawia się zawadiacki uśmieszek. „Ale jak?!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000298.belarusian: "О-о-у. О-о-у!" Збянтэжаны твар Яйкагаловага расплываецца ў хітрай усмешцы. "Але як?!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000210000029E.english: What do we have around here to achieve some sort of... *parallel processing*...
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000029E.polish: Co może być takiego w pobliżu, co pozwoliłoby uzyskać jakieś... *przetwarzanie równoległe*...
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000029E.belarusian: Што б мы маглі тут выкарыстаць для... *паралельнай апрацоўкі*...

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002A4.english: What about that compressor Andre was setting up... to achieve some sort of *parallel processing*.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002A4.polish: A gdyby tak użyć kompresora, który przygotowywał Andre? Zastosować jakieś *przetwarzanie równoległe*...
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002A4.belarusian: А што наконт таго кампрэсара, які наладжваў Андрэ... каб дасягнуць нейкай *паралельнай апрацоўкі*.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002B8.english: "You're *THE WARRIOR*! THE WARRIOR OF DANCE MUSIC!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002C4.english: "Don't be too hard on yourself if you don't figure it out. I think the jam's already pretty ultra."
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002C4.polish: „Proszę nie być dla siebie zbyt surowym, jeśli nie jest pan w stanie tego rozgryźć. Według mnie ten kawałek już i tak jest całkiem ultra”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002C4.belarusian: "Не карайце сябе занадта строга, калі не прыдумаеце. Як на мяне, гэты трэк ужо даволі ультра".

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002CB.english: "But it could be hyper, HYPER HARD CORE!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002CB.belarusian: "Але ён мог бы быць гіпер, ГІПЕРХАРДКОРНЫМ!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002D4.english: "HARD CORE! Not exactly the hyper that I was hoping for, but... it's definitely ULTRA!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002D4.polish: „HARDKOR! Nie do końca tak hiperowe, jak liczyłem, ale... zdecydowanie ULTRA!”
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002D4.belarusian: "ХАРДКОР! Не зусім тое гіпер, на якое я спадзяваўся, але... гэта безумоўна УЛЬТРА!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002E3.english: "I think you did an amazing job here, detective. I would have never thought that van Eyck could be improved on -- but you did it, you made it even better than before."
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002E3.polish: „Moim zdaniem niesamowicie się pan spisał, detektywie. Nigdy nie pomyślałbym, że da się ulepszyć van Eycka, ale pan to osiągnął – sprawił pan, że ten kawałek jest jeszcze lepszy”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002E3.belarusian: "Я лічу, вы прарабілі неверагодную працу, дэтэктыве. Я б ніколі не падумаў, што ван Эйка можна палепшыць — але вы гэта зрабілі, зрабілі яго яшчэ лепшым, чым раней".

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002EC.english: "Yeah, plus it's good to know your limits."
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002EC.polish: „No i dobrze jest znać swoje ograniczenia”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000002EC.belarusian: "Ага, да таго ж карысна ведаць свае межы".

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000157AE.english: Could it be? Maybe for him -- you only have a chapter or two left in you. Last of the penultimate, more like...
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000157AE.polish: Czyżby? Może dla niego. Tobie został tylko jeden czy dwa rozdziały. Prędzej to ostatni z przedostatnich...
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000157AE.belarusian: Няўжо? Можа, для яго — а ў табе засталося хіба раздзел-другі. Хутчэй ужо апошні з перадапошніх...

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000157BC.english: Whooh, thank god -- adapters noticeably degrade the sound quality.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000157BC.polish: Uf, dzięki bogu. Adaptery znacząco obniżają jakość dźwięku.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000157BC.belarusian: "Фух, дзякуй богу — перахаднікі прыкметна пагаршаюць якасць гуку".

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000157D0.english: Here's an idea -- say what you said before. The exact same thing! OR. Or, wait! Say something that's only marginally different! It will yield a drastically different outcome.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000157D0.polish: Mam taki pomysł: powiedz to, co mówiłeś wcześniej. Dokładnie to samo! Albo... Albo czekaj! Powiedz coś tylko minimalnie innego! Rezultat będzie kompletnie inny.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000157D0.belarusian: Вось ідэя — скажы тое, што казаў раней. Акурат тое ж самае! АБО. Не, пачакай! Скажы нешта толькі ледзь-ледзь іншае! Гэта дасць зусім іншы вынік.

Dialogue Text/0x010000350000002E.english: "Hey..." Acele looks up from her microphone. "What did you do to Egg Head, cop-man? Did you *break* him?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000350000002E.polish: „Hej...” – odzywa się Acele znad swojego mikrofonu. „Co zrobiłeś Jajkogłowcowi, gliniarzu? *Zepsułeś* go?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000350000002E.belarusian: "Гэй..." Асэль падымае вочы ад мікрафона. "Што ты зрабіў з Яйкагаловым, дзядзька мент? Ты яго *зламаў*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100003500000043.english: "Uh, no, actually I found it tangled up in a hawthorn tree..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100003500000043.polish: „Eee, nie. Znalazłem ją zaplątaną w gałęziach głogu...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100003500000043.belarusian: "Э-э, не, насамрэч я знайшоў яе заблытанай у галлі глогу..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000350000004C.english: "Listen, I'm just going to show it to you... Ready?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000350000004C.polish: „Słuchaj, po prostu ci to puszczę... Gotowy?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000350000004C.belarusian: "Слухай, я зараз табе гэта пакажу... Гатовы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100003500000067.english: "Just wait and see." (Nod at Egg Head.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000350000008A.english: Noid straightens his back, ready for the beat...
Dialogue Text/0x010000350000008A.polish: Noik prostuje plecy, szykując się na bit...
Dialogue Text/0x010000350000008A.belarusian: Ноік выпрамляе спіну, рыхтуючыся да біту...

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E15E.english: Your cop training did not prepare you for this. What to do?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E15E.polish: Twoje policyjne szkolenie cię na to nie przygotowało. Co zrobić?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E15E.belarusian: Твая паліцэйская падрыхтоўка цябе да такога не рыхтавала. Што рабіць?

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F781.english: A great excitement is bubbling to the surface within him. This is *big*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F781.polish: Aż wrze w jego wnętrzu ogromne podniecenie. To *duża rzecz*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F781.belarusian: У ім віруе ашаламляльнае хваляванне. Гэта нешта *вялікае*.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000027D6.english: Chill, my man. You'll get there -- eventually.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000027D6.polish: Spokojnie, chłopaku. Kiedyś w końcu to osiągniesz.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000027D6.belarusian: Астынь, дружа. Ты туды дабярэшся — у рэшце рэшт.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000027DD.english: "Oh no, please become one..." (He didn't even notice you mentioning some 'island'.) "You'll miss out on so much good content otherwise. It's like being the greatest cop on earth!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000027DD.polish: „O nie, proszę – zostań nim...” (Nie zauważył nawet, że wspomniałeś o jakiejś »wyspie«). „W przeciwnym razie przegapisz mnóstwo świetnej muzyki. Byłbyś najwspanialszym gliną na Ziemi!”
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000027DD.belarusian: "О не, калі ласка, стань ім..." (Ён нават не заўважыў, што ты згадаў нейкі 'востраў'.) "Інакш ты прапусціш столькі файнай музыкі. Гэта як быць найлепшым копам на зямлі!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000027E9.english: Wait, they want you to run all the way back to Martinaise with that leg of yours, just to get some 'tape'? Ouch.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000027E9.polish: Czekaj, czy oni chcą, żebyś z tą swoją ranną nogą leciał całą drogę z powrotem do Martinaise, żeby zabrać jakąś taśmę? Auć.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000027E9.belarusian: Пачакай, яны хочуць, каб ты бег назад праз увесь Марцінэз на сваёй хворай назе толькі дзеля нейкай 'стужкі'? Ой.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000027FD.english: It's your health -- you're not well enough to run around just days after you've been shot.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000027FD.polish: To kwestia twojego zdrowia. Nie jesteś wystarczająco sprawny, żeby tak biegać w tę i we w tę ledwie kilka dni po tym, jak dostałeś kulkę.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000027FD.belarusian: Гэта тваё здароўе — ты не настолькі паправіўся, каб бегаць туды-сюды праз пару дзён пасля агнястрэльнага ранення.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002A31.english: I think you might know the answer...

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002A42.english: You can't just leave it without a bass track!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002A42.polish: Nie możesz tak zostawić tego numeru bez ścieżki basowej!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002A42.belarusian: Ты не можаш проста так пакінуць трэк без басовай партыі!

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002EE6.english: Noid's right, Egg Head's technical talent is the key.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002EE6.polish: Noik ma rację, kluczowy jest tutaj talent techniczny Jajkogłowca.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002EE6.belarusian: Ноік мае рацыю, тэхнічны талент Яйкагаловага — гэта ключ.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F07.english: "Yeagh, re-mix time!" His voice booms through the church as he takes the tape and attaches it to the empty reel slot. "Tape goes here -- into deck B." He clicks a switch, the tape starts spinning...
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F07.polish: „O taaak, pora na remiks!” – jego głos odbija się w pomieszczeniu echem, gdy bierze od ciebie taśmę i wkłada szpulę na wolne miejsce na konsolecie. „Taśma idzie tutaj – do odtwarzacza B” – pstryka przełącznikiem i szpula zaczyna wirować...
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F07.belarusian: "Е-е-а, час для рэміксу!" Ягоны голас грыміць па царкве, калі ён бярэ стужку і ўстаўляе яе ў пустую катушачную дэку. "Стужка ідзе сюды — у дэку Б". Ён пстрыкае тумблерам, стужка пачынае круціцца...

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F17.english: "Hear that?" He grins with glee. "Sounds like the missing part of van Eyck's jam!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F17.polish: „Słyszysz to?” – pyta, uśmiechając się z radością. „Brzmi jak brakująca część numeru van Eycka!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F17.belarusian: "Чуеш гэта?" Ён радасна вышчарваецца. "Гучыць як адсутная частка трэка ван Эйка!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F27.english: "Whooh, hear that?!" He wipes his brow. "The sines match perfectly!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F27.polish: „Łooo, słyszysz to?!” – woła, ocierając czoło. „Fale idealnie do siebie pasują!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F27.belarusian: "О-о-у, чуеш гэта?!" Ён выцірае лоб. "Сінусы ідэальна супадаюць!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F4A.english: Noid's right, Egg Head's technical talent is the key.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F4A.polish: Noik ma rację, kluczowy jest tutaj talent techniczny Jajkogłowca.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F4A.belarusian: Ноік мае рацыю, тэхнічны талент Яйкагаловага — гэта ключ.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F50.english: No, this is definitely part of the same song. Something cut from it. It fits too well.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F50.polish: Nie, to ewidentnie część tego samego utworu. Coś wcześniej wyciętego. Za bardzo pasuje.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002F50.belarusian: Не, гэта безумоўна частка таго ж трэка. Нешта з яго выразанае. Яны занадта добра пасуюць адно да аднаго.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000057D9.english: It's colder outside than you were expecting. You see the lieutenant, standing there, a small cloud of white escaping from his mouth...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000057D9.polish: Na zewnątrz jest zimniej, niż się spodziewałeś. Widzisz porucznika stojącego w białym obłoku wydobywającego się z jego ust...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000057D9.belarusian: На дварэ халадней, чым ты чакаў. Ты бачыш лейтэнанта: ён стаіць там, а з рота ў яго вырываецца маленькае белае воблачка...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000057E0.english: He turns to you, but says nothing.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000057E0.polish: Odwraca się do ciebie, ale milczy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000057E0.belarusian: Ён паварочваецца да цябе, але маўчыць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000057E7.english: He's waiting to see what you do. For god's sake say you fucked up, please.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000057E7.polish: Czeka, żeby zobaczyć, co zrobisz. Na litość boską, powiedz, że zjebałeś. Proszę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000057E7.belarusian: Ён чакае, што ты зробіш. Дзеля ўсяго святога, скажы, што ты аблажаўся, калі ласка.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000057EE.english: "I think I fucked up back there..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005803.english: "Detective," he says, his voice level as a tabletop.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005803.belarusian: "Дэтэктыве, - кажа ён роўным, як стол, голасам."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000580C.english: There won't be any preamble chit-chat this time. Get to the point.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000580C.polish: Tym razem nie będzie żadnej wstępnej dyskusji. Przejdź do rzeczy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000580C.belarusian: Гэтым разам ніякай свецкай балбатні для пачатку не будзе. Пераходзь да сутнасці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005813.english: "What's *my* problem?" he says, his voice rising with indignation...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005813.polish: „O co *mi* chodzi?” – odpowiada pytaniem, a w jego głosie słychać narastające wzburzenie...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005813.belarusian: "У чым *мая* праблема? - кажа ён, і ў ягоным голасе расце абурэнне..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000581A.english: "You're a real piece of work, detective, you know that?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000581A.belarusian: "Ну і фрукт жа вы, дэтэктыве, ведаеце гэта?"

Alternate1/0x0100008E0000581A.belarusian: "Ну і фрукт жа вы, Гары, ведаеце гэта?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000582F.english: "Hey, I made a mistake, but it's not all my fault, you know."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000582F.polish: „Hej, popełniłem błąd, ale wiesz, to nie wszystko moja wina”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000582F.belarusian: "Гэй, я памыліўся, але гэта не цалкам мая віна, ведаеш".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005843.english: "Really? It's not your *fault* that you're *down with racism* or whatever you told that lorryman?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005843.polish: „Poważnie? To nie twoja *wina*, że *rasizm ci pasuje*, czy co tak powiedziałeś temu kierowcy ciężarówki?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005843.belarusian: "Сапраўды? Гэта не ваша *віна*, што вы *за расізм* ці што вы там наплялі таму кіроўцу грузавіка?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005852.english: "It's not your *fault* that you subscribed to Measurehead's inane racial theories?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005852.polish: „To nie twoja *wina*, że poparłeś szalone rasistowskie teorie Miarogłowego?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005852.belarusian: "Гэта не ваша *віна*, што вы павяліся на бязглуздыя расавыя тэорыі Мерагаловага?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005869.polish: Porucznik wpatruje się w ciebie beznamiętnie.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005870.english: What are you, a petulant child? He expects you to apologize.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005870.polish: Co ty, nadąsane dziecko jesteś? Oczekuje, że przeprosisz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005870.belarusian: Ты што, капрызнае дзіця? Ён чакае, што ты папросіш прабачэння.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000587D.english: "I'm not apologizing, if that's what you're waiting for."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000587D.polish: „Nie zamierzam przepraszać, jeśli na to czekasz”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000587D.belarusian: "Я не збіраюся прасіць прабачэння, калі ты гэтага чакаеш".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005891.english: MAKE IT RIGHT. MORE THAN YOU KNOW DEPENDS ON IT.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005891.polish: NAPRAW TO. NA SZALI LEŻY WIĘCEJ, NIŻ SOBIE ZDAJESZ SPRAWĘ.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005891.belarusian: ВЫПРАЎ ГЭТА. АД ГЭТАГА ЗАЛЕЖЫЦЬ БОЛЬШ, ЧЫМ ТЫ ДУМАЕШ.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000589A.english: He is your half-brother and you're driving him away. For what?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000589A.polish: To twój przyrodni brat, a ty go tak traktujesz. I za co?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000589A.belarusian: Ён твой зводны брат, а ты адштурхоўваеш яго. Дзеля чаго?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000589F.english: "It's not your *fault* that you buy into whatever conspiracies bug-chasing cryptofascists feed you?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000589F.polish: „To nie twoja *wina*, że wierzysz w konspiracyjne teorie, którymi karmią cię polujący na robactwo kryptofaszyści?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000589F.belarusian: "Гэта не ваша *віна*, што вы верыце ва ўсе канспіралагічныя тэорыі, якімі вас кормяць лаўцы жамяры, гэтыя крыптафашысты?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000058AF.english: "I don't see why you're getting all bent out of shape over a *word*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000058AF.polish: „Nie rozumiem, czemu aż tak się irytujesz przez głupie *słowo*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000058AF.belarusian: "Не разумею, чаго ты так завёўся праз нейкае *слова*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000058BB.english: "What do you want me to do?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000058D2.english: The lieutenant sighs. "Maybe it really *isn't* your fault. You might just be an irretrievable human catastrophe..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000058D2.polish: Porucznik wzdycha. „Może to rzeczywiście *nie jest* twoja wina. Może jesteś po prostu beznadziejną ludzką katastrofą...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000058D2.belarusian: Лейтэнант уздыхае: "Можа, гэта сапраўды *не* ваша віна. Можа, вы проста безнадзейная чалавечая катастрофа..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000058FF.english: "Let me ask you something..." He leans in to inspect you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000058FF.polish: „Pozwól, że o coś cię zapytam...” – stwierdza, przysuwając się do ciebie, by lepiej ci się przyjrzeć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000058FF.belarusian: "Дазвольце спытаць ваское-што... - ён нахіляецца, каб уважліва агледзець цябе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005909.english: "What do you see when you look at me?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005909.belarusian: "Каго вы бачыце, калі глядзіце на мяне?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005932.english: "Well, at least you're explicit about it. Most of the time people try to be *polite*." The lieutenant doesn't even flinch. "You know what you did *not* say I am, though?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005932.polish: „Cóż... Przynajmniej się z tym nie kryjesz. Ludzie zazwyczaj próbują być *uprzejmi*” – porucznik nawet nie drgnie. „Ale czy wiesz, kogo we mnie *nie* widzisz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005932.belarusian: "Што ж, прынамсі, вы кажаце наўпрост. Звычайна людзі спрабуюць быць *ветлівымі*. - Лейтэнант нават не тузануўся. - Але ведаеце, кім вы мяне *не* назвалі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005939.english: "Yeah, that's what most people *say*. But do you know what they *don't* say?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005939.polish: „Taa... To *mówi* większość ludzi. Ale wiesz, kogo ci ludzie we mnie *nie* widzą?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005939.belarusian: "Ага, гэта тое, што большасць людзей *кажа*. Але ведаеце, чаго яны *не* кажуць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005940.english: "That's what you're *supposed* to say, of course... But do you know what you *didn't* say?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005940.polish: „To *powinieneś* powiedzieć, oczywiście... Ale wiesz, kogo we mnie *nie* widzisz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005940.belarusian: "Вось што вы *павінны* былі сказаць, вядома ж... Але ведаеце, каго вы *не* назвалі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005947.belarusian: "Будзьце сур'ёзным хоць на хвілінку, калі ласка..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005A85.english: "You know, detective, one of your problems is that *nothing* ever seems to be your fault. Have you noticed that?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005A85.polish: „Wiesz, detektywie, jednym z twoich problemów jest to, że *nic* nigdy nie jest twoją winą. Zauważyłeś to?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005A85.belarusian: "Ведаеце, дэтэктыве, адна з вашых праблем у тым, што вы ніколі *ні ў чым* не вінаватыя. Вы заўважалі гэта?"

Alternate1/0x0100008E00005A85.polish: „Wiesz, Harry, jednym z twoich problemów jest to, że *nic* nigdy nie jest twoją winą. Zauważyłeś to?”
Alternate1/0x0100008E00005A85.belarusian: "Ведаеце, Гары, адна з вашых праблем у тым, што вы ніколі *ні ў чым* не вінаватыя. Вы заўважалі гэта?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005A90.english: You definitely could have handled that better.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005A90.belarusian: Ты дакладна мог бы справіцца лепей.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005A97.english: He's right. No one *forced* you to believe that nonsense.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005A97.polish: Ma rację. Nikt cię nie *zmuszał* do wiary w te bzdury.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005A97.belarusian: Ён мае рацыю. Ніхто не *змушаў* цябе верыць у гэтае глупства.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005A9D.english: Those theories didn't really hold up in retrospect, did they?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005A9D.polish: Te teorie, jak teraz na to spojrzeć, nie do końca się sprawdziły, nieprawdaż?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005A9D.belarusian: Гэтыя тэорыі не надта вытрымалі праверку часам, га?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005AA5.english: "Okay, you're right. I fucked up back there."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005ABE.english: "Which I guess makes *me* the idiot for hoping you could be better... I mean, *look* at yourself..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005ABE.polish: „Co czyniłoby *mnie* kretynem, który ma nadzieję, że możesz zmienić się na lepsze... *Spójrz* tylko na siebie...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005ABE.belarusian: "І гэта, напэўна, робіць *мяне* ідыётам, бо я спадзяваўся, што вы можаце стаць лепшым... Я маю на ўвазе, *паглядзіце* на сябе..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005AD1.english: Yes, look at yourself. What do you see?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005AD1.polish: Tak. Popatrz na siebie. Co widzisz?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005AD1.belarusian: Так, паглядзі на сябе. Што ты бачыш?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005ADD.polish: „Beznadziejna ludzka katastrofa” brzmi mniej więcej właściwie.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005AE3.english: A good guy, underneath it all.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005AE3.polish: Pod tą wierzchnią warstwą? Dobrego chłopaka.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005AE3.belarusian: Добрага хлопца, дзесьці ў глыбіні душы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005AF8.english: So that's it? You don't even *want* to change?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005AF8.polish: A więc to tak? Nawet *nie chcesz* się zmienić?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005AF8.belarusian: І гэта ўсё? Ты нават *не хочаш* змяніцца?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005AFF.english: If that good guy never comes out, what difference does it make?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005AFF.polish: Skoro ten dobry chłopak pozostaje wciąż w środku, to co on właściwie zmienia?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005AFF.belarusian: Калі гэты добры хлопец ніколі не вылазіць вонкі, якая розніца?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B06.english: Kind of hard to sing a duet when you're all alone on-stage, isn't it, superstar?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B06.polish: Trochę trudno śpiewać w duecie, kiedy na scenie jesteś sam, co, supergwiazdo?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B06.belarusian: Даволі цяжка спяваць дуэтам, калі ты адзін на сцэне, ці не так, суперзорка?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B20.english: "I just don't understand. We had been making *real* progress toward solving the case..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B20.polish: „Po prostu nie rozumiem. Robiliśmy *prawdziwe* postępy w rozwiązywaniu tej sprawy...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B20.belarusian: "Я проста не разумею. Мы рабілі *сапраўдны* прагрэс у раскрыцці справы..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B26.english: "You've been spinning your wheels here for *how* long? And what do you have to show for it?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B26.polish: „*Ile* już czasu spędziłeś na tym błąkaniu się po omacku? I co z tego wynikło?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B26.belarusian: "*Колькі* вы ўжо буксуеце на адным месцы? І што ў вас ёсць паказаць у выніку?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B2C.english: "You've not just been *unhelpful* when it comes to solving the case, you've been an active *hindrance* to the investigation..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B2C.polish: „Nie tylko *nie pomagałeś* w rozwiązywaniu tej sprawy, ale aktywnie *przeszkadzałeś* w śledztwie...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B2C.belarusian: "Вы не проста *не дапамагалі* раскрыццю справы, вы актыўна *перашкаджалі* расследаванню..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B35.english: "But now I'm afraid I just can't trust you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B35.polish: „Ale teraz obawiam się, że po prostu nie mogę ci ufać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B35.belarusian: "Але цяпер, баюся, я проста не магу вам давяраць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B3C.english: "Well, I'm done waiting for you to get your shit together."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B3C.polish: „Dość już mam czekania, aż weźmiesz się w garść”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B3C.belarusian: "Што ж, мне надакучыла чакаць, пакуль вы возьмеце сябе ў рукі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B5C.english: "Stop, STOP. You won't even call me by my *actual title*. It's always, 'Kim this, Kim that.' Has it even occurred to you how disrespectful that is?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B5C.polish: „Przestań, PRZESTAŃ! Nie zwracasz się nawet do mnie, stosując mój *służbowy stopień*. Ciągle tylko Kim to, Kim tamto. Czy zdajesz sobie w ogóle sprawę z tego, jak bardzo jest to lekceważące i obraźliwe?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B5C.belarusian: "Спыніцеся, СПЫНІЦЕСЯ. Вы нават не называеце мяне маім *сапраўдным званнем*. Заўсёды толькі: 'Кім тое, Кім гэта'. Вам хоць калі-небудзь прыходзіла ў галаву, наколькі гэта непаважліва?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B63.english: "But, see, you *can't*, or you just refuse to, not that the difference really matters."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B63.polish: „Problem w tym, że *nie możesz* albo po prostu nie chcesz się zmienić. Chociaż i tak nie ma to żadnego znaczenia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B63.belarusian: "Але бачыце, вы *не можаце* або проста адмаўляецеся — хоць розніца тут не мае ніякага значэння".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B6C.english: The lieutenant goes silent for a moment.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B73.english: "For the sake of the investigation... I'll stay."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B7A.belarusian: "Значыць, ты даеш мне яшчэ адзін шанец?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B81.english: "No, you fucking asshole. This isn't a *game* and you're not the *hero*. You don't *get* infinite chances to do the right thing. That's not how the world works..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B81.polish: „Nie, pieprzony dupki. To nie jest *gra*, a ty nie jesteś *bohaterem*. Nie *masz* nieskończonej liczby szans, aby postąpić właściwie. Świat tak nie działa...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B81.belarusian: "Не, блядскі вы мудак. Гэта не *гульня*, а вы не *герой*. У вас няма *бясконцых* шанцаў паступіць правільна. Свет так не працуе..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B88.english: "I'm staying because *I* have to protect the investigation *from you*..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B88.belarusian: "Я застаюся, таму што *я* павінен абараніць расследаванне *ад вас*..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B96.english: "Now, if you'll excuse me, I have some other matters to attend to. We'll meet again as usual in the morning. And detective..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B96.polish: „A teraz wybacz, ale mam coś do zrobienia. Spotkamy się ponownie tak jak zwykle rano. I, detektywie...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005B96.belarusian: "А цяпер прабачце, мне трэба залагодзіць іншыя справы. Сустрэнемся, як звычайна, раніцай. І, дэтэктыве..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BAF.english: "Okay, I know you're mad, but I actually just talked to the spirit of Revachol and she told me we need to work together..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BAF.polish: „No dobrze, wiem, że jesteś zły, ale rozmawiałem właśnie z duszą Revacholu. Powiedziała mi, że musimy współpracować...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BAF.belarusian: "Добра, я ведаю, што ты злуешся, але я толькі што гаварыў з духам Рэвашоля, і яна сказала мне, што мы мусім працаваць разам..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BB7.english: The lieutenant looks at you with a mix of pity, contempt, and alarm...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BB7.polish: Porucznik spogląda na ciebie z politowaniem, pogardą i niepokojem...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BB7.belarusian: Лейтэнант глядзіць на цябе са сумессю жалю, пагарды і трывогі...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BCB.english: "I'm working on it, I just need your help..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BCB.polish: „Pracuję nad tym, ale potrzebuję twojej pomocy...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BCB.belarusian: "Я працую над гэтым, мне проста патрэбна твая дапамога..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BD3.english: "God, *no*. I'm a detective, not a charity service for shambolic degenerates who won't help themselves..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BD3.polish: „Boże, *nie*. Jestem detektywem, a nie instytucją charytatywną zajmującą się chaotycznymi degeneratami, którzy nie są w stanie pomóc sobie sami...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BD3.belarusian: "Божа, *не*. Я дэтэктыў, а не дабрачынная служба для бязладных дэгенератаў, якія не хочуць дапамагчы самі сабе..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BDA.english: "Detective, enough. I don't want to hear about your degenerate ravings. I've heard *plenty* as it is. Just stop."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BDA.polish: „Dość tego, detektywie. Nie chcę więcej wysłuchiwać twojego zdegenerowanego bredzenia. Nasłuchałem się już go *ponad miarę*. Po prostu przestań”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005BDA.belarusian: "Дэтэктыве, досыць. Я не хачу чуць вашага дэгенерацкага трызнення. Я і так наслухаўся *вышэй даху*. Проста спыніцеся".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CAE.english: You hear that? The lieutenant's staying! Brotherhood conquers all!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CAE.polish: Słyszysz? Porucznik zostaje z tobą! Braterstwo zwycięża wszystko!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CAE.belarusian: Чуеш? Лейтэнант застаецца! Братэрства перамагае ўсё!

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CB4.english: "That's great, I could still use your assistance."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CB4.polish: „To wspaniale, nadal potrzebna mi twoja pomoc”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CBA.english: "Why? I don't really need you anyway."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CBA.polish: „Ale czemu? I tak nie jesteś mi potrzebny”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CBA.belarusian: "Чаму? Ты мне ўсё адно не надта патрэбны".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CC3.english: "You fucking asshole. I'm not here to be your *loyal assistant*, and I never have been..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CC3.polish: „Ty pieprzony dupku. Nie jestem twoim *lojalnym pomocnikiem* i nigdy nim nie byłem...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CC3.belarusian: "Блядскі вы мудак. Я тут не дзеля таго, каб быць вашым *верным памагатым*, і ніколі ім не быў..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CCB.english: "Of course that's what you think, contrary to all evidence and experience. I'm not here for your sake..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CCB.polish: „Oczywiście, że tak myślisz – wbrew wszystkiemu, co się wydarzyło. Nie jestem tu z twojego powodu...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CCB.belarusian: "Вядома ж, вы так лічыце, насуперак усім фактам і досведу. Я тут не дзеля вас..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CDB.english: He has the upright bearing of a king's headsman, waiting to carry out the crown's sentence.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CDB.polish: Trzyma się prosto niczym królewski kat czekający na sygnał wykonania wyroku.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CDB.belarusian: Ён трымаецца прама, нібы каралеўскі кат, які чакае загаду выканаць прысуд кароны.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CE1.english: He's been anticipating this moment for some time. Still, it doesn't make it any easier for him to say...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CE1.polish: Spodziewał się już od dłuższego czasu, że ten moment nadejdzie. A jednak wcale mu nie jest przez to łatwiej powiedzieć...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CE1.belarusian: Ён чакаў гэтага моманту ўжо некаторы час. І ўсё ж яму ад гэтага не лягчэй сказаць...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CEF.english: The dark shadow of the church is drawn out on the sand... two men stand there, silent. Their talk is over.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CEF.polish: Mroczny cień kościoła pada na okoliczny piach... W jego objęciach stoi dwóch milczących mężczyzn. Ich rozmowa dobiegła końca.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005CEF.belarusian: Цёмны цень царквы цягнецца па пяску... двое мужчын стаяць там моўчкі. Іхняя размова скончана.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D07.english: The only doom you've brought about so far is your own.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D07.polish: Jedyne zniszczenie, jakie dotąd skutecznie obwieściłeś, to twój własny upadek.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D07.belarusian: Адзіная пагібель, якую ты пакуль спрычыніў, — твая ўласная.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D17.english: "I don't suppose anyone ever questions whether you belong here. No matter how badly you fuck up, no matter what a mess you make, you never *stop* being Revacholian..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D17.polish: „Nie sądzę, aby ktokolwiek kwestionował kiedykolwiek to, czy powinieneś tu być. Niezależnie od tego, jak mocno spieprzysz sprawę... Niezależnie od tego, jak wielkiego bajzlu narobisz... Nigdy nie *przestajesz* być revacholczykiem...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D17.belarusian: "Не думаю, што хоць нехта калі-небудзь сумняваецца, ці ваша гэтае месца. Як бы моцна вы ні налажалі, які б вэрхал ні ўчынілі, вы ніколі не *перастаяце* быць рэвашольцам..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D2C.english: "People call me all sorts of things. But you know the one thing they *never* call me?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D2C.polish: „Ludzie nazywają mnie różnie. Ale wiesz, kogo we mnie *nigdy* nie widzą?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D2C.belarusian: "Людзі называюць мяне па-рознаму. Але ведаеце адзіную рэч, якой яны мяне *ніколі* не называюць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D62.english: "I was born here. I grew up here. It's the only *home* I've ever known. And there's a good chance I'll die in the line of duty here, too."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D62.polish: „Ja urodziłem się tu. Dorastałem tu. To jedyny *dom*, jaki znam. I istnieje duże prawdopodobieństwo tego, że zginę tu na służbie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D62.belarusian: "Я нарадзіўся тут. Я вырас тут. Гэта адзіны *дом*, які я калі-небудзь ведаў. І ёсць вялікая імавернасць, што я загіну тут пры выкананні абавязкаў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D6F.english: "But -- to most of my countrymen, I will always be some *monkey fucker*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D6F.polish: „Ale – dla większości moich ziomków – zawsze będę jakimś *małpojebcą*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005D6F.belarusian: "Але для большасці маіх суайчыннікаў я заўсёды застануся нейкім *малпаёбам*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005DF3.english: "I don't suppose anyone ever questions whether you belong here. Whatever your faults, you're a decent-enough detective. No one will ever *doubt* that you're a real Revacholian..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005DF3.polish: „Nie sądzę, aby ktokolwiek kwestionował kiedykolwiek to, czy powinieneś tu być. Mimo swoich wad jesteś dość przyzwoitym detektywem. Nikt nigdy nie będzie *wątpił* w to, że jesteś prawdziwym revacholczykiem...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005DF3.belarusian: "Не думаю, што хоць нехта калі-небудзь сумняваецца, ці ваша гэтае месца. Якія б ні былі вашыя заганы, вы досыць прыстойны дэтэктыў. Ніхто ніколі не *ўсумніцца*, што вы сапраўдны рэвашолец..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005DF9.english: "I don't suppose anyone ever questions whether you belong here. Whatever your faults, you're a solid detective. You're *obviously* Revacholian..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005DF9.polish: „Nie sądzę, aby ktokolwiek kwestionował kiedykolwiek to, czy powinieneś tu być. Mimo swoich wad jesteś porządnym detektywem. Jesteś *bez wątpienia* revacholczykiem...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005DF9.belarusian: "Не думаю, што хоць нехта калі-небудзь сумняваецца, ці ваша гэтае месца. Якія б ні былі вашыя заганы, вы грунтоўны дэтэктыў. Вы *відавочна* рэвашолец..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E51.english: "Wait, before I blacked out, I *talked* to *La Revacholière*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E51.belarusian: "Пачакай, перад тым як высечыся, я *размаўляў* з *La Revacholière*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E5D.english: "I see..." the lieutenant says, tapping his foot...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E63.english: "Never mind, I was just talking crazy talk."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E63.belarusian: "Не звяртай увагі, я проста вярзу лухту".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E69.english: "I spoke with the spirit of Revachol. Or, I guess, she spoke to *me*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E69.polish: „Rozmawiałem z duszą Revacholu. A właściwie to ona przemówiła *do mnie*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E69.belarusian: "Я гаварыў з духам Рэвашоля. Ці, напэўна, яна гаварыла *са мной*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E6F.english: "Suppose I *don't* recommend you be involuntarily committed for a moment... what did *La Revacholière* say to you?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E6F.polish: „Załóżmy przez chwilę, że *nie* zarekomenduję przymusowego umieszczenia cię w szpitalu psychiatrycznym... Co powiedziała ci ta *La Revacholière*?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E6F.belarusian: "Выкажам здагадку, што на хвілінку я *не* парэкамендую прымусова шпіталізаваць вас у вар'ятню... што *La Revacholière* сказала вам?"

Alternate1/0x0100008E00005E6F.polish: „Załóżmy przez chwilę, że to nie są kolejne bzdury związane z tym twoim *zdalnym widzeniem*... Co powiedziała ci ta *La Revacholière*?”
Alternate1/0x0100008E00005E6F.belarusian: "Выкажам здагадку на хвілінку, што гэта не чарговае трызненне пра вашага *далёказорца*... што *La Revacholière* сказала вам?"

Alternate2/0x0100008E00005E6F.polish: „Załóżmy przez chwilę, że to nie były po prostu halucynacje wywołane pyrholidonem... Co powiedziała ci ta *La Revacholière*?”
Alternate2/0x0100008E00005E6F.belarusian: "Выкажам здагадку на хвілінку, што гэта не проста галюцынацыя ад піралідону... што *La Revacholière* сказала вам?"

Alternate3/0x0100008E00005E6F.polish: „Załóżmy przez chwilę, że to nie są kolejne bzdury związane z tym twoim wywoływaniem duchów... Co powiedziała ci ta *La Revacholière*?”
Alternate3/0x0100008E00005E6F.belarusian: "Выкажам здагадку на хвілінку, што гэта не чарговае глупства з выкліканнем прывідаў... што *La Revacholière* сказала вам?"

Alternate4/0x0100008E00005E6F.polish: „Załóżmy przez chwilę, że nie uganiasz się znowu po prostu za miejskimi legendami... Co powiedziała ci ta *La Revacholière*?”
Alternate4/0x0100008E00005E6F.belarusian: "Выкажам здагадку на хвілінку, што вы не проста зноў ганяецеся за гарадскімі легендамі... што *La Revacholière* сказала вам?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E7A.english: "Yes, it *does*." The lieutenant begins tapping his foot...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E81.english: The lieutenant's not comfortable talking about himself so openly. He's eager to change the subject.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E81.polish: Porucznik nie czuje się dobrze, mówiąc tak otwarcie o sobie. Bardzo chętnie zmieni temat.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E81.belarusian: Лейтэнанту няўтульна гаварыць пра сябе так адкрыта. Ён хоча хутчэй змяніць тэму.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E87.english: "In any case, I have some personal matters I'd like to get in order. If you don't object, I'm going to leave the rest of the day's investigation to you..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E87.polish: „Tak czy inaczej, muszę zająć się pewnymi prywatnymi sprawami. Jeśli nie masz nic przeciwko, to do końca dnia pozostawię nasze śledztwo w twoich rękach...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E87.belarusian: "У любым выпадку, у мяне ёсць асабістыя справы, якія я хацеў бы залагодзіць. Калі вы не супраць, я пакіну рэшту сённяшняга расследавання вам..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E9B.english: "Try not to break anything while I'm gone. I'll see you in the morning, detective."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E9B.polish: „Postaraj się niczego nie zepsuć, gdy mnie nie będzie. Zobaczymy się rano, detektywie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005E9B.belarusian: "Пастарайцеся нічога не зламаць, пакуль мяне не будзе. Убачымся раніцай, дэтэктыве".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005EAA.english: For a moment the lieutenant seems to be suppressing something uncomfortable. Then he clears his throat...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005EAA.polish: Przez chwilę porucznik zdaje się tłumić coś nieprzyjemnego. W końcu odchrząkuje...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005EAA.belarusian: На імгненне здаецца, што лейтэнант душыць у сабе нейкае няёмкае пачуццё. Потым ён адкашліваецца...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005EBA.english: "But what about all the good times we had together?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005EBA.polish: „Ale co z dobrymi wspomnieniami, jakie nas łączą?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005EBA.belarusian: "А як жа ўсе тыя добрыя моманты, што мы перажылі разам?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005EC0.english: "It was just words, Kim. They don't mean anything."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005EC0.polish: „To były tylko słowa, Kim. One nic nie znaczą”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005EC0.belarusian: "Гэта былі проста словы, Кім. Яны нічога не значаць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005ECF.english: "If they don't mean anything, why do you say them?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005ECF.polish: „Jeśli nic nie znaczą, to po co je wypowiadasz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005ECF.belarusian: "Калі яны нічога не значаць, навошта вы іх кажаце?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005EFD.english: "Don't fuck anything else up while I'm away."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005EFD.polish: „Nie spieprz niczego więcej, gdy mnie nie będzie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005EFD.belarusian: "Не налажайце больш ні ў чым, пакуль мяне не будзе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005F0B.english: The lieutenant appears caught off-guard by your response. He takes a moment to collect himself...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005F0B.polish: Porucznik sprawia wrażenie zaskoczonego twoją odpowiedzią. Potrzebuje chwili, by się pozbierać...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005F0B.belarusian: Лейтэнант выглядае знянацку заспелым тваім адказам. Яму патрабуецца хвіліна, каб апанаваць сябе...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005F12.english: "Nobody's ever said that to me before..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005F12.polish: „Nikt nigdy mi tego jeszcze nie mówił...”

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005F1D.english: The lieutenant's not comfortable with emotional openness. He's eager to change the subject.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005F1D.polish: Porucznik nie nawykł do emocjonalnej otwartości. Bardzo chętnie zmieni temat.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005F1D.belarusian: Лейтэнант не любіць эмацыйнай адкрытасці. Ён хоча хутчэй змяніць тэму.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005F24.english: "Well, good, because we *are* partners. Now, I have some personal matters I'd like to get in order. If you don't object, I'm going to leave the rest of the day's investigation to you..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005F24.polish: „No cóż... To dobrze, bo *jesteśmy* partnerami. Muszę zająć się pewnymi prywatnymi sprawami. Jeśli nie masz nic przeciwko, to do końca dnia pozostawię nasze śledztwo w twoich rękach...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005F24.belarusian: "Што ж, добра, бо мы *і ёсць* партнёры. А цяпер у мяне ёсць асабістыя справы, якія я хацеў бы залагодзіць. Калі вы не супраць, я пакіну рэшту сённяшняга расследавання вам..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005F2D.english: The dark shadow of the church is drawn out on the sand... two men part there. In silence.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005F2D.polish: Mroczny cień kościoła pada na okoliczny piach... Rozstaje się tam dwóch mężczyzn. W milczeniu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005F2D.belarusian: Цёмны цень царквы цягнецца па пяску... двое мужчын расходзяцца. У маўчанні.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005FB5.english: Hold on a moment. Maybe now's not the best time to tell the lieutenant that the world is ending...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005FB5.polish: Poczekaj no. Może to nie jest najlepszy moment na opowiadanie porucznikowi o końcu świata...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005FB5.belarusian: Пачакай хвілінку. Можа, цяпер не найлепшы час казаць лейтэнанту, што надыходзіць канец свету...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005FBC.english: "Uh... she said the RCM is gonna have an important role to play..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005FBC.polish: „Eee... Powiedziała, że MOR będzie miał ważną rolę do odegrania...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005FBC.belarusian: "Э-э... яна сказала, што РГМ давядзецца адыграць важную ролю..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005FC2.english: "She said the world is going to end in 22 years."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005FC2.polish: „Powiedziała, że świat skończy się za 22 lata”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005FC2.belarusian: "Яна сказала, што праз 22 гады настане канец свету".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005FF1.english: "What kind of *future* are we talking about here?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005FF8.english: "You know... like stuff that hasn't happened yet."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005FF8.polish: „No wiesz... O rzeczach, które się jeszcze nie wydarzyły”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00005FF8.belarusian: "Ну ведаеш... пра тое, што яшчэ не адбылося".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00006006.english: "Quit fooling around, detective." There's real urgency in the lieutenant's voice now. "What did La Revacholière tell you about the future?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00006006.polish: „Przestań się wygłupiać, detektywie” – w głosie porucznika słychać prawdziwe zniecierpliwienie. „Co La Revacholière powiedziała o przyszłości?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00006006.belarusian: "Перастаньце блазнаваць, дэтэктыве. - У голасе лейтэнанта цяпер чуваць сапраўдная трывожнасць. - Што La Revacholière сказала вам пра будучыню?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000600D.english: "She said the world is ending in 22 years."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000600D.polish: „Powiedziała, że świat skończy się za 22 lata”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000600D.belarusian: "Яна сказала, што свет скончыцца праз 22 гады".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00006014.english: "The world... is going to end..." The lieutenant considers this for a long moment...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00006014.polish: „Świat... się skończy...” – porucznik rozważa to przez chwilę.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00006026.english: The lieutenant is a rational observer of reality. His worldview can't accommodate this kind of thing.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00006026.polish: Porucznik racjonalnie ocenia rzeczywistość. Jego poglądy nie uwzględniają tego typu rzeczy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00006026.belarusian: Лейтэнант — рацыянальны назіральнік рэчаіснасці. Ягоны светапогляд не можа змясціць падобныя рэчы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000602D.english: "Promise me something, detective: You won't tell anyone else what you just told me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000602D.polish: „Obiecaj mi coś, detektywie... Obiecaj, że nikomu więcej o tym nie powiesz”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000602D.belarusian: "Абяцайце мне адну рэч, дэтэктыве: вы нікому больш не раскажаце таго, што толькі што сказалі мне".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00006035.english: "But Kim, I'm the Augur of Desolation."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000603B.english: "Are you sure? It seems kinda important."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000603B.polish: „Jesteś pewny? To się wydaje dość ważne”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00006051.english: "Now, I... think I need to take care of some personal matters for a while. If you don't object, I'm going to leave the rest of the day's investigation to you..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00006051.polish: „A teraz... Zdaje się, że muszę zająć się pewnymi prywatnymi sprawami. Jeśli nie masz nic przeciwko, to do końca dnia pozostawię nasze śledztwo w twoich rękach...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00006051.belarusian: "А цяпер... здаецца, мне трэба на нейкі час заняцца асабістымі справамі. Калі вы не супраць, я пакіну рэшту сённяшняга расследавання вам..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000606E.english: "Detective, I'm serious. Have you considered what will happen to the RCM's reputation if one of our own starts going around talking about the end of the world? In an official capacity?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000606E.polish: „Detektywie, mówię poważnie. Pomyślałeś, co stanie się z reputacją MOR-u, gdy ktoś z naszych zacznie opowiadać wszystkim o zbliżającym się końcu świata? I to na służbie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E0000606E.belarusian: "Дэтэктыве, я сур'ёзна. Вы думалі, што будзе з рэпутацыяй РГМ, калі адзін з нашых пачне хадзіць і балбатаць пра канец свету? Пры выкананні службовых абавязкаў?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D45.english: First the investigation, now this... how many more things do you have to fuck up?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D45.polish: Najpierw śledztwo, teraz to... Ile jeszcze rzeczy musisz zjebać?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D45.belarusian: Спачатку расследаванне, цяпер гэта... Колькі яшчэ ўсяго ты мусіш налажаць?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D4C.english: Sharp pain shoots through your hip, throbbing...
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D4C.polish: Przez biodro przebiega ci błyskawica ostrego, pulsującego bólu...

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D5F.english: "Now -- if it were any other day, I would leave for the night. But we have more pressing matters. We need to wrap up this investigation and we need to do it *fast*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D5F.polish: „Gdyby to był inny dzień, udałbym się teraz na nocny spoczynek. Ale mamy ważniejsze sprawy na głowie. Musimy zakończyć to śledztwo i to *szybko*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D5F.belarusian: "А цяпер — калі б гэта быў любы іншы дзень, я б пайшоў на ноч. Але ў нас ёсць больш пільныя справы. Нам трэба завяршыць гэтае расследаванне, і мы павінны зрабіць гэта *хутка*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D65.english: "Now -- if it were any other day, I would leave for the night. But we have more pressing matters. We need to get to the island -- and we need to do it as soon as possible."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D65.polish: „Gdyby to był inny dzień, udałbym się teraz na nocny spoczynek. Ale mamy ważniejsze sprawy na głowie. Musimy dostać się na wyspę – i musimy zrobić to jak najszybciej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D65.belarusian: "А цяпер — калі б гэта быў любы іншы дзень, я б пайшоў на ноч. Але ў нас ёсць больш пільныя справы. Нам трэба патрапіць на востраў — і мы павінны зрабіць гэта як мага хутчэй".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D73.english: "This case," he turns to face the sea, "is much, *much* bigger than just you and me. We're close -- let's keep it professional until the very end."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D73.polish: „Ta sprawa” – odwraca się w kierunku morza – „jest znacznie, *znacznie* ważniejsza od ciebie czy mnie. Prawie ją rozwiązaliśmy – zachowujmy się profesjonalnie do samego końca”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D73.belarusian: "Гэтая справа, - ён паварочваецца тварам да мора, - значна, *значна* большая за вас ці мяне. Мы блізка — давайце захаваем прафесіяналізм да самага канца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D7B.english: The dark shadow of the church is drawn out on the sand... two men stand there. In silence.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D7B.polish: Mroczny cień kościoła pada na okoliczny piach... Stoi tam dwóch mężczyzn. W milczeniu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002D7B.belarusian: Цёмны цень царквы цягнецца па пяску... двое мужчын стаяць там. У маўчанні.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002DC9.english: The dark shadow of the church is drawn out on the sand... two men stand there, silent. Their talk is over.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002DC9.polish: Mroczny cień kościoła pada na okoliczny piach... W jego objęciach stoi dwóch milczących mężczyzn. Ich rozmowa dobiegła końca.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002DC9.belarusian: Цёмны цень царквы цягнецца па пяску... двое мужчын стаяць там моўчкі. Іхняя размова скончана.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002DCF.english: "This case," he turns to face the sea, "is much, *much* bigger than just you or me. We're close to the end -- let's cross the finish line. Then we can part our ways."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002DCF.polish: „Ta sprawa” – odwraca się w kierunku morza – „jest znacznie, *znacznie* ważniejsza od ciebie czy mnie. Zbliżamy się do jej końca, więc dotrzyjmy razem do mety. Wtedy będziemy mogli się rozejść na dobre”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002DCF.belarusian: "Гэтая справа, - ён паварочваецца тварам да мора, - значна, *значна* большая за вас ці мяне. Мы блізкія да канца — давайце дойдзем да фінішу. І тады разыдземся".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002DDA.english: "Now -- if it were any other day, I would excuse myself for the night. But we have more pressing matters. We need to wrap up this investigation and we need to do it *fast*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002DDA.polish: „Gdyby to był inny dzień, pożegnałbym się teraz i udał na nocny spoczynek. Ale mamy ważniejsze sprawy na głowie. Musimy zakończyć to śledztwo i to *szybko*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002DDA.belarusian: "А цяпер — калі б гэта быў любы іншы дзень, я б пайшоў на ноч. Але ў нас ёсць больш пільныя справы. Нам трэба завяршыць гэтае расследаванне, і мы павінны зрабіць гэта *хутка*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002DE0.english: "Now -- if it were any other day, I would excuse myself for the night. But we have more pressing matters. We need to get to the island -- and we need to do it as soon as possible."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002DE0.polish: „Gdyby to był inny dzień, pożegnałbym się teraz i udał na nocny spoczynek. Ale mamy ważniejsze sprawy na głowie. Musimy dostać się na wyspę – i musimy zrobić to jak najszybciej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002DE0.belarusian: "А цяпер — калі б гэта быў любы іншы дзень, я б развітаўся і пайшоў на ноч. Але ў нас ёсць больш пільныя справы. Нам трэба патрапіць на востраў — і мы павінны зрабіць гэта як мага хутчэй".

Dialogue Text/0x010000400000314A.english: Just a sorry stack of shit...

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003151.english: Yeah, didn't even know they stack shit *that* sorry.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003151.polish: Tak, nie przyszło mi nawet do głowy, że istnieją kupy *aż tak* żałosnego gówna.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003151.belarusian: Ага, нават і не ведаў, што дзярмо бывае *настолькі* вартым жалю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300021117.english: "She said it was important that we stick together, as partners."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300021117.polish: „Powiedziała, że to ważne, żebyśmy trzymali się razem. Jako partnerzy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300021117.belarusian: "Яна сказала, што важна трымацца разам. Як партнёры".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B00000639.english: You see a youngish man bleaching the tips of his hair with a toothbrush. He puts the toothbrush down and extends his hand in greeting.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B00000639.polish: Widzisz dość młodo wyglądającego mężczyznę wybielającego szczoteczką do zębów końcówki swoich włosów. Odkłada szczoteczkę i wyciąga rękę na powitanie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B00000639.belarusian: Ты бачыш маладога на выгляд мужчыну, які адбельвае зубной шчоткай кончыкі сваіх валасоў. Ён адкладае шчотку і працягвае руку для прывітання.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B0000064D.english: There is definitely something futuristic about his hair, aggressively so. You get the sense that *this* is what the future will look like...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B0000064D.polish: Jego włosy mają w sobie bez wątpienia coś agresywnie futurystycznego. Masz przeczucie, że *tak właśnie* będzie wyglądać przyszłość...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B0000064D.belarusian: У яго валасах дакладна ёсць нешта футурыстычнае, нават агрэсіўна футурыстычнае. У цябе ўзнікае адчуванне, што будучыня будзе выглядаць *менавіта так*...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B00000655.english: Imbecilic. Yes, should the future ever come, it will look deeply imbecilic. Like this guy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B00000655.polish: Kretyńsko. Tak, jeśli przyszłość kiedykolwiek nadejdzie, będzie wyglądać kompletnie kretyńsko. Jak ten gość.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B00000655.belarusian: Ідыёцкай. Так, калі будучыня калі-небудзь і настане, яна будзе выглядаць несусветна ідыёцкай. Як гэты хлопец.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B00000673.english: His grip is strong, sweaty, and warm. He's trying to project and inspire confidence.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B00000673.polish: Uścisk jego dłoni jest mocny, ciepły i mokry od potu. Próbuje sprawiać wrażenie pewnego siebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B00000673.belarusian: Ягоны поціск дужы, пакрыты потам і цёплы. Ён спрабуе выпраменьваць і выклікаць упэўненасць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B00000693.english: "This is my posse: Noid..." He pauses with his hand still hanging in the air.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B00000693.polish: „To moja posse: Noik...” – robi pauzę ze wciąż wyciągniętą przed siebie dłonią.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B00000693.belarusian: "Гэта маё пасэ: Ноік..." — Ён робіць паўзу з усё яшчэ вісячай у паветры рукой.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006A9.english: The young man with earrings looks at you suspiciously.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006A9.polish: Młody mężczyzna z kolczykami przygląda ci się podejrzliwie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006A9.belarusian: Малады чалавек з завушніцамі падазрона глядзіць на цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006B0.english: "Egg!" he yells. The tape player high above his head continues to blast strange music.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006B0.polish: „Głowiec!” – krzyczy. Z magnetofonu szpulowego uniesionego wysoko nad jego głową nieustannie wydobywa się głośna i dziwna muzyka.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006B0.belarusian: "Яйка!" — крычыць ён. Стужачны магнітафон высока над яго галавой працягвае раўсці дзіўнай музыкай.

Alternate1/0x0100000B000006B0.polish: „Głowiec!” – krzyczy. Z magnetofonu szpulowego uniesionego wysoko nad jego głową nieustannie wydobywa się prawdopodobnie muzyka *anodic*.
Alternate1/0x0100000B000006B0.belarusian: "Яйка!" Стужачны магнітафон высока над яго галавой працягвае раўсці музыкай, якая, імаверна, з'яўляецца *аноднай*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006BF.english: "Together with Acele Berger -- who's out there right now, doing some *seriously* progressive sonic experimentation -- we like to think of ourselves as 'music venue organizers.'"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006BF.polish: „Razem z Acele Berger, która w tej chwili zajmuje się w terenie *poważnie* progresywnymi eksperymentami sonicznymi, tworzymy grupę »organizatorów lokalu muzycznego«”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006BF.belarusian: "Разам з Асэль Бержэ — якая зараз там займаецца *сур'ёзна* прагрэсіўнымі гукавымі эксперыментамі — мы любім лічыць сябе "арганізатарамі музычных пляцовак"".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006C7.english: "Wait, how many music venues have you organized?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006C7.belarusian: "Пачакай, колькі музычных пляцовак вы ўжо арганізавалі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006D7.english: "We have many in the pipeline, officer."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006D7.belarusian: "У нас шмат праектаў у планах, афіцэру".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006E1.english: "You see, we've been all over Jamrock North, prospecting for real estate to establish a new venue in..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006E1.polish: „Widzi pan, przemierzyliśmy cały Północny Jamrock w poszukiwaniu nieruchomości, w której moglibyśmy otworzyć nowy lokal...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006E1.belarusian: "Бачыце, мы абшукалі ўвесь Паўночны Джэмрок, падшукваючы нерухомасць, каб адкрыць новую пляцоўку..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006EF.english: "Yes, thank you, Egg Head. And, while there is no shortage of raw, unfettered talent spinning tapes in Jamrock, we've had rotten luck with the real estate part."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006EF.polish: „Tak, dziękuję, Jajkogłowcze. I chociaż nie brakuje w Jamrock surowych, nieskrępowanych talentów puszczających taśmy, to znalezienie nieruchomości okazało się trudne”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000006EF.belarusian: "Так, дзякуй, Яйкагаловы. І хоць у Джэмроку хапае сырых, нястрымных талентаў, што круцяць стужкі, з нерухомасцю нам зусім не шанцуе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B00000704.english: "Which brings me to the problem of occupied ecclesiastical property. I bet you've noticed the derelict hive of *narcomania* on the coast?"
