Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000088BD.english: Yeah let it out! Let the disco happen. Bring the disco into this world!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000088BD.polish: Tak, obudź to w sobie! Niech się stanie disco. Sprowadź je na ten świat!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000088BD.belarusian: Так, выпускай гэта вонкі! Няхай адбудзецца дыска. Прынясі дыска ў гэты свет!

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000088C3.english: You can't be scared of moving a lil bit, are you?! Get the grind on!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000088C3.polish: Chyba nie boisz się odrobiny ruchu, co?! Jedziemy z tym tematem!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000088C3.belarusian: Ты ж не баішся крыху паварушыцца, праўда?! Давай у рух!

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00009F56.english: "Yeah. It's all set up, man! Can you already imagine a thousand people in here?! Ten thousand?!" He waves his hands in an unbelievably lame, non-hard-core manner.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00009F56.polish: „Tak. Wszystko zainstalowane! Niech pan to sobie wyobrazi: tysiąc bawiących się tu osób! Dziesięć tysięcy!” – wymachuje rękami w żałosny, zupełnie niehardkorowy sposób.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00009F56.belarusian: "Так. Усё гатова, стары! Ты ўжо можаш уявіць тут тысячу чалавек?! Дзесяць тысяч?!" Ён размахвае рукамі неймаверна ўбога і зусім не па-хардкораваму.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000AD96.english: "What's the deal with Egg Head? I want to talk to him."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000AD96.polish: „O co chodzi z Jajkogłowcem? Chciałbym z nim pogadać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000AD96.belarusian: "Што за тып гэты Яйкагаловы? Я хачу з ім пагаварыць".

Alternate1/0x0100005A0000AD96.polish: „Wiem, że Noik ma te swoje fale, ale co ma Jajkogłowiec?”
Alternate1/0x0100005A0000AD96.belarusian: "Я ведаю, што ў Ноіка яго сінусы, але што там з Яйкагаловым?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000AD9D.english: "He's a quiet man, mostly communicates through music... and by being a master of ceremonies."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000AD9D.polish: „Jest małomówny – komunikuje się głównie poprzez muzykę... i bycie mistrzem ceremonii”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000AD9D.belarusian: "Ён маўклівы хлопец, камунікуе ў асноўным праз музыку... і праз тое, што ён вядучы цырымоніі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000ADAD.english: "Well..." he shrugs, "...he's just kinda here, I don't really know how to *communicate* with him."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000ADAD.polish: „No cóż...” – wzrusza ramionami. „On po prostu tu jest. Tak naprawdę nie wiem, jak się z nimi *porozumieć*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000ADAD.belarusian: "Ну..." ён паціскае плячыма, "...ён проста нібыта тут, я не надта ведаю, як з ім *камунікаваць*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000ADB9.polish: „Hm, a kto to jest mistrz ceremonii?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000ADC1.english: "You know, a host. A declaimer of slogans. He's a performer. Gets the people going."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000ADC1.polish: „No wie pan... Gospodarz. Deklamator sloganów. On jest wykonawcą. Rozkręca imprezę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000ADC1.belarusian: "Ну ведаеце, канферансье. Дэкламатар слоганаў. Ён выканаўца. Заводзіць натоўп".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000ADD0.english: "Yeah, sometimes... when I, like, stumble and find my way into his centre. You have to hear a lot of 'hard core to the mega' first, though."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000ADD0.polish: „Tak, czasem... Gdy przypadkiem uda mi się do niego dotrzeć. Ale najpierw trzeba wysłuchać mnóstwo »hardkoru do potęgi mega«”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000ADD0.belarusian: "Так, часам... калі мне, ну, удаецца дабрацца да яго сутнасці. Праўда, спачатку даводзіцца выслухаць кучу "хардкору да поўнага мега"".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000ADD6.english: "Oh, that makes sense. Another question then."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000ADD6.polish: „Och. Ma to sens. W takim razie następne pytanie”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000AE62.english: "Oh, the Founding Party. I do know them... but can you refresh my memory?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000AE62.polish: „Och, Partia Założycielska. Wiem, co to... ale może odświeżysz mi pamięć?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000AE62.belarusian: "О, Партыя Заснавальнікаў. Я ведаю іх... але ці можаш асвяжыць маю памяць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B878.english: Audio waves thump against your rib cage. The speaker set-up makes everything sound much better... but there's a noticeable lack of something.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B878.polish: Fale dźwiękowe uderzają ci o żebra. Głośniki sprawiają, że wszystko brzmi o wiele lepiej... Wciąż jednak daje się odczuć jakiś zauważalny brak.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B878.belarusian: Гукавыя хвалі б'юць у грудную клетку. Гукавая сістэма робіць гучанне нашмат лепшым... але чагосьці прыкметна бракуе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B8F4.english: Audio waves thump against your rib cage. The speaker set-up makes everything sound much better... but the *BEAT* is still so weak.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B8F4.polish: Fale dźwiękowe uderzają ci o żebra. Głośniki sprawiają, że wszystko brzmi o wiele lepiej... Ale *bit* wciąż jest strasznie słaby.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B8F4.belarusian: Гукавыя хвалі б'юць у грудную клетку. Гукавая сістэма робіць гучанне нашмат лепшым... але *БІТ* усё яшчэ такі слабы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B96F.english: "Oh, hey, man! It's good to see you." He dances over to you in an inexplicably soft-core manner. It's embarrassing.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B96F.polish: „O, witam! Dobrze pana widzieć” – rusza w twoim kierunku tanecznym i niewytłumaczalnie softkorowym krokiem. To żenujący widok.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B96F.belarusian: "О, прывітанне, стары! Рады цябе бачыць". Ён танцуючы падыходзіць да цябе неяк невытлумачальна па-софткараваму. Гэта выглядае няёмка.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA0D.english: What if... you re-routed the terrifying audio assault that the lead programmer's microphone setup picks up through this compressor?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA0D.polish: A gdybyś tak... domiksował ten przerażający nawał dźwięków, który odbiera przez ten kompresor mikrofon głównej programistki?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA0D.belarusian: Што калі... перанакіраваць той жахлівы шквал гуку, які ловіць мікрафон галоўнай праграмісткі, праз гэты кампрэсар?

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA22.english: "About the church... I checked it out."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA22.polish: „Co do tego kościoła – przyjrzałem mu się”.

Alternate1/0x0100005A0000BA22.belarusian: "Я тут, каб зноў пагаварыць пра царкву".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA28.polish: „I...?” – pyta cały spięty. „Co z tego wynikło?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA3B.english: "I saw a shadow-clad being climbing the beams. A man-beast!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA3B.polish: „Widziałem spowitą cieniem istotę wspinającą się po wspornikach. Ludzkie zwierzę!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA3B.belarusian: "Я бачыў агорнутую ценем істоту, якая лазіла па бэльках. Чалавеказвера!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA4E.english: "Uh... c'mon, that was just the crab-man. You're a brave cop, maybe you should go back and talk to him. Figure out the situation, see what he wants."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA4E.polish: „Ee... Przecież to był tylko kraboczłek. Jest pan dzielnym gliną, może powinien pan tam wrócić i z nim porozmawiać? Ustalić, jak wygląda sytuacja, i dowiedzieć się, czego on chce”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA4E.belarusian: "Э-э... ды ладна, гэта ж проста крабачалавек. Вы адважны паліцыянт, можа, вам варта вярнуцца і пагаварыць з ім? Разабрацца ў сітуацыі, даведацца, чаго ён хоча".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA55.english: "I... came here to *report* what I saw. The crab-man."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA55.polish: „No... Przyszedłem tutaj, żeby *zgłosić*, co widziałem. Kraboczłeka”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA55.belarusian: "Я... прыйшоў сюды, каб *далажыць* пра тое, што бачыў. Пра крабачалавека".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA5C.english: "But you didn't talk to him?" He hums to himself. "I think you should go back -- figure out the situation, see what he wants."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA5C.polish: „Ale nie rozmawiał pan z nim?” – mruczy do siebie. „Myślę, że powinien pan tam wrócić – ustalić, jak wygląda sytuacja, i dowiedzieć się, czego on chce”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA5C.belarusian: "Але вы з ім не размаўлялі?" Ён напявае сабе пад нос. "Думаю, вам варта вярнуцца — разабрацца ў сітуацыі, даведацца, чаго ён хоча".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA64.english: "Actually, I want to talk about something else."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BA64.polish: „Właściwie to chciałbym porozmawiać o czymś innym”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BF92.english: "I talked to the shadow-clad being climbing the beams -- a man living on the ceiling!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BF92.polish: „Porozmawiałem ze spowitą cieniem istotą wspinającą się po wspornikach. Człowiekiem żyjącym na suficie!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BF92.belarusian: "Я пагаварыў з агорнутай ценем істотай, што лазіла па бэльках — чалавекам, які жыве на столі!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BF99.english: "I was using the mainframe when Soona, the former lead programmer of Fortress Accident, appeared."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BF99.polish: „Używałem akurat komputera, kiedy pojawiła się Soona, dawna główna programistka Fortecy Katastrof”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BF99.belarusian: "Я працаваў за мейнфрэймам, калі з'явілася Суна, былая вядучая праграмістка Fortress Accident".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFA0.english: "Oh man! Who is he, what did you think?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFA0.polish: „O rety! Kim on jest? Co pan o nim myśli?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFA0.belarusian: "Ого! Хто ён такі, што вы пра яго думаеце?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFD9.english: "Seemed okay, to be honest. Very spiritual."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFD9.polish: „Szczerze mówiąc, wydał mi się w porządku. Bardzo uduchowiony”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFE0.english: "He keeps himself physically active, thinks spiritual thoughts and doesn't drink. Who am I to evict such a person?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFE0.polish: „Dba o aktywność fizyczną, prowadzi duchowe rozważania i nie pije alkoholu. Kim ja jestem, żeby eksmitować kogoś takiego?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFE0.belarusian: "Ён падтрымлівае фізічную форму, думае пра духоўнае і не п'е. Хто я такі, каб высяляць такога чалавека?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFE6.english: "Of course he's a problem -- he's a *crab-man*!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFEC.english: "As far as I can tell he's not going to leave. He'll climb around up there, and guys, you'll never catch him."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFEC.polish: „Jak na moje to nigdy stamtąd nie odejdzie. Wespnie się do siebie na górę i uwierzcie – w życiu go nie złapiecie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFEC.belarusian: "Наколькі я разумею, ён не збіраецца сыходзіць. Ён будзе лазіць там наверсе, і, хлопцы, вы яго ніколі не зловіце".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFF8.english: "You're just going to have to live with the crab-man."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFF8.polish: „Będziecie po prostu musieli żyć z kraboczłekiem”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFFE.english: "A programmer? That's odd. What was she like? Did you ask her about the nightclub?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFFE.polish: „Programistka? To dziwne. Jaka ona była? Zapytał pan ją o klub nocny?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000BFFE.belarusian: "Праграмістка? Дзіўна. І як яна? Вы спыталі яе пра начны клуб?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000C00A.english: "A shame." He sighs. "What can we do now? Do you see a way out of this jam -- and into a laser-lit future of dance and unity?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000C00A.polish: „Szkoda” – wzdycha. „Co teraz? Mamy jakiś pomysł na wybrnięcie z tego impasu i ruszenie ku oświetlonej laserami przyszłości przepełnionej tańcem i jednością?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000C00A.belarusian: "Шкада". Ён уздыхае. "Што ж нам цяпер рабіць? Ці бачыце вы выйсце з гэтага тупіка — насустрач залітай лазерамі будучыні танцаў і адзінства?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CCC3.english: "I kicked the programmer out, she won't bother you anymore. Time to dance!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CCC3.polish: „Wyrzuciłem programistkę, nie będzie wam już robić kłopotów. Czas zatańczyć!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CCC3.belarusian: "Я выкінуў праграмістку, яна больш не будзе вас турбаваць. Час танцаваць!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CCCA.english: "Really?" He smiles, happier than he's ever been before. "We are grateful, cop-man. You're a true ally and the augury of a new era of *ANODIC DANCE MUSIC*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CCCA.polish: „Poważnie?” – pyta, uśmiechając się radośniej niż dotąd. „Jesteśmy panu bardzo wdzięczni, funkcjonariuszu. Jest pan prawdziwym sojusznikiem i zapowiedzią nowej epoki *MUZYKI ANODIC DANCE*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CCCA.belarusian: "Праўда?" Ён усміхаецца шчаслівей, чым калі-небудзь раней. "Мы ўдзячныя вам, паліцыянт. Вы сапраўдны саюзнік і прадвеснік новай эры *АНОДНАЙ ТАНЦАВАЛЬНАЙ МУЗЫКІ*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CCF7.english: "Hm." He sounds disappointed. "But do let us know if something changes in the church..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CCF7.polish: „Hmm” – sprawia wrażenie rozczarowanego. „Tylko proszę dać nam znać, jeśli coś się zmieni w sprawie kościoła...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CCF7.belarusian: "Хм". У яго голасе чуваць расчараванне. "Але дайце ведаць, калі нешта зменіцца ў царкве..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD03.english: "Maybe... uh... I guess we'll figure something out. Okay, but what about the other spooker -- the one in grandma's clothes? Did you see her?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD03.polish: „Może... ee... Chyba coś wymyślimy. No dobrze, ale co z tym drugim straszydłem – z tą kobietą w babcinych ciuchach? Widział ją pan?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD03.belarusian: "Можа... э-э... думаю, мы нешта прыдумаем. Добра, а што наконт іншай страшыдлы — той, што ў бабулінай вопратцы? Вы яе бачылі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD09.english: "I'm making progress in the church, but it's slow going. There's a hitch in Soona's research."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD09.polish: „Powoli załatwiam sprawę kościoła, ale wolno to idzie. Soona utknęła trochę w swoich badaniach”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD09.belarusian: "Я прасоўваюся ў царкве, але справа ідзе марудна. У даследаваннях Суны ўзнікла замінка".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD0F.english: "She's trying to catch an anomaly using a special microphone set up, but she can't hear the audio coming through her headphones."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD0F.polish: „Próbuje wychwycić anomalię za pomocą specjalnego zestawu mikrofonów, ale nie słyszy w słuchawkach żadnego dźwięku”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD0F.belarusian: "Яна спрабуе зафіксаваць анамалію з дапамогай адмысловага мікрафона, але не чуе гуку ў навушніках".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD1A.english: "An audio shortfall, you say?" The other speedfreak points his thumb toward the speaker in the back. "Guess what, we've got speakers with *massive* low end. There's a good chance it can do it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD1A.polish: „Deficyt dźwięku?” – pyta drugi speedziarz i wskazuje kciukiem głośniki stojące na tyłach. „Tak się składa, że mamy głośniki o *potężnych* niskich tonach. Pewnie by sobie z tym poradziły”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD1A.belarusian: "Дэфіцыт гуку, кажаце?" Другі спідфрык паказвае вялікім пальцам на калонку ззаду. "Ведаеце што, у нас ёсць калонкі з *магутнымі* нізамі. Ёсць вялікі шанец, што яны пацягнуць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD20.english: "I think we have found a solution."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD25.english: "Good news! I managed to convince Soona. She's okay with you guys moving in, but on one condition -- she needs your speakers for her project."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD25.polish: „Dobre wieści! Zdołałem przekonać Soonę. Zgadza się, żebyście się wprowadzili, ale pod jednym warunkiem – potrzebuje do swojego projektu waszych głośników”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD25.belarusian: "Добрыя навіны! Мне ўдалося пераканаць Суну. Яна не супраць вашага пераезду, але з адной умовай — ёй патрэбныя вашы калонкі для праекта".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD9D.english: "She made it very clear that she won't leave until her own project is finished."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD9D.polish: „Powiedziała bardzo jasno, że się nie wyniesie, dopóki nie ukończy swojego projektu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CD9D.belarusian: "Яна ясна дала зразумець, што не сыдзе, пакуль не скончыць уласны праект".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDA3.english: "No, I *won't* evict her. We have to come up with a different solution."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDA3.polish: „Nie, *nie* eksmituję jej. Musimy wymyślić jakieś inne rozwiązanie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDA3.belarusian: "Не, я *не буду* высяляць яе. Трэба знайсці іншае рашэнне".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDA9.english: "Yeah, I *can't* evict her. I tried, but she quoted the Wayfarer Act, and she's actually correct about it, so..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDA9.polish: „Tak, *nie mogę* jej eksmitować. Próbowałem, ale powołała się na Ustawę o podróżach. I ma rację, więc...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDA9.belarusian: "Так, я *не магу* яе выселіць. Я спрабаваў, але яна спаслалася на Закон аб падарожжах і мела рацыю, так што..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDB5.english: "We can figure something out, right, guys? Work out a deal. We can run the club without bothering her."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDB5.polish: „Wymyślimy coś, prawda, chłopaki? Wypracujemy jakiś układ. Możemy prowadzić klub i nie przeszkadzać jej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDB5.belarusian: "Мы можам нешта прыдумаць, так, хлопцы? Дамовіцца. Мы можам весці клуб і не замінаць ёй".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDBB.english: "The lines in the dark, exist, CO-EXIST!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDC1.english: "Wonderful!" He nods enthusiastically, then leans in and whispers: "If co-existing fails, you can always muscle her out, right? If... it's all okay with you. What do you think?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDC1.polish: „Cudownie!” – woła, kiwając z entuzjazmem głową, po czym pochyla się i szepcze: „Jeśli współistnienie nie wypali, zawsze może ją pan wyrzucić stamtąd siłą, prawda? Jeśli... nie ma pan nic przeciwko. Co pan na to?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDC1.belarusian: "Цудоўна!" Ён з энтузіязмам ківае, потым нахіляецца і шэпча: "Калі суіснаванне не спрацуе, вы заўсёды можаце выкінуць яе сілай, так? Калі... вы не супраць. Што скажаце?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDCC.english: "Perhaps if you dropped the drug lab, it might make it easier to convince her."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDCC.polish: „Może gdybyście zrezygnowali z pomysłu produkcji narkotyków, byłoby ją łatwiej przekonać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDCC.belarusian: "Магчыма, калі б вы адмовіліся ад наркалабараторыі, яе было б прасцей пераканаць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDD2.english: He looks around the tent. "Aww man, but the drug lab was like an *integral* part of getting the club going."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDD2.polish: Rozgląda się po namiocie. „Rety... Fabryka narkotyków była *integralną* częścią prowadzenia klubu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDD2.belarusian: Ён азірае шацёр. "Эх, але ж наркалабараторыя была *неаддзельнай* часткай запуску клуба".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDD7.english: "Excellent! Good luck, my friend." He smiles wide, like a replica of his friend with the large head.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDD7.polish: „Doskonale! Powodzenia, przyjacielu” – uśmiecha się szeroko, przez co wygląda jak replika swojego towarzysza z wielką głową.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDD7.belarusian: "Выдатна! Поспехаў, сябра". Ён шырока ўсміхаецца, становячыся копіяй свайго сябра з вялікай галавой.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDE4.english: "Alright, I'll see how it goes." (Proceed with the quest.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CDE4.polish: „No dobrze, zobaczę, czy to się uda”. (Kontynuuj zadanie).

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE0E.english: "Yeah, he can do his climbing thing in the tower. And the programmer... does she like anodic dance music?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE0E.polish: „Tak, może dalej wspinać się w wieży. A programistka... Czy ona lubi muzykę anodic dance?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE0E.belarusian: "Так, ён можа лазіць сабе ў вежы. А праграмістка... ёй падабаецца анодная танцавальная музыка?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE14.english: "She *absolutely* does not. Really truly despises it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE14.polish: „*Ani trochę*. Prawdę mówiąc, to wręcz jej nie znosi”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE14.belarusian: "*Абсалютна* не. Шчыра і ад усёй душы пагарджае ёй".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE19.english: (Lie.) "She gets down. I mean, who doesn't? Just listen to that crazy pulse!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE19.polish: (Skłam). „Jara się nią. Jak chyba każdy, nie? Posłuchaj tylko tego wariackiego pulsowania!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE19.belarusian: (Схлусіць.) "Яна качаецца. У сэнсе, а хто не? Вы толькі паслухайце гэты шалёны пульс!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE20.english: "At least crab-man seems like an *advanced* being. He's hard. He'll understand."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE20.polish: „Przynajmniej kraboczłek sprawia wrażenie *zaawansowanej* istoty. Jest hardkorowy. Zrozumie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE20.belarusian: "Прынамсі крабачалавек выглядае як *прасунутая* істота. Ён цвёрды. Ён зразумее".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE26.polish: „I nie może jej pan po prostu eksmitować?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE26.belarusian: "І вы не можаце проста выселіць яе?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE34.english: "If that's okay with her... We only wanna get in the church and spread the joy and ecstasy of music."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE34.polish: „Jeśli by się na to zgodziła... Chcemy tylko dostać się do kościoła i dzielić się radością oraz ekstazą muzyki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE34.belarusian: "Калі яна не супраць... Мы проста хочам трапіць у царкву і распаўсюджваць радасць і экстаз музыкі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE4C.english: "She did not like it, and the drug lab didn't really help either."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE4C.polish: „Nie spodobał jej się ten pomysł. A produkcja narkotyków też nie pomogła”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE4C.belarusian: "Ёй не спадабалася, дый наркалабараторыя не надта дапамагла".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE52.english: "What a pity! That's my favourite thing in the world." He drops a hammer back into a toolbox. "And she doesn't like it at all."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE52.polish: „Jaka szkoda! To moja ulubiona rzecz na całym świecie” – stwierdza i wrzuca młotek do skrzynki z narzędziami. „A ona w ogóle jej nie lubi”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE52.belarusian: "Якая дасада! Гэта мая найлюбімейшая рэч у свеце". Ён кідае малаток назад у скрыню з інструментамі. "А ёй зусім не падабаецца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE64.english: "For me it was my favourite part. Chemistry is great. Besides, imagine all the drugs we could do if we had our own drug lab."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE64.polish: „To była moja ulubiona część. Chemia jest świetna. Poza tym wyobraźcie sobie wszystkie narkotyki, jakie moglibyśmy wyprodukować, gdybyśmy posiadali własne laboratorium”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE64.belarusian: "Для мяне гэта была самая любімая частка. Хімія — гэта выдатна. Да таго ж уявіце, колькі наркотыкаў мы маглі б ужываць, калі б мелі ўласную лабараторыю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE76.english: "She said you guys haven't been completely honest with me about your plans."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE76.polish: „Twierdzi, że nie byliście ze mną tak do końca szczerzy co do swoich planów”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE76.belarusian: "Яна сказала, што вы былі не да канца шчырымі са мной наконт сваіх планаў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE7C.english: "C'mon, man. Who will you trust, a spooky programmer or us? We just wanna make the world a better place."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE7C.polish: „Niech pan da spokój. Komu pan ufa? Dziwnej programistce czy nam? My chcemy uczynić świat lepszym miejscem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CE7C.belarusian: "Ды кіньце, паліцыянт. Каму вы верыце: жудаснай праграмістцы ці нам? Мы проста хочам зрабіць свет лепшым".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEA9.english: A courageous cop-man such as thyself surely did not flee in fear from a mere mortal!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEA9.polish: Odważny glinoczłek, taki jak ty, z pewnością nie umknie pełen lęku przed zwykłym śmiertelnikiem!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEA9.belarusian: Такі адважны паліцыянт, як ты, пэўна ж, не ўцёк у страху ад простага смяротнага!

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEB1.english: "You won't believe it. I stood my ground, bravely staring him down, but suddenly -- fire started shooting out of his eyes! It was out of this world."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEB1.polish: „Nie uwierzysz. Stanąłem mężnie i śmiało zmierzyłem go wzrokiem, ale... nagle z jego oczu buchnęły płomienie! To było jak nie z tego świata”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEB1.belarusian: "Ты не паверыш. Я не адступіў, мужна пазіраючы яму ў вочы, але раптам... з яго вачэй пачаў вырывацца агонь! Гэта было нешта незямное".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEB9.english: "You're right, I don't believe the last part... sounds like one of the cheap *literature fantastique* novels. Always full of otherworldly sorceries and hokey stuff."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEB9.polish: „Ma pan rację – nie wierzę w końcówkę... To brzmi jak coś z tanich powieści *fantastique*. Pełno w nich czarów nie z tego świata i naciąganych bzdur”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEB9.belarusian: "Вы маеце рацыю, у апошнюю частку я не веру... гучыць як танныя раманы *literature fantastique*. Заўсёды поўныя тагасветнай магіі і таннай лухты".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEC0.english: "That must have been the crab-man. It's okay if you got spooked and ran away." He hums to himself. "I think you should go talk to him -- figure out the situation, see what he wants."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEC0.polish: „To musiał być kraboczłek. To nic, jeśli wystraszył się pan i uciekł” – mruczy do siebie. „Myślę, że powinien pan z nim porozmawiać – ustalić, jak wygląda sytuacja, i dowiedzieć się, czego on chce”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEC0.belarusian: "Гэта, пэўна, быў крабачалавек. Нічога страшнага, калі вы спалохаліся і ўцяклі". Ён напявае сабе пад нос. "Думаю, вам варта пайсці пагаварыць з ім — разабрацца ў сітуацыі, даведацца, чаго ён хоча".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CECD.english: "Really? Huh... interesting. What's he doing in the church?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CECD.polish: „Naprawdę? Hmm... Interesujące. Co on robi w kościele?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CECD.belarusian: "Праўда? Хм... цікава. А што ён робіць у царкве?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEE2.english: "No matter," the paranoid young man mumbles gruffly. "Is he going to be a problem?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEE2.polish: „Nieważne” – mamrocze gburowato paranoiczny młody mężczyzna. „Będzie sprawiał nam problemy?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEE2.belarusian: "Няважна", — груба мармыча паранаідальны хлопец. "Ён будзе ствараць праблемы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEF3.english: "Yeah, Noid is right... let's get back to the point. What are we going to *do* about him?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEF3.polish: „Taaa... Noik ma rację... Wróćmy do sedna. Co z nim *zrobimy*?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEF3.belarusian: "Так, Ноік мае рацыю... давайце вернемся да сутнасці. Што мы будзем з ім *рабіць*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEFC.english: "I guess it's not a *massive* problem, now that I think of it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEFC.polish: „Jak się nad tym zastanowić, to chyba nie będzie jakiś *wielki* problem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CEFC.belarusian: "Калі падумаць, гэта, напэўна, не такая ўжо і *вялікая* праблема".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF02.english: "Everyone is welcome -- to dance till the morning light! YEAGH!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF02.polish: „Wszyscy są mile widziani – by tańczyć do samego rana! TAAAK!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF02.belarusian: "Запрашаем усіх — танцаваць да самай раніцы! Е-Е-Е!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF20.english: "So...?" He rubs his chilled hands together.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF20.polish: „Więc...?” – zaciera zmarznięte ręce, aby je rozgrzać.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF27.english: "It's impossible to catch someone who climbs walls like a freaking spider-crab."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF27.polish: „Nie da się złapać kogoś, kto łazi po ścianach jak jakiś szurnięty pająkokrab”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF27.belarusian: "Немагчыма злавіць чалавека, які лазіць па сценах, як грэбаны краб-павук".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF2E.english: "But he's likely up to no good." Andre shakes his head. "He's a crab-man, man... a menace to society."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF2E.polish: „Na pewno ma jakieś niecne zamiary” – stwierdza Andre, kręcąc głową. „To kraboczłek... Zagrożenie dla społeczeństwa”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF2E.belarusian: "Але ён напэўна задумаў нешта нядобрае". Андрэ хітае галавой. "Ён жа крабачалавек, стары... пагроза для грамадства".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF35.english: "I doubt that. Besides, I'm pretty sure it's impossible to catch him climbing up there."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF35.polish: „Wątpię. Poza tym jestem raczej pewien, że nie da się go złapać podczas tej jego wspinaczki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF35.belarusian: "Сумняваюся. Да таго ж я амаль упэўнены, што яго немагчыма злавіць, пакуль ён там лазіць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF3C.english: "I dunno, man... doesn't it feel like a major hindrance to you?" He rubs his jaw. "A spooky guy climbing around when all the guests are trying to have nice friendly hyper-time?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF3C.polish: „No nie wiem... Nie wydaje się panu, że będzie poważną przeszkodą?” – pyta, pocierając swoją szczękę. „Straszny koleś wspinający się pod sufitem, gdy goście próbują spędzić ze sobą trochę przyjaznego hiperczasu?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF3C.belarusian: "Не ведаю, стары... вам не здаецца, што гэта вялікая перашкода?" Ён пацірае сківіцу. "Жудасны тып лазіць наверсе, пакуль усе госці спрабуюць добра і дружна патусіць у гіперчасе?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF47.english: "Right? There's something really odd about him... what's he doing in the church anyway?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF47.polish: „Prawda? Jest w nim coś naprawdę dziwnego... Co on właściwie robi w kościele?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF47.belarusian: "Праўда ж? У ім ёсць нешта сапраўды дзіўнае... І што ён увогуле робіць у царкве?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF9D.english: "Feel the love! GET DOWN AND FEEL IT!" The stuffy tent muffles the last two words. The command fails to impress.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF9D.polish: „Poczuj miłość! DALEJ, POCZUJ JĄ!” – duszny namiot tłumi dwa ostatnie słowa. Polecenie nie robi na nikim wrażenia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CF9D.belarusian: "Адчуй любоў! УРУБІСЯ І АДЧУЙ ЯЕ!" Душны шацёр глушыць апошнія два словы. Заклік не выклікае захаплення.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFAA.english: "You'll get there, believe me... when we've got our gear set up. Things will be flowin' and pumpin'..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFAA.polish: „Poczuje pan ją, proszę mi wierzyć... Jak tylko zainstalujemy nasz sprzęt. Wszystko będzie płynęło i pompowało...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFAA.belarusian: "Вы яшчэ адчуеце, паверце мне... калі мы паставім наша абсталяванне. Усё будзе качаць і вібраваць..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFB3.english: "The love? No, I'm really not feeling it at all."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFB3.polish: „Miłość? Nie, nie czuję jej ani trochę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFB3.belarusian: "Любоў? Не, я зусім яе не адчуваю."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFBD.english: "Anyway, now that it's settled... how did she seem? I mean, disposition-wise, about the dance club idea? 'Ja' oder 'Nein'? Rockin' it or droppin' it?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFBD.polish: „W każdym razie skoro sprawa została dogadana... to jakie ona sprawiała wrażenie? Znaczy, w sensie nastawienia do klubu z muzyką dance? »Ja« oder »Nein«? Buja czy zamula?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFBD.belarusian: "У кожным разе, калі ўсё вырашана... як яна вам? У сэнсе настрою наконт танцавальнага клуба? "Ja" oder "Nein"? Залятае ці міма?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFD1.english: "She did not like the anodic dance club idea."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFD1.polish: „Nie spodobał jej się pomysł otworzenia klubu anodic dance”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFD1.belarusian: "Ёй не спадабалася ідэя клуба аноднай музыкі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFDC.english: "Drugs and anodic music, I mean. And she doesn't like either one of them. Some people are just *born* retrograde."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFDC.polish: „Narkotyki i muzyka anodic, ma się rozumieć. A ona nie lubi ani tego, ani tego. Niektórzy ludzie po prostu *rodzą się* uwstecznieni”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFDC.belarusian: "Наркотыкі і анодная музыка, я маю на ўвазе. А ёй не падабаецца ні тое, ні другое. Некаторыя людзі проста *нараджаюцца* рэтраградамі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFE2.english: "What a pity! Those are my two favourite things in the world." He drops a bundle of screws into his toolbox.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFE2.polish: „Jaka szkoda! To są moje dwie najulubieńsze rzeczy na świecie” – stwierdza i wrzuca kilka wkrętów do swojej skrzynki z narzędziami.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CFE2.belarusian: "Якая дасада! Гэта мае дзве найлюбімейшыя рэчы ў свеце". Ён кідае жменю шруб у скрыню з інструментамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D00E.english: These guys will never catch him. You will never catch him. There's nothing to do.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D00E.polish: Ci goście nigdy go nie złapią. Ty też nie. Nic się nie da zrobić.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D00E.belarusian: Гэтыя хлопцы ніколі яго не зловяць. Ты ніколі яго не зловіш. Тут нічога не зробіш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D018.english: "Don't worry, I don't think he really gives a damn about you or anyone else."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D018.polish: „Spokojnie, wątpię, żebyście obchodzili go wy albo ktokolwiek inny”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D018.belarusian: "Не хвалюйцеся, я не думаю, што яму ёсць хоць нейкая справа да вас ці да каго-небудзь яшчэ".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D020.english: A half-hearted sell of something which does not seem worth buying.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D020.polish: Niezbyt przekonująca próba sprzedaży czegoś, co nie wydaje się warte kupna.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D020.belarusian: Млявая спроба ўцюхаць тое, што відавочна не варта купляць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D030.english: "No, Noid. He's right... maybe we've approached it the wrong way after all. I'm sure there's a workaround. We can make a deal not to bother her."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D030.polish: „Nie, Noik. Pan ma rację... Chyba podeszliśmy do tego w niewłaściwy sposób. Jestem pewny, że znajdzie się jakieś rozwiązanie. Możemy obiecać, że nie będziemy jej przeszkadzać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D030.belarusian: "Не, Ноік. Ён мае рацыю... магчыма, мы сапраўды падышлі да гэтага не з таго боку. Я ўпэўнены, што ёсць выйсце. Мы можам дамовіцца, што не будзем ёй замінаць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D04C.english: "I *could* go for another try. Bring down the hammer of the law."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D04C.polish: „*Mógłbym* spróbować jeszcze raz. Uderzyć prawem niczym młotem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D04C.belarusian: "Я *мог бы* паспрабаваць яшчэ раз. Абрынуць молат закону".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D053.english: "Hell yeah." He picks up a small hammer and holds it out, ritualistically.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D053.polish: „O tak!” – podnosi mały młotek i wykonuje nim rytualny gest.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D053.belarusian: "Вось гэта так". Ён падымае маленькі малаток і трымае яго перад сабой рытуальным жэстам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D05A.english: "No, Noid. No hammer. I'm sure there's a workaround. We can, like, make a deal not to bother her? You know, co-exist."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D05A.polish: „Nie, Noik. Żadnych młotków. Jestem pewny, że znajdzie się jakieś rozwiązanie. Może obiecamy, że nie będziemy jej przeszkadzać? No wiesz – współistnienie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D05A.belarusian: "Не, Ноік. Ніякіх малаткоў. Я ўпэўнены, што ёсць выйсце. Мы можам, ну, дамовіцца, каб не замінаць ёй? Ведаеш, суіснаваць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D06B.english: "No worries. We'll figure it out." The man nods enthusiastically, then leans in and whispers: "If co-existing fails, you can always muscle her out, right? If... it's all okay with you. What do you think?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D06B.polish: „Spokojnie. Coś wymyślimy” – stwierdza, kiwając z entuzjazmem głową, po czym pochyla się i szepcze: „Jeśli współistnienie nie wypali, zawsze może ją pan wyrzucić stamtąd siłą, prawda? Jeśli... nie ma pan nic przeciwko. Co pan na to?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D06B.belarusian: "Не перажывайце. Мы нешта прыдумаем". Ён з энтузіязмам ківае, потым нахіляецца і шэпча: "Калі суіснаванне не спрацуе, вы заўсёды можаце выкінуць яе сілай, так? Калі... вы не супраць. Што скажаце?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D075.english: Egg head cannot believe what you just said. It makes him pump the jam a *little* slower for a moment, but then he returns to the full swing of it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D075.polish: Jajkogłowiec nie może uwierzyć w twoje słowa. Z tego powodu przez chwilę pompuje pięścią *odrobinę* wolniej, ale szybko wraca do pełnego rozmachu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D075.belarusian: Яйкагаловы не верыць сваім вушам. Ад гэтага ён на імгненне качае *трохі* павольней, але хутка вяртаецца да поўнага размаху.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D30A.english: "We've got some serious range on this baby." He nods. "It'll blast her shoes off, believe me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D30A.polish: „Ta dziecinka ma całkiem niezły zakres” – stwierdza, kiwając głową. „Zdmuchnie jej beret z głowy, zapewniam”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D30A.belarusian: "У гэтай малечы сур'ёзны дыяпазон". Ён ківае. "З яе падкоўкамі вынесе, паверце мне".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D310.english: "I'm not really so sure it's about the lack of bass, but I'll see what Soona thinks."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D310.polish: „Nie jestem pewien, czy to kwestia braku basów, ale spytam, co o tym sądzi Soona”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D310.belarusian: "Я не надта ўпэўнены, што справа ў недахопе басоў, але пагляджу, што скажа Суна".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D327.english: "We are grateful, cop-man. You're an augury of a new era of *ANODIC DANCE MUSIC*." The speedfreak smiles, happier than he's ever been before.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D327.polish: „Jesteśmy panu bardzo wdzięczni, funkcjonariuszu. Jest pan zapowiedzią nowej epoki *MUZYKI ANODIC DANCE*” – speedziarz uśmiecha się radośnie jak nigdy dotąd.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D327.belarusian: "Мы ўдзячныя вам, паліцыянт. Вы прадвеснік новай эры *АНОДНАЙ ТАНЦАВАЛЬНАЙ МУЗЫКІ*". Спідфрык усміхаецца шчаслівей, чым калі-небудзь раней.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D32E.english: "You're going to have to share space for a couple of weeks until she gets her research finished."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D32E.polish: „Będziecie musieli się przez kilka tygodni dzielić miejscem, dopóki nie ukończy swoich badań”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D32E.belarusian: "Вам давядзецца дзяліць прастору пару тыдняў, пакуль яна не скончыць сваё даследаванне".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D335.english: "That's fine, we can manage." He grins, excited.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D335.polish: „To nic, poradzimy sobie” – zapewnia, szczerząc zęby z podekscytowaniem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D335.belarusian: "Усё нармальна, мы справімся". Ён узбуджана шчэрыцца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D377.english: "We appreciate it." He grins. "It's going to take us a bit to move our stuff inside. A couple of hours, maybe. Come check back later!" Andre waves to the other speedfreaks. "Let's get moving!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D377.polish: „Jesteśmy panu wdzięczni” – uśmiecha się. „Przeniesienie naszych rzeczy do środka trochę potrwa. Pewnie kilka godzin. Niech pan zajrzy do nas za jakiś czas!” – zaprasza, po czym macha do swoich towarzyszy i woła: „Do roboty!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000D377.belarusian: "Мы цэнім гэта". Ён шчэрыцца. "Нам спатрэбіцца крыху часу, каб зацягнуць нашы рэчы ўнутр. Можа, пару гадзін. Зазірніце пазней!" Андрэ махае астатнім спідфрыкам. "Пагналі!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DC47.english: The man smiles mysteriously -- choosing to let the beat speak for itself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DC47.polish: Mężczyzna uśmiecha się tajemniczo – pozwala, aby bit mówił sam za siebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DC47.belarusian: Хлопец таямніча ўсміхаецца — дазваляючы біту гаварыць за сябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DC5B.english: No words, enjoy the beat. (Nod your head.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DC5B.polish: Nic nie mów, ciesz się bitem. (Kiwnij głową).
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DC5B.belarusian: Без слоў, атрымліваць асалоду ад біту. (Кіўнуць галавой.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF0F.english: "I mean, anodic music is great and all, but drugs -- they make you feel really good. When did you last feel really, really good?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF0F.polish: „Muzyka anodic jest świetna i w ogóle, ale narkotyki... One sprawiają, że człowiek czuje się naprawdę dobrze. Kiedy ostatni raz czułeś się naprawdę dobrze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF0F.belarusian: "У сэнсе, анодная музыка — гэта выдатна і ўсё такое, але наркотыкі... ад іх табе па-сапраўднаму добра. Калі табе апошні раз было па-сапраўднаму, па-сапраўднаму добра?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF15.english: "Hey, who needs drugs when you've got a bottle of beer or two?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF15.polish: „Hej, na co komu prochy, jak można wypić piwo albo dwa?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF15.belarusian: "Гэй, каму патрэбныя наркотыкі, калі ёсць бутэлька-другая піва?"

Alternate1/0x0100005A0000DF15.polish: „Hej, na co komu prochy, skoro czekają na odkrycie tajemnice *Al-Gula*?”
Alternate1/0x0100005A0000DF15.belarusian: "Гэй, каму патрэбныя наркотыкі, калі можна адкрываць таямніцы *Аль-Гуля*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF1A.english: "You're right, I only ever feel good when I'm blasting some high-grade narcotics. Then I feel *great*!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF1A.polish: „Racja. Czuję się dobrze tylko po tym, jak sieknę sobie wysokiej klasy procha. Wtedy jest *świetnie*!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF1A.belarusian: "Твая праўда, мне добра толькі тады, калі я закінуся высакаякаснымі наркотыкамі. Тады я адчуваю сябе *цудоўна*!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF1F.english: "Never. I've never felt good in my entire life."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF1F.polish: „Nigdy. Nigdy w swoim życiu nie poczułem się dobrze”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF1F.belarusian: "Ніколі. Мне ніколі ў жыцці не было добра".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF25.english: "I don't have time to feel good, I'm a very busy officer of the law."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF25.polish: „Nie mam czasu na dobre samopoczucie. Jestem bardzo zajętym funkcjonariuszem policji”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF25.belarusian: "У мяне няма часу, каб адчуваць сябе добра, я вельмі заняты праваахоўнік".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF2C.english: "No, but you see, no one likes *drunk* people, drunk people get into fights and try to hit on everyone. Now, people on *speed*, however..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF2C.polish: „Nie no, nikt nie lubi *pijanych* ludzi – pijani ludzie wywołują bójki i próbują wszystkich podrywać. Za to ludzie na *speedzie*...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF2C.belarusian: "Не, але разумееш, ніхто не любіць *п'яных* людзей: п'яныя лезуць у бойкі і заляцаюцца да ўсіх запар. А вось людзі на *спідзе*..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF3E.english: "But that's exactly what drugs are for. Exactly. Time to expand your mind!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF3E.polish: „I właśnie od tego są narkotyki. Dokładnie od tego. Pora poszerzyć horyzonty”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF3E.belarusian: "Але ж менавіта дзеля гэтага наркотыкі і патрэбныя. Менавіта. Час пашырыць свядомасць!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF44.english: "Pull out that stick, law-man. You'd absolutely *love* drugs. They'll make you feel transcendent."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF44.polish: „Wyciągnij ten kij ze swojego dupska, stróżu prawa. *Pokochałbyś* narkotyki. Sprawiają, że człowiek doświadcza transcendencji”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DF44.belarusian: "Дастань кій з дупы, паліцыянт. Табе б дакладна *спадабаліся* наркотыкі. Яны прывядуць цябе ў стан трансцэндэнтнасці".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005029.english: "Yeah -- it's a matter of occupied ecclesiastical property. I bet you've noticed the derelict hive of *narcomania* on the coast?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005029.polish: „Tak – chodzi o problem zajętej eklezjastycznej nieruchomości. Pewnie zauważył pan zapuszczone siedlisko *narkomanii* wznoszące się na wybrzeżu?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005029.belarusian: "Так — справа ў занятай царкоўнай маёмасці. Б'юся аб заклад, вы заўважылі занядбанае логава *наркаманіі* на ўзбярэжжы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100002160.english: "Was there something you wanted? Your friend Acele said there was a problem with the church."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100002160.polish: „Potrzebujesz czegoś? Twoja przyjaciółka mówiła, że jest jakiś problem z kościołem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100002160.belarusian: "Ты нешта хацеў? Твая сяброўка Асэль сказала, што з царквой нейкая праблема".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100002293.english: "Hello, I'm Andre. It's a pleasure to meet you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100002293.polish: „Dzień dobry, nazywam się Andre. Miło mi pana poznać”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000710000229D.english: That means they haven't set up a single one yet.
Dialogue Text/0x010000710000229D.polish: To znaczy, że nie zorganizowali jeszcze ani jednego.
Dialogue Text/0x010000710000229D.belarusian: Гэта азначае, што яны яшчэ не адкрылі аніводнай.

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000022AC.english: He leans back a little, watching you with a steady, serious gaze, letting you imagine just how bad those 'dopeheads' and 'burnouts' really are.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000022AC.polish: Odchyla się odrobinę, spoglądając na ciebie poważnie. Pozwala ci pomyśleć o tym, jak straszne są te wraki i ćpuny.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000022AC.belarusian: Ён трохі адхінаецца назад, назіраючы за табой спакойным, сур'ёзным позіркам, даючы табе ўявіць, наколькі жудасныя гэтыя "торкі" і "канчалыгі".

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000022B4.english: "Ecstatic vibrations! Totally transcendent! And I've finished setting up the new compressor too!" He looks at the imposing black box in the corner that's churning out the sound.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000022B4.polish: „Ekstatyczne wibracje! Totalna transcendencja! Skończyłem też instalowanie nowego kompresora!” – zerka na onieśmielające czarne pudło stojące w kącie, z którego wydobywa się muzyka.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000022B4.belarusian: "Экстатычныя вібрацыі! Поўная трансцэндэнтнасць! І я скончыў падключаць новы кампрэсар!" Ён глядзіць на вялікую чорную скрыню ў куце, якая выдае гук.

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000022CF.english: "Hi again. Have you changed your mind? You changed your mind, right?" The tips of his hair are sharp and white. The bleach has consumed almost all of the toothbrush on the mirror in front of him.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000022CF.polish: „Witam ponownie. Zmienił pan zdanie? Zmienił pan zdanie, tak?” – kolce uformowane z jego włosów są ostre i białe. Wybielacz niemal do końca rozpuścił szczoteczkę do zębów leżącą na znajdującym się przed nim lusterku.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000022CF.belarusian: "Зноў прывітанне. Вы перадумалі? Вы ж перадумалі, так?" Кончыкі яго валасоў вострыя і белыя. Адбельвальнік амаль цалкам раз'еў зубную шчотку на люстэрку перад ім.

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000022DA.english: "Oh, the God of Dance is back! I'm dancing with the God of Dance!" He dances over to you, moving in a slightly less lame manner.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000022DA.polish: „O, powrócił Bóg Tańca! Tańczę z Bogiem Tańca!” – woła, podchodząc do ciebie tanecznym i odrobinę mniej beznadziejnym krokiem.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000022DA.belarusian: "О, Бог Танцу вярнуўся! Я танцую з Богам Танцу!" Ён танцуючы падыходзіць да цябе, рухаючыся трохі менш убога.

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000015C3.english: "You can always come ask for the key to the church if you change your mind. Keep it cool, officer." He winks at you.
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000015C3.polish: „Zawsze możesz wrócić i poprosić o klucz do kościoła, jeśli zmienisz zdanie. Bez spiny, funkcjonariuszu” – puszcza ci oko.
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000015C3.belarusian: "Вы заўсёды можаце прыйсці і папрасіць ключ ад царквы, калі перадумаеце. Трымайцеся, афіцэру". Ён падміргвае табе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001814.english: They've got one speaker. One. Uno. Un.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001814.polish: Mają jeden głośnik. Jeden. Uno. Un.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001814.belarusian: У іх адна калонка. Адна. Uno. Un.

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018A3.english: "He gave me this odd lecture on alcoholism, before rambling on and on about Mother's love."
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018A3.polish: „Dał mi dziwaczny wykład na temat alkoholizmu, a potem zaczął bajdurzyć coś o matczynej miłości”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018A3.belarusian: "Ён прачытаў мне дзіўную лекцыю пра алкагалізм, а потым доўга разважаў пра матчыну любоў".

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018AD.english: "You were right, he's a true narcomaniac. And the way he climbs! It was terrifying."
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018AD.polish: „Miałeś rację, to prawdziwy narkoman. A jak się wspina! Przerażające”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018AD.belarusian: "Ты меў рацыю, ён сапраўдны наркаман. А як ён лазіць! Гэта было жудасна".

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018B5.english: "Just preaching and praying, from the looks of it."
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018B5.polish: „Wygląda na to, że wygłasza kazania i się modli”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018B5.belarusian: "Мяркуючы па ўсім, проста прапаведуе і моліцца".

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018BC.english: "There's something sinister going on under the building's roof... I think he's getting high or something."
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018BC.polish: „Pod tym dachem dzieje się coś złowrogiego. Zdaje się, że gość się narkotyzuje albo coś takiego”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018BC.belarusian: "Пад дахам будынка адбываецца нешта злавеснае... Здаецца, ён там уторкваецца ці нешта такое".

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018C4.english: "He clearly enjoys the physical activity. Guy climbs like a freak!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018C4.polish: „Ewidentnie aktywność fizyczna sprawia mu radość. Gość wspina się jak jakiś pojeb!”
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018C4.belarusian: "Яму відавочна ў кайф фізічная нагрузка. Хлопец лазіць як шалёны!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018D0.english: "It didn't sound like a sober man's talk. He must be getting *visions* up there."
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018D0.polish: „Nie brzmiało to jak wypowiedzi trzeźwego człowieka. Ewidentnie doznaje tam *wizji*”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018D0.belarusian: "Гэта не было падобна на словы цвярозага чалавека. На яго там напэўна наплываюць *відзежы*".

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018D5.english: "I'm not sure, I'm just telling you what it *felt* like."
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018D5.polish: „Nie jestem pewien, mówię ci tylko, jakie to było *uczucie*”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018D5.belarusian: "Не ўпэўнены, я проста кажу, як гэта *адчувалася*".

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018ED.english: "I hear you, friend. What about it?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000018ED.belarusian: "Я цябе чую, сябра. І што з таго?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000019CE.english: "And... you haven't changed your mind about our little side business, have you?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000019CE.polish: „I... Nie zmienił pan zdania na temat naszego małego interesu na boku, prawda?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000019CE.belarusian: "І... вы ж не перадумалі наконт нашага маленькага дадатковага бізнесу, праўда?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000019DC.english: "And... you're still sure about keeping out our little side business, right?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000019DC.polish: „I... Wciąż nie chce pan mieć nic wspólnego z naszym małym interesem na boku, tak?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000019DC.belarusian: "І... вы ўсё яшчэ ўпэўненыя, што хочаце пакінуць за бортам наш маленькі дадатковы бізнес, так?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000019E3.english: "Oh, you mean the *illegal drug lab*? There will be no shady shenanigans in the church, only love and anodic dance music."
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000019E3.polish: „Och, masz na myśli *nielegalną fabrykę narkotyków*? Nie będzie w kościele żadnych szemranych spraw. Tylko miłość i muzyka anodic dance”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000019E3.belarusian: "О, ты пра *нелегальную наркалабараторыю*? У царкве не будзе ніякіх мутных мутак, толькі любоў і анодная танцавальная музыка".

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000019F1.english: "No." A smile vanishes from Egg Head's face as he looks around the room. "No, I thought we agreed to do this pure and true. Guys, we're not changing our mind."
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000019F1.polish: „Nie” – Jajkogłowiec rozgląda się wokoło, a z jego ust znika uśmiech. „Nie. Myślałem, że się dogadaliśmy. Chłopaki, nie zmieniamy zdania”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000019F1.belarusian: "Не". Усмешка знікае з твару Яйкагаловага, калі ён аглядае памяшканне. "Не, я думаў, мы дамовіліся рабіць усё чыста і сумленна. Хлопцы, мы не перадумваем".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A05.english: "No." The one with the necklace stares at you coldly. "You don't get to squeeze out every drop of us and then 'change your mind'."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A05.polish: „Nie” – sprzeciwia się ten z naszyjnikiem i wpatruje się w ciebie chłodno. „Nie wyciśniesz z nas wszystkiego po tym, jak »zmieniłeś zdanie«”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A05.belarusian: "Не". Той, што з пацеркамі, холадна глядзіць на цябе. "Ты не можаш выціснуць з нас усё да апошняй кроплі, а потым "перадумаць"".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A11.english: "We're setting up the shop. It's too late to turn around now. Deal with it, it was your decision, cop-man."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A11.polish: „Rozkręcimy to laboratorium. Za późno, żeby to odkręcić. Pogódź się z tym – to ty podjąłeś tę decyzję, glino”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A11.belarusian: "Мы адкрываем лавачку. Цяпер ужо позна даваць назад. Змірыся, гэта было тваё рашэнне, паліцыянт".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A23.english: "No." The one with the necklace stares at you coldly. "You don't get to take all our money and then 'change your mind'.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A23.polish: „Nie” – sprzeciwia się ten z naszyjnikiem i wpatruje się w ciebie chłodno. „Nie możesz »zmienić zdania« po zabraniu nam wszystkich pieniędzy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A23.belarusian: "Не". Той, што з пацеркамі, холадна глядзіць на цябе. "Ты не можаш забраць усе нашы грошы, а потым "перадумаць"".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A33.english: "Alright!" Andre grins as if this settles it. "It's going to take us a bit to move our stuff inside. A couple of hours, maybe. Come check back later!" He waves to the other speedfreaks. "Let's get moving!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A33.polish: „W porządku!” – Andre uśmiecha się, jakby to załatwiało sprawę. „Przeniesienie naszych rzeczy do środka trochę potrwa. Pewnie kilka godzin. Niech pan zajrzy do nas za jakiś czas!” – zaprasza, po czym macha do swoich towarzyszy i woła: „Do roboty!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A33.belarusian: "Выдатна!" Андрэ шчэрыцца, нібыта пытанне вырашана. "Нам спатрэбіцца крыху часу, каб зацягнуць нашы рэчы ўнутр. Можа, пару гадзін. Зазірніце пазней!" Ён махае астатнім спідфрыкам. "Пагналі!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A41.english: "No." The one with the necklace stares at you coldly. "You don't get to say one thing and then 'change your mind'. We trusted you, cop-man."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A41.polish: „Nie” – sprzeciwia się ten z naszyjnikiem i wpatruje się w ciebie chłodno. „Nie możesz obiecać czegoś, a później »zmienić zdanie«. Zaufaliśmy ci, glino”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A41.belarusian: "Не". Той, што з пацеркамі, холадна глядзіць на цябе. "Ты не можаш спачатку казаць адно, а потым "перадумаць". Мы табе давяралі, паліцыянт".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A48.english: "We're setting up the shop. It's too late to turn around now."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A48.polish: „Rozkręcimy to laboratorium. Za późno, żeby to odkręcić”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A48.belarusian: "Мы адкрываем лавачку. Цяпер ужо позна даваць назад".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A6B.english: "Fine..." He seems disappointed. "We can make do. It's going to take us a bit to move our stuff inside. A couple of hours, maybe. Come check back later." Andre waves to the other speedfreaks. "Let's get moving!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A6B.polish: „Niech będzie...” – stwierdza zawiedziony. „Poradzimy sobie. Przeniesienie naszych rzeczy do środka trochę potrwa. Pewnie kilka godzin. Niech pan zajrzy do nas za jakiś czas!” – zaprasza, po czym macha do swoich towarzyszy i woła: „Do roboty!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A6B.belarusian: "Добра..." Ён выглядае расчараваным. "Абыдземся. Нам спатрэбіцца крыху часу, каб зацягнуць нашы рэчы ўнутр. Можа, пару гадзін. Зазірніце пазней". Андрэ махае астатнім спідфрыкам. "Пагналі!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A9C.english: "And... what about the side business? Have you made up your mind?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A9C.polish: „A co z interesem na boku? Namyślił się pan?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001A9C.belarusian: "І... што наконт дадатковага бізнесу? Вы вырашылі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AA4.english: "You mean the drug lab? Yeah, that's not going to happen. It's illegal, you see." (Refuse to set it up.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AA4.polish: „Masz na myśli fabrykę narkotyków? Tak, o tym nie ma mowy. Bo widzisz, to nielegalne”. (Odmów jej budowy).
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AA4.belarusian: "Ты пра наркалабараторыю? Не, гэтага не будзе. Гэта незаконна, разумееш". (Адмовіцца яе ставіць.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AAA.english: "Proceed with the side business, but I want a cut." (Allow them to set it up.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AAA.polish: „Interes na boku może być, ale chcę dostawać dolę”. (Pozwól im produkować prochy).
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AAA.belarusian: "Займайцеся дадатковым бізнесам, але я хачу долю". (Дазволіць ім паставіць лабараторыю.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AB0.english: "Side business? I don't know what you're talking about." (Turn a blind eye.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AB0.polish: „Interes na boku? Nie mam pojęcia, o czym mowa”. (Nie przeszkadzaj im w niczym).
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AB0.belarusian: "Дадатковы бізнес? Я не разумею, пра што вы". (Заплюшчыць вочы.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AB9.english: "Of course!" He gives you a knowing nod. "I meant the bar, obviously. Why am I even talking about this?" Andre grins as if this settles it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AB9.polish: „Oczywiście!” – woła i porozumiewawczo kiwa głową. „Oczywiście miałem na myśli bar. Po co ja w ogóle poruszyłem ten temat?” – Andre uśmiecha się, jakby to załatwiało sprawę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AB9.belarusian: "Вядома!" Ён з разуменнем ківае. "Я меў на ўвазе бар, натуральна. Чаго я наогул пра гэта загаварыў?" Андрэ шчэрыцца, нібыта пытанне вырашана.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AC0.english: "No." The one with the necklace stares at you coldly. "You don't get to squeeze out every drop of us after keeping us in the dark for so long."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AC0.polish: „Nie” – sprzeciwia się ten z naszyjnikiem i wpatruje się w ciebie chłodno. „Nie wyciśniesz z nas wszystkiego po tym, jak trzymałeś nas w niepewności tak długo”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AC0.belarusian: "Не". Той, што з пацеркамі, холадна глядзіць на цябе. "Ты не будзеш выціскаць з нас усё да апошняй кроплі пасля таго, як так доўга трымаў нас у няведанні".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AC7.english: "Noid!" Andre turns to his friend. "Let's be reasonable here! We could use a friendly face in the station." He turns back to you with a wide smile on his face.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AC7.polish: „Noik!” – zwraca się Andre do swojego przyjaciela. „Bądźmy rozsądni! Przydałaby się nam przyjazna twarz na komisariacie” – stwierdza, po czym z szerokim uśmiechem na ustach odwraca się do ciebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AC7.belarusian: "Ноік!" Андрэ паварочваецца да сябра. "Будзьма разумнымі! Нам не зашкодзіць свой чалавек ва ўчастку". Ён паварочваецца назад да цябе з шырокай усмешкай на твары.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001ACE.english: "How about 50%? It's more than a fair deal. We good?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001ACE.polish: „Co pan powie na 50%? To bardzo uczciwa propozycja. Umowa stoi?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001ACE.belarusian: "Як наконт 50%? Гэта больш чым сумленна. Дамовіліся?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AE2.english: "It's going to take us a bit to move our stuff inside. A couple of hours, maybe. Come check back later!" He waves to the other speedfreaks. "Let's get moving!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AE2.polish: „Przeniesienie naszych rzeczy do środka trochę potrwa. Pewnie kilka godzin. Niech pan zajrzy do nas za jakiś czas!” – zaprasza, po czym macha do swoich towarzyszy i woła: „Do roboty!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AE2.belarusian: "Нам спатрэбіцца крыху часу, каб зацягнуць нашы рэчы ўнутр. Можа, пару гадзін. Зазірніце пазней!" Ён махае астатнім спідфрыкам. "Пагналі!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AF9.english: "Hang on, I thought I'd get it right now?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AF9.polish: „Zaraz, myślałem, że dostanę swoją część już teraz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AF9.belarusian: "Пачакай, я думаў, што атрымаю прама зараз?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AFF.english: "Come now, it'll take weeks to get everything set up, start making the produce, and deliver it around to the needy. This is a lengthy process."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AFF.polish: „Niech pan nie przesadza. Zainstalowanie sprzętu, rozpoczęcie produkcji i dostarczenie towaru potrzebującym potrwa tygodnie. To długotrwały proces”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001AFF.belarusian: "Ды кіньце, спатрэбяцца тыдні, каб усё наладзіць, пачаць вытворчасць тавару і развозіць яго тым, хто мае патрэбу. Гэта працяглы працэс".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001B08.english: "Alright!" He grins. "It's going to take us a bit to move our stuff inside. A couple of hours, maybe. Come check back later!" Andre waves to the other speedfreaks. "Let's get moving!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001B08.polish: „W porządku!” – uśmiecha się. „Przeniesienie naszych rzeczy do środka trochę potrwa. Pewnie kilka godzin. Niech pan zajrzy do nas za jakiś czas!” – zaprasza, po czym macha do swoich towarzyszy i woła: „Do roboty!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001B08.belarusian: "Выдатна!" Ён шчэрыцца. "Нам спатрэбіцца крыху часу, каб зацягнуць нашы рэчы ўнутр. Можа, пару гадзін. Зазірніце пазней!" Андрэ махае астатнім спідфрыкам. "Пагналі!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001B15.english: "Aw man, really?!" His smile wanes slightly. "You're a complete ballbuster."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001B15.polish: „O rety, naprawdę?” – jego uśmiech przygasa. „Straszny z pana nudziarz”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001B15.belarusian: "Эх, сур'ёзна?!" Яго ўсмешка трохі згасае. "Ну вы і душніла".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001B1B.english: "Fine..." He seems disappointed. "We can make do. It's going to take us a bit to move our stuff inside. A couple of hours, maybe. Come check back later." Andre waves to the other speedfreaks. "Let's get moving!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001B1B.polish: „Niech będzie...” – stwierdza zawiedziony. „Poradzimy sobie. Przeniesienie naszych rzeczy do środka trochę potrwa. Pewnie kilka godzin. Niech pan zajrzy do nas za jakiś czas!” – zaprasza, po czym macha do swoich towarzyszy i woła: „Do roboty!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500001B1B.belarusian: "Добра..." Ён выглядае расчараваным. "Абыдземся. Нам спатрэбіцца крыху часу, каб зацягнуць нашы рэчы ўнутр. Можа, пару гадзін. Зазірніце пазней". Андрэ махае астатнім спідфрыкам. "Пагналі!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000044E4.english: "I don't know, I'm a bit of a dopehead myself..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000044E4.polish: „No nie wiem. Sam jestem trochę ćpunem...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000044E4.belarusian: "Не ведаю, я і сам трохі торак..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000044EA.english: "Are they foreigners? I bet they're foreigners."
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000044EA.polish: „To jacyś obcokrajowcy? Założę się, że tak”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000044EA.belarusian: "Яны іншаземцы? Б'юся аб заклад, яны іншаземцы".

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000044F7.english: "Oh, if it was just like that," he rushes to reassure you, "it would be fine. But they're also *spooky*."
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000044F7.polish: „Och, gdyby chodziło tylko o to” – zapewnia cię prędko. „To nie byłoby problemu. Ale jest w nich też coś *strasznego*”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000044F7.belarusian: "О, калі б справа была толькі ў гэтым", — ён спяшаецца запэўніць цябе, — "усё было б нармальна. Але яны яшчэ і *жудасныя*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600004500.english: "Could be, we don't know for sure. But we do know they are *spooky*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600004500.polish: „Możliwe – nie wiemy tego na pewno. Ale wiemy, że jest w nich coś *strasznego*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600004500.belarusian: "Магчыма, мы дакладна не ведаем. Але мы дакладна ведаем, што яны *жудасныя*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600004508.english: "I won't stand for narcomaniacs of any kind. No *narcomaniacs* on my watch." (Shake your head gravely.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600004508.polish: „Nie godzę się na obecność jakichkolwiek narkomanów. Nie na mojej zmianie”. (Pokręć ponuro głową).
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600004508.belarusian: "Я не пацярплю ніякіх наркаманаў. Ніякіх *наркаманаў* на маёй змене". (Змрочна паківаць галавой.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000450F.english: "Yes, yes. And the worst part is -- they're also *spooky*."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000450F.polish: „Tak, tak. A najgorsze w tym wszystkim jest to, że jest w nich coś *strasznego*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000450F.belarusian: "Так, так. І найгоршае — яны яшчэ і *жудасныя*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600004517.english: "I feel like you may be laying this on a bit thick. What's really so bad about these 'dopeheads' and 'burnouts'?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600004517.polish: „Mam wrażenie, że chyba trochę przesadzasz. Co jest takiego złego w tych niby wrakach i ćpunach?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600004517.belarusian: "Мне здаецца, ты трохі перабольшваеш. Што такога дрэннага ў гэтых "торках" і "канчалыгах"?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600004526.english: "I don't know, I indulge a little too sometimes..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600004526.polish: „No nie wiem, sam sobie czasem lubię pofolgować...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600004526.belarusian: "Не ведаю, я і сам часам люблю пабалавацца..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000452C.english: "Oh, that's all fine, of course" he rushes to reassure you. "But these people -- they're also *spooky*."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000452C.polish: „Och, nie ma w tym nic złego, oczywiście” – zapewnia cię szybko. „Ale ci ludzie – oni są też *straszni*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000452C.belarusian: "О, гэта ўсё нармальна, вядома", — ён спяшаецца запэўніць цябе. "Але гэтыя людзі — яны яшчэ і *жудасныя*".

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000070C0.english: "If you do decide to look into the matter of the church, you know where to find us." He flashes you a confident smile.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000070C0.polish: „Jeśli postanowisz zająć się sprawą kościoła, to wiesz, gdzie nas szukać” – stwierdza z pewnym się siebie uśmiechem.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000070C0.belarusian: "Калі ўсё ж такі вырашыце разабрацца са справай царквы, вы ведаеце, дзе нас знайсці". Ён упэўнена ўсміхаецца.

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000070E0.english: "Oh! Oh! You should have the key. We had to padlock the door to the church to keep more vagrants from wandering in... Noid, give the officer the key!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000070E0.polish: „O! O! Powinieneś mieć klucz. Musieliśmy założyć kłódkę na drzwi do kościoła, żeby nie szwendali się tu włóczędzy... Noik, daj funkcjonariuszowi klucz!”
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000070E0.belarusian: "О! О! Вам патрэбен ключ. Нам прыйшлося павесіць замок на дзверы царквы, каб сюды не валачыліся валацугі... Ноік, дай афіцэру ключ!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002A34.english: "What do you propose as the name, Andre?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002A3A.english: "Egg Head, you must have a lot of ideas."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002A40.english: "Acele, what would you suggest as the name?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002A40.belarusian: "Асэль, што б ты прапанавала для назвы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002A46.english: "Soona, do you have an opinion on this?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002A46.polish: „Soono, masz w tej kwestii jakieś zdanie?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002A50.english: "Kim, how would you name the club?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002A56.english: "I think I've come up with a name..." (Proceed.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002A88.english: "Too modern," Andre shakes his spiky head. "And too ironic. We don't want ironic, we want *real*. Real and true and beautiful, like a morning after the rave."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002A88.polish: „Zbyt nowoczesne” – stwierdza Andre, kręcąc swoją kolczastą głową. „I zbyt ironiczne. Nie chcemy, aby nazwa była ironiczna – ma być *prawdziwa*. Prawdziwa, szczera i piękna – jak poranek po balandze”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002A88.belarusian: "Занадта сучасна", — Андрэ хітае сваёй калючай галавой. "І занадта іранічна. Мы не хочам іроніі, мы хочам *сапраўднага*. Сапраўднага, шчырага і прыгожага, як раніца пасля рэйву".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002A94.english: "The name..." He appears to mull it over, one hand idly touching his hair. "Everything I manage to come up with sounds just *wrong*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002A94.polish: „Nazwa...” – pogrąża się w myślach, dotykając dłonią bezwiednie swoje włosy. „Jak dotąd wszystkie, które przyszły mi do głowy, brzmiały po prostu *źle*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002A94.belarusian: "Назва..." Здаецца, ён разважае над гэтым, машынальна дакранаючыся да валасоў. "Усё, што прыходзіць у галаву, гучыць неяк *няправільна*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AA9.english: "No, it has to be bigger than Hard Core." Andre looks worried as he comes to this realization. "Yes, it has to be even bigger than *Hard Core to the Mega*, it has to be bigger than the scene!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AA9.polish: „Nie, to musi być coś mocniejszego niż hardkor” – uświadamia sobie Andre, a na jego twarzy widać zmartwienie. „Tak, to mysi być mocniejsze nawet od *hardkoru do potęgi mega* – to musi być większe od całej sceny!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AA9.belarusian: "Не, трэба нешта больш значнае за хардкор". На твары Андрэ з'яўляецца турбота, калі ён гэта ўсведамляе. "Так, гэта павінна быць нават большым за *Хардкор да поўнага мега*, большым за ўсю тусоўку!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AAF.english: "YEKOKATAA!" The freak with the large head yells from the stage, waving his hand in the air. "THE PLACE TO BE!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AAF.polish: „YEKOKATAA!” – krzyczy ze sceny dziwak z wielką głową, wymachując przy tym rękami. „MIEJSCE, W KTÓRYM WARTO BYĆ!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AAF.belarusian: "ЕКАКАТАА!" — крычыць са сцэны фрык з вялікай галавой, махаючы рукой у паветры. "МЕСЦА, ДЗЕ ТРЭБА БЫЦЬ!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AB5.english: "Yekokataa, the zone of ecological catastrophe? That's too morbid, Egg. Got anything else?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AB5.polish: „Yekokataa? Obszar katastrofy ekologicznej? To zbyt makabryczne, Głowiec. Masz coś innego?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AB5.belarusian: "Екакатаа, зона экалагічнай катастрофы? Занадта змрочна, Яйка. Ёсць яшчэ нешта?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002ABB.english: "HARD CORE!" A witless, victorious smile adorns his face. "HARD CORE TO THE MEGA!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002ABB.polish: „HARDKOR!” – jego twarz zdobi bezmyślny, triumfalny uśmiech. „HARDKOR DO POTĘGI MEGA!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002ABB.belarusian: "ХАРДКОР!" Бязглуздая пераможная ўсмешка асвятляе яго твар. "ХАРДКОР ДА ПОЎНАГА МЕГА!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002ACB.english: "I wouldn't. I wouldn't build a club and I wouldn't name it either."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002ACB.polish: „Nie nazwałbym. Nie założyłbym klubu ani nie nazwałbym go”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002ACB.belarusian: "Ніяк. Я б не будаваў клуб і не даваў бы яму назвы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AD2.english: "An underground place with no name? Sounds like something the crab-man would say."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AD2.polish: „Podziemny lokal bez nazwy? To brzmi jak coś, co powiedziałby kraboczłek”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AD2.belarusian: "Падпольны клуб без назвы? Гучыць як тое, што сказаў бы крабачалавек".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AD9.english: "We're not going with anything the crab-man would say."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AD9.polish: „Nie zgodzimy się na nic, co powiedziałby kraboczłek”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AD9.belarusian: "Мы не будзем рабіць тое, што сказаў бы крабачалавек".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002ADF.english: "Noid, give me your two cents on the issue."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002ADF.polish: „Noik, dorzuć swoje trzy grosze do tej dyskusji”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AED.polish: „W sensie... »Nie mogę sobie przypomnieć nazwy klubu«?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AFA.english: "Why not? The crab-man has *ideas*, Acele. Ideas from another level of consciousness!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AFA.polish: „Czemu nie? Kraboczłek ma *idee*, Acele. Idee z innego poziomu świadomości!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002AFA.belarusian: "Чаму не? У крабачалавека ёсць *ідэі*, Асэль. Ідэі з іншага ўзроўню свядомасці!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B01.english: "I don't care, I don't like the crab-man and I don't like his ideas, his ideas are spooky. Next, please!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B01.polish: „Mało mnie to obchodzi. Nie lubię kraboczłeka i nie lubię jego pomysłów – jego pomysły są upiorne. Następny, proszę!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B01.belarusian: "Мне ўсё адно, мне не падабаецца крабачалавек і не падабаюцца яго ідэі, яго ідэі жудасныя. Наступны, калі ласка!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B21.english: "Good, we have too many opinions anyway."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B21.polish: „To dobrze, i tak mamy zbyt wiele propozycji”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B21.belarusian: "Выдатна, у нас і так зашмат думак".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B2D.english: "Andre's overthinking it," says the girl with the microphone.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B2D.polish: „Andre za dużo nad tym myśli” – stwierdza dziewczyna z mikrofonem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B2D.belarusian: "Андрэ занадта шмат думае", — кажа дзяўчына з мікрафонам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B47.english: "You have?" Andre stops touching his hair. "Well, what's the name?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B47.polish: „Tak?” – pyta i przestaje dotykać swoich włosów. „Jak brzmi ta nazwa?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B47.belarusian: "Прыдумалі?" Андрэ перастае чапаць валасы. "І якая назва?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B69.english: "No, it's beautiful. Beautiful and brave! Like we want it to be."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B69.polish: „Nie, to piękna nazwa. Piękna i odważna! Dokładnie taka, na jakiej nam zależy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B69.belarusian: "Не, гэта цудоўна. Цудоўна і смела! Менавіта тое, чаго мы хочам".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B6F.english: "Like that Dolorian word for the world, you mean? Elysium..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B6F.polish: „Jak to doloriańskie słowo określające świat? Elizjum...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B6F.belarusian: "У сэнсе, тое даларыянскае слова для свету? Элізіум..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B75.english: "But *Disco* Elysium..." She looks unsure. "Isn't it wacky? Disco's kind of gone, isn't it? Forgotten."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B75.polish: „Ale *Disco* Elysium...” – zdaje się, że nie jest pewna. „Czy to nie brzmi dziwacznie? Disco to przeszłość, co nie? Zapomniana”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B75.belarusian: "Але *Disco* Elysium..." Яна выглядае няўпэўненай. "Хіба гэта не дзіўна? Дыска ж ужо нібыта сышло, хіба не? Забытае".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B7B.english: "THE PAST IS THE FUTURE, BUT THE FUTURE IS DEAD!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B7B.polish: „PRZESZŁOŚĆ TO PRZYSZŁOŚĆ, ALE PRZYSZŁOŚĆ JEST MARTWA!”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B85.english: "Egg's right, they can call it 'No Truce' if it's too long. At least it stands out from the others, it *evokes* something, it's victorious."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B85.polish: „Głowiec ma rację, mogą go nazywać »Żadnego rozejmu«, żeby było krócej. Przynajmniej wyróżnia się na tle innych – *wywołuje* jakieś uczucie, jest zwycięska”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B85.belarusian: "Яйка мае рацыю, калі занадта доўга, можна называць проста "Ніякага перамір'я". Прынамсі яна вылучаецца сярод іншых, яна нешта *выклікае*, яна пераможная".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B90.english: "What does that mean?" he yells over the thumping music.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B90.polish: „Co to niby znaczy?” – pyta, próbując przekrzyczeć dudniącą muzykę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B90.belarusian: "Што гэта значыць?" — перакрыквае ён гучную музыку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B99.english: "Wow, it's big. A club for entire Revachol West? So big!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B99.polish: „O, duża rzecz. Klub dla całego Zachodniego Revacholu? Naprawdę duża rzecz!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002B99.belarusian: "Ого, гэта маштабна. Клуб для ўсяго Заходняга Рэвашоля? Як крута!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002BA7.english: "It's settled, then. Everyone, welcome to Revachol West!" He looks around the church as light beams paint the dance floor violet blue.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002BA7.polish: „W takim razie postanowione. Witajcie wszyscy w klubie Zachodni Revachol!” – stwierdza i rozgląda się po kościele, a snopy światła malują parkiet fioletowym błękitem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002BA7.belarusian: "Тады вырашана. Вітаем усіх у "Заходнім Рэвашолі"!" Ён азірае царкву, пакуль прамяні святла афарбоўваюць танцпляц у фіялетава-сіні.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002BB0.english: "It's too long. No one's going to remember it on a Friday night."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002BB0.polish: „Zbyt długie. Nikt nie będzie tej nazwy pamiętał w piątkową noc”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002BB0.belarusian: "Занадта доўга. Ніхто гэтага не запомніць у пятніцу ўвечары".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002BC5.english: "And yet mysterious." He looks around the church as light beams wash over the dance floor, bathing it in violet blue.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002BC5.polish: „A przy tym tajemnicza” – stwierdza i rozgląda się po kościele, a snopy światła omiatają parkiet, zalewając go fioletowym błękitem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002BC5.belarusian: "І пры гэтым таямнічая". Ён азірае царкву, пакуль прамяні святла слізгаюць па танцпляцы, заліваючы яго фіялетава-сінім.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002BCC.english: "It's settled, then. Everyone, welcome to No Truce with the Furies!"
