Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008D54.english: "When I said we have to navigate community matters, I did not mean we have any *say* in them. I meant we should be careful. If we are not... the *shit* will blow right in our faces." He makes a quick gesture towards his visage -- where the shit would blow.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008D54.polish: „Gdy mówiłem o kluczeniu wśród meandrów kwestii społecznych, nie miałem na myśli *angażowania* się w nie. Powinniśmy być ostrożni. W przeciwnym razie... całe to *gówno* trafi nas prosto w twarz” – wyjaśnia, wskazując szybkim ruchem swoją twarz, na której miałoby wylądować rzeczone gówno.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008D54.belarusian: "Калі я казаў, што мы павінны лавіраваць у грамадскіх пытаннях, я не меў на ўвазе, што мы маем у іх права *голасу*. Я меў на ўвазе, што мы павінны быць асцярожнымі. Калі не... усё гэта *лайно* паляціць нам проста ў твар". Ён робіць хуткі жэст у бок свайго твару — куды паляціць лайно.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008ED4.english: "I'm afraid you and I are pawns in a..." He considers the phrasing. "A *pissing* competition."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008ED4.polish: „Obawiam się, że jesteśmy pionkami w...” – przerywa, zastanawiając się chwilę nad najlepszym określeniem. „Zawodach w *przeciąganiu liny*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008ED4.belarusian: "Баюся, мы з вамі пешкі ў..." Ён падбірае выраз. "...спаборніцтве па *вымярэнні пісякамі*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008EDB.english: "I really don't remember anything. There was drinking involved."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008EDB.polish: „Naprawdę nic nie pamiętam. Było dużo pite”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008EDB.belarusian: "Я сапраўды нічога не памятаю. Там без выпіўкі не абышлося".

Alternate1/0x0100000400008EDB.polish: „Czuję, że muszę to powtórzyć – nie pamiętam *niczego*. Bardzo dużo wypiłem”.
Alternate1/0x0100000400008EDB.belarusian: "Адчуваю, што мушу паўтарыць гэта — я не памятаю *анічога*. Там было вельмі шмат выпіўкі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008EE6.english: "Have you tried concentrating on something other than your personal affairs?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008EE6.polish: „Próbowałeś skupić się na czymś innym niż sprawy osobiste?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008EE6.belarusian: "Ці спрабавалі вы сканцэнтравацца на чымсьці акрамя сваіх асабістых спраў?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008EED.english: There is a sudden, harsh edge to his voice. Like he's tired of hearing about your "personal affairs."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008EED.polish: W jego głosie znienacka pobrzmiewają szorstkie tony. Jakby miał już dość słuchania o twoich „sprawach osobistych”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008EED.belarusian: У яго голасе раптам з'яўляюцца рэзкія ноткі. Нібыта яму надакучыла слухаць пра твае "асабістыя справы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008EFA.polish: „W takim razie na czym *powinienem* się skupić?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F00.english: "I'm afraid this is a medical situation." (Move on.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F00.polish: „Obawiam się, że to kwestia zdrowotna”. (Przejdź dalej).

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F0E.english: "Try work. The case at hand. It can work miracles."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F0E.polish: „Spróbuj na pracy. Na bieżącej sprawie. To może zdziałać cuda”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F0E.belarusian: "Паспрабуйце на працы. На бягучай справе. Гэта можа тварыць цуды".

Alternate1/0x0100000400008F1A.polish: „Mowa o poważnych uszkodzeniach neurologicznych. Zobaczyłem się w lustrze i nie miałem pojęcia, kim jestem”.
Alternate1/0x0100000400008F1A.belarusian: "Я кажу пра глыбокія неўралагічныя пашкоджанні. Я пабачыў сябе ў люстэрку і паняцця не меў, хто я такі".

Alternate1/0x0100000400008F22.polish: „Mowa o dużych, niewiarygodnych problemach. Zobaczyłem się w lustrze i nie miałem pojęcia, kim jestem”.
Alternate1/0x0100000400008F22.belarusian: "Я кажу пра сур'ёзныя, неверагодныя пашкоджанні. Я пабачыў сябе ў люстэрку і паняцця не меў, хто я такі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F28.english: "Really?" The lieutenant gives you a look, thorough as if performing triage. "You look fine to me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F28.polish: „Poważnie?” – porucznik przygląda ci się, jakby oceniał stan twojego zdrowia na potrzeby triażu. „Wyglądasz w porządku”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F28.belarusian: "Няўжо? — лейтэнант ацэньвае вас позіркам, нібы праводзіць трыаж. — Як па мне, вы выглядаеце нармальна".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F31.english: "This psycho-drama is unbecoming of an officer."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F40.english: "Focus on *other* people's troubles. Not your own. That is the relief."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F40.polish: „Skup się na problemach *innych* ludzi. Nie na swoich. To przynosi ulgę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F40.belarusian: "Засяродзьцеся на праблемах *іншых* людзей. Не на сваіх уласных. У гэтым і ёсць палёгка".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F4B.english: "It's not psychological. Some sort of major brain damage has occurred. On an unprecedented scale."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F4B.polish: „To nie jest kwestia psychologii. Doszło do jakichś poważnych uszkodzeń mózgu. Na bezprecedensową skalę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F4B.belarusian: "Гэта не псіхалагічнае. Адбылося нейкае маштабнае пашкоджанне мазгоў. На беспрэцэдэнтным узроўні".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F58.english: Clearly he prefers to think you're malingering. He cannot fathom that anyone could drink so much as to retroactively erase their entire life.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F58.polish: Ewidentnie woli myśleć, że bredzisz w malignie. Nie umie sobie wyobrazić, że ktoś wypił tyle, żeby wymazać z głowy całe swoje dotychczasowe życie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F58.belarusian: Відавочна, ён аддае перавагу думцы, што ты проста сімулюеш. Ён не можа ўявіць, што хтосьці здольны выпіць столькі, каб рэтраактыўна сцерці ўсё сваё жыццё.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F68.english: "Then you should consider seeking medical attention. You can use the radio in my Kineema to call your station's *lazareth*. Was there anything else you wanted?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F68.polish: „W takim razie potrzebujesz pomocy lekarskiej. Możesz użyć radiostacji w mojej kineemie, aby skontaktować się z *lazaretem* swojego komisariatu. Mogę ci jeszcze w czymś pomóc?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F68.belarusian: "Тады вам варта звярнуцца па медычную дапамогу. Вы можаце скарыстацца рацыяй у маёй Kineema, каб выклікаць *лазарэт* вашага пастарунка. Вы яшчэ нешта хацелі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F81.english: Your heart beats twice, like a fist. The serotonin deficiency makes your teeth clench.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F81.polish: Twoje serce uderza dwukrotnie niczym pięść. Niedobór serotoniny każe ci zacisnąć zęby.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F81.belarusian: Тваё сэрца б'ецца двойчы, як кулак. Дэфіцыт сератаніну прымушае цябе сціснуць зубы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F96.english: The lieutenant blinks, his mouth slightly open and his body motionless. A microsecond passes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F96.polish: Porucznik mruga, po czym zastyga z lekko otwartymi ustami. Mija mikrosekunda.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F96.belarusian: Лейтэнант лыпае вачыма, ягоны рот крыху прыадкрыты, а цела нерухомае. Мінае мікрасекунда.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F9D.english: "Excuse me. I was lecturing you. I shouldn't have. You should consult a medical professional if you feel that you need help. You can use the radio in my Kineema to call your station's *lazareth*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F9D.polish: „Przepraszam. Pouczałem cię. To było nie na miejscu. Powinieneś zasięgnąć profesjonalnej porady lekarskiej, jeśli czujesz, że potrzebujesz pomocy. Możesz użyć radiostacji w mojej kineemie, aby skontaktować się z *lazaretem* swojego komisariatu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008F9D.belarusian: "Прабачце. Я пачаў чытаць вам мараль. Не варта было. Вам варта пракансультавацца з медыкам, калі адчуваеце, што маеце патрэбу ў дапамозе. Вы можаце скарыстацца рацыяй у маёй Kineema, каб выклікаць *лазарэт* вашага пастарунка".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FA4.english: This habit of dispensing wisdom has been brought to his attention before. He will not think less of you for lashing out -- he is trying to curb it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FA4.polish: Zwracano mu już wcześniej uwagę na jego nawyk wygłaszania mądrości. Nie ma do ciebie żalu o tę reakcję – próbuje go zwalczyć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FA4.belarusian: Яму ўжо не раз рабілі заўвагі наконт гэтай звычкі сыпаць мудрасцямі. Ён не стане горш думаць пра цябе за гэтую ўспышку — ён сам спрабуе яе ўтаймаваць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FC4.polish: „A co jest złego w sprawach osobistych?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FCB.english: "Not a fan. It's just the nature of lieutenancy."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FCB.polish: „Nie przepadam za nimi. Taki po prostu urok bycia porucznikiem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FCB.belarusian: "Не аматар. Такая ўжо натура ў лейтэнантскай пасады".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FD2.english: The RCM deploys a self-styled structure called the Décomptage as its chain of command. Every lieutenant is responsible for two sergeants and eight officers. That means the average lieutenant has to deal with quite a few personal affairs. Even you know this.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FD2.polish: MOR stosuje jako łańcuch dowodzenia stworzoną na własne potrzeby strukturę zwaną décomptage'em. Każdy porucznik odpowiedzialny jest za dwóch sierżantów i ośmiu funkcjonariuszy. A to oznacza, że zazwyczaj musi radzić sobie z niejedną sprawą osobistą. Nawet ty o tym wiesz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FD2.belarusian: РКМ выкарыстоўвае самаробную структуру пад назвай Décomptage у якасці свайго ланцужка камандавання. Кожны лейтэнант адказвае за двух сяржантаў і васьмярых афіцэраў. Гэта азначае, што сярэднестатыстычнаму лейтэнанту даводзіцца разбірацца з ладнай колькасцю асабістых спраў. Нават ты гэта ведаеш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FF7.english: "But I'm completely lacking in basic information about even this organization we're in. Can you help me?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FF7.polish: „Ale nie posiadam nawet podstawowych informacji choćby na temat organizacji, do której należymy. Możesz mi pomóc?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FF7.belarusian: "Але ў мяне зусім няма базавай інфармацыі нават пра гэтую арганізацыю, у якой мы служым. Ці можаш ты мне дапамагчы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FFE.english: "Fine. We should get through the day first. Off-hours begin at 21:00. If you're still having trouble then, I can give you an orientation."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FFE.polish: „W porządku. Najpierw jednak powinniśmy zająć się śledztwem. Kończymy pracę o 21:00. Jeśli do tego czasu wciąż będziesz miał ten problem, to dam ci przyśpieszony kurs wprowadzający”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400008FFE.belarusian: "Добра. Спачатку мы павінны перажыць гэты дзень. Непрацоўны час пачынаецца а 21:00. Калі ў вас да таго часу ўсё яшчэ будуць праблемы, я магу правесці для вас уводны інструктаж".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009016.english: His disdain is clear. This man would not use such an expression otherwise.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009016.polish: Jego odraza jest ewidentna. Ten człowiek nie miałby w innym przypadku takiej miny.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009016.belarusian: Ягоная пагарда відавочная. Інакш гэты чалавек не стаў бы ўжываць такі выраз.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000902A.english: "You don't know?" His eyes narrow. "I assumed you were in on it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000902A.polish: „Nie wiesz?” – pyta, mrużąc oczy. „Założyłem, że bierzesz w tym udział”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000902A.belarusian: "Вы не ведаеце?" Яго вочы звужаюцца. "Я меркаваў, што вы ў курсе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009050.english: "You know what I'm in on -- retrograde amnesia."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009050.polish: „Wiesz, w czym biorę udział. W amnezji”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009050.belarusian: "Ты ведаеш, у чым я ў курсе — у рэтраграднай амнезіі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000906C.polish: „I tak lepsze to niż kretyńskie *gliniarskie przepychanki*”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009082.english: "It's just stupidity. We shouldn't waste any more time on it. If you want my take, ask me after we've inspected the victim."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009082.polish: „To zwykła głupota. Nie powinniśmy tracić na to czasu. Jeśli interesuje cię moje zdanie, to zapytaj mnie o to po oględzinach ofiary”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009082.belarusian: "Гэта проста глупства. Нам не варта марнаваць на гэта больш часу. Калі вам цікавы мой погляд, спытайцеся пасля таго, як мы агледзім ахвяру".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009089.english: "I don't remember being in on anything."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009089.polish: „Nie pamiętam, żebym brał w czymkolwiek udział”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009089.belarusian: "Я не памятаю, каб быў у чымсьці замяшаны".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009092.english: "I think the dispatch desk just told both our stations about the hanging. There was quite the brouhaha at the 57th, I can tell you that. 'Time to *settle it*', they said, '*Cop Off*'. But..." He leans in: "I assure you, I am not their *finest* or *toughest*, with *one hundred-and-two cases solved*. What I am is *least interested in a pissing competition*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009092.polish: „Zdaje się, że dyspozytornia przekazała obu naszym komisariatom zgłoszenie o powieszeniu. Na 57. wywołało to spory rejwach. Pojawiły się głosy, że najwyższa pora *na rozstrzygnięcie* – że to będzie *pojedynek posterunków*. Ale” – pochyla się w twoim kierunku – „zapewniam cię, że ze swoimi *stu dwoma rozwiązanymi sprawami* nie jestem ich *najlepszym* czy *najtwardszym* człowiekiem. Jestem za to kimś, kogo *nie obchodzą zawody w przeciąganiu liny*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400009092.belarusian: "Думаю, дыспетчарская проста паведаміла абодвум нашым участкам пра павешанне. На 57-м быў такі вэрхал, скажу я вам. 'Час усё *вырашыць*', — казалі яны, — '*Копаўскі батл*'. Але... — ён нахіляецца бліжэй: — Запэўніваю вас, са сваімі *ста двума раскрытымі справамі* я зусім не іхні *найлепшы* ці *найдужэйшы*. Я проста той, каго *найменш цікавіць памяранне піськамі* ".

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000090B7.english: "The *cop* kind. Our Precincts can't decide if Martinaise is part of Jamrock or the Industrial Harbour. *Yours* or *mine*, as if we somehow *own* parts of the city. Typical street-gang mentality.... so we've let the Union make a mockery of law enforcement here. And now it's come to its natural conclusion."
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000090B7.polish: „*Gliniarska*. Nasze komisariaty nie są w stanie dojść do porozumienia w sprawie tego, czy Martinaise jest częścią Jamrock czy Portu Przemysłowego. Czy jest *twoje*, czy *moje* – jakbyśmy mogli *posiadać* część miasta. Typowo gangsterska mentalność... Dlatego pozwoliliśmy Związkowi, by kpił sobie z sił ochrony porządku publicznego. I teraz mamy do czynienia z naturalną kulminacją tego procesu”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000090B7.belarusian: "*Копаўская* дурасць. Нашыя пастарункі не могуць вырашыць, ці Марцінэз з'яўляецца часткай Джэмрока, ці Індустрыйнага Порта. *Ваша* гэта ці *маё*, нібыта мы нейкім чынам *валодаем* часткамі горада. Тыповы менталітэт вулічных банд... вось мы і дазволілі Прафсаюзу здзекавацца з законаахоўнікаў тут. А цяпер усё прыйшло да свайго заканамернага фіналу".

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000090FB.english: "What's there to say? It's just stupidity."
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000090FB.polish: „O czym tu mówić? To zwykła głupota”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000910A.english: "Now that we've inspected the scene -- I want to know more about this 'pissing competition' you mentioned."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000910A.polish: „No dobrze, skoro obejrzeliśmy już miejsce zbrodni, chciałbym posłuchać o tym niby przeciąganiu liny”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000910A.belarusian: "Цяпер, калі мы агледзелі месца здарэння, — я хачу даведацца больш пра гэтае 'спаборніцтва па вымярэнні пісякамі', пра якое ты казаў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002700000001.english: So he volunteered to represent the 57th, but not out of competitiveness -- on the contrary.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002700000001.polish: Czyli zgłosił się na ochotnika, aby reprezentować pięćdziesiąty siódmy, ale nie z potrzeby rywalizacji. Wręcz przeciwnie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002700000001.belarusian: Значыць, ён вызваўся прадстаўляць 57-ы, але зусім не з духу суперніцтва — наадварот.

Dialogue Text/0x010000270000001B.english: On the surface he's dismissive, but there's a conspiratorial glint in his black eyes. If only you knew what *he* would say...
Dialogue Text/0x010000270000001B.polish: Wypowiada się lekceważąco, ale w jego ciemnych oczach widzisz konspiratorski błysk. Gdybyś tylko wiedział, co powiedziałby *on*...
Dialogue Text/0x010000270000001B.belarusian: Звонку ён не надае гэтаму значэння, але ў яго чорных вачах праскоквае змоўніцкі бляск. Калі б толькі ты ведаў, што *ён* скажа...

Dialogue Text/0x0100002700000024.english: "Talk of this..." (Consider the phrasing.) "...pissing competition worries me. What stupidity is this?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002700000024.polish: „Całe to...” (Przemyśl użyte określenie). „…przeciąganie liny mocno mnie martwi. Co to za głupota?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002700000024.belarusian: "Размовы пра гэтыя... — (Абдумаць выраз.) — ...памяранні піськамі мяне непакояць. Што гэта за дурасць?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000270000002A.english: "You should tell me now. This seems relevant."
Dialogue Text/0x010000270000002A.polish: „Lepiej powiedz mi teraz. To chyba ważne”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000270000002A.belarusian: "Табе варта сказаць мне зараз. Гэта здаецца істотным".

Dialogue Text/0x010000270000003E.english: "Later." His voice is unflinching. "Was there anything else you wanted to know about the case?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000270000003E.polish: „Później” – odpowiada niewzruszonym tonem. „Masz do mnie jeszcze jakieś pytania dotyczące śledztwa?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000270000003E.belarusian: "Пазней". Яго голас непахісны. "Было нешта яшчэ, што вы хацелі даведацца пра справу?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002700000060.english: Somewhere in your mind hangs a dark green blackboard. There are two columns. One says: "cases solved", the other: "confirmed kills".
Dialogue Text/0x0100002700000060.polish: Gdzieś w głębi twojego umysłu wisi ciemnozielona tablica, na niej zaś tabela z dwiema kolumnami: „Rozwiązane sprawy” i „Potwierdzone zastrzelenia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002700000060.belarusian: Дзесьці ў глыбінях твайго розуму вісіць цёмна-зялёная дошка. На ёй дзве калонкі. На адной напісана: "раскрытыя справы", на другой: "пацверджаныя забойствы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002700000069.english: Look for: Precinct 57 -> Lieutenants -> Kitsuragi, Kim.

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000167FA.english: Relax. You'll find them sooner or later -- this will just take some time.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000167FA.polish: Spokojnie. Znajdziesz tę osobę prędzej czy później. Potrzebujesz tylko trochę czasu.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000167FA.belarusian: Расслабся. Рана ці позна ты іх знойдзеш — проста спатрэбіцца крыху часу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016819.english: Rubbish! You're a green hat and feather totin' birdwatcher!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016819.polish: Bzdury! Jesteś obserwatorem ptaków w zielonej czapeczce z piórkiem!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016819.belarusian: Ерунда! Ты арнітолаг-аматар у зялёным капелюшы з пяром!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016829.english: Or a cop with brain damage. One of the two.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016829.polish: Albo policjantem z uszkodzeniami mózgu. Jedno albo drugie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016829.belarusian: Або паліцыянт з пашкоджанымі мазгамі. Адно з двух.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016838.english: "I won't even *mention* you waving your gun around, harassing customers, *threatening* to sing karaoke, threatening to kill yourself..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016838.polish: „Nie *wspominając* o wymachiwaniu bronią, nękaniu klientów, *grożeniu* śpiewaniem karaoke, grożeniu samobójstwem...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016838.belarusian: "Я нават не буду *згадваць*, як вы размахвалі пісталетам, чапляліся да наведвальнікаў, *пагражалі* спяваць у караоке, пагражалі забіць сябе..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016847.english: Interesting... you still have to find it, however.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016847.polish: Ciekawe. Tak czy inaczej, musisz wciąż znaleźć tę piosenkę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016847.belarusian: Цікава... аднак табе ўсё яшчэ трэба яе знайсці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016869.english: "Seems like Klaasje wasn't lying when she said it was her." The lieutenant makes a note. "This corroborates her story -- she made the call."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016869.polish: „Zdaje się, że Klaasje nie kłamała, gdy się do tego przyznała” – stwierdza porucznik, zapisując coś w notatniku. „To potwierdza jej słowa – to ona dokonała zgłoszenia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016869.belarusian: "Здаецца, Клаас'е не хлусіла, калі казала, што гэта была яна, — лейтэнант робіць пазнаку. — Гэта пацвярджае яе словы — гэта яна выклікала паліцыю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016875.english: Seems like Klaasje wasn't lying when she said she made the call. This corroborates.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016875.polish: Zdaje się, że Klaasje nie kłamała, gdy mówiła, że to ona zadzwoniła. To potwierdza jej zeznania.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016875.belarusian: Здаецца, Клаас'е не хлусіла, калі казала, што выклікала паліцыю. Гэта пацвярджае яе словы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016884.english: She iseth the fairest of them all. The ugliness of lies wouldst never escape her lips!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016884.polish: Najpiękniejszą jest wśród białogłów świata. Jej usta nie zniosłyby ohydy kłamstw!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016884.belarusian: Яна найпрыгажэйшая з усіх дзеў! Брыдота хлусні ніколі б не зляцела з яе вуснаў!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016894.english: Are you *sure* lieutenant? For some reason, you have a little doubt about that...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016894.polish: Jesteś *pewien*, poruczniku? Z jakiegoś powodu wydajesz się mieć drobne wątpliwości...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016894.belarusian: Ты *ўпэўнены*, лейтэнант? Чамусьці ў цябе ёсць пэўныя сумневы...

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000168A2.english: I wouldn't be so sure, detective.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000168A2.belarusian: Я б не быў такім упэўненым, дэтэктыве.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016A41.english: Interesting... you still have to find a copy though. Before you can blast it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016A41.polish: Ciekawe. Tak czy inaczej, musisz znaleźć jej kopię. Inaczej nie zaśpiewasz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016A41.belarusian: Цікава... але табе ўсё роўна трэба знайсці копію. Перш чым урубіць яе на поўную.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016A84.english: "Good. Then it's not lost." She seems a little relieved. "Just don't throw it in the toilet again. Toilets don't work like that."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016A84.polish: „Dobrze. To znaczy, że nie zaginęło” – wyraźnie trochę jej ulżyło. „Proszę nie wrzucać ich już więcej do toalety. Toalety tak nie działają”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016A84.belarusian: "Добра. Значыць, яны не згубленыя, — здаецца, ёй стала крыху лягчэй. — Толькі не кідайце іх зноў ва ўнітаз. Туалеты так не працуюць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016A9B.english: "Especially when there's a hurricane loose. It's *your* fault for losing them -- not mine."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016A9B.polish: „Zwłaszcza gdy szaleje huragan. To *pańska* wina, że je pan stracił, a nie moja”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016A9B.belarusian: "Асабліва калі вакол бушуе ўраган. Гэта *ваша* віна, што вы іх згубілі — не мая".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AA2.english: Something in you wants to immediately *forget* about this. As if there was a reason you threw them away.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AA2.polish: Coś w twoim wnętrzu chce *natychmiast* o tym zapomnieć. Jak gdybyś wyrzucił je nie bez powodu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AA2.belarusian: Нешта ўнутры цябе хоча неадкладна *забыцца* на гэта. Быццам была прычына, чаму ты іх выкінуў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AB0.english: "Are you *sure* you don't remember where the paperwork I flushed is?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AB0.polish: „*Na pewno* nie pamięta pani, gdzie są dokumenty, które wrzuciłem do toalety?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AB0.belarusian: "Ты *ўпэўненая*, што не памятаеш, дзе тыя паперы, якія я спусціў ва ўнітаз?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AB6.english: "Sorry about that." She doesn't sound like she's too sorry. "Anything else, detective?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AB6.polish: „Przykro mi” – wcale nie brzmi, jakby jej było przykro. „Mogę w czymś jeszcze pomóc, detektywie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AB6.belarusian: "Прабачце за гэта, — яна не гучыць так, нібы ёй сапраўды шкада. — Нешта яшчэ, дэтэктыве?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016ABC.english: "Yes, I'm sure. Every time we talk about it I'm going to be *more* sure I don't know."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016ABC.polish: „Tak, jestem pewna. I za każdym razem, gdy będziemy do tego wracać, ja będę tego *bardziej* pewna”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016ABC.belarusian: "Так, упэўненая. І кожны раз, калі мы будзем пра гэта гаварыць, я буду яшчэ *больш* упэўненая, што не ведаю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AD5.english: "I, ugh... the ones I had to wrench out of your toilet?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AD5.polish: „Uch... Te, które musiałam wyciągać z pańskiej toalety?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AD5.belarusian: "Я, э-э... тыя, што мне давялося выдзіраць з вашага туалета?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AE1.english: "I... dammit, I don't remember what I did to your damn papers! I don't remember every little thing I do..." Resentment gives way to concern in her voice.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AE1.polish: „Ja... Cholera, nie pamiętam, co zrobiłam z pańskimi przeklętymi papierami! Nie pamiętam każdej najmniejszej rzeczy, którą robię” – niechęć w jej głosie ustępuje miejsca niepokojowi.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AE1.belarusian: "Я... чорт, я не памятаю, што зрабіла з вашымі клятымі паперамі! Я не памятаю кожную дробязь, якую раблю..." Крыўда ў яе голасе саступае месца трывозе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AE7.english: She's worried she might have accidentally done something bad. Then she remembers it's *you*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AE7.polish: Martwi się, że mogła przypadkiem zrobić coś złego, lecz po chwili przypomina sobie, że rozmawia z *tobą*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AE7.belarusian: Яна перажывае, што магла выпадкова зрабіць нешта дрэннае. Але потым згадвае, што гаворыць з *табой*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AED.english: "Especially when there's a hurricane loose. It's your fault for losing them -- not mine."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AED.polish: „Zwłaszcza gdy szaleje huragan. To pańska wina, że je pan stracił, a nie moja”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AED.belarusian: "Асабліва калі вакол бушуе ўраган. Гэта ваша віна, што вы іх згубілі — не мая".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AF3.english: Something in you wants to immediately *forget* about this. As if there was a reason you threw them away.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AF3.polish: Coś w twoim wnętrzu chce *natychmiast* o tym zapomnieć. Jak gdybyś wyrzucił je nie bez powodu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AF3.belarusian: Нешта ўнутры цябе хоча неадкладна *забыцца* на гэта. Быццам была прычына, чаму ты іх выкінуў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AFF.english: "Yes. You put *something* there. Causing bad water damage in the kitchen. I think it was that."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AFF.polish: „Tak. Włożyła pan *coś* do toalety. Powodując poważne zalanie kuchni. Przypuszczam, że to były te dokumenty”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016AFF.belarusian: "Так. Вы *нешта* туды запхнулі. Заліўшы кухню паверхам ніжэй. Думаю, гэта былі яны".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016B0F.english: It's *on*. The Love Quest is on -- too late everyone! It's *on*. Take it to Garte now!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016B0F.polish: No to *jazda*. Rozpoczęła się misja miłości. Nie ma odwrotu, ludzie! Zaczęło się. Ruszaj do Garte'a!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016B0F.belarusian: Пагнала! Квэст Кахання пачаўся — усе спазніліся! Пагнала! А зараз — да Гарта!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019974.english: "God, why can't you just mind your own business..." she mutters.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019974.polish: „Boże, czemu on nie może po prostu nie wtrącać się w cudze sprawy...” – mamrocze.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019974.belarusian: "Божа, чаму вы не можаце проста не лезці не ў свае справы..." — мармыча яна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001340E.english: The lieutenant goes pale. 'Missing badge?' he mouths to himself, silently.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001340E.polish: Porucznik blednie. „Zgubił odznakę?” – pyta sam siebie bezgłośnie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001340E.belarusian: Лейтэнант бляднее. 'Зніклы значок?' — бязгучна шэпча ён сам сабе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000210000253A.polish: „Przepraszam. Przykro mi z powodu tej piosenki”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000210000271F.english: If she used to work in the Whirling-in-Rags, then you must have met her.
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000271F.polish: Jeśli pracowała w Whirling-in-Rags, to musieliście się poznać.
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000271F.belarusian: Калі яна раней працавала ў Whirling-in-Rags, то вы павінны былі сустракацца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000210000272E.english: "Oh, all sorts of things. Some disco, rock too. So much disco and rock..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000272E.polish: „Och, różne piosenki. Jakieś disco i rock. Mnóstwo disco i rocka...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000272E.belarusian: "О, усякае рознае. Трохі дыска, рок таксама. Столькі дыска і року..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000210000283F.english: "Okay. I don't know what to say."
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000283F.belarusian: "Добра. Я нават не ведаю, што сказаць".

Dialogue Text/0x010000210000313A.english: Whatever this Empathy failure tells you -- *don't* take the quest. It's not wonderful, it's ugly.
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000313A.polish: Cokolwiek ci podpowiada ta żałosna empatia, *nie podejmuj się* tej misji. Nie jest cudowna. Jest paskudna.
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000313A.belarusian: Што б ні казаў табе гэты правал Эмпатыі — *не* бярыся за гэтае заданне. Яно не цудоўнае, яно пачварнае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000761.english: "Sergeant Torson here is wondering if you are still in possession of your genitalia. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000761.polish: „Sierżant Torson chciałby wiedzieć, czy nadal jest pan w posiadaniu swoich genitaliów. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000761.belarusian: "Сяржант Торсан тут цікавіцца, ці вы ўсё яшчэ валодаеце сваімі геніталіямі. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000076C.english: "Yes, I lost my wiener too, just lay off, okay?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000076C.polish: „Tak, parówę też zgubiłem. Przestańcie mi truć, okej?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000076C.belarusian: "Так, піпіську я таксама згубіў, проста адчапіцеся, добра?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000772.english: "I left it at his momma's after I fucked her ass all night. Tell him that."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000772.polish: „Zostawiłem je u jego mamuśki po tym, jak całą noc jechałem ją w dupę. Przekaż mu to”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000772.belarusian: "Я пакінуў яго ў ягонай мамачкі пасля таго, як усю ноч драў яе ў дупу. Перадай яму гэта".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000778.english: "I don't need to listen to this. Firewalker out!" (Turn off the radio.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000778.polish: „Nie muszę tego słuchać. Ognisty kończy połączenie!” (Wyłącz radio).
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000778.belarusian: "Мне не трэба гэта слухаць. Агністы скончыў!" (Выключыць радыё.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000077E.english: "That did not go well. I guess the important thing is that you followed protocol and reported your lost items."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000077E.polish: „Nie poszło najlepiej. Ale najważniejsze, że postąpiłeś zgodnie z przepisami i zgłosiłeś zgubę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000077E.belarusian: "Пайшло не вельмі. Думаю, галоўнае — што вы прытрымліваліся пратаколу і паведамілі пра згубленыя рэчы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007A6.english: "Did we need anything else here?" He looks around in the cabin.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007A6.polish: „Potrzebujemy stąd czegoś jeszcze?” – pyta, rozglądając się po kabinie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007A6.belarusian: "Нам тут яшчэ нешта трэба?" — Ён азірае салон.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007B4.english: The silence is almost deafening after you flick off the switch, severing the connection.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007B4.polish: Stukasz w przełącznik, odcinając połączenie. Zapada ogłuszająca niemal cisza.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007B4.belarusian: Пасля таго, як ты пстрыкаеш тумблерам, абрываючы сувязь, цішыня здаецца амаль аглушальнай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007BA.english: "Thank god for that! That would have been a nightmare. I don't even want to imagine the poor prick who has to relay that kind of news to the captain."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007BA.polish: „Dzięki bogu chociaż za to! To byłby koszmar. Nie chciałbym być w skórze nieszczęsnego skurwiela, który przekazuje kapitanowi takie wieści”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007BA.belarusian: "Дзякуй богу хоць за гэта! Гэта быў бы кашмар. Нават уяўляць не хачу таго беднага чмошніка, якому давялося б паведамляць такія навіны капітану".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007C5.english: "This might sound odd, but there's *personal details* I'd like to discuss."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007C5.polish: „Może zabrzmi to dziwne, ale chciałbym przedyskutować kilka *kwestii osobistych*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007C5.belarusian: "Гэта можа прагучаць дзіўна, але ёсць *асабістыя звесткі*, якія я хацеў бы абмеркаваць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007D2.english: "I guess I can hold off the report for a few days." Oldboy lights another cigarette.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007D2.polish: „W sumie mogę poczekać z raportem kilka dni” – Wyga zapala kolejnego papierosa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007D2.belarusian: "Думаю, я магу прытрымаць рапарт на некалькі дзён". Стары запальвае яшчэ адну цыгарэту.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007FC.english: "This shit does *not* leave this room! Not a word of this to the captain or anyone else. We'll give him a couple of days to pull his shit together!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007FC.polish: „To *nie* może wyjść poza ten pokój! Ani słowa kapitanowi czy komukolwiek innemu. Damy mu kilka dni na zebrane się do kupy!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000007FC.belarusian: "Гэтае лайно *не* выходзіць з гэтага пакоя! Ані слова пра гэта капітану ці каму-небудзь яшчэ. Дамо яму пару дзён, каб узяць сябе ў рукі!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000804.english: The fuck do you need a gun for? Look at the pythons on your arms. You *are* a gun. The biggest one in the world.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000804.polish: Po chuj ci w ogóle spluwa? Popatrz tylko na te potężne węże – twoje dłonie. *Ty* jesteś spluwą. Największą na świecie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000804.belarusian: На якога хера табе той пісталет? Паглядзі на гэтых пітонаў у цябе на руках. Ты *і ёсць* пісталет. Самы вялікі ў свеце.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000827.english: "Mack, man the door," he gestures Torson to block the doorway, then turns to Minot. "You know what he told me? 'I don't want to get better -- I want to get worse.' Those were his words." He sighs heavily and turns to address the room...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000827.polish: „Pilnuj drzwi, Mack” – gestem nakazuje Torsonowi zablokowanie wejścia, po czym odwraca się do Minot. „Wiesz, co mi powiedział? »Nie chcę się odbić od dna, tylko na nim spocząć«. To jego słowa” – wzdycha ciężko i odwraca się do pozostałych.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000827.belarusian: "Мак, устань на дзверы", — ён жэстам загадвае Торсану перакрыць праход, потым паварочваецца да Міно. — "Ведаеш, што ён мне сказаў? 'Я не хачу папраўляцца — я хачу, каб мне стала горш'. Гэта былі ягоныя словы". — Ён цяжка ўздыхае і звяртаецца да ўсіх у пакоі...

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000082D.english: "I just know we can't give up on him when he's at his weakest. He wouldn't..." The crowd in the room has started fidgeting uncomfortably. Someone's trying to slip out unnoticed.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000082D.polish: „Wiem, że nie możemy go skreślać, gdy upadł tak nisko. On by tego nie zrobił...” – zebrani w pomieszczeniu zaczęli kręcić się z zażenowaniem. Ktoś próbuje wyślizgnąć się niepostrzeżenie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000082D.belarusian: "Я проста ведаю, што мы не можам ад яго адмовіцца, калі ён найбольш бездапаможны. Ён бы не..." — Людзі ў пакоі пачынаюць няёмка варушыцца. Хтосьці спрабуе незаўважна выслізнуць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000833.english: "Just a second, officer..." She puts you on hold, the static crackling softly like a bonfire. After a while you hear an old man greet you from the radio. His rattly voice is oddly familiar:
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000833.polish: „Chwila, funkcjonariuszu...” – każe ci czekać. Szum zakłóceń potrzaskuje cicho jak polana w ognisku. Po jakimś czasie słyszysz głos witającego cię starszego mężczyzny. Jego chrapliwy głos jest dziwnie znajomy:
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000833.belarusian: "Секундачку, афіцэру..." Яна ставіць цябе на ўтрыманне, перашкоды ціха патрэскваюць, нібы вогнішча. Праз нейкі час ты чуеш, як з радыё цябе вітае пажылы мужчына. Ягоны дрыготкі голас чамусьці знаёмы:

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000839.english: "That's a negative. Not going to say that. Over."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000844.english: "What's he saying? Share with the class!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000844.polish: „Co mówi? Podziel się z resztą klasy!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000844.belarusian: "Што ён кажа? Падзяліся з усім класам!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000084A.english: "Yeah? How do you fucking plan to do that, huh?! Get him off the drink?! Go jogging with him in the morning and get him on carrot juice?! He's a lost man!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000084A.polish: „Tak? A niby jak, kurwa, chcesz tego dokonać?! Odstawić go od butelki?! Zrobić mu poranny kurs joggingowy z sokiem marchewkowym w gratisie?! Ten gość już przepadł!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000084A.belarusian: "Так? І як ты, бляха, плануеш гэта рабіць, га?! Зняць яго са стакана?! Бегаць з ім раніцай і паіць маркоўным сокам?! Ён прапашчы чалавек!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000850.english: "He... He said he sodomized your mother."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000850.polish: „Mówi... mówi, że uprawiał seks analny z twoją matką”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000850.belarusian: "Ён... Ён сказаў, што займаўся анальным сексам з тваёй маці".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000856.english: "We must help him." Minot looks down at her neatly polished black shoes. There is a quiet firmness to her voice when she speaks.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000856.polish: „Musimy mu pomóc” – Minot spogląda na swoje starannie wypolerowane buty. W jej głosie da się dosłyszeć cichą stanowczość.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000856.belarusian: "Мы мусім дапамагчы яму". — Міно глядзіць уніз на свае акуратна начышчаныя чорныя туфлі. У яе голасе чуваць ціхая цвёрдасць, калі яна гаворыць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000085C.english: "The prick ate momma's vanilla waffles at the captain's birthday party! Some nerve he's got..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000085C.polish: „Ten jebaniec jadł waniliowe wafle mamy na urodzinach kapitana! Bezczelny typ...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000085C.belarusian: "Гэты гандон еў маміны ванільныя вафлі на дні народзінаў капітана! Якое нахабства..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000866.english: "Sure her vanilla waffles were the only thing he ate?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000866.polish: „Może chciał się jej za nie odwdzięczyć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000866.belarusian: "Упэўнены, што яе ванільныя вафлі былі адзіным, што ён еў?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000872.english: "Shut up, Chester, this isn't funny. This is my mom we're talking about!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000872.polish: „Zamknij się, Chester, to nie jest śmieszne. Mówisz o mojej mamie!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000872.belarusian: "Заткніся, Чэстэр, гэта не смешна. Мы гаворым пра маю маму!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000088A.english: "Sergeant Torson requests that you apologize for the claims you made about his mother. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000088A.polish: „Sierżant Torson żąda przeprosin za insynuacje na temat jego matki. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000088A.belarusian: "Сяржант Торсан патрабуе, каб вы папрасілі прабачэння за заявы, зробленыя пра ягоную маці. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000890.english: "10-4, come in..." He hesitates. "...*Fire walker*. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000890.polish: „10-4, zgłoś się...” – następuje chwila wahania – „...*Ognisty*. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000890.belarusian: "10-4, выхадзіце на сувязь... - Ён вагаецца. - ...*Агністы*. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000089B.english: "Yeah, Mullen was fucked alright. Sounded fucking drunk to me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000089B.polish: „Ta, Mullen był, kurwa, zrobiony. Schlany w opór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000089B.belarusian: "Ага, Малену дакладна гамон. Як па мне, ён гучаў у дупель п'яным".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000008A1.english: "Okay, tell him I'm sorry -- It was just banter, I thought that's what cops do."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000008A1.polish: „Dobra, powiedz mu, że przepraszam. Zwykła słowna przepychanka, myślałem, że tak robią gliniarze”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000008A1.belarusian: "Добра, скажы яму, што я прашу прабачэння — гэта быў проста сцёб, я думаў, усе копы так робяць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000008AC.english: "He says he's sorry and he didn't mean nothing by it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000008AC.polish: „Mówi, że przeprasza i nie miał nic złego na myśli”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000008AC.belarusian: "Кажа, што просіць прабачэння і не меў на ўвазе нічога такога".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000008BE.english: "Enough!" The commotion dies down. All eyes turn to Satellite-Officer Vicquemare. "None of this is funny! It's fucking sad, that's what it is. He's a cop. He's one of us, goddamn this..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000008BE.polish: „Dość!” – gwar natychmiast przycicha. Wszystkie oczy zwracają się ku funkcjonariuszowi satelickiemu Vicquemare'owi. „Nie ma w tym nic śmiesznego! To raczej kurewsko smutne, ot co. Jest gliną, jednym z nas, do cholery...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000008BE.belarusian: "Даволі!" — Шум сціхае. Усе вочы звяртаюцца да сатэліт-афіцэра Вікмара. — "Нічога смешнага тут няма! Гэта, бляць, сумна, вось што гэта такое. Ён коп. Ён адзін з нас, чорт бы ўсё пабраў..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000008C4.english: "Tell him to find his *goddamn* badge and gun, that's the *only* thing that matters here!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000008C4.polish: „Powiedz mu, że ma znaleźć tę *cholerną* odznakę i broń – *tylko* to się teraz liczy!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000008C4.belarusian: "Скажы яму знайсці свой *кляты* значок і пісталет, гэта *адзінае*, што цяпер мае значэнне!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000008F9.english: "Yeah, Mack's right, that was some gnarly shit there..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000008F9.belarusian: "Ага, Мак мае рацыю, гэта была поўная жарсць..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000903.english: You *really* need to get your shit together, this is nearing a complete meltdown.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000903.polish: *Naprawdę* musisz ogarnąć gówno w swojej głowie, jesteś bliski kompletnego rozsypania się.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000903.belarusian: Табе *сапраўды* трэба ўзяць сябе ў рукі, гэта ўжо амаль поўны зрыў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000091E.english: "Fire-*water*? He's lost it... Fuck it, tell him to find his goddamn badge and gun, that's the only thing that matters!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000091E.polish: „Og-*oniasty*? Całkiem odpłynął... Jebać to, powiedz mu, że ma, do cholery, znaleźć odznakę i broń – tylko to się liczy!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000091E.belarusian: "Вогненная *вада*? Ён з глузду з'ехаў... Пайшло яно, скажы яму знайсці кляты значок і пісталет, гэта адзінае, што мае значэнне!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000924.english: "Hey, if you don't like the fallout, maybe *don't* fuck with the Firewalker!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000924.polish: „Te, jak się nie podoba riposta, to może trzeba było *nie* dopierdalać się do Ognistego?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000924.belarusian: "Гэй, калі не падабаюцца наступствы, мо *не* трэба лезці да Агністага?!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000092A.english: "Who?!" The disbelief in Vicquemare's voice is overwhelming.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000092A.polish: „Kogo?!” – niedowierzanie w głosie Vicquemare'a jest przemożne.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000092A.belarusian: "Каго?!" Недавер у голасе Вікмара проста бязмежны.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000930.english: "10-2 (Receiving Well), 10-5 (Relay Message). This is 41st, come in! Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000930.belarusian: "10-2 (Добры прыём), 10-5 (Перадайце паведамленне). Гэта 41-шы, выйдзіце на сувязь! Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000936.english: "Wrap it up, don't indulge in his drunken antics!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000936.polish: „Streszczaj się, nie daj się wciągnąć w jego pijackie dziwactwa!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000936.belarusian: "Закругляйся, не паддавайся на ягоныя п'яныя выбрыкі!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000093C.english: "Listen, I've actually lost my gun, too."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000093C.polish: „Słuchaj, tak się składa, że broń też zgubiłem”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000942.english: "Mack, he says maybe you shouldn't have antagonised the Firewalker in the first place."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000942.polish: „Mack, on mówi, że może nie warto było robić sobie wroga z Ognistego”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000942.belarusian: "Мак, ён кажа, што, магчыма, не варта было першым чапляць Агністага".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000960.english: Mack 'The Torso' Torson is finger-fucking his fist, laughing hoarsely and apparently telling some dirty story to his partner, Chester McLaine, near the entrance.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000960.polish: Obok wejścia Mack „Tors” Torson posuwa palcem swoją zaciśniętą pięść, śmiejąc się ochryple, co najwyraźniej stanowi oprawę artystyczną jakiejś świńskiej historyjki, którą raczy swojego partnera, Chestera McLaine'a.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000960.belarusian: Мак 'Торс' Торсан поркаецца пальцам у кулаку, хрыпла рагоча і, відаць, расказвае нейкую брудную гісторыю свайму напарніку, Чэстэру МакЛэйну, каля ўваходу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000966.english: "I am afraid he might be referring to himself as *Firewater*, sir."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000966.polish: „Obawiam się, że mówi o sobie per *Ogoniasty*”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000970.english: A scrawny old man sits in a dusty cubicle, smoking, with a large white rectangle sewn on his vest. In front of him is a box-shaped apparatus with an array of wires and antennas -- the radio switchboard.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000970.polish: Kościsty staruszek z papierosem w zębach siedzi w zakurzonym boksie. Na kamizelce ma naszyty duży, biały prostokąt. Przed nim leży aparat w kształcie pudełka, z którego wystają najróżniejsze kable i anteny – centrala radiowa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000970.belarusian: Хударлявы стары сядзіць у запыленым боксе, курыць, на ягонай камізэльцы нашыты вялікі белы прастакутнік. Перад ім каробкападобны апарат з кучай правадоў і антэн — радыёкамутатар.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000976.english: "He acknowledges your joke and asks you to lay off."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000976.polish: „Przyjmuje pańskie docinki i prosi, żeby mu nie truć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000976.belarusian: "Ён прымае ваш жарт і просіць вас адчапіцца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000988.english: "Lay off? Lay off?! Tell him we'll lay off when he retrieves the goddamn police property that he has been entrusted with."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000988.polish: „Nie truć? Ja truję? Powiedz mu, że przestaniemy truć, jak, do cholery, odzyska własność policji, którą mu powierzono”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000988.belarusian: "Адчапіцца? Адчапіцца?! Скажы яму, што мы адчэпімся, калі ён верне клятую паліцэйскую маёмасць, якую яму даверылі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000098E.english: "10-4, I know, I already wrote it in a report, but..." He hesitates. "It will stay on my desk for a few days. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000098E.polish: „10-4, wiem, uwzględniłem to w raporcie, ale...” – waha się. „Poleży u mnie na biurku kilka dni. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000098E.belarusian: "10-4, ведаю, я ўжо ўнёс гэта ў рапарт, але... — Ён вагаецца. — Ён паляжыць у мяне на стале некалькі дзён. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009AC.english: "Does he actually want something or is he hell-bent on disrupting our work?!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009AC.polish: „On w ogóle czegoś chce czy uparł się, żeby nam utrudnić życie?!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009AC.belarusian: "Яму сапраўды нешта трэба ці ён наўмысна зрывае нашу працу?!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009BF.english: "10-9, repeat message! I didn't get that, sir. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009BF.belarusian: "10-9, паўтарыце паведамленне! Я не зразумеў, сэру. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009C5.english: "No, I think I'm good. I think I'm good without my gun, thanks."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009C5.polish: „Nie, chyba dam spokój. Nie potrzebuję swojej broni, dzięki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009C5.belarusian: "Не, думаю, усё ў парадку. Думаю, мне і без пісталета добра, дзякуй".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009D0.english: "I heard him and I'm on it. "
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009D0.belarusian: "Я яго чуў і ўжо займаюся гэтым".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009D6.english: You probably don't *want* to continue on this road.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009D6.polish: Raczej *nie chcesz* chyba brnąć w to dalej.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009D6.belarusian: Ты, напэўна, *не хочаш* працягваць гэты шлях.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009DC.english: "10-4, affirmative. Officer is in pursuit of his firearm." There's static.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009DC.polish: „10-4, potwierdzam. Funkcjonariusz prowadzi poszukiwania broni służbowej” – słychać szum.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000009DC.belarusian: "10-4, пацвярджаю. Афіцэр займаецца пошукам сваёй агнястрэльнай зброі". Чуваць перашкоды.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A03.english: "I'm going to report that you are in pursuit of your service weapon. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A03.polish: „Zamelduję, że poszukuje pan swojej broni. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A03.belarusian: "Я паведамлю, што вы займаецеся пошукам сваёй табельнай зброі. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A09.english: "10-4, Station 41. I've got a urgent business. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A09.belarusian: "10-4, Пастарунак 41. У мяне тэрміновая справа. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A15.english: "Hi, this is... *me* here, I work at your station."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A15.belarusian: "Прывітанне, гэта... *я*, я працую ў вашым пастарунку".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A21.english: "The officer is describing his genitalia in exaggerated terms. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A21.polish: „Funkcjonariusz opisuje swoje genitalia w sposób mocno wyolbrzymiony. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A21.belarusian: "Афіцэр апісвае свае геніталіі ў перабольшаных выразах. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A2C.english: "It's got a magnetic accelerator an *arc* that accelerates the energized ball of periwinkle-blue hydrogen-based *blaasma* to near light speed..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A2C.polish: „Ma magnetyczny akcelerator, *promień* przyspieszający naenergetyzowaną kulę barwinkowatej, wodorowej *blazmy* do prędkości bliskiej świetlnej...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A2C.belarusian: "У ім ёсць магнітны паскаральнік, *дуга*, якая разганяе зараджаную кулю барвянкава-блакітнай вадароднай *блазмы* амаль да хуткасці святла..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A32.english: Click, your index finger goes as the thumb cocks the hammer, click, cock, click... and then nothing. Three-shot, probably. Needs reloading. Break it open.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A32.polish: Klik – twój palec wskazujący ugina się, kiedy kciuk naciąga kurek. Klik, cyk, klik... a potem nic. Pewnie trójstrzałowiec. Trzeba przeładować. Otwórz go.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A32.belarusian: Клік — робіць твой указальны палец, пакуль вялікі ўзводзіць курок, клік, узвод, клік... а потым нічога. Трохзарадны, напэўна. Трэба перазарадзіць. Пераламі яго.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A38.english: You are describing a Villiers three-shot 9mm Pepperbox with a revolving barrel.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A38.polish: Opisujesz trójstrzałową broń Villiersa typu pieprzniczka, kaliber 9 milimetrów.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A38.belarusian: Ты апісваеш трохзарадны 9-міліметровы пепербокс Villiers з барабанам, які круціцца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A4F.english: "You really think I'd lose my *Villiers 9mm*? Nine millimetres of red hot leaden pepper for you right here, boys!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A4F.polish: „Naprawdę myślisz, że zgubiłbym swojego *Villiersa 9 mm*? Dziewięć milimetrów rozgrzanego ołowiu czeka na was, chłopaki!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A4F.belarusian: "Вы сапраўды думаеце, што я згубіў бы свой *9-міліметровы Villiers*? Дзевяць міліметраў распаленага свінцовага перцу для вас проста тут, хлопцы!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A5B.english: "Triangular barrel, three shot, hammer at the end -- what else do you want from me? To tell you all about my wooden handle? Lay off, boys."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A5B.polish: „Trójkątna lufa, trzy strzały, kurek na końcu. Co jeszcze mam powiedzieć? Opowiedzieć coś o gładkim uchwycie? Odczepcie się, chłopaki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A5B.belarusian: "Трохкутны ствол, тры зарады, курок на канцы — чаго вы яшчэ ад мяне хочаце? Расказаць вам усё пра драўляную дзяржальню? Адчапіцеся, хлопцы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A6D.english: "10-4 (Message Received), 10-5 (Relay Message). What's your status? Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A6D.belarusian: "10-4 (Паведамленне прынята), 10-5 (Перадайце паведамленне). Які ваш статус? Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A7D.english: "Well, I guess he'd better crack the case before sundown then!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A7D.polish: „No to lepiej, żeby uporał się z tą sprawą przed zmierzchem!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A7D.belarusian: "Ну, тады яму лепей раскрыць справу да заходу сонца!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A8D.english: "He isn't getting a red cent, you can tell him that!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A8D.polish: „Złamanego grosza nie dostanie, tak mu powiedz!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A8D.belarusian: "Ён не атрымае ані шэлега, так яму і скажы!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A99.english: (Speak into the radio.) "It's a single-shot Armistice Kiejl A9. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A99.polish: (Powiedz do radia). „To jednostrzałowy Armistice Kiejl A9. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000A99.belarusian: (Сказаць у радыё.) "Гэта адназарадны Armistice Kiejl A9. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AAE.english: "Armistice? What, is he a fucking...? Clearly he doesn't have his Villiers anymore."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AAE.polish: „Armistice? Co on, kurwa...? No to wiemy, że nie ma już swojego villiersa”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AAE.belarusian: "Armistice? Ён што, бляха...? Ясна, што ніякага Villiers у яго больш няма".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AB4.english: "What is going on here? Did something happen?" she asks, startled. Jean Vicquemare turns to her and says...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AB4.polish: „Co się tutaj dzieje? Stało się coś?” – pyta zaskoczona. Jean Vicquemare odwraca się do niej i mówi:
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AB4.belarusian: "Што тут адбываецца? Нешта здарылася?" — спалохана пытаецца яна. Жан Вікмар паварочваецца да яе і кажа...

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AC4.english: "In contact it *detonates* with the power of a dying star, erasing every living thing from existence. Oh, and did I mention it is dripping with sexy blue blaasma?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AC4.polish: „Po zetknięciu się z celem *detonuje* z mocą umierającej gwiazdy, kładąc kres istnieniu każdej żywej istocie. A, wspominałem już, że ocieka wręcz seksowną, niebieską blazmą?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AC4.belarusian: "Пры кантакце яна *дэтануе* з моцай паміраючай зоркі, сціраючы ўсё жывое з існавання. О, а я згадваў, што з яго сцякае сэксуальная блакітная блазма?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000ACA.english: "Uh... I'm going to need to put you on speaker for a second. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000ACA.polish: „Uch... To może przełączę na chwilę na głośnik. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000ACA.belarusian: "Эм... Мне трэба на секунду пераключыць вас на гучную сувязь. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AE1.belarusian: "Гучыць так, нібы ён наўмысна пазбягае канкрэтыкі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AE7.english: "Detective Mullen has done it again! 'Uh... where's my gun?'" the speaker crudely mimics your voice.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AE7.polish: „Detektyw Mullen zawsze w formie! »Uch... gdzie moja spluwa?«” – słyszysz mało subtelną parodię swojego głosu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AE7.belarusian: "Дэтэктыў Мален зноў у сваім рэпертуары! 'Э-э... а дзе мой пісталет?'" — той, хто гаворыць, няўмела перадражнівае твой голас.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AFC.english: "Dear god, he lost his gun!!! Oh my... I can't... He..." The man succumbs to laughter again.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AFC.polish: „Dobry boże, zgubił broń!!! O mój... Nie wytrzymam...” – mężczyzna ponownie zanosi się śmiechem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000AFC.belarusian: "Божа літасцівы, ён згубіў пісталет!!! О мой... я не магу... Ён..." Мужчына зноў заходзіцца смехам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B02.english: "Mack can face the Giant of Koko Nur by himself, but Disco here made him piss his pants!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B02.polish: „Mack może w pojedynkę wziąć się za Olbrzyma z Koko Nur, ale Disco potrafi sprawić, żeby robił w gacie!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B02.belarusian: "Мак можа сам-насам выйсці супраць Волата з Кока Нур, але тут Дыска прымусіў яго сцыкануць у нагавіцы!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B08.english: "Oh I... I can't... Fuuuuuck, he lost his... Ask him if he still has his wiener!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B08.polish: „O ja pierdolę... nie zdzierżę... zgubił... Zapytaj go, czy wacka też nie zapodział!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B08.belarusian: "Ой, я... не магу... Бля-а-аць, ён згубіў свой... Спытай у яго, ці піпіська яшчэ на месцы!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B25.english: (Put the microphone back in its holder and quit the call.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B25.belarusian: Пакласці мікрафон назад на трымальнік і скончыць выклік.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B31.english: "I just thought you might have heard of them, that's all."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B31.polish: „Myślałem po prostu, że może coś wiesz na ten temat”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B31.belarusian: "Я проста падумаў, што ты мог чуць пра іх, вось і ўсё".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B64.english: "It's a gun, what can I say? A regular god damn murder weapon, you know how they are -- *bang-bang*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B64.polish: „To broń, co mogę powiedzieć? Normalna, cholerna broń do mordowania, jak to zwykle bywa. *Bang-bang*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B64.belarusian: "Гэта пісталет, што я магу сказаць? Звычайная клятая прылада забойства, вы ж ведаеце, як яны працуюць — *піф-паф*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B76.english: "He says it's important to the case."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B94.english: "Trick question. I'm a martial artist. My entire body is one big gun."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B94.polish: „Podchwytliwe pytanie. Jestem mistrzem sztuk walki. Moje całe ciało jest jedną wielką spluwą”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B94.belarusian: "Пытанне з падвохам. Я майстар баявых мастацтваў. Усё маё цела — адзін вялікі пісталет".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B9A.english: "He says he's in trouble, doesn't have a place to sleep."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B9A.polish: „Mówi, że jest w potrzebie. Nie ma gdzie spać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000B9A.belarusian: "Кажа, што ў бядзе, няма дзе пераначаваць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000BAC.english: Oh, *requests a description*, huh? We'll *give* him one. Describe the Blaasma Gun.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000BAC.polish: Och, *podanie opisu*, co? No to *opisz* mu ją. Opisz pistolet blazmowy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000BAC.belarusian: О, *просіць апісанне*, га? Мы *дамо* яму апісанне. Апішы блазмамёт.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000BB4.english: "Uh... He says he is a living weapon and we are trying to trick him."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000BB4.polish: „Uch... Mówi, że jest żywą bronią, a my próbujemy go podejść”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000BB4.belarusian: "Эм... Кажа, што ён — жывая зброя, а мы спрабуем яго падмануць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000BD2.english: We can do it, brother. You have it in the nerve endings in your hand. You just need to dig into your muscle memory.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000BD2.polish: Damy radę, bracie. Masz tę wiedzę w zakończeniach nerwowych dłoni. Musisz tylko wgryźć się w swoją pamięć mięśniową.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000BD2.belarusian: Мы можам гэта зрабіць, браце. Гэта ў цябе ў нервовых канчатках на руцэ. Трэба проста капнуць у цягліцавую памяць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000BE1.english: Try to imagine the weapon in your hand.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000BE1.polish: Spróbuj wyobrazić sobie, jak trzymasz broń w ręce.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000BE1.belarusian: Паспрабаваць уявіць зброю ў сваёй руцэ.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000BFD.english: (Whisper to the lieutenant.) "Kim, what are you packing?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000BFD.belarusian: (Шэптам да лейтэнанта.) "Кім, які ў цябе ствол?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C09.english: "It's a single-shot Kiejl A9. An *Armistice* to be precise."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C15.english: "Host in heaven, did he lose his gun *and* his mind?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C15.polish: „Panie w niebiesiech, razem z bronią postradał *też* zmysły?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C15.belarusian: "Сілы нябесныя, ён згубіў і пісталет, *і* розум?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C1B.english: "It's your partner, Satellite-Officer Vicquemare, sir. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C1B.polish: „To pański partner, funkcjonariusz satelicki Vicquemare. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C1B.belarusian: "Гэта ваш партнёр, сатэліт-афіцэр Вікмар, сэру. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C27.english: "Please, I don't wanna be here... I have to..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C27.polish: „Proszę, ja nie chcę tu być... Muszę...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C27.belarusian: "Калі ласка, я не хачу тут быць... Мне трэба..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C2D.english: "Look, I don't have it, all right? I don't have my gun."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C2D.polish: „Słuchaj, nie mam jej, dobra? Nie mam swojej broni”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C2D.belarusian: "Слухайце, у мяне яго няма, добра? У мяне няма майго пісталета".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C43.english: "He says it's just a regular gun."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C49.english: "What? What is it?! He's still on the line?!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C49.polish: „Co? O co mu chodzi?! Nadal jest na linii?!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C49.belarusian: "Што? Што такое?! Ён усё яшчэ на лініі?!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C57.english: Just say you lost your gun. Anything else would only make the situation worse here.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C57.polish: Po prostu powiedz, że zgubiłeś broń. Wszystko inne tylko pogorszy sytuację.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C57.belarusian: Проста скажы, што згубіў пісталет. Усё астатняе толькі пагоршыць сітуацыю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C5D.english: "Please just talk human to me. These numbers mean nothing to me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C5D.polish: „Proszę, mów do mnie po ludzku. Te liczby zupełnie nic mi nie mówią”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C5D.belarusian: "Калі ласка, размаўляй са мной па-чалавечы. Гэтыя лічбы мне нічога не кажуць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C63.english: "Enough with this now, I have other things to discuss."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C63.polish: „Dość już o tym, mam inne sprawy do poruszenia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C63.belarusian: "Хопіць ужо пра гэта, у мяне ёсць іншыя справы для абмеркавання".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C69.english: "Satellite-Officer McLaine requests a description of your weapon. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C69.polish: „Funkcjonariusz satelicki McLaine prosi o podanie opisu pańskiej broni. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C69.belarusian: "Сатэліт-афіцэр МакЛэйн просіць апісанне вашай зброі. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C6F.english: "Losing his badge is bad enough. Tell him to find it and *fast*! We can't have some gangbanger running around with it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C6F.polish: „Wystarczy, że zgubił odznakę. Każ mu ją znaleźć, i to *szybko*! Nie można pozwolić, żeby jacyś gangsterzy z nią paradowali”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C6F.belarusian: "Згубіць значок — ужо кепска. Скажы яму знайсці яго, і *хутка*! Нельга, каб нейкі гангстар бегаў з ім".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C7D.english: "No, I'm alright, I'm all right. I had... other things."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C7D.polish: „Nie, wszystko dobrze, wszystko dobrze. Mam jeszcze... inne sprawy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C7D.belarusian: "Не, са мной усё добра, усё добра. У мяне былі... іншыя справы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C83.english: "He asked if he ever told me about his days before joining the RCM."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C83.polish: „Spytał, czy opowiadał mi kiedyś o swoim życiu sprzed wstąpienia do MOR-u”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C83.belarusian: "Ён спытаў, ці распавядаў калі-небудзь пра жыццё да ўступлення ў РГМ".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C89.english: "Ask him..." The speaker gasps for air. "Ask him if he lost his *gun* too!" The room roars with laughter.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C89.polish: „Zapytaj go...” – osoba po drugiej stronie z trudem powstrzymuje wybuch śmiechu. „Zapytaj, czy zgubił też *broń*!” – teraz cały pokój wypełnia się śmiechem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C89.belarusian: "Спытай у яго... — Той, хто гаворыць, задыхаецца ад смеху. — Спытай, ці не згубіў ён яшчэ і *пісталет*!" Пакой заходзіцца ад рогату.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C8F.english: "Sergeant Torson wants to know if you lost your gun too. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C8F.polish: „Sierżant Torson chce wiedzieć, czy broń też pan zgubił. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C8F.belarusian: "Сяржант Торсан хоча ведаць, ці вы згубілі і пісталет. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C9A.english: "Uh... No, sir, I haven't. You're not really keen on mentioning your home life, so I've always assumed things weren't that good on that front. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C9A.polish: „Uch... Nie, nie słyszałem. Zwykle niechętnie wspomina pan o życiu prywatnym, więc zakładałem, że na tym froncie nie dzieje się najlepiej. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000C9A.belarusian: "Эм... Не, сэру, не чуў. Вы не надта ахвотна згадваеце пра хатняе жыццё, таму я заўсёды меркаваў, што на тым фронце справы не вельмі. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CA4.english: "Sergeant Torson was wondering if you found your badge yet? Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CA4.polish: „Sierżant Torson jest ciekaw, czy znalazł pan już swoją odznakę. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CA4.belarusian: "Сяржант Торсан цікавіцца, ці вы ўжо знайшлі свой значок? Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CAA.english: "Yes, tell him I found it from his mother's bed."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CAA.polish: „Tak, powiedz, że znalazłem ją w łóżku jego matki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CAA.belarusian: "Так, скажы яму, што я знайшоў яго ў ложку ягонай маці".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CB0.english: "Alright." The operator turns back to you. "That's a negative on the additional funds, sir. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CB0.polish: „W porządku” – operator zwraca się ponownie do ciebie: „Nie ma zgody na dodatkowe fundusze. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CB0.belarusian: "Добра". Аператар зноў звяртаецца да цябе: "Адмоўны адказ наконт дадатковых сродкаў, сэру. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CC1.english: "He's not replying. Looks like he is still looking for it." You can hear laughter in the background.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CC1.polish: „Nie odpowiada. Chyba nadal jej szuka” – w tle słyszysz śmiech.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CC1.belarusian: "Ён не адказвае. Здаецца, усё яшчэ шукае яго". На фоне чуваць смех.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CCD.english: "Negative, sir. Over." You can hear laughter in the background.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CCD.belarusian: "Адмоўна, сэру. Прыём". На фоне чуваць смех.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CE5.english: "... new heights even for Captain Sober!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CEB.english: "Sir, I will not have you talk to me in this manner. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CEB.polish: „Nie pozwolę tak do siebie mówić. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CEB.belarusian: "Сэру, я не дазволю вам размаўляць са мной у такім тоне. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CF1.english: Convince them that you didn't lose your gun.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CF1.polish: Przekonaj ich, że nie zgubiłeś swojej broni.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CF1.belarusian: Пераканаць іх, што ты не згубіў свой пісталет.

tooltip2/0x0100004C00000CF1.belarusian: Ты ўсё яшчэ не даў адказу.

tooltip3/0x0100004C00000CF1.polish: Na wszystkie świętości, wciąż nie odpowiedziałeś!
tooltip3/0x0100004C00000CF1.belarusian: На ўсе святы, ты ўсё яшчэ не адказаў!

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000CFF.english: "Come again, sir, I didn't get that! 10-9. Over!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D0A.english: "Did he lose his memory along with his fucking badge?" The man in the background sounds like he's losing his patience.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D0A.polish: „Oprócz odznaki stracił też, kurwa, pamięć?” – mężczyźnie, którego słychać w tle, kończy się chyba cierpliwość.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D0A.belarusian: "Ён разам са сваім ёбаным значком і памяць згубіў?" Здаецца, чалавек на фоне губляе цярпенне.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D1B.english: "10-1, you're breaking up. 10-9, repeat please. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D1B.belarusian: "10-1, вы прападаеце. 10-9, паўтарыце, калі ласка. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D2F.english: "I don't want to be here anymore, I want to go home! Please come and get me..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D2F.polish: „Nie chcę już tu być, chcę wrócić do domu! Proszę, przyjedźcie po mnie...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D2F.belarusian: "Я больш не хачу тут быць, я хачу дадому! Калі ласка, прыедзьце і забярыце мяне..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D41.english: "Come in, officer! 10-9, repeat message please. Did you misplace your firearm? Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D41.polish: „Zgłoś się! 10-9, powtórz, proszę. Zgubił pan gdzieś swoją broń? Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D41.belarusian: "Выйдзіце на сувязь, афіцэру! 10-9, калі ласка, паўтарыце паведамленне. Вы згубілі сваю зброю? Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D47.english: "Says he lost his badge and needs to report it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D47.polish: „Mówi, że zgubił odznakę i musi to zgłosić”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D47.belarusian: "Кажа, што згубіў значок і мусіць паведаміць пра гэта".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D4D.english: "This is Communications Officer Jules Pidieu, sir. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D4D.polish: „Z tej strony funkcjonariusz łączności Jules Pidieu. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D4D.belarusian: "Гэта афіцэр сувязі Жуль Підыё, сэру. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D5E.english: "He says he didn't lose his gun -- *or* his fun, whatever that means."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D5E.polish: „Mówi, że nie zgubił broni. *Albo* woni, cokolwiek to znaczy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D5E.belarusian: "Кажа, што не губляў ствол — *ці* стол, што б гэта ні значыла".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D69.english: "Ask him to describe it! His gun! Not his *fun*, just the gun will do..." He laughs.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D69.polish: „Niech ją opisze! Broń! O *woni* wolimy nie wiedzieć...” – śmieje się.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D69.belarusian: "Папрасі яго апісаць! Ствол! Не *стол*, хопіць і ствала..." — Ён смяецца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D75.english: "Let us address them now, sir. Over."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D83.english: "I wanted to know if you got my badge's description right in your report. Could you read it to me -- name, rank, date of birth?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D83.polish: „Chciałem tylko potwierdzić, czy opis mojej odznaki w twoim meldunku jest poprawny. Możesz mi go odczytać? Imię, stopień, datę urodzenia?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D83.belarusian: "Я хацеў даведацца, ці правільна ты апісаў мой значок у сваім рапарце. Можаш зачытаць мне — імя, званне, дату нараджэння?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D93.english: Check your pockets! Check your... holy fuck, you don't know where it is, do you?!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D93.polish: Sprawdź w kieszeniach! Sprawdź w... O ja pierdolę, nie wiesz, gdzie ona jest, prawda?!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000D93.belarusian: Правер кішэні! Правер... тваю ж маць, ты не ведаеш, дзе ён, так?!

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000DA4.english: "Uh, listen..." He seems to lower his voice a bit, carefully choosing his words. "It's okay... you can do it, sir. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000DA4.polish: „Uch, spokojnie...” – ścisza nieco głos, uważnie dobierając słowa. „Będzie dobrze... da pan sobie radę. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000DA4.belarusian: "Эм, паслухайце... — Ён нібы крыху паніжае голас, асцярожна падбіраючы словы. — Усё добра... вы справіцеся, сэру. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000DB0.english: Okay, it's gone. Your gun is most definitely gone.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000DB0.polish: Dobra. Nie ma jej. Twoja broń ewidentnie zaginęła.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000DB0.belarusian: Добра, яго няма. Твайго пісталета дакладна больш няма.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000DBF.polish: „Proszę, Jules, po prostu wypowiedz moje imię!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000DBF.belarusian: "Калі ласка, проста назаві маё імя, Жуль!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000DC9.english: "I need to report my badge missing."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000DD5.english: "That's all for now." (End call with the 41st.)

Alternate1/0x0100004C00000DD5.polish: „10-10 (Transmisja zakończona, czekam). Bez odbioru”. (Zakończ rozmowę z 41).
Alternate1/0x0100004C00000DD5.belarusian: "10-10 (Сувязь скончана, застаюся на прыёме). Прыём". (Скончыць размову з 41-м.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000DE3.english: "I am in dire need of financial assistance."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000DEF.english: "Uh... okay, 10-4, sir -- I hear you, relay your question. Over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000DEF.polish: „Uch... no dobrze, 10-4 – słyszę, proszę przekazać pytanie. Odbiór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000DEF.belarusian: "Эм... добра, 10-4, сэру — я вас чую, перадавайце сваё пытанне. Прыём".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E05.english: Suddenly the necktie feels like a boa constrictor around your neck, squeezing the dear life out of you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E05.polish: Nagle krawat zaciska się wokół twojej szyi niczym boa dusiciel. Wyciska z ciebie życie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E05.belarusian: Раптам гальштук сціскае шыю, нібы ўдаў-душыцель, выціскаючы з цябе рэшткі жыцця.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E2D.english: "Why, did he find it?" The room at the other end of the line erupts in volcanic laughter.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E2D.polish: „A co, znalazła się?” – pokój po drugiej stronie eksploduje salwami śmiechu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E2D.belarusian: "А што, ён яго знайшоў?" Пакой на тым канцы лініі выбухае вулканічным рогатам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E38.english: "For god's sake, cut this shit out! Tell him to stop wasting time and be a goddamn policeman for a change!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E38.polish: „Na litość boską, dość tych pierdół! Powiedz mu, żeby nie marnował czasu i dla odmiany zaczął zachowywać się jak policjant!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E38.belarusian: "Божа літасцівы, спыні гэтую лухту! Скажы яму, каб перастаў траціць час і дзеля разнастайнасці пабыў клятым паліцыянтам!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E3E.english: "10-9, come again, I didn't get that. Over." The animated conversation in the back is making it difficult for him to hear you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E3E.polish: „10-9, powtórz, nie dosłyszałem” – ożywiona dyskusja w tle utrudnia wam komunikację.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E3E.belarusian: "10-9, паўтарыце, я не зразумеў. Прыём". Ажыўленая размова на фоне перашкаджае яму цябе чуць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E46.english: "He asks you to please stop saying he lost his badge."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E46.polish: „Prosi, żebyście przestali mu wypominać zgubioną odznakę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E46.belarusian: "Ён просіць вас перастаць казаць, што ён згубіў значок".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E4C.english: "He wants to verify the information on his badge."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E4C.belarusian: "Ён хоча праверыць інфармацыю на сваім значку".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E52.english: "It is paramount to the investigation that you grant me more money."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E52.polish: „To kluczowe dla dochodzenia, żebyście dali mi więcej pieniędzy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E52.belarusian: "Для расследавання вельмі важна, каб вы выдзелілі мне больш грошай".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E58.english: "But of course, it says Dick Mullen -- High General of the Revacholian Cavalry Force."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E58.polish: „Ależ oczywiście, napisali na niej: Dick Mullen – głównodowodzący Revacholskich Sił Kawaleryjskich”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E58.belarusian: "Ну вядома ж, там напісана 'Дзік Мален — вярхоўны генерал Рэвашольскай кавалерыі'".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E62.english: "Could you all please just stop saying 'lost his badge' for a moment?!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E62.polish: „Czy możecie przestać na moment powtarzać »zgubił odznakę«?!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E62.belarusian: "Ці можаце вы ўсе хоць на хвіліну перастаць паўтараць 'згубіў значок'?!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E68.english: Wait! Before you say anything stupid, think it through!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E68.polish: Poczekaj! Zanim powiesz coś głupiego, dobrze to przemyśl!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E68.belarusian: Пачакай! Перш чым сказаць якое-небудзь глупства, падумай добра!

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E6E.english: "Yeah, Mack's right, this was some gnarly shit there. I mean, before he started begging for money -- it was..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E6E.polish: „No, Mack ma rację, spierdolił po całości. Zanim jeszcze zaczął błagać o pieniądze. To było...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E6E.belarusian: "Ага, Мак мае рацыю, там быў поўны піздзец. У сэнсе, яшчэ да таго, як ён пачаў жабраваць грошы — гэта было..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E7B.english: "Please, I'm begging you here! I don't even have a place to sleep tonight."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00000E7B.polish: „Proszę, błagam! Nie mam nawet gdzie dzisiaj spać”.
