Dialogue Text/0x01000006000198C1.polish: W jego głosie nie słychać zaskoczenia. Jedynie beztroskie poczucie wyższości.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000198C1.belarusian: У яго голасе няма здзіўлення. Толькі абыякавая перавага.

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000198C9.english: It's hard to say if he doesn't believe you -- or doesn't care.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000198C9.polish: Trudno powiedzieć, czy ci nie wierzy, czy po prostu go to nie obchodzi.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000198C9.belarusian: Цяжка сказаць, ці ён табе не верыць, ці яму проста ўсё адно.

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000198D3.english: "And no, I *don't* want to hear a *political commentary* on the topic. In fact -- I've got work to do. Some idiot has glued his eyelids shut with Cyanoacrylate. It looks like Mack Torson."
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000198D3.polish: „I nie – *nie* chcę wysłuchiwać *politycznego komentarza* na ten temat. Bo jestem zajęty. Jakiś idiota skleił sobie powieki cyjanoakrylem. Zdaje się, że to Mack Torson”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000198D3.belarusian: "І не, я *не* хачу чуць *палітычных каментароў* на гэтую тэму. Насамрэч — у мяне ёсць праца. Нейкі ідыёт склеіў сабе павекі цыянакрылатам. Падобна, што гэта Мак Торсан."

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000198E1.english: "It's not fucking cryo-actilate... it's super glue, doc."
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000198E1.polish: „Jaki, kurwa, cynokryl... to jakiś klej po prostu”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000198E1.belarusian: "Гэта не якісьці там, бляць, крыя-актылат... гэта суперклей, док."

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000198F0.english: The money is probably going to some old, oily...
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000198F0.polish: Te pieniądze dostaje pewnie jakiś stary, oślizły...
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000198F0.belarusian: Грошы, напэўна, ідуць нейкаму старому, масляністаму...

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001990A.english: "Do you know who this person was, have I told you..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001990A.polish: „Wiesz, kim była ta osoba? Mówiłem ci...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001990A.belarusian: "Ты ведаеш, хто быў гэты чалавек, ці я табе казаў..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019911.english: "That's what the guys say, officer. That some chick pumped you -- and then dumped you. Threw you away like an empty juice carton."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019911.polish: „To określenie, którego używają faceci, funkcjonariuszu. Laska nakręca cię, a później porzuca. Wyrzuca jak pusty karton po soku”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019911.belarusian: "Так хлопцы кажуць, афіцэру. Што нейкая дзеўка цябе паматросіла — а потым кінула. Выкінула, як пусты пакецік ад соку."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019919.english: "You must have me confused for a close personal friend... I am not. I am a medical professional -- with a constant *idiot* emergency on my hands."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019919.polish: „Zdaje się, że mylisz mnie ze swoim bliskim przyjacielem... którym nie jestem. Jestem zawodowym lekarzem nieustannie zmagającym się z *idiotami*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019919.belarusian: "Ты, пэўна, блытаеш мяне з блізкім сябрам... Я ім не з'яўляюся. Я медычны работнік — у якога пад рукамі вечнае надзвычайнае становішча з *ідыётамі*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019921.english: Don't take it personally. There just wasn't any *juice* left in your carton, pal.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019921.polish: Nie bierz tego do siebie. Po prostu w twoim kartonie skończył się *sok*, chłopie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019921.belarusian: Не прымай блізка да сэрца. Проста ў тваім пакеціку больш не засталося *соку*, дружа.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019929.english: You hear someone whine in the background. "My eye, doc... my eye..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019929.polish: Słyszysz, jak w tle ktoś jęczy: „Moje oko, doktorze... Moje oko...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019929.belarusian: Ты чуеш, як нехта ные на заднім плане: "Маё вока, док... маё вока..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019935.english: One needs tending to right now, he thinks, looking around the room. God, these apes...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019935.polish: Jeden wymaga nawet właśnie pomocy – myśli, rozglądając się po pokoju. Boże, co za małpiszony...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019935.belarusian: Адным трэба заняцца проста зараз, думае ён, азіраючы пакой. Божа, што за малпы...

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B0F4.english: So it's political! You're being *neglected* because of political reasons...
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B0F4.polish: A więc to sprawa polityczna! Jesteś *zaniedbywany* z powodów politycznych...
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001B0F4.belarusian: Дык гэта палітыка! Табой *пагарджаюць* з палітычных прычын...

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2B2.english: Even at a standstill the uni-body Coupris Kineema looks sleek and dynamic. The cabin is tilted frontward to give it a more aggressive *hunched* look.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2B2.polish: Nawet kiedy coupris kineema stoi w miejscu, jej jednolita sylwetka wygląda elegancko i dynamicznie. Kabina jest pochylona naprzód, nadając wozowi bardziej agresywnego, *przygarbionego* wyglądu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2B2.belarusian: Нават калі яна стаіць на месцы, суцэльны кузаў Coupris Kineema выглядае элегантна і дынамічна. Кабіна нахіленая наперад, што надае ёй больш агрэсіўны, *згорблены* выгляд.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2BF.english: "That machine really puts the 'loco' back in 'locomotion'!" (Point to the vehicle.) "Very cool."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2BF.polish: „Oto i maszyna będąca uosobieniem *loco* w słowie „lokomocja”!” (Wskaż na pojazd). „Naprawdę czadowa”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2BF.belarusian: "Гэтая машына сапраўды вяртае 'loco' ў 'лакамоцыю'!" (Паказаць на аўтамабіль.) "Вельмі крута."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2CC.english: "I don't like your machine, lieutenant. Looks impractical."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2CC.polish: „Nie podoba mi się twój wóz, poruczniku. Bardzo niepraktyczny”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2CC.belarusian: "Мне не падабаецца твая машына, лейтэнант. Выглядае непрактычнай."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2D4.english: "Mhmh..." the lieutenant huffs. "No point in stopping then."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2D4.polish: „Mhmm...” – fuka porucznik. „Nie ma w takim razie powodu, by się zatrzymywać”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2D4.belarusian: "Гм-гм... — фыркае лейтэнант. — Тады няма сэнсу спыняцца."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2E2.english: "I'd still like to take a close look."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2E2.polish: „Mimo wszystko chciałbym mu się przyjrzeć dokładniej”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A2E2.belarusian: "Я ўсё адно хацеў бы зірнуць бліжэй."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A30D.english: "Mhmh." The lieutenant smiles ever so slightly. "You want to take a closer look?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A30D.polish: „Mhmm” – odpowiada porucznik, uśmiechając się lekko. „Chcesz rzucić okiem?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A30D.belarusian: "Гм-гм, — лейтэнант ледзь заўважна ўсміхаецца. — Хочаце зірнуць бліжэй?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A320.english: This is a Coupris Kineema, the Coupris MotorCorp's follow-up to their highly successful workhorse, Coupris 40, and the answer to the LUM's racing-bred 'Fevre' series.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A320.polish: To model Coupris Kineema, następca cieszącego się wielką popularnością Coupris 40 tej samej firmy – Coupris MotorCorp – oraz odpowiedź na wyścigową serię Fevre od LUM.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A320.belarusian: Гэта Coupris Kineema, працяг вельмі паспяховага рабочага коніка Coupris 40 ад Coupris MotorCorp і адказ на гоначную серыю 'Fevre' ад LUM.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A334.english: With its air-cooled, rear-mounted twelve cylinder compression ignition engine driving the rear wheels through a four-speed manual gearbox, the Kineema is able to reach 100 kilometres per hour in 13.5 seconds. And go on to a top speed of 180 kilometres an hour.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A334.polish: Chłodzony powietrzem, montowany z tyłu, napędzający tylne koła za pośrednictwem czterostopniowej skrzyni biegów dwunastocylindrowy silnik wysokoprężny pozwala kineemie osiągać prędkość 100 kilometrów na godzinę w 13,5 sekundy. I rozpędzać się maksymalnie do 180 kilometrów na godzinę.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A334.belarusian: Дзякуючы дванаццаціцыліндраваму дызельнаму рухавіку паветранага ахаладжэння, усталяванаму ззаду і прыводзячаму ў рух заднія колы праз чатырохступеністую механічную скрынку перадач, Kineema здольная разагнацца да 100 кіламетраў на гадзіну за 13,5 секунды. І дасягнуць максімальнай хуткасці ў 180 кіламетраў на гадзіну.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A33B.english: The high centre of balance is offset by a large battery bank mounted at the bottom of the cabin, feeding all the auxiliary systems and making the Kineema effectively a mobile power plant.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A33B.polish: Środek ciężkości wysokiej maszyny obniżany jest dużym akumulatorem zamontowanym w dolnej części kabiny. Zasila on wszystkie dodatkowe systemy i czyni z kineemy w zasadzie ruchomą elektrownię.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A33B.belarusian: Высокі цэнтр цяжару кампенсуецца вялікім блокам акумулятараў, усталяваным у ніжняй частцы кабіны, які сілкуе ўсе дапаможныя сістэмы і фактычна робіць Кініму перасоўнай электрастанцыяй.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A342.english: Due to a quite steep price tag it is very unusual to see one in police livery.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A342.polish: Ze względu na ich cenę, rzadko widuje się je w malowaniu policyjnym.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A342.belarusian: Праз даволі высокі кошт убачыць такую машыну ў паліцэйскай ліўрэі — вялікая рэдкасць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A34D.english: "What in there made the infernal whining sound that woke me?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A34D.polish: „Co w tej maszynie wydało ten piekielny jęk, który mnie obudził?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A34D.belarusian: "Што там выдавала той пякельны свіст, які мяне разбудзіў?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A354.english: "A fine machine..." (Run your hand over the smooth metal surface.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A354.polish: „Wspaniała maszyna...” (Przesuń dłonią po gładkiej metalowej powierzchni).
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A354.belarusian: "Выдатная машына... — (Правесці рукой па гладкай металічнай паверхні.)"

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A4EF.english: "When variable current passes through wires that make up the coils on the electrical systems on this machine -- it causes vibration in the wires and the cores of the coils."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A4EF.polish: „Kiedy prąd zmienny przepływa przewodami tworzącymi cewki systemów elektrycznych tej maszyny, powoduje wibracje w przewodach i rdzeniach cewek”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A4EF.belarusian: "Калі зменны ток праходзіць праз драты, з якіх складаюцца шпулькі ў электрычных сістэмах гэтай машыны, ён выклікае вібрацыю ў дратах і сардэчніках шпулек".

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A4FD.english: "When the frequency of the current in the coils falls within the audible range  the resulting vibration creates the *whiny sound* you mentioned."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A4FD.polish: „Gdy częstotliwość prądu w cewkach mieści się w zakresie słyszalnym, wibracje generują *przeciągły dźwięk*, o którym wspomniałeś”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A4FD.belarusian: "Калі частата току ў шпульках трапляе ў чутны дыяпазон, узніклая вібрацыя стварае той самы *тонкі свіст*, пра які вы згадалі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A511.english: "Wow... how do you know all that?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A511.polish: „O rany. Skąd ty to wszystko wiesz?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A518.polish: „Tak, mhm, tak właśnie mi się zdawało”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A51F.english: "The resulting vibration creates the whining sound, that's right," the lieutenant finishes your sentence. "Very impressive."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A51F.polish: „Wibracje generują przeciągły dźwięk, zgadza się” – porucznik kończy zdanie. „Bardzo imponujące”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A51F.belarusian: "У выніку гэтая вібрацыя стварае тонкі свіст, усё дакладна, — лейтэнант сканчвае ваш сказ. — Вельмі ўражальна."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A52D.english: There's respect in that curious look. Definitely.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A52D.polish: W tym ciekawskim spojrzeniu widać też szacunek. Ewidentnie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A52D.belarusian: У гэтым цікаўным позірку ёсць павага. Безумоўна.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A543.english: "I have pretty much maintained my vehicles by myself ever since one was assigned to me. You inevitably pick up some knowledge on the way."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A543.polish: „Odkąd przydzielono mi ten pojazd, właściwie sam dbam o jego stan techniczny. Wiele się człowiek przy tym uczy, czy tego chce, czy nie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A543.belarusian: "Я практычна сам абслугоўваю свой транспарт з таго часу, як яго за мной замацавалі. Хочаш не хочаш, а набіраешся ведаў па дарозе".

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A580.english: "Of course..." His gaze wanders over your face.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A580.polish: „Oczywiście...” – stwierdza i przygląda się twojej twarzy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A580.belarusian: "Вядома... — яго позірк блукае па вашым твары."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A611.english: "Yes." There's gentleness in the lieutenant's voice as his eyes run over the vehicle's contours. "An extraordinary machine."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A611.polish: „Tak” – odpowiada łagodnym tonem, wodząc wzrokiem po karoserii pojazdu. „Nadzwyczajna maszyna”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A611.belarusian: "Так, — у голасе лейтэнанта гучыць пяшчота, пакуль яго вочы слізгаюць па абрысах аўтамабіля. — Незвычайная машына."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A670.english: "What's it packing there?" (Point to the engine.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A670.belarusian: "Што там у яе пад капотам?" (Паказаць на рухавік.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A677.english: "You need to *slam* it, Kim. Make it more imposing."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A677.polish: „Musisz *dojechać* tę furę, Kim. Żeby była imponująca”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A677.belarusian: "Табе трэба *занізіць* яе, Кім. Зрабіць больш самавітай."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A6A7.english: "With a winch and mud tyres we could take it off the beaten path, Kim."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A6A7.polish: „Z wyciągarką i oponami na błoto można by ruszyć nim na bezdroża, Kim”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A6A7.belarusian: "З лябёдкай і гразевымі шынамі мы маглі б выехаць на бездарожжа, Кім."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A6AE.english: "We are not going to though, because this is clearly a *sports* motor carriage." Sounds like he has a strong concept of what this machine is.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A6AE.polish: „Ale nie zrobimy tego, bo jak widać, jest to *sportowy* powóz motorowy” – wygląda na to, że porucznik ma jasną wizję tego, czym jest ta maszyn.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A6AE.belarusian: "Але мы гэтага рабіць не будзем, бо гэта відавочна *спартыўная* маторная карэта". Гучыць так, нібыта ён вельмі выразна ўяўляе, чым з'яўляецца гэтая машына.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A6C8.english: "Drop the ride *two hundo mill*, get the camber to frosty-frosty minuses..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A6C8.polish: „Opuścić zawieszenie *dwie sety milimetrów*, nachylenie kół na srogi minus...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A6C8.belarusian: "Апусціць падвеску на *дзвесце міліметраў*, развал колаў у люты мінус..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A6F1.polish: „No i? Co jest złego w pornografii?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A6F8.english: "That's a negative on the porno. Thank you, though."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A6F8.polish: „Pornografia nie wchodzi w grę. Ale dziękuję”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A713.english: (Let out a whistle.) "Momma's serving some serious macaroni."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A720.english: "You lost me there." He is looking at you, perplexed.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A720.polish: „Chyba nie rozumiem” – odpowiada, spoglądając na ciebie z konsternacją.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A720.belarusian: "Я вас тут не зразумеў", — ён глядзіць на вас са здзіўленнем.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A727.english: "Hundred-and-thirty kilowatts is a lot of power, Kim."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A727.polish: „Sto trzydzieści kilowatów to ładny kawał mocy, Kim”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A727.belarusian: "Сто трыццаць кілаватаў — гэта вялікая моц, Кім."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A72E.english: "The Kineema *is* fast. Feels right at home on the raised motor tract. Hard to find something that could overtake it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A72E.polish: „Kineema *jest* szybka. Na torze wyścigowym czuje się jak w domu. Nie łatwo znaleźć maszynę, która mogłaby ją wyprzedzić”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A72E.belarusian: "Кініма *сапраўды* хуткая. На эстакадзе адчувае сябе як дома. Цяжка знайсці нешта, што магло б яе абагнаць".

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A735.english: "That's what..." (Rub your chin.) "... a seven-litre V12?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A735.polish: „Tam jest co...?” (Podrap się po brodzie). „Siedmiolitrowa dwunastka?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A73B.english: "Ever thought about switching to helium headlights?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A73B.belarusian: "Ніколі не думаў перайсці на геліевыя фары?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A741.english: "Actually, I have a pair at home -- just haven't gotten around to fitting them yet. I need to lay some wiring for the ballasts first..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A741.polish: „Właściwie mam dwie takie lampy w domu – po prostu nie znalazłem jeszcze czasu, by je zamontować. Najpierw muszę zainstalować okablowanie stateczników...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A741.belarusian: "Насамрэч у мяне дома ляжыць пара — проста яшчэ рукі не дайшлі іх паставіць. Спачатку трэба пракласці правадку для баластаў..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A74F.english: "If we ever get this case solved, maybe we can do it together?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A74F.polish: „Może jak rozwiążemy tę sprawę, zrobilibyśmy to razem?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A74F.belarusian: "Калі мы калі-небудзь раскруцім гэтую справу, можа, зробім гэта разам?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A756.english: "Maybe," he replies with an apologetic smile and nods. "Yes, definitely maybe."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A756.polish: „Może” – odpowiada z przepraszającym uśmiechem i kiwa głową. „Tak, zdecydowane może”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A756.belarusian: "Магчыма, — адказвае ён з вінаватай усмешкай і ківае. — Так, абсалютна магчыма."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A762.english: "Sounds like a hassle, but good luck."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A762.polish: „Brzmi to jak upierdliwa robota, ale powodzenia”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A769.english: "Thanks." The lieutenant smiles. "Are we done here?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A772.english: "Seven-point-two. Supercharged." The lieutenant is trying to suppress a smug smile. Unsuccessfully.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A772.polish: „Siedem przecinek dwa. Z doładowaniem” – odpowiada porucznik, starając się ukryć uśmiech samozadowolenia. Nieskutecznie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A772.belarusian: "Сем і два. З турбанаддзіманнем, — лейтэнант спрабуе здушыць самазадаволеную ўсмешку. Безвынікова."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A78D.english: "It must be an advancement of the KR18GU engine on the older *Forty* models, right?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A78D.polish: „To pewnie rozwojowa wersja silnika KR18GU ze starych *czterdziestek*, nie?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A78D.belarusian: "Гэта, напэўна, развіццё рухавіка KR18GU са старых мадэляў *сараковак*, так?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A79F.english: "Yeah, you know it?" The lieutenant seems surprised.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A79F.polish: „Tak, znasz się na tym?” – pyta wyraźnie zdziwiony porucznik.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7A6.english: "Just the basics. Cast-iron block, swirl-chamber-injection, dual-chains driving overhead camshafts, two valves per cylinder, hydraulic valve lash adjustment..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7A6.polish: „Znam podstawy. Odlewany z żelaza blok, wtrysk pośredni, podwójny łańcuch wałków rozrządu, dwa zawory na cylinder, popychacz hydrauliczny...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7A6.belarusian: "Толькі асновы. Чыгунны блок, віхракамерны ўпырск, падвойныя ланцугі прывада верхніх размеркавальных валоў, два клапаны на цыліндр, гідраўлічныя кампенсатары зазораў клапанаў..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7B0.english: "Uh... yes, that's right." He stares at you in surprise. "I am very impressed that you know these things."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7B0.polish: „Ee... Tak, zgadza się” – stwierdza, przyglądając ci się z niedowierzaniem. „Jestem zaskoczony, że tyle o tym wiesz”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7B0.belarusian: "Э-э... так, усё дакладна, — ён здзіўлена глядзіць на вас. — Я вельмі ўражаны, што вы ведаеце такія рэчы."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7BF.english: "Oh..." The lieutenant rubs the back of his head. "Yes, let's definitely *think* about it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7BF.polish: „Och...” – porucznik pociera swoją potylicę. „Tak, na pewno o tym *pomyślę*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7BF.belarusian: "О... — лейтэнант пацірае патыліцу. — Так, давайце абавязкова *падумаем* пра гэта."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7C9.english: "I am not a *binoclard*, I am a driver... and a police lieutenant."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7C9.polish: „Nie jestem *pinglarzem* – jestem kierowcą... i porucznikiem policji”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7C9.belarusian: "Я не *даўбакулярнік*, я кіроўца... і лейтэнант паліцыі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7CF.english: Poor choice of words. Lieutenant Kitsuragi obviously doesn't want to be a *binoclard*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7CF.polish: Kiepski dobór słów. Porucznik Kitsuragi ewidentnie nie chce być *pinglarzem*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7CF.belarusian: Няўдалы выбар слоў. Лейтэнант Кіцурагі відавочна не хоча быць *даўбакулярнікам*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7D6.english: "Binoclard... binoclard..." he repeats to himself, eyes fixed on the ground.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7D6.polish: „Pinglarz... Pinglarz...” – powtarza do siebie ze wzrokiem wbitym w ziemię.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7D6.belarusian: "Даўбакулярнік... даўбакулярнік... — паўтарае ён сам сабе, утаропіўшы вочы ў зямлю."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7DD.english: Whatever high-school bullying memories you woke in your colleague, he doesn't enjoy them.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7DD.polish: Obudziłeś w swoim koledze wspomnienie udręk dzieciństwa i ewidentnie nie przynosi mu ono radości.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7DD.belarusian: Якія б школьныя ўспаміны пра здзекі ты ні абудзіў у сваім калегу, яны не прыносяць яму радасці.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7E9.english: "I'm sorry. I don't even know what it means. It just popped into my head."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7E9.polish: „Przepraszam, nie wiem, co to znaczy. Po prostu pojawiło mi się w głowie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A7E9.belarusian: "Прабач. Я нават не ведаю, што гэта значыць. Проста выскачыла з галавы."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A811.english: "I'm perfectly proud of my glasses." The lieutenant adjusts his spectacles. "I need them for seeing. Anyway..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A811.polish: „Jestem dumny ze swoich okularów” – odpowiada porucznik, poprawiając swoje szkła. „Potrzebuję ich, by wyraźnie widzieć. Tak czy inaczej...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A811.belarusian: "Я цалкам ганаруся сваімі акулярамі, — лейтэнант папраўляе акуляры. — Яны патрэбныя мне, каб бачыць. Ва ўсякім разе..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A818.english: "Maybe don't blurt out everything that *pops into your head*. Just some friendly advice. Anyway..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A818.polish: „Może nie wygaduj wszystkiego, co *wpadnie ci do głowy*. Potraktuj to jako przyjacielską radę. Tak czy inaczej...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A818.belarusian: "Можа, не варта выстрэльваць усім, што *выскоквае з галавы*. Проста сяброўская парада. Ва ўсякім разе..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A82B.english: In the morning light the white-on-blue police livery on the motor carriage cannot but catch your eye.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A82B.polish: Poranne światło sprawia, że nie sposób nie zwrócić uwagi na biało-niebieskie policyjne malowanie powozu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A82B.belarusian: У ранішнім святле бела-сіняя паліцэйская ліўрэя на маторнай карэце не можа не прыцягнуць твой позірк.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A833.english: Won't it roll over in the first sharp corner?
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A833.polish: Nie przewróci się na pierwszym ostrzejszym zakręcie?
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A833.belarusian: Хіба яна не перакуліцца на першым жа крутым павароце?

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A839.english: Turn your attention to the motor carriage itself.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A839.polish: Skieruj swoją uwagę na sam powóz motorowy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A839.belarusian: Звярнуць увагу на саму маторную карэту.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A847.english: This tech-talk is really rubbing me the right way here.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A847.polish: Ta techniczna gadka zdecydowanie robi mi dobrze.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A847.belarusian: Гэтыя тэхнічныя размовы мне вельмі даспадобы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A884.english: "Don't leave fingerprints on the bodywork, I just had it polished."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A884.polish: „Nie zostaw odcisków palców na karoserii. Właśnie ją wypolerowałem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A884.belarusian: "Не пакідайце адбіткаў пальцаў на кузаве, я яго толькі што адпаліраваў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A8C9.english: "Hang on, you're telling me you remember all these little mechanical details, but you have trouble remembering your name?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A8C9.polish: „Chwila... Chcesz mi powiedzieć, że pamiętasz te wszystkie mechaniczne szczegóły, ale masz trudności z przypomnieniem sobie, jak się nazywasz?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A8C9.belarusian: "Пачакайце, вы хочаце сказаць, што памятаеце ўсе гэтыя дробныя механічныя дэталі, але вам цяжка ўспомніць уласнае імя?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A8D0.english: "It's strange, I know. I don't even like motor carriages that much."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A8D0.polish: „Dziwne, wiem. Nawet nie jestem jakimś wielkim amatorem powozów motorowych”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A8D0.belarusian: "Дзіўна, я ведаю. Я нават не сказаў бы, што надта люблю маторныя карэты."

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A8D7.english: "Strange... but plausible, I guess." He gives you a quick side-glance and turns to go. "I guess you're a bit of a... torque dork too."
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A8D7.polish: „Dziwne... ale pewnie możliwe” – rzuca ci spojrzenie z ukosa, po czym odwraca się, by ruszyć w dalszą drogę. „Najwyraźniej też jesteś do pewnego stopnia... mechanicznym szurem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A8D7.belarusian: "Дзіўна... але падобна на праўду, мяркую, — ён хутка кідае на вас позірк скоса і паварочваецца, каб ісці. — Выходзіць, вы таксама трохі... запісаць пасля мэрджа 292 дыялога".

Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A8DE.english: He seems to like the idea.
Dialogue Text/0x010000310000A8DE.polish: Zdaje się, że cieszy go ta myśl.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007AA2.english: A motor carriage in white-on-blue police livery.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007AA2.polish: Powóz motorowy w biało-niebieskim policyjnym malowaniu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007AA2.belarusian: Маторная карэта ў бела-сіняй паліцэйскай ліўрэі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007AC6.english: Droplets of rain fall on the white-on-blue police livery of the motor carriage.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007AC6.polish: Krople deszczu spływają po karoserii wozu o biało-niebieskim policyjnym malowaniu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007AC6.belarusian: Кроплі дажджу падаюць на бела-сінюю паліцэйскую ліўрэю маторнай карэты.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007ACC.english: Snow covers the white-on-blue police livery of the motor carriage. The white colours nearly meld together.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007ACC.polish: Śnieg pokrywa karoserię wozu o biało-niebieskim policyjnym malowaniu. Jasne kolory nieomal zlewają się w jednolitą barwę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007ACC.belarusian: Снег пакрывае бела-сінюю паліцэйскую ліўрэю маторнай карэты. Белыя колеры амаль зліваюцца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007AD2.english: The surrounding blaze of the electric lights makes the white-on-blue police livery of the motor carriage seem beautifully ominous.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007AD2.polish: Elektryczne światła z okolicy sprawiają, że biało-niebieskie policyjne malowanie powozu wydaje się na swój piękny sposób złowrogie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007AD2.belarusian: Ззянне электрычных агнёў навокал робіць бела-сінюю паліцэйскую ліўрэю маторнай карэты па-прыгожаму злавеснай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007AD8.english: The afternoon sun shimmers off the white-on-blue police livery of the motor carriage.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007AD8.polish: Popołudniowe słońce lśni na karoserii wozu o biało-niebieskim policyjnym malowaniu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007AD8.belarusian: Паўдзённае сонца пераліваецца на бела-сіняй паліцэйскай ліўрэі маторнай карэты.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B27.english: Come on, you know how it works... put it together.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B27.polish: No już, wiesz, jak to działa. Poskładaj to tylko w całość.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B27.belarusian: Давай, ты ж ведаеш, як гэта працуе... звядзі ўсё разам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B48.english: "It causes vibration in the wires and as the frequency of the current happens to fall within the audible range"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B48.polish: „...dochodzi do wibracji przewodów, a kiedy częstotliwość prądu mieści się w zakresie słyszalnym...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B48.belarusian: "Гэта выклікае вібрацыю ў дратах, а паколькі частата току трапляе ў чутны дыяпазон..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B54.english: "You mean when variable current passes through the coils on the electrical systems and the varying magnetic fields around them..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B54.polish: „Chodzi o to, że kiedy prąd zmienny przepływa przez cewki systemów elektrycznych, wytwarzane przez nie zmienne pole magnetyczne sprawia, że...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B54.belarusian: "Ты маеш на ўвазе, калі зменны ток праходзіць праз шпулькі ў электрычных сістэмах і зменныя магнітныя палі вакол іх..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B7C.english: I reckon that's a seven-litre V12 there.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B7C.polish: Podejrzewam, że skrywa się tam dwunastozaworowy, siedmiolitrowy silnik.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B8F.english: An advancement of the KR18GU engine of the Coupris 40, to be precise.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B8F.polish: Dokładniej mówiąc, rozwojowa wersja silnika KR18GU z modelu Coupris 40.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B8F.belarusian: Дакладней кажучы, развітальная версія рухавіка KR18GU з мадэлі Coupris 40.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B94.english: Man, that's got to be a major advancement over the KR18GU engine on the old Coupris 40.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B94.polish: O raju, to musi być nie lada krok naprzód w porównaniu z silnikiem KR18GU ze starego Coupris 40.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007B94.belarusian: Ого, гэта павінен быць значны крок наперад у параўнанні з рухавіком KR18GU на старой Coupris 40.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007BA9.english: It's nice and all, but why so modest? Put some zing into it. Flare it up. Slam it down!
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007BA9.polish: No ładna jest, ale czemu taka skromna? Powinna być bardziej czadowa. Wypasiona. Dojechana!
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007BA9.belarusian: Усё гэта добра, але чаму так сціпла? Дадай перцу. Раздзімай аркі. Заніжай у падлогу!

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007BCD.english: "Wait, what about the spinners then, huh?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007BCD.polish: „Chwila, a co w takim razie z kołpakami, hę?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007BCD.belarusian: "Пачакай, а як жа тады спінэры, га?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007BD4.english: "Those spinners were elegant, sleek..." He pauses, looking for words. "Radiant, even. What you're suggesting is *porno*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007BD4.polish: „Te kołpaki były eleganckie, gustowne...” – przez chwilę szuka odpowiedniego słowa – „...wręcz olśniewające. Twoje sugestie to zwykłe *porno*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007BD4.belarusian: "Тыя спінэры былі элегантнымі, вытанчанымі... — ён робіць паўзу, падбіраючы словы. — Нават ззяючымі. А тое, што прапануеце вы, — гэта *порна*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007BE7.english: Helium headlights would improve the range and quality of the visual field a lot.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007BE7.polish: Helowe reflektory znacząco zwiększyłyby zasięg widzenia w nocy i jakość oświetlenia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007BE7.belarusian: Геліевыя фары значна палепшылі б далёкасць і якасць поля зроку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007C12.english: "You want to help?" He glances at you and smiles. "Thank you for the offer. That might be fun. Let's do the case first though, alright?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007C12.polish: „Chcesz pomóc?” – pyta, zerkając na ciebie z uśmiechem. „Dziękuję za ofertę. To mogłoby być zabawne. Ale najpierw zakończmy to śledztwo, dobrze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00007C12.belarusian: "Хочаце дапамагчы? — ён паглядае на вас і ўсміхаецца. — Дзякуй за прапанову. Гэта можа быць весела. Але давайце спачатку скончым справу, добра?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000095F1.english: Saying these words brings him immense joy.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000095F1.polish: Wypowiadanie tych słów sprawia mu ogromną radość.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000095F1.belarusian: Вымаўленне гэтых слоў прыносіць яму велізарную радасць.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000095F9.english: Wow... he's not happy you called him a binoclard. He'll get over it.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000095F9.polish: O rany... Nie jest zadowolony, że nazwałeś go pinglarzem. Ale przejdzie mu.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000095F9.belarusian: Ого... ён незадаволены, што ты назваў яго даўбакулярнікам. Але гэта пройдзе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009609.english: "I might not know much, but I *do* know I like motor carriages -- must be a subconscious thing."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009609.polish: „Może nie wiem za wiele, ale jestem *pewien*, że lubię powozy motorowe. To chyba coś podświadomego”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009609.belarusian: "Можа, я і не ведаю шмат чаго, але я *дакладна* ведаю, што люблю маторныя карэты — напэўна, гэта нешта падсвядомае."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009611.english: "Right," the lieutenant marks dryly. "Speed isn't for everyone."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009611.polish: „Jasne” – stwierdza sucho porucznik. „Grzanie nie jest dla każdego”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009611.belarusian: "Зразумела, — суха заўважае лейтэнант. — Хуткасць не для ўсіх."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009618.english: What?! Speed most definitely *is* for... Oh... he means velocity. Can't really get properly high on that so... Nevermind.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009618.polish: Co?! Oczywiście, że grzanie *jest* dla... Och. Jemu chodzi o szybką jazdę. No tym się naćpać nie da, więc... nieważne.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009618.belarusian: Што?! Спід акурат для... О... ён пра хуткасць. Ім нармальна не закінешся, таму... няважна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009624.english: What?! Speed isn't for...?! Oh... he means velocity. Yeah, that's definitely an acquired taste.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009624.polish: Że jak?! Grzanie nie jest dla...?! A, mówi o szybkiej jeździe. Tak, to zdecydowanie wymaga przyzwyczajenia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009624.belarusian: Што?! Хуткасць не для...?! А... ён пра рух. Так, да гэтага сапраўды трэба прызвычаіцца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700013004.english: "I'm not either. Don't know why I said that."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700013004.polish: „Ja też nie. Nie wiem, czemu to powiedziałem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700013004.belarusian: "Я і сам не разумею. Не ведаю, навошта я гэта сказаў."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001300B.english: "Well," the lieutenant says, frowning ever so slightly, "maybe don't just say every little thing in your head out loud. It confuses people."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001300B.polish: „No cóż” – stwierdza porucznik, lekko marszcząc brwi. „Może nie powinieneś mówić na głos wszystkiego, co przyjdzie ci do głowy. To dezorientuje ludzi”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001300B.belarusian: "Ну, — кажа лейтэнант, ледзь прыкметна хмурачыся, — можа, не варта агучваць кожную дробязь, што ўзнікае ў галаве. Гэта збівае людзей з панталыку."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001305E.english: The sole purpose of 'pornography' is to stimulate one's visual sense to evoke sexual arousal -- the same is true with the modifications you're proposing.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001305E.polish: Jedynym celem pornografii jest stymulacja zmysłu wzroku w celu wywołania podniecenia seksualnego – to samo dotyczy modyfikacji, które proponujesz.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001305E.belarusian: Адзіная мэта 'парнаграфіі' — стымуляваць глядзельнае ўспрыманне дзеля выклікання сэксуальнага ўзбуджэння — тое ж самае і з мадыфікацыямі, якія ты прапануеш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700013065.english: "Alright, I guess it did get a bit porny there."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700013065.polish: „No dobra, faktycznie zrobiło się nieco pornograficznie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700013065.belarusian: "Добра, здаецца, тут сапраўды атрымалася крыху парнаграфічна."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001306C.english: "I'm sincerely relieved I don't have to try and convince you of that." He glances at his vehicle. "Back to work?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001306C.polish: „Odczuwam szczerą ulgę, że nie muszę cię do tego przekonywać”. Zerka na swój pojazd. „Wracamy do pracy?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001306C.belarusian: "Я шчыра рады, што мне не трэба вас у гэтым пераконваць, — ён кідае позірк на свой аўтамабіль. — Назад да працы?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001308D.english: No one in the history of convictions has been more sure of *anything*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001308D.polish: *Nikt* w historii przekonań nie był niczego bardziej pewien.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001308D.belarusian: Ніхто ў гісторыі перакананняў не быў больш упэўнены ні ў чым.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000130A8.english: "... the wires go *bweeeeeeeeee* and then *neeeeeeeow*?" (Loudly imitate the sounds.)
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000130A8.polish: „...przewody robią *błiiiiiii*, a potem *bziuuuuuu*?” (Głośno naśladuj dźwięki, o których mówisz).

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000130B1.english: This is your chance to impress the lieutenant!

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000130BA.english: "Basically, yes -- although it's mostly about frequency range, not the wires making *bwee-*sounds. Still -- I'm impressed."
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000130BA.polish: „W zasadzie tak – chociaż chodzi głównie o zakres częstotliwości, a nie o przewody robiące *błiiiii*. Ale i tak jestem pod wrażeniem”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000130BA.belarusian: "У прынцыпе, так — хоць справа пераважна ў дыяпазоне частот, а не ў тым, што драты выдаюць гукі *бвііі*. Але ўсё адно — я ўражаны".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700013102.english: Whatever you do, don't make fun of the lieutenant for explaining this to you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700013102.polish: Cokolwiek zrobisz, nie naśmiewaj się z porucznika, że ci to wyjaśnił.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700013102.belarusian: Што б ты ні рабіў, не кпі з лейтэнанта за тое, што ён табе гэта патлумачыў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700013156.english: "Oh, I thought it would make more."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001315F.english: "Believe me," the lieutenant replies -- sounding a little defensive -- "it's plenty enough. Kineema feels right at home on the raised motor tract. Hard to find something that could overtake it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001315F.polish: „Uwierz mi” – odpowiada porucznik lekko defensywnym tonem – „to wystarczy z nawiązką. Na torze wyścigowym kineema czuje się jak w domu. Nie łatwo znaleźć maszynę, która mogłaby ją wyprzedzić”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001315F.belarusian: "Паверце мне, — адказвае лейтэнант трохі апраўдальным тонам, — гэтага больш чым дастаткова. Кініма на эстакадзе адчувае сябе як дома. Цяжка знайсці нешта, што магло б яе абагнаць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700013181.english: He is not enthused about the idea.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700013181.polish: Nie pała do tego pomysłu entuzjazmem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700013181.belarusian: Ён не ў захапленні ад гэтай ідэі.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000131C4.english: Motor carriages don't interest me. [Finish thought.]
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000131C4.polish: Powozy motorowe mnie nie interesują. [Zakończ myśl].
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000131C4.belarusian: Маторныя карэты мяне не цікавяць. [Скончыць думку.]

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000131E1.english: Harmel-Rioux 'Supersonique' -- a racing motorbike for the road -- could probably do it.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000131E1.polish: Harmel-Rioux Supersonique – wyścigowy motocykl przeznaczony na drogi – dałby pewnie radę.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000131E1.belarusian: Harmel-Rioux 'Supersonique' — дарожны гоначны матацыкл — верагодна, змог бы.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000131F1.english: "Okay." The lieutenant nods too. "That's confusing. Can we get back to business now?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000131F1.polish: „W porządku” – porucznik też kiwa głową. „To dziwne. Ale możemy już wracać do naszego śledztwa?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000131F1.belarusian: "Добра, — лейтэнант таксама ківае. — Гэта дзіўна. Мы можам вярнуцца да справы?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000134DC.english: Wait, why am I even thinking about this? Wasn't I supposed to...
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000134DC.polish: Chwila, czemu ja w ogóle o tym myślę? Czy ja nie miałem...
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000134DC.belarusian: Пачакай, чаму я наогул пра гэта думаю? Хіба я не павінен быў...

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000134E2.english: "No time for this, gotta run." [Finish thought.]
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000134E2.polish: „Nie czas na to, muszę lecieć”. [Zakończ myśl].

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000134EB.english: ... do something important? Something murder-related? There's always *something* important. Doesn't mean you can't take a moment to admire this piece of machinery.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000134EB.polish: ...robić czegoś ważniejszego? Czegoś związanego z morderstwem? Zawsze jest *coś* ważnego do zrobienia. To nie znaczy, że nie można zatrzymać się na moment i popodziwiać tej wspaniałej maszyny.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000134EB.belarusian: ...зрабіць нешта важнае? Нешта звязанае з забойствам? Заўсёды ёсць *нешта* важнае. Гэта не значыць, што ты не можаш спыніцца на хвілінку і палюбавацца гэтым цудам тэхнікі.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000134F3.english: Actually motor carriages don't interest me. [Finish thought.]
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000134F3.polish: Właściwie to powozy motorowe mnie nie interesują. [Zakończ myśl].
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000134F3.belarusian: Насамрэч маторныя карэты мяне не цікавяць. [Скончыць думку.]

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600018D6E.english: There's pride in there. A trained driver, *knows* his ride.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600018D6E.polish: W jego głosie pobrzmiewa duma. Wyszkolony kierowca *zna* swój wóz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600018D6E.belarusian: У гэтым адчуваецца гонар. Дасведчаны кіроўца *ведае* сваю машыну.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600018D78.english: It's a bit *girly* right now. Fit it with some proper off-road components.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600018D78.polish: Chwilowo jest trochę *dziewczyński*. Potrzebne mu porządne akcesoria terenowe.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600018D78.belarusian: Цяпер яна трохі *дзяўчачая*. Усталюй нармальныя пазадарожныя кампаненты.

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000008F0.english: As you hold your ledger's clip under the headlamp, a shimmering iridescent pattern appears. One you've definitely seen before...
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000008F0.polish: Kiedy umieszczasz zatrzask notatnika w snopie światła z lampy, pojawia się migocący wzór. Wzór, który na pewno już wcześniej widziałeś...
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000008F0.belarusian: Калі ты трымаеш заціск нататніка пад святлом фары, з'яўляецца мігатлівы радужны ўзор. Такі ты дакладна бачыў раней...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000009C6.english: Around the borders of the watermark are dozens, no, *hundreds* of micro-perforations.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000009C6.polish: Wokół brzegów znaku wodnego widać dziesiątki... nie. *Setki* mikroperforacji.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000009C6.belarusian: Вакол краёў вадзянога знака бачныя дзясяткі, не, *сотні* мікраперфарацый.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000009CD.english: It's not unlike the pattern from the racist lorryman's boots. A stylized map of Revachol.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000009CD.polish: Przypomina to nieco wzór z butów rasistowskiego szofera. Stylizowaną mapę Revacholu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000009CD.belarusian: Ён вельмі падобны да ўзору з ботаў дальнабойніка-расіста. Стылізаваная мапа Рэвашоля.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000009D4.english: As you hold your ledger's clip under the headlamp, an iridescent hologram appears: a street grid and the veins of a great river. A familiar sensation washes over you...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000009D4.polish: Kiedy przytrzymujesz zatrzask swojego notatnika w snopie światła z lampy, pojawia się lśniący hologram: siatka ulic i żyły wielkiej rzeki. Ogarnia cię znajome uczucie...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000009D4.belarusian: Калі ты трымаеш заціск нататніка пад святлом фары, з'яўляецца радужная галаграма: сетка вуліц і жылкі вялікай ракі. Цябе агортвае знаёмае пачуццё...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000009DB.english: "There she is: Revachol West." There's a note of pride in the lieutenant's voice.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000009DB.polish: „Oto i on: Zachodni Revachol” – w głosie porucznika pobrzmiewa nuta dumy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000009DB.belarusian: "Вось і ён: Заходні Рэвашоль", — у голасе лейтэнанта чуваць нотка гонару.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E000009EA.english: Look at the shimmering street grid.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A0D.english: There are many of them. And they are divided into three separate rows.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A0D.polish: Jest ich wiele. Podzielone są na trzy oddzielne rzędy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A0D.belarusian: Іх тут шмат. І яны падзеленыя на тры асобныя шэрагі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A22.polish: W pierwszym rzędzie jest osiemnaście kropek.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A30.english: The next is the longest. It runs all the way around the border and then some.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A30.polish: Następny jest najdłuższy. Obiega cały obwód i to z nawiązką.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A30.belarusian: Наступны — найдаўжэйшы. Ён ідзе па ўсім перыметры і нават больш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A5A.english: There are so many it's hard to count. More than 150, at least. Maybe even 200.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A5A.polish: Jest ich tyle, że trudno policzyć. Na pewno ponad sto pięćdziesiąt. Może nawet ponad dwieście.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A5A.belarusian: Іх так шмат, што цяжка палічыць. Больш за 150, прынамсі. Можа, нават 200.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A6B.english: The last row has three perforations.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A80.english: "Hey, Kim, what do all these holes mean?" (Point to the dots on the watermark.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A80.polish: „Hej, Kim, co oznaczają te wszystkie otwory?” (Wskaż otwory na znaku wodnym).
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A80.belarusian: "Гэй, Кім, а што значаць усе гэтыя дзірачкі?" (Паказаць на кропкі на вадзяным знаку.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A9A.english: "Those are *perforations*. They represent your record as an officer of the RCM. They're your statistics, as it were. I should have guessed you'd keep a record, officers often do. Let's take a look..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A9A.polish: „To *perforacje*. Stanowią zapis twojej służby w MOR-ze. To twoje dotychczasowe statystyki. Powinienem się był domyślić, że je prowadzisz – wielu funkcjonariuszy tak robi. Rzućmy okiem...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000A9A.belarusian: "Гэта *перфарацыі*. Яны адлюстроўваюць вашы дасягненні як афіцэра РГМ. Гэта, так бы мовіць, ваша статыстыка. Варта было здагадацца, што вы ведзяце ўлік — афіцэры часта так робяць. Давайце зірнем..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AA1.english: "The first row represents your years of service. *Eighteen* years? Okay -- not bad at all. What did you do before you volunteered?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AA1.polish: „Pierwszy wiersz to lata służby. *Osiemnaście* lat? Okej – całkiem nieźle. Co robiłeś, zanim zgłosiłeś się na ochotnika?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AA1.belarusian: "Першы шэраг паказвае гады службы. *Васямнаццаць* гадоў? Добра — вельмі някепска. А чым вы займаліся да таго, як пайшлі дабраахвотнікам?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AAE.english: "I walked the land telling whores and liars of the End to come. There are 9,855 days remaining."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AAE.polish: „Wędrowałem po świecie, opowiadając wszetecznicom i kłamcom o nadciągającym końcu. Pozostało 9855 dni”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AAE.belarusian: "Я хадзіў па зямлі і распавядаў блудніцам ды хлусам пра надыходзячы Канец. Засталося 9855 дзён".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AB4.english: "Do you really think I have any idea?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AB4.polish: „Naprawdę myślisz, że mam choćby blade pojęcie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AB4.belarusian: "Ты праўда думаеш, што я маю хоць нейкае ўяўленне?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000ABC.english: "Yes, that *does* seem quite likely. Your youth coincided with some heady days for Revachol. But let's move on, shall we?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000ABC.polish: „Tak, to *rzeczywiście* całkiem prawdopodobne. Twoja młodość zbiegła się z ekscytującym okresem w historii Revacholu. Ale przejdźmy dalej, dobrze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000ABC.belarusian: "Так, гэта *сапраўды* гучыць вельмі праўдападобна. Ваша маладосць супала з бурнымі для Рэвашоля часамі. Але пойдзем далей, добра?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AC3.english: "Fair point... Let's move on, shall we?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000ACB.english: "Cool. I'm glad you joined us. Not a lot of money in doomcrying... Let's move on, shall we?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000ACB.polish: „Fajnie. Cieszę się, że do nas dołączyłeś. Trudno się dorobić na wieszczeniu końca... Przejdźmy dalej, dobrze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000ACB.belarusian: "Выдатна. Рады, што вы далучыліся да нас. На прароцтвах канца свету шмат не заробіш... Пойдзем далей, добра?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AD2.english: "I was a hobo and I lived under a boat."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AD2.polish: „Byłem żulem i mieszkałem pod odwróconą łodzią”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AD2.belarusian: "Я быў бамжом і жыў пад лодкай".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AD8.english: "You know, the RCM is a volunteer's organization. We would have no qualms with vagrants joining our ranks were they qualified... but let's move on, shall we?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AD8.polish: „MOR to organizacja tworzona przez ochotników. Bez problemu przyjmujemy w nasze szeregi włóczęgów, jeśli tylko nadają się do tej pracy... Ale przejdźmy dalej, dobrze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AD8.belarusian: "Ведаеце, РГМ — арганізацыя дабраахвотнікаў. Мы не супраць таго, каб валацугі папаўнялі нашы шэрагі, калі яны падыходзяць па кваліфікацыі... але пойдзем далей, добра?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AE0.english: "No shame in working a regular job, detective. Sometimes after a long day of doing *this*, I even envy it... Let's move on, shall we?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AE0.polish: „Nie ma nic złego w zwykłej pracy, detektywie. Czasem po długim dniu robieniu *tego*, zazdroszczę tym, którzy ją mają... Przejdźmy dalej, dobrze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AE0.belarusian: "Няма нічога ганебнага ў звычайнай працы, дэтэктыве. Часам пасля доўгага дня заняткаў *вось гэтым* я нават зайздрошчу... Але пойдзем далей, добра?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AE6.english: "Probably a some boring office job. Same as everyone else."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AE6.polish: „Pewnie miałem jakąś nudną robotę w biurze. Jak wszyscy inni”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AE6.belarusian: "Пэўна, нейкая нудная праца ў офісе. Як ва ўсіх астатніх".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AEE.english: "I feel like I just went around apologizing all the time."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AEE.polish: „Mam wrażenie, że po prostu ciągle wszystkich przepraszałem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AEE.belarusian: "Мне здаецца, я проста хадзіў і ўвесь час перад усімі выбачаўся".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AF5.english: "Maybe you were a diplomat? Or in PR? Doesn't matter, I suppose... Let's move on, shall we?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AF5.polish: „Może byłeś dyplomatą? Albo specem od PR-u? Właściwie nie ma to znaczenia... Przejdźmy dalej, dobrze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AF5.belarusian: "Можа, вы былі дыпламатам? Ці працавалі ў піяры? Зрэшты, не мае значэння... Пойдзем далей, добра?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AFC.english: "This next row -- the one that wraps all the way around -- is your number of closed cases. *Closed* is good. It means finished. You've got, let's see..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AFC.polish: „Następny wiersz – ten, który biegnie aż do końca – to liczba zamkniętych spraw. *Zamkniętych* czyli ukończonych. Spójrzmy, ile ich masz...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000AFC.belarusian: "Наступны шэраг — той, што апяразвае ўвесь край, — гэта колькасць закрытых спраў. *Закрытых* — гэта добра. Значыць, завершаных. У вас тут, давайце паглядзім..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B16.english: "I would have thought there'd be more."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B1F.english: "It's *quite* a lot, even for someone who's been on the force for nearly two decades. Usually clearing more than 10 cases a year puts you in the 90th percentile of *all* RCM officers..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B1F.polish: „To *całkiem* dużo, nawet jak na kogoś, kto służy od niemal dwóch dekad. Zazwyczaj zamknięcie ponad 10 spraw rocznie zapewnia miejsce w 90. percentylu *wszystkich* funkcjonariuszy MOR-u...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B1F.belarusian: "Гэта *даволі* шмат, нават для таго, хто служыць амаль два дзесяцігоддзі. Звычайна больш за 10 раскрытых спраў на год выводзяць вас у 90-ы перцэнтыль сярод *усіх* афіцэраў РГМ..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B27.english: The lieutenant nods with evident respect. "It's quite a lot, even for someone who's been on the force for nearly two decades. Usually clearing more than 10 cases a year puts you in the 90th percentile of *all* RCM officers..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B27.polish: Porucznik kiwa głową z wyraźnym szacunkiem. „To całkiem dużo, nawet jak na kogoś, kto służy od niemal dwóch dekad. Zazwyczaj zamknięcie ponad 10 spraw rocznie zapewnia miejsce w 90. percentylu *wszystkich* funkcjonariuszy MOR-u...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B27.belarusian: Лейтэнант ківае з відавочнай павагай. "Гэта даволі шмат, нават для таго, хто служыць амаль два дзесяцігоддзі. Звычайна больш за 10 раскрытых спраў на год выводзяць вас у 90-ы перцэнтыль сярод *усіх* афіцэраў РГМ..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B2E.english: "So you're saying I used to be a *supercop*?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B2E.belarusian: "То бок ты хочаш сказаць, што я быў *суперкопам*?"

Alternate1/0x0100008E00000B2E.polish: „Widzisz, Kim? Mówiłem, że jestem supergwiazdorskim gliną!”
Alternate1/0x0100008E00000B2E.belarusian: "Бачыш, Кім? Я ж *казаў* табе, што я коп-суперзорка!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B34.english: "I used to be good. That's some solace I guess. What's the last number?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B34.polish: „Byłem w tym dobry. Zawsze to jakieś pocieszenie. A ta ostatnia liczba?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B34.belarusian: "Калісьці я быў добрым копам. Хоць нейкае суцяшэнне. А што за апошняя лічба?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B3C.english: "I don't think I can ever *re-become* this person... What's the last number?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B3C.polish: „Wątpię, żebym kiedykolwiek znów *stał się ponownie* kimś takim... A ta ostatnia liczba?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B3C.belarusian: "Не думаю, што я калі-небудзь здолею *зноў стаць* такім чалавекам... А што за апошняя лічба?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B4C.english: Doesn't that tingle in your index finger give it away?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B4C.polish: Nie domyślasz się po tym łaskotaniu w palcu wskazującym?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B4C.belarusian: Хіба гэтае паколванне ва ўказальным пальцы не падказвае?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B54.english: "Right. Those are your confirmed kills. You've got precisely *three* perforations there."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B54.polish: „Tak. To liczba potwierdzonych zabójstw. Masz w tym wierszu dokładnie *trzy* perforacje”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B54.belarusian: "Так. Гэта вашы пацверджаныя забойствы. У гэтым шэрагу ў вас акурат *тры* перфарацыі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B62.english: "I was expecting a higher number, honestly."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B70.english: "Is now a good time to pour one out for the fallen?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B70.polish: „Czy to dobry moment, żeby uronić kroplę za zmarłych?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000B70.belarusian: "Ці добры цяпер момант, каб пляснуць кілішак за загінулых?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000BB1.english: "Call it what you want. You were a valuable member of your precinct. Now, let's look at the last row..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000BB1.polish: „Nazywaj to, jak chcesz. Byłeś wartościowym członkiem obsady swojego komisariatu. A teraz sprawdźmy ostatni wiersz...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000BB1.belarusian: "Называйце як хочаце. Вы былі каштоўным супрацоўнікам свайго пастарунка. А цяпер зірнем на апошні шэраг..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000BDE.english: "Everyone has their own method of coping, some more effective, or self-destructive, than others..." He gives you a meaningful look.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000BDE.polish: „Każdy radzi sobie po swojemu – jedni skuteczniej lub bardziej autodestrukcyjnie niż inni...” – odpowiada, spoglądając na ciebie znacząco.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000BDE.belarusian: "Ва ўсіх свае спосабы спраўляцца: нечыя больш эфектыўныя, нечыя больш самаразбуральныя..." — ён шматзначна глядзіць на цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000BE4.polish: „Tak” – odpowiada, ale nie wdaje się w szczegóły.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000BE4.belarusian: "Так", — кажа ён, адмаўляючыся ўдавацца ў падрабязнасці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000BFB.english: Right. The meaning of the perforations remains opaque to you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000BFB.polish: Tak. Znaczenie tych perforacji pozostaje dla ciebie niejasne.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000BFB.belarusian: Добра. Сэнс гэтых перфарацый застаецца для цябе няясным.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C1F.english: As you look at them you feel your index finger reflexively contract three times.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C1F.polish: Kiedy na nie spoglądasz, czujesz, jak twój palec wskazujący odruchowo zgina się trzy razy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C1F.belarusian: Калі ты глядзіш на іх, твой указальны палец рэфлекторна згінаецца тры разы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C32.english: Seems like something I've done before.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C32.polish: Chyba robiłem coś takiego już wcześniej.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C39.english: A memory, an echo in the recesses of your amygdala.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C39.polish: Wspomnienie odbijające się echem z zakamarków twojego ciała migdałowatego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C39.belarusian: Успамін, рэха ў глыбінях твайго міндалепадобнага цела.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C48.english: And something you'll do again, before this is all over.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C48.polish: I zanim to wszystko się skończy, zrobisz to ponownie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C48.belarusian: І зробіш яшчэ раз, перш чым усё гэта скончыцца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C56.english: You know the answer already. The tingle in your index finger gave it away.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C56.polish: Znasz już odpowiedź. Zdradziło ci ją łaskotanie w palcu wskazującym.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C56.belarusian: Ты ўжо ведаеш адказ. Паколванне ва ўказальным пальцы падказала яго.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C5D.english: "Those are my confirmed kills. Three of them."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C64.english: "That's right," the lieutenant says, gauging your reaction. "How did you know?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C64.polish: „Zgadza się” – odpowiada porucznik, obserwując twoją reakcję. „Skąd wiedziałeś?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C64.belarusian: "Так і ёсць", — кажа лейтэнант, ацэньваючы тваю рэакцыю. — "Адкуль вы ведаеце?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C6B.english: "Because I felt a twitch in my index finger."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C6B.belarusian: "Бо я адчуў тузанне ва ўказальным пальцы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C80.english: "Ah, right. Sometimes the brain's able to preserve certain responses even when conscious memory has been... let's say... *misplaced*..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C80.polish: „Racja. Czasem mózg jest w stanie zachować pewne reakcje, nawet jeśli świadoma pamięć... powiedzmy... *się zapodzieje*...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C80.belarusian: "А, дакладна. Часам мазгі здольныя захоўваць пэўныя рэакцыі, нават калі свядомая памяць была... скажам так... *згублена*..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C96.english: The rectangular watermark is overlaid with the logo of the RCM, and yet the major arteries of Revachol are all recognizable. They shimmer in the Kineema's headlights.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C96.polish: Na kwadratowym znaku wodnym widnieje logo MOR-u, nie uniemożliwia to jednak rozpoznania największych arterii Revacholu. Połyskują w świetle lamp kineemy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000C96.belarusian: На прамавугольны вадзяны знак накладзены лагатып РГМ, але ўсе галоўныя артэрыі Рэвашоля пазнавальныя. Яны мігцяць у святле фар Кінімы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CA4.english: "Where are we on this?" (Point to the halogen map.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CA4.polish: „Gdzie jesteśmy na tej mapie?” (Wskaż na halogenowy plan).
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CA4.belarusian: "А дзе мы тут?" (Паказаць на галагенавую мапу.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CAB.english: You catch a faint glimmer from a broken beer bottle. In the distance -- sounds. Two men engaged in a drunken argument, followed by the closing of some distant window.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CAB.polish: Dostrzegasz blady błysk rozbitej butelki po piwie. Gdzieś z oddali dobiegają dźwięki. Dwóch mężczyzn toczy pijacką kłótnię; po chwili słychać trzask zamykanego w oddali okna.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CAB.belarusian: Ты заўважаеш слабенькі водбліск ад разбітай піўной бутэлькі. Удалечыні — гукі. Двое мужчын зацята і п'яна сварацца, а пасля чуваць, як зачыняецца нейкае далёкае акно.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CB2.english: In the middle of a broken plaza, illuminated in a cone of light, two men, one slim, the other sturdy. They are on the city stage, but only one of them knows his lines...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CB2.polish: Pośrodku zniszczonego placu, w świetlnym stożku, stoi dwóch mężczyzn – jeden szczupły, drugi postawny. Obaj występują na scenie miasta, lecz tylko jeden pamięta swoją rolę...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CB2.belarusian: Пасярод разбітага пляца, асветленыя конусам святла, стаяць двое мужчын: адзін хударлявы, другі каржакаваты. Яны на гарадской сцэне, але толькі адзін з іх ведае свае рэплікі...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CB8.english: "Ah, Martinaise at night," he smells the air and says.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CB8.polish: „Ach, Martinaise nocą...” – bierze wdech przez nos.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CB8.belarusian: "Ах, Марцінэз уначы", — ён уцягвае паветра носам і кажа.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CBF.english: "Let me see." He takes the ledger for a moment and inspects it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CBF.polish: „Niech no spojrzę” – bierze na chwilę notatnik i przygląda się mu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CBF.belarusian: "Дайце паглядзець", — ён бярэ нататнік на хвілінку і аглядае яго.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CC6.english: "Right here," he says, his finger near the top of the map, on a segment of coast jutting out into the great ocean.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CC6.polish: „Tutaj” – mówi, wskazując palcem punkt leżący w górnej części mapy – fragment wybrzeża wrzynający się w olbrzymi ocean.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CC6.belarusian: "Вось тут", — кажа ён, трымаючы палец каля верхняга краю мапы, на адрэзку ўзбярэжжа, які выступае ў вялікі акіян.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CDF.english: You count 216 perforations. Considering that nice, large number, a wave of pride washes over you, though you can't say why, precisely.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CDF.polish: Doliczyłeś się 216 perforacji. Myśl o tej porządnej, dużej liczbie sprawia, że pierś wzbiera ci dumą, choć nie wiesz dokładnie dlaczego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CDF.belarusian: Ты налічваеш 216 перфарацый. Ад думкі пра гэты ладны, вялікі лік цябе агортвае хваля гонару, хоць ты і не можаш дакладна сказаць, чаму.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CF7.english: "For an RCM officer -- especially Precinct 41, which is in the Jamrock Quarter -- it's rather... tame. I mean that in a good way."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CF7.polish: „Jak na funkcjonariusza MOR-u – zwłaszcza z 41. komisariatu, który znajduje się w dzielnicy Jamrock – to raczej... niewielka liczba. W pozytywnym sensie tego słowa”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CF7.belarusian: "Для афіцэра РГМ — асабліва з Пастарунка 41, які знаходзіцца ў раёне Джэмрок, — гэта даволі... сціпла. Я ў добрым сэнсе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CFD.english: "What's it feel like to kill a man, Mr. McCoy?" a young woman asks the man across the desk from her...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CFD.polish: „Jakie to uczucie zabić człowieka, panie McCoy?” – pyta młoda kobieta mężczyznę siedzącego po drugiej stronie biurka...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000CFD.belarusian: "Якое гэта пачуццё — забіць чалавека, спадару Маккой?" — маладая жанчына пытаецца ў мужчыны насупраць праз стол...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D04.english: "Honestly, babe," says John McCoy, crossing his ankles over said desk, "I don't feel anything anymore. It's just like brushing my teeth -- I do it once or twice a week and don't really think about it." There's no trace of guilt in his voice.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D04.polish: „Szczerze mówiąc, kochana” – odpowiada McCoy, zarzucając na to biurko skrzyżowane nogi – „to nic już nie czuję. To jak mycie zębów, robię to raz czy dwa razy w tygodniu i się nad tym nie zastanawiam” – w jego głosie próżno szukać śladu wyrzutów sumienia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D04.belarusian: "Шчыра кажучы, дзетка, — кажа Джон Маккой, закінуўшы скрыжаваныя ногі на той самы стол, — я больш нічога не адчуваю. Гэта як чысціць зубы: раблю гэта раз ці два на тыдзень і асабліва не задумваюся". У ягоным голасе няма і следу віны.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D11.english: "There are certain officers who treat their kills like some kind of ghoulish game. If they do happen to *solve* a case it's usually by accident." It's obvious the lieutenant doesn't think very highly of these officers...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D11.polish: „Niektórzy funkcjonariusze traktują liczbę zabójstw jak wynik w jakiejś makabrycznej grze. Gdy udaje im się *rozwiązać* jakąś sprawę, to zwykle wyłącznie przez przypadek” – od razu widać, że porucznik nie ma o tych funkcjonariuszach zbyt wysokiego mniemania...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D11.belarusian: "Ёсць пэўныя афіцэры, якія ставяцца да сваіх забойстваў як да нейкай вусцішнай гульні. Калі ім і ўдаецца *раскрыць* справу, то звычайна выпадкова". Відавочна, лейтэнант не надта высокай думкі пра такіх афіцэраў...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D19.english: "But it seems as though you are, or at least *were*, one of the good ones. So we have that to be thankful for."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D19.polish: „Ale najwyraźniej jesteś – a przynajmniej *byłeś* – jednym z tych dobrych. Powinniśmy się z tego cieszyć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D19.belarusian: "Але, здаецца, вы з тых, хто робіць усё правільна — ці прынамсі *былі* такім. І за гэта варта быць удзячнымі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D42.english: "Maybe I should pour one out for the boys? The fallen?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D42.polish: „Może powinienem uronić kroplę za chłopaków? Za zmarłych?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D42.belarusian: "Можа, мне варта пляснуць кілішак за хлопцаў? За загінулых?"

Alternate1/0x0100008E00000D42.polish: „Jesteś *pewien*, że nie powinienem uronić kropli za tych zmarłych chłopaków?”
Alternate1/0x0100008E00000D42.belarusian: "Ты *ўпэўнены*, што мне не варта пляснуць кілішак за тых загінулых хлопцаў?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D55.english: "If you want to pour out the booze you've been carrying around *on duty*, I'm certainly not going to stop you..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D55.polish: „Jeśli zamierzasz wylać gorzałę, którą nosisz przy sobie *na służbie*, to ja na pewno nie będę cię powstrzymywał...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D55.belarusian: "Калі вы хочаце выліць пойла, якое цягаеце з сабой *на службе*, я дакладна не буду вас спыняць..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D69.english: "Actually, I'm just gonna hold onto this."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D69.polish: „Właściwie to może lepiej ją sobie zatrzymam”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D70.english: (Pour one out on the ground -- ceremonially.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D77.english: A dark pool of cheap wine appears at your feet. It shimmers in the lights of the Kineema.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D77.polish: U twoich stóp rozlewa się ciemna kałuża podłego wina. Połyskuje w świetle reflektorów kineemy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D77.belarusian: Цёмная лужына таннага віна расцякаецца каля тваіх ног. Яна мігціць у святле фар Кінімы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D7E.english: Honourably done. You have given up some of your own blood -- for theirs.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D7E.polish: Bardzo honorowo. Oddałeś nieco własnej krwi na cześć tej, którą rozlali oni.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D7E.belarusian: Зроблена з гонарам. Ты аддаў крыху ўласнай крыві — за іхнюю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D8F.english: "The Gloaming comes for all, but it came first for you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D8F.polish: „Zmrok czeka każdego, po was przyszedł jednak najpierw”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000D8F.belarusian: "Цемра прыходзіць па ўсіх, але па вас яна прыйшла раней."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000DA3.english: "I will make it okay with the power of rock and roll."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000DA3.polish: „Ukoję wasz ból mocą rock and rolla”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000DAA.english: "I'm not really sure what you're supposed to say at these things."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000DAA.polish: „Nie wiem za bardzo, co się mówi przy takich okazjach”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000DAA.belarusian: "Я не надта ўпэўнены, што трэба казаць у такіх выпадках."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000DB1.english: "Very noble of you. Are we done here?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000DB1.polish: „To bardzo szlachetnie z twojej strony. Możemy wracać do pracy?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000DB1.belarusian: "Вельмі высакародна з вашага боку. Мы тут скончылі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000DDD.english: "Personally, I find it helps to keep up a few hobbies."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000DF9.english: "Oh, this and that. Let's not get into it now."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000DF9.polish: „Och, takie tam. Nie rozmawiajmy teraz o tym”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000DF9.belarusian: "О, усякае. Не будзем цяпер пра гэта".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008E00000E05.polish: „Może i ja powinienem sobie znaleźć hobby?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000633B.english: "We didn't find anything *conclusive* linking them to the smuggling operation, but somehow I doubt that Evrart Claire would be oblivious to something like this happening right under his nose."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000633B.polish: „Nie znaleźliśmy żadnego *niezbitego* dowodu łączącego Związek z tym przemytem, ale wątpię, aby Evrart Claire nie miał pojęcia o tego typu operacji działającej tuż pod jego nosem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000633B.belarusian: "Мы не знайшлі нічога *канчатковага*, што звязвала б іх з кантрабандай, але неяк сумняюся, што Эўрар Клэр не ведаў пра нешта падобнае, што адбываецца проста ў яго пад носам".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00006361.english: "Like Joyce told us, yes -- logistically. But don't expect to bust this open during our stay here. At best, this is an angle we can use against them. To other ends. As extra ammunition."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00006361.polish: „Jak powiedziała nam Joyce, tak – logistycznie. Ale nie licz na to, że rozpracujemy tę operację podczas naszego pobytu tutaj. Możemy najwyżej wykorzystać to doraźnie przeciwko nim. Jako środek do osiągnięcia innych celów. Dodatkową amunicję”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00006361.belarusian: "Як нам і казала Джойс, так — лагістычна. Але не спадзявайцеся накрыць усё гэта падчас нашага знаходжання тут. У лепшым выпадку гэта козыр, які мы можам выкарыстаць супраць іх. Для іншых мэт. Як дадатковыя набоі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B169.english: Don't be fooled, desire always plays a role.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B169.polish: Nie daj się zwieść, pożądanie zawsze gra jakąś rolę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B169.belarusian: Не паддавайся на падман: жаданне заўсёды адыгрывае ролю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B176.english: "Klaasje might have been right about Ruby -- she looks awfully lot like one of the poster girls in the cabin."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B176.polish: „Klaasje mogła mieć rację co do Ruby – bardzo przypomina jedną z tych dziewczyn z plakatu w kabinie kierowczyni”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B176.belarusian: "Клаас'е магла мець рацыю наконт Рубі — яна жудасна падобная да адной з тых дзяўчат з плакатаў у кабіне."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B183.english: "And last but not least, it looks like the Hardie boys knew this driver, as we know that she was present at the lynching. This may be the Union connection we've been searching for."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B183.polish: „No i wygląda na to, że chłopaki Hardiego znali tę kierowczynię, która – jak wiemy – była obecna podczas linczu. To może być szukane przez nas ogniwo łączące tę operację ze Związkiem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B183.belarusian: "І апошняе, але не менш важнае: выглядае, што хлопцы Хардзі ведалі гэтую кіроўцу, бо нам вядома, што яна прысутнічала пры самасудзе. Гэта можа быць тая самая сувязь з Прафсаюзам, якую мы шукалі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B25D.english: "Perhaps you're right..." He stops to think. "This is one connection I find a little dubious, to be honest. I prefer not to profile people's emotions. Perhaps it's because I'm not very good at it, but still."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B25D.polish: „Może masz rację...” – zamyśla się. „Szczerze mówiąc, to jedno powiązanie wydaje mi się odrobinę wątpliwe. Wolę nie profilować ludzkich emocji. To pewnie dlatego, że nie jestem w tym zbyt dobry, no ale”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B25D.belarusian: "Магчыма, вы маеце рацыю..." (Ён спыняецца падумаць.) "Шчыра кажучы, гэтая сувязь падаецца мне крыху сумнеўнай. Я аддаю перавагу таму, каб не складаць псіхалагічных партрэтаў на аснове чалавечых эмоцый. Можа, таму, што мне гэта не надта ўдаецца, але ўсё ж".

Dialogue Text/0x01000011000016DF.english: Actually, he's not bad at it at all.
Dialogue Text/0x01000011000016DF.polish: Tak naprawdę to jest w tym naprawdę niezły.
Dialogue Text/0x01000011000016DF.belarusian: Насамрэч яму гэта вельмі нават удаецца.

Dialogue Text/0x01000011000016EC.polish: „Tak, no cóż...” – nie mówi nic więcej.
Dialogue Text/0x01000011000016EC.belarusian: "Так, ну што ж..." — больш ён нічога не кажа.

Dialogue Text/0x01000011000016F2.english: "A lot of women there. Especially for a lady driver's cabin."
Dialogue Text/0x01000011000016F2.polish: „Wiele tu kobiet. Zwłaszcza jak na kabinę użytkowaną przez kobietę”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000011000016F2.belarusian: "Там багата жанчын. Асабліва як для кабіны жанчыны-кіроўцы".

Dialogue Text/0x01000011000016F8.english: "Maybe the trader is some sort of cinephile."

Dialogue Text/0x01000011000016FE.polish: „Może mieć w tym udział przemysł filmowy?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000011000016FE.belarusian: "Ці можа кінаіндустрыя быць замяшаная ў гэтым?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000110000171A.english: In short: this is a future angle. Possibly a good one.
Dialogue Text/0x010000110000171A.polish: Krótko mówiąc: jest to temat na przyszłość. Może okazać się obiecujący.
Dialogue Text/0x010000110000171A.belarusian: Карацей: гэта зачэпка на будучыню. Магчыма, нядрэнная.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001100001721.english: Meaning: someone as slippery as Evrart won't be caught by a couple of cops and some stuff they found in some cabin.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001100001721.polish: Innymi słowy: ktoś tak oślizgły jak Evrart nie dałby się złapać dwóm policjantom na podstawie jakichś rzeczy znalezionych w jakiejś kabinie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001100001721.belarusian: Гэта значыць: кагосьці такога слізкага, як Эўрар, парачка копаў не зловіць на нейкім маллі, знойдзеным у нейкай кабіне.

Dialogue Text/0x010000110000172A.english: "Will the RCM open an investigation into this?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000110000172A.polish: „Czy MOR rozpocznie w tej sprawie dochodzenie?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000110000172A.belarusian: "Ці пачне РГМ расследаванне ў гэтай справе?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100001100001731.english: "We should return to the murder case. See what Joyce tells us about the lynching. When we're done for the day, I'll call my station and suggest our narcotics department look into it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001100001731.polish: „Powinniśmy wrócić do śledztwa w sprawie zabójstwa. Sprawdzić, co Joyce powie nam o linczu. Na koniec dnia skontaktuję się z moim komisariatem i zasugeruję naszemu wydziałowi narkotykowemu, aby się temu przyjrzał”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001100001731.belarusian: "Мы павінны вярнуцца да справы аб забойстве. Паглядзець, што Джойс раскажа нам пра самасуд. Калі скончым на сёння, я патэлефаную ў свой участак і прапаную нашаму аддзелу па барацьбе з наркотыкамі заняцца гэтым".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001100001738.english: "There are more than enough grounds to start an official investigation -- some time later, when we're done here. We do *not* want to get caught in that..." He stops to think.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001100001738.polish: „Odkryliśmy znacznie więcej niż potrzeba, aby rozpocząć oficjalne śledztwo – za jakiś czas, gdy skończymy bieżące dochodzenie. *Nie* chcemy utknąć w tym...” – nagle przerywa i myśli.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001100001738.belarusian: "Падстаў для пачатку афіцыйнага расследавання больш чым дастаткова — некалі пазней, калі мы скончым тут. Мы *не* хочам у гэта ўліпнуць..." — ён спыняецца падумаць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001100001746.english: "The fact that one hasn't started already gives me pause. An investigation, I mean. Especially if the Madre grouping is involved... and I can't imagine they aren't. It's certainly worrisome."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001100001746.polish: „To, że jeszcze się nie zaczęło, dało mi do myślenia. Chodzi mi o śledztwo. Zwłaszcza jeśli zamieszana jest w to grupa Madre... A wątpię, aby nie była. To bardzo niepokojące”.
