Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015124.polish: „Wciąż uważam, że to nie był dobry pomysł, ale tak – jeśli chodzi o Wild Pines, to nie mamy z nimi żadnych zaległości. Zwłaszcza, że ich przedstawicielki nie ma już w Martinaise”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015124.belarusian: "Я ўсё яшчэ не лічу, што гэта была добрая ідэя, але так — нашы справы з Wild Pines у парадку. Паколькі яе больш няма ў Марцінэзе".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001512A.english: Someone's been a very busy boy. Good on you...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001512A.polish: Ktoś był bardzo zajętym chłopcem. Dobra robota...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001512A.belarusian: Хтосьці быў вельмі занятым хлопчыкам. Малайчына...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015131.english: "You think we should finish running it *now*?" he whispers. "Maybe you're right. It might not be as useful later..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015131.polish: „Myślisz, że powinniśmy dokończyć jego sprawdzanie *teraz*?” – pyta szeptem. „Może masz rację. To może się jeszcze przydać...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015131.belarusian: "Думаеце, нам варта скончыць праверку *зараз*? — шэпча ён. — Можа, вы і маеце рацыю. Пазней гэта можа быць ужо не так карысна..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015139.english: "We've checked the buoy with Klaasje's documents. I want to hear her take on why it was empty before."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015139.polish: „Zajrzeliśmy do boi z dokumentami Klaasje. Chciałbym najpierw usłyszeć, czemu jej zdaniem była pusta”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015139.belarusian: "Мы праверылі той бакен з дакументамі Клаас'е. Хачу спачатку пачуць яе тлумачэнне, чаму ён быў пусты".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015141.english: "Okay -- why not. Whatever goes down might also affect her. The Union is watching her closely now..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015141.polish: „W porządku – czemu nie. To, co się wkrótce wydarzy, może wpłynąć również na nią. Związek ma ją teraz na oku...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015141.belarusian: "Добра — чаму б і не. Што б ні здарылася, гэта можа закрануць і яе. Цяпер Прафсаюз пільна за ёй сочыць..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001514D.english: Not closely enough, you suspect. But still -- good idea to visit her once more.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001514D.polish: Podejrzewasz, że niewystarczająco. Niemniej dobrym pomysłem byłoby jeszcze raz ją odwiedzić.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001514D.belarusian: Недастаткова пільна, як ты падазраеш. Але ўсё адно — добрая думка наведаць яе яшчэ раз.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015154.english: "Do you think whatever happens will affect our cryptozoologists?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015154.polish: „Myślisz, że cokolwiek się stanie, wpłynie to jakoś na naszych kryptozoologów?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015154.belarusian: "Як думаеш, што б ні здарылася, гэта закране нашых крыптазоолагаў?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001515C.english: "You mean Lena? I don't see how cryptozoology and the murder investigation are connected. But... the situation in the city will get tense for everyone."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001515C.polish: „Masz na myśli Lenę? Kryptozoologia i śledztwo w sprawie morderstwa raczej nie są powiązane. Ale... Napięta sytuacja w mieście może wpłynąć na wszystkich”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001515C.belarusian: "Вы маеце на ўвазе Лену? Я не бачу, як крыптазаалогія звязаная з расследаваннем забойства. Але... сітуацыя ў горадзе стане напружанай для ўсіх".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015162.english: If it gets that tense, the amateur zoologists might not be able to do their job.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015162.polish: Jeśli zrobi się aż tak napięta, zoolodzy amatorzy mogą nie być w stanie wykonywać swojej pracy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015162.belarusian: Калі стане настолькі напружана, заолагі-аматары наўрад ці змогуць выконваць сваю працу.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001516A.english: "How bad do you think things could get?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001516A.polish: „Jak zła twoim zdaniem może zrobić się sytuacja?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001516A.belarusian: "Як думаеш, наколькі дрэнна ўсё можа скончыцца?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015170.english: "Well... we're not responsible for what we can't predict, are we? I don't think the *entire* city will be razed to the ground." He smiles in the dark.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015170.polish: „No cóż... Nie jesteśmy odpowiedzialni za coś, czego nie jesteśmy w stanie przewidzieć, prawda? Nie sądzę, aby *całe* miasto zostało zrównane z ziemią” – stwierdza, uśmiechając się w ciemności.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015170.belarusian: "Ну... мы ж не адказваем за тое, чаго не можам прадбачыць, праўда? Не думаю, што *ўвесь* горад зраўняюць з зямлёй", — ён усміхаецца ў цемры.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015176.english: If you can't predict it, there's nothing you could have done.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015176.polish: Jeśli nie możesz tego przewidzieć, nie możesz też temu w żaden sposób zapobiec.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015176.belarusian: Калі ты не можаш гэтага прадбачыць, ты нічога не здолеў бы зрабіць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001517C.english: "What do you think is waiting for us there?" (Conclude.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015182.english: "I think I see a cavern..." The lieutenant's whisper echoes down the tunnel. "Maybe more cellars? I think we've been careful enough -- we still have the element of surprise."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015182.polish: „Zdaje się, że widzę jaskinię...” – szept porucznika odbija się w tunelu echem. „Może są tam kolejne piwnice? Myślę, że przy odrobinie ostrożności wciąż będziemy mogli liczyć na element zaskoczenia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015182.belarusian: "Здаецца, я бачу пячору..." — сэпт лейтэнанта рэхам коціцца па тунэлі. — "Можа, чарговыя сутарэнні? Думаю, мы былі дастаткова асцярожнымі — элемент нечаканасці ўсё яшчэ за намі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015189.english: I wouldn't be so sure. You haven't exactly been sneaking.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015189.polish: Nie byłbym taki pewien. Skradać to się raczej nie skradaliście.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015189.belarusian: Я б не быў такім упэўненым. Крадком вы, шчыра кажучы, не ішлі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015190.english: "Or... maybe not." He puts his hand to his holster. "Either way, once we go deeper, there will be no turning back."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015190.polish: „Albo i nie” – kładzie dłoń na kaburze swojej broni. „Tak czy siak, gdy zapuścimy się głębiej, nie będzie odwrotu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015190.belarusian: "Або... магчыма, не", — ён кладзе руку на кабуру. — "У любым выпадку, як толькі мы зойдзем глыбей, шляху назад ужо не будзе".

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000151C0.english: It's a minor point. Don't worry too much about this. There are bigger fish.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000151C0.polish: To akurat detal. Nie przejmuj się tym za bardzo. Są ważniejsze sprawy.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000151C0.belarusian: Гэта дробная дэталь. Не пераймайся занадта. Ёсць рыба і паболей.

Dialogue Text/0x01000035000000B2.english: "You mean Morell? I don't see how cryptozoology and the murder investigation are connected. But... the situation in the city will get tense for everyone."
Dialogue Text/0x01000035000000B2.polish: „Masz na myśli Morella? Kryptozoologia i śledztwo w sprawie morderstwa raczej nie są powiązane. Ale... Napięta sytuacja w mieście może wpłynąć na wszystkich”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000035000000B2.belarusian: "Вы маеце на ўвазе Марэля? Я не бачу, як крыптазаалогія звязаная з расследаваннем забойства. Але... сітуацыя ў горадзе стане напружанай для ўсіх".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E6BC.english: "I don't feel it, but..." He looks ahead, beyond the arch. "We should still be careful. There were footprints back there. And I'm pretty sure they were fresh."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E6BC.polish: „Nie czuję niczego, ale...” – zerka w przód za łuk. „Powinniśmy zachować ostrożność. Widziałem tam ślady stóp. I jestem pewny, że były świeże”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E6BC.belarusian: "Я нічога не адчуваю, але..." — ён глядзіць наперад, за арку. — "Нам усё адно варта быць асцярожнымі. Там ззаду былі сляды. І я амаль упэўнены, што яны свежыя".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E6C6.english: Let's *try* not to worry, he thinks.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013B34.english: "We've still got a date with The Pigs... and *my gun*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013B34.polish: „Mamy jeszcze umówioną randkę ze Świniarką... i moją *spluwą*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013B34.belarusian: "У нас яшчэ спатканне з Мусарняй... і *маім пісталетам*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013B3A.english: "We absolutely cannot skip that appointment." His face is stone. "Consider that 100% confirmed. I fear you'll need your gun for this..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013B3A.polish: „Pod żadnym pozorem nie możemy przegapić tego spotkania” – jego twarz jest jak kamienna maska. „Odbędzie się na 100%. Obawiam się, że będziesz potrzebował swojej broni...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013B3A.belarusian: "Мы катэгарычна не можам прапусціць гэтую сустрэчу", — ягоны твар нібы каменны. — "Лічыце, што яна пацверджана на ўсе сто. Баюся, для гэтага вам спатрэбіцца ваш пісталет..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013B41.english: His hand rests on his holster. It's not enough -- you need a gun in your hand, too. *Your* gun.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013B41.polish: Kładzie rękę na kaburze. To za mało. Ty też potrzebujesz spluwy w dłoni. *Swojej* spluwy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013B41.belarusian: Ягоная рука ляжыць на кабуры. Гэтага недастаткова — табе таксама патрэбны пісталет у руцэ. *Твой* пісталет.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00002A87.english: "Maybe we should finish looking into the Speedfreaks FM mystery?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00002A87.polish: „Może powinniśmy zgłębić do końca tajemnicę Naspeedowanych FM?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00002A87.belarusian: "Можа, нам варта да канца разабрацца з таямніцай Хуткарэзаў FM?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00002A8F.english: "If you want to do that, then yes. We'd be advised to finish every lead. I don't think we'll have the chance to after..." He looks down the dark tunnel. He does not finish the thought.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00002A8F.polish: „Jeśli chcesz się temu przyjrzeć, to tak. Powinniśmy pozałatwiać wszystkie niedokończone sprawy. Raczej nie będziemy mieli na to szansy, gdy będzie już po...” – spogląda w głąb mrocznego tunelu i nie kończy myśli.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00002A8F.belarusian: "Калі вы хочаце гэта зрабіць, тады так. Нам варта праверыць усе зачэпкі. Не думаю, што ў нас будзе магчымасць пасля таго, як..." — ён глядзіць углыб цёмнага тунэля. І не заканчвае думку.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000DE45.english: Could this have been the killer's hideout, and this narrow window -- the point of origin of the shot that killed the mercenary?
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000DE45.polish: Czy to może być kryjówka zabójcy, a to wąskie okienko – miejsce, z którego oddano śmiertelny strzał do najemnika?
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000DE45.belarusian: Ці магла гэта быць схаванка забойцы, а гэтае вузкае акенца — месцам, адкуль зрабілі стрэл, што забіў найміта?

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B07.english: This does look like an *embrasure*, a slit made for shooting out of.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B07.polish: Wygląda nawet trochę jak *ambrazura* – szczelina przeznaczona do prowadzenia ostrzału.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B07.belarusian: Гэта сапраўды выглядае як *амбразура*, шчыліна для стральбы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B1F.english: Outside the window -- another day. The beach sand soaks up the drizzling rain, growing darker and darker.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B1F.polish: Za oknem widzisz, że trwa kolejny dzień. Piasek na plaży chłonie mżący deszcz, ciemniejąc coraz bardziej i bardziej.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B1F.belarusian: За акном — чарговы дзень. Пляжны пясок усмоктвае дробны дождж, усё больш і больш цямнеючы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B25.english: Outside the window -- desolation. Snow falls softly onto the coastal sand, where it melts almost instantly. On rooftops, it lingers.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B25.polish: Za oknem – pustkowie. Śnieg opada łagodnie na przybrzeżny piach i niemal natychmiast topnieje. Utrzymuje się nieco dłużej na dachach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B25.belarusian: За акном — пустэча. Снег мякка падае на прыбярэжны пясок, дзе растае амаль імгненна. На дахах жа ён затрымліваецца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B2B.english: Outside the window -- the day is clear, and as mild as can be in early spring.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B2B.polish: Za oknem widzisz pogodny dzień, tak ciepły, jak tylko to możliwe wczesną wiosną.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B2B.belarusian: За акном — дзень ясны і настолькі лагодны, наколькі гэта магчыма ранняй вясной.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B31.english: You hear the rain's susurration across the sea water. The night shudders.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B31.polish: Słyszysz szelest deszczu padającego na powierzchnię morza. Noc wydaje się drżeć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B31.belarusian: Ты чуеш шэлест дажджу над марской вадой. Ноч уздрыгвае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B37.english: In the darkness, you can barely make out the falling snow. It settles, making the night still quieter.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B37.polish: Ledwo widzisz w ciemnościach padający śnieg. Opada powoli, sprawiając, że noc staje się jeszcze cichsza.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B37.belarusian: У цемры ты ледзь бачыш падаючы снег. Ён асядае, робячы ноч яшчэ цішэйшай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B3D.english: The lights of Martinaise shine coolly in the clear night.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B3D.polish: Światła Martinaise świecą zimno wśród pogodnej nocy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B3D.belarusian: Агні Марцінэза халодна свецяць у ясную ноч.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B73.english: Would this have been a good hideout for a sniper?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B73.polish: Czy to byłaby dobra kryjówka dla snajpera?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010B73.belarusian: Ці была б гэта добрая схаванка для снайпера?

Alternate1/0x0100005800010B73.polish: (Odwróć się do Kima). „Czy zabójca mógł tu sobie urządzić kryjówkę?”
Alternate1/0x0100005800010B73.belarusian: (Павярнуцца да Кіма.) "Ці мог забойца выкарыстаць гэта як схаванку?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BB2.english: No, it's not. No matter how you crane your neck, you can't see the whole of the Whirling-in-Rags, and certainly not the relevant segment of the top floor.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BB2.polish: Nie. Jak bardzo byś nie wyciągał szyi, nie widzisz całego Whirling-in-Rags, a już na pewno nie odpowiednią część piętra.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BB2.belarusian: Не, нерэальна. Як ні выцягвай шыю, ты не бачыш Whirling-in-Rags цалкам, і тым больш патрэбную частку верхняга паверха.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BD1.english: "It's a great place to hide, certainly, but there hasn't been anyone here in ages."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BD1.polish: „To świetna kryjówka, ale nie było tu nikogo od bardzo dawna”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BD1.belarusian: "Гэта, безумоўна, выдатная схаванка, але тут ужо вечнасць нікога не было".

Alternate1/0x0100005800010BD1.polish: „To świetna kryjówka, a mazowizm i morderstwo z pewnością się nie wykluczają, ale nie było tu nikogo od bardzo dawna”.
Alternate1/0x0100005800010BD1.belarusian: "Гэта выдатная схаванка, дый мазавізм і забойства, безумоўна, не выключаюць адно аднаго. Але тут ужо вечнасць нікога не было".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BD7.english: "It's a great place to hide, certainly, but there hasn't been anyone in here for ages."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BD7.polish: „To świetna kryjówka, ale nie było tu nikogo od bardzo dawna”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BD7.belarusian: "Гэта, безумоўна, выдатная схаванка, але тут ужо вечнасць нікога не было".

Alternate1/0x0100005800010BD7.polish: „To świetna kryjówka, a mazowizm i zabijanie z pewnością się nie wykluczają, ale nie było tu nikogo od bardzo dawna”.
Alternate1/0x0100005800010BD7.belarusian: "Гэта выдатная схаванка, дый мазавізм і пазбаўленне жыцця, безумоўна, не выключаюць адно аднаго. Але тут ужо вечнасць нікога не было".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BDD.english: It's a good place to hide, but doesn't look like anyone has stayed here in a while.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BDD.polish: To dobre miejsce na kryjówkę, ale nie wygląda na to, żeby ktoś przebywał tu w ostatnim czasie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BDD.belarusian: Гэта добрае месца для схаванкі, але не падобна, каб тут нехта быў апошнім часам.

Alternate1/0x0100005800010BDD.polish: To dobre miejsce na kryjówkę, ale nie wygląda na to, żeby ktoś – czy to wyznawca mazowizmu, czy morderca – przebywał tu w ostatnim czasie.
Alternate1/0x0100005800010BDD.belarusian: Гэта добрае месца для схаванкі, але не падобна, каб тут нехта — ці то мазавіст, ці то забойца — быў апошнім часам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BE3.english: It's definitely a good place to hide. You barely found it yourself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BE3.polish: To zdecydowanie dobre miejsce na kryjówkę. Sam ledwo je znalazłeś.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010BE3.belarusian: Гэта безумоўна добрае месца для схаванкі. Ты сам яго ледзь знайшоў.

Alternate1/0x0100005800010BE3.polish: To zdecydowanie dobre miejsce na kryjówkę. Mazowianie wiedzą, jak zapadać się pod ziemię.
Alternate1/0x0100005800010BE3.belarusian: Гэта безумоўна добрае месца для схаванкі. Мазавісты ўмеюць залягаць на дно.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010C0C.english: Is it feasible to hit a target in the Whirling-in-Rags from this window? (Conclude.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010C0C.polish: Czy dałoby się trafić z tego okna cel w Whirling-in-Rags? (Zakończ).
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010C0C.belarusian: Ці рэальна з гэтага акна пацэліць у мішэнь у Whirling-in-Rags? (Скончыць.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010C13.english: "Kim, I can't see the Whirling-in-Rags... The shot didn't come from here." (Conclude.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010C13.polish: „Kim, nie widzę Whirling-in-Rags... Strzał nie mógł paść stąd”. (Zakończ).
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010C13.belarusian: "Кім, я не бачу Whirling-in-Rags... Стрэл быў не адсюль". (Скончыць.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010C1D.english: "Indeed. No one could get a clear view. Well, at least we've been thorough. I like thorough."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010C1D.polish: „Rzeczywiście. Nikt nie mógłby oddać stąd tego strzału. Przynajmniej byliśmy skrupulatni. Lubię skrupulatność”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010C1D.belarusian: "Сапраўды. Агляду адсюль аніякага. Што ж, прынамсі мы падышлі да справы грунтоўна. Люблю грунтоўнасць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010C25.english: The lieutenant's voice betrays a slight disappointment, which he glosses over by reasserting control.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010C25.polish: W głosie porucznika słychać lekkie rozczarowanie, które natychmiast tłamsi poczuciem kontroli nad sytuacją.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010C25.belarusian: У голасе лейтэнанта чуваць лёгкае расчараванне, якое ён згладжвае, вяртаючы сабе кантроль.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015003.english: "In fact -- I think we're done with this bunker." He looks to the exit. "After you, officer."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015003.polish: „Moim zdaniem niczego więcej już tu nie znajdziemy” – spogląda na wyjście. „Prowadź, oficerze”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015003.belarusian: "Насамрэч — думаю, з гэтым бункерам мы скончылі, — ён глядзіць на выхад. — Пасля вас, афіцэру".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00002602.english: This hat is so soft, so warm. It wraps around your head... and your mind tingles with all manner of socio-economic theory.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00002602.polish: Ta czapka jest taka miękka i ciepła. Otula twoją głowę... i umieszcza w niej rozmaite rozmyślania o teorii socjoekonomicznej.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00002602.belarusian: Гэтая шапка такая мяккая, такая цёплая. Яна ахінае тваю галаву... і ў тваім розуме паколвае ад рознага кшталту сацыяльна-эканамічных тэорый.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00002608.english: Kras Mazov would have worn this ushanka. Mazov knew where to cook those thoughts, that's why it bears a Mazovian logo.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00002608.polish: Taką uszankę chętnie nosiłby Kras Mazow. Wiedział on, czym rozgrzewać myśli. Dlatego też widnieje na niej mazowskie logo.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00002608.belarusian: Крас Мазаў насіў бы такую вушанку. Мазаў ведаў, дзе варыць гэтыя думкі, таму на ёй і красуецца мазавісцкі лагатып.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000260D.english: Glory to the Revolution, comrade! Whether you like it or not, wearing this hat has made you more communist.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000260D.polish: Chwała rewolucji, towarzyszu! Czy ci się to podoba, czy nie, noszenie tej czapki uczyniło cię bardziej komunistą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000260D.belarusian: Слава Рэвалюцыі, камрад! Падабаецца табе гэта ці не, але гэтая шапка зрабіла цябе больш камуністам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009B3F.english: This is an *ushanka*, right? (Pat the hat.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009B45.english: Oops, it's a fashion faux pas! [Discard the thought -- and the hat.]
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009B45.polish: Ojej, to modowe faux pas! [Odrzuć myśl. Czapkę też].
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009B45.belarusian: Ой, гэта моднае faux pas! [Адкінуць думку — і шапку.]

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009F1.english: Let's hope no one saw you wearing that outrageously communist hat.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009F1.polish: Miejmy nadzieję, że nikt nie widział, jak nosisz tę skandalicznie komunistyczną czapkę.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009F1.belarusian: Будзем спадзявацца, што ніхто не бачыў цябе ў гэтай абуральна камуністычнай шапцы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001528A.english: This isn't just glass -- these are old computation components.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001528A.polish: To nie jest zwykłe szkło – to stare komponenty komputerowe.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001528A.belarusian: Гэта не проста шкло — гэта старыя камп'ютарныя кампаненты.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000152A0.english: Yes. Filament memories. From the time when wires were cast in glass; slides with an inlaid nervous system.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000152A0.polish: Tak. Pamięci włosowate. Z czasów, kiedy topiono je jeszcze w szkle. Slajdy z umieszczonym w środku układem nerwowym.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000152A0.belarusian: Так. Валаконныя кубы памяці. З часоў, калі драты яшчэ адлівалі са шкла. Слайды з размешчанай унутры нервовай сістэмай.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000152B4.english: How'd they do that? And why?
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000152B4.polish: Jak oni to robili? I po co?
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000152B4.belarusian: Як яны гэта рабілі? І навошта?

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000152BC.english: The 'how' was a closely guarded secret. Something that was locked in safes and human heads across the river where they were manufactured. As to why? Your fingers don't know.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000152BC.polish: „Jak” stanowiło pilnie strzeżony sekret. Coś, co trzymano zamknięte w sejfach i ludzkich głowach po drugiej stronie rzeki, gdzie produkowano te elementy. A po co? Twoje palce nie wiedzą.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000152BC.belarusian: 'Як' — гэта была таямніца, якая старанна ахоўвалася. Якая была зачынена ў сейфах і чалавечых галовах на іншым баку ракі, дзе вырабляліся гэтыя элементы. А навошта? Твае пальцы не ведаюць.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000152CB.english: The lieutenant tilts his head, watching the light glimmer on the glass. "So it is. I think these used to form a single system, slotted in the wall."
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000152CB.polish: Porucznik przechyla głowę i przygląda się połyskiwaniu światła w szkle. „Rzeczywiście. Zdaje się, że te elementy umieszczone w ścianie tworzyły pojedynczy system”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000152CB.belarusian: Лейтэнант нахіляе галаву і прыглядаецца да водбліскаў святла на шкле: "Сапраўды. Здаецца, што гэтыя элементы, размешчаныя ў сцяне, утваралі адзіную сістэму".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F17.english: "So this is all that remains of Feld R&D?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F17.polish: „I tylko tyle zostało z działu badań i rozwoju Felda?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F17.belarusian: "І гэта ўсё, што засталося ад цэнтра даследаванняў і распрацовак Feld?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F1E.english: "Could this be part of the Feld Playback Experiment?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F1E.polish: „Czy to mógł być element eksperymentu odtwarzania Felda?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F1E.belarusian: "Ці магла гэта быць частка Эксперыментальнага Прайгравальніка Feld?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F26.english: He nods. "The rest of the building seems to have been picked clean."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F26.polish: Kiwa głową. „Pozostałe pomieszczenia zostały wyprzątnięte do czysta”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F26.belarusian: Ён ківае: "Здаецца, астатнія пакоі былі вычышчаны да бляску".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F2E.english: "These? No. These are old filament memories. I hope you're not expecting to find that device here -- you will be disappointed."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F2E.polish: „To? Nie. To stare pamięci włosowate. Lepiej nie licz na to, że znajdziesz tu to urządzenie, bo tylko się rozczarujesz”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F2E.belarusian: "Гэта? Не. Гэта стары валаконны куб памяці. Лепш не разлічвайце на тое, што знойдзеце тут гэтую прыладу, бо толькі расчаруецеся".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F35.english: All you will find here is pain.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F35.polish: Jedyne, co tutaj znajdziesz, to ból.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600014F35.belarusian: Адзінае, што ты тут знойдзеш, гэта боль.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E694.english: The 'why' is easy -- because they hadn't come up with modern silicon-based systems yet. For vitreous-cast filament memories, though, these seem incredibly advanced.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E694.polish: Po co? To łatwe. Bo nie wymyślili jeszcze współczesnych elementów krzemowych. Te konkretne wyglądają na niesamowicie zaawansowane jak na szklane pamięci włosowate.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E694.belarusian: Навошта? Гэта лёгка. Бо яшчэ не прыдумалі сучасныя элементы з крэмню. Гэтыя канкрэтныя выглядаюць надзвычай прагрэсіўна для шкляных валаконных кубоў памяці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E76.english: Go away necktie. You're just a figment of my imagination.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E76.polish: Cicho, krawacie. Jesteś wytworem mojej wyobraźni.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E76.belarusian: "Адчапіся, гальштук. Ты проста плод майго ўяўлення".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E7D.english: *Bratan*, don't push me away. I want to be there for you. Also -- how can you be sure *you* are not just a figment of *my* imagination?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E7D.polish: *Bratan*, nie odrzucaj mnie. Chcę być tu z tobą. Poza tym skąd możesz być pewien, że to nie *ty* jesteś wytworem *mojej* wyobraźni?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E7D.belarusian: "*Братан*, не адштурхоўвай мяне. Я хачу быць побач з табой. Да таго ж — адкуль ты ведаеш, што *ты* не проста плод *майго* ўяўлення?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E84.english: Oh... you will see. (It feels like the tie is rubbing itself against your chest like a cat in heat.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E84.polish: Och... sam zobaczysz. (Masz uczucie, jakby krawat ocierał się o twoją klatkę piersiową niczym marcujący kot).
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E84.belarusian: "Ох... сам пабачыш". (Здаецца, нібы гальштук трэцца аб твае грудзі, як котка падчас цечкі.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E8C.english: Okay, then tell me -- it is time for what?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E8C.polish: Dobrze, w takim razie powiedz – na co nadszedł czas?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E8C.belarusian: "Добра, тады скажы мне — час для чаго?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E92.english: Get lost, necktie! I don't want to be your friend.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E92.polish: Spadaj, krawacie! Nie chcę się z tobą przyjaźnić.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E92.belarusian: "Адчапіся, гальштук! Я не хачу з табой сябраваць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E9B.english: But, *bratan*... I... I understand. (The tie loosens around your neck.) I just wanted you to have fun. I... I never meant to be a burden.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E9B.polish: Ale *bratan*, ja... Rozumiem. (Krawat rozluźnia ci się wokół szyi). Chciałem tylko, żebyś się dobrze bawił. Ja... nie chciałem być dla ciebie ciężarem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017E9B.belarusian: "Але, *братан*... Я... я разумею". (Гальштук слабне на тваёй шыі.) "Я проста хацеў, каб ты павесяліўся. Я... я ніколі не хацеў быць цяжарам".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EA7.english: Necktie, you and I are done. Both professionally -- and as friends. Begone! (End the tie.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EA7.polish: Krawacie, między nami skończone. Zarówno na gruncie zawodowym, jak i towarzyskim. Precz! (Zakończ historię krawata).
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EA7.belarusian: "Гальштук, паміж намі ўсё скончана. І ў прафесійным плане — і як сябры. Згінь!" (Пакласці канец гальштуку.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EAD.english: Necktie... I'm sorry. I didn't mean it like that.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EAD.polish: Krawacie... Przepraszam. Nie to do końca miałem na myśli.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EAD.belarusian: "Гальштук... прабач. Я не тое меў на ўвазе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EB5.english: The lifeless necktie looks like a colourful intestine of some dead animal: oily, alien and otherwise disgusting. What could have driven a man to wear something so repulsive around his neck?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EB5.polish: Zwisający bezwładnie krawat wygląda jak kolorowe jelito jakiegoś martwego zwierzęcia. Tłuste, obce i w ogóle odrażające. Co mogło popchnąć kogokolwiek do założenia na szyję czegoś tak odrażającego?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EB5.belarusian: Бязжыўны гальштук выглядае як каляровая кішка нейкай мёртвай жывёлы: тлусты, чужы і агулам агідны. Што магло прымусіць чалавека насіць такую агіднасць на шыі?

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EBC.english: Seems you'll never learn the answer to that question.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EBC.polish: Chyba nigdy nie poznasz odpowiedzi na to pytanie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EBC.belarusian: Здаецца, ты ніколі не даведаешся адказу на гэтае пытанне.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EC4.english: No, *bratan*, no need for that. You and I are *bratannoi* -- brothers. Brothers fight. But when they're done fighting, you know what they do? They party. They fucking party!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EC4.polish: Nie, *bratan*, nie musisz. W końcu jesteśmy *bratannoi* – braćmi. Bracia się kłócą. Ale jak już skończą, to wiesz, co robią? Imprezują! Imprezują, kurwa!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EC4.belarusian: "Не, *братан*, не трэба выбачацца. Мы з табой *братаны* — браты. Браты б'юцца. Але калі бойка сканчаецца, ведаеш, што яны робяць? Яны адрываюцца. Яны, бляха, адрываюцца!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017ECB.english: First, the spirits -- the blue medicinal spirits. Grab the bottle and uncork it! It is time to unleash the Other-World.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017ECB.polish: Najpierw alkohol. Niebieski spirytus medyczny. Bierz butelkę i ją otwórz! Czas przenieść się do innego świata!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017ECB.belarusian: "Спачатку спірт — сіні медычны спірт. Бяры бутэльку і адкаркоўвай! Час выпусціць на волю Іншасвет".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017ED3.english: Wait, right now? A woman just died and you think now is a good time to party?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017ED3.polish: Chwila. Teraz? Właśnie zginęła kobieta, a ty uważasz, że to dobry moment na imprezę?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017ED3.belarusian: "Пачакай, зараз? Толькі што загінула жанчына, і ты лічыш, што зараз самы час тусавацца?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EDA.english: Wait, right now? Ruby's gone. I don't really think there's anything to celebrate here.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EDA.polish: Chwila. Teraz? Ruby nie żyje. Nie wydaje mi się, żeby było co tu świętować.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EDA.belarusian: "Пачакай, зараз? Рубі больш няма. Не думаю, што тут ёсць што святкаваць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EF2.english: Slowly uncork the blue medicinal spirit.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EF9.english: Hush-hush, *bratan*, now is not the time to celebrate, now is the time to get *ready*. Trust me on this. This is what it's all been building towards. It's gonna be off the hook. Off *all* hooks.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EF9.polish: Ćśś, *bratan*, to nie czas na świętowanie, tylko na *przygotowanie się*. Zaufaj mi. To jest moment, do którego od początku dążyłem. Bez zaciągniętego hamulca. *Jakiegokolwiek*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017EF9.belarusian: "Ціш-ціш, *братан*, зараз не час святкаваць, зараз час *рыхтавацца*. Даверся мне. Мы да гэтага ішлі ўвесь гэты час. Гэта будзе поўны адрыў. Сарве *ўсе* тармазы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F0C.english: You know what, I'm done with this crazy talking necktie bullshit!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F0C.polish: Wiesz co? Mam dość tego debilizmu z szurniętym gadającym krawatem!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F0C.belarusian: "Ведаеш што, з мяне хопіць гэтай лухты з вар'яцкім гаворачым гальштукам!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F13.english: But, *bratan*... no. Please uncork it. I can make it good again.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F13.polish: Ale *bratan*... nie. Proszę, otwórz butelkę. Mogę to naprawić.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F13.belarusian: "Але, *братан*... не. Калі ласка, адкаркуй яе. Я зноў магу зрабіць усё як трэба."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F1F.english: *Bratan*, life and death are inseparable. There's a party when you're born, a party every year to celebrate that birth, and a party when you're put in the ground.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F1F.polish: *Bratan*, życie i śmierć są nierozłączne. Kiedy się rodzisz, jest impreza. Potem to samo co roku, żeby uczcić te narodziny. A gdy trafisz do piachu, też imprezują.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F1F.belarusian: "*Братан*, жыццё і смерць непадзельныя. Вечарынка, калі ты нараджаешся, вечарынка кожны год, каб адзначыць гэтае нараджэнне, і вечарынка, калі цябе кладуць у зямлю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F26.english: Why shouldn't there be a party when you die? And, beside, this isn't even about that! You have no idea what this is about... this is gonna be so off the hook. It's gonna be off *all* hooks.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F26.polish: Czemu by nie imprezować z okazji śmierci? Poza tym nie o to w ogóle chodzi! Nie masz pojęcia, o co... Nie będzie zaciągniętego hamulca. *Jakiegokolwiek*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F26.belarusian: "Чаму б не патусавацца, калі хтосьці памірае? Дый наогул, справа нават не ў гэтым! Ты паняцця не маеш, у чым тут справа... Гэта будзе поўны адрыў. Сарве *ўсе* тармазы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F2F.english: The bottle opens with a silent, mysterious hiss. The fumes rising from its mouth are as crisp as the northern winds.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F2F.polish: Butelka otwiera się z cichym, tajemniczym sykiem. Opary unoszące się z jej szyjki uderzają cię niczym północny wicher.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F2F.belarusian: Бутэлька адкрываецца з ціхім, таямнічым шыпеннем. Выпары, што ўздымаюцца з рыльца, свежыя, як паўночны вецер.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F36.english: Howling somewhere, lashing the boardwalk with brine and rain -- an ancient warmth crawls under your skin.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F36.polish: Skowyczy gdzieś, tłucze w promenadę solą i deszczem. Pod skórą czujesz starożytne nieomal ciepło.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F36.belarusian: Вые недзе там, сцябае праменад салёнай вадой і дажджом — старажытнае цяпло запаўзае пад скуру.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F44.english: What? I didn't know I could do that...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F44.polish: Co? Nie wiedziałem, że mogę to zrobić...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F44.belarusian: "Што? Я не ведаў, што магу гэта зрабіць..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F5D.english: *Bratan*, have I ever lied to you? Just take me off. (The necktie tugs encouragingly at your neck.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F5D.polish: *Bratan*, czy ja cię kiedyś okłamałem? No, zdejmuj mnie. (Krawat szarpie cię zachęcająco za szyję).
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F5D.belarusian: "*Братан*, хіба я табе калі-небудзь хлусіў? Проста здымі мяне". (Гальштук падбадзёрліва торгае цябе за шыю.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F66.english: Your fingers manage to undo the oily knot and the necktie slides off. It looks so frail sitting there in your hand, weighing almost nothing.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F66.polish: Twoje palce rozplątują tłusty węzeł i krawat zsuwa ci się z szyi. Wygląda tak delikatnie, kiedy trzymasz go w ręce. Prawie nic nie waży.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F66.belarusian: Твае пальцы распускаюць тлусты вузел, і гальштук спаўзае. Ён выглядае такім кволым у тваёй руцэ, амаль бязважкім.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F74.english: Now put me in the bottle.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F74.polish: Teraz wsadź mnie do tej butelki.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F82.english: Put the necktie tie in the bottle.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F8B.english: Begone, foul necktie! Finally I rid myself of you! (End it. Throw the necktie as far as you can.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F8B.polish: Precz, parszywy krawacie! W końcu się ciebie pozbyłem! (Skończ z tym. Odrzuć krawat tak daleko, jak to możliwe).
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F8B.belarusian: "Згінь, брыдкі гальштук! Нарэшце я пазбаўлюся ад цябе!" (Скончыць з гэтым. Выкінуць гальштук як мага далей.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F92.english: The oily rag flaps miserably in the air and lands close by in the dirt. It looks like an inanimate object, completely devoid of life.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F92.polish: Tłusta szmata łopocze bezradnie na wietrze i upada nieopodal w błoto. Wygląda jak nieożywiony, kompletnie pozbawiony duszy przedmiot.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F92.belarusian: Тлустая ануча бездапаможна ляціць у паветры і падае побач у бруд. Яна выглядае як неадушаўлёны прадмет, цалкам пазбаўлены жыцця.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017F99.english: It was just trying to help....

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FA0.english: Trust me -- just trust me. You and I are going to have so much fun it should be illegal!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FA0.polish: Zaufaj mi. Po prostu. Będziemy mieć tyle zabawy, że to powinno być wręcz nielegalne!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FA0.belarusian: "Даверся мне — проста даверся. Мы з табой павесялімся так, што гэта павінна быць па-за законам!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FA7.english: I suspect that it might be.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FA7.polish: Zdaje się, że może nawet jest.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FB5.english: Just put me in the bottle, *bratan*. I'm not gonna let you down. You and I are, like, the same person.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FB5.polish: Wsadź mnie do tej butelki, *bratan*. Nie zawiodę cię. Jesteśmy przecież jak jedna i ta sama osoba.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FB5.belarusian: "Проста засунь мяне ў бутэльку, *братан*. Я цябе не падвяду. Мы ж з табой лічы што адзін чалавек".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FC0.english: As the necktie slides into the purifying liquid, large stains of grease rise off from it and float to the surface. There they quickly dissolve and disappear completely.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FC0.polish: Kiedy krawat wślizguje się w dezynfekujący płyn, odklejają się od niego duże tłuste plamy. Wypływają na powierzchnię, gdzie szybko się rozpuszczają i znikają na zawsze.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FC0.belarusian: Калі гальштук апускаецца ў ачышчальную вадкасць, ад яго аддзяляюцца вялікія плямы тлушчу і ўсплываюць на паверхню. Там яны хутка раствараюцца і знікаюць бясследна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FC7.english: Cleansed by the blue spirit-fire of 98.7% pure alcohol, the fabric looks almost new again. No longer like a disgusting worm of the lower intestine, but like a colourful and deadly poisonous reef-snake of the Insulindian ocean.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FC7.polish: Oczyszczony przez niebieski spirytus o zawartości alkoholu 98,7% materiał wygląda znów niemal jak nowy. Nie jak ohydny pasożyt jelita grubego, lecz barwny i śmiertelnie niebezpieczny wąż z raf Oceanu Insulindiańskiego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FC7.belarusian: Ачышчаная сінім спіртавым агнём 98,7%-га чыстага алкаголю, тканіна зноў выглядае амаль як новая. Больш не як агідны чарвяк з тоўстай кішкі, а як стракатая і смяротна атрутная рыфавая змяя з Інсуліндыйскага акіяна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FDC.english: The necktie floats in the blueish liquid with almost unearthly grace.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FDC.polish: Krawat pływa w niebieskawym płynie z nieomal nieziemską gracją.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FDC.belarusian: Гальштук плавае ў блакітнаватай вадкасці з амаль незямной грацыяй.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FE4.english: It's like an organic sample brought back from a distant star system inhabited by sentient neckwear.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FE4.polish: Jest jak próbka materiału biologicznego przywiezionego z odległego układu planetarnego zamieszkałego przez inteligentne krawaty.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FE4.belarusian: Нібыта арганічны ўзор, прывезены з далёкай зорнай сістэмы, населенай разумнымі гальштукамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00017FF2.english: Cork the bottle and put it away.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018009.english: The lieutenant has been observing you quietly all this time.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018009.polish: Porucznik obserwował cię w ciszy przez cały ten czas.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018009.belarusian: Увесь гэты час лейтэнант моўчкі назіраў за табой.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018010.english: He's struggling to keep silent, but finally seems to give up.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018010.polish: Stara się zachować milczenie, ale w końcu się poddaje.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018010.belarusian: Ён з усіх сіл спрабуе маўчаць, але ўрэшце, здаецца, здаецца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018017.english: "I've got to ask..." he says, a peculiar look in his eyes. "What are you doing?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018017.polish: „Muszę zapytać” – stwierdza z osobliwym spojrzeniem. „Co ty robisz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018017.belarusian: "Я мушу запытацца... - кажа ён з дзіўным позіркам у вачах. - Што вы робіце?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018025.english: "I don't really know, but I'm eager to find out."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018025.polish: „Naprawdę nie wiem, ale bardzo chciałbym się dowiedzieć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018025.belarusian: "Я і сам не ведаю, але мне карціць даведацца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0001803A.english: "Alright." The lieutenant's face stiffens as he turns to look at the road ahead. "I won't ask again."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0001803A.polish: „W porządku” – twarz porucznika sztywnieje, po czym mężczyzna odwraca się i spogląda na drogę przed sobą. „Nie będę o to więcej pytał”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0001803A.belarusian: "Добра". Твар лейтэнанта камянее, ён адварочваецца і глядзіць на дарогу наперадзе. "Больш пытацца не буду".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018056.english: "That makes two of us." He shakes his head slowly. "Let's not waste any more time under this boardwalk. We need to clear this all up... somehow."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018056.polish: „To jest nas dwóch” – stwierdza, kręcąc powoli głową. „Nie traćmy więcej czasu pod tą promenadą. Musimy to wszystko wyjaśnić... jakoś”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018056.belarusian: "Значыць, нас ужо двое, - ён павольна хітае галавой. - Не будзем марнаваць больш часу пад гэтым праменадам. Нам трэба ва ўсім гэтым разабрацца... хоць неяк".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018067.english: "In my family, you put a piece of clothing in some hard liquor and drink it for good luck. It's silly, but no harm done, right?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018067.polish: „W mojej rodzinie wkłada się kawałek ubrania do mocnego alkoholu i wypija się to na szczęście. To głupie, ale przecież nikomu nie zaszkodzi, tak?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018067.belarusian: "У маёй сям'і кладуць кавалак адзення ў моцны алкаголь і п'юць на шчасце. Гэта глупства, але ж нікому не шкодзіць, так?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0001807D.english: "No harm? In drinking 98.7% alcohol with a god-knows-how-old tie in it? I wouldn't be so sure." The lieutenant tilts his head slightly. "However, I'm not here to judge. Let's go."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0001807D.polish: „Nie zaszkodzi? Picie 98,7-procentowego alkoholu z umieszczonym w nim bóg jeden wie jak starym krawatem? Nie byłbym tego taki pewny” – porucznik przekrzywia głowę. „Ale nie zamierzam cię osądzać. Ruszajmy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0001807D.belarusian: "Не шкодзіць? Піць 98,7%-вы спірт з гальштукам, якому бог ведае колькі гадоў? Я б не быў такім упэўненым, - лейтэнант ледзь схіляе галаву. - Зрэшты, я тут не для таго, каб судзіць. Хадземце".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018084.english: "Okay, Kim... I didn't want to tell anyone, but my necktie has been talking to me lately."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018084.polish: „No dobra, Kim. Nie chciałem nikomu mówić, ale ostatnio gada do mnie mój krawat”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00018084.belarusian: "Добра, Кім... Я не хацеў нікому казаць, але апошнім часам са мной размаўляе мой гальштук".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180A3.english: "Of course it has." He doesn't even look too surprised.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180A3.polish: „Oczywiście” – nie wygląda nawet na zbytnio zaskoczonego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180A3.belarusian: "Ну вядома". Ён нават не выглядае асабліва здзіўленым.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180AA.english: "Forget it, you're not *open-minded* enough to understand anyway."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180AA.polish: „Nieważne. I tak nie masz wystarczająco *otwartego umysłu*, żeby zrozumieć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180AA.belarusian: "Забудзься, у цябе ўсё адно не настолькі *шырокія погляды*, каб зразумець".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180B1.english: "It started when I woke up in the Whirling-in-Rags. It's been talking to me ever since."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180B1.polish: „To się zaczęło, jak się obudziłem w Whirling-in-Rags. Od tego czasu ciągle do mnie mówi”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180B1.belarusian: "Гэта пачалося, калі я прачнуўся ў Whirling-in-Rags. З таго часу ён увесь час са мной размаўляе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180BE.english: "A relationship between a man and a talking necktie? No, apparently I am not." His voice rings of insincere sadness as he turns to leave.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180BE.polish: „Relacji między mężczyzną i jego gadającym krawatem? Nie, najwyraźniej nie” – w jego głosie pobrzmiewa nieszczery smutek. Odwraca się, aby odejść.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180BE.belarusian: "Адносіны паміж мужчынам і гаворачым гальштукам? Не, відавочна, што не". У ягоным голасе гучыць няшчыры смутак, калі ён адварочваецца, каб пайсці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180C6.english: "And what has the necktie been telling you, if I may ask?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180C6.polish: „I co ten krawat ci mówił, jeśli można wiedzieć?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180C6.belarusian: "І што ж вам казаў гальштук, калі дазволіце спытаць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180CD.english: "It mostly urges me to party harder."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180CD.belarusian: "У асноўным ён падбухторвае мяне адрывацца напоўніцу".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180D4.english: "It teaches me about life, Kim. Sort of a father figure."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180D4.polish: „Uczy mnie wiele o życiu, Kim. Jest trochę jak rodzic”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180D4.belarusian: "Ён вучыць мяне жыццю, Кім. Нешта накшталт бацькоўскай фігуры".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180F0.english: He doesn't actually believe it's wonderful.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180F0.polish: Tak naprawdę nie uważa tego za cudowne.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180F0.belarusian: Насамрэч ён не лічыць, што гэта цудоўна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180F7.english: "Okay. So why did you put it in the bottle?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180F7.polish: „W porządku. Więc dlaczego wsadziłeś go do butelki?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000180F7.belarusian: "Добра. Дык навошта вы засунулі яго ў бутэльку?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0001811B.english: "Right. Okay. Anyway, I'm glad you told me your necktie has been speaking to you. That must not have been easy." For a second it looks like he's about to add something...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0001811B.polish: „Racja. W porządku. W każdym razie cieszę się, że powiedziałeś mi o swoim gadającym krawacie. Nie przyszło ci to pewnie łatwo” – przez chwilę wygląda, jakby chciał coś jeszcze dodać...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0001811B.belarusian: "Ясна. Добра. Ва ўсякім разе, я рады, што вы расказалі мне пра гальштук, які з вамі размаўляе. Гэта, напэўна, было няпроста". На імгненне здаецца, што ён хоча дадаць нешта яшчэ...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013318.english: "Let us not linger. We have a great big mess to figure out." He turns to face the road ahead.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013318.polish: „Nie marnujmy tu więcej czasu. Mamy wielki bałagan do wyjaśnienie”. Odwraca się gotowy, by odejść.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013318.belarusian: "Не будзем затрымлівацца. Нам трэба разабрацца з вялікім бардаком". Ён паварочваецца тварам да дарогі наперадзе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000780001331E.english: "That makes absolutely no sense." He thinks for a moment. "But I guess every family has its own traditions."
Dialogue Text/0x010000780001331E.polish: „To nie ma absolutnie żadnego sensu” – stwierdza, po czym zamyśla się. „Ale każda rodzina ma chyba jakieś swoje tradycje”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000780001331E.belarusian: "У гэтым няма абсалютна ніякага сэнсу, - ён задумваецца на хвіліну. - Але, мабыць, у кожнай сям'і свае традыцыі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000780001332A.english: "In my family when someone dies you put a piece of clothing in a bottle as a sign of eternal respect."
Dialogue Text/0x010000780001332A.polish: „W mojej rodzinie panuje zwyczaj, żeby po czyjejś śmierci wsadzić do butelki element ubrania na znak wiecznego szacunku”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000780001332A.belarusian: "У маёй сям'і, калі нехта памірае, кладуць кавалак адзення ў бутэльку ў знак вечнай павагі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013339.english: "Signs of some really hard core mental illness, Kim." (Point to your head.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013339.polish: „To oznaka naprawdę poważnej choroby psychicznej, Kim”. (Wskaż swoją głowę).
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013339.belarusian: "Прыкметы вельмі хардкорнага псіхічнага разладу, Кім". (Паказаць на галаву.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013340.english: "I would assume, yes. Why did you put it in the bottle?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013340.polish: „Też tak mi się wydaje. Dlaczego wsadziłeś go do butelki?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013340.belarusian: "Мяркую, што так. Чаму вы засунулі яго ў бутэльку?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000780001334C.english: We're all under stress. This is turning into a great big mess. I'm not judging. Just keep it together.
Dialogue Text/0x010000780001334C.polish: Wszyscy jesteśmy zestresowani. Robi się z tego straszny bałagan. Nie oceniam. Ale trzymajmy się w garści.
Dialogue Text/0x010000780001334C.belarusian: Мы ўсе ў стрэсе. Гэта ператвараецца ў вялікі бардак. Я не суджу. Проста трымайцеся ў руках.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013352.english: ...but then he turns away -- his gaze fixed on the road ahead. "Let's go," he concludes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013352.polish: ...ale odwraca się – wbija wzrok w drogę przed sobą. „Ruszajmy” – oznajmia i kończy rozmowę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013352.belarusian: ...але потым ён адварочваецца — ягоны позірк скіраваны на дарогу наперадзе. "Хадземце", - падсумоўвае ён.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013885.english: Oh... you will see. (It feels like the tie is rubbing itself against your chest like a cat in heat.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013885.polish: Och... sam zobaczysz. (Masz uczucie, jakby krawat ocierał się o twoją klatkę piersiową niczym marcujący kot).
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013885.belarusian: Ох... сам пабачыш. (Адчуванне такое, быццам гальштук трэцца аб твае грудзі, як котка падчас цечкі.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013893.english: "I've got to ask..." he says, a peculiar look in his eyes. "What are you doing?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013893.polish: „Muszę zapytać” – stwierdza z osobliwym spojrzeniem. „Co ty robisz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013893.belarusian: "Я мушу запытацца... - кажа ён з дзіўным позіркам у вачах. - Што вы робіце?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013899.english: ...but then he turns away -- his gaze fixed on the road ahead. "Let's go," he concludes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013899.polish: ...ale odwraca się – wbija wzrok w drogę przed sobą. „Ruszajmy” – oznajmia i kończy rozmowę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013899.belarusian: ...але потым адварочваецца — яго позірк скіраваны на дарогу наперадзе. "Хадземце", - падсумоўвае ён.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001389F.english: Okay, then tell me -- it is time for what?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001389F.polish: Dobrze, w takim razie powiedz – na co nadszedł czas?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001389F.belarusian: Добра, тады скажы мне — час на што?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138A5.english: "It mostly urges me to party harder."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138AB.english: "In my family when someone dies you put a piece of clothing in a bottle as a sign of eternal respect."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138AB.polish: „W mojej rodzinie panuje zwyczaj, żeby po czyjejś śmierci wsadzić do butelki element ubrania na znak wiecznego szacunku”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138AB.belarusian: "У маёй сям'і, калі нехта памірае, кладуць кавалак адзення ў бутэльку на знак вечнай павагі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138B1.english: Necktie... I'm sorry. I didn't mean it like that.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138B1.polish: Krawacie... Przepraszam. Nie to do końca miałem na myśli.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138B1.belarusian: Гальштук... прабач. Я не тое меў на ўвазе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138B7.english: No, *bratan*, no need for that. You and I are *bratannoi* -- brothers. Brothers fight. But when they're done fighting, you know what they do? They party. They fucking party!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138B7.polish: Nie, *bratan*, nie musisz. W końcu jesteśmy *bratannoi* – braćmi. Bracia się kłócą. Ale jak już skończą, to wiesz, co robią? Imprezują! Imprezują, kurwa!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138B7.belarusian: Не, *братан*, не трэба выбачацца. Мы ж з табой *братанной* — браты. Браты чубяцца. Але калі яны сканчаюць чубіцца, ведаеш, што яны робяць? Яны тусуюцца. Яны, бляха, тусуюцца!

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138C3.english: We're all under stress. This is turning into a great big mess. I'm not judging. Just keep it together.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138C3.polish: Wszyscy jesteśmy zestresowani. Robi się z tego straszny bałagan. Nie oceniam. Ale trzymajmy się w garści.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138C3.belarusian: Мы ўсе ў стрэсе. Гэта ператвараецца ў вялізны беспарадак. Я не асуджаю. Проста трымайся.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138C9.english: Go away necktie. You're just a figment of my imagination.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138C9.polish: Cicho, krawacie. Jesteś wytworem mojej wyobraźni.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138C9.belarusian: Адчапіся, гальштук. Ты проста плод майго ўяўлення.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138CF.english: *Bratan*, don't push me away. I want to be there for you. Also -- how can you be sure *you* are not just a figment of *my* imagination?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138CF.polish: *Bratan*, nie odrzucaj mnie. Chcę być tu z tobą. Poza tym skąd możesz być pewien, że to nie *ty* jesteś wytworem *mojej* wyobraźni?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138CF.belarusian: *Братан*, не адштурхоўвай мяне. Я хачу быць побач з табой. Да таго ж — адкуль табе ведаць, што гэта не *ты* проста плод *майго* ўяўлення?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138D5.english: First, the spirits -- the blue medicinal spirits. Grab the bottle and uncork it! It is time to unleash the Other-World.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138D5.polish: Najpierw alkohol. Niebieski spirytus medyczny. Bierz butelkę i ją otwórz! Czas przenieść się do innego świata!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138D5.belarusian: Спачатку спірт — сіні медычны спірт. Хапай бутэльку і адкаркоўвай! Час выпусціць Іншасвет.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138DB.english: "I don't really know, but I'm eager to find out."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138DB.polish: „Naprawdę nie wiem, ale bardzo chciałbym się dowiedzieć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138DB.belarusian: "Я і сам не ведаю, але карціць даведацца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138E7.english: "Let us not linger. We have a great big mess to figure out." He turns to face the road ahead.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138E7.polish: „Nie marnujmy tu więcej czasu. Mamy wielki bałagan do wyjaśnienia” – odwraca się gotowy, by odejść.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138E7.belarusian: "Не будзем затрымлівацца. Нам яшчэ разграбаць вялізны беспарадак". Ён паварочваецца тварам да дарогі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138ED.english: Get lost, necktie! I don't want to be your friend.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138ED.polish: Spadaj, krawacie! Nie chcę się z tobą przyjaźnić.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138ED.belarusian: Адчапіся, гальштук! Не хачу быць тваім сябрам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138F3.english: He doesn't actually believe it's wonderful.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138F3.polish: Tak naprawdę nie uważa tego za cudowne.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138F3.belarusian: Насамрэч ён не лічыць гэта цудоўным.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138F9.english: But, *bratan*... I... I understand. (The tie loosens around your neck.) I just wanted you to have fun. I... I never meant to be a burden.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138F9.polish: Ale *bratan*, ja... Rozumiem. (Krawat rozluźnia ci się wokół szyi). Chciałem tylko, żebyś się dobrze bawił. Ja... nie chciałem być dla ciebie ciężarem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138F9.belarusian: Але, *братан*... я... я разумею. (Гальштук слабне вакол тваёй шыі.) Я проста хацеў, каб ты павесяліўся. Я... я ніколі не хацеў быць цяжарам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138FF.english: "Signs of some really hard core mental illness, Kim." (Point to your head.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138FF.polish: „To oznaka naprawdę poważnej choroby psychicznej, Kim”. (Wskaż swoją głowę).
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000138FF.belarusian: "Прыкметы па-сапраўднаму хардкорнай душэўнай хваробы, Кім". (Паказаць на галаву.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013916.english: Wait, right now? A woman just died and you think now is a good time to party?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013916.polish: Chwila. Teraz? Właśnie zginęła kobieta, a ty uważasz, że to dobry moment na imprezę?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013916.belarusian: Пачакай, проста зараз? Жанчына толькі што памерла, і ты лічыш, што зараз самы час тусавацца?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001391C.english: Slowly uncork the blue medicinal spirit.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013922.english: "Alright." The lieutenant's face stiffens as he turns to look at the road ahead. "I won't ask again."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013922.polish: „W porządku” – twarz porucznika sztywnieje, po czym mężczyzna odwraca się i spogląda na drogę przed sobą. „Nie będę o to więcej pytał”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013922.belarusian: "Добра". Твар лейтэнанта камянее, калі ён паварочваецца паглядзець на дарогу наперадзе: "Больш пытацца не буду".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001392E.english: "I would assume, yes. Why did you put it in the bottle?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001392E.polish: „Też tak mi się wydaje. Dlaczego wsadziłeś go do butelki?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001392E.belarusian: "Мяркую, што так. Чаму вы засунулі яго ў бутэльку?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001393A.english: "That makes absolutely no sense." He thinks for a moment. "But I guess every family has its own traditions."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001393A.polish: „To nie ma absolutnie żadnego sensu” – stwierdza, po czym zamyśla się. „Ale każda rodzina ma chyba jakieś swoje tradycje”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001393A.belarusian: "У гэтым няма ані кроплі сэнсу, - ён на імгненне задумваецца. - Але мяркую, у кожнай сям'і свае традыцыі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013940.english: "No harm? In drinking 98.7% alcohol with a god-knows-how-old tie in it? I wouldn't be so sure." The lieutenant tilts his head slightly. "However, I'm not here to judge. Let's go."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013940.polish: „Nie zaszkodzi? Picie 98,7-procentowego alkoholu z umieszczonym w nim bóg jeden wie jak starym krawatem? Nie byłbym tego taki pewny” – porucznik przekrzywia głowę. „Ale nie zamierzam cię osądzać. Ruszajmy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013940.belarusian: "Не шкодзіць? Выпіць 98,7-адсоткавы алкаголь з бог ведае якой даўнасці гальштукам унутры? Я б не быў такі ўпэўнены, - лейтэнант злёгку хіліць галаву. - Зрэшты, я тут не для таго, каб судзіць. Хадземце".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013946.english: "That makes two of us." He shakes his head slowly. "Let's not waste any more time under this boardwalk. We need to clear this all up... somehow."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013946.polish: „To jest nas dwóch” – stwierdza, kręcąc powoli głową. „Nie traćmy więcej czasu pod tą promenadą. Musimy to wszystko wyjaśnić... jakoś”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013946.belarusian: "Тады нас ужо двое, - ён павольна хітае галавой. - Не будзем больш марнаваць час пад гэтым праменадам. Трэба з гэтым усім разабрацца... хоць неяк".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001394C.english: "Right. Okay. Anyway, I'm glad you told me your necktie has been speaking to you. That must not have been easy." For a second it looks like he's about to add something...
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001394C.polish: „Racja. W porządku. W każdym razie cieszę się, że powiedziałeś mi o swoim gadającym krawacie. Nie przyszło ci to pewnie łatwo” – przez chwilę wygląda, jakby chciał coś jeszcze dodać...
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001394C.belarusian: "Ясна. Добра. Ва ўсякім разе, я рады, што вы расказалі мне пра гальштук, які размаўляе з вамі. Гэта, напэўна, было няпроста". На імгненне здаецца, што ён хоча нешта дадаць...

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013958.english: Wait, right now? Ruby's gone. I don't really think there's anything to celebrate here.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013958.polish: Chwila. Teraz? Ruby nie żyje. Nie wydaje mi się, żeby było co tu świętować.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013958.belarusian: Пачакай, проста зараз? Рубі больш няма. Не думаю, што тут ёсць што святкаваць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013964.english: Your fingers manage to undo the oily knot and the necktie slides off. It looks so frail sitting there in your hand, weighing almost nothing.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013964.polish: Twoje palce rozplątują tłusty węzeł i krawat zsuwa ci się z szyi. Wygląda tak delikatnie, kiedy trzymasz go w ręce. Prawie nic nie waży.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013964.belarusian: Тваім пальцам удаецца развязаць тлусты вузел, і гальштук спаўзае з шыі. Ён выглядае такім кволым у тваёй руцэ, амаль нічога не важыць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001396E.english: Hush-hush, *bratan*, now is not the time to celebrate, now is the time to get *ready*. Trust me on this. This is what it's all been building towards. It's gonna be off the hook. Off *all* hooks.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001396E.polish: Ćśś, *bratan*, to nie czas na świętowanie, tylko na *przygotowanie się*. Zaufaj mi. To jest moment, do którego od początku dążyłem. Bez zaciągniętego hamulca. *Jakiegokolwiek*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001396E.belarusian: Ціш-ціш, *братан*, цяпер не час святкаваць, цяпер час *падрыхтавацца*. Даверся мне. Мы да гэтага ішлі ўвесь гэты час. Гэта сарве ўсе клямкі. *Усе да адзінай* клямкі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013974.english: *Bratan*, life and death are inseparable. There's a party when you're born, a party every year to celebrate that birth, and a party when you're put in the ground.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013974.polish: *Bratan*, życie i śmierć są nierozłączne. Kiedy się rodzisz, jest impreza. Potem to samo co roku, żeby uczcić te narodziny. A gdy trafisz do piachu, też imprezują.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013974.belarusian: *Братан*, жыццё і смерць непадзельныя. Вечарынка, калі ты нараджаешся, вечарынка кожны год у гонар гэтага нараджэння і вечарынка, калі цябе закопваюць у зямлю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001397A.english: The bottle opens with a silent, mysterious hiss. The fumes rising from its mouth are as crisp as the northern winds.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001397A.polish: Butelka otwiera się z cichym, tajemniczym sykiem. Opary unoszące się z jej szyjki uderzają cię niczym północny wicher.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001397A.belarusian: Бутэлька адкрываецца з ціхім, таямнічым шыпеннем. Пары, што падымаюцца з яе рыльца, такія ж свежыя, як паўночны вецер.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013985.belarusian: Ага... і ў чым тут праблема?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001398B.english: Howling somewhere, lashing the boardwalk with brine and rain -- an ancient warmth crawls under your skin.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001398B.polish: Skowyczy gdzieś, tłucze w promenadę solą i deszczem. Pod skórą czujesz starożytne nieomal ciepło.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001398B.belarusian: Вые недзе воддаль, хвашчыць праменад марской соллю і дажджом — старажытнае цяпло распаўзаецца пад скурай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013991.english: Cork the bottle and put it away.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001399D.english: Why shouldn't there be a party when you die? And, beside, this isn't even about that! You have no idea what this is about... this is gonna be so off the hook. It's gonna be off *all* hooks.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001399D.polish: Czemu by nie imprezować z okazji śmierci? Poza tym nie o to w ogóle chodzi! Nie masz pojęcia, o co... Nie będzie zaciągniętego hamulca. *Jakiegokolwiek*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001399D.belarusian: Чаму б не патусіць, калі паміраеш? Ды і да таго ж, тут справа нават не ў гэтым! Ты паняцця не маеш, пра што гэта... Гэта сарве ўсе клямкі. Сарве *ўсе да адзінай* клямкі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139A9.english: "A relationship between a man and a talking necktie? No, apparently I am not." His voice rings of insincere sadness as he turns to leave.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139A9.polish: „Relacji między mężczyzną i jego gadającym krawatem? Nie, najwyraźniej nie” – w jego głosie pobrzmiewa nieszczery smutek. Odwraca się, aby odejść.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139A9.belarusian: "Адносіны паміж мужчынам і гальштукам, які размаўляе? Не, відаць, не". У яго голасе гучыць няшчыры смутак, калі ён паварочваецца, каб сысці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139AF.english: "Okay, Kim... I didn't want to tell anyone, but my necktie has been talking to me lately."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139AF.polish: „No dobra, Kim. Nie chciałem nikomu mówić, ale ostatnio gada do mnie mój krawat”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139AF.belarusian: "Добра, Кім... Я не хацеў нікому казаць, але апошнім часам са мной размаўляе мой гальштук".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139B5.english: What? I didn't know I could do that...
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139B5.polish: Co? Nie wiedziałem, że mogę to zrobić...
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139B5.belarusian: Што? Я і не ведаў, што так можна...

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139BB.english: "Forget it, you're not *open-minded* enough to understand anyway."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139BB.polish: „Nieważne. I tak nie masz wystarczająco *otwartego umysłu*, żeby zrozumieć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139BB.belarusian: "Забудзь, у цябе ўсё адно недастаткова *шырокія погляды*, каб зразумець".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139C7.english: "In my family, you put a piece of clothing in some hard liquor and drink it for good luck. It's silly, but no harm done, right?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139C7.polish: „W mojej rodzinie wkłada się kawałek ubrania do mocnego alkoholu i wypija się to na szczęście. To głupie, ale przecież nikomu nie zaszkodzi, tak?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139C7.belarusian: "У маёй сям'і кладуць кавалак адзення ў моцны алкаголь і выпіваюць на шчасце. Гэта дурасць, але ж нікому не шкодзіць, так?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139CD.english: "Of course it has." He doesn't even look too surprised.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139CD.polish: „Oczywiście” – nie wygląda nawet na zbytnio zaskoczonego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139CD.belarusian: "Вядома ж". Ён нават не выглядае надта здзіўленым.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139DD.english: *Bratan*, have I ever lied to you? Just take me off. (The necktie tugs encouragingly at your neck.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139DD.polish: *Bratan*, czy ja cię kiedyś okłamałem? No, zdejmuj mnie. (Krawat szarpie cię zachęcająco za szyję).
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139DD.belarusian: *Братан*, хіба я калі-небудзь табе хлусіў? Проста здымі мяне. (Гальштук падбадзёрліва тузае цябе за шыю.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139E8.english: The lifeless necktie looks like a colourful intestine of some dead animal: oily, alien and otherwise disgusting. What could have driven a man to wear something so repulsive around his neck?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139E8.polish: Zwisający bezwładnie krawat wygląda jak kolorowe jelito jakiegoś martwego zwierzęcia. Tłuste, obce i w ogóle odrażające. Co mogło popchnąć kogokolwiek do założenia na szyję czegoś tak odrażającego?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139E8.belarusian: Бязжыўны гальштук выглядае як стракаты кішачнік нейкай мёртвай жывёлы: тлусты, чужародны і ва ўсім агідны. Што магло прымусіць чалавека насіць на шыі нешта настолькі агіднае?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139FA.english: Now put me in the bottle.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139FA.polish: Teraz wsadź mnie do tej butelki.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000139FA.belarusian: А цяпер запіхні мяне ў бутэльку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A06.english: The oily rag flaps miserably in the air and lands close by in the dirt. It looks like an inanimate object, completely devoid of life.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A06.polish: Tłusta szmata łopocze bezradnie na wietrze i upada nieopodal w błoto. Wygląda jak nieożywiony, kompletnie pozbawiony duszy przedmiot.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A06.belarusian: Тлустая ануча бездапаможна трапяшча ў паветры і падае побач у бруд. Яна выглядае неадушаўлёным прадметам, цалкам пазбаўленым жыцця.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A0C.english: Put the necktie tie in the bottle.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A12.english: "It started when I woke up in the Whirling-in-Rags. It's been talking to me ever since."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A12.polish: „To się zaczęło, jak się obudziłem w Whirling-in-Rags. Od tego czasu ciągle do mnie mówi”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A12.belarusian: "Гэта пачалося, калі я прачнуўся ў Whirling-in-Rags. З таго часу ён увесь час са мной гаворыць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A18.english: "And what has the necktie been telling you, if I may ask?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A18.polish: „I co ten krawat ci mówił, jeśli można wiedzieć?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A18.belarusian: "І што ж вам гаварыў гэты гальштук, калі дазволіце спытаць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A1E.english: "Okay. So why did you put it in the bottle?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A1E.polish: „W porządku. Więc dlaczego wsadziłeś go do butelki?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A1E.belarusian: "Добра. Дык чаму вы засунулі яго ў бутэльку?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A24.english: But, *bratan*... no. Please uncork it. I can make it good again.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A24.polish: Ale *bratan*... nie. Proszę, otwórz butelkę. Mogę to naprawić.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A24.belarusian: Але, *братан*... не. Калі ласка, адкаркуй яе. Я магу зноў усё выправіць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A2A.english: Trust me -- just trust me. You and I are going to have so much fun it should be illegal!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A2A.polish: Zaufaj mi. Po prostu. Będziemy mieć tyle zabawy, że to powinno być wręcz nielegalne!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A2A.belarusian: Даверся мне — проста даверся. Нам з табой будзе так весела, што гэта павінна быць па-за законам!

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A30.english: You know what, I'm done with this crazy talking necktie bullshit!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A30.polish: Wiesz co? Mam dość tego debilizmu z szurniętym gadającym krawatem!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A30.belarusian: Ведаеш што, надакучыла мне гэтая херня з вар'яцкім размаўлялым гальштукам!

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A36.english: As the necktie slides into the purifying liquid, large stains of grease rise off from it and float to the surface. There they quickly dissolve and disappear completely.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A36.polish: Kiedy krawat wślizguje się w dezynfekujący płyn, odklejają się od niego duże tłuste plamy. Wypływają na powierzchnię, gdzie szybko się rozpuszczają i znikają na zawsze.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A36.belarusian: Калі гальштук слізгае ў ачышчальную вадкасць, буйныя тлустыя плямы аддзяляюцца ад яго і ўсплываюць на паверхню. Там яны хутка раствараюцца і знікаюць назаўжды.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A3C.english: It's like an organic sample brought back from a distant star system inhabited by sentient neckwear.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A3C.polish: Jest jak próbka materiału biologicznego przywiezionego z odległego układu planetarnego zamieszkałego przez inteligentne krawaty.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A3C.belarusian: Гэта як узор арганікі, прывезены з далёкай зорнай сістэмы, населенай разумнымі гальштукамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A42.english: I suspect that it might be.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A42.polish: Zdaje się, że może nawet jest.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A42.belarusian: Падазраю, што так яно і ёсць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A54.english: Necktie, you and I are done. Both professionally -- and as friends. Begone! (End the tie.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A54.polish: Krawacie, między nami skończone. Zarówno na gruncie zawodowym, jak i towarzyskim. Precz! (Zakończ historię krawata).
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A54.belarusian: Гальштук, паміж намі ўсё скончана. Як у прафесійным плане, так і па-сяброўску. Прэч! (Пакласці канец гальштуку.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A5A.english: Cleansed by the blue spirit-fire of 98.7% pure alcohol, the fabric looks almost new again. No longer like a disgusting worm of the lower intestine, but like a colourful and deadly poisonous reef-snake of the Insulindian ocean.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A5A.polish: Oczyszczony przez niebieski spirytus o zawartości alkoholu 98,7% materiał wygląda znów niemal jak nowy. Nie jak ohydny pasożyt jelita grubego, lecz barwny i śmiertelnie niebezpieczny wąż z raf Oceanu Insulindiańskiego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A5A.belarusian: Ачышчаная блакітным спіртавым агнём 98,7-адсоткавага чыстага алкаголю, тканіна зноў выглядае амаль як новая. Больш не як агідны чарвяк з тоўстага кішачніка, а як стракатая і смяротна атрутная рыфавая змяя з Інсуліндыйскага акіяна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A60.english: Seems you'll never learn the answer to that question.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A60.polish: Chyba nigdy nie poznasz odpowiedzi na to pytanie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A60.belarusian: Здаецца, ты так ніколі і не даведаешся адказу на гэтае пытанне.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A66.english: He's struggling to keep silent, but finally seems to give up.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A66.polish: Stara się zachować milczenie, ale w końcu się poddaje.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A66.belarusian: Ён з усіх сіл спрабуе змаўчаць, але ўрэшце, здаецца, здаецца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A6C.english: Just put me in the bottle, *bratan*. I'm not gonna let you down. You and I are, like, the same person.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A6C.polish: Wsadź mnie do tej butelki, *bratan*. Nie zawiodę cię. Jesteśmy przecież jak jedna i ta sama osoba.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A6C.belarusian: Проста запіхні мяне ў бутэльку, *братан*. Я цябе не падвяду. Мы ж з табой лічы што адзін і той жа чалавек.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A72.english: Begone, foul necktie! Finally I rid myself of you! (End it. Throw the necktie as far as you can.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A72.polish: Precz, parszywy krawacie! W końcu się ciebie pozbyłem! (Skończ z tym. Odrzuć krawat tak daleko, jak to możliwe).
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A72.belarusian: Прэч, паскудны гальштук! Нарэшце я пазбавіўся цябе! (Скончыць з гэтым. Закінуць гальштук як мага далей.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A78.english: It was just trying to help....

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A84.english: "It teaches me about life, Kim. Sort of a father figure."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A84.polish: „Uczy mnie wiele o życiu, Kim. Jest trochę jak rodzic”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A84.belarusian: "Ён вучыць мяне жыццю, Кім. Нешта накшталт бацькі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A8A.english: The necktie floats in the blueish liquid with almost unearthly grace.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A8A.polish: Krawat pływa w niebieskawym płynie z nieomal nieziemską gracją.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A8A.belarusian: Гальштук плавае ў блакітнаватай вадкасці з амаль незямной грацыяй.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A90.english: The lieutenant has been observing you quietly all this time.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A90.polish: Porucznik obserwował cię w ciszy przez cały ten czas.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013A90.belarusian: Увесь гэты час лейтэнант моўчкі назіраў за табой.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100DD.english: Is that the phasmid? It looks like the phasmid, leaning against the wall...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100DD.polish: Czy to straszyk? Zdaje się że tak, opiera się o ścianę...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100DD.belarusian: Гэта што, фазмід? Выглядае як фазмід, прыхінуты да сцяны...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100E3.english: Try to sneak up to the phasmid.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100F7.english: It's not the phasmid... It's not even organic -- it's a fire iron. How disappointing!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100F7.polish: To nie straszyk... To nawet nie substancja organiczna, a zwykły pogrzebacz. Co za rozczarowanie!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100F7.belarusian: Гэта не фазмід... Гэта нават не арганіка — гэта качарга. Якое расчараванне!

Dialogue Text/0x0100008100000141.english: Of course that wasn't the phasmid. It's way too big.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008100000141.polish: Oczywiście, że to nie był straszyk. Jest za duży.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008100000141.belarusian: Вядома ж, гэта быў не фазмід. Ён занадта вялікі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008100000147.english: This is what I get for trying to be a scientist instead of a cop. I mean, I'm not even a *good* cop.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008100000147.polish: Oto jak się kończy zabawa policjanta w naukowca. A przecież *nawet gliną* nie jestem za dobrym.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008100000147.belarusian: Вось што бывае, калі спрабуеш быць навукоўцам замест копа. Я ж нават не *добры* коп.

Dialogue Text/0x010000810000014F.english: Right?! You'll have better luck next time, though. The phasmid -- finding it is your destiny.
Dialogue Text/0x010000810000014F.polish: No nie? Ale następnym razem ci się bardziej poszczęści. Znalezienie tego straszyka to twoje przeznaczenie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000810000014F.belarusian: Праўда ж?! Але наступным разам табе пашанцуе болей. Гэты фазмід — знайсці яго твой лёс.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008100000155.english: Don't be too hard on yourself. You couldn't have known that for sure. And, besides, finding this phasmid is your special destiny -- you can feel it!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008100000155.polish: Nie bądź dla siebie zbyt surowy. Nie mogłeś wiedzieć tego na pewno. Poza tym znalezienie tego straszyka to twoje wyjątkowe przeznaczenie. Czujesz to!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008100000155.belarusian: Не картай сябе занадта. Ты не мог ведаць напэўна. І да таго ж, знайсці гэтага фазміда — тваё асаблівае прызначэнне, ты ж адчуваеш!
