Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A07.belarusian: "Мгу-мгу", — адказвае яна. — "І гэта яшчэ і галаваломка. Можна адгадваць, хто злачынца або як добрыя хлопцы яго зловяць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A0E.english: "Wait -- not crime *fiction*. I need to know what *crime* is."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A0E.polish: „Czekaj, ja nie mówię o *kryminałach* do czytania. Chodzi mi o to, czym *jest* kryminał. Przestępstwa, znaczy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A0E.belarusian: "Пачакай — не крымінальная *літаратура*. Мне трэба ведаць, што такое *злачынства*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A1B.polish: „Tu się bardzo źle dzieje”. (Wskaż na swoją głowę).

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A2F.english: "Crime is a deviation from the law punishable by either a civil or criminal sentencing. It's what *The Law* prevents."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A2F.polish: „Przestępstwo to odstępstwo od prawa podlegające karze na podstawie wyroku wydanego w procedurze cywilnej lub karnej. Właśnie takim czynom zapobiega *prawo*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A2F.belarusian: "Злачынства — гэта парушэнне закону, якое караецца паводле грамадзянскага альбо крымінальнага судаводства. Гэта тое, што прадухіляе *Закон*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A3D.english: "Crime is what we were solving before this conversation began."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A3D.polish: „Przestępstwo to czyn, co badaliśmy, zanim rozpoczęła się ta rozmowa”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A3D.belarusian: "Злачынства — гэта тое, што мы расследавалі да пачатку гэтай размовы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A44.english: "Crime is what criminals do. And policemen... solve?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A44.polish: „Przestępstwa to to, co robią przestępcy. A policjanci je... tropią?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A44.belarusian: "Злачынства — гэта тое, што робяць злачынцы. А паліцыянты... раскрываюць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A58.english: "It's not your body that's important in police work, anyway. It's your..." (Point to your head.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A58.polish: „To i tak nie ciało jest najważniejsze w pracy policyjnej, a...” (Wskaż na swoją głowę).
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A58.belarusian: "Ды і ўвогуле, у паліцэйскай працы галоўнае — не цела. Галоўнае — гэта..." (Пастукаць сябе па галаве.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A62.english: "Muscle training is flower arranging for men. I bet he thinks he's real manly like that. He isn't. It's just unhealthy."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A62.polish: „Trening mięśni to taka florystyka dla facetów. Pewnie myśli, że jest dzięki niemu strasznie męski. Nie jest. To jest po prostu niezdrowe”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A62.belarusian: "Трэніроўка цягліц — гэта як ікебана для мужчын. Закладаюся, ён думае, што так ён жудасна мужны. Але гэта не так. Гэта проста нездарова".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A68.english: "Bet he can't even bend over to pick the gun his rigid fingers dropped. Real detectives are sinewy and snake-hipped. Like me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A68.polish: „Założę się, że nie byłby w stanie się nawet pochylić po broń, która mu wypadła z tych sztywnych paluchów. Prawdziwi detektywi są żylaści i gibcy. Jak ja”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A68.belarusian: "Закладаюся, ён нават нахіліцца не здольны, каб падняць пісталет, які выпаў з яго акасцянелых пальцаў. Сапраўдныя дэтэктывы — жыластыя і гнуткія. Як я".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A6E.english: "I don't know. Let's talk about something else. This making me feel sad."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A6E.polish: „No, nie wiem. Porozmawiajmy o czym innym. Smutno mi się od tego robi”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A6E.belarusian: "Не ведаю. Давай пагаворым пра нешта іншае. Мне ад гэтага робіцца сумна".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A75.english: "Don't feel sad, sir! Mullen isn't even real. You're real!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A75.polish: „Proszę się nie smucić! Mullen nie jest prawdziwy. Pan jest prawdziwy!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A75.belarusian: "Не сумуйце, спадар! Муллен нават не сапраўдны. А вы сапраўдны!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A9C.english: No -- It's your soul, your blue soul.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A9C.polish: Nie. Chodzi o duszę. Policyjną duszę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000A9C.belarusian: Не — твая душа, твая блакітная паліцэйская душа.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AA3.english: "Soul. That Mullen guy looks like a *Hampelmann* -- who could respect that face? It's not even drawn correctly! He lacks *soul*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AA3.polish: „Dusza. Ten cały Mullen wygląda jak *hampelmann* – kto mógłby szanować kogoś o takiej twarzy? Nie jest nawet dobrze narysowana! Brak w niej *ducha*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AA3.belarusian: "Душа. Гэты хлопец Муллен выглядае як *Хампельман* — хіба можна паважаць такі твар? Ён нават намаляваны няправільна! У ім няма *душы*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AB0.english: "Flexibility. There are millions of different people out there and you have to get into their heads -- sometimes you gotta be the killer to catch the killer."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AB0.polish: „Elastyczność. Na świecie są miliony najróżniejszych ludzi i trzeba umieć wdzierać im się w umysły. Czasem żeby złapać zabójcę, też trzeba się nim stać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AB0.belarusian: "Гнуткасць. У свеце мільёны розных людзей, і табе трэба залазіць ім у галаву — часам трэба саму быць забойцам, каб злавіць забойцу".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000ACB.english: "Grit. A total disregard for personal safety. You gotta take the pain. This Mullen guy looks like he'd run to his mom. Ain't got no balls."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000ACB.polish: „Twardość charakteru. Całkowite lekceważenie własnego bezpieczeństwa. Trzeba pogodzić się z bólem. Ten cały Mullen wygląda jak buc, który ma zaraz uciec do mamusi. Nie ma jaj”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000ACB.belarusian: "Трываласць. Поўнае ігнараванне ўласнай бяспекі. Трэба трываць боль. Гэты хлопец Муллен выглядае так, нібы пабяжыць да мамы. У яго няма яек".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AD2.english: "A dick with no balls! Bam! Mullen's no real deal, he's got nothing on me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AD2.polish: „Buc bez jaj! Bam! Mullen to miękka faja, nie ma do mnie startu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AD2.belarusian: "Хрэн без яек! Бам! Муллен — фуфло, ён мне і ў падмёткі не гадзіцца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AD9.english: "A quicksilver mind. This Mullen guy looks like he needs four hours just to come up with a single idea."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AD9.polish: „Bystry umysł. Ten cały Mullen wygląda, jakby potrzebował kilku godzin, żeby wpaść na najprostszy pomysł”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AD9.belarusian: "Хуткі, як ртуць, розум. Гэты хлопец Муллен выглядае так, нібы яму трэба чатыры гадзіны, каб нарадзіць адну-адзіную думку".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AE8.english: "No-no, think about it! One where they plunge into a torrid spiral of pain and recrimination. Only it's *really long* and drawn out. Scarred for life. Phantom limb!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AE8.polish: „Nie, nie, zastanów się! Taki, w którym wpadają w potężny wir bólu i wzajemnych oskarżeń. To *bardzo długa* i ciągnąca się opowieść. Rany, które się nie zabliźniają. Ból fantomowy!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AE8.belarusian: "Не-не, падумай! Такая, дзе яны зрываюцца ў вір пякельнага болю і ўзаемных абвінавачанняў. Толькі *вельмі доўгая* і зацяжная. Рубцы на ўсё жыццё. Фантомны боль!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AF5.english: "I'm sorry, sir, I don't know how to help you..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000AF5.belarusian: "Прабачце, спадар, я не ведаю, як вам дапамагчы..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B04.english: "I haven't read many of... those. Maybe you should ask Mum?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B04.polish: „Nie znam wielu... takich. Proszę spytać mamę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B04.belarusian: "Я не вельмі шмат такіх чытала... Можа, вам спытаць у мамы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B0B.english: "Yeah. Yeah! And it drags on for *years* and *years* with no resolution in sight..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B0B.polish: „Tak. Tak! I ciągnie się całymi *latami*. Próżno czekać, aż to się rozwiąże...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B0B.belarusian: "Так. Так! І гэта цягнецца *гадамі* і *гадамі*, і ніякага вырашэння на гарызонце..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B11.english: "... each of you filling with resentment and bitterness for having *ruined* each other's lives..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B11.polish: „Każde z was pełne nienawiści i zgorzknienia, bo *zrujnowaliście* sobie nawzajem życia...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B11.belarusian: "...кожны з вас напаўняецца крыўдай і горыччу за тое, што *зруйнавалі* жыцці адно аднаму..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B18.english: You can take this! Blossom like a pain-flower.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B18.polish: Masz to w garści! Rozkwitnij niczym kwiat bólu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B18.belarusian: Ты вытрымаеш гэта! Распусціся, нібы кветка болю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B23.english: Stop. There's no need for this. It's in your power to change the subject.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B23.polish: Przestań. To nie jest potrzebne. Jesteś w stanie zmienić temat na inny.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B23.belarusian: Спыніся. У гэтым няма патрэбы. Ты цалкам здольны змяніць тэму.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B2A.english: "... each of you tearing at the other's innards, leaving a gaping emptiness, a vacuum heart that still hurts ceaselessly!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B2A.polish: „Rozszarpujecie sobie nawzajem wnętrzności, zostawiając tylko ziejącą pustkę. Zawieszone w próżni serce, które tylko boli bez końca!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B2A.belarusian: "...кожны з вас рве вантробы іншага, пакідаючы ззяючую пустэчу, вакуумнае сэрца, якое ўсё яшчэ няспынна баліць!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B37.english: "Can I become famous by reading one of those books?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B37.polish: „A mógłbym stać się sławny, gdybym przeczytał jedną z tych książek?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B37.belarusian: "Ці магу я стаць знакамітым, калі прачытаю адну з гэтых кніг?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B5D.english: "I don't know about that... But I imagine life is great when you're famous."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B5D.polish: „Tego nie wiem... Ale życie musi być wspaniałe, kiedy jest się sławnym”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B5D.belarusian: "Гэтага я не ведаю... Але ўяўляю, як гэта цудоўна — быць знакамітым".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B65.english: "Yeah, I'm old. That's just what happens to people."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B65.polish: „Tak. Jestem stary. Tak to już się dzieje z ludźmi”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B65.belarusian: "Так, я стары. Вось што адбываецца з людзьмі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B6C.english: "Wow, look at the guy. I'll never be as good as Mullen."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B6C.polish: „O rany, tylko na niego popatrz. Nigdy nie będę tak dobry jak Mullen”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B6C.belarusian: "Ого, паглядзі на гэтага хлопца. Я ніколі не буду такім крутым, як Муллен".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B72.english: "Don't say that. He's not even real. You're real."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B72.polish: „Proszę tak nie mówić. On nawet nie jest prawdziwy. A pan jest”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B72.belarusian: "Не кажыце так. Ён нават не сапраўдны. А вы сапраўдны".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B7F.english: "Overshadowed by a fake man? That's harsh."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B7F.polish: „Muszę żyć w cieniu nieistniejącego człowieka? Bolesne”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B7F.belarusian: "Апынуцца ў цені выдуманага чалавека? Гэта жорстка".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B93.english: "Maybe I should start *killing* these famous people. Hunt them down."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B93.polish: „Może powinienem zacząć *zabijać* tych sławnych ludzi. Polować na nich”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500000B93.belarusian: "Можа, мне варта пачаць *забіваць* гэтых знакамітасцяў. Паляваць на іх".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B3BA.english: "What kind of a store is this anyway?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B3BA.polish: „Co to w ogóle jest za sklep?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B3EB.english: Remorse. The parquet of assembly halls, the rows of stall bars are growing cold. The corridors stand empty. A girl's voice somehow finds its way through this strange feeling...
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B3EB.polish: Wyrzuty sumienia. Parkiet sal lekcyjnych, rzędy drabinek stają się coraz chłodniejsze. Korytarze zieją pustką. Przez tę dziwną emocję przedziera się jakimś sposobem dziewczęcy głos...
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B3EB.belarusian: Згрызоты сумлення. Паркет актавых залаў, шэрагі шведскіх сценак стынуць на холадзе. Калідоры пустуюць. Дзявочы голас нейкім чынам прабіваецца скрозь гэтае дзіўнае пачуццё...

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B3F2.english: You haven't heard a word of what she's been saying these past few moments. You only hear...
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B3F2.polish: Nie usłyszałeś ani słowa z tego, co mówiła przez ostatnich kilka chwil. Słyszysz tylko...
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B3F2.belarusian: За гэтыя некалькі імгненняў ты не пачуў ніводнага яе слова. Ты чуеш толькі...

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B3FA.english: She sways slowly side-to-side, her wide eyes fixed at you standing there, silently, like a weirdo.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B3FA.polish: Kołysze się wolno na boki z szeroko otwartymi oczami i utkwionym w tobie wzrokiem, bez słowa, jak pomylona.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B3FA.belarusian: Яна павольна хістаецца з боку ў бок, шырока расплюшчанымі вачыма ўтаропіўшыся ў цябе, пакуль ты стаіш там моўчкі, як дзівак.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B421.english: "It does not *manifest* itself in any way. It does not exist. I liked it better when we were talking about whether it's appropriate to stand out in the freezing weather."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B421.polish: „Ona się nie *przejawia* w żaden sposób. Ona nie istnieje. Wolałem, gdy rozmawialiśmy o tym, czy powinno się sterczeć na zewnątrz przy takiej mroźnej pogodzie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B421.belarusian: "Ён ніяк не *праяўляецца*. Яго не існуе. Мне больш падабалася, калі мы размаўлялі пра тое, ці дарэчна стаяць на вуліцы ў такі мароз".

Alternate1/0x0100002F0000B421.polish: „Ona się nie *przejawia* w żaden sposób. Ona nie istnieje. Wolałem, gdy rozmawialiśmy o różnych gatunkach książek”.
Alternate1/0x0100002F0000B421.belarusian: "Ён ніяк не *праяўляецца*. Яго не існуе. Мне больш падабалася, калі мы размаўлялі пра розныя віды кніг".

Alternate2/0x0100002F0000B421.polish: „Ona się nie *przejawia* w żaden sposób. Ona nie istnieje. Wolałem, gdy pytaliśmy o Dicka Mullena”.
Alternate2/0x0100002F0000B421.belarusian: "Ён ніяк не *праяўляецца*. Яго не існуе. Мне больш падабалася, калі мы распытвалі пра Дзіка Муллена".

Alternate3/0x0100002F0000B421.polish: „Ona się nie *przejawia* w żaden sposób. Ona nie istnieje. Wolałem, gdy pytaliśmy o powieści romantyczne”.
Alternate3/0x0100002F0000B421.belarusian: "Ён ніяк не *праяўляецца*. Яго не існуе. Мне больш падабалася, калі мы распытвалі пра любоўныя раманы".

Alternate4/0x0100002F0000B421.polish: „Ona się nie *przejawia* w żaden sposób. Ona nie istnieje. Wolałem, gdy pytaliśmy o słynne osoby”.
Alternate4/0x0100002F0000B421.belarusian: "Ён ніяк не *праяўляецца*. Яго не існуе. Мне больш падабалася, калі мы распытвалі пра знакамітасцяў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B430.english: Her eye lands on the sign on the window that says *Crime, Romance, and Biographies of Famous People*. She brightens up and points to it: "But I do know books! We can talk about books."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B430.polish: Jej wzrok zatrzymuje się na witrynie z napisem »Kryminał, Romans i Biografie Słynnych Osób«. Rozchmurza się i wskazuje na nią: „Ale znam się na książkach! Może o nich porozmawiamy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B430.belarusian: Яе позірк спыняецца на шыльдзе на акне, дзе напісана *Дэтэктывы, Раманы і Біяграфіі Знакамітасцяў*. Яна ажыўляецца і паказвае на яе: "Але ж я разбіраюся ў кнігах! Мы можам пагаварыць пра кнігі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B452.english: "It does not *manifest* itself in any way. It does not exist."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B452.polish: „Ona się nie *przejawia* w żaden sposób. Ona nie istnieje”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B479.english: "Uh..." The girl looks back and forth between you two. "Anything else you wanted to talk about, sir?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B479.polish: „Ee...” – dziewczynka nie wie, na którym z was się skupić. „Chce pan porozmawiać o czymś jeszcze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B479.belarusian: "Э-э..." Дзяўчынка пераводзіць позірк з аднаго з вас на другога. "Ці вы хочаце пагаварыць пра нешта яшчэ, спадар?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B485.english: "No such thing." The lieutenant stands at your side, stern and serious.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B485.polish: „Nic takiego nie istnieje” – porucznik stoi u twego boku surowy i poważny.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B485.belarusian: "Няма нічога такога". Лейтэнант стаіць побач з табой, строгі і сур'ёзны.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B4C7.english: She studies the picture on the cover. "That sounds smart, I guess."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B4C7.belarusian: Яна разглядае малюнак на вокладцы. "Гучыць разумна, напэўна".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B4E5.english: "Probably got a violent streak because he's emotionally stunted."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B4E5.polish: „Pewnie ma skłonność do przemocy, bo jest upośledzony emocjonalnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B4E5.belarusian: "У яго, напэўна, цяга да гвалту, бо ён эмацыйна недаразвіты".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B4F0.english: She examines the picture closely. The Vespertine detective exhibits few signs of health or unhealth.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B4F0.polish: Uważnie przygląda się obrazkowi. Wesperski detektyw nie wykazuje wielu oznak zdrowia lub jego braku.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B4F0.belarusian: Яна пільна вывучае малюнак. Весперскі дэтэктыў амаль не выказвае прыкмет здароўя ці нездароўя.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B4F6.english: She's trying to examine the shadow-obscured hips of Dick Mullen. "They don't look rigid to me..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B4F6.polish: Próbuje spojrzeć krytycznie na ukryte w cieniu biodra Dicka Mullena. „Nie wyglądają na zesztywniałe...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B4F6.belarusian: Яна спрабуе разгледзець схаваныя ценем сцёгны Дзіка Муллена. "Яны не выглядаюць акасцянелымі..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B4FC.english: She examines the cover, trying to gauge the inner workings of the detective.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B4FC.polish: Studiuje okładkę, starając się przeniknąć istotę przedstawionego na niej bohatera.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B4FC.belarusian: Яна вывучае вокладку, спрабуючы пранікнуць ва ўнутраны свет дэтэктыва.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B506.english: "Being smart is the only way to *cop*, little girl. I can do this way better than him."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B506.polish: „Bycie sprytnym to jedyny słuszny sposób na bycie *gliną*, dziewczynko. A w tym jestem o wiele lepszy niż on”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B506.belarusian: "Быць кемлівым — адзіны правільны спосаб *быць копам*, дзяўчынка. Я раблю гэта значна лепш за яго".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B512.english: "If you say so, sir." She smiles mischievously. "He's just a fictional character, he's no match for you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B512.polish: „Skoro pan tak mówi” – uśmiecha się zadziornie. „To tylko zmyślona postać, z panem nie ma szans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B512.belarusian: "Калі вы так кажаце, спадар", — хітра ўсміхаецца яна. — "Ён жа проста выдуманы персанаж, ён вам не супернік".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B535.english: "That's just no way to *cop*." I can do it way better than Dick Mullen."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B535.polish: „Tak się nie zostaje dobrym *gliną*. W policyjnej robocie jestem o wiele lepszy niż on”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B535.belarusian: "Гэта проста не спосаб *быць копам*. Я спраўляюся куды лепш за Дзіка Муллена".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B543.english: "But that's like... the same thing." She squints her eyes, trying to solve this puzzle.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B543.polish: „Ale to jakby... to samo” – mruży oczy, głowiąc się nad tą zagadką.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B543.belarusian: "Але ж гэта... адно і тое ж". Яна прыжмурваецца, спрабуючы разгадаць гэтую загадку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B54A.english: "Obviously, sir." She smiles mischievously. "He's just a fictional character, he's no match for you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B54A.polish: „Oczywiście, psze pana” – uśmiecha się zadziornie. „To tylko zmyślona postać, z panem nie ma szans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B54A.belarusian: "Відавочна, спадар", — хітра ўсміхаецца яна. — "Ён жа проста выдуманы персанаж, ён вам не супернік".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B55A.english: "Poor vitality is no way to *cop*, little girl. I could take him down easy."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B55A.polish: „A nikt niezdrowy nie zostaje dobrym *gliną*, dziewczynko. Załatwiłbym go z palcem w nosie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B55A.belarusian: "Слабая жыццёвая сіла — не варыянт для *копа*, дзяўчынка. Я б яго лёгка паклаў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B560.english: "Mobility is the proper way to *cop*, girl. Dick Mullen can't compete with my hip-grind."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B560.polish: „Zwinność jest kluczowa dla dobrego *gliny*, dziewczynko. Dick Mullen nie ma startu do moich gibkich bioder”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B560.belarusian: "Рухомасць — вось правільны спосаб *быць копам*, дзяўчынка. Дзік Муллен не пацягне супроць маёй пластыкі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B56A.english: "Emotional ineptitude is no way to *cop*. He can't compare to my sensitive soul."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B56A.polish: „Emocjonalna ułomność nie przystoi dobremu *glinie*. Nie ma co gość się równać z moją wrażliwą duszą”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B56A.belarusian: "Эмацыйная няўмеласць — не спосаб *быць копам*. Ён і блізка не стаіць побач з маёй чуллівай душой".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B57A.english: The girl is at a loss for words.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B580.english: She shifts and sways on her feet, looking confused and uncomfortable.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B580.polish: Szura stopami i kołysze się, dając wyraz swojemu zakłopotaniu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B580.belarusian: Яна перамінаецца з нагі на нагу і хістаецца, выглядаючы збянтэжанай і ўстрывожанай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B586.english: "Ummm... no? I don't know..." She looks at you with puzzlement.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B586.polish: „Eee... nie? Nie wiem...” – patrzy na ciebie z konsternacją.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B586.belarusian: "Эм-м-м... не? Я не ведаю..." Яна глядзіць на цябе са здзіўленнем.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B599.english: "Doesn't ring a bell? Alright, I'll ask your mom."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B599.polish: „Nie kojarzysz nic takiego? No dobrze, spytam twoją mamę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B599.belarusian: "Не прыгадваецца нічога такога? Добра, спытаю ў тваёй мамы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B59F.english: "Yes!" She nods, relieved. "She knows books, definitely."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B59F.polish: „Tak!” – przytakuje z ulgą. „Ona zna się na książkach jak nikt!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B59F.belarusian: "Так!" — з палёгкай ківае яна. — "Яна дакладна разбіраецца ў кнігах".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5AD.english: "I don't need *help*, I need a real book that tells it how it *is*, not this drivel."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5AD.polish: „Nie potrzebuję *pomocy*. Potrzebuję prawdziwej książki o tym, jak *jest*, a nie tego śmiecia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5AD.belarusian: "Мне не патрэбна *дапамога*, мне патрэбна сапраўдная кніга, якая раскажа ўсё як *ёсць*, а не гэтая бязглуздзіца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5B3.polish: „Mhm!” – entuzjastycznie kiwa głową z ewidentną ulgą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5B3.belarusian: "Мгу!" Яна заўзята ківае з відавочнай палёгкай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5C9.english: "Sir, sorry, sir. I'm still little?" She stumbles on her words. "I don't... I can't..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5C9.polish: „Przepraszam pana. Jestem jeszcze mała” – gubi się we własnych słowach. „Nie wiem... nie umiem...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5C9.belarusian: "Спадар, прабачце, спадар. Я ж яшчэ маленькая?" Яна блытаецца ў словах. "Я не... я не магу..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5D0.english: Damn right I am! Proud as the Lion of Serber.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5D0.polish: Jak jasna cholera! Dumny niczym Lew Serberu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5D0.belarusian: Чорт пабяры, яшчэ як ганаруся! Ганаруся, як Серберскі Леў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5D6.english: Excuse me, I'm not sure I heard that properly...
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5D6.polish: Przepraszam, chyba coś mi się przesłyszało...
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5D6.belarusian: Прабачце, я не ўпэўнены, што правільна гэта пачуў...

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5DC.english: It's time to leave it be. You're about to make a child cry. Are you proud of yourself?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5DC.polish: Najwyższy czas odpuścić. Zaraz doprowadzisz dziecko do płaczu. Dumny z siebie jesteś?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5DC.belarusian: Пара спыніцца. Ты зараз давядзеш дзіця да слёз. Ты ганарышся сабой?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5E3.english: "I... uh... don't worry, little girl. Got a bit carried away there. Let's back up out of this."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5E3.polish: „Ja... Yyy... Nie przejmuj się, dziewczynko. Trochę mnie poniosło. Lepiej zakończmy ten temat”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5E3.belarusian: "Я... э-э... не хвалюйся, дзяўчынка. Трохі занесла. Давай забудзем пра гэта".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5EC.english: "I said I'm proud like a goddamn lion!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5EC.polish: „Powiedziałem, że jestem dumny jak cholerny lew!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5EC.belarusian: "Я сказаў, што ганаруся, як кляты леў!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5F3.english: Her eyes grow wide as she tries to comprehend the outburst. "I'm sorry, sir?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5F3.polish: Otwiera oczy coraz szerzej, próbując zrozumieć ten wybuch. „Przepraszam, psze pana?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5F3.belarusian: Яе вочы акругляюцца, пакуль яна спрабуе асэнсаваць гэты выбух. "Прабачце, спадар?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5F9.english: "You heard me! I'm full of pride and I ready to talk about books. Let's do this."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5F9.polish: „Dobrze słyszałaś! Jestem pełen dumy i gotowości do rozmowy o książkach. Do dzieła!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5F9.belarusian: "Ты мяне чула! Я поўны гонару і гатовы гаварыць пра кнігі. Паехалі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5FF.english: "Yes... yes, sir!" She blinks her eyes rapidly, in confusion and relief.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5FF.polish: „Tak... dobrze, psze pana!” – mruga raz za razem, dając wyraz dezorientacji, ale i uldze.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B5FF.belarusian: "Так... так, спадар!" Яна часта лыпае вачыма ад разгубленасці і палёгкі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B61C.english: Not a single shred of pride remains in me.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B61C.polish: Nie ostał się we mnie nawet strzępek dumy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B61C.belarusian: Ува мне не засталося ні каліва гонару.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B623.english: This is your *tiny* chance for redemption. Apologize.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B623.polish: Oto twoja *maleńka* szansa na zrehabilitowanie się. Przeproś.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B623.belarusian: Вось твой *малюсенькі* шанец на адкупленне. Папрасі прабачэння.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B629.english: "Little girl, I'm sorry I got agitated. I just can't handle things sometimes. Let's get back to books."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B629.polish: „Dziewczynko, przepraszam, że się zirytowałem. Czasem sobie nie daję trochę rady. Wróćmy do rozmowy o książkach”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B629.belarusian: "Дзяўчынка, прабач, што я так узрушыўся. Часам я проста не магу з сабой саўладаць. Давай вернемся да кніг".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B62F.english: "Yes... yes, sir!" She blinks her eyes rapidly, in confusion and relief.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B62F.polish: „Tak... dobrze, psze pana!” – mruga raz za razem, dając wyraz dezorientacji, ale i uldze.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B62F.belarusian: "Так... так, спадар!" Яна часта лыпае вачыма ад разгубленасці і палёгкі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B639.english: "On second thought, this seems like an inappropriate topic to discuss with children."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B639.polish: „W sumie to chyba nie jest temat, o którym się powinno rozmawiać z dzieckiem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B639.belarusian: "Калі падумаць, гэта непрыдатная тэма для размовы з дзецьмі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B649.english: You're not really an automaton, you do know that?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B649.polish: Nie jesteś maszyną. Zdajesz sobie z tego sprawę?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B649.belarusian: Ты ж не сапраўдны аўтамат, ты гэта ведаеш?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B650.english: "Little girl, pardon the deviation. I wish to discuss books and other such matters."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B650.polish: „Wybacz mi ten wybuch, dziecko. Chcę porozmawiać o książkach i innych takich rzeczach”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B650.belarusian: "Дзяўчынка, прабач за адхіленне. Я хачу абмеркаваць кнігі ды іншыя падобныя рэчы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B65C.english: "Okay!" She looks at you with her wide eyes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B65C.polish: „Dobrze!” – patrzy na ciebie szeroko otwartymi oczami.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B65C.belarusian: "Добра!" Яна глядзіць на цябе сваімі шырокімі вачыма.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B668.english: "I wonder how I'll be when I get old..." She mumbles. "Maybe I'll also get all wrinkly..." She giggles to herself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B668.polish: „Ciekawe, jak ja będę wyglądać na starość...” – mruczy pod nosem. „Może też będę cała pomarszczona...” – chichocze na myśl o tym.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B668.belarusian: "Цікава, якой я буду, калі пастарэю..." — мармыча яна. — "Можа, таксама ўся зморшчуся..." Яна ціхенька хіхікае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B66F.english: "Sir?!" She looks at you, eyes wide in shock.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B66F.polish: „Co pan mówi?!” – patrzy na ciebie pełnym przerażenia wzrokiem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B66F.belarusian: "Спадар?!" Яна глядзіць на цябе шырока расплюшчанымі ад шоку вачыма.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B676.english: "They *deserve* punishment for all the things they had to do get so famous."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B676.polish: „*Zasługują* na karę za wszystkie te rzeczy, które musieli zrobić, żeby zdobyć sławę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B676.belarusian: "Яны *заслугоўваюць* пакарання за ўсё тое, што ім давялося зрабіць, каб стаць такімі вядомымі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B67D.english: "Haha, never mind, girl. I'm quite the joker. I would never do something like that."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B67D.polish: „Ha, ha, nieważne, dziecko. Taki ze mnie żartowniś. W życiu bym czegoś takiego nie zrobił”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B67D.belarusian: "Ха-ха, не звяртай увагі, дзяўчынка. Люблю пажартаваць. Я б ніколі такога не зрабіў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B684.english: "Okay..." She coughs. "Maybe buy some books then?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B684.polish: „Aha...” – chrząka. „A może kupi pan jakieś książki?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B684.belarusian: "Добра..." Яна кашляе. "Можа, тады купіце якія-небудзь кнігі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B68A.english: "That's not a funny joke. At all."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6A5.english: "Hey... Why do you keep your hands folded?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6AB.english: "What do you mean, sir?" She looks wary.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6AB.polish: „Nie rozumiem, psze pana” – przybiera czujną postawę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6AB.belarusian: "Што вы маеце на ўвазе, спадар?" Яна насцярожваецца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6B1.english: She knows where this is going.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6B1.belarusian: Яна ведае, да чаго ўсё ідзе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6BE.english: She looks around anxiously. Her hands remain folded in front of her. She doesn't want to show them.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6BE.polish: Rozgląda się nerwowo. Dłonie nadal ma splecione. Nie chce ich pokazać.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6BE.belarusian: Яна трывожна азіраецца. Яе рукі застаюцца складзенымі перад сабой. Яна не хоча іх паказваць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6D0.english: She brings out her reddened hands -- her nails are frayed, nearly chewed down to the flesh.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6D0.polish: Wyciąga zaczerwienione dłonie. Jej paznokcie są połamane, obgryzione niemal do ciała.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6D0.belarusian: Яна паказвае свае пачырванелыя рукі — пазногці абламаныя, згрызеныя амаль да самага мяса.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6DC.english: "And you knew this from me keeping my hands folded?" She shoots you a suspicious glance.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6DC.polish: „Domyślił się pan po moich złożonych dłoniach?” – rzuca ci podejrzliwe spojrzenie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6DC.belarusian: "І вы зразумелі гэта толькі таму, што я трымала рукі складзенымі?" Яна кідае на цябе падазроны позірк.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6EE.english: "Well... that proves nothing! Anyone could do an easy deduction like that!" Her eyes flash with defiance. She's not impressed.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6EE.polish: „No... to żaden dowód! Każdy może wydedukować taką prostą rzecz!” – w jej oczach pojawia się błysk zuchwałości. Wyraźnie nie jest pod wrażeniem twojego procesu myślowego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6EE.belarusian: "Ну... гэта нічога не даказвае! Любы мог бы зрабіць такую простую выснову!" У яе вачах успыхвае выклік. Твая дэдукцыя яе не ўразіла.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6F4.english: She actually is impressed, this is more like a defensive reflex.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6F4.polish: Tak naprawdę jest pod wrażeniem. To tylko odruch obronny.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6F4.belarusian: Насамрэч яна ўражаная, гэта проста абарончы рэфлекс.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6FB.english: "You think so? Fine, do better -- deduce something about me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6FB.polish: „Tak myślisz? Dobra, to pokaż mi. Wydedukuj coś o mnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B6FB.belarusian: "Думаеш? Ну добра, пакажы клас — выведзі што-небудзь пра мяне".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B702.english: "That was a master class move. Whatever, kid, I don't need to prove myself to you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B702.polish: „To był mistrzowski ruch. Zresztą wszystko jedno, dzieciaro. Nie muszę ci niczego udowadniać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B702.belarusian: "Гэта быў рух найвышэйшага класа. Хоць усё адно, дзіця, мне няма чаго табе даказваць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B709.english: "If you say so, sir." She grins victoriously.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B709.polish: „Skoro pan tak mówi” – szczerzy się triumfalnie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B709.belarusian: "Калі вы так кажаце, спадар". Яна пераможна шчэрыцца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B714.english: "You're quite sober." She snaps back quickly.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B71B.english: "Wait... How do you know I'm usually not?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B71B.polish: „Zaraz. Skąd wiesz, że zazwyczaj nie jestem?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B71B.belarusian: "Пачакай... Адкуль ты ведаеш, што звычайна я не такі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B727.belarusian: Ёсць нешта, чаго ты не заўважаеш...

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B72D.english: "Hang on. So you... know me? We've met before?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B72D.polish: „Chwila. A więc ty... mnie znasz? Spotkaliśmy się wcześniej?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B72D.belarusian: "Пачакай. Значыць, ты... ведаеш мяне? Мы раней сустракаліся?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B733.english: "You've been running around for several days, talking about small churches and how everyone betrayed you, sir."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B733.polish: „Przez kilka dni biegał pan po okolicy i mówił coś o jakichś małych kościołach i że wszyscy pana zdradzili”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B733.belarusian: "Вы бегалі тут некалькі дзён і казалі пра нейкія маленькія цэрквы і пра тое, што вас усе здрадзілі, спадар".

Alternate1/0x0100002F0000B733.polish: „Przez cały tydzień biegał pan po okolicy bez koszulki. Mówił pan, że jest gwiazdą czy coś. Nie wiem, co pan miał na myśli...”
Alternate1/0x0100002F0000B733.belarusian: "Вы ўвесь тыдзень бегалі без кашулі, спадар. Расказвалі людзям, што вы зорка ці нешта такое. Я насамрэч не разумею, што гэта за зоркі..."

Alternate2/0x0100002F0000B733.polish: „Przez cały tydzień biegał pan po okolicy bez koszulki. Mówił pan, że nadchodzi koniec świata. Nie wiem, co pan miał na myśli...”
Alternate2/0x0100002F0000B733.belarusian: "Вы ўвесь тыдзень бегалі без кашулі, спадар. Казалі людзям, што набліжаецца канец свету. Я насамрэч не разумею, што вы мелі на ўвазе..."

Alternate3/0x0100002F0000B733.polish: „Przez cały tydzień biegał pan po okolicy bez koszulki. Wszystkich pan przepraszał. Nie wiem, co takiego złego pan zrobił...”
Alternate3/0x0100002F0000B733.belarusian: "Вы ўвесь тыдзень бегалі без кашулі, спадар. Усіх перапрашалі. Я насамрэч не разумею, што такога вы нарабілі..."

Alternate4/0x0100002F0000B733.polish: „Przez cały tydzień biegał pan po okolicy. Czasem bez koszulki. Zadawał pan ludziom różne pytania. Nie zrozumiałam, o co właściwie pan pytał...”
Alternate4/0x0100002F0000B733.belarusian: "Вы ўвесь тыдзень бегалі тут, спадар. Часам без кашулі — распытвалі людзей. Я насамрэч не зразумела, пра што менавіта..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B747.english: "What do you mean better? I look like shit."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B747.belarusian: "Што значыць лепш? Я выглядаю як лайно".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B74D.english: "Yeah, but you don't have party eyes anymore."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B74D.polish: „Tak, ale nie ma pan już imprezowych oczu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B74D.belarusian: "Так, але ў вас больш няма тых тусовачных вачэй".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B767.english: "Want more? Bet I can figure out *why* you bite your nails. I got a few reasons in mind."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B767.polish: „Chcesz więcej? Na pewno zdołam dojść, *dlaczego* obgryzasz paznokcie. Mam już kilka pomysłów”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B767.belarusian: "Хочаш яшчэ? Закладаюся, я магу высветліць, *чаму* ты грызеш пазногці. У мяне ёсць пара версій".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B76D.english: "It was okay, sir." She's still got a rebellious streak.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B76D.polish: „Ujdzie, psze pana” – nadal jest w buntowniczym nastroju.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B76D.belarusian: "Было нядрэнна, спадар". У ёй усё яшчэ віруе дух бунту.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B787.english: She nods -- half provocative, half enthusiastic.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B787.polish: Przytakuje, w czym dostrzegasz rozbawienie i prowokację.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B787.belarusian: Яна ківае — напалову правакацыйна, напалову з запалам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B78E.english: "It's super simple for a detective such as myself."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B78E.polish: „To łatwizna dla takiego detektywa jak ja”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B78E.belarusian: "Для такога дэтэктыва, як я, гэта прасцей простага".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7A2.english: "Either way, another *ace* deduction by the #1 detective in town."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7A2.polish: „Tak czy tak, oto i kolejna godna *asa* dedukcja najlepszego detektywa w mieście”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7A2.belarusian: "У любым выпадку, чарговая *бліскучая* дэдукцыя ад дэтэктыва нумар адзін у горадзе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7BB.english: "I sure hope you are, sir!" She rubs her red nose.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7BB.polish: „Mam nadzieję, psze pana!” – pociera swój zaczerwieniony nos.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7BB.belarusian: "Вельмі спадзяюся, спадар!" Яна церці свой чырвоны нос.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7C5.english: "On second thought, maybe I shouldn't remember. Maybe there's a reason I forgot."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7C5.polish: „Z drugiej strony, może nie powinienem sobie tego przypominać? Może nie bez powodu zapomniałem?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7C5.belarusian: "З іншага боку, можа, мне і не варта гэтага памятаць. Можа, недарэмна я ўсё забыў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7CD.english: "Yeah, about that... maybe you could point me toward some booze?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7CD.polish: „A, właśnie... Wiesz może, gdzie znajdę trochę gorzały?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7CD.belarusian: "Ага, наконт гэтага... можа, падкажаш, дзе мне знайсці якое-небудзь пойла?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7D4.english: "Uhm... Frittte, maybe?" She shrugs, a compassionate look in her eyes. "Alcohol is not good for you, sir."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7D4.polish: „Uch... może we Frittte?” – wzrusza ramionami ze współczuciem w oczach. „Alkohol tylko panu zaszkodzi”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7D4.belarusian: "Эм-м... можа, у Frittte?" Яна паціскае плячыма з спачуваннем у вачах. "Алкаголь вам не на карысць, спадар".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7ED.english: "Yes, sir." The girl looks at you quizzically. "Maybe you are interested in books?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7ED.polish: „Może tak, psze pana” – dziewczynka patrzy na ciebie pytająco. „Może interesują pana książki?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B7ED.belarusian: "Так, спадар". Дзяўчынка глядзіць на цябе з недаўменнем. "Можа, вас цікавяць кнігі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B803.english: "Of course. You stopped by a few times." She looks at you intently. "You certainly look better than the last time I saw you!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B803.polish: „Oczywiście. Był pan tu kilka razy” – przygląda ci się uważnie. „Teraz wygląda pan zdecydowanie lepiej niż ostatnio!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B803.belarusian: "Вядома. Вы спыняліся тут некалькі разоў". Яна ўважліва глядзіць на цябе. "Цяпер вы выглядаеце значна лепш, чым калі я бачыла вас мінулым разам!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B80F.english: "You know... like a cat in the dark! All big-and-wide-eyed." She giggles at the thought. "It certainly looks odd on a man."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B80F.polish: „Wie pan... jak kot w ciemności! Wielgachne” – chichocze na myśl o tym. „Człowiek śmiesznie z takimi wygląda”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B80F.belarusian: "Ну ведаеце... як у ката ў цемры! Вялізныя-вялізныя такія". Яна хіхікае ад гэтай думкі. "На мужчынах гэта выглядае вельмі дзіўна".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B816.english: The girl doesn't know what she's talking about! Forget about this.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B816.polish: Dziewczyna nie wie nawet, o czym mówi! Daj spokój.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B816.belarusian: Дзяўчынка не разумее, пра што кажа! Забудзься пра гэта.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B81C.english: Fuck yeah! You should get some party eyes right now! Snap those sequins on you, boy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B81C.polish: Tak jest, kurwa! Teraz też by ci się przydały takie imprezowe oczy! Jak naklejone cekiny, chłopaku.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B81C.belarusian: А то ж, бляха! Табе б зараз таксама не зашкодзілі тусовачныя вочы! Чапляй бліскаўкі, хлопча.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B823.english: Does that mean... I've been partaking in *narcotics*?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B823.belarusian: Ці азначае гэта... што я спажываў *наркотыкі*?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B82B.english: "So... why didn't you tell me you knew me to begin with?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B82B.polish: „To... czemu od razu mi nie powiedziałaś, że mnie znasz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B82B.belarusian: "Дык... чаму ты адразу не сказала, што мы знаёмыя?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B833.english: "Thanks -- I've learned something about myself today." (Conclude.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B833.polish: „Dziękuję. Czegoś się dzisiaj o sobie nauczyłem”. (Zakończ).
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B833.belarusian: "Дзякуй... Сёння я даведаўся пра сябе сёе-тое новае". (Скончыць.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B839.english: Don't leave us hanging like that, man. Open yourself to the experiences of the world, expand your consciousness. With amphetamines.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B839.polish: No nie zostawiaj nas w takim stanie, stary. Otwórz się na doświadczenie świata, poszerz swoją świadomość. Najlepiej amfetaminą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B839.belarusian: Не абломвай нас так, чалавеча. Адкрыйся насустрач новаму досведу, пашыр сваю свядомасць. Амфетамінамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B841.english: Oh baby, that's not what you have to worry about. Worry about the important thing!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B841.polish: Och, słoneczko, nie tym powinieneś się martwić. Jest jedna ważniejsza rzecz!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B841.belarusian: Ой, малеча, не пра тое ты хвалюешся. Хвалюйся пра галоўнае!

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B84F.english: "I didn't know I had to do that." She looks puzzled.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B84F.polish: „Nie wiedziałam, że tak trzeba” – wygląda na zdziwioną.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B84F.belarusian: "Я не ведала, што так трэба". Яна выглядае збянтэжанай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B885.english: "Yes! I stand in this spot all the time." She sways back and forth on her feet.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B885.polish: „Tak! Zawsze stoję w tym miejscu” – kołysze się w przód i w tył.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B885.belarusian: "Так! Я ўвесь час тут стаю". Яна пагойдваецца з нагі на нагу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B897.english: "I don't really like this detective-deduction game anymore..." (Conclude.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B897.polish: „Przestała mi się już podobać ta zabawa w dedukcję...” (Zakończ).
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B897.belarusian: "Мне ўжо неяк не падабаецца гэтая гульня ў дэтэктыўную дэдукцыю..." (Скончыць.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B89F.english: She gives you a rather concerned look. "I guess we can change the subject, sir. I didn't mean to bring you down."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B89F.polish: Spogląda na ciebie pełnym zaniepokojenia wzrokiem. „To może zmieńmy temat, psze pana. Nie chciałam pana zdołować”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B89F.belarusian: Яна глядзіць на цябе даволі занепакоена. "Думаю, мы можам змяніць тэму, спадар. Я не хацела вас засмучаць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8A6.english: "I'm a detective. I deduce that... You are very small."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8A6.polish: „Jestem detektywem. Wydedukowałem, że... jesteś bardzo mała”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8A6.belarusian: "Я дэтэктыў. Я раблю выснову, што... ты вельмі маленькая".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8AD.english: "Come on, don't be silly. That's not a proper deduction." She rolls her eyes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8AD.polish: „Proszę się nie wygłupiać. To nie jest żadna dedukcja” – przewraca oczami.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8AD.belarusian: "Ды ладна вам, не дурыце галавы. Гэта не сапраўдная дэдукцыя". Яна закочвае вочы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8C7.english: She gazes at the image of Dick Mullen, frowning. "Nooo, he's wicked smart in the stories."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8C7.polish: Wpatruje się w obrazek Dicka Mullena, marszcząc czoło. „Nie, w książkach jest diabelnie sprytny”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8C7.belarusian: Яна ўглядаецца ў выяву Дзіка Муллена, насупіўшыся. "Не-е-е, у кнігах ён страшэнна разумны".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8CD.english: She looks at the cover illustration and frowns. "That's a bit childish..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8CD.polish: Przygląda się ilustracji na okładce i marszczy brwi. „To dość dziecinne...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8CD.belarusian: Яна глядзіць на малюнак на вокладцы і хмурыцца. "Гэта неяк па-дзіцячы..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8D3.english: "Isn't that very dangerous?" She examines the picture of Dick Mullen.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8D3.polish: „To chyba bardzo niebezpieczne, prawda?” – studiuje ilustrację przedstawiającą Dicka Mullena.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8D3.belarusian: "Хіба гэта не вельмі небяспечна?" Яна разглядае малюнак Дзіка Муллена.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8D8.english: She examines the illustration of Dick Mullen, attempting to find his soul. "I'm not sure I understand..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8D8.polish: Studiuje ilustrację Dicka Mullena, próbując dojrzeć w niej jego duszę. „Chyba nie rozumiem...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8D8.belarusian: Яна разглядае ілюстрацыю з Дзікам Мулленам, спрабуючы адшукаць ягоную душу. "Я не ўпэўненая, што разумею..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8FE.english: "Sure you can, sir." She smiles mischievously. "He's just a fictional character, he'll be no match for you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8FE.polish: „No pewnie, psze pana” – uśmiecha się zadziornie. „To tylko zmyślona postać, z panem nie ma szans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B8FE.belarusian: "Вядома, спадар", — хітра ўсміхаецца яна. — "Ён жа проста выдуманы персанаж, ён вам не супернік".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B906.english: "Sure you could, sir." She smiles mischievously. "He's just a fictional character, he's no match for your strength."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B906.polish: „No pewnie, psze pana” – uśmiecha się zadziornie. „To tylko zmyślona postać, nigdy nie dorówna pana sile”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B906.belarusian: "Вядома, спадар", — хітра ўсміхаецца яна. — "Ён жа проста выдуманы персанаж, яму далёка да вашай сілы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B90E.english: "Sure he can't, sir." She smiles mischievously. "He's just a fictional character, he's no match for you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B90E.polish: „Ma się rozumieć, psze pana” – uśmiecha się zadziornie. „To tylko zmyślona postać, z panem nie ma szans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B90E.belarusian: "Вядома, не пацягне, спадар", — хітра ўсміхаецца яна. — "Ён жа проста выдуманы персанаж, ён вам не супернік".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B91B.english: "Of course not, sir." She smiles mischievously. "He's just a fictional character, he'll be no match for you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B91B.polish: „Się wie, psze pana” – uśmiecha się zadziornie. „To tylko zmyślona postać, z panem nie ma szans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B91B.belarusian: "Вядома ж, не, спадар", — хітра ўсміхаецца яна. — "Ён жа проста выдуманы персанаж, ён вам не супернік".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B923.english: "In the eyes of a kid, maybe. The difference between me and Mullen is vast. He's nothing!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B923.polish: „W oczach dziecka może tak. Różnica między mną a Mullenem jest ogromna. On jest nikim!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B923.belarusian: "У вачах дзіцяці, можа, і так. Але розніца паміж мной і Мулленам каласальная. Ён ніхто!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B92A.english: "Sure, when the author does all the thinking for him. Real policemen have to think and act on their own."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B92A.polish: „Jasne, kiedy to autor myśli za niego. Prawdziwi policjanci muszą myśleć i działać sami”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B92A.belarusian: "Вядома, калі аўтар думае за яго. Сапраўдныя паліцыянты мусяць думаць і дзеяць самі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B930.english: "Policemen live and breathe danger, little girl. Mullen obviously lacks the *chameleonic* skill."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B930.polish: „Policjanci żyją i oddychają zagrożeniem, dziecko. Mullenowi brakuje tych zdolności godnych *kameleona*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B930.belarusian: "Паліцыянты жывуць і дыхаюць небяспекай, дзяўчынка. Муллену відавочна не хапае здольнасці *хамелеона*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B936.english: "A policeman's gotta have *the right stuff*. An ingrained sense of The Law. No one would follow a weakling like Mullen."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B936.polish: „Policjant musi mieć *to coś*. Wszczepione w duszę wyczucie prawa. Nikt nie słuchałby takiego słabeusza jak Mullen”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B936.belarusian: "Паліцыянт павінен мець *той самы стрыжань*. Прыроднае пачуццё Закону. За такім слабым чалавекам, як Муллен, ніхто б не пайшоў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B93E.english: "Unlike you, sir." She smiles mischievously. "He's just a fictional character, he's no match for you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B93E.polish: „Ale pan to co innego” – uśmiecha się zadziornie. „To tylko zmyślona postać, z panem nie ma szans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B93E.belarusian: "Не тое што вам, спадар", — хітра ўсміхаецца яна. — "Ён жа проста выдуманы персанаж, ён вам не супернік".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B944.english: "If you say so, sir." She smiles mischievously. "He's just a fictional character, he's no match for your... *soul*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B944.polish: „Skoro pan tak mówi” – uśmiecha się zadziornie. „To tylko zmyślona postać, nie ma szans z pana... *duszą*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B944.belarusian: "Калі вы так кажаце, спадар", — хітра ўсміхаецца яна. — "Ён жа проста выдуманы персанаж, ён не супернік вашай... *душы*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B94A.english: "Like you, sir, of course." She smiles mischievously. "He's just a fictional character, he's no match for you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B94A.polish: „Czyli tak jak pan” – uśmiecha się zadziornie. „To tylko zmyślona postać, z panem nie ma szans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B94A.belarusian: "Як вы, спадар, вядома", — хітра ўсміхаецца яна. — "Ён жа проста выдуманы персанаж, ён вам не супернік".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B95F.english: "If you say so, sir." She smiles mischievously. "He's just a fictional character, he's no match for you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B95F.polish: „Skoro pan tak mówi” – uśmiecha się zadziornie. „To tylko zmyślona postać, z panem nie ma szans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B95F.belarusian: "Калі вы так кажаце, спадар", — хітра ўсміхаецца яна. — "Ён жа проста выдуманы персанаж, ён вам не супернік".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B969.english: Her eyes shine with sympathy. "Cheer up, sir. No need to compare yourself to a fictional character."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B969.polish: Jej oczy wypełniają się współczuciem. „Proszę się rozchmurzyć. Nie ma co się porównywać z wymyśloną postacią”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B969.belarusian: Яе вочы свецяцца спачуваннем. "Павесялейце, спадар. Не трэба параўноўваць сябе з выдуманым персанажам".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B96F.english: She looks at you with sympathy. "Cheer up, sir. It's much easier being a fictional character, he doesn't have to deal with... real things."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B96F.polish: Patrzy na ciebie ze współczuciem. „Proszę się rozchmurzyć. Wymyślonym bohaterom jest łatwiej. Nie mają na głowie... prawdziwych problemów”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B96F.belarusian: Яна спагадліва глядзіць на цябе. "Павесялейце, спадар. Выдуманым героям нашмат прасцей, ім не трэба сутыкацца з... рэальнымі рэчамі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B976.english: "Maybe you can show me some *real* deductive police work, sir? Like in the books!" Her smile is warm and consoling, unlike the imperial image of Dick Mullen.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B976.polish: „Pokaże mi pan, jak wygląda *prawdziwa* dedukcja policyjna? Tak jak w książkach!” – jej uśmiech jest ciepły i krzepiący, to przeciwieństwo posągowego wizerunku Dicka Mullena.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B976.belarusian: "Можа, пакажаце мне *сапраўдную* дэдукцыйную паліцэйскую працу, спадар? Як у кнігах!" Яе ўсмешка цёплая і суцяшальная, зусім не падобная да велічнай выявы Дзіка Муллена.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B985.english: "I don't really want to DEAL with this. It's too much."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B985.polish: „Nie chcę się teraz tym zajmować. To dla mnie za dużo”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B985.belarusian: "Я насамрэч не хачу з гэтым РАЗБІРАЦЦА. Гэта занадта".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B98B.english: She looks at you with sympathy. "We can talk about something else if you want. Something nicer."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B98B.polish: Spogląda na ciebie ze współczuciem. „Jak pan chce, możemy porozmawiać o czymś innym. O czymś przyjemniejszym”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B98B.belarusian: Яна глядзіць на цябе са спачуваннем. "Калі хочаце, мы можам пагаварыць пра нешта іншае. Пра нешта больш прыемнае".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B994.english: "There's the mind... and there's *the mind*, if you catch my drift."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B994.polish: „Jest umysł i *umysł*. Mam nadzieję, że rozumiesz”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B994.belarusian: "Ёсць розум... а ёсць *Розум*, калі ты разумееш, да чаго я хілю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B99B.polish: „Uch, chyba nie do końca, psze pana”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9A2.english: "See, that's what reading those fakey-fake Mullen books gets you. Now you're dealing with a real cop."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9A2.polish: „Widzisz, tyle właśnie ci dały te oszukańcze książki o Mullenie. A teraz masz do czynienia z prawdziwym gliniarzem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9A2.belarusian: "Вось бачыш, да чаго даводзіць чытанне гэтых ліпавых кніжак пра Муллена. Цяпер ты маеш справу з сапраўдным копам".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9A9.english: "Yes, sir." She smiles mischievously. "He's just a fictional character, I understand. He's no match for you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9A9.polish: „Tak, psze pana” – uśmiecha się zadziornie. „To tylko zmyślona postać, rozumiem. Z panem nie ma szans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9A9.belarusian: "Так, спадар", — хітра ўсміхаецца яна. — "Ён жа проста выдуманы персанаж, я разумею. Ён вам не супернік".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9B1.english: "Actually, I... I... I'm sorry... I can't deduce anything.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9B1.polish: „Właściwie, to... to... przepraszam, ale... nie umiem niczego wydedukować”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9B1.belarusian: "Насамрэч я... я... прабач... я нічога не магу вывесці".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9B8.english: A small disappointment rolls over her, but she promptly gets over it and says: "It's okay, sir."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9B8.polish: Szybko rozprawia się z tym przypływem rozczarowania i mówi: „Nic nie szkodzi, psze pana”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9B8.belarusian: Яе ахоплівае лёгкае расчараванне, але яна хутка спраўляецца з ім і кажа: "Усё добра, спадар".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9C0.english: You disappointed a small child. Well done, champ.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9C0.polish: Rozczarowałeś małą dziewczynkę. Świetna robota, stary.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9C0.belarusian: Ты расчараваў малое дзіця. Выдатная праца, чэмпіён.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9CB.english: "So I can absorb their *essence*. All their fame will flow into me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9CB.polish: „Żebym mógł wchłonąć ich *esencję*. Cała ich sława przejdzie na mnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9CB.belarusian: "Каб я мог увабраць іхнюю *сутнасць*. Уся іхняя слава пяройдзе да мяне".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9D2.english: "I don't think that's how fame works, sir..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9D2.polish: „Sława chyba tak nie działa, psze pana...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9D2.belarusian: "Я не думаю, што слава так працуе, спадар..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9DD.english: "Because it's the nature of the powerful to exploit the weak."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9DD.belarusian: "Бо такая натура тых, хто мае ўладу — выціскаць усё са слабых".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9E5.english: There must be an economic reason for this.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9E5.polish: Musi być jakaś ekonomiczna przyczyna tego stanu rzeczy.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9F3.english: "No, it's too much. I don't want to say that to a little girl."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9F3.polish: „Nie, to przesada. Nie chcę mówić takich rzeczy małej dziewczynce”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9F3.belarusian: "Не, гэта ўжо занадта. Не хачу казаць такое малой дзяўчынцы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9FA.english: Psst! You forgot the subterfuge. You're saying this out loud.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9FA.polish: Psst! Zapomniałeś o milczeniu. Gadasz na głos.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000B9FA.belarusian: Псс! Ты забыўся на канспірацыю. Ты кажаш гэта ўслых.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA00.english: She raises her eyebrows. "Say what, sir?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA17.english: The lieutenant stands by -- looking at the two of you with little interest.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA17.polish: Porucznik stoi w pobliżu i przygląda się waszej dwójce z niewielkim zainteresowaniem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA17.belarusian: Лейтэнант стаіць побач, пазіраючы на вас абодвух амаль без цікавасці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA1D.english: A façade of true professionalism. He is far more intrigued by the situation than his poise reveals.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA1D.polish: Fasada prawdziwego profesjonalizmu. Jest o wiele bardziej zaintrygowany tą sytuacją, niż wskazywałaby jego powierzchowność.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA1D.belarusian: Фасад сапраўднага прафесіяналізму. Гэтая сітуацыя інтрыгуе яго значна больш, чым выдае ягоная стрыманасць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA2B.english: "Yeah, I can see. You don't have party eyes anymore."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA2B.polish: „Tak, widzę. Nie ma pan już imprezowych oczu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA2B.belarusian: "Так, я бачу. У вас больш няма тых тусовачных вачэй".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA38.english: The lieutenant slowly -- ever so slowly -- realizes something. "Party eyes. Yes, of course. That makes sense."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA38.polish: Porucznik powoli – bardzo powoli – coś sobie uświadamia. „Imprezowe oczy. Tak, oczywiście. To ma sens”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA38.belarusian: Лейтэнант павольна — надта павольна — нешта ўсведамляе. "Тусовачныя вочы. Так, вядома. Гэта ўсё тлумачыць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA3F.english: I'm not surprised children have seen you running around with *party eyes* on, he thinks. Not at all.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA3F.polish: Nie jestem zdziwiony, że dzieci widziały cię biegającego po okolicy z *imprezowymi oczami* – myśli. Ani trochę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA3F.belarusian: Я не здзіўлены, што дзеці бачылі, як ты бегаеш з *тусовачнымі вачыма*, — думае ён. — Анікроплі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA92.english: What are you missing here? Why does this feel familiar?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA92.polish: Co tu jest nie halo? Czemu wydaje mi się to znajome?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BA92.belarusian: Што тут не так? Чаму гэта здаецца знаёмым?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAB2.english: Because you know each other. She's been talking to you so openly because you've talked before.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAB2.polish: Bo się znacie. Rozmawia z tobą tak otwarcie, bo robiła to już wcześniej.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAB2.belarusian: Бо вы знаёмыя. Яна размаўляе з табой так адкрыта, бо вы ўжо гаварылі раней.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAC3.english: "I am also sad and my head hurts."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAC3.polish: „Jestem też smutny i boli mnie głowa”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAC3.belarusian: "А яшчэ мне сумна і баліць галава".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAC9.english: "I'm sorry, sir. I hope things get better soon." She looks you in the eye, a gleam of sympathy on her face.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAC9.polish: „Przykro mi, psze pana. Mam nadzieję, że wszystko się ułoży” – gdy patrzy ci w oczy, na jej twarzy maluje się współczucie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAC9.belarusian: "Мне шкада, спадар. Спадзяюся, хутка ўсё наладзіцца". Яна глядзіць табе ў вочы, на яе твары праступае спачуванне.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAD0.english: The lieutenant does not flinch at the comment. He does not flinch even a single bit. He is intensely not flinching. It takes effort.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAD0.polish: Porucznik nawet nie drgnął, słysząc ten komentarz. Nie drgnął nawet odrobinę. Skupia całą swoją wolę, aby nie drgać. Wymaga to od niego wysiłku.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAD0.belarusian: Лейтэнант нават вокам не міргнуў на гэтую рэпліку. Нават на мікраскапічную драбніцу не здрыгануўся. Ён з усіх сіл напружваецца, каб не выдаць ніводнага руху. Гэта патрабуе высілкаў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAE4.english: There she stands, swaying on her feet, assaulted by the early spring breeze. She smiles at you. The whole situation suddenly feels familiar, somehow.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAE4.polish: I tak stoi, kołysząc się na stopach, napastowana przez podmuchy wczesnowiosennego wiatru. Uśmiecha się do ciebie. Nagle cała ta scena wydaje ci się dziwnie znajoma.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BAE4.belarusian: Вось яна стаіць, перамінаючыся з нагі на нагу пад парывамі ранневясновага ветрыка. Яна ўсміхаецца табе. Уся гэтая сцэна раптам здаецца дзіўна знаёмай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB0D.english: "Nothing, forget it. Dick Mullen sucks, is what I meant."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB0D.polish: „Nic, nieważne. Dick Mullen jest do kitu. To chciałem powiedzieć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB0D.belarusian: "Нічога, забудзь. Дзік Муллен — адстой, вось што я меў на ўвазе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB13.english: "You don't have to be, sir." She smiles mischievously. "He's just a fictional character, he's no match for you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB13.polish: „I dobrze, psze pana” – uśmiecha się zadziornie. „To tylko zmyślona postać, z panem nie ma szans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB13.belarusian: "І не павінен, спадар", — хітра ўсміхаецца яна. — "Ён жа проста выдуманы персанаж, ён вам не супернік".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB1A.english: "Never you mind. Either way, I'm not impressed with this Mullen guy."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB1A.polish: „Nic takiego. Tak czy inaczej, ten cały Mullen nie robi na mnie wrażenia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB1A.belarusian: "Не звяртай увагі. У кожным разе, гэты хлопец Муллен мяне не ўражвае".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB23.english: "Of course, sir." She smiles mischievously. "He's just a fictional character, he's no match for you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB23.polish: „Ma pan rację” – uśmiecha się zadziornie. „To tylko zmyślona postać, z panem nie ma szans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB23.belarusian: "Вядома, спадар", — хітра ўсміхаецца яна. — "Ён жа проста выдуманы персанаж, ён вам не супернік".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB68.english: "Actually, I'd rather not deduce anything. Every time I deduce people get hurt."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB68.polish: „Właściwie to wolałbym niczego nie dedukować. Zawsze, kiedy to robię, komuś dzieje się krzywda”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000BB68.belarusian: "Насамрэч я б лепш нічога не высноўваў. Кожны раз, калі я раблю высновы, камусьці робіцца балюча".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00011D8D.english: "I can't get into the Doomed Commercial Area. Your mother won't let me through the back door."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00011D8D.polish: „Nie mogę dostać się do Zgubionej Strefy Handlowej. Twoja matka nie chce mnie wpuścić tylnymi drzwiami”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00011D8D.belarusian: "Я не магу патрапіць у праклятую гандлёвую зону. Твая маці не пускае мяне праз чорны ход".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00011D92.english: "Hey, guess what. I found a way into the Doomed Commercial Area."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00011D92.polish: „Hej, wiesz co? Znalazłem wejście do Zgubionej Strefy Handlowej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00011D92.belarusian: "Гэй, угадай што. Я знайшоў шлях у гандлёвую зону".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000004F6.english: "Mhm. Mum can get really agitated about that." She sways on her feet. "I guess you can try making her less afraid somehow... then she might trust you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000004F6.polish: „Mhm. Mama potrafi się o to bardzo zeźlić” – kołysze się w miejscu. „Może zrobi pan coś, żeby się mniej bała... i wtedy panu zaufa”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000004F6.belarusian: "Мгм. Мама праз гэта моцна нервуецца". Яна пагойдваецца на нагах. "Думаю, можна неяк паспрабаваць зрабіць так, каб яна менш баялася... тады яна, можа, і паверыць вам".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00000502.english: "Oh, that's great!" Her smile is warm. "I hope exciting adventures lie ahead! And maybe you can help mother become... less afraid."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00000502.polish: „O, to super!” – od jej uśmiechu bije ciepło. „Mam nadzieję, że czekają tam niezwykłe przygody! I może zrobi pan coś, żeby mama... mniej się bała”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00000502.belarusian: "О, гэта цудоўна!" Яе ўсмешка цёплая. "Спадзяюся, наперадзе вас чакаюць захапляльныя прыгоды! І, можа, вы дапаможаце маме... менш баяцца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003049.english: "I'm sorry, sir, I can't talk right now. I'm very busy with my homework... I have so much homework now."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003049.polish: „Przepraszam pana, nie mogę teraz rozmawiać. Jestem bardzo zajęta pracą domową... Strasznie dużo nam zadają”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003049.belarusian: "Прабачце, спадар, я зараз не магу размаўляць. Я вельмі занятая ўрокамі... Мне цяпер столькі ўсяго задаюць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000304E.english: "Hi, ace detective." She smiles warmly. "Are you here for more books?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000304E.polish: „Czołem, superdetektywie” – uśmiecha się ciepło. „Przychodzi pan po więcej książek?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000304E.belarusian: "Прывітанне, найлепшы дэтэктыў!" Яна цёпла ўсміхаецца. "Вы па новыя кнігі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003058.english: "Hello, sir. How is the investigation going? Found any *cuuurses* yet?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003058.polish: „O, to pan. Jak śledztwo? Znalazł pan już jakieś *kląąątwy*?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003058.belarusian: "Вітаю, спадар. Як там расследаванне? Ужо знайшлі якія-небудзь *пракляяяцці*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000305E.english: "Is it okay if I ask you some questions?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003064.english: "Okay, sir. I'll try to answer any questions you have. I hope they're about books."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003064.polish: „Dobrze, psze pana. Spróbuję pomóc. Mam nadzieję, że to pytania o książki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003064.belarusian: "Добра, спадар. Я паспрабую адказаць на любыя вашы пытанні. Спадзяюся, яны пра кнігі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000307A.english: "Hello again, sir! Are you interested in a new and exciting book this time?" She sways slowly on her feet.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000307A.polish: „To pan. Zapraszamy! Chciałby pan tym razem kupić nową, wciągającą książkę?” – kołysze się z wolna na stopach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000307A.belarusian: "І зноў вітаю, спадар! Можа, гэтым разам вас зацікавіць новая захапляльная кніга?" Яна павольна пагойдваецца з нагі на нагу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003098.english: "Yes, people get that you are *the law*. You really don't have to keep saying it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003098.polish: „Tak, ludzie wiedzą, że jesteś *prawem*. Naprawdę nie musisz tego ciągle powtarzać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003098.belarusian: "Так, людзі разумеюць, што вы — *закон*. Вам сапраўды не трэба казаць гэта кожны раз".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000030A3.english: "Everyone understands you're *the law*. That's why you have that insignia on your arm. So you don't have to keep saying it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000030A3.polish: „Wszyscy rozumieją, że jesteś *prawem*. To dlatego masz insygnia na ramieniu. Więc nie musisz tego ciągle powtarzać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000030A3.belarusian: "Усе разумеюць, што вы — *закон*. Менавіта таму ў вас на рукаве гэтыя знакі. Каб не паўтараць гэта кожны раз".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003508.english: Pfft... books? Postcards? Easy! Even a kid would know all of this.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003508.polish: Pff. Książki? Pocztówki? Łatwizna! Nawet dzieci wiedzą takie rzeczy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003508.belarusian: Пфф... кнігі? Паштоўкі? Элементарна! Нават дзіця ўсё гэта ведае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000351A.english: "Little girl, I know what a book is. Books are like very long letters, with stories inside them."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000351A.polish: „Dziecko, wiem, czym jest książka. To jak taki bardzo długi list, w którym są różne historyjki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000351A.belarusian: "Дзяўчынка, я ведаю, што такое кніга. Кнігі — гэта як вельмі доўгія лісты з гісторыямі ўнутры".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003ABC.english: Nah, it feels inappropriate to lecture this girl.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003ABC.polish: Nie, prawienie kazań tej dziewczynce nie wydaje się słuszne.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003ABC.belarusian: Не, неяк няёмка чытаць маралі гэтай дзяўчынцы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003AC2.polish: „Tak!” – przytakuje z uśmiechem. „To są właśnie książki”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003AD3.english: "Sir? Are you okay?" Her voice suddenly reaches your mind. "You've been standing here silently for a while now..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003AD3.polish: „Psze pana? Wszystko w porządku?” – jej głos przebija się nagle do twojej świadomości. „Długo pan tak stoi bez słowa...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003AD3.belarusian: "Спадар? З вамі ўсё добра?" Яе голас раптам прабіваецца да тваёй свядомасці. "Вы ўжо даволі доўга моўчкі тут стаіце..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003AE1.english: I said I know all of these things and I do, god dammit.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003AE1.polish: Jak powiedziałem, że to wiem, to wiem, do cholery.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003AE1.belarusian: Я сказаў, што ведаю ўсё гэта, і я сапраўды ведаю, чорт пабяры.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003AF2.english: "Sir? Are you okay?" Her voice suddenly reaches your mind. "You've been standing here silently for a while now..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003AF2.polish: „Psze pana? Wszystko w porządku?” – jej głos przebija się nagle do twojej świadomości. „Długo pan tu tak stoi bez słowa...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003AF2.belarusian: "Спадар? З вамі ўсё добра?" Яе голас раптам прабіваецца да тваёй свядомасці. "Вы ўжо даволі доўга моўчкі тут стаіце..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003AF8.english: Don't tell me what to do.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003AF8.polish: Nie mów mi, co mam robić.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003AFE.english: Hey now, I already made up my mind.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B04.english: Don't be a fool -- as an expert, it's your duty to tell what you know to everyone.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B04.polish: Nie bądź głupi. Twoim obowiązkiem jako eksperta jest opowiadać wszystkim, co wiesz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B04.belarusian: Не будзь дурнем — твой абавязак як эксперта распавядаць усім тое, што ведаеш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B21.english: "I also know what a postcard is... it's a small cardboard picture that you can send to a friend or a loved one."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B21.polish: „Wiem też, czym jest pocztówka. To taki mały kartonikowy obrazek, który możesz wysłać przyjacielowi albo komuś, kogo kochasz”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B21.belarusian: "Я таксама ведаю, што такое паштоўка... гэта невялікі кардонны малюнак, які можна адправіць сябру ці каханаму чалавеку".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B27.english: "Mhm mhm. You've got it, sir. What about board games?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B27.polish: „Mhm, mhm. Dobrze pan mówi. A planszówki?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B27.belarusian: "Мгм-мгм. Вы маеце рацыю, спадар. А як наконт настольных гульняў?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B2C.english: "Who cares about board games? No one."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B31.english: "The police don't have time for games."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B37.english: "Okay, sir. This was all very... *enlightening*. Can I help you with anything else?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B37.polish: „No dobrze, psze pana. To było bardzo... *pouczające*. Mogę jeszcze w czymś pomóc?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B37.belarusian: "Добра, спадар. Гэта было вельмі... *павучальна*. Магу яшчэ чымсьці вам дапамагчы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B46.english: "Alright, I think that was enough. I have proven myself."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B46.polish: „No dobra, chyba wystarczy. Pokazałem, co umiem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B46.belarusian: "Добра, думаю, гэтага дастаткова. Я давёў, што ведаю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B54.english: "If you say so, sir. Can I help you with anything else?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B54.polish: „Skoro pan tak twierdzi. Mogę jeszcze w czymś pomóc?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B54.belarusian: "Як скажаце, спадар. Магу яшчэ чымсьці вам дапамагчы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B63.english: "I like playing games... with peoples' minds."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003B63.belarusian: "Я люблю гуляць у гульні... з розумам людзей".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005102.english: "Every snowflake is like a little gift from the sky." She shivers as one falls on her nose.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005102.polish: „Każdy płatek śniegu to jak drobny upominek od nieba”. Przechodzi ją dreszcz, gdy jeden spada jej prosto na nos.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005102.belarusian: "Кожная сняжынка — быццам маленькі падарунак ад неба". Яна здрыгваецца, калі адна падае ёй на нос.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000524B.english: "That's very good to hear." She flicks you a thumbs up. "You'll get to the bottom of this in no time! Just like a detective in the stories."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000524B.polish: „Bardzo się cieszę” – unosi kciuk. „Raz-dwa pan to rozwiąże! Jak detektyw z kryminałów”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000524B.belarusian: "Вельмі прыемна чуць". Яна паказвае вялікі палец уверх. "Вы хутка дакапаецеся да праўды! Проста як дэтэктыў у кнігах".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000525D.english: "Oh, that's very sad to hear." She frowns. "But it'll pick up soon, don't worry. There's always a... bad spot in the stories, right before the detective figures things out."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000525D.polish: „Przykro mi” – zasępia się. „Ale pan się nie martwi, na pewno zaraz ruszy z kopyta. W kryminałach detektyw zawsze jest w kropce, a potem wpada na rozwiązanie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000525D.belarusian: "Ой, вельмі шкада". Яна хмурыцца. "Але хутка ўсё наладзіцца, не хвалюйцеся. У кнігах заўсёды бывае такі... цяжкі момант, якраз перад тым, як дэтэктыў ва ўсім разбярэцца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005265.english: "Yeah, I found a way into the Doomed Commercial Area."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005265.polish: „Tak, znalazłem wejście do Zgubionej Strefy Handlowej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005265.belarusian: "Так, я знайшоў шлях у праклятую гандлёвую зону".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000526B.english: "Oh, that's great!" Her smile is warm. "I hope exciting adventures lie ahead! And maybe you can help mother become... less afraid."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000526B.polish: „O, to super!” – od jej uśmiechu bije ciepło. „Mam nadzieję, że czekają tam niezwykłe przygody! I może zrobi pan coś, żeby mama... mniej się bała”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000526B.belarusian: "О, выдатна!" Яна цёпла ўсміхаецца. "Спадзяюся, наперадзе вас чакаюць захапляльныя прыгоды! І, можа, вы зможаце зрабіць так, каб мама... менш баялася".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005289.english: "The lights are so pretty when it gets dark." She scans the surrounding buildings, a happy look on her face.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005289.polish: „Światła są takie piękne, kiedy robi się ciemno” – z radosną miną omiata wzrokiem pobliskie budynki.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005289.belarusian: "Агні такія прыгожыя, калі цямнее". Яна з радасным выразам твару аглядае навакольныя будынкі.
