Dialogue Text/0x0100007000003196.english: Then why does all of this feel like some sad, strange dream?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000003196.polish: Więc czemu czujesz się jak w jakimś smutnym, dziwnym śnie?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000003196.belarusian: Тады чаму ўсё гэта здаецца нейкім сумным, дзіўным сном?

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006528.english: "Little girl, help. My Dick Mullen book ripped before I could get to the end. Do you know what happens?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006528.polish: „Dziecko, pomóż mi! Moja książka o Dicku Mullenie podarła się, zanim zdążyłem doczytać. Wiesz, co się dzieje na końcu?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006528.belarusian: "Дзяўчынка, дапамажы. Мая кніга пра Дзіка Муллена парвалася раней, чым я дачытаў да канца. Ты ведаеш, чым усё скончылася?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006544.english: "Oh..." She frowns. "I'm very sorry, sir. I haven't read that one yet. I wish I could help you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006544.polish: „Och...” – pochmurnieje. „Bardzo mi przykro. Tej jeszcze nie czytałam. Szkoda, że nie mogę pomóc”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006544.belarusian: "Ой..." Яна хмурыцца. "Мне вельмі шкада, спадар. Я гэтую яшчэ не чытала. Хацела б я вам дапамагчы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000BF3.english: "Your mother told me about the curse, but she wouldn't let me investigate."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000BF3.polish: „Twoja mama powiedziała mi o klątwie, ale nie pozwala mi się jej przyjrzeć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000BF3.belarusian: "Твая маці расказала мне пра праклён, але не дазволіла правесці расследаванне".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000BF9.english: "I'm currently investigating the curse on your mother's behalf."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000BF9.polish: „Przyglądam się tej klątwie na prośbę twojej mamy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000BF9.belarusian: "Я цяпер якраз расследую гэтае праклён па просьбе тваёй маці".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C00.english: "Yes, she can be quite strict about it." Annette nods. "My mum doesn't let anyone sneak around in the back rooms or the cellar."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C00.polish: „Tak, potrafi być bardzo stanowcza, jeśli o to chodzi” – przyznaje Annette. „Mama nikomu nie pozwala myszkować po zapleczu ani w piwnicy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C00.belarusian: "Так, яна можа быць даволі строгай наконт гэтага", — ківае Анэта. — "Мама нікому не дазваляе шнырыць па падсобках ці ў склепе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C0E.english: "I've been in this house and you're right, there's an awful lot of failed businesses there."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C0E.polish: „Byłem w budynku i faktycznie – bardzo tam dużo różnych zamkniętych firm”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C0E.belarusian: "Я быў у гэтым будынку, і ты маеш рацыю — там процьма прагарэлых бізнесаў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C13.english: Annette's eyes go wide: "She let you in there? Usually she doesn't let anyone sneak around in the back rooms or the cellar."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C13.polish: Annette robi wielkie oczy. „Wpuściła tam pana? Zazwyczaj nikomu nie pozwala myszkować po zapleczu ani w piwnicy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C13.belarusian: Вочы Анэты акругляюцца: "Яна вас туды ўпусціла? Звычайна яна нікому не дазваляе шнырыць па падсобках ці ў склепе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C1C.english: "I hope you can help her. Help her become less afraid or something..." She looks at her freezing hands, before hiding them in her coat sleeves.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C1C.polish: „Mam nadzieję, że jej pan pomoże. Żeby nie bała się tak bardzo czegoś...” – ogląda swoje skostniałe dłonie, po czym wsuwa je w rękawy kurtki.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C1C.belarusian: "Спадзяюся, вы зможаце ёй дапамагчы. Зрабіць так, каб яна менш баялася ці нешта такое..." Яна глядзіць на свае змерзлыя рукі, а потым хавае іх у рукавы паліто.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C25.english: "You've been there?" Her eyes go wide. "My mum never lets me sneak around in the back room or the cellar!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C25.polish: „Był pan tam?” – robi wielkie oczy. „Mama nigdy mi nie pozwala myszkować po zapleczu ani w piwnicy!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C25.belarusian: "Вы там былі?" Яе вочы акругляюцца. "Мама ніколі не дазваляе мне шнырыць па падсобцы ці ў склепе!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C2C.english: "This must have been really scary..." She looks at her freezing hands, before hiding them in her coat sleeves.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C2C.polish: „To musiało być naprawdę straszne...” – ogląda swoje skostniałe dłonie, po czym wsuwa je w rękawy kurtki.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000C2C.belarusian: "Гэта, напэўна, было вельмі страшна..." Яна глядзіць на свае змерзлыя рукі, а потым хавае іх у рукавы паліто.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F58.english: "Math..." She looks into her notebook with trepidation. "It's really difficult. Like -- really. They say you need it to get rich. Better than standing outside in the cold, I guess."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F58.polish: „Matmę...” – z nieskrywaną niechęcią zagląda do zeszytu. „Jest bardzo trudna. Ale tak naprawdę bardzo. Podobno trzeba ją umieć, żeby być bogatym. To chyba i tak lepsze od stania na mrozie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F58.belarusian: "Матэматыкай..." Яна з бояссю зазірае ў свой сшытак. "Яна вельмі цяжкая. Ну вось проста жудасна. Кажуць, трэба яе ведаць, каб разбагацець. Напэўна, гэта лепш, чым стаяць на марозе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F5D.english: "Oh, oh...!" Suddenly, she smiles and perks up. "I found something while you were away."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F5D.polish: „Ach!...” – uśmiecha się nagle, odzyskując animusz. „Znalazłam coś, kiedy pana nie było”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F5D.belarusian: "О, о...!" Раптам яна ўсміхаецца і ажыўляецца: "Я тут сёе-тое знайшла, пакуль вас не было".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F6C.english: "Maybe? It's the hat Dick Mullen wears all the time..." She grins with joy. "You'll look way more serious with that."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F6C.polish: „No może... Dick Mullen zawsze nosi taką czapkę...” – uśmiecha się rozradowana. „Będzie pan w niej wyglądał dużo poważniej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F6C.belarusian: "Можа быць? Гэта капялюш, які Дзік Муллен увесь час носіць..." Яна радасна ўсміхаецца. "У ім вы будзеце выглядаць значна салідней".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F71.english: "Yes! Just like the one Dick Mullen wears all the time..." She grins. "You'll look way more serious with that."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F71.polish: „Tak! Taka sama jak ta, którą zawsze nosi Dick Mullen...” – szczerzy się do ciebie. „Będzie pan w niej wyglądał dużo poważniej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F71.belarusian: "Так! Сапраўды такі, як Дзік Муллен заўсёды носіць..." Яна шчэрыцца: "У ім вы будзеце выглядаць значна салідней".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F97.english: "I thought this would fit you... Like thanks for helping out! Not me -- the city I mean. Like a detective does." She gives you a hat -- almost exactly like the one Dick Mullen wears on the covers.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F97.polish: „Pomyślałam sobie, że będzie panu pasowała... W nagrodę za pana pomoc! To znaczy, nie mnie – miastu. Jak prawdziwy detektyw” – podaje ci czapkę, prawie taką samą jak ta, w której Dick Mullen pozuje na okładkach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003F97.belarusian: "Падумала, што гэта вам падыдзе... Ну, як падзяка за дапамогу! То бок не мне — гораду. Як сапраўднаму дэтэктыву". Яна працягвае табе капялюш — амаль такі самы, які Дзік Муллен носіць на вокладках.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003FB0.english: "Okay, I get it. I can look just like Dick Mullen -- except I'm an actual police officer."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003FB0.polish: „Dobra, rozumiem. Mogę wyglądać tak jak Dick Mullen. Tyle że jestem prawdziwym policjantem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003FB0.belarusian: "Добра, я зразумеў. Я магу выглядаць толька-ў-тольк як Дзік Муллен — хіба што я сапраўдны афіцэр паліцыі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003FB7.english: "Yes!" She grins. "I bet it looks good on you. Really serious."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003FB7.polish: „Tak!” – szczerzy się w uśmiechu. „Na pewno będzie panu w niej do twarzy. Tak poważnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003FB7.belarusian: "Так!" Яна шчэрыцца: "Упэўненая, ён вам пасуе. Выглядае вельмі салідна".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003FC0.english: "Right. I have to get back to my homework now, before Mum notices. Man, this is *hard*..." She looks back at the infernal scribblings under her nose.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003FC0.polish: „No tak, muszę wracać do lekcji, zanim mama zauważy. Jeny, ale to *trudne*...” – patrzy na swoje zapiski z piekła rodem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900003FC0.belarusian: "Так. Цяпер мне трэба вяртацца да ўрокаў, пакуль мама не заўважыла. Божа, як жа гэта *цяжка*..." Яна зноў глядзіць на пякельныя крэмзлі перад сваім носам.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060000919D.english: "Say, child... *you* wouldn't happen to know a good fridge, would you?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000060000919D.polish: „A posłuchaj... może *ty* wiesz przypadkiem, czy nie znajdę tu gdzieś porządnej lodówki?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060000919D.belarusian: "Слухай, дзіця... *ты* выпадкова не ведаеш, дзе знайсці добры халадзільнік?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000091B1.english: "Yes. Like a big, big fridge a cop could put a dead body into."
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000091B1.polish: „Tak. Takiej bardzo dużej lodówki, do której policjant mógłby wsadzić ciało”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000091B1.belarusian: "Так. Такі вялікі-вялікі халадзільнік, куды паліцыянт мог бы запхаць труп."

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000091B7.english: "Hah!" She smiles. "You mean like the ice bear fridge? Man, that's scary."
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000091B7.polish: „Ha!” – uśmiecha się. „To znaczy takiej jak ta lodowoniedźwiedzia? O rany, straszne rzeczy”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000091B7.belarusian: "Ха!" Яна ўсміхаецца. "Вы пра той халадзільнік з ледзянога мядзведзя? Жах, які ён страшны."

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000091D5.english: "Yes. Like a bear, but white. There's a fridge below the building, in the basement." She points underground. "With red glowing eyes. I went back there once. Behind the bookstore..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000091D5.polish: „Tak. Bo to jest niedźwiedź, tylko biały. I jest lodówką, tu pod tym budynkiem, w piwnicy” – wskazuje palcem na dół. „I on ma takie czerwone świecące ślepia. Byłam tam raz. Za księgarnią...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000091D5.belarusian: "Так. Як мядзведзь, толькі белы. Тут пад будынкам, у склепе, ёсць такі халадзільнік", — паказвае яна пальцам уніз. — "І вочы ў яго свецяцца чырвоным. Я аднойчы туды хадзіла. За кнігарню..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000091E0.english: She lowers her voice. "Mum doesn't want me to go there anymore. Not that I want to. It was pretty scary.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000091E0.polish: Ścisza głos. „Mama nie chce, żebym tam więcej chodziła. I tak bym nie poszła. Strasznie było”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000091E0.belarusian: Яна сцішвае голас: "Мама не хоча, каб я туды больш хадзіла. Ды я і сама не хачу. Было вельмі страшна".

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000091E9.polish: „I to tam jest ta duża lodówka?”

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020DD.english: "I can't understand how I didn't notice a giant ice bear fridge myself..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020DD.polish: „Nie rozumiem, jakim cudem nie zauważyłem tam wielkiej niedźwiedziej lodówki...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020DD.belarusian: "Не разумею, як я сам мог не заўважыць гіганцкі халадзільнік з ледзянога мядзведзя..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020E3.english: "One more thing. How do I get inside the building?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020E3.polish: „Jeszcze jedno. Jak mogę się dostać do budynku?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020E3.belarusian: "І яшчэ адно. Як мне трапіць у будынак?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020E9.english: "One more thing. How do I get inside the building? I already talked to your mom, but she's not letting anyone in."
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020E9.polish: „Jeszcze jedno. Jak mogę się dostać do budynku? Rozmawiałem już z twoją mamą, ale nikogo tam nie wpuszcza”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020E9.belarusian: "І яшчэ адно. Як мне трапіць у будынак? Я ўжо гаварыў з тваёй мамай, але яна нікога не пускае".

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020EF.english: The girl shrugs cheerfully: "Well, it is pretty dark in there..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020EF.polish: Dziewczynka wesoło wzrusza ramionami: „Ciemno tam jest...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020EF.belarusian: Дзяўчынка весела паціскае плячыма: "Ну, там жа вельмі цёмна..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020F8.english: "Um... that's a problem. The only way in is through the bookstore, but my mum is pretty strict about not letting anyone in."
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020F8.polish: „Ee... to będzie problem. Jedyna droga prowadzi przez księgarnię, a moja mama bardzo pilnuje, żeby nikt tam nie wchodził”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020F8.belarusian: "Эм... гэта праблема. Адзіны шлях — праз кнігарню, а мая мама вельмі строга сочыць, каб ніхто туды не заходзіў".

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020FF.english: "But, I don't know, you're a *police man*..." She says it with admiration, eyeing you up and down. "Maybe you can convince her somehow?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020FF.polish: „Ale, no nie wiem, pan jest *policjantem*” – mówi to z podziwem w głosie, mierząc cię wzrokiem z góry na dół. „Może ją pan jakoś przekona”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000020FF.belarusian: "Але, не ведаю, вы ж *паліцыянт*..." — кажа яна з захапленнем, аглядаючы цябе з ног да галавы. — "Можа, вам удасца яе неяк пераканаць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002107.english: "Um... she can be pretty strict, you're right about that. I don't really know what to say. You could try sneaking in?" She smiles shyly, like she's not sure it's the right answer.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002107.polish: „Ee... potrafi być stanowcza, ma pan rację. Nie wiem, co powiedzieć. Może spróbuje się pan zakraść?” – uśmiecha się nieśmiało, jakby nie była pewna, czy to właściwa odpowiedź.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002107.belarusian: "Эм... яна бывае вельмі строгай, гэта праўда. Нават не ведаю, што сказаць. Можаце паспрабаваць пракрасціся?" Яна нясмела ўсміхаецца, нібы не ўпэўненая, ці гэта добры адказ.

Dialogue Text/0x010000050000210E.english: "I'm sorry, sir, I really don't know."

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000027F5.english: "Uh..." She doesn't know what to say.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002D000001A0.english: "Anyway..." She looks around again, her nose red from the cold.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002D000001A0.polish: „Tak czy siak...” – znów się rozgląda, kręcąc poczerwieniałym z zimna nosem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002D000001A0.belarusian: "У кожным разе..." Яна зноў азіраецца, яе нос пачырванеў ад сцюжы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600018295.english: "You don't look much like a policeman." She examines you, as if to find something policeman-like.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600018295.polish: „Nie wygląda pan na policjanta” – patrzy na ciebie badawczo, jakby w poszukiwaniu czegoś bezsprzecznie policyjnego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600018295.belarusian: "Вы не надта падобныя на паліцыянта", — яна разглядае цябе, нібы шукаючы хоць штосьці паліцэйскае.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001829E.english: "Huh, well what does a cop look like then?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001829E.polish: „Hm? A jak w takim razie wygląda policjant?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001829E.belarusian: "Хм, ну і як тады выглядае коп?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182A9.english: What could you do to help her anyway?
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182A9.polish: Co mógłbyś zrobić, żeby mimo to jakoś jej pomóc?
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182A9.belarusian: Ды і што ты ўвогуле можаш зрабіць, каб ёй дапамагчы?

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182BA.english: Did someone say *sneak around in the cellar*? We should do that.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182BA.polish: Czy ktoś powiedział coś o *myszkowaniu po piwnicy*? To bardzo dobra myśl.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182BA.belarusian: Хтосьці сказаў *пашнырыць у склепе*? Гэта варта зрабіць.

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182CA.english: "I guess, yes. People in books are always very interesting. Especially the romance-people."
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182CA.polish: „No chyba. Ludzie w książkach zawsze są bardzo ciekawi. Szczególnie ci z romansów”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182CA.belarusian: "Напэўна, так. Людзі ў кнігах заўсёды вельмі цікавыя. Асабліва людзі з раманаў".

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182D9.english: "Sometimes they break up for a little while, but then they always get back together."
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182D9.polish: „Czasem na chwilę się rozstają, ale w końcu zawsze do siebie wracają”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182D9.belarusian: "Часам яны расстаюцца на нейкі час, але потым заўсёды вяртаюцца адно да аднаго".

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182E5.english: "Why can't you help me? I'm beyond help, right?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182E5.polish: „Czemu nie możesz mi pomóc? Pewnie nic się już nie da zrobić, co?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182E5.belarusian: "Чаму ты не можаш мне дапамагчы? Мне ўжо нічым не дапаможаш, так?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182FE.english: What *was* that? An idea for an unfinished novel stuck somewhere in your fore-brain?
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182FE.polish: Co to *było*? Pomysł na nieukończoną powieść, który utknął ci gdzieś w płacie czołowym?
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000182FE.belarusian: Што гэта *было*? Ідэя для няскончанага рамана, якая засела недзе ў пярэднім мозгу?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600018304.english: You clearly have issues you need to address.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600018304.polish: Ewidentnie masz ze sobą problemy, którymi powinieneś się zająć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600018304.belarusian: У цябе відавочныя праблемы, з якімі трэба разабрацца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001830D.english: Later when you get the chance, you should address these issues -- by getting *drunk*. That'll show them!
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001830D.polish: Jak później będziesz miał chwilę, zajmij się tymi problemami – *upij się*! To im wszystkim pokaże!
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001830D.belarusian: Пазней, калі будзе магчымасць, варта разабрацца з гэтымі праблемамі — *напіўшыся*. Гэта ім пакажа!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019A50.english: There's more that can be achieved here. Ask her to do the same.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019A50.polish: Możesz tu jeszcze coś osiągnąć. Poproś ją, żeby zrobiła to samo.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019A50.belarusian: Тут можна дасягнуць большага. Папрасі яе зрабіць тое самае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019A59.english: You have absolutely no idea. Familiar how? You must have forgotten something you heard again.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019A59.polish: Nie masz zielonego pojęcia. W jaki sposób znajome? Musiałeś znowu zapomnieć coś, co już kiedyś słyszałeś.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019A59.belarusian: Ты не маеш ні найменшага паняцця. У якім сэнсе знаёмае? Ты, напэўна, зноў забыўся пра тое, што недзе чуў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019A69.english: The swivelling eyes of a loony drug addict. That is what she meant. You were probably gurning too.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019A69.polish: Rozbiegane oczy szurniętego narkomana. To miała na myśli. Pewnie miałeś też tiki.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019A69.belarusian: Шалёна разбеганыя вочы наркамана-псіха. Вось што яна мела на ўвазе. І моршчыўся ты, напэўна, не менш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019A73.english: "I'm glad I could help you, sir." She smiles a wide, helpful smile.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019A73.polish: „Cieszę się, że pomogłam, psze pana” – na jej twarzy rozlewa się szeroki, pełen życzliwości uśmiech.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019A73.belarusian: "Рада, што змагла дапамагчы, спадар". Яна шырока і ветліва ўсміхаецца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019B65.english: Out of the rain and into the gutter.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019B7D.english: "Just what Dick Mullen would ask!" She lowers her voice. "I got it from behind the curtains. I'm not really supposed to go there..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019B7D.polish: „Tak samo zapytałby Dick Mullen!” – ścisza głos. „Był za zasłonami. Nie wolno mi tam chodzić...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600019B7D.belarusian: "Якраз тое, што спытаў бы Дзік Муллен!" Яна сцішвае голас: "Я дастала яго з-за фіранак. Наогул мне нельга туды хадзіць..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB3D.english: "Yes! I used to stand out there all the time, before mother told me to focus on my homework."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB3D.polish: „Tak! Stałam tam bez przerwy, póki mama nie kazała mi przyłożyć się do lekcji”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB3D.belarusian: "Так! Я ўвесь час тут стаяла, пакуль мама не сказала рабіць урокі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB4D.english: "No, you don't have party eyes anymore."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB4D.polish: „Nie, nie ma pan już imprezowych oczu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB4D.belarusian: "Не, у вас больш няма тых тусовачных вачэй".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB64.english: Good thing she's didn't say PARTY EYES loud, her mother's nearby...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB64.polish: Dobrze, że nie powiedziała o tych *imprezowych oczach* głośniej. Jej matka jest niedaleko...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001AB64.belarusian: Добра, што яна не сказала ТУСОВАЧНЫЯ ВОЧЫ ўслых, маці ж побач...

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013646.english: "You don't need to be worried. I'm here to help."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013646.polish: „Nie musisz się martwić. Przyszedłem, żeby pomóc”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013646.belarusian: "Табе не трэба хвалявацца. Я тут, каб дапамагчы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001364E.english: She sighs -- not relieved, but resigned. "No," she says. "You're right..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001364E.polish: Wzdycha, nie z ulgą, a raczej kapitulując. „Nie” – odpowiada. „Ma pan rację...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001364E.belarusian: Яна ўздыхае — без палёгкі, хутчэй пакорліва. "Не", — кажа яна. — "Вы маеце рацыю..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000137B.english: "Y'r ded to me, y'hear y'r DEAD!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000137B.belarusian: „Не шыецца для мяне, зусім не шыецца!”

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00001388.english: "I's hard you know... It's j'st so hard sometimes... (hic)."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00001388.polish: „Tak trudno... Czasem jest tak trudno... Czk...”

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000138E.english: "I'm scum, just a scummy ol' scum..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00005022.english: "I work hard, I play hard... *Nobody* works harder!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00005022.polish: „Pracuję na całego i bawię się na całego... *Nikt* nie pracuje ciężej!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00005022.belarusian: "Працую на поўную, гуляю на поўную... *Ніхто* не працуе цяжэй!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000502D.english: "All I got I built with my bare hands..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000502D.belarusian: "Усё, што маю, я збудаваў уласнымі рукамі..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00005540.english: "They don't know me... no one *knows* me... (hic)."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00005540.polish: „Oni mnie nie znają... Nikt mnie nie *zna*... Czk...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00005540.belarusian: "Яны мяне не ведаюць... ніхто мяне не *ведае*... (ік)."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002C51.english: "I'm a scum, just a scummy ol' scum..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002C58.english: "MY MISSUS! She be better without me..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002C58.polish: „MOJA KOCHANA! Będzie jej lepiej beze mnie...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002C58.belarusian: «МАЯ КАХАНАЯ! Ёй будзе лепш без мяне...»

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002C6A.english: "I don't deserve 'er, I don't deserve anybody..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002C6A.polish: „Nie zasługuję na nią. Na nikogo nie zasługuję...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002C6A.belarusian: "Я не варты яе, я нікога не варты..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002C71.english: "I make my own way, t's all. Always have, always will."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002C71.polish: „Chodzę swoją drogą i tyle. Zawsze tak było i zawsze będzie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002C71.belarusian: "Я іду сваім шляхам, і ўсё. Заўсёды так было і заўсёды будзе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A18.english: "And can you describe me their appearance? Any features that stand out, something to make identifying a little easier?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A18.polish: „A może mi pani opisać ich wygląd? Wszelkie cechy szczególne, coś, co ułatwiłoby ich rozpoznanie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A18.belarusian: "А вы можаце апісаць іх знешнасць? Нейкія асаблівыя прыкметы, каб было прасцей апазнаць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A2A.english: "Why do you need to know this? Haven't I repeatedly told you that they are not missing? That they're in Jamrock, safe and well, at some stupid party."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A2A.polish: „Po co to panu? Ile razy mam powtarzać, że one nie zaginęły? Że są w Jamrock, całe i zdrowe na jakiejś głupiej imprezie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A2A.belarusian: "Навошта вам гэта ведаць? Хіба я не паўтарала, што яны не знікалі? Што яны ў Джэмроку, жывыя і здаровыя, на нейкай дурной вечарыне."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A42.english: "I could do with a party.. A *killer* party, not a lame-o one!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A42.polish: „Impreza to by mi się przydała. *Zabójcza* impreza, nie jakaś lamerska!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A42.belarusian: "Мне б не зашкодзіла вечарына... *Адпадная* вечарына, а не нейкі адстой!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A48.english: "It's for the investigation. I'm trying to be professional."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A48.polish: „To na potrzeby śledztwa. Staram się być profesjonalistą”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A48.belarusian: "Гэта для следства. Я спрабую быць прафесіяналам."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A4E.english: "A 'killer' party? What is it with you and *pulp* staples? My god. Please, no more talk about my daughters. They are fine!" She picks up a book and tries to concentrate. A flock of seabirds passes by.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A4E.polish: „»Zabójcza impreza«? Musi być pan taki *sztampowy*? Dobry boże. Błagam, nie mówmy już o moich córkach. Nic im nie jest!” – podnosi książkę i próbuje się na niej skupić. W pobliżu przelatuje stado morskich ptaków.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003A4E.belarusian: ""Адпадная" вечарына? Што ў вас за цяга да гэтых *бульварных* клішэ? Божа мой. Калі ласка, хопіць пра маіх дачок. З імі ўсё добра!" Яна бярэ кнігу і спрабуе засяродзіцца. Побач пралятае чарада марскіх птушак.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003AAD.english: "Report what? He's just out, drinking with his friends... I'm sure the police has better things to do than to chase down local goofballs."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003AAD.polish: „Co miałabym zgłaszać? Po prostu pije gdzieś z kumplami... Policja na pewno ma ważniejsze sprawy na głowie, niż uganianie się za miejscowymi przygłupami”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003AAD.belarusian: "Заяву пра што? Ён проста недзе п'е з сябрамі... Я ўпэўнена, што ў паліцыі ёсць больш важныя справы, чым ганяцца за мясцовымі прыдуркамі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003AB9.english: "Ma'am, just to be completely clear -- do you want to report it to the police?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003AB9.polish: „Proszę pani, chciałbym się upewnić – czy chce pani zgłosić zaginięcie męża?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003AB9.belarusian: "Пані, проста каб цалкам высветліць: вы хочаце падаць заяву ў паліцыю?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003AE7.english: "There is no *investigation* here, I can tell you that!" She picks up a book and tries to concentrate. A flock of seabirds passes by.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003AE7.polish: „Nie ma żadnego *śledztwa*, mówię to panu!” – podnosi książkę i próbuje się na niej skupić. W pobliżu przelatuje stado morskich ptaków.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003AE7.belarusian: "Няма тут ніякага *следства*, я вам дакладна кажу!" Яна бярэ кнігу і спрабуе засяродзіцца. Побач пралятае чарада марскіх птушак.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003B7E.english: "I wouldn't be so sure," he replies, before turning to face the working class woman.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003B7E.polish: „Nie byłbym tego taki pewien” – odpowiada, po czym przenosi spojrzenie na kobietę z klasy robotniczej.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003B7E.belarusian: "Я не быў бы такі ўпэўнены", — адказвае ён і паварочваецца да жанчыны з рабочага класа.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003BE2.english: No, please. I don't really want to remember.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003BE2.polish: Nie, proszę. Nie chcę sobie tego przypominać.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003BE2.belarusian: Не, калі ласка. Я не вельмі хачу гэта памятаць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003C06.english: "Honestly, not that different from you." She eyes you from head to toe.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003C06.polish: „Szczerze mówiąc, niewiele się od pana różni” – odpowiada, przyglądając ci się od góry do dołu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003C06.belarusian: "Шчыра кажучы, не надта іначай, чым вы." Яна аглядае цябе з ног да галавы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003C50.english: "Are you a police man or a nanny?" She's definitely disturbed by now.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003C50.polish: „Jest pan policjantem czy niańką?” – jest zdecydowanie poruszona.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003C50.belarusian: "Вы паліцыянт ці нянька?" Яна ўжо выразна ўстрывожаная.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003C65.english: "So you *are* going to look for him?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D02.english: "I don't mean to disrespect, sir, but *you* are being a bit of a cockatoo here."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D02.polish: „Z całym szacunkiem, ale to *pan* zachowuje się trochę jak kakadu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D02.belarusian: "Не хачу пакрыўдзіць, пане, але *вы* самі тут паводзіцеся як какаду."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D20.english: "Right around the corner. He has pissed himself."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D20.polish: „Tuż za rogiem. Urżnął się w trupa”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D32.english: "Protect and serve, madam! I found your husband."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D32.polish: „Służyć i chronić, proszę pani! Znalazłem pani męża”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D32.belarusian: "Служыць і абараняць, пані! Я знайшоў вашага мужа."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D38.english: "There." (Point to the working class drunk down near the sea.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D38.belarusian: "Вунь там." (Паказаць на п'янага пралетарыя каля мора.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D3E.english: "Mhm. You're welcome." She reverts her attention back to the book stand.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D3E.polish: „Mhm. Nie ma za co” – wraca do przeglądania książek.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D3E.belarusian: "Мгм. Няма за што." Яна зноў вяртаецца да стэлажа з кнігамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D44.english: "Very well, then. Where is he?" She's getting impatient, her hands now picking on a random book cover.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D44.polish: „No dobrze. Gdzie on jest?” – zaczyna się niecierpliwić. Jej dłonie błądzą po losowych okładkach książek.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D44.belarusian: "Ну добра. Дзе ён?" Яна пачынае нецярпелівіцца, пальцамі мацаючы выпадковую вокладку кнігі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D52.english: "And I specifically added that I didn't *need* to know where he was."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D52.polish: „Wyraźnie też dodałam, że *nie chcę* wiedzieć, gdzie jest”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D52.belarusian: "І я выразна дадала, што мне і *не трэба* ведаць, дзе ён."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D7B.english: "That's all for the moment. I'll let you read." [Leave.]
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D7B.polish: „To na razie wszystko. Pozwolę pani dalej czytać”. [Odejdź].
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D7B.belarusian: "На гэтым пакуль усё. Не буду перашкаджаць вам чытаць." [Сысці.]

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D8D.english: "Yes, but..." She looks around and takes a deep breath, a little annoyed. "I don't really need to know where my husband is. Not all the time."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D8D.polish: „Tak, ale...” – lekko zirytowana rozgląda się wokół i bierze głęboki wdech. „Naprawdę nie muszę wiedzieć, gdzie jest mój mąż. Nie przez cały czas”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D8D.belarusian: "Так, але..." Яна азіраецца і робіць глыбокі ўдых, трохі раздражнёная. "Мне і не трэба ведаць, дзе мой муж. Не ўвесь жа час."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D93.english: "But you said you didn't know where he was."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D93.polish: „Ale mówiła pani, że nie wie pani, gdzie on jest”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003D93.belarusian: "Але вы казалі, што не ведаеце, дзе ён."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003DE9.english: "No. Absolutely not." Her words come out quick as gunshots.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003DE9.polish: „Nie. Absolutnie nie” – wypowiada te słowa z szybkością karabinu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003DE9.belarusian: "Не. Катэгарычна не." Яе словы вылятаюць хутка, як стрэлы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003DF5.english: "Hello." She nods, her attention fully focused on reading.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003DF5.polish: „Witam” – odpowiada, kiwając głową. Jej uwagę pochłania czytana książka.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003DF5.belarusian: "Добры дзень." Яна ківае, цалкам пагружаная ў чытанне.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003E07.english: "Shouldn't a working class woman be working?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003E07.polish: „Czy kobieta z klasy robotniczej nie powinna pracować?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003E07.belarusian: "Хіба жанчына з рабочага класа не павінна працаваць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003E1F.english: "Me?" She looks up briefly. "No one, I'm just a working class woman."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003E1F.polish: „Ja?” – spogląda na ciebie krótko. „Nikim, zwykłą kobietą z klasy robotniczej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003E1F.belarusian: "Я?" Яна ненадоўга падымае вочы. "Ніхто, я проста жанчына з рабочага класа."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003E48.english: "That's one way to put it, yes. No offence. I'd also add that he's a little bit chubby."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003E48.polish: „Tak też to można ująć, tak. Bez obrazy. Chciałabym też dodać, że jest pulchny”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003E48.belarusian: "Можна і так сказаць, так. Без крыўдаў. Я б яшчэ дадала, што ён трохі таўсцячок."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003E70.english: "Not all the time. Right now I'm browsing books." She pauses. "Even a working class woman needs something to read."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003E70.polish: „Nie przez cały czas. W tej chwili przeglądam książki” – mówi, po czym na chwilę przerywa. „Nawet przedstawicielka klasy robotniczej potrzebuje czegoś do czytania”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003E70.belarusian: "Не ўвесь жа час. Зараз я праглядаю кнігі." Яна робіць паўзу. "Нават жанчыне з рабочага класа трэба нешта чытаць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003EA5.english: "What with?" She tries hard to focus on the book stand.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003EA5.polish: „Z czym?” – pyta, próbując skupić się na książkach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003EA5.belarusian: "З чым?" Яна з усіх сіл спрабуе засяродзіцца на кніжным стэлажы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003EAB.english: "Everyone can see that. The rectangles." He points to his sleeve.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003EAB.polish: „Wszyscy to widzą. Prostokąty” – wskazuje na swój rękaw.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003EAB.belarusian: "Усе гэта бачаць. Прамавугольнікі." Ён паказвае на свой рукаў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003EB1.english: "Do you need the help of a policeman?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003EBD.english: "Mhm." She reverts her attention to the soggy books on the book stand.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003EBD.belarusian: "Мгм." Яна зноў звяртае ўвагу на вільготныя кнігі на стэлажы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003ED3.english: "You're right, let's not talk about your daughters. I don't know what got into me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003ED3.polish: „Ma pani rację, nie rozmawiajmy o pani córkach. Nie wiem, co we mnie wstąpiło”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003ED3.belarusian: "Вы маеце рацыю, давайце не будзем пра вашых дачок. Не ведаю, што на мяне найшло."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003ED9.polish: „Słucham?!” – pyta, mrugając. „Nic z tego nie rozumiem”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F1E.english: Intimacy? It's a catastrophe waiting in the wings.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F1E.polish: Intymność? To czekająca na swój moment katastrofa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F1E.belarusian: Інтымнасць? Гэта катастрофа, якая толькі і чакае свайго часу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F24.english: "Hey, I hug whomever I please! I'm a hug monster."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F24.polish: „Hej, będę przytulał, kogo chcę! Jestem przytulasowym potworem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F24.belarusian: "Гэй, я абдымаю каго хачу! Я — монстр абдымкаў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F2A.english: "I am fighting for the working class."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F4A.english: "I don't know, at home now? Out drinking with his friends? Working?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F4A.polish: „Nie wiem, w domu? Może pije gdzieś z kumplami? Albo jest w pracy?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F4A.belarusian: "Не ведаю, можа, ужо дома? П'е дзесьці з сябрамі? На працы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F56.english: "Is there anything else I can help you with?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F56.belarusian: "Ці магу я яшчэ чымсьці вам дапамагчы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F5C.english: "So what I'm hearing is: you don't really *know* where your husband is."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F5C.polish: „Czyli mówi mi pani, że *nie wie* pani tak właściwie, gdzie jest pani mąż”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F5C.belarusian: "Значыць, выходзіць так: вы насамрэч *не ведаеце*, дзе ваш муж."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F74.english: I wonder how long has it been since you last hugged someone?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F74.polish: Tak się zastanawiam – ile czasu minęło, od kiedy kogoś ostatnio przytulałeś?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F74.belarusian: Цікава, колькі часу мінула з таго часу, як ты апошні раз кагосьці абдымаў?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F8B.english: "It's okay. We all feel out of sorts at times." She starts patting your back. "There you go, officer."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F8B.polish: „Nic się nie stało. Wszyscy czujemy się czasem nieswojo” – zaczyna poklepywać cię po plecach. „Już w porządku, panie policjancie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F8B.belarusian: "Усё добра. Мы ўсе часам адчуваем сябе не ў сваёй талерцы." Яна пачынае паляпваць цябе па спіне. "Вось так, афіцэру."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F9D.english: "I had the strangest... I'm not even sure."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003F9D.belarusian: "У мяне здарылася самае дзіўнае... Я нават не ўпэўнены."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003FA9.english: "God damn it, I already told you -- my husband isn't missing!" She crosses her arms.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003FA9.polish: „Na litość boską, przecież już mówiłam, że mój mąż nie zaginął!” – zakłada ręce na piersiach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003FA9.belarusian: "Чорт пабяры, я ж ужо казала — мой муж не знікаў!" Яна складвае рукі на грудзях.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003FB5.english: So tell me, how does it feel -- to be close to someone, skin to skin?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003FB5.polish: To powiedz, jak to jest, czuć czyjąś skórę na swojej?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00003FB5.belarusian: Дык скажы мне, як гэта — быць блізка да кагосьці, скура да скуры?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004004.english: "Police? I don't follow." She narrows her eyes, trying to understand.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004004.polish: „Z policją? Nie rozumiem” – mruży oczy, próbując odnaleźć w tym jakiś sens.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004004.belarusian: "З паліцыяй? Не разумею." Яна прыжмурваецца, спрабуючы зразумець.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000400A.english: "The fuckupatoo. It's the one who always fucks everything up."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000400A.polish: „Zjebadu. To ta, która zawsze musi wszystko zjebać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000400A.belarusian: "Праябаду. Гэта тое, якое заўсёды ўсё праябвае."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004072.english: "No. But I am an officer of the law and you have just insulted my work uniform."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004072.polish: „Nie. Ale jestem funkcjonariuszem porządku, a pani właśnie obraziła mój mundur”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004072.belarusian: "Не. Але я праваахоўнік, а вы толькі што абразілі маю форму."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004080.english: "Oh, thank god, no!" She nearly begins to laugh. "It hasn't come down to *this* yet."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004080.polish: „Och, dzięki bogu nie!” – odpowiada, wybuchając niemal śmiechem. „Do *tego* jeszcze nie doszło”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004080.belarusian: "Ой, дзякуй богу, не!" Яна ледзь не смяецца. "Да *такога* яшчэ не дайшло."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000040B0.english: Hold on! Did she just laugh at your disco pants? You're not going to leave it there, are you?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000040B0.polish: Zaraz! Czy ona właśnie wyśmiała twoje disco portki? Chyba tego tak nie zostawisz, co?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000040B0.belarusian: Хвіліначку! Яна толькі што высмеяла твае дыска-штаны? Ты ж гэтага так не пакінеш, праўда?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000040F4.english: "No, no!" Her eyes widen at your misunderstanding. "He is definitely not a cop. I meant that he's a little chubby, that's all."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000040F4.polish: „Nie, nie!” – zaprzecza, a jej oczy rozszerzają się na myśl o tym nieporozumieniu. „Zdecydowanie nie jest policjantem. Miałam na myśli, że jest pulchny, to wszystko”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000040F4.belarusian: "Не, не!" Яе вочы акругляюцца ад твайго непаразумення. "Ён дакладна не коп. Я мела на ўвазе, што ён трохі таўсцячок, вось і ўсё."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000040FA.polish: „Dobrze. Czyli mamy do czynienia z policjantem”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000410C.english: Technically speaking, your trousers could be considered part of your work gear. This means she has insulted *the police*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000410C.polish: Będąc drobiazgowym, można uznać, że twoje spodnie to część twojego munduru. A to znaczy, że właśnie obraziła *policję*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000410C.belarusian: Строга кажучы, твае нагавіцы можна лічыць часткай службовай формы. Гэта азначае, што яна абразіла *паліцыю*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004117.english: "I don't know, the most talkative one?" She's ready to put that question aside.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004117.polish: „Czy ja wiem? Najbardziej gadatliwą?” Jest gotowa, by mieć to pytanie za sobą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004117.belarusian: "Не ведаю, самае балбатлівае?" Яна гатовая хутчэй замяць гэтае пытанне.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004135.english: "Wow, ma'am! Do we have a *problem* here?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004135.polish: „No, proszę pani! Czy my mamy tu jakiś *problem*?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004140.english: "I'm not *chubby* and neither is your husband. What you meant to say is that we both share a *Franconigerian hard-body*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004140.polish: „Nie jestem *pulchny* i pani mąż też nie. Chciała pani powiedzieć, że mamy obaj wspaniałe *frankonigeryjskie ciała*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004140.belarusian: "Я не *таўсцячок*, і ваш муж таксама. Вы мелі на ўвазе, што ў нас абодвух *франканігерыйскае дужае цела*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000415E.polish: „Czyli jak alkoholik w późnym stadium choroby”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000041C6.english: "No, no..." she backs off, "my relationship with disco remains irrefutably healthy."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000041C6.polish: „Nie, nie...” – wycofuje się. „Moje relacje z disco pozostają nieodmiennie zdrowe”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000041C6.belarusian: "Не, не..." — яна адступае, — "мае адносіны з дыска застаюцца бясспрэчна здаровымі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000041DE.english: "Oh, no! That's not what I meant!" She takes a step back.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000041DE.polish: „O nie! Nie to miałam na myśli!” – zapewnia i robi krok w tył.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000041DE.belarusian: "О не! Я не гэта мела на ўвазе!" Яна робіць крок назад.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004203.english: Keep your eyes closed for a brief longer.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004203.polish: Nie otwieraj oczu jeszcze przez krótką chwilę.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004209.english: "You had the strangest what?" She hasn't let go of your embrace.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004209.polish: „Co takiego pan miał?” – pyta, wciąż pozostając w twoich objęciach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004209.belarusian: "Самае дзіўнае што?" Яна ўсё яшчэ не вызвалілася з тваіх абдымкаў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004226.english: Less talk, more feeling. Keep your eyes closed, soak in the closeness. See what the feeling entails.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004226.polish: Mniej gadania, więcej odczuwania. Nie otwieraj oczu, napawaj się bliskością. Myśl, co niesie to uczucie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004226.belarusian: Менш слоў, больш пачуццяў. Не расплюшчвай вачэй, убірай гэтую блізкасць. Паглядзі, што нясе гэтае пачуццё.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000423E.english: It all comes together now. I was built to be close with other beings.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000423E.polish: Wszystko składa się w całość. Powstałem, aby być blisko innych istot.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000423E.belarusian: Цяпер усё сыходзіцца. Я быў створаны, каб быць блізкім з іншымі істотамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000424A.english: She seems to be confused. Your hands are wrapped around her polyester coat. The fabric feels cold, moist from the sea nearby.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000424A.polish: Jest zdezorientowana. Twoje ręce obejmują jej poliestrowy płaszcz. Materiał jest zimny w dotyku i wilgotny od morskiej bryzy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000424A.belarusian: Яна выглядае разгубленай. Твае рукі абдымаюць яе паліто з поліэстру. Тканіна здаецца халоднай, вільготнай ад блізкага мора.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004268.english: The woman looks baffled by your personal revelation. "You truly are one *strange* cop, aren't you?" she says, slowly shaking her head.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004268.polish: Kobieta wygląda na zaskoczoną twoimi osobistymi wynurzeniami. „Rzeczywiście jest pan *dziwnym* policjantem, prawda?” – stwierdza, powoli kręcąc głową.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004268.belarusian: Жанчына выглядае збітай з панталыку тваім асабістым адкрыццём. "Вы сапраўды *дзіўны* коп, ці не так?" — кажа яна, павольна хістаючы галавой.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000426E.english: "Mhm, I see. Thanks." She tries to read again.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000426E.polish: „Mhm, rozumiem. Dzięki” – odpowiada i próbuje wrócić do czytania.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000426E.belarusian: "Мгм, зразумела. Дзякуй." Яна зноў спрабуе чытаць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004279.english: "The Major Majestic cockatoo. It's the most impressive one."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004285.english: "The funeral cockatoo. It's the most depressing one."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004291.english: "The bang-bang cockatoo. It's the most common one."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004297.english: "What if something awful has happened... what if they're in the sewers."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004297.polish: „A co jeśli stało się coś okropnego... i są teraz w kanałach?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004297.belarusian: "А што, калі здарылася нешта жудаснае... што, калі яны ў каналізацыі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004497.english: An array of neurons fires up with joy. Bum her a cigarette -- lest it turn to pain.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004497.polish: Twoje neurony aktywują się radośnie. Wysęp od niej papierosa, zanim euforia zmieni się w ból.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004497.belarusian: Шэраг нейронаў успыхвае радасцю. Страляй у яе цыгарэту — пакуль радасць не змянілася болем.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044A9.english: "It's the kind of place where everyone does."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044A9.polish: „To typ miejsca, w którym palą wszyscy”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044B5.english: "From the kiosk? There's one near the harbour, it's a Frittte. You can look it up."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044B5.polish: „W kiosku? W pobliżu portu jest jeden – to Frittte. Niech go pan poszuka”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044B5.belarusian: "У шапіку? Каля порта ёсць адзін — гэта Frittte. Можаце праверыць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044BB.english: "Do you know where I could get a new pack?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044BB.polish: „Wie pani, gdzie mogę kupić nową paczkę?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044BB.belarusian: "Ці ведаеце вы, дзе я магу дастаць новы пачак?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044C7.english: "You're right, we do smoke worse than chimneys here."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044C7.polish: „Ma pan rację, kopcimy tutaj gorzej niż kominy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044C7.belarusian: "Вы маеце рацыю, мы тут смалім горш за коміны."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044CF.english: "Why do you think that I smoke?" She looks up, slightly startled.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044CF.polish: „Skąd to przekonanie, że palę?” – podnosi wzrok, lekko przestraszona.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044CF.belarusian: "Чаму вы думаеце, што я куру?" Яна падымае позірк, трохі здзіўленая.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044E6.english: "Sorry, officer?" She stares at you in disbelief.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044E6.polish: „Co proszę, panie policjancie?” – przygląda ci się z niedowierzaniem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044E6.belarusian: "Што, прабачце, афіцэру?" Яна глядзіць на цябе з недаверам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044EC.english: "Just gimme your cigarettes, okay? Don't lie."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044EC.polish: „Po prostu proszę mi dać papierosy, dobra? A nie kłamać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044EC.belarusian: "Проста дайце мне свае цыгарэты, добра? Не хлусіце."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044F2.english: "I already told you -- I don't have any. Go bother someone else."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044F2.polish: „Już mówiłam, że nie mam. Niech pan znajdzie sobie kogoś innego do dokuczania”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044F2.belarusian: "Я ж ужо казала — у мяне няма. Ідзіце чапляйцеся да каго-небудзь іншага."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044F8.english: "It's not like yours look much better," she says while eyeing yours.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044F8.polish: „Pańskie nie wyglądają wcale lepiej” – odpowiada, przyglądając się im.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044F8.belarusian: "Вашы выглядаюць не надта лепш", — кажа яна, разглядаючы твае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044FE.english: "Your hands look like they belong to a heavy smoker."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000044FE.belarusian: "Вашы рукі выглядаюць так, нібы належаць заўзятай курчысе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000451C.english: "I suspect I may possess supra-natural abilities."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000451C.polish: „Tak sobie myślę, że być może posiadam nadnaturalne moce”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000451C.belarusian: "Я падазраю, што магу валодаць звышнатуральнымі здольнасцямі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004522.english: "No, you don't." She puts her hands into her coat pockets.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004522.polish: „Nie, nie posiada pan” – wkłada dłonie do kieszeni swojego płaszcza.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004522.belarusian: "Не, не валодаеце." Яна хавае рукі ў кішэні паліто.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004528.english: "I know for a fact that you smoke."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004559.english: Her hands move over the book covers. The tips of her fingers look rough, stained with yellow. It seems like she has spent a lot of time at work, smoking.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004559.polish: Jej dłonie przesuwają się po okładkach książek. Koniuszki palców są szorstkie i zżółknięte. Zdaje się, że spędza wiele czasu w pracy – paląc papierosy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004559.belarusian: Яе рукі слізгаюць па кніжных вокладках. Кончыкі пальцаў выглядаюць грубымі, з жоўтымі плямамі. Здаецца, яна правяла багата часу на працы за курэннем.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000045E5.english: "No." She looks you straight into the eye. Her right foot is tapping nervously.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000045E5.polish: „Nie” – odpowiada, patrząc ci prosto w oczy. Potupuje nerwowo prawą stopą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000045E5.belarusian: "Не." Яна глядзіць табе проста ў вочы. Яе правая нага нервова пастуквае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000045EC.english: "I can totally help you find your missing husband."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000045EC.polish: „Absolutnie mogę pani pomóc w znalezieniu zaginionego męża”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000045EC.belarusian: "Я цалкам магу дапамагчы вам знайсці вашага зніклага мужа."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000045F3.english: "Why are we still talking about this? I haven't lost my husband."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000045F3.polish: „Dlaczego pan ciągle o tym mówi? Mój mąż nie zaginął”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000045F3.belarusian: "Чаму мы ўсё яшчэ гаворым пра гэта? Я не губляла мужа."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004619.english: "It's all right to not know where your husband is. Nothing shameful in that."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004619.polish: „To nic złego, nie wiedzieć, gdzie jest pani mąż. Nie ma powodu do wstydu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004619.belarusian: "Няма нічога страшнага ў тым, каб не ведаць, дзе ваш муж. У гэтым няма нічога ганебнага."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004620.english: "Who said anything about shame? Stop talking down to me." She puts her foot down. "My husband is not missing."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004620.polish: „A kto tu mówi cokolwiek o wstydzie? Proszę przestać mówić do mnie w tym protekcjonalnym tonie” – tupie nogą. „Mój mąż nie zaginął”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004620.belarusian: "Хто наогул казаў пра ганьбу? Перастаньце размаўляць са мной звысоку." Яна тупае нагой. "Мой муж не знікаў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004662.polish: „Kiedy widziała go pani po raz ostatni?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004668.english: "Yesterday morning. He went to the library." Her eyes become cold with recollection. "He went to retrieve my book and he promised, he *promised* he'd walk straight back home."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004668.polish: „Wczoraj rano. Poszedł do biblioteki” – w jej oczach pojawia się zimny błysk, gdy sobie o tym przypomina. „Miał odebrać moją książkę i obiecał – *obiecał* mi – że wróci prosto do domu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004668.belarusian: "Учора раніцай. Ён пайшоў у бібліятэку." Яе вочы халадзеюць ад успамінаў. "Ён пайшоў забраць маю кнігу і паабяцаў, *паабяцаў*, што адразу пойдзе дадому."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000047B8.english: "Because people either show up on their own or you'll never find them," he says with a flash of teeth.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000047B8.polish: „Bo ludzie wracają do domu sami albo nie wracają wcale – i nigdy się ich nie odnajduje” – dodaje, błyskając zębami.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000047B8.belarusian: "Таму што людзі або самі вяртаюцца, або вы іх ніколі не знойдзеце", — кажа ён, бліснуўшы зубамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000047DB.english: "I'd say there's nothing mysterious about incompleteness. It's in fact rather unpleasant."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000047DB.polish: „Według mnie nie ma nic tajemniczego w niekompletności. To raczej nieprzyjemne”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000047DB.belarusian: "Я б сказаў, што ў незавершанасці няма нічога таямнічага. Насамрэч гэта даволі непрыемна."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000048E3.polish: „*Co* obaj macie?” – kobieta nic z tego nie rozumie.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000048EA.english: "*Franconigerian hard-body*. Softly round, yet still in shape. Ladies dig it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000048EA.polish: „*Frankonigeryjskie ciało*. Miękkie i krągłe, a mimo to w formie. Panie takie lubią”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000048EA.belarusian: "*Франканігерыйскае дужае цела*. Мякка-акруглае, але ў форме. Дамам падабаецца."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000048F1.english: "I'm not sure about the rest, but softly round sounds about right. He's not in great shape." She stops to think.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000048F1.polish: „Nie jestem pewna, co do reszty, ale miękkie i krągłe to by się zgadzało. Nie jest w najlepszej formie” – zamyśla się.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B000048F1.belarusian: "Наконт астатняга не ўпэўнена, але мякка-акруглае — гэта падобна да праўды. Ён не ў найлепшай форме." Яна задумваецца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004935.english: "Hmm-hmm-hmm..." She's still searching for a book, her eyes wandering over the colourful grid of softcovers.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004935.polish: „Hmm... Hmm... Hmm” – wciąż szuka książki, błądząc wzrokiem po kolorowej mozaice miękkich okładek.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004935.belarusian: "Хм-хм-хм..." Яна ўсё яшчэ шукае кнігу, блукаючы позіркам па стракатай сетцы мяккіх вокладак.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000493E.english: Another comrade! Years of labour are pressing down on her shoulders. She deserves a hug -- for all the work she's done for mankind.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000493E.polish: Kolejna towarzyszka! Na jej barkach ciążą lata trudnej pracy. Zasługuje na przytulenie za cały trud, jakiego podjęła się dla ludzkości.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000493E.belarusian: Яшчэ адзін камрад! Гады працы ціснуць на яе плечы. Яна заслугоўвае абдымкаў — за ўсю тую працу, што зрабіла для чалавецтва.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004974.english: "I'm sorry, I don't really understand what you're talking about." She lets go of your hug.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004974.polish: „Przykro mi, ale naprawdę nie rozumiem, o czym pan mówi” – odpowiada i wydostaje się z twojego uścisku.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004974.belarusian: "Прабачце, я не зусім разумею, пра што вы." Яна вызваляецца з тваіх абдымкаў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004990.english: "Fighting for it how?" She hasn't let go of your embrace yet.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004990.polish: „Jak pan za nią walczy?” – pyta, wciąż pozostając w twoich objęciach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004990.belarusian: "І як вы за яго змагаецеся?" Яна яшчэ не вызвалілася з тваіх абдымкаў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004A02.english: "A hug monster? How do these two go hand-in-hand?" She hasn't let go of your embrace yet.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004A02.polish: „Przytulasowym potworem? Te słowa w ogóle się ze sobą łączą?” – pyta, wciąż pozostając w twoich objęciach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004A02.belarusian: "Монстр абдымкаў? Як гэтыя два словы наогул спалучаюцца?" Яна ўсё яшчэ не вызвалілася з тваіх абдымкаў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004A90.english: "I police whatever I want. Where are they?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004A90.polish: „Policjantem, który zajmuje się, czym chce. Gdzie one są?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004A90.belarusian: "Я расследую ўсё, што захачу. Дзе яны?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004ADB.english: "This little girl over there told me you have a bad husband."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004ADB.polish: „Tamta dziewczynka powiedziała mi, że ma pani niedobrego męża”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004ADB.belarusian: "Вунь тая маленькая дзяўчынка сказала мне, што ў вас дрэнны муж."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004AE1.english: "Excuse me, a *bad husband?*" Her back straightens. "What do you mean?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004AE1.polish: „Co, proszę? *Niedobrego męża*?” – prostuje się. „Co to ma znaczyć?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004AE1.belarusian: "Прабачце, *дрэнны муж?*" Яна выпростваецца. "Што вы маеце на ўвазе?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004AE8.polish: „To, że nie jest miły i pomocny”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004AE8.belarusian: "Не з тых, што добрыя і спагадлівыя."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004AF7.english: "Do *police men* just go around repeating what some kid off the street said?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004AF7.polish: „Czy *policjanci* zajmują się powtarzaniem tego, co mówią jakieś dzieciaki na ulicy?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004AF7.belarusian: "Ці *паліцыянты* проста ходзяць і паўтараюць тое, што сказалі нейкія дзеці з вуліцы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004AFD.english: "Those were her words, not mine. I'm merely asking."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004AFD.polish: „To nie moje słowa, a jej. Ja tylko pytam”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004AFD.belarusian: "Гэта яе словы, не мае. Я проста пытаюся."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B03.english: "So you don't have a bad husband?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B03.polish: „A więc nie ma pani niedobrego męża?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B0B.english: "No, I don't. I have a good husband, the kind and helpful sort. And he's *not* missing."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B0B.polish: „Nie, nie mam. Mój mąż jest dobry i pomocny. I *nie* zaginął”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B0B.belarusian: "Не, не дрэнны. У мяне добры муж, з тых, што добрыя і спагадлівыя. І ён *не* знікаў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B12.english: "She isn't just some 'kid off the street'. She seems very mature for her age."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B12.polish: „To nie jest byle dzieciak z ulicy. Jest bardzo dojrzała jak na swój wiek”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B12.belarusian: "Яна не проста нейкае 'дзіця з вуліцы'. Яна выглядае вельмі сталай для свайго ўзросту."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B19.english: "Is she now?" She dries her hands in the apron underneath her coat. Her eyes narrow.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B19.polish: „Doprawdy?” – pyta, wycierając dłonie w fartuch pod swoim płaszczem. Mruży oczy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B19.belarusian: "Няўжо?" Яна выцірае рукі аб фартух пад паліто. Яе вочы звужаюцца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B20.english: "Can I give you some friendly advice, mister policeman? Don't listen to kids."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B20.polish: „Czy mogę dać panu, panie policjancie, przyjacielską radę? Proszę nie słuchać dzieci”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B20.belarusian: "Ці магу я даць вам сяброўскую параду, спадару паліцыянт? Не слухайце дзяцей."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004B2E.polish: „Hmm... Hmm... Hmm” – mamrocze, wciąż przeglądając książki.

Dialogue Text/0x01000036000000F8.english: "They don't. I just forced them this way. That's why I am a monster."
Dialogue Text/0x01000036000000F8.polish: „Nie łączy się. Dokonałem tego powiązania siłą. I dlatego jestem potworem”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000036000000F8.belarusian: "Ніяк. Я проста злучыў іх сілай. Вось чаму я монстр."

Dialogue Text/0x01000036000000FE.english: "Well, you're not actually entitled to another person's body. Hugging can be considered a rather monstrous thing to do."
Dialogue Text/0x01000036000000FE.polish: „No cóż, nikt nie ma prawa do ciała drugiej osoby. Przytulanie może być więc uznane za coś całkiem potwornego”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000036000000FE.belarusian: "Ну, насамрэч ніхто не мае права на чужое цела. Абдымкі можна палічыць даволі жахлівай рэччу."

Dialogue Text/0x0100003600000132.english: "You were right that I'm a cockatoo."

Dialogue Text/0x0100003600000154.english: "You were right. I do have an alcoholic husband. Although not that one."
Dialogue Text/0x0100003600000154.polish: „Masz rację. Mam męża alkoholika. Ale to nie ten”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100003600000154.belarusian: "Вы мелі рацыю. У мяне сапраўды муж — алкаголік. Але не гэты."

Dialogue Text/0x010000360000015A.english: "But didn't you say your husband was kind and helpful?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000360000015A.polish: „Ale mówiła pani przecież, że pani mąż jest dobry i pomocny”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000360000015A.belarusian: "Але хіба вы не казалі, што ваш муж добры і спагадлівы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100003600000168.english: "I did and he is." She takes a step back. "He's also an alcoholic."
Dialogue Text/0x0100003600000168.polish: „Tak mówiłam i taki jest” – robi krok w tył. „Jest też alkoholikiem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100003600000168.belarusian: "Казала, і так яно і ёсць." Яна робіць крок назад. "А яшчэ ён алкаголік."

Dialogue Text/0x0100003600000170.english: "No, he's not. Or maybe he is, I don't know. He's probably in the park, or in Jamrock somewhere. Drinking with his *friends*." She looks away.
Dialogue Text/0x0100003600000170.polish: „Nie, nie zaginął. A może i zaginął, nie wiem. Jest pewnie w parku albo gdzieś w Jamrock. Chleje ze swoimi *kumplami*” – odwraca wzrok.
Dialogue Text/0x0100003600000170.belarusian: "Не, не знік. А можа, і знік, не ведаю. Напэўна, у парку ці дзесьці ў Джэмроку. П'е са сваімі *сябрамі*." Яна адводзіць погляд.

Dialogue Text/0x010000360000017F.english: "Right. What about him?" Her face becomes anxious again.
Dialogue Text/0x010000360000017F.polish: „Tak. Co z nim?” – na jej twarzy znowu pojawia się niepokój.
Dialogue Text/0x010000360000017F.belarusian: "Так. А што з ім?" На яе твары зноў з'яўляецца трывога.

Dialogue Text/0x0100003600000196.english: "What else... He was wearing a dark brown leather jacket with a bright blue inner lining. The lining is hand-sewn, I made it myself." She sighs, her voice slightly quivering when she adds:
Dialogue Text/0x0100003600000196.polish: „Co jeszcze... Miał na sobie ciemnobrązową skórzaną kurtkę z jasnoniebieską podpinką. Podpinka jest ręcznie wszyta, sama ją zrobiłam” – wzdycha, po czym dodaje lekko drżącym głosem:
Dialogue Text/0x0100003600000196.belarusian: "Што яшчэ... На ім была цёмна-брунатная скураная куртка з ярка-блакітнай падшэўкай. Падшэўка падшыта ўручную, я сама рабіла." Яна ўздыхае, яе голас ледзь дрыжыць, калі яна дадае:

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004BD8.english: She tries to concentrate on books, but her eyes are full of bewilderment.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004BD8.polish: Stara się skupić na książkach, ale jej spojrzenie jest pełne zdumienia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004BD8.belarusian: Яна спрабуе сканцэнтравацца на кнігах, але яе вочы поўныя разгубленасці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004C79.english: She doesn't mean to be antagonistic, but she can't help coming off defensive.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004C79.polish: Nie chce być wobec ciebie wroga, ale mimo to wydaje się dość nieprzyjemna.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004C79.belarusian: Яна не хоча праяўляць варожасць, але міжволі становіцца ў абарончую пазіцыю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004D12.english: "A hug a day keeps the bourgeoisie away."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004D19.english: "I guess it's better than nothing. Keep fighting on, my fellow comrade." Then she breaks up the hug, her cheeks flushed.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004D19.polish: „Lepsze to chyba niż nic. Proszę walczyć dalej, towarzyszu” – odpowiada, po czym przerywa uścisk. Na jej policzkach widać rumieńce.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004D19.belarusian: "Думаю, гэта лепш, чым нічога. Працягвайце змагацца, мой камрад." Потым яна разрывае абдымкі, яе шчокі палаюць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004E65.english: "Well, I still want one. I want a missing person's case!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004E65.polish: „Dobrze, ale i tak chcę się tym zająć. Domagam się sprawy związanej z zaginięciem!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004E65.belarusian: "Ну, а я ўсё роўна хачу! Хачу справу аб знікненні чалавека!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004E77.english: "Okay, I don't want it. Let's move on." (Don't take the case.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004E77.polish: „Dobra, nie chcę się tym zajmować. Ruszajmy dalej”. (Nie przyjmuj sprawy).
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004E77.belarusian: "Добра, не хачу. Рушым далей." (Не браць справу.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00004E8C.english: "All right then..." He sighs. "He has *questions* now."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00005002.english: "I went and read up on them, just like you said. And I even decided on what kind of a cockatoo I am. Want to know?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00005002.polish: „Poczytałem o nich trochę, jak pani mówiła. I nawet zdecydowałem, którą jestem. Chce pani wiedzieć?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B00005002.belarusian: "Я пайшоў і пачытаў пра іх, як вы і казалі. І нават вырашыў, якое я какаду. Хочаце ведаць?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C5C0.english: "Hmm-hmm-hmm." You see a sturdy woman humming to herself. She seems to be browsing books.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C5C0.polish: „Hmm... Hmm... Hmm” – krzepka kobieta mamrocze do siebie. Zdaje się, że przegląda książki.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C5C0.belarusian: "Хм-хм-хм." Ты бачыш каржакаватую жанчыну, якая напявае сабе пад нос. Здаецца, яна праглядае кнігі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C5C6.english: "The ship takes off like a silvery mosquito... unfolding its rotor blade arms..." She mumbles reading. Then puts down the softcover.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C5C6.polish: „Okręt wznosi się niczym srebrzysty komar... rozwija swe wirnikowe skrzydła...” – mamrocze pod nosem, gdy czyta. Po chwili odkłada książkę.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C5C6.belarusian: "Карабель узлятае, нібы срабрысты камар... распраўляючы лопасцевыя крылы..." — мармыча яна, чытаючы. Потым кладзе кнігу ў мяккай вокладцы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C5E1.english: If she's such a *working class* woman, why isn't she working?
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C5E1.polish: Skoro to kobieta *z klasy robotniczej*, to czemu nie pracuje?
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C5E1.belarusian: Калі яна такая *працоўная* жанчына, чаму яна не працуе?

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C60B.english: "Looking for something to read." She reverts her attention to a worn out paperback.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C60B.polish: „Szukam czegoś do czytania” – odpowiada i znowu skupia swoją uwagę na sfatygowanej książce w miękkiej okładce.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C60B.belarusian: "Шукаю, што пачытаць." Яна зноў звяртае ўвагу на пацёртую кнігу ў мяккай вокладцы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C627.english: "Annette's a sweet sprout, but she doesn't know anything about marriage. Why am I even talking about this..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C627.polish: „Annette to słodki szczypiorek, ale nie ma zielonego pojęcia o małżeństwie. Dlaczego my o tym w ogóle rozmawiamy...?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C627.belarusian: "Анэта — мілы парастак, але яна нічога не цяміць у шлюбе. Навошта я наогул пра гэта гавару..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C652.english: She gives you a short nod and shifts her attention back to books.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C652.polish: Kiwa głową, po czym znowu skupia się na książkach.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C652.belarusian: Яна коратка ківае табе і зноў пераводзіць увагу на кнігі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C65F.english: "Suit yourself then. I don't really care if your husband is missing."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C65F.polish: „Jak sobie pani chce. W sumie to mnie nie obchodzi, czy pani mąż zaginął”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C65F.belarusian: "Як хочаце. Мне насамрэч усё адно, ці знік ваш муж."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C667.english: She has though. The husband is totally lost. You should tell her that it's okay.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C667.polish: A jednak zgubiła. Jej mąż zaginął jak nic. Lepiej jej powiedz, żeby się nie przejmowała.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C667.belarusian: Але ж згубіла. Муж дакладна знік. Варта сказаць ёй, што ўсё ў парадку.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C66E.english: "Maybe you´re right. Maybe he isn't missing indeed."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C66E.polish: „Może i ma pani rację. Może faktycznie nie zaginął”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C66E.belarusian: "Можа, вы і маеце рацыю. Можа, ён сапраўды не знік."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C675.english: "Of course he's not. It's not like he's a pocket watch. I wouldn't just lose him."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C675.polish: „Oczywiście, że nie zaginął. Przecież to nie kieszonkowy zegarek. Nie zgubiłabym go”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C675.belarusian: "Вядома, не знік. Ён жа не кішэнны гадзіннік. Я б яго проста так не згубіла."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6BD.english: You know where they are. They're at home. *Smoking*. Giving the ladder of vices a chance.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6BD.polish: Wiesz, gdzie są. W domu. I *palą*. Wspinają się po drabince występków.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6BD.belarusian: Ты ведаеш, дзе яны. Яны дома. *Кураць*. Робяць першы крок па лесвіцы заган.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6C4.english: No, they're at a disco. Getting down. Stupid disco dancing teenagers.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6C4.polish: Nie, są na dyskotece. Szaleją. Głupie, tańczące do disco nastolatki.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6C4.belarusian: Не, яны на дыскатэцы. Адрываюцца. Дурныя падлеткі, што танчаць пад дыска.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6DA.english: "What? That's just -- my daughters are perfectly *fine*. They're with their friends down in Jamrock! There's *nothing* to worry about."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6DA.polish: „Co? Nie no... Moje córki mają się *dobrze*. Są ze swoimi przyjaciółmi w Jamrock! Nie ma *żadnych* powodów do zmartwień”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6DA.belarusian: "Што? Гэта проста... з маімі дочкамі ўсё ў *поўным парадку*. Яны з сябрамі ў Джэмроку! Няма *нічога*, пра што варта хвалявацца."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6E1.english: "They're almost grown up now anyway. They're past the age they need me protecting them from everything now."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6E1.polish: „Są prawie dorosłe. Dawno już nie są w wieku, w którym trzeba je było przed wszystkim chronić”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6E1.belarusian: "Яны ўжо і так амаль дарослыя. Даўно мінуў той узрост, калі ім трэба было, каб я абараняла іх ад усяго."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6EC.english: Did someone say... party? You could use a party. Hunt it down!
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6EC.polish: Czy ktoś powiedział... „impreza”? Przydałaby ci się jedna. Znajdź ją!
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C6EC.belarusian: Хтосьці сказаў... вечарына? Табе б не зашкодзіла вечарына. Знайдзі яе!

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C71D.english: "Maybe you're right. Maybe they aren't missing after all. Tell me something else..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C71D.polish: „Może i ma pani rację. Może jednak nie zaginęły. Proszę mi jeszcze powiedzieć...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C71D.belarusian: "Можа, вы і маеце рацыю. Можа, яны і праўда не зніклі. Скажыце мне іншае..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C724.english: "My youngest girl, Jolie, is just shy of sixteen. Jennie, she is turning eighteen next month. But we shouldn't even be talking about them!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C724.polish: „Moja najmłodsza córka, Jolie, ma prawie szesnaście. Jennie skończy osiemnaście za miesiąc. Ale nie powinniśmy nawet o nich rozmawiać!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C724.belarusian: "Маёй малодшай, Жалі, хутка шаснаццаць. Джэні ў наступным месяцы споўніцца васямнаццаць. Але мы наогул не павінны пра іх гаварыць!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C78D.english: She's lying. She's god damn lying, she has smokes!
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C78D.polish: Kłamie. Kłamie jak cholera. Ma fajki!
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C78D.belarusian: Яна хлусіць. Яна, чорт пабяры, хлусіць, у яе ёсць курыва!

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7A3.english: "Just one, I beg you. Just one. GIVE ME THE DAMN CIGARETTE, MA'AM!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7A3.polish: „Tylko jednego. Błagam. Jednego. NIECHŻE MI PANI DA TEGO CHOLERNEGO PAPIEROSA!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7A3.belarusian: "Толькі адну, я малю вас. Толькі адну. ДАЙЦЕ МНЕ ГЭТУЮ ПРАКЛЯТУЮ ЦЫГАРЭТУ, ПАНІ!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7AA.english: "I *know* you're lying, please just give me a cigarette."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7AA.polish: „*Wiem*, że pani kłamie. Proszę po prostu dać mi papierosa”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7AA.belarusian: "Я *ведаю*, што вы хлусіце, калі ласка, проста дайце мне цыгарэту."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7B0.english: The situation is oddly intimate -- your cheek is pressed against her shoulder, her hand is trapped between your chest. Five seconds pass and their passing seems so unimaginably long. Then she coughs and says again:
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7B0.polish: Sytuacja jest dziwnie intymna – twój policzek jest przyciśnięty do jej ramienia, jej ręka uwięziona między nią a twoją piersią. Niewyobrażalnie wolno mija pięć sekund, po czym kaszle i znowu się odzywa:
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7B0.belarusian: Сітуацыя дзіўна інтымная — твая шчака прыціснутая да яе пляча, яе рука заціснутая паміж тваімі грудзьмі. Мінае пяць секунд, і яны здаюцца неймаверна доўгімі. Затым яна кашляе і зноў прамаўляе:

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7E2.english: She steps back and returns her attention to books, pretending this hug didn't happen.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7E2.polish: Robi krok w tył i skupia się na książkach, udając, że uścisk nigdy się nie wydarzył.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7E2.belarusian: Яна робіць крок назад і вяртаецца да кніг, удаючы, нібы гэтых абдымкаў і не было.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7F7.english: The feeling continues. Warm and comfy on the cold shoreline. You hear a question rising to the surface, trying to break the sensation.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7F7.polish: Uczucie trwa. Ciepło i odprężenie na zimnym wybrzeżu. Czujesz, jak na powierzchnię twojej świadomości wypływa pytanie. Próbuje zburzyć ten błogostan.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C7F7.belarusian: Пачуццё трывае. Цёпла і ўтульна на халодным беразе. Ты чуеш, як на паверхню падымаецца пытанне, спрабуючы разбурыць гэтае адчуванне.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C804.english: Silence your thoughts. I don't want to answer anything.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C804.polish: Ucisz swoje myśli. Nie chcę odpowiadać na żadne pytania.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C804.belarusian: Заглушыць думкі. Я не хачу ні на што адказваць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C819.english: OH MY GOD, WHY ARE YOU CALLING ME? STOP CALLING ME! ARE YOU DRUNK AGAIN?
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C819.polish: O BOŻE, CZEMU TY DO MNIE DZWONISZ? PRZESTAŃ DO MNIE DZWONIĆ! ZNOWU SIĘ SCHLAŁEŚ?
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C819.belarusian: БОЖА МОЙ, ЧАМУ ТЫ МНЕ ТЭЛЕФАНУЕШ? ПЕРАСТАНЬ МНЕ ТЭЛЕФАНАВАЦЬ! ТЫ ЗНОЎ П'ЯНЫ?

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C820.english: "Khm, officer." A coarse female voice pulls you out of your reverie. "What are you doing?" A swash of water hits the coast behind her figure.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C820.polish: „Panie policjancie” – jej chropowaty damski głos wyrywa cię z zadumy. „Co pan robi?” Fala uderza w wybrzeże rozciągające się za jej figurą.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C820.belarusian: "Кхм, афіцэру." Хрыплы жаночы голас вырывае цябе з задуменнасці. "Што вы робіце?" Пляск вады б'ецца аб бераг за яе спінай.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C925.english: "Well, I found him nevertheless. I'm Dick Mullen."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C925.polish: „No, tak czy inaczej go znalazłem. Jestem Dickiem Mullenem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C925.belarusian: "Ну, я ўсё адно яго знайшоў. Я — Дзік Мален."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C92B.english: "Well, I found him nevertheless. I'm that good."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C92B.polish: „No, tak czy inaczej go znalazłem. Taki jestem w tym dobry”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C92B.belarusian: "Ну, я ўсё адно яго знайшоў. Вось такі я круты."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C93C.english: Wait! Did she just imply that you're *fat*? You're not fat! The body type she's referring to is called a *Franconigerian hard-body*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C93C.polish: Chwileczkę! Czy ona właśnie stwierdziła, że jesteś *gruby*? Nie jesteś gruby! Sylwetka, o której ona mówi, nazywa się *frankonigeryjskim ciałem*!
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C93C.belarusian: Хвіліначку! Яна што, намякнула, што ты *тоўсты*? Ты не тоўсты! Тып целаскладу, пра які яна кажа, называецца *франканігерыйскае дужае цела*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C947.english: "I even tried throwing it away once, but he just dug it out of the bin. Can you believe it?" She looks back at you, shaking her head.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C947.polish: „Raz próbowałam nawet mu ją wyrzucić, ale wygrzebał ją ze śmietnika. Uwierzyłby pan?” – spogląda na ciebie i kręci głową.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C947.belarusian: "Я нават аднойчы спрабавала яе выкінуць, дык ён выцягнуў са сметніцы. Уяўляеце?" Яна глядзіць на цябе, хістаючы галавой.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C963.english: She genuinely wants you to, now. Don't make her ask.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000C963.polish: Ona naprawdę tego chce. Nie każ jej prosić.
