Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000110AC.english: Why would anyone like it here?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000110AC.polish: Czemu komukolwiek miałoby się tu podobać?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000110C1.english: Even at the worst of times, Revachol cares for its inhabitants.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000110C1.polish: Nawet w najgorszych czasach Revachol troszczy się o swoich mieszkańców.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000110C1.belarusian: Нават у найгоршыя часы Рэвашоль клапоціцца пра сваіх жыхароў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B727.english: Factory balanced... bakelite and stainless steel.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B727.polish: Fabrycznie wyważany... Z bakelitu i stali nierdzewnej.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B727.belarusian: Завадская балансіроўка... бакеліт і нержавеючая сталь.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B7D3.english: "Aye." She looks at the rain circles on the water. "*Sunny* days. You got a problem with that?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B7D3.polish: „Tak” – odpowiada, spoglądając na rozchodzące się na wodzie kręgi wywoływane kroplami deszczu. „*Słoneczne* dni. Ma pan z tym jakiś problem?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B7D3.belarusian: "Ага. — Яна глядзіць на колы ад дажджу на вадзе. — *Сонечныя* дні. У вас з гэтым нейкія праблемы?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B7E3.english: "Sunny days?" (Put your hand in the rain.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B7E9.english: "Sunny days?" (Catch a snowflake in your palm.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B7F0.english: "Aye." She looks at the snow melt in the water. "*Sunny* days. You got a problem with that?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B7F0.polish: „Tak” – odpowiada, spoglądając na śnieg topniejący na powierzchni wody. „*Słoneczne* dni. Ma pan z tym jakiś problem?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B7F0.belarusian: "Ага. — Яна глядзіць, як снег растае ў вадзе. — *Сонечныя* дні. У вас з гэтым нейкія праблемы?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B806.english: She looks at the boat dripping with slush and nods, proudly.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B806.polish: Spogląda na łódkę ociekającą wodą z topniejącego śniegu i kiwa poważnie głową.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B806.belarusian: Яна глядзіць на лодку, з якой сцякае снежная каша, і горда ківае.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B810.english: "No, ma'am. We have no quarrel with sunny days."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B810.polish: „Nie, proszę pani. Nie mamy żadnego problemu ze słonecznymi dniami”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B810.belarusian: "Ніякіх, спадарыня. Мы нічога не маем супраць сонечных дзён."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B817.english: "Good. 'Twould have been bad news had it turned out it wasn't a sunny day. Bad news for the skiff. Bad news for the nets. Bad news for the kids."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B817.polish: „To dobrze. Bo brak słonecznych dni byłby niekorzystny. Niekorzystny dla łódki. Niekorzystny dla sieci. Niekorzystny dla dzieci”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B817.belarusian: "Добра. Бо гэта была б дрэнная навіна, калі б выявілася, што дзень не сонечны. Дрэнная навіна для яліка. Дрэнная навіна для сетак. Дрэнная навіна для дзяцей."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B82E.english: "Sure it is. 'Twould be bad news for the skiff if it weren't. Bad news for the nets. Bad news for the kids."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B82E.polish: „Oczywiście, że jest. Bo brak słonecznego dnia byłby niekorzystny dla łódki. Niekorzystny dla sieci. Niekorzystny dla dzieci”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B82E.belarusian: "Вядома, сонечны. Бо інакш гэта была б дрэнная навіна для яліка. Дрэнная навіна для сетак. Дрэнная навіна для дзяцей."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B835.english: There's a moment's silence. She looks at the slush-like rain-thing melt on the yellow belly of the boat.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B835.polish: Zapada chwila milczenia. Kobieta wpatruje się w topniejący śnieg spływający po żółtym kadłubie łódki.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B835.belarusian: Настае хвіліна маўчання. Яна глядзіць, як гразепадобны дождж растае на жоўтым чэраве лодкі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B852.english: She sounds almost disappointed with you. *Reprimanding* you for falling and hurting your knee.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B852.polish: Jej ton jest niemal pełen rozczarowania tobą. Udziela ci *reprymendy* za to, że się przewróciłeś i uszkodziłeś sobie kolano.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B852.belarusian: Яе голас гучыць амаль расчаравана. Быццам яна чытае табе *натацыю* за тое, што ты ўпаў і пашкодзіў калена.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B859.english: "I got shot in the foot. It was pretty bad-ass. You would've liked it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B859.polish: „Zostałem postrzelony w nogę. Całkiem to było czadowe. Spodobałoby się pani”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B859.belarusian: "Мяне паранілі ў нагу. Гэта было даволі эпічна. Вам бы спадабалася".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B85F.english: "I'm a cop. I don't merely exist in *this* world -- I live in the *between* life and death."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B85F.polish: „Jestem gliniarzem. Nie istnieję ot tak w *tym* świecie. Trwam *pomiędzy* życiem i śmiercią”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B85F.belarusian: "Я коп. Я не проста існую ў *гэтым* свеце — я жыву *паміж* жыццём і смерцю".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B86E.english: "I wanted to talk to you about something else -- your boat."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B86E.polish: „Chciałem porozmawiać z panią o czym innym. O pani łodzi”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B86E.belarusian: "Я хацеў пагаварыць з вамі пра іншае — пра ваш човен".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B87C.english: "Look at you, you can barely walk!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B87C.polish: „Niech pan na siebie spojrzy! Ledwo pan chodzi!”

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B88D.polish: W ogóle nie *kulejesz*. Jesteś po prostu *sobą*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B897.english: "Everyone does that, in a way. You don't have to get shot for that." She waves her hand dismissively.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B897.polish: „Tak jak wszyscy, w pewnym sensie. Nikt nie obrywa z tego powodu kulki” – stwierdza, machając lekceważąco ręką.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B897.belarusian: "Кожны так жыве, у нейкім сэнсе. Дзеля гэтага неабавязкова лавіць кулю". Яна грэбліва адмахваецца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B89D.english: "What happened to you anyway? We heard gunshots from the town. They were closer than usual."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B89D.polish: „Co się panu właściwie stało? Słyszeliśmy odgłosy wystrzałów dochodzące od strony miasta. Ich źródło było bliżej niż zwykle”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B89D.belarusian: "Што з вамі наогул здарылася? Мы чулі стрэлы з боку горада. Яны былі бліжэй, чым звычайна".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B8B9.english: "Officer, what happened? You're limping. Why are you limping? You look terrible."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B8B9.polish: „Funkcjonariuszu, co się stało? Kuleje pan. Dlaczego pan kuleje? Wygląda pan paskudnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B8B9.belarusian: "Афіцэру, што здарылася? Вы кульгаеце. Чаму вы кульгаеце? Вы выглядаеце жудасна".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B8BE.english: "Officer Harry... you're wounded. Why are you wounded? You look terrible."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B8BE.polish: „Funkcjonariusz Harry... Jest pan ranny. Dlaczego jest pan ranny? Wygląda pan paskudnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B8BE.belarusian: "Афіцэр Гары... вы паранены. Чаму вы паранены? Вы выглядаеце жудасна".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B8D1.english: "Is this from the shooting in town?" She's not letting it go that easy. "We heard gunshots. Not that we don't hear gunshots all the time, but they were closer than usual."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B8D1.polish: „To z powodu tej strzelaniny w mieście?” – pyta, nie odpuszczając. „Słyszeliśmy wystrzały z broni palnej. Takie odgłosy to tutaj żadna nowość, ale tym razem ich źródło było bliżej niż zazwyczaj”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B8D1.belarusian: "Гэта праз тую страляніну ў горадзе?" — яна не збіраецца адступаць так лёгка. — "Мы чулі стрэлы. Не тое каб мы не чулі іх увесь час, але гэтым разам яны былі бліжэй, чым звычайна".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B911.english: "There was an exchange of fire on Rue de Saint-Ghislaine. It's nothing to be worried about, ma'am."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B911.polish: „Na Rue de Saint-Ghislaine doszło do wymiany ognia. Nie ma się czym przejmować, proszę pani”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B911.belarusian: "На ру дэ Сэн-Гілен адбылася перастрэлка. Няма пра што хвалявацца, спадарыня".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B929.english: "Of course, ma'am. It's only for a day or two -- official police business."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B929.polish: „Oczywiście, proszę pani. Chodzi o jeden, góra dwa dni – to oficjalne policyjne sprawy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B929.belarusian: "Вядома, спадарыня. Гэта толькі на дзень-два — службовая справа."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B930.english: "That won't be a problem. It's windstill -- and the tar just dried." She points to her skiff next to the jetty. "We've got two days of *relative* sunshine ahead."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B930.polish: „To nie będzie problem. Mamy ciszę morską – a smoła właśnie wyschła” – wskazuje swoją łódkę przy pirsie. „Przed nami dwa dni *stosunkowo* słonecznej pogody”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B930.belarusian: "Гэта не будзе праблемай. Поўны штыль — і смала якраз высахла, — яна паказвае на свой ялік каля мола. — Наперадзе ў нас два дні *адноснага* сонца."

Alternate1/0x010000450001B943.polish: „Co jest na tej wyspie? Widziałem przez lornetkę jakieś ruiny...”
Alternate1/0x010000450001B943.belarusian: "Што на тым востраве? Я бачыў нейкія руіны праз бінокль..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B94F.english: "Thank you, I'll use your skiff to get there then."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B94F.polish: „Dziękuję. W takim razie popłynę tam pani łódką”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B94F.belarusian: "Дзякуй, тады я паплыву туды на вашым яліку."

Alternate1/0x010000450001B94F.polish: „Dziękuję. W takim razie popłyniemy tam pani łódką”.
Alternate1/0x010000450001B94F.belarusian: "Дзякуй, тады мы паплывём туды на вашым яліку."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B956.english: "I need to get to that island." (Point to it.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B956.polish: „Muszę dostać się na tamtą wyspę”. (Wskaż ją).

Alternate1/0x010000450001B956.polish: „Musimy dostać się na tamtą wyspę”. (Wskaż ją).

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B971.english: "I dodged the second shot. I can also get *not shot*."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B971.belarusian: "Ад другога стрэлу я ўхіліўся. Я таксама ўмею *не лавіць кулі*".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B977.english: "I also got shot in the chest." (Point to your chest.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B977.polish: „Postrzelili mnie też w klatkę piersiową”. (Wskaż ją).
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B977.belarusian: "Мне яшчэ і ў грудзі пацэлілі". (Паказаць на грудзі.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B97D.english: "You should see the other guys. They're all dead."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B97D.polish: „Trzeba było widzieć pozostałych. Wszyscy nie żyją”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B97D.belarusian: "Бачылі б вы тых, другіх. Яны ўсе трупы".

Alternate1/0x010000450001B97D.polish: „Trzeba było widzieć pozostałych. Dwóch nie żyje, jeden jest w szpitalu”.
Alternate1/0x010000450001B97D.belarusian: "Бачылі б вы тых, другіх. Двое мёртвыя, адзін у шпіталі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B995.english: "Officer Harry, what happened? You're limping. Why are you limping? You look terrible."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B995.polish: „Funkcjonariuszu Harry, co się stało? Kuleje pan. Dlaczego pan kuleje? Wygląda pan paskudnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B995.belarusian: "Афіцэр Гары, што здарылася? Вы кульгаеце. Чаму вы кульгаеце? Вы выглядаеце жудасна".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B99B.english: "Officer, what happened? You're wounded. Why are you wounded? You look terrible."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B99B.polish: „Funkcjonariusz, co się stało? Jest pan ranny. Dlaczego jest pan ranny? Wygląda pan paskudnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B99B.belarusian: "Афіцэру, што здарылася? Вы параненыя. Чаму вы параненыя? Вы выглядаеце жахліва."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B9BA.english: "Doesn't look like nothing. Looks like you got banged up real good."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B9BA.polish: „Nie wygląda mi to na nic. Wygląda na to, że nieźle pan oberwał”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B9BA.belarusian: "Не надта падобна на дробязі. Выглядае так, нібы вам добра дасталася".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B9DC.english: You feel the ligament move on your left shoulder. And a small, warm drip of blood. It's nothing.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B9DC.polish: Czujesz ruch ścięgna w swoim lewym barku. I małą, ciepłą kropelkę krwi. To nic takiego.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B9DC.belarusian: Ты адчуваеш, як рухаецца звязка ў левым плячы. І маленькую цёплую кроплю крыві. Гэта дробязі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B9EE.english: "So you're a killer." She nods solemnly. "That's good, I guess. I guess... Better than being dead."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B9EE.polish: „Więc jest pan mordercą” – kiwa z powagą głową. „To chyba dobrze. Lepsze to... niż zginąć”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B9EE.belarusian: "Значыць, вы забойца". Яна паважна ківае. "Напэўна, гэта добра. Мабыць... лепш, чым быць мёртвым".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001B9FB.english: "I'm not a killer, I'm a cop."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA0A.english: "Aye, I bet they are. The good ones at least."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA0A.polish: „Tak, założę się, że nimi są. Przynajmniej ci dobrzy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA0A.belarusian: "Ага, магу пабіцца аб заклад, што так і ёсць. Прынамсі, добрыя".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA11.english: "Aye, I guess you are." She nods. "I understand that's how it goes."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA11.polish: „Tak, najwyraźniej pan nim jest” – kiwa głową. „Rozumiem, że tak to wygląda”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA11.belarusian: "Ага, мабыць, так і ёсць". Яна ківае. "Я разумею, як яно бывае".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA18.english: She just looks at you, her tea-length skirt flapping in the wind.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA18.polish: Tylko patrzy na ciebie, a jej spódnica sięgająca do połowy łydki powiewa na wietrze.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA18.belarusian: Яна проста глядзіць на цябе, а яе спадніца лопаціць на ветры.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA22.english: "Of course. Can I help you with something?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA32.english: "I was a killer long before this happened."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA32.polish: „Byłem mordercą na długo przed tym, jak to się stało”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA39.english: "Aye." She nods solemnly. "Not a lot of RCM men who aren't killers."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA39.polish: „Tak” – kiwa z powagą głową. „Niewielu funkcjonariuszy MOR-u nie jest mordercami”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA39.belarusian: "Ага". Яна паважна ківае. "Няшмат у РГМ тых, хто не забіваў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA47.english: "Aye." She nods solemnly. "I've always taken you for one, that's for sure. Not a lot of RCM men who aren't killers."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA47.polish: „Tak” – kiwa z powagą głową. „Nigdy nie miałam co do tego wątpliwości. Niewielu funkcjonariuszy MOR-u nie jest mordercami”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA47.belarusian: "Ага". Яна паважна ківае. "Я заўсёды вас такім і лічыла, гэта дакладна. Няшмат у РГМ тых, хто не забіваў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA56.english: "I'm sad to hear that. Take care of that with ether, will you? Don't get too many RCM men around here. Be sad to lose the first one."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA56.polish: „Przykro mi to słyszeć. Niech się pan podleczy eterem, dobrze? Nie pojawia się tu zbyt wielu mężczyzn z MOR-u. Byłoby szkoda, gdybyśmy stracili pierwszego”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA56.belarusian: "Шкада гэта чуць. Палячыцеся эфірам, добра? Супрацоўнікі РГМ сюды завітваюць нячаста. Будзе сумна страціць першага."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA63.english: "If you promise to bring it back. And no scraping the hull -- I just got it nice and yellow. And *no* drinking on the boat." Her eyes narrow. "And no joyriding, either."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA63.polish: „Jeśli obieca pan, że ją pan zwróci. I żadnych rys na kadłubie – właśnie pomalowałam ją na żółto. I *żadnego* picia na pokładzie” – zastrzega, mrużąc oczy. „I żadnych rejsów bez pozwolenia”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA63.belarusian: "Калі паабяцаеце вярнуць яе. І не драпаць корпус — я толькі-толькі зрабіла яго прыгожым і жоўтым. І *ніякай* выпіўкі ў лодцы, — яе вочы звужаюцца. — І ніякіх забаўляльных катанняў таксама."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA86.english: "See, that makes me not want to lend you my skiff. On a boat, *rocking* leads to capsizing. That there is an absolutely one-hundred percent *rock-free* skiff, you got that?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA86.polish: „Przez takie pytania nie mam ochoty pożyczać panu mojej łódki. Na łodzi *bujanie* powoduje wywrotki. To jest łódź, na której pod żadnym pozorem nie ma miejsca na *bujanie się*, zrozumiano?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA86.belarusian: "Вось бачыце, пасля такога мне зусім не хочацца пазычаць вам ялік. У лодцы *гайданне* вядзе да перакульвання. Гэты ялік на ўсе сто працэнтаў *без гайдання*, зразумела?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA8C.english: The crow's feet disappear from the corners of her eyes, as she smiles at you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA8C.polish: Kurze łapki znikają z kącików jej oczu, gdy uśmiecha się do ciebie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BA8C.belarusian: Маршчынкі ў кутках яе вачэй разгладжваюцца, калі яна табе ўсміхаецца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAA2.english: "Mhm, used to be some kind of fortification there before the war -- for the communards. An anti-aircraft gun, I think. Bombed to bits in the landing... I haven't been there myself -- always steered clear of it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAA2.polish: „Przed wojną były na niej jakieś fortyfikacje – komunardów. Działa przeciwlotnicze, zdaje się. Rozwalili je na kawałki podczas lądowania... Sama nigdy tam nie byłam – zawsze trzymam się od tego miejsca z daleka”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAA2.belarusian: "Мгм, да вайны там было нейкае ўмацаванне — камунараў. Зенітная гармата, здаецца. Яе разбамбілі ўшчэнт падчас высадкі... Сама я там не была — заўсёды трымалася далей ад гэтага месца."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAAA.english: "Two days of sunshine? I just got a bacterial infection."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAAA.polish: „Dwa dni słońca? Dopiero co dostałem infekcji bakteryjnej”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAAA.belarusian: "Два дні сонца? А я толькі што падхапіў бактэрыяльную інфекцыю."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BABB.english: "Is there anything I should know about getting there?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BABB.polish: „Jest coś, co powinienem wiedzieć, jeśli chodzi o drogę na wyspę?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BABB.belarusian: "Ці ёсць нешта, што мне варта ведаць пра дарогу туды?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAC2.english: "Well -- most of it's sunken. Underwater. That means concrete under water -- cut your boat if you're not careful. Be sure to enter from the south side, water's deep there."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAC2.polish: „No cóż – większość zatonęła. Jest pod wodą. To oznacza beton pod powierzchnią – beton, który dziurawi łodzie, gdy nie zachowa się ostrożności. Proszę podejść do wyspy od południowej strony – woda jest tam głęboka”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAC2.belarusian: "Ну... большая частка затопленая. Пад вадой. Гэта значыць — бетон пад вадой, парэжа лодку, калі не будзеце асцярожнымі. Абавязкова падыходзьце з паўднёвага боку, там глыбока."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAE6.english: "My husband used to drink there. Him and his drinking buddies. Always seemed like a bad place to drink to me. People died there during the landing, you know, my mother told me..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAE6.polish: „Mój mąż miał w zwyczaju tam pić. On i jego kumple od flaszki. Zawsze uważałam, że to kiepskie miejsce na picie. Ludzie tam zginęli podczas lądowania – opowiadała mi o tym moja matka...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAE6.belarusian: "Мой муж меў звычку там піць. Ён і яго сабутэльнікі. Мне заўсёды здавалася, што гэта дрэннае месца для выпіўкі. Людзі там гінулі падчас высадкі, ведаеце, маці распавядала..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAEC.english: She looks around. "The kids sometimes go there too, I know they do -- on rafts. I tell them not to but they bring back old bullet casings and such."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAEC.polish: Rozgląda się. „Czasem wybierają się tam dzieci – wiem, że to robią. Na tratwie. Mówię im, żeby tego nie robiły, ale i tak przywożą stamtąd stare łuski nabojów i tego typu rzeczy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAEC.belarusian: Яна азіраецца. "Дзеці часам таксама туды плаваюць, я ведаю — на платах. Я ім забараняю, але яны прывозяць адтуль старыя гільзы і ўсё такое."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAFA.english: "The twins." She points to the two kids playing on the concrete yard. "God forbid they bring the girl along on some rickety barge."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAFA.polish: „Bliźnięta” – wskazuje dwoje dzieci bawiących się na wybetonowanym placu. „Nie daj boże, aby zabrali ze sobą na tej rozklekotanej barce dziewczynkę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BAFA.belarusian: "Блізняты, — яна паказвае на двух дзяцей, што гуляюць на бетоннай пляцоўцы. — Не дай бог яны пацягнуць з сабой дзяўчынку на нейкай разваленай баржы."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB09.english: "Nothing, just ruins. Used to be some kind of fortification there before the war, for the communards. An anti-aircraft gun, I think. Bombed to bits in the landing... I haven't been there myself -- always steered clear of it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB09.polish: „Nic, same ruiny. Przed wojną były na niej jakieś fortyfikacje – komunardów. Działa przeciwlotnicze, zdaje się. Rozwalili je na kawałki podczas lądowania... Sama nigdy tam nie byłam – zawsze trzymam się od tego miejsca z daleka”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB09.belarusian: "Нічога, адны руіны. Да вайны там было нейкае ўмацаванне камунараў. Зенітная гармата, здаецца. Яе разбамбілі ўшчэнт падчас высадкі... Сама я там не была — заўсёды трымалася далей ад гэтага месца."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB11.english: Hasn't been there *herself*... who has then?
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB11.polish: *Ona sama* nigdy tam nie była... Kto więc był?
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB11.belarusian: *Сама* там не была... А хто тады быў?

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB2A.english: "You said you haven't been there *yourself* -- who has then? If not you?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB2A.polish: „Powiedziała pani, że *sama* nigdy tam nie była. Skoro nie pani, to kto?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB2A.belarusian: "Вы сказалі, што *самі* там не былі — хто ж тады быў? Калі не вы?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB3E.english: "The twins." She points to the two kids playing on the concrete yard. "God forbid they bring the girl along on a rickety barge."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB3E.polish: „Bliźnięta” – wskazuje dwoje dzieci bawiących się na wybetonowanym placu. „Nie daj boże, aby zabrali ze sobą na tej rozklekotanej barce dziewczynkę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB3E.belarusian: "Блізняты, — яна паказвае на двух дзяцей, што гуляюць на бетоннай пляцоўцы. — Не дай бог яны пацягнуць з сабой дзяўчынку на той разваленай баржы."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB4A.english: "Hundreds. Maybe thousands even..." She looks around. "The kids sometimes go there too, I know they do. On barges. I tell them not to but they bring back old bullet casings and such."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB4A.polish: „Setki. Może nawet tysiące...” – stwierdza, rozglądając się. „Czasem wybierają się tam dzieci – wiem, że to robią. Barkami. Mówię im, żeby tego nie robiły, ale i tak przywożą stamtąd stare łuski nabojów i tego typu rzeczy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB4A.belarusian: "Сотні. Можа, нават тысячы... — яна азіраецца. — Дзеці часам таксама туды плаваюць, я ведаю. На баржах. Я ім забараняю, але яны прывозяць адтуль старыя гільзы і ўсё такое."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB50.english: "My husband used to drink there. Him and his drinking buddies. Always seemed like a bad place to drink to me. People died there during the landing, you know -- my mother told me..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB50.polish: „Mój mąż miał w zwyczaju tam pić. On i jego kumple od flaszki. Zawsze uważałam, że to kiepskie miejsce na picie. Ludzie tam zginęli podczas lądowania – opowiadała mi o tym moja matka...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB50.belarusian: "Мой муж меў звычку там піць. Ён і яго сабутэльнікі. Мне заўсёды здавалася, што гэта дрэннае месца для выпіўкі. Людзі там гінулі падчас высадкі, ведаеце — маці распавядала..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB65.english: She nods. "Please be conservative with the fuel, will you? I just filled her up, but it's a small tank."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB65.polish: Kiwa głową. „Proszę oszczędzać paliwo, dobrze? Właśnie zatankowałam, ale bak jest bardzo mały”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB65.belarusian: Яна ківае. "Калі ласка, эканомце паліва, добра? Я толькі што заправіла яе, але бак там малы."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB81.english: "Be careful out there. Sea's calm as death, but still... there are ruins underwater. You can scrape the paint... or worse."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB81.polish: „Niech pan na siebie uważa. Morze jest spokojne, ale mimo to... Pod wodą znajdują się ruiny. Może pan zarysować lakier... albo skończyć jeszcze gorzej”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BB81.belarusian: "Будзьце асцярожныя там. Мора спакойнае, як смерць, але ўсё ж... пад вадой руіны. Можаце садраць фарбу... ці яшчэ горш."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000F32F.english: "I don't want a funeral. I *hate* death."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000F357.english: "Holding a funeral doesn't mean you love death. Don't be childish. You're a police officer..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000F357.polish: „Zorganizowanie pogrzebu nie oznacza, że kocha się śmierć. Niech pan nie będzie dziecinny. Jest pan funkcjonariuszem policji...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000F357.belarusian: "Зладзіць пахаванне не азначае любіць смерць. Не будзьце дзіцем. Вы ж афіцэр паліцыі..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FA7E.english: "I don't think they have funerals for motor carriages."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FA7E.belarusian: "Не думаю, што для маторных карэт ладзяць пахаванні."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FA90.english: "What an... odd thought. Maybe I should."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FA90.polish: „Co za... dziwna myśl. Może faktycznie powinienem?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FA90.belarusian: "Якая... дзіўная думка. Можа, мне і варта."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FA97.english: "And why so? Our things are a part of our life-world. They're made with human sweat and they share human history. We should care about them as we care about humans, to some extent at least."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FA97.polish: „Dlaczego? Nasze przedmioty są częścią naszego życioświata. Powstają dzięki ludzkiemu wysiłkowi i dzielą z nami naszą historię. Powinniśmy dbać o nie tak, jak dbamy o ludzi – przynajmniej do pewnego stopnia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FA97.belarusian: "А чаму не? Нашы рэчы — частка нашага жыццёвага свету. Яны створаныя чалавечым потам і падзяляюць чалавечую гісторыю. Мы павінны клапаціцца пра іх так, як клапоцімся пра людзей, прынамсі да пэўнай ступені."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FAC9.english: "Our things are a part of our life-world. They're made with human sweat and they share human history. We should care about them as we care about humans. To some extent at least," she adds.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FAC9.polish: „Nasze przedmioty są częścią naszego życioświata. Powstają dzięki ludzkiemu wysiłkowi i dzielą z nami naszą historię. Powinniśmy dbać o nie tak, jak dbamy o ludzi. Przynajmniej do pewnego stopnia” – dodaje.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FAC9.belarusian: "Нашы рэчы — частка нашага жыццёвага свету. Яны створаныя чалавечым потам і падзяляюць чалавечую гісторыю. Мы павінны клапаціцца пра іх так, як клапоцімся пра людзей. Прынамсі да пэўнай ступені", — дадае яна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FAD0.english: "Alright, I'm in. But organizing a funeral takes lot of time and effort, doesn't it?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FAD0.polish: „Dobrze, tak zrobię. Ale zorganizowanie pogrzebu wymaga wiele czasu i wysiłku, nieprawdaż?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FAD0.belarusian: "Добра, я згодны. Але арганізацыя пахавання вымагае шмат часу і высілкаў, ці не так?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FAD8.english: "I don't get attached. Definitely not to things."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FAD8.polish: „Ja się nie przywiązuję. A już na pewno nie do rzeczy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FAD8.belarusian: "Я не прывязваюся. Дакладна не да рэчаў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FADE.belarusian: Яна паціскае плячыма. "Калі вы так кажаце."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FAEC.english: "Oh yeah," she says with a chuckle. "You won't even be able to get it out of the water before early June and where are you gonna bury it? Who to invite? What music to play at the wake?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FAEC.polish: „O tak” – odpowiada, chichocząc. „Nie uda się panu wydobyć go nawet z wody przed początkiem czerwca, a przecież trzeba znaleźć miejsce na grób! Zaprosić gości! Wybrać muzykę na stypę!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000FAEC.belarusian: "О так, — кажа яна з усмешкай. — Вы нават не зможаце выцягнуць яе з вады да пачатку чэрвеня, і дзе вы збіраецеся яе хаваць? Каго запрашаць? Якую музыку ўключаць на памінках?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00001700.english: "If you haven't been there yourself, who has?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00001700.polish: „Skoro pani nigdy tam nie była, to kto był?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00001700.belarusian: "Калі вы самі там не былі, то хто быў?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000030CC.english: "Men with authority have their quirks. Comes with never being second-guessed about anything..." She waves you off.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000030CC.polish: „Mężczyźni u władzy mają swoje dziwactwa. Wynika to z tego, że nikt nigdy nie wątpi w to, co mówią...” – macha lekceważąco ręką.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000030CC.belarusian: "У надзеленых уладай мужчын свае дзівацтвы. Так бывае, калі ў тваіх словах ніхто ніколі не сумняваецца..." — яна адмахваецца ад цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000030DB.english: "I guess men with authority have their quirks." She waves you off. "What brings you here, Lawbringer?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000030DB.polish: „Mężczyźni u władzy mają swoje dziwactwa” – stwierdza, machając lekceważąco ręką. „Co pana tu sprowadza, panie Prawodawco?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000030DB.belarusian: "Мабыць, ва ўладных мужчын свае дзівацтвы. — Яна адмахваецца ад цябе. — Што прывяло вас сюды, Законатворца?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000030E9.polish: „Więc co pana tu sprowadza, panie Prawodawco?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000030F3.english: "The sign on the street leading here is *illegible*. Has been since they built this place." The wind rattles her earrings.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000030F3.polish: „Znak na prowadzącej tu ulicy jest *nieczytelny*. Był taki już w czasie, gdy ta wieś powstała” – wyjaśnia, a wiatr podzwania jej kolczykami.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000030F3.belarusian: "Таблічка на вуліцы, што вядзе сюды, *нечытэльная*. Заўсёды такой была, з самага часу, як пабудавалі гэтае месца". Вецер пазвоньвае яе завушніцамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003104.english: "The name is Lilienne. People call me Net Picker." She gestures toward the fishnets. "I think I have time for questions. And that was actually the second one."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003104.polish: „Nazywam się Lilienne. Ludzie nazywają mnie wybieraczką sieci” – stwierdza, wskazując rybackie sieci. „Zdaje się, że mam chwilę, aby odpowiedzieć na kilka pytań. To pytanie było drugie, a nie pierwsze”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003104.belarusian: "Мяне завуць Ліліен. Людзі клічуць мяне Выбіральніцай сетак". Яна паказвае ў бок рыбацкіх сетак. "Думаю, у мяне ёсць час на пытанні. І гэта было насамрэч другое".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003125.english: "I see you haven't left our little Martinaise yet. Still running around," she observes. "Like some kind of cross-country law official."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003125.polish: „Widzę, że nie opuścił pan jeszcze naszego malutkiego Martinaise. Wciąż pana wszędzie pełno” – stwierdza. „Jak jakiegoś międzynarodowego przedstawiciela prawa”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003125.belarusian: "Бачу, вы яшчэ не пакінулі наш маленькі Марцінэз. Усё яшчэ бегаеце тут вакол, — заўважае яна. — Як нейкі міжгародні праваахоўнік".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000312F.english: "The waves are beginning to die down... look at those little bastards. Simmer down. Simmer down, bastards."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000312F.polish: „Fale zaczynają słabnąć... Niech pan spojrzy na te draństwa. Uspokójcie się. Uspokójcie się, dranie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000312F.belarusian: "Хвалі пачынаюць супакойвацца... зірніце на гэтых паскудаў. Сціхніце. Сціхніце, паскуды".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003144.english: "What is it with you and those waves?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003144.polish: „Co pani tak ciągle z tymi falami?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003144.belarusian: "Што ў вас за адносіны з гэтымі хвалямі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000314A.english: "What is it with waves and fishermen?" She tilts her head and looks at the sea. "We need to be out there, with them. Fishing, making a living. So I ask them to accommodate me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000314A.polish: „Co łączy fale i rybaków?” – pyta, przekrzywiając głowę, i spogląda na morze. „Musimy być tam z nimi. Łowiąc, zarabiając na życie. Więc proszę je, aby miały mnie na względzie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000314A.belarusian: "Што за адносіны ў хваль і рыбакоў?" — яна схіляе галаву і глядзіць на мора. — "Нам трэба быць там, разам з імі. Лавіць рыбу, зарабляць на жыццё. Таму я прашу іх паставіцца да мяне з разуменнем".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003151.english: "I still have a case to solve."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000315B.english: "I have some loose ends to tie up."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031AB.english: "This place is kinda growing on me, you know."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031AB.polish: „Wie pani, zaczyna mi się tu nawet podobać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031AB.belarusian: "Ведаеце, гэтае месца пачынае мне нават падабацца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031B3.english: "Aye, but don't let it grow too much... this is not the place to settle down. Now, what's on your mind, Officer Harry?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031B3.polish: „Tak, tylko niech się pan nie przyzwyczaja za bardzo... To nie jest miejsce, w którym człowiek chciałby się osiedlić. W czym mogę pomóc, funkcjonariuszu Harry?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031B3.belarusian: "Ага, але глядзіце, каб не надта прыпала да душы... гэта не тое месца, дзе варта асядаць. Дык што ў вас на думцы, афіцэр Гары?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031BA.english: "Aye, I guess you do. What's on your mind, Officer Harry?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031BA.polish: „Tak, pewnie tak. W czym mogę pomóc, funkcjonariuszu Harry?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031BA.belarusian: "Ага, мабыць, так. Што ў вас на думцы, афіцэр Гары?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031CB.english: "Aye, I guess you do. What's on your mind, officer?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031CB.polish: „Tak, pewnie tak. W czym mogę pomóc, funkcjonariuszu?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031CB.belarusian: "Ага, мабыць, так. Што ў вас на думцы, афіцэру?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031D9.english: "Aye, but don't let it grow too much... this is not the place to settle down. Now, what's on your mind, officer?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031D9.polish: „Tak, tylko niech się pan nie przyzwyczaja za bardzo... To nie jest miejsce, w którym człowiek chciałby się osiedlić. W czym mogę pomóc, funkcjonariuszu?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000031D9.belarusian: "Ага, але глядзіце, каб не надта прыпала да душы... гэта не тое месца, дзе варта асядаць. Дык што ў вас на думцы, афіцэру?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A0D.english: "Were you?" Her eyes dart back and forth on the paper. "Hmm... this says by signing I agree to living with construction noise. What exactly is the Union building?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A0D.polish: „Naprawdę?” – pyta, a jej oczy błądzą po dokumencie. „Hmm... Wynika z tego, że podpisując, zgadzam się na hałas związany z robotami budowlanymi. Co Związek zamierza zbudować?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A0D.belarusian: "Няўжо? — яе вочы бегаюць па радках на паперы. — Гм... тут сказана, што падпісваючыся, я згаджаюся жыць з шумам ад будоўлі. А што канкрэтна будуе Прафсаюз?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A13.english: "I was asked to get your signature." (Hand her Evrart's envelope.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A13.polish: „Zostałem poproszony o zdobycie pani podpisu”. (Podaj jej kopertę Evrarta).
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A13.belarusian: "Мяне папрасілі ўзяць ваш подпіс." (Працягнуць ёй канверт Эўрара.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A19.english: "What a *nice* idea. Wouldn't have thought that..." Her voice trails off.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A19.polish: „Jaki *wspaniały* pomysł. Nie wpadłabym na to...” – stwierdza.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A19.belarusian: "Якая *цудоўная* ідэя. Ніколі б не падумала..." — яе голас сціхае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A21.english: "Evrart's planning to turn some of the village into a youth centre."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A21.polish: „Evrart planuje zmienić część wsi w centrum młodzieżowe”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A21.belarusian: "Эўрар плануе ператварыць частку вёскі ў моладзевы цэнтр."

Alternate1/0x0100006B00003A21.polish: „Jak mówiłem, Evrart planuje zmienić część wsi w centrum młodzieżowe”.
Alternate1/0x0100006B00003A21.belarusian: "Як я і казаў, Эўрар плануе ператварыць частку вёскі ў моладзевы цэнтр."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A35.english: "On second thought, don't sign the papers."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A35.polish: „Właściwie to niech nie podpisuje pani tych papierów”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A35.belarusian: "З іншага боку, не падпісвайце гэтыя паперы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A47.english: "Here, use my pen." (Give her your pen.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A47.polish: „Proszę, niech pani użyje mojego długopisu”. (Daj jej swój długopis).
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A47.belarusian: "Вось, вазьміце маю ручку." (Даць ёй сваю ручку.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A52.english: She thinks in silence, glances at the sea and finally speaks: "Aye, why not?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A52.polish: Myśli w milczeniu, spoglądając na morze, po czym odpowiada: „Tak, czemu nie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A52.belarusian: Яна моўчкі думае, глядзіць на мора і нарэшце кажа: "Добра, чаму б і не?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A5C.english: "Aye, if you say so." She plucks on her net. "Probably better that way. I mean -- who likes construction noise?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A5C.polish: „Dobrze, skoro pan tak mówi” – stwierdza i skubie swoją sieć. „Tak pewnie będzie lepiej. W końcu kto lubi hałas?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A5C.belarusian: "Добра, калі вы так кажаце, — яна перабірае сетку. — Напэўна, так нават лепш. У сэнсе — каму падабаецца шум ад будоўлі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A6C.english: "He has a pen and everything..." She takes it from you, a doubtful look in her eyes, clicks it and places the tip on the paper.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A6C.polish: „Ma długopis i w ogóle...” – stwierdza, biorąc oferowany długopis. Z powątpiewaniem w oczach włącza go i przykłada do papieru.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A6C.belarusian: "У яго і ручка ёсць, і ўсё такое... — яна бярэ яе з сумневам у вачах, пстрыкае ёй і прыстаўляе кончык да паперы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A81.english: "That Evrart and the Union have nice plans for anything. I thought they only cared about themselves." She shakes her head. "Well, I guess Union members have children too."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A81.polish: „Że Evrart i Związek ma jakieś wspaniałe pomysły na cokolwiek. Myślałam, że zależy im wyłącznie na własnych interesach” – stwierdza, kręcąc głową. „Najwyraźniej związkowcy też mają dzieci”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003A81.belarusian: "Што ў Эўрара і Прафсаюза ёсць добрыя планы на што б там ні было. Я думала, яны клапоцяцца толькі пра сябе, — яна хітае галавой. — Ну, напэўна, у чальцоў Прафсаюза таксама ёсць дзеці."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000452C.english: "I changed my mind. I would like you to sign the documents." (Hand her the envelope.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000452C.polish: „Zmieniłem zdanie. Chciałbym, żeby podpisała pani te dokumenty”. (Daj jej kopertę).
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000452C.belarusian: "Я змяніў рашэнне. Я хачу, каб вы падпісалі дакументы." (Працягнуць ёй канверт.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004532.english: She pulls out the papers. "Evrart and his plan for the village. I guess it does sound nice enough..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004532.polish: Wyciąga z niej dokumenty. „Evrart i jego plan dla naszej wsi. Rzeczywiście brzmi całkiem nieźle...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004532.belarusian: Яна дастае паперы. "Эўрар і яго план для вёскі. Здаецца, гучыць нядрэнна..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00000812.english: There's a moment's silence. She looks at the slushy snow-melt on the yellow belly of the boat.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00000812.polish: Zapada chwila milczenia. Kobieta wpatruje się w topniejący śnieg spływający po żółtym kadłubie łódki.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00000812.belarusian: Настае хвіліна маўчання. Яна глядзіць на снегавую кашу на жоўтым чэраве лодкі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007B0000081A.english: There's a moment's silence. She looks at the rain streaming down the yellow belly of the boat.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B0000081A.polish: Zapada chwila milczenia. Kobieta wpatruje się w deszcz spływający po żółtym kadłubie łódki.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B0000081A.belarusian: Настае хвіліна маўчання. Яна глядзіць, як дождж сцякае па жоўтым чэраве лодкі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BDC.english: "I'm just trying to help out a stranger in need."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BDC.polish: „Próbuję po prostu pomóc nieznajomemu w potrzebie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BDC.belarusian: "Я проста спрабую дапамагчы незнаёмцу ў бядзе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BE8.english: "I'm collecting evidence to charge him with petty theft.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BE8.polish: „Zbieram dowody, żeby móc oskarżyć go o kradzież”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BE8.belarusian: "Я збіраю доказы, каб абвінаваціць яго ў дробным крадзяжы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BEE.english: "I don't really know why I do things. Everything just *happens* to me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BEE.polish: „Nie wiem tak naprawdę, czemu robię różne rzeczy. Po prostu mi się *przytrafiają*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BEE.belarusian: "Я сам не ведаю, навошта нешта раблю. Усё проста *здараецца* са мной."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BF8.english: "That's sweet of you. It really is. I'd check around the abandoned fish market on the boardwalk. Drunks are inexplicably drawn to markets... might be why they have such trouble staying in business..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BF8.polish: „To bardzo miło z pana strony. Naprawdę. Na pana miejscu rozejrzałabym się na opuszczonym targu rybnym na promenadzie. To miejsce z jakiegoś powodu przyciąga pijaków... Może dlatego ten targ miał takie problemy z utrzymaniem się na powierzchni...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BF8.belarusian: "Гэта міла з вашага боку. Сапраўды. Я б праверыла каля закінутага рыбнага рынку на праменадзе. П'яніц невытлумачальна цягне да рынкаў... можа, таму тым так цяжка трымацца на плаву..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BFF.english: "Johnny what now?" She's trying to resist a smile. "That's not proper cop behaviour, is it?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BFF.polish: „Że co?” – pyta, starając się powstrzymać śmiech. „To nie jest zachowanie właściwe dla policjanta, prawda?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001BFF.belarusian: "Казіміра каго? — яна стрымлівае ўсмешку. — Гэта не вельмі па-паліцэйску, ці не так?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001C07.english: "Not the best use of your time, is it, Mr. Lawman? Harassin' homeless people on the beach and the like..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001C07.polish: „To chyba nie jest najlepszy sposób na wykorzystywanie pańskiego czasu, prawda, panie stróżu prawa? Napastowanie bezdomnych na plaży i tym podobne...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001C07.belarusian: "Не найлепшая трата вашага часу, ці не так, спадару праваахоўнік? Чапляцца да бяздомных на пляжы і ўсё такое..."

Alternate1/0x0100007B00001C3C.polish: „Myśli pani, że *to* jest takie straszne? Niech no tylko pani się dowie o *przepadku dóbr cywilnych*!”
Alternate1/0x0100007B00001C3C.belarusian: "Думаеце, *гэта* дрэнна? Пачакайце, пакуль не даведаецеся пра *грамадзянскую канфіскацыю маёмасці*!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001C4A.english: "I'm sure you have," she replies with a peculiar look. "I don't have to hear about it, but I do wish you luck finding the thing. Look near the fish market north of here, on the boardwalk. Drunks are *drawn* to markets."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001C4A.polish: „Jestem tego pewna” – odpowiada, spoglądając na ciebie dziwnie. „Nie muszę znać szczegółów, ale życzę panu, aby udało się panu znaleźć tę rzecz. Proszę rozejrzeć się w pobliżu targu rybnego na północ stąd, na promenadzie. To miejsce *przyciąga* pijaków”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001C4A.belarusian: "Я ўпэўненая, што рабілі, — адказвае яна з дзіўным позіркам. — Мне не трэба пра гэта ведаць, але я жадаю вам поспеху ў пошуках гэтай рэчы. Пашукайце каля рыбнага рынку на поўнач адсюль, на праменадзе. П'яніц *цягне* да рынкаў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001C54.english: "Sure, sure... that makes it alright." She rolls her eyes, but then suddenly a smile appears. "Still, I do hope you find it. Look near the fish market north of here, on the boardwalk. Drunks are *drawn* to markets."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001C54.polish: „Jasne, jasne... W takim razie wszystko w porządku” – odpowiada, wywracając oczami. Nagle na jej ustach pojawia się uśmiech. „Mimo to mam nadzieję, że pan ją znajdzie. Proszę rozejrzeć się w pobliżu targu rybnego na północ stąd, na promenadzie. To miejsce *przyciąga* pijaków”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001C54.belarusian: "Вядома, вядома... тады ўсё ў парадку, — яна закочвае вочы, але раптам усміхаецца. — І ўсё ж, спадзяюся, вы яе знойдзеце. Пашукайце каля рыбнага рынку на поўнач адсюль, на праменадзе. П'яніц *цягне* да рынкаў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001C6E.english: "If one of 'em lost something, that's as good a place to start looking as any."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001C6E.polish: „Jeśli jeden z nich coś zgubił, to jest to dobre miejsce, aby zacząć poszukiwania”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001C6E.belarusian: "Калі нехта з іх нешта згубіў, гэта месца для пачатку пошукаў не горшае за іншыя."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001E64.english: A phenomenon that the spectral hand theory of the market fails to account for.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001E64.polish: Zjawisko, którego nie jest w stanie wyjaśnić teoria działania niewidzialnej ręki rynku.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007B00001E64.belarusian: З'ява, якую тэорыя прывіднай рукі рынку не ў стане растлумачыць.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000015CE.english: She sounds incredulous about the niceness of the idea.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000015CE.polish: Zdaje się tak naprawdę nie wierzyć we wspaniałość tego pomysłu.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000015CE.belarusian: Гучыць так, нібыта яна не надта верыць у цудоўнасць гэтай ідэі.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000015EB.english: "You're welcome," she says with a little nod.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000015EB.polish: „Nie ma za co” – stwierdza, kiwając głową.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000015EB.belarusian: "Няма за што", — кажа яна з лёгкім кіўком.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000015FF.english: "I've looked at the documents and no, you shouldn't have."
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000015FF.polish: „Patrzyłem na te dokumenty. I nie, nie powinna pani”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000015FF.belarusian: "Я паглядзеў дакументы, і не, не трэба было."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001605.english: "No-no, it's a youth centre. Why *shouldn't* you?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001605.polish: „Nie, nie. To centrum młodzieżowe. Czemu miałaby pani *nie podpisywać*?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001605.belarusian: "Не-не, гэта ж моладзевы цэнтр. Чаму б вам *не* падпісаць?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000160B.english: "I mean it's Evrart, so it's probably a mistake."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000160B.polish: „No, to w końcu Evrart, więc to pewnie błąd”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000160B.belarusian: "Я маю на ўвазе, гэта ж Эўрар, так што гэта, напэўна, памылка."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001613.english: "That's what I asked *you*." She tilts her head. "It's a youth centre and I have children. Got to give them *something* else to do. They're cute and small now, but they're growing up fast. I had my first drink when I was eleven, because I was so bored..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001613.polish: „Właśnie o to *pana* pytam” – stwierdza, przechylając głowę na bok. „To centrum młodzieżowe, a ja mam dzieci. Muszę dać im jakieś *inne* zajęcie. W tej chwili są urocze i małe, ale szybko dorosną. Sama pierwszego drinka wypiłam, gdy miałam jedenaście lat, bo się nudziłam...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001613.belarusian: "Вось і я *вас* пра гэта спытала, — яна хіліць галаву набок. — Гэта моладзевы цэнтр, а ў мяне дзеці. Трэба даць ім хоць *нейкі* іншы занятак. Цяпер яны мілыя і маленькія, але яны хутка растуць. Я ўпершыню выпіла ў адзінаццаць гадоў, таму што мне было так сумна..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000161B.english: "Yes. Well. I looked at it and thought I should -- because it says *youth centre* and I have my own children. I am, of course, just a stupid poor person, so what do I know?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000161B.polish: „Tak. Cóż. Ja je przejrzałam i pomyślałam, że powinnam – bo mówią o *centrum młodzieżowym*, a ja mam dzieci. Ale – oczywiście – jestem tylko głupią, biedną osobą, więc co ja tam mogę wiedzieć?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000161B.belarusian: "Так. Ну. Я паглядзела на гэта і падумала, што варта — бо там напісана *моладзевы цэнтр*, а ў мяне ёсць уласныя дзеці. Я, вядома, проста дурная бяднячка, дык што я магу ведаць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001628.english: "Living with the construction noise is going to be a challenge."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001628.polish: „Życie z hałasem związanym z robotami budowlanymi będzie wyzwaniem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001628.belarusian: "Жыць з шумам ад будоўлі будзе няпроста."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000162E.english: "Besides, you also need Isobel's signature," she says with a smile. "If it's a bad idea, she won't sign."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000162E.polish: „Poza tym potrzebuje pan też podpisu Isobel” – stwierdza z uśmiechem. „Jeśli uzna, że to zły pomysł, to tego nie podpisze”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000162E.belarusian: "Акрамя таго, вам таксама патрэбны подпіс Ізабель, — кажа яна з усмешкай. — Калі гэта дрэнная ідэя, яна не падпіша."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001636.english: "Sure, but it's temporary and for a good cause and I need to give the children *something* else to do..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001636.polish: „Oczywiście, ale to tymczasowa sytuacja i wyniknie z niej coś dobrego – muszę dać swoim dzieciom jakieś *inne* zajęcie...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001636.belarusian: "Вядома, але гэта часова і дзеля добрай справы, а мне трэба даць дзецям хоць *нейкі* іншы занятак..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001643.english: "Probably." She smiles. "But it is a youth centre and I have children. Got to give them *something* else to do. They're cute and small now, but they're growing up fast. I had my first drink when I was eleven, because I was so bored..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001643.polish: „Pewnie tak” – stwierdza, uśmiechając się. „Ale to centrum młodzieżowe, a ja mam dzieci. Muszę dać im jakieś *inne* zajęcie. W tej chwili są urocze i małe, ale szybko dorosną. Sama pierwszego drinka wypiłam, gdy miałam jedenaście lat, bo się nudziłam...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700001643.belarusian: "Магчыма, — яна ўсміхаецца. — Але гэта моладзевы цэнтр, а ў мяне дзеці. Трэба даць ім хоць *нейкі* іншы занятак. Цяпер яны мілыя і маленькія, але яны хутка растуць. Я ўпершыню выпіла ў адзінаццаць гадоў, таму што мне было так сумна..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000164A.english: Sound logic, division of labour. She leaves the scepticism to the sceptic.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000164A.polish: Rozsądne i logiczne. Podział pracy. Pozostawia sceptycyzm sceptyczce.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000164A.belarusian: Здаровая логіка, падзел працы. Яна пакідае скептыцызм скептыку.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000165B.english: Sounds like *Isobel* is the leader around here.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000165B.polish: Zdaje się, że ta *Isobel* jest tu przywódczynią.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700005BBC.english: "Anyhow.... you also need Isobel's signature. If it's a bad idea, she won't sign. You'll find she's a tougher nut to crack than me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700005BBC.polish: „W każdym razie... potrzebuje pan też podpisu Isobel. Jeśli to jest zły pomysł, to ona tego nie podpisze. Przekona się pan, że ona jest znacznie trudniejszym orzechem do zgryzienia niż ja”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700005BBC.belarusian: "У кожным разе... вам яшчэ патрэбны подпіс Ізабель. Калі гэта дрэнная ідэя, яна не падпіша. Убачыце, яна мацнейшы арэшак, чым я."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700005F74.english: ... and those members have a vote, when electing the head of the local chapter.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700005F74.polish: Mają też głos przy wyborze przewodniczącego miejscowego komitetu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700005F74.belarusian: ...і гэтыя чальцы маюць голас на выбарах кіраўніка мясцовай суполкі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700005F90.english: "They're cute and small now, but they're growing up fast. Too fast, I had my first drink when I was eleven, because I was so bored..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700005F90.polish: „W tej chwili są urocze i małe, ale szybko dorosną. Zbyt szybko. Sama pierwszego drinka wypiłam, gdy miałam jedenaście lat, bo się nudziłam...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700005F90.belarusian: "Цяпер яны мілыя і маленькія, але яны хутка растуць. Занадта хутка — я ўпершыню выпіла ў адзінаццаць гадоў, таму што мне было так сумна..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700005F97.english: "Anyway... you'll have to get Isobel to sign it too. I saw the signatories --  she won't if it's a bad idea. She's a much tougher nut to crack."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700005F97.polish: „W każdym razie... Musi pan zdobyć też podpis Isobel. Widziałam listę sygnatariuszy. Ona tego nie zrobi, jeśli uzna to za zły pomysł. To znacznie trudniejszy orzech do zgryzienia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700005F97.belarusian: "У любым выпадку... вам давядзецца ўзяць подпіс і ў Ізабель. Я бачыла спіс падпісантаў — яна не падпіша, калі гэта дрэнная ідэя. Яна куды мацнейшы арэшак."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060000E455.english: She knew you were one when you took her to Land's End.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060000E455.polish: Wiedziała, że nim jesteś, kiedy zabierałeś ją na Kraniec.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060000E455.belarusian: Яна ведала, што ты такі, калі ты вёў яе на Край Свету.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060000E471.english: "Always seemed like there was something off about that islet to me..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060000E471.polish: „Zawsze miałam wrażenie, że z tą wysepką jest coś nie tak...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060000E471.belarusian: "Мне заўсёды здавалася, што з тым астраўком нешта не так..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060000E482.english: "Can we maybe ask your twins about that place -- before we go? Would that be all right?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000060000E482.polish: „Czy moglibyśmy zapytać bliźnięta o to miejsce, zanim tam popłyniemy? Nie ma pani nic przeciwko?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060000E482.belarusian: "Ці можам мы распытаць вашых блізнятаў пра тое месца — перш чым выправімся туды? Вы не супраць?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000060000E492.english: "Be my guest." She looks at the boys. "They've a strange way of talking. See if you can get anything *useful* out of them. I seldom do..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060000E492.polish: „Proszę bardzo” – stwierdza, spoglądając na chłopców. „Mają dziwny sposób mówienia. Może wydobędą panowie z nich coś *przydatnego*. Mnie rzadko się to udaje...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060000E492.belarusian: "Калі ласка, — яна глядзіць на хлопчыкаў. — Яны неяк дзіўна размаўляюць. Паглядзім, ці выцягнеце вы з іх нешта *карыснае*. Мне гэта рэдка ўдаецца..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000290000000F.english: Why does she care about the waves so much?
Dialogue Text/0x010000290000000F.polish: Czemu tak bardzo obchodzą ją fale?
Dialogue Text/0x010000290000000F.belarusian: Чаму яе так моцна хвалююць гэтыя хвалі?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002900000017.english: Nevermind the waves. Let's stay on track here.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002900000017.polish: Zapomnij o falach. Trzymajmy się tematu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002900000017.belarusian: Забудзься пра хвалі. Давай трымацца сутнасці.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FEE4.english: "I'm looking for someone, maybe you can help?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FEE4.polish: „Szukam kogoś. Może będzie mi pani w stanie pomóc?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FEE4.belarusian: "Я шукаю аднаго чалавека, можа, вы можаце дапамагчы?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FEEC.english: "Let's see," she tilts her head ever so slightly. "Who are you looking for?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FEEC.polish: „Przekonajmy się” – stwierdza, przechylając głowę odrobinę na bok. „Kogo pan szuka?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FEEC.belarusian: "Паглядзім, — яна ледзь-ледзь хіліць галаву набок. — Каго вы шукаеце?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FEF9.english: "I'm looking for a suspect who might have stayed in this neighbourhood."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FEF9.polish: „Szukam podejrzanej, która mogła zatrzymać się tu w okolicy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FEF9.belarusian: "Я шукаю падазраваную, якая магла спыняцца ў гэтым раёне."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF0B.english: "That's it, I'm not looking for anyone else right now."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF0B.polish: „To już wszystko, nie szukam na razie nikogo innego”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF0B.belarusian: "Гэта ўсё, пакуль я больш нікога не шукаю."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF12.english: "Okay, when did this person stay here?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF12.polish: „W porządku, kiedy ta osoba się tu zatrzymała?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF12.belarusian: "Добра, а калі гэты чалавек тут спыняўся?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF19.english: "Very recently, over the past few days. She might have arrived on Friday."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF19.polish: „Bardzo niedawno, jakoś kilka dni temu. Mogła tu przybyć w piątek”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF19.belarusian: "Зоўсім нядаўна, цягам апошніх некалькіх дзён. Яна магла прыбыць у пятніцу."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF20.english: "Oh..." She looks slightly disappointed. "I've been out on the sea for most of the past week. The weather's been good for fishing, so I usually start at four in the morning."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF20.polish: „Och...” – wygląda na odrobinę zawiedzioną. „Przez większość zeszłego tygodnia byłam na morzu. Pogoda sprzyjała połowom, więc wypływałam już o czwartej rano”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF20.belarusian: "Ох... — яна выглядае крыху расчараванай. — Большую частку мінулага тыдня я была ў моры. Надвор'е было добрым для рыбалкі, таму я звычайна выходжу а чацвёртай раніцы."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF2E.english: "Yes, that's the optimal time. Got to make the most of the calm. I've been sleeping like a corpse after. The sea really takes its toll. Now I'm just waiting for the wind to settle to get out there again..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF2E.polish: „Tak, to najlepszy czas. Trzeba korzystać ze spokojnego morza. Po powrocie spałam jak zabita. Praca na morzu jest naprawdę męcząca. Teraz czekam, aż wiatr się uspokoi, aby znowu wypłynąć na połów...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF2E.belarusian: "Так, гэта найлепшы час. Трэба карыстацца штылем напоўніцу. Пасля гэтага я спала як забітая. Мора вельмі вымотвае. Цяпер проста чакаю, пакуль аціхне вецер, каб зноў выйсці ў мора..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF35.english: "Sorry I couldn't help you out." A faint smile runs across her face. "Maybe I can help you find someone else?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF35.polish: „Przykro mi, że nie mogę panu pomóc” – przeprasza, a na jej ustach pojawia się cień uśmiechu. „Może uda mi się pomóc panu odnaleźć kogoś innego?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF35.belarusian: "Прабачце, што не змагла дапамагчы, — слабая ўсмешка прабягае па яе твары. — Можа, я магу дапамагчы вам знайсці кагосьці іншага?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF42.english: "Ugh..." She frowns, thinking. "I don't think I know what these are. Care to elaborate?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF42.polish: „Yy...” – marszczy czoło w zamyśleniu. „Zdaje się, że nie mam pojęcia, co to za jedni. Mógłby pan wyjaśnić?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF42.belarusian: "Э-э... — яна хмурыцца, разважаючы. — Здаецца, я нават не ведаю, хто гэта такія. Не патлумачыце?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF4F.english: "People who look for animals, who are hard to find."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF4F.belarusian: "Людзей, якія шукаюць жывёл, якіх цяжка знайсці."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF55.english: "People who look for animals *mainstream* scientists deny exist."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF55.polish: „Ludzie szukający zwierząt, w których istnienie nie wierzą naukowcy *głównego nurtu*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF55.belarusian: "Людзей, якія шукаюць жывёл, існаванне якіх адмаўляюць навукоўцы *мэйнстрыму*."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF67.english: "Snow Men? I haven't heard about those."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF67.belarusian: "Снежных Людзей? Пра такіх я не чуў."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF6E.english: "Two odd guys have been wandering around here, nose in sand, talking nonsense about Snow Men and the like."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF6E.polish: „Dwóch dziwnych facetów kręciło się tutaj z nosem w piasku i opowiadali jakieś bzdury o bałwanach i takich tam”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF6E.belarusian: "Тут бадзяліся два дзіўныя тыпы, носам у пясок, і верзлі нейкую лухту пра Снежных Людзей і ўсё такое."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF90.english: "Right," she nods. "Not only Snow Men -- also Green Men, Monkey Men, burning rhinos. You get the picture."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF90.polish: „Zgadza się” – kiwa głową. „Nie tylko o bałwanach, ale też o niebieskich ludkach, małpoludziach, płonących nosorożcach. Chyba pan łapie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF90.belarusian: "Менавіта, — яна ківае. — Не толькі Снежных Людзей, але і Зялёных Чалавечкаў, Людзей-Малпаў, палаючых насарогаў. Ну, вы зразумелі."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF97.english: Oh, you're getting it and it *is* gorgeous.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF9F.english: "I don't really know. Further down the peninsula I guess. I mean that's where they were heading." She points north. "Who else are you looking for, beside Snow Men?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF9F.polish: „Właściwie to nie wiem. Chyba w głąb półwyspu. Znaczy – w tym kierunku zmierzali” – wskazuje północ. „Kogo pan jeszcze szuka poza bałwanami?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FF9F.belarusian: "Дакладна не ведаю. Далей па паўвостраве, мабыць. Прынамсі, яны накіроўваліся туды, — яна паказвае на поўнач. — Каго яшчэ вы шукаеце, акрамя Снежных Людзей?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFAE.english: "Yeah, *I'm* not really looking for that anymore. Not much into the middle-class ones either." She sighs. "I could use some *landed gentry*, but apparently they don't make those anymore."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFAE.polish: „Taa... *Ja* już właściwie kogoś takiego nie szukam. Nie interesuje mnie też klasa średnia” – wzdycha. „Przydałby mi się *ziemianin*, ale najwyraźniej już takich nie robią”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFAE.belarusian: "Ну, *я* такога ўжо не шукаю. Да сярэдняга класа таксама не ляжыць душа, — уздыхае яна. — Мне б не зашкодзіла крыху *памешчыцкага дваранства*, але такіх, відаць, ужо не робяць."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFB7.english: "The husband isn't for me. I'm looking for him for his wife."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFB7.polish: „To nie dla mnie ten mąż. Szukam go w imieniu jego żony”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFB7.belarusian: "Гэты муж не для мяне. Я шукаю яго для ягонай жонкі."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFBE.english: "Wish I could help you with that, but I haven't seen your 'working class husband'. Maybe I can help you find someone else?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFBE.polish: „Chciałabym panu w tym pomóc, ale nie widziałam tego *męża należącego do klasy robotniczej*. Może mogę panu pomóc w poszukiwaniu kogoś innego?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFBE.belarusian: "Хацела б я вам дапамагчы, але не бачыла вашага 'мужа з рабочага класа'. Можа, магу дапамагчы знайсці кагосьці іншага?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFCA.english: She seems genuinely sorry for not being able to help you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFCA.polish: Wydaje się szczerze żałować, że nie może ci pomóc.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFCA.belarusian: Здаецца, ёй сапраўды шкада, што яна не можа табе дапамагчы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFDC.english: "Well, how can I assist you then, officer?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFDC.polish: „W takim razie jak mogę panu pomóc?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFDC.belarusian: "Ну, і чым я магу вам дапамагчы, афіцэру?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFEA.english: "Really? Are you sure you're not also looking for Nadia Harnankur? Or Ignus Nilsen? Or the great lost city of Eis under the waves?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFEA.polish: „Naprawdę? Na pewno nie szuka pan również Nadii Harnankur? Albo Ignusa Nilsena? Albo zaginionego miasta Eis pod powierzchnią morza?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFEA.belarusian: "Сапраўды? Упэўненыя, што не шукаеце яшчэ і Надзю Харнакур? Ці Ігнуса Нільсэна? Ці вялікі згублены горад Эйс пад хвалямі?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFF1.english: "I am looking for a lot of stuff, ain't I?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFF1.belarusian: "Шмат усяго я шукаю, ці не так?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000FFF8.english: "A *lot* of stuff," she concurs with a smile.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010009.english: "I'm just doing my job. Let's change the subject."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010009.belarusian: "Я проста раблю сваю працу. Давайце зменім тэму."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001000F.english: "I guess that makes you into some sort of a terrier." She picks on her net. "Either way, I can't help you out."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001000F.polish: „W takim razie jesteście czymś w rodzaju terierów” – stwierdza, łapiąc swoją sieć. „Tak czy siak, nie jestem w stanie panu pomóc”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001000F.belarusian: "Відаць, гэта робіць вас чымсьці накшталт тэр'ера, — яна перабірае сетку. — Так ці інакш, дапамагчы я вам не магу."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010015.english: "Intense." She pulls her fingers through her hair. "You're like some kind of dark terrier with your endless searches. Maybe there's something else I can help you with then?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010015.polish: „Intensywny pan” – stwierdza, przeczesując swoje włosy palcami. „Jest pan jak jakiś mroczny terier z tymi swoimi poszukiwaniami. Może mogę panu pomóc w jakiś inny sposób?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010015.belarusian: "Магутна, — яна праводзіць пальцамі па валасах. — Вы як нейкі змрочны тэр'ер з гэтымі вашымі бясконцымі пошукамі. Можа, я магу дапамагчы вам з чымсьці іншым?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010025.english: "I'm an agent of unstoppable forces. No one can escape what's coming for them."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010025.polish: „Jestem wysłannikiem sił nie do powstrzymania. Nikt nie ucieknie przed tym, co ma się wydarzyć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010025.belarusian: "Я агент нястрымных сіл. Ніхто не ўцячэ ад таго, што на іх насоўваецца."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001002B.english: "I guess so. Doesn't feel like a lot to me. I could be doing *more*. Maybe there's someone missing from your life?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001002B.polish: „Na to wygląda. Ale dla mnie nie wydaje się to wiele. Mógłbym wrobić *więcej*. Może w pani życiu też kogoś brakuje?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001002B.belarusian: "Напэўна. Мне не здаецца, што гэта шмат. Я мог бы рабіць *больш*. Можа, у вашым жыцці кагосьці не хапае?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001004B.english: "Oh," she chuckles. "There's plenty missing, but that's too much for even an eager terrier like you to handle. Although you seem very thorough. Tell me instead, is there something else I can help you with?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001004B.polish: „Och!” – chichocze. „Wiele mi brakuje, ale nawet taki gorliwy terier by sobie z tym nie poradził. Chociaż sprawia pan wrażenie bardzo skrupulatnego. Niech pan lepiej powie, czy mogę pomóc panu w czymś innym”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001004B.belarusian: "Ох, — пасмейваецца яна. — Шмат каго не хапае, але гэта занадта нават для такога заўзятага тэр'ера, як вы. Хоць вы і выглядаеце вельмі грунтоўным. Лепш скажыце, ці ёсць яшчэ нешта, з чым я магла б вам дапамагчы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010074.english: "Unbelievable, you *are* looking for more lost things." She smiles. "Doom Spiral losing his jacket on the other hand is *very* believable. I mean he has lost everything else already."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010074.polish: „Niewiarygodne, *szuka* pan kolejnych zgubionych rzeczy” – stwierdza z uśmiechem. „Za to Spirala Katastrof tracący swoją kurtkę to coś *mało* zaskakującego. W końcu stracił już wszystko”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010074.belarusian: "Неверагодна, вы і *праўда* шукаеце яшчэ нейкія згубленыя рэчы, — яна ўсміхаецца. — А вось тое, што Кручаны Ёлуп згубіў куртку, наадварот, *вельмі* праўдападобна. У сэнсе, ён жа ўсё астатняе ўжо згубіў."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001007B.english: "Remarkable..." She shakes her head. "That one already lost everything else and now his jacket too?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001007B.polish: „Niesamowite...” – kręci głową. „Stracił już wszystko, a teraz do tego też kurtkę?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001007B.belarusian: "Неверагодна..." Яна хітае галавой. "Той ужо страціў усё астатняе, а цяпер яшчэ і куртку?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010068.english: "Idiot Doom Spiral over there needs his jacket. Have you seen it?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010068.polish: „Idiota w Spirali Katastrof, ten tam, potrzebuje swojej kurtki. Widziała ją pani?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010068.belarusian: "Вунь таму Лёсам Кручанаму Ёлупу патрэбна яго куртка. Вы яе не бачылі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010084.english: "It's a good thing too that he has an actual police officer looking for it." A smile lights up her face. "Good old Doom Spiral, upper-management to the core."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010084.polish: „Dobrze, że ma prawdziwego funkcjonariusza policji, który jej szuka” – stwierdza z uśmiechem na twarzy. „Stary dobry Idiota w Spirali – kierownik wyższego szczebla do szpiku kości”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010084.belarusian: "І вельмі добра, што яе шукае сапраўдны афіцэр паліцыі, — усмешка асвятляе яе твар. — Стары добры Кручаны Ёлуп, топ-менеджар да мозга касцей."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001008B.english: That's odd. Is she actually impressed?
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001008B.polish: To dziwne. Czyżby naprawdę była pod wrażeniem?

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100A9.english: She's genuinely rooting for you, sire!
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100A9.polish: Ona szczerze trzyma za ciebie kciuki, szanowny panie!
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100A9.belarusian: Яна шчыра за вас заўзее, мой пане!

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100B8.english: "*No one* plays Johnny Jacket. I find it -- I keep it."
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100B8.polish: „*Nikt* nie będzie robił w konia Konrada Kurtkiewicza. Znajdę ją. I zatrzymam dla siebie”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100B8.belarusian: "*Ніхто* не ашукае Казіміра Куртку. Знайду — пакіну сабе."

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100C0.english: "Aye, we all feel that way sometimes..." She turns her gaze towards the beach. "Sometimes I wonder if I'm the protagonist even in my own life story."
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100C0.polish: „Tak, wszyscy mamy czasem takie wrażenie...” – stwierdza i spogląda na plażę. „Czasem zastanawiam się, czy to ja jestem protagonistką w historii mojego życia”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100C0.belarusian: "Так, усе мы часам гэта адчуваем... — яна пераводзіць позірк на пляж. — Часам я думаю, ці галоўная я гераіня нават у гісторыі ўласнага жыцця."

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100C7.english: A gush of sadness suddenly washes over her.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100CE.english: "Anyway..." She clears her throat. Twice. "I'd look near the fish market north of here, on the boardwalk. Drunks are *drawn* to markets, for some reason. Was there something else?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100CE.polish: „W każdym razie...” – odchrząkuje. Dwa razy. „Na pana miejscu rozejrzałabym się w pobliżu targu rybnego na północ stąd, na promenadzie. To miejsce z jakiegoś powodu *przyciąga* pijaków. Mogę panu jeszcze w czymś pomóc?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100CE.belarusian: "У кожным разе... — яна адхаркваецца. Двойчы. — Я б пашукала каля рыбнага рынку на поўнач адсюль, на праменадзе. П'яніц чамусьці *цягне* да рынкаў. Было нешта яшчэ?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100DF.english: Ask her about the cool sword -- helps to break the ice.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100DF.polish: Spytaj ją o ten czadowy miecz. Przełamiesz pierwsze lody.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000100DF.belarusian: Спытай яе пра круты меч — дапаможа растапіць лёд.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010106.english: "But until that happens I can try to assist you the best I can," she adds with a smile. "So, what will it be, officer?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010106.polish: „Ale zanim do tego dojdzie, mogę panu pomóc” – dodaje z uśmiechem. „Więc co chce pan wiedzieć?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010106.belarusian: "Але пакуль гэтага не сталася, я магу паспрабаваць дапамагчы вам, чым здолею, — дадае яна з усмешкай. — Дык што вас цікавіць, афіцэру?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000102B2.english: But not when you're in a *tight* spot.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000102B2.belarusian: Але не калі ты ў *цесным* становішчы.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000102C9.english: Is she flirting with you? A *little*? You think she might be...
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000102C9.polish: Czy ona z tobą flirtuje? *Odrobinę*? Masz wrażenie, że może faktycznie...
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000102C9.belarusian: Яна з табой фліртуе? *Крышачку*? Табе здаецца, што так...

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000102D7.english: That does *not* go for *real* men. It does not go for *you*. Show her. Show her The Wonder.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000102D7.polish: *Nie tyczy* się to *prawdziwych* mężczyzn. Nie tyczy się *ciebie*. Pokaż jej swój osobisty cud.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000102D7.belarusian: Гэта *не* тычыцца *сапраўдных* мужчын. Гэта не тычыцца *цябе*. Пакажы ёй. Пакажы ёй Цуд.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000102FD.english: Sounds like she'd prefer her men to be less 'real'.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000102FD.polish: Brzmi to, jakby wolała, żeby jej mężczyźni byli nieco mniej „prawdziwi”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000102FD.belarusian: Гучыць так, нібыта яна б аддала перавагу менш 'сапраўдным' мужчынам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010323.english: "Find someone else to laugh at, I'm not a clown!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010323.polish: „Proszę sobie znaleźć kogoś innego do wyśmiewania. Nie jestem błaznem!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010323.belarusian: "Знайдзіце сабе кагосьці іншага для насмешак, я не блазан!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001032B.english: "I apologize," she replies with a nod. "It looked like you could face-down any horror in the world with that unchanging grin. Looked like a shield."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001032B.polish: „Przepraszam” – odpowiada, kiwając głową. „Wyglądało, jakby był pan w stanie stawić czoła każdej grozie świata z tym niezmiennym uśmieszkiem. Ten uśmiech był jak tarcza”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001032B.belarusian: "Прабачце, — адказвае яна з кіўком. — Выглядала так, нібыта вы маглі б сустрэць любы жах у свеце з гэтым нязменным ашчэрам. Гэта выглядала як шчыт."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010338.english: The traces of her laughter are still there -- in her eyes, fading fast.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010338.polish: W jej oczach wciąż widać gasnące szybko błyski rozbawienia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010338.belarusian: Сляды яе смеху ўсё яшчэ там — у яе вачах, хутка згасаючы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010345.english: "Yeah, by himself. Inadvertently." She continues with a frown. "He never respected the sea. Went out there drunk like a skunk and sure enough one day he didn't come back."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010345.polish: „Tak, przez samego siebie. Nieumyślnie” – kontynuuje ze zmarszczonym czołem. „Nigdy nie szanował morza. Wypływał pijany jak bela i wreszcie pewnego dnia nie wrócił”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010345.belarusian: "Ага, сам сябе. Выпадкова, — працягвае яна, нахмурыўшыся. — Ён ніколі не паважаў мора. Выйшаў у мора п'яны як смок, і вось аднойчы не вярнуўся."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001034D.english: "Who knows, maybe he fell over?" She shrugs. "He didn't respect the sea. Went out there drunk like a skunk and sure enough one day the boat was found floating empty. The bloated corpse turned up two weeks later."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001034D.polish: „Kto wie? Może wypadł za burtę?” – stwierdza, wzruszając ramionami. „Nie szanował morza. Wypływał pijany jak bela i wreszcie pewnego dnia jego łódź znaleziono pustą. Wzdęte zwłoki znalazły się dwa tygodnie później”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001034D.belarusian: "Хто ведае, можа, выпаў за борт? — яна паціскае плячыма. — Ён не паважаў мора. Выйшаў у мора п'яны як смок, і вось аднойчы лодку знайшлі пустой. Раздзьмуты труп усплыў праз два тыдні."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010354.english: "He didn't respect the sea. Went out there drunk like a skunk and sure enough one day the boat was found floating empty. The bloated corpse turned up two weeks later."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010354.polish: „Nie szanował morza. Wypływał pijany jak bela i wreszcie pewnego dnia jego łódź znaleziono pustą. Wzdęte zwłoki znalazły się dwa tygodnie później”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010354.belarusian: "Ён не паважаў мора. Выйшаў у мора п'яны як смок, і вось аднойчы лодку знайшлі пустой. Раздзьмуты труп усплыў праз два тыдні."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001036A.english: "Now, before you tell me how sorry you are for my loss, know that it was four years ago and I've moved on. There's only so much mourning you can do for a drunk with sinewy muscles."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001036A.polish: „Zanim powie pan, że przykro mu z powodu mojej straty, musi pan wiedzieć, że to wydarzyło się cztery lata temu i że już się z tym pogodziłam. Nie można opłakiwać w nieskończoność żylastego pijaka”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001036A.belarusian: "А цяпер, перш чым вы скажаце, як вам шкада маёй страты, ведайце, што гэта было чатыры гады таму, і я жыву далей. Нельга бясконца аплакваць п'яніцу з жылістымі цягліцамі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010379.english: "Yeah, death is nothing. I shit on death."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010379.polish: „Tak, śmierć jest niczym. Sram na śmierć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700010379.belarusian: "Так, смерць — гэта нішто. Я сраў на смерць."
