Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F335.belarusian: Ты такі ж самотны, як і мінулым разам. Усё, што складала табе кампанію ў гэтым свеце — усё, што ахоўвала цябе — пакінула цябе і ніколі больш не вернецца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F347.english: "Why are you doing this? Don't do this to me, please!" Remember? Who *was* that meant for?
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F347.polish: „Czemu to robisz? Nie rób mi tego, proszę!” – pamiętasz? Do kogo *skierowałeś* te słowa?
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F347.belarusian: "Чаму ты гэта робіш? Не рабі так са мной, калі ласка!" Памятаеш? Каму гэта *было* адрасавана?

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F34C.english: Beauty has abandoned you in this ugliness, honcho. And then some! You cannot even remember the *name* of beauty; what beauty was...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F34C.polish: Piękno porzuciło cię wśród tej brzydoty, szefuniu. Co więcej! Nie umiesz nawet przypomnieć sobie *imienia* tego piękna. Czym to piękno było...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F34C.belarusian: Прыгажосць пакінула цябе сярод гэтай брыдоты, бос. І нават больш! Ты нават не можаш прыгадаць *імя* прыгажосці; чым была прыгажосць...

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F351.english: You swallow, like you swallowed the last time. Whatever bitter emotion was swimming to the surface then -- and now -- subsides. Submerges. Sinks back into you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F351.polish: Przełykasz ślinę, tak jak poprzednio. Gorzkie uczucie, które próbowało wydostać się na powierzchnię wtedy – i teraz – przemija. Zanurza się ponownie. Tonie w twoim wnętrzu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F351.belarusian: Ты сглынаеш, як сглынаў мінулым разам. Горкае пачуццё, што выплывала на паверхню тады — і цяпер — сціхае. Апускаецца. Зноў тоне ў табе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F375.english: White Mourning. It was mourning all along. You should've seen it coming, it was right behind her eyes...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F375.polish: Biała żałoba. To od początku była żałoba właśnie. Powinieneś był się zorientować, kryła się tuż za jej oczami...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F375.belarusian: Белая жалоба. Гэта ўвесь час была жалоба. Табе варта было здагадацца, яна стаяла проста за яе вачыма...

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F383.english: Caustic Echo. It was darkness all along. But you were young and it was summer. You just had to take a dive...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F383.polish: Gorzkie echo. Mrok, od samego początku. Ale ty byłeś młodszy, było lato. Musiałeś tylko rzucić się na głowę...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F383.belarusian: З'едлівае рэха. Гэта ўвесь час была цемра. Але ты быў малады і было лета. Табе трэба было проста нырнуць уніз...

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F3B8.english: There is no answer -- it's nighttime, officer.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F3B8.polish: Nie ma odpowiedzi. Jest noc, panie władzo.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F3BF.english: A young woman like this is probably out partying the night away. Drink and drugs, sweet drugs are involved. Loneliness begone...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F3BF.polish: Taka młoda kobieta spędza zapewne noc na imprezie. Pije i bierze prochy. Kochane prochy. Precz, samotności...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F3BF.belarusian: Такая маладая жанчына напэўна адрываецца недзе ўсю ноч. Выпіўка і наркотыкі, салодкія наркотыкі. Прэч, самота...

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F3CF.english: In the Jamrock Quarter, The Paliseum for music, company and men... or the Door To The River, for death and synthetic opiates. Or, way in the East in Couron, in a starlit *boîte de nuits* like *La Cherte*... far from here and you, shivering dog.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F3CF.polish: W dzielnicy Jamrock, w Paliseum, gdzie szuka muzyki, towarzystwa i mężczyzn... albo w Drzwiach do Rzeki, by znaleźć śmierć i syntetyczne opiaty. Albo daleko na wschodzie, w Couron, w rozświetlonym gwiazdami *boîte de nuits* jak *La Cherte*. Daleko stąd i od ciebie, trzęsący się psie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F3CF.belarusian: У квартале Джэмрок, у Палізэі — дзеля музыкі, кампаніі і мужчын... ці ў Дзвярах да Ракі — дзеля смерці і сінтэтычных апіятаў. Ці далёка на ўсходзе ў Куроне, у залітымі зоркамі *boîte de nuits*, як *Ля Шэртэ*... далёка адсюль і ад цябе, дрыготкі сабака.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F3E1.english: "We should come back in the morning."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F3EA.english: "Who is it?" A woman's voice answers -- muffled by the door.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F3EA.polish: „Kto tam?” – odpowiada przytłumiony drzwiami kobiecy głos.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F3EA.belarusian: "Хто там?" — глуха адказвае праз дзверы жаночы голас.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F401.english: "This is the police. Can we come in?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F410.english: Somewhere not far from here the lieutenant is preparing her file. "Klaasje Amandou," he writes. You realize the detective should be here for what comes next. It could prove... *dangerous* to go in alone.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F410.polish: Gdzieś niedaleko stąd porucznik tworzy jej kartotekę. „Klaasje Amandou” – pisze. Dociera do ciebie, że powinien być świadkiem tego, co się zaraz stanie. Wejście tam samotnie może być *niebezpieczne*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F410.belarusian: Дзесьці недалёка адсюль лейтэнант рыхтуе яе дасье. "Клаас'е Аманду", — піша ён. Ты разумееш, што дэтэктыў павінен быць тут дзеля таго, што будзе далей. Ісці туды ў адзіночку можа апынуцца... *небяспечна*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F41C.english: "Come on up -- the door is open!" She shouts: "I'm drying my hair..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F41C.polish: „Proszę bardzo – drzwi są otwarte!” – krzyczy. „Suszę włosy...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000F41C.belarusian: "Падымайцеся — дзверы адчыненыя!" — крычыць яна. — "Я сушу валасы..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000780000A904.english: Sounds like it's coming from upstairs somewhere -- you could snoop around before going up...
Dialogue Text/0x010000780000A904.polish: Zdaje się, że głos dobiega gdzieś z góry. Mógłbyś tu powęszyć, zanim tam pójdziesz...
Dialogue Text/0x010000780000A904.belarusian: Здаецца, гук даносіцца аднекуль зверху — можна тут агледзецца, перш чым падымацца...

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F4F3.belarusian: Не кажучы ўжо пра тое, што гэта *выдатнае* практыкаванне!

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002E8B.english: The lieutenant gives you a quick glance.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002E8B.belarusian: Лейтэнант кідае на цябе хуткі погляд.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002E94.english: He doesn't like where this is going.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002E94.polish: Nie podoba mu się to, co się dzieje.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002E94.belarusian: Яму не падабаецца, куды ўсё ідзе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000671E.english: "Revachol (Zone of Control), 0° centigrade, black ice warning."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002B0000671E.polish: „Revachol (Strefa Kontroli), 0 stopni Celsjusza, ostrzeżenie przed gołoledzią”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013B12.english: The skiff bobs in the calm waters. It has nothing more to do.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013B12.polish: Łódź kołysze się na spokojnej tafli. Nie ma już nic do roboty.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013B12.belarusian: Маторка гайдаецца на спакойнай вадзе. Ёй больш няма чаго рабіць.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000032C2.english: Nothing to do here without the lieutenant... You must return here with him.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000032C2.polish: Bez porucznika nie ma tu czego szukać... Musisz wrócić razem z nim.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000032C2.belarusian: Без лейтэнанта тут няма чаго рабіць... Ты мусіш вярнуцца сюды з ім.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001029E.english: "God, I was so young... and stupid."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0001029E.belarusian: "Божа, я была такая маладая... і бязглуздая".

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001998A.english: "The board is not gonna like it."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019991.english: "To think I even used to go dancing here."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019991.polish: „I pomyśleć, że nawet przychodziłam tu potańczyć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019991.belarusian: "Падумаць толькі, я нават прыходзіла сюды патанчыць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00010284.english: "I really need to get out there, catch something."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00010284.belarusian: "Мне сапраўды трэба выбрацца ў мора, злавіць хоць нешта."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00011576.english: "The throw-nets just aren't paying off this time of the year..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00011576.polish: „O tej porze roku po prostu nie opłaca się zarzucać sieci...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00011576.belarusian: "Кідальныя сеткі проста не акупляюцца ў гэтую пару года..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019942.belarusian: "Чорт пабяры... Я ж *толькі што* купіла гэтую сетку..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019950.english: "Huh... haven't seen the RCM around for ages."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019950.polish: „Hę...? Od wieków nie było tu MOR-u”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019950.belarusian: "Хм... РГМ тут ужо сто гадоў не было відаць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019957.english: "Thought you guys forgot this place even exists."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019957.polish: „Myślałam, że zapomnieliście, że to miejsce w ogóle istnieje”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019957.belarusian: "Думала, вы ўжо забыліся, што гэтае месца ўвогуле існуе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E695.english: "Hello, mister!" A young girl, barely four or five years old, sits on the sofa. She is looking at you with frank curiosity.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E695.polish: „Dzień dobry panu!” – na sofie siedzi mała dziewczynka, ledwie cztero- lub pięcioletnia. Spogląda na ciebie z niekłamanym zaciekawieniem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E695.belarusian: "Прывітанне, дзядзечка!" — на канапе сядзіць малая дзяўчынка, гадоў чатырох ці пяці. Яна глядзіць на цябе з непрыхаванай цікаўнасцю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E69B.english: "I heard you kids might have gotten into the Feld building?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E69B.polish: „Słyszałem, że ponoć dostałyście się do budynku Felda, dzieciaki?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E69B.belarusian: "Я чуў, што вы, дзеці, маглі залезці ў будынак Feld?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E6A7.english: "Noo, mister!" Her eyes grow wider as she shakes her head. "Even Lamby doesn't like it." She hugs her stuffed toy tighter.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E6A7.polish: „Nieee, proszę pana!” – otwiera szeroko oczy, kręcąc głową. „Nawet Jagnusiowi nie podoba się ten pomysł” – przytula mocniej pluszową zabawkę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E6A7.belarusian: "Не-е, дзядзечка! — яе вочы акругляюцца, і яна хітае галавой. — Нават Ягнятку гэта не падабаецца". Яна мацней прыціскае плюшавую цацку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E6CB.english: "Yesssss, I am! Little Lily!" She gazes at you with her big eyes. "You know my mom?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E6CB.polish: „Taaak, to ja! Mała Lily!” – spogląda na ciebie wielkimi oczami. „Zna pan moją mamę?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E6CB.belarusian: "Та-а-ак, гэта я! Малая Лілі! — яна глядзіць на цябе сваімі вялікімі вачыма. — Вы ведаеце маю маму?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E6F5.english: "Bye!" The girl's large, curious eyes remain fixed on you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E6F5.polish: „Pa, pa!” – dziewczynka nie odrywa od ciebie wielkich, pełnych ciekawości oczu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E6F5.belarusian: "Пакуль!" — вялікія, цікаўныя вочы дзяўчынкі працягваюць глядзець на цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E721.english: "There was a phasmid in it! I was trying to catch it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E721.belarusian: "Там быў фазмід! Я спрабаваў яго злавіць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E727.english: "Uh, mister, what were you doing in my fireplace?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E727.polish: „Yyy... Proszę pana, co pan robił w moim kominku?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E727.belarusian: "Э-э, дзядзечка, а што вы рабілі ў маім каміне?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E733.english: "What's that?" (Point at the stuffed bird hanging from the ceiling.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E733.polish: „Co to jest?” (Wskaż wiszącego u sufitu wypchanego ptaka).
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000E733.belarusian: "Што гэта там?" (Паказаць пальцам на пудзіла птушкі, якое вісіць пад столлю.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001008B.polish: „Te bliźniaki na zewnątrz to twoi bracia?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100A8.english: "Yesss." She frowns. "They don't want to play with me. They're older and play outside!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100A8.polish: „Taaak” – marszczy czoło. „Nie chcą się ze mną bawić. Są starsi i siedzą na dworze!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100A8.belarusian: "Та-ак, — яна хмурыцца. — Яны не хочуць са мной гуляць. Яны старэйшыя і гуляюць на вуліцы!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100D1.english: "Uh huh," she nods. "Mom is great! You know what's great about my mom?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100D1.polish: „Aha” – kiwa głową. „Mama jest super! Wie pan, co jest fajnego w mojej mamie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100D1.belarusian: "Ага, — яна ківае. — Мама цудоўная! Ведаеце, што такога цудоўнага ў маёй маме?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100D7.english: "That's nice! My mom is great," she nods. "She's never angry or anything."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100D7.polish: „Fajnie! Mama jest super” – kiwa głową. „Nigdy się nie złości ani nic”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100D7.belarusian: "Як файна! Мая мама цудоўная, — яна ківае. — Яна ніколі не злуецца ці нешта такое".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001010B.english: "Hello, mister!" The Net Picker's daughter waves at you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001010B.polish: „Dzień dobry panu!” – córka wybieraczki sieci macha ci ręką.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001010B.belarusian: "Прывітанне, дзядзечка!" — дачка прыбіральніцы сяцей махае табе рукой.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000101EB.english: She clutches a small stuffed animal. Occasionally she twirls it around.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000101EB.polish: Trzyma w rękach małą wypchaną przytulankę. Od czasu do czasu robi z nią piruet.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000101EB.belarusian: Яна сціскае ў руках невялікую плюшавую жывёлінку. Час ад часу круціць яе ў руках.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010203.english: "Haa haa, yessss!" She smiles, hugging her fuzzy toy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010203.polish: „Ha, ha, taaak!” – uśmiecha się, przytulając puchatą zabawkę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010203.belarusian: "Ха-ха, та-а-ак!" — яна ўсміхаецца, абдымаючы пухнатую цацку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010214.english: "What's that thing you're holding?" (Point at her toy.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010214.belarusian: "Што гэта ў цябе ў руках?" (Паказаць пальцам на яе цацку.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001021B.english: "It's Lamby! He's my friend. Sort of, like..." She holds the fuzzy beast up to demonstrate.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001021B.polish: „To Jagnuś! Mój przyjaciel. Taki, no...” – unosi przytulankę do góry, żeby ci pokazać.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001021B.belarusian: "Гэта Ягнятка! Ён мой сябар. Ну, тыпу... — яна падымае пухнатага зверыка, каб паказаць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010222.english: Lamby is a stuffed lamb that, admittedly, has seen better days. One of the eye-buttons is missing and the fur is tattered in several parts.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010222.polish: Jagnuś to wypchana owieczka, która – trzeba przyznać – pamięta lepsze czasy. Jeden z udających oczy guzików jest urwany, a futerko uległo w wielu miejscach rozdarciu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010222.belarusian: Ягнятка — гэта плюшавае ягня, якое, трэба прызнаць, бачыла лепшыя часы. Адзін гузік-вочка адарваны, а поўсць у некалькіх месцах падраная.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010229.polish: „Jagnuś wygląda, jakby miał się zaraz rozpaść”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010233.english: "Oh, okay. Well, pleased to meet you, Lamby."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010233.polish: „Ach, rozumiem. No, miło cię poznać, Jagnusiu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010233.belarusian: "А, добра. Што ж, прыемна пазнаёміцца, Ягнятка".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001023D.english: "Lamby usually doesn't like strangers, but you're also fuzzy like Lamby."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001023D.polish: „Jagnuś zwykle nie lubi nieznajomych, ale pan jest puchaty tak jak on”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001023D.belarusian: "Ягнятка звычайна не любіць чужых, але вы такі ж пухнаты, як і Ягнятка".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010248.english: "Yessss, Lamby has lived a long life." She waves the lamb around in the air. "Lamby was a... re.. a rev..." She stumbles on her words.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010248.polish: „Taaak, Jagnuś już długo żyje” – wymachuje zabawką w powietrzu, „Był lew... rew...” – ma trudności z wypowiedzeniem słowa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010248.belarusian: "Та-а-ак, Ягнятка пражыў доўгае жыццё. — Яна махае ягнём у паветры. — Ягнятка быў... рэ... рэв..." Яна спатыкаецца на словах.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001025B.english: "Noo-noooo, that's not it." She frowns, looking at her tattered toy. "You know what you are, Lamby."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001025B.polish: „Nie, nieee, nie tak” – marszczy czoło, patrząc na zniszczoną zabawkę. „Wiesz, czym jesteś, Jagnusiu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001025B.belarusian: "Не-е, не-е-е, не тым, — яна хмурыцца, гледзячы на падраную цацку. — Ты ж ведаеш, хто ты, Ягнятка".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010275.english: "Yessss," she yelps happily! "Lamby was a re-luz-ion...ry."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010275.belarusian: "Та-а-ак! — радасна выгуквае яна. — Ягнятка быў рэ-ва-лю... нелам".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010299.english: "They look the same! Haa ha haa! Sometimes I can't tell them 'part."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010299.polish: „Wyglądają tak samo! Ha, ha, ha! Czasem ich nie rozróżniam”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010299.belarusian: "Яны выглядаюць аднолькава! Ха-ха-ха! Часам я не магу іх раз'лічыць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102A5.english: "They look identical, right? I said the same thing."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102A5.polish: „Są tacy sami, prawda? To samo powiedziałem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102A5.belarusian: "Яны выглядаюць ідэнтычна, так? Я сказаў тое самае".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102B6.english: "Haa ha haa!" She continues laughing. "Lamby tells them part." She waves her fuzzy doll in the air.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102B6.polish: „Ha, ha, ha!” – śmieje się dalej. „Jagnuś ich rozróżnia” – wymachuje w powietrzu swoją puchatą zabawką.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102B6.belarusian: "Ха-ха-ха! — працягвае яна смяяцца. — Ягнятка іх раз'лічае". Яна маша сваёй пухнатай лялькай у паветры.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102BC.english: "They look... ai-dent-ik!" She slowly processes the word, then snickers with laughter.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102BC.polish: „Wyglądają i-den-tycznie!” – wymawia powoli trudne słowo, po czym chichocze radośnie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102BC.belarusian: "Яны выглядаюць... і-дэн-тышна!" — яна павольна асэнсоўвае слова і хіхікае ад смеху.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102CA.english: "We don't go there. Mom and auntie think we do, but it's very booky."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102CA.polish: „Nie chodzimy tam. Mama i ciocia myślą, że chodzimy, ale zbyt tam opiórnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102CA.belarusian: "Мы туды не ходзім. Мама з цёцяй думаюць, што ходзім, але там вельмі трашна".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102D2.english: "Is there anything you can tell me about the building?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102D2.polish: „Możesz mi powiedzieć coś jeszcze o tym budynku?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102D2.belarusian: "Можаш расказаць мне што-небудзь яшчэ пра гэты будынак?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102E0.english: "Vee-eery booky!" She's clutching her stuffed toy and shaking her head. "Don't go there."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102E0.polish: „Baaardzo opiórnie!” – chwyta mocno swoją zabawkę i kręci głową. „Proszę tam nie iść”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102E0.belarusian: "Ве-ельмі трашна! — яна сціскае сваю цацку і хітае галавой. — Не хадзіце туды".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102E7.english: "It's old and broken." She nods. "Dan-ze-ruus, Mom says. I listen to mom. Lamby also listens. Brothers listen. They tried going there, but it was scary and they ran away!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102E7.polish: „Wszystko tam stare i zniszczone” – kiwa głową. „»Nie-przez-pięczne«, mówi mama. A ja słucham mamy. Jagnuś też. I bracia też. Próbowali tam wejść, ale było strasznie i uciekli!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102E7.belarusian: "Там усё старое і зламанае, — яна ківае. — Не-бась-печна, кажа мама. Я слухаю маму. Ягнятка таксама слухае. Браты слухаюць. Яны спрабавалі пайсці туды, але было страшна, і яны ўцяклі!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102F5.english: "Sure! Just go and get it. I don't like it anyway... it looks angry."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102F5.polish: „Pewnie! Proszę ją sobie wziąć. I tak jej nie lubię. Wygląda, jakby była zła”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102F5.belarusian: "Вядома! Проста ідзіце і вазьміце яго. Яно мне ўсё адно не падабаецца... выглядае сярдзітым".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102FC.english: She twirls the furry doll around in the air, giggling happily.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102FC.polish: Kręci lalką w powietrzu, chichocząc radośnie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000102FC.belarusian: Яна круціць пухнатую ляльку ў паветры, радасна хіхікаючы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010307.english: You might be able to get on Garte's good side if you make up for the skua you broke?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010307.polish: Może udobruchasz Garte'a, jeśli jakoś się zrehabilitujesz za zniszczenie tego wydrzyka?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010307.belarusian: Можа, табе ўдасца заваяваць прыхільнасць Гарта, калі ты загладзіш віну за паморніка, якога зламаў?

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00003188.polish: „Aaa, no dobra!” – kiwa z powagą głową.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000318D.english: "Ohh, okay!" She twirls her fuzzy beast in the air.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000318D.polish: „Aaa, no dobra!” – wymachuje w powietrzu swoim futrzastym zwierzątkiem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000318D.belarusian: "А-а, добра!" — яна круціць свайго пухнатага зверыка ў паветры.

Dialogue Text/0x010000810000647C.english: You might be able to get on Garte's good side if you replace the broken skua you almost certainly broke?
Dialogue Text/0x010000810000647C.polish: Może udobruchasz Garte'a, jeśli zamienisz na innego ptaka tego wydrzyka, którego prawie na pewno zniszczyłeś właśnie ty?
Dialogue Text/0x010000810000647C.belarusian: Можа, табе ўдасца заваяваць прыхільнасць Гарта, калі ты заменіш зламанага паморніка, якога амаль напэўна зламаў ты сам?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008100006488.english: "Can I have it? I know someone who really likes stuffed birds."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008100006488.polish: „Mogę ją wziąć? Znam kogoś, kto bardzo lubi wypchane ptaki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008100006488.belarusian: "Можна мне яго забраць? Я ведаю таго, хто вельмі любіць пудзілы птушак".

Dialogue Text/0x010000810000648F.english: "Sure! Just go and get it. I don't like it anyway... it looks angry."
Dialogue Text/0x010000810000648F.polish: „Pewnie! Proszę ją sobie wziąć. I tak jej nie lubię. Wygląda, jakby była zła”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000810000648F.belarusian: "Вядома! Проста ідзіце і вазьміце яго. Яно мне ўсё адно не падабаецца... выглядае сярдзітым".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000362D.english: "I heard there was a girl here who has armoured gloves. Is that you?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000362D.polish: „Słyszałem, że jest tu dziewczynka, która ma opancerzone rękawice. To ty?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000362D.belarusian: "Я чуў, тут ёсць дзяўчынка, у якой ёсць браніраваныя пальчаткі. Гэта ты?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000364F.english: "Ooooh." She looks alarmed. "I had gloves, very big ones! Heavy too."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000364F.polish: „Ooo” – wygląda na zaniepokojoną. „Miałam rękawice. Bardzo duże! Ciężkie też”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000364F.belarusian: "О-о-ой, — яна выглядае спалоханай. — У мяне былі пальчаткі, вельмі вялікія! І цяжкія таксама".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000366E.english: "Found them when Lamby and I were playing hide-and-seek. In an empty house where no one lives! I think someone hid them there..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000366E.polish: „Znalazłam je, jak bawiłam się z Jagnusiem w chowanego. W pustym domu, w którym nikt nie mieszka! Ktoś je tam pewnie schował...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000366E.belarusian: "Знайшла, калі мы з Ягняткам гулялі ў хованкі. У пустым доме, дзе ніхто не жыве! Думаю, нехта іх там схаваў..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000367B.english: She pouts. "I hid them. The twins were going to take them. They're stupid..." She lifts her stuffed toy up and looks into its one remaining eye, as though searching for confirmation.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000367B.polish: „Ukryłam je” – mówi z naburmuszoną miną. „Bliźniacy chcieli je zabrać. Głupi są...” – podnosi wysoko swoją zabawkę i spogląda jej w jedyne pozostałe oko, jakby szukała tam aprobaty dla swoich słów.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000367B.belarusian: Яна дзьмецца: "Я іх схавала. Блізняты хацелі іх забраць. Яны дурныя... — яна падымае сваю цацку і глядзіць у яе адзінае ацалелае вочка, нібы шукаючы пацверджання".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000369A.english: "We're going to need those gloves. It's for important police business." He enunciates the last two words carefully.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000369A.polish: „Potrzebujemy tych rękawic. To ważne policyjne sprawy” – ostatnie dwa słowa wymawia bardzo wyraźnie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000369A.belarusian: "Нам спатрэбяцца гэтыя пальчаткі. Гэта для важнай паліцэйскай справы", — ён старанна вымаўляе апошнія два словы.

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036A0.belarusian: "Чаму?" — яна глядзіць на цябе з падазрэннем.

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036A6.english: "I need them for a very important police investigation."
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036A6.polish: „Potrzebuję ich do bardzo ważnego policyjnego śledztwa”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036A6.belarusian: "Яны патрэбны мне для вельмі важнага паліцэйскага расследавання".

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036AC.english: "It's grown-up business. You wouldn't understand. Just tell me where they are."
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036AC.polish: „To sprawy dorosłych. Nie zrozumiałabyś. Powiedz mi po prostu, gdzie one są”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036AC.belarusian: "Гэта дарослыя справы. Ты не зразумееш. Проста скажы, дзе яны".

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036B2.english: "Oooh..." She doesn't seem to understand, but the lieutenant's tone has conveyed to her the 'important' part.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036B2.polish: „Oooch...” – wydaje się nie rozumieć, ale porucznik samym swoim tonem przekazał jej to, co *najważniejsze*.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036B2.belarusian: "О-о-ох..." Здаецца, яна не разумее, але тон лейтэнанта даў ёй зразумець 'важную' частку.

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036B8.english: She frowns, delaying divulging her secret. "Oo-kay," she says finally with some reluctance. "I hid them inside my sandcastle. Behind the house." She points somewhere outside. "You can take them."
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036B8.polish: Marszczy czoło, opóźniając zdradzenie swojej tajemnicy. „No dooobra” – mówi w końcu z pewnym wahaniem. „Ukryłam je w moim zamku z piasku, za domem” – wskazuje gdzieś na zewnątrz. „Może je pan sobie wziąć”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036B8.belarusian: Яна хмурыцца, марудзячы з выдачай сакрэту. "Ну до-обра, — кажа яна нарэшце з неахвотай. — Я схавала іх у сваім замку з пяску. За домам. — Яна паказвае кудысьці на вуліцу. — Можаце забраць іх".

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036BE.english: "Oooh..." She doesn't seem to understand, but you have conveyed the 'important' part, at least.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036BE.polish: „Oooch...” – wydaje się nie rozumieć, ale zdołałeś przekazać jej przynajmniej to, co *najważniejsze*.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036BE.belarusian: "О-о-ох..." Здаецца, яна не разумее, але табе прынамсі ўдалося перадаць 'важную' частку.

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036CE.english: She doesn't want you to think she stole them.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036CE.polish: Nie chce, żebyś pomyślał, że je ukradła.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036CE.belarusian: Яна не хоча, каб ты падумаў, нібыта яна іх скрала.

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036E5.english: "They're in my sandcastle." She points somewhere outside. "Behind our house. Under the sand. You can break the castle, it's not very good."
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036E5.polish: „Są w moim zamku z piasku” – wskazuje gdzieś na zewnątrz. „Za naszym domem. Pod piachem. Możecie go zburzyć, nie wyszedł mi”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000036E5.belarusian: "Яны ў маім замку з пяску. — Яна паказвае кудысьці на вуліцу. — За нашым домам. Пад пяском. Можаце паламаць замак, ён усё адно не вельмі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700011F42.polish: „Zaraz, chodzi ci o to, że jest tam upiornie, tak?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700011F42.belarusian: "Пачакай, ты маеш на ўвазе страшна, так?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700011F49.english: "Mhmh," she replies, nodding. "It's very, very booky."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700011F49.belarusian: "Мг-мг, — адказвае яна, ківаючы. — Вельмі, вельмі трашна".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016B18.english: "What's this?" (Show her the stuffed bird you took from the ceiling.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016B18.polish: „Co to?” (Pokaż jej wypchanego ptaka, którego zdjąłeś z sufitu).
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016B18.belarusian: "Што гэта?" (Паказаць ёй пудзіла птушкі, якое ты зняў са столі.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016B32.english: Wasn't Garte, the cafeteria manager, trying to repair a piece of taxidermy?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016B32.polish: Czy Garte, kierownik baru, nie próbował naprawić właśnie wypchanego ptaka?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016B32.belarusian: Ці не Гарт, кіраўнік бара, спрабаваў адрамантаваць нейкае пудзіла?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016B69.english: All right. You just need to grab it from the ceiling and go!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016B69.polish: Świetnie. Musisz tylko zdjąć zwierzę z sufitu i wracać do baru!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016B69.belarusian: Выдатна. Табе проста трэба сцягнуць яго са столі і сыходзіць!

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000AD8.english: "Sure! I mean you already took it. I don't like it anyway... it looks angry."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000AD8.polish: „Pewnie! Zresztą już pan ją wziął. I tak jej nie lubię. Wygląda, jakby była zła”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000AD8.belarusian: "Вядома! Вы яго ўсё адно ўжо забралі. Яно мне ўсё адно не падабаецца... выглядае сярдзітым".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000AE7.english: "Sure! I mean you already took it. I don't like it anyway... it looks angry."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000AE7.polish: „Pewnie! Zresztą już pan ją wziął. I tak jej nie lubię. Wygląda, jakby była zła”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000AE7.belarusian: "Вядома! Вы яго ўсё адно ўжо забралі. Яно мне ўсё адно не падабаецца... выглядае сярдзітым".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000B55.english: "My mom's outside, and I don't really know about my dad." She gives you a bright smile like it's a good thing.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000B55.polish: „Mama jest na zewnątrz, a o tacie to ja właściwie nic nie wiem” – posyła ci promienny uśmiech, jakby to było coś dobrego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000B55.belarusian: "Мама на вуліцы, а пра тату я нічога асабліва не ведаю", — яна ярка ўсміхаецца табе, нібы гэта нешта добрае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000B69.english: "Ll... Luby... Rr... R-luuby." Suddenly the girl gets all serious and leans in, as if she's about to tell you a secret.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000B69.polish: „Ll... Luby... Rr... R-luuby” – nagle dziewczynka robi się poważna i nachyla się do ciebie, jakby miała zdradzić ci jakiś sekret.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000B69.belarusian: "Лл... Любі... Рр... Р-любі". Раптам дзяўчынка робіцца вельмі сур'ёзнай і хіліцца бліжэй, нібы збіраецца адкрыць табе таямніцу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000B70.english: "My mom tells me that I'm a big girl, but she doesn't know that I can't say *ll*. Or like, sometimes I can, but then... *ll*... *rr*... *llrr*..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000B70.polish: „Mama powtarza, że jestem już duża, ale nie wie, że nie umiem mówić takiego podwójnego *ly*. Znaczy, no, czasem umiem, ale czasem... *ll*... *rr*... *llrr**...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000B70.belarusian: "Мама кажа мне, што я ўжо вялікая дзяўчынка, але яна не ведае, што я не ўмею казаць *л*. Ці, ну, часам умею, але потым... *л*... *р*... *лр-р*..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DE4D.english: "Yes. Very soft." Suddenly she pushes the stuffed animal toward your face.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DE4D.polish: „Tak. Bardzo mięciutki” – nagle przysuwa ci zwierzaka-przytulankę do twarzy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DE4D.belarusian: "Так. Вельмі мякенькі". Раптам яна падсоўвае цацку табе да самага твару.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DE68.english: "Press your damn cheek against Lamby, okay?" The lieutenant sounds authoritative -- and surprisingly gruff.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DE68.polish: „Przyciśnij swój przeklęty policzek do Jagnusia, jasne?” – głos porucznika jest stanowczy – i zaskakująco burkliwy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DE68.belarusian: "Прыцісніцеся сваёй клятай шчакой да Ягнятка, добра?" — голас лейтэнанта гучыць аўтарытэтна — і на дзіва рэзка.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DE70.english: "Okay, then. I'm sorry." She presses her own cheek against Lamby and smiles, sadly.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DE70.polish: „No dobrze. Przykro mi” – przyciska do Jagnusia własny policzek i uśmiecha się smutno.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DE70.belarusian: "Ну добра. Прабачце", — яна прыціскае ўласную шчаку да Ягнятка і сумна ўсміхаецца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DE78.english: "Isn't he soft?" She's right, Lamby is very soft. She rubs the white fur against your cheek, then returns the lamb into her lap, cuddling it.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DE78.polish: „Miękki jest, co?” – ma rację, Jagnuś jest bardzo miękki. Dziewczynka pociera białym futerkiem o twój policzek, po czym kładzie sobie zwierzątko na kolanach i je głaszcze.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DE78.belarusian: "Праўда ж ён мякенькі?" Яна мае рацыю, Ягнятка вельмі мяккі. Дзяўчынка трэ белай поўсцю аб тваю шчаку, а потым вяртае ягня назад на калені, прыціскаючы да сябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EB1.english: "Uhhhhh..." She sits her doll on her lap. Its ragged limbs reach out toward you, as if longing for a cuddle. "Like what?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EB1.polish: „Nooo...” – sadza sobie lalkę na kolanach. Wystrzępione sztuczne łapki sięgają ku tobie, jakby prosząc o przytulenie. „Co na przykład?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EB1.belarusian: "Э-э-э-э... — яна саджае цацку сабе на калені. Яе падраныя лапкі цягнуцца да цябе, нібы просячы абдымак. — Як што?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EB6.english: "Anything. Maybe something you saw or heard that was weird?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EB6.polish: „Cokolwiek. Może widziałaś albo słyszałaś coś, co ci się wydało dziwnie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EB6.belarusian: "Што заўгодна. Можа, ты бачыла альбо чула нешта дзіўнае?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EBF.english: "Anything that will help me dismantle Capitalism, so that you can inherit Communism, O' Girl Child Revolution?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EBF.polish: „Cokolwiek, co pomoże mi zniszczyć kapitalizm, abyś ty mogła odziedziczyć komunizm, o Dziewczę Rewolucji?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EBF.belarusian: "Што-небудзь, што дапаможа мне знішчыць капіталізм, каб ты змагла атрымаць у спадчыну камунізм, о Дзяўчынка-Рэвалюцыя?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EC4.english: "Cap-capi-capeel..." She struggles to pronounce the words. She shakes her head. "No."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EC4.polish: „Kapi... Paki... Kapitu...” – stara się wymówić trudne słowo. Później kręci głową. „Nie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EC4.belarusian: "Ка-капі-капіль... — яна спрабуе вымавіць словы. Яна хітае галавой. — Не".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000ED2.english: The lieutenant sighs, and kneels to be eye-level with the girl. "Maybe someone you know has acted a little different, lately?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000ED2.polish: Porucznik wzdycha i klęka, aby spojrzeć dziewczynce w oczy. „Może ktoś, kogo znasz, zachowywał się ostatnio trochę inaczej?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000ED2.belarusian: Лейтэнант уздыхае і апускаецца на калені на адзін узровень з дзяўчынкай: "Можа, хтосьці са знаёмых апошнім часам паводзіў сябе крыху інакш?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000ED7.english: "Poor Girl Child Revolution. What have the bourgeois done to you?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000ED7.polish: „Biedne Dziewczę Rewolucji. Cóż ci zrobiła burżuazja?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000ED7.belarusian: "Бедная Дзяўчынка-Рэвалюцыя. Што з табой зрабілі буржуі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EDC.english: "Never mind. Have you just seen or heard anything weird lately?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EDC.polish: „Nieważne. Widziałaś albo słyszałaś po prostu ostatnio coś dziwnego?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EDC.belarusian: "Няважна. Ты проста бачыла альбо чула што-небудзь дзіўнае апошнім часам?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EE1.english: She turns the stuffed lamb to face her. "What does that mean, Lamby?" The doll offers no reply. Stuffing hangs out its rear.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EE1.polish: Odwraca wypchaną owcę do siebie. „Co to znaczy, Jagnusiu?” – pyta, ale lalka nie odpowiada. Z tyłu wystaje jej wypełniacz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EE1.belarusian: Яна паварочвае плюшавае ягнятка да сябе: "Што гэта значыць, Ягнятка?" Цацка не адказвае. Ззаду ў яе тырчыць набіўка.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EE7.english: "Yes!" She lights with recognition. "The twins got in trouble for saying *bad words*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EE7.polish: „Tak!” – twarz rozjaśnia jej się w wyrazie zrozumienia. „Bliźniacy dostali burę za mówienie *brzydkich słów*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EE7.belarusian: "Так! — яе твар святлее ад разумення. — Блізнятам дасталася за тое, што яны казалі *дрэнныя словы*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EF7.english: "I see. Thank you for the tip; I'll talk to them about it." (Move on.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EF7.polish: „Rozumiem. Dziękuję ci, porozmawiam o tym z nimi”. (Przejdź dalej).
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000EF7.belarusian: "Зразумела. Дзякуй за падказку, я пагавару з імі пра гэта". (Рушыць далей.)

Alternate1/0x0100004B00000EF7.polish: „No, w każdym razie porozmawiam z twoimi braćmi o tych brzydkich słowach. Dziękuję ci!” (Przejdź dalej).
Alternate1/0x0100004B00000EF7.belarusian: "Ва ўсякім разе... я пагавару з тваімі братамі наконт дрэнных слоў. Дзякуй за падказку!" (Рушыць далей.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F01.english: "Bad words are for losers. Good on you for not saying them."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F01.polish: „Brzydkie słowa są dla gamoni. Dobrze, że ich nie mówisz”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F01.belarusian: "Дрэнныя словы — для няўдачнікаў. Малайчына, што не кажаш іх".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F06.english: "Yep!" The girl nods firmly. "I don't say bad words. Lamby doesn't either."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F06.polish: „Tak!” – dziewczynka kiwa stanowczo głową. „Ja nie mówię brzydkich słów. I Jagnuś też nie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F06.belarusian: "Ага! — дзяўчынка цвёрда ківае. — Я не кажу дрэнных слоў. І Ягнятка таксама не".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F0B.english: "What's wrong with bad words? I love bad words."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F0B.polish: „A co jest złego w brzydkich słowach? Ja je bardzo lubię”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F0B.belarusian: "А што дрэннага ў дрэнных словах? Я люблю дрэнныя словы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F15.english: "Yes." She yawns, and leans back into the cushion.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F15.polish: „Tak” – ziewa, po czym opada z powrotem na poduszkę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F15.belarusian: "Так", — яна пазяхае і адкідваецца назад на падушку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F1E.english: She gasps. "No! Don't say bad words! Promise?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F1E.polish: Wzdycha nagle. „Nie! Proszę nie mówić brzydkich słów! Obiecuje pan?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F1E.belarusian: Яна ахае: "Не! Не кажыце дрэнных слоў! Абяцаеце?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F31.english: Lamby remains silent. The fireplace flickers and cackles. She hugs the doll close to her chest and laughs.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F31.polish: Jagnuś zachowuje milczenie. Ogień w kominku migocze i trzaska. Dziewczynka przytula lalkę do piersi i wybucha śmiechem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F31.belarusian: Ягнятка маўчыць. Камін мігціць і патрэсквае. Дзяўчынка прыціскае цацку да грудзей і смяецца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F3A.english: "I'll keep an eye on him." The lieutenant cuts in faster than you can reply. "Don't worry."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F3A.polish: „Przypilnuję go” – wtrąca się porucznik i robi to tak szybko, że nie masz szansy jej odpowiedzieć. „Nie musisz się o to martwić”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F3A.belarusian: "Я прыпільную яго, — лейтэнант уступае хутчэй, чым ты паспяваеш адказаць. — Не турбуйся".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F3F.english: He's not going to let you make a fool of yourself or the RCM in front of this girl. Not while he's here.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F3F.polish: Dopóki tu jest, nie pozwoli ci zrobić przed tą dziewczynką durnia z siebie ani z MOR-u.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F3F.belarusian: Пакуль ён тут, ён не дазволіць табе выставіць дурнем сябе ці РГМ перад гэтай дзяўчынкай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F52.english: "But bad words can be good! It can be healthy to express yourself with them."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F52.polish: „Ale brzydkie słowa czasem są dobre! Zdrowo jest czasem wyrazić nimi złość”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F52.belarusian: "Але ж дрэнныя словы могуць быць карыснымі! Часам карысна выказаць сябе праз іх".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F57.english: "No can do. I got a potty mouth till I die."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F57.polish: „Nic z tego. Będę przeklinał aż do śmierci”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F57.belarusian: "Не выйдзе. Я буду лаяцца да самай смерці".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F61.english: Hey, why can't I swear off swearing for real?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F61.polish: Hej, właściwie to czemu nie mogę naprawdę zrezygnować z przekleństw?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F61.belarusian: Гэй, а чаму я не магу насамрэч завязаць з лаянкай?

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F66.english: "What?" She covers Lamby's ears by cupping his whole head in her small palms.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F66.polish: „Co?” – zakrywa Jagnusiowi uszy, zamykając całą jego głowę w swoich drobnych dłoniach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F66.belarusian: "Што?" — яна закрывае вушы Ягнятку, абхапіўшы ўсю яго галаву сваімі маленькімі далонькамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F6B.english: "Nooooo! Don't be bad too!" Her face bunches up in a scowl.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F6B.polish: „Nieee, niech pan nie będzie niedobry!” – wykrzywia buzię w grymasie niezadowolenia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F6B.belarusian: "Не-е-е-е! Не будзьце і вы дрэнным!" — яе тварык скурчваецца ў грымасе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F70.english: "Good." She hugs Lamby close to her again.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F70.belarusian: "Вось і добра", — яна зноў моцна прыціскае да сябе Ягнятка.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F75.english: She stares at you, waiting for an answer.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F75.polish: Wpatruje się w ciebie, czekając na odpowiedź.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F75.belarusian: Яна пільна глядзіць на цябе, чакаючы адказу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F7A.english: "Lamby doesn't like bad words. Please promise!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F7A.polish: „Jagnuś nie lubi brzydkich słów. Proszę obiecać!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F7A.belarusian: "Ягнятка не любіць дрэнных слоў. Калі ласка, паабяцайце!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F80.english: Guess you held your ground. It can be good, being honest with yourself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F80.polish: No, to nie ustąpiłeś. To ważne, żeby być ze sobą szczerym.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F80.belarusian: Што ж, ты выстаяў на сваім. Часам карысна быць шчырым з самім сабой.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F85.english: Was it good to lie to a child? Maybe it doesn't matter. It's not your responsibility.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F85.polish: Warto było okłamywać dziecko? Może to bez znaczenia. To nie twoja odpowiedzialność.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F85.belarusian: Ці добра было хлусіць дзіцяці? Можа, гэта і няважна. Гэта не твая адказнасць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F8A.english: You can't abandon swearing for a simple reason: You're just a man who swears.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F8A.polish: Nie zrezygnujesz z przekleństw z prostego powodu: jesteś po prostu przeklinającym człowiekiem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F8A.belarusian: Ты не можаш кінуць лаяцца па простай прычыне: ты проста чалавек, які лаецца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F9E.english: What? No clever answers from the body and brain? Nothing?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F9E.polish: Co? Żadnych cwanych odpowiedzi ciała czy mózgu? Nic?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000F9E.belarusian: Што? Ніякіх разумных адказаў ад цела і мазгоў? Зусім нічога?

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FA3.english: The little girl tilts her head. "Do you promise you won't say bad words anymore?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FA3.polish: Dziewczynka przekrzywia głowę. „Obiecuje pan, że nie będzie pan więcej przeklinał?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FA3.belarusian: Маленькая дзяўчынка схіляе галаву: "Вы абяцаеце, што больш не будзеце казаць дрэнных слоў?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FB2.english: But what if I don't want to be a man who swears? What if I want to be a No-Bad-Word Cop?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FB2.polish: A jeśli nie chcę być przeklinającym człowiekiem? Jeśli chcę być gliniarzem bez brzydkich słów?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FB2.belarusian: А што калі я не хачу быць чалавекам, які лаецца? Што калі я хачу быць Копам Без Дрэнных Слоў?

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FB7.english: ... Fuck. I guess I am a man who swears.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FB7.polish: Kurwa. Chyba faktycznie jestem przeklinającym człowiekiem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FB7.belarusian: ...Бляха. Відаць, я і праўда чалавек, які лаецца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FBC.english: Because it's just not you. I'm sorry.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FBC.polish: Bo to po prostu nie byłbyś ty. Przykro mi.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FBC.belarusian: Таму што гэта проста не ты. Прабач.

Alternate1/0x0100004B00000FC1.polish: Tak. Sam widzisz. Ale to nie szkodzi, oddychaj już. Widzisz? Nie było tak źle. Taki po prostu jesteś.
Alternate1/0x0100004B00000FC1.belarusian: "Так. Вось і ўсё. Усё добра — цяпер можаш дыхаць. Бачыш, не так і страшна было? Проста такі ты ёсць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FC6.english: It has only lasted three seconds. The girl still waits for her answer.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FC6.polish: To trwało ledwie trzy sekundy. Dziewczynka wciąż czeka na odpowiedź.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FC6.belarusian: Мінула ўсяго тры секунды. Дзяўчынка ўсё яшчэ чакае адказу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FCF.english: I won't swear! I just won't! I'll just go quiet, you watch!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FCF.polish: Nie będę przeklinał! Nie będę! Po prostu zamilknę, zobaczysz!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FCF.belarusian: Я не буду лаяцца! Проста не буду! Я проста замаўчу, вось пабачыш!

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FD4.english: Please, don't make this more difficult for yourself. It's okay to swear. It can be healthy, even.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FD4.polish: Proszę, nie utrudniaj tego sobie samemu. Przeklinanie jest w porządku. Może być wręcz zdrowe.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00000FD4.belarusian: Калі ласка, не ўскладняй сабе жыццё. Лаяцца — гэта нармальна. Гэта нават можа быць карысна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00001574.english: "I'm talking to the children to learn from them. Has anything strange happened here lately?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00001574.polish: „Rozmawiam z dziećmi, żeby się od nich uczyć. Wydarzyło się tu może ostatnio coś dziwnego?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004B00001574.belarusian: "Я размаўляю з дзецьмі, каб вучыцца ў іх. Ці здаралася тут апошнім часам што-небудзь дзіўнае?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000100B8.polish: „W górę, w górę i w dal!”

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC0C.english: The scruffy-haired little boy kicks a stone. He can't be more than five years old.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC0C.polish: Rozczochrany chłopiec kopie kamień. Nie może mieć więcej niż pięć lat.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC0C.belarusian: Ускудлачаны хлапчук штурхае камень. Яму наўрад ці больш за пяць гадоў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC13.english: The other one looks indistinguishable from him. He watches his brother kick the stone with his tongue lolling out of his mouth.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC13.polish: Drugi wygląda dokładnie tak samo jak on. Z językiem na wierzchu przygląda się bratu kopiącemu kamień.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC13.belarusian: Другі выглядае дакладна гэтаксама. Ён назірае, як брат штурхае камень, высунуўшы язык з рота.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC39.english: This one doesn't say anything, kicking the concrete with his worn-out sneaker.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC39.polish: Ten bliźniak nie odzywa się, tylko kopie kawałek betonu swoimi znoszonymi trampkami.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC39.belarusian: Гэты нічога не кажа, штурхаючы бетон сваім зношаным кедам.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC3F.english: "Lily's our mom," explains the other one, tongue still lolling out of his mouth.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC3F.polish: „Lily to nasza mama” – wyjaśnia drugi chłopak z wywieszonym językiem.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC3F.belarusian: "Лілі — наша мама", — тлумачыць другі з высунутым языком.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC5A.english: The stone-kicker laughs suddenly. His head is too large for his shoulders.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC5A.polish: Kopiący kamień chłopak nagle wybucha śmiechem. Jego głowa jest za duża w porównaniu z jego ramionami.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC5A.belarusian: Той, што штурхае камень, раптам смяецца. Ягоная галава занадта вялікая для ягоных плячэй.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC61.english: The other one laughs as well.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC69.english: Maybe there's some kind of reason why they're laughing? An interesting reason somehow tied to the case!
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC69.polish: Może jest jakiś powód, dla którego się śmieją? Jakaś ciekawa, powiązana ze sprawą przyczyna!
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC69.belarusian: Можа, ёсць нейкая прычына, чаму яны смяюцца? Цікавая прычына, нейкім чынам звязаная са справай!

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC84.english: "Ha-ha," the scruffy-haired little kid laughs, as though in agreement.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC84.polish: „Ha, ha!” – śmieje się rozczochrany chłopak, jakby się z tobą zgadzał.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC8B.english: "You're stupid," the other one tells him, suddenly very serious.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC8B.polish: „Ty jesteś głupi” – oznajmia mu drugi chłopak bardzo poważnym tonem.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC8B.belarusian: "Гэта ты тупы", — кажа яму другі, раптам вельмі сур'ёзна.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC98.english: The stone-kicking one becomes frantic all of a sudden, as if that's something to be scared of -- the obvious fact that you just stated.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC98.polish: Ten kopiący kamień nagle zaczyna zachowywać się dziwnie, zupełnie jakby czegoś się bał – najwyraźniej tym czymś jest oczywisty fakt, który właśnie stwierdziłeś.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC98.belarusian: Той, што штурхае камень, раптам пачынае мітусіцца, быццам гэтага варта баяцца — відавочнага факта, які ты толькі што агучыў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC9F.english: "He looks just like me," the other one says.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC9F.polish: „To on wygląda jak ja” – odzywa się drugi chłopak.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BC9F.belarusian: "Гэта ён выглядае як я", — кажа другі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCBA.english: The boy doesn't answer. His brother throws another rock. Both of their hair is covered in some kind of dirt.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCBA.polish: Chłopak nie odpowiada. Jego brat ciska kolejnym kamieniem. Włosy obu są pokryte jakimś brudem.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCBA.belarusian: Хлапчук не адказвае. Ягоны брат кідае чарговы камень. Валасы абодвух пакрытыя нейкім брудам.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCC7.english: "You're bad with kids," the lieutenant remarks with evident glee.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCC7.polish: „Nie radzisz sobie z dziećmi” – zauważa porucznik z wyraźną radością.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCC7.belarusian: "Вы дрэнна ладзіце з дзецьмі", — заўважае лейтэнант з відавочнай злараднасцю.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCCF.english: "It's impossible to be *good* with kids, they're too stupid."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCCF.polish: „Nie da się *radzić* sobie z dziećmi, są zbyt głupie”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCDD.english: "And what are you, Kid Master General?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCDD.polish: „A ty co, jesteś niby wielkim dziecięcym generałem?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCDD.belarusian: "А ты ў нас хто, галоўны знаўца дзяцей?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCE3.english: "Maybe I am?" He grins. "Now, how about some actual police work? We're not getting anything here."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCE3.polish: „Może jestem?” – stwierdza, szczerząc zęby. „Może zajmiemy się teraz policyjną robotą? Tracimy tu tylko czas”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCE3.belarusian: "Можа, і так? — ён усміхаецца. — А цяпер, як наконт сапраўднай паліцэйскай працы? Тут мы нічога не даведаемся".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCEB.english: "Don't worry, everyone is." He looks at the little scruffian, then at you. "How about we do some police work now? We're not getting anything here."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCEB.polish: „Nie przejmuj się, wszyscy tak mają” – pociesza cię. Spogląda na małych rozczochrańców, a później na ciebie. „Może zajmiemy się teraz policyjną robotą? Tracimy tu tylko czas”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCEB.belarusian: "Не пераймайцеся, усе такія, — ён глядзіць на маленькага абарванца, потым на цябе. — Як наконт таго, каб заняцца паліцэйскай працай? Тут мы нічога не даведаемся".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCF1.english: "You're right there." He looks at the little scruffian, then at you. "Let's see if we can find some police work, shall we? We're not getting anything here."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCF1.polish: „Masz rację” – stwierdza. Spogląda na małych rozczochrańców, a później na ciebie. „Może zajmiemy się teraz policyjną robotą? Tracimy tu tylko czas”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCF1.belarusian: "Тут вы маеце рацыю, — ён глядзіць на маленькага абарванца, потым на цябе. — Давайце пашукаем якую паліцэйскую працу, га? Тут мы нічога не даведаемся".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCFD.english: "I'm just gonna leave now. I'm gonna leave and not talk to you anymore." [Leave.]
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCFD.polish: „Po prostu sobie pójdę. Pójdę i nie będę z wami więcej rozmawiał”. [Odejdź].
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BCFD.belarusian: "Я проста зараз пайду. Я пайду і больш не буду з вамі размаўляць". [Сысці.]

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD0C.english: Just a second ago, the first one was laughing. Now he's doing something with his lip and his gap tooth.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD0C.polish: Jeszcze sekundę wcześniej pierwszy chłopak się śmiał. Teraz robi coś dziwnego ze swoją wargą i szczerbą między zębami.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD0C.belarusian: Яшчэ секунду таму першы смяяўся. Цяпер ён нешта вытварае са сваёй губой і шчарбінай паміж зубамі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD13.polish: Ich zachowanie nie rządzi się żadnymi *prawami*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD2E.english: "You're stupid," the other one repeats, still deathly serious.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD2E.polish: „Ty jesteś głupi” – powtarza drugi chłopak wciąż śmiertelnie poważnym tonem.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD2E.belarusian: "Ты тупы", — паўтарае другі, усё яшчэ смяротна сур'ёзна.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD38.english: The boy stops laughing and looks at his toes.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD38.polish: Chłopak przestaje się śmiać i wpatruje się w palce swoich stóp.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD38.belarusian: Хлапчук перастае смяяцца і глядзіць на пальцы сваіх ног.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD40.english: The boy keeps laughing. Then he bows down to inspect the rock as though there's something noteworthy about it.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD40.polish: Chłopak śmieje się dalej. Po chwili schyla się, aby przyjrzeć się kamieniowi – jakby było w nim coś wartego uwagi.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD40.belarusian: Хлапчук працягвае смяяцца. Потым нахіляецца, каб разгледзець камень, быццам у ім ёсць нешта вартае ўвагі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD50.english: "Okay kids. You've been to that island, right?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD50.polish: „No dobra, chłopcy. Byliście na tej wyspie, nie?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD50.belarusian: "Добра, дзеткі. Вы ж былі на тым востраве, так?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD57.english: "On that island?" The one who's busy kicking his stone points to the bay.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD57.polish: „Na tej wyspie?” – pyta chłopak zajęty kopaniem kamienia, wskazując na zatokę.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD57.belarusian: "На тым востраве?" — той, што заняты штурханнем каменя, паказвае на заліў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD5E.english: "Yes, that one. I need to know what's there."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD5E.polish: „Tak, na tej. Muszę się dowiedzieć, co tam jest”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD5E.belarusian: "Так, на тым. Мне трэба ведаць, што там ёсць."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD64.english: "No, some other island. *Of course* that one."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD64.polish: „Nie, na jakiejś innej. *No pewnie*, że na tej”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD64.belarusian: "Не, на нейкім іншым востраве. *Вядома ж*, на гэтым".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD73.english: "No," the boy answers, shaking his head vehemently.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD7A.english: "Yes." His brother looks at him, then at you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD7A.polish: „Tak” – jego brat spogląda na niego, a później na ciebie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD7A.belarusian: "Так", — ягоны брат глядзіць на яго, потым на цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD80.english: "That's... uhm... nothing?" The boy pauses to think with his finger in his mouth. "It's just a seafort and some plants. You can take a raft there. It's great."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD80.polish: „Tam... ee... nie ma nic?” – chłopak zamyśla się przez chwilę z palcem w ustach. „To tylko fort morski i trochę roślin. Można tam popłynąć tratwą. Jest fajnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD80.belarusian: "Там... э-э... нічога? — хлапчук спыняецца падумаць з пальцам у роце. — Там проста марскі форт і розныя расліны. Туды можна на плыце даплыць. Там файна".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD86.english: "And! And!" the other one butts in. "We make a fire. We make a... we make a fire."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD86.polish: „I! I!” – wtrąca się drugi. „Rozpalamy ogień. Rozpalamy... Rozpalamy ognisko”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD86.belarusian: "І! І! — улазіць другі. — Мы робім вогнішча. Мы робім... мы робім вогнішча".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD8C.english: "Mhm," his brother nods. "Gather the sticks for the fire -- and bullets. Or not real bullets, empty bullets."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD8C.polish: „Mhm” – kiwa głową drugi brat. „Zbieramy patyki na ognisko – i naboje. Ale nie prawdziwe naboje – puste naboje”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD8C.belarusian: "Мгм, — ківае ягоны брат. — Збіраем палкі для вогнішча — і кулі. Ну не сапраўдныя кулі, а пустыя кулі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BD9A.english: "Because.... because..." The boy pauses to think.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDA0.english: "Because he asks to put the fire out!" the other explains.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDA0.polish: „Bo każe nam gasić ogień!” – wyjaśnia drugi.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDA0.belarusian: "Бо ён просіць затушыць вогнішча!" — тлумачыць другі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDA6.english: "Why does he ask you to put the fire out?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDAC.english: "Uhm... I don't know. He doesn't like it. He doesn't like people to be there. You shouldn't go."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDAC.polish: „Ee... Nie wiem. Nie lubi go. Nie lubi, jak są tam ludzie. Nie powinien pan tam płynąć”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDAC.belarusian: "Э-э... Я не ведаю. Яму не падабаецца. Яму не падабаецца, калі там людзі. Вам не варта туды ісці".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDB2.english: "Yes," the other one adds laconically, standing with his hands glued to his sides like a little tin soldier.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDB2.polish: „Tak” – dodaje drugi lakonicznie, stojąc na baczność jak mały ołowiany żołnierzyk.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDB2.belarusian: "Так", — лаканічна дадае другі, стоячы з прыціснутымі па швах рукамі, як маленькі алавяны салдацік.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDCE.english: The scruffy-haired little boy kicks a stone while the other watches him do it.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDCE.polish: Rozczochrany chłopiec kopie kamień, a drugi się w tym czasie przygląda.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDCE.belarusian: Ускудлачаны хлапчук штурхае камень, пакуль іншы за ім назірае.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDDC.english: "I need you to tell me what you know about it -- what's *on* the island?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDDC.polish: „Musicie powiedzieć mi, co wiecie o wyspie. Co na niej *jest*?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDDC.belarusian: "Мне трэба, каб вы расказалі ўсё, што ведаеце, — што *на* востраве?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDEA.english: "I..." starts one of them -- it's hard to tell which one now. "I don't know."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDEA.polish: „Ja...” – zaczyna jeden z nich – trudno powiedzieć który. „Ja nie wiem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDEA.belarusian: "Я... — пачынае адзін з іх — цяпер ужо цяжка сказаць, каторы. — Я не ведаю".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDF6.english: "Did you mean there are *electrical* lights?" He points to the streetlight.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDF6.polish: „Mieliście na myśli *elektryczne* światła?” – pyta, wskazując uliczną latarnię.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDF6.belarusian: "Вы мелі на ўвазе, што там ёсць *электрычныя* агні?" — ён паказвае на вулічны ліхтар.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDFD.english: "Uhm... yes." The boy looks at his toes.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDFD.polish: „Ee... tak” – odpowiada chłopak i wpatruje się w palce swoich stóp.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BDFD.belarusian: "Э-э... так", — хлапчук глядзіць на пальцы сваіх ног.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE17.english: "There are lights. The fire guy comes and asks us to put the fire out."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE17.polish: „Pojawiają się światła. Przychodzi ogniowy facet i każe nam zgasić ogień”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE17.belarusian: "Там ёсць агні. Прыходзіць вогненны дзядзька і просіць нас затушыць вогнішча".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE20.english: Your nerve endings *sting* from the mention of a *guy*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE20.polish: Czujesz, jak *kłują* cię końcówki nerwów na wspomnienie o *facecie*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE20.belarusian: Твае нервовыя канчаткі *ўколвае* ад згадкі пра *дзядзьку*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE27.english: They must mean a human being. On that island? But it's cut off...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE27.polish: Muszą mówić o jakimś człowieku. Na tej wyspie? Ale ona jest odcięta od świata...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE27.belarusian: Яны, мусіць, маюць на ўвазе чалавека. На тым востраве? Але ж ён адрэзаны ад свету...

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE4A.english: "Let's go with *yes*." The lieutenant raises his eyebrows and whips out his notebook.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE4A.polish: „Przyjmijmy, że odpowiedź brzmi *tak*” – porucznik unosi lekko brew i wyjmuje swój notatnik.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE4A.belarusian: "Схілімся да варыянту *так*, — лейтэнант ускідвае бровы і выхоплівае свой нататнік.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE55.english: Because he doesn't want to be found. Smoke traces...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE55.polish: Bo nie chce być znaleziony. Dym zwraca uwagę...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE55.belarusian: Бо ён не хоча, каб яго знайшлі. Сляды дыму...

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE68.english: "Mhm. Lily's our mom," says one of the twins.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE68.polish: „Mhm. Lily to nasza mama” – potwierdza jeden z bliźniaków.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE68.belarusian: "Мгм. Лілі — наша мама", — кажа адзін з блізнят.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE81.english: One of the boys nods, the other one looks at his brother and shrugs.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE81.polish: Jeden z chłopców kiwa głową, a drugi spogląda na swojego brata i wzrusza ramionami.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE81.belarusian: Адзін з хлапчукоў ківае, другі глядзіць на брата і паціскае плячыма.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE8D.english: "Okay, how about the policeman asks you something else now?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE8D.polish: „No dobra, to może policjant spyta was teraz o coś innego?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE8D.belarusian: "Добра, а як наконт таго, каб паліцыянт запытаўся ў вас цяпер нешта іншае?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE93.english: "Okay." The scruffy-haired boy squints up at you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BE93.polish: „Dobra” – stwierdza rozczochrany chłopak, przyglądając ci się z przymrużonymi oczami.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEA3.english: "Your father used to go to that island too, didn't he?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEA3.polish: „Wasz ojciec też pływał na tę wyspę, prawda?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEA3.belarusian: "Ваш бацька таксама плаваў на той востраў, праўда?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEB1.english: "Don't say that. He didn't." His brother punches him. The boy's eyes well up like he's about to start crying.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEB1.polish: „Nie mów tak. To nieprawda” – stwierdza jego brat i daje mu kuksańca. W jego oczach pojawiają się łzy, jakby za chwilę miał się rozpłakać.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEB1.belarusian: "Не кажы так. Гэта не так", — брат штурхае яго кулаком. Вочы хлапчука напаўняюцца слязьмі, быццам ён вось-вось заплача.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEBE.english: "Shut up." The lieutenant jabs you in the ribs with his elbow, then turns to the boy...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEBE.polish: „Zamknij się” – syczy porucznik i wbija ci łokieć w żebra, po czym zwraca się do chłopaka...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEBE.belarusian: "Заткніцеся, — лейтэнант штурхае цябе локцем у рэбры, пасля чаго паварочваецца да хлапчука..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BED0.english: "It's okay to kill yourself, you know. I'm gonna blow my brains out. Gonna close this one final case and then *blam* -- I'm outta here."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BED0.polish: „Wiecie, to nic złego się zabić. Ja na przykład odstrzelę sobie łeb. Zamknę to ostatnie śledztwo, a potem *bam*. Żegnam się ze światem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BED0.belarusian: "Забіць сябе — гэта нармальна, ведаеце. Я вось пушчу сабе кулю ў мазгі. Закрыю гэтую апошнюю справу, а потым *бабах* — і мяне няма".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEDC.belarusian: "Ды забіў ён сябе, дакладна табе кажу".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEE7.english: "Is that all you know? Is there anything more you can tell me about the island?" (Conclude.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEE7.polish: „To wszystko, co wiecie? Jesteście w stanie powiedzieć mi jeszcze coś o wyspie?” (Zakończ).
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEE7.belarusian: "Гэта ўсё, што вы ведаеце? Вы можаце расказаць мне яшчэ нешта пра востраў?" (Скончыць.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEEE.english: "There's a..." the boy says, rubbing his eyes. It's clear that he has no intention of finishing the sentence.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEEE.polish: „Tam jest...” – zaczyna chłopak, pocierając swoje oczy. Szybko staje się jasne, że nie zamierza dokończyć tego zdania.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEEE.belarusian: "Там ёсць... — кажа хлапчук, паціраючы вочы. Зразумела, што ён не збіраецца заканчваць сказ.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEFC.english: "I'm sorry." The one says to the other, rubbing his brother's shoulder affectionately.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEFC.polish: „Przepraszam” – odpowiada drugi chłopak, poklepując czule ramię swojego brata.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BEFC.belarusian: "Прабач", — кажа адзін другому, ласкава пагладжваючы брата па плячы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF03.english: "I don't know..." The boy who made the claim finds himself unsure of it. He looks around.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF03.polish: „No nie wiem...” – stwierdza niepewnie chłopak, który wcześniej twierdził inaczej. Rozgląda się.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF03.belarusian: "Я не ведаю... — хлапчук, які гэта сцвярджаў, цяпер губляе ўпэўненасць. Ён азіраецца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF13.english: "Don't punch your brother.... please. Don't start crying. We still need to ask more questions."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF13.polish: „Nie bij swojego brata... proszę. I nie płacz. Musimy zadać wam jeszcze kilka pytań”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF13.belarusian: "Не бі свайго брата... калі ласка. Не трэба плакаць. Нам яшчэ трэба задаць некалькі пытанняў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF19.english: "I'm not gonna start *crying*," the one who almost started crying snaps, regaining control of his quivering chin.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF19.polish: „Wcale nie będę *płakał*” – odpiera ten, który niemal się popłakał, i odzyskuje kontrolę nad swoją drżącą brodą.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF19.belarusian: "Не збіраюся я *плакаць*! — агрызаецца той, хто ледзь не заплакаў, вяртаючы кантроль над падбароддзем, якое дрыжыць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF33.english: "Please don't..." The boy's eyes well up as he looks at you. They're dark and round. The wind tussles his hair.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF33.polish: „Proszę, nie...” – oczy chłopaka wypełniają się łzami, gdy na ciebie patrzy. Są ciemne i okrągłe. Wiatr mierzwi jego włosy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF33.belarusian: "Калі ласка, не трэба... — вочы хлапчука напаўняюцца слязьмі, калі ён глядзіць на цябе. Яны цёмныя і круглыя. Вецер кудлаціць ягоныя валасы.

Alternate1/0x010000450001BF33.polish: Oczy chłopaka wypełniają się łzami, gdy na ciebie patrzy. Są ciemne i okrągłe. Wiatr mierzwi jego włosy.
Alternate1/0x010000450001BF33.belarusian: Вочы хлапчука напаўняюцца слязьмі, калі ён глядзіць на цябе. Яны цёмныя і круглыя. Вецер кудлаціць ягоныя валасы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF3A.english: "Don't start *crying*," his brother says, then, in a whisper, adds: "I'm sorry."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF3A.polish: „Nie *becz*” – prosi go brat, po czym dodaje szeptem: „Przepraszam”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF3A.belarusian: "Не *рэві*", — кажа брат, а потым шэптам дадае: — Прабач".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF40.english: The other boy straightens his back. "I'm not gonna start *crying*, stupid," he snaps, regaining control of his quivering chin.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF40.polish: Drugi chłopiec prostuje się. „Wcale nie będę *beczał*, głupi” – odpiera, odzyskując kontrolę nad swoją drżącą brodą.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF40.belarusian: Другі хлапчук выпроствае спіну. "Не збіраюся я *равець*, дурань", — агрызаецца ён, вяртаючы кантроль над падбароддзем, якое дрыжыць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF4E.english: "Is there anything else you can tell me about this *guy*? Age? Does he live there?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF4E.polish: „Możecie powiedzieć mi cokolwiek więcej o tym *facecie*? Ile ma lat? Mieszka tam?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF4E.belarusian: "Ці можаце вы расказаць мне яшчэ нешта пра гэтага *дзядзьку*? Узрост? Ён там жыве?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF54.english: The other watches him, brows knitted. "It doesn't even have anything to do with this, you. Father isn't the fire guy."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF54.polish: Drugi przygląda się mu ze zmarszczonym czołem. „To nie ma nic do rzeczy. Ojciec nie jest ogniowym facetem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF54.belarusian: Другі глядзіць на яго, ссунуўшы бровы. "Гэта наогул ні пры чым, ты. Бацька — не вогненны дзядзька".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF5B.english: The two things are *unconnected*. Your question didn't make sense.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF5B.polish: Te dwie sprawy są *niepowiązane*. Twoje pytanie nie miało sensu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF5B.belarusian: Гэтыя дзве рэчы *ніяк не звязаныя*. Тваё пытанне не мела ніякага сэнсу.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF70.english: "No, he doesn't live there. I don't think."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF70.polish: „Nie, on tam nie mieszka. Tak myślę”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF77.english: "No, he lives there." The other nods. "He's been there twice, two times."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF77.polish: „Nie, on tam mieszka” – kiwa głową drugi chłopak. „Był tam dwukrotnie, dwa razy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF77.belarusian: "Не, ён там жыве, — ківае другі. — Ён быў там двойчы, два разы".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF7E.english: "Huh..." The first one pauses to think, then comes to some kind of conclusion. "He doesn't live there. He isn't there sometimes."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF7E.polish: „Hmm...” – pierwszy zamyśla się, po czym dochodzi do jakiejś konkluzji. „On tam nie mieszka. Czasem go tam nie ma”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF7E.belarusian: "Хм... — першы робіць паўзу на падумаць, а потым прыходзіць да нейкай высновы. — Ён там не жыве. Часам яго там няма".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF8B.english: "Anything else? What does this guy look like?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF92.english: "Anything else? What does this guy look like?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF99.english: "I don't know," they say almost in unison.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BF99.belarusian: "Не ведаю", — кажуць яны амаль ва ўнісон.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BFA8.english: "We... we ran. He just yelled we shouldn't be there."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BFA8.polish: „My... My uciekliśmy. Krzyczał, że nie powinniśmy tam być”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BFA8.belarusian: "Мы... мы ўцяклі. Ён проста крычаў, што нам нельга там быць".

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BFC7.english: "Don't say that, he's a *po-leees oooffi-ser*," his brother whispers.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BFC7.polish: „Nie mów tak, on jest *po-liiii-cjaaaan-tem*” – szepcze jego brat.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BFC7.belarusian: "Не кажы так, ён жа *па-лііі-цыыы-янт*", — шэпча ягоны брат.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BFDA.english: "Lights? Fire guy?" The lieutenant looks at you. "We should check up on that island."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BFDA.polish: „Światła? Ogniowy facet?” – porucznik spogląda na ciebie. „Musimy sprawdzić tę wyspę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001BFDA.belarusian: "Агні? Вогненны дзядзька? — лейтэнант глядзіць на цябе. — Нам варта праверыць той востраў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010125.english: "I heard you kids sometimes play in the abandoned Feld building?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010125.polish: „Słyszałem, że bawicie się czasami w opuszczonym budynku Felda?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010125.belarusian: "Я чуў, вы, дзеткі, часам гуляеце ў закінутым будынку Feld?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010135.english: "I dunno what you're talking about." The boy stuffs his hands deep into his pockets and kicks another rock.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010135.polish: „Nie wiem, o czym pan mówi” – chłopak wsadza ręce głęboko w kieszenie i kopie kolejny kamień.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010135.belarusian: "Я не знаю, пра што вы гаворыце, — хлапчук засоўвае рукі глыбока ў кішэні і штурхае чарговы камень.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001013B.english: "What's a Feld building?" one of the twins asks with a shrug.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001013B.polish: „Co to jest budynek Felda?” – pyta jeden z bliźniaków, wzruszając ramionami.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001013B.belarusian: "А што такое будынак Feld?" — пытаецца адзін з блізнят, паціскаючы плячыма.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010141.english: "He dunno what you're talking about." The other nods.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010141.polish: „On nie wie, o czym pan mówi” – potwierdza drugi, kiwając głową.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010141.belarusian: "Ён не знае, пра што вы гаворыце", — ківае другі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001014C.english: "Nah, we don't go anywhere, nah," the other mumbles.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001014C.polish: „Nie, my się stąd nie ruszamy” – mamrocze drugi.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001014C.belarusian: "Не, мы нікуды не ходзім, не", — мармыча другі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010162.english: "He dunno what you're talking about," the first kid says loudly. Or you think it's the first kid -- it could be the second.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010162.polish: „On nie wie, o czym pan mówi” – stwierdza głośno pierwszy chłopak. A przynajmniej masz wrażenie, że to pierwszy z nich – to równie dobrze może być drugi z braci.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A00010162.belarusian: "Ён не знае, пра што вы гаворыце", — гучна кажа першы хлапчук. Ці табе здаецца, што гэта першы — гэта цалкам можа быць і другі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001016A.english: "I dunno what you're talking about," the other kid nods along.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001016A.polish: „Nie wiem, o czym pan mówi” – potwierdza drugi chłopak.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0001016A.belarusian: "Я не знаю, пра што вы гаворыце", — падтаквае другі хлапчук, ківаючы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000101DA.english: "Ha ha, I dunno what you're talking about." One of the boys shrugs his shoulders and starts laughing.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000101DA.polish: „Ha, ha! Nie wiem, o czym pan mówi” – stwierdza jeden z chłopaków, wzrusza ramionami i zaczyna się śmiać.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A000101DA.belarusian: "Ха-ха, я не знаю, пра што вы гаворыце", — адзін з хлапчукоў паціскае плячыма і пачынае смяяцца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000780000044D.english: You will never get an answer. That's how it is with these little idiots.
Dialogue Text/0x010000780000044D.polish: Nigdy nie otrzymasz odpowiedzi. Tak to już jest z tymi małymi przygłupami.
Dialogue Text/0x010000780000044D.belarusian: Ты ніколі не атрымаеш адказу. З гэтымі маленькімі ідыётамі заўсёды так.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800000462.english: Bullet shells? There are a lot of them left over from the war -- but this could be important.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800000462.polish: Łuski po nabojach? Dużo ich zostało po wojnie, ale to może być istotne.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800000462.belarusian: Гільзы ад куль? Іх шмат засталося з часоў вайны — але гэта можа быць важным.

Dialogue Text/0x010000810000661E.english: It's a purposefully shrill laugh. Like he's practised it for the express purpose of annoying people.
Dialogue Text/0x010000810000661E.polish: Śmiech jest zamierzenie piskliwy. Jak gdyby wyćwiczył go specjalnie po to, żeby irytować nim ludzi.
Dialogue Text/0x010000810000661E.belarusian: Гэта наўмысна пранізлівы смех. Быццам ён спецыяльна трэніраваўся, каб дражніць людзей.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008100006626.english: Are there actually two of them? Are you sure you're not just hallucinating or seeing double?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008100006626.polish: Jest ich faktycznie dwóch? Na pewno nie masz halucynacji? Nie widzisz podwójnie?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008100006626.belarusian: Іх сапраўды двое? Ты ўпэўнены, што гэта не галюцынацыя ці ў цябе проста дваіцца ў вачах?

Dialogue Text/0x010000810000662E.english: The rock-kicker was just being *shy*, but now he's enthusiastic again.
