Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000055EC.polish: „W porządku” – stwierdza porucznik, odchrząkując głośno. „Cieszę się, że to przerwaliśmy... Zaczynała mnie już boleć szyja. Jeśli to wszystko, to powinniśmy ruszać dalej...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000055EC.belarusian: "Добра, — раптам кашляе лейтэнант. — Гэта добры момант, каб спыніцца. У мяне пачынае балець шыя. Калі гэта ўсё, то нам варта рушыць далей".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000055FC.english: Follow your brother into death itself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000055FC.polish: Ruszaj za swoim bratem choćby i w objęcia śmierci.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000055FC.belarusian: Ідзі за сваім братам нават у абдымкі смерці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000560B.english: Phew! All that nodding was rough on the old neck. Close to feeling that twinge...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000560B.polish: Uf! Od kiwania głową rozbolał cię kark. Mało sobie go nie nadwerężyłeś...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000560B.belarusian: Ой! Гэтае ківанне далося ў знакі тваёй старой шыі. Цябе вось-вось прашые боль...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000562C.english: The lieutenant matches your nodding pace. He's a true professional at this.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000562C.polish: Porucznik dopasowuje swoje tempo kiwania głową do twojego. Jest w tym prawdziwym profesjonalistą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000562C.belarusian: Лейтэнант падладжваецца пад рытм твайго ківання. Ён сапраўдны прафесіянал у гэтай справе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005632.english: The nodding's reaching critical mass! You can't take this much longer, captain!
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005632.polish: Kiwanie osiągnie zaraz masę krytyczną! Ten okręt niedługo nie wytrzyma, kapitanie!
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005632.belarusian: Ківанне дасягае крытычнай масы! Гэты карабель хутка не вытрымае, капітан!

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005639.english: Keep nodding, goddamn it! Stay the course!
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005639.polish: Kiwać dalej, do cholery! Trzymać kurs!
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005639.belarusian: Ківаць далей, чорт бяры! Трымаць курс!

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005647.english: A small bead of sweat runs down the side of the lieutenant's face as he maintains his nodding...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005647.polish: Mała kropla potu spływa po boku twarzy porucznika, który kontynuuje kiwanie głową...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005647.belarusian: Маленькая кропля поту спаўзае па скроні лейтэнанта, які працягвае ківаць галавой...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005653.english: Abort! Abort! No... shit, it's too late!
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005653.polish: Przerwać manewr! Przerwać! Nie... Cholera, za późno!
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005653.belarusian: Адмена! Адмена! Не... халера, занадта позна!

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000565D.english: Your neck couldn't withstand all this effort... it's too much!
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000565D.polish: Twój kark nie wytrzymał wysiłku... To zbyt wiele!
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000565D.belarusian: Твая шыя не ў стане вытрымаць такой напругі... Гэта занадта!

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005662.english: Almost snapped your neck... but I fucking got this. No pain... no pain...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005662.polish: Kark już prawie trzasnął... Ale dam radę. Żadnego bólu... Żadnego...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005662.belarusian: Твая шыя амаль трэснула... але я даў рады, халера. Ніякага болю... ніякага болю...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000566C.english: It's too much! You can feel your vertebrae starting to crack, your muscles groaning...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000566C.polish: To za wiele! Czujesz, jak kręgi zaczynają się kruszyć. Mięśnie stękają z bólu...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000566C.belarusian: Гэта занадта! Ты адчуваеш, як твой хрыбетнік пачынае храбусцець, а цягліцы стогнуць ад болю...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005682.english: As the lieutenant takes out a handkerchief and softly taps the sweat off his temple... a faint crack echoes through the coast...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005682.polish: Gdy porucznik wyjmuje chusteczkę i delikatnie ociera pot ze swojej skroni... nad wybrzeżem roznosi się cichy trzask...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005682.belarusian: Калі лейтэнант дастае насоўку і акуратна выцірае пот з сваёй скроні... над узбярэжжам разносіцца ціхі трэск...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056A8.english: Whew, got off lucky there... that could have resulted in a world of hurt.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056A8.polish: Uf, poszczęściło ci się... Mogło się skończyć dużym bólem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056A8.belarusian: Фух, якая ўдача... Гэта магло скончыцца жудасным болем.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056AE.english: Whew, got off really lucky... that could have resulted in a world of hurt.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056AE.polish: Uf, co za szczęście... Mogło się skończyć dużym bólem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056AE.belarusian: Фух, якая ўдача... Гэта магло скончыцца жудасным болем.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056BE.english: "Busted the neck, did you?" He cranes his neck left and right, stretching. "Glad I stopped when I did... my neck was really starting to hurt. Don't worry, it'll mend... now, we should get going."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056BE.polish: „Nabawiłeś się urazu szyi, prawda?” – pyta, przechylając głowę w lewo i w prawo, rozciągając mięśnie szyi. „Dobrze, że przerwałem to, zanim było za późno... Zaczynał mnie już boleć kark. Nie martw się, wydobrzejesz... A teraz powinniśmy ruszać w drogę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056BE.belarusian: "Вы пашкодзілі шыю, так? — лейтэнант нахіляе галаву налева і направа, расцягваючы мышцы шыі. — Добра, што я своечасова спыніўся... Шыя сапраўды ўжо пачынала балець. Не пераймайцеся, гэта пройдзе... А цяпер варта рушыць далей".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056DD.english: He would follow you into death itself... and you would do the same for him.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056DD.polish: Poszedłby z tobą choćby i w objęcia śmierci... A ty zrobiłbyś dla niego to samo.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056DD.belarusian: Ён бы пайшоў за табой нават у абдымкі смерці... і ты зрабіў бы для яго тое ж самае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056E3.english: "Alright," the lieutenant coughs abruptly. "It's a good moment to stop. My neck was starting to hurt. If there's nothing more, we should get going."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056E3.polish: „W porządku” – stwierdza porucznik, odchrząkując głośno. „To dobra chwila, aby to przerwać... Zaczyna mnie boleć szyja. Jeśli to wszystko, to powinniśmy ruszać dalej...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000056E3.belarusian: "Добра, — раптам кашляе лейтэнант. — Гэта добры момант, каб спыніцца. У мяне пачынае балець шыя. Калі гэта ўсё, то нам варта рушыць далей".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005759.english: They stand, facing the wall... It's impossible to discern any details about their personality or background.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005759.polish: Stoją twarzami do ściany... Nie sposób wychwycić żadnych szczegółów co do ich osobowości czy pochodzenia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005759.belarusian: Яны стаяць тварамі да сцяны... Немагчыма распазнаць ніякіх падрабязнасцяў наконт іх асобаў ці паходжання.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000576A.english: "What if it was the Feld personnel when their assets were being seized by the revolutionaries?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000576A.polish: „A może to byli pracownicy Felda, kiedy fabrykę przejęli rewolucjoniści?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000576A.belarusian: "А можа, гэта былі працаўнікі Feld, калі іх маёмасць захапілі рэвалюцыянеры?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005770.english: "Perhaps the ones executed here were the loyalist-conservatives -- killed by the communists at the start of the civil war. Or it could have been the communists, put to death during the last stretch of the conflict by the Coalition forces."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005770.polish: „Być może zginęli tu konserwatywni lojaliści – straceni przez komunistów na początku wojny domowej. Ale mogli to też być komuniści uśmierceni pod koniec konfliktu przez siły Koalicji”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005770.belarusian: "Магчыма, пакараныя тут смерцю былі лаялістамі-кансерватарамі — забітыя камуністамі напачатку грамадзянскай вайны. Або гэта маглі быць камуністы, асуджаныя на смерць сіламі Кааліцыі падчас апошняй часткі канфлікту".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000582D.english: The morning sun rises beyond the horizon, radiating the first light of the day. The order was carried out at dawn.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000582D.polish: Poranne słońce wznosi się nad horyzont, rzucając na ziemię pierwsze promienie. Rozkaz wykonano o świcie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000582D.belarusian: Ранішняе сонца ўзнімаецца над даляглядам, кідаючы на зямлю першыя прамяні. Загад быў выкананы на світанку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005833.english: The sun blazes high up in the sky... baking the planks, the sand, your skin. The order was carried out in the afternoon.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005833.polish: Słońce płonie wysoko na niebie, parząc deski, piasek i twoją skórę. Rozkaz wykonano po południu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005833.belarusian: Сонца ззяе высока ў небе... Апякае дошкі, пясок, тваю скуру. Загад быў выкананы папаўдні.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005839.english: The sun falls slowly toward the horizon... the last light of the day. The order was carried out in the evening.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005839.polish: Słońce opada powoli ku horyzontowi, rzucając na ziemię ostatni blask dnia. Rozkaz wykonano wieczorem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005839.belarusian: Сонца павольна апускаецца за далягляд... Апошняе дзённае святло. Загад быў выкананы ўвечары.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000583F.english: It's dark, very dark... faint lights flicker at the edge of your vision. It's rare for the order to be carried out at night...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000583F.polish: Jest ciemno, bardzo ciemno... Słabe światła migoczą gdzieś na granicy twojego pola widzenia. Rzadko wykonywano takie rozkazy nocą...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000583F.belarusian: Цёмна, вельмі цёмна... Слабыя агні мігцяць недзе на мяжы твайго поля зроку. Гэта рэдкасць, каб такія загады выконваліся ноччу...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000585A.english: Droplets of rain fall on the wooden planks, the surrounding sand dunes. The clouds block out any rays of light...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000585A.polish: Krople deszczu padają na drewniane deski i okoliczne wydmy. Chmury blokują wszelkie promienie słońca...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000585A.belarusian: Кроплі дажджу падаюць на драўляныя дошкі і навакольныя дзюны. Хмары блакуюць усе промні святла...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005860.english: Snowflakes fall on the wooden planks and the surrounding sand dunes, covering the land with the white of innocence...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005860.polish: Płatki lecą na drewniane deski i okoliczne wydmy, pokrywając ziemię niewinną bielą...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005860.belarusian: Сняжынкі падаюць на драўляныя дошкі і навакольныя дзюны, пакрываючы зямлю цнатлівай беллю...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000586F.english: Look at the person standing on the side.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000586F.polish: Spójrz na stojącą z boku osobę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000586F.belarusian: Паглядзець на чалавека, які стаіць збоку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058A0.english: Overpriced mercenaries putting down some rabid dogs. Someone's gotta do it, right?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058A0.polish: Przepłacanymi najemnikami pozbywającymi się jakichś wściekłych psów. Ktoś to musi robić, nieprawdaż?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058A0.belarusian: Пераацэненымі наймітамі, якія прыстрэльваюць шалёных сабакаў. Хтосьці павінен гэта рабіць, праўда ж?

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058A6.english: In all truth, violence offers no answer... It's only the last available resort when all mediation fails. And here, all did fail.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058A6.polish: Przemoc w swej istocie nie niesie żadnej odpowiedzi. To tylko ostatnia deska ratunku, kiedy zawodzą wszelkie próby porozumienia. W tym wypadku zawiodły.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058A6.belarusian: Шчыра кажучы, гвалт не дае ніякіх адказаў... Гэта толькі апошняя мера, калі ўсе спробы паразумецца марныя. У гэтым выпадку яны ўсе былі марныя.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058AC.english: Martyrs of the Nation, the ardent knights. The few who had the guts to do this.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058AC.polish: Męczennikami narodu, nieugiętymi rycerzami. Nielicznymi, którzy mieli odwagę to robić.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058AC.belarusian: Пакутнікамі Народа, непахіснымі рыцарамі. Тымі нешматлікімі, якія мелі мужнасць гэта рабіць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058B7.english: Murderers. Twisted by orders. Young boys forced into killing.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058B7.polish: Wypaczonymi przez rozkazy mordercami. Młodymi chłopcami zmuszonymi do zabijania.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058B7.belarusian: Забойцамі. Сапсаванымі загадамі. Юнакамі, прымушанымі забіваць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058CE.english: You, your friends, your family. Everyone you had ever known. This was *you*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058CE.polish: To ty, twoi przyjaciele, twoja rodzina. Wszyscy, których kiedyś znałeś. To byliście *wy*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058CE.belarusian: Гэта ты, твае сябры, твая сям'я. Усе, каго ты калісьці ведаў. Гэта быў *ты*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058DB.english: Soldiers... people in a bad spot they probably did not choose, ordered to commit acts they wanted no part of.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058DB.polish: Żołnierzami... Ludźmi w strasznym położeniu, którego raczej sami nie wybrali. Zmuszonymi do czynów, w których nie chcieli mieć udziału.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058DB.belarusian: Жаўнерамі... Людзьмі ў складаным становішчы, якое, імаверна, яны не абіралі, прымушанымі рабіць учынкі, у якіх яны не хацелі браць удзел.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058EF.english: "It could even have been the employees of the Feld R&D Center down the coast, as their building was taken over by the revolutionaries."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058EF.polish: „To mogli być nawet pracownicy ośrodka badań i rozwoju Felda znajdującego się dalej na wybrzeżu, którzy trafili tu, gdy rewolucjoniści przejęli ich budynek”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000058EF.belarusian: "Гэта маглі быць нават супрацоўнікі Цэнтра даследаванняў і распрацовак Feld са ўзбярэжжа, якія апынуліся тут, калі рэвалюцыянеры захапілі іх будынак".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001491D.english: Behind this building -- the other one. Once filled with engineers and designers of Feld Electric, now collapsed and dead, but for some rats... You feel drawn, for some reason, to the faded mural again.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001491D.polish: Za tym budynkiem – następny. Niegdyś pełen inżynierów i projektantów z Feld Electric, dziś zawalony i martwy, nie licząc kilku szczurów... Z jakiegoś powodu czujesz znowu, że coś przyciąga cię do wyblakłego muralu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001491D.belarusian: За гэтым будынкам — наступны. Калісьці поўны інжынераў і праектыроўшчыкаў з Feld Electric, сёння ён разбураны і мёртвы, калі не лічыць некалькіх пацукоў... Ты адчуваеш, што па нейкай прычыне цябе зноў цягне да выцвілага мурала.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000B93.english: "You mentioned Coalition forces. Could it have been them against the wall?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000B93.polish: „Wspomniałeś o siłach Koalicji. Może to oni stali pod ścianą?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000B93.belarusian: "Ты згадваў пра сілы Кааліцыі. Ці маглі яны стаяць ля сцяны?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D7F4.english: The scattering of bullet holes looks like one giant smiling mouth. Smiling its deadly smile.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D7F4.polish: Ślady po kulach układają się w coś przypominającego wielkie, uśmiechnięte usta. Śmiercionośnie uśmiechnięte.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D7F4.belarusian: Россып слядоў ад куль нагадвае вялікія вусны. Расцягнутыя ў смяротнай усмешцы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D7FB.english: The scattering of bullet holes looks like one giant smiling mouth. Smiling its deadly smile. Laughing at you and the world and the living.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D7FB.polish: Ślady po kulach układają się w coś przypominającego wielkie, uśmiechnięte usta. Śmiercionośnie uśmiechnięte. Śmiejące się z ciebie i świata. I wszystkich żyjących.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D7FB.belarusian: Россып слядоў ад куль нагадвае вялікія вусны. Расцягнутыя ў смяротнай усмешцы. Якія смяюцца з цябе, і свету, і з усіх жывых.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D813.english: Maybe you should change it. They were praying... screaming...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D813.polish: Może powinieneś to zmienić? Modlili się... Krzyczeli...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D813.belarusian: Можа, табе варта яго змяніць. Яны маліліся... крычалі...

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D81F.english: Remember what Trant Heidelstam said about Feld.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D81F.polish: Pamiętaj, co Trant Heidelstam mówił o Feldzie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D81F.belarusian: Памятай, што Трант Хайдэльстам казаў пра Feld.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA3C.english: The man sees you approaching and turns away...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA3C.polish: Mężczyzna widzi, że się zbliżasz, i odwraca się...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA3C.belarusian: Мужчына бачыць, як ты набліжаешся, і адварочваецца...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA64.english: "I've been looking all over for you."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA74.english: "I must admit. I did not take you for a sightseer. What do you want now?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA74.polish: „Muszę przyznać, że nie miałem pana za kogoś, kto lubi podziwiać widoki. Czego pan chce?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA74.belarusian: "Мушу прызнаць: я не лічыў вас аматарам краявідаў. Чаго вы хочаце цяпер?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA7A.english: "Is that so? Have you come to *enforce* an arrest warrant?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA7A.belarusian: "Вось як? Вы прыйшлі *прывесці ў выкананне* ордар на арышт?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA7F.english: "Is that an RCM *term of art* for the *wrongfully accused*?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA7F.polish: „Czy w *żargonie* MOR-u tak określa się *niesłusznie oskarżonych*?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA7F.belarusian: "Гэта ў ГМР такі *прафесійны тэрмін* для *несправядліва абвінавачаных*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA84.polish: „Wie pan, co do tego, co stało się wcześniej...”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA91.english: How do you expect to assign la responsabilité if you won't apologise for your own mistakes?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA91.polish: Jak zamierzasz przydzielać komukolwiek la responsabilité, skoro nie umiesz przeprosić za własne błędy?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA91.belarusian: Як ты збіраешся вызначаць la responsabilité, калі не можаш папрасіць прабачэння за ўласныя памылкі?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA98.english: "Sorry, bad joke. I wanted to talk about what happened earlier."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA98.polish: „Przepraszam, to był kiepski żart. Chciałem porozmawiać o tym, co stało się wcześniej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA98.belarusian: "Прабачце, няўдалы жарт. Я хацеў пагаварыць пра тое, што адбылося раней."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA9E.english: "Let's get right to it. I have something to say."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EA9E.belarusian: "Давайце адразу да справы. Я маю што сказаць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAA6.polish: „Tak?” – pyta, odwracając się, by spojrzeć ci w oczy.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAAC.english: "And what is that, officer?" He turns to face you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAAC.polish: „Cóż takiego, oficerze?” – pyta, odwracając się, by spojrzeć ci w oczy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAAC.belarusian: "І што ж гэта, афіцэр?" — Ён паварочваецца да цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAB1.english: "I'm listening." He turns to face you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAB1.polish: „Słucham” – stwierdza, odwracając się, by spojrzeć ci w oczy.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAC3.polish: „Wygląda na to, że doszło do drobnego »nieporozumienia«”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAC8.english: "I would like to sincerely apologise for my behaviour. It was completely inappropriate, and I accept full responsibility."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAC8.polish: „Chciałbym jak najszczerzej przeprosić za moje zachowanie. Było absolutnie niestosowne i biorę za nie pełną odpowiedzialność”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAC8.belarusian: "Я хацеў бы шчыра папрасіць прабачэння за свае паводзіны. Яны былі абсалютна непрымальнымі, і я бяру на сябе поўную адказнасць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EACD.english: "I'm still pretty sure you were in the wrong, but I'm willing to forgive you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EACD.polish: „Wciąż jestem raczej pewien, że to pan zawinił, ale jestem gotów panu wybaczyć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EACD.belarusian: "Я ўсё яшчэ амаль упэўнены, што вы былі няправыя, але я гатовы вам дараваць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAD8.english: "Unbelievable. I have never seen the nerve before..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAD8.polish: „Niewiarygodne. Nigdy jeszcze nie zetknąłem się z taką bezczelnością...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAD8.belarusian: "Неверагодна. Ніколі яшчэ не бачыў такога нахабства..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EADD.english: "Especially from a common officer of the Revachol Citizens Militia."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EADD.polish: „Zwłaszcza ze strony zwykłego funkcjonariusza Milicji Obywatelskiej Revacholu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EADD.belarusian: "Асабліва ад звычайнага афіцэра Грамадзянскай міліцыі Рэвашоля."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAE2.english: "Does this behaviour represent the RCM's *official stance* toward its Coalition partners?" He turns to the lieutenant.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAE2.polish: „Czy to zachowanie reprezentuje *oficjalne stanowisko* MOR-u wobec koalicyjnych partnerów?” – pyta, zwracając się do porucznika.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAE2.belarusian: "Ці адлюстроўваюць гэтыя паводзіны *афіцыйную пазіцыю* ГМР у дачыненні да партнёраў па Кааліцыі?" — Ён паварочваецца да лейтэнанта.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAE7.english: "That is certainly a *euphemistic* way to describe what I recall..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAE7.belarusian: "Гэта вельмі *эўфемістычны* спосаб апісаць тое, што я памятаю..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAEC.english: The man considers your words a moment, then nods slowly...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAEC.polish: Mężczyzna przez chwilę rozważa twoje słowa, po czym kiwa wolno głową...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAEC.belarusian: Мужчына на імгненне задумваецца над тваімі словамі, пасля чаго павольна ківае...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAF1.english: "I accept your apology, officer, out of my *profound* respect for the RCM, and the importance of our continuing partnership."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAF1.polish: „Przyjmuję pańskie przeprosiny przez wzgląd na mój *olbrzymi* szacunek do MOR-u oraz wagi, jaką ma nasza dalsza współpraca”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAF1.belarusian: "Я прымаю вашае прабачэнне, афіцэр, з увагі на маю *глыбокую* павагу да ГМР і значнасць нашага далейшага партнёрства."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAF6.english: "Now, what brings you down to the coast?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAFB.english: "And now, this conversation is over. Good day, *officer*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EAFB.polish: „Ta rozmowa dobiegła końca. Dobrego dnia, funkcjonariuszu”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB00.english: "Perhaps he does, perhaps he does not. In any case, this conversation is over. Good day, officers."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB00.polish: „Być może tak, być może nie. W każdym razie ta rozmowa dobiegła końca. Dobrego dnia, panowie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB00.belarusian: "Магчыма, выказвае, магчыма, не. Ва ўсякім разе, размова скончаная. Добрага дня, афіцэры."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB05.english: With that, he turns his back to you once more.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB05.polish: Milknie i znowu odwraca się do ciebie plecami.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB05.belarusian: З гэтымі словамі ён зноў адварочваецца ад цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB0C.english: You aren't going to get out of this with evasion.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB0C.polish: Unikami się z tego nie wywiniesz.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB31.english: Do you hear that contempt in his voice? He's always considered himself *above* you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB31.polish: Słyszysz tę pogardę w jego głosie? Od początku uważał się za *lepszego* od ciebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB31.belarusian: Чуеш гэтую пагарду ў ягоным голасе? Ён заўсёды лічыў сябе *вышэйшым* за цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB3F.english: Do you hear that contempt in his voice? He's always considered himself *above* you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB3F.polish: Słyszysz tę pogardę w jego głosie? Od początku uważał się za *lepszego* od ciebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB3F.belarusian: Чуеш гэтую пагарду ў ягоным голасе? Ён заўсёды лічыў сябе *вышэйшым* за цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB4A.english: "I must apologise on my partner's behalf, again. Please believe me when I say that he does not speak for the RCM in *any* capacity."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB4A.polish: „Raz jeszcze muszę przeprosić za mojego partnera. Zapewniam, że nie wypowiada się w imieniu MOR-u w *jakimkolwiek* charakterze”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB4A.belarusian: "Я мушу яшчэ раз папрасіць прабачэння за свайго напарніка. Калі ласка, паверце: ён *ні ў якай меры* не выказвае пазіцыю ГМР."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB55.english: The lieutenant stares at the man's back, then steps away. He makes sure no one else can hear him as he turns to face you...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB55.polish: Porucznik wpatruje się przez chwilę w plecy mężczyzny, po czym odchodzi. Upewnia się, że nikt go nie słyszy, i staje z tobą twarzą w twarz...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB55.belarusian: Лейтэнант глядзіць на спіну мужчыны, потым адыходзіць убок. Ён пільнуе, каб ніхто іншы не пачуў яго, і паварочваецца да цябе...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB5A.english: "I don't understand why you have it in for this man. He's never been anything but gracious and helpful to our cause. Why do you feel the need to insult him?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB5A.polish: „Nie rozumiem, dlaczego tak się uwziąłeś na tego człowieka. Jak dotąd był bardzo uprzejmy i pomocny, jeśli chodzi o nasze śledztwo. Dlaczego odczuwasz potrzebę, by go obrażać?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB5A.belarusian: "Я не разумею, чаму вы так уз'еліся на гэтага чалавека. Ён заўсёды быў выключна ветлівым і карысным для нашай справы. Навошта вам яго абражаць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB5F.english: "I'm sorry, Kim. I just can't help it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB5F.polish: „Przykro mi, Kim. To silniejsze ode mnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB5F.belarusian: "Прабач, Кім. Нічога не магу з сабой зрабіць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB64.english: "It feels like he holds us in contempt, like he thinks he's better than we are."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB64.polish: „Mam wrażenie, że nami pogardza, jakby uważał się za lepszego od nas”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB64.belarusian: "Здаецца, што ён пагарджае намі, нібыта лічыць сябе лепшым за нас."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB69.english: "I just don't like his face, okay?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB69.polish: „Po prostu nie podoba mi się jego gęba, tak?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB69.belarusian: "Мне проста не падабаецца ягоная пыса, ясна?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB7B.belarusian: "Божа літасцівы, ці не маглі б вы хаця б *паспрабаваць*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB80.english: "Of course he does, he's from the Moralintern. But that doesn't mean *we* don't have standards to maintain..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB80.polish: „Oczywiście, przecież jest z Moralinternu. Ale to nie oznacza, że *my* nie mamy standardów, których powinniśmy się trzymać...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB80.belarusian: "Вядома, ён жа з Маралінтэрна. Але гэта не значыць, што *мы* не павінны трымаць планку..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB85.belarusian: "Божа літасцівы, ці не маглі б вы хаця б *прыкінуцца*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB90.english: "I'm not even sure why I'm bothering. This is *your* side task, after all..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB90.polish: „Nie wiem nawet, dlaczego tak się tym przejmuję. W końcu to *twoje* zajęcie na boku...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB90.belarusian: "Я нават не ведаю, навошта лезу. Гэта ж у рэшце рэшт *вашае* дадатковае заданне..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB9B.english: "Now, let's go. You've done enough damage here."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB9B.polish: „Chodźmy już stąd. Dość już narobiłeś tu szkód”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EB9B.belarusian: "А цяпер хадзем. Вы тут і так нарабілі дастаткова шкоды."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBAC.english: "Ah, super, here you are again, officer. How can I help?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBAC.polish: „Ach, wspaniale, to znowu pan, funkcjonariuszu. W czym mogę pomóc?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBAC.belarusian: "Ах, super, вось вы зноў тут, афіцэр. Чым магу дапамагчы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBB1.english: As you approach, the man turns and greets you with a polite wave.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBB1.polish: Gdy podchodzisz, mężczyzna odwraca się do ciebie i wita cię uprzejmym machaniem ręki.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBB1.belarusian: Калі ты падыходзіш, мужчына паварочваецца і вітае цябе ветлівым узмахам рукі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBB8.english: "Ah, super, it's the officer! I was not expecting to run into you again, but things have a funny way of turning out, no?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBB8.polish: „Ach, wspaniale, to pan, funkcjonariuszu! Nie spodziewałem się, że tu na pana wpadnę, ale życie potrafi nas zaskakiwać, prawda?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBB8.belarusian: "Ах, super, гэта ж афіцэр! Я не чакаў сустрэць вас зноў, але жыццё часам робіць пацешныя павароты, ці не так?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBBD.english: "What brings you down to the scenic Martinaise coast?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBBD.polish: „Co sprowadza pana z powrotem na malownicze wybrzeże Martinaise?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBBD.belarusian: "Што прывяло вас на маляўнічае ўзбярэжжа Марцінэза?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBCF.english: He appears completely at ease, like a common holidaymaker.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBCF.polish: Wydaje się zupełnie wyluzowany, jak zwykły wczasowicz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBCF.belarusian: Ён выглядае цалкам спакойным і разняволеным, як звычайны адпачывальнік.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBDE.english: "I need your help forming a committee. I'm trying to assign *la responsabilité*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBDE.polish: „Potrzebuję pana pomocy w powołaniu komitetu. Chcę rozdzielać *la responsabilité*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBDE.belarusian: "Мне патрэбна вашая дапамога, каб стварыць камітэт. Я спрабую размеркаваць *la responsabilité*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBE8.english: "Actually, I was wondering what *you're* doing out here."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBE8.belarusian: "Насамрэч я хацеў спытаць, што тут робіце *вы*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBF5.english: "My friend, if it's *la responsabilité* you're after, I have good news for you: There's no need to form such a committee, because it already exists!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBF5.polish: „Przyjacielu, jeśli zależy ci na *la responsabilité*, to mam dla ciebie dobrą wiadomość: nie ma potrzeby powoływania takiego komitetu, ponieważ on już istnieje!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBF5.belarusian: "Мой сябар, калі вы шукаеце *la responsabilité*, то ў мяне для вас добрыя навіны: няма ніякай патрэбы ствараць такі камітэт, бо ён ужо існуе!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBFC.english: God, of course it does. These Moralintern types...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBFC.polish: Boże, no oczywiście. Ech, ci z Moralinternu...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EBFC.belarusian: Божа, ну вядома ж ён існуе. Гэтыя тыпажы з Маралінтэрна...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC03.english: "The Comité de Responsabilité de Revachol. It acts as a sort-of clearinghouse for Coalition activities. To put it simply, they are the ultimate arbiters of la responsabilité in this part of the world."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC03.polish: „Comité de Responsabilité de Revachol. Działa on jako swoista izba rozliczeniowa dla działań Koalicji. Mówiąc prościej, członkowie tego komitetu są najwyższymi arbitrami w sprawach la responsabilité w tej części świata”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC03.belarusian: "Comité de Responsabilité de Revachol. Ён служыць своеасаблівай разліковай палатай для дзейнасці Кааліцыі. Прасцей кажучы, яны — вышэйшыя арбітры la responsabilité у гэтай частцы свету."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC0A.english: Yes, this is just the sort of reasonable authority you're looking for!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC0A.polish: Tak, właśnie takiej zdroworozsądkowej władzy szukasz!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC0A.belarusian: Так, менавіта такі разважлівы аўтарытэт ты і шукаеш!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC11.english: "I would offer to connect you with the committee myself, but alas, I am not actually *in* Martinaise."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC11.polish: „Zaproponowałbym, że skontaktuję pana z komitetem osobiście, ale tak naprawdę nie ma mnie *w* Martinaise”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC11.belarusian: "Я прапанаваў бы асабіста звязаць вас з камітэтам, але, на жаль, я насамрэч не *ў* Марцінэзе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC32.english: You *knew* there was something strange about this one! He's an astral projection, a bureaucratic phantasm!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC32.polish: *Wiedziałeś*, że coś jest z tym człowiekiem nie tak! Jest astralną projekcją, biurokratycznym fantazmatem!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC32.belarusian: Ты *ведаў*, што з ім нешта не так! Ён астральная праекцыя, бюракратычны фантом!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC37.english: He's speaking figuratively. He means he's not in Martinaise in his *official* capacity.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC37.polish: To tylko przenośnia. Ma na myśli to, że nie przebywa w Martinaise *oficjalnie*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC37.belarusian: Ён гаворыць пераносна. Мае на ўвазе, што ён не ў Марцінэзе ў *афіцыйным* статусе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC4D.english: "What are you talking about? I'm looking at you right now!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC4D.polish: „O czym pan mówi? Przecież właśnie na pana patrzę!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC4D.belarusian: "Пра што вы? Я гляджу на вас проста зараз!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC52.english: (Attempt to stick your hand through his astral form.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC52.belarusian: (Паспрабаваць прасунуць руку скрозь ягоную астральную форму.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC57.english: "I got it. You're only here on *personal* business."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC69.english: "Of course, we are speaking informally, but *officially* I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC69.polish: „Oczywiście, rozmawiamy nieformalnie, ale *oficjalnie* wciąż jestem w La Delta – przygotowuję się do nadchodzącej konferencji o pochodnych oleju napędowego...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC69.belarusian: "Вядома, мы размаўляем неафіцыйна, але *афіцыйна* я ўсё яшчэ ў Ля Дэльце, рыхтуюся да будучай канферэнцыі па вытворных мазуту..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC74.english: "Précisément. *Officially* I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC74.polish: „Précisément. *Oficjalnie* wciąż jestem w La Delta – przygotowuję się do nadchodzącej konferencji o pochodnych oleju napędowego...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC74.belarusian: "Précisément. *Афіцыйна* я ўсё яшчэ ў Ля Дэльце, рыхтуюся да будучай канферэнцыі па вытворных мазуту..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC79.english: "Why, *officially* I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives. I'm only in Martinaise in an unofficial capacity..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC79.polish: „Cóż, *oficjalnie* wciąż jestem w La Delta – przygotowuję się do nadchodzącej konferencji o pochodnych oleju napędowego. W Martinaise przebywam nieformalnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC79.belarusian: "Ну як жа, *афіцыйна* я ўсё яшчэ ў Ля Дэльце, рыхтуюся да будучай канферэнцыі па вытворных мазуту. У Марцінэзе я толькі ў неафіцыйным статусе..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC7E.english: "Mais que faites-vous, officer?" Your hand bumps up against the man's solid if somewhat fleshy chest.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC7E.polish: „Mais que faites-vous, funkcjonariuszu?” – twoja ręka zderza się z solidną, choć cokolwiek cielistą klatką piersiową mężczyzny.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC7E.belarusian: "Mais que faites-vous, афіцэр?" — Твая рука ўпіраецца ў цвёрдыя, хоць і крыху мясістыя грудзі мужчыны.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC83.english: "That's why it would be extremely irregular, or potentially even *inappropriate* for me to intercede with the Committee concerning a district I'm not officially in."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC83.polish: „Właśnie dlatego bardzo nieoczekiwane a może nawet *niestosowne* byłoby, gdybym interweniował przed komitetem w sprawie dzielnicy, w której oficjalnie nie przebywam”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC83.belarusian: "Таму было б вельмі ненармальна ці нават *непрыстойна* з майго боку хадайнічаць перад Камітэтам датычна раёна, у якім я афіцыйна не знаходжуся."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC94.english: "Yes, I was wondering the same thing. What are you doing?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC94.polish: „Tak, też się nad tym zastanawiałem. Co ty wyprawiasz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EC94.belarusian: "Так, я і сам пра гэта думаў. Што вы робіце?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECA2.english: "You said you weren't really here. I had to make sure you weren't an astral projection."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECA2.polish: „Powiedział pan, że pana tu nie ma. Musiałem się upewnić, że nie jest pan tylko astralną projekcją”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECA2.belarusian: "Вы сказалі, што вас тут насамрэч няма. Я мусіў упэўніцца, што вы не астральная праекцыя."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000ECA2.polish: „Powiedział, że go tu nie ma. Musiałem się upewnić, że nie jest tylko astralną projekcją”.
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000ECA2.belarusian: "Ён сказаў, што яго тут насамрэч няма. Я мусіў упэўніцца, што ён не астральная праекцыя."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECA7.english: "Nothing, just lost my balance a moment."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECA7.polish: „Nic, po prostu straciłem na chwilę równowagę”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECAC.english: "No, no, don't be silly. We're simply speaking in an informal capacity. *Officially* I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECAC.polish: „Nie, nie – nie bądźmy śmieszni. Po prostu rozmawiamy teraz nieformalnie. *Oficjalnie* wciąż jestem w La Delta – przygotowuję się do nadchodzącej konferencji o pochodnych oleju napędowego...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECAC.belarusian: "Не, не, не будзьце такімі наіўнымі. Мы проста размаўляем у неафіцыйным статусе. *Афіцыйна* я ўсё яшчэ ў Ля Дэльце, рыхтуюся да будучай канферэнцыі па вытворных мазуту..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECB1.english: "Perhaps your blood sugar is a bit low? As I was saying, *officially* speaking I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECB1.polish: „Być może ma pan niski poziom cukru we krwi? Jak już mówiłem, *oficjalnie* wciąż jestem w La Delta – przygotowuję się do nadchodzącej konferencji o pochodnych oleju napędowego...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECB1.belarusian: "Магчыма, у вас трохі знізіўся ўзровень цукру ў крыві? Як я і казаў, *афіцыйна* я ўсё яшчэ ў Ля Дэльце, рыхтуюся да будучай канферэнцыі па вытворных мазуту..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECC5.english: "But this is an urgent matter. I *need* to get in touch with the Committee."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECC5.polish: „Ale to ważna sprawa. *Muszę* skontaktować się z Komitetem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECC5.belarusian: "Але гэта тэрміновая справа. Мне *трэба* звязацца з Камітэтам."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECCA.english: "How am I supposed to contact the Committee then?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECCA.polish: „Jak w takim razie mam się skontaktować z Komitetem?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECCF.english: "Are you saying I should just give up?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECCF.polish: „Twierdzi pan, że powinienem się po prostu poddać?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECCF.belarusian: "Вы хочаце сказаць, што мне варта проста здацца?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECD4.english: "Yes, you've made your *persistence* quite clear. Under normal circumstances I would have to insist you go through the regular channels."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECD4.polish: „Tak, udowodnił już pan swoją *wytrwałość*. W normalnych okolicznościach nalegałbym, aby skorzystał pan z oficjalnych kanałów”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECD4.belarusian: "Так, вы вельмі ясна прадэманстравалі сваю *настойлівасць*. Пры звычайных акалічнасцях я мусіў бы настойваць на звароце праз афіцыйныя каналы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECD9.english: The man frowns. "Well, under ordinary circumstances, the Committee contacts *you*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECD9.polish: Mężczyzna marszczy czoło. „Cóż, w zwykłych okolicznościach to komitet kontaktuje się z *obywatelami*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECD9.belarusian: Мужчына хмурыцца. "Ну, пры звычайных акалічнасцях Камітэт сам выходзіць на сувязь з *вамі*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECDE.english: "I don't mean to discourage you, of course, just to say that it won't be *easy* to reach the Committee."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECDE.polish: „Nie chciałbym pana zniechęcać, oczywiście, ale uprzedzam, że dotarcie do komitetu nie będzie *łatwe*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECDE.belarusian: "Вядома, я не хачу вас абяскуражваць, проста кажу, што звязацца з Камітэтам будзе *няпроста*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECE3.english: No, no. You can't let them give you the runaround.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECE3.polish: Nie, nie. Nie możesz pozwolić, żeby cię zbyli.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECE3.belarusian: Не, не. Не дазваляй ім вадзіць цябе за нос.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECE8.english: In other words, the Committee only knows what it *wants* to know.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECE8.polish: Innymi słowy, komitet wie tylko to, co *chce* wiedzieć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECE8.belarusian: Іншымі словамі, Камітэт ведае толькі тое, што *хоча* ведаць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECED.english: Not exactly a model of accessible and accountable governance...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECED.polish: Nie brzmi to jak modelowo dostępne i odpowiedzialne ciało rządzące...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ECED.belarusian: Не надта падобна на ўзор даступнага і падсправаздачнага кіравання...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED04.english: "But if you have information of a vital interest, they might be willing to entertain an exception. In which case, I would advise you to contact them via Coalition Warship Archer."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED04.polish: „Ale jeśli ma pan istotne informacje, to może komitet będzie skłonny zrobić wyjątek. W takim wypadku radziłbym skontaktować się z nim za pośrednictwem okrętu wojennego Koalicji o nazwie »Łucznik«”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED04.belarusian: "Але калі вы валодаеце жыццёва важнай інфармацыяй, яны могуць зрабіць выключэнне. У такім выпадку я параіў бы вам звязацца з імі праз вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі "Лучнік"."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED32.polish: „Zaraz, ale co to jest Okręt Wojenny Koalicji Łucznik?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED37.english: "Why do I need to go through Archer to speak to the Committee?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED37.polish: „Czemu muszę skontaktować się z Łucznikiem, żeby porozmawiać z Komitetem?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED37.belarusian: "Чаму мне трэба звязвацца з "Лучнікам", каб пагаварыць з Камітэтам?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED3C.english: "So how does one go about contacting a Coalition warship?" (Proceed.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED3C.polish: „I jak można skontaktować się z okrętem wojennym Koalicji?” (Przejdź dalej).
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED3C.belarusian: "І як жа звязацца з вайсковым караблём Кааліцыі?" (Працягнуць.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED45.english: "Officer? You mean to say you haven't noticed the giant Coalition aerostatic peacefully patrolling the skies over Revachol?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED45.polish: „Słucham? Chce mi pan powiedzieć, że nie zauważył olbrzymiego aerostatu Koalicji patrolującego spokojnie niebo nad Revacholem?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED45.belarusian: "Афіцэр? Хочаце сказаць, вы не заўважылі гіганцкі аэрастат Кааліцыі, які мірна патрулюе неба над Рэвашолем?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED52.english: You follow the man's gaze out toward the west. There, hanging some distance above the horison, you can just make out a strange silhouette...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED52.polish: Wzorem mężczyzny spoglądasz ku zachodowi. Tam, na pewnej wysokości nad horyzontem, dostrzegasz dziwną sylwetkę...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED52.belarusian: Ты сочыш за позіркам мужчыны ў кірунку захаду. Там, крыху над гарызонтам, ледзь віднеецца дзіўны сілуэт...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED59.english: You follow the man's gaze out toward the west. There, amidst the low-hanging stars, you can just make out signs of motion...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED59.polish: Wzorem mężczyzny spoglądasz ku zachodowi. Tam, wśród nisko zawieszonych gwiazd, dostrzegasz ślady ruchu...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED59.belarusian: Ты сочыш за позіркам мужчыны ў кірунку захаду. Там, сярод нізка павіслых зорак, ледзь відаць рух...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED6C.english: It looks, to your eye, like some kind of long, metallic fish, suspended beneath a number of ceiling fans...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED6C.polish: Wygląda to twoim zdaniem jak długa, metaliczna ryba zawieszona pod kilkoma wentylatorami sufitowymi...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED6C.belarusian: На твой погляд, гэта падобна на доўгую металічную рыбіну, падвешаную пад некалькімі стольнымі вентылятарамі...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED71.english: You look around, but you don't see anything unusual. Then again, your eyes aren't the sharpest...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED71.polish: Rozglądasz się, nie widzisz jednak nic niezwykłego. Twój wzrok nie jest w końcu szczególnie dobry...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED71.belarusian: Ты азіраешся, але не бачыш нічога незвычайнага. Зрэшты, зрок у цябе не найлепшы...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED76.english: It's a set of position lights moving in unison, like a restless constellation...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED76.polish: To zestaw poruszających się razem świateł pozycyjnych. Niczym niespokojna konstelacja...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED76.belarusian: Гэта група навігацыйных агнёў, што рухаюцца ва ўнісон, нібы неспакойнае сузор'е...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED7B.english: You can't see anything. But then, it's dark, and your eyes aren't the sharpest...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED7B.polish: Nic nie widzisz. Jest w końcu ciemno, a twój wzrok nie jest szczególnie dobry...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED7B.belarusian: Ты нічога не бачыш. Але ж і цёмна, дый зрок у цябе не найлепшы...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED8A.english: Not just any fish, it moves like some ancient bottom-feeder gliding over the ocean floor in search of prey...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED8A.polish: Nie jakaś byle ryba, lecz pradawna przydenna istota sunąca przez ocean w poszukiwaniu ofiary...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED8A.belarusian: І не проста рыба — яно рухаецца, нібы старажытная прыдонная істота, што слізгае над акіянскім дном у пошуках здабычы...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED8F.english: Don't let the paintjob fool you, it's a goddamn killing machine, and there's nothing you can do to stop it!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED8F.polish: Nie daj się zmylić malowaniu. To cholerna maszyna do zabijania i nie możesz zrobić nic, żeby ją powstrzymać!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED8F.belarusian: Не паддавайся на падман афарбоўкі, гэта чортава машына для забойства, і ты ніяк не зможаш яе спыніць!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED98.english: It's about four-and-a-half kilometres from your position, you estimate.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED98.polish: Oceniasz, że znajduje się około czterech i pół kilometra od twojej pozycji.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED98.belarusian: Паводле тваіх ацэнак, да яго каля чатырох з паловай кіламетраў ад тваёй пазіцыі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED9F.english: No, it's more like a creature from the abyssopelagic zone, a great dark bioluminescent fish...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED9F.polish: Nie, jest bardziej jak jakaś istota ze strefy abisalnej, wielka, mroczna, bioluminescencyjna ryba...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ED9F.belarusian: Не, хутчэй гэта істота з абісапелагічнай зоны, вялікая цёмная біялюмінесцэнтная рыба...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDA5.english: Don't let the shiny lights fool you, it's a goddamn killing machine, and there's nothing you can do to stop it!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDA5.polish: Nie daj się zmylić tym błyszczącym światełkom. To cholerna maszyna do zabijania i nie możesz zrobić nic, żeby ją powstrzymać!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDA5.belarusian: Не паддавайся на падман бліскучых агеньчыкаў, гэта чортава машына для забойства, і ты ніяк не зможаш яе спыніць!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDAF.english: "Oh, right. The *Archer*. I thought you said... something else."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDAF.polish: „Och, racja. *Łucznik*. Myślałem, że powiedział pan... coś innego”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDAF.belarusian: "А, дакладна. *"Лучнік"*. Я думаў, вы сказалі... нешта іншае."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDB4.english: "I don't think I've ever noticed it before."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDB4.belarusian: "Не думаю, што калі-небудзь заўважаў яго раней."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDBB.english: "Ah, well, I'm glad to hear that at least. It would really be *quite unusual* for you to have never noticed it before..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDBB.polish: „No cóż, cieszę się, że to słyszę. To byłoby *bardzo niezwykłe*, gdyby ktoś taki jak pan dotąd go nie zauważył...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDBB.belarusian: "Ах, ну, прынамсі гэта прыемна чуць. Было б сапраўды *вельмі дзіўна*, каб вы ніколі не заўважалі яго раней..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDC0.english: "Interesting. In a sense, that's the very idea. The Coalition doesn't want the people of Revachol to feel that they are under a *military* occupation. That is why the Archer is always careful to maintain a constant, discreet distance."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDC0.polish: „Interesujące. W pewnym sensie o to właśnie chodzi. Koalicja nie chce, aby mieszkańcy Revacholu czuli, że znajdują się pod *wojskową* okupacją. Właśnie dlatego Łucznik zawsze zachowuje stały, dyskretny dystans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDC0.belarusian: "Цікава. У пэўным сэнсе, у гэтым і ёсць сутнасць. Кааліцыя не хоча, каб жыхары Рэвашоля адчувалі сябе пад *вайсковай* акупацыяй. Менавіта таму "Лучнік" заўсёды пільна трымаецца на нязменнай, стрыманай адлегласці."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDE8.english: "Huh. Can't believe I never noticed it before."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDE8.polish: „Hm. Nie do wiary, że nigdy go wcześniej nie dostrzegłem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDE8.belarusian: "Гм. Не магу паверыць, што ніколі не заўважаў яго раней."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000EDE8.polish: „Wygląda, jakby był jakieś cztery i pół kilometra stąd”.
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000EDE8.belarusian: "Выглядае так, нібы да яго каля чатырох з паловай кіламетраў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDF5.english: "Isn't it? A triumph of both technical ingenuity and international cooperation. I, for one, feel much safer knowing it's up there, watching all of us."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDF5.polish: „Nieprawdaż? Triumf technicznej pomysłowości i międzynarodowej współpracy. Osobiście czuję się znacznie bezpieczniej, wiedząc, że jest tam i obserwuje nas wszystkich”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDF5.belarusian: "Ці ж не так? Трыумф і тэхнічнай вынаходлівасці, і міжнароднага супрацоўніцтва. Што да мяне, дык я пачуваюся нашмат бяспечней, ведаючы, што ён там, наверсе, назірае за ўсімі намі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDFA.english: "Fascinating. I always thought it was more like a dragonfly. But isn't it interesting how humanity always finds inspiration in nature?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDFA.polish: „Fascynujące. Zawsze wydawało mi się, że wygląda raczej jak ważka. Ale czy to nie interesujące, że ludzkość zawsze znajduje inspirację w naturze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDFA.belarusian: "Займальна. Я заўсёды лічыў, што ён больш падобны на страказу. Але хіба не цікава, як чалавецтва заўжды знаходзіць натхненне ў прыродзе?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDFF.english: "Well, of course it *is* a heavily armed and armoured warship with a full complement. But I assure you its purpose in Revachol is to *keep* the peace, not disturb it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDFF.polish: „No cóż, to oczywiście *jest* ciężko uzbrojony i opancerzony okręt wojenny z pełną obsadą. Ale zapewniam, że jego celem w Revacholu jest *utrzymywanie* pokoju, a nie jego zakłócanie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EDFF.belarusian: "Ну, вядома, гэта *і ёсць* цяжкаўзброены і браняваны вайсковы карабель з поўным экіпажам. Але запэўніваю вас: ягоная мэта ў Рэвашолі — *берагчы* спакой, а не парушаць яго."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE04.english: "That is part of the idea, of course. The Coalition doesn't want the people of Revachol to feel that they are under a *military* occupation. That is why the Archer is always careful to maintain a constant, discreet distance."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE04.polish: „Po części o to właśnie chodzi, oczywiście. Koalicja nie chce, aby mieszkańcy Revacholu czuli, że znajdują się pod *wojskową* okupacją. Właśnie dlatego Łucznik zawsze zachowuje stały, dyskretny dystans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE04.belarusian: "У гэтым частка задумы, вядома. Кааліцыя не хоча, каб жыхары Рэвашоля адчувалі сябе пад *вайсковай* акупацыяй. Менавіта таму "Лучнік" заўсёды пільна трымаецца на нязменнай, стрыманай адлегласці."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE22.english: "You see, in addition to being an airborne artillery platform, Coalition Warship Archer is also the linchpin of the Coalition's surveillance and communications infrastructure in Revachol."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE22.polish: „Okręt wojenny Koalicji »Łucznik« jest nie tylko powietrzną platformą artyleryjską, ale również zwornikiem koalicyjnej infrastruktury inwigilacyjnej i komunikacyjnej w Revacholu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE22.belarusian: "Бачыце, акрамя таго, што ён з'яўляецца паветранай артылерыйскай платформай, вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі "Лучнік" таксама стрыжань інфраструктуры сачэння і сувязі Кааліцыі ў Рэвашолі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE27.english: "And listening! It has the most objective vantage point in the entire city. Not to mention a vast array of radio, photographic, and meteorological monitoring instruments."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE27.polish: „I słucha! Zajmuje najkorzystniejszy punkt obserwacyjny w całym mieście. Nie wspominając o szerokiej gamie instrumentów do monitoringu radiowego, fotograficznego i meteorologicznego, którymi dysponuje”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE27.belarusian: "І слухае! Ён мае найбольш аб'ектыўную кропку агляду ва ўсім горадзе. Не кажучы ўжо пра велізарны набор радыё-, фота- і метэаралагічных прыбораў назірання."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE31.english: "I find it a great comfort to know there are benevolent powers watching over all, in strict accordance with the Wayfarer Act and the Bristelmüne Conventions."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE31.polish: „Dodaje mi wielkiej otuchy wiedza, że nad wszystkim czuwają życzliwe siły, przestrzegając ściśle Ustawy o podróżach i konwencji bristelmüńskich”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE31.belarusian: "Мне вельмі суцяшальна ведаць, што за ўсім назіраюць добразычлівыя сілы ў строгай адпаведнасці з Законам аб падарожжах і Брыстэльмюнскімі канвенцыямі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE53.english: "Hmmm, this is quite the problem, very tricky. Of course, the Archer has orders to fire on any unidentified aerostatics that might approach it, so it might be safer to get in touch *from the ground*..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE53.polish: „Hmm... To jest całkiem spory problem – bardzo skomplikowany. Oczywiście Łucznik ma rozkaz otworzyć ogień do każdego niezidentyfikowanego aerostatu, który spróbuje się do niego zbliżyć, więc najbezpieczniej byłoby skontaktować się z nim *z ziemi*...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE53.belarusian: "Гммм, гэта даволі няпростая праблема, вельмі хітрая. Вядома, "Лучнік" мае загад адкрываць агонь па любых неапазнаных аэрастатах, якія набліжаюцца да яго, таму было б бяспечней звязацца *з зямлі*..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE5A.english: "But in that case, you would require a radio transmitter capable of broadcasting on Coalition frequencies. And that kind of technology naturally isn't typically available for non-Coalition use. Yes, it *is* a bit of a conundrum."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE5A.polish: „Ale w takim przypadku potrzebny byłby nadajnik radiowy umożliwiający transmisję na częstotliwościach Koalicji. A taką technologią naturalnie dysponują zazwyczaj jedynie przedstawiciele Koalicji. Tak, to *jest* twardy orzech do zgryzienia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE5A.belarusian: "Але ў такім разе вам спатрэбіцца радыёперадатчык, здольны вяшчаць на частотах Кааліцыі. А такая тэхналогія, натуральна, звычайна недаступная для тых, хто не ўваходзіць у Кааліцыю. Так, гэта сапраўды галаваломка."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE60.english: "I suppose there might be some way to *circuit-bend* your way onto those frequencies, but you'd have to be one of those *techno-tinkerers* to do it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE60.polish: „Pewnie istnieje jakiś sposób na *zagięcie obwodów* i dostanie się na te częstotliwości, ale musiałby pan być jednym z tych *techno-majsterkowiczów*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE60.belarusian: "Мяркую, магчыма нейкім чынам *перапаяць схему*, каб выйсці на гэтыя частоты, але для гэтага трэба быць адным з тых *тэхна-ўмельцаў*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE6A.english: "Do you know any of these tinkerers?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE74.english: "So what am I supposed to do?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE7F.english: "Unfortunately not, no, I don't have the pleasure. I am merely a representative of the Coalition Government, not very well-versed in technology. But you..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE7F.polish: „Niestety nie, nie mam tej przyjemności. Jestem tylko przedstawicielem Rządu Koalicyjnego i kiepsko znam się na technologii. Ale pan...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE7F.belarusian: "На жаль, не, не маю такога прыемства. Я толькі прадстаўнік Кааліцыйнага Урада, не надта абазнаны ў тэхналогіях. А вось вы..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE84.english: "Unauthorised circuit-bending is a very serious matter with grave security implications, but as of the moment there is no specific law *forbidding* it, in Revachol at least..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE84.polish: „Nieautoryzowane zaginanie obwodów to bardzo poważna sprawa, z którą wiążą się bardzo poważne konsekwencje dla bezpieczeństwa, ale w tej chwili nie istnieją żadne przepisy prawa *zabraniające*, które by tego zabraniały – przynajmniej nie w Revacholu...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE84.belarusian: "Несанкцыянаваная перапайка схем — вельмі сур'ёзная справа з цяжкімі наступствамі для бяспекі, але на гэты момант няма канкрэтнага закону, які б гэта *забараняў*, прынамсі ў Рэвашолі..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE89.english: "That, my friend, is your responsabilité. I cannot take it from you, nor can you delegate it to someone else..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE89.polish: „To, mój przyjacielu, twoje responsabilité. Nie mogę cię od tej odpowiedzialności uwolnić, ani przenieść ją na kogoś innego...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EE89.belarusian: "А вось гэта, мой сябар, вашая responsabilité. Я не магу зняць яе з вас, як і вы не можаце перакласці яе на кагосьці іншага..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EF06.english: "Always my pleasure to be of assistance to the RCM. Godspeed, and if we don't meet again, bonne chance!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EF06.polish: „Zawsze cieszę się, gdy mogę w jakiś sposób pomóc MOR-owi. Z bogiem, jeśli już się więcej nie spotkamy, bonne chance!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EF06.belarusian: "Заўсёды рады дапамагчы ГМР. Няхай вам шчасціць, а калі больш не сустрэнемся — bonne chance!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EF0B.english: "Already leaving?" He shakes his head merrily. "À tout à l'heure, officer!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EF0B.polish: „Już się pan żegna?” – pyta, kręcąc serdecznie głową. „À tout à l'heure, panie funkcjonariuszu!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EF0B.belarusian: "Ужо сыходзіце?" — Ён весела ківае галавой. — "À tout à l'heure, афіцэр!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003113.english: "Mm, well that's très simple. I was visiting the fishing village just north of here. They have applied for a series of micro-loans to revitalise the old market, and well, I wished to see the situation *first-hand*..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003113.polish: „Mm... To très simple. Odwiedzałem wieś rybacką znajdującą się na północ stąd. Jej mieszkańcy złożyli wniosek o serię mikropożyczek, aby zrewitalizować stary targ i, no cóż, chciałem sprawdzić sytuację *naocznie*...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003113.belarusian: "Гм, ну гэта très simple. Я наведваў рыбацкую вёску на поўнач адсюль. Яны падалі заяўку на шэраг мікрапазык, каб адрадзіць стары рынак, і я захацеў ацаніць сітуацыю *на ўласныя вочы*..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000530000311A.english: "And then, well, I had some extra time on my hands, so I decided to stroll down here. It's quite peaceful, isn't it?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000311A.polish: „A później, no cóż, miałem trochę wolnego czasu, więc postanowiłem udać się tu na spacer. Bardzo tu spokojnie, prawda?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000311A.belarusian: "А потым у мяне з'явіўся вольны час, таму я вырашыў прагуляцца сюды. Тут вельмі спакойна, ці не так?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000530000312D.polish: „Nie jest to tak do końca miejsce w moim stylu”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003133.english: "You do know there was a mass execution right over there?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003133.polish: „Wie pan, że o tam miała miejsce masowa egzekucja?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003133.belarusian: "Вы ведаеце, што вунь там адбыўся масавы расстрэл?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003139.english: "Did you see all the bullet holes in that wall over there?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003139.polish: „Widział pan te ślady po kulach na tamtej ścianie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003139.belarusian: "Вы бачылі ўсе тыя сляды ад куль на той сцяне?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003140.english: The man takes a deep breath. "Yes, there's nothing like a stroll along the coast to lift one's spirits."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003140.polish: Mężczyzna robi głęboki wdech. „Tak, nie ma to jak spacer wzdłuż wybrzeża, by podnieść się na duchu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003140.belarusian: Мужчына робіць глыбокі ўдых. "Так, нішто так не паднімае настрой, як шпацыр уздоўж узбярэжжа."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003148.english: "Well, you know what they say, 'In matters of taste, there can be no dispute'! For my part, I find it quite invigorating."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003148.polish: „No cóż, jak mawiają, o gustach się nie dyskutuje! Według mnie to miejsce jest bardzo pobudzające”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003148.belarusian: "Ну, ведаеце, як кажуць: "Пра густы не спрэчаюцца"! А мне тут здаецца вельмі бадзёра."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003151.english: "Actually, there was something *else* I wanted to ask you about."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003151.polish: „Właściwie to chciałem spytać pana o coś *innego*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003151.belarusian: "Насамрэч я хацеў спытаць вас пра нешта *іншае*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003158.polish: „Ach, bon? Zamieniam się w słuch, funkcjonariuszu”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003164.english: "Really?" The man frowns. "*Here*? How can you be sure?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003164.polish: „Naprawdę?” – mężczyzna marszczy czoło. „*Tutaj*? Skąd ta pewność?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000530000316B.english: "It's sort of a gift I have. I can reconstruct things that happened in the past. High-end detective stuff."
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000316B.polish: „Mam coś w rodzaju daru. Umiem odtwarzać rzeczy, które miały miejsce w przeszłości. To skomplikowana detektywistyczna procedura”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000316B.belarusian: "У мяне такі дар. Я магу рэканструяваць тое, што адбывалася ў мінулым. Штучка высокакласных дэтэктываў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003171.english: "For one, that wall over there is *covered* in bullet holes."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003171.polish: „Tamta ściana jest na przykład *całkowicie* pokryta śladami po kulach”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003171.belarusian: "Ну, напрыклад, тая сцяна вунь там *уся* ў кулявых адтулінах."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003179.english: "Ah, a very useful gift for a police detective, I'm sure. Fascinating, *how much history* is contained right here, if only one knows where to look for it..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003179.polish: „Ach, to z pewnością bardzo przydatny dar dla policyjnego detektywa. Fascynujące, *jak wiele historii* można tu odkryć, gdy wie się, gdzie jej szukać...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003179.belarusian: "Ах, вельмі карысны дар для паліцэйскага дэтэктыва, без сумневу. Займальна, *колькі гісторыі* хаваецца тут, калі ведаць, дзе шукаць..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003180.english: "Ah, is that what those pock marks are? I might've guessed. Fascinating, *how much history* is contained right here, if only one knows where to look for it..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003180.polish: „Ach, więc tym są te ospowe blizny? Mogłem się domyślić. Fascynujące, *jak wiele historii* można tu odkryć, gdy wie się, gdzie jej szukać...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003180.belarusian: "Ах, дык вось што гэта за вышчарблены? Мог бы і здагадацца. Займальна, *колькі гісторыі* хаваецца тут, калі ведаць, дзе шукаць..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003187.english: Are you just going to let him get away with these generalities and euphemisms?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003187.polish: Pozwolisz, żeby te ogólniki i eufemizmy tak mu uszły na sucho?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003187.belarusian: Ты проста так дазволіш яму адкараскацца агульнымі фразамі і эўфемізмамі?

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003195.english: "I'm sure the communards who were killed here take a different view."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003195.polish: „Podejrzewam, że zamordowani tu komunardzi mają nieco inne zdanie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003195.belarusian: "Упэўнены, забітыя тут камунары глядзелі б на гэта інакш."

Dialogue Text/0x010000530000319B.english: "Ugly work, but at least someone had the balls to do what had to be done."
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000319B.polish: „Paskudna robota, ale ktoś przynajmniej miał jaja, żeby ją wykonać”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000319B.belarusian: "Брудная праца, але хоць у кагосьці хапіла яек зрабіць тое, што мусіла быць зроблена."

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031A1.english: "Really, it's the property damage that most offends me."
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031A1.polish: „Prawdę mówiąc, najbardziej razi mnie w tym niszczenie budynku”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031A1.belarusian: "Шчыра кажучы, найбольш мяне абурае пашкоджанне маёмасці."

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031AA.english: "Yes, the loss of human life was truly catastrophic... This is why the Coalition is so focused on preventing another war. Our peacekeeping mission is a testament to this..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031AA.polish: „Tak, utrata ludzkich żyć była prawdziwą katastrofą... Dlatego właśnie Koalicja jest tak bardzo skupiona na zapobieganiu kolejnej wojnie. Nasza misja pokojowa jest tego najlepszym dowodem...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031AA.belarusian: "Так, гібель людзей была сапраўды катастрафічнай... Менавіта таму Кааліцыя так засяроджаная на прадухіленні новай вайны. Наша міратворчая місія — таму пацверджанне..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031B1.english: "Thankfully, the region is becoming more and more stable. I'm confident that atrocities like this belong in the past. The future is..." he snaps his fingers, "*tranquilou bilou!*"
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031B1.polish: „Na szczęście ten region staje się coraz bardziej stabilny. Jestem pewny, że te okrucieństwa należą już do przeszłości. Przyszłość jest...” – pstryka palcami – „*tranquilou bilou*!”
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031B1.belarusian: "На шчасце, рэгіён робіцца ўсё больш стабільным. Я ўпэўнены, што такім зверствам месца ў мінулым. Будучыня..." — ён пстрыкае пальцамі, — "*tranquilou bilou!*"

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031B8.english: *Tranquilou bilou*? Let's not get into this, you can't argue with someone who uses words like 'tranquilou bilou'.
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031B8.polish: *Tranquilou bilou*? Nie pakujmy się w to. Nie wygrasz dyskusji z kimś, kto używa tego rodzaju słów.
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031B8.belarusian: *Tranquilou bilou*? Лепей не лезці, немагчыма спрачацца з тым, хто ўжывае выразы накшталт "tranquilou bilou".

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031C4.english: "A rather *brutal* perspective on history." He frowns slightly. "I personally take the more nuanced view that it was regrettably harsh, but perhaps necessary to end the war..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031C4.polish: „To raczej *brutalne* spojrzenie na historię” – stwierdza, marszcząc lekko czoło. „Osobiście wyznaję bardziej zniuansowane pogląd, że było to niefortunnie przykre, ale być może konieczne zakończenie wojny...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031C4.belarusian: "Даволі *брутальны* погляд на гісторыю." — Ён злёгку хмурыцца. — "Асабіста я прытрымліваюся больш тонкай думкі, што гэта было прыкра жорстка, але, магчыма, неабходна дзеля заканчэння вайны..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031D0.english: "Now, now. Human life is *always* more important than private property..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031D0.polish: „Oj, oj... Ludzkie życie jest *zawsze* ważniejsze od prywatnej własności...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031D0.belarusian: "Ну-ну. Чалавечае жыццё *заўсёды* важнейшае за прыватную маёмасць..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031DB.english: "Though, I do hope whoever was responsible at least compensated the building's owner appropriately."
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031DB.polish: „Ale mam nadzieję, że odpowiedzialne za to osoby przynajmniej zrekompensowały szkody właścicielowi tego budynku”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031DB.belarusian: "Хоць я спадзяюся, што адказныя за гэта прынамсі належным чынам кампенсавалі шкоду ўладальніку будынка."

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031E7.english: "You're right. It's so complex and fascinating I can't even *begin* to think critically about it."
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031E7.polish: „Racja. Jest tak złożona i fascynująca, że nie umiem nawet *próbować* myśleć o niej krytycznie”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031E7.belarusian: "Вашая праўда. Усё настолькі складана і займальна, што я нават не магу *пачаць* думаць пра гэта крытычна."

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031EE.english: "Well said. Let us just be grateful that *we* don't live in such fascinating times."
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031EE.polish: „Dobrze powiedziane. Bądźmy po prostu wdzięczni, że *my* nie żyjemy w tak fascynujących czasach”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031EE.belarusian: "Добра сказана. Будзьма проста ўдзячныя за тое, што *мы* не жывём у такія цікавыя часы."

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031FA.english: You feel like there's *something* you could say here, if only you really knew what was going on...
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031FA.polish: Czujesz, że gdybyś rozumiał tak naprawdę, co się dzieje, miałbyś w tym momencie *coś* do powiedzenia...
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000031FA.belarusian: Адчуваеш, што табе ёсць *што* сказаць, каб ты толькі ведаў, што тут насамрэч адбываецца...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003201.english: You feel like there's *something* you could say here, if only you really knew what was going on...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003201.polish: Czujesz, że gdybyś rozumiał tak naprawdę, co się dzieje, miałbyś w tym momencie *coś* do powiedzenia...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003201.belarusian: Адчуваеш, што табе ёсць *што* сказаць, каб ты толькі ведаў, што тут насамрэч адбываецца...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003207.english: "Ah, is that what those pock marks are? I might've guessed. Fascinating, *how much history* is contained right here, if only one knows where to look for it..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003207.polish: „Ach, więc tym są te ospowe blizny? Mogłem się domyślić. Fascynujące, *jak wiele historii* można tu odkryć, gdy wie się, gdzie jej szukać...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003207.belarusian: "Ах, дык вось што гэта за вышчарблены? Мог бы і здагадацца. Займальна, *колькі гісторыі* хаваецца тут, калі ведаць, дзе шукаць..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000580001C727.english: "What's certain is that we must do everything to prevent such tragic events from ever happening again. The answers lie in *debates*, not in violence."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580001C727.polish: „Pewne jest to, że musimy zrobić wszystko, aby takie tragiczne wydarzenia nigdy już się nie powtórzyły. Rozwiązaniem są *debaty*, a nie przemoc”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580001C727.belarusian: "Несумненна адно: мы мусім зрабіць усё, каб падобныя трагічныя падзеі ніколі больш не паўтарыліся. Адказ ляжыць у *дыскусіях*, а не ў гвалце."

Dialogue Text/0x010000580001C73C.english: The Bristelmüne Conventions are a series of international agreements governing the treatment of military personnel and civilians in theatres of war as well as occupied territories. In practice, they are more talked about than observed.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580001C73C.polish: Konwencje Bristelmüńskie to seria umów międzynarodowych normujących zasady traktowania personelu wojskowego i cywilów na terenach objętych konfliktami oraz okupowanych. W praktyce bardziej się o nich mówi niż je stosuje.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580001C73C.belarusian: Брыстэльмюнскія канвенцыі — гэта шэраг міжнародных пагадненняў, якія рэгулююць абыходжанне з вайскоўцамі і цывільнымі ў зонах баявых дзеянняў і на акупаваных тэрыторыях. На практыцы пра іх больш гавораць, чым іх выконваюць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B5C.english: "Hmmm, perhaps your young friends in the *tent* might be of assistance?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B5C.polish: „Hmm... Może twoi młodzi przyjaciele z *namiotu* mogliby ci w tym pomóc?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B5C.belarusian: "Гммм, магчыма, вашы маладыя сябры ў *палатцы* маглі б дапамагчы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B62.english: This sounds like something that programmer you met in the church might help with...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B62.polish: To brzmi jak coś, w czym mogłaby pomóc programistka, którą spotkałeś w kościele...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B62.belarusian: Падобна на тое, з чым магла б дапамагчы тая праграмістка, якую ты сустрэў у царкве...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B68.english: "Let me just say that I have *complete confidence* in the RCM. I'm sure you'll figure something out."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B68.polish: „Powiem tylko, że pokładam *całkowite zaufanie* w MOR. Jestem pewny, że coś pan wymyśli”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B68.belarusian: "Дазвольце толькі сказаць, што я маю *поўны давер* да ГМР. Я ўпэўнены, вы нешта прыдумаеце."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B70.english: You *will* figure it out. Something tells you the person you're looking for is already on this coast...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B70.polish: W końcu to *rozgryziesz*. Coś ci mówi, że osoba, której szukasz, przebywa już na tym wybrzeżu...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B70.belarusian: Ты *абавязкова* нешта прыдумаеш. Нешта падказвае табе, што чалавек, якога ты шукаеш, ужо на гэтым узбярэжжы...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B76.english: Perhaps your new friends in the tent might be able to help you?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B76.polish: Może twoi nowi przyjaciele z namiotu byliby w stanie pomóc?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B76.belarusian: Магчыма, твае новыя сябры ў палатцы маглі б табе дапамагчы?

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B7C.english: "Hmmm, sounds like something that programmer we met in the church might be able to help with..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B7C.polish: „Hmm... To brzmi jak coś, w czym mogłaby pomóc programistka, którą spotkaliśmy w kościele...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B7C.belarusian: "Гммм, падобна, што тая праграмістка, якую мы сустрэлі ў царкве, магла б тут дапамагчы..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B82.english: "Oh, good: 'Techno-tinkerers.' Just what this *side task* was missing..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B82.polish: „Świetnie – techno-majsterkowicze. Właśnie tego w tym *pobocznym zadaniu* brakowało...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004B82.belarusian: "О, выдатна: "Тэхна-ўмельцы". Якраз тое, чаго не хапала гэтаму *пабочнаму заданню*..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000057C7.english: The awkward silence that follows is yours to fill.
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000057C7.polish: Zapada niezręczna cisza, którą musisz czymś wypełnić.
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000057C7.belarusian: Нязручную цішыню, што настае следам, запаўняць табе.

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000057CF.english: This isn't the end. There may yet be someone along this coast who can direct you where you need to go...
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000057CF.polish: To jeszcze nie koniec. Może jeszcze być na tym wybrzeżu ktoś, kto będzie cię w stanie pokierować...
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000057CF.belarusian: Гэта яшчэ не канец. На гэтым узбярэжжы можа быць нехта, хто падкажа табе правільны кірунак...

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000057D6.english: This isn't the end. There may yet be someone along this coast who can direct you where you need to go...
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000057D6.polish: To jeszcze nie koniec. Może jeszcze być na tym wybrzeżu ktoś, kto będzie cię w stanie pokierować...
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000057D6.belarusian: Гэта яшчэ не канец. На гэтым узбярэжжы можа быць нехта, хто падкажа табе правільны кірунак...

Dialogue Text/0x010000530000630F.english: "The sea air is so invigorating, don't you agree?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000630F.belarusian: "Марское паветра так бадзёрыць, ці не праўда?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000530000631F.english: "This whole area is a strong candidate for a micro-loan."
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000631F.polish: „Cały ten obszar jest ma duże szanse na mikropożyczkę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000631F.belarusian: "Уся гэтая мясцовасць — выдатны кандыдат на мікрапазыку."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006324.polish: „Najpierw responsabilité, później stabilité i w końcu prospérité!”

Dialogue Text/0x010000530000632D.english: "Even high-ranking bureaucrats are entitled to a holiday."
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000632D.polish: „Nawet wysoko postawieni biurokraci mają prawo do urlopu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000632D.belarusian: "Нават высокапастаўленыя бюракраты маюць права на адпачынак."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800002A15.english: "Here we go. Nice and easy. No way out, little guys, not out of this jam..."
