Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B07B.belarusian: "Той малы, які збег, — Вострык, — ты проста так гэта пакінеш?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B081.english: "Krenel, Wild Pines... All the people responsible for the deaths of your friends. You're just going to leave it like that?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B081.polish: „Krenel, Wild Pines... Wszyscy ludzie odpowiedzialni za śmierć twoich przyjaciół. Tak zostawisz ich w spokoju?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B081.belarusian: "Krenel, Wild Pines... Усе тыя, хто адказны за смерць тваіх сяброў. Ты проста так усё пакінеш?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B090.english: The flicker of light in his eyes goes out and he collapses back on the table.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B090.polish: Światło w jego oczach gaśnie; opada z powrotem na stół.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B090.belarusian: Агеньчык у ягоных вачах згасае, і ён зноў валіцца на стол.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B09C.english: "Sons of bitches..." He mumbles something in Mesque. When he sinks down on the table again, a malevolent smile spreading across his face.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B09C.polish: „Skurwysyny...” – mówi i dodaje coś po meskijsku. Kiedy opada z powrotem na stół, na twarzy maluje mu się złowrogi uśmiech.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B09C.belarusian: "Сучыя дзеці..." - ён мармыча нешта па-мескійску. Калі ён зноў ападае на стол, на ягоным твары расплываецца зларадная ўсмешка.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0A8.english: "Was this really the best idea?" The lieutenant pauses to think for a moment. "I guess you may have prolonged his existence a bit. If he can still remember this when he sobers up."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0A8.polish: „Czy to naprawdę najlepszy pomysł?” – pyta porucznik, po czym przez chwilę milczy w zamyśleniu. „Pewnie przedłużyłeś tym trochę jego życie. O ile będzie pamiętał twoje słowa, gdy wytrzeźwieje”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0A8.belarusian: "Ці гэта сапраўды была найлепшая ідэя?" - лейтэнант спыняецца падумаць на імгненне. - "Мяркую, вы трохі падоўжылі ягонае існаванне. Калі ён яшчэ будзе памятаць гэта, як працверазіцца".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0B2.english: "If you think this will keep him from offin' himself, I'll make sure to remind him... so far I've just been pouring whiskey in him to keep him sedated." He nods.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0B2.polish: „Jeśli sądzisz, że to powstrzyma go przed wykończeniem się, na pewno mu przypomnę. Jak dotąd po prostu wlewałem w niego whiskey, żeby go znieczulić” – mówi i kiwa głową.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0B2.belarusian: "Калі думаеш, што гэта ўтрымае яго ад самагубства, я абавязкова яму нагадаю... дагэтуль я проста ўліваў у яго віскі, каб ён сядзеў сцішна", - ён ківае.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0BA.english: His eyes, which remain fixed on yours, become somewhat clearer, and he smiles a malevolent drunken smile. "Dennis is a dead man... just doesn't know it yet..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0BA.polish: Jego wlepione w ciebie oczy stają się nieco mniej zamglone. Uśmiecha się złowrogim, pijackim uśmieszkiem. „Dennis jest już trupem... tyle że jeszcze o tym nie wie...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0BA.belarusian: Ягоныя вочы, прыкаваныя да тваіх, крыху яснеюць, і ён зларадна, п'яна ўсміхаецца. "Дэніс — нябожчык... ён проста яшчэ гэтага не ведае..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0C8.english: "Couldn't help you even if I wanted to." He shakes his head. "The whole harbour is in lockdown and Evrart sent word to sit tight and wait for instructions."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0C8.polish: „Nie mógłbym ci pomóc, nawet gdybym chciał” – kręci głową. „Cały port jest zamknięty, Evrart nakazał nam siedzieć spokojnie i czekać na polecenia”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0C8.belarusian: "Не змог бы дапамагчы, нават каб захацеў", - ён хітае галавой. - "Увесь порт закрыты, а Эўрар перадаў сядзець ціха і чакаць інструкцый".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0D4.english: "T... Ti... Tit..." The spit flying out of his mouth is accompanied by a painful grimace. "Tit... Titus's fuckin' dead..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0D4.polish: „T... Ti... Tit...” – bełkocze z bolesnym grymasem, bryzgając kroplami śliny. „Tit... Titus, kurwa, nie żyje...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0D4.belarusian: "Ц... Ці... Ціт..." - сліна ляціць з ягонага рота разам з пакутным грымасам. - "Ціт... Цітус, бляха, мёртвы..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0DC.english: "What's gonna happen to the Hardie boys? Look around you, man. This shit is done. There are no more Hardie boys!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0DC.polish: „Co będzie z chłopakami Hardiego? Rozejrzyj się, facet. Nie ma o czym gadać. Nie ma już żadnych chłopaków Hardiego!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0DC.belarusian: "Што будзе з Хлопцамі Хардзі? Азірніся, чалавеча. Гэтаму капец. Хлопцаў Хардзі больш няма!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0E8.english: "Oh yeah... that makes sense. Never mind."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0E8.polish: „No tak... to ma sens. W takim razie nieważne”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0E8.belarusian: "А, ну так... у гэтым ёсць сэнс. Забудзься."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0EF.english: "You two are just going to go back to hauling containers in the harbour?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0EF.polish: „I co, powrócicie tak po prostu do targania kontenerów w porcie?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0EF.belarusian: "І вы ўдваіх проста вернецеся цягаць кантэйнеры ў порце?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0F6.english: "Look, what do you want from us, man? Things are pretty tough right now."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0F6.polish: „Słuchaj, typie, czego ty od nas chcesz? Chwilowo jest jakby trochę ciężko”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B0F6.belarusian: "Слухай, чалавеча, чаго ты ад нас хочаш? Нам зараз і так нялёгка."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B102.english: "No, man. I don't know... I guess the Union will still be policing the neighbourhood, but..." He looks at his dazed companion. "Who's gonna do it now?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B102.polish: „Nie, stary, nie wiem... Związek pewnie wciąż będzie pilnował okolicy, ale...” – spogląda na swojego zamroczonego kompana. „Kto to teraz będzie dla niego robił?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B102.belarusian: "Не, чалавеча. Не ведаю... Мяркую, Прафсаюз усё адно будзе патруляваць раён, але..." - ён глядзіць на свайго ачмурэлага таварыша. - "Хто цяпер гэтым зоймецца?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B117.english: "He will." (Point to Alain.) "You just need to sober him up, that's all."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B117.polish: „On”. (Wskaż na Alaina). „Musisz go tylko otrzeźwić i tyle”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B117.belarusian: "Ён зоймецца." (Паказаць на Алена.) "Табе проста трэба яго працверазіць, вось і ўсё".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B11D.english: "You should just disband. Let other, better people take over."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B11D.polish: „Powinniście dać spokój i już. Pozwolić przejąć pałeczkę komuś lepszemu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B11D.belarusian: "Вам варта проста распусціцца. Няхай іншыя, лепшыя людзі возьмуць усё ў свае рукі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B12B.english: "Anyone ever tell you you're a total dickhead?" His voice is quiet and resigned. "Well... you are, man. Just fuck off and leave us be."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B12B.polish: „Mówił ci już ktoś kiedyś, że jesteś skończonym chujem?” – mówi cichym, zrezygnowanym głosem. „No więc jesteś, typie. Odpierdol się i daj nam spokój”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B12B.belarusian: "Табе калі-небудзь казалі, што ты поўны казёл?" - ягоны голас ціхі і пакорлівы. - "Дык вось... так і ёсць, чалавеча. Проста ад'ябіся і пакінь нас у спакоі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B13E.english: "Alain? He won't be leading anything." He turns to his friend. "I mean, look at him -- the man's broken through and through."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B13E.polish: „Alain? On już nikim nie będzie dowodził” – mówi i odwraca się do swojego przyjaciela. „Popatrz na niego tylko. To złamany człowiek”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B13E.belarusian: "Ален? Ён нічым кіраваць не будзе", - ён паварочваецца да свайго сябра. - "Ну паглядзі на яго — чалавек зламаны дашчэнту".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B14D.english: "That wouldn't be funny even if we weren't surrounded by the ghosts of our fallen friends."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B14D.polish: „To nie byłoby śmieszne nawet wtedy, gdyby nie otaczały nas duchy naszych zabitych przyjaciół”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B14D.belarusian: "Гэта не было б смешна, нават каб нас не акружалі прывіды нашых загінулых сяброў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B155.english: "Me? No, man... I'm not a leader." He smiles suddenly. "You know Titus only recruited me 'cause I play the guitar? Said the team could use the morale boost."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B155.polish: „Ja? Nie, chłopie. Ze mnie żaden przywódca” – mówi i uśmiecha się nagle. „Wiesz, że Titus mnie zrekrutował tylko dlatego, że gram na gitarze? Mówił, że ekipie przyda się taki wzmacniacz morale”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B155.belarusian: "Я? Не, чалавеча... Я не лідар", - ён раптам усміхаецца. - "Ведаеш, што Цітус узяў мяне толькі таму, што я іграю на гітары? Сказаў, камандзе спатрэбіцца падтрымка маралі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B175.belarusian: "А хіба ў Цітуса не было брата? Цібса?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B17C.english: "Tiberius? He doesn't wanna get mixed up in our shit. Titus has been buttering him for years on the count of all this being *fun as fuck*."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B17C.polish: „Tiberius? On nie chce mieszać się w ten nasz syf. Titus namawiał go do tego od lat, mówił, że to *kurewsko dobra zabawa*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B17C.belarusian: "Тыберыя? Ён не хоча ўлазіць у нашае дзярмо. Цітус гадамі яго ўгаворваў, кажучы, што гэта *афігенна весела*".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B186.english: "But he's got his window fitting business, a wife with two kids and the third one on the way... No way he's gonna leave all that."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B186.polish: „Ale on ma swój biznes szklarski, żonę, dwójkę dzieci i trzecie w drodze. Ni ciula tego wszystkiego nie zostawi”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B186.belarusian: "Але ў яго бізнес па ўсталёўцы вокнаў, жонка з двума дзецьмі і трэцяе на падыходзе... Нізашто ён усё гэта не кіне".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B18E.english: "You can do it. *Eugenie Boys* has quite the ring, doesn't it?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B18E.polish: „Dasz radę. *Chłopaki Eugene'a*. Brzmi to całkiem nieźle, nie sądzisz?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B18E.belarusian: "У цябе атрымаецца. *Хлопцы Эжэна* — гучыць неблага, га?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B194.english: "Sounds like you gotta go with Mr. Outside Hire, then."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B194.polish: „No to pozostaje wam chyba pan Ktoś z Zewnątrz”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B194.belarusian: "Падобна, што вам давядзецца ўзяць кагосьці з боку".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B19B.english: "I ain't gonna stick around for that." He shakes his head resolutely. "I only stayed because of Titus. *There* was a man born to lead."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B19B.polish: „Ale mnie tu już wtedy nie będzie” – kręci zdecydowanie głową. „Siedziałem w tym tylko ze względu na Titusa. To był *urodzony* dowódca”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B19B.belarusian: "Дзеля такога я тут заставацца не буду", - ён рашуча хітае галавой. - "Я заставаўся толькі праз Цітуса. *Вось хто* быў прыроджаным лідарам".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1A4.english: "What? Fuck no! *If* I'd stay we'd keep the name to honour Titus."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1A4.polish: „Co? Kurwa no, ni chuja! *O ile* w ogóle miałbym zostać, to z szacunku działalibyśmy dalej pod nazwiskiem Titusa”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1A4.belarusian: "Што? Бляць, не! *Калі* б я і застаўся, мы б захавалі назву ў гонар Цітуса".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1AB.english: "You're right, Eugene Hardie doesn't sound bad either."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1AB.polish: „Masz rację. Eugene Hardie też wcale nie brzmi źle”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1AB.belarusian: "Твая праўда, Эжэн Хардзі таксама гучыць някепска".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1B2.english: "That's a noble thought. You're going to do alright. No one is born to lead."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1B2.polish: „Szlachetna myśl. Poradzisz sobie. Nikt nie jest przywódcą z urodzenia”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1B2.belarusian: "Гэта высакародная думка. У цябе ўсё атрымаецца. Ніхто не нараджаецца лідарам".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1B9.english: "Titus was..." His eyes meet yours. "But thanks for the vote of confidence. If I don't stick around, it's all over. So I guess sorta I have to now."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1B9.polish: „Titus nim był...” – wasze spojrzenia spotykają się. „Ale dzięki za ten głos zaufania. Jeśli tu nie zostanę, będzie po wszystkim. Więc w zasadzie to chyba muszę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1B9.belarusian: "Цітус нарадзіўся..." - ягоныя вочы сустракаюцца з тваімі. - "Але дзякуй за давер. Калі я не застануся, то ўсяму канец. Так што, мусіць, давядзецца".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1CA.english: "Man... you have no idea how this works do you?" He looks at the glass of milk on the table. "But yes... If I don't stick around then it's all over. So I guess I sorta have to now."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1CA.polish: „W mordę. Nie masz pojęcia, jak to wszystko działa, co?” – spogląda na stojącą na stole szklankę mleka. „Ale fakt. Jeśli tu nie zostanę, będzie po wszystkim. Więc w zasadzie to chyba muszę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1CA.belarusian: "Чалавеча... ты паняцця не маеш, як гэта працуе, так?" - ён глядзіць на шклянку малака на стале. - "Але так... Калі я не застануся, то ўсяму канец. Так што, мусіць, давядзецца".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1D2.english: "Hardie boys without a Hardie? That's just stupid."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1D2.polish: „Chłopaki Hardiego bez Hardiego? To jakaś bzdura”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1D2.belarusian: "Хлопцы Хардзі без Хардзі? Гэта проста глупства".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1D9.english: "Cop, you just don't understand how things work." He exhales sharply in frustration, but then quickly collects himself.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1D9.polish: „Glino, nie rozumiesz w ogóle, jak to działa” – wydycha gwałtownie powietrze z frustracji, szybko jednak się opanowuje.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1D9.belarusian: "Мент, ты проста не разумееш, як тут усё ўладкавана", - ён рэзка выдыхае ад расчаравання, але хутка апаноўвае сябе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1E1.english: "Nah. Garte said she took off some time before the firefight, that's all. Trying to remember if there was anything... oh, yeah, he said she seemed to be in real hurry."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1E1.polish: „Nie. Garte powiedział, że zniknęła na jakiś czas przed strzelaniną i tyle. Próbuję sobie jeszcze przypomnieć... A, tak, mówił, że bardzo jej się spieszyło”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B1E1.belarusian: "Не. Гарт сказаў, што яна змылася перад самай перастрэлкай, вось і ўсё. Спрабую ўспомніць, ці было яшчэ штосьці... а, так, казаў, яна вельмі спяшалася".

Dialogue Text/0x01000082000040E8.english: "Oh no..." He winces. "You fly solo on this one."
Dialogue Text/0x01000082000040E8.polish: „O nie...” – jęczy. „Radź se z tym sam”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000082000040E8.belarusian: "О не..." - ён моршчыцца. - "З гэтым разбірайся сам".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004107.english: Seeing you approach, the bruised man clenches his fists.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004107.polish: Widząc, że się zbliżasz, posiniaczony mężczyzna zaciska pięści.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004107.belarusian: Убачыўшы, што ты набліжаешся, пабіты мужчына сціскае кулакі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004117.english: Seeing you approach, the bruised man raises his beer can in welcome.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004117.polish: Widząc, że się zbliżasz, posiniaczony mężczyzna unosi swoją puszkę z piwem w geście powitania.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004117.belarusian: Убачыўшы, што ты набліжаешся, пабіты мужчына вітальна падымае бляшанку піва.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004128.english: "Those guys have been going around town," he continues in a whisper, "Crying about their new asshole. Cuno can't handle this emotional shit when he's off the lightning."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004128.polish: „Ci kolesie łażą po całym mieście” – kontynuuje szeptem – „i beczą, jakby im kto przegwintował odbytnice. Cuno nie znosi tego emocjonalnego gówna, jak nie jest na speedzie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004128.belarusian: "Гэтыя тыпы швэндаюцца па горадзе", - працягвае ён шэптам, - "і плачуць, нібы ім сраку парвалі. Куна не выносіць гэтай эмацыйнай херні, калі ён не пад кайфам".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000413B.english: He probably means they've been mourning their lost friends.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000413B.polish: Ma pewnie na myśli to, że opłakują swoich utraconych przyjaciół.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000413B.belarusian: Ён, напэўна, мае на ўвазе, што яны аплакваюць загінулых сяброў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900001019.english: The man stares at you with spite in his eyes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900001019.polish: Mężczyzna wpatruje się w ciebie z gniewem w oczach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900001019.belarusian: Мужчына глядзіць на цябе са злосцю ў вачах.

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000101E.english: The man stares at you through the haze in his eyes.
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000101E.polish: Mężczyzna wpatruje się w ciebie zamglonymi oczami.
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000101E.belarusian: Мужчына глядзіць на цябе скрозь затуманеныя вочы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000020000010B.english: "I suppose," he continues, his voice now calm, "I should at least consider sticking around. If I'm not here, it's all over."
Dialogue Text/0x010000020000010B.polish: „Może i tak” – mówi dalej, spokojnym już głosem. „Powinienem choć pomyśleć o tym, żeby tu zostać. Jeśli tu nie zostanę, będzie po wszystkim”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000020000010B.belarusian: "Мяркую", - працягвае ён ужо спакойным голасам, - "мне варта прынамсі падумаць пра тое, каб застацца. Калі мяне тут не будзе, то ўсяму канец".

Dialogue Text/0x010000020000011C.english: "Let's not get ahead of ourselves." He frowns. "We'll see what he does with the whole Shanky business."
Dialogue Text/0x010000020000011C.polish: „Nie rozpędzajmy się zbytnio” – marszczy czoło. „Zobaczymy, co zrobi z tym całym Kosiorem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000020000011C.belarusian: "Давай без спешкі", - ён хмурыцца. - "Паглядзім, што ён зробіць з гэтай справай Вострыка".

Dialogue Text/0x010000020000015C.english: "Yeah, man, you know..." He slaps his hand on the table in a sudden burst of drunk enthusiasm. "You know -- you've got this. You got this!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000020000015C.polish: „Tak, stary, wiesz co...” – mówi, uderzając w stół ręką w nagłym przypływie pijackiego entuzjazmu. „Wiesz co? Mamy to w garści. Ty masz to w garści!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000020000015C.belarusian: "Так, братуха, ведаеш..." - ён пляскае далонню па стале ў раптоўным прыліве п'янага энтузіязму. - "Ведаеш — у цябе ўсё выйдзе. У цябе атрымаецца!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000200000166.english: He looks off to the side, eyes filled with worry. "I haven't *got* shit, Al."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000200000166.polish: Odwraca wzrok. W jego oczach widać troskę. „Ja tam *nic* nie mam w garści, Al”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000200000166.belarusian: Ён глядзіць убок з трывогай у вачах. "Ніхрэна ў мяне не *выйдзе*, Ал".

Dialogue Text/0x010000020000016E.english: There's something there. A germ of determination. He knows he has no choice but to rise to the occasion.
Dialogue Text/0x010000020000016E.polish: Coś tam drzemie. Jakiś zalążek determinacji. Wie, że nie ma wyboru i musi sprostać temu wyzwaniu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000020000016E.belarusian: Там нешта ёсць. Зярнятка рашучасці. Ён ведае, што ў яго няма выбару, акрамя як адпавядаць моманту.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008BC0.english: He's not gonna get over it.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008BC8.english: Yes. People have called you that before. You didn't care.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008BC8.polish: Tak. Ludzie cię już tak kiedyś nazywali. Nie dbałeś o to.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008BC8.belarusian: Так. Цябе ўжо так называлі. Табе было ўсё адно.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFD0.english: If *any* of them had leadership capacity beside Titus, it's him. Keep encouraging him.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFD0.polish: Jeśli *którykolwiek* z nich poza Titusem miał jakieś zdolności przywódcze, to właśnie on. Podnieś go jeszcze na duchu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFD0.belarusian: Калі ў *каго-небудзь* з іх, акрамя Цітуса, і былі лідарскія здольнасці, дык гэта ў яго. Працягвай яго падбадзёрваць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFD9.english: He's not a drinker. Another good thing about him.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFD9.polish: Nie pije. To kolejna jego dobra cecha.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFD9.belarusian: Ён не п'е. Яшчэ адзін ягоны плюс.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFE1.english: This is not *completely* ludicrous. Him and Titus were the only detectives of the bunch. Titus more, but Eugene at least knew how to think along.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFE1.polish: To nie jest takie *kompletnie* absurdalne. On i Titus byli w tej bandzie jedynymi detektywami. Titus bardziej, ale Eugene umiał przynajmniej nadążać myślą.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFE1.belarusian: Гэта не *зусім* недарэчна. Ён і Цітус былі адзінымі дэтэктывамі ў гэтай шайцы. Цітус у большай ступені, але Эжэн прынамсі ўмеў думаць у тым жа кірунку.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFE9.english: "Damn songbird of misery that one..." The man shakes his head.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFE9.polish: „Cholerny z niej ptak niedoli...” – mówi, kręcąc głową.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFF6.english: "And do you have any information on this 'songbird of misery'?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFF6.belarusian: "І ці ёсць у вас якая-небудзь інфармацыя пра гэтую 'птушку няшчасця'?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFFD.english: "And do you have any information on her whereabouts?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFFD.polish: „Masz jakieś informacje co do jej miejsca pobytu?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EFFD.belarusian: "А ці ёсць у цябе якая-небудзь інфармацыя пра яе месцазнаходжанне?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F00E.english: Move on. There's no catching her this time around.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F00E.polish: Daj spokój. Tym razem nie zdołasz jej złapać.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F00E.belarusian: Руш далей. Гэтым разам яе не дагнаць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F016.english: "Yeah, you too. It's a rough world out there..." He shakes his head. "It's not easy being a cop. We were too hard on you..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F016.polish: „Tak, ty też. Świat nie jest przyjaznym miejscem...” – kręci głową. „Niełatwo jest być gliną. Byliśmy dla ciebie zbyt surowi...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F016.belarusian: "Так, ты таксама. Сурвовы свет навокал..." - ён хітае галавой. - "Няпроста быць ментом. Мы былі занадта жорсткія з табой..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F021.english: "...both of you," he turns to the lieutenant. "We shouldn't have fucked with you like we did. You got between us and a lot of bullets in that fight. Martinaise owes you one."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F021.polish: „Dla was obu” – dodaje, odwracając się do porucznika. „Nie powinniśmy byli tak z wami pogrywać. W tej walce stanęliście między nami a całym gradem kul. Martinaise wisi wam przysługę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F021.belarusian: "...з вамі абодвума", - ён паварочваецца да лейтэнанта. - "Мы не павінны былі так да вас чапляцца. У тым баі вы ўсталі паміж намі і кучай куль. Марцінэз перад вамі ў даўгу".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F027.english: "That's kind of you to say." The lieutenant closes his notes. "Take care of your friend, okay?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F027.polish: „To miło z twojej strony” – odpowiada porucznik, zamykając swój notatnik. „Zaopiekuj się swoim przyjacielem, dobrze?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F027.belarusian: "Прыемна гэта чуць", - лейтэнант закрывае нататнік. - "Паклапаціцеся пра свайго сябра, добра?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F02D.english: "I will. You take care of yours," he nods to you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F02D.polish: „Dobrze. A ty swoim” – pokazuje na ciebie brodą.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F02D.belarusian: "Абавязкова. А вы клапаціцеся пра свайго", - ён ківае на цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F033.english: "We shouldn't have fucked with you like we did. You got between us and a lot of bullets in that fight -- Martinaise owes you one."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F033.polish: „Nie powinniśmy byli tak z tobą pogrywać. W tej walce stanąłeś między nami a całym gradem kul. Martinaise wisi ci przysługę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F033.belarusian: "Мы не павінны былі так да цябе чапляцца. У тым баі ты ўстаў паміж намі і кучай куль — Марцінэз перад табой у даўгу".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F042.english: "Hear that, detective Pig? You're a fuckin' hero now."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F042.polish: „Słyszałeś, detektywistyczna świnio? Jesteś teraz jebanym bohaterem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F042.belarusian: "Чуў, дэтэктыў Парсюк? Ты цяпер ёбаны герой".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F048.english: "I wouldn't go that far -- but you have a home here if you need it. And two busted up Union men who are grateful to you. So take care, okay?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F048.polish: „To akurat za wiele powiedziane, ale jeśli będziesz potrzebował domu, to tutaj go znajdziesz. I dwóch mocno obitych ludzi ze Związku żywi wobec ciebie wdzięczność. Więc uważaj na siebie, dobra?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F048.belarusian: "Я б не заходзіў так далёка — але калі табе спатрэбіцца прытулак, тут ён ёсць. І два пабітыя члены Прафсаюза, удзячныя табе. Так што трымайся, добра?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F069.english: A sharp pain shoots up your side and into your stomach. You must not look too good. Luckily it passes...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F069.polish: Błyskawica bólu przebiega od twojego boku w stronę brzucha. Chyba nie wyglądasz za dobrze. Szczęśliwie to mija...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001F069.belarusian: Востры боль прасякае бок і аддае ў жывот. Ты, мабыць, выглядаеш не вельмі. На шчасце, гэта праходзіць...

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002ED0.english: "Strange... I even miss Angie's loud stomach..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002ED0.polish: „Dziwne... Tęsknię nawet za hałaśliwym brzuchem Angiego...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002ED0.belarusian: "Дзіўна... Я нават сумую па гучным жываце Ангі..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002ED6.english: "Think Mañana could make a good Hardie boy?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002ED6.polish: „Myślisz, że z Mañany byłby dobry chłopak Hardiego?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002ED6.belarusian: "Думаеш, з Mañana атрымаўся б добры хлопец Хардзі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002EDC.english: "Shit like that really makes you think."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002EDC.polish: „Takie gówno naprawdę zmusza człowieka do myślenia”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002EE2.english: "One day I'll write a song about it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002EE2.polish: „Przyjdzie dzień, że napiszę o tym piosenkę”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002EEA.english: "Goddamn Shanky... never liked that rat-faced fuck."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002EEA.polish: „Cholerny Kosior. Nigdy nie lubiłem tego skurwysyńskiego szczura”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002EEA.belarusian: "Пракляты Вострык... ніколі не любіў гэтага пацукамордага вырадка".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B221.english: "I wrote a song about the fight, anybody wanna hear it, or...? Too soon, I get it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B221.polish: „Napisałem piosenkę o naszej walce. Chce ją ktoś usłyszeć czy...? Jeszcze za wcześnie, rozumiem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B221.belarusian: «Я напісаў песню пра нашу барацьбу. Хто-небудзь хоча яе пачуць ці...? Яшчэ занадта рана, разумею».

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B207.english: "Never thought I'd miss the smell of Angie's rotting feet..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B207.polish: „Nie pomyślałbym, że zatęsknię za smrodem gnijących stóp Angiego...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B207.belarusian: «Я б ніколі не падумаў, што засумую па смуродзе тлеючых ног Энджы...»

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B20D.english: "What about Mañana? Think he'd make a good Hardie boy?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B20D.polish: „A Mañana? Może byłby z niego dobry chłopak Hardiego?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B20D.belarusian: «А Маñана? Магчыма, з яго б выйшаў добры хлопец Хардзі?»

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B213.english: "Shit like that can turn a man into pacifist... Not me, but someone..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B213.polish: „Po takim gównie człowiek może stać się pacyfistą... Nie ja, ale jakiś inny człowiek...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B213.belarusian: «Пасля такога лайна чалавек можа стаць пацыфістам... Не я, але нейкі іншы чалавек...»

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B201.english: "Word on the street is: 'Outgunned, the Hardie boys kill twenty Krenel mercs...'"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B201.polish: „Na ulicy krąży taka plota: »Mimo przewagi przeciwnika chłopaki Hardiego zabiły dwudziestu najemników z Krenel«…”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B201.belarusian: «На вуліцы ходзіць такая чутка: "Нягледзячы на перавагу суперніка, хлопцы Хардзі забілі дваццаць наймітаў з Крэнэль"...»

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B229.english: "Think the mercs were bad? Should've seen the bangers down on Boogie Street..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B229.polish: „Myślisz, że ci najemnicy byli twardzi? Żebyś zobaczył gangusów z Boogie Street...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B229.belarusian: «Думаеш, гэтыя найміты былі жорсткія? Каб ты пабачыў бандытаў з Багі-стрыт…»

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B22F.english: "*This* is gonna make a hell of a sad tattoo..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B235.english: "I envy Theo. To go out in the twilight of your life in a blaze of glory..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B235.polish: „Zazdroszczę Theo. Zginąć w podeszłym wieku, w blasku chwały...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B235.belarusian: «Зайздрошчу Тэо. Загінуць у старэчым узросце, у ззянні славы...»

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B23B.english: "The Hardie boys are *unfuckable* now. We could take over the isola."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B23B.polish: „Chłopaki Hardiego są teraz *nie do zajebania*. Moglibyśmy przejąć całą isolę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B23B.belarusian: „Хлопцы Хардзі зараз *неаб'здзельныя*. Мы маглі б узяць пад кантроль увесь востраў”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B241.english: "Death ain't sad -- theirs was glorious. Hope mine will be dignified like that..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B241.polish: „Śmierć nie jest smutna. W ich przypadku była chwalebna. Oby moja była tak pełna godności...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B241.belarusian: «Смерць не сумная. У іх выпадку яна была славутая. Каб мая была так поўная годнасці...»

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002EF6.english: "... no worse than the bangers on Boogie Street."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002EF6.polish: „...nie gorsi od gangusów z Boogie Street”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002F02.english: "*This* is gonna make a hell of a sad tattoo..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002F08.english: "Theo went like he lived -- fast and hard. Tough old man."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002F08.polish: „Theo zginął tak, jak żył. Szybko i z jebnięciem. Stary twardziel”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002F08.belarusian: "Тэа сышоў так, як і жыў — хутка і жорстка. Стары крэмень."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002F14.english: "We could take over the entire city."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B251.english: "Uh... (unintelligible)... like a fucking *cobarde*... like a fucking bitch..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B257.english: "Alain is a fucking cockroach name... (unintelligible)... suits me..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B257.polish: „Alain to jebane karalusze imię... (niezrozumiałe)… Pasuje do mnie...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B257.belarusian: «Ален — гэта грэбенае каралюшнае імя... (неразборліва)… Падыходзіць мне...»

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B25D.english: "Shame... (hic)... burns worse than anything... I just want this to end...
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B25D.polish: „Wstyd... *czk*... pali gorzej niż cokolwiek. Niech to się już skończy...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B25D.belarusian: «Сорам... *ікаўка*... пячэ больш, чым што-небудзь. Няхай гэта ўжо скончыцца...»

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B263.english: "C'mere, you mesque coward... die with the rest... die like a man..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B263.polish: „No chodź, ty meskijski tchórzu... Giń jak reszta... Giń jak facet...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B263.belarusian: «Ну хадзі, ты мескійскі баязлівец... Памры як астатнія... Памры як мужчына...»

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B269.english: "...bullet's too good for me... Just let it end, *madre*..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B269.polish: „...kula jest dla mnie zbyt dobra... Niech to się już skończy, *madre*...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B269.belarusian: «...куля для мяне занадта добрая... Няхай гэта ўжо скончыцца, *мадрэ*...»

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B296.english: "Avenge and die... that simple (hic)... You'll be proud, T..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B296.polish: „Pomścić i zginąć... To takie proste. *Czk*... Będziesz dumny, T...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B296.belarusian: «Адпомсціць і загінуць... Гэта так проста. *Гык*... Ты будзеш ганарыцца, Т...»

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B288.english: "For Titus... for Glenny... for... for Titus... wait... already got one for Titus..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B288.polish: „Za Titusa... za Glenny'ego... Za... za Titusa... Zaraz. Za Titusa już było...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B288.belarusian: «За Тыта... за Гленні... За... за Тыта... Зараз. За Тыта ўжо было...»

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B28F.english: "When it's done I'll just blow my brains out... I'll *earn* it..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B28F.polish: „Jak to się skończy, to se po prostu odstrzelę łeb... *Zasłużę* sobie na to...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B28F.belarusian: «Як гэта ўсё скончыцца, то я проста адстрэлю галаву... *Заслужу* сабе на гэта...»

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B281.english: "I will not get weary... will not tire... hatred will carry me..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B281.polish: „Nie zmęczę się... Nie spocznę... Nienawiść mnie poniesie...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B281.belarusian: «Не стамлюся... Не спынюся... Нянавісць мяне панясе...»

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B27A.english: "... will hunt you down and gut you like butcher..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B27A.belarusian: «Я цябе высачыць і ўскрыю, як мяснік...»

Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031B9.english: "... no worse than the bangers on Boogie Street."
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031B9.polish: „...nie gorsi od gangusów z Boogie Street”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031B9.belarusian: "...нічым не горшыя за бандзюкоў з Бугі-стрыт".

Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031BF.english: "*This* is gonna make a hell of a sad tattoo..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031C5.english: "Theo went like he lived -- fast and hard. Tough old man."
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031C5.polish: „Theo zginął tak, jak żył. Szybko i z jebnięciem. Stary twardziel”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031C5.belarusian: "Тэа сышоў так, як і жыў — хутка і жорстка. Моцны стары".

Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031D1.english: "We could take over the entire city."

Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031DD.english: "Alain is a fucking roach name anyway... So *me*."
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031DD.polish: „Alain to imię jak dla robaka... Idealne *dla mnie*”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031DD.belarusian: "Ален — гэта і так ёбанае імя для таракана... Акурат *як я*".

Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031E9.english: "I'm the lucky fuck, who didn't take a scratch." (Sighs.)
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031E9.polish: „Jestem fartowny skurwiel, którego nawet nie tknęli” – mówi, wzdychając.
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031E9.belarusian: "Я той шчаслівы мудак, на якім ні драпіны". (Уздыхае.)

Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031EF.english: "Ain't no one gonna be writing any ballads about me..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031EF.polish: „O mnie nikt ballad pisał nie będzie...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031EF.belarusian: "Ніхто пра мяне балад пісаць не будзе..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031F5.english: "Shanky's gonna get a lesson in Boogie Street justice."
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031F5.polish: „Kosior dostanie lekcję sprawiedliwości rodem z Boogie Street”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000031F5.belarusian: "Вострык атрымае ўрок правасуддзя па законах Бугі-стрыт".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003201.english: "For Titus... for Glenny... for... for Titus!!!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003201.polish: „Za Titusa... za Glenny'ego... Za... za Titusa!!!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003201.belarusian: "За Цітуса... за Глені... за... за Цітуса!!!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003207.english: "When it's done I'll just blow my brains out... Fuck everything."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003207.polish: „Jak to się skończy, to se po prostu odstrzelę łeb... Jebać to wszystko”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003207.belarusian: "Калі ўсё скончыцца, я проста вынесу сабе мазгі... Пайшло яно ўсё нахуй".

Dialogue Text/0x010000400000320D.english: "Boogie street justice. Gonna make you proud, T."
Dialogue Text/0x010000400000320D.polish: „Sprawiedliwość rodem z Boogie Street. Będziesz ze mnie dumny, T”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000400000320D.belarusian: "Правасуддзе Бугі-стрыт. Ты будзеш ганарыцца мной, Т."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000168F.english: "Cuno's gonna scram now." He rubs his hands together. "Can't be seen with pigs. Can't shit on Cuno's good name."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000168F.polish: „Cuno się teraz zmyje” – oznajmia, zacierając ręce. „Jeszcze ktoś go zobaczy ze świnią. Cuno musi dbać o dobre imię”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000168F.belarusian: "Куна зараз змыецца". Ён пацірае рукі. "Нельга, каб яго бачылі з парсюкамі. Нельга сраць на добрае імя Куна".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00001695.english: "So yeah -- see you on the seafort island. Try not to get shot or drunk again. Cuno's counting on your ass."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00001695.polish: „No to widzimy się na wyspie z fortem. Tym razem spróbuj nie oberwać kulki i nie urżnij się. Cuno na ciebie liczy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00001695.belarusian: "Карацей, так — убачымся на выспе з марскім фортам. Паспрабуй зноў не злавіць кулю і не нажрацца. Куна разлічвае на тваю сраку."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000016A0.english: As you approach the door leading out of the hostel, the bespectacled man in an orange bomber jacket turns to you:
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000016A0.polish: Gdy podchodzisz do drzwi prowadzących na zewnątrz, mężczyzna w okularach i pomarańczowej kurtce bomberce zwraca się do ciebie...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000016A0.belarusian: Калі падыходзіш да дзвярэй, якія вядуць на вуліцу, мужчына ў акулярах і аранжавай куртцы-бамбёрцы звяртаецца да цябе...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000016AB.english: "Excuse me... I think you may be the person I've been waiting for." He narrows his eyes and extends his hand in greeting.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000016AB.polish: „Przepraszam... Zdaje się, że jesteś osobą, na którą czekam” – mruży oczy i wyciąga dłoń na powitanie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000016AB.belarusian: "Прабачце... Здаецца, вы той чалавек, якога я чакаў". Ён прыжмурвае вочы і працягвае руку для прывітання.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400016004.english: "Hold up, piggo. There's something you gotta understand about the Cuno first." He drags his sleeve across his nose. "Cuno's gotta protect the Cuno name."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400016004.polish: „Czekaj, prośku. Musisz coś zrozumieć o Cuno” – stwierdza, przeciągając rękawem pod zasmarkanym nosem. „Cuno musi dbać o swoje imię”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400016004.belarusian: "Пачакай, парсючок. Спачатку ты мусіш сёе-тое зразумець пра Куна". Ён праводзіць рукавом па носе. "Куна мусіць берагчы імя Куна".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001600A.english: "The gimps out there ain't gonna think we a thing. Cuno will follow you, but don't expect anything *extra* okay, pig? Cuno's silent, like a fucking vegetable."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001600A.polish: „Cuno nie pozwoli, żeby te ułomki z miasta myślały, że coś nas łączy. Cuno z tobą pójdzie, ale niczego *więcej* się nie spodziewaj. Jasne, świnio? Cuno będzie cicho jak jebane warzywo”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001600A.belarusian: "Мясцовыя калекі не павінны думаць, што мы парачка. Куна пойдзе за табой, але не чакай нічога *лішняга*, ясна, парсюк? Куна маўчыць, як ёбаная гародніна".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400016019.english: "Listen up, pig! Cuno's gonna scram now." He rubs his hands together.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400016019.polish: „Słuchaj, świnio! Cuno się teraz zmyje” – oznajmia, zacierając ręce.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400016019.belarusian: "Слухай сюды, парсюк! Куна зараз змыецца". Ён пацірае рукі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001601F.english: "See you on the seafort island -- try not to get shot again or drunk or shit. Cuno's counting on you."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001601F.polish: „Widzimy się na wyspie z fortem – tym razem spróbuj nie oberwać kulki i się nie urżnij czy co. Cuno na ciebie liczy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001601F.belarusian: "Убачымся на выспе з марскім фортам — паспрабуй зноў не злавіць кулю, не нажрацца ці яшчэ чаго. Куна на цябе разлічвае".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001602A.english: "And don't forget about that bitch's window. Scope that shit. Cop Cuno's telling you, that's the break in the case."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001602A.polish: „I nie zapomnij o oknie tej suki. Dobrze se to gówno obcykaj. Cuno-glina mówi ci, że to przełom w śledztwie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001602A.belarusian: "І не забудзься пра акно гэтай сукі. Агледзь усё гэтае лайно. Коп Куна табе кажа, гэта прарыў у справе".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001C2BA.english: Cuno will rejoin your party later.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001C2BA.polish: Cuno dołączy do twojej grupy później.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001C2BA.belarusian: Куна далучыцца да тваёй групы пазней.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000E552.english: "You're far from home, *lieutenants*... This isn't a district known for its love of self-proclaimed militiamen."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000E552.polish: „Jesteście daleko od domu, *porucznicy*... To nie jest dzielnica znana z miłości do samozwańczych stróżów prawa”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000E552.belarusian: "Вы далёка ад дому, *лейтэнанты*... Гэты раён не славіцца любоўю да самаабвешчаных апалчэнцаў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC26.english: "Detective Disorientated." She smiles coldly. "Are you still wondering where you are? This is Martinaise, in case you've forgotten. I advise you not to overstay your welcome."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC26.polish: „Detektyw Zdezorientowany” – uśmiecha się zimno. „Wciąż zastanawiasz się, gdzie jesteś? To Martinaise – przypominam na wypadek, gdybyś zapomniał. Radzę nie zostawać tu zbyt długo”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC26.belarusian: "Дэтэктыў Дэзарыентаваны, — яна халодна ўсміхаецца. — Усё яшчэ думаеш, дзе ты? Гэта Марцінэз, калі ты забыўся. Раю не злоўжываць гасціннасцю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC2C.english: "Officer Discotheque." She smiles coldly. "Still wondering if we listen to disco? We don't, by the way. We don't listen to disco anymore."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC2C.polish: „Funkcjonariusz Dyskotekowiec” – uśmiecha się zimno. „Wciąż zastanawiasz się, czy słuchamy disco? Nie, nie słuchamy już disco”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC2C.belarusian: "Афіцэр Дыскатэка, — яна халодна ўсміхаецца. — Усё яшчэ цікавішся, ці слухаем мы дыска? Не слухаем, дарэчы. Мы больш не слухаем дыска".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC32.english: "Detective Skin-Colour." She smiles coldly. "I'm still black as you can see. Do you have any more keen-eyed observations?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC32.polish: „Detektyw Kolor Skóry” – uśmiecha się zimno. „Wciąż jestem czarna, jak widzisz. Masz jeszcze jakieś spostrzegawcze obserwacje?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC32.belarusian: "Дэтэктыў Колер Скуркі, — яна халодна ўсміхаецца. — Як бачыш, я ўсё яшчэ чарнаскурая. У цябе ёсць яшчэ нейкія праніклівыя назіранні?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC5C.english: "Let me handle this," the woman says to the crowd in the mess hall before turning to you...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC5C.polish: „Ja się tym zajmę” – mówi kobieta do tłumu w stołówce, po czym odwraca się do ciebie...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC5C.belarusian: "Дазвольце мне з гэтым разабрацца", — кажа жанчына натоўпу ў сталовай, перш чым павярнуцца да цябе...

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC86.english: Her entire character has shifted. This young woman is cold as ice.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC86.polish: Jakby nagle odmienił się jej charakter. Młoda kobieta jest zimna jak lód.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC86.belarusian: Увесь яе вобраз змяніўся. Гэтая маладая жанчына халодная як лёд.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BCDB.english: "I mean no trouble, I'm here to do my job, that's all."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BCDB.polish: „Nie szukam kłopotów. Wykonuję tylko swoją pracę i tyle”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BCDB.belarusian: "Я не хачу непрыемнасцей, я тут, каб рабіць сваю працу, вось і ўсё".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BCE2.english: "You're right, lieutenant, she did seem friendlier sitting on that corner."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BCE2.polish: „Masz rację, poruczniku. Jak siedziała na tamtym rogu, wydawała się przyjaźniejsza”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BCE2.belarusian: "Твая праўда, лейтэнанце, калі яна сядзела на тым рагу, то здавалася больш прыязнай".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BCE9.english: "I'm a legal counsellor for the Dockworkers' Union. I've been watching you." It feels like she's waiting for a reaction of some sort.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BCE9.polish: „Jestem radczynią prawną Związku Robotników Portowych. Obserwowałam cię” – masz wrażenie, że czeka na jakąś reakcję.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BCE9.belarusian: "Я юрыдычны кансультант Прафсаюза Партовых Рабочых. Я назірала за табой". Здаецца, яна чакае нейкай рэакцыі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BCF3.english: Not a muscle moves in her face, but her eyes trace yours, stern and perceptive.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BCF3.polish: Mięśnie jej twarzy ani drgną, ale jej oczy – surowe i spostrzegawcze – śledzą każdy ruch twojej.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BCF3.belarusian: Ніводны мускул не варухнуўся на яе твары, але яе вочы сочаць за тваімі — суровыя і праніклівыя.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BD0C.english: "You are looking for Titus Hardie, who you think has information on a murder the RCM is investigating. You want to interview him." She points to the man standing in the middle of the room.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BD0C.polish: „Szukasz Titusa Hardiego, bo myślisz, że ma informacje dotyczące morderstwa, które bada MOR. Chcesz przesłuchać jego” – wskazuje mężczyznę stojącego pośrodku pomieszczenia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BD0C.belarusian: "Ты шукаеш Цітуса Хардзі, бо думаеш, што ён мае інфармацыю пра забойства, якое расследуе РГМ. Ты хочаш яго дапытаць", — яна паказвае на мужчыну, які стаіць пасярод пакоя.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BD14.english: "That's Titus. Talk to him. But know this: I'll be keeping an eye on you. No strong-arming, nothing official. The district of Martinaise does not recognize your authority to make arrests."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BD14.polish: „To Titus. Porozmawiaj z nim. Ale wiedz jedno: będę cię miała na oku. Żadnych siłowych działań ani oficjalnych posunięć. Dzielnica Martinaise nie uznaje waszego prawa do aresztowania jej mieszkańców”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BD14.belarusian: "Гэта Цітус. Пагавары з ім. Але май на ўвазе: я буду сачыць за табой. Ніякага ціску, нічога афіцыйнага. Раён Марцінэз не прызнае вашага права арыштоўваць людзей".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BD1C.english: "Be straight with me, what kind of music *do* you listen to?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BD1C.belarusian: "Скажы наўпрост: якую музыку ты *ўсё ж* слухаеш?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BD2F.english: "What if I want to talk to *you*, not Titus?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BD2F.polish: „A co jak chcę porozmawiać z *tobą*, nie z Titusem?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BD2F.belarusian: "А што, калі я хачу пагаварыць з *табой*, а не з Цітусам?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BD36.english: "What are you going to *do* to me?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDAB.english: "What are we going to *do* to you?" She starts laughing. It's a cold laughter, devoid of joy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDAB.polish: „Co ci *zrobimy*?” – pyta i zaczyna się śmiać. Jej śmiech jest zimny, pozbawiony radości.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDAB.belarusian: "Што мы табе *зробім*? — яна пачынае смяяцца. Гэта халодны смех, пазбаўлены радасці".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDB1.english: "Hmh..." The lieutenant is not satisfied with the approach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDB1.polish: „Hmm” – porucznik nie jest zadowolony z tego podejścia.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDB9.english: *Why* did you say that? Did you forget you're a cop... again?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDB9.polish: *Czemu* to powiedziałeś? Zapomniałeś, że jesteś gliną? Znowu?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDB9.belarusian: *Чаму* ты гэта сказаў? Ты забыўся, што ты коп... зноў?

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDC0.english: "The Union isn't going to *do* anything to you. It is not a crime syndicate, it is a labour organization."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDC0.polish: „Związek nic ci nie *zrobi*. Nie jest przestępczym syndykatem – to organizacja robotnicza”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDC0.belarusian: "Прафсаюз табе нічога не *зробіць*. Гэта не злачынны сіндыкат, гэта працоўная арганізацыя".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDCC.english: "I suggest not wasting time on trivial pleasantries and focusing on why you are actually here -- Titus Hardie," she points to the tall man by the table.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDCC.polish: „Proponuję nie marnować czasu na trywialne uprzejmości i skupić się raczej na powodzie tej wizyty – na Titusie Hardiem” – wskazuje wysokiego mężczyznę stojącego przy stole.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDCC.belarusian: "Прапаную не марнаваць час на банальныя ветлівасці і сканцэнтравацца на тым, дзеля чаго ты насамрэч тут, — Цітусе Хардзі, — яна паказвае на высокага мужчыну каля стала".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDD3.english: Even though she has excellent control over her self, something moved behind her eyes, in the way she stands, in her face...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDD3.polish: Choć doskonale panuje nad sobą, coś zmieniło się w jej spojrzeniu, w tym, jak stoi, jaką ma minę...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDD3.belarusian: Хоць яна выдатна валодае сабой, нешта мільганула ў яе вачах, у паставе, на твары...

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDDF.english: You caught her off guard. Push her some more.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDDF.polish: Wziąłeś ją z zaskoczenia. Dociśnij mocniej.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDDF.belarusian: Ты заспеў яе знянацку. Цісні далей.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDF6.english: "What you want is of no significance, *officer*. Don't test your authority -- in Martinaise you are no one."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDF6.polish: „To, czego chcesz, nie ma znaczenia, *funkcjonariuszu*. Nie poddawaj próbie swojej władzy – w Martinaise jesteś nikim”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BDF6.belarusian: "Твае жаданні не маюць ніякага значэння, *афіцэру*. Не выпрабоўвай свой аўтарытэт — у Марцінэзе ты ніхто".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE09.english: She looks as if pondering whether to answer or not... but then shakes her head slightly.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE09.polish: Przygląda ci się, jakby zastanawiała się, czy odpowiedzieć na to pytanie... a po chwili kręci nieznacznie głową.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE09.belarusian: Яна глядзіць так, нібы раздумвае, адказваць ці не... але потым злёгку хітае галавой.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE1D.english: "Dance music -- basically disco? I know all about it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE1D.polish: „Muzyka taneczna. Czyli w zasadzie disco? O nim wiem wszystko”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE1D.belarusian: "Танцавальная музыка — фактычна дыска? Я пра яго ўсё ведаю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE24.english: "You're right. I don't know anything about anything. What is anodic music?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE24.polish: „Racja. Nie wiem zupełnie nic. Czym jest muzyka anodic?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE24.belarusian: "Твая праўда. Я нічагусенькі не ведаю. Што такое анодная музыка?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE2B.english: "Okay, let's put on a new record." (Conclude.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE7D.english: "No," she steadies her breathing. "Not disco. Disco is *undead*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE7D.polish: „Nie” – odpowiada, wyrównując oddech. „To nie disco. Disco to *żywy trup*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE7D.belarusian: "Не, — яна супакойвае дыханне. — Не дыска. Дыска — *нежыць*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE98.english: "Look, we're not discussing your taste in music anymore, officer. Do you have questions for my clients or not?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE98.polish: „Nie będziemy dłużej dyskutować na temat twojego muzycznego gustu, funkcjonariuszu. Masz jakieś pytania do mojego klienta czy nie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BE98.belarusian: "Слухай, мы больш не абмяркоўваем твой музычны густ, афіцэру. У цябе ёсць пытанні да маіх кліентаў ці не?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC4D.english: "I guess it's fair to say you guys have it on life support."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC4D.polish: „Chyba można powiedzieć, że trzymacie ją pod respiratorem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BC4D.belarusian: "Хіба што справядліва сказаць, што вы, хлопцы, трымаеце яго на апараце жыццезабеспячэння".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BEA5.belarusian: "Што ты маеш на ўвазе пад *вы, хлопцы*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BEB8.english: "A lot of people out there appreciate a good disco breakdown."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BEB8.polish: „Wielu ludzi ceni sobie dobrą bibę z disco”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BECE.english: "I will." It doesn't look like you changed her mind.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BECE.polish: „Taki mam zamiar” – raczej nie udało ci się zmienić jej zdania.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BECE.belarusian: "І застануся". Не падобна, што табе ўдалося пераканаць яе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BF43.english: "Aggressive? You make your living enforcing violence. These people are just *dock workers*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BF43.polish: „Jestem agresywna? To ty zarabiasz na życie, stojąc na straży przemocy. Ci ludzie są zwykłymi *robotnikami portowymi*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BF43.belarusian: "Агрэсіўная? Ты зарабляеш на жыццё, чынячы гвалт. А гэтыя людзі — проста *рабочыя порта*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BF56.english: "Get sober." Her expression stiffens. "Do your *job*. Ask your questions and get the hell out of Martinaise."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BF56.polish: „Wytrzeźwiej” – jej twarz tężeje. „Rób *swoje*. Zadaj pytania i wynoś się z Martinaise”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BF56.belarusian: "Пратверазей, — яе твар застывае. — Рабі сваю *працу*. Задавай свае пытанні і вымятайся к чорту з Марцінэза".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BF5D.english: "Listen, you Moralintern lackeys. You're a mob, enforcing the unlawful privatization of Revachol. Twenty fat men in the Occident are stealing it all -- and you're their body guards."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BF5D.polish: „Słuchajcie, sługusy Moralinternu. Jesteście mafią wymuszającą bezprawną prywatyzację Revacholu. Dwudziestu spasionych facetów z Okcydentu kradnie to wszystko – a wy jesteście ich ochroniarzami”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BF5D.belarusian: "Слухайце, вы, прыслужнікі Маралінтэрна. Вы банда, якая забяспечвае незаконную прыватызацыю Рэвашоля. Дваццаць тоўстых дзядзькоў у Акцыдэнце крадуць усё падчыстую — а вы іх целаахоўнікі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BF64.english: "I don't need privatization paeans from a rent-a-cop." Her expression stiffens. "Just do your *job*. Ask your questions. Then get out of Martinaise."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BF64.polish: „Nie potrzebuję peanów na cześć prywatyzacji wygłaszanych przez glinę do wynajęcia” – jej twarz tężeje. „Po prostu rób *swoje*. Zadaj pytania i wynoś się z Martinaise”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000BF64.belarusian: "Мне не патрэбныя дыфірамбы прыватызацыі ад наёмнага легавага, — яе твар застывае. — Проста рабі сваю *працу*. Задавай свае пытанні. І вымятайся з Марцінэза".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D81F.english: You will never be able to experience it the way she does. She's even a bit sad about it; then the feeling passes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D81F.polish: Nigdy nie doświadczysz tej muzyki tak jak ona. Jest jej wręcz trochę smutno z tego powodu. Po chwili to uczucie przemija.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D81F.belarusian: Ты ніколі не зможаш адчуць яе так, як адчувае яна. Ёй нават трохі сумна з-за гэтага; потым гэтае пачуццё знікае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D826.english: She means it's part of the future you won't experience.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D826.polish: Ma na myśli, że to element przyszłości, której ty nie doświadczysz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D826.belarusian: Яна мае на ўвазе, што гэта частка будучыні, якую ты не зведаеш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D83B.english: What if I want to, it's in my mind for some reason...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D83B.polish: A jeśli chcę? Z jakiegoś powodu mam ją w umyśle...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D83B.belarusian: А што, калі я хачу, яно чамусьці круціцца ў мяне ў галаве...

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D841.english: Yeah, I don't care about that.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D841.polish: Ta, nic mnie to nie obchodzi.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D849.english: There is nothing a determined man could not achieve.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D849.polish: Nie ma nic, czego nie osiągnąłby zdeterminowany człowiek.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D849.belarusian: Няма нічога такога, чаго не мог бы дасягнуць рашучы чалавек.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D850.english: Sure, why be interested in the world around us. Get back to boring, brutal detective work.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D850.polish: Jasne, po co interesować się światem wokół nas. Wracaj do brutalnej i nudziarskiej detektywistycznej roboty.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D850.belarusian: Вядома, навошта цікавіцца навакольным светам. Вяртайся да нуднай, грубай дэтэктыўнай працы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BBF5.english: "You're far from home, *officer*... This isn't a district known for its love of self-proclaimed militiamen."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BBF5.polish: „Jesteś daleko od domu, *funkcjonariuszu*... To nie jest dzielnica znana z miłości do samozwańczych stróżów prawa”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BBF5.belarusian: "Ты далёка ад дому, *афіцэру*... Гэты раён не славіцца любоўю да самаабвешчаных апалчэнцаў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BC47.english: "You're far from home, *lieutenants*... This isn't a district known for its love of self-proclaimed militiamen."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BC47.polish: „Jesteście daleko od domu, *porucznicy*... To nie jest dzielnica znana z miłości do samozwańczych stróżów prawa”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BC47.belarusian: "Вы далёка ад дому, *лейтэнанты*... Гэты раён не славіцца любоўю да самаабвешчаных апалчэнцаў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BC4D.english: "You seem a little different today. Less hospitable."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BC4D.polish: „Wydajesz się dzisiaj jakaś inna. Mniej gościnna”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BC4D.belarusian: "Сёння вы выглядаеце трохі інакш. Менш гасціннай".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BC53.english: "You're far from home, *officer*... This isn't a district known for its love of self-proclaimed militiamen."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BC53.polish: „Jesteś daleko od domu, *funkcjonariuszu*... To nie jest dzielnica znana z miłości do samozwańczych stróżów prawa”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BC53.belarusian: "Ты далёка ад дому, *афіцэру*... Гэты раён не славіцца любоўю да самаабвешчаных апалчэнцаў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BC70.english: She's right, you're basically an epidermochromatic police officer.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BC70.polish: Ma rację, jesteś w gruncie rzeczy tylko epidermochromatycznym funkcjonariuszem policji.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BC70.belarusian: Яна мае рацыю, па сутнасці ты эпідэрмахраматычны афіцэр паліцыі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BCCF.english: "You lied to me! You're *not* a gardener!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BCDD.english: "I mean no trouble, just here to do my job, that's all."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BCDD.polish: „Nie szukam kłopotów. Jestem tu tylko, żeby wykonywać swoją pracę i tyle”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BCDD.belarusian: "Я не хачу непрыемнасцей, проста раблю сваю працу, вось і ўсё".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BCE6.english: "I was just making an observation. I was reacting to stimuli."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BCE6.polish: „To było tylko spostrzeżenie. Reakcja na bodziec”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BCE6.belarusian: "Я проста назіраў. Я рэагаваў на раздражняльнікі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BCEB.english: "I just wanted to know what kind of music you listen to. I was just curious!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BCEB.polish: „Chciałem się tylko dowiedzieć, jakiej słuchasz muzyki. Byłem ciekawy i tyle!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BCEB.belarusian: "Я проста хацеў даведацца, якую музыку ты слухаеш. Мне проста было цікава!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BCF0.english: "I just wanted to know more about the place before I check it out. That's normal."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BCF0.polish: „Chciałem tylko dowiedzieć się więcej o okolicy, zanim się rozejrzę. To normalne”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BCF0.belarusian: "Я проста хацеў даведацца больш пра гэтае месца, перш чым яго агледзець. Гэта нармальна".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BD07.english: "That's right, this is an epidermochromatic police officer. Deal with it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BD07.polish: „Zgadza się, jestem epidermochromatycznym funkcjonariuszem policji. Pogódź się z tym”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BD07.belarusian: "Вось менавіта, перад табой эпідэрмахраматычны афіцэр паліцыі. Змірыся з гэтым".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BD47.english: "So let's get to it -- you're looking for Titus Hardie. You think he has information that will help you. Maybe he does." She points to the man on her right.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BD47.polish: „Przejdźmy więc do rzeczy – szukasz Titusa Hardiego. Myślisz, że ma informacje, które mogą ci pomóc. Być może ma” – stwierdza, wskazując mężczyznę po swojej prawej.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BD47.belarusian: "Таму давай да справы: ты шукаеш Цітуса Хардзі. Ты лічыш, што ў яго ёсць інфармацыя, якая табе дапаможа. Можа, і ёсць", — яна паказвае на мужчыну справа ад сябе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BDF3.english: "It doesn't matter if you recognize our authority. We will make an arrest if we have to."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BDF3.polish: „Nie ma znaczenia, czy uznajecie nasze zwierzchnictwo. Jeśli zajdzie potrzeba, dokonamy aresztowania”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BDF3.belarusian: "Не мае значэння, ці прызнаеце вы нашы паўнамоцтвы. Калі спатрэбіцца, мы правядзем арышт".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE02.english: "No, I'm not a gardener, I'm a legal counsellor for the Dockworkers' Union." She crosses her arms.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE02.polish: „Nie, nie jestem ogrodniczką. Jestem radczynią prawną Związku Robotników Portowych” – odpowiada, krzyżując ręce na piersiach.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE02.belarusian: "Не, я не садоўніца, я юрыдычны кансультант Прафсаюза Партовых Рабочых", — яна складвае рукі на грудзях.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE08.english: "That's right, I'm not a gardener, I'm a legal counsellor for the Dockworkers' Union." She crosses her arms.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE08.polish: „Zgadza się, nie jestem ogrodniczką. Jestem radczynią prawną Związku Robotników Portowych” – odpowiada, krzyżując ręce na piersiach.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE08.belarusian: "Менавіта так, я не садоўніца, я юрыдычны кансультант Прафсаюза Партовых Рабочых", — яна складвае рукі на грудзях.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE0E.english: "Sure, reacting to stimuli... I'm not a gardener, by the way, I'm a legal counsellor for the Dockworkers' Union." She crosses her arms.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE0E.polish: „Jasne, reagowanie na bodźce... A przy okazji – nie jestem ogrodniczką. Jestem radczynią prawną Związku Robotników Portowych” – odpowiada, krzyżując ręce na piersiach.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE0E.belarusian: "Вядома, рэагаваў на раздражняльнікі... Я не садоўніца, дарэчы, я юрыдычны кансультант Прафсаюза Партовых Рабочых", — яна складвае рукі на грудзях.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE14.english: "Sure, you were *curious*... I'm not a gardener, by the way, I'm a legal counsellor for the Dockworkers' Union." She crosses her arms.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE14.polish: „Jasne, byłeś *ciekawy*... A przy okazji – nie jestem ogrodniczką. Jestem radczynią prawną Związku Robotników Portowych” – odpowiada, krzyżując ręce na piersiach.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE14.belarusian: "Вядома, табе было *цікава*... Я не садоўніца, дарэчы, я юрыдычны кансультант Прафсаюза Партовых Рабочых", — яна складвае рукі на грудзях.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE1A.english: "Of course, you were just doing your *job*... I'm not a gardener, by the way, I'm a legal counsellor for the Dockworkers' Union." She crosses her arms.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE1A.polish: „Oczywiście, wykonywałeś tylko swoje *obowiązki*... A przy okazji – nie jestem ogrodniczką. Jestem radczynią prawną Związku Robotników Portowych” – odpowiada, krzyżując ręce na piersiach.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE1A.belarusian: "Вядома, ты проста рабіў сваю *працу*... Я не садоўніца, дарэчы, я юрыдычны кансультант Прафсаюза Партовых Рабочых", — яна складвае рукі на грудзях.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE20.english: "Yes, extremely normal... I'm not a gardener, by the way, I'm a legal counsellor for the Dockworkers' Union." She crosses her arms.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE20.polish: „Tak, to *ekstremalnie* normalne... A przy okazji – nie jestem ogrodniczką. Jestem radczynią prawną Związku Robotników Portowych” – odpowiada, krzyżując ręce na piersiach.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE20.belarusian: "Так, надзвычай нармальна... Я не садоўніца, дарэчы, я юрыдычны кансультант Прафсаюза Партовых Рабочых", — яна складвае рукі на грудзях.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE2C.english: "Of course, and I'm just an epidermochromatic counsellor for the Dockworkers' Union," she says without blinking an eye.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE2C.polish: „Oczywiście, a ja jestem po prostu epidermochromatyczną radczynią prawną Związku Robotników Portowych” – odpowiada bez mrugnięcia okiem.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE2C.belarusian: "Вядома, а я проста эпідэрмахраматычны кансультант Прафсаюза Партовых Рабочых", — кажа яна і вокам не маргнуўшы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE4A.english: "Obviously I'm a lawyer. A legal counsellor for the Dockworkers' Union." She crosses her arms. "I would urge you to consider what you say to my clients."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE4A.polish: „Oczywiście jestem prawniczką. Radczynią prawną Związku Robotników Portowych” – odpowiada, krzyżując ręce na piersiach. „Radzę uważać na to, co mówisz do moich klientów”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE4A.belarusian: "Відавочна, я юрыстка. Юрыдычны кансультант Прафсаюза Партовых Рабочых, — яна складвае рукі на грудзях. — Я настойліва раю табе думаць, што ты кажаш маім кліентам".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE50.english: "Like I already told you, I'm a legal counsellor." She crosses her arms. "Do you have hearing problems?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE50.polish: „Jak już mówiłam, jestem radczynią prawną” – odpowiada, krzyżując ręce na piersiach. „Masz problemy ze słuchem?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE50.belarusian: "Як я табе ўжо казала, я юрыдычны кансультант, — яна складвае рукі на грудзях. — У цябе праблемы са слыхам?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE6B.english: "That's right, I'm not a gardener, I'm a legal counsellor for the Dockworkers' Union." It feels like she's waiting for a reaction of some sort.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE6B.polish: „Zgadza się, nie jestem ogrodniczką. Jestem radczynią prawną Związku Robotników Portowych” – masz wrażenie, że czeka na jakąś reakcję.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE6B.belarusian: "Менавіта так, я не садоўніца, я юрыдычны кансультант Прафсаюза Партовых Рабочых". Здаецца, яна чакае нейкай рэакцыі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE79.english: She says nothing; her glare speaks for her.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE79.polish: Milczy, ale jej spojrzenie mówi samo za siebie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE79.belarusian: Яна маўчыць; яе скіраваны позірк гаворыць сам за сябе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE8B.english: "I've got nothing to say to you. Why are you wasting your time?" She crosses her arms.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE8B.polish: „Nie mam ci nic do powiedzenia. Dlaczego marnujesz swój czas?” – pyta, krzyżując ręce na piersiach.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BE8B.belarusian: "Мне няма чаго табе сказаць. Чаму ты марнуеш свой час?" — яна складвае рукі на грудзях.

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000002E.english: I saw what you were thinking. You want to say 'what are you going to *do* to me?'. Don't. Just because it's in your head doesn't mean you have to say it.
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000002E.polish: Wiem, co myślisz. Chcesz spytać „I co mi niby *zrobicie*?”. Nie pytaj. To, że masz coś w głowie, nie znaczy, że powinieneś to mówić.
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000002E.belarusian: Я бачыў, пра што ты падумаў. Хочаш спытаць: 'І што вы мне *зробіце*?'. Не трэба. Тое, што гэта круціцца ў цябе ў галаве, не значыць, што гэта трэба агучваць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900000048.english: "Anodic dance music, you wouldn't get it."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008900000050.english: "Hold on, of course I *get it*. It's a progressive soundscape, mixing nomadic rhythms with pop melodies."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900000050.polish: „Chwila, oczywiście, że *rozumiem*. To progresywny krajobraz dźwiękowy. Łączy nomadyczne rytmy z melodiami stylu pop”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008900000050.belarusian: "Пачакай, вядома, я *разумею*. Гэта прагрэсіўны гукавы пейзаж, што спалучае качавыя рытмы з поп-мелодыямі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000005B.english: "Okay, you have a dictionary. That doesn't mean you get it..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000005B.polish: „Dobra, masz słownik. Ale to nie znaczy, że rozumiesz...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000005B.belarusian: "Добра, слоўнік у цябе ёсць. Але гэта не значыць, што ты разумееш..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009EEC.english: Could this be the *Miss Beaufort* that Easy Leo mentioned? The one Mr. Evrart sent to law school?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009EEC.polish: Czy to może być ta *panna Beaufort*, o której wspominał Luźny Leo? Ta, którą pan Evrart wysłał na studia prawnicze?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009EEC.belarusian: Ці можа гэта быць тая самая *спадарыня Бафор*, пра якую казаў Бестурботны Лео? Тая, якую спадар Эўрар адправіў вучыцца на юрыста?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F11.english: "Easy Leo told me about you, he likes to talk a lot."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F11.polish: „Mówił mi o tobie Luźny Leo. Lubi dużo gadać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F11.belarusian: "Бестурботны Лео распавёў мне пра цябе, ён любіць пабалбатаць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F18.english: "Hardie? Not yet, I had another question."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F18.polish: „Hardie? Nie, jeszcze nie. Mam inne pytanie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F18.belarusian: "Хардзі? Яшчэ не, у мяне было іншае пытанне".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F2B.english: "You're not here to chat up the legal counsel, you're here to question these men."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F2B.polish: „Nie jesteś tu po poradę prawną. Chodzi ci o przesłuchanie tych ludzi”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F2B.belarusian: "Ты тут не для таго, каб фліртаваць з юрыдычным кансультантам, ты тут, каб дапытаць гэтых мужчын".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F3F.english: You set the pace and the topic of these conversations here. Establish that.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F3F.polish: Ty decydujesz o tempie i temacie waszych rozmów. Daj jej to do zrozumienia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F3F.belarusian: Тут ты задаеш тэмп і тэму гэтых размоў. Пакажы гэта.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F4A.english: "He said Mr. Evrart sent you to law school?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F4A.polish: „Mówił, że pan Evrart wysłał cię na studia prawnicze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F4A.belarusian: "Ён казаў, што спадар Эўрар адправіў цябе вучыцца на юрыста?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F52.english: "He said you were in debt to Mr. Claire."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F52.polish: „Mówił, że masz dług u pana Claire'a”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F52.belarusian: "Ён казаў, што ты завінавацілася спадару Клэру".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F59.english: "He said you're the Union fixer. You fix things."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F59.polish: „Mówił, że jesteś w Związku od brudnej roboty. Naprawiasz, co zepsute”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F59.belarusian: "Ён казаў, што ты вырашала Прафсаюза. Вырашаеш праблемы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F60.english: A man like Easy Leo could have said anything. Do not be restrained, sire.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F60.polish: Ktoś taki jak Luźny Leo mógł powiedzieć cokolwiek. Nie ograniczaj się, szanowny panie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F60.belarusian: Такі чалавек, як Бестурботны Лео, мог сказаць што заўгодна. Не стрымлівай сябе, мілордзе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F6D.english: "He said you're Mr. Evrart's *Doux et Sucré* Death Machine."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F6D.polish: „Mówił, że jesteś *Doux et Sucré* maszyną śmierci pana Evrarta”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F6D.belarusian: "Ён казаў, што ты 'Doux et Sucré' Машына Смерці спадара Эўрара".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F74.english: "He said no such thing." She accidentally raises her voice. "This isn't about me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F74.polish: „Niczego takiego nie powiedział” – odpowiada, przypadkowo unosząc głos. „Nie chodzi o mnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F74.belarusian: "Нічога такога ён не казаў! — яна міжволі павышае голас. — Размова не пра мяне".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F7C.english: "I represent the Union and these men here." She points to the crew around the table. "Don't make this personal."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F7C.polish: „Reprezentuję Związek i tych ludzi” – wskazuje grupę wokół stołu. „Nie róbmy z tego sprawy osobistej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F7C.belarusian: "Я прадстаўляю Прафсаюз і гэтых людзей, — яна паказвае на кампанію за сталом. — Не пераходзь на асобы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F88.english: "I am a *legal counsel*," she intones. "Don't make this personal."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F88.polish: „Jestem *radczynią prawną*” – oznajmia. „Nie róbmy z tego sprawy osobistej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009F88.belarusian: "Я *юрыдычны кансультант*, — чаканіць яна. — Не пераходзь на асобы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009FBF.english: You will not lose out on anything good by not saying it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009FBF.polish: Niczego nie stracisz, nie mówiąc tego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009FBF.belarusian: Калі ты гэтага не скажаш, нічога добрага не страціш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009FE1.english: Not only do you *get it* -- you know it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009FE1.polish: Nie dość, że *rozumiesz*, to jeszcze ją znasz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009FE1.belarusian: Ты не проста *разумееш* — ты яе ведаеш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009FFB.english: Hjelmdallermen is a reference to the *Northern* themed action-adventure series, Man From... Actually, this is less than helpful right now. I'll just get out of the way.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009FFB.polish: „Hjelmdallermanni” to odniesienie do serii książek przygodowych w *nordyckim* klimacie, Człowiek z... W sumie to to nie jest zbyt pomocne. Nie będę już przeszkadzać.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200009FFB.belarusian: "Хэймдальцы" — гэта адсылка да прыгодніцкай серыі ў *паўночным* стылі "Чалавек з..." Насамрэч, гэта зараз зусім не дапаможа. Я лепш пайду з дарогі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A01E.english: "No." It doesn't look like she's into popular adventure-fantasy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A01E.polish: „Nie” – nie wygląda na kogoś, kogo pociąga popularna fantastyka przygodowa.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A01E.belarusian: "Не". Не падобна, што яна захапляецца папулярным прыгодніцкім фэнтэзі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A04B.english: You were specifically asked *not* to say that -- and then you said it anyway. You junior delinquent! But you *still* did!
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A04B.polish: Poproszono cię właśnie o to, żebyś tego *nie* mówił, a ty i tak to powiedziałeś. Ty niesforny wyrostku! Powiedziałeś to!
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A04B.belarusian: Цябе ж спецыяльна папрасілі гэтага *не* казаць — і ты ўсё адно сказаў. Ах ты малалетні хуліган! Але ты *ўсё роўна* гэта зрабіў!

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A054.english: "Mhm..." A gruff humph from the table. "Goddamn right it is."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A054.polish: „Mhm...” – dobiega chrapliwe potwierdzenie od strony stołu. „Właśnie tak, cholera”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A054.belarusian: "Гм... — грубы хмык з-за стала. — Чортава праўда".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A05D.english: "If anything, it is the RCM who *do* things to people..." She shakes her head. "But we digress."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A05D.polish: „Jeśli już, to właśnie MOR *robi* coś tym ludziom...” – kręci głową. „Ale odbiegliśmy od tematu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A05D.belarusian: "Калі ўжо на тое пайшло, дык гэта РГМ *робіць* усякае з людзьмі... — яна хітае галавой. — Але мы адышлі ад тэмы".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A06D.english: "Do dock workers spy on the Police? You were on that corner all day. Now we know why." He smiles: "Just dock workers..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A06D.polish: „Czy robotnicy portowi szpiegują policję? Byłaś na tym rogu przez cały dzień. Teraz wiemy dlaczego” – uśmiecha się. „Zwykli robotnicy portowi...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A06D.belarusian: "Хіба рабочыя порта шпіёняць за Паліцыяй? Вы прастаялі на тым рагу ўвесь дзень. Цяпер мы ведаем чаму. — Ён усміхаецца: — Проста рабочыя порта..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A07D.english: "Hmh. So you were spying on us. And now you represent murder suspects -- *just dock workers*."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A07D.polish: „Hmm. Więc szpiegowałaś nas. A teraz reprezentujesz podejrzanych o morderstwo – *zwykłych robotników portowych*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A07D.belarusian: "Гм. Значыць, вы шпіёнілі за намі. А цяпер прадстаўляеце падазраваных у забойстве — *проста рабочых порта*".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A085.english: "I guess you're not a winner after all."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A085.belarusian: "Здаецца, ты ўсё ж такі не пераможца па жыцці".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A095.english: "No one is emotional here." Her expression stiffens further. "Do your *job*. Ask your questions -- then leave."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A095.polish: „Nikt tu nie jest emocjonalny” – wyraz jej twarzy staje się jeszcze bardziej surowy. „Rób *swoje*. Zadaj pytania i odejdź”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A095.belarusian: "Ніхто тут не паддаецца эмоцыям, — яе твар застывае яшчэ мацней. — Рабі сваю *працу*. Задавай пытанні — і сыходзь".
