Dialogue Text/0x0100007800010A31.polish: „Co, kurwa, ma z tym wszystkim wspólnego kuchnia?” – mężczyzna z tatuażami nie bardzo rozumie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800010A31.belarusian: "Якім бокам тут нахуй кухня?" — татуяваны мужчына не разумее.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800010A37.english: "While you're in there -- make fatty a snack." He grins. "Can't you hear how his stomach is growling?!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800010A37.polish: „Jak już tam będziecie, to przygotujcie grubasowi jakąś przekąskę” – mówi, szczerząc zęby. „Słyszycie, jak mu burczy w brzuchu?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800010A37.belarusian: "Пакуль вы там — згатуйце таўстуну перакусіць", — ён выскаляецца. — "Не чуеце, як у яго бурчыць у жываце?!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000800001320.english: You can and it's pretty terrifying.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016F38.english: Nothing. Even though you *know* you should see it -- you don't. Just branches like black tangles of hair. Motionless. The wind in the yard doesn't reach the hawthorn. Maybe come back later and you can try again?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016F38.polish: Nic. Choć *wiesz*, że powinieneś coś zobaczyć, to nie widzisz. Nie licząc przypominających splątane włosy, nieruchomych gałęzi. Wiatr na podwórzu nie dociera do głogu. Może spróbuj jeszcze raz nieco później?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016F38.belarusian: Нічога. Хоць ты і *ведаеш*, што павінен нешта пабачыць, — нічога не бачыш. Толькі галіны, падобныя да зблытаных чорных валасоў. Нерухомыя. Вецер на дварэ не даходзіць да глогу. Можа, вярнуцца пазней і паспрабаваць зноў?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016F41.english: It wasn't time yet. You have to know of the girl... Return when you know more.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016F41.polish: To jeszcze nie ten czas. Musisz wiedzieć o dziewczynie... Wróć, jak dowiesz się więcej.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016F41.belarusian: Яшчэ не час. Ты павінен ведаць пра дзяўчыну... Вярніся, калі даведаешся больш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000C102.english: "I just let him have it. Left, right, lights out."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000C102.polish: „Nie żałowałem mu. Lewy, prawy i gleba”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000C102.belarusian: "Я яму як урэзаў. Левы, правы — і тушы святло."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000C110.english: "Some tits you just have to see to believe."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000C110.polish: „Niektóre cycki trzeba zobaczyć, żeby w nie uwierzyć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000C110.belarusian: "Некаторыя цыцкі трэба на свае вочы пабачыць, каб паверыць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000C14A.english: "Fuck no, beer makes me a *better* driver."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000C14A.polish: „A gdzie tam! Piwo sprawia, że jestem *lepszym* kierowcą”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000C14A.belarusian: "Ды ні хуя, ад піва я толькі *лепшы* кіроўца."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019D42.english: "You need to see that choke-hold again?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019D42.polish: „Pokazać ci ten chwyt duszący jeszcze raz?”

Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030BB.english: "All *we* need to do right now is get our brewskie on."
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030BB.polish: „Jedyne, co teraz *musimy*, to dostać nasze browary”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030BB.belarusian: "Адзінае, што *нам* зараз трэба — гэта выпіць па півку."

Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030C7.english: "I'm gonna miss those guys. Theo too."
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030C7.polish: „Będzie mi brakowało tych chłopaków. Thea też”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030C7.belarusian: "Мне будзе не хапаць гэтых хлопцаў. Тэа таксама."

Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030D3.english: "Though boys... I knew Glen's a beast, but even Angie..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030D3.polish: „Twarde chłopaki... Wiedziałem, że Glen to bestia, ale nawet Angie...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030D3.belarusian: "Крутыя хлопцы... Я ведаў, што Глен — звер, але нават Ангі..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019D50.english: "Hey, don't be going soft on me."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019D5C.english: "Tell it like it's told, man. Tell it straight."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019D5C.polish: „Nie owijaj w bawełnę, stary. Mów wprost”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019D6E.english: "No way I'm going back to Jamrock."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019D6E.polish: „Mowy nie ma, żebym wrócił do Jamrock”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019D6E.belarusian: "Ні за што не вярнуся ў Джэмрок".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019D74.english: "I did what?! Can't remember shit, I was wasted."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019D74.polish: „Że co zrobiłem? Ni cholery nic nie pamiętam, byłem porobiony”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019D74.belarusian: "Што я зрабіў?! Ні хера не памятаю, у гаўно быў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003050.english: "We could take over the entire city."

Dialogue Text/0x010000400000305C.english: "Theo went like he lived -- fast and hard. Tough old man."
Dialogue Text/0x010000400000305C.polish: „Theo zginął tak, jak żył. Szybko i z jebnięciem. Stary twardziel”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000400000305C.belarusian: "Тэа пайшоў так, як і жыў — хутка і жорстка. Моцны стары".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003062.english: "*This* is gonna make a hell of a sad tattoo..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003068.english: "... no worse than the bangers on Boogie Street."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003068.polish: „...nie gorsi od gangusów z Boogie Street”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003079.english: "Survivor guilt my ass, *I* wanted to go that way!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003079.polish: „Gówno, a nie poczucie winy ocalałego. To *ja* chciałem iść w tamtą stronę!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003079.belarusian: "У дупу пачуццё віны ацалелага, гэта *я* хацеў так пайсці!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003085.english: "I'm the lucky fuck, who didn't take a scratch." (Sighs.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003085.polish: „Jestem fartowny skurwiel, którego nawet nie tknęli” – mówi, wzdychając.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003085.belarusian: "Я той фартовы хуй, на якім ні драпіны". (Уздыхае.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000400000308B.english: "Ain't no one gonna be riding any ballads about me..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000400000308B.polish: „O mnie nikt ballad wyśpiewywał nie będzie...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000400000308B.belarusian: "Ніхто не будзе скакаць ніякіх балад пра мяне..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003091.english: "For Titus... for Glenny... for... for Titus!!!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003091.polish: „Za Titusa... za Glenny'ego... Za... za Titusa!!!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003091.belarusian: "За Цітуса... за Глені... за... за Цітуса!!!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000400000309D.english: "Shanky's gonna get a lesson in Boogie Street justice."
Dialogue Text/0x010000400000309D.polish: „Kosior dostanie lekcję sprawiedliwości rodem z Boogie Street”.

Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030A3.english: "When it's done I'll just blow my brains out... Fuck everything."
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030A3.polish: „Jak to się skończy, to se po prostu odstrzelę łeb... Jebać to wszystko”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030A3.belarusian: "Калі ўсё скончыцца, я проста вынесу сабе мазгі... Пайшло яно ўсё да хера".

Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030A9.english: "Boogie street justice. Gonna make you proud, T."
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030A9.polish: „Sprawiedliwość rodem z Boogie Street. Będziesz ze mnie dumny, T”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000040000030A9.belarusian: "Правасуддзе Бугі-стрыт. Ты будзеш ганарыцца мной, Т".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019D88.belarusian: "Ды ладна вам, хлопцы, вы ж мяне ведаеце."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019D8E.english: "Two in the chest and down he goes."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019D8E.belarusian: "Дзве кулі ў грудзі — і ён ляжыць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019DAC.belarusian: "У мяне ёсць яйкі. Вось і ўсё."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019DC6.polish: „A Monika to nie miała wielkich cycorów?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019DC6.belarusian: "Хіба ў Монікі не было гіганцкіх цыцак?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019DCC.english: "I don't do karaoke, man. I'm too good."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019DCC.polish: „Nie śpiewam karaoke, stary. Za dobry na to jestem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019DCC.belarusian: "Я не спяваю ў караоке, чувак. Я занадта добры для гэтага."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019DD8.belarusian: "Ага, і што з гэтым не так?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003025.english: "Goddamn Shanky... never liked that rat-faced fuck."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003025.polish: „Cholerny Kosior. Nigdy nie lubiłem tego skurwysyńskiego szczura”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003025.belarusian: "Кляты Вострык... ніколі не любіў гэтага пацукатварага ўблюдка."

Dialogue Text/0x010000400000302B.english: "One day I'll write a song about it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000400000302B.polish: „Przyjdzie dzień, że napiszę o tym piosenkę”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003031.english: "Strange... I even miss Angie's loud stomach..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003031.polish: „Dziwne... Tęsknię nawet za hałaśliwym brzuchem Angiego...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003031.belarusian: "Дзіўна... Я нават сумую па гучным жываце Ангі..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003037.english: "Think Mañana could make a good Hardie boy?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003037.polish: „Myślisz, że z Mañany byłby dobry chłopak Hardiego?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003037.belarusian: "Думаеш, з Mañana атрымаўся б добры хлопец Хардзі?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000400000303D.english: "Shit like that really makes you think."
Dialogue Text/0x010000400000303D.polish: „Takie gówno naprawdę zmusza człowieka do myślenia”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A668.english: "*This* is what I studied law for?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A66E.english: "Titus, you were told to keep a low profile."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A674.english: "Can't wait to change out of these rags."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A674.polish: „Nie mogę się doczekać, żeby zrzucić te łachy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A674.belarusian: "Не дачакаюся, калі змагу скінуць гэтае рыззё."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A680.english: "Evrart isn't paying me enough for this."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A680.polish: „Evrart za mało mi za to płaci”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019EA2.english: "Funny how your sis didn't get it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019EA2.polish: „Zabawne, że twoja siostra nic nie skumała”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019EA2.belarusian: "Смешна, што твая сяструха нічога не ўцяміла."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019EC6.english: "Did you fucking shit in your boots?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019EC6.polish: „Co ty, kurwa, w buty se nasrałeś?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019EC6.belarusian: "Ты што, блядзь, у боты сабе насраў?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC48.english: Titus grins. "I think you got your answer, Mr. Law."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC48.polish: Titus szczerzy zęby. „Chyba usłyszałeś swoją odpowiedź, panie stróżu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC48.belarusian: Цітус выскаляецца: "Здаецца, ты атрымаў свой адказ, містэр Закон".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC60.english: "Why's there a container belt around the dead man's neck?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC60.polish: „Czemu na szyi wisielca jest zaciśnięty pas transportowy?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC66.english: "I have spoken to the dead man -- in a *bizarre* occult vision."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC66.polish: „Rozmawiałem z wisielcem... kiedy doznałem *dziwacznej*, okultystycznej wizji”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC66.belarusian: "Я размаўляў з нябожчыкам — у *дзівоснай* акультнай візіі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC6C.english: "Why are your boot prints all over the scene?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC6C.polish: „Czemu na miejscu zbrodni jest masa śladów waszych butów?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC6C.belarusian: "Чаму на месцы злачынства паўсюль сляды вашых чаравікаў?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC78.english: "I have spoken to the head of the Union."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC84.english: "Who do you fucking think does?" He sounds more amused than angry.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC84.polish: „A jak ci się, kurwa, wydaje?” – jest bardziej rozbawiony niż wkurzony.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC84.belarusian: "А як ты, бляха, думаеш?" — ён гучыць хутчэй развяселена, чым раззлавана.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD13.english: "Or sent them to Reunion to *rot* -- for twenty years, for *life*?!" He says it as if it were worse than dying.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD13.polish: „Albo wysłałeś do Spotkania, żeby tam *gnili*, marnując dwadzieścia lat albo i całe *życie*?” – mówi, jakby to było gorsze od śmierci.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD13.belarusian: "Або адправіў у Рэюньён *гніць* — на дваццаць гадоў, *пажыццёва*?!" — ён кажа гэта так, нібыта гэта горш за смерць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD30.english: "It wasn't a question, dickwad! How fucking stupid are you?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD30.polish: „To nie było pytanie, zjebie! Ty jakiś durny jesteś?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD30.belarusian: "Гэта не было пытанне, мудзіла! Наколькі ж ты, бляха, тупы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD42.english: "This asshole is worse than..." He falls silent. "Titus runs the Hardie boys, genius! That's why we're called the *Hardie boys*, ain't that right, fellas?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD42.polish: „Ten dupek jest gorszy niż...” – milknie. „To Titus rządzi chłopakami Hardiego, geniuszu! Dlatego nazywamy się *chłopakami Hardiego*. Racja, panowie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD42.belarusian: "Гэты казёл горшы за... — ён замаўкае. — Цітус кіруе хлопцамі Хардзі, геній! Таму мы і завёмся *хлопцамі Хардзі*, ці не так, мужыкі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD4E.english: (Point at Titus.) "You do. You give the commands."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD5A.english: "Are you deaf? There will be no singling anyone out. You can't arrest *a* Hardie boy without arresting *all* Hardie boys."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD5A.polish: „Głuchy jesteś? Siedzą w tym razem. Nie możesz aresztować chłopaka Hardiego bez posyłania do paki *wszystkich* chłopaków Hardiego”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD5A.belarusian: "Ты глухі? Нікога вылучаць не будуць. Ты не можаш арыштаваць *аднаго* хлопца Хардзі, не арыштаваўшы *ўсіх* хлопцаў Хардзі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD66.english: "So, what are we going to do now?" (Conclude the questioning.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD66.belarusian: "Дык што мы будзем рабіць цяпер?" (Скончыць допыт.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD71.english: "That's right, asshole! Titus Hardie runs the Hardie boys! Ain't that so, fellas?" He looks around for approval.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD71.polish: „Zgadza się, dupku! Titus Hardie rządzi chłopakami Hardiego! Racja, panowie?” – rozgląda się, szukając aprobaty.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD71.belarusian: "Вось менавіта, казёл! Цітус Хардзі кіруе хлопцамі Хардзі! Ці не так, хлопцы?" — ён аглядаецца ў пошуках ухвалы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD7D.english: (Bow to the bearded man.) "Gangs are usually run by the oldest, most venerable member."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD7D.polish: (Ukłoń się brodaczowi). „Gangami rządzi zwykle najstarszy i najbardziej czcigodny ich członek”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD7D.belarusian: (Пакланіцца барадатаму мужчыне.) "Бандамі звычайна кіруе найстарэйшы, найбольш паважаны чалец".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD83.english: (Point at Fat-Angus.) "The biggest animal dominates the herd. I'm guessing it's the big one."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD83.polish: (Wskaż na Grubego Angusa). „Największe zwierzę dominuje stado. Więc zakładam, że ten duży”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CD83.belarusian: (Паказаць на Тоўстага Ангуса.) "Самая вялікая жывёліна дамінуе ў статку. Мяркую, гэта вось гэты вялікі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CDA1.english: "You murdered him just like that -- no remorse?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CDA1.polish: „Ot tak go zamordowaliście? Bez żadnych skrupułów?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CDA1.belarusian: "Вы забілі яго вось так проста — без ніякага раскаяння?"

Alternate1/0x0100004C0000CDA7.polish: „Spytam jeszcze raz, Titus. Czemu go zabiliście?”
Alternate1/0x0100004C0000CDA7.belarusian: "Я спытаю цябе яшчэ раз, Цітус. Чаму вы яго забілі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CDD0.english: "We hanged him up by his neck until he got real still. Wasn't that obvious, copper?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CDD0.polish: „Powiesiliśmy go za szyję i czekaliśmy, aż przestanie wierzgać. Czy to nie było oczywiste, glino?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CDD0.belarusian: "Мы падвесілі яго за шыю, пакуль ён не заціх зусім. Хіба гэта не відавочна, легавы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CDD6.english: "I know, Lizzy, relax." He takes a sip. "We killed him last Sunday night. Seemed like a good way to end the week."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CDD6.polish: „Wiem, Lizzy, spokojnie” – bierze łyk piwa. „Zabiliśmy go nocą w zeszłą niedzielę. Stwierdziliśmy, że to będzie dobre zakończenie tygodnia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CDD6.belarusian: "Ведаю, Лізі, расслабся, — ён робіць глыток. — Мы забілі яго мінулай нядзельнай ноччу. Здалося нядрэнным спосабам скончыць тыдзень".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D241.english: "Yes, but these were all *bad people* -- criminals, the scum of the earth."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D241.polish: „Dobrze, ale to wszystko byli *źli ludzie*. Przestępcy, szumowiny”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D241.belarusian: "Так, але ўсё гэта былі *дрэнныя людзі* — злачынцы, поскудзь зямная".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D250.english: "Honestly, I drink so much I can't really remember anyone I've sent behind bars."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D250.polish: „Szczerze mówiąc, to piję tak dużo, że nie pamiętam nikogo z tych, których posłałem za kratki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D250.belarusian: "Шчыра кажучы, я п'ю столькі, што нават не памятаю нікога, каго адправіў за краты".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D257.english: "What I do is *different*. I enforce the law. You just kill people like it's nothing."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D257.polish: „Moje działania to *co innego*. Ja egzekwuję prawo. Wy zabijacie ludzi ot tak”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D257.belarusian: "Тое, што раблю я — *іншая справа*. Я падтрымліваю закон. А вы проста забіваеце людзей ні за што ні пра што".

Alternate1/0x0100004C0000D257.polish: „Nasze działania to *co innego*. My egzekwujemy prawo. Wy zabijacie ludzi ot tak”.
Alternate1/0x0100004C0000D257.belarusian: "Тое, што робім мы — *іншая справа*. Мы падтрымліваем закон. А вы проста забіваеце людзей ні за што ні пра што".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D25E.english: "But you see, a *law*, lawman," he says, squeezing his beer can, "is something people agree upon.  And here in Martinaise we agreed that this man had to die."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D25E.polish: „Tylko tak się składa, stróżu prawa, że prawo...” – mówi, miażdżąc puszkę po piwie – „...to coś, na co godzą się ludzie. A my tutaj, w Martinaise, zgodziliśmy się, że ten człowiek musiał zginąć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D25E.belarusian: "Але бачыш, *закон*, праваахоўнік, — кажа ён, сціскаючы бляшанку з півам, — гэта тое, аб чым людзі дамовіліся. І тут, у Марцінэзе, мы дамовіліся, што гэты чалавек мусіць памерці".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D26F.english: "*Doesn't remember them*!" the rat-faced man shouts. "He just forgets! Are you hearing this, Titus?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D26F.polish: „*Nie pamięta ich*!” – wykrzykuje mężczyzna o twarzy szczura. „Ot tak zapomina! Słyszysz to, Titus?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D26F.belarusian: "*Не памятае іх*! — выкрыквае пацукатвары. — Ён проста забывае! Ты гэта чуеш, Цітус?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D276.english: Titus grins. "Rest assured, lawman, none worse than our guy. He got what was coming to him."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D276.polish: Titus szczerzy zęby w uśmiechu. „Zapewniam cię, stróżu prawa, że nasz koleś nie był od nich lepszy. Dostał to, na co zasłużył”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D276.belarusian: Цітус выскаляецца: "Будзь упэўнены, праваахоўнік, горшага за нашага хлопца яшчэ пошукаць. Ён атрымаў па заслугах".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D282.english: "Ain't no use keeping a stiff catalogue in your head, that's for sure." He wipes his mouth with the back of his hand.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D282.polish: „Nie ma sensu trzymać w głowie dokładnego katalogu, to na pewno” – ociera usta wierzchem dłoni.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D282.belarusian: "Няма сэнсу трымаць у галаве цэлы каталог мярцвякоў, гэта дакладна". Ён выцірае рот тыльным бокам далоні.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D4FC.english: "You don't have to answer any of his questions," the fixer turns to remind Titus.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D4FC.polish: „Nie musisz odpowiadać na jego pytania” – przypomina Titusowi prawniczka.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D4FC.belarusian: "Ты не абавязаны адказваць ні на адно з яго пытанняў", — паварочваецца нагадаць Цітусу юрыстка.

Alternate1/0x0100004C0000D4FC.polish: „Nie musisz odpowiadać na jego pytania” – przypomina Titusowi prawniczka.
Alternate1/0x0100004C0000D4FC.belarusian: "Ты не абавязаны працягваць адказваць на яго пытанні", — паварочваецца нагадаць Цітусу юрыстка.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D514.english: "How long had you known the victim?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D51B.english: "*Known* him?! We don't associate with scum like that, asshole!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D51B.polish: „Jak długo go *znaliśmy*?! My się nie zadajemy z takimi łajzami, dupku!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D51B.belarusian: "*Ведалі* яго?! Мы не водзімся з такой поскуддзю, казёл!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D523.english: "Yeah, who do you think we are?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D52A.english: "Quiet!" Titus gives Glen a stern look. "He came around 'bout three weeks ago, when that *Pines* cow first sailed into town. Happy?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D52A.polish: „Cisza!” – Titus rzuca Glenowi surowe spojrzenie. „Pojawił się jakieś trzy tygodnie temu, jak ta krowa z *Wild Pines* przypłynęła pierwszy raz do miasta. Zadowolony?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D52A.belarusian: "Ціха! — Цітус кідае на Глена строгі погляд. — Ён аб'явіўся недзе тры тыдні таму, калі тая карова з *Pines* упершыню прыплыла ў горад. Досыць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D60A.english: "Didn't they teach you *anything* at the cop school, idiot?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D60A.polish: „*Niczego* cię nie nauczyli w twojej glinoszkółce, debilu?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D60A.belarusian: "Цябе што, *нічому* не вучылі ў паліцэйскай школе, ідыёт?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D611.english: You're pretty sure you've had at least two years of *cop school* and many more of active service.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D611.polish: Jesteś raczej pewien, że masz za sobą co najmniej dwa lata *glinoszkółki* i wiele więcej aktywnej służby.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D611.belarusian: Ты амаль упэўнены, што правёў мінімум два гады ў *паліцэйскай школе* і яшчэ значна больш — на сапраўднай службе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D665.english: "Can you give us a few more details? Did you muffle him? We haven't heard any reports of screams."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D665.polish: „Możecie podać nam więcej szczegółów? Zakneblowaliście go? Nie mieliśmy żadnych zeznań wspominających krzyki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D665.belarusian: "Ці можаце даць нам яшчэ некалькі падрабязнасцей? Вы затыкалі яму рот? Мы не чулі ніякіх паведамленняў пра крыкі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D66C.english: "Be more specific. How did you subdue him?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D66C.belarusian: "Будзьце больш канкрэтнымі. Як вы яго адолелі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D679.english: "Maybe wrap it up instead?" She doesn't even look at you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D679.polish: „A może zamiast tego skończymy już z tym przesłuchaniem?” – pyta, nawet nie patrząc na ciebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D679.belarusian: "А можа, замест гэтага скончым?" — яна нават не глядзіць на цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D682.english: "Titus, you don't have to clarify anything."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D689.english: "We overpowered him, dragged his unconscious body to the tree, put a noose around his neck and hanged him 'til he was dead and steady."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D689.polish: „Obezwładniliśmy go, zaciągnęliśmy nieprzytomnego pod drzewo, założyliśmy stryczek na szyję i powiesiliśmy, aż był martwy i nieruchomy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D689.belarusian: "Мы яго адолелі, пацягнулі непрытомнае цела да дрэва, накінулі пятлю на шыю і павесілі, пакуль ён не сціх насмерць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D691.english: "Then we left him for seagulls, maggots," the small man points at you, "and you fucks."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D691.polish: „A potem zostawiliśmy go na pastwę mew, robactwa... i was, zjeby” – mały mężczyzna wskazuje na was.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D691.belarusian: "А потым пакінулі яго кірлям, лічынкам, — маленькі чалавечак паказвае на вас, — і вам, вырадкам".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6B2.english: "The autopsy showed there were no ligature marks. His hands were not tied. Can you explain that?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6B2.polish: „Autopsja nie wykazała żadnych śladów więzów. Jego ręce nie były związane. Możesz to wyjaśnić?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6B2.belarusian: "Ускрыццё паказала, што странгуляцыйных барознаў не было. Яго рукі не былі звязаныя. Вы можаце гэта растлумачыць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6B9.english: "The autopsy revealed the victim's hands were not tied. No signs of struggle. How do you explain *that*?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6B9.polish: „Autopsja wykazała, że ręce ofiary nie były związane. Żadnych śladów walki. *Jak* to wyjaśnicie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6B9.belarusian: "Ускрыццё паказала, што рукі ахвяры не былі звязаныя. Ніякіх слядоў барацьбы. Як вы растлумачыце *гэта*?"

Alternate1/0x0100004C0000D6B9.polish: „A teraz to *ty* posłuchaj *mnie*, syneczku. Autopsja wykazała, że ręce ofiary nie były związane. Ani śladu walki. Wyjaśnij mi to i poproszę *jak najprościej*”.
Alternate1/0x0100004C0000D6B9.belarusian: "А зараз *ты* паслухай *мяне*, хлапчук. Ускрыццё паказала, што рукі ахвяры не былі звязаныя. Ніякіх слядоў барацьбы. Растлумач гэта, і каб было 'зусім проста'."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6C0.english: "Uh... we, huh..." He looks even more irritated than before. "Look, I'm not gonna play Twenty Questions with you, coppo. I'll say it again: We killed him."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6C0.polish: „Ee... My...” – patrzy na ciebie z jeszcze większym poirytowaniem niż wcześniej. „Słuchaj, nie będę z tobą grał w dwadzieścia pytań, glino. Powtórzę: zabiliśmy go”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6C0.belarusian: "Э-э... мы, ну... — ён выглядае яшчэ больш раздражнёным, чым раней. — Слухай, я не збіраюся гуляць з табой у дваццаць пытанняў, копа. Паўтаруся: мы яго забілі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6D7.english: "Yeah, *I* knocked him out." The tattooed one speaks up, banging on his chest. "Came up behind him and clubbed him in the back of the head. He went down like a sack of sand."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6D7.polish: „Tak, *ja* go znokautowałem” – odzywa się gość z tatuażami, uderzając się w pierś. „Podszedłem od tyłu i dałem mu w łeb. Złożył się jak worek piasku”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6D7.belarusian: "Ага, гэта *я* высек яго, — падае голас татуяваны, б'ючы сябе ў грудзі. — Падышоў ззаду і заехаў яму ў патыліцу. Ён зваліўся, як мех з пяском".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6DE.english: "That's right, lawman." He spits through his teeth. "And then we hanged the fuck."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6DE.polish: „Właśnie tak, stróżu prawa” – spluwa przez zęby. „A później powiesiliśmy zjeba”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6DE.belarusian: "Вось менавіта, праваахоўнік, — ён плюе скрозь зубы. — А потым мы павесілі гэтага падонка".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6F3.english: "Right, I have other questions about the lynching."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6F3.polish: „Taa. Mam jeszcze inne pytania co do tego linczu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000D6F3.belarusian: "Добра, у мяне ёсць іншыя пытанні наконт самасуду".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000127AD.english: Things aren't quite right here, are they?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000127AD.polish: Coś tu się nie trzyma kupy, nieprawdaż?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000127AD.belarusian: Штосьці тут не зусім сыходзіцца, так?

tooltip2/0x0100004C000127AD.polish: Dziwna odpowiedź co do związanych rąk.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00012E76.english: He's so sure it's him -- but it's not that simple. There's someone above him (or beside him?) sharing the leadership. Hard to say who...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00012E76.polish: Jest taki pewien, że to on... tylko że to nie takie proste. Jest ktoś nad nim (albo obok niego?), z kim dzieli tę władzę. Trudno powiedzieć kto...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00012E76.belarusian: Ён так упэўнены, што гэта ён — але ўсё не так проста. Ёсць нехта над ім (ці побач з ім?), хто дзеліць з ім лідарства. Цяжка сказаць, хто...

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000142FE.english: "No, no, no..." He shakes his head: "FUCK NO! The big dick is right here, asshole! You're looking at it!" He grabs his crotch. "Right fucking here!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000142FE.polish: „Nie, nie, nie...” – kręci głową. „TAKIEGO CHUJA! Wielkiego kutasa masz tutaj, dupku! Patrzysz na niego!” – krzyczy, łapiąc się za krocze. „Właśnie tutaj!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000142FE.belarusian: "Не, не, не... — ён круціць галавой. — ХУЙ ТАМ! Вялікі чэлес проста тут, казёл! Ты на яго глядзіш! — ён хапае сябе за пахвіну. — Проста, бляха, тут!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00014315.english: A moment of silence. The long haired one breaks it: "Titus, no one was thinking..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00014315.polish: Zapada chwila ciszy, którą przerywa ten z długimi włosami: „Titus, nikt nie myślał...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00014315.belarusian: Хвіліна маўчання. Даўгавалосы перарывае яе: "Цітус, ніхто і не думаў..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0001433E.english: "Disregard the outburst, officer." She gives Titus a condescending glance. "None of the boys have any more comments on their power relations. That night they acted as one. That's all."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0001433E.polish: „Proszę zignorować ten wybuch, funkcjonariuszu” – rzuca Titusowi protekcjonalne spojrzenie. „Żaden z chłopaków nie ma więcej nic do dodania w kwestii hierarchii. Tamtej nocy działali razem. To wszystko”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0001433E.belarusian: "Не звяртайце ўвагі на гэты выбух, афіцэру, — яна кідае на Цітуса паблажлівы погляд. — Ні ў кога з хлопцаў больш няма каментароў наконт іх суадносін улады. Той ноччу яны дзейнічалі як адно цэлае. Вось і ўсё".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00014391.english: "Why not? Yap my ear off, I got nothing to hide."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00014391.polish: „Czemu nie? Możesz pytać, ile wlezie – nie mam nic do ukrycia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00014391.belarusian: "Чаму б і не? Трындзі колькі заўгодна, мне няма чаго хаваць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000143FD.english: Titus is solid as a rock, and so are a few others, but...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000143FD.polish: Titus jest twardy jak skała, kilku z pozostałych też, ale...
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000143FD.belarusian: Цітус трымаецца як скала, дый некаторыя іншыя таксама, але...

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00014402.english: Actually, they're admirably -- surprisingly -- composed. The entire room. Given how many questions you've lobbed their way.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00014402.polish: Prawdę mówiąc, są zadziwiająco – i zaskakująco – spokojni. Wszyscy w pomieszczeniu. Zwłaszcza biorąc pod uwagę, jak zasypałeś ich pytaniami.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C00014402.belarusian: Насамрэч яны зайздросна — на здзіўленне — спакойныя. Увесь пакой. Улічваючы, колькі пытанняў ты на іх высыпаў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AB6E.english: "Why was there a *Vermillion* belt around his neck?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AB88.english: "And what did he tell you?" His eyes narrow. "That we killed him? That we took a cargo belt from the harbour, went out back, and used it to hang him?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AB88.polish: „I co powiedział?” – pyta, mrużąc oczy. „Że zabiliśmy tego gościa? Że zabraliśmy z portu pas transportowy, poszliśmy na tyły i użyliśmy go, żeby go powiesić?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AB88.belarusian: "І што ён вам сказаў? — яго вочы звужаюцца. — Што мы яго забілі? Што ўзялі грузавы рэмень з порта, пайшлі на задні двор і павесілі яго на ім?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ABC3.english: "The man hanged in the backyard -- did you do it?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ABC3.polish: „Ten wisielec na tyłach to wasza sprawka?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000142C2.english: "Don't worry," the lieutenant catches Titus's glance. "We're *resourceful*. We'll find a good topic for us to discuss."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000142C2.polish: „Bez obaw” – porucznik łapie spojrzenie Titusa. „Jesteśmy *zaradni*. Znajdziemy dobry temat do wspólnej rozmowy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000142C2.belarusian: "Не хвалюйцеся, — лейтэнант ловіць погляд Цітуса. — Мы *знаходлівыя*. Мы знойдзем добрую тэму для абмеркавання".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000142C9.english: We've hit a wall. Giving the body a more thorough look might give us some leverage. Just saying.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000142C9.polish: Doszliśmy do ściany. Dokładniejsze przyjrzenie się ciału może dać nam do ręki więcej argumentów. Tak tylko mówię.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000142C9.belarusian: Мы ўперліся ў тупік. Больш дбайны агляд цела мог бы даць нам пэўныя рычагі. Проста да ведама.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC72.english: "You're involved. Somehow. I just don't have proof -- yet."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC72.polish: „Jesteście w to jakoś zamieszani, choć nie mam na to dowodu. Jeszcze”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC72.belarusian: "Вы ў гэтым замяшаныя. Неяк. Проста ў мяне няма доказаў — пакуль што".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CCA8.english: "Well..." He picks up his beer can. "Maybe you should just fuck off then?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CCA8.polish: „No cóż...” – bierze w rękę puszkę piwa. „W takim razie może byś się odpierdolił?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CCA8.belarusian: "Ну... — ён бярэ сваю бляшанку з півам. — Можа, табе тады проста пайсці нахуй?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADC2.english: "Because we took it," he says, "from the harbour where we work. Then we went out back and used it to *hang* him."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADC2.polish: „Bo go zabraliśmy z portu, gdzie pracujemy. Później poszliśmy na tyły i użyliśmy tego pasa, żeby go *powiesić*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADC2.belarusian: "Бо мы ўзялі яго, — кажа ён, — з порта, дзе мы працуем. Потым выйшлі на задні двор і *павесілі* яго на ім".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADC8.english: He looks you dead in the eye. "Because we *did*. All of us together. I hope he told the story straight. I hope he told it well."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADC8.polish: Patrzy ci prosto w oczy. „Bo to *zrobiliśmy*. Wszyscy razem. Mam nadzieję, że opowiedział wszystko tak, jak było. Mam nadzieję, że opowiedział wszystko dobrze”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADC8.belarusian: Ён глядзіць табе проста ў вочы: "Бо мы гэта *зрабілі*. Усе разам. Спадзяюся, ён распавёў усё як было. Спадзяюся, распавёў добра".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADDC.english: The man gets a strange gleam in his eyes. His fists contract as if going through the pulling motion again, savouring it.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADDC.polish: W oczach mężczyzny pojawia się dziwny błysk. Pięści zaciskają mu się, jakby przeżywał po raz kolejny ten ciągnący ruch. Napawał się nim.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADDC.belarusian: У вачах мужчыны з'яўляецца дзіўны бляск. Яго кулакі сціскаюцца, нібы ён зноў паўтарае цягнучы рух, смакуючы яго.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADEE.english: "We did this," -- he looks you dead in the eye -- "together. All of us. Until he was dead. That's why there's a container belt around his neck."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADEE.polish: „Zrobiliśmy to” – mówi, patrząc ci prosto w oczy. „Razem. Wszyscy. Aż był martwy. Właśnie dlatego wokół jego szyi zaciśnięty jest pas transportowy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADEE.belarusian: "Мы гэта зрабілі, — ён глядзіць табе проста ў вочы, — разам. Усе мы. Пакуль ён не сканаў. Вось чаму на яго шыі кантэйнерны рэмень".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADF4.english: As he speaks, his fists contract, going through the pulling motion again, savouring it.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADF4.polish: Kiedy mówi, pięści zaciskają mu się, jakby przeżywał po raz kolejny ten ciągnący ruch. Napawał się nim.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000ADF4.belarusian: Калі ён гаворыць, яго кулакі сціскаюцца, паўтараючы цягнучы рух і смакуючы яго.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE23.english: "So you're not just here to swing your big dick -- you're here for the Pretty Boy? A real looker that one..." He shakes his head. "Stinks like *shit* too."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE23.polish: „Więc nie jesteś tu tylko po to, żeby wymachiwać swoim wielkim kutasem – chodzi o przystojniaka? Jest na co popatrzeć...” – kręci głową. „A do tego śmierdzi jak *gówno*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE23.belarusian: "Дык ты тут не проста каб памахаць сваім вялікім чэлесам — ты тут па Прыгажунчыка? Вось ужо сапраўдная паглядалка..." — ён круціць галавой. — "Дый смярдзіць як *лайно*".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE29.english: "The Pretty Boy?" He takes a sip from his can. "You guys really love talking about that Pretty Boy..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE29.polish: „Przystojniak?” – pyta i bierze łyk ze swojej puszki. „Naprawdę lubicie gadać o tym przystojniaku...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE29.belarusian: "Прыгажунчык?" — ён робіць глыток са сваёй бляшанкі. — "Вы, хлопцы, рэальна любіце пагаварыць пра гэтага Прыгажунчыка..."

Alternate1/0x010000820000AE29.polish: „Przystojniak?” – pyta i bierze łyk ze swojej puszki. „Naprawdę lubisz gadać o tym przystojniaku...”
Alternate1/0x010000820000AE29.belarusian: "Прыгажунчык?" — ён робіць глыток са сваёй бляшанкі. — "Ты рэальна *любіш* пагаварыць пра яго..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE3F.english: "They love him, boss. Spent all day digging around in there. Can't get enough of that Pretty Boy smell."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE3F.polish: „Kochają go, szefie. Spędzili cały dzień na grzebaniu tutaj. Nie mogą się nacieszyć zapaszkiem przystojniaka”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE3F.belarusian: "Яны яго абажаюць, бос. Увесь дзень там корпаліся. Ніяк не надыхаюцца смуродам Прыгажунчыка".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE45.english: "They couldn't get him down boss. He's still up there, stinking up the place." The small guy smirks.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE45.polish: „Nie zdołali go ściągnąć, szefie. Ciągle tam wisi i rozsiewa swój smród” – uśmiecha się złośliwie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE45.belarusian: "Яны не змаглі яго зняць, бос. Ён усё яшчэ там вісіць, паскудзіць паветра", — з'едліва ўсміхаецца малы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE70.english: "Container belt? Like we use in the harbour?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE70.polish: „Pas transportowy? Taki, jak używamy w porcie?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE70.belarusian: "Кантэйнерны рэмень? Такі, як мы выкарыстоўваем у порце?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE85.english: "Vermillion? Like we use in the harbour?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AE85.belarusian: "Vermillion? Такі, як мы выкарыстоўваем у порце?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000142EC.english: "Again? Someone ask the guy for an autograph -- you cops are his biggest fans."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000142EC.polish: „Znowu? Niech któryś poprosi go o autograf – wy, gliny, jesteście jego największymi fanami”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C000142EC.belarusian: «Зноў? Няхай нехта папросіць у яго аўтограф – вы, паліцыя, ягоныя самыя вялікія фанаты».

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AEA4.english: "I wanna talk about the hanging again."

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AEB3.english: A burst of laughter in the room; the little guy is the loudest. "Good one, Titus!" he fawns.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AEB3.polish: W pomieszczeniu rozlega się wybuch śmiechu. Niewielki mężczyzna śmieje się najgłośniej. „Dobre, Titus!” – mówi przymilnie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AEB3.belarusian: У пакоі чутны выбух смеху. Невялікі мужчына смяецца найбольш гучна. «Добра, Цітус!» — кажа самадавольна.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AED0.english: Evidence. Show them you have it. It doesn't have to be conclusive.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AED0.polish: Dowody. Pokaż, że je masz. Nie muszą być niezbite.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AED0.belarusian: Доказы. Пакажы ім, што яны ў цябе ёсць. Не абавязкова бясспрэчныя.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AED6.english: "Funny," the lieutenant says without a smile. "But my partner and I have a serious matter to discuss with you."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AED6.polish: „Zabawne” – odpowiada porucznik bez uśmiechu. „Ale mój partner i ja mamy do omówienia z wami poważną sprawę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AED6.belarusian: "Смешна, — кажа лейтэнант без усмешкі. — Але ў нас з напарнікам ёсць сур'ёзная справа для абмеркавання з вамі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AEE6.english: Just keep talking. Put something on the table. Something incriminating.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AEE6.polish: Mów dalej. Dorzuć coś do tej rozmowy. Coś, co ich obciąży.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AEE6.belarusian: Проста працягвай гаварыць. Выкладзі нешта на стол. Нешта выкрывальнае.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF07.english: "You mean *these* boots?" He raises his worker boot -- size 46, steel reinforced toe.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF07.polish: „Mówisz o *tych* butach?” – pyta, unosząc swój roboczy but: rozmiar 46, stalowa osłona palców.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF07.belarusian: "Ты маеш на ўвазе *гэтыя* чаравікі?" — ён падымае свой працоўны чаравік: 46-ы памер, узмоцнены сталёвы падносак.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF16.english: As he speaks, his fists contract, going through the pulling motion again, savouring it.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF16.polish: Kiedy mówi, pięści zaciskają mu się, jakby przeżywał po raz kolejny ten ciągnący ruch. Napawał się nim.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF16.belarusian: Калі ён гаворыць, яго кулакі сціскаюцца, паўтараючы цягнучы рух і смакуючы яго.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF24.english: "Yeah, we did this." He looks you dead in the eye. "Together. All of us. Until he was dead. That's why our prints are all over the scene."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF24.polish: „Tak, zrobiliśmy to” – oznajmia, patrząc ci prosto w oczy. „Razem. Wszyscy. Aż był martwy. Dlatego wszędzie są ślady naszych butów”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF24.belarusian: "Ага, мы гэта зрабілі, — ён глядзіць табе проста ў вочы. — Разам. Усе мы. Пакуль ён не сканаў. Вось чаму нашы сляды паўсюль на месцы здарэння".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF2C.english: "We all got a pair." He squints. "We wore them the night we took the Pretty Boy out back and hung him. By the neck."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF2C.polish: „Wszyscy takie mamy” – mruży oczy. „Mieliśmy je na sobie tej nocy, gdy zabraliśmy przystojniaka na tyły i powiesiliśmy. Za szyję”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF2C.belarusian: "Ва ўсіх нас ёсць такая пара, — ён прыжмурваецца. — Мы былі ў іх той ноччу, калі вывелі Прыгажунчыка на задні двор і павесілі. За шыю".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF3A.english: "That *is* fucking bizarre. A magic-man, a goddamn magician..." he shakes his head.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF3A.polish: „No i to *jest*, kurwa, dziwaczne. Czarodziej – pieprzony magik...” – kręci głową.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF3A.belarusian: "Вось гэта *рэальна*, бляха, дзівосна. Чараўнік, ёбаны чарадзей..." — ён круціць галавой.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF41.english: The lieutenant waits for your reply. Patiently. His foot taps only a little.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF41.polish: Porucznik czeka na twoją odpowiedź. Cierpliwie. Potupuje stopą tylko trochę.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF41.belarusian: Лейтэнант чакае твайго адказу. Цярпліва. Яго нага толькі ледзь-ледзь пастуквае.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF57.english: Just keep it simple. He said they killed him. These uninitiated do not understand the fineries of Runic Science.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF57.polish: Mów prosto. Powiedział, że go zabili. Ci niewtajemniczeni nie rozumieją zawiłości nauki runicznej.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF57.belarusian: Проста скажы прасцей. Ён сказаў, што гэта яны яго забілі. Гэтыя непасвечаныя не разумеюць тонкасцяў Рунічнай Навукі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF65.english: (Lie) "He told me it was you who killed him. Why is that?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF65.polish: (Skłam). „Powiedział mi, że to wy go zabiliście. Czemu?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF65.belarusian: (Збрэхаць.) "Ён сказаў мне, што гэта вы яго забілі. Чаму так?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF71.polish: „Powiedział, że to miłość go tak urządziła”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF7A.english: "Honestly, the occult vision was too confusing for me to understand."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF7A.polish: „Szczerze mówiąc, ta wizja była dla mnie zbyt dziwaczna, żebym ją pojął”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF7A.belarusian: "Шчыра кажучы, гэтая акультная візія была занадта заблытанай, каб я яе зразумеў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF86.english: "Well," he says. "You're not completely off. We *did* kill him -- we took him out back and hung him by the neck. Until he was dead."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF86.polish: „No cóż...” – zaczyna. „Aż tak całkiem się nie pomyliłeś. *Zabiliśmy* go – zaciągnęliśmy go na tyły i powiesiliśmy za szyję. Aż był martwy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF86.belarusian: "Ну, — кажа ён. — Ты не зусім памыліўся. Мы яго *забілі* — вывелі на задні двор і павесілі за шыю. Пакуль ён не сканаў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF94.english: "Well well, fortune teller." He squints at you, assessing your sincerity. "You might be on to something -- they don't just end up in trees for nothing."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF94.polish: „Nieźle, wróżbito” – mruży oczy, oceniając twoją szczerość. „Możliwe, że na coś wpadłeś – w końcu nie trafia się na drzewo za nic”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AF94.belarusian: "Ну-ну, варажбіт, — ён прыжмурваецца, ацэньваючы тваю шчырасць. — Можа, ты на нешта і натрапіў — проста так на дрэве не апынаюцца".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AFAF.english: There was a speck of truth in there for him. You accidentally touched something.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AFAF.polish: Jego zdaniem tkwiło w tym ziarnko prawdy. Przypadkiem w coś utrafiłeś.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AFAF.belarusian: Для яго ў гэтым была каліўца праўды. Ты выпадкова зачапіў нешта важнае.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AFB8.english: As he speaks, his fists contract, going through the pulling motion again, savouring it.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AFB8.polish: Kiedy mówi, pięści zaciskają mu się, jakby przeżywał po raz kolejny ten ciągnący ruch. Napawał się nim.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AFB8.belarusian: Калі ён гаворыць, яго кулакі сціскаюцца, паўтараючы цягнучы рух і смакуючы яго.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AFBE.english: "We did this --" he looks you dead in the eye, "-- together. All of us. Last Sunday night. So maybe... that's why he told you what he told you?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AFBE.polish: „Zrobiliśmy to” – stwierdza, patrząc ci prosto w oczy. „Razem. Wszyscy. Nocą ostatniej niedzieli. Więc może... dlatego powiedział ci to, co ci powiedział?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AFBE.belarusian: "Мы гэта зрабілі, — ён глядзіць табе проста ў вочы, — разам. Усе мы. Мінулай нядзельнай ноччу. Можа... таму ён і сказаў табе тое, што сказаў?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AFC6.english: "Well, what'cha chatting me up for then? Go arrest communism before it skips town."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AFC6.polish: „No to po co ucinasz sobie ze mną pogawędki? Aresztuj komunizm, zanim zwieje z miasta”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AFC6.belarusian: "Ну дык чаго ты мне зубы загаворваеш? Ідзі арыштуй камунізм, пакуль ён не зваліў з горада".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC92.english: "I'm getting a bizarre message from Angus's stomach right now. It says... wait, what is it saying, Angie?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC92.polish: „Właśnie odbieram dziwną wiadomość z brzucha Angusa. Mówi... Chwila, co on mówi, Angie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100004C0000CC92.belarusian: "Я проста зараз атрымліваю дзівоснае пасланне з пуза Ангуса. Яно кажа... пачакай, што яно там кажа, Ангі?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B014.english: "We had something else. Beside the *occult vision*..." He turns to you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B014.polish: „Mamy coś jeszcze. Poza *okultystyczną wizją*...” – oznajmia, odwracając się do ciebie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B014.belarusian: "У нас было нешта яшчэ. Акрамя *акультнай візіі*..." — ён паварочваецца да цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B02A.english: You had something other than the bizarre vision too, right? You better have something, because this didn't work.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B02A.polish: Masz jeszcze coś poza tą dziwaczną wizją, nie? Lepiej, żebyś miał, bo to, co robisz, raczej nie działa.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B02A.belarusian: У цябе ж было нешта яшчэ, акрамя гэтай дзівоснай візіі, так? Лепей бы ў цябе нешта было, бо гэты варыянт не спрацаваў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B035.polish: „Mówi, że gówno na nas mają, szefie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B035.belarusian: "Кажа, што ў іх ні хуя няма, бос".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B03D.english: We had to have *something*. His foot-tapping has become less patient now.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B03D.polish: *Coś* musieliśmy mieć. Jego tupanie staje się bardziej niecierpliwe.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B03D.belarusian: У нас *мусіла* быць нешта яшчэ. Пастукванне яго нагі цяпер стала менш цярплівым.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B054.english: "What are you doing, officer?" He lowers his voice. "We had enough questions to keep this going."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B054.polish: „Co ty robisz, oficerze?” – pyta szeptem. „Mieliśmy jeszcze pytania i powinniśmy byli kontynuować”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B054.belarusian: "Што вы робіце, афіцэру? — ён паніжае голас. — У нас было дастаткова пытанняў, каб працягваць размову".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B06F.english: You should have kept pushing if you had something.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B06F.polish: Trzeba było naciskać, jeśli masz coś jeszcze.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B06F.belarusian: Табе варта было працягваць націскаць, калі ў цябе нешта было.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B080.english: "Guess what -- I've come upon something incriminating."

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B088.english: "Incriminating... now that's a big boy word." He puts his beer can down.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B088.polish: „»Obciążającego«... To słowo używane przez dorosłych” – odpowiada, odstawiając swoje piwo.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B088.belarusian: «„Абцяжарвальнага“... Гэта слова, якое ўжываюць дарослыя», — адказвае ён, адстаўляючы сваё піва.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0AF.english: "That's it, the game's over. I got the perpetrator!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0AF.polish: „No, koniec zabawy. Mamy sprawcę w garści!”

Alternate1/0x010000820000B0AF.polish: „No, koniec zabawy. Mamy sprawcę w garści!”

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0B5.english: "A-ha, so you just confess to murder?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0B5.polish: „Ha, czyli po prostu przyznajesz się do morderstwa?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0B5.belarusian: "Ага, то бок вы проста прызнаецеся ў забойстве?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0C4.english: "No, you don't. What you have is seven honest men, who thought it forthcoming to tell you what happened -- so that you don't waste any more of your time."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0C4.polish: „Nie, nie macie. Macie siedmiu uczciwych mężczyzn, którzy uznali za stosowne opowiedzieć, co się wydarzyło – abyście nie marnowali już więcej naszego czasu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0C4.belarusian: "Не, не злавілі. У вас ёсць сямёра сумленных мужчын, якія палічылі правільным расказаць вам, што здарылася — каб вы больш не марнавалі свой час".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0D6.english: There's a catch hidden somewhere. He didn't confess so that you could take them all away. It's too simple.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0D6.polish: Gdzieś tutaj tkwi haczyk. Nie przyznał się po to, żebyś ich wszystkich pozamykał. To by było za proste.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0D6.belarusian: Дзесьці тут схаваны падвох. Ён прызнаўся не дзеля таго, каб ты іх усіх засадзіў. Гэта было б занадта проста.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0F6.english: "No." The woman interjects. "These *seven* honest men have *equally* come forth. They told you what happened -- so that you don't waste any more of your time."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0F6.polish: „Nie” – wtrąca się kobieta. „Tych *siedmiu* uczciwych mężczyzn zgłosiło się *razem*. Powiedzieli, co się wydarzyło, abyś nie marnował już więcej naszego czasu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0F6.belarusian: "Не, — устаўляе жанчына. — Гэтыя *сямёра* сумленных мужчын выступілі *разам*. Яны распавялі вам, што здарылася — каб вы больш не марнавалі свой час".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0FD.english: All -- seven -- together. They're diluting responsibility. It's an anti-arrest tactic.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0FD.polish: Wszyscy zgłosili się w siódemkę. Razem. Rozmywanie odpowiedzialności. Taktyka przeciw aresztowaniu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B0FD.belarusian: Усе — сямёра — разам. Яны размываюць адказнасць. Гэта тактыка супраць арышту.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B109.english: They're playing to their *considerable* strength in numbers. Don't talk about arresting them. You'll only bring attention to your inability to do so.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B109.polish: Wykorzystują swoją *zdecydowaną* przewagę liczebną. Nie mów nic o aresztowaniu ich. Zwrócisz tylko uwagę na to, że nie możesz tego zrobić.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B109.belarusian: Яны выкарыстоўваюць сваю *значную* колькасную перавагу. Не кажы пра іх арышт. Толькі прыцягнеш увагу да сваёй няздольнасці гэта зрабіць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B11D.english: "There is no catch. These seven honest men have all *equally* come forth to tell you what happened -- so that you don't waste any more of your time."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B11D.polish: „Nie ma żadnego haczyka. Tych siedmiu uczciwych mężczyzn zgłosiło się *razem*, aby opowiedzieć, co się wydarzyło – żebyś nie marnował już więcej naszego czasu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B11D.belarusian: "Няма ніякага падвоху. Гэтыя сямёра сумленных мужчын *пароўну* выйшлі наперад і расказалі, што здарылася — каб вы больш не марнавалі свой час".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B140.english: "How many people have you sent to the *chaise*? Ever felt remorse for them?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B140.polish: „Ile osób posłałeś na *chaise*? Dręczą cię z ich powodu wyrzuty sumienia?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B140.belarusian: "А колькі людзей ты адправіў на *chaise*? Адчуваў хоць калі-небудзь раскаянне?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B147.english: Chaise électrique is the method of capital punishment in Revachol under the Coalition. During the Suzerain's reign it used to be the firing squad.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B147.polish: Chaise électrique to sposób wykonywania kary śmierci w zarządzanym przez Koalicję Revacholu. Za czasów monarchii jego odpowiednikiem był pluton egzekucyjny.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B147.belarusian: Chaise électrique — гэта спосаб смяротнага пакарання ў Рэвашолі пад кіраваннем Кааліцыі. У часы праўлення Сюзэрэна гэта быў расстрэл.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B161.polish: A to Spotkanie? Co to jest?

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B17C.english: The River Esperance Correctional Facility -- a military prison run by the Coalition, dubbed *Reunion* by the inmates. The origin of the name is unknown.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B17C.polish: Ośrodek Resocjalizacyjny Rzeki Esperance. Wojskowe więzienie Koalicji nazywane przez więźniów *Spotkaniem*. Pochodzenie tej nazwy nie jest znane.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B17C.belarusian: Папраўчая ўстанова ракі Эсперанс — вайсковая турма пад кіраваннем Кааліцыі, якую зняволеныя ахрысцілі *Рэюньёнам*. Паходжанне назвы невядомае.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B18B.english: "Look, I'm just doing my job, that's all."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B18B.polish: „Posłuchajcie. Wykonuję tylko swoją pracę, to wszystko”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B18B.belarusian: "Слухайце, я проста раблю сваю працу, вось і ўсё".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B195.english: "Oh, so you're just a simple, well-meaning man, huh?" He spits on the ground before him. "Ever been in solitary? Prison is *torture*, that's what it is."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B195.polish: „Ach, czyli że jesteś tylko prostym, poczciwym człeczyną, co?” – spluwa na podłogę. „Byłeś kiedyś w izolatce? Więzienie to *tortury*, ot co”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B195.belarusian: "А, дык ты проста просты, дабрадушны чалавек, га? — ён плюе на падлогу перад сабой. — Бываў калі-небудзь у ізалятары? Турма — гэта *катаванне*, вось што гэта такое".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B19C.english: This isn't something he came up with on the spot. It's his standard reasoning -- a product of many years of being Titus Hardie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B19C.polish: To nie jest coś, co sobie ot tak wymyślił. To jego standardowy sposób myślenia. Efekt wielu lat bycia Titusem Hardiem.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B19C.belarusian: Гэта не тое, што ён прыдумаў на месцы. Гэта яго звыклы ход думак — вынік многіх гадоў жыцця ў якасці Цітуса Хардзі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1A6.english: He's clearly been in solitary confinement -- and at a young age, nonetheless.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1A6.polish: On ewidentnie był kiedyś w izolatce. I to w młodym wieku.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1A6.belarusian: Ён відавочна сядзеў у карцары — прычым яшчэ ў маладым веку.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1AF.english: He nods to his friend. "The fucker got what was coming to him. Our conscience is clean."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1AF.polish: Przytakuje swojemu przyjacielowi. „Zjeb dostał za swoje. Mamy czyste sumienie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1AF.belarusian: Ён ківае свайму сябру: "Гэты падонак атрымаў па заслугах. Наша сумленне чыстае".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1BF.english: "So is hanging a man slowly, without breaking his neck," the lieutenant replies dryly.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1BF.polish: „Tak jak powieszenie kogoś bez łamania mu karku” – odpowiada oschle porucznik.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1BF.belarusian: "Як і павольнае павешанне чалавека без пералому шыі", — суха адказвае лейтэнант.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1D4.english: (Address Elizabeth.) "I don't have to. One of them was more complicit than others."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1D4.polish: (Zwróć się do Elizabeth). „Nie muszę. Jeden z nich był w tym bardziej umoczony niż inni”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1D4.belarusian: (Звярнуцца да Элізабэт.) "І не трэба. Адзін з іх быў замяшаны больш за астатніх".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1DA.english: (Address Titus.) "No, but seriously -- who calls the shots around here?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1DA.polish: (Zwróć się do Titusa). „Ale tak poważnie – kto tutaj wydaje rozkazy?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1DA.belarusian: (Звярнуцца да Цітуса.) "Не, ну а сур'ёзна — хто тут галоўны?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1E2.english: Titus. Keep addressing him. He *wants* everyone to know he's in charge.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1E2.polish: Titus. Zwracaj się ciągle do niego. On *chce*, żeby wszyscy wiedzieli, że tu rządzi.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1E2.belarusian: Цітус. Працягвай звяртацца да яго. Ён *хоча*, каб усе ведалі, што тут галоўны ён.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1EB.english: "That's for the courts in Le Jardin to decide, not for the officer making an arrest. Which we all know you won't be."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1EB.polish: „O tym zdecydować mogą sądy w Le Jardin, a nie funkcjonariusz dokonujący aresztowania. Którego, jak wszyscy wiemy, nie będzie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B1EB.belarusian: "Гэта вырашаць судам у Лё Жардэне, а не афіцэру, які праводзіць арышт. Якога, як мы ўсе ведаем, ты праводзіць не будзеш".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B205.english: "No, no," the lieutenant says, calmly. "We'll stay here and discuss what happened that night."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B205.polish: „Nie, nie” – odpowiada porucznik spokojnie. „Zostaniemy tutaj i przedyskutujemy wydarzenia tamtej nocy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B205.belarusian: "Не, не, — спакойна кажа лейтэнант. — Мы застанемся тут і абмяркуем, што здарылася той ноччу".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B20B.english: But... they don't *want* you back at the station, do they?
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B20B.polish: Ale... na komisariacie cię *nie chcą*, nieprawdaż?
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B20B.belarusian: Але ж... цябе *не хочуць* бачыць у пастарунку, ці не так?

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B21B.english: She probably knows you're not welcome there... somehow she does.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B21B.polish: Pewnie wie, że nie jesteś tam mile widziany. Nie wiesz skąd, ale wie...
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B21B.belarusian: Яна, напэўна, ведае, што табе там не рады... нейкім чынам ведае.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B244.english: "It's the eighth Hardie boy. The one who's missing. The big dick."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B244.polish: „Rządzi tu ósmy chłopak Hardiego. Ten, którego tu nie ma. To jest właśnie gość z wielkim kutasem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B244.belarusian: "Гэта восьмы хлопец Хардзі. Той, якога няма. Вось ён — вялікая шышка з вялікім чэлесам".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B24D.english: (Point at the harbour.) "Evrart Claire runs the Union. You answer to him, right?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B24D.polish: (Wskaż w kierunku portu). „Związkiem rządzi Evrart Claire. Podlegacie mu, nieprawdaż?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B24D.belarusian: (Паказаць у бок порта.) "Эўрар Клэр кіруе Прафсаюзам. Вы падпарадкоўваецеся яму, так?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B256.english: "You keep him the fuck out of this." He leans toward you. "We have *autonomy*. It's all on us. Evrart runs the Union -- *I* run the Hardie boys."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B256.polish: „Nie mieszaj go do tego” – odpowiada, nachylając się ku tobie. „Mamy *autonomię*. To wszystko idzie na nasze konto. Evrart rządzi Związkiem – *ja* rządzę chłopakami Hardiego”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B256.belarusian: "Не прыплятай яго сюды, нахуй, — ён нахіляецца да цябе. — У нас *аўтаномія*. Усё гэта на нашай адказнасці. Эўрар кіруе Прафсаюзам — а *я* кірую хлопцамі Хардзі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B25D.english: "Yes, there are *some* administrative differences," she gives Titus a stern look, "but on that night they all acted as *one* man."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B25D.polish: „Tak, istnieją *pewne* administracyjne wątpliwości” – odpowiada, rzucając Titusowi surowe spojrzenie – „ale tamtej nocy wszyscy działali jak *jeden* mąż”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B25D.belarusian: "Так, ёсць *пэўныя* адміністрацыйныя адрозненні, — яна строга глядзіць на Цітуса, — але той ноччу яны ўсе дзейнічалі як *адзін* чалавек".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B265.english: The sweaty man turns red and looks first down, then around him, apologetically.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B265.polish: Spocony mężczyzna czerwienieje. Najpierw wlepia wzrok w ziemię, po czym rozgląda się wokół przepraszająco.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B265.belarusian: Упрэлы мужчына чырванее і глядзіць спачатку ўніз, а потым вакол сябе з вінаватым выглядам.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B26B.english: The old man lets out an annoyed cough, then reaches into his pocket for another cigarette.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B26B.polish: Starszy mężczyzna pokasłuje z irytacją, po czym sięga do kieszeni po kolejnego papierosa.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B26B.belarusian: Стары раздражнёна кашляе, пасля чаго лезе ў кішэню па яшчэ адну цыгарэту.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B27B.english: He *has* authority in the group, but it wasn't him calling the shots that night. Hasn't been him for a long time.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B27B.polish: *Ma* autorytet w tej grupie, ale to nie on rządził tamtej nocy. Nie rządzi już od dawna.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B27B.belarusian: Ён *мае* аўтарытэт у групе, але той ноччу верхаводзіў не ён. І ўжо даўно не ён.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B28D.english: He wasn't calling the shots that night... or any night. If anything, he was used as a tool -- for carrying, or clean-up.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B28D.polish: To nie on rządził tamtej nocy. Ani jakiejkolwiek innej. W najlepszym razie stanowił narzędzie. Był tragarzem albo sprzątaczem.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B28D.belarusian: Ён не кіраваў той ноччу... дый любой іншай ноччу таксама. У лепшым выпадку яго выкарыстоўвалі як інструмент — для пераноскі ці прыборкі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B297.english: "It's not the fat-ass!" the scrawny guy shrieks. "Titus runs the Hardie boys, genius! That's why we're called the *Hardie boys*, ain't that right, fellas?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B297.polish: „Nie, nie grubas!” – wywrzaskuje chudzielec. „To Titus rządzi chłopakami Hardiego, geniuszu! Dlatego nazywamy się *chłopakami Hardiego*. Racja, panowie?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B297.belarusian: "Гэта не таўстун! — вярэдзіць хударлявы. — Цітус кіруе хлопцамі Хардзі, геній! Таму мы і завёмся *хлопцамі Хардзі*, ці не так, мужыкі?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2A3.english: "Theo's a great guy, a great guy, but c'mon..." He spreads his arms. "*Titus Hardie* runs the Hardie boys. That's why we're called the *Hardie boys*, genius!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2A3.polish: „Theo to świetny gość. Świetny. Ale dajże spokój...” – rozkłada ręce. „To *Titus Hardie* rządzi chłopakami Hardiego. Dlatego nazywamy się *chłopakami Hardiego*, geniuszu!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2A3.belarusian: "Тэа выдатны хлопец, выдатны хлопец, але кінь ты... — ён разводзіць рукамі. — *Цітус Хардзі* кіруе хлопцамі Хардзі. Таму мы і завёмся *хлопцамі Хардзі*, геній!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2B1.english: "When Titus Hardie says he *runs* the Hardie boys," the woman adds, "he means that in an *administrative* capacity. On that night everyone acted as *one* man."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2B1.polish: „Gdy Titus Hardie mówi, że *rządzi* chłopakami Hardiego” – dodaje kobieta – „to ma na myśli kwestie *administracyjne*. Tamtej nocy wszyscy działali jak *jeden* mąż”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2B1.belarusian: "Калі Цітус Хардзі кажа, што ён *кіруе* хлопцамі Хардзі, — дадае жанчына, — ён мае на ўвазе *адміністрацыйныя* абавязкі. Той ноччу кожны дзейнічаў як *адзін* чалавек".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2C4.english: You stepped on some big toes there. Tried to take out a satellite. That's not how it's going to go. They'd rather rot in jail than implicate Mr. Claire in this mess.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2C4.polish: Nadepnąłeś tu na odcisk komuś zbyt ważnemu. Spróbowałeś wystartować do zbyt grubej ryby. Nie uda ci się to. Prędzej zgniją w więzieniu niż wciągną w ten bałagan pana Claire'a.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2C4.belarusian: Ты наступіў тут камусьці на важкі мазоль. Паспрабаваў падбіць спадарожнік. Так справа не пойдзе. Яны хутчэй згніюць у турме, чым уцягнуць у гэтую кашу пана Клэра.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2D6.english: When the shit starts spinning it will *not* land on Mr. Claire -- that's the deal here. The fixer will ignore the notion completely, focusing on Titus' culpability.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2D6.polish: Jeśli wpadną w gówno, pan Claire *nie* zostanie nim zachlapany – tak to tutaj wygląda. Prawniczka całkowicie zignoruje ten wątek i skupi się na ewentualnej winie Titusa.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2D6.belarusian: Калі лайно паляціць на вентылятар, яно *не* зачэпіць пана Клэра — такі тут расклад. Юрыстка цалкам праігнаруе гэтую думку, засяродзіўшыся на вінаватасці Цітуса.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2DE.english: "...that there's any question who's the leader." That's how he would have ended it. Titus won't let him.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2DE.polish: „...że twoja władza podlega wątpliwości”. Tak by zakończył tę wypowiedź. Ale Titus mu nie pozwoli.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2DE.belarusian: "...што тут увогуле ёсць сумневы, хто лідар". Вось як ён бы скончыў. Але Цітус яму не дазволіць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2E4.english: That's it. There's some kind of power issue they don't want to admit -- and the missing Hardie is involved.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2E4.polish: Proszę bardzo. Mają jakiś spór o władzę, do którego nie chcą się przyznać. I jest w niego wplątany zaginiony Hardie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B2E4.belarusian: Вось яно. Тут нейкія трэнні наконт улады, у якіх яны не хочуць прызнавацца — і адсутны Хардзі ў гэтым замяшаны.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B302.english: "No. You did not get an answer. Titus does *administrative* work. He pushes paper. Fills out forms -- the others can't read. But on that night they all acted as *one* man."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B302.polish: „Nie. Nie usłyszałeś odpowiedzi. Titus pełni funkcje *administracyjne*. Przekłada papierki. Wypełnia formularze, bo reszta nie umie pisać. Ale tamtej nocy wszyscy działali jak *jeden* mąż”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B302.belarusian: "Не. Ты не атрымаў адказу. Цітус выконвае *адміністрацыйную* працу. Перакладае паперкі. Запаўняе бланкі — бо астатнія не ўмеюць чытаць. Але той ноччу яны ўсе дзейнічалі як *адзін* чалавек".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B308.english: Titus grins. "I think you got your answer, Mr. Law."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B308.polish: Titus szczerzy zęby. „Chyba usłyszałeś swoją odpowiedź, panie stróżu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B308.belarusian: Цітус выскаляецца: "Здаецца, ты атрымаў свой адказ, містэр Закон".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B328.english: "By the 'Pines cow', you mean the representative for Wild Pines?" The lieutenant checks his notes. "The shipping company you're striking against?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B328.polish: „Mówiąc o »krowie z Wild Pines«, masz na myśli przedstawicielkę Wild Pines?” – pyta porucznik, zaglądając do swoich notatek. „Firmy transportowej, przeciwko której strajkujecie?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B328.belarusian: "Пад 'каровай з Pines' вы маеце на ўвазе прадстаўніцу Wild Pines? — лейтэнант звяраецца з нататкамі. — Суднаходнай кампаніі, супраць якой вы страйкуеце?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B33B.english: "By the 'Pines cow' you mean Joyce, the negotiator for Wild Pines?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B33B.polish: „Mówiąc o »krowie z Wild Pines«, masz na myśli Joyce, negocjatorkę Wild Pines?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B33B.belarusian: "Пад 'каровай з Pines' ты маеш на ўвазе Джойс, перамоўшчыцу ад Wild Pines?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B341.english: "By the 'Pines cow' you mean Joyce Messier, the representative for Wild Pines?" The lieutenant pretends to check his notes. "The same company you're striking against?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B341.polish: „Mówiąc o »krowie z Wild Pines«, masz na myśli Joyce Messier, przedstawicielkę Wild Pines?” – pyta porucznik, zaglądając do swoich notatek. „Firmy, przeciwko której strajkujecie?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B341.belarusian: "Пад 'каровай з Pines' вы маеце на ўвазе Джойс Месье, прадстаўніцу Wild Pines? — лейтэнант робіць выгляд, што звяраецца са сваімі нататкамі. — Той самай кампаніі, супраць якой вы страйкуеце?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B34A.english: "No," he stresses, "I mean *the Pines cow*. The stupid-ass cow they sent in to fuck us over. But you know what..." He rubs his chin, pretending to mull it over.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B34A.polish: „Nie” – odpowiada stanowczo. „Mam na myśli *krowę z Wild Pines*. Głupią krowę, którą przysłali, żeby nas wydymała. Ale wiesz co...?” – pociera brodę, udając, że się nad czymś zastanawia.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B34A.belarusian: "Не, — падкрэслівае ён, — я маю на ўвазе *карову з Pines*. Тупую карову, якую яны даслалі, каб нас паімець. Але ведаеш што... — ён пацірае падбароддзе, робячы выгляд, што абдумвае гэта.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B354.english: "Why don't you ask *her* about the Pretty Boy? I'm sure she has interesting things to say -- when you ask her *hard* enough."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B354.polish: „Czemu *jej* nie zapytasz o przystojniaka? Na pewno ma wiele interesujących rzeczy do powiedzenia – trzeba ją tylko odpowiednio mocno *zapytać*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B354.belarusian: "Чаму б табе не спытаць пра Прыгажунчыка ў *яе*? Упэўнены, ёй ёсць шмат цікавага расказаць — калі распытаць яе як *след*".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B369.english: This is where he tries to sow discord between you two -- because he knows the company is responsible for bringing the mercenaries into town.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B369.polish: Teraz spróbuje zasiać między wami niezgodę. Bo wie, że firma jest odpowiedzialna za nasłanie na miasto najemników.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B369.belarusian: Вось тут ён спрабуе пасеяць варожасць паміж вамі — бо ведае, што гэта кампанія адказная за тое, што ў горад прыцягнуліся найміты.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B373.english: "That's enough insinuation for today, Titus." She turns to you. "Officer, your interview is drawing to an end. Don't waste your last questions."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B373.polish: „Wystarczy tych insynuacji na dzisiaj, Titusie” – mówi, po czym zwraca się do ciebie. „Funkcjonariuszu, twoje przesłuchanie dobiega końca. Nie zmarnuj swoich ostatnich pytań”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B373.belarusian: "Дастаткова намёкаў на сёння, Цітус, — яна паварочваецца да цябе. — Афіцэру, вашае апытанне падыходзіць да канца. Не марнуйце свае апошнія пытанні".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B37B.english: "Why?" he hisses through his teeth. "Because he was worthless mercenary scum -- *and* he stepped out of line. In *my* town."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B37B.polish: „Dlaczego?” – cedzi pytanie przez zęby. „Bo był bezwartościową najemną łajzą – a do tego przekroczył granice. W *moim* mieście”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B37B.belarusian: "Чаму? — шыпіць ён скрозь зубы. — Бо ён быў нікчэмнай найміцкай брыдой — *і* перайшоў усе межы. У *маім* горадзе".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B552.english: "So he was a mercenary, that's it?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B552.belarusian: "То бок ён быў наймітам, і ўсё?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B605.english: "*And* he stepped out of line," he repeats, jaw clamped shut like a vice.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B605.polish: „A do tego przekroczył granice” – powtarza, zaciskając szczęki jak imadło.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000B605.belarusian: "*І* перайшоў межы", — паўтарае ён, сцяўшы сківіцы, як у цісках.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E411.english: "I can't prove it, but I *know* he was sent by the Wild Pines. They hire merc-shit like that. Story of every strike from here to Samara."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E411.polish: „Nie mogę tego udowodnić, ale *wiem*, że nasłali go ci z Wild Pines. Zatrudniają takie najemne łajzy. Robią tak przy każdym strajku – stąd aż po Samarę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E411.belarusian: "Я не магу гэтага даказаць, але я *ведаю*, што яго даслалі Wild Pines. Яны наймаюць такое найміцкае гаўно. Звычайная гісторыя для кожнага страйку адсюль і да Самары".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E421.english: "Hold on, how do you even know he was in special forces?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E421.polish: „Chwila, skąd wiecie w ogóle, że należał do sił specjalnych?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E421.belarusian: "Пачакай, адкуль вы наогул ведаеце, што ён быў са спецпрызна?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E427.english: "Right, but what did he actually do *wrong*?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E427.polish: „No dobra, ale co tak konkretnie zrobił *złego*?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E42F.english: "A live grenade." The man spreads his arms. "Right here in *our* bar!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E42F.polish: „Odbezpieczony granat” – mówi, rozkładając ręce. „Tu, w *naszym* barze!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E42F.belarusian: "Баявая граната, — мужчына разводзіць рукамі. — Проста тут, у *нашым* бары!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E437.english: "Cause one night he walked straight up to the mic and said: 'I'm Oranjese goddamn Special Forces and I'm gonna fuck you all'."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E437.polish: „Jednego wieczora podszedł po prostu do mikrofonu i powiedział »Jestem z cholernych sił specjalnych Oranje i wydymam was wszystkich«”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E437.belarusian: "Бо аднойчы ўвечары ён падышоў проста да мікрафона і сказаў: 'Я з клятага араньезскага спецпрызна і я вас усіх паімею'."

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E44B.english: "We couldn't believe it, either. But he fucking did. Right there," he points at the stage, "like some kind of animal."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E44B.polish: „Też ciężko było nam w to uwierzyć. Ale, kurwa, tak zrobił. O tam” – wskazuje na scenę. „Jak jakieś zwierzę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E44B.belarusian: "Мы таксама не маглі паверыць. Але ён, бляха, так і зрабіў. Вунь там, — ён паказвае на сцэну, — як нейкая жывёліна".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E452.english: "Wrong?!" he roars. "He harassed women. Raped one. Harassed workers. Threatened to kill some as a *warning*..." He wipes spittle from his mouth.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E452.polish: „Co zrobił?” – grzmi. „Nękał kobiety. Jedną zgwałcił. Nękał robotników. Groził, że zabije kilku z nas jako *ostrzeżenie*...” – wyciera ślinę ze swojej brody.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E452.belarusian: "Дрэннага?! — раве ён. — Ён дамагаўся жанчын. Адну згвалтаваў. Чапляўся да рабочых. Пагражаў забіць некаторых для *папярэджання*..." — ён выцірае сліну з рота.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E459.english: "Yeah -- really. Had a gin and tonic up there, sang some Oranjese paratrooper song, and said he's gonna fuck everyone."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E459.polish: „Tak, poważnie. Wypił gin z tonikiem, zaśpiewał jakąś piosenkę oranjeskich spadochroniarzy i powiedział, że wszystkich wydyma”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E459.belarusian: "Ага — праўда. Выпіў там джын-тонік, праспяваў нейкую песню араньезскіх дэсантнікаў і сказаў, што ўсіх паімее".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E47A.english: "Yeah, he said it was his 'favourite joint' now, started coming here every night! Drinking, grabbing girls -- grabbed one of ours mid-karaoke. Right there on the stage!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E47A.polish: „Tak, mówił, że to teraz jego »ulubiony lokal«, zaczął przychodzić co wieczór! Pił, obłapiał dziewczyny... Jedną z naszych zaczął macać podczas karaoke. O tam, na scenie!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E47A.belarusian: "Ага, казаў, што гэта цяпер ягоная 'любімая забягалаўка', пачаў прыходзіць сюды кожны вечар! Піў, лапаў дзяўчат... адну з нашых схапіў проста падчас караоке. Вунь там, на сцэне!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E486.english: "Yeah, this girl's on the mic, a beautiful girl, young. Gets into the second verse of 'Lover Lake'. The fucker grabs her legs, starts screaming..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E486.polish: „Tak, dziewczyna stoi przy mikrofonie. Piękna, młoda. Zaczyna drugą zwrotkę »Jeziora Zakochanych«, a ten skurwiel łapie ją za nogi, zaczyna wrzeszczeć...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E486.belarusian: "Ага, дзяўчына стаіць ля мікрафона, прыгожая дзяўчына, маладая. Пачынае другі куплет 'Lover Lake'. Гэты падонак хапае яе за ногі, пачынае гарлапаніць..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000E4AB.english: "... to kill us all if we don't open the gates, if we don't let the scabs in. If we don't bend over." He cracks his knuckles. "And that was *before* he started coming *here*."
