Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA49.english: Scared? You should be too. A strange fear creeps over you, a metallic taste in your mouth. Change the subject.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA49.polish: Bała się? I słusznie. Ogarnia cię dziwny lęk, w twoich ustach pojawia się metaliczny smak. Zmień temat.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA49.belarusian: Спалохалася? Табе таксама варта. Дзіўны страх падступае да цябе, у роце з'яўляецца металічны прысмак. Змяні тэму.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA4F.english: "Do you have any clues on where Ruby went?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA4F.polish: „Macie jakikolwiek trop, gdzie się udała Ruby?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA4F.belarusian: "Ці ёсць у вас зачэпкі, куды пайшла Рубі?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA55.english: "She's not far. We know that much -- she didn't take her lorry. So she's on foot."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA55.polish: „Jest gdzieś niedaleko. Tyle wiemy, bo nie zabrała swojej ciężarówki. Porusza się pieszo”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA55.belarusian: "Яна недалёка. Гэта мы ведаем дакладна — яна не ўзяла свой грузавік. Значыць, яна пешшу".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA5B.english: It's not a threat -- it's a warning.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA61.english: "Is that true Kim? Am I a can-opener?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA61.polish: „To prawda, Kim? Jestem otwieraczem do puszek?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA67.english: "Nah. We're good." He lets go of your hand.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA67.polish: „Nie. Obejdzie się” – odpowiada, puszczając twoją dłoń.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA67.belarusian: "Не. Нам і так добра", — ён адпускае тваю руку.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA6D.english: Evrart's file on you seemed thin on info. She must know from somewhere else. From Jamrock. Something *more*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA6D.polish: W kartotece Evrarta nie było raczej wielu informacji o tobie. Ona musi mieć wiedzę z innego źródła. Z Jamrock. Wiedzieć coś *więcej*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA6D.belarusian: Дасье Эўрара на цябе выглядала бедным на інфармацыю. Яна мусіць ведаць аднекуль яшчэ. З Джэмрока. Нешта *большае*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA74.english: "Good fucking luck, man... She knows this place like the back of her hand. You'll never find her."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA74.polish: „Kurwa, koleś, powodzenia. Ona zna okolicę jak własną kieszeń. W życiu jej nie znajdziesz”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA74.belarusian: "Бляха, поспехаў, чалавеча... Яна ведае гэтыя мясціны як свае пяць пальцаў. Ты яе ніколі не знойдзеш".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA7A.english: "Yeah, Al." He gives a sharp look. "And we won't either."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA7A.polish: „Taa, Al” – rzuca mu ostre spojrzenie. „I my też jej nie znajdziemy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA7A.belarusian: "Ага, Эл, — ён кідае востры позірк. — І мы таксама не знойдзем".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA84.english: *Evrart* has a file on you, but that's bogus. What she knows comes from somewhere else -- from Jamrock. It must be *real* stuff.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA84.polish: *Evrart* ma na twój temat kartotekę, ale to jakieś bzdety. To, co wie ona, pochodzi z innego źródła. Z Jamrock. To muszą być *prawdziwe* informacje.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA84.belarusian: У *Эўрара* ёсць дасье на цябе, але гэта лухта. Тое, што ведае яна, паходзіць з іншага месца — з Джэмрока. Гэта павінна быць нешта *рэальнае*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA8A.belarusian: "Вы ўсе тут. Хто ж тады шукае?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA90.english: "She's not really a..." The man stares into his beer. "Hardie candidate anymore, is she?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA90.polish: „Ona nie jest już...” – mężczyzna gapi się w swoje piwo – „...kandydatką na Hardiego, co nie?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA90.belarusian: "Яна больш не зусім... — мужчына ўзіраецца ў сваё піва, — ...кандыдатка ў хлопцы Хардзі, так?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA96.english: Right. That's the second one now who's trying to flee you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA96.polish: Tak. To już druga, która próbuje ci się wymknąć.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DA96.belarusian: Так. Гэта ўжо другая, якая спрабуе ўцячы ад цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAA2.english: "You said it would be nice to have a ballistics lab. You could use ours."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAA2.polish: „Mówiłeś, że miło by było mieć laboratorium balistyczne. Możecie używać naszego”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAA2.belarusian: "Ты казаў, што добра было б мець балістычную лабараторыю. Вы маглі б карыстацца нашай".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAA8.english: That will only piss him off. He's not going to yap about Evrart.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAA8.polish: To go tylko wkurzy. Nie będzie gadał na Evrarta.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAA8.belarusian: Гэта толькі раззлуе яго. Ён не збіраецца плявузгаць пра Эўрара.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAB6.english: "Could she have gotten this info from... Evrart?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAB6.belarusian: "Яна магла атрымаць гэтую інфармацыю ад... Эўрара?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAC0.english: No -- he already is a sergeant. That's what you're feeling. He just wasn't sure what *you* are.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAC0.polish: Nie. On już jest sierżantem. Czujesz to. Nie był tylko pewien, czym jesteś *ty*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAC0.belarusian: Не — ён ужо сяржант. Вось што ты адчуваеш. Ён проста не быў упэўнены, хто *ты* такі.

Alternate1/0x010000820001DACE.polish: „Wybrzeże to niebezpieczne miejsce dla stróżów prawa. Zwłaszcza dla pana Otwieracza Puszek”.
Alternate1/0x010000820001DACE.belarusian: "Узбярэжжа — небяспечнае месца для законнікаў. Асабліва для спадара Адкаркоўніка".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DADA.english: "Why not?" He looks at your chest. "You look about ready to do something pretty crazy because some bird fucked you over."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DADA.polish: „Czemu nie?” – pyta, wpatrując się w twoją pierś. „Wyglądasz, jakbyś był gotowy na zrobienie czegoś nieźle porąbanego, bo jakaś sikorka cię wydymała”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DADA.belarusian: "Чаму б і не? — ён глядзіць на твае грудзі. — Ты выглядаеш гатовым учыніць нейкае дзікае глупства праз тое, што нейкая цёлка цябе кінула".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAE5.english: You and I are going to dance in the moonlight under a billion stars.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAE5.polish: Ty i ja zatańczymy w blasku księżyca, pod miliardem gwiazd.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAE5.belarusian: Мы з табой будзем танчыць у месячным святле пад мільярдам зорак.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAEB.english: "Rich-boy law is a sham." He shakes his hand. "It only works for the Wild Pines lady. So keep your lab -- and watch your ass out there."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAEB.polish: „Prawo bogatych chłoptasiów to ściema” – odpowiada, potrząsając jego dłonią. „Działa tylko dla paniusi z Wild Pines. Więc zatrzymajcie sobie to swoje laboratorium – i uważajcie na siebie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAEB.belarusian: "Закон багаценькіх хлапчукоў — гэта фікцыя, — ён паціскае яму руку. — Ён працуе толькі на паненку з Wild Pines. Так што пакіньце сваю лабараторыю сабе — і глядзіце ў абодва".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAFB.english: "Yeah, there was something else. She wouldn't tell me though. I could see she wanted to. It was *burning* on her lips: 'This cop, Titus, this cop, he...' But she was too scared."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAFB.polish: „Taa, było coś jeszcze. Ale nie powiedziała mi, co. Chociaż widziałem, że tego chce. To *wyrywało* się z jej ust: »Ten glina, Titus – ten glina, on...«, ale za bardzo się bała”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DAFB.belarusian: "Ага, было яшчэ сёе-тое. Толькі яна не стала казаць. Але я бачыў, што хацела. Гэта літаральна *гарэла* ў яе на вуснах: 'Гэты коп, Цітус, гэты коп, ён...' Але яна надта спалохалася".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB01.english: "Why not? You suck on that gun like someone tore you a brand new asshole."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB01.polish: „Czemu nie? Zassałeś lufę tej spluwy, jakby ktoś cię nieźle wydymał”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB01.belarusian: "Чаму б і не? Ты смактаў гэты ствол так, нібыта табе парвалі сраку на брытанскі сцяг".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB1E.english: Sure. It was someone else. It appears we have a *ninth* Hardie boy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB1E.polish: Jasne. To był ktoś inny. Zdaje się, że mamy też *dziewiątego* chłopaka Hardiego.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB1E.belarusian: Вядома. Гэта быў нехта іншы. Здаецца, у нас з'явіўся *дзевяты* хлопец Хардзі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB24.english: "Where have you looked for her, more precisely?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB31.english: "More precisely? On the *coast*. Past the water lock." He nods southwest. "She's not here, so I'm thinking she's there."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB31.polish: „Dokładniej? Na *wybrzeżu*. Za śluzą” – skinieniem głowy wskazuje południowy zachód. „Nie jest stąd, więc myślę, że właśnie tam się ukrywa”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB31.belarusian: "Канкрэтна? На *ўзбярэжжы*. За шлюзам, — ён ківае на паўднёвы захад. — Тут яе няма, таму я мяркую, што яна там".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB37.english: *Who's* doing this looking? They're all here.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB37.polish: *Kto* zajmuje się tymi poszukiwaniami? Wszyscy są tutaj.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB37.belarusian: *Хто* яе шукаў? Яны ж усе тут.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB3D.english: And he still isn't. People aren't afraid of good cops in the way Ruby was afraid of you, he thinks, then turns back to his men.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB3D.polish: I wciąż nie jest. Ludzie nie boją się dobrych gliniarzy tak, jak Ruby bała się ciebie – myśli. Po chwili odwraca się do swoich ludzi.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB3D.belarusian: І ён дагэтуль не ўпэўнены. Людзі не баяцца добрых копаў так, як Рубі баялася цябе, думае ён, пасля чаго паварочваецца назад да сваіх хлопцаў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB48.english: "When are you gonna get it through your dumb head?" He scoffs. "I already *am*, I just wasn't sure you were."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB48.polish: „Kiedy wreszcie wbijesz to sobie do tego swojego durnego łba?” – prycha. „*Już* nim jestem – za to nie byłem pewny co do ciebie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001DB48.belarusian: "Калі ты ўжо ўб'еш гэта ў сваю тупую галаву? — ён хмыкае. — Я *ўжо* ён і ёсць, гэта я не быў упэўнены наконт цябе".

Alternate1/0x010000820001DB48.polish: „Kiedy wreszcie wbijesz to sobie do tego swojego samobójczego łba?” – prycha. „*Już* nim jestem – za to nie byłem pewny co do ciebie”.
Alternate1/0x010000820001DB48.belarusian: "Калі ты ўжо ўб'еш гэта ў сваю самагубчую галаву? — ён хмыкае. — Я *ўжо* ён і ёсць — гэта я не быў упэўнены наконт цябе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800010885.english: Never -- not until the case is solved. And then the next case. And the next...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800010885.polish: Nigdy. Dopóki nie rozwiążesz tej sprawy. A potem następnej. I następnej...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800010885.belarusian: Ніколі — пакуль справа не будзе раскрытая. А потым наступная справа. І наступная...

Dialogue Text/0x010000780001088D.english: And then when they're all empty, just move on. Unto the next can. Don't look back -- unless there was something you *missed*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000780001088D.polish: A kiedy już są puści, ruszasz dalej. Żeby otworzyć kolejną. Nie spoglądaj wstecz. Chyba że coś *przegapiłeś*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000780001088D.belarusian: А калі яны апусцеюць, проста ідзі далей. Да наступнай бляшанкі. Не азірайся назад — хіба што ты нешта *ўпусціў*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800010897.english: "Not until you *have* something on her. She said she's heard of you from Jamrock. That you're a human can-opener. That you play suspects against each other. Open them up, like cans."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800010897.polish: „Dopóki nie *znajdziesz* czegoś na nią. Powiedziała, że słyszała pogłoski o tobie z Jamrock. Że jesteś otwieraczem ludzkich puszek. Że napuszczasz na siebie podejrzanych. Otwierasz ich – jak puszki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800010897.belarusian: "Пакуль не *знойдзеш* нешта на яе. Казала, чула пра цябе з Джэмрока. Што ты чалавечы адкаркоўнік. Што ты ствараеш інтрыгі і сцвярбоўваеш падазраваных між сабой. Адкаркоўваеш іх, як бляшанкі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000820001EC14.english: "The elevator is *outside* the building. It's an old dumbwaiter -- used for moving pinball machines up and down from the workshop."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001EC14.polish: „Winda znajduje się *na zewnątrz* budynku. To stara winda kuchenna – używana do przewożenia automatów do pinballa z i do warsztatu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820001EC14.belarusian: "Ліфт знаходзіцца *звонку* будынка. Гэта стары малы грузавы пад'ёмнік — на ім падымалі і спускалі пінбольныя аўтаматы з майстэрні".

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003942.english: I fear we just can't piece this puzzle together. At this point, the only sensible thing to do is get someone else to put the pieces together.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003942.polish: Obawiam się, że nie zdołamy ułożyć tej układanki. Jedyna sensowna rzecz, jaką można teraz zrobić, to dać ją do ułożenia komuś innemu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003942.belarusian: Баюся, мы проста не можам скласці гэты пазл. На гэтым этапе адзінае разумнае выйсце — каб хтосьці іншы сабраў гэтыя кавалачкі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003948.english: (Whisper) "Kim, you've had long enough to come up with a theory. What'cha got?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003948.polish: (Szepnij). „Kim, miałeś sporo czasu, żeby stworzyć jakąś teorię. Jak poszło?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003948.belarusian: (Шэптам.) "Кім, у цябе было дастаткова часу, каб прыдумаць тэорыю. Што ў цябе ёсць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000397E.english: No, I want to do this all by myself!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000397E.polish: Nie. Chcę to wszystko zrobić sam!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000397E.belarusian: Не, я хачу зрабіць усё сам!

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000399E.english: Suit yourself! But remember, you're the one putting yourself through this hassle.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000399E.polish: Jak wolisz! Pamiętaj tylko, że sam sobie dokładasz wysiłku.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000399E.belarusian: Як хочаш! Але памятай: гэта ты сам ствараеш сабе лішні галаўны боль.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039AE.english: But the lieutenant isn't here. What am I supposed to do without him?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039AE.polish: Ale porucznika tu nie ma. Co ja mam zrobić bez niego?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039AE.belarusian: Але лейтэнанта тут няма. Што мне рабіць без яго?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039B9.english: Easy! If the lieutenant isn't here, you should find him and attempt this again while he's with you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039B9.polish: Spokojnie! Jeśli porucznika tu nie ma, powinieneś go poszukać i spróbować jeszcze raz, kiedy będzie z tobą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039B9.belarusian: Усё проста! Калі лейтэнанта тут няма, табе варта знайсці яго і паспрабаваць яшчэ раз, калі ён будзе з табой.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039C1.english: "I think it's best we just dive in," he whispers back, before turning to Titus and asking: "What makes you so sure Ruby *didn't* kill him?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039C1.polish: „Myślę, że najlepiej po prostu przejść do rzeczy” – odpowiada szeptem, po czym zwraca się do Titusa: „Skąd pewność, że Ruby go *nie* zabiła?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039C1.belarusian: "Думаю, лепей адразу перайсці да справы", — шэпча ён у адказ, пасля чаго паварочваецца да Цітуса і пытаецца: "Чаму вы так упэўненыя, што Рубі яго *не* забівала?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039CF.english: The lieutenant looks around the room, evidently enjoying the moment's respite. But before long, he puts his hand on your shoulder. "Unless we have more business, we should..." He looks to the door.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039CF.polish: Porucznik rozgląda się wokoło, najwyraźniej ciesząc się chwilą wytchnienia. Po chwili jednak kładzie swoją dłoń na twoim ramieniu. „Jeśli to już wszystko, to powinniśmy...” – spogląda na drzwi.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039CF.belarusian: Лейтэнант азірае пакой, відавочна атрымліваючы асалоду ад кароткай перадышкі. Але неўзабаве ён кладзе руку табе на плячо. "Калі ў нас тут больш няма спраў, нам варта..." - Ён глядзіць на дзверы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039EF.english: Can't get through the door? You know what would help -- doing a *thorough* search of this room! Maybe something's hidden.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039EF.polish: Nie możesz przejść przez drzwi? Wiesz, co by pomogło? *Dokładne* przeszukanie tego pomieszczenia! Może coś tu jest ukryte.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039EF.belarusian: Не можаш прайсці праз дзверы? Ведаеш, што дапаможа? *Грунтоўны* ператрус гэтага пакоя! Можа, тут нешта схавана.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039F5.english: There's a *spooky* building West of this. Take a flashlight with you, search the basement. There are secrets -- magisterial, ancient secrets that may assist you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039F5.polish: Na zachód stąd stoi *złowrogi* budynek. Weź latarkę, przeszukaj piwnicę. Skrywa tajemnice. Władcze, pradawne tajemnice, które mogą ci pomóc.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039F5.belarusian: На захад адсюль ёсць *жудасны* будынак. Вазьмі з сабой ліхтарык, абшукай склеп. Там схаваныя таямніцы — велічныя, старажытныя таямніцы, якія могуць табе дапамагчы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039FB.english: Hey! Did someone say something already? No? Yes? Who cares! Upstairs, in Klaasje's bedroom -- the window the bullet came through. Analyse that!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039FB.polish: Hej! Ktoś już coś powiedział? Nie? Tak? Nieważne! Na piętrze, w sypialni Klaasje. Okno, które rozbiła kula. Przeanalizuj je!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000039FB.belarusian: Гэй! Нехта ўжо нешта сказаў? Не? Так? Каму якая розніца! Наверсе, у спальні Клаас'е — акно, праз якое праляцела куля. Прааналізуй яго!

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A01.english: Reporting for duty! A *thorough* search of this Union box may help unearth something *incriminating*! Pin it on her -- she's been here, right?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A01.polish: Zgłaszam się na służbę! *Dokładne* przeszukanie sali Związku może ujawnić coś *obciążającego*! Dowal jej tym. W końcu tu była, nie?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A01.belarusian: Гатовы да службы! *Грунтоўны* ператрус гэтай ложы Прафсаюза можа дапамагчы раскапаць нешта *выкрывальнае*! Павесь усё на яе — яна ж была тут, так?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A11.english: For starters, you could search the Whirling-in-Rags for hidden passages she could have used to get to the roof. There's a door in the *kitchen* I've had my eye on for a while...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A11.polish: Na dobry początek można by poszukać w Whirling-in-Rags ukrytych przejść, którymi mogła dostać się na dach. W *kuchni* są drzwi, które już jakiś czas temu wpadły mi oko...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A11.belarusian: Для пачатку ты мог бы пашукаць у Whirling-in-Rags патаемныя хады, якімі яна магла скарыстацца, каб падняцца на дах. На *кухні* ёсць адны дзверы, на якія я ўжо даўно паклаў вока...

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A26.english: For starters, you could find out what's behind that mystery door in the kitchen. If it's a secret route, she could have used that to get to the roof!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A26.polish: Na dobry początek można by sprawdzić, co jest w tych tajemniczych kuchennych drzwiach. Jeśli to tajne przejście, to mogła go użyć, żeby wejść na dach!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A26.belarusian: Для пачатку ты мог бы высветліць, што хаваецца за тымі таямнічымі дзвярыма на кухні. Калі гэта таемны праход, яна магла скарыстацца ім, каб трапіць на дах!

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A31.english: Wow, you've been very thorough. There's nothing else to add -- just crack that Klaasje's defences. Maybe she'll tell you something helpful?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A31.polish: O rany, byłeś bardzo dokładny. Nie ma nic więcej do dodania. Po prostu złam ten opór Klaasje. Może powie ci coś przydatnego?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A31.belarusian: Ого, ты быў вельмі грунтоўны. Больш няма чаго дадаць — проста зламай абарону гэтай Клаас'е. Можа, яна раскажа нешта карыснае?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A37.english: You could crack that Klaasje's defences. Maybe she'll tell you something helpful?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A37.polish: Mógłbyś próbować złamać opór tej Klaasje. Może powie ci coś przydatnego?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A37.belarusian: Ты мог бы зламаць абарону гэтай Клаас'е. Можа, яна раскажа нешта карыснае?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A5B.english: Thanks guys. Let's get moving again.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A5B.polish: Dzięki, panowie. Ruszajmy z tym dalej.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A60.english: Not just yet -- can't we review the components of the theory?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A60.polish: Jeszcze nie. Moglibyśmy powtórzyć, jakie elementy ma nasza teoria?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A60.belarusian: Пакуль не — хіба мы не можам паўтарыць складнікі гэтай тэорыі?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A71.english: Sure. Why not? Let's hear what some of our friends have to say.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A71.polish: Oczywiście. Czemu nie? Posłuchajmy, co mają do powiedzenia nasi przyjaciele.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003A71.belarusian: Вядома. Чаму б і не? Давай паслухаем, што скажуць некаторыя з нашых сяброў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003AA3.english: It's very unlikely to help, but sure. We can go to Theory Town.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003AA3.polish: To raczej na pewno nie pomoże, ale nie ma sprawy. Wybierzmy się na spacer po Teoriowie Dolnym.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003AA3.belarusian: Наўрад ці гэта дапаможа, але давай. Можам схадзіць у Гарадок Тэорый.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003AA9.english: Got it. Now get me moving again, please.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003AA9.polish: Dobra. A teraz nakłońcie mnie do ruszenia, proszę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003AA9.belarusian: Зразумеў. А цяпер прымусьце мяне рухацца далей, калі ласка.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003ABD.english: Sure thing. But before anything else -- can I venture to Theory Town?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003ABD.polish: Jasna sprawa. Ale mogę przedtem udać się do Teoriowa Dolnego?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00003ABD.belarusian: Вядома. Але перад гэтым — ці магу я наведаць Гарадок Тэорый?

Dialogue Text/0x01000097000040A6.english: "When are you gonna get it through your dumb head?" He scoffs. "I already *am*, I just wasn't sure you were."
Dialogue Text/0x01000097000040A6.polish: „Kiedy wreszcie wbijesz to sobie do tego swojego durnego łba?” – prycha. „*Już* nim jestem – za to nie byłem pewny co do ciebie”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000097000040A6.belarusian: "Калі ты ўжо ўб'еш гэта ў сваю тупую галаву? — ён хмыкае. — Я *ўжо* ён і ёсць, гэта я не быў упэўнены наконт цябе".

Alternate1/0x01000097000040A6.polish: „Kiedy wreszcie wbijesz to sobie do tego swojego samobójczego łba?” – prycha. „*Już* nim jestem – za to nie byłem pewny co do ciebie”.
Alternate1/0x01000097000040A6.belarusian: "Калі ты ўжо ўб'еш гэта ў сваю самагубчую галаву? — ён хмыкае. — Я *ўжо* ён і ёсць — гэта я не быў упэўнены наконт цябе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014599.english: Just me, huh? Wow. Well... Good luck!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014599.polish: Nikt poza mną, co? O rany. No cóż... Powodzenia!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014599.belarusian: Толькі я, так? Ого. Ну... Поспехаў!

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000145B6.english: Just me, huh? Wow. Well... Good luck!
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000145B6.polish: Nikt poza mną, co? O rany. No cóż... Powodzenia!
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000145B6.belarusian: Толькі я, так? Ого. Ну... Поспехаў!

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000145D9.english: "Still, there's definitely something there to check out..." He turns the Eugene. "We need to have a look at that secret passage, boys."
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000145D9.polish: „Mimo to zdecydowanie trzeba to sprawdzić...” – stwierdza, po czym zwraca się do Eugene'a: „Musimy rzucić okiem na to sekretne przejście, chłopaki”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000145D9.belarusian: "Але там дакладна ёсць што праверыць... - ён паварочваецца да Эжэна. - Трэба нам зірнуць на гэты таемны праход, хлопцы".

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000145F1.english: "I see. But what's back there, I mean -- storage rooms or shit?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000145F1.polish: „Rozumiem. Ale co jest za tymi drzwiami – jakieś magazyny czy coś?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000145F1.belarusian: "Ясна. Але што там ззаду, у сэнсе — кладоўкі ці што?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000145F7.english: "... a secret passage. That leads to the roof."

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000145FC.english: "I'll level with you, Titus. I've still got to check it out."
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000145FC.polish: „Będę z tobą szczery, Titus. Muszę to jeszcze sprawdzić”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000145FC.belarusian: "Буду шчыры з табой, Цітус. Мне яшчэ трэба там усё праверыць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014601.english: "Wild stuff, Titus. Stuff you're not prepared to believe."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014601.polish: „Wariactwa, Titus. Nie uwierzyłbyś nawet, gdybym ci powiedział”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014601.belarusian: "Там дзіч, Цітус. Рэчы, у якія ты пакуль не гатовы паверыць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014609.english: "You've not even been back there, have you?" The big guy sighs at his beer. "Fuckin' clown. Honest to god, this shit is only funny in the circus."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014609.polish: „Nawet tam nie zajrzałeś, co nie?” – olbrzym pyta, wzdychając do swojego piwa. „Pieprzony klaun. Cholera jasna, te wygłupy są śmieszne tylko w cyrku”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014609.belarusian: "Ты нават там не быў, так? - здаравяк уздыхае над сваім півам. - Ябучы блазан. Ей-богу, такія прыколы смешныя толькі ў цырку".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001460E.english: The big man pinches the bridge of his nose. "Course you do, clown. Of fucking course. That's how you do it in the Revachol Circus Militia."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001460E.polish: Olbrzym ściska palcami podstawę swojego nosa. „Oczywiście, klaunie. No, oczywiście, kurwa. Tak właśnie działacie w tej swojej Milicji Obciachowej Revacholu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001460E.belarusian: Здаравяк сціскае пераноссе. "Вядома, што трэба, блазан. Ясна ж, бляха. Вось так вы і працуеце ў сваёй Рэвашольскай цыркавой міліцыі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014613.english: "Cop, I'm gonna stop you right there." He pushes up his hat. "I'll save you the embarrassment -- I won't force you to tell me you've not been back there."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014613.polish: „Glino, przerwę ci” – stwierdza, unosząc daszek swojej czapki. „Oszczędzę ci upokorzenia – nie zmuszę cię do przyznania, że nawet tam nie zajrzałeś”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014613.belarusian: "Копе, я цябе адразу спыню, - ён папраўляе казырок. - Пашкадую цябе ад ганьбы — не буду прымушаць прызнавацца, што ты там нават не быў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001463E.english: "While we cannot say for certain right *now*, we *will* find out."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001463E.polish: „Chociaż *jeszcze* nie mamy pewności, to *wkrótce* się dowiemy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001463E.belarusian: "Хоць проста *зараз* мы не можам сказаць напэўна, мы гэта *высветлім*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014644.english: "Sure, cops, sure..." he turns the Eugene. "We need to have a look at that secret passage, boys."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014644.polish: „Jasne, gliny, jasne...” – stwierdza, po czym zwraca się do Eugene'a: „Musimy rzucić okiem na to sekretne przejście, chłopaki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014644.belarusian: "Ну-ну, копы, вядома... - ён паварочваецца да Эжэна. - Трэба нам зірнуць на гэты таемны праход, хлопцы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014653.english: "I don't know, but I'll find out."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001465E.english: "Sure, cop, sure..." he turns the Eugene. "We need to have a look at that secret passage, boys."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001465E.polish: „Jasne, glino, jasne...” – stwierdza, po czym zwraca się do Eugene'a: „Musimy rzucić okiem na to sekretne przejście, chłopaki”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001465E.belarusian: "Ну-ну, копе, вядома... - ён паварочваецца да Эжэна. - Трэба нам зірнуць на гэты таемны праход, хлопцы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014668.english: "You got it boss! Professional law enforcement will investigate."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014668.polish: „Jasna sprawa, szefie. Zawodowi stróże prawa się temu przyjrzą”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014668.belarusian: "Будзе зроблена, бос! Прафесійныя ахоўнікі парадку правядуць расследаванне".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001466F.english: The big guy smiles. "You got something else to back this route up? Or is that it?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001466F.polish: Olbrzym uśmiecha się. „Masz coś jeszcze, co poparłoby tę hipotezę? Czy to już wszystko?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001466F.belarusian: Здаравяк усміхаецца. "У цябе ёсць яшчэ нешта, каб пацвердзіць гэты маршрут? Ці гэта ўсё?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014678.english: "The elevator is on the *outer wall* of the building. It's an old dumbwaiter -- used for moving pinball machines up and down from the workshop."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014678.polish: „Winda znajduje się *na zewnętrznej ścianie* budynku. To stara winda kuchenna – używana do przewożenia automatów do pinballa z i do warsztatu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014678.belarusian: "Ліфт знаходзіцца на *вонкавай сцяне* будынка. Гэта стары кухонны пад'ёмнік — на ім падымалі і спускалі пінбольныя аўтаматы з майстэрні".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001467F.english: The big guy takes a long, considered gulp of beer. "And? How does she come into it?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001467F.polish: Olbrzym bierze potężny, przemyślany łyk piwa. „I? Co ona ma z tym wspólnego?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001467F.belarusian: Здаравяк робіць доўгі, разважлівы глыток піва. "І? Якім бокам яна тут?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014684.english: "Ruby could have gone up -- shot him -- come down -- all under seven minutes."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014684.polish: „Ruby mogła dostać się na górę, zastrzelić go i zjechać na dół – wszystko to w niecałe siedem minut”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014684.belarusian: "Рубі магла падняцца наверх — застрэліць яго — спусціцца — і ўсё менш чым за сем хвілін".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014705.english: "And I suppose you have a theory on that?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014705.polish: „I pewnie masz na ten temat jakąś hipotezę?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014705.belarusian: "І я мяркую, у цябе і на гэты конт ёсць тэорыя?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001471C.english: "But she didn't! This is fucking stupid, Titus. This and the queer thing, all of it!" The blond man looks around. "Why aren't more of you defending her? This is fucking stupid, Titus."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001471C.polish: „Ale ona tego nie zrobiła! To jakaś pieprzona głupota, Titus. To i ta gadka, o byciu homo – i wszystko!” – blondyn rozgląda się wokoło. „Dlaczego jej nie bronicie? To jakaś pieprzona głupota, Titus”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001471C.belarusian: "Але яна гэтага не рабіла! Гэта блядская лухта, Цітус. Гэта і гэтыя размовы пра лесбіянку, усё гэта! — бландзін азіраецца. — Чаму вы яе не абараняеце? Гэта блядская лухта, Цітус".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001472B.english: "Fuck you, man, I would never fuck my guys over like that." He squeaks with indignation. "Especially for some bird..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001472B.polish: „Pierdol się, typku. W życiu bym tak nie wydymał swoich kumpli” – piszczy zagniewany. „A już na pewno nie dla jakiejś panienki...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001472B.belarusian: "Парайся, чалавеча, я б ніколі так не падставіў сваіх хлопцаў, — пішчыць ён ад абурэння. — Асабліва дзеля нейкай цёлкі..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014735.english: "Which is why she didn't! This is fucking stupid, Titus. This and the queer thing, all of it!" The blond man waves his beer around. "Why aren't more of you defending her? This is fucking stupid, Titus."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014735.polish: „I właśnie dlatego ona tego nie zrobiła! To jakaś pieprzona głupota, Titus. To i ta gadka, o byciu homo – i wszystko!” – blondyn wymachuje swoim piwem. „Dlaczego jej nie bronicie? To jakaś pieprzona głupota, Titus”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014735.belarusian: "Вось таму яна гэтага і не рабіла! Гэта блядская лухта, Цітус. Гэта і гэтыя размовы пра лесбіянку, усё гэта! — бландзін размахвае півам. — Чаму вы яе не абараняеце? Гэта блядская лухта, Цітус".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014774.english: He sighs heavily. "Anything else you want, cop?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400014774.belarusian: Ён цяжка ўздыхае: "Яшчэ чагосьці хочаш, копе?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002900001DFC.english: "Boyish. Hair's red, dyed. She looks like a lorryman."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002900001DFC.polish: „Męska uroda. Włosy czerwone, farbowane. Wygląda jak kierowca ciężarówki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002900001DFC.belarusian: "Хлапчукаватая. Валасы рудыя, фарбаваныя. Выглядае як кіроўца грузавіка".

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000151F5.english: "Do you know what she's doing with Ulan frequencies?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000151F5.belarusian: "Ты ведаеш, што яна робіць з частатамі ULAN?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015202.english: "The what now? I've no idea." He looks around. "Boys?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015202.polish: „Z czym? Nie mam pojęcia” – rozgląda się. „Chłopaki?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015202.belarusian: "З чым-чым? Паняцця не маю, — ён азіраецца. — Хлопцы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015209.english: "She said she's... building a..." His voice is very quiet. "A pale emitter."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015209.polish: „Twierdzi, że... buduje...” – mówi bardzo cicho – „...emiter szaroty”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015209.belarusian: "Яна казала, што... будуе... — ягоны голас вельмі ціхі. — Цьмянавы выпраменьвальнік".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015217.english: "We were talkin' about radio equipment. She said she's doing Ulan frequencies and a pale-something. I don't know more."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015217.polish: „Rozmawialiśmy o sprzęcie radiowym. Mówiła, że zajmuje się częstotliwościami ULAN i czymś związanym z szarotą. Więcej nie wiem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015217.belarusian: "Мы гаварылі пра радыёабсталяванне. Яна казала, што працуе з частатамі ULAN і нечым там з цьмянасцю. Больш я нічога не ведаю".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001521E.english: This guy barely understands what he's talking about.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001521E.polish: Facet ledwo rozumie, co sam mówi.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001521E.belarusian: Гэты хлопец ледзь разумее, пра што сам гаворыць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015231.english: "There you have it. Pale-something." Titus puts an end to it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015231.polish: „Słyszałeś. Coś tam do szaroty” – zamyka temat.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015231.belarusian: "Вось табе і адказ. Нешта там з цьмянасцю", — Цітус ставіць кропку.

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000172D1.english: It's called a... radio, you believe. The gardener may have played you again when she stormed out. She has her own plan.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000172D1.polish: To się nazywa... Zdaje się, że radio. Ogrodniczka mogła cię znów wykiwać, kiedy stąd tak nagle wyszła. Ma swój własny plan.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000172D1.belarusian: Гэта называецца... рацыя, здаецца. Садоўніца магла зноў цябе абвесці вакол пальца, калі вылецела адсюль. У яе свой уласны план.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001C09E.english: Stop thinking about your lost gun, dammit. You'll get a heart attack.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001C09E.polish: Przestań myśleć o tej zgubionej spluwie, do cholery. Bo zawału w końcu dostaniesz.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001C09E.belarusian: Перастань думаць пра свой згублены пісталет, халера. Інфаркт схопіш.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D22E.english: "I'll start there. One more question: what does Ruby look like?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D22E.polish: „Więc tam zaczniemy. Jeszcze jedno pytanie: jak wygląda Ruby?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D22E.belarusian: "Я пачну адтуль. Яшчэ адно пытанне: як выглядае Рубі?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D3AC.english: It feels like you'll get to know -- soon enough.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D3AC.polish: Masz wrażenie, że się dowiesz. I to całkiem niedługo.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001D3AC.belarusian: Здаецца, ты хутка пра гэта даведаешся.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013159.english: Could this *complex operation* be the one Joyce asked you to look into? Probably, though they'll never open up about it. You'll have to keep investigating!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013159.polish: Czy ta *skomplikowana operacja* może być tym, o sprawdzenie czego prosiła cię Joyce? Pewnie tak, choć w życiu ci nic o niej nie powiedzą. Musisz sam badać sprawę dalej!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013159.belarusian: Ці можа гэтая *складаная аперацыя* быць той самай справай, якую Джойс прасіла цябе расследаваць? Хутчэй за ўсё, хоць яны ніколі пра гэта не раскажуць. Табе давядзецца працягваць расследаванне!

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013160.english: Of course! Ruby is the lady driver in this great big *Jam Mystery*! Probably. You'll have to keep investigating -- they'll never open up about it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013160.polish: Oczywiście! Ruby jest kierowczynią w tej wielkiej *tajemnicy korka*! Zapewne. Musisz badać sprawę dalej. Oni ci w życiu nic nie powiedzą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013160.belarusian: Вядома ж! Рубі — гэта кіроўца ў гэтай вялікай *Таямніцы корка*! Хутчэй за ўсё. Табе давядзецца працягваць расследаванне — яны ніколі пра гэта не раскажуць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013178.english: You know this already. It all fits together: Ruby, the missing Hardie, was present at the hanging and running the drug trade.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013178.polish: Już to wiesz. Wszystko do siebie pasuje: Ruby, brakująca osoba od Hardiego, była obecna podczas wieszania i siedzi w narkobiznesie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013178.belarusian: Ты гэта ўжо ведаеш. Усё сыходзіцца: Рубі, адсутная з хлопцаў Хардзі, прысутнічала пры павешанні і запраўляла наркагандлем.

Dialogue Text/0x010000420000008A.english: Say... Hard to remember with your brain in overload, but have you smoked lately? A cigarette may help you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000420000008A.polish: Wiesz co...? Trudno zapamiętać przy takim przeciążeniu mózgu, ale kiedy ostatnio paliłeś? Papieros mógłby ci pomóc.
Dialogue Text/0x010000420000008A.belarusian: Слухай... Цяжка ўспомніць, калі твае мазгі перагружаныя, але ты курыў апошнім часам? Цыгарэта магла б табе дапамагчы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000420000008F.english: YES! Huff and puff and *blow* this case wide open!
Dialogue Text/0x010000420000008F.polish: Tak! Zaciągnij się porządnie i *zdmuchnij* zasłonę z tajemnic tej sprawy!
Dialogue Text/0x010000420000008F.belarusian: ТАК! Зацягніся мацней і *выверні* гэтую справу навыварат!

Dialogue Text/0x01000042000000B0.english: Say... Hard to remember with your brain in overload, but have you smoked lately? A cigarette may help you.
Dialogue Text/0x01000042000000B0.polish: Wiesz co...? Trudno zapamiętać przy takim przeciążeniu mózgu, ale kiedy ostatnio paliłeś? Papieros mógłby ci pomóc.
Dialogue Text/0x01000042000000B0.belarusian: Слухай... Цяжка ўспомніць, калі твае мазгі перагружаныя, але ты курыў апошнім часам? Цыгарэта магла б табе дапамагчы.

Dialogue Text/0x01000042000000B6.english: YES! Huff and puff and *blow* this case wide open!
Dialogue Text/0x01000042000000B6.polish: Tak! Zaciągnij się porządnie i *zdmuchnij* zasłonę z tajemnic tej sprawy!
Dialogue Text/0x01000042000000B6.belarusian: ТАК! Зацягніся мацней і *выверні* гэтую справу навыварат!

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003104.english: Hey! Lost gun right here! Lost and found!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000003104.belarusian: Гэй! Згублены ствол проста тут! Бюро знаходак!

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C82.english: Wait... No, something about this bunch doesn't smell right...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C82.polish: Chwila... Nie, coś ci w tej bandzie nie pasuje...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C82.belarusian: Пачакай... Не, чымсьці ад гэтай хэўры нясе...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C89.english: What do you mean? Aren't they Evrart's guys?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C89.polish: Co masz na myśli? To nie są ludzie Evrarta?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C89.belarusian: Што ты маеш на ўвазе? Хіба гэта не людзі Эўрара?

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C8F.english: Alright, guess I'll look elsewhere then. [Leave.]
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C8F.polish: No dobra, w takim razie rozejrzę się gdzie indziej. [Odejdź].
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C8F.belarusian: Добра, думаю, пашукаю недзе ў іншым месцы. [Адысці.]

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C98.english: They are, but they don't seem too keen to talk with you, do they?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C98.polish: Są, ale nie wyglądają, jakby byli szczególnie chętni do rozmowy z tobą, nieprawdaż?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C98.belarusian: Так, вось толькі яны не імкнуцца размаўляць з табой, ці не так?

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C9F.english: Besides, you're pretty sure they consider themselves social democrats.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C9F.polish: Poza tym jesteś raczej pewien, że uważają się za socjaldemokratów.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002C9F.belarusian: Да таго ж, ты амаль перакананы, што яны лічаць сябе сацыял-дэмакратамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CA6.english: No, they don't. Glen seems to be contemplating grievous bodily harm while he massages his raw knuckles...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CA6.polish: Nie, nie są. Glen wydaje się kontemplować zadawanie poważnych obrażeń ciała, masując swoje poobijane knykcie...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CA6.belarusian: Не, не імкнуцца. Глен, здаецца, думае пра нанясенне цяжкіх цялесных, пакуль размінае свае збітыя ў кроў кулакі...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CAB.english: And from his perch at the end of the table, Titus Hardie himself stares at you with a cold contempt that makes you want to leave the cafeteria straightaway.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CAB.polish: A ze swojej grzędy u szczytu stołu Titus Hardie wpatruje się w ciebie z zimną pogardą, od której masz ochotę opuścić bar.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CAB.belarusian: А са свайго седала на самым краі стала сам Цітус Хардзі глядзіць на цябе з такой халоднай пагардай, што хочацца пакінуць бар неадкладна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CB0.english: In the far back, Eugene is doing his best to ignore you...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CB0.polish: Siedzący w głębi Eugene za wszelką cenę próbuje cię ignorować...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CB0.belarusian: Дзесьці на задворках Эжэн прыкладае ўсе намаганні, каб цябе не заўважаць...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CC0.english: What do you mean? Who are they?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CC0.polish: Co masz na myśli? Kim oni są?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CC0.belarusian: Што ты маеш на ўвазе? Хто яны?

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CC7.english: You may not know them, but they seem to know exactly who *you* are...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CC7.polish: Ty ich może nie znasz, ale oni zdają się bardzo dobrze wiedzieć, kim *jesteś*...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CC7.belarusian: Можа, ты іх і не ведаеш, але яны, здаецца, дакладна ведаюць, кім ёсць *ты*...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CD6.english: A little man, hardly bigger than a child, with a lean, hateful face...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CD6.polish: Drobny mężczyzna, dziecięcego niemal wzrostu, ze szczupłą twarzą o nienawistnym wyrazie...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CD6.belarusian: Шчуплы мужчына, ледзь большы за дзіця, з хударлявым, напоўненым нянавісцю тварам...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CDB.english: You've seen the expression on this one's face before, on a dozen hardened thieves and killers...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CDB.polish: Widziałeś już taką minę u niejednego starego złodzieja i zabójcy...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CDB.belarusian: Ты ўжо бачыў такі выраз твару раней — у мноства мацёрых злодзеяў і забойцаў...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CE0.english: And here, guarding the entrance to his den, the undisputed alpha wolf, radiating contempt for you and all you represent.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CE0.polish: A tu, strzegący wejścia do swego legowiska niekwestionowany wilk alfa emanujący pogardą do ciebie i wszystkiego, co reprezentujesz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002CE0.belarusian: І на варце ля свайго логава — бясспрэчны альфа-воўк, які так і прамянее пагардай да цябе і ўсяго, што ты прадстаўляеш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002D31.english: They look pretty organised to me.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002D5A.english: Meanwhile, Fat Angus keeps shooting you furtive glances and mumbling uneasily to himself...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002D5A.polish: Gruby Angus w międzyczasie rzuca ci ukradkowe spojrzenia i mamrocze do siebie niespokojnie...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002D5A.belarusian: Тым часам Тоўсты Ангус крадком на цябе зыркае і нешта нясмела мармыча сабе пад нос...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002D62.english: Meanwhile, the fat one keeps shooting you furtive looks while mumbling uneasily to himself...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002D62.polish: Grubas w międzyczasie rzuca ci ukradkowe spojrzenia i mamrocze do siebie niespokojnie...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300002D62.belarusian: Тым часам таўстун крадком на цябе зыркае і нешта нясмела мармыча сабе пад нос.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450000E5F4.english: "I would really prefer not to talk to you right now..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000E5F4.polish: „W tej chwili wolałabym z tobą nie rozmawiać...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450000E5F4.belarusian: "Я б вельмі не хацела размаўляць з табой цяпер..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B9F1.english: "Is everything alright? Why don't you want to talk to me?" (Proceed.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B9F1.polish: „Wszystko w porządku? Czemu nie chcesz ze mną rozmawiać?” (Nie odpuszczaj).
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000B9F1.belarusian: "Усё ў парадку? Чаму ты не хочаш са мной размаўляць?" (Працягнуць.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA06.english: "Okay." It looks like she's about to add something, but then she changes her mind.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA06.polish: „W porządku” – odpowiada. Przez chwilę sprawia wrażenie, jakby chciała coś dodać, ale rozmyśla się.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA06.belarusian: "Добра". Здаецца, яна хоча нешта дадаць, але потым перадумвае.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA15.english: "I don't know..." She's still avoiding your gaze. "I mean, why would I want to talk to you?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA15.polish: „Nie wiem...” – odpowiada, wciąż unikając twojego wzroku. „Dlaczego miałabym chcieć z tobą rozmawiać?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA15.belarusian: "Не ведаю... - яна ўсё яшчэ пазбягае твайго позірку. - У сэнсе, чаму я павінна хацець размаўляць з табой?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA1C.english: "I'm a deeply flawed individual, but I bring joy to the world."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA1C.polish: „Jestem mocno wadliwą osobą, ale przynoszę światu radość”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA1C.belarusian: "Я чалавек з вялікімі хібамі, але я прыношу радасць у гэты свет".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA23.english: "It's cool to see another cop. I thought Kim and I were the only ones."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA23.polish: „Czadowo widzieć kogoś z policji. Myślałem, że poza mną i Kimem nikogo z naszych tu nie ma”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA23.belarusian: "Крута бачыць яшчэ аднаго копа. Я думаў, што мы з Кімам тут адзіныя".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA2A.english: "Why?! I bring word of *the End to come*."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA47.english: "Yes," she looks at you. "What is it?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA47.belarusian: "Так, - яна глядзіць на цябе. - У чым справа?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA4E.english: "God... I don't know why, I'm just trying to do my best..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA4E.polish: „Boże... Nie wiem czemu, staram się, jak tylko mogę...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA4E.belarusian: "Божа... Не ведаю чаму, я проста стараюся з усіх сіл..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA5C.english: "Word of the End to come..." She shakes her head, tired.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA5C.polish: „Słowo Końca, który nadejdzie...” – zmęczona kręci głową.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA5C.belarusian: "Вестку пра набліжэнне Канца... - стомлена ківае яна галавой.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA63.english: "Okay, fine. Let's talk. What did you want?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA63.belarusian: "Добра, хай так. Давай пагаворым. Чаго ты хацеў?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA75.english: "Do you now?" she asks, narrowing her eyes. After a moment she shakes her head.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA75.polish: „Czyżby?” – pyta, mrużąc oczy. Po chwili kręci głową.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BA75.belarusian: "Няўжо?" - пытаецца яна, прыжмурваючыся. Праз імгненне яна хітае галавой.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BAD2.english: "Are you with him?" (Point to the man with sunglasses.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BAD2.polish: „Jesteś tu z nim?” (Wskaż na mężczyznę w okularach).
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BAD2.belarusian: "Ты з ім?" (Паказаць на мужчыну ў сонцаахоўных акулярах.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BAD9.english: "What are you -- the police -- doing here?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BAD9.polish: „Co tutaj robi policja? Ty, znaczy się?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BAEC.english: "*You're* an asshole!" He pauses. "You know what, maybe we're both assholes..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BAEC.polish: „*Sam jesteś* dupkiem!” – odpowiada, po czym milknie. „Wiesz co? Możliwe, że obaj jesteśmy dupkami...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BAEC.belarusian: "*Сам* ты мудак! - Ён спыняецца. - Ведаеш што, можа, мы абодва мудакі..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BAFE.english: "The sooner you figure this hanging out, the sooner everyone can go home."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BAFE.polish: „Im szybciej rozwiążesz sprawę powieszenia, tym szybciej wszyscy wrócimy do domu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BAFE.belarusian: "Чым хутчэй ты разбярэшся з гэтым павешаным, тым хутчэй усе змогуць пайсці дадому".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB04.english: "Of course I'm *with him*..." She seems startled by her own tone. "Why do you ask?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB04.polish: „Oczywiście, że jestem *z nim*...” – sprawia wrażenie zaskoczonej swoim tonem głosu. „Dlaczego pytasz?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB04.belarusian: "Вядома ж, я *з ім*... - Здаецца, яна сама здзіўленая сваім тонам. - Чаму ты пытаешся?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB0F.english: "Well, he's not." The man interjects -- his voice is stern. "He's a sack of shit barely kept together by crazy glue -- but at least he tries. Unlike you."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB0F.polish: „Ale nim nie jest” – wtrąca się mężczyzna surowym głosem. „To wór łajna ledwie trzymający się kupy dzięki klejowi szaleństwa – ale przynajmniej się stara. W przeciwieństwie do ciebie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB0F.belarusian: "Дык вось, не, - устаўляе мужчына суровым голасам. - Ён мех з гаўном, які ледзь трымаецца купы на суперкліі, — але ён хаця б спрабуе. У адрозненне ад цябе".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB17.english: "Please," she looks at you, then him, then you again. "Let's not turn this into another *exchange*, okay?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB17.polish: „Proszę” – wtrąca się. Patrzy na ciebie, później na niego i znowu na ciebie. „Nie róbmy z tego kolejnej *wymiany* zdań, dobrze?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB17.belarusian: "Калі ласка, - яна глядзіць на цябе, потым на яго, потым зноў на цябе. - Давайце не будзем ператвараць гэта ў чарговую *спрэчку*, добра?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB2C.english: "What? No. No, he's not... what are you talking about?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB2C.polish: „Co? Nie. Nie, nie jest... O czym ty mówisz?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB2C.belarusian: "Што? Не. Не, ён не... пра што ты наогул?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB33.english: "Actually never mind. Don't tell me about it. It will just turn into another..." She stops mid-sentence.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB33.polish: „Właściwie nieważne. Nie odpowiadaj. To zmieni się w kolejną...” – przerywa w pół zdania.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB33.belarusian: "Хаця не важна. Не распавядай мне. Гэта зноў ператворыцца ў чарговы..." - Яна спыняецца пасярод фразы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB3B.english: "I know this might sound weird, but are you... a firefighter?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB3B.polish: „Wiem, że może to zabrzmieć dziwnie, ale czy jesteś... strażaczką?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB3B.belarusian: "Ведаю, гэта можа прагучаць дзіўна, але ці ты... пажарнік?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB42.english: Her brown eyes linger on you for a moment.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB42.polish: Jej brązowe oczy zatrzymują się na tobie przez chwilę.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB42.belarusian: Яе брунатныя вочы на імгненне затрымліваюцца на табе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB49.english: "No, Harry, neither of us are firefighters," she says with a heavy sigh, and falls silent.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB49.polish: „Nie, Harry – żadne z nas nie jest strażakiem” – odpowiada z ciężkim westchnieniem i pogrąża się w milczeniu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB49.belarusian: "Не, Гары, ніхто з нас не пажарнік", - кажа яна з цяжкім уздыхам і замаўкае.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB50.english: Did she just call you *Harry*? These people do *NOT* know you! You don't *have* a name.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB50.polish: Czy ona właśnie nazwała cię *Harrym*? Ci ludzie cię *nie* znają! *Nie masz* imienia.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB50.belarusian: Яна толькі што назвала цябе *Гары*? Гэтыя людзі цябе *НЕ* ведаюць! У цябе *няма* імя.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB5E.english: "Yes, I called you by your name, what about it?" She sounds slightly agitated and... sad.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB5E.polish: „Tak, nazwałam cię po imieniu – co w tym dziwnego?” – wydaje się lekko wzburzona i... smutna.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB5E.belarusian: "Так, я назвала цябе па імені, і што з таго?" - Яна гучыць крыху раздражнёнай і... сумнай.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB75.english: "God, everybody knows your name..." She waves at you in a discarding motion. "Please go finish your investigation, so everyone can go home."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB75.polish: „Boże, wszyscy znają twoje imię...” – wykonuje w twoim kierunku lekceważący ruch dłonią. „Proszę, dokończ swoje dochodzenie, żebyśmy wszyscy mogli wrócić do domu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB75.belarusian: "Божа, ды ўсе ведаюць тваё імя... - яна махае на цябе рукой з пагардай. - Калі ласка, ідзі скончы сваё расследаванне, каб усе маглі пайсці дадому".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB83.english: "I don't understand what this conversation is about anymore." She's trying to look elsewhere.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB83.polish: „Nie rozumiem już, o czym jest ta rozmowa” – stwierdza i próbuje patrzeć w inną stronę.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB83.belarusian: "Я ўжо не разумею, пра што гэтая размова". Яна спрабуе глядзець у іншы бок.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB9D.english: She doesn't reply, but her eyes are still sad.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB9D.polish: Nie odpowiada, ale jej oczy są wciąż smutne.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BB9D.belarusian: Яна не адказвае, але вочы яе па-ранейшаму сумныя.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BBAE.english: "Honestly..." Her sad eyes scan your face, looking for signs of deceit. "I don't care. I don't think anyone does anymore."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BBAE.polish: „Szczerze...” – jej smutne oczy badają twoją twarz, szukając oznak fałszu. „Nie obchodzi mnie to. Nikogo już to chyba nie obchodzi”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000BBAE.belarusian: "Шчыра кажучы... - яе сумныя вочы вывучаюць твой твар у пошуках прыкмет падману. - Мне ўсё адно. Не думаю, што гэта цяпер хоць кагосьці хвалюе".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C806.english: "And you look like you don't bathe -- on principle," the man with sunglasses interjects.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C806.polish: „A ty wyglądasz, jakbyś się nie mył – z zasady” – wtrąca się mężczyzna w okularach.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C806.belarusian: "А ты выглядаеш так, нібы не мыешся — з прынцыпу", - устаўляе мужчына ў сонцаахоўных акулярах.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C8E8.english: "Goddamnit, you leave her alone!" The man with sunglasses snaps at you. "Keep your weird bullshit to yourself and be professional for once, for fucks sake..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C8E8.polish: „Cholera jasna, zostaw ją w spokoju!” – wybucha mężczyzna w okularach. „Zachowaj te swoje głupoty dla siebie i przynajmniej raz bądź profesjonalny, do kurwy nędzy...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C8E8.belarusian: "Чорт пабяры, адчапіся ад яе! - агрызаецца мужчына ў акулярах. - Трымай сваю дзіўную хуйню пры сабе і будзь прафесіяналам хоць раз, дзеля ўсяго святога..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C8EE.english: "NO ONE!" The man looks at her. "I'm just a man with sunglasses and you are..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C8EE.polish: „Nikogo!” – mężczyzna patrzy na nią. „Jestem tylko mężczyzną w okularach, a ty jesteś...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C8EE.belarusian: "НІ ЗА КІМ! - Мужчына глядзіць на яе. - Я проста мужчына ў акулярах, а ты..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C8FC.english: "You're a fucking asshole." She says this with quiet dignity. "Are we done here?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C8FC.polish: „Ty jesteś pieprzonym dupkiem” – odpowiada cicho z godnością. „Skończyliśmy już?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C8FC.belarusian: "Ты ябучы мудак, - кажа яна з ціхай годнасцю. - Мы скончылі?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C90A.english: "You have a blue uniform and mine is black... what does this mean?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C90A.polish: „Masz niebieski mundur. Mój jest czarny. Co to oznacza?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C90A.belarusian: "У цябе сіняя форма, а мая чорная... што гэта значыць?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C910.english: "Uh..." she seems confused for a moment. "It means I'm a patrol officer, sir."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C910.polish: „Ee...” – przez chwilę sprawia wrażenie zbitej z tropu. „To oznacza, że jestem funkcjonariuszką patrolu, proszę pana”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C910.belarusian: "Э-э... - яна на імгненне разгублена. - Гэта значыць, што я патрульны афіцэр, сэр".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D332.english: She's obviously a bit uncomfortable in your company.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D332.polish: Ewidentnie nie czuje się komfortowo w twoim towarzystwie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D332.belarusian: Ёй відавочна няўтульна ў тваёй кампаніі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D369.english: "Yes..." Her voice is quiet. "A police woman who just wants to do her job, that's all," she says quietly and looks away.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D369.polish: „Tak...” – odpowiada cichym głosem. „Jestem policjantką, która po prostu chce wykonywać swoją pracę, to wszystko” – stwierdza cicho i odwraca wzrok.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D369.belarusian: "Так... - яе голас ціхі. - Паліцыянтка, якая проста хоча рабіць сваю працу, вось і ўсё", - кажа яна ціха і адводзіць погляд.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D371.english: "I just want to do my job, that's all," she says quietly and looks away.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D371.polish: „Chcę tylko wykonywać swoją pracę, to wszystko” – stwierdza cicho i odwraca wzrok.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D371.belarusian: "Я проста хачу рабіць сваю працу, вось і ўсё", - кажа яна ціха і адводзіць погляд.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D378.english: Something about the man with sunglasses and you, the energy between you two, is making her uncomfortable.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D378.polish: Coś, co jest między tobą a mężczyzną w okularach przeciwsłonecznych, jakaś energia, sprawia, że czuje się niekomfortowo.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D378.belarusian: Нешта паміж табой і мужчынам у сонцаахоўных акулярах, нейкая напруга паміж вамі, выклікае ў яе няўтульнасць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D389.english: She's a woman, that's how women speak to men. With respect.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D389.polish: Jest kobietą, a tak właśnie kobiety zwracają się do mężczyzn. Z szacunkiem.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D389.belarusian: Яна жанчына, вось так жанчыны размаўляюць з мужчынамі. З павагай.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3A5.english: No...NO... NO!!! You're a feminist, remember?
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3A5.polish: Nie. Nie! NIE! Jesteś feministą, pamiętasz?
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3A5.belarusian: Не... НЕ... НЕ!!! Ты ж фемініст, памятаеш?

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3AC.english: Something is seriously wrong with you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3AC.polish: Coś jest z tobą naprawdę nie tak.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3AC.belarusian: З табой нешта сур'ёзна не так.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3BC.english: "Well, I... uh..." She looks extremely uncomfortable right now. "I guess I..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3BC.polish: „Cóż, ja... ee...” – sprawia wrażenie ekstremalnie skrępowanej. „Ja chyba...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3BC.belarusian: "Ну, я... э-э... - Ёй відавочна вельмі няўтульна. - Відаць, я..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3C3.english: "Cut the shit." The words are addressed to you. "Every second you stand here running your mouth the case grows colder."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3C3.polish: „Skończ z tym” – te słowa są skierowane do ciebie. „Z każdą sekundą, którą marnujesz tu, kłapiąc jadaczką, tropy robią się coraz zimniejsze”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3C3.belarusian: "Завязваў бы ты з гэтай хернёй, - словы адрасаваныя табе. - Кожную секунду, пакуль ты стаіш тут і ляпаеш языком, справа астывае".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3DC.english: "Did you hear that? Did you hear me sing? Did you like it?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3DC.polish: „Słyszałaś? Wiesz, jak śpiewam? Podobało ci się?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3DC.belarusian: "Ты чула гэта? Чула, як я спяваў? Табе спадабалася?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3E3.english: "I bet you liked that, didn't you? Let's be honest, that was some first rate karaoke."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3E3.polish: „Na pewno ci się podobało, co? Tak szczerze. To było pierwszej klasy karaoke”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3E3.belarusian: "Біцца аб заклад, табе спадабалася, га? Калі шчыра, гэта было караоке найвышэйшага гатунку".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3EA.english: "That... that was pretty good, Harry." She pokes her companion with an elbow. "Wasn't it Jean?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3EA.polish: „To... To było całkiem niezłe, Harry” – opowiada i szturcha swojego towarzysza łokciem. „Prawda, Jean?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D3EA.belarusian: "Гэта... гэта было нядрэнна, Гары, - яна штурхае свайго спадарожніка локцем. - Праўда, Жан?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D40D.english: "Uh, that was..." He stares at you. "Yeah, that was absolute shit -- if you want my opinion. Drunken shit. Haven't wanted anything to end this badly since I had cluster headaches."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D40D.polish: „Hm, to było...” – wpatruje się w ciebie. „Taa, to było absolutne gówno – jeśli interesuje cię moja opinia. Pijackie gówno. Gdy ostatni raz chciałem tak bardzo, by coś się skończyło, chodziło o klasterowy ból głowy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D40D.belarusian: "Э-э, гэта было... - Ён глядзіць на цябе. - Ага, поўнае гаўно — калі табе цікава маё меркаванне. П'янае гаўно. Мне так моцна не хацелася, каб нешта скончылася, з таго часу, як у мяне былі кластарныя галаўныя болі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D415.english: "Horrible, truly horrible," he continues. "I beg of you, don't ever subject anyone to this torture again. I mean seriously, you need to..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D415.polish: „Straszne, naprawdę straszne” – kontynuuje. „Błagam, nigdy już nie poddawaj nikogo tej torturze. Poważnie, powinieneś...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D415.belarusian: "Жахліва, сапраўды жахліва, - працягвае ён. - Я малю цябе, ніколі больш не падвяргай нікога гэтаму катаванню. Я сур'ёзна, табе трэба..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D41C.english: "Jean..." she quietly interjects, giving you a compassionate side glance. "He's not right, don't make it worse and... and *I* really liked it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D41C.polish: „Jean...” – wtrąca się cichym głosem, rzucając ci z ukosa pełne współczucia spojrzenie. „On nie jest sobą, nie pogarszajmy tego... A poza tym... *mi* się naprawdę podobało”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D41C.belarusian: "Жан... - ціха ўстаўляе яна, спачувальна косячыся на цябе. - Ён не ў сабе, не пагаршай... і... і *мне* сапраўды спадабалася".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D432.english: "I'm going to venture a guess. You're a nurse, right?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D438.english: "Do you work for the animal control?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D43E.english: "Are you by any chance..." (Lean in real close.) "*working class*?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D43E.polish: „Należysz może przypadkiem...” (Nachyl się bardzo blisko). „...do *klasy robotniczej*?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D43E.belarusian: "Ты выпадкова не... - (нахіліцца вельмі блізка) - з *рабочага класа*?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D448.english: She just looks at you and says nothing.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D448.belarusian: Яна проста глядзіць на цябе і нічога не кажа.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D455.english: "Actually, I wanted to address other matters."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D455.polish: „Prawdę mówiąc, chciałem porozmawiać o innych sprawach”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D469.english: "Cut the crazy act," the man with sunglasses interjects angrily. "She's being polite enough by not telling you to fuck off."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D469.polish: „Przestań zgrywać wariata” – wtrąca się gniewnie mężczyzna w okularach przeciwsłonecznych. „Ona stara się być uprzejma, dlatego nie kazała ci się jeszcze odpieprzyć”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D469.belarusian: "Перастань ламаць вар'ята, - злосна ўстаўляе мужчына ў сонцаахоўных акулярах. - Яна дастаткова ветлівая, каб не паслаць цябе нахуй".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D470.english: "No, it's okay." She raises her eyes to meet your gaze. "I am not. Polite. I'm just tired... was there something else you wanted?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D470.polish: „Nie, w porządku” – podnosi wzrok i spogląda ci w oczy. „Nie staram się. Być uprzejma. Jestem po prostu zmęczona... Chciałeś czegoś jeszcze?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D470.belarusian: "Не, усё нармальна, - яна падымае вочы і сустракаецца з тваім позіркам. - Я не стараюся. Быць ветлівай. Я проста стамілася... Ты нешта яшчэ хацеў?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D478.english: "No, no I don't." It doesn't look like she does -- the *police* uniform she's wearing is a dead giveaway.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D478.polish: „Nie, nie zajmuję się tym” – odpowiada. To oczywiste – *policyjny* mundur, który ma na sobie, nie pozostawia wątpliwości.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D478.belarusian: "Не, я там не працую". Яна і праўда там не працуе — *паліцэйская* форма на ёй гаворыць сама за сябе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D480.english: "Well... raising two children and half a husband on a patrol officer's wage. Yes, I guess I am working class."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D480.polish: „Cóż... Wychowuję dwójkę dzieci i połowę męża za pensję funkcjonariuszki patrolu. Tak, chyba należę do klasy robotniczej”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D480.belarusian: "Ну... гадую двух дзяцей і палову мужа на заробак патрульнага афіцэра. Так, відаць, я з рабочага класа".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D487.english: "Do you want to rise up and tear down the entire fucking system with me?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D487.polish: „Chcesz razem ze mną doprowadzić do powstania i obalić cały ten jebany system?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D487.belarusian: "Хочаш паўстаць і знішчыць усю гэтую ябучую сістэму разам са мной?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D48E.english: "Cool. (Give her a little wink.) I am too."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4B4.english: "Uh.... okay." Her tone doesn't suggest she's convinced.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4B4.polish: „Ee... Okej” – odpowiada. Z tonu wynika, że raczej nie jest przekonana.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4B4.belarusian: "Э-э... добра, - па яе тоне не скажаш, што яна перакананая.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4BB.english: She's merely agreeing with you to reach the conclusion of this conversation faster.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4BB.polish: Zgadza się z tobą tylko po to, by szybciej zakończyć tę rozmowę.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4BB.belarusian: Яна проста згаджаецца з табой, каб хутчэй скончыць гэтую размову.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4C3.english: "No." She sighs. "Okay. Sort of. But not with you. Like you are now. Don't take this the wrong way..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4C3.polish: „Nie” – wzdycha. „Okej. Tak jakby. Ale nie z tobą. Nie, gdy jesteś w tym stanie. Nie zrozum tego źle...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4C3.belarusian: "Не, - яна ўздыхае. - Ну добра. Быццам бы так. Але не з табой. Не такім, які ты цяпер. Не зразумей няправільна..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4CB.english: "Uh... okay. Yes, that was pretty good."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4CB.polish: „Ee... Okej. Tak, to było całkiem niezłe”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4D2.english: "What? No. Nonononono!" The man with sunglasses shakes his head stubbornly. "There are *universal* standards of good out there and that... that was just complete shit."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4D2.polish: „Co? Nie. Nieeeeee!” – mężczyzna w przeciwsłonecznych okularach uparcie kręci głową. „Istnieją *uniwersalne* standardy dobra i to... to było totalne gówno”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4D2.belarusian: "Што? Не. Не-не-не-не-не! - мужчына ў сонцаахоўных акулярах упарта круціць галавой. - Існуюць *універсальныя* стандарты добрага, і гэта... гэта было проста поўнае гаўно".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4D9.english: "Jean," she quietly interjects, giving you a compassionate side glance. "He's not right... treat him like you'd treat McCoy's little brother."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4D9.polish: „Jean...” – wtrąca się cichym głosem, rzucając ci z ukosa pełne współczucia spojrzenie. „On nie jest sobą... Traktuj go, jakbyś traktował młodszego brata McCoya”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4D9.belarusian: "Жан, - ціха ўстаўляе яна, спачувальна косячыся на цябе. - Ён не ў сабе... паводзься з ім так, як з малодшым братам Макоя".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4E0.english: Lieutenant Double-Yefreitor John "Archetype" McCoy's younger brother Lance McCoy, although a man of 32 years, will mentally never surpass a six year old.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4E0.polish: Lance McCoy, młodszy brat porucznika podwójnego gefrajtera Johna McCoya pseudonim Archetyp, choć ma 32 lata, nigdy nie będzie miał mentalnie więcej niż 6.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4E0.belarusian: Лэнс Макой, малодшы брат лейтэнанта двойчы-яфрэйтара Джона 'Архетыпа' Макоя, хоць яму і 32 гады, разумова ніколі не пераўзыдзе шасцігодка.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4F0.english: "Yes, and I'm wondering why? Don't you have a case to solve?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4F0.polish: „Tak, a ja zastanawiam się dlaczego! Nie masz przypadkiem sprawy do rozwiązania?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4F0.belarusian: "Так, і мне цікава, чаму? У цябе хіба няма справы, якую трэба раскрыць?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D4F7.english: "Yes, did you want something from me?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D503.english: Wait... what? John? Lance? Who are these people?
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D503.polish: Zaraz. Co? John? Lance? Co to za ludzie?
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D503.belarusian: Пачакай... што? Джон? Лэнс? Хто ўсе гэтыя людзі?

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D50A.english: No idea. Just passing on information stored in your fractured neural cortex.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D50A.polish: Nie mam pojęcia. Przekazuję tylko informacje zawarte w twojej zniszczonej korze mózgowej.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D50A.belarusian: Паняцця не маю. Проста перадаю інфармацыю, захаваную ў тваёй пашкоджанай кары галаўнога мозгу.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D511.english: From within your mind-haze you hear the end of a sentence: "...and I'm not going to pretend like he's got a *learning disability*!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D511.polish: Wśród umysłowego zamglenia słyszysz końcówkę zdania: „...i nie zamierzam traktować go, jakby *miał problemy z uczeniem się*!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D511.belarusian: Скрозь смугу ў галаве ты чуеш канец фразы: "...і я не збіраюся рабіць выгляд, нібыта ў яго *парушэнні ў навучанні*!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D519.polish: „Nie da się zrobić ze mnie inwalidy”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D520.english: "Jean, detective." She looks at both of you. "I don't understand what you're talking about."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D520.polish: „Jean, detektywie” – patrzy na was obu. „Nie rozumiem, o czy mówicie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D520.belarusian: "Жан, дэтэктыў, - яна глядзіць на вас абодвух. - Я не разумею, пра што вы".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D527.english: "Now he's got a problem with learning disabilities... is that supposed to be ironic?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D527.polish: „A teraz ma jakiś problem z problemami z uczeniem się... To miała być ironia?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D527.belarusian: "Цяпер у яго праблемы з парушэннямі ў навучанні... Гэта тыпу іронія такая?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D52F.english: "Maybe it didn't go as well as I thought..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D52F.polish: „Może nie poszło tak dobrze, jak się spodziewałem...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D52F.belarusian: "Можа, усё прайшло не так добра, як я думаў..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D53D.english: "It was very nice. Different, but good kind of different. I liked it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D53D.polish: „To było bardzo ładne. Inne, ale w dobrym sensie. Podobało mi się”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D53D.belarusian: "Гэта было вельмі міла. Незвычайна, але ў добрым сэнсе. Мне спадабалася".

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D544.english: Sssssssshe's lying. Probably hated it. They all did.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D544.polish: Kłaaaaamie. Nie podobało jej się pewnie. Jak wszystkim.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D544.belarusian: Яна і-і-ілжэ-э-э. Хутчэй за ўсё, ёй не спадабалася. Як і ўсім.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D94D.english: "Look, something is really bugging me. Are we or are we not from the same police station?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D94D.polish: „Posłuchaj, coś mnie strasznie gnębi. My jesteśmy z tego samego komisariatu czy nie?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D94D.belarusian: "Слухай, мяне сёе-тое непакоіць. Мы з табой з аднаго паліцэйскага ўчастка ці не?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D964.english: "Can I actually help you with something?" She looks at you apologetically.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D964.polish: „Mogę ci w jakiś sposób pomóc?” – pyta i patrzy na ciebie przepraszająco.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D964.belarusian: "Я магу табе чым-небудзь дапамагчы?" - Яна глядзіць на цябе з вінаватым выглядам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000676B.english: Whoa, how does she know your name? She probably heard it from somewhere. You have to be more careful. Names are *dangerous*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000676B.polish: O rany, skąd ona zna twoje imię? Pewnie gdzieś je usłyszała. Musisz bardziej uważać. Imiona są *niebezpieczne*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000676B.belarusian: Ого, адкуль яна ведае тваё імя? Мабыць, пачула недзе. Трэба быць асцярожнейшым. Імёны *небяспечныя*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000067A0.english: It might be because you have the higher rank.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000067A0.polish: Może to dlatego, że masz wyższy stopień.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000067A0.belarusian: Магчыма, таму што ў цябе вышэйшае званне.

Dialogue Text/0x01000082000042F9.english: The woman in an RCM patrol officer's uniform winces as she notices you.
Dialogue Text/0x01000082000042F9.polish: Kobieta w mundurze funkcjonariuszki patrolowej MOR-u krzywi się na twój widok.
Dialogue Text/0x01000082000042F9.belarusian: Жанчына ў форме патрульнага афіцэра РГМ маршчыніцца, заўважыўшы цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004303.english: "Hold on, you are a cop with the RCM?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004316.english: A patrol officer is the lowest rank in the RCM, below lieutenant and sergeant.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004316.polish: Funkcjonariusz patrolowy to najniższy stopień w MOR-ze, poniżej porucznika i sierżanta.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004316.belarusian: Патрульны афіцэр — гэта найніжэйшае званне ў РГМ, ніжэй за лейтэнанта і сяржанта.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004329.english: As Lieutenant Kitsuragi explained, a patrol officer is the lowest rank in the RCM, below lieutenant and sergeant.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004329.polish: Jak wyjaśnił porucznik Kitsuragi, funkcjonariusz patrolowy to najniższy stopień w MOR-ze, poniżej porucznika i sierżanta.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004329.belarusian: Як растлумачыў лейтэнант Кіцурагі, патрульны афіцэр — гэта найніжэйшае званне ў РГМ, ніжэй за лейтэнанта і сяржанта.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004343.english: "I'm on a murder investigation. Are you the cavalry?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004343.polish: „Prowadzę śledztwo w sprawie morderstwa. Jesteś moim wsparciem?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000434A.polish: „No wsparciem to na pewno nie jestem”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000435A.english: ...after all you've done -- is what her tone implies.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000435A.polish: ...po tym wszystkim, co zrobiłeś – zdaje się sugerować jej ton.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000435A.belarusian: ...пасля ўсяго, што ты нарабіў, — чытаецца ў яе тоне.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004366.english: "No you're not, you're not the only cop in the world." She shakes her head and breathes out.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004366.polish: „Nie, nie jesteś – nie jesteś jedynym gliną na świecie” – kręci głową i robi wydech.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004366.belarusian: "Не, не адзіныя, вы не адзіныя копы ў свеце, - яна круціць галавой і выдыхае.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000436E.english: Something changes in her. It's pity. Pity comes over her.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000436E.polish: Coś się w niej odmienia. To współczucie. Ogarnia ją litość.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000436E.belarusian: Нешта ў ёй змяняецца. Гэта літасць. Яе ахоплівае літасць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000437A.english: "Have I wronged you? I've done that to a lot of people."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000437A.polish: „Skrzywdziłem cię jakoś? Zdaje się, że dotyczy to wielu ludzi”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004381.english: "No, you haven't wronged me. It's okay." She shakes her head and breathes out.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004381.polish: „Nie, nie skrzywdziłeś mnie. Wszystko jest w porządku” – kręci głową i robi wydech.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004381.belarusian: "Не, ты мяне не пакрыўдзіў. Усё нармальна, - яна круціць галавой і выдыхае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004389.english: "Of course he does..." The man at the table says to himself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004389.polish: „No oczywiście...” – mężczyzna przy stoliku mówi do siebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004389.belarusian: "Ну вядома ж, нясе... - кажа сам сабе мужчына за сталом.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004391.english: "But you're not trying your best, are you?" He says with a flash of anger.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004391.polish: „Ale nie dajesz z siebie wszystkiego, co nie?” – stwierdza z gniewem w głosie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004391.belarusian: "Але ты ж не стараешся з усіх сіл, так?" - кажа ён з успышкай гневу.

Dialogue Text/0x01000082000043FA.english: "He's the real deal, he has a badge."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004401.english: "He's the real deal, he has a gun now."
