Dialogue Text/0x010000070000898F.english: "*Why* do you wanna come with me?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070000899C.english: "This scene is dead." He gestures towards the window. "Cuno's outta here -- might as well be a pig, big-up fucky-fingers on my way out."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000899C.polish: „Ta scena wykitowała” – wskazuje na okno. „Cuno się musi stąd zmywać – to może nawet zostać świnią. Na odchodne pokaże wszystkim fakolca”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070000899C.belarusian: "Тут усё стухла, - ён паказвае ў бок акна. - Куна звальвае адсюль — можна заадно і пабыць ментом, паказаць усім на развітанне факі".

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089A3.english: Say what you will, but this kid's *hard shit*. He might actually make a good cop one day.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089A3.polish: Gadaj, co chcesz, ale ten dzieciak to *twarda sztuka*. Kiedyś może być z niego dobry gliniarz.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089A3.belarusian: Кажы што хочаш, але гэты хлапчук — *дужы арэшак*. З яго некалі можа атрымацца нядрэнны коп.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089AA.english: Big-up fucky-fingers? He *is* a *free-thinker*. Beyond the box. Can't argue with that.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089AA.polish: Fakolca? Chłopak jednak *jest wolnomyślicielem*. Niesztampowym. Z tym nie sposób się kłócić.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089AA.belarusian: Паказаць усім факі? Ён *сапраўдны* *вольнадумца*. Мысліць нестандартна. Тут не паспрачаешся.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089B1.belarusian: Кхм... ВЫЯЎЛЕНЫ КАДРАВЫ РЭЗЕРВ ДЛЯ НАРКАКАНТРОЛЮ!

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089B8.english: Kid would make a half-decent sharpshooter, no?
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089B8.polish: Z chłopaka byłby niezły strzelec, co?
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089B8.belarusian: З малога атрымаўся б нядрэнны снайпер, га?

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089BF.english: Trying to recruit him is like trying to make a pet out of fire. This kid recognizes only one authority -- his own.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089BF.polish: Próba zatrudnienia go to jak próba oswojenia ognia. Ten dzieciak rozumie tylko jeden autorytet: siebie samego.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089BF.belarusian: Спроба завербаваць яго — усё адно што спроба прыручыць полымя. Гэты малы прызнае толькі адзін аўтарытэт — свой уласны.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089CD.english: Look, this might be his only way out.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089CD.polish: Słuchaj, to może być dla niego jedyny ratunek.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089CD.belarusian: Паслухай, гэта можа быць ягоным адзіным шанцам вырвацца.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089D4.english: He is streetwise. Knows the neighbourhood. Knows the people. He could be useful.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089D4.polish: Zna język ulicy. Okolicę też. I ludzi. Może się przydać.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089D4.belarusian: Ён ведае вуліцу. Ведае раён. Ведае мясцовых. Ён можа спатрэбіцца.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089DB.english: This is a twelve year old kid. You can't seriously be considering *taking him along*?! What's gonna happen to him?
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089DB.polish: To dwunastoletnie dziecko. Nie myślisz chyba poważnie o *zabraniu go ze sobą*?! Co się z nim stanie?
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089DB.belarusian: Гэтаму хлапчуку дванаццаць гадоў. Ты ж не сур'ёзна збіраешся *ўзяць яго з сабой*?! Што з ім будзе?

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089E2.english: Look at him. Life hasn't been easy on him. You wanna drag him along and put him through more shit? *Your* shit?
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089E2.polish: Popatrz na niego. Życie go doświadczyło. Chcesz go ciągać ze sobą i wystawiać na jeszcze większy syf? *Twój* syf?
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000089E2.belarusian: Паглядзі на яго. Жыццё не песціла яго. Ты хочаш цягнуць яго за сабой і падстаўляць пад яшчэ большае лайно? Пад *тваё* лайно?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A0E.english: "Now... as to what's going to happen next..." (Get up.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A0E.polish: „No dobrze... A co do tego, jak zrobimy dalej...” (Wstań).
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A0E.belarusian: "Цяпер... што да таго, што будзе далей..." (Устаць.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A15.english: "Yes, gimp... ?" Cuno asks, seeing the effort it takes you to stand. "What are you gonna do now? Ride outta here on your shit-river? You'll die alone. Cuno doesn't give a shit now. Too late now. Cuno's gonna hang here and *fuck* your room up again..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A15.polish: „Co, sztywniaku...?” – pyta Cuno, widząc, ile wysiłku kosztuje cię stanięcie na nogi. „Co zamierzasz teraz zrobić? Wypłyniesz stąd na swojej rzece gówna? Sam umrzesz. Cuno ma to w dupie. Teraz już za późno. Cuno tu zostanie i znowu *rozpierdzieli* twój pokój...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A15.belarusian: "Ну што, калека...? - пытаецца Куна, бачачы, якіх высілкаў табе каштуе ўстаяць. - Што ты будзеш рабіць цяпер? Паплывеш адсюль па сваёй рацэ з лайна? Ты здохнеш у адзіноце. Куна цяпер пахуй. Цяпер ужо позна. Куна застанецца тут і зноў *раз'ябе* твой пакой..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A23.english: "Accepted the Cuno like a motherfucker..." He nods respectfully. "What are we gonna do now?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A23.polish: „Przyjąłeś Cuno jak skurwysyn...” – kiwa głową z szacunkiem. „Co teraz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A23.belarusian: "Прыняў Куна як раз'ябай... - ён паважліва ківае. - Што мы будзем рабіць цяпер?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A37.english: "Thanks, pig." He quickly glances at you, then looks away. "Now get your crippled ass up and tell Cuno, what are we gonna do now?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A37.polish: „Dzięki, świnio” – rzuca ci krótkie spojrzenie, po czym szybko odwraca wzrok „Rusz te swoje kalekie dupsko i powiedz Cuno, jaki mamy plan”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A37.belarusian: "Дзякуй, парсюк, - ён хутка зіркае на цябе, потым адводзіць погляд. - А цяпер падымай сваю калечную сраку і скажы Куна, што мы будзем рабіць цяпер?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A43.english: "Sorry for what?! For not adding Cuno to your shitshow?! Cuno's not sorry. Cuno's glad. I was just kidding. You couldn't get Cuno for a million reál. You can't even get out bed, loser."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A43.polish: „Za co mnie przepraszasz?! Za to, że nie dołączyłeś Cuno do swojego cyrku?! Cuno się nie martwi. Cuno jest zadowolony. Tylko żartowałem. Byś nie zwerbował Cuno nawet za milion reáli. Nie dasz rady się nawet zwlec z wyra, frajerze”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A43.belarusian: "Прабач за што?! За тое, што не ўзяў Куна ў сваё гаўна-шоу?! Куна не шкадуе. Куна рады. Я проста сцябаўся. Ты б і за мільён рэалаў не атрымаў Куна. Ты нават з ложка ўстаць не можаш, лузер".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A4A.english: "Sorry for what?! For not adding Cuno to your shitshow?! Cuno's not sorry. Cuno's glad. I was just kidding too. You couldn't get Cuno for million reál. Fuck you, okay?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A4A.polish: „Za co mnie przepraszasz?! Za to, że nie dołączyłeś Cuno do swojego cyrku?! Cuno się nie martwi. Cuno jest zadowolony. Też tylko żartowałem. Byś nie zwerbował Cuno nawet za milion reáli. Jeb się, słyszysz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A4A.belarusian: "Прабач за што?! За тое, што не ўзяў Куна ў сваё гаўна-шоу?! Куна не шкадуе. Куна рады. Я таксама проста сцябаўся. Ты б і за мільён рэалаў не атрымаў Куна. Пайшоў ты, ясна?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A51.english: Wow, he did not take that rejection well.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A51.polish: O rany. Nie przyjął twojej odmowy za dobrze.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A51.belarusian: Аго, не надта лёгка ён перажыў гэтую адмову.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A58.english: Wow, he did not take that rejection well.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A58.polish: O rany. Nie przyjął twojej odmowy za dobrze.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A58.belarusian: Аго, не надта лёгка ён перажыў гэтую адмову.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A5F.english: "Now? As to what's going to happen next..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A5F.polish: „No dobrze. A co do tego, jak zrobimy dalej...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A5F.belarusian: "Цяпер? Што да таго, што будзе далей..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A77.english: "Yeah, debrief Cuno. Let Cuno know *the plan*." The kid rubs his hands together.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A77.polish: „Taa, zrób Cuno odprawę. Pozwól Cuno poznać *plan*” – chłopak zaciera dłonie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A77.belarusian: "Ага, увядзі Куна ў курс справы. Дай Куна ведаць *план*", - хлапчук пацірае рукі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A8F.english: "That sounds like a hella shit plan. You askin' Cuno to come along to your shit-show and you don't even know what to do? Fuckin' check your pig journal or something. C'mon..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A8F.polish: „To mi brzmi jak chujowy plan. Prosisz Cuno, żeby dołączył do twojego cyrku, a teraz nie wiesz nawet, co robić? Cholera, weź sprawdź swój świński dziennik czy coś. No weź...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A8F.belarusian: "Гэта гучыць як вельмі хуёвы план. Ты просіш Куна пайсці з табой на тваё гаўна-шоу і нават не ведаеш, што рабіць? Бля, пагартай свой ментоўскі дзённік ці тыпу таго. Давай ужо..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A95.english: "Bitch next door? That's what Cuno's thinking too," he agrees. "Good call. Let's rock it, pig-man."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A95.polish: „Tej suki z pokoju obok? Cuno też tak pomyślał” – zgadza się. „Dobry pomysł. Ruszajmy, świnio-człeku”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008A95.belarusian: "Сучка з суседняга пакоя? Куна думае так сама, - згаджаецца ён. - Правільная думка. Пагналі, чалавек-парсюк".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008B42.english: "That's Klaasje, right? Bitch next door? Cuno's thinking the same thing," he agrees. "Let's rock it, pig-man."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008B42.polish: „Chodzi o Klaasje, tak? Tą sukę z pokoju obok? Cuno też tak pomyślał” – zgadza się. „Ruszajmy, świnio-człeku”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700008B42.belarusian: "Гэта Клаас'е, так? Сучка з суседняга пакоя? Куна думае пра тое самае, - згаджаецца ён. - Пагналі, чалавек-парсюк".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009636.english: He's not saying Cuno -- he's saying *I*? And not calling you a f****t or a pig? Is he ill or something?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009636.polish: Nie mówi „Cuno” – mówi w pierwszej osobie? I nie nazywa ciebie p***łem ani świnią? Zachorował czy co?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700009636.belarusian: Ён не кажа пра сябе "Куна" — ён кажа *я*? І не абзывае цябе підарам ці парсюком? Ён захварэў ці што?

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000169A6.english: "Final-style," he repeats. "You fucked everything up. Now Cuno's all you got. Terminal Cuno."
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000169A6.polish: „Ostatecznie” – powtarza – „wszystko zjebałeś. Teraz masz tylko Cuno. Ostateczny Cuno”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000169A6.belarusian: "Фінальны стыль, - паўтарае ён. - Ты ўсё прасраў. Цяпер у цябе ёсць толькі Куна. Тэрмінальны Куна".

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000169B4.english: Nix Gottlieb, station medic, throws a bag containing a small bullet into the medical waste disposer. Then he pops some caramel candy into his mouth and says: "Next." There's a line behind his door...
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000169B4.polish: Nix Gottlieb, sanitariusz z komisariatu, wrzuca torebkę z niewielką kulą do śmietnika na odpadki medyczne. Następnie wkłada sobie do ust karmelka, po czym woła: „Następny!”. Za drzwiami stoi kolejka...
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000169B4.belarusian: Нікс Готліб, пастарункавы медык, выкідае пакунак з маленькай куляй ва ўтылізатар медычных адходаў. Затым закідвае ў рот карамельку і гукае: "Наступны". За дзвярыма стаіць чарга...

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000169BD.english: "What?" He studies your expression. "You don't believe the Cuno? You don't believe the Cuno knows this shit? Fuck you, Cuno keeps tabs. Bitch is outta town."
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000169BD.polish: „Co?” – przygląda się bacznie wyrazowi twojej twarzy. „Nie wierzysz Cuno? Nie wierzysz, że Cuno to wie? Jeb się, Cuno ma rękę na pulsie. Suka zwiała z miasta”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000169BD.belarusian: "Што? - ён узіраецца ў твой выраз твару. - Ты не верыш Спадарству Куна? Не верыш, што Той Самы Куна ведае такое лайно? Пайшоў ты, Куна ўсё трымае на кантролі. Скулліха зваліла з горада".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA6F.english: There were only ten people present at the fight. Ten times more than that is very unlikely.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA6F.polish: Podczas walki obecnych było tylko dziesięć osób. Śmierć nawet dziesięć razy tylu jest wysoce nieprawdopodobna.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA6F.belarusian: У сутычцы ўдзельнічала ўсяго дзесяць чалавек. Нават у дзесяць разоў больш — гэта вельмі малаверагодна.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA77.english: If he did triage and left, you must be relatively stable.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA77.polish: Jeśli rzeczywiście uleczył cię i się stąd zabrał, to musisz być w dość stabilnym stanie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA77.belarusian: Калі ён аказаў першую дапамогу і сышоў, твой стан павінен быць адносна стабільным.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA83.english: We're detecting *drouamine* in your bloodstream. It's a potent morphine-based painkiller. The good doctor must have given you some... It's gonna suck when it wears off.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA83.polish: Wyczuwamy w twojej krwi *druaminę*. To potężny środek przeciwbólowy na bazie morfiny. Dobry pan doktor musiał ci jej trochę dać... Jak przestanie działać, zrobi się do dupy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA83.belarusian: Мы фіксуем *друамін* у тваёй крыві. Гэта магутны абязбольвальны сродак на аснове марфіну. Добры доктар, мусіць, увёў табе дозу... Калі дзеянне скончыцца, будзе вельмі кепска.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA91.english: Ouch, ouch... The kid turns double for a second. Damn, that hurts. Breathe...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA91.polish: Au, au... Chłopak dwoi ci się przez moment w oczach. Cholera, ale boli. Oddychaj...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA91.belarusian: Ай, ай... Хлопец на імгненне двоецца. Чорт, як жа балюча. Дыхай...

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA99.english: Yeah, that kid's taken a beating -- or ten -- from his dad. He has regard for a man who can walk after taking some damage.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA99.polish: Tak, ten dzieciak zebrał manto – albo i dziesięć – od ojca. Czuje szacunek do kogoś, kto umie wstać po tym, jak oberwał.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EA99.belarusian: Так, гэтага хлапчука бацька лупцаваў не раз і не два. Ён паважае чалавека, які здольны ісці пасля такіх удараў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAA8.english: "Yeah, fuckin' babybeard. Cleaned all your shit up. He's like your fuckin' mom now or something."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAA8.polish: „Taa, jebany szczylowąs. Sprzątnął ten twój chlew. Robi teraz za twoją pieprzoną matkę czy coś”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAA8.belarusian: "Ага, ябучы шмаркавус. Прыбраў усё тваё гаўно. Цяпер ён табе як ябучая мамка ці тыпу таго".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAB0.english: He looks you in the eye and repeats: "Two days is *nothing* to the Cuno."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAB0.polish: Patrzy ci w oczy i powtarza: „Dwa dni to dla Cuno *nic*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAB0.belarusian: Ён глядзіць табе ў вочы і паўтарае: "Два дні для Спадарства Куна — гэта *нішто*".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EABF.english: "Yeah, fuckin' dead. Died in the hospital, I hear. Union's all weepy and shit..." He gives you a nod of acknowledgement: "It's probably your fault."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EABF.polish: „Taa, wykitował. Podobno się przekręcił w szpitalu. Cały Związek się pobeczał i w ogóle...” – odpowiada, kiwając głową z uznaniem. „To pewnie twoja wina”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EABF.belarusian: "Ага, бля, памёр. Сканаў у шпіталі, як кажуць. Прафсаюз увесь у слязах і саплях... - ён ухвальна ківае табе: - Гэта, пэўна, твая віна".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAC6.belarusian: Хутчэй за ўсё, так і ёсць... крыварукі ты мудак.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EACD.english: It's the *fault* of those who *killed* him. Not you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EACD.polish: To *wina* tych, którzy go *zabili*. Nie twoja.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EACD.belarusian: Гэта *віна* тых, хто яго *забіў*. Не твая.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAE3.english: Who would have thought? Perhaps you should have *arrested* her?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAE3.polish: Kto by pomyślał? Może trzeba było ją *aresztować*?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAE3.belarusian: Хто б мог падумаць? Можа, варта было яе *арыштаваць*?

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAEB.english: "Do you know if Klaasje -- the blonde next door -- is really gone?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAEB.polish: „Wiesz, czy Klaasje – ta blondynka, co mieszka obok – naprawdę zniknęła?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAEB.belarusian: "Ці ведаеш ты, ці сапраўды знікла Клаас'е — бландынка з суседняга пакоя?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAF1.english: "Yeah, she's way gone pig. Cuno's been here for two days and babybeard and you are the only fucks in the building."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAF1.polish: „Taa, dawno już się zmyła, świnio. Cuno tu był przez dwa dni i jedyne zjeby w całej tej budzie to ty i szczylowąs”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAF1.belarusian: "Ага, даўно зваліла, парсюк. Куна тут ужо два дні, і адзіныя вырадкі ва ўсім будынку — гэта ты і шмаркавус".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAFF.english: Of course she's *really* gone, what did you think.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAFF.polish: Oczywiście, że *naprawdę* zniknęła. A coś ty myślał?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EAFF.belarusian: Вядома, яна *сапраўды* знікла, а ты што думаў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB10.english: "Was nothin'." He tries to shake off the image. "Cuno's gonna go into a bag too. We all are."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB10.polish: „Nie obeszło mnie to” – stara się pozbyć wspomnienia. „Cuno też kiedyś trafi do worka. Wszyscy trafimy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB10.belarusian: "Дробязі, - ён спрабуе адагнаць гэты вобраз. - Куна таксама калі-небудзь ляжа ў мех. Усе мы там будзем".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB18.english: That bag's on *you*. You could have done something, but you just stood there. Fuck...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB18.polish: Ten worek to *twoja* wina. Mogłeś coś zrobić, a tylko stałeś jak palant. Kurwa...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB18.belarusian: Гэты мех — на *тваім* сумленні. Ты мог бы нешта зрабіць, але проста стаяў там. Чорт...

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB21.english: He's really been keeping tabs -- on you, the Hardies, even the company rep.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB21.polish: Serio miał wszystkich na oku. Ciebie, Hardiech, nawet przedstawicielkę firmy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB21.belarusian: Ён сапраўды сачыў за ўсім — за табой, за хлопцамі Хардзі, нават за прадстаўніцай кампаніі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB2A.english: Let's do this tango, pig, he thinks. Detective Pig and detective Cunn on the case. We bouncin'.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB2A.polish: Zatańczmy to tango, świnio – myśli. Detektyw Świnia i detektyw Cunn na tropie. Jedziemy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB2A.belarusian: Давай станцуем гэтае танга, парсюк, думае ён. Дэтэктыў Парсюк і дэтэктыў Кун на справе. Працуем.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB3A.english: Cunn and Pig? And you're picking him up on your cop-frequency too. This is... bad.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB3A.polish: Cunn i Świnia? W dodatku odbierasz go na swojej gliniarskiej częstotliwości. Jest... źle.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB3A.belarusian: Кун і Парсюк? І ты прымаеш яго на сваёй ментоўскай хвалі. Гэта... кепска.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB4E.english: "Walls are full of holes in here, pig. Even Cuno knows that."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB4E.polish: „Tutaj jest pełno dziur w ścianach, świnio. Nawet Cuno to wie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB4E.belarusian: "Сцены тут поўныя дзірак, парсюк. Нават Куна гэта ведае".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB56.english: "You want Cuno to be your yes-man, or you want me to tell it like it is? Walls are full of holes here, pig. Even Cuno knows that."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB56.polish: „Chcesz, żeby Cuno ci przytakiwał, czy mam ci mówić, jak jest? Tutaj jest pełno dziur w ścianach, świnio. Nawet Cuno to wie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB56.belarusian: "Ты хочаш, каб Куна табе падтакваў, ці каб я казаў як ёсць? Сцены тут поўныя дзірак, парсюк. Нават Куна гэта ведае".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB5F.english: There is no telling *when* it was made. He had a point there.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB5F.polish: Nie sposób stwierdzić, *kiedy* ktoś ją zrobił. Mówi z sensem.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB5F.belarusian: Немагчыма сказаць, *калі* яе зрабілі. Тут ён мае рацыю.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB68.english: He's genuinely impressed, but that's mostly to do with how scientific that percentage sounded.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB68.polish: Naprawdę jest pod wrażeniem, ale raczej głównie dlatego, że ta wartość procentowa brzmiała bardzo naukowo.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB68.belarusian: Ён шчыра ўражаны, але пераважна тым, наколькі навукова прагучаў гэты працэнт.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB7C.english: A gust of wind blows in from the bay, the duraluminium box around you vibrates imperceptibly... a familiar cold, a red thread on the roof upstairs. Taut. Plucked like a string by the gust.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB7C.polish: Znad zatoki dobiega powiew wiatru, duraluminiowa skrzynka wokół ciebie niepostrzeżenie wibruje. Znajome zimno, czerwona nić na dachu. Napięta. Szarpana przez podmuch niczym struna.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB7C.belarusian: Павеў ветру далятае з заліва, дзюралюмініевая скрынка вакол цябе ледзь прыкметна вібруе... знаёмы холад, чырвоная нітка на даху наверсе. Нацягнутая. Вецер тузае яе, як струну.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB87.english: Also, it's just close enough to endure the walk.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB87.polish: W dodatku jest tam wystarczająco blisko, żeby dało się wytrzymać spacer.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB87.belarusian: Да таго ж гэта дастаткова блізка, каб вытрымаць пешы пераход.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB97.english: You did mention doing more ballistics...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EB97.belarusian: Ты казаў нешта пра дадатковую балістыку...

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EBA2.english: Ballistics. In Klaasje's room. Do it *properly*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EBA2.polish: Badanie balistyczne. W pokoju Klaasje. Przeprowadź je *porządnie*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EBA2.belarusian: Балістыка. У пакоі Клаас'е. Зрабі гэта *як мае быць*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EBB8.english: "You askin' Cuno to come along to your shit-show and you don't even know what to do? Fuckin' check your pig journal or something. C'mon..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EBB8.polish: „Prosisz Cuno, żeby dołączył do twojego cyrku, a teraz nie wiesz nawet, co robić? Cholera, sprawdź swój świński dziennik czy coś. No weź...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001EBB8.belarusian: "Ты просіш Куна пайсці з табой на тваё гаўна-шоу і нават не ведаеш, што рабіць? Бля, пагартай свой ментоўскі дзённік ці тыпу таго. Давай ужо..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002B78.english: "Didn't you say you and I were done. Professionally?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002B78.belarusian: "Хіба ты не казаў, што паміж намі ўсё скончана? Па працы?"

Alternate1/0x0100004000002B78.polish: „Co ty tutaj robisz, Cuno? Nie jesteś już na mnie wkurzony?”
Alternate1/0x0100004000002B78.belarusian: "Як ты тут апынуўся, Куна... хіба ты больш не злуешся на мяне?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002B86.english: "Don't get all hung up on that yesterday's shit, piggo," the kid says, trying to sound mature. "That was then, this is now. Cuno's all about being in the moment."
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002B86.polish: „Nie rozpamiętuj wczorajszego gówna, prośku” – odpowiada chłopak, próbując brzmieć dorośle. „Wczoraj było wczoraj, teraz jest teraz. Cuno żyje na całego chwilą”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002B86.belarusian: "Не закліньвайся на ўчорашнім лайне, парсючок, - кажа хлапчук, спрабуючы гучаць па-даросламу. - Тое было тады, цяпер усё па-іншаму. Куна жыве момантам".

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002B8D.english: The kid really doesn't seem to harbour any animosity towards you. He seems almost friendly.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002B8D.polish: Dzieciak naprawdę nie wydaje się żywić żadnej urazy. Wydaje się nieomal przyjaźnie nastawiony.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002B8D.belarusian: Хлопец сапраўды не трымае на цябе зла. Ён выглядае амаль што прыязна.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9B5.english: "I knew it! I knew I was someone well known. A superstar."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9B5.polish: „Wiedziałem. Wiedziałem, że jestem kimś znanym. Supergwiazdą”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9B5.belarusian: "Я так і ведаў! Я ведаў, што я нехта вядомы. Суперзорка."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9BD.english: "I fear..." The lieutenant lowers his voice. "I fear you're misinterpreting this situation."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9BD.polish: „Obawiam się...” – odpowiada porucznik, ściszając głos. „Obawiam się, że błędnie interpretujesz tę sytuację”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9BD.belarusian: "Баюся... — лейтэнант сцішвае голас. — Баюся, вы няправільна тлумачыце гэтую сітуацыю."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9C4.english: "Talk to me, superstar. What do you want?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9C4.belarusian: "Пагавары са мной, суперзорка. Чаго ты хочаш?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9CC.english: "Jean, he's obviously suffering..." The woman stops mid-sentence.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9CC.polish: „Jean, przecież widać, że on...” – kobieta urywa wypowiedź w połowie zdania.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9CC.belarusian: "Жан, ён жа відавочна пакутуе..." — жанчына спыняецца на паўслове.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9D3.english: The man with sunglasses looks at her -- then back at you: "Okay, superstar. Talk to me, what do you want? You want a pat on the back?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9D3.polish: Mężczyzna w okularach przeciwsłonecznych spogląda na nią, a później zwraca się do ciebie: „Dobra, supergwiazdo. Mów – czego chcesz? Chcesz, żeby poklepać cię po pleckach?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9D3.belarusian: Мужчына ў сонцаахоўных акулярах глядзіць на яе, потым зноў на цябе: "Добра, суперзорка. Кажы, чаго ты хочаш? Хочаш, каб цябе пагладзілі па галоўцы?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9DC.english: "Oh, yes you are! And you've worked really, *really* hard, haven't you?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9DC.polish: „O tak, rzeczywiście! Pracowałeś bardzo, *bardzo* ciężko, prawda?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9DC.belarusian: "О так, рабішся! І ты працаваў вельмі, *вельмі* цяжка, ці не так?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000C9F9.english: She's trying to keep a straight face.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6AE.english: "No, you wouldn't cramp my style at all."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6AE.polish: „Nie, nie burzyłbyś mi go ani trochę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6AE.belarusian: "Не, ты б аніколькі не ламаў мой стыль."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6C0.english: "Oh god, I'd hate for that to happen... you know what might help prevent that though?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6C0.polish: „O nie, nie chciałbym, aby do tego doszło... Wiesz, w jaki sposób mógłbyś temu zapobiec?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6C0.belarusian: "О божа, не хацелася б, каб такое здарылася... але ведаеш, што магло б дапамагчы гэтаму прадухіліць?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6D8.english: "Me doing my fucking job and not pestering you anymore?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6D8.polish: „Wykonując swoje pieprzone obowiązki i nie zawracając ci więcej głowy?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6D8.belarusian: "Каб я рабіў сваю ябучую працу і больш да цябе не чапляўся?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6EC.english: "Perfect, great, I don't give a shit!" He shakes his head. "Now leave us alone and do your thing... and I don't mean get drunk and piss yourself, right? You realize that, don't you?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6EC.polish: „Świetnie, idealnie – mam na to wyjebane!” – kręci głową. „A teraz zostaw nas w spokoju i zajmij się swoimi obowiązkami... I nie mam na myśli chlania i obszczywania się, jasne? Chyba zdajesz sobie z tego sprawę, co?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6EC.belarusian: "Выдатна, цудоўна, мне насраць! — ён хітае галавой. — А цяпер пакінь нас у спакоі і займайся сваёй справай... і я не маю на ўвазе надзерціся і абасцацца, ясна? Ты ж гэта разумееш, праўда?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6F2.english: "A little premonition for you, lieutenant. Sooner or later -- probably sooner -- your new friend tells you he doesn't need you. He will then suggest you should *fuck off*."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6F2.polish: „Pozwól, że przepowiem ci przyszłość, poruczniku. Prędzej czy później – ale raczej prędzej – twój nowy przyjaciel powie ci, że cię nie potrzebuje. A później zasugeruje, żebyś »spierdalał«”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6F2.belarusian: "Невялікае прадказанне для вас, лейтэнанце. Рана ці позна — хутчэй за ўсё, рана — ваш новы сябар скажа, што вы яму не патрэбны. А потым прапануе вам *пайсці нахуй*."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6F9.english: "When that happens I suggest you take his advice," he adds bitterly.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6F9.polish: „Gdy do tego dojdzie, proponuję, abyś go posłuchał” – dodaje gorzko.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D6F9.belarusian: "Калі гэта здарыцца, раю вам прыслухацца да ягонай парады", — горка дадае ён.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D700.english: The lieutenant merely bows his head in response.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D700.polish: W odpowiedzi porucznik tylko kiwa głową.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D700.belarusian: Лейтэнант толькі схіляе галаву ў адказ.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D71A.english: "Okay... how about you stop wasting my time and get on with whatever you were doing then?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D71A.polish: „Okej... W takim razie może przestań już marnować mój czas i wracaj do tego, czym się teraz zajmujesz?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D71A.belarusian: "Добра... як наконт таго, каб ты перастаў марнаваць мой час і вярнуўся да таго, чым там займаўся?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D736.english: That voice... so very familiar... Did you hear it when calling to your station and reporting your badge missing?
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D736.polish: Ten głos... Taki znajomy... Czy ty go nie słyszałeś, kiedy połączyłeś się z komisariatem i meldowałeś o zaginięciu odznaki?
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D736.belarusian: Гэты голас... такі знаёмы... Ці не чуў ты яго, калі тэлефанаваў у свой участак і паведамляў пра знікненне значка?

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D75C.english: "I lost my badge recently. When I called in to report it missing, you were there."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D75C.polish: „Zgubiłem niedawno odznakę. Kiedy to zgłaszałem, usłyszałem ciebie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D75C.belarusian: "Я нядаўна згубіў свой значок. Калі я тэлефанаваў, каб паведаміць пра знікненне, ты быў там."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D777.english: "Okay then. It's probably a *coincidence*. People sound alike. Good bye."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D777.polish: „W porządku. To pewnie *zbieg okoliczności*. Wiele osób brzmi podobnie. Żegnam”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D777.belarusian: "Ну добра. Напэўна, гэта *супадзенне*. Галасы бываюць падобныя. Бывай."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D927.english: "Look, I just have to ask: are we from the same police station?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D927.polish: „Słuchaj, muszę zapytać: czy my jesteśmy z tego samego komisariatu?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D927.belarusian: "Слухай, я проста мушу запытацца: мы з аднаго паліцэйскага ўчастка?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D92E.english: "I'm going to say... *no*. Just to see what you'll say to that. What do you say?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D92E.polish: „Powiem... *nie*. Tylko po to, żeby przekonać się, co na to odpowiesz. Więc co na to odpowiesz?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D92E.belarusian: "Я скажу... *не*. Проста каб паглядзець, што ты на гэта адкажаш. Ну, і што ты скажаш?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D943.english: "Jean, he said okay, give it a rest."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D99E.english: "Or...OR..." The man with sunglasses raises his index finger. "We could go back to doing our jobs. This was stupid..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D99E.polish: „Albo... ALBO...” – mężczyzna w okularach przeciwsłonecznych unosi palec wskazujący. „Moglibyśmy wrócić do swoich zajęć. Wiem, to głupi pomysł...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D99E.belarusian: "Ці... ЦІ... — мужчына ў сонцаахоўных акулярах уздымае ўказальны палец. — Мы маглі б вярнуцца да сваёй працы. Гэта было глупствам..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9AA.english: "If you don't want to answer questions maybe you want to hear me *say things?*"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9AA.polish: „Skoro nie chcesz odpowiadać na pytania, to może chcesz posłuchać, jak *mówię różne rzeczy*?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9AA.belarusian: "Калі ты не хочаш адказваць на пытанні, можа, ты хочаш паслухаць, як я *гавару ўсякае?*"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9B4.english: "Okay I'm doing this investigation -- a man is hanged."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9B4.belarusian: "Добра, я вяду гэтае расследаванне — чалавека павесілі."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9BA.english: "Okay, I'm doing this investigation and it turns out he was shot *and* hanged..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9BA.polish: „No dobra. Prowadzę śledztwo i okazuje się, że facet został nie tylko powieszony, ale i *zastrzelony*...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9BA.belarusian: "Добра, я вяду гэтае расследаванне, і выявілася, што яго застрэлілі *і* павесілі..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9C0.english: "Okay, this person who was shot and then made to look like he was hanged -- he *might* have been shot by the people who hanged him."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9C0.polish: „No więc ten człowiek, co został zastrzelony, a potem zrobili, że niby został powieszony – *możliwe*, że zastrzelili go ci sami ludzie, co go powiesili”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9C0.belarusian: "Добра, гэты чалавек, якога застрэлілі, а потым зрабілі выгляд, быццам яго павесілі — яго *маглі* застрэліць тыя ж людзі, якія яго павесілі."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9C6.english: "Okay, the person who was shot and hanged. He may have been shot by the person who made it look like he was hanged."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9C6.polish: „No to co do tego zastrzelonego i powieszonego gościa – *możliwe*, że zastrzeliła go ta osoba, która potem upozorowała powieszenie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9C6.belarusian: "Добра, чалавек, якога застрэлілі і павесілі. Яго мог застрэліць той самы чалавек, які зрабіў выгляд, быццам яго павесілі."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9D8.english: "The person who we *think* shot him -- who made it look like he was hanged, that we're looking for -- we can't find her."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9D8.polish: „Ta osoba, która, jak *sądzimy*, go powiesiła – ta, co upozorowała powieszenie i co jej szukamy, tak? To nie możemy jej znaleźć”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000D9D8.belarusian: "Чалавека, які, як мы *думаем*, застрэліў яго — які зрабіў выгляд, быццам яго павесілі, якога мы шукаем — мы не можам яе знайсці."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA02.english: "I don't know... why are you?" He gives you an odd look.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA02.polish: „Nie wiem... Dlaczego?” – pyta, rzucając ci dziwne spojrzenie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA02.belarusian: "Не ведаю... а чаму ты гэта кажаш?" — ён дзіўна глядзіць на цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA09.english: Who knows why we do the things we do. Somehow bouncing those ideas off the man with sunglasses felt calming. Like you've done it before.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA09.polish: Kto wie, czemu robimy to, co robimy? Z jakiegoś powodu rozmowa o tym wszystkim z mężczyzną w okularach cię uspokoiła. Jakbyś już kiedyś to robił.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA09.belarusian: Хто ведае, чаму мы робім тое, што робім. Чамусьці абмяркоўваць гэтыя думкі з мужчынам у сонцаахоўных акулярах было супакойліва. Быццам ты ўжо рабіў так раней.

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA10.english: "So... do you know who hanged him?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA16.english: "You think he was hanged as a coverup? To hide the shooting?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA16.polish: „Myślisz, że powieszono go, żeby zatrzeć ślady? Żeby ukryć postrzał?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA16.belarusian: "Думаеш, яго павесілі для прыкрыцця? Каб схаваць расстрэл?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA1C.english: "I get it. Okay. But what is the motive?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA22.english: "A cover-up -- where the author of the cover-up is the perp? Makes sense."
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA22.polish: „Przykrywka, której pomysłodawca jest też zabójcą? To ma sens”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA22.belarusian: "Прыкрыццё, дзе аўтар прыкрыцця — сам злачынца? Лагічна."

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA2E.english: "Well... where have you looked for her?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA3A.english: "Hey, why am I even telling you this?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA3A.polish: „Hej, czemu ja ci to w ogóle mówię?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA3A.belarusian: "Гэй, чаму я наогул табе гэта кажу?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA42.english: "Hey, why am I telling you this?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA4A.english: "It's quite possible... hey! Why am I telling you these things?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA4A.polish: „To całkiem możliwe... Hej! Czemu ja ci mówię te rzeczy?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA4A.belarusian: "Гэта цалкам магчыма... гэй! Чаму я расказваю табе гэтыя рэчы?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA53.english: "Yeah... hey, why am I telling you these things?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA53.polish: „Tak... Hej, czemu ja ci mówię te rzeczy?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA53.belarusian: "Ага... гэй, чаму я табе гэта расказваю?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA85.english: "Well, yeah... hey, why am I telling you these things?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA85.polish: „No, tak... Hej, czemu ja ci mówię te rzeczy?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DA85.belarusian: "Ну так... гэй, чаму я расказваю табе гэтыя рэчы?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DAA7.english: "Oh my god, there's more..." He looks at you in disbelief. "You want something more... what is it?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DAA7.polish: „O mój boże, to nie wszystko...” – przygląda ci się z niedowierzaniem. „Chodzi ci o coś jeszcze... O co?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000640000DAA7.belarusian: "О божа, там яшчэ нешта ёсць... — ён глядзіць на цябе з недаверам. — Ты хочаш чагосьці яшчэ... чаго?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006664.english: He's trying to protect you from further rough handling dished out by this sun-glassed man.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006664.polish: Próbuje uchronić cię przed dalszymi nieprzyjemnościami ze strony faceta w okularach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006664.belarusian: Ён спрабуе абараніць цябе ад далейшых грубых выпадаў гэтага мужчыны ў сонцаахоўных акулярах.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000445E.english: "And I don't mean that as a metaphor."

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004466.english: "Like undercover?" The woman in the RCM uniform interjects.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004466.polish: „To przykrywka?” – wtrąca się kobieta w mundurze MOR-u.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004466.belarusian: "У сэнсе пад прыкрыццём?" — устаўляе жанчына ў форме РГМ.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000447B.english: You can't leave it like that -- spin it on its head. ENGAGE CAPS LOCK.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000447B.polish: Nie możesz tego tak zostawić – zepchnij go do defensywy. ZAŁĄCZAJ CAPS LOCKA.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000447B.belarusian: Ты не можаш пакінуць гэта проста так — перавярні ўсё з ног на галаву. УКЛЮЧАЙ CAPS LOCK.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004497.english: "I mean the likeness of the holy sun in the sky. I LOOK LIKE IT."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004497.polish: „Mam na myśli podobiznę świętego słońca na niebie. TAK WŁAŚNIE WYGLĄDAM”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008200004497.belarusian: "Я маю на ўвазе падабенства да святога сонца ў небе. Я ВЫГЛЯДАЮ ЯК ЯНО."

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000449F.english: No, you don't -- you look like a young god.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000449F.polish: Nie, to nieprawda. Wyglądasz jak młody bóg.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000449F.belarusian: Не, зусім не — ты выглядаеш як малады бог.

Dialogue Text/0x01000082000044A7.polish: Nic nie mów. Napnij tylko mięśnie.
Dialogue Text/0x01000082000044A7.belarusian: Нічога не казаць. Проста напружыць цягліцы.

Dialogue Text/0x01000082000044AE.english: "Oh god... it's the fucking muscle thing..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000082000044AE.polish: „O boże... Znowu mu odpierdala z tymi mięśniami...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000082000044AE.belarusian: "О божа... зноў гэтае ябучае дрыганне цягліцамі..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000082000044BB.english: He is secretly admiring your sea of muscles. Everyone is.
Dialogue Text/0x01000082000044BB.polish: Potajemnie podziwia twoje ogromne muskuły. Jak wszyscy.
Dialogue Text/0x01000082000044BB.belarusian: Ён таемна захапляецца тваім морам цягліц. Як і ўсе.

Dialogue Text/0x01000082000044C3.english: Push it more. Harder. Be *more* intelligent.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500002FA6.english: "You're not. I really don't believe you are."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500002FA6.belarusian: "Не раскрыеш. Я сапраўды не веру, што раскрыеш."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013AED.english: It's like you felt it would be intellectually stimulating -- and would lead somewhere. A custom even? Strange...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013AED.polish: Jakbyś czuł, że będzie to intelektualnie stymulujące i do czegoś doprowadzi. Coś niemal jak obyczaj? Dziwne...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013AED.belarusian: Здаецца, быццам ты адчуў, што гэта будзе інтэлектуальна стымулюючым — і да нечага прывядзе. Мо нават звычка? Дзіўна...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B06.english: "Okay. Well..." He corrects his blonde wig. Khm... his hair. He corrects his hair.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B06.polish: „Okej. Cóż...” – poprawia swoją blond perukę. Znaczy... swoje włosy. Poprawia swoje włosy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B06.belarusian: "Добра. Ну... — ён папраўляе свой бялявы парык. Кхм... свае валасы. Ён папраўляе свае валасы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B15.english: "That would be my first guess, yes."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B15.belarusian: "Я б таксама так спачатку падумаў, так."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B1D.english: "I know, right? But what's the motive?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B1D.polish: „No właśnie. Ale jaki może być motyw?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B23.english: "You don't have a motive? Then the double cover-up seems too neat."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B23.polish: „Nie masz motywu? W takim razie podwójna przykrywka wydaje się zbyt schludna”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B23.belarusian: "У цябе няма матыву? Тады падвойнае прыкрыццё выглядае занадта гладкім."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B2F.english: "You're not shitting me, Mullen. I can smell it all the way here. The whole town stinks."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B2F.polish: „Nie ściemniasz, Mullen. Czuję go aż tutaj. Śmierdzi w całym mieście”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B2F.belarusian: "Ты не хлусіш, Муллен. Я чую гэты смурод аж адсюль. Увесь горад смярдзіць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B3B.english: "We're getting to it... There have been complications."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B4A.english: "Hey... why am I even telling you these things?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B4A.polish: „Hej... czemu ja ci to wszystko w ogóle mówię?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B4A.belarusian: "Гэй... чаму я наогул расказваю табе ўсё гэта?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B59.english: "I would love to -- but I'm busy *fucking off and not cramping your style*. And that might cramp it, you see. Helping you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B59.polish: „Bardzo bym chciał, ale jestem zajęty *odpierdalaniem się i nieburzeniem twojego stylu*. A to mogłoby go zburzyć. Pomaganie ci”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B59.belarusian: "З радасцю б — але я заняты тым, што *ад'ябваюся і не ламаю твой стыль*. А гэта магло б яго зламаць, бачыш. Дапамога табе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B5F.english: "I have a little problem. The person who was hanged is still hanging there. I still haven't taken him down."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B5F.polish: „Mam mały problem. Powieszona osoba ciągle tam wisi. Nadal jej nie ściągnąłem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B5F.belarusian: "У мяне невялікая праблема. Чалавек, якога павесілі, усё яшчэ там вісіць. Я яго дагэтуль не зняў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B6A.english: Suddenly, out of nowhere, case-related things start popping up in your head!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B6A.polish: Nagle, jakby znikąd, w głowie pojawiają ci się rzeczy związane ze sprawą!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B6A.belarusian: Раптам, ніадкуль, у тваёй галаве пачынаюць узнікаць думкі, звязаныя са справай!

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B7F.english: "We think she may be on the coast."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B7F.belarusian: "Мы думаем, што яна можа быць на ўзбярэжжы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B85.english: "West of here? Though luck. The place is ruined from the bombardment. A lot of places to hide there..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B85.polish: „Na zachód stąd? Kiepsko. Ta okolica jest zniszczona bombardowaniem. Mnóstwo miejsc do ukrywania się...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013B85.belarusian: "На захад адсюль? Не пашанцавала. Тое месца зруйнаванае бамбардзіроўкай. Там шмат дзе можна схавацца..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BA2.english: "Khm... I have a bit of..." (Point to you head.) "Memory trouble."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BA2.polish: „Khm... Mam trochę...” (Wskaż na swoją głowę). „Kłopotów z pamięcią”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BA2.belarusian: "Кхм... У мяне тут трохі..." (Паказаць на галаву.) "Праблемы з памяццю."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BA8.english: "You don't say?" He turns away from you. "Good bye then. The voice thing was a *coincidence*. Run along, asshole."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BA8.polish: „Poważnie?” – pyta i odwraca się od ciebie. „W takim razie żegnam. To z głosem to był *zbieg okoliczności*. Idź już sobie, dupku”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BA8.belarusian: "Няўжо? — ён адварочваецца ад цябе. — Тады бывай. Гэтая фішка з голасам была *супадзеннем*. Валі адсюль, мудак."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BB3.english: "Yeah. Probably not. I don't remember you from anywhere."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BB3.polish: „Taaa. Pewnie nie. Znikąd cię nie pamiętam”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BB3.belarusian: "Ага. Напэўна, не. Я цябе ніадкуль не памятаю."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BBA.english: "God fucking shit..." He pinches the root of his nose.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BBA.polish: „Boże ja pierdolę...” – odpowiada, ściskając palcami nasadę nosa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BBA.belarusian: "Тваю ж блядскую маць..." — ён сціскае пальцамі пераноссе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BC1.english: None of this is great news for him.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BC1.polish: Nic z tego nie brzmi dla niego jak dobre wieści.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BC1.belarusian: Усё гэта для яго зусім не добрыя навіны.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BD1.english: "Mkm." He shakes his head. "I'm not getting involved in this."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BD1.polish: „Khm” – kręci głową. „Nie zamierzam się w to mieszać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BD1.belarusian: "Мгм, — ён хітае галавой. — Я не збіраюся ў гэта ўмешвацца."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BD8.english: It's not my style, he thinks, glancing at the man in sunglasses. And the woman beside him. Ooo boy, they're mad at him. No wonder. He just doesn't recognize them.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BD8.polish: To nie w moim stylu – myśli, patrząc na mężczyznę w okularach. O rany, ale są na niego wściekli. Nie dziwne. On ich po prostu nie poznaje.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BD8.belarusian: Гэта не ў маім стылі, думае ён, паглядаючы на мужчыну ў акулярах. І на жанчыну побач з ім. Ох хлопча, ну і злыя ж яны на яго. Нядзіўна. Ён іх проста не пазнае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BE4.english: As if waiting for some kind of reaction, or response -- something to *click*. It's not happening though. Who is this guy?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BE4.polish: Jakby czekali na jakąś reakcję albo odpowiedź. Aż coś *zaskoczy*. Tyle że nie zaskakuje. Co to za gość?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013BE4.belarusian: Быццам чакае нейкай рэакцыі ці адказу — чагосьці, што *пстрыкне*. Але нічога не адбываецца. Хто гэты хлопец?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013C04.english: Okay. I was clearly wrong. He is a firefighter, male nurse, animal control agent -- something of that kind. Not a cop. Go on with your cop work. Don't let me stop you again.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013C04.polish: No dobra, to ewidentnie mój błąd. Jest strażakiem, pielęgniarzem, łapaczem psów – kimś w tym rodzaju. Nie gliną. Wracaj do swojej policyjnej roboty. Nie będę ci przeszkadzać.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800013C04.belarusian: Добра. Я відавочна памыліўся. Ён пажарнік, медбрат, службовец адлову жывёл — нешта такое. Не коп. Працягвай сваю паліцэйскую працу. Не дазваляй мне зноў цябе адцягваць.

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000079AA.english: "Okay, why not. Let's do the whole thing over again. We're not wasting time. There *is* no time!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000079AA.polish: „Dobra, czemu nie. Omówmy to wszystko jeszcze raz od nowa. Nie marnujemy czasu. Bo *nie ma* czasu!”
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000079AA.belarusian: "Добра, чаму не. Давай усё спачатку. Мы ж не марнуем час. Часу наогул *няма*!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000007000079BE.english: There's something strange about this guy. Figure it out.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000079BE.polish: Coś jest w tym gościu dziwnego. Dojdź, co to może być.
Dialogue Text/0x01000007000079BE.belarusian: У гэтым хлопцу ёсць нешта дзіўнае. Высветлі, што.

tooltip1/0x01000007000079BE.belarusian: Вы звязаліся са сваім аддзяленнем міліцыі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A945.english: Okay, so this guy is cool -- he stands there like a statue. An *angry* statue. And he does *not* like you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A945.polish: No dobra, gość jest spokojny. Stoi niczym posąg. *Gniewny* posąg. Który cię *nie lubi*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A945.belarusian: Добра, гэты хлопец стрыманы — ён стаіць нібы статуя. *Злая* статуя. І ты яму *зусім* не падабаешся.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A94C.english: Don't even try to win him over. You won't.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A94C.polish: Nawet nie próbuj go do siebie przekonać. Nie dasz rady.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A94C.belarusian: Нават не спрабуй схіліць яго на свой бок. У цябе не атрымаецца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A95A.english: There's a joke you're not getting here. Could have something to do with the brain damage.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A95A.polish: Padł tu jakiś żart, którego nie rozumiesz. Może to mieć coś wspólnego z twoim uszkodzeniem mózgu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A95A.belarusian: Тут ёсць жарт, якога ты не разумееш. Магчыма, гэта неяк звязана з пашкоджаннем мазгоў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A980.english: "I'm sure he's fucking *flattered*, but *Kim* is not part of this thought experiment. In this one -- *we're* partners."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A980.polish: „Na pewno *miło mu* to słyszeć, ale *Kim* nie jest częścią tego eksperymentu myślowego. W nim to *my* jesteśmy partnerami”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A980.belarusian: "Я ўпэўнены, што ён, бляха, *узрушаны*, але *Кім* не з'яўляецца часткай гэтага разумовага эксперыменту. У гэтым — *мы* напарнікі."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A991.english: Okay, yes -- you get the joke. Leave it at that.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A991.polish: Okej, dobra. Zrozumiałeś żart. Na tym poprzestańmy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A991.belarusian: Добра, так — ты зразумеў жарт. На гэтым і спыніся.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A9A9.english: Who does this asshole think he is -- a *cop*?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A9A9.polish: Za kogo się ma ten dupek? Za *glinę*?

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A9B1.english: Hear that? He wants you to say things. Say one!
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A9B1.polish: Słyszysz to? Chce, żebyś mówił rzeczy. Więc mów!
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A9B1.belarusian: Чуеш гэта? Ён хоча, каб ты гаварыў усякае. Скажы нешта!

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A9BA.english: You know what? It must be because he's *buff*. He looks like he works out like he's got the devil on his back.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A9BA.polish: Wiesz co? To chyba dlatego, że jest *napakowany*. Wygląda, jakby sam diabeł go zaganiał na siłownię.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A9BA.belarusian: Ведаеш што? Гэта, мабыць, таму, што ён *напампаваны*. Ён выглядае так, быццам гайдаецца, нібыта сам чорт за ім гоніцца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A699.english: The man doesn't reply. He's too busy furiously squinting at you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A699.polish: Mężczyzna nie odpowiada. Jest zbyt zajęty zaciekłym mrużeniem oczu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A699.belarusian: Мужчына не адказвае. Ён занадта заняты тым, што люта жмурыцца на цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A6A0.english: Trying to get a good picture of your jacket, no doubt.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A6A0.polish: Na pewno chce się dobrze przyjrzeć twojej kurtce.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A6A0.belarusian: Без сумневу, спрабуе добра разгледзець тваю куртку.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A6A7.english: Can he even see through those glasses?
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A6A7.polish: Czy on w ogóle coś widzi przez te okulary?
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A6A7.belarusian: Ці ён наогул хоць нешта бачыць праз гэтыя акуляры?

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A6B7.english: Again he provides no reply, instead seemingly trying to get a better look of your attire through his sunglasses.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A6B7.polish: Kolejny raz nie odpowiada. Zamiast tego najwyraźniej próbuje przyjrzeć się twojemu strojowi przez swoje okulary przeciwsłoneczne.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A6B7.belarusian: Ён зноў нічога не адказвае, замест гэтага, здаецца, спрабуючы лепей разгледзець тваё адзенне скрозь свае сонцаахоўныя акуляры.

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A6BE.english: Good luck, these look darker than welding glasses.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A6BE.polish: Powodzenia, chyba nawet maska spawalnicza ma jaśniejsze szkło.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A6BE.belarusian: Поспехаў, яны выглядаюць цямнейшымі за зварачныя акуляры.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000133FD.english: The lieutenant goes pale. 'No badge?' he mouths to himself silently.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000133FD.polish: Porucznik blednie. „Brak odznaki?” – pyta sam siebie bezgłośnie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000133FD.belarusian: Лейтэнант бляднее. 'Няма значка?' — бясшумна прамаўляе вуснамі ён.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005100009673.english: *"That's* the where you remember me from?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001686E.english: "Hi, gendarme. Another rendezvous." There he is again -- the smoker on the balcony! Right here in the Whirling-in-Rags.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001686E.polish: „Witam, żandarmie. Kolejne rendezvous”. To znowu on – palacz z balkonu! I to tutaj, w Whirling-in-Rags.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001686E.belarusian: "Прывітанне, жандарме. Чарговае рандэву". Вось ён зноў — курэц на гаўбцы! Проста тут, у Whirling-in-Rags.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016874.english: He takes another drag of his cigarette before knitting his brows. "What friend?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016874.polish: Zaciąga się jeszcze raz dymem z papierosa, po czym marszczy brwi. „Jakim przyjacielu?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016874.belarusian: Ён робіць яшчэ адну зацяжку цыгарэтай і ссоўвае бровы: "Якога сябра?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016881.english: "Sure. Anything else on your mind?" His lazy eyes stroll over your face.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016881.polish: „Nie ma za co. Jeszcze coś?” – pyta, a jego wzrok leniwie błądzi po twojej twarzy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016881.belarusian: "Няма за што. Нешта яшчэ цябе цікавіць?" — Яго лянівы позірк блукае па тваім твары.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001689F.english: "*Everything* will be constantly shifting and moving under our rule, the future will belong to a circus of identities, just spinning around, surreal and unreal... You won't even know who you are anymore."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001689F.polish: „Pod naszymi rządami *wszystko* będzie się nieustannie zmieniać i przemieszczać, przyszłość będzie należała do cyrku tożsamości – wirującego, surrealistycznego i nierealnego… Nie będziesz nawet wiedział, kim jesteś”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001689F.belarusian: "Пад нашай уладай *усё* будзе пастаянна змяняцца і рухацца, будучыня будзе належаць цырку ідэнтычнасцей, што проста кружыцца ў віры, сюррэалістычным і нерэальным... Ты нават больш не будзеш ведаць, хто ты такі".

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168B8.english: "Muscular. Handsome." He shrugs nonchalantly. "Strong. Like one of those military types."
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168B8.polish: „Muskularny. Przystojny” – nonszalancko wzrusza ramionami. „Silny. Jak jeden z tych wojskowych typów”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168B8.belarusian: "Мускулісты. Прыгожы, — ён нядбайна паціскае плячыма. — Моцны. Як адзін з тых вайсковых тыпаў".

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168C4.english: "Oh, it's a *pleasure* group... a sub-rosa pleasure group congregating in cellars under the cover of night... Saturday night, sometimes even *Friday* night!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168C4.polish: „Och, to grupa *uciech*... Potajemna grupa skupiająca się na przyjemności spotykająca się w piwnicach pod osłoną nocy – sobotniej nocy, a czasem nawet *piątkowej* nocy!”
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168C4.belarusian: "О, гэта суполка *асалоды*... таемная суполка асалоды, што збіраецца ў сутарэннях пад покрывам ночы... суботняй ночы, часам нават *пятнічнай*!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168CA.english: "Oh we're ambitious, we want to destroy the last vestiges of meaning, the last things people in Revachol have to hold on to, the true symbols of security -- the meaning of man and woman, mother and father, their marriage."
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168CA.polish: „Och, jesteśmy ambitni – chcemy zniszczyć ostatnie ostoje znaczenia, ostatnie reduty, na których chronią się mieszkańcy Revacholu, prawdziwe symbole bezpieczeństwa: tego, czym jest bycie mężczyzną i kobietą, matką i ojcem oraz czym jest ich małżeństwo”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168CA.belarusian: "О, мы амбіцыйныя: мы хочам знішчыць апошнія рэшткі сэнсу, апошняе, за што людзі ў Рэвашолі яшчэ могуць трымацца, сапраўдныя сімвалы бяспекі — сэнс мужчыны і жанчыны, маці і бацькі, іхняга шлюбу".

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168D0.english: Just pointing it out, we're not talking about some kind of a cult with *members* here, you made it up.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168D0.polish: Przypomnę tylko, że nie rozmawiamy tu o żadnym kulcie mającym *członków*. Wymyśliłeś to.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168D0.belarusian: Проста заўважу: мы тут гаворым не пра нейкі культ з *членамі*, ты сам гэта выдумаў.

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168D6.english: "Or Thursday night! Sometimes the congregating doesn't even end, it carries on into our daily life..." He lowers his voice conspiratorially and looks around.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168D6.polish: „Albo czwartkowej nocy! Czasem nawet zgromadzenie się nie kończy, lecz trwa i towarzyszy nam w naszym codziennym życiu...” – wyjaśnia konspiracyjnym szeptem, rozglądając się wokoło.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168D6.belarusian: "Або чацвярговай ночы! Часам зборышчы нават не спыняюцца і перацякаюць у нашае паўсядзённае жыццё..." — Ён змоўніцкі сцішвае голас і азіраецца.

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168E6.english: "Tell me again about that *muscular type* who came to investigate the crime."
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168E6.polish: „Opowiedz mi jeszcze raz o tym *muskularnym facecie*, który przyszedł przyjrzeć się miejscu zbrodni”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168E6.belarusian: "Раскажы мне яшчэ раз пра таго *мускулістага тыпа*, які прыходзіў расследаваць злачынства".

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168EC.english: I'm not bringing it up -- let it go.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168EC.polish: Nie będę o tym wspominał. Odpuść.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168EC.belarusian: Я не буду гэта ўздымаць — адпусціць.

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168F2.english: "No, I don't think it came up."
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168F2.belarusian: "Не, не думаю, што да гэтага дайшло".

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168FD.english: "Oh, yes... let's see. He knocked on my door a few days after the lynching. I think he was going through the entire building, asking questions."
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168FD.polish: „A tak... Niech no pomyślę. Zapukał do moich drzwi kilka dni po linczu. Odwiedził chyba wszystkie mieszkania w budynku, zadawał pytania”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000168FD.belarusian: "О так... зараз узгадаю. Ён пастукаў у мае дзверы праз некалькі дзён пасля самасуду. Здаецца, ён абыходзіў увесь дом і распытваў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016914.english: "But why do you convene, what do you *do*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016930.english: "Besides *muscular*, did he have any other identifying traits?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016930.polish: „Miał jakieś cechy szczególne poza tym, że był *muskularny*?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016930.belarusian: "Акрамя таго, што *мускулісты*, ці былі ў яго іншыя прыкметы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016936.english: "Why was he staying at your place in the middle of night?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016936.polish: „Czemu był u ciebie w środku nocy?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016936.belarusian: "Чаму ён начаваў у цябе сярод ночы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016942.english: "The *homo-sexual underground*?" The smoker sits up immediately, his eyes wide with amused surprise; a honeyed smile lingers on his lips.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016942.polish: „*Homoseksualnego podziemia*?” – palacz prostuje się, w jego oczach widać rozbawienie, a na ustach pojawia się słodki uśmiech.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016942.belarusian: "*Гомасексуальнага падполля*?" — Курэц імгненна выпрамляецца, ягоныя вочы расшыраюцца ад забаўленага здзіўлення; мядовая ўсмешка застывае на ягоных вуснах.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016948.english: "Yes, but he was speaking to someone on his earpiece."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016948.polish: „Tak, ale rozmawiał z kimś przez słuchawkę w uchu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016948.belarusian: "Так, але размаўляў з некім праз навушнік".

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001694E.english: This *sexual* thing seems interesting... Ask around, become involved.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001694E.polish: Ciekawa ta *seksualna* sprawa... Popytaj ludzi, zaangażuj się w to.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001694E.belarusian: Гэтая *сексуальная* тэма выглядае цікава... Параспытвай, далучыся.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016954.english: "Oh, let me think..." He turns his eyes upward in recollection. "He had an accent. He sounded like one of those mercenaries."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016954.polish: „Och, niech no pomyślę...” – odpowiada, spoglądając gdzieś w górę, by przypomnieć sobie szczegóły. „Mówił z akcentem. Brzmiał jak jeden z tych najemników”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016954.belarusian: "О, дай падумаць... — ён закочвае вочы ўгору, прыгадваючы. — У яго быў акцэнт. Ён гучаў як адзін з тых наймітаў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001695A.english: "Yes, I want to hear more about this *homo-sexual underground* you're part of."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001695A.polish: „Tak, chcę dowiedzieć się więcej o tym *homoseksualnym podziemiu*, do którego należysz”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001695A.belarusian: "Так, я хачу пачуць больш пра гэтае *гомасексуальнае падполле*, часткай якога ты з'яўляешся".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016971.english: What is it about the way he carries himself?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016971.polish: Nosi się w jakiś niezwykły sposób. O co tu chodzi?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016971.belarusian: Што такога ў тым, як ён сябе трымае?

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001697F.english: "Just reporting back whatever I was telling him."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001697F.polish: „Po prostu powtarzał to, co mu mówiłem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001697F.belarusian: "Проста пераказваў усё, што я яму казаў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016985.english: Yes, this man is definitely one of the homos, I've seen them homos with my own eyes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016985.polish: Tak, ten gość jest zdecydowanie homo. Doskonale wiem, jak oni wyglądają.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016985.belarusian: Так, гэты мужык дакладна з гэтых гома, я бачыў гэтых гома на ўласныя вочы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016991.english: "You did?" A small smile adorns his face. "And how did you like him?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016991.polish: „Tak?” – jego twarz zdobi niewielki uśmiech. „Jak ci się spodobał?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016991.belarusian: "Сустрэў? — на ягоным твары з'яўляецца лёгкая ўсмешка. — І як ён табе?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016997.english: "He sounded vaguely Oranjese." He closes his eyes. "No, not vaguely, scratch that. He sounded *definitely* Oranjese."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016997.polish: „Brzmiał trochę jak ktoś z Oranje” – stwierdza i zamyka oczy. „Nie, nie trochę. Brzmiał *zdecydowanie* jak ktoś z Oranje”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016997.belarusian: "Ён гучаў крыху па-араньезску, — ён заплюшчвае вочы. — Не, не крыху, выкраслі гэта. Ён гучаў *дакладна* як араньезец".

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001699D.english: Could he be... a member of the *homo-sexual underground*?
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001699D.polish: Czy on może być... członkiem *homoseksualnego podziemia*?
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001699D.belarusian: Ці можа ён быць... сябрам *гомасексуальнага падполля*?

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000169A3.english: "Are you... are you part of the *homo-sexual underground*?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000169B5.polish: „Nic. Powiedziałem mu, że niczego nie widziałem”.

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000169C0.english: "Did you tell him about your friend?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016A3F.english: "I see you've found yourself a little something from my wardrobe." He scans you. "Not bad, not bad at all. What brings you here?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016A3F.polish: „Widzę, że znalazłeś coś dla siebie w mojej garderobie” – przygląda ci się. „Nieźle, całkiem nieźle. Co cię tu sprowadza?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016A3F.belarusian: "Бачу, ты знайшоў сабе нешта ў маім гардэробе, — ён аглядае цябе. — Някепска, зусім някепска. Што цябе сюды прывяло?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016A6E.english: "About the hat and the robe I'm wearing..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016A6E.polish: „Co do mojego ubrania i nakrycia głowy...”

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016AD9.english: "You can keep it, I don't mind. I can appreciate beauty when I see it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016AD9.polish: „Możesz to zatrzymać, nie mam nic przeciwko. Potrafię docenić piękno, gdy je ujrzę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016AD9.belarusian: "Можаш пакінуць сабе, я не супраць. Я ўмею цаніць прыгажосць, калі бачу яе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016AE3.english: It's the sports, he's a sports guy, all about that physical prowess and athletic skill... Nothing else here.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016AE3.polish: To kwestia sportu. Jest sportowcem, ceni fizyczne możliwości i atletyzm... Nic poza tym.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016AE3.belarusian: Гэта спорт: ён спартовец, увесь у фізічнай моцы ды атлетычным спрыце... Нічога больш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016AFB.english: "Why yes I am, officer. Why, do you want to *investigate*?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016AFB.belarusian: "Ну вядома ж, афіцэру. А што, хочаш правесці *расследаванне*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B01.english: He's assuming a role to mock you -- or to entertain himself with your ignorance. Don't fall for it!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B01.polish: Przyjmuje pozę, żeby cię wykpić albo żeby wyśmiać twoją ignorancję. Nie wolno na to pozwolić!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B01.belarusian: Ён уваходзіць у ролю, каб паздзекавацца з цябе — ці пацешыцца тваім невуцтвам. Не паддавайся!

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B0C.english: "No, I just wanted to know whether you were one of them."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B0C.polish: „Nie, chciałem tylko wiedzieć, czy do niego należysz”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B0C.belarusian: "Не, я проста хацеў даведацца, ці ты адзін з іх".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B13.english: "Well, I *am* one of them, one of this *sub-rosa pleasure group* congregating in cellars under the cover of night... Saturday night, sometimes even *Friday* night!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B13.polish: „No cóż, *jestem* jednym z nich – należę do jednej z tych *potajemnych grup rozkoszy* gromadzących się w piwnicach pod osłoną nocy... sobotniej nocy, a czasem nawet *piątkowej* nocy!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B13.belarusian: "Ну, я *сапраўды* адзін з іх, з гэтай *таемнай суполкі асалоды*, што збіраецца ў сутарэннях пад покрывам ночы... суботняй ночы, часам нават *пятнічнай*!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B1A.english: "Let's just not talk about this anymore."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B1A.belarusian: "Давай проста больш не гаварыць пра гэта".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B20.english: "Why not? Don't you want to hear about how we want to destroy the last vestiges of meaning, the last things people in Revachol have to hold on to, the meaning of man and woman?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B20.polish: „Dlaczego? Nie chcesz usłyszeć o tym, jak chcemy zniszczyć ostatnie ostoje znaczenia, ostatnie reduty, na których chronią się mieszkańcy Revacholu, tego, czym jest bycie mężczyzną i kobietą?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B20.belarusian: "Чаму б не? Хіба ты не хочаш пачуць пра тое, як мы хочам знішчыць апошнія рэшткі сэнсу, апошняе, за што людзі ў Рэвашолі яшчэ могуць трымацца, — сэнс мужчыны і жанчыны?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B33.english: "Or the true symbols of security, mother and father and their everlasting marriage... *Everything* will be constantly shifting and moving under our rule, the future will belong to a *circus* of identities, just spinning around, surreal and unreal..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B33.polish: „Albo prawdziwych symboli bezpieczeństwa: matki i ojca oraz ich nierozerwalnego małżeństwa... Pod naszymi rządami *wszystko* będzie się nieustannie zmieniać i przemieszczać, przyszłość będzie należała do *cyrku* tożsamości – wirującego, surrealistycznego i nierealnego…”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B33.belarusian: "Ці сапраўдныя сімвалы бяспекі, маці і бацьку і іх вечны шлюб... Пад нашай уладай *усё* будзе пастаянна змяняцца і рухацца, будучыня будзе належаць *цырку* ідэнтычнасцей, што проста кружыцца ў віры, сюррэалістычным і нерэальным..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B41.english: "You won't even know who you are anymore."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B41.belarusian: "Ты нават больш не будзеш ведаць, хто ты такі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B50.english: "But I like knowing who I am."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B56.english: "Does it have anything to do with disco?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B56.polish: „Czy to ma coś wspólnego z disco?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B56.belarusian: "Ці мае гэта хоць якое дачыненне да дыска?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B5C.english: "Other questions, I had other questions, really!" (Try to back off.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B5C.polish: „Dobrze, mam inne pytania. Mam je, naprawdę!” (Spróbuj się z tego wycofać).
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B5C.belarusian: "Іншыя пытанні, у мяне былі іншыя пытанні, праўда!" (Паспрабаваць адступіць.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B65.english: The smoker starts laughing and leans back against the counter: "Sure thing, officer, what do you want to know next?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B65.polish: Palacz zaczyna się śmiać i opiera się plecami o ladę. „Oczywiście, funkcjonariuszu. Co chcesz jeszcze wiedzieć?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B65.belarusian: Курэц пачынае смяяцца і адкідваецца на стойку: "Вядома ж, афіцэру, пра што ты хочаш даведацца далей?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B71.english: "Yes, we listen to a lot of disco. Some say we *engineered* disco to spread our vision of a vertiginous, ever-changing society, where all there is a razzle-dazzle of gold!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B71.polish: „Tak, często słuchamy disco. Niektórzy twierdzą nawet, że *stworzyliśmy* disco, aby szerzyć naszą wizję przyprawiającego o zawrót głowy, nieustannie zmieniającego się społeczeństwa, w którym wszystko lśni złotym blichtrem!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B71.belarusian: "Так, мы слухаем шмат дыска. Некаторыя кажуць, што мы *сканструявалі* дыска, каб пашыраць наша бачанне галавакружнага грамадства, якое вечна змяняецца, дзе ёсць толькі бліскавічны шык золата!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B78.english: "We are going to *change* the family unit with all this razzamatazz and finger-dancing," he wiggles his hands, "and with mysteries, of course, the mysteries are also of sexual nature, very esoteric."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B78.polish: „Zamierzamy *zmienić* całym tym mętlikiem i tańcem palców podstawową jednostkę społeczną, rodzinę” – wyjaśnia, przebierając palcami. „I tajemnicami, oczywiście – tajemnice mają też seksualną naturę, bardzo ezoteryczną”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B78.belarusian: "Мы збіраемся *змяніць* інстытут сям'і ўсім гэтым вірам-гармідарам і танцам пальцаў, — ён варушыць рукамі, — і таямніцамі, вядома ж: таямніцы таксама сексуальнага характару, вельмі эзатэрычныя".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B86.english: "I do like disco, maybe I should get into it?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B86.polish: „Lubię disco. Może powinienem się w to wkręcić?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B86.belarusian: "Я сапраўды люблю дыска, можа, мне варта гэтым заняцца?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B99.english: "You can't just get into it, you have to be born into it -- one is either already *in* the homo-sexual movement or forever excluded from it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B99.polish: „Nie da się w to tak po prostu wkręcić – z tym trzeba się urodzić. Albo się do homoseksualnego ruchu *należy*, albo jest się z niego na zawsze wykluczonym”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016B99.belarusian: "Ты не можаш проста так у гэта ўвайсці, з гэтым трэба нарадзіцца — ты альбо ўжо *ў* гомасексуальным руху, альбо назаўсёды выключаны з яго".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BA0.english: "What if I can't remember whether I'm in or not? What if I can't remember anything about my life -- aside from the fact that I like disco?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BA0.polish: „A jeśli nie pamiętam, czy do niego należę, czy nie? Co jeśli nie pamiętam ze swojego życia nic poza tym, że lubię disco?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BA0.belarusian: "А што, калі я не памятаю, у ім я ці не? Што, калі я нічога пра сваё жыццё не памятаю — акрамя таго, што люблю дыска?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BA7.polish: „Dobra, to na pewno się nie wkręcę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BA7.belarusian: "Добра, тады я дакладна не ў ім".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BAE.english: "Beautiful!" The smoker crawls up to you like an animal preparing to jump. "Beautiful, that's exactly what we're looking for! Who knows, maybe you *were* homo-sexual in the past, maybe all of that has been *repressed*..." He circles his hands around you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BAE.polish: „Pięknie!” – palacz podchodzi do ciebie jak zwierzę przygotowujące się do skoku. „Pięknie, właśnie do tego dążymy! Kto wie, może w przeszłości *byłeś* homoseksualistą – może to wszystko było *tłumione*...” – zatacza swoimi rękami wokół ciebie koła.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BAE.belarusian: "Цудоўна! — курэц падкрадаецца да цябе, нібы звер перад скачком. — Цудоўна, гэта акурат тое, што мы шукаем! Хто ведае, можа, ты *быў* гомасексуалам у мінулым, можа, усё гэта было *задушана*... — ён робіць рукамі кругі вакол цябе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BB5.english: "I have to say that you do look like someone who might be part of *the underground*. You have that very distinctive 'I-can't-understand-what's-going-on-here' look."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BB5.polish: „Muszę powiedzieć, że wyglądasz jak ktoś, kto mógłby należeć do *podziemia*. Masz to bardzo charakterystyczne spojrzenie, jakbyś nie miał pojęcia, co się wokół ciebie dzieje”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BB5.belarusian: "Мушу прызнаць, ты сапраўды выглядаеш як нехта, хто мог бы быць часткай *падполля*. У цябе гэты вельмі характэрны позірк накшталт 'я-не-магу-зразумець-што-тут-адбываецца'".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BC1.english: "But do you also like the *razzle-dazzle* of gold? Do you like parties and discos and having fun under the vibrant lights of Saturday night?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BC1.polish: „Ale czy lubisz też *blichtr* złota? Czy lubisz imprezy i dyskoteki, i zabawę w tętniących światłach sobotniej nocy?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BC1.belarusian: "Але ці падабаецца табе таксама *бліскавічны шык* золата? Ці падабаюцца табе вечарыны, дыскатэкі і забавы пад пульсуючым святлом суботняга вечара?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BC8.english: "Because instead of the traditional family unit we're going to have all this *razzamatazz*," he wiggles his hands, "and mysteries, of course, too -- mysteries of *sexual* nature, very esoteric. And disco music and drugs."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BC8.polish: „Bo zamiast tradycyjnej rodziny będziemy mieli cały ten *mętlik*” – wyjaśnia, przebierając palcami. „I tajemnice, oczywiście – tajemnice o *seksualnej* naturze, bardzo ezoteryczne. I muzykę disco, i narkotyki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016BC8.belarusian: "Бо замест традыцыйнай сям'і ў нас будзе ўвесь гэты *вір-гармідар*, — ён варушыць пальцамі, — і таямніцы, вядома ж, таксама — таямніцы *сексуальнага* характару, вельмі эзатэрычныя. І дыска-музыка, і наркотыкі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023F41.english: "I am. So are you. What brings you here?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023F41.polish: „Jestem. Ty też. Co cię tu sprowadza?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023F41.belarusian: "Тут. І ты тут. Што цябе сюды прывяло?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000750000361B.english: "Ah... But for the better part of history it *has been* illegal."
Dialogue Text/0x010000750000361B.belarusian: "А... але ж большую частку гісторыі яна і *была* незаконнай".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500003622.english: "Okay..." (Blink.) "Okay, I have to think about it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500003622.belarusian: "Добра..." (Мільгануць вачыма.) "Добра, мне трэба падумаць пра гэта".

Dialogue Text/0x010000750000364D.english: "Admiring the atmosphere..." He smiles. "What about you, officer?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000750000364D.belarusian: "Любуюся атмасферай... — ён усміхаецца. — А ты, афіцэру?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000750000370A.english: "I live here, my room is right upstairs."
Dialogue Text/0x010000750000370A.polish: „Mieszkam tu. Mój pokój jest na górze”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000750000370A.belarusian: "Я тут жыву, мой пакой проста наверсе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500003710.english: "I'm here to drink myself into oblivion."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500003710.polish: „Jestem tu, żeby się zapić na śmierć”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500003716.english: "This is where I'm going to go down in history: I'm going to sing karaoke."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500003716.polish: „Zamierzam zostać tu zapamiętany przez historię. Będę śpiewał karaoke”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500003716.belarusian: "Вось дзе я ўвайду ў гісторыю: я заспяваю ў караоке".

Dialogue Text/0x010000750000371C.english: "I'm here to kick some ass and solve the case I'm working on."
Dialogue Text/0x010000750000371C.polish: „Jestem tu, żeby skopać kilka tyłków i rozwiązać sprawę, nad którą pracuję”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000750000371C.belarusian: "Я тут, каб надаць па азадках і раскрыць справу, над якой працую".
