Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B91C.polish: „Stąd wygląda na to, że buty, które ma na sobie ofiara...” – porucznik przerywa w pół zdania. Nagła zmiana kierunku wiatru posyła na was smród rozkładającego się ciała. Porucznik próbuje kontynuować przerwaną myśl...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B91C.belarusian: "Адсюль боты ахвяры выглядаюць..." Лейтэнант змаўкае на паўслове. Раптоўная змена ветру дзьмухае смуродам гнілога мяса проста вам у твар. Ён спрабуе працягнуць...

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B923.english: It's bad. Very bad. Before you can heave the wind changes direction again, the greenhouse plastic flapping in it's gust.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B923.polish: Jest straszny. Naprawdę straszny. Zanim udaje ci się wstrzymać oddech, wiatr znów się zmienia. Plastik powłoki szklarni trzepocze od podmuchu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B923.belarusian: Кепска. Вельмі кепска. Перш чым вас паспявае званітаваць, вецер зноў змяняе кірунак, лопаючы цяплічнай плёнкай ад парыву.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B92A.english: "He appears to be wearing some kind of armoured boots. I can't see any exotic prints here..." His face muscles twitch. "Someone had to carry him. Are any of the other prints deep enough?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B92A.polish: „Zdaje się, że ma na sobie jakieś opancerzone buty. Nie widzę tu żadnych egzotycznych śladów...” – mięśnie jego twarzy wykonują mimowolny skurcz. „Ktoś musiał go przynieść. Czy któryś z pozostałych śladów jest wystarczająco głęboki?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B92A.belarusian: "Здаецца, ён у нейкіх браніраваных ботах. Я не бачу тут ніякіх экзатычных адбіткаў..." Мышцы на яго твары тузаюцца. "Нехта мусіў несці яго. Ці ёсць сярод іншых слядоў дастаткова глыбокія?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B93A.english: "Wind keeps changing... are any of the prints deep enough in your opinion?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B93A.polish: „Zmienia się kierunek wiatru... Czy według ciebie któryś z pozostałych śladów jest wystarczająco głęboki?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B93A.belarusian: "Вецер увесь час круціць... ці ёсць тут сляды, якія, на вашу думку, дастаткова глыбокія?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B954.english: "What do I think? A mob of people brought something heavy to the tree. One of them was carrying the victim. They shuffled around, especially under the tree."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B954.polish: „Co *ja* o tym myślę? Grupa ludzi przyniosła coś ciężkiego pod drzewo. Jeden z nich niósł ofiarę. Kręcili się tutaj – zwłaszcza pod drzewem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B954.belarusian: "Што я думаю? Натоўп прынёс нешта цяжкае да дрэва. Адзін з іх нёс ахвяру. Яны тапталіся на месцы, асабліва пад самім дрэвам."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B95B.english: "Then after hoisting him up, they stood in a semicircle facing his direction. At first glance, this appears to be a lynching."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B95B.polish: „Potem powiesili go i stali w półkolu z twarzami zwróconymi w jego kierunku. Na pierwszy rzut oka wygląda to na lincz”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B95B.belarusian: "Потым, узняўшы яго, яны сталі паўколам тварам да яго. На першы погляд гэта выглядае як самасуд."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B972.english: Isn't it strange when all your assumptions are confirmed like this? Stood in a semicircle, hung him, carried him over... like you're supposed to be feeling clever. And content.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B972.polish: Czy to nie dziwne, że twoje założenia tak się potwierdzają? Stali w półkolu, powiesili go, przynieśli... To jakbyś miał czuć się mądry. I zadowolony.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B972.belarusian: Ці не дзіўна, калі ўсе твае здагадкі вось так пацвярджаюцца? Стаялі паўколам, павесілі, прынеслі... быццам ты павінен адчуваць сябе разумным. І задаволеным.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B99F.english: Say: "Everything fits. We should celebrate by getting absolutely *UNDER THE HAMMER* in this yard."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B99F.polish: Powiedz: „Wszystko pasuje. Powinniśmy to uczcić, *CHLAJĄC NA TYM PODWÓRZU DO OPORU*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B99F.belarusian: Сказаць: "Усё сыходзіцца. Мы мусім адсвяткаваць гэта і наліцца *Ў СТЭЛЬКУ* проста ў гэтым двары."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9B4.english: That's not going to happen, I'm not letting him make it into one of his tasks. Know your limits, tie-creature!
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9B4.polish: Nie ma nawet mowy, nie pozwolę mu uznać tego za jedno z jego zadań. Znaj swoje miejsce, krawacia kreaturo!
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9B4.belarusian: Гэтага не будзе, я не дазволю яму зрабіць гэта адной са сваіх задач. Знай сваё месца, гальштучная пачвара!

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9DD.english: The lieutenant is saying something, but you can't hear it... Suddenly it seems like your tie is alive again, whispering -- no, *screaming* -- into your ear:
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9DD.polish: Porucznik mówi coś, ale nie słyszysz go... Nagle twój krawat znowu wydaje się żywy i szepcze – nie, on *krzyczy* – do twojego ucha:
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9DD.belarusian: Лейтэнант нешта кажа, але вы яго не чуеце... Раптам вам здаецца, што гальштук зноў ажыў і шэпча — не, *лямантуе* — вам у самае вуха:

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9E4.english: Live a little! Everything on the god damn crime scene fits like a glove, you should get *SHITFACED* on this *GOD DAMN CRIME SCENE*!
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9E4.polish: Ciesz ty się życiem! Wszystko na miejscu zbrodni pasuje jak ulał. Powinieneś się *UPODLIĆ WÓDĄ* na tym *ZASRANYM MIEJSCU PRZESTĘPSTWA*!
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9E4.belarusian: Пажыві хоць трохі! Усё на гэтым клятым месцы злачынства падыходзіць ідэальна, ты павінен *НАБУХАЦЦА Ў ДЗЯРМО* проста на гэтым *КЛЯТЫМ МЕСЦЫ ЗЛАЧЫНСТВА*!

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9EF.english: Say: "I'm experiencing a mild malfunction, lieutenant. Something to do with my tie. It'll pass, can you hold on for a moment?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9EF.polish: Powiedz: „Mam niewielką awarię, poruczniku. To coś związanego z moim krawatem. Zaraz mi przejdzie. Możesz chwilkę zaczekać?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9EF.belarusian: Сказаць: "У мяне тут невялікі збой, лейтэнант. Нешта звязанае з маім гальштукам. Зараз пройдзе, пачакаеце секунду?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9FE.english: This is not how vivid I want my inner life to be. I just want to get back to solving the crime now.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9FE.polish: Nie chcę, żeby moje życie wewnętrzne było aż tak bogate. Chcę wrócić po prostu do śledztwa.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000B9FE.belarusian: Я не хачу, каб маё ўнутранае жыццё было настолькі яркім. Я проста хачу вярнуцца да расследавання злачынства.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA03.english: I'll find a way to get drunk on this scene, I swear to god I will.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA03.polish: Znajdę sposób, żeby się tutaj nawalić, przysięgam to na boga.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA03.belarusian: Я знайду спосаб набухацца на гэтым месцы, клянуся богам, знайду.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA0A.english: I like how vivid my interior is, but could we maybe do something that doesn't involve getting drunk?
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA0A.polish: Podoba mi się moje bogate życie wewnętrzne, ale może zajęlibyśmy się czymś niezwiązanym z piciem na umór?
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA0A.belarusian: Мне падабаецца, які яркі мой унутраны свет, але, можа, зоймемся чымсьці, што не патрабуе напівацца?

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA10.english: REGARDEZ LA RETARD! He wants to have fun *without* alcohol. That won't be fun, that'll be boring and sad.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA10.polish: REGARDEZ LA RETARD! Chce się dobrze bawić *bez* alkoholu. To nie będzie zabawa, tylko nudziarski smut.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA10.belarusian: REGARDEZ LA RETARD! Ён хоча весяліцца *без* алкаголю. Гэта будзе не весела, гэта будзе нудна і сумна.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA20.english: The lieutenant looks at you curiously. A beat passes in silence, the wind blowing, the cargo belt squeaking.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA20.polish: Porucznik spogląda na ciebie z zaciekawieniem. Mija chwila w ciszy – wieje wiatr, trzeszczy pas transportowy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA20.belarusian: Лейтэнант з цікаўнасцю глядзіць на вас. Праходзіць секунда маўчання, вецер дзьме, рыпіць грузавы рэмень.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA27.english: "I agree," he clears his throat. "Our assumptions could be wrong. Better not to have them confirmed just yet. Do you see anything else?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA27.polish: „Zgadzam się” – potwierdza, po czym odchrząkuje. „Nasze założenia mogą być błędne. Lepiej jeszcze ich nie potwierdzać. Widzisz coś jeszcze?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA27.belarusian: "Згодзен", — ён адхаркваецца. — "Нашы здагадкі могуць быць памылковымі. Лепш пакуль не рабіць канчатковых высноў. Ці бачыце вы яшчэ нешта?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA35.english: "Uhm..." His face is one of disbelief. The words coming out of your mouth are filled with such sincerity.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA35.polish: „Ee...” – na jego twarzy maluje się niedowierzanie. Słowa, które padają z twoich ust, są przepełnione wyjątkową szczerością.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA35.belarusian: "Гм..." На яго твары напісаны недавер. Словы, што сыходзяць з вашых вуснаў, прасякнутыя такой шчырасцю.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA3C.english: "Yes, it was naive of me to congratulate us. Assumptions are dangerous." He looks around. "Do you see anything else?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA3C.polish: „Tak, gratulacje były przejawem naiwności z mojej strony. Założenia są niebezpieczne” – rozgląda się. „Widzisz coś jeszcze?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA3C.belarusian: "Так, было наіўна з майго боку рана віншаваць нас. Здагадкі небяспечныя", — ён азіраецца. — "Ці бачыце вы яшчэ нешта?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA43.english: The lieutenant doesn't understand what's happening right now. You're twisting at your tie, looking sweaty even by your standards. He needs to say something.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA43.polish: Porucznik nie rozumie, co się z tobą dzieje. Szarpiesz swój krawat i wyglądasz na niesamowicie spoconego nawet jak na siebie. Musi coś powiedzieć.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA43.belarusian: Лейтэнант не разумее, што зараз адбываецца. Вы круціце свой гальштук і выглядаеце спацелым нават па вашых мерках. Яму трэба нешта сказаць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA4F.english: "Do you think there's something we're missing?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA65.english: I have no idea what's going on here, but you should not do anything that the horrific necktie tells you to do.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA65.polish: Nie mam pojęcia, co się tutaj dzieje, ale nie powinieneś robić niczego, co proponuje ci ten okropny krawat.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA65.belarusian: Паняцця не маю, што тут адбываецца, але табе не варта рабіць нічога з таго, што кажа гэты жахлівы гальштук.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA6C.english: "Yes. We should have another look at the tracks."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA6C.polish: „Tak. Powinniśmy jeszcze raz spojrzeć na ślady”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA6C.belarusian: "Так. Нам варта яшчэ раз зірнуць на сляды."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA78.english: "We should just generally withhold being content. With life. It's a philosophical disposition we should have."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA78.polish: „Powinniśmy tak ogólnie powstrzymywać zadowolenie. Takie z życia. To powinna być nasza filozoficzna postawa”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA78.belarusian: "Нам увогуле не варта радавацца. Жыццю. Гэта філасофская пазіцыя, якой мы мусім трымацца."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA81.english: His eyebrows arch. They are the liveliest part of his otherwise quite inexpressive face:
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA81.polish: Unosi brwi. To w tej chwili najbardziej ekspresyjny element jego pozbawionej wyrazu twarzy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA81.belarusian: Ягоныя бровы падымаюцца. Гэта самая жывая частка ягонага ў астатнім даволі невыразнага твару:

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA88.english: "Is that so? Well, okay I guess. If it helps with the police-work, by all means. Do you see anything else?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA88.polish: „Doprawdy? No cóż, skoro tak uważasz. Jeśli to pomoże w naszym śledztwie, to jak najbardziej. Widzisz tu coś więcej?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA88.belarusian: "Вось як? Ну, добра, напэўна. Калі гэта дапамагае ў паліцэйскай працы — калі ласка. Ці бачыце вы яшчэ нешта?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA94.english: "It does." He looks around. "I shouldn't have assumed in the first place. The caller could have lied, the whole thing could be misreported. Should we take another look? Or go?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA94.polish: „Rzeczywiście” – rozgląda się wokół. „Nie powinienem był niczego zakładać. Zgłaszający mógł kłamać – całe to zgłoszenie mogło mijać się z prawdą. Rozejrzymy się tu jeszcze raz? Czy wystarczy?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA94.belarusian: "Сапраўды", — ён азіраецца. — "Мне не варта было рабіць паспешлівых высноў. Той, хто званіў, мог схлусіць, усё магло быць зусім інакш. Паглядзім яшчэ раз? Ці пойдзем?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA9E.english: "Mhm. If it fits too well, we might be missing something. What do you see?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA9E.polish: „Mhm. Jeśli wszystko pasuje do siebie zbyt dobrze, to mogliśmy coś przeoczyć. Co widzisz?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BA9E.belarusian: "Мгм. Калі ўсё сыходзіцца занадта добра, мы маглі нешта прапусціць. Што вы бачыце?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAA6.english: "I think we have a firm understanding of what happened here."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAA6.polish: „Myślę, że wiemy już całkiem dobrze, co się tutaj wydarzyło”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAA6.belarusian: "Думаю, мы дакладна разумеем, што тут адбылося."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAAD.english: The lieutenant's eyes narrow. He's thinking to himself.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAAD.polish: Porucznik mruży oczy. O czymś myśli.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAAD.belarusian: Лейтэнант прыжмурваецца. Ён разважае сам сабе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAB4.english: A doubt perhaps? It would be unprofessional of him to be sure of himself at such an early stage of the investigation.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAB4.polish: Czyżby to była wątpliwość? Zbytnia pewność siebie na tak wczesnym etapie śledztwa byłaby z jego strony nieprofesjonalna.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAB4.belarusian: Сумнеў, магчыма? З ягонага боку было б непрафесійна быць настолькі ўпэўненым на такой ранняй стадыі расследавання.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BABB.belarusian: "Як бы там ні было... — падсумоўвае ён. — Што яшчэ?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAD4.english: The lieutenant looks around, tracing your eyes on the tracks.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAD4.polish: Porucznik rozgląda się wokoło, śledząc twoje spojrzenie omiatające ślady.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAD4.belarusian: Лейтэнант азіраецца, сочачы за вашым позіркам па слядах.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAE0.english: There are several footprints in the mud, left by work boots: anywhere from 6 to 12 pairs have walked here.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAE0.polish: W błocie widać liczne ślady odzianych w robocze buty stóp. Mogło tu chodzić od 6 do 12 osób.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BAE0.belarusian: У гразі відаць некалькі слядоў ад працоўных ботаў: тут прайшло ад 6 да 12 пар.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BB00.english: Heavy worker's boots with reinforced toes and hobnails. All over the yard.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BB00.polish: Ciężkie buty robocze ze wzmocnionymi czubami i ćwiekami. Ślady są na całym podwórzu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BB00.belarusian: Цяжкія працоўныя боты з узмоцненымі насамі і падкоўкамі. Па ўсім двары.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BB07.english: Isn't this something an industrial worker would wear?
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BB07.polish: Czy to nie obuwie, jakie noszą zwykle robotnicy w zakładach przemysłowych?
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BB07.belarusian: Хіба гэта не абутак прамысловага працоўнага?

tooltip2/0x010000040000BB1B.polish: Chłopaki Hardiego powiedzieli, że powiesili ofiarę.
tooltip2/0x010000040000BB1B.belarusian: Хлопцы Хардзі сказалі, што павесілі ахвяру.

tooltip3/0x010000040000BB1B.polish: Wewnętrzny głos kazał ci to zrobić.
tooltip3/0x010000040000BB1B.belarusian: Унутраны голас сказаў табе гэта зрабіць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BB2C.english: What do you think you are, a super-detective? You're hung over, these are just dents in the mud. No pattern emerges for the time being.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BB2C.polish: Za kogo ty się masz? Superdetektywa? Masz kaca, a to są zwykłe wgłębienia w błocie. Na razie nie dostrzegasz w nich żadnych sensownych wzorów.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BB2C.belarusian: Кім ты сябе ўяўляеш, супердэтэктывам? У цябе пахмелле, а гэта проста яміны ў гразі. Пакуль ніякіх заканамернасцяў не відаць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BB43.english: Eight pairs of boots have shuffled back and forth in the mud.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BB43.polish: W błocie kręciło się w tę i z powrotem osiem par butów.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000BB43.belarusian: Восем пар ботаў тапталіся ў гразі туды-сюды.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000EDC6.english: "As I said, I pulled last week's forecast for coastal Revachol. Seven days below freezing. The day before his hanging was the last warm day."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000EDC6.polish: „Jak już mówiłem, sprawdziłem prognozy pogody dla wybrzeża Revacholu z ostatniego tygodnia. Siedem dni z temperaturą poniżej zera. Dzień przed jego powieszeniem był ostatnim z dodatnią temperaturą”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000EDC6.belarusian: "Як я ўжо казаў, я паглядзеў прагноз надвор'я на мінулы тыдзень для ўзбярэжжа Рэвашоля. Сем дзён трымаўся мароз. Дзень перад яго павешаннем быў апошнім цёплым днём."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B0EE.english: ...you won't get far without the lieutenant here to bounce thoughts off of -- where could he be right now? The asphalt passing underneath the front wheels of his motor carriage at a high speed...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B0EE.polish: ...niewiele tu zdziałasz, nie mogąc konsultować swoich rozmyślań z porucznikiem. Gdzie on może teraz być? Asfalt znika pod przednimi kołami, kiedy pędzi przed siebie swoim powozem motorowym...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B0EE.belarusian: ...вы не далёка зойдзеце без лейтэнанта, каб абмеркаваць з ім думкі, — дзе ён зараз можа быць? Асфальт імкліва праносіцца пад пярэднімі коламі ягонай маторнай карэты...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B0FC.english: "Perhaps it could be a *driver*? A driver would wear out their right shoe before the left. The accelerator is on the right."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B0FC.polish: „Może to był *kierowca*? Kierowca znosiłby prawy but przed lewym. Pedał gazu znajduje się po prawej stronie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B0FC.belarusian: "Можа, гэта мог быць *кіроўца*? Кіроўца сцёр бы правы чаравік раней за левы. Педаль газу справа."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B106.english: "Interesting. If only I had come up with that idea."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B106.polish: „Ciekawe. Szkoda, że nie przyszło mi to do głowy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B106.belarusian: "Цікава. Шкада, што гэта не я прыдумаў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B10B.english: "I was actually thinking the exact same thing."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000B10B.belarusian: "Я якраз думаў дакладна пра тое самае."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FE97.english: "Noted." The lieutenant takes out his little notebook.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FE97.polish: „Odnotowane” – odpowiada porucznik, wyjmując swój mały notatnik.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FE97.belarusian: "Прынята да ведама", — лейтэнант дастае свой маленькі нататнік.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FEB3.english: He doesn't seem to hear you, looking south toward the traffic jam instead. The machines are silent, the engines are all turned off...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FEB3.polish: Zdaje się, że cię nie słucha. Zamiast tego spogląda na południe, w kierunku drogowego zatoru. Pojazdy nie wydają żadnych dźwięków – ich silniki są wyłączone...
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FEB3.belarusian: Здаецца, ён вас не чуе, гледзячы на поўдзень, у бок затору. Машыны маўчаць, рухавікі заглушаныя...

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FECC.english: "Perhaps it could be a *driver?*" He raises his index finger. "A driver would wear out their right shoe before the left. The accelerator is on the right."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FECC.polish: „Może to był *kierowca*?” – pyta, unosząc palec wskazujący. „Kierowca znosiłby prawy but przed lewym. Pedał gazu znajduje się po prawej stronie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FECC.belarusian: "Можа, гэта мог быць *кіроўца*?" — ён падымае ўказальны палец. — "Кіроўца сцёр бы правы чаравік раней за левы. Педаль газу справа."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FED8.english: "Probably yes. This would also fit with the victim being dead from a previous gunshot wound. They had to carry him, because he could no longer walk."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FED8.polish: „Prawdopodobnie tak. To pasowałoby też do tego, że ofiara była już wtedy martwa z powodu strzału w głowę. Przynieśli go, bo nie był już w stanie chodzić”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FED8.belarusian: "Хутчэй за ўсё, так. Гэта таксама стасуецца з тым, што ахвяра ўжо была мёртвая ад агнястрэльнага ранення. Ім давялося несці яго, бо сам ён ісці ўжо не мог."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FEE2.english: We're liking this. The pieces fit.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FEE2.polish: Podoba nam się to. Kawałki układanki do siebie pasują.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FEED.english: He makes a note in his blue binder: "Is there anything else that's noteworthy here?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FEED.polish: Robi notatkę w swoim niebieskim notatniku. „Widzisz tu jeszcze coś wartego odnotowania?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FEED.belarusian: Ён робіць запіс у сваёй блакітнай папцы: "Ці ёсць тут яшчэ нешта вартае ўвагі?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FEFB.english: "But we *know* the victim had a bullet in his head. A more precise way to put it is: it was *made* to look like a lynching."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FEFB.polish: „Ale *wiemy*, że ofiara miała pocisk w mózgu. Więc ujmując to precyzyjniej, należałoby powiedzieć, że *upozorowano* lincz”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FEFB.belarusian: "Але мы *ведаем*, што ў ахвяры была куля ў галаве. Больш дакладна будзе сказаць: усё было зроблена так, каб *выглядаць* як самасуд."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF03.english: The lieutenant doesn't understand what's happening right now. You're twisting at your tie, looking sweaty even by your standards. He needs to say something.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF03.polish: Porucznik nie rozumie, co się z tobą dzieje. Szarpiesz swój krawat i wyglądasz na niesamowicie spoconego nawet jak na siebie. Musi coś powiedzieć.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF03.belarusian: Лейтэнант не разумее, што зараз адбываецца. Вы круціце свой гальштук і выглядаеце спацелым нават па вашых мерках. Яму трэба нешта сказаць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF0D.english: I'm pretty good at this, ain't I?
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF0D.polish: Jestem w tym całkiem dobry, nie?

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF14.english: You're not bad. It's as if the whole world darkens, everything else has a thin film of unimportance on it -- and the tracks burn in the middle of it, in a strange, beautiful way.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF14.polish: Nie jesteś słaby. To jakby cały świat pociemniał, pokryty cienką warstwą nieistotności, wśród której w dziwaczny, ale i piękny sposób płoną te ślady stóp.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF14.belarusian: Ты нядрэнны. Быццам увесь свет цямнее, усё астатняе пакрываецца тонкай плёнкай няважнасці — а сляды палаюць пасярод гэтага дзіўнай, прыгожай выявай.

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF24.english: "A morbidly obese 250 kilogram man? Let's say it is a very *low* probability. I'm thinking..." He looks around. "Maybe there's a more *commonplace* explanation."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF24.polish: „Chorobliwie otyły, 250-kilogramowy mężczyzna? Powiedzmy, że jest to bardzo *mało* prawdopodobne. Myślę...” – rozgląda się wokół. „Myślę, że jest jakieś bardziej *banalne* wyjaśnienie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF24.belarusian: "Хваравіта атлусцелы чалавек вагой 250 кілаграмаў? Скажам так, гэта вельмі *малаверагодна*. Я вось думаю..." Ён азіраецца. "Можа, ёсць больш *звыклае* тлумачэнне."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF3C.english: "Like the Coalition official said... surreal like a *play*."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF3C.polish: „Jak to powiedział urzędnik Koalicji... surrealne niczym *spektakl*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF3C.belarusian: "Як і казаў чыноўнік Кааліцыі... сюррэалістычна, быццам *спектакль*."

Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF51.english: "Exactly. They had to perform it to whoever was looking -- the whole neighbourhood, I suppose." He adds: "And us too."
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF51.polish: „Zgadza się. To było przedstawienie dla tych, którzy patrzyli – przypuszczam, że dla całej okolicy” – stwierdza, po czym dodaje: „I dla nas”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000450001FF51.belarusian: "Менавіта. Яны мусілі разыграць гэта для ўсіх, хто глядзеў — думаю, для ўсяго раёна", — дадае ён. — "І для нас таксама."

Dialogue Text/0x0100004500020459.english: OH YEAH BABY! FUCK THIS PLACE UP!
Dialogue Text/0x0100004500020459.belarusian: О ТАК, ДЗЕТКА! РАЗНЕСІ ГЭТАЕ МЕСЦА Ў ДРАБАЗНЫ!

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004E9A.english: "The fat guy from the mess hall isn't *that* obese, he's more like a farm boy -- definitely not 250 kilograms on his own. You have to admit, he's the best fit we've got."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004E9A.polish: „Ten gruby koleś ze stołówki nie jest aż *tak* otyły – to raczej taki farmer przy kości, na pewno nie waży 250 kilogramów. A musisz przyznać, że on najlepiej pasuje do tej teorii”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004E9A.belarusian: "Таўстун з залы не настолькі *ўжо* атлусцелы, ён хутчэй як вясковы дзяцюк — сам па сабе на 250 кілаграмаў дакладна не цягне. Але мусіце прызнаць, ён падыходзіць лепш за ўсіх."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004EC6.english: "I'm guessing that's the skinny Hardie boy, the one with his front teeth missing."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004EC6.polish: „Zgaduję, że to ślady chudego chłopaka Hardiego – tego bez zęba z przodu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004EC6.belarusian: "Мяркую, гэта той хударлявы хлопец Хардзі, у якога няма пярэдніх зубоў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004EDB.english: "I could still be wrong, but... I'm probably not."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004EDB.polish: „Oczywiście mogę się mylić... Ale raczej się nie mylę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004EDB.belarusian: "Я, вядома, магу памыляцца, але... хутчэй за ўсё, не."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004EE1.english: "Hmm, maybe you're right and it's someone else... although I doubt it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004EE1.polish: „Hmm... Może masz rację i chodzi o kogoś innego... Chociaż wątpię w to”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004EE1.belarusian: "Гм, можа, вы і маеце рацыю, і гэта нехта іншы... хоць я сумняваюся."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004EF3.english: Go over them one by one.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004EFB.english: 1) Standard work boot, steel reinforced toes, no 46. Just like Titus was wearing in his booth. This is the big dick -- Titus Hardie. The one with the ball cap on his head.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004EFB.polish: 1) Standardowy but roboczy ze wzmacnianym stalą czubem. Rozmiar 46. Takie buty miał na stołówce Titus. No wiesz, pan wielki kutas. Titus Hardie. Ten z bejsbolówką.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004EFB.belarusian: 1) Звычайны працоўны бот, узмоцнены сталлю насок, 46-ы памер. Такія ж, як у Цітуса ў кабінцы. Гэта гэты круты хлопец — Цітус Хардзі. Той, што ў бейсболцы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F01.english: 2) Standard work boot, steel reinforced toes, no 44. Either the blond muscular guy, Glen, or the young guy with a plectrum around his neck.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F01.polish: 2) Standardowy but roboczy ze wzmacnianym stalą czubem. Rozmiar 44. Albo muskularny blondas Glen, albo ten młody z kostką gitarową na szyi.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F01.belarusian: 2) Звычайны працоўны бот, узмоцнены сталлю насок, 44-ы памер. Або светлавалосы качок Глен, або малады хлопец з медыятарам на шыі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F07.english: 3) Hobnailed work boot, steel reinforced toes, no 43. The inked banger perhaps?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F07.polish: 3) Ćwiekowany but roboczy ze wzmacnianym stalą czubem. Rozmiar 43. Może ten gangus z dziarami?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F07.belarusian: 3) Падкаваны працоўны бот, узмоцнены сталлю насок, 43-і памер. Можа, той забіты татуіроўкамі гангстар?

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F0D.english: 4) Standard work boot, no 45 or 46... Theo, the old smoker. You think you even see a tiny fleck of cigarette ash inside the print...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F0D.polish: 4) Standardowy but roboczy. Rozmiar 45 lub 46... Theo, palacz w podeszłym wieku. Wydaje ci się nawet, że widzisz w odcisku mały płatek papierosowego popiołu...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F0D.belarusian: 4) Звычайны працоўны бот, 45-ы ці 46-ы памер... Тэа, стары курэц. Табе здаецца, што ў адбітку ты нават бачыш дробную шматку цыгарэтнага попелу...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F19.english: 5) Another standard work boot, reinforced toes, no 44. Same as before -- either the musician Eugene, or the muscle-bound blond Glen.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F19.polish: 5) Kolejny standardowy but roboczy ze wzmacnianym stalą czubem. Rozmiar 44. Tak jak wcześniej – albo to muzyk Eugene, albo muskularny blondyn Glen.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F19.belarusian: 5) Яшчэ адзін звычайны працоўны бот, узмоцнены насок, 44-ы памер. Так жа, як і раней: або музыкант Эжэн, або мускулісты бландынак Глен.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F1F.english: 6) Light as air. Same make of boot, but no 41. Small like a rat? Shanky!
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F1F.polish: 6) Ślady lekkie jak piórko. Równy krok. Ten sam typ buta, ale rozmiar 41. Małe jak u szczura? Kosior!
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F1F.belarusian: 6) Лёгкі як пёрка. Такая ж мадэль бота, але 41-ы памер. Маленькі, як пацук? Вострык!

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F25.english: 7) The glowing outline of a standard work boot, no 46. The imprints are *twice* as deep as the others -- the weight exceeds 200 kilograms. Fat-Angus -- carrying something?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F25.polish: 7) Wyraźny odcisk standardowego buta roboczego, rozmiar 46. Ślady są jednak *dwa razy* głębsze od innych. Ponad 200 kilogramów nacisku. Gruby Angus. Coś niósł?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F25.belarusian: 7) Зіхоткі контур звычайнага працоўнага бота, 46-ы памер. Адбіткі *ўдвая* глыбейшыя за іншыя — вага перавышае 200 кілаграмаў. Тоўсты Ангус — нешта нёс?

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F2B.english: 8) Another standard work boot, no 44. There's an aberration in the pattern of the sole. The right sole is smoother, more worn. Curious... A missing *eighth* Hardie boy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F2B.polish: 8) Kolejny standardowy but roboczy, rozmiar 44. Bieżnik podeszwy jest nierównomierny. Ten na prawym bucie jest gładszy, bardziej zużyty. Ciekawe... To brakujący, *ósmy* chłopak Hardiego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F2B.belarusian: 8) І яшчэ адзін звычайны працоўны бот, 44-ы памер. Аднак на малюнку падэшвы ёсць анамалія. Правая падэшва больш гладкая, мацней сцёртая. Цікава... Зніклы *восьмы* хлопец Хардзі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F37.english: "I never got the hang of it. Hyperopia." He points to his glasses. "Any of them look familiar? Are these the Hardies?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F37.polish: „Nigdy nie byłem w tym najlepszy. Nadwzroczność” – wskazuje swoje okulary. „Czy te ślady wyglądają znajomo? Zostawili je chłopaki Hardiego?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F37.belarusian: "Я ніколі не ўмеў гэта рабіць. Дальназоркасць", — ён паказвае на акуляры. — "Ці выглядае нехта з іх знаёмым? Гэта хлопцы Хардзі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F69.english: I'm pretty good at this, ain't I?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F69.polish: Jestem w tym całkiem dobry, nie?

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F75.english: You're not bad. It's as if the whole world darkens -- and the tracks burn in it with strange beauty.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F75.polish: Nie jesteś słaby. To jakby cały świat pociemniał, a ślady płonęły w nim w dziwacznie piękny sposób.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F75.belarusian: Ты нядрэнны. Быццам увесь свет цямнее — і сляды палаюць у ім дзіўнай прыгажосцю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F8B.english: Maybe the carrier wanted to impress his peers... demonstrate his physical might?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F8B.polish: Może ten niosący chciał zaimponować pozostałym... Pokazać swoją fizyczną siłę?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F8B.belarusian: Можа, той, хто нёс, хацеў уразіць сваіх сябрукоў... паказаць сваю фізічную моц?

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F9D.english: "I do." The lieutenant marks something in his notebook. "The fat guy, I think I heard them call him Angus -- most likely to have carried the victim over."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F9D.polish: „A ja wiem” – porucznik zaznacza coś w swoim notatniku. „Ten gruby facet, zdaje się, że nazywają go Angus – to najprawdopodobniej on przyniósł tutaj ofiarę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00004F9D.belarusian: "А я ведаю", — лейтэнант робіць пазнаку ў нататніку. "Таўстун, здаецца, я чуў, як яго называлі Ангусам, — хутчэй за ўсё, гэта ён прынёс сюды ахвяру."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005048.english: Is it? They didn't even bother to change boots. Putting them on the scene is easy; maybe even *too* easy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005048.polish: Tak? Nie przyszło im nawet do głowy zmienić butów. Umieszczenie ich na miejscu zbrodni było łatwe. Może nawet *zbyt* łatwe.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005048.belarusian: Праўда? Яны нават не паклапаціліся змяніць абутак. Прывязаць іх да месца злачынства лёгка; магчыма, нават *занадта* лёгка.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000050C8.english: "Seven sets of tracks, right?" The lieutenant has been tracking your eyes' movements. "The Hardie boys were here..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000050C8.polish: „Siedem zestawów śladów, zgadza się?” – pyta porucznik. Śledził ruch twoich oczu. „Były tu chłopaki Hardiego...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000050C8.belarusian: "Сем пар слядоў, так?" — лейтэнант сачыў за рухам вашых вачэй. — "Хлопцы Хардзі былі тут..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000050DD.english: "That so? Interesting. Then one of them seems to be missing. Anything else out of the ordinary?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000050DD.polish: „Naprawdę? Interesujące. W takim razie zdaje się, że jednego brakuje. Zauważyłeś jeszcze coś niezwykłego?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000050DD.belarusian: "Вось як? Цікава. Значыць, аднаго не хапае. Нешта яшчэ незвычайнае ёсць?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A616.english: "So far so good -- only one thing missing." He looks at the tracks, face lighting up from the realization.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A616.polish: „Jak na razie wszystko się zgrywa, tylko jednej rzeczy brakuje” – przygląda się śladom, a jego twarz rozjaśnia nagłe zrozumienie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A616.belarusian: "Пакуль што ўсё сыходзіцца — не хапае толькі адной дэталі", — ён глядзіць на сляды, і яго твар святлее ад здагадкі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A626.english: "I know. Eight tracks, seven Hardie boys."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A626.belarusian: "Я ведаю. Восем слядоў, сямёра хлопцаў Хардзі."

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A62C.english: Let him have his moment of joy.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A632.english: Of course, there were eight tracks! But there are only *seven* Hardie boys.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A632.polish: Oczywiście, było osiem par śladów! A chłopaków Hardiego jest tylko *siedmiu*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A632.belarusian: Вядома, слядоў было восем пар! А хлопцаў Хардзі толькі *сямёра*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A63D.english: "There's one pair missing from the Union box. The eighth pair. I'm going to say it was our odd-sole."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A63D.polish: „W sali Związku brakuje jednej pary butów. Ósmej pary. Zaryzykuję stwierdzenie, że to nasza »dziwna podeszwa«”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A63D.belarusian: "У зале Прафсаюза не хапае адной пары. Восьмай пары. Я б сказаў, гэта была наша дзіўная падэшва."

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A644.english: "Mhmh. Which one is missing do you think?" He quickly adds: "I'm going to say it was our odd-sole."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A644.polish: „Mhm. Którego, według ciebie, brakuje?” – pyta, po czym szybko dodaje: „Moim zdaniem chodzi o naszą »dziwną podeszwę«”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A644.belarusian: "Мгм. Як думаеце, каго не хапае?" — ён хутка дадае: — "Я б сказаў, нашай дзіўнай падэшвы."

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A652.english: He's not going to let you steal his thunder twice.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A652.polish: Nie pozwoli ci dwukrotnie podkraść jego spostrzeżenia.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000A652.belarusian: Ён не дазволіць вам двойчы скрасці яго трыумф.

Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AAF8.english: "So, the odd-sole was present at the lynching, but isn't in the mess hall right now."
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AAF8.polish: „Czyli dziwna podeszwa była obecna podczas linczu, ale nie ma jej teraz na stołówce”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000820000AAF8.belarusian: "Значыць, дзіўная падэшва была на самасудзе, але зараз яе няма ў зале."

Dialogue Text/0x01000078000099D9.english: Check out the big brains on Harrier Du Bois!
Dialogue Text/0x01000078000099D9.polish: I proszę, panie Harrier Du Bois! Ale masz mózgownicę!
Dialogue Text/0x01000078000099D9.belarusian: Паглядзіце, якія мазгі ў Гар'е Дзю Буа!

Dialogue Text/0x01000078000099E2.english: Check out the big brains on Harry Whatever-Your-Last-Name-Is!
Dialogue Text/0x01000078000099E2.polish: I proszę, panie Harry Jak Ty Tam Masz Na Nazwisko! Ale masz mózgownicę!
Dialogue Text/0x01000078000099E2.belarusian: Паглядзіце, якія мазгі ў Гары Як-Там-Тваё-Прозвішча!

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CA1.english: "A *driver* would wear down their right shoe before the left -- the accelerator is on the right. And remember that abandoned lorry cabin we found?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CA1.polish: „*Kierowca* znosiłby prawy but przed lewym. Pedał gazu znajduje się po prawej stronie. Pamiętasz tę porzuconą szoferkę, którą znaleźliśmy?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CA1.belarusian: "*Кіроўца* сцёр бы правы чаравік раней за левы — педаль газу справа. І памятаеш тую закінутую кабіну грузавіка, якую мы знайшлі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CA7.english: "With a piece of sandpaper glued to the throttle..." The lieutenant adjusts his glasses as his eyes light up with excitement.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CA7.polish: „Tę z papierem ściernym przyklejonym do pedału gazu...” – stwierdza porucznik, poprawiając swoje okulary. Jego oczy lśnią z ekscytacji.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CA7.belarusian: "З кавалкам наждачкі, налепленым на педаль газу..." — лейтэнант папраўляе акуляры, і яго вочы загараюцца ад хвалявання.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CAE.english: "Which means that the missing lady driver was also present at the lynching? That's it, she's the odd-sole!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CAE.polish: „To by oznaczało, że zaginiona kierowczyni również brała udział w linczu? To jej but miał »dziwną podeszwę«!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CAE.belarusian: "Гэта значыць, што зніклая кіроўца таксама была на самасудзе? Вось яно, гэта яе дзіўная падэшва!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CBA.english: "She's also the one running the drug trade... Interesting."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CBA.polish: „I to ona zajmowała się narkobiznesem. Ciekawe”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CC0.english: "Now we know who's the missing eighth person at the lynching. Do you think that Hardie and his boys could also be involved in the drug operation?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CC0.polish: „Teraz wiemy, kto jest ósmą, brakującą osobą, która brała udział w linczu. Myślisz, że Hardie i jego chłopaki biorą też udział w handlu narkotykami?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CC0.belarusian: "Цяпер мы ведаем, хто гэты зніклы восьмы чалавек на самасудзе. Думаеце, Хардзі і яго хлопцы таксама могуць быць замяшаныя ў наркааперацыі?"

Alternate1/0x0100007800009CC0.polish: „To mi wygląda na dowód na to, że ósmą, brakującą osobą, która brała udział w linczu, była Ruby... Myślisz, że Hardie i jego »chłopaki« biorą też udział w handlu narkotykami?”
Alternate1/0x0100007800009CC0.belarusian: "Гэта выглядае як доказ таго, што зніклым восьмым чалавекам на самасудзе была Рубі... Думаеце, Хардзі і яго 'хлопцы' таксама могуць быць замяшаныя ў наркааперацыі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CC6.english: "Not necessarily. The lady driver could have kept the drug trade a secret."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CC6.polish: „Niekoniecznie. Kierowczyni mogła utrzymywać swój narkotykowy biznes w tajemnicy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CC6.belarusian: "Не абавязкова. Кіроўца магла трымаць наркагандаль у таямніцы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CD2.english: "I think the entire Union is involved. Maybe even all of Martinaise..." (Look around suspiciously.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CD2.polish: „Myślę, że umoczony jest cały Związek. Może nawet całe Martinaise...” (rozejrzyj się podejrzliwie).
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CD2.belarusian: "Думаю, замяшаны ўвесь Прафсаюз. Можа, нават увесь Марцінэз..." (Падазрона азірнуцца.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CDE.english: "This would fit what Joyce told us, but I don't want to make any assumptions."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CDE.polish: „To by pasowało do tego, co mówiła Joyce, ale nie chcę zakładać niczego z góry”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CDE.belarusian: "Гэта стасуецца з тым, што казала нам Джойс, але я не хачу рабіць заўчасных высноў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CE8.english: "First the drug smuggling, now this... How deep does this rabbit hole go?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CE8.polish: „Najpierw handel narkotykami, teraz to... Co jeszcze znajdziemy w tej króliczej norze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CE8.belarusian: "Спачатку кантрабанда наркотыкаў, цяпер гэта... Наколькі ж глыбокая гэтая трусіная нара?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CEE.english: "Yes, well..." He quickly disregards your statement as another one of your outbursts.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CEE.polish: „Tak, no cóż...” – szybko ignoruje twoje stwierdzenie, biorąc je za kolejny z twoich wybuchów.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CEE.belarusian: "Так, ну..." Ён хутка пакідае вашу рэпліку без увагі, палічыўшы яе чарговым вашым выбрыкам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CF4.english: "We've identified one of the footprints, but there are still seven to go..." He writes something in his little blue notebook.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CF4.polish: „Zidentyfikowaliśmy jeden ślad butów, a do rozpoznania pozostało jeszcze siedem...” – stwierdza, zapisując coś w swoim niebieskim notatniku.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CF4.belarusian: "Мы ідэнтыфікавалі адзін са слядоў, але засталося яшчэ сем..." — ён нешта піша ў свой маленькі блакітны нататнік.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CFA.english: "Understood. We should still go and see what Titus Hardie has got to say on the matter -- this might throw them off, work in our advantage..." He writes something down into his little notebook. "So, what else?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CFA.polish: „Zrozumiano. Powinniśmy przekonać się, co ma w tym temacie do powiedzenia Titus Hardie – to może wytrącić ich z równowagi i zadziałać na naszą korzyść...” – stwierdza, zapisując coś w swoim notatniku. „Co jeszcze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009CFA.belarusian: "Зразумела. Нам усё адно варта схадзіць і даведацца, што Цітус Хардзі скажа на гэты конт — гэта можа збіць іх з панталыку і згуляць нам на руку..." — ён нешта запісвае ў свой маленькі нататнік. — "Дык што яшчэ?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009D00.english: "You're right. But we should still go and see what Titus Hardie has got to say on the matter -- this might throw them off, work in our advantage..." He writes something down into his little notebook. "So, what else?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009D00.polish: „Masz rację. Ale i tak powinniśmy przekonać się, co ma w tym temacie do powiedzenia Titus Hardie – to może wytrącić ich z równowagi i zadziałać na naszą korzyść...” – stwierdza, zapisując coś w swoim notatniku. „Co jeszcze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009D00.belarusian: "Вы маеце рацыю. Але нам усё адно варта схадзіць і даведацца, што Цітус Хардзі скажа на гэты конт — гэта можа збіць іх з панталыку і згуляць нам на руку..." — ён нешта запісвае ў свой маленькі нататнік. — "Дык што яшчэ?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009D06.english: "We should start with Titus Hardie, see what he's got to say on the matter -- this might throw them off, work in our advantage..." He writes something down into his little notebook. "So, what else?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009D06.polish: „Powinniśmy zacząć od Titusa Hardiego, przekonać się, co ma w tym temacie do powiedzenia Titus Hardie – to może wytrącić ich z równowagi i zadziałać na naszą korzyść...” – stwierdza, zapisując coś w swoim notatniku. „Co jeszcze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009D06.belarusian: "Трэба пачаць з Цітуса Хардзі, паглядзець, што ён скажа на гэты конт — гэта можа збіць іх з панталыку і згуляць нам на руку..." — ён нешта запісвае ў свой маленькі нататнік. — "Дык што яшчэ?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009D0C.english: "We should see what Titus Hardie has got to say on the matter -- this might throw them off, work in our advantage..." He writes something down into his little notebook. "So, what else?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009D0C.polish: „Powinniśmy przekonać się, co ma w tym temacie do powiedzenia Titus Hardie – to może wytrącić ich z równowagi i zadziałać na naszą korzyść...” – stwierdza, zapisując coś w swoim notatniku. „Co jeszcze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009D0C.belarusian: "Трэба паглядзець, што Цітус Хардзі скажа на гэты конт — гэта можа збіць іх з панталыку і згуляць нам на руку..." — ён нешта запісвае ў свой маленькі нататнік. — "Дык што яшчэ?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009D3A.english: Oh, this one's easy. Way too easy. It's a driver.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009D3A.polish: O, to akurat łatwe. Aż zbyt łatwe. To kierowca.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800009D3A.belarusian: О, гэта проста. Аж занадта проста. Гэта кіроўца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002234.english: "Yes." He corrects his glasses. "I doubt the Hardies are going to tell us much, but we should still confront them about the possible drug trade connection."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002234.polish: „Tak” – odpowiada, poprawiając okulary. „Wątpię, aby chłopaki Hardiego powiedzieli nam wiele, ale i tak powinniśmy przesłuchać ich i sprawdzić, czy mają jakieś powiązania z handlem narkotykami”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002234.belarusian: "Так", — ён папраўляе акуляры. — "Сумняваюся, што хлопцы Хардзі нам шмат раскажуць, але мы ўсё адно мусім прыціснуць іх наконт магчымай сувязі з наркагандлем."

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000223A.english: "Yes." He corrects his glasses. "I doubt the Hardies are going to tell us who this person is. For now it's best if we just keep our eyes open -- I'm sure our investigation will eventually lead us to the odd-sole."
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000223A.polish: „Tak” – odpowiada, poprawiając okulary. „Wątpię, aby chłopaki Hardiego powiedzieli nam, kim jest ta osoba. Na razie powinniśmy po prostu mieć oczy szeroko otwarte – jestem przekonany, że nasze śledztwo w końcu doprowadzi nas do właściciela »dziwnej podeszwy«”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000223A.belarusian: "Так", — ён папраўляе акуляры. — "Сумняваюся, што хлопцы Хардзі скажуць нам, хто гэты чалавек. Пакуль што лепш проста глядзець у абодва — я ўпэўнены, што следства рана ці позна прывядзе нас да гэтай дзіўнай падэшвы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002333.english: "Maybe the victim refused to walk to his own lynching."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002333.polish: „Może ofiara nie zgodziła się pójść na własny lincz”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002333.belarusian: "Можа, ахвяра адмовілася ісці на ўласны самасуд."

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000233C.english: "You have a point there." He clicks his pen, thinking for a moment. "Anyway, it's something to consider. What else can you see?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000233C.polish: „Masz rację” – klika długopisem i przez chwilę milczy w zamyśleniu. „W każdym razie, warto wziąć to pod uwagę. Co jeszcze tu widzisz?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000233C.belarusian: "У гэтым нешта ёсць", — ён пстрыкае асадкай, на імгненне задумваючыся. "У любым выпадку, варта ўзяць да ўвагі. Што яшчэ вы бачыце?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800011857.english: Wow. Still not doing it. You're *bad* at this.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800011857.polish: O rany. Wciąż nie wychodzi. Jesteś w tym *beznadziejny*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800011857.belarusian: Вось табе і на. Усё яшчэ не атрымліваецца. Ты *кепскі* ў гэтым.

Dialogue Text/0x010000780001185E.english: "This seems *really* important. Tracks on the scene. And I can't read them at all, lieutenant!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000780001185E.polish: „To wydaje się *naprawdę* ważne. Ślady na miejscu zbrodni. A ja zupełnie nie umiem ich odczytać, poruczniku!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000780001185E.belarusian: "Гэта здаецца *вельмі* важным. Сляды на месцы злачынства. А я зусім не магу іх прачытаць, лейтэнант!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800011864.polish: Przełknij tę gorycz. Przejdź do kolejnej rzeczy.

Dialogue Text/0x010000780001186C.english: What else is there to do?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800011873.english: (Whisper to yourself) "Why is this so complicated? I keep failing..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800011873.polish: (Wyszepcz sam do siebie). „Dlaczego to takie skomplikowane? Wciąż mi nie wychodzi...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800011873.belarusian: (Прашаптаць сабе.) "Чаму гэта так складана? У мяне нічога не выходзіць..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000780001187A.english: "Don't beat yourself down -- neither can I. We'll have another look later."
Dialogue Text/0x010000780001187A.polish: „Nie zadręczaj się – ja też nie mogę. Później przyjrzymy się im jeszcze raz”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000780001187A.belarusian: "Не карайце сябе — я таксама не магу. Мы зірнем яшчэ раз пазней."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007800011886.english: Maybe you keep failing because you *suck*?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800011886.polish: Może nie wychodzi ci dlatego, że jesteś *do dupy*?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007800011886.belarusian: Можа, у цябе нічога не выходзіць, бо ты *бяздарнасць*?

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002567.english: "Yes." He corrects his glasses. "I doubt the Hardies are going to tell us much, but we should still confront them about the possible drug trade connection."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002567.polish: „Tak” – odpowiada, poprawiając okulary. „Wątpię, aby chłopaki Hardiego powiedzieli nam wiele, ale i tak powinniśmy przesłuchać ich i sprawdzić, czy mają jakieś powiązania z handlem narkotykami”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002567.belarusian: "Так", — ён папраўляе акуляры. — "Сумняваюся, што хлопцы Хардзі нам шмат раскажуць, але мы ўсё адно мусім прыціснуць іх наконт магчымай сувязі з наркагандлем."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002577.english: What, *WITHHOLD BEING CONTENT*?! What are you, mild to moderately disabled? That doesn't feel like something you should do.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002577.polish: Że jak? *POWSTRZYMAĆ ZADOWOLENIE*?! Co ty, masz lekkie do średniego upośledzenie umysłowe? Takich rzeczy się nie robi.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002577.belarusian: Што, *НЕ РАДАВАЦЦА*?! Ты што, трохі ці сярэдне прыдуркаваты? Гэта зусім не тое, што ты павінен рабіць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002596.english: "Uhm... detective?" He's staring at you as you clutch your necktie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002596.polish: „Ee... Detektywie?” – porucznik wpatruje się w ciebie, gdy kurczowo ściskasz swój krawat.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002596.belarusian: "Гм... дэтэктыве?" Ён глядзіць на вас, пакуль вы сціскаеце свой гальштук.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500003483.english: "You're right. Let's keep a low profile." The lieutenant writes something down in his notebook, then reverts to the tracks in the mud.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500003483.polish: „Masz rację. Nie zwracajmy na siebie zbyt dużej uwagi” – porucznik zapisuje coś w swoim notatniku, po czym wraca do śladów w błocie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500003483.belarusian: "Вы маеце рацыю. Не будзем прыцягваць увагі", — лейтэнант робіць пазнаку ў нататніку, а пасля вяртаецца да слядоў у гразі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015A48.english: "No unusual horizontal bootprints, like the ones I saw in the Whirling's pinball workshop..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015A48.polish: „Żadnych nietypowych śladów z poziomymi liniami, jak te, które widziałem w warsztacie pinballowym w Whirling...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015A48.belarusian: "Ніякіх незвычайных гарызантальных адбіткаў, як тыя, што я бачыў у пінбольнай майстэрні Whirling..."

Alternate1/0x0100000400015A48.polish: „Żadnych śladów z pionowymi liniami. Ktokolwiek chodził po warsztacie pinballowym w Whirling, tutaj nie wszedł...”
Alternate1/0x0100000400015A48.belarusian: "Ніякіх гарызантальных адбіткаў. Хто б ні хадзіў у пінбольнай майстэрні Whirling, сюды ён не заходзіў..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015A5D.english: "I don't know..." He inspects the odd sole more closely. "They're about the same size. Not the same *boot*, no -- but they *could* be the same person."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015A5D.polish: „Nie wiem...” – odpowiada i przygląda się bliżej śladowi dziwnej podeszwy. „To mniej więcej ten sam rozmiar. *But* inny, ale ślady tu i tam *mogła* zostawić ta sama osoba”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015A5D.belarusian: "Не ведаю..." Ён уважлівей вывучае дзіўную падэшву. "Памер прыкладна аднолькавы. *Бот* іншы, гэта так, але гэта *мог* быць той самы чалавек."

Alternate1/0x0100000400015A63.polish: „Nie, te odciski są raczej standardowe – tamte ślady zostawione w kurzu wyglądały na odcisk buta wykonanego na zamówienie. Albo stworzonego za granicą? Tak czy siak, to jest odcisk podeszwy buta”.
Alternate1/0x0100000400015A63.belarusian: "Не. Гэтыя сляды цалкам звычайныя — тыя, у пыле, выглядалі зробленымі на замову. Ці, можа, проста замежнай вытворчасці? Як бы там ні было, гэта след ад бота."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015A72.english: "It still doesn't rule Ruby out. People change shoes, after all. But this isn't an argument for her guilt either."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015A72.polish: „To wciąż nie wyklucza Ruby. W końcu ludzie zmieniają buty. Ale nie jest to też dowód przesądzający o jej winie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015A72.belarusian: "Гэта ўсё адно не выключае Рубі. У рэшце рэшт, людзі мяняюць абутак. Але гэта і не доказ яе віны."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015A81.english: "So. Our Odd Sole wasn't in the back of the Whirling?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015A81.polish: „A więc nasza dziwna podeszwa nie wchodziła na zaplecze Whirling?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015A81.belarusian: "Значыць, нашай Дзіўнай Падэшвы не было на заднім двары Whirling?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000020000536E.english: Sitting at a desk, Lieutenant Kitsuragi fiddles with a pen, then writes something on the paper in front of him. He shouldn't be doing that, he should be here discussing the footprints.
Dialogue Text/0x010000020000536E.polish: Porucznik Kitsuragi siedzi przy biurku; przez chwilę bawi się długopisem, po czym zapisuje coś na leżącej przed nim kartce. Nie powinien tego teraz robić. Powinien być tu i rozmawiać o śladach butów.
Dialogue Text/0x010000020000536E.belarusian: Седзячы за сталом, лейтэнант Кіцурагі круціць у руках асадку, а пасля нешта піша на аркушы перад сабой. Ён не павінен гэтым займацца, ён мусіць быць тут і абмяркоўваць сляды.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000928.belarusian: "Маеш на ўвазе таго, з пацучыным тварам?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000210000092E.english: "Yes, well." The lieutenant thinks for a moment. "He *did* look a bit like a rat, you're right. Do you think those prints belong to him?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000092E.polish: „Tak. No cóż...” – porucznik zastanawia się chwilę. „*Wyglądał* trochę jak szczur, masz rację. Myślisz, że to on zostawił te ślady?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000092E.belarusian: "Так, ну..." Лейтэнант на імгненне задумваецца. "Ён *сапраўды* крыху падобны на пацука, вы маеце рацыю. Думаеце, гэтыя сляды належаць яму?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100001092.english: Check out the big brains on Harry Du Bois!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100001092.polish: I proszę, panie Harry Du Bois! Ale masz mózgownicę!
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100001092.belarusian: Паглядзіце, якія мазгі ў Гары Дзю Буа!

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A77B.english: I should have gotten this earlier.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A782.english: Better late than never, detective. The whole world is dark and the tracks burn in it with strange beauty.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A782.polish: Lepiej późno niż wcale, detektywie. Cały świat pociemniał, a ślady płoną w nim w dziwacznie piękny sposób.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A782.belarusian: Лепш позна, чым ніколі, дэтэктыве. Увесь свет ахутаны цемрай, і сляды палаюць у ім дзіўнай прыгажосцю.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A78A.english: Note to self: this would be a good question to ask Titus -- where's the eighth man?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A78A.polish: Zapamiętać: to by było dobre pytanie dla Titusa. Gdzie jest ósma osoba?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A78A.belarusian: Нататка для сябе: добрае пытанне для Цітуса — дзе восьмы чалавек?

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A792.english: A leader like Titus doesn't let one of his guys out of sight easily -- especially at a time like this.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A792.polish: Przywódca taki jak Titus nie spuściłby tak łatwo z oczu jednego ze swoich ludzi. Zwłaszcza w takim momencie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A792.belarusian: Такі лідар, як Цітус, не выпускае сваіх хлопцаў з-пад увагі без прычыны — асабліва ў такі час.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000131FC.english: "There's no denying it. Ruby really is running a *complex operation* out of her lorry."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000131FC.polish: „Nie ma wątpliwości. Ruby naprawdę przeprowadza ze swojej ciężarówki *skomplikowaną operację*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F000131FC.belarusian: "Тут не паспрачаешся. Рубі сапраўды круціць са свайго грузавіка *складаную аперацыю*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013202.english: "She is. And now we have concrete evidence binding everything together. We should ask Titus about this."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013202.polish: „To prawda. A my mamy wreszcie konkretne dowody łączące wszystko w jedną całość. Powinniśmy zapytać o to Titusa”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F00013202.belarusian: "Так. І цяпер у нас ёсць бясспрэчныя доказы, якія звязваюць усё разам. Трэба спытаць пра гэта Цітуса."

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC41.english: "I thought we decided to leave it to Processing." The lieutenant shakes his head. "Let's not turn this into some kind of circus."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC41.polish: „Myślałem, że postanowiliśmy zostawić to koronerowi” – porucznik kręci głową. „Nie róbmy z tego jakiegoś cyrku”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC41.belarusian: "Я думаў, мы вырашылі пакінуць гэта судмедэкспертам, - лейтэнант круціць галавой. - Давайце не будзем ператвараць гэта ў нейкі цырк".

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC52.english: The body is reluctant to let go of the boots -- as though they were its last bit of dignity.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC52.polish: Ciało nie chce rozstawać się z butami. Jakby stanowiły jego ostatnią resztkę godności.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC52.belarusian: Цела не хоча расставацца з ботамі — нібы яны былі апошняй рэшткай ягонай годнасці.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC70.english: It's not completely useless. You're able to reveal a little more of the putrid polymer sock beneath the boot.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC70.polish: Jakiś efekt jest – udało ci się odsłonić spod buta większy kawałek trupiej, polimerowej skarpety.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC70.belarusian: Гэта не зусім марна. Табе ўдаецца агаліць яшчэ трохі гнілой палімернай шкарпэткі пад ботам.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC76.english: Pick up the body and try to shake the boots off.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC76.polish: Podnieś ciało i spróbuj nim potrząsnąć, aby zsunąć buty.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC76.belarusian: Падняць цела і паспрабаваць сцягнуць боты, страсянуўшы ім.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC7C.english: Try to twist the boots off one by one.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC7C.polish: Spróbuj obrotowym ruchem ściągnąć buty, najpierw jeden, a potem drugi.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC82.english: Step on the corpse as you pull on the boots.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC82.polish: Stań na ciele, próbując zdjąć buty.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC88.english: You're going to need to summon all your strength for this undertaking.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC88.polish: Aby to zrobić, będziesz musiał użyć całej swojej siły.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC88.belarusian: Для гэтай задачы табе спатрэбіцца сабраць усе свае сілы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC8F.english: It's heavier than you'd think. You're forced to drop it back down immediately. The corpse lands on the ground with a nauseating thud, looking even sadder than before.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC8F.polish: Jest cięższe, niż myślałeś – musisz je natychmiast upuścić z powrotem. Ciało uderza o ziemię z przyprawiającym o mdłości plaśnięciem. Wygląda jeszcze smutniej niż wcześniej.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC8F.belarusian: Яно цяжэйшае, чым здавалася. Табе даводзіцца адразу ж выпусціць яго. Труп падае на зямлю з агідным глухім ударам, выглядаючы яшчэ больш сумна, чым раней.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC95.english: This is the right method. It takes some time, but eventually the boots come off -- with nasty slices of polymer sock stuck to even bigger pieces of skin and rotting flesh.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC95.polish: To właściwa metoda. Zajmuje nieco czasu, ale ostatecznie udaje ci się zdjąć buty. Wraz z ohydnymi kawałkami polimerowych skarpet przyklejonych do jeszcze większych kawałków skóry i gnijącego ciała.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC95.belarusian: Вось гэта слушны метад. Патрэбен пэўны час, але ўрэшце боты здымаюцца — разам з агіднымі кавалкамі палімернай шкарпэткі, прыліплымі да яшчэ большых кавалкаў скуры і гнілога мяса.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC9B.english: Something cracks in the left leg -- it really is about to come off. The leg, I mean. Not the boot.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC9B.polish: Coś trzaska w lewej nodze. Za chwilę naprawdę puści. Noga, znaczy się. Nie but.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AC9B.belarusian: Нешта трэскаецца ў левай назе — яна вось-вось адарвецца. Нага, маю на ўвазе. Не бот.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000ACA9.english: The legs look like they've been clawed at by wild animals. As for the boots -- you can't possibly do anything with them until you have cleaned and *disinfected* them thoroughly.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000ACA9.polish: Nogi wyglądają, jakby znęcały się nad nimi jakieś dzikie zwierzęta. Co do butów – nie nadają się zupełnie do niczego, dopóki ich dokładnie nie wyczyścisz i *zdezynfekujesz*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000ACA9.belarusian: Ногі выглядаюць так, нібы іх падралі дзікія звяры. Што да ботаў — з імі наогул нічога немагчыма зрабіць, пакуль ты іх старанна не памыеш і не *дэзінфікуеш*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000ACBA.english: It feels like the leg is going to come off along with the boot, but you are able to get the boot to move a centimetre or two.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000ACBA.polish: Masz wrażenie, że noga oderwie się zaraz razem z butem, ale udaje ci się zsunąć go o centymetr czy dwa.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000ACBA.belarusian: Здаецца, што нага адарвецца разам з ботам, але табе ўдаецца ссунуць бот на сантыметр-два.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AD01.english: Whatever you're planning to do, you need to do it before you catch pneumonia in the cold draft coming from deep inside the fridge.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AD01.polish: Cokolwiek zamierzasz zrobić, musisz się pospieszyć, zanim zimny powiew z głębi lodówki nie przyprawi cię o zapalenie płuc.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AD01.belarusian: Што б ты ні задумаў зрабіць, рабі хутчэй, пакуль цябе не схапіла запаленне лёгкіх ад скразняку, які цягне з глыбіні халадзільніка.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AD08.english: "Whoah. Cuno's little *sneak-pig's* back for the booty... "
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AD08.polish: „Łooo! Mała *świnka-spryciulka* Cuno wróciła, żeby obrobić dupę...”

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AD11.english: "Look -- he's skinning the fucker up good. *Puukko* style."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AD11.polish: „Patrz! Nieźle goli zdechlaka. Skalpuje go jak *puukko*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AD11.belarusian: "Глядзі — ён выдатна здзірае скуру з гэтага ўблюдка. У стылі *puukko*".

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AD2E.english: Not good. Let's pin this on the bear -- the ice bear tore up his legs with its claws. As for the boots -- you can't possibly do anything with them until you have cleaned and *disinfected* them thoroughly.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AD2E.polish: Niedobrze. Zwalmy to na niedźwiedzia – lodowy niedźwiedź poszarpał nogi denata pazurami. Co do butów – nie nadają się zupełnie do niczego, dopóki ich dokładnie nie wyczyścisz i *zdezynfekujesz*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000AD2E.belarusian: Дрэнна. Спішам гэта на мядзведзя — ледзяны мядзведзь падраў ягоныя ногі кіпцюрамі. Што да ботаў — з імі наогул нічога немагчыма зрабіць, пакуль ты іх старанна не памыеш і не *дэзінфікуеш*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600009350.english: Damn it, this is turning into some sort of mega-puzzle.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600009350.polish: Cholera, robi się z tego powoli jakaś megazagadka.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600009350.belarusian: Чорт, гэта ператвараецца ў нейкую мегагалаваломку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600009357.english: Okay, so you can *sneak* out of your room maybe, after he's gone asleep...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600009357.polish: No dobrze, w takim razie może dałoby radę *wykraść* się z pokoju, kiedy już pójdzie spać...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600009357.belarusian: Добра, значыць, можна *выкрасціся* з пакоя, можа, калі ён засне...

Dialogue Text/0x010000060000935F.english: "Yeah, fuck it to pieces for us. Liar cop!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000060000935F.polish: „Dalej, wydymaj go na całego. Kłamliwa glino!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060000935F.belarusian: "Ага, раздзяры яго на кавалкі дзеля нас. Мент-хлус!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002D000003E4.english: Before you can grab hold of the boot, you hear a voice coming out of the dead man's mouth. It's the voice of Lieutenant Kim Kitsuragi, telling you to stop whatever you're doing.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002D000003E4.polish: Twoje ręce nie dotykają jeszcze buta, kiedy z ust zmarłego dobiegają cię słowa. To głos porucznika Kima Kitsuragiego mówiący, żebyś przestał, cokolwiek kombinujesz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002D000003E4.belarusian: Перш чым ты паспяваеш схапіцца за бот, з рота нябожчыка чуецца голас. Гэта голас лейтэнанта Кіма Кіцурагі, які загадвае спыніць усё, што ты робіш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002D000003EB.english: You're sabotaging the crime scene, and yet you haven't even finished the field autopsy. Come back later when you're done with the investigation.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002D000003EB.polish: Dokonujesz sabotażu miejsca zbrodni, a nie zakończyłeś jeszcze nawet autopsji polowej. Wróć później, jak już zamkniesz sprawy związane ze śledztwem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002D000003EB.belarusian: Ты руйнуеш месца злачынства, хоць нават не скончыў палявую аўтапсію. Вярніся пазней, калі скончыш расследаванне.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A2E2.english: Just relax. This is easy. This is *happening*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A2EA.english: Damn, you're out of shape... In your defence, the corpse *was* quite slippery.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A2EA.polish: Jasna cholera, ależ jesteś nie w formie... Na twoją obronę trzeba podkreślić, że ciało *było* mocno śliskie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A2EA.belarusian: Чорт, ну ты і не ў форме... На тваю абарону варта сказаць, што труп *быў* даволі слізкім.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A2F2.english: You may want to slow down. Don't tear into it like that.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A2F2.polish: Lepiej trochę zwolnij. Nie szarp aż tak gwałtownie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A2F2.belarusian: Лепей трохі сцішыцца. Не трэба так ірваць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A2FA.english: Yes. These absolutely need to be washed before. The stink is incredible.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A2FA.polish: Tak. Zdecydowanie trzeba je wcześniej umyć. Smród jest niesamowity.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A2FA.belarusian: Так. Іх абавязкова трэба спачатку памыць. Смурод проста неймаверны.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A300.english: Yes. These absolutely need to be washed before. The stink is incredible.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A300.polish: Tak. Zdecydowanie trzeba je wcześniej umyć. Smród jest niesamowity.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A300.belarusian: Так. Іх абавязкова трэба спачатку памыць. Смурод проста неймаверны.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A30A.english: Didn't the Whirling have a kitchen?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A30A.polish: Czy w Whirling nie było przypadkiem kuchni?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A30A.belarusian: Ці ў Whirling не было кухні?

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A312.english: Didn't the Whirling have a kitchen?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A312.polish: Czy w Whirling nie było przypadkiem kuchni?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A312.belarusian: Ці ў Whirling не было кухні?

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A3F4.english: See? The corpse doesn't care if you try to take his boots. He doesn't need them. He's probably *glad* to get rid of them.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A3F4.polish: Widzisz? Trupa nie obchodzi, że bierzesz sobie jego buty. Nie potrzebuje ich. Pewnie się *cieszy*, że może je zdjąć.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A3F4.belarusian: Бачыш? Трупу ўсё адно, што ты спрабуеш зняць ягоныя боты. Яны яму не патрэбныя. Ён, напэўна, нават *рады* іх пазбыцца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A8CD.english: He's too heavy to move by yourself -- a great mass of dead muscles, with hoarfrost covering his milky eyes.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A8CD.polish: Jest zbyt ciężki, żebyś mógł przenieść go sam – to ogromna masa martwych mięśni z oszronionymi przez bielmo oczami.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A8CD.belarusian: Ён занадта цяжкі, каб зрушыць яго аднаму — велізарная маса мёртвых цягліц, а ягоныя мутныя вочы пакрыты шэранню.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A8D3.english: Is that an accusatory glance he gave you? No... no, he's cool.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A8D3.polish: Czyżby spojrzał na ciebie oskarżycielsko? Nie... Nie, dobra jest.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001A8D3.belarusian: Гэта ён што, зірнуў з дакорам? Не... не, усё нармальна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C52.english: Except that *candidate* members never become *full* members, do they?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C52.polish: Tyle że te kraje *kandydujące* nigdy nie zostają *członkami*, nieprawdaż?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C52.belarusian: Вось толькі краіны-*кандыдаты* ніколі не становяцца *поўнымі* чальцамі, так?

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C6A.english: A busy bee? What an odd choice of words.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C6A.polish: Pracowita pszczółka? Co za dziwny dobór słów.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C70.english: "EPIS is a very special program developed by the Moralintern to support certain Occidental nations. It began as a unified system of weights and measures, which proved to be a *wild* success. Nothing but kilograms and centimetres as far as the eye can see!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C70.polish: „EPIS to bardzo specjalny program opracowany przez Moralintern w celu wsparcia części narodów Okcydentu. Początkowo był zunifikowanym systemem miar i wag, który okazał się *ogromnym* sukcesem. Jak okiem sięgnąć same kilogramy i centymetry!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C70.belarusian: "ЭПІС — гэта вельмі адмысловая праграма, распрацаваная Маралінтэрнам дзеля падтрымкі некаторых акцыдэнтальных краін. Усё пачыналася як адзіная сістэма мер і вагі, што займела *шалёны* поспех. Адны толькі кілаграмы і сантыметры, куды ні кінь вокам!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C7A.english: "It was *such* a wild success that we expanded it into an economic union for the processing of steel -- another success. And between you and me... the Moralintern feels *emboldened* by this success. Emboldened to take EPIS to the next level."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C7A.polish: „Sukces był *tak* ogromny, że rozszerzyliśmy program, przekształcając go w ekonomiczną unię przetwórstwa stali – i odnieśliśmy kolejny sukces. Tak między nami... Moralintern czuje się tym *zachęcony*. Zachęcony, by przejść z EPIS-em na kolejny poziom”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C7A.belarusian: "Поспех быў *настолькі* шалёным, што мы пашырылі яе да эканамічнага саюза па апрацоўцы сталі — яшчэ адзін поспех. І між намі... Маралінтэрн адчувае *ўздым* ад гэтага поспеху. Гатоўнасць вывесці ЭПІС на новы ўзровень."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C80.english: "My friend comes and goes. I'm sure you'll see him around, he's a busy bee."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C80.polish: „Mój przyjaciel pojawia się i znika. Z pewnością jeszcze się ze sobą zobaczycie, to pracowita pszczółka”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C80.belarusian: "Мой сябар прыходзіць і сыходзіць. Упэўнены, вы яшчэ ўбачыце яго тут, ён як пчолка круціцца."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C92.english: "A supranational political alliance, the United States of Occident."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015C9C.english: "Is it going to be like this place here?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CA4.english: "You mean Revachol? No, it's going to have transparent democracy."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CA4.polish: „Ma pan na myśli Revachol? Nie, to będzie transparentna demokracja”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CA4.belarusian: "Вы маеце на ўвазе Рэвашоль? Не, там будзе празрыстая дэмакратыя."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CAA.english: Waves crashing in the distance, the sound of sea below the window.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CAA.polish: Fale rozbijają się w oddali o brzeg – zza okna dobiega szum morza.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CAA.belarusian: Хвалі б'юцца ўдалечыні, пад акном чуваць шум мора.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CB0.english: "Is Revachol going to be part of EPIS?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CCC.english: A baby is crying in the neighbouring apartment.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CCC.polish: Z sąsiedniego mieszkania słychać płacz dziecka.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CD2.english: "What are you talking about? No one becomes friends that way."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CD2.polish: „O czym pan mówi? Nikt się w taki sposób nie zaprzyjaźnia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CD2.belarusian: "Пра што вы? Ніхто так не заводзіць сяброў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CD8.english: "We're old friends, nothing's taboo between us. He comes and goes."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CD8.polish: „Jesteśmy starymi przyjaciółmi, nie ma między nami żadnego tabu. Pojawia się i znika”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CD8.belarusian: "Мы старыя сябры, паміж намі няма ніякіх табу. Ён прыходзіць і сыходзіць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CDE.english: "Officer, you have to understand... I can't give you his personal information. I'm sure you have your own methods and databases, right? Please don't put me in this situation."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CDE.polish: „Ależ funkcjonariuszu, proszę zrozumieć... Nie mogę podać panu jego danych osobowych. Jestem pewny, że ma pan własne metody i bazy danych, prawda? Proszę nie stawiać mnie w tak niezręcznej sytuacji”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CDE.belarusian: "Афіцэру, вы павінны зразумець... Я не магу даць вам ягоныя асабістыя звесткі. Упэўнены, у вас ёсць уласныя метады і базы даных, так? Калі ласка, не стаўце мяне ў такое становішча."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CE4.english: "Au contraire. It's how millions of people end up where they are, meeting the people they meet. It's how I came here, and my friend, too."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CE4.polish: „Au contraire. W ten sposób miliony osób trafiły tam, gdzie są, i spotkały ludzi, których znają. To dlatego tutaj przybyłem – i dlatego przybył tu mój przyjaciel”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CE4.belarusian: "Au contraire. Менавіта так мільёны людзей апынаюцца там, дзе яны ёсць, і сустракаюць тых, каго сустракаюць. Так сюды трапіў я, і мой сябар таксама."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CEA.polish: „No dobrze, ale jak ma naprawdę na imię?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CF6.english: "One of the wonders of democracy is that everyone is allowed to have his own opinion." The man pats his pockets, looking for something. "And not just allowed, *encouraged* even. Have you ever tried debate?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CF6.polish: „Jednym z cudów demokracji jest fakt, że każdy może mieć na wszystko własną opinię” – mężczyzna poklepuje swoje kieszenie, szukając czegoś. „Nie tylko może, ale jest wręcz do tego *zachęcany*. Próbował pan kiedyś brać udział w debacie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CF6.belarusian: "Адно з цудаў дэмакратыі ў тым, што кожны мае права на сваё меркаванне, — мужчына паплясквае па кішэнях, нешта шукаючы. — І не проста мае права, гэта нават *заахвочваецца*. Вы калі-небудзь спрабавалі дэбатаваць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CFC.english: "He's a bright young man here to pursue his education. Education is the foundation of our future, especially the arts. It is a cornerstone of our civilization."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CFC.polish: „To bystry młody człowiek, który dba o swoją edukację. Edukacja to fundament naszej przyszłości – zwłaszcza w dziedzinie sztuki. To kamień węgielny naszej cywilizacji”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015CFC.belarusian: "Ён здольны малады чалавек, які прыехаў сюды па адукацыю. Адукацыя — падмурак нашай будучыні, асабліва мастацтва. Гэта краевугольны камень нашай цывілізацыі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015D02.english: "Ah, my friend. My friend is a good young man. His family immigrated here from Kedra and life has not been easy for him. But he understands the importance of education. He has taken his future into his own hands and that's all that matters."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015D02.polish: „Ach, mój przyjaciel. Mój przyjaciel to dobry młody człowiek. Jego rodzina przybyła tu z Kedry i życie go nie rozpieszczało. Ale rozumie, jak ważna jest edukacja. Wziął swoją przyszłość we własne ręce i to jest najważniejsze”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015D02.belarusian: "Ах, мой сябар. Мой сябар — добры юнак. Ягоная сям'я імігравала сюды з Кедры, і жыццё не песціла яго. Але ён разумее важнасць адукацыі. Ён узяў сваю будучыню ва ўласныя рукі, і гэта галоўнае."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015D08.english: "Isn't it rude for your friend to leave you alone like this?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015D08.polish: „Czy to nie niegrzeczność ze strony pańskiego przyjaciela, że tak pana zostawił samego?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015D08.belarusian: "Хіба гэта не груба з боку вашага сябра — пакінуць вас вось так аднаго?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015D0E.english: "Martin Martinaise? That's not a name. Are you referring to my friend? But I told you, he's from Kedra -- definitely not just another Martin Martinaise or Raoul Revachol. Perhaps that's why he and I became friends..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700015D0E.polish: „Martin Martinaise? To nie jest prawdziwe imię i nazwisko. Ma pan na myśli mojego przyjaciela?
