Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F97C.polish: „Zwłoki wiszą ponad 1,2 metra nad ziemią, żaden z nas nie jest w stanie dosięgnąć pasa bez pomocy. A nawet jeśli go dosięgniemy, to pozostaje kwestia przecięcia tego wzmacnianego materiału...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F97C.belarusian: "Труп у добрых 1.2 метра над зямлёй, ніводны з нас не дацягнецца да рэменя без дапамогі. А нават калі дацягнемся, застаецца пытанне як разрэзаць яго ўзмоцнены матэрыял..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F987.english: There's no *question*. There's only CUTTING. How hard can it be?
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F987.polish: Nie ma żadnej *kwestii*. Jest tylko CIĘCIE. Co może być w tym takiego trudnego?
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F987.belarusian: Няма тут ніякага *пытання*. Толькі РАЗРЭЗ. Што ў ім можа быць складанага?

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F990.english: "I don't doubt your physical prowess, officer, but this is a gruelling surgical procedure. I saw twenty steel strands in there -- and we do not have a secure platform for the cutting."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F990.polish: „Nie wątpię w twoją fizyczną sprawność, oficerze, ale to wyczerpujący zabieg wymagający chirurgicznej precyzji. Widziałem tam dwadzieścia stalowych pasm, a do tego nie mamy żadnej stabilnej platformy, na której można by stać w trakcie cięcia”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F990.belarusian: "Я не сумняюся ў вашых фізічных здольнасцях, афіцэру, але гэта цяжкая працэдура, якая патрабуе хірургічнай дакладнасці. Я бачыў там дваццаць сталёвых жыл, да таго ў нас няма надзейнай платформы, на якой можна было б стаяць падчас рэзання".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F996.english: "I don't doubt your physical prowess, officer, but that's aircraft strength material. And we do not have a secure platform to perform the procedure on."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F996.polish: „Nie wątpię w twoją fizyczną sprawność, oficerze, ale to wzmacniany materiał używany w lotnictwie. A my nie mamy żadnej stabilnej platformy, na której można by stać w trakcie cięcia”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F996.belarusian: "Я не сумняюся ў вашых фізічных здольнасцях, афіцэру, але гэта авіацыйны ўзмоцнены матэрыял. Да таго ў нас няма надзейнай платформы, на якой можна было б стаяць падчас працэдуры".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9AB.english: "Seems like a lot of hassle, let's *not* do it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9AB.belarusian: "Гучыць, як шмат намаганняў. Давай *не* будзем гэтага рабіць".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9B9.english: "I'm out of ideas. Let's have another look at him."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9B9.polish: „Nie mam pomysłów. Rzućmy na niego jeszcze raz okiem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9B9.belarusian: "У мяне няма ідэй. Давай яшчэ зірнём на труп".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9CF.english: The lieutenant inspects the belt, his forehead lined with worry.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9CF.polish: Porucznik przygląda się pasowi, a na jego czole pojawiają się linie zdradzające zmartwienie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9CF.belarusian: Лейтэнант уважліва аглядае рэмень, а на яго ілбе з'яўляюцца трывожныя рысы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9D6.english: "Hmmm..." The lieutenant falls deep in thought.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9E7.english: "It's tempting. But decapitating him will make it impossible to ascertain whether he was really hung. The damage to the neck would make coronary work pointless."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9E7.polish: „To kuszące. Ale po dekapitacji nie będziemy w stanie ustalić, czy powieszenie było prawdziwą przyczyną zgonu. Uszkodzenie szyi sprawiłoby, że dalsze badanie zwłok nie miałoby sensu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9E7.belarusian: "Спакусліва. Але пасля гэтага мы не зможам дакладна вызначыць, ці было павешанне прычынай смерці. Пашкоджанне шыі зробіць працу патолагаанатама бессэнсоўнай".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9FA.english: An acrobatic manoeuvre would solve this situation. Nothing can go wrong with a good *manoeuvre*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9FA.polish: Manewr akrobatyczny rozwiązałby wasz problem. Dobry *manewr* to zawsze świetny pomysł.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000F9FA.belarusian: Акрабатычны манеўр вырашыў бы гэтую праблему. Удалы *манеўр* — заўжды выдатная ідэя.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA02.english: "I have thought of that, yes. But the tyre tracks would compromise the scene. Any prints would become illegible. That's *if* we get it through the hole in the fence..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA02.polish: „Tak, rozważałem to. Ale ślady opon naruszyłyby miejsce zbrodni. Ślady pozostawione przez sprawców stałyby się nieczytelne. A i to pod warunkiem, że kineema zmieściłaby się w dziurze w ogrodzeniu...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA02.belarusian: "Я пра гэта разважаў, так. Але коламі машыны мы нашкодзім месцу злачынства. Усе адбіткі стануць нечытэльнымі. І гэта толькі *калі* ў нас атрымаецца ўціснуцца ў тую дзірку..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA10.english: "Also, my MC has a sloped roof, it's a *sports* model." He makes a gesture indicating a harsh degree of sloping. "The roof is slippery -- an all-around bad platform to stand on."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA10.polish: „Poza tym mój powóz ma pochyły dach – to model *sportowy*” – wyjaśnia, pokazując ręką ostry kąt jego nachylenia. „Dach jest śliski – byłaby z niego kiepska platforma”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA10.belarusian: "Да таго дах маёй МК мае схіл — гэта *спартыўная* мадэль, — ён паказвае рукамі востры кут схілу даху. — Яшчэ ён слізкі — з усіх бакоў дрэнная платформа, каб на ёй стаяць".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA17.english: He could come up with at least four more reasons why not to trample on the roof of his *sports model* motor carriage.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA17.polish: Umiałby wymyślić jeszcze co najmniej cztery powody, dla których nie powinniście deptać dachu jego *sportowego* powozu motorowego.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA17.belarusian: Ён мог бы прыдумаць яшчэ, прынамсі, чатыры прычыны, чаму не трэба станавіцца на дах яго *спартыўнай мадэлі* маторнай карэты.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA1F.english: "Could your attachment to your sports model motor carriage be clouding your judgement?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA1F.polish: „Czyżby przywiązanie do twojego sportowego powozu motorowego zaburzało ci jasność myślenia?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA1F.belarusian: "Ці не захінае твой прафесійны погляд такая прывязанасць да тваёй спартыўнай маторнай карэты?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA26.english: "Yes," he concedes. "I am attached to it. But it's also unsuitable. We can't bring a supercharged tractor through that tiny gap in the fence, then plough the scene with it. Then fall off the roof. It would sound bad on Channel 8."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA26.polish: „Tak” – przyznaje. „Jestem do niego przywiązany. Ale to nie zmienia faktu, że się do tego nie nadaje. Nie możemy przecisnąć tej potężnej maszyny przez malutki otwór w płocie, a później zaorać nią miejsca zbrodni, aby na koniec spaść z dachu. To nie brzmiałoby dobrze na kanale 8”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA26.belarusian: "Так, — прызнае ён, — Я да яе прывязаны. Але яна ўсё адно не пасуе для гэтага. Нельга проста ўціснуць турба-трактар у дзірку ў плоце, а потым узараць ім месца злачынства, каб у рэшце зваліцца з даху. Гэта гучала б не лепшым чынам на Восьмым канале".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA2D.english: "We're *not* getting him down already. Not getting him down is a task that's already accomplished. Sadly, it's not our job to *keep* him up there, but to get him down."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA2D.polish: „Już teraz *nie* zdejmujemy go z drzewa. Niezdejmowanie go na ziemię to zadanie, które zostało już wykonane. Niestety, nasze zadanie nie polega na *pozostawieniu* go na górze tylko na zdjęciu go na ziemię”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA2D.belarusian: "Мы ўжо цяпер *не* знялі яго з дрэва. Нездыманне — ужо выкананая задача. На жаль, наша мэта не ў тым, каб *пакінуць* яго вісець, а ўсё ж у тым, каб яго адтуль спусціць".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA39.english: "How about I take *you* piggyback?" After a moment’s silence, he raises an eyebrow.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA39.polish: „Może wezmę *ciebie* na barana?” – po chwili milczenia unosi brew.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA39.belarusian: "Можа, я вазьму *цябе* на барана?" — на імгненне павісае цішыня, ён падымае брыво.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA40.english: "The fuck are these pigs talking about?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA47.english: "Their bank or something. It's fucking boring, Cuno. Wish they'd fuck already."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA47.polish: „Coś o hodowli baranów. Cholernie to nudne, Cuno. Zajęliby się już pieprzeniem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA47.belarusian: "Пра свайго пахана, ці што. Такая, бляха, нудота, Куна. Хай бы порхнуліся ўжо".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA5A.english: "Lieutenant, are you sure you could carry my weight though?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA5A.polish: „Poruczniku, ale czy na pewno byś mnie uniósł?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA5A.belarusian: "Лейтэнант, а ты сапраўды мог бы мяне падняць?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA63.english: "Lieutenant, you meant it rhetorically, right? You're criticizing my idea?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA63.polish: „To była figura retoryczna, poruczniku, prawda? Krytykujesz mój pomysł?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA63.belarusian: "Гэта было рытарычнае пытанне, лейтэнант? Ты крытыкуеш маю ідэю?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA71.english: "It's a fucking hilarious idea -- you two paskapää's get on top each other and *fuck*!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA71.polish: „To cholernie śmieszny pomysł – wskakujcie na siebie, paskapää, i *pieprzcie się*!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA71.belarusian: "Гэта ачмурэнна пацешная ідэя — залязайце адзін на аднаго, paskapää, і *порхайцеся*!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA78.english: "Would you please SUCK MY DICK?" The one behind the fence makes a gesture, as if taking out their penis.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA78.polish: „A mógłbyś, proszę, OBCIĄGNĄĆ MI KUTASA?” – pyta dzieciak za płotem, udając, że wyjmuje ze spodni swojego penisa.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA78.belarusian: "Можаш, калі ласка, ПАСМАКТАЦЬ МОЙ СТРУК?" — дзіця за плотам удае, быццам дастае свой пеніс.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA86.english: "Pig, why you gotta disrespect my girl? This shit makes Cuno *sad*."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA86.polish: „Świnio, dlaczego obrażasz moją dziewczynę? Cuno się od tego robi *smutno*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA86.belarusian: "Ты чаго, свіння ментаўская, абражаеш маю дзяўчыну? Гэтая хуйня наводзіць на Куна *смутак*".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA9C.english: "I wasn't actually implying I would. I meant it's a bad idea."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA9C.polish: „Nie sugerowałem tego. Chodziło mi o to, że to kiepski pomysł”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FA9C.belarusian: "Я не гэта хацеў сказаць. Я меў на ўвазе, што гэта дрэнная ідэя".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAB0.english: "It'd sound fucking hilarious, do it! Fucking get on top of it and dance, fägäri!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAB0.polish: „To w chuj śmieszny pomysł! Zróbcie to! Wleźcie na ten dach i zatańczcie, fägäri!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAB0.belarusian: "Гэта было б абассацца як смешна! Давай, курва, станчы нам на даху, fägäri!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FACC.english: "Climb up there and... saw the branch?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FACC.polish: „Wdrapać się tam na górę i... odpiłować gałąź?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAD3.english: "Yes. Either one of us could do it. We could use the kids' ladder on the side of the tree."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAD3.polish: „Tak. Mógłby to zrobić każdy z nas. Możemy użyć tej dziecięcej drabiny na pniu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAD3.belarusian: "Так. Любы з нас мог бы даць тут рады. Можна скарыстацца драбінкамі на ствале".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAE4.english: "There has to be a less risky way. With less falling down off trees."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAE4.polish: „Musi być jakiś mniej ryzykowny sposób. Na przykład taki, który nie uwzględnia spadania z drzew”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAE4.belarusian: "Павінен быць нейкі менш рызыкоўны спосаб. Напрыклад, такі, праз які ніхто не зваліцца з дрэва".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAF5.english: It seems doable. The kids' ladder is treacherously rotten, but you could use your hands and feet to reach around the tree, then hang from the branch...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAF5.polish: Wydaje się to być do zrobienia. Drabinka jest niebezpiecznie przegniła, ale mógłbyś użyć rąk i nóg, żeby owinąć się wokół drzewa, a potem zawisnąć z gałęzi...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAF5.belarusian: Здаецца здзяйсняльным. Драбіны наскрозь прагнілыя, але можна ўскараскацца, абхапіўшы ствол рукамі ды нагамі, а потым звесіцца з галіны...

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAFC.english: "Honestly, I prefer a *non-acrobatic* solution to this." He looks around -- then at you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAFC.polish: „Szczerze mówiąc, wolę rozwiązanie *bez akrobacji*” – rozgląda się wokół, a później patrzy na ciebie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FAFC.belarusian: "Шчыра кажучы, я б аддаў перавагу чамусьці *не* акрабатычнаму", – ён глядзіць вакол, а потым на цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB0A.english: "I could do it. It's well within my repertoire."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB0A.polish: „Dałbym radę. Mieści się to w moim repertuarze”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB14.english: "I don't trust that ladder. The assailants didn't use it. It's rotten and less sturdy than it looks. And I don't see another good way up there."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB14.polish: „Nie ufam tej drabinie. Sprawcy jej nie użyli. Jest przegniła i mniej wytrzymała, niż na to wygląda. A ja nie widzę innego sposobu, aby dostać się na górę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB14.belarusian: "Я не давяраю гэтым драбінам. Злачынцы імі таксама не скарысталіся. Яны куды больш прагнілыя, чым падаецца. І я не бачу іншага добрага спосабу ўзлезці наверх".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB2F.english: "*Clown Cops Climb Tree, Fall Down*," he says, furrowing his brow. "*Enraged Cop Assaults Children -- After Falling From Tree*."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB2F.polish: „»Policjanci-cyrkowcy spadają z drzewa«” – odpowiada, marszcząc brwi. „»Po upadku z drzewa wściekły policjant atakuje dzieci«”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB2F.belarusian: "*Цыркачы-Паліцыянты Зваліліся з Дрэва*, — кажа ён, зморшчыўшы бровы. — *Раз'юшаны Паліцыянт Кідаецца на Дзяцей Пасля Падзення з Дрэва*".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB36.english: "*Cretin Cop*... -- they like that word -- ...*Saws The Branch He's Sitting On (Literally)*. *Local Children Report Corpse Mutilation*."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB36.polish: „»Policjant-kretyn«... – lubią to określenie – »Policjant-kretyn odcina gałąź, na której siedzi (dosłownie)«, »Miejscowe dzieci zgłaszają zbezczeszczenie zwłok«”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB36.belarusian: "*Крэтын-паліцыянт*... — ім падабаюцца такія звароты — *Крэтын-паліцыянт Зразае Галіну на Якой Сядзіць (Літаральна)*, *Мясцовыя Дзеці Паведамляюць аб Зняслаўленні Трупа*."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB3D.english: "Can you see into the future, Kim?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB43.polish: „O tak! Właźcie na to drzewo, małpy!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB43.belarusian: "Ашаленна, блядзь! Лезьце ўжо на гэтую хуйню, малпы!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB4A.english: "C, you're only making them do those things less."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB4A.polish: „C., przez ciebie nie robią tych rzeczy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB4A.belarusian: "К., праз цябе яны цяпер дакладна так не зробяць".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB63.english: "No, I do not see the future. I made those up using two decades in the Revacholian police force as a reference point."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB63.polish: „Nie, nie jestem jasnowidzem. Wymyśliłem to wszystko na podstawie doświadczeń z dwóch dekad służby w revacholskiej policji”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB63.belarusian: "Не, будучыні я не бачу. Я гэта выдумаў на падставе сваіх двух дзесяцігоддзяў службы ў рэвашольскай паліцыі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB6A.english: "I'm not afraid of newspapers. We shouldn't be."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB6A.polish: „Nie boję się gazet. Nie powinniśmy się ich bać”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB6A.belarusian: "Я не баюся газет. Нам не варта іх баяцца".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB71.english: "Oh, no." He shakes his head slowly. "We should be *very* afraid of newspapers. And the radio stations too. We should be wary of enticing them in *any* way."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB71.polish: „O nie” – kręci powoli głową. „Powinniśmy *bardzo* bać się prasy. I stacji radiowych też. Nie powinniśmy w *żaden* sposób przyciągać ich uwagi”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB71.belarusian: "О не, — ён павольна круціць галавой. — Нам варта *вельмі* баяцца газет. І радыёстанцый. Нам лепей *любым чынам* унікаць іх увагі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB78.english: "So we're going to just let those kids bully us into not doing our work?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB78.polish: „Czyli pozwolimy tak po prostu, żeby te dzieciaki uniemożliwiły nam wykonywanie naszej pracy?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB78.belarusian: "То бок, мы проста дазволім гэтым малым сваімі здзекамі не даць нам выканаць сваю працу?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB7F.english: "What I'm proposing is -- we save acrobatic tricks as a last resort. After we've tried *everything* else."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB7F.polish: „Proponuję, aby zostawić akrobacje jako ostatnią deskę ratunku. Sięgniemy po nie, gdy wykorzystamy *wszystkie* inne możliwości”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB7F.belarusian: "Прапаную пакінуць акрабатыку як крайні варыянт. Калі не застанецца *ніякіх* іншых магчымасцяў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB92.english: "You're right. The risks are too high and there are too many."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB92.polish: „Masz rację. Ryzyko jest zbyt wielkie, może się to źle skończyć”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB92.belarusian: "Ты маеш рацыю. Занадта рызыкоўна, гэта можа дрэнна скончыцца".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB99.english: "Yes. We should use acrobatics as the very last option. After we've tried *everything* normal."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB99.polish: „Tak. Akrobacje powinny być ostatnią deską ratunku. Sięgniemy po nie, gdy wykorzystamy *wszystkie* konwencjonalne możliwości”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FB99.belarusian: "Так. Нам варта пакінуць акрабатыку на крайні выпадак. Калі не застанецца *ніякіх* нармальных варыянтаў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FBA0.english: "These have got to be the most fucking boring *mulkkupäät* I've ever seen."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FBA0.polish: „To chyba najnudniejsi *mulkkupäät*, jakich w życiu widziałam”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FBA0.belarusian: "Гэта, здаецца, самыя нудныя *mulkkupäät* з усіх, якіх я толькі бачыла".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCB4.english: Go ahead, ask me more questions. You fucking *love* questions.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCB4.polish: No dawaj, zadaj mi więcej pytań. *Kurewsko* lubisz pytania.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCB4.belarusian: Наперад, задай мне больш пытанняў. Ты, трасца, *кахаеш* пытанні.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCBC.english: I feel like I've been getting a lot of Harry lately...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCBC.polish: Ostatnio mocno jestem bombardowany tym Harrym...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCBC.belarusian: Здаецца, апошнім часам я часта чую Гары...

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCE1.english: Where the buckle ties the rope to the branch -- that's a good spot to aim.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCE1.polish: Miejsce, w którym sprzączka mocuje pas do gałęzi – tam będzie najlepiej celować.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCE1.belarusian: Спражка, якая ўтрымлівае рэмень на галіне, — добрая цэль для стрэлу.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCE7.english: The lieutenant is undecided. On one hand he *wants* to shoot some gun -- on the other, it's an awfully stupid idea.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCE7.polish: Porucznik jest niezdecydowany. Z jednej strony *chce* sobie postrzelać, ale z drugiej – to koszmarnie głupi pomysł.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCE7.belarusian: Лейтэнант вагаецца. З аднаго боку, ён *хоча* паспрабаваць, але з другога, ідэя — поўнае шаленства.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCF2.english: (Point to it.) "There. The buckle holds the belt together."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCF2.polish: (Wskaż palcem). „Tam. Ta sprzączka łączy pas w całość”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCF2.belarusian: (Паказаць на яе.) "Вось. Спражка, якая ўтрымлівае рэмень".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCF8.english: "I don't know, just, you know -- shoot up there maybe?" (Point towards the branch.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCF8.polish: „Nie wiem, po prostu, no wiesz – strzel może tam?” (Wskaż na gałąź).
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCF8.belarusian: "Не ведаю, можа, проста стрэлім туды, як мяркуеш?" (Паказаць на галіну.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCFE.english: "Just shoot the belt, the bullet will break it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FCFE.polish: „Po prostu strzel w pas, pocisk go przerwie”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD05.english: "Where?" He corrects his glasses. "Ah, yes. I see. If the shot hits that there *might* be a chance to release the belt..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD05.polish: „Gdzie?” – pyta, poprawiając okulary. „A tak. Widzę. Jeśli pocisk trafi w to miejsce, to *może* zwolni pas...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD05.belarusian: "Дзе? — ён папраўляе акуляры. — Ага. Бачу. *Магчыма*, калі стрэл у яе трапіць, будзе шанец вызваліць рэмень..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD0E.english: "It absolutely will not, officer. That's not how physics work. It will maybe cut *one* thread loose."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD0E.polish: „Oczywiście, że nie przerwie, oficerze. To wbrew zasadom fizyki. Pocisk najwyżej przetnie *jedno* pasmo”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD0E.belarusian: "Вядома, што не праб'е, афіцэру. Фізіка не так працуе. Добра, калі куля зрэжа *адну* са стальных жыл".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD15.english: "Yes..." He corrects his glasses. "The buckle -- where it ties the cargo belt to the tree. If the shot hits that then there might be a small chance to release the belt..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD15.polish: „Tak...” – stwierdza, poprawiając okulary. „Sprzączka – w miejscu, w którym pas jest przywiązany do drzewa. Jeśli pocisk ją trafi, to istnieje niewielka szansa na to, że zwolni pas...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD15.belarusian: "Так... — ён папраўляе акуляры. — Спражка ўтрымлівае рэмень на галіне. Калі трапіць у яе, існуе пэўная верагоднасць, што яна вызваліць рэмень..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD24.english: "Yeah, now we're talkin'. Entertain the Cuno with some shit."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD24.polish: „No, wreszcie coś się dzieje. Zabawcie czymś Cuno, kurwa”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD24.belarusian: "О! Пайшла справа. Павесяліце ўжо Куна, каб вас халера".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD2B.english: "They'll miss. The pigs will miss, Cuno!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD2B.belarusian: "Яны не трапяць. Мянты ні за што не трапяць, Куна!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD38.english: "I don't know how. Maybe it's better not to..." (Back off.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD38.polish: „Nie wiem jak. Może lepiej nie...” (Wycofaj się).

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD4B.english: "Take the shot, lieutenant -- what's the worst thing that could happen?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD4B.polish: „Strzelaj, poruczniku. Co się może stać takiego złego?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD4B.belarusian: "Страляй, лейтэнант. Што такога дрэннага можа здарыцца?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD51.english: "Actually -- don't. It has *bad idea* written all over it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD51.polish: „Właściwie to lepiej nie. Aż śmierdzi to *złym pomysłem*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD51.belarusian: "Ведаеш, лепей не трэба. Гэта з усіх бакоў *кепская ідэя*".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD66.english: "Yeah!" The enthusiasm is unrestrained. "Bang bang time, pigs! Shoot his head off!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD66.polish: „Taaak!” – krzyczy z dzikim entuzjazmem. „Pora na strzelanie, świnie! Odstrzel mu łeb!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD66.belarusian: "Таак! — энтузіязм так і плешча. — Час пастраляць, парсюкі! Адстрэль яму галаву!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD6E.english: The lieutenant's brow is furrowed. He appears too deep in concentration to even notice what you said.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD6E.polish: Porucznik marszczy czoło. Jest tak bardzo skupiony, że zdaje się nawet cię nie słyszeć.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD6E.belarusian: Лейтэнант моршчыць бровы. Ён настолькі сканцэнтраваны, што, здаецца, увогуле цябе не пачуў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD7B.polish: Nic nie mów – daj mu wybrać.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD7B.belarusian: Нічога не казаць. Даць яму самому вырашыць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD8A.english: "Yeah, take the shot, Cuno wants some of that shit."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD8A.polish: „Taa, strzelaj! Cuno chce zobaczyć ten pierdolnik”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD8A.belarusian: "Так, страляй! Куна ашалець як хоча на гэта паглядзець".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD91.english: Silence. With his elbows sharp, the lieutenant unzips his jacket...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD91.polish: Cisza. Zdecydowanym ruchem porucznik otwiera zamek swojej kurtki...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD91.belarusian: Цішыня. Лейтэнант рашучым жэстам расшморгвае свой бомбер...

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD98.english: ...and produces a lightweight firearm. He drops a paper cartridge in the barrel, separates the scouring stick and gives the cartridge five tucks.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD98.polish: I wyciąga spod niej lekki pistolet. Wrzuca do lufy papierowy ładunek, bierze w rękę wycior i ubija patron pięcioma pchnięciami.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FD98.belarusian: ...і выцягвае з-пад яго лёгкі пісталет. Ён закідвае ў рулю папяровы картрыдж, бярэ ў руку шомпал і дае картрыджу пяць тычкоў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDA1.english: That's a Kiejl A9/90 Armistice mass-produced muzzleloader. Ascetic, frugal, one of the most common firearms in the world.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDA1.polish: To masowo produkowany, ładowany odprzodowo Kiejl A9/90 Armistice. Ascetyczny, skromny i jeden z najpowszechniejszych rodzajów broni palnej na świecie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDA1.belarusian: Гэта Kiejl A9/90 Armistice, рулязарадны пісталет масавай вытворчасці. Аскетычны, сціплы і адзін з найбольш распаўсюджаных відаў агнястрэльнай зброі ў свеце.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDA9.english: He then steps back and assumes the Falostesse position, taking aim. The corner of his eye twitches -- his finger is on the trigger...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDA9.polish: Robi krok w tył i przyjmuje pozycję Falostessa, mierząc do celu. Kącik oka porucznika drży – ma palec na spuście...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDA9.belarusian: Ён робіць крок назад, прымае паставу Фалоста і цэліцца. Куток вока лейтэнанта дрыжыць — яго палец на спуску...

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDCE.english: The kid's voice is drowned in a shrill blast that echoes off the walls of the surrounding tenements. A cloud of smoke slowly parts in the air, as the lieutenant steps back and says to himself...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDCE.polish: Głos dziecka zagłusza huk wystrzału, który odbija się echem od ścian budynków otaczających plac. Wiatr powoli rozwiewa gęsty dym, gdy porucznik robi kilka kroków w tył i mówi do siebie...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDCE.belarusian: Дзіцячы голас патанае ў грукаце стрэлу, які адбіваецца рэхам ад сцен будынкаў, што атачаюць двор. Вецер павольна разносіць густы дым, а лейтэнант робіць некалькі крокаў назад і кажа сабе...

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDDC.english: He feels bad about it. About his eyes mostly, just having bad eyesight -- probably from a young age. Whatever you do, do not *console* him.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDDC.polish: Źle mu z tym. Głównie z jego oczami, słabym wzrokiem – zapewne od urodzenia. Cokolwiek zrobisz, *nie* pocieszaj go.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDDC.belarusian: Яму сорамна. Асабіста за яго зрок, слабы — напэўна, з дзяцінства. Рабі што хочаш, але *не* суцяшай яго.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDE2.english: A lot of things were wrong with that shot: the Falostesse was the wrong choice, his shoulders were raised, but above all -- he cannot trust his eyesight.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDE2.polish: Wiele rzeczy można było w tym strzale poprawić: pozycja Falostessa była złym wyborem, miał uniesione barki, ale przede wszystkim – nie może ufać swojemu wzrokowi.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDE2.belarusian: Шмат чаго пайшло не так з гэтым стрэлам: пастава Фалоста была дрэнным выбарам, ён падняў плечы, але, што галоўнае, — у яго не лепшы зрок.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDF1.english: He feels bad about it. About his eyes mostly, just having bad eyesight -- probably from a young age. Whatever you do, do not *console* him.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDF1.polish: Źle mu z tym. Głównie z jego oczami, słabym wzrokiem – zapewne od urodzenia. Cokolwiek zrobisz, *nie* pocieszaj go.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FDF1.belarusian: Яму сорамна. Асабіста за яго зрок, слабы — напэўна, з дзяцінства. Рабі што хочаш, але *не* суцяшай яго.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE01.english: "Cuno could've hit it easy, but then -- Cuno's not fucking handicapped, is he?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE01.polish: „Cuno by trafił z łatwością. No ale Cuno nie jest, kurwa, inwalidą, co nie?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE01.belarusian: "Куна б лёгка трапіў, але ж Куна і не сраны калека, так?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE14.english: "I can try to shoot him down myself."

Alternate1/0x010000040000FE14.polish: „Mogę twój pistolet? Powinienem spróbować, ale nie chcę używać swojego”.
Alternate1/0x010000040000FE14.belarusian: "Дасі мне твой пісталет? Я таксама мушу паспрабаваць, але не хачу страляць са свайго".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE1A.polish: „W mordę, weź ty się w garść!”

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE27.english: "Cuno's sorry too. Cuno feels sorry for the binoclard."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE27.polish: „Cuno też jest przykro. Cuno współczuje pinglarzowi”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE35.english: OH MY GOD, that was so many types of wrong -- who taught four-eyes to shoot?! Whip up a gruelling training regiment for him RIGHT NOW. Beat THE MAN into him, go go go!
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE35.polish: O boże, tyle rzeczy tu było źle. Kto uczył tego pinglarza strzelać?! Opracuj mu plan treningowy z piekła rodem, I TO JUŻ. Zrób z niego MĘŻCZYZNĘ. Dawaj, dawaj!
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE35.belarusian: БОЖУХНА, гэта проста нельга было зрабіць горш. Хто вучыў гэтага акулярніка страляць?! Яму варта прайсці жорсткі трэнінг па стральбе. НЕАДКЛАДНА. Трэба зрабіць з яго МУЖЫКА! Давай, давай!

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE3C.english: "What THE HELL is wrong with you, Sally!? You need to square your shoulders!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE3C.polish: „Co DO CHOLERY jest z tobą nie tak, koleś? Powinieneś zablokować ramiona!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE3C.belarusian: "Што ЗА ТРАСЦА з табой, малы? Плечы трэба было выпрастаць!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE43.english: "I think you have your sports mixed up there, officer, squaring my shoulders has nothing to do with this."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE43.polish: „Zdaje się, że pomieszały ci się dziedziny sportu, oficerze. Prostowanie ramion nie ma tu nic do rzeczy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE43.belarusian: "Здаецца, вы ўсё пераблыталі, афіцэру. Выпрастаць плечы з гэтым бы аніяк не дапамагло".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE59.english: The lieutenant doesn't say a word, just looks at the gun in his hand.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE59.polish: Porucznik nie odzywa się ani jednym słowem. Patrzy tylko na broń w swojej ręce.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE59.belarusian: Лейтэнант не кажа ні слова. Толькі глядзіць на пісталет у руцэ.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE66.english: "No, we're lucky as it is. We didn't break anything -- and the victim remains uncompromised." He looks around, at the windows overlooking the yard.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE66.polish: „Nie. I tak dopisało nam szczęście. Niczego nie zniszczyliśmy, a ofiara wciąż jest w jednym kawałku” – rozgląda się wokoło, sprawdzając okna wychodzące na plac.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE66.belarusian: "Не. Нам і так пашчасціла нічога не знішчыць і цела ахвяры яшчэ не пашкоджана", — ён азіраецца, аглядаючы вокны дамоў навокал.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE6D.english: "Any more mistakes could put us in an unfortunate position with the locals. We have eyes on us. I didn't do us any favours with that."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE6D.polish: „Kolejne błędy mogą narazić nas na nieprzyjemności z miejscowymi. Mają na nas oko. Moje niepowodzenie nie poprawiło naszej sytuacji”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE6D.belarusian: "Наступныя памылкі могуць прывесці да непрыемнасцяў з тутэйшымі. За намі прыглядаюць. Мой учынак не зрабіў нам паслугі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE79.english: "Remain collegial, officer. It was an honest mistake -- and I will not repeat it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE79.polish: „Gdzie twoje koleżeństwo, oficerze? To był zwykły błąd – którego nie powtórzę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE79.belarusian: "Зважайце на манеры, афіцэру. Гэта была звычайная памылка, і я яе не паўтару".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE80.english: "It's bad as it is -- us shooting firearms like punks..." He pauses, then shrugs and proceeds to load the pistolette...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE80.polish: „Już i tak wygląda to źle – strzelamy jak jacyś chuligani...” – zaczyna, ale po chwili milknie, wzrusza ramionami i ładuje pistolet...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FE80.belarusian: "Гэта ўсё і так выглядае блага — страляем, як нейкая шпана..." — ён змаўкае, паціскае плячыма і зараджае пісталет...

Alternate1/0x010000040000FE80.polish: „Oby to nie była kolejna *demonstracja*...” – zaczyna, ale po chwili milknie, wzrusza ramionami i ładuje pistolet...
Alternate1/0x010000040000FE80.belarusian: "Хай бы гэта не было чарговай *дэманстрацыяй*..." — ён змаўкае, паціскае плячыма і зараджае пісталет:

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FEAF.english: "I have to say, it's beginning to look unlikely we can get him down without *assistance*."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FEAF.polish: „Muszę powiedzieć, że zaczyna wyglądać na to, że bez czyjejś *pomocy* chyba nie zdejmiemy go na dół”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FEAF.belarusian: "Мушу прызнаць, мне пачынае падавацца, што без *дапамогі* мы наўрад ці спусцім яго ўніз".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FEE7.english: "This is the sorriest pair of pigs Cuno's ever seen."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FEE7.polish: „To najbardziej żałosna para świń, jaką Cuno kiedykolwiek widział”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FEE7.belarusian: "Гэта самая жаласлівая пара свіней, якую Куна калі-небудзь бачыў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF5F.english: The cold piece of bakelite and gunmetal is surprisingly light. Your finger fits right through the guard, instinctively resting on the trigger.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF5F.polish: Zimny kawałek bakelitu i metalu jest zaskakująco lekki. Twój palec idealnie wpasowuje się w kabłąk i instynktownie opiera się na spuście.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF5F.belarusian: Халодны кавалак бакеліту і сталі надзіва лёгкі. Ты прасоўваеш палец у адтуліну, і ён інстынктыўна кладзецца на спускавы кручок.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF6D.english: You've held this -- an A9 Armistice -- before. At some point it probably used to be your choice of firearm. It still feels comfortable, like you never laid it down.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF6D.polish: Trzymałeś już tę broń – A9 Armistice. Kiedyś pewnie była twoją ulubioną. Wciąż wydaje ci się wygodna, jakbyś nigdy jej nie odkładał.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF6D.belarusian: Ты ўжо трымаў яго — A9 Armistice. Раней. Калісьці, напэўна, ён быў тваім улюбёным пісталетам. Ён усё такі ж зручны, быццам ты ніколі яго не адкладаў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF74.english: "The fuck are you waiting for, Cuno?! Tell him to shoot himself in the mouth!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF74.polish: „Na co, kurwa, czekasz, Cuno?! Powiedz mu, żeby palnął sobie w ryj!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF74.belarusian: "Чаго ты, бляха, чакаеш, Куна?! Скажы, каб ён стрэліў сабе ў рот!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF7A.english: Cuno is silent. Aggression gathers in the air, the trigger feels delicate and ready to break under your finger.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF7A.polish: Cuno milczy. Powietrze wzbiera agresją; spust wydaje się delikatny, gotów złamać się pod naciskiem twojego palca.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF7A.belarusian: Куна маўчыць. Паветра прасякаецца агрэсіяй; спускавы кручок здаецца крохкім, здольным пераламацца пад тваім пальцам.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF83.english: "Yeah, take it you fucking *banaanipoika*. Take it and shoot yourself in the mouth!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF83.polish: „Taa, weź go, pieprzony *banaanipoika*. Weź go i strzel sobie w ryj!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF83.belarusian: "Давай, кончаны *banaanipoika*. Вазьмі і стрэльні сабе ў рот!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FF9B.english: Point the gun at the belt.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFA7.english: Give the gun back to Lieutenant Kitsuragi. (Don't shoot.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFB9.english: The buckle comes into focus in your sights. You stand with your feet planted firmly in the ground and your left hand supporting your gun arm...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFB9.polish: Sprzączka pojawia się na muszce broni. Stajesz pewnie na ziemi, podpierając lewą ręką dłoń, w której masz pistolet...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFB9.belarusian: Ты факусуеш зрок на спражцы. Ты ўпэўнена стаіш на зямлі, падпіраючы левай рукою далонь, якая сціскае пісталет...

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFC8.english: "Why don't you just shoot yourself in your f****t mouth?" she hisses. "At least you won't miss."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFC8.polish: „Czemu nie strzelisz sobie po prostu w ten p***lski ryj?” – syczy. „Przynajmniej nie spudłujesz”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFC8.belarusian: "Чаму б табе не стрэліць у свой пі**рскі рот? — шыпіць яна. — Ты не прамажаш".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFE8.english: Your field of view narrows. The branch slowly moves, becoming entirely two-dimensional. The metal buckle glimmers, catching the noon light as the corpse slowly rotates.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFE8.polish: Twoje pole widzenia zawęża się. Gałąź rusza się powoli, nagle całkowicie dwuwymiarowa. Metalowa sprzączka migocze, odbijając południowe światło. To obracające się niespiesznie ciało wprawia ją w ruch.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFE8.belarusian: Тваё поле зроку звужаецца. Галіна павольна гайдаецца і раптам становіцца цалкам двухмернай. Металічная спражка паблісквае ў промнях паўдзённага святла, калі труп павольна паварочваецца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFEF.english: "Or what? You gonna *fuck* me?" Her voice is almost a whisper now: "You wanna fuck me, pig? Is that what this is about?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFEF.polish: „Bo co? *Przelecisz* mnie?” – pyta, po czym kontynuuje niemal szeptem: „Chcesz mnie przelecieć, świnio? To o to ci chodzi?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFEF.belarusian: "Ці што? *Выябеш* мяне? — яе голас зніжаецца амаль да шэпта: — Хочаш выябаць мяне, свіння? Ты гэта маеш на ўвазе?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFFE.english: "Look, he's crying! You gonna cry now, fucking *fägäri*?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFFE.polish: „Patrz, on beczy! Popłaczesz się teraz, jebany *fägäri*?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040000FFFE.belarusian: "Глядзі, ён плача! Ты што, зараз заравеш, блядзкі *fägäri*?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001000E.english: "F****T!" She's ripping her blazer open to bare her chest. "DO IT!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001000E.polish: „P***Ł!” – krzyczy, rozchylając poły marynarki i odsłaniając pierś. „ZRÓB TO!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001000E.belarusian: "П***Р! – крычыць яна, раздзіраючы куртку і агаляючы грудную клетку: — ДАВАЙ!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400010015.english: You feel as though it would be *dangerous* to set this creature free to roam about the cosmos.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400010015.polish: Czujesz, że *niebezpiecznie* byłoby uwolnić tę istotę i pozwolić jej na wędrówkę po kosmosie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400010015.belarusian: Ты адчуваеш, што было б *небяспечна* вызваліць гэтую істоту і дазволіць ёй свабодна падарожнічаць па космасе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001003F.english: "Don't." You feel the lieutenant's hand on your shoulder.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001003F.polish: „Nie” – czujesz dłoń porucznika na swoim ramieniu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001003F.belarusian: "Не", — ты адчуваеш руку лейтэнанта на сваім плячы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400010047.english: Point the gun at the belt.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400010063.english: "Put it right here *mulkku*," she points to her heart. "RIGHT HERE!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400010063.belarusian: "Страляй сюды, *mulkku*, — яна паказвае на сваё сэрца. — ПРОСТА СЮДЫ!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000110DE.english: "I agree." The lieutenant holsters the weapon with a quick move. "Enough gunslinging for today."
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000110DE.polish: „Zgoda” – porucznik chowa szybkim ruchem pistolet do kabury. „Wystarczy strzelania na dziś”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000110DE.belarusian: "Згодны, — лейтэнант хуткім рухам хавае пісталет у кабуру: — Досыць на сёння страляніны".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011115.english: "F****t waved his gun." She pants, breathless with excitement. "It wasn't intense, it was pathetic."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011115.polish: „P***ł pomachał swoją spluwą” – odpowiada, dysząc z ekscytacji. „To nie było intensywne. To było żałosne”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011115.belarusian: "П***р размахаўся сваёй руляй, — узрушана выдыхае яна. — Гэта не жорстка, гэта жаласна".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001112C.english: The lieutenant takes the gun carefully from you and holsters it. His eyes are narrow and he doesn't comment on your antics.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001112C.polish: Porucznik ostrożnie odbiera ci broń i chowa ją do kabury. Ma przymrużone oczy i nie komentuje twojego zachowania.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001112C.belarusian: Лейтэнант асцярожна забірае ў цябе зброю і хавае яе ў кабуру. Яго вочы прыжмураныя, ён ніяк не каментуе тваё паводзіны.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011133.english: "Fucking pussy didn't shoot shit, did he? Didn't shoot me, didn't shoot himself in the mouth..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011133.polish: „Jebana pizdeczka sobie nie postrzelała, co? Nie strzeliła do mnie, nie strzeliła sobie w ryj...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011133.belarusian: "Блядзкая сучка нават не стрэльне, га? Мяне не падстрэліў, у рот сабе не стрэліў..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001113A.english: "Didn't shoot *me*." There is sincere disappointment on her face. This kid was expecting *pandemonium* and release from her mortal coil.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001113A.polish: „Nie strzeliła *do mnie*”. Na jej twarzy widnieje szczere rozczarowanie. Oczekiwała *pandemonium* i uwolnienia z cielesnej powłoki.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001113A.belarusian: "*Мяне* не падстрэліў", — на яе твары шчырае расчараванне. Дзяўчынка чакала *пандэмоніуму* і вызвалення з цялеснай абалонкі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011166.english: The slow movement of the branch in the wind and your shoulders directing the gun sync up, dancing hypnotically.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011166.polish: Powolny ruch gałęzi na wietrze i twoich kierujących bronią ramion synchronizują się w hipnotycznym tańcu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011166.belarusian: Цэлячы пісталет, твае плечы, быццам у гіпнатычным танцы, рухаюцца сінхронна хістанню галінкі на ветры.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011170.english: As you wait, your breathing slows down. Some mosquito-like organism buzzes in your peripheral:
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011170.polish: Czekasz, a twój oddech zwalnia. Jakiś przypominający komara organizm bzyczy ci nad uchem:
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011170.belarusian: Пакуль ты чакаеш, тваё дыханне запавольваецца. Нейкая істота, падобная да камара, пішчыць у цябе на перыферыі:

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000111AB.english: "Can I have the gun? I should try."
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000111AB.belarusian: "Дасі мне пісталет? Я таксама мушу паспрабаваць".

Alternate1/0x01000004000111AB.polish: „Mogę twój pistolet? Powinienem spróbować, ale nie chcę używać swojego”.
Alternate1/0x01000004000111AB.belarusian: "Дасі мне твой пісталет? Я таксама мушу паспрабаваць, але не хачу страляць са свайго".

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000111B5.english: "Go ahead, I'm not stopping you. Just don't lose it." The piece shines in his outstretched hand.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000111B5.polish: „Proszę, nie powstrzymuję cię. Tylko go nie zgub” – pistolet lśni w wyciągniętej ręce porucznika.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000111B5.belarusian: "Наперад. Я не супраць. Толькі не згубіце", — пісталет блішчыць у працягнутай руцэ лейтэнанта.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000111C3.english: "Go ahead, I'm not stopping you. Just don't lose it." The Armistice A9 shines in his outstretched hand.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000111C3.polish: „Proszę, nie powstrzymuję cię. Tylko go nie zgub” – Armistice A9 lśni w wyciągniętej ręce porucznika.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000111C3.belarusian: "Наперад. Я не супраць. Толькі не згубіце", — Armistice A9 блішчыць у працягнутай руцэ лейтэнанта.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000111FA.english: "It's bad as it is -- us shooting firearms like punks here..." He pauses, then shrugs: "Go ahead, I'm not stopping you. Just don't hit the victim."
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000111FA.polish: „Już i tak wygląda to źle – strzelamy jak jacyś chuligani...” – zaczyna, ale po chwili milknie i wzrusza ramionami. „Proszę, nie powstrzymuję cię. Tylko nie traf ofiary...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000111FA.belarusian: "Гэта ўсё і так выглядае блага — страляем, як нейкая шпана... — ён змаўкае, паціскае плячыма: — Наперад. Я не супраць. Паспрабуйце не трапіць у ахвяру".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011206.english: "I'm gonna need your gun for this."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001120D.english: "This is the sorriest pair of pigs Cuno's ever seen."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001120D.polish: „To najbardziej żałosna para świń, jaką Cuno kiedykolwiek widział”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001120D.belarusian: "Гэта самая жаласная пара мянтоў, якіх Куна толькі бачыў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011221.english: "Officer, why *do* we only have one gun?" he asks -- carefully loading his pistolette.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011221.polish: „Oficerze, dlaczego *mamy* tylko jeden pistolet?” – pyta, ostrożnie ładując swoją broń.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011221.belarusian: "Афіцэру, *чаму* ў нас толькі адна руля?" – пытае ён, асцярожна зараджаючы пісталет.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001122A.english: "Remember when I told you I didn't have my badge or uniform with me when I woke up -- I didn't have my gun either."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001122A.polish: „Pamiętasz, jak ci mówiłem, że po przebudzeniu nie miałem odznaki ani munduru? Broni też nie miałem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001122A.belarusian: "Памятаеш, як я казаў табе, што, калі я прачнуўся, пры мне не было ні значка, ні мундзіра? Зброі таксама не было".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011236.english: "I think someone has stolen it from me, stolen my gun. Gun is stolen."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011236.polish: „Chyba ktoś mi go ukradł. Ukradł mi broń. Broń została skradziona”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011236.belarusian: "Я думаю, хтосьці скраў яго ў мяне, скраў у мяне зброю. Пісталет быў скрадзены".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001123F.english: "That is even *more* unfortunate than the badge. You need to contact your station about it as soon as possible." The piece shines in his outstretched hand. "Try not to lose this one, please."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001123F.polish: „To nawet *większy* problem niż brak odznaki. Musisz jak najszybciej skontaktować się w tej sprawie ze swoim komisariatem” – broń lśni w jego wyciągniętej ręce. „Postaraj się nie zgubić tego pistoletu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001123F.belarusian: "Гэта *яшчэ горш*, чым страта значка. Вы мусіце як мага хутчэй паведаміць пра гэта ў свой пастарунак, — зброя блішчыць у яго выцягнутай руцэ. — Толькі гэты не згубіце, калі ласка".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001124A.english: The lieutenant follows suit. He finishes loading the gun in silence, then hands it to you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001124A.polish: Porucznik również się nie odzywa. Kończy ładować broń w milczeniu, po czym podaje ci ją.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001124A.belarusian: Лейтэнант таксама маўчыць. Не вымавіўшы ані слова, ён зараджае пісталет і перадае яго табе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011259.english: "*Extremely* unfortunate. You need to contact your station about it as soon as possible." The piece shines in his outstretched hand. "Try not to lose this one, please."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011259.polish: „To *ogromny* problem. Musisz jak najszybciej skontaktować się w tej sprawie ze swoim komisariatem” – broń lśni w jego wyciągniętej ręce. „Postaraj się nie zgubić tego pistoletu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011259.belarusian: "Гэта *гіганцкая* праблема. Вы мусіце як мага хутчэй паведаміць пра гэта ў свой пастарунак, — зброя блішчыць у яго выцягнутай руцэ. — Толькі гэты не згубіце, калі ласка".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011268.english: This isn't mere boundary pushing. There is a true suicidal rage in the kid as she's provoking you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011268.polish: To nie jest zwykłe sprawdzanie, gdzie leży granica. W prowokującej cię dziewczynie drzemie prawdziwy samobójczy szał.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011268.belarusian: Яна не проста дражніць цябе, правяраючы межы дазволенага. Дзіця правакуе цябе з сапраўднай лютасцю самагубцы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011270.english: With your hand numb from the recoil, you look at the body slump down. For a moment the man appears to *kneel* in front of you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011270.polish: Ze zdrętwiałą od odrzutu broni ręką spoglądasz na spadające na ziemię ciało. Przez moment wygląda to, jakby przed tobą *klękało*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011270.belarusian: З анямелай ад аддачы зброі рукой ты глядзіш на цела, якое чвякаецца аб зямлю. На імгненне падаецца, што яно *ўкленчыла* перад табою.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011275.english: You missed the belt, but hit the corpse straight in the chest. Bits of ribcage protrude from the skin. No blood, only a murky sludge dripping down his belly. The sudden stink makes your eyes water.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011275.polish: Nie trafiłeś w pas, ale kula ugodziła ciało prosto w klatkę piersiową. Przez skórę przezierają kawałki żeber. Brak krwi – po brzuchu spływa tylko mętna maź. Nagły smród sprawia, że oczy zachodzą ci łzami.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011275.belarusian: Ты не трапіў у рэмень, але куля патрапіла проста ў грудную клетку. Праз скуру тырчаць рэшткі рэбраў. Крыві няма — толькі па жываце цячэ мутная вадкасць. Раптоўны подых смуроду выціскае з вачэй слёзы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011289.english: Looking straight at you. Helpless, trapped within itself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011289.polish: Wpatrując się prosto w ciebie. Bezradne, uwięzione w sobie samym.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011289.belarusian: Пры гэтым гледзячы проста на цябе. Бездапаможнае, заняволенае ў самім сабе.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000112A7.english: It takes a millisecond for the association to flash within your cortex. You have no idea *where* it's coming from -- only that it's *right*.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000112A7.polish: Ledwie milisekundę zajmuje utworzenie się w twojej korze mózgowej powiązania. Nie masz pojęcia *skąd* ono się wzięło, ale wiesz, że jest *słuszne*.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000112A7.belarusian: Нейронныя сувязі кары тваіх мазгоў выдалі такую выснову за мілісекунду. Ты не маеш разумення, *адкуль* думка ўзялася, але ведаеш, што яна *правільная*.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000112B3.english: Then the *rigor* in his muscles gives up, and he smashes sideways into the spring mud, letting out a horrid stench.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000112B3.polish: Później *stężenie* jego mięśni ustępuje; upada bokiem w wiosenne błoto, wyrzucając z siebie koszmarny odór.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000112B3.belarusian: *Адубенне* цягліц саступае, ён нахіляецца ўбок і валіцца ў вясновы бруд, выпускаючы задушлівы смурод.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000112DD.english: "Are you sure we've finished the preliminary examination of the cadaver? We might miss some of these things once he's down." He stops to think, then checks his notes.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000112DD.polish: „Jesteś pewny, że zakończyliśmy już wstępne oględziny zwłok? Możemy przegapić coś, gdy zdejmiemy go na ziemię” – milknie i pogrąża się w myślach, po czym sprawdza swoje notatki.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000112DD.belarusian: "Вы ўпэўнены, што скончылі з папярэднім аглядам? Мы можам прапусціць нешта важнае, калі проста зараз яго спусцім", — ён заціхае і занураецца ў думкі, пасля чаго правярае свае нататкі.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000112E4.english: "We've been thorough. Do you have a plan for getting him down?" (Proceed.)
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000112E4.polish: „Byliśmy dokładni. Masz plan, jak go stamtąd ściągnąć?” (Przejdź dalej).
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000112E4.belarusian: "Мы ўсё зрабілі дасканала. У цябе ёсць план, як зняць яго з дрэва?" (Працягнуць.)

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000112EA.english: Step back and have another look first.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000112EA.polish: Odsuń się i spójrz jeszcze raz.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011310.polish: „I kto się śmieje teraz, zasrana gówniaro?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001131E.english: "Oh my god, he's gonna fucking cry, I knew it! What a *mulkku*..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001131E.polish: „O mój boże, zaraz się, kurwa, popłacze! Wiedziałam! Jaki *mulkku*...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001131E.belarusian: "Божачкі, ён зараз, курва, заплача! Я ведала! Ну, што за *mulkku*..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011325.english: "Nice shot, though. Fucked him up good..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011339.english: "There's something wrong with your weapon, lieutenant. It keeps missing."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011339.polish: „Coś jest nie tak z twoją bronią, poruczniku. Nie trafia do celu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011339.belarusian: "Нешта не так з тваім пісталетам, лейтэнанце. Не трапляе ў цэль".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011341.english: "I don't wanna do this anymore, this is boring."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011341.polish: „Nie chcę już tego robić. To nudne”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011348.english: "Don't provoke her." The lieutenant takes his sidearm from you, then holsters it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011348.polish: „Nie prowokuj jej” – porucznik odbiera od ciebie swój pistolet i chowa go do kabury.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011348.belarusian: "Не правакуйце яе", — лейтэнант забірае ў цябе пісталет, затым хавае яго ў кабуру.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001134F.english: "Shot him in the chest." The creature is still in disbelief. "What a FUCKING IDIOT."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001134F.polish: „Strzelił mu w klatę” – stworzenie wciąż nie może w to uwierzyć. „Jaki JEBANY IDIOTA”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001134F.belarusian: "Стрэліў яму ў грудзі, — істота дагэтуль не можа паверыць. — Які ж ЯБАНЫ АФЭЛАК".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011367.english: "Actually it was f****ted. Cuno just said that because he felt sorry for you, pig. It's not your fault you can't shoot -- it's your pig-hands."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011367.polish: „Tak naprawdę to było p***lskie. Cuno powiedział inaczej, bo zrobiło mu się ciebie żal, świnio. To nie twoja wina, że nie umiesz strzelać – to wina twoich świńskich łap”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011367.belarusian: "Гэта быў поўны гамон. Куна сказаў інакш, бо яму стала цябе шкада, свіны лыч. Ты не вінны ў тым, што страляць не ўмееш — гэта ўсё твае свінарукі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011375.english: Are you? Because it sort of feels like you *are*. Please don't cry.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011375.polish: Popłaczesz się? Bo trochę tak się *wydaje*. Nie płacz, proszę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011375.belarusian: Ты што, зараз заплачаш? Бо, здаецца, так яно і *ёсць*. Калі ласка, не трэба.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011388.english: It feels dry. Nothing comes out of you as you stretch and bend your face into a crying shape. You're too furious to cry, apparently.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011388.polish: Policzki masz suche. Nie lecą żadne łzy, choć wykrzywiłeś twarz w płaczliwym grymasie. Najwyraźniej jesteś zbyt wściekły, żeby płakać.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011388.belarusian: Шчокі застаюцца сухімі. Слёзы не цякуць, хоць твар скурчыўся ў плаксівую грымасу. Здаецца, ты занадта раззлаваны, каб плакаць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001138F.english: "I can't even cry..." (Throw the gun in the mud.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001138F.polish: „Nie umiem się nawet popłakać...” (Rzuć bronią w błoto).
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001138F.belarusian: "Я нават заплакаць не магу..." (Кінуць пісталет у бруд.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011395.english: Try harder. Try *really* hard to cry.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011395.polish: Spróbuj bardziej. *Naprawdę* mocno postaraj się rozpłakać.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113AA.english: The lieutenant picks up his gun and then holsters it. "In the name of god, please get a hang of yourself."
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113AA.polish: Porucznik podnosi swoją broń i chowa ją do kabury. „Na litość boską, weź się w garść”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113AA.belarusian: Лейтэнант падымае свой пісталет і хавае яе ў кабуру: "Божа літасцівы, вазьміце сябе ў рукі, калі ласка".

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113B7.english: He's definitely not impressed by the way you're handling it, but he doesn't hold it against you either. He's supportive like that.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113B7.polish: Zdecydowanie nie podoba mu się to, jak to wszystko rozgrywasz, ale też nie ma do ciebie o to żalu. Jest pełen chęci wsparcia.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113B7.belarusian: Ён відавочна не ўражаны тым, як ты трымаешся, але і не крыўдзіцца на цябе таксама. Вось наколькі ён спагадлівы.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113C1.english: The lieutenant watches you jerk some tears, your shoulders shaking and your eyes dry. The gun begins to slip from your fingers.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113C1.polish: Porucznik przygląda się, jak ronisz kilka łez, twoje ramiona drżą, a oczy obsychają. Pistolet zaczyna wyślizgiwać się z twoich rąk.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113C1.belarusian: Лейтэнант назірае, як ты выціскаеш з сябе колькі слязінак, твае плечы дрыжаць, а вочы высыхаюць. Пісталет пачынае выслізгваць з тваіх пальцаў.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113C8.polish: „*Jumalauta*! P***ł nawet rozbeczeć się nie potrafi”.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113D3.english: (Give the gun back to Kim.) "What now?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113E5.english: You hear that, Sally? They're *laughing* at you. Are you gonna let it stand? Are you, Sally? Or are you gonna CRY LIKE A BEAST?! Like a BEAAAST!
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113E5.polish: Słyszysz, Dorotko? *Śmieją się* z ciebie. I ty tak na to pozwolisz? Co, Dorotko? A może RYKNIESZ NICZYM BESTIA?! Niczym BEEEESTIA!
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113E5.belarusian: Ты чуеш, слімак? Яны *смяюцца* з цябе. І ты гэта так пакінеш? Так, слімак? Ці можа ўжо ЗАРАВЕШ ЯК ЗВЕР! Як ЗВЕЕЕЕЕР!

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113FF.english: Don't take coach Physical Instrument's advice. It's bad advice.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113FF.polish: Nie słuchaj rad trenera ciała jako narzędzia. To złe rady.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000113FF.belarusian: Не слухаць параду Фізічнага Інструмента. Парада трэнера дрэнная.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011411.english: The lieutenant gently picks his gun from your hand and holsters it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011411.polish: Porucznik ostrożnie wyjmuje swoją broń z twojej ręki i chowa ją do kabury.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011411.belarusian: Лейтэнант асцярожна вымае свой пісталет з тваёй рукі і хавае яго ў кабуру.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001141F.english: A tiny tear forms on your duct. The corpse stinks from the blackened bullet hole in his chest. A single drop of decay liquid runs out of it, then down his stomach...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001141F.polish: W twoim kanaliku łzowym tworzy się maleńka łza. Trup bucha smrodem z poczerniałej dziury po kuli w klatce piersiowej. Wypływa z niej kropla gnijącego płynu. Spływa mu po brzuchu...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001141F.belarusian: У тваім слёзным канале ўтвараецца маленькая сляза. Пачарнелая дзірка ад кулі ў грудзях трупа дзьме смуродам. З яе выцякае кропля гною, збягаючы ўніз па жываце...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011427.english: The lieutenant gently picks his gun from your hand and holsters it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011427.polish: Porucznik ostrożnie wyjmuje swoją broń z twojej ręki i chowa ją do kabury.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011427.belarusian: Лейтэнант асцярожна вымае свой пісталет з тваёй рукі і хавае яго ў кабуру.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001144D.english: "The *Armistice* is sufficiently precise, officer. Especially at close range." He takes his sidearm from you and holsters it.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001144D.polish: „*Armistice* jest wystarczająco celne, oficerze. Zwłaszcza przy tak małym dystansie” – bierze od ciebie swój pistolet i chowa go do kabury.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001144D.belarusian: "*Armistice* дастаткова дакладны, афіцэру. Асабіста на такой адлегласці", — ён забірае ў цябе свой пісталет і хавае яго ў кабуру.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001145B.english: "It's not the gun's fault you can't shoot. It's your pig-hands."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001145B.polish: „To nie wina spluwy, że nie umiesz strzelać. To przez te twoje świńskie ręce”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001145B.belarusian: "Зброя не вінная ў тым, што ў цябе свінячыя рукі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011462.english: "Pigs don't have hands. They have, like, fucking hoofs or something."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011462.polish: „Świnie nie mają rąk. Mają jakieś jebane kopyta czy coś”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011462.belarusian: "У свіней няма рук. У іх там, здаецца, сраныя капыты ці што".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011469.english: "Cuno has hands." He displays his little fingers, they're pink. "Cuno can shoot that shit down for you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011469.polish: „Cuno ma ręce” – odpowiada, pokazując swoje różowe paluszki. „Cuno może zestrzelić tego trupa, jak chcesz”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011469.belarusian: "Вось у Куна рукі, — адказвае ён, паказваючы свае ружовыя пальчыкі. — Куна можа адстрэліць тое гаўно для цябе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011470.english: "No, Cuno. If I can't shoot him down, no one will."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011470.polish: „Nie, Cuno. Jeśli ja go nie mogę zestrzelić, to nikt nie da rady”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011470.belarusian: "Не, Куна. Калі я не магу яго адстрэліць, ніхто не можа".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011476.english: "Lieutenant, we should entrust Cuno with your service weapon. He says he can shoot it down."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011476.polish: „Poruczniku, powinniśmy dać Cuno twoją broń służbową. Twierdzi, że może zestrzelić ciało”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011476.belarusian: "Лейтэнант, нам варта даць Куна твой пісталет. Ён кажа, што можа яго адстрэліць".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001147C.english: "That's preposterous. We're not giving you the gun, kid."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001147C.polish: „To niedorzeczne. Nie damy ci broni do ręki, dzieciaku”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001147C.belarusian: "Несусвеціца. Мы не дадзім табе ў рукі зброю, хлапец".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001149A.english: The lieutenant does not dignify that with an answer. He snaps the button on his holster and says...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001149A.polish: Porucznik nie zamierza nawet tego komentować. Zapina kaburę i mówi...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001149A.belarusian: Лейтэнант не збіраецца нават каментаваць тваю прапанову. Зашпільвае кабуру і кажа...

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114A1.english: "Cop's bitter cos' he fucked that corpse up, Cuno. What a fucking *kyrpelö*."
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114A1.polish: „Glina jest nie w sosie, bo rozjebał trupa, Cuno. Co za pieprzony *kyrpelö*”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114A1.belarusian: "Мусар не ў гуморы, бо збаёдаў труп, Куна. Які ж ён блядзкі *kyrpelö*".

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114A8.english: *"Mulkku*, *vittupää*? What is that?! What the hell kind of words are those?!"
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114A8.polish: „*Mulkku*? *Vittupää*? Co to jest? Co to w ogóle za słowa, do cholery?!”
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114A8.belarusian: "*Mulkku*, *vittupää*? Што гэта? Што гэта, трасца, за словы такія?!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114AE.english: "It's the song of my people, asshole!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114BD.english: "I agree. Police work is overrated. It is trying and stressful. However, it is still our job to get the dead body down from the tree." He takes his sidearm from you and holsters it.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114BD.polish: „Zgadza się. Praca w policji jest przereklamowana. Wymagająca i stresująca. Tak czy siak, to my musimy zdjąć zwłoki z tego drzewa” – bierze od ciebie swój pistolet i chowa go do kabury.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114BD.belarusian: "Пагаджуся. Праца ў паліцыі пераацэненая. Яна патрабавальная і багатая на стрэс. Але як бы тое ні было, зняць труп з дрэва — наш абавязак", — ён забірае ў цябе пісталет і хавае яго ў кабуру.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114D1.english: "Oh my god, what a fucking boring cop."
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114D1.polish: „O mój boże, jaki cholernie nudny glina”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114D1.belarusian: "Божа ты мой, які, сука, нудны мент".

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114D9.english: "That's *preposterous*," she whines mockingly. "What are you, a fucking earl?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114D9.polish: „»To *niedorzeczne*«” – naigrywa się z ciebie. „A ty co? Jebany hrabia?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114D9.belarusian: "*Несусвеціца*, — яна кпліва пішчыць. — Ты хто такі? Сраны граф?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114ED.english: He doesn't mean it in earnest. It's a cruel jest. He's going to say as much too, just you wait:
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114ED.polish: Nie mówi tego szczerze. To tylko okrutny żart. Zaraz ci to zresztą powie, tylko poczekaj:
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000114ED.belarusian: Ён гэта не шчыра. Гэта чорны жарт. У яго яшчэ шмат чаго ёсць дадаць, толькі пачакай:

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011504.english: "Can you reload it, please? I need another shot."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011504.belarusian: "Перазарадзіш, калі ласка? Мне трэба яшчэ адна спроба".

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001150B.english: Ask for another shot. You'll get it with the next one, the god damn light reflected off some window, surely...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001150B.polish: Poproś o kolejny strzał. Następnym razem ci się uda, to na pewno przez to cholerne światło odbite w jakimś oknie...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001150B.belarusian: Папрасі яшчэ адну спробу. Другім разам у цябе атрымаецца, проста кляты прамень адбіўся ад той шыбіны і асляпіў цябе, напэўна...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011515.english: "The cadaver is already compromised bad enough. We don't have to make it *worse*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011515.polish: „Zwłoki i bez tego są już w kiepskim stanie. Nie musimy go *pogarszać*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011515.belarusian: "Труп і так ужо моцна пацярпеў. Нам не варта яшчэ *пагаршаць* яго стан".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011523.english: It came out wrong, you made it sound like you're some sort of roulette addict looking for a fix, ask again, more controlled this time:
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011523.polish: Źle wyszło, zabrzmiało, jakbyś był jakimś nałogowcem potrzebującym działki. Spróbuj jeszcze raz, tym razem z większym opanowaniem:
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011523.belarusian: Прагучала неяк няправільна, быццам ты нейкі лудаман, якому трэба адыграцца. Паспрабуй яшчэ раз, але спакайней:

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011543.english: "*Vittupää* wants to fuck up again, bad."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011543.polish: „*Vittupää* chce znowu dać dupy. I to mocno”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001154B.english: Feels like shit man, how did this happen? Hit him straight in the chest... how horrible, you're so sorry.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001154B.polish: Co za parszywe uczucie, stary. Jak to się stało? Trafiłeś go prosto w klatkę piersiową... Co za dramat, jesteś fatalny.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001154B.belarusian: Мярзотнае пачуцце, стары. Як так здарылася? Ты трапіў яму проста ў грудзі... як жудасна. Табе сорамна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011554.english: "We still need to get him down *somehow*." His tone is growing tired now -- the stench makes him turn away from the corpse.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011554.polish: „Wciąż musimy *jakoś* zdjąć go na ziemię” – ton jego głosu zdradza zmęczenie. Smród sprawia, że odwraca się od zwłok.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011554.belarusian: "Нам усё яшчэ трэба яго спусціць на зямлю *нейкім чынам*", — у яго голасе адчуваецца стома — смурод прымушае яго адвярнуцца ад трупа.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001158A.english: I don't really want to pull his head off.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001158A.polish: Nie chcę mu za bardzo urywać głowy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001158A.belarusian: Нешта мне не хочацца адрываць яму галаву.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011590.english: Just pull his rotting head off. The meat's cooked anyway, give the boot another yank and it's done.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011590.polish: Po prostu urwij mu tę gnijącą głowę. Mięso i tak jest rozbabrane – pociągnij jeszcze raz za ten but i będzie z głowy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011590.belarusian: Проста адарві яго гнілую галаву. Гэтаму мясу ўсё адно капцы — пацягні яшчэ разок за бот, і справе канец.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011599.english: How do you plan to get him down then? With social sensibility? Are you going to *educate* him down?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011599.polish: To jak masz go zamiar ściągnąć? Przemówić mu do poczucia obywatelskiego obowiązku? Ściągniesz go *siłą perswazji*?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011599.belarusian: Ну, і як ты плануеш яго здымаць? Спадзявацца на яго грамадскую адказнасць? Плануеш *пераканаць* яго спусціцца?

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115AC.english: "Someone else?" He pauses. "You mean like... *the police*?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115AC.polish: „Ktoś inny?” – pyta i na chwilę milknie. „Na przykład... *policja*?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115AC.belarusian: "Хто-небудзь іншы? — ён заціхае на імгненне. — Напрыклад... *паліцыя*?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115B4.english: You hear an explosion within the weapon in your hands. The branches of the pinetree behind the girl shake ever so lightly. Your ears are still ringing...
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115B4.polish: Słyszysz eksplozję wewnątrz broni w twoich rękach. Gałęzie sosny za dziewczyną lekko drżą. Wciąż dzwoni ci w uszach...
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115B4.belarusian: Ты чуеш выбух у рулі твайго пісталета. Галіны сасны за дзяўчынай лёгка гайдаюцца. Усё яшчэ звініць увушшу...

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115CD.english: A plume of smoke has erupted from the barrel. The little monstrosity stands in the cloud. Her face is petrified, then it begins to twist, demonically.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115CD.polish: Z lufy broni wybucha pióropusz dymu. Mały potwór stoi w powstałym z niego obłoku. Jej twarz zastyga, po czym zaczyna wykrzywiać się demonicznie.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115CD.belarusian: З рулі вырываецца дымная стужка. Маленькая пачварына стаіць у воблаку парахавых газаў. Яе здранцвелы твар пачынае па-д'ябальску скажацца.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115D6.english: She is disappointed, *trapped*, entangled in this world -- all because of the continuously *appalling* marksmanship of law officials.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115D6.polish: Jest rozczarowana, *uwięziona*, wplątana w ten świat. A to wszystko przez *fatalne* umiejętności strzeleckie stróżów prawa.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115D6.belarusian: Яна расчараваная, *утрапёная*, прывязаная да гэтага свету. І ўсё праз нязменна *жудасныя* навыкі стральбы праваахоўнікаў.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115DD.english: "YOU FUCKING F****TS!" she wails. "LEARN TO SHOOT."
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115DD.belarusian: "ВЫ БЛЯДЗКІЯ П***РЫ! – крычыць яна. — СТРАЛЯЦЬ НАВУЧЫЦЕСЯ".

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115EA.english: "Whoah, C..." Cuno's voice is low. "Pig tried to shoot you. You're *alive*."
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115EA.polish: „Łoo, C.” – odzywa się Cuno cicho. „Świnia próbowała cię zastrzelić. Ty *żyjesz*”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115EA.belarusian: "Авой, К.", — голас Куна ціхі. — Свінота спрабавала цябе прыстрэліць. А ты *жывая*".

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115F8.english: You sense nylon moving somewhere to your left. There's motion in your peripherals, then it's already too late...
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115F8.polish: Wyczuwasz ruch nylonu gdzieś po swojej lewej. Rejestrujesz ruch na skraju pola widzenia, a potem jest już za późno...
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115F8.belarusian: Ты адчуваеш варушэнне нейлону дзесьці злева. Перыферыйны зрок заўважае нейкі рух, але ўжо занадта позна...

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115FF.english: The gun has left your hand, still numb from the recoil. The lieutenant holsters it under his arm.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115FF.polish: Broń znika z twojej dłoni wciąż odrętwiałej po wystrzale. Porucznik chowa ją w kaburze pod pachą.
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000115FF.belarusian: Зброя знікае з тваёй рукі, усё яшчэ знямелай пасля стрэлу. Лейтэнант хавае яе ў кабуру пад пахай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011605.english: "Fucking die!" (Throw the empty gun at her.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001160B.english: "Kim, I need you to do your reload-thing, the beast is still alive."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001160B.polish: „Kim, musisz zrobić to całe przeładowanie, potwór wciąż żyje”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001160B.belarusian: "Кім, давай перазараджай штуковіну, сука дагэтуль жывая".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011617.english: "Oh my god, why did I just try to shoot a kid?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011617.polish: „Mój boże, czemu ja właśnie próbowałem zastrzelić dziecko?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011617.belarusian: "Божачкі, чаму я толькі што спрабаваў застрэліць дзіця?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011625.english: My liege, it may be possible to *spin* this as some sort of, uhm... pedagogical exercise.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011625.polish: Miłościwy panie, może uda się *wymyślić historyjkę*, zrobić z tego jakieś... ćwiczenie o charakterze pedagogicznym.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011625.belarusian: Ягамосць, верагодна, гэта атрымаецца *разгарнуць*, як штосьці накшталт... педагагічнага практыкавання.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011634.english: But I wasn't trying to teach her a lesson. I was trying to *kill* her.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011634.polish: Ale ja nie próbowałem dać jej nauczki. Ja ją próbowałem *zabić*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011634.belarusian: Але я не спрабаваў яе правучыць. Я спрабаваў яе *забіць*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011642.english: Well, then maybe you shouldn't have missed. This is merely a suggestion. If you want to be a *failed* child murderer, go with that.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011642.polish: W takim razie może należało nie pudłować. To li tylko rada. Jeśli chcesz, miłościwy panie, być *niedoszłym* zabójcą dziecka, to wszystko w porządku.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011642.belarusian: У такім выпадку, варта было трапіць. Гэта ўсяго толькі парада. Калі васпан хоча быць *няўдалым* забойцам дзяцей, то ўсё ў парадку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011649.english: Yes, of course -- attempted child murder, that's not *me*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011649.polish: Tak, oczywiście. Próba zabicia dziecka – to do mnie *niepodobne*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011649.belarusian: Так, вядома. Спроба забойства дзіцяці — гэта не пра *мяне*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011650.polish: Ani odrobinę! O nie, nie, nie!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011650.belarusian: Зусім не пра цябе! О, не, не, не!

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001166F.english: "I was merely teaching her a lesson, of course."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001166F.polish: „Chciałem jej tylko udzielić lekcji, rzecz jasna”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001167E.english: "And what kind of lesson is that?" Just like that the gun has left your hand. The lieutenant holsters it.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001167E.polish: „I jaka to lekcja?” – pyta. Broń nagle znika z twojej ręki. Porucznik chowa ją do kabury.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001167E.belarusian: "І што гэта за навука такая?". Зброя раптам знікае з тваёй рукі. Лейтэнант хавае яе ў кабуру.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011684.english: You sense nylon moving somewhere to your left. There's motion in your peripherals, then it's already too late...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011684.polish: Wyczuwasz ruch nylonu gdzieś po swojej lewej. Rejestrujesz ruch na skraju pola widzenia, a potem jest już za późno...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011684.belarusian: Ты адчуваеш варушэнне нейлону дзесьці злева. Перыферыйны зрок заўважае нейкі рух, але ўжо занадта позна...

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001168C.english: "That he's a fucking f****t who misses."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001168C.polish: „Że jest pieprzonym p***łem, co nie umie w nic trafić”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001168C.belarusian: "Што ён блядзкі п***р, які не ўмее страляць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011693.english: "I think you're underestimating the gravity of this situation, officer. We need to take a breather from this scene." He points at you. "Now."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011693.polish: „Zdaje się, że nie pojmujesz w pełni powagi tej sytuacji, oficerze. Musimy odetchnąć gdzieś z dala od miejsca zbrodni” – stwierdza, wskazując na ciebie. „Teraz”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011693.belarusian: "Здаецца, вы не цалкам разумееце сур'ёзнасць сітуацыі, афіцэру. Нам трэба адпачыць недзе падалей ад месца злачынства, — ён паказвае на цябе пальцам. — Зараз жа".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011699.english: "What are you Kim, a martial artist? Where'd the gun go?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011699.polish: „A ty co, Kim? Mistrz sztuk walki? Gdzie się podziała broń?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400011699.belarusian: "Кім, ты што, майстар баявых мастацтваў? Куды знікла зброя?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001169F.english: "Yeah, a lesson about respecting the law."
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001169F.belarusian: "Так, гэта была навука аб павазе да закону".

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000116AB.english: "It was merely a jest. A light-hearted jab!"

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000116B2.polish: „To w tej chwili nie jest ważne”.

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000116CF.english: "Can't the boys from Processing take care of this?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000116CF.polish: „Nie mogą się tym zająć chłopaki z kostnicy?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000116CF.belarusian: "Хіба гэтым не могуць заняцца хлопцы з морга?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000116DB.english: What was that about *Processing*, then -- weren't they supposed to take care of the *boots*? Why don't they help?
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000116DB.polish: A co z tym całym *koronerem*? Nie miał się zająć *butami*? Czemu z tym nie pomoże?
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000116DB.belarusian: А што наконт *судмедэксперта*? Хіба гэта не яго справа *ботамі* займацца? Чаму б яму нам не дапамагчы?
