Dialogue Text/0x0100007200000701.belarusian: "Не ўпэўнены наконт гэтага..." — Ён здымае акуляры, каб працерці іх. — "Былі іншыя часы. Іншая вайна".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200000715.english: "We should board that old spooker up, Andre." A voice from the back of the church. "It'll only disturb the people while they're trying to dance, unshackled by the failure of humanism."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200000715.polish: „Powinniśmy zabić deskami to stare straszydło, Andre” – odzywa się głos na tyłach kościoła. „Będzie tylko przeszkadzało ludziom próbującym tańczyć, wyzwolonym z okowów przez porażkę humanizmu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200000715.belarusian: "Трэба забіць гэтае старое пудзіла дошкамі, Андрэ", — чуецца голас з глыбіні царквы. — "Яно толькі замінацьме людзям, пакуль тыя танчаць, скінуўшы кайданы праваленага гуманізму".

Dialogue Text/0x010000720000071C.english: "How about we *don't* do that, Noid?" Another voice. "She looks cool."
Dialogue Text/0x010000720000071C.polish: „Co ty na to, żebyśmy tego *nie* robili, Noik?” – pyta kolejny głos. „Ona wygląda fajnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000720000071C.belarusian: "А як наконт таго, каб мы гэтага *не* рабілі, Ноік?" — яшчэ адзін голас. — "Яна крута выглядае".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E30.english: "Okey-doe-doe," he whispers in the silence of the great building.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E30.polish: „W porząsiu” – szepcze wśród ciszy zalegającej wnętrze wspaniałej budowli.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E30.belarusian: "Окі-до-до", — шэпча ён у цішыні велічнага будынка.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E3D.english: A touch of absurdity there, nice!

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E49.english: A very, very skilled thespian would detect a touch of drama when he says he doesn't know why it was conducted...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E49.polish: Bardzo, bardzo uzdolniony aktor wychwyciłby nutę dramatyzmu w jego słowach o tym, że nie wie, czemu do tego doszło...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E49.belarusian: Вельмі, вельмі таленавіты камедыянт улавіў бы нотку драмы, калі ён кажа, што не ведае, чаму яе ладзілі...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E5B.english: "I assure you, I'm not." He looks up at the stained glass window.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E5B.polish: „Zapewniam cię, że nie” – odpowiada i spogląda w górę na okno.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E5B.belarusian: "Упэўніваю вас, не". — Ён глядзіць угору на вітражнае акно.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E87.english: Something during the raid the lieutenant mentioned? Or just hooligans looking for something to break.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E87.polish: Coś podczas nalotu, o którym wspominał porucznik? A może po prostu chuligani pragnący coś zniszczyć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E87.belarusian: Нешта падчас рэйду, пра які згадваў лейтэнант? Альбо проста хуліганы, якім хацелася нешта разбіць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E95.english: Your heart knows. But it does not want to say, not yet. Let these things be unknown for now.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E95.polish: Twoje serce wie. Ale nie chce tego jeszcze powiedzieć. Niech pozostanie to na razie niewiadomą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200002E95.belarusian: Тваё сэрца ведае. Але не хоча казаць — пакуль не. Няхай усё гэта пакуль застаецца невядомым.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DDD.english: Looks like I can't give this figurine to her.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DDD.polish: Zdaje się, że nie mogę jej dać tej figurki.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DDD.belarusian: Здаецца, я не магу аддаць ёй гэтую фігурку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DEA.english: Because she's a stained glass window.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DF0.english: That does seem to be a problem... maybe you meant something else?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DF0.polish: To faktycznie może być problem... Może miałeś na myśli coś innego?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DF0.belarusian: Гэта і праўда можа быць праблемай... Можа, ты меў на ўвазе нешта іншае?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DF8.english: Like what? Is the task still on?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DF8.polish: Na przykład co? To zadanie jest wciąż aktualne?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DF8.belarusian: Напрыклад, што? Заданне яшчэ ў сіле?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DFE.english: I don't know. What are we thinking of? Part of your mind has gone on to other things already...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DFE.polish: Nie wiem. O czym my myślimy? Część twojego umysłu zajmuje się już innymi sprawami...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DFE.belarusian: Не ведаю. Пра што мы думаем? Частка твайго розуму ўжо пераключылася на іншыя рэчы...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003E04.english: Only a strange little sadness remains.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A853.english: Your fingertips touch your chest four times as you stand in the apricot-coloured light of the window. Above you, the woman still smiles her distant smile, sundered by the crack in the glass.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A853.polish: Czubkami palców dotykasz czterokrotnie piersi, stojąc w morelowo zabarwionej smudze światła padającej z okna. Kobieta uśmiecha się wciąż nad tobą tym nieobecnym uśmiechem, rozdarta na dwoje pęknięciem w szybie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A853.belarusian: Кончыкі тваіх пальцаў чатыры разы кранаюцца грудзей, пакуль ты стаіш у абрыкосавым святле акна. Над табой жанчына ўсё так жа ўсміхаецца сваёй далёкай усмешкай, рассечанай расколінай у шкле.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A892.english: As that soft word passes through your mind, you rise -- into the apricot-coloured light of the window. The woman keeps smiling her distant smile, sundered by the crack in the glass.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A892.polish: Kiedy głowie pojawia ci się to miękkie słowo, wstajesz prosto w morelowo zabarwione światło padające z okna. Kobieta uśmiecha się wciąż tym nieobecnym uśmiechem, rozdarta na dwoje pęknięciem w szybie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A892.belarusian: Калі гэтае лагоднае слова праносіцца ў тваёй галаве, ты падымаешся — у абрыкосавае святло акна. Жанчына працягвае ўсміхацца сваёй далёкай усмешкай, рассечанай расколінай у шкле.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A8A3.english: As that lonely word passes through your mind, you rise -- into the apricot-coloured light of the window. The woman keeps smiling her distant smile above you, sundered by the crack in the glass.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A8A3.polish: Kiedy głowie pojawia ci się to samotne słowo, wstajesz prosto w morelowo zabarwione światło padające z okna. Kobieta uśmiecha się wciąż nad tobą tym nieobecnym uśmiechem, rozdarta na dwoje pęknięciem w szybie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A8A3.belarusian: Калі гэтае самотнае слова праносіцца ў тваёй галаве, ты падымаешся — у абрыкосавае святло акна. Жанчына над табой працягвае ўсміхацца сваёй далёкай усмешкай, рассечанай расколінай у шкле.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A8B3.english: With that terrible word ringing through your mind, you rise -- into the apricot coloured-light of the window. The woman keeps smiling her distant smile above you, sundered by the crack in the glass.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A8B3.polish: Mając w głowie to straszne słowo, wstajesz prosto w morelowo zabarwione światło padające z okna. Kobieta uśmiecha się wciąż nad tobą tym nieobecnym uśmiechem, rozdarta na dwoje pęknięciem w szybie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A8B3.belarusian: З гэтым жахлівым словам, што аддаецца рэхам у галаве, ты падымаешся — у абрыкосавае святло акна. Жанчына над табой працягвае ўсміхацца сваёй далёкай усмешкай, рассечанай расколінай у шкле.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A8C3.english: As that great and desperate thought passes through your mind you rise. From your knees and into the apricot-coloured light of the window. Above you, the woman keeps smiling her distant smile, sundered by the crack in the glass.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A8C3.polish: Kiedy głowie pojawia ci się ta wielka i desperacka myśl, wstajesz z kolan prosto w morelowo zabarwione światło padające z okna. Kobieta uśmiecha się wciąż nad tobą tym nieobecnym uśmiechem, rozdarta na dwoje pęknięciem w szybie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000A8C3.belarusian: Калі гэтая вялікая і адчайная думка праносіцца ў тваёй галаве, ты падымаешся. З каленяў і проста ў абрыкосавае святло акна. Над табой жанчына працягвае ўсміхацца сваёй далёкай усмешкай, рассечанай расколінай у шкле.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A6B.english: "We should be respectful here, although the building appears to be deserted. I do not believe we'll find anything connected to the lynching here. Something else, perhaps..." He looks at the machinery lying around.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A6B.polish: „Powinniśmy zachowywać się tu z szacunkiem, nawet jeśli wszystko wskazuje na to, że świątynia została opuszczona. Nie sądzę, abyśmy znaleźli tu cokolwiek związanego z linczem. Coś innego? Być może...” – stwierdza, rzucając okiem na rozstawione wokół urządzenia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A6B.belarusian: "Нам варта праявіць павагу, хоць будынак і выглядае закінутым. Не думаю, што мы знойдзем тут нешта звязанае з самасудам. Хіба што нешта іншае..." — Ён глядзіць на раскіданае вакол абсталяванне.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A7B.english: She was crowned two years after the first expedition returned, setting in motion what is widely considered the greatest era in history -- the Dolorian Era.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A7B.polish: Została ukoronowana dwa lata po powrocie pierwszej ekspedycji. Rozpoczął się wtedy czas uważany powszechnie za najwspanialszy w historii: epoka doloriańska.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A7B.belarusian: Яе каранавалі праз два гады пасля вяртання першай экспедыцыі, паклаўшы пачатак таму, што паўсюдна лічыцца найвелічнейшай эпохай у гісторыі — Даларыянскай эпосе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A84.english: Bystanders reported golden filaments lighting the already sunlit chamber around her, clearly visible beneath her dress.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A84.polish: Postronni świadkowie twierdzili, że w i tak rozświetlonej słońcem komnacie widoczne były pojawiające się pod jej suknią złote nici.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A84.belarusian: Відавочцы паведамлялі пра залатыя ніці, якія асвятлялі і без таго заліты сонцам пакой вакол яе і былі выразна бачныя пад сукенкай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A8C.english: Bystanders reported golden filaments lighting the already sunlit chamber around her, clearly visible beneath her dress. I repeat: *Her lungs started glowing*. Do you care now?
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A8C.polish: Postronni świadkowie twierdzili, że w i tak rozświetlonej słońcem komnacie widoczne były pojawiające się pod jej suknią złote promienie. Powtarzam: *zaczęły jej świecić płuca*. Jesteś już zainteresowany?
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A8C.belarusian: Відавочцы паведамлялі пра залатыя ніці, якія асвятлялі і без таго заліты сонцам пакой вакол яе і былі выразна бачныя пад сукенкай. Паўтараю: *Яе лёгкія пачалі свяціцца*. Цяпер табе не ўсё роўна?

Dialogue Text/0x010000210000044B.english: "Tiago said the place was abandoned because of a police raid. Do you know anything about it?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000044B.polish: „Tiago mówił, że to miejsce jest opuszczone ze względu na policyjny nalot. Wiesz coś o tym?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000044B.belarusian: "Цьяга казаў, што гэтае месца закінулі праз паліцэйскі рэйд. Ты ведаеш што-небудзь пра гэта?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000451.english: "I do." There's a pause, then he continues: "I heard it was a particularly bad one. The place was shot to pieces."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000451.polish: „Wiem”. Zapada chwila ciszy, po czym porucznik kontynuuje: „Słyszałem, że to była wyjątkowo nieciekawa sprawa. Wywiązała się wielka strzelanina”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000451.belarusian: "Ведаю". — Паўза, пасля чаго ён працягвае: — "Я чуў, усё было вельмі брудна. Будынак расстралялі ўшчэнт".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000458.english: "If this man was really here when it happened, then it's better for all of us that he doesn't remember what happened."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000458.polish: „Jeśli ten mężczyzna rzeczywiście tu wtedy był, to lepiej dla nas wszystkich, że nie pamięta, co się tu wydarzyło”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000458.belarusian: "Калі гэты чалавек сапраўды быў тут, калі ўсё здарылася, то для нас усіх лепей, што ён не памятае тых падзей".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E3D4.english: A motor carriage? A gunshot? Someone falling into it? Or maybe just hooligans looking for something to break.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E3D4.polish: Powóz motorowy? Strzał z broni? Ktoś na nie wpadł? A może po prostu chuligani chcieli coś zniszczyć?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E3D4.belarusian: Маторная карэта? Стрэл? Нехта наляцеў на яго? Ці, можа, проста хуліганы, якім хацелася нешта разбіць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD1C.english: It's awfully silent again, as if someone turned off the entire world outside those walls. Water inside the bowls stands still.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD1C.polish: Znów zapada niesamowita cisza, jakby ktoś wyłączył istniejący za ścianami kościoła świat. Woda w misach pozostaje nieruchoma.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD1C.belarusian: Зноў страшэнна ціха, нібы нехта выключыў увесь свет за гэтымі сценамі. Вада ў місах стаіць нерухома.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD26.english: Move the fourth bowl from the left five centimetres to the right.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD26.polish: Przesuń czwartą misę od lewej pięć centymetrów w prawo.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD26.belarusian: Пасунуць чацвёртую місу злева на пяць сантыметраў управа.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD34.english: Move the third bowl from the left two centimetres away.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD34.polish: Przesuń trzecią misę od lewej dwa centymetry od siebie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD34.belarusian: Пасунуць трэцюю місу злева на два сантыметры ад сябе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD3A.english: It moves like a ghost without creating a single trace of sound.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD3A.polish: Przesuwa się niczym duch, nie wydając ani śladu dźwięku.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD3A.belarusian: Яна ссоўваецца, нібы прывід, не выдаючы ані следу гуку.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD40.english: Some water spills out of the bowl, wetting the floor.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD40.polish: Z misy wylewa się na podłogę nieco wody.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD40.belarusian: Трохі вады выплюхваецца з місы, змочваючы падлогу.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD62.english: Oh boy, this is going to be good.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD72.english: The lead programmer sends you an encouraging thumbs up from across the hall.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD72.polish: Główna programistka zachęcającym gestem pokazuje ci z drugiego końca pomieszczenia wyciągnięte w górę kciuki.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD72.belarusian: Галоўная праграмістка з іншага канца залы падбадзёрліва паказвае табе падняты ўверх вялікі палец.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD7A.english: This task is an insult to your mental skills.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD7A.polish: To zadanie jest niczym obelga dla twojego intelektu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CD7A.belarusian: Гэтае заданне — проста абраза для тваіх разумовых здольнасцяў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CFAC.english: Measurements have been marked down around the bowls, each chalk-drawn line representing a centimetre on the floor.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CFAC.polish: Wokół mis narysowana została podziałka. Każda narysowana kredą na podłodze kreska odpowiada jednemu centymetrowi.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001CFAC.belarusian: Вакол місаў нанесеныя адзнакі — кожная накрэсленая крэйдай рыска на падлозе адпавядае аднаму сантыметру.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000028A7.english: Time to run back! Or maybe walk, this *is* a sacred place after all...
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000028A7.polish: Czas biec z powrotem! Albo może iść, to w końcu *uświęcone* miejsce...
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000028A7.belarusian: Час бегчы назад! Ці мо ісці, гэта ўсё ж такі *святое* месца...

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002C25.english: *And* your leg still hurts from the tribunal.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002C25.polish: No i noga ciągle boli cię po trybunale.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002C25.belarusian: *Дый* нага ўсё яшчэ баліць пасля трыбунала.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB2C.english: The silence in this part of the church -- it's almost palpable. All the shifting matter and shuffling of living things is gone. Nothing seems to exist beyond the church anymore.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB2C.polish: Cisza w tej części kościoła jest niemal namacalna. Wszelka poruszająca się materia i pełzające istoty żywe są tu nieobecne. Oprócz samego budynku nic zdaje się nie istnieć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB2C.belarusian: Цішыня ў гэтай частцы царквы — амаль адчувальная. Увесь рух матэрыі і шоргат жывых істот зніклі. Здаецца, па-за межамі царквы больш нічога не існуе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB33.english: Wait, I think I still hear something...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB33.polish: Zaraz, chyba mimo to coś jeszcze słyszę...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB33.belarusian: Пачакай, здаецца, я ўсё яшчэ нешта чую...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB3A.english: And then it's gone. Almost all of it -- but for the faintest of hums.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB3A.polish: A potem i to coś znika. Niemal wszystko poza najcichszym z szumów.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB3A.belarusian: А потым і гэта знікае. Амаль усё — акрамя найцішэйшага гудзення.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB47.english: Yell as loud as you can.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB47.polish: Krzyknij tak głośno, jak tylko możesz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB47.belarusian: Крыкні так гучна, як толькі можаш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB51.english: Look up into the bell tower.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB51.polish: Spójrz w górę, do wnętrza dzwonnicy.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB5C.english: The orderly rows of ceiling panels become barely visible, then disappear completely in the darkness of the tower overhead.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB5C.polish: Zwarte szeregi paneli sufitowych zacierają się, a potem całkowicie znikają w mroku wieży nad twoją głową.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB5C.belarusian: Стройныя шэрагі столевых панэляў робяцца ледзь прыкметнымі, а потым і зусім знікаюць у цемры вежы над галавой.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB72.english: It's like there's something moving up there -- a shadow has emerged from the tower and is making its way *toward* you through all the other shadows.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB72.polish: Jakby coś się tam ruszało, z wieży wyłonił się cień, który przenika wszystkie inne, zmierzając *ku tobie*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB72.belarusian: Здаецца, там наверсе нешта рухаецца — з вежы вынырнуў цень і прабіраецца скрозь іншыя цені *да цябе*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB77.english: Try to see beyond the shadows.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB7C.english: Just darkness without end -- it makes your head spin.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB7C.polish: Jest tam tylko niekończący się mrok. Aż ci się kręci w głowie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB7C.belarusian: Проста бясконцая цемра — ад яе кружыцца галава.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB97.english: You see something hanging from the rafters, looking straight at you with dark eyes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB97.polish: Widzisz coś zwisającego z krokwi, patrzącego na ciebie ciemnymi oczami.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB97.belarusian: Ты бачыш, як нешта вісіць на кроквах і глядзіць проста на цябе цёмнымі вачыма.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB9E.english: It's not a shadow anymore -- becoming more substantial as it gets closer. The shape of an *animal* descends.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB9E.polish: To już nie jest cień. W miarę jak się zbliża, staje się coraz bardziej materialny. Zniża się ku tobie *zwierzęcy* kształt.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CB9E.belarusian: Гэта больш не цень — ён робіцца ўсё больш матэрыяльным па меры набліжэння. Уніз спускаецца сілуэт *жывёлы*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBA5.english: Oh no! You've lost sight of it. Where did it go?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBA5.polish: O nie! Straciłeś go z oczu. Gdzie się podział?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBA5.belarusian: О не! Ты згубіў яго з віду. Куды яно дзелася?

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBB6.english: The lieutenant points to his ears and shakes his head. Then he leans closer.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBB6.polish: Porucznik wskazuje swoje uszy i kręci głową, po czym podchodzi do ciebie bliżej.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBB6.belarusian: Лейтэнант паказвае на свае вушы і круціць галавой. Потым нахіляецца бліжэй.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBBD.english: Your voice is barely audible -- not a howl, but the softest of whimpers.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBBD.polish: Twój głos jest ledwie słyszalny. Zamiast wyciem jest cichutkim jękiem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBBD.belarusian: Твой голас ледзь чутны — не выццё, а найцішэйшае хныканне.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBC9.english: Stomp your feet and clap your hands.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBC9.belarusian: Тупні нагамі і плясні ў ладкі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBD0.english: You produce a few muffled thumps, after which the silence feels even more... *total* somehow.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBD0.polish: Udaje ci się wydać kilka stłumionych stuknięć, po których cisza wydaje się z jakiegoś powodu jeszcze bardziej... *absolutna*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBD0.belarusian: Ты выдаеш некалькі глухіх удараў, пасля якіх цішыня здаецца чамусьці яшчэ больш... *абсалютнай*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBDF.english: "Almost nothing, and it's beginning to worry me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBDF.polish: „Prawie nic i zaczyna mnie to martwić”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBDF.belarusian: "Амаль нічога, і гэта пачынае мяне турбаваць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBE6.english: "The church just has... strange acoustics -- some engineering trick."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBE6.polish: „Ten kościół ma... dziwną akustykę – to musi być jakaś architektoniczna sztuczka”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000CBE6.belarusian: "У гэтай царкве проста... дзіўная акустыка — нейкі інжынерны трук".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE43.english: Yes. The darkness makes the ceiling feel infinitely far away...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE43.polish: Tak. Mrok sprawia, że sufit ten wydaje się nieskończenie daleki...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE43.belarusian: Так. З-за цемры столь здаецца бясконца далёкай...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE51.english: Try to make out something -- anything.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE51.belarusian: Паспрабуй разгледзець хоць штосьці — хоць што-небудзь.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE56.english: There's nothing. You're dizzy and disoriented as you see dark and more dark -- rising...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE56.polish: Nie ma nic. Kręci ci się w głowie i czujesz się otumaniony. Widzisz tylko mrok i jeszcze więcej mroku. Gęstniejącego...
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE56.belarusian: Тут нічога няма. У цябе кружыцца галава і ты дэзарыентаваны, бо бачыш толькі цемру і яшчэ больш цемры — якая ўздымаецца...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE70.english: Filled with vague shapes of woodwork. The sense of a great height.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE70.polish: Wypełniony niewyraźnymi kształtami drewnianej konstrukcji. Wrażeniem ogromnej wysokości.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE70.belarusian: Поўная цьмяных абрысаў драўляных канструкцый. Адчуванне велізарнай вышыні.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE79.english: You see something hanging from the rafters, looking straight at you with dark eyes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE79.polish: Widzisz coś zwisającego z krokwi, patrzącego na ciebie ciemnymi oczami.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE79.belarusian: Ты бачыш, як нешта вісіць на кроквах і глядзіць проста на цябе цёмнымі вачыма.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE88.english: What if I don't *want* to know what's up there?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE88.polish: A jeśli *nie chcę* wiedzieć, co jest tam na górze?
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE88.belarusian: А што, калі я *не хачу* ведаць, што там наверсе?

Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE8F.english: The silence, the darkness -- they've enveloped you, as in a cocoon. You cannot move anymore.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE8F.polish: Cisza i mrok otoczyły cię niczym kokon. Nie jesteś się już w stanie ruszyć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005A0000DE8F.belarusian: Цішыня, цемра — яны ахінулі цябе, як у кокане. Ты больш не можаш варухнуцца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8C4.english: "Not really, but it's extraordinary. I've never experienced anything like this."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8C4.polish: „Nie bardzo, ale to niezwykłe. Nigdy czegoś podobnego nie doświadczyłem”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8C4.belarusian: "Не зусім, але гэта неверагодна. Я ніколі нічога падобнага не адчуваў".

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8CB.english: "I wonder why the... church was built with such strange acoustics..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8CB.polish: „Zastanawiam się, dlaczego... wzniesiono kościół z tak dziwną akustyką...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8CB.belarusian: "Цікава, чаму... царкву збудавалі з такой дзіўнай акустыкай..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8D2.english: His detached tone conceals how uncomfortable he is.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8D2.polish: Obojętnością w głosie ukrywa swój niepokój.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8D2.belarusian: Ягоны абыякавы тон хавае тое, наколькі яму няўтульна.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8DC.english: Maybe the church was designed in this way to prevent boisterous activity -- singing and dancing -- on its premises?
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8DC.polish: Być może kościół zaprojektowano w ten sposób, aby zapobiec hałaśliwym rozrywkom na jego terenie, jak śpiew czy taniec?
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8DC.belarusian: Можа, царкву так спраектавалі, каб прадухіліць шумныя дзеянні — спевы і танцы — у яе сценах?

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8E6.english: "Maybe they wanted to discourage singing and dancing."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8E6.polish: „Może chcieli utrudnić tu ludziom śpiew i taniec?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F8E6.belarusian: "Можа, яны хацелі перашкодзіць спевам і танцам".

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F90C.english: "Whatever it is, it's definitely real. Something odd is happening around us."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F90C.polish: „Cokolwiek to jest, ewidentnie naprawdę ma miejsce. Dzieje się wokół nas coś dziwnego”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F90C.belarusian: "Што б гэта ні было, яно сапраўды рэальнае. Вакол нас адбываецца нешта дзіўнае".

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F91A.polish: „Proszę, detektywie, nie zaczynaj z tym znowu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F91A.belarusian: "Калі ласка, дэтэктыве, толькі не зноў гэта".

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F921.english: He's trying to act dismissive, but at this particular moment, he's more open than usual to the idea of paranatural phenomena.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F921.polish: Próbuje zabrzmieć lekceważąco, ale w tym konkretnym momencie jest bardziej niż zwykle otwarty na pomysł występowania tu zjawisk paranormalnych.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F921.belarusian: Ён спрабуе выглядаць грэбліва, але ў гэты канкрэтны момант ён больш, чым звычайна, адкрыты да ідэі паранатуральных з'яў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F934.english: Maybe if you were to stand in just the right spot, even your footsteps would be completely silent...
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F934.polish: Może gdybyś stanął w odpowiednim miejscu, nawet twoje kroki nie wydawałyby żadnego odgłosu...?
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F934.belarusian: Можа, калі стаць у патрэбным месцы, нават твае крокі стануць цалкам бясшумнымі...

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F93C.english: It seems that sound here is detached from its source somehow, if not blotted out outright. Truly unusual.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F93C.polish: Zdaje się, że dźwięk jest tu jakoś oddzielany od źródła, o ile nie tłumiony od razu po jego wydaniu. Bardzo to nietypowe.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F93C.belarusian: Здаецца, гук тут неяк аддзяляецца ад сваёй крыніцы, калі не глушыцца на пні. Сапраўды незвычайна.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F9A8.english: How do I know what the pale sounds like?
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F9A8.polish: Skąd ja wiem, jak brzmi szarota?
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F9A8.belarusian: Адкуль я ведаю, як гучыць Цьмянасць?

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F9B4.polish: Nie. Daj mi po prostu słuchać.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F9C9.english: From recordings. Of the far pale. You've heard them. We all have.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F9C9.polish: Z nagrań. Odległej szaroty. Słyszałeś je. Jak my wszyscy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F9C9.belarusian: З запісаў. Далёкай Цьмянасці. Ты іх чуў. Усе мы чулі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F9E6.english: You can hardly hear your own breathing.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F9FC.english: You know, in the middle of the last century, there was a group of Revacholian painters who famously disdained the use of black.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F9FC.polish: Wiesz, w połowie zeszłego stulecia w działała grupa revacholskich malarzy, której członkowie słynęli ze swojej pogardy do korzystania z koloru czarnego.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000F9FC.belarusian: Ведаеш, у сярэдзіне мінулага стагоддзя была група рэвашольскіх мастакоў, якія славіліся сваёй пагардай да выкарыстання чорнага колеру.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA13.english: What did they have against black?
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA13.belarusian: А што яны мелі супраць чорнага?

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA2C.english: Can I use this to see through the darkness up there, somehow? (Proceed.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA2C.polish: Mogę wykorzystać tę wiedzę, żeby jakoś przebić się przez ten mrok na górze? (Przejdź dalej).
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA2C.belarusian: Ці магу я нейкім чынам скарыстаць гэта, каб бачыць скрозь цемру там наверсе? (Працягнуць.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA33.english: No, this is just an intellectual musing. In fact, it's probably dangerous to waste time like this. You should stop.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA33.polish: Nie, to tylko takie rozmyślania. Prawdę mówiąc, takie marnowanie czasu jest zapewne niebezpieczne. Powinieneś przestać.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA33.belarusian: Не, гэта проста інтэлектуальныя развагі. Насамрэч, марнаваць так час, напэўна, небяспечна. Табе варта спыніцца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA3F.english: Revachol was an overwhelmingly colourful place back then. They made most of the world's dyes here.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA3F.polish: Revachol był wtedy niesamowicie kolorowym miejscem. Powstawała tu większość znanych na świecie barwników.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA3F.belarusian: Рэвашоль тады быў надзвычай маляўнічым месцам. Тут выраблялі большую частку фарбавальнікаў у свеце.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA45.english: They wanted to capture what it really felt like to look at the world -- to be *inside* colour, to be blinded by early afternoon light glittering on the crests of sea waves.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA45.polish: Chcieli ująć to, jakie wrażenia naprawdę towarzyszą oglądaniu świata. Jak to jest być *wewnątrz* koloru, być oślepionym przez światło popołudnia odbijające się od piany morskich fal.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA45.belarusian: Яны хацелі перадаць, як гэта насамрэч — глядзець на свет. Быць *унутры* колеру, быць аслепленым раннім папаўдзённым святлом, што блішчыць на грабянях марскіх хваляў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA57.english: Such an effect is best achieved by using the juxtaposition of complementary colours -- rather than the addition of black -- to create contrast.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA57.polish: Taki efekt najlepiej osiąga się poprzez zestawianie komplementarnych kolorów w celu stworzenia kontrastu raczej niż dodawanie czerni.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA57.belarusian: Такі эфект найлепш дасягаецца супрацьпастаўленнем дадатковых колераў — а не дадаваннем чорнага — дзеля стварэння кантрасту.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA65.english: Hmm, maybe I should take up painting.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA65.belarusian: Гм, можа, мне варта заняцца жывапісам.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA6B.english: Seems unfair to black. I like black, look at it!
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA6B.polish: To brzmi niesprawiedliwie dla czerni. Lubię czerń. Patrz na nią!
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA6B.belarusian: Гэта несправядліва да чорнага. Мне падабаецца чорны, паглядзі на яго!

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA80.english: It's unclear if you have enough years left in you to make up for your lack of technique...
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA80.polish: Nie wiadomo tylko, czy zostało ci dosyć życia, żeby nadrobić braki w technice...
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA80.belarusian: Невядома, ці засталося ў цябе дастаткова гадоў жыцця, каб кампенсаваць недахоп тэхнікі...

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA88.english: Sometimes an encounter with an opposing aesthetic is required for one to truly grow into one's tastes and preferences.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA88.polish: Czasami trzeba zetknąć się z obcą dla siebie estetyką, aby prawdziwie ukształtować swoje gusta i preferencje.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA88.belarusian: Часам патрабуецца сустрэцца з супрацьлеглай эстэтыкай, каб па-сапраўднаму асэнсаваць уласныя густы і перавагі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA90.english: It would likely be easier to explain with a hands-on demonstration. Alas!
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA90.polish: Łatwiej chyba byłoby zademonstrować niż wyjaśnić. Niestety!
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FA90.belarusian: Напэўна, было б прасцей патлумачыць на наглядным прыкладзе. На жаль!

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FABA.english: "Officer, is there something up there?" The lieutenant follows your gaze, attempting to see whatever it is that you are seeing.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FABA.polish: „Oficerze, czy tam na górze coś jest?” – pyta porucznik i podąża za twoim wzrokiem, próbując dostrzec to, co przykuło twoją uwagę.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FABA.belarusian: "Афіцэру, там наверсе нешта ёсць?" — Лейтэнант сочыць за тваім позіркам, спрабуючы разгледзець тое, што бачыш ты.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006200000027.english: Look up into the bell tower.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006200000027.polish: Spójrz w górę, do wnętrza dzwonnicy.

Dialogue Text/0x010000620000002F.english: "Hmm, maybe. Darkness often has that effect on people."
Dialogue Text/0x010000620000002F.polish: „Hmm... Możliwe. Ciemność często ma taki wpływ na ludzi”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000620000002F.belarusian: "Гм, магчыма. Цемра часта так уплывае на людзей".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500000205.english: Maybe it's possible to... talk to it?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500000205.polish: Może dałoby się z tym... porozmawiać?

Dialogue Text/0x010000050000020D.english: "Officer, what are you looking at?" He follows your gaze, attempting to see whatever it is that you are seeing.
Dialogue Text/0x010000050000020D.polish: „Oficerze, czemu się przyglądasz?” – pyta porucznik i podąża za twoim wzrokiem, próbując dostrzec to, co przykuło twoją uwagę.
Dialogue Text/0x010000050000020D.belarusian: "Афіцэру, на што вы глядзіце?" — Ён сочыць за тваім позіркам, спрабуючы разгледзець тое, што бачыш ты.

Dialogue Text/0x010000050000022A.english: It's like you see your own face reflected back at you in the vanishing geometry -- a strange, alien image that's supposed to be you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000050000022A.polish: To jak widzieć swoją własną twarz odbijającą się w wykrzywionym zwierciadle. Dziwną, obcą aparycję, która rzekomo jest tobą.
Dialogue Text/0x010000050000022A.belarusian: Здаецца, нібы ты бачыш уласнае аблічча, што глядзіць на цябе са знікаючай геаметрыі — дзіўны, чужы вобраз, які нібыта мусіць быць табой.

Dialogue Text/0x01000005000016D2.english: Maybe it's possible to... talk to it?
Dialogue Text/0x01000005000016D2.polish: Może dałoby się z tym... porozmawiać?

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000004F1.polish: „To pewnie nic takiego, tylko nasza wyobraźnia”.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000004FA.english: The lieutenant doesn't reply, but you can sense him tense up next to you.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000004FA.polish: Porucznik nie odpowiada, ale czujesz, że robi się spięty.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000004FA.belarusian: Лейтэнант не адказвае, але ты адчуваеш, як ён напружваецца побач з табой.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000507.english: He doesn't seem entirely convinced, though.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000507.polish: Nie wydaje się jednak do końca przekonany.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000507.belarusian: Аднак ён не выглядае цалкам перакананым.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E3EE.english: But to what? There is almost nothing.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E3EE.polish: Ale czego? Prawie nic nie słychać.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E3EE.belarusian: Але чаго? Тут амаль нічога няма.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E414.english: It's *climbing*. Climbing down, holding on the beams.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001E414.belarusian: Яно *паўзе*. Спускаецца ўніз, трымаючыся за бэлькі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D53.english: Hey! Her Innocence Dolores Dei liked little figurines, right? Liked holding little men between her fingers, remember?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D53.polish: Ejże! Jej niewinność Dolores Dei lubiła małe figurki, prawda? Lubiła trzymać między palcami małych ludzi, pamiętasz?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D53.belarusian: Гэй! Яе Праведнасць Далорэс Дэй любіла маленькія фігуркі, так? Любіла трымаць маленькіх чалавечкаў паміж пальцамі, памятаеш?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D66.english: No, I don't remember anything, I don't want to think about this. Good bye. [Discard thought.]
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D66.polish: Nie, nic nie pamiętam, nie chcę o tym myśleć. Do widzenia. [Odrzuć myśl].
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D66.belarusian: Не, я нічога не памятаю, я не хачу пра гэта думаць. Бывай. [Адкінуць думку.]

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D79.english: You have the Headless FALN Rider figurine. You should give it to her. Win her back!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D79.polish: Masz figurkę bezgłowego jeźdźca FALN. Powinieneś jej go dać. Odzyskać jej względy!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D79.belarusian: У цябе ёсць фігурка безгаловага вершніка FALN. Ты мусіш аддаць яе ёй. Вярні яе!

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D87.english: You have the revolutionary soldier figurine. You should give it to her. Win her back!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D87.polish: Masz figurkę żołnierza rewolucjonisty. Powinieneś jej go dać. Odzyskać jej względy!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D87.belarusian: У цябе ёсць фігурка рэвалюцыйнага жаўнера. Ты мусіш аддаць яе ёй. Вярні яе!

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D91.english: No... it would have been *beautiful*. Really tiny. Thoughtful. Clever!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D91.polish: Nie... To by było *piękne*. Maleńkie. Przemyślane. Sprytne!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D91.belarusian: Не... гэта было б *прыгожа*. Зусім маленечка. Прадумана. Разумна!

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D97.english: Whatever this was, it feels like you made the right choice not to peek into it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D97.polish: Cokolwiek to było, zdaje się, że podjąłeś słuszną decyzję, nie zaglądając tam.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003D97.belarusian: Што б гэта ні было, здаецца, ты зрабіў правільны выбар, што не стаў зазіраць туды.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DA7.english: What? (Look around.) Win who back? I can't win her back, she's a long dead historical figure.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DA7.polish: Co? (Rozejrzyj się). Ale czyje względy? Nie mogę odzyskać jej względów, to od dawna nieżyjąca postać historyczna.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DA7.belarusian: "Што?" (Азірнуцца.) "Каго вярнуць? Я не магу яе вярнуць, яна даўно памерлая гістарычная постаць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DAD.english: I should yes. This is a TASK of mine now.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DAD.polish: Tak, powinienem. To teraz moje ZADANIE.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DAD.belarusian: Так, варта. Цяпер гэта мая ЗАДАЧА.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DBA.english: Don't be so pessimistic. Love doesn't die that easily!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DBA.polish: Nie bądź takim pesymistą. Miłość tak łatwo nie umiera!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DBA.belarusian: Не будзь такім песімістам. Каханне не памірае так проста!

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DC1.english: This isn't funny... you have a bad feeling about this one.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DC1.polish: To nie jest śmieszne... Masz co do tego złe przeczucia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DC1.belarusian: Гэта не смешна... У цябе дрэннае прадчуванне наконт гэтага.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DCC.english: So very, very, *very* nifty... nifty and mysterious. This is surely what the figurines are for!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DCC.polish: Tak bardzo, *bardzo* sprytne... i tajemnicze. Jak nic właśnie po to istnieją figurki!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007200003DCC.belarusian: Так вельмі, вельмі, *вельмі* спрытна... спрытна і таямніча. Вось дзеля чаго сапраўды патрэбныя фігуркі!

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C28.english: They really have an interesting set up here. Like kids preparing for a school science fair. It's pretty neat.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C28.polish: Naprawdę mają tu wszystko ciekawie przygotowane. Jak dzieciaki szykujące się do szkolnego pikniku naukowego. Naprawdę nieźle.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C28.belarusian: Тут сапраўды ўсё цікава ўладкавана. Як дзеці, якія рыхтуюцца да школьнага навуковага кірмашу. Сапраўды нядрэнна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C3A.english: Are we sure about this? Something smells fishy...
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C3A.polish: Jesteśmy co do tego pewni? Jakieś to podejrzane...
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C3A.belarusian: Мы ўпэўнены ў гэтым? Пахне неяк падазрона...

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C46.english: "This? Oh, we're trying to see if we can come up with some cool new special effects to add to the visual aspect of our club experience..." He gestures toward the set-up proudly.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C46.polish: „To? Och, próbujemy wymyślić jakieś nowe fajne efekty specjalne, aby wzbogacić wizualny aspekt naszego klubowego przeżycia...” – wyjaśnia, wskazując z dumą instalację.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C46.belarusian: "Гэта? О, мы спрабуем прыдумаць нейкія новыя класныя спецэфекты, каб аздобіць візуальны бок нашага клубнага досведу..." — ён з гонарам паказвае на ўстаноўку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C4D.english: "We tinker with things. Art, music... chemistry."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C4D.polish: „Majstrujemy z różnymi rzeczami. Sztuką, muzyką... chemią”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C4D.belarusian: "Эксперыментуем з рознымі рэчамі. Мастацтва, музыка... хімія."

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C5F.english: "Some chemicals when mixed can, you know, change colour, or sort of -- blow up..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C5F.polish: „Niektóre chemikalia po zmieszaniu mogą, no wiesz, zmieniać kolor albo tak jakby... wybuchać...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C5F.belarusian: "Некаторыя хімікаты пры змешванні могуць, ну ведаеце, мяняць колер альбо так нібы... выбухаць..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C66.english: "BLOW UP! BLOW UP!" The young man with the large head pumps his fist in the air.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C66.polish: „WYBUCHAĆ! WYBUCHAĆ!” – woła młody mężczyzna z dużą głową, rytmicznie unosząc pięść.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C66.belarusian: "ВЫБУХАЦЬ! ВЫБУХАЦЬ!" — хлопец з вялікай галавой рытмічна ўздымае кулак у паветра.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C6C.english: "Not, like, you know, in a dangerous way," he throws Egg Head an uneasy glance, "or, well, we're not going to do it in a dangerous way."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C6C.polish: „No wiesz, nie w niebezpieczny sposób” – rzuca Jajkogłowcowi zaniepokojone spojrzenie. „Czy raczej my nie będziemy robić tego w niebezpieczny sposób”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C6C.belarusian: "Не тое каб, ну ведаеце, небяспечным чынам, — ён кідае на Яйкагаловага занепакоены погляд, — ці, ну, мы не збіраемся гэта рабіць небяспечным чынам".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C7E.english: "Yes, chemistry has many uses. In police work, too," the lieutenant says, deadpan.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C7E.polish: „Tak, chemia ma wiele zastosowań. Także w pracy policji” – stwierdza porucznik beznamiętnym tonem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C7E.belarusian: "Так, хімія мае шырокі ўжытак. І ў працы паліцыі таксама", — безэмацыйна кажа лейтэнант.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C84.english: The lead programmer turns to look at you for a moment, her gaze impassive, then returns to her work.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C84.polish: Główna programistka odwraca się na chwilę do ciebie, spogląda wzrokiem bez wyrazu, po czym wraca do pracy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C84.belarusian: Галоўная праграмістка на хвіліну паварочваецца да цябе з безвыразным позіркам, а затым вяртаецца да працы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C91.english: "I hope you get to experience one of our light-smell shows sometime, sir," he says with a smile, nodding his blond, spiked head vigorously. "It'll be a blast."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C91.polish: „Mam nadzieję, że doświadczy pan jednego z naszych świetlno-zapachowych pokazów” – oznajmia z uśmiechem, kiwając energicznie swoją głową pokrytą najeżonymi blond włosami. „Będzie wystrzałowo”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008C91.belarusian: "Спадзяюся, калі-небудзь вы пабываеце на адным з нашых светла-водарных шоу, пане, — кажа ён з усмешкай, энергічна ківаючы бялявай калючай галавой. — Будзе бамбічна".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CA8.english: "Feel free to come back later and 'have a blast' with these exemplars of youthful avant-gardism. But we really need to return to the present now."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CA8.polish: „Możesz wrócić tu później i bawić się »wystrzałowo« z tymi wzorcowymi przedstawicielami młodzieżowego awangardyzmu. Teraz naprawdę musimy wracać do teraźniejszości i naszego śledztwa”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CA8.belarusian: "Можаце смела завітаць сюды пазней і 'бамбічна правесці час' з гэтымі ўзорамі моладзевага авангардызму. Але цяпер нам сапраўды трэба вярнуцца да рэчаіснасці".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CAF.english: Nah, that's just the smell of healthy experimentation. And lots of chemicals.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CAF.polish: Nie tam, to tylko zapach zwykłych eksperymentów. I mnóstwa chemikaliów.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CAF.belarusian: Ды не, гэта проста пах здаровых эксперыментаў. І безлічы хімікатаў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CB7.english: The young man looks startled for a moment, but then flashes you his most winsome smile.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CB7.polish: Młody mężczyzna przez chwilę wygląda na przestraszonego, ale szybko rzuca ci swój najbardziej ujmujący uśmiech.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CB7.belarusian: Хлопец на імгненне выглядае спалоханым, але потым адорвае цябе самай абаяльнай усмешкай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CBF.english: "I hope you get to experience one of our light-smell shows sometime, sir," he says, nodding his blond, spiked head vigorously. "It'll be a blast."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CBF.polish: „Mam nadzieję, że doświadczy pan jednego z naszych świetlno-zapachowych pokazów” – oznajmia, kiwając energicznie swoją głową pokrytą najeżonymi blond włosami. „Będzie wystrzałowo”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CBF.belarusian: "Спадзяюся, калі-небудзь вы пабываеце на адным з нашых светла-водарных шоу, пане, — кажа ён, энергічна ківаючы бялявай калючай галавой. — Будзе бамбічна."

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CCD.english: I hope I did stuff like this when I was a kid.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CCD.polish: Mam nadzieję, że za dzieciaka też robiłem takie rzeczy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CCD.belarusian: Спадзяюся, што ў дзяцінстве я таксама рабіў такія рэчы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CD3.english: I'm sure you did. You have an exploratory, creative streak -- just like them.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CD3.polish: Na pewno tak. Masz w sobie twórczą żyłkę odkrywcy. Tak jak oni.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CD3.belarusian: Упэўнены, што так. Ты маеш творчую жылку даследчыка — як і яны.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CE8.english: "I'm not sure I'm buying what you're selling. What kind of effects?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CE8.polish: „Nieszczególnie kupuję tę historyjkę. Co to niby za efekty?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600008CE8.belarusian: "Нешта я не купляюся на гісторыю, што вы тут прадаяце. Што яшчэ за эфекты?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFA2.english: "Why, *officially* I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives. I'm only in Martinaise in an unofficial capacity..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFA2.polish: „Cóż, *oficjalnie* wciąż jestem w La Delta – przygotowuję się do nadchodzącej konferencji o pochodnych oleju napędowego. W Martinaise przebywam nieformalnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFA2.belarusian: "Як дзе, *афіцыйна* я ўсё яшчэ ў Ля Дэльта, рыхтуюся да хуткай канферэнцыі па вытворных мазуту. У Марцінэзе я знаходжуся выключна неафіцыйна..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFA8.english: "Mais que faites-vous, officer?" Your hand bumps up against the man's solid if somewhat fleshy chest.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFA8.polish: „Mais que faites-vous, funkcjonariuszu?” – twoja ręka zderza się z solidną, choć cokolwiek cielistą klatką piersiową mężczyzny.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFA8.belarusian: "Mais que faites-vous, афіцэру? — твая рука натыкаецца на шчыльныя, хоць і крыху пухлыя грудзі мужчыны."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFAE.english: "That's why it would be extremely irregular, or potentially even *inappropriate* for me to intercede with the Committee concerning a district I'm not officially in."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFAE.polish: „Właśnie dlatego bardzo nieoczekiwane a może nawet *niestosowne* byłoby, gdybym interweniował przed komitetem w sprawie dzielnicy, w której oficjalnie nie przebywam”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFAE.belarusian: "Вось чаму было б вельмі незвычайна ці патэнцыйна нават *непрыстойна* з майго боку хадайнічаць перад Камітэтам наконт раёна, дзе я афіцыйна не знаходжуся."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFBA.english: "Unfortunately not, no, I don't have the pleasure. I am merely a representative of the Coalition Government, not very well-versed in technology..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFBA.polish: „Niestety nie, nie mam tej przyjemności. Jestem tylko przedstawicielem Rządu Koalicyjnego i kiepsko znam się na technologii...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFBA.belarusian: "На жаль, не, не маю такога прыемнага знаёмства. Я ўсяго толькі прадстаўнік Кааліцыйнага Урада і не надта разбіраюся ў тэхналогіях..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFC0.english: "Well, of course it *is* a heavily armed and armoured warship with a full complement. But I assure you its purpose in Revachol is to *keep* the peace, not disturb it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFC0.polish: „No cóż, to oczywiście *jest* ciężko uzbrojony i opancerzony okręt wojenny z pełną obsadą. Ale zapewniam, że jego celem w Revacholu jest *utrzymywanie* pokoju, a nie jego zakłócanie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFC0.belarusian: "Ну, вядома, гэта *і ёсць* цяжкаўзброены і браніраваны вайсковы карабель з поўным экіпажам. Але запэўніваю вас, ягоная мэта ў Рэвашолі — *ахоўваць* мір, а не парушаць яго."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFCD.english: "Yes, I was wondering the same thing."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFDA.english: You *will* figure it out. Something tells you the person you're looking for is already on this coast...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFDA.polish: W końcu to *rozgryziesz*. Coś ci mówi, że osoba, której szukasz, przebywa już na tym wybrzeżu...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFDA.belarusian: Ты *разбярэшся*. Нешта падказвае табе, што чалавек, якога ты шукаеш, ужо знаходзіцца на гэтым узбярэжжы...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFE0.english: Don't let the paintjob fool you, it's a goddamn killing machine, and there's nothing you can do to stop it!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFE0.polish: Nie daj się zmylić malowaniu. To cholerna maszyna do zabijania i nie możesz zrobić nic, żeby ją powstrzymać!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFE0.belarusian: Не дазваляй фарбе падмануць цябе, гэта чортава машына смерці, і ты нічога не здольны зрабіць, каб спыніць яе!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFE6.english: Perhaps your new friends in the tent might be able to help you?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFE6.polish: Może twoi nowi przyjaciele z namiotu byliby w stanie pomóc?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFE6.belarusian: Можа, твае новыя сябры ў палатцы здолеюць табе дапамагчы?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFEC.english: "I don't think I've ever noticed it before."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFEC.belarusian: "Не думаю, што я калі-небудзь раней яго заўважаў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFF2.english: This sounds like something that programmer you met in the church might help with...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFF2.polish: To brzmi jak coś, w czym mogłaby pomóc programistka, którą spotkałeś w kościele...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFF2.belarusian: Гучыць як нешта, у чым магла б дапамагчы тая праграмістка, якую ты сустрэў у царкве...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFF8.english: "Oh, right. The *Archer*. I thought you said... something else."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFF8.polish: „Och, racja. *Łucznik*. Myślałem, że powiedział pan... coś innego”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFF8.belarusian: "А, так. *'Лучнік'*. Я думаў, вы сказалі... нешта іншае."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F004.english: Don't let the shiny lights fool you, it's a goddamn killing machine, and there's nothing you can do to stop it!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F004.polish: Nie daj się zmylić tym błyszczącym światełkom. To cholerna maszyna do zabijania i nie możesz zrobić nic, żeby ją powstrzymać!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F004.belarusian: Не дазваляй бліскучым агням падмануць цябе, гэта чортава машына смерці, і ты нічога не здольны зрабіць, каб спыніць яе!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F00A.english: "Oh, good: 'Techno-tinkerers.' Just what this *side task* was missing..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F00A.polish: „Świetnie – techno-majsterkowicze. Właśnie tego w tym *pobocznym zadaniu* brakowało...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F00A.belarusian: "О, выдатна: 'Тэхна-ўмельцы'. Якраз тое, чаго не хапала гэтаму *пабочнаму заданню*..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F010.english: "Hmmm, perhaps your young friends in the *tent* might be of assistance?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F010.polish: „Hmm... Może twoi młodzi przyjaciele z *namiotu* mogliby ci w tym pomóc?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F010.belarusian: "Хм-м, магчыма, вашыя маладыя сябры ў *палатцы* маглі б дапамагчы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F016.english: "You said you weren't really here. I had to make sure you weren't an astral projection."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F016.polish: „Powiedział pan, że pana tu nie ma. Musiałem się upewnić, że nie jest pan tylko astralną projekcją”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F016.belarusian: "Вы сказалі, што вас насамрэч тут няма. Я павінен быў упэўніцца, што вы не астральная праекцыя."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000F016.polish: „Powiedział, że go tu nie ma. Musiałem się upewnić, że nie jest tylko astralną projekcją”.
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000F016.belarusian: "Ён сказаў, што яго насамрэч тут няма. Я павінен быў упэўніцца, што ён не астральная праекцыя."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F01E.english: "Nothing, just lost my balance a moment."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F01E.polish: „Nic, po prostu straciłem na chwilę równowagę”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F024.english: "Hmmm, sounds like something that programmer we met in the church might be able to help with..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F024.polish: „Hmm... To brzmi jak coś, w czym mogłaby pomóc programistka, którą spotkaliśmy w kościele...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F024.belarusian: "Хм-м, гучыць як нешта, у чым магла б дапамагчы тая праграмістка, якую мы сустрэлі ў царкве..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F02E.english: "But this is an urgent matter. I *need* to get in touch with the Committee."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F02E.polish: „Ale to ważna sprawa. *Muszę* skontaktować się z Komitetem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F02E.belarusian: "Але гэта неадкладная справа. Мне *трэба* звязацца з Камітэтам."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F034.english: "How am I supposed to contact the Committee then?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F034.polish: „Jak w takim razie mam się skontaktować z Komitetem?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F03A.english: "Are you saying I should just give up?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F03A.polish: „Twierdzi pan, że powinienem się po prostu poddać?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F03A.belarusian: "Вы хочаце сказаць, мне трэба проста здацца?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F040.english: No, it's more like a creature from the abyssopelagic zone, a great dark bioluminescent fish...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F040.polish: Nie, jest bardziej jak jakaś istota ze strefy abisalnej, wielka, mroczna, bioluminescencyjna ryba...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F040.belarusian: Не, хутчэй гэта істота з абісапелагічнай зоны, вялікая цёмная біялюмінесцэнтная рыба...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F046.english: It's about four-and-a-half kilometres from your position, you estimate.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F046.polish: Oceniasz, że znajduje się około czterech i pół kilometra od twojej pozycji.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F046.belarusian: Па тваіх ацэнках, гэта прыкладна за чатыры з паловай кіламетры ад цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F04C.english: "Ah, well, I'm glad to hear that at least. It would really be *quite unusual* for you to have never noticed it before..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F04C.polish: „No cóż, cieszę się, że to słyszę. To byłoby *bardzo niezwykłe*, gdyby ktoś taki jak pan dotąd go nie zauważył...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F04C.belarusian: "Ах, ну, я рады чуць хоць гэта. Было б сапраўды *вельмі незвычайна*, каб вы ніколі раней яго не заўважалі..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F052.english: "No, no, don't be silly. We're simply speaking in an informal capacity. *Officially* I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F052.polish: „Nie, nie – nie bądźmy śmieszni. Po prostu rozmawiamy teraz nieformalnie. *Oficjalnie* wciąż jestem w La Delta – przygotowuję się do nadchodzącej konferencji o pochodnych oleju napędowego...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F052.belarusian: "Не, не, не глуміце галавы. Мы проста размаўляем у неафіцыйнай абстаноўцы. *Афіцыйна* я ўсё яшчэ ў Ля Дэльта, рыхтуюся да хуткай канферэнцыі па вытворных мазуту..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F058.english: "Perhaps your blood sugar is a bit low? As I was saying, *officially* speaking I am still in La Delta, preparing for an upcoming conference on fuel oil derivatives..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F058.polish: „Być może ma pan niski poziom cukru we krwi? Jak już mówiłem, *oficjalnie* wciąż jestem w La Delta – przygotowuję się do nadchodzącej konferencji o pochodnych oleju napędowego...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F058.belarusian: "Магчыма, у вас трохі панізіўся цукар у крыві? Як я і казаў, *афіцыйна* кажучы, я ўсё яшчэ ў Ля Дэльта, рыхтуюся да хуткай канферэнцыі па вытворных мазуту..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F05E.english: Not just any fish, it moves like some ancient bottom-feeder gliding over the ocean floor in search of prey...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F05E.polish: Nie jakaś byle ryba, lecz pradawna przydenna istota sunąca przez ocean w poszukiwaniu ofiary...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F05E.belarusian: Не проста рыба — яна рухаецца як нейкая старажытная прыдонная істота, што слізгае над акіянскім дном у пошуках здабычы...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F06E.english: "Yes, you've made your *persistence* quite clear. Under normal circumstances I would have to insist you go through the regular channels."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F06E.polish: „Tak, udowodnił już pan swoją *wytrwałość*. W normalnych okolicznościach nalegałbym, aby skorzystał pan z oficjalnych kanałów”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F06E.belarusian: "Так, вы цалкам ясна прадэманстравалі сваю *ўпартасць*. Пры звычайных акалічнасцях я павінен быў бы настаяць на тым, каб вы скарысталіся звычайнымі каналамі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F074.english: The man frowns. "Well, under ordinary circumstances, the Committee contacts *you*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F074.polish: Mężczyzna marszczy czoło. „Cóż, w zwykłych okolicznościach to komitet kontaktuje się z *obywatelami*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F074.belarusian: Мужчына хмурыцца: "Ну, пры звычайных акалічнасцях Камітэт сам выходзіць на сувязь з *вамі*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F07A.english: "I don't mean to discourage you, of course, just to say that it won't be *easy* to reach the Committee."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F07A.polish: „Nie chciałbym pana zniechęcać, oczywiście, ale uprzedzam, że dotarcie do komitetu nie będzie *łatwe*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F07A.belarusian: "Я не хачу вас абяскуражваць, вядома, проста кажу, што звязацца з Камітэтам будзе *нялёгка*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F085.english: "Interesting. In a sense, that's the very idea. The Coalition doesn't want the people of Revachol to feel that they are under a *military* occupation. That is why the Archer is always careful to maintain a constant, discreet distance."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F085.polish: „Interesujące. W pewnym sensie o to właśnie chodzi. Koalicja nie chce, aby mieszkańcy Revacholu czuli, że znajdują się pod *wojskową* okupacją. Właśnie dlatego Łucznik zawsze zachowuje stały, dyskretny dystans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F085.belarusian: "Цікава. У пэўным сэнсе, гэта і ёсць галоўная задума. Кааліцыя не хоча, каб жыхары Рэвашоля адчувалі, нібы знаходзяцца пад *вайсковай* акупацыяй. Вось чаму 'Лучнік' заўсёды старанна трымае нязменную, стрыманую дыстанцыю."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F08F.english: No, no. You can't let them give you the runaround.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F08F.polish: Nie, nie. Nie możesz pozwolić, żeby cię zbyli.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F08F.belarusian: Не, не. Не дазваляй ім вадзіць цябе за нос.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F095.english: In other words, the committee only knows what it *wants* to know.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F095.polish: Innymi słowy, komitet wie tylko to, co *chce* wiedzieć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F095.belarusian: Іншымі словамі, камітэт ведае толькі тое, што *хоча* ведаць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F09B.english: Not exactly a model of accessible and accountable governance...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F09B.polish: Nie brzmi to jak modelowo dostępne i odpowiedzialne ciało rządzące...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F09B.belarusian: Не зусім узор даступнага і падсправаздачнага кіравання...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0A1.english: "But if you have information of a vital interest, they might be willing to entertain an exception. In which case, I would advise you to contact them via Coalition Warship Archer."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0A1.polish: „Ale jeśli ma pan istotne informacje, to może komitet będzie skłonny zrobić wyjątek. W takim wypadku radziłbym skontaktować się z nim za pośrednictwem okrętu wojennego Koalicji o nazwie »Łucznik«”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0A1.belarusian: "Але калі вы маеце інфармацыю выключнай важнасці, яны маглі б зрабіць выключэнне. У такім выпадку я б параіў вам звязацца з імі праз вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі 'Лучнік'."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0AC.english: It looks, to your eye, like some kind of long, metallic fish, suspended beneath a number of ceiling fans...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0AC.polish: Wygląda to twoim zdaniem jak długa, metaliczna ryba zawieszona pod kilkoma wentylatorami sufitowymi...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0AC.belarusian: На твой погляд, гэта выглядае як нейкая доўгая металічная рыба, падвешаная пад шэрагам столевых вентылятараў...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0BB.english: "That is part of the idea, of course. The Coalition doesn't want the people of Revachol to feel that they are under a *military* occupation. That is why the Archer is always careful to maintain a constant, discreet distance."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0BB.polish: „Po części o to właśnie chodzi, oczywiście. Koalicja nie chce, aby mieszkańcy Revacholu czuli, że znajdują się pod *wojskową* okupacją. Właśnie dlatego Łucznik zawsze zachowuje stały, dyskretny dystans”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0BB.belarusian: "У гэтым частка задумы, вядома. Кааліцыя не хоча, каб жыхары Рэвашоля адчувалі, нібы знаходзяцца пад *вайсковай* акупацыяй. Вось чаму 'Лучнік' заўсёды старанна трымае нязменную, стрыманую дыстанцыю."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0C1.english: "I suppose there might be some way to *circuit-bend* your way onto those frequencies, but you'd have to be one of those *techno-tinkerers* to do it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0C1.polish: „Pewnie istnieje jakiś sposób na *zagięcie obwodów* i dostanie się na te częstotliwości, ale musiałby pan być jednym z tych *techno-majsterkowiczów*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0C1.belarusian: "Мяркую, ёсць нейкі спосаб *перапаяць схему*, каб выйсці на гэтыя частоты, але для гэтага трэба быць адным з тых *тэхна-ўмельцаў*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0DF.english: "Fascinating. I always thought it was more like a dragonfly. But isn't it interesting how humanity always finds inspiration in nature?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0DF.polish: „Fascynujące. Zawsze wydawało mi się, że wygląda raczej jak ważka. Ale czy to nie interesujące, że ludzkość zawsze znajduje inspirację w naturze?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0DF.belarusian: "Займальна. Я заўсёды думаў, што ён больш падобны да страказы. Але ці не цікава, як чалавецтва заўсёды знаходзіць натхненне ў прыродзе?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0F5.english: "That, my friend, is your responsabilité. I cannot take it from you, nor can you delegate it to someone else..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0F5.polish: „To, mój przyjacielu, twoje responsabilité. Nie mogę cię od tej odpowiedzialności uwolnić, ani przenieść ją na kogoś innego...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F0F5.belarusian: "Гэта, мой сябар, ваша la responsabilité. Я не магу забраць яе ў вас, як і вы не можаце дэлегаваць яе камусьці іншаму..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F105.polish: „Zaraz, ale co to jest Okręt Wojenny Koalicji Łucznik?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F105.belarusian: "Пачакайце, а што такое вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі 'Лучнік'?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F111.english: "So how does one go about contacting a Coalition warship?" (Proceed.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F111.polish: „I jak można skontaktować się z okrętem wojennym Koalicji?” (Przejdź dalej).
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F111.belarusian: "І як жа можна звязацца з вайсковым караблём Кааліцыі?" (Працягнуць.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F11B.english: "Officer? You mean to say you haven't noticed the giant Coalition aerostatic peacefully patrolling the skies over Revachol?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F11B.polish: „Słucham? Chce mi pan powiedzieć, że nie zauważył olbrzymiego aerostatu Koalicji patrolującego spokojnie niebo nad Revacholem?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F11B.belarusian: "Афіцэру? Вы хочаце сказаць, што не заўважалі гіганцкага аэрастата Кааліцыі, які мірна патрулюе неба над Рэвашолем?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F121.english: "Huh. Can't believe I never noticed it before."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F121.polish: „Hm. Nie do wiary, że nigdy go wcześniej nie dostrzegłem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F121.belarusian: "Хм. Не верыцца, што я ніколі раней яго не заўважаў."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000F121.polish: „Wygląda, jakby był jakieś cztery i pół kilometra stąd”.
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000F121.belarusian: "Здаецца, ён прыкладна за чатыры з паловай кіламетры адсюль."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F12F.english: "This is quite the problem, very tricky. Of course, the Archer has orders to fire on any unidentified aerostatics that might approach it, so it might be safer to get in touch *from the ground*..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F12F.polish: „To jest całkiem spory problem – bardzo skomplikowany. Oczywiście Łucznik ma rozkaz otworzyć ogień do każdego niezidentyfikowanego aerostatu, który spróbuje się do niego zbliżyć, więc najbezpieczniej byłoby skontaktować się z nim *z ziemi*...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F12F.belarusian: "Гэта немалая праблема, вельмі няпростая. Вядома, 'Лучнік' мае загад страляць па любых неапазнаных аэрастатах, якія паспрабуюць наблізіцца да яго, таму было б бяспечней выйсці на сувязь *з зямлі*..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F14C.english: "Do you know any of these tinkerers?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F164.english: "But in that case, you would require a radio transmitter capable of broadcasting on Coalition frequencies. And that kind of technology naturally isn't typically available for non-Coalition use. Yes, it *is* a bit of a conundrum."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F164.polish: „Ale w takim przypadku potrzebny byłby nadajnik radiowy umożliwiający transmisję na częstotliwościach Koalicji. A taką technologią naturalnie dysponują zazwyczaj jedynie przedstawiciele Koalicji. Tak, to *jest* twardy orzech do zgryzienia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F164.belarusian: "Але ў такім выпадку вам спатрэбіцца радыёперадатчык, здольны вяшчаць на частотах Кааліцыі. А падобная тэхналогія, натуральна, звычайна недаступная не для Кааліцыі. Так, гэта *сапраўды* загадка."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F16A.english: You look out the window toward the north. There, hanging some distance above the horison, you can just make out a strange silhouette...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F16A.polish: Wyglądasz przez okno w kierunku północnym. Tam, na pewnej wysokości nad horyzontem, dostrzegasz dziwną sylwetkę...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F16A.belarusian: Ты глядзіш праз акно на поўнач. Там, завіснуўшы на пэўнай вышыні над гарызонтам, ты ледзьве адрозніваеш дзіўны сілуэт...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F170.english: You look out the window toward the north. There, amidst the low-hanging stars, you can just make out signs of motion...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F170.polish: Wyglądasz przez okno w kierunku północnym. Tam, wśród nisko zawieszonych gwiazd, dostrzegasz ślady ruchu...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F170.belarusian: Ты глядзіш праз акно на поўнач. Там, сярод нізка павіслых зорак, ты ледзьве адрозніваеш прыкметы руху...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F182.english: You look out the window, but you can't see anything. But then, it's dark, and your eyes aren't the sharpest...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F182.polish: Wyglądasz przez okno, lecz nic nie widzisz. Jest w końcu ciemno, a twój wzrok nie jest szczególnie dobry...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F182.belarusian: Ты глядзіш у акно, але нічога не бачыш. Зрэшты, на дварэ цемра, а зрок у цябе не найлепшы...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F188.english: It's a set of position lights moving in unison, like a restless constellation...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F188.polish: To zestaw poruszających się razem świateł pozycyjnych. Niczym niespokojna konstelacja...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F188.belarusian: Гэта набор габарытных агнёў, што рухаюцца ва ўнісон, нібы неспакойнае сузор'е...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F18E.english: You look around, but you don't see anything unusual. Then again, your eyes aren't the sharpest...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F18E.polish: Rozglądasz się, nie widzisz jednak nic niezwykłego. Twój wzrok nie jest w końcu szczególnie dobry...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000F18E.belarusian: Ты азіраешся, але не бачыш нічога незвычайнага. Зрэшты, зрок у цябе не найлепшы...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFB4.english: "Let me just say that I have *complete confidence* in the RCM. I'm sure you'll figure something out."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFB4.polish: „Powiem tylko, że pokładam *całkowite zaufanie* w MOR. Jestem pewny, że coś pan wymyśli”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000EFB4.belarusian: "Дазвольце толькі сказаць, што я маю *поўны давер* да РГМ. Упэўнены, вы нешта прыдумаеце."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BC7.english: "Why do I need to go through Archer to speak to the Committee?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BC7.polish: „Czemu muszę skontaktować się z Łucznikiem, żeby porozmawiać z Komitetem?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BC7.belarusian: "Чаму мне трэба звяртацца да 'Лучніка', каб пагаварыць з Камітэтам?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BCD.english: "I find it a great comfort to know there are benevolent powers watching over all, in strict accordance with the Wayfarer Act and the Bristelmüne Conventions."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BCD.polish: „Dodaje mi wielkiej otuchy wiedza, że nad wszystkim czuwają życzliwe siły, przestrzegając ściśle Ustawy o podróżach i konwencji bristelmüńskich”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BCD.belarusian: "Мне вельмі суцяшальна ведаць, што над усім чуваюць добразычлівыя сілы, у строгай адпаведнасці з Законам аб падарожжах і Брыстэльмюнскімі канвенцыямі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BD3.english: "You see, in addition to being an airborne artillery platform, Coalition Warship Archer is also the linchpin of the Coalition's surveillance and communications infrastructure in Revachol."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BD3.polish: „Okręt wojenny Koalicji »Łucznik« jest nie tylko powietrzną platformą artyleryjską, ale również zwornikiem koalicyjnej infrastruktury inwigilacyjnej i komunikacyjnej w Revacholu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BD3.belarusian: "Бачыце, акрамя таго што гэта паветраная артылерыйская платформа, вайсковы карабель Кааліцыі 'Лучнік' таксама з'яўляецца асновай кааліцыйнай інфраструктуры назірання і сувязі ў Рэвашолі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BD9.english: "And listening! It has the most objective vantage point in the entire city. Not to mention a vast array of radio, photographic, and meteorological monitoring instruments."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BD9.polish: „I słucha! Zajmuje najkorzystniejszy punkt obserwacyjny w całym mieście. Nie wspominając o szerokiej gamie instrumentów do monitoringu radiowego, fotograficznego i meteorologicznego, którymi dysponuje”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BD9.belarusian: "І слухае! Ён займае самы аб'ектыўны назіральны пункт ва ўсім горадзе. Не кажучы ўжо пра шырокі арсенал прыбораў радыё-, фота- і метэаралагічнага маніторынгу."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BE7.english: The Bristelmüne Conventions are a series of international agreements governing the treatment of military personnel and civilians in theatres of war as well as occupied territories. In practice, they are more talked about than observed.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BE7.polish: Konwencje Bristelmüńskie to seria umów międzynarodowych normujących zasady traktowania personelu wojskowego i cywilów na terenach objętych konfliktami oraz okupowanych. W praktyce bardziej się o nich mówi niż je stosuje.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300004BE7.belarusian: Брыстэльмюнскія канвенцыі — гэта шэраг міжнародных пагадненняў, якія рэгулююць абыходжанне з вайскоўцамі і цывільнымі асобамі на тэатрах ваенных дзеянняў, а таксама на акупаваных тэрыторыях. На практыцы пра іх часцей гавораць, чым іх выконваюць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000FBF1.english: A bundle of clothes heaped on the bed. A stained parka, some towels and a duvet. Some socks even.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000FBF1.polish: Stos ubrań na łóżku. Poplamiona kurtka, jakieś ręczniki i kołdra. A nawet kilka skarpet.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000FBF1.belarusian: Куча адзення, накіданая на ложку. Заплямленая парка, нейкія ручнікі і пярына. Нават некалькі шкарпэтак.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DF20.english: Figure out what he's trying to say.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DF2B.english: He's trying to call you pigs.

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000211E6.english: "I'm afraid it is. Look, it *moves*." He points to a fleshy lump sticking out from the other end of the blanket. The limb seems to be twitching from time to time.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000211E6.polish: „Obawiam się, że tak. Przyjrzyj się – to się *rusza*” – odpowiada porucznik, wskazując kawał ciała wystający spod drugiego końca koca. Od czasu do czasu kończyną wstrząsa dreszcz.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000211E6.belarusian: "Баюся, што так. Глядзіце, яно *рухаецца*", — ён паказвае на кавалак плоці, што тырчыць з іншага краю коўдры. Здаецца, канечнасць час ад часу тузаецца.

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000211ED.english: And look, the other foot is camouflaged by a striped sock bearing the name MAXTOR on the sole. Three toes are poking out of a hole.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000211ED.polish: I popatrz, druga stopa jest zamaskowana paskowaną skarpetą z napisem MAXTOR na podeszwie. Z dziury wystają trzy palce.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000211ED.belarusian: І паглядзі: другая ступня замаскаваная паласатай шкарпэткай з надпісам MAXTOR на падэшве. З дзіркі тырчаць тры пальцы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021200.english: Maxtor is a gas company. He's wearing free socks from a gas company. They probably came with the bills.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021200.polish: Maxtor to firma gazownicza. Ma na sobie jej darmowe skarpetki reklamowe. Pewnie przysłali je razem z rachunkiem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021200.belarusian: Maxtor — гэта газавая кампанія. Ён у бясплатных рэкламных шкарпэтках ад газавай кампаніі. Напэўна, іх даслалі разам з рахункамі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570002124A.english: Silence... Only heat emanates from the sleeping body.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570002124A.polish: Cisza... Jedyne, co wydobywa się ze śpiącego ciała, to ciepło.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570002124A.belarusian: Цішыня... Толькі жар струменіць ад спячага цела.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021250.english: "Well, judging by the colour of his hair I would say yes, it is."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021250.polish: „Sądząc po kolorze jego włosów, to pewnie on”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021250.belarusian: "Ну, мяркуючы па колеры валасоў, я б сказаў, што так, гэта ён".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021264.english: "Doesn't look like he's going fuck anyone up any time soon."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021264.polish: „Nie wygląda na to, żeby miał komuś spuścić rychłe manto”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021264.belarusian: "Не падобна, каб ён збіраўся каму-небудзь уламаць у найбліжэйшы час".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021271.english: "No, it really doesn't." The lieutenant tilts his head. "This looks very hard to recover from."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021271.polish: „Rzeczywiście” – zgadza się z tobą porucznik, przechylając na bok głowę. „Dojście do siebie po czymś takim nie będzie łatwe”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021271.belarusian: "Так, зусім не падобна. — Лейтэнант нахіляе галаву. — Пасля такога вельмі цяжка ачуняць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021277.english: The lieutenant's right -- the man's unwashed hair bears a familiar ginger tone. Even the hair on his chest is coppery. The light from the window falls into his half-open eyes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021277.polish: Porucznik ma rację – w brudnych włosach mężczyzny widać znajome rude tony. Nawet włosy na jego piersi są miedziane. Światło sączące się przez okno pada na jego na wpół otwarte oczy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700021277.belarusian: Лейтэнант мае рацыю — у нямытых валасах мужчыны праглядаецца знаёмы руды адліг. Нават валасы на грудзях медныя. Святло з акна падае на ягоныя напаўразплюшчаныя вочы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570002127F.english: "I can't believe it, Cuno's dad isn't a loser! It *must* be someone else."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570002127F.polish: „Nie chce mi się w to wierzyć, ojciec Cuna nie może być przegrańcem! To *musi* być kto inny”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570002127F.belarusian: "Не веру, бацька Куны не няўдачнік! Гэта *мусіць* быць нехта іншы".
