Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042C3.english: Mmmm. (Savour the feeling a moment longer.)
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042C3.polish: Mmmm. (Ciesz się tym uczuciem chwilę dłużej).

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042CA.english: Alright, time to get back to work. (Close the book.)
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042CA.polish: No dobra, czas wracać do pracy. (Zamknij książkę).
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042CA.belarusian: Добра, час вяртацца да працы. (Закрыць кнігу.)

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042D2.english: A tingle rushes down your spine and you feel your toes uncurl. If only it could always be like this.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042D2.polish: Czujesz mrowienie na plecach, twoje palce u nóg prostują się. Gdyby tylko zawsze mogło tak być...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042D2.belarusian: Па спіне прабягаюць мурашы, і пальцы на нагах расслабляюцца. Каб жа заўсёды было так.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042DE.english: You close the book and find yourself staring at the familiar cover once more.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042DE.polish: Zamykasz książkę i kolejny raz przyglądasz się znajomej już okładce.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042DE.belarusian: Ты закрываеш кнігу і зноў глядзіш на знаёмую вокладку.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042E6.english: Great, so where can I get all this stuff?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042E6.polish: Świetnie, to skąd ja to wszystko mogę wziąć?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042E6.belarusian: Выдатна, дык дзе мне ўсё гэта ўзяць?

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042EC.english: You close the book and find yourself staring at the familiar cover once more.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042EC.polish: Zamykasz książkę i kolejny raz przyglądasz się znajomej już okładce.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042EC.belarusian: Ты закрываеш кнігу і зноў глядзіш на знаёмую вокладку.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042F5.english: From the pale, of course. Or perhaps from some enterprising entroponaut. Where you would find one of those, though, the book does not say.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042F5.polish: Z szaroty, rzecz jasna. Ewentualnie od jakiegoś przedsiębiorczego entroponauty. Ale gdzie kogoś takiego znaleźć – o tym książka nie mówi.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000042F5.belarusian: З цьмянасці, вядома. Ці, магчыма, у якога-небудзь прадпрымальнага энтрапанаўта. Дзе такога шукаць, кніга, аднак, замоўчвае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004304.english: You close the book and find yourself staring at the familiar cover once more.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004304.polish: Zamykasz książkę i kolejny raz przyglądasz się znajomej już okładce.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004304.belarusian: Ты закрываеш кнігу і зноў глядзіш на знаёмую вокладку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004340.english: A note of caution, however. Be sure to limit your exposure to the pale to no more than an hour a day, and no more than three hours total per week.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004340.polish: Małe ostrzeżenie: pamiętaj, aby ograniczyć swój kontakt z szarotą do maksymalnie godziny dziennie i – łącznie – trzech godzin w tygodniu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004340.belarusian: Але адна засцярога: абавязкова абмяжуй сваё знаходжанне ў цьмянасці не больш як гадзінай на дзень і не больш як трыма гадзінамі на тыдзень агулам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004348.english: You glance over at the lieutenant, who is standing, as usual, with his hands neatly folded behind his back. What he's thinking about, if he's thinking about anything at all, is absolutely opaque to you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004348.polish: Rzucasz okiem na porucznika, który jak zwykle stoi elegancko z dłońmi za plecami. O czym myśli, jeśli w ogóle o czymkolwiek? Nie jesteś w stanie stwierdzić.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004348.belarusian: Ты кідаеш позірк на лейтэнанта, які, як звычайна, акуратна склаў рукі за спінай. Пра што ён думае, калі наогул думае, для цябе поўная таямніца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005E94.english: The tome seems to get heavier with every passing minute.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005E94.polish: Książka wydaje się cięższa z każdą upływającą minutą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005E94.belarusian: З кожнай хвілінай фаліянт нібы становіцца ўсё цяжэйшым.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005EA3.english: You close the book and find yourself staring at the familiar cover once more.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005EA3.polish: Zamykasz książkę i kolejny raz przyglądasz się znajomej już okładce.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00005EA3.belarusian: Ты закрываеш кнігу і зноў глядзіш на знаёмую вокладку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C1A.english: At the Remote Viewers Division we're trained to keep our agiogenous zones maximally dilated.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C1A.polish: Członkowie Wydziału Zdalnych Obserwatorów są uczeni, jak utrzymywać strefy agiogeniczne w stanie maksymalnego otwarcia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C1A.belarusian: У Аддзеле Дыстанцыйных Назіральнікаў нас вучаць трымаць свае агіягенныя зоны максімальна расшыранымі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C21.english: Remote Viewers Division? What kind of woo-woo shit is that?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C21.polish: Wydziału Zdalnych Obserwatorów? Co to za absurdalny wymysł?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C21.belarusian: Аддзел Дыстанцыйных Назіральнікаў? Што гэта яшчэ за шызатэрычная лухта?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C28.english: Nor should you. Nudity is *shameful*. No officer of the law should ever be caught *sans pantalones*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C28.polish: I nie powinieneś. Nagość jest *wstydliwa*. Żaden funkcjonariusz policji nie powinien nigdy być widywany *sans pantalones*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C28.belarusian: І не павінен. Аголенасць — гэта *ганьба*. Ніводнага праваахоўніка нельга заставаць *sans pantalones*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C34.english: Free your body! You long to feel the cool breeze tickle against your inner thighs and midriff.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C34.polish: Uwolnij swe ciało! Pragniesz poczuć, jak chłodny powiew muska wewnętrzną stronę twoich ud i brzuch.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C34.belarusian: Вызвалі сваё цела! Ты прагнеш адчуць, як прахалодны ветрык казыча сцёгны знутры і жывот.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C4C.english: Well, yeah, on your junk, too.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C54.english: Your genitalia are the site of your most important agiogenous zone. It's vitally important to aerate them in the pale.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C54.polish: Twoje genitalia to miejsce, w którym znajduje się najważniejsza strefa agiogeniczna. Wietrzenie ich w szarocie jest absolutnie kluczowe.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C54.belarusian: Твае геніталіі — гэта месца знаходжання найважнейшай агіягеннай зоны. Жыццёва важна праветрываць іх у цьмянасці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C5E.english: This book contains serious ancient wisdom, not whacko conspiracy theories. If you don't respect it, it will never reveal its secrets.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C5E.polish: W książce tej kryje się poważna, pradawna wiedza, a nie jakieś wariackie teorie spiskowe. Jeśli nie będziesz jej szanował, nigdy nie ujawni przed tobą swoich tajemnic.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006C5E.belarusian: У гэтай кнізе змешчана сур'ёзная старажытная мудрасць, а не вар'яцкія тэорыі змовы. Калі ты не будзеш яе паважаць, яна ніколі не адкрые сваіх таямніц.

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000040E8.english: Oh... then I do, very much so. I meditate *all the time*.
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000040E8.polish: Och. W takim razie tak, jak najbardziej. Medytuję *cały czas*.
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000040E8.belarusian: Ох... тады так, яшчэ як. Я медытую *ўвесь час*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000890000410A.english: I want to try concoct one of those hangover-cures again.
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000410A.polish: Chcę jeszcze raz spróbować stworzyć jeden z tych leków na kaca.
Dialogue Text/0x010000890000410A.belarusian: Я хачу яшчэ раз паспрабаваць згатаваць які-небудзь з тых сродкаў ад пахмелля.

Dialogue Text/0x010000700000436B.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000436B.english: In your hand, you hold four-fifths of "Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity."
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000436B.polish: W dłoni trzymasz cztery piąte książki „Dick Mullen i pomylona tożsamość”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000436B.belarusian: У руцэ ты трымаеш чатыры пятыя кнігі "Дзік Муллен і памылковая асоба".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004371.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004371.english: In your hand, you hold "Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity." The brittle paperback feels fragile to the touch.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004371.polish: W dłoni trzymasz książkę „Dick Mullen i pomylona tożsamość”. Sypiący się tom w miękkiej okładce wydaje się niesamowicie delikatny.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004371.belarusian: У руцэ ты трымаеш "Дзік Муллен і памылковая асоба". Ломкая кніжка ў мяккай вокладцы здаецца далікатнай навобмацак.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004789.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004789.english: The cover features a pastiche of different scenes. In the foreground, a man in a dark overcoat clutches a pistol to his chest. Rising up behind him are two silhouettes wrapped in a passionate embrace.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004789.polish: Na okładce widnieje złożony z kilku planów pastisz. Mężczyzna w ciemnym płaszczu przyciska do piersi pistolet, za nim zaś dwie sylwetki splatają się w namiętnym uścisku.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004789.belarusian: На вокладцы — папуры з розных сцэн. На пярэднім плане мужчына ў цёмным паліто прыціскае да грудзей пісталет. За ягонай спінай узвышаюцца два сілуэты ў гарачых абдымках.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004790.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004790.english: The tagline reads: "Detective Dick Mullen must prove his innocence after an old friend is murdered -- by someone who looks just like Dick Mullen!" That seems to sum up the premise nicely.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004790.polish: Podsumowujący fabułę slogan brzmi: „Detektyw Dick Mullen musi udowodnić swoją niewinność po tym, jak jego stary przyjaciel zostaje zabity... przez kogoś wyglądającego jak on!”. Brzmi to jak niezłe podsumowanie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004790.belarusian: Слоган абвяшчае: "Дэтэктыў Дзік Муллен мусіць давесці сваю невінаватасць пасля таго, як ягонага старога сябра забіваюць... нехта, хто выглядае вылітым Дзікам Мулленам!" Здаецца, гэта няблага падсумоўвае сюжэт.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004797.english: Needless to say, it violates nearly every RCM regulation for a detective to investigate a murder in which he is a suspect.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004797.polish: Nie trzeba chyba wspominać, że prowadzenie śledztwa w sprawie morderstwa, o które jest się podejrzanym, stanowi naruszenie niemal każdej z obowiązujących MOR zasad.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004797.belarusian: Залішне казаць, што гэта парушае амаль кожнае правіла РГМ — каб дэтэктыў расследаваў забойства, дзе ён сам з'яўляецца падазраваным.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047B0.english: "I really need to know who this Dick Mullen guy is."
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047B0.polish: „Muszę się koniecznie dowiedzieć, kim jest ten Dick Mullen”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047B0.belarusian: "Мне вельмі трэба даведацца, хто такі гэты Дзік Муллен".

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047B7.english: "I'm looking for advice on being a real detective."
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047B7.belarusian: "Я шукаю парад, як быць сапраўдным дэтэктывам".

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047C5.english: "Well, you won't find it in *there*. Those books are much more about ravishing dames and gun play than real policework."
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047C5.polish: „Cóż, *tam* na pewno się tego nie dowiesz. To książki raczej o pięknych kobietach i zabawie bronią niż o prawdziwej policyjnej robocie”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047C5.belarusian: "Што ж, *там* вы іх дакладна не знойдзеце. Гэтыя кнігі куды больш пра спакуслівых паненак і страляніну, чым пра сапраўдную паліцэйскую працу".

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047CC.english: "Good luck finding it. He's not much of a character, I think you'll find. Just a stand-in for the reader."
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047CC.polish: „Powodzenia w poszukiwaniach. Szybko się, myślę, zorientujesz, że to dość marna postać. Taka kukiełka, w którą może wczuć się czytelnik”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047CC.belarusian: "Поспехаў у пошуках. Баюся, вы хутка зразумееце, што ён не надта цікавы персанаж. Проста падстаўная фігура для чытача".

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047D3.english: The point is for the reader to feel like *they're* solving the crime along with Dick Mullen. A crude narrative convention, but no less effective for it.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047D3.polish: Cel jest taki, żeby czytelnik poczuł, jakby to *on* rozwiązywał zagadkę razem z Dickiem Mullenem. To prymitywna konwencja narracyjna, niemniej skuteczna.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047D3.belarusian: Сэнс у тым, каб чытач адчуў, быццам *ён сам* расследуе злачынства разам з Дзікам Мулленам. Грубая апавядальная ўмоўнасць, але ад гэтага не менш эфектыўная.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047DF.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047DF.english: The story opens with a knock at the door. Detective Dick Mullen is greeted by an old friend, Charlie Spillane, who's come to Mullen to ask a favour on this dark and cold night...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047DF.polish: Fabuła rozpoczyna się pukaniem do drzwi. Detektywa Dicka Mullena wita jego stary przyjaciel, Charlie Spillane, który w tę mroczną i zimną noc przybył, aby poprosić o przysługę...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047DF.belarusian: Гісторыя пачынаецца са стуку ў дзверы. Дэтэктыва Дзіка Муллена сустракае стары сябар, Чарлі Спілэйн, які прыйшоў да Муллена папрасіць аб паслузе ў гэтую цёмную і халодную ноч...

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047E6.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047E6.english: Spillane needs Mullen to drive him in from Vesper to a small town along the Insulindian coast. Despite his friend's apparent agitation, Mullen does as he's asked, then returns home where he passes out drunk, as he does most nights...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047E6.polish: Spillane chce, aby Mullen zawiózł go z Wesperu do małego miasteczka na insulindiańskim wybrzeżu. Nie zważając na ewidentnie podniecenie przyjaciela, detektyw spełnia prośbę, po czym wraca do domu, gdzie upija się i traci przytomność, tak, jak to robi zazwyczaj...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047E6.belarusian: Спілэйн просіць Муллена адвезці яго з Веспера ў маленькае мястэчка на ўзбярэжжы Інсуліндыі. Нягледзячы на бачнае хваляванне сябра, Муллен робіць так, як той просіць, а потым вяртаецца дадому і адключаецца п'яным, як і большасць начэй...

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047ED.english: An extremely unprofessional and *hurtful* stereotype that's offensive to all upstanding officers of the law.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047ED.polish: Wyjątkowo nieprofesjonalny i *krzywdzący* stereotyp, afront dla wszystkich szanujących się funkcjonariuszy policji.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000047ED.belarusian: Надзвычай непрафесійны і *абразлівы* стэрэатып, зняважлівы для ўсіх прыстойных ахоўнікаў закону.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004800.english: I don't need to read this. I'm already living it. (Close the book.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004800.polish: Nie muszę tego czytać. Własne życie mam na co dzień. (Zamknij książkę).
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004800.belarusian: Мне не трэба гэта чытаць. Я і так гэтым жыву. (Закрыць кнігу.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004809.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004809.english: Two days later, Mullen is arrested by the Vesper police and charged with the murder of Charlie Spillane. At his interrogation, Mullen learns that Charlie Spillane was shot in a bar in the very town Mullen dropped him off in, by a man matching *Mullen's* description...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004809.polish: Dwa dni później Mullen zostaje aresztowany przez wesperską policję i oskarżony o zamordowanie Charliego Spillane'a. Podczas swojego przesłuchania dowiaduje się, że został on zastrzelony w barze, w mieście, w do którego podwoził go detektyw. Przez człowieka wyglądającego jak *Mullen*...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004809.belarusian: Праз два дні Муллена арыштоўвае весперская паліцыя і абвінавачвае ў забойстве Чарлі Спілэйна. На допыце Муллен даведваецца, што Чарлі Спілэйн быў застрэлены ў бары ў тым самым мястэчку, куды яго падвёз Муллен, чалавекам з апісаннем вылітага *Муллена*...

Dialogue Text/0x010000700000481D.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000481D.english: Desperate to clear his name, Mullen manages to convince the Vesper police to release him for *three days* so that Mullen may solve his friend's murder and prove his innocence.
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000481D.polish: Desperacko pragnący oczyścić się z podejrzeń Mullen przekonuje wesperskich policjantów, aby wypuścili go na *trzy dni*, w trakcie których rozwiąże on zagadkę morderstwa jego przyjaciela i udowodni swoją niewinność.
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000481D.belarusian: Адчайна імкнучыся ачысціць сваё імя, Муллен угаворвае весперскую паліцыю адпусціць яго на *тры дні*, каб ён мог расследаваць забойства сябра і давесці сваю невінаватасць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004824.english: "The cops release their prime murder suspect so he can find 'the real killer'? Are you shitting me?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004824.polish: „Policjanci wypuszczają głównego podejrzanego o morderstwo, żeby ten mógł poszukać »prawdziwego zabójcy«? Jaja sobie robicie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004824.belarusian: "Копы адпускаюць галоўнага падазраванага ў забойстве, каб ён мог знайсці 'сапраўднага забойцу'? Вы што, здзекуецеся?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000700000482A.english: No way Mullen did it. (Keep reading.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000482A.polish: Nie wierzę, że to Mullen był winowajcą. (Czytaj dalej).
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000482A.belarusian: Не можа быць, каб гэта зрабіў Муллен. (Працягваць чытаць.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004832.english: They're not shitting you, detective. This is what the writers think passes for police procedure.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004832.polish: Nie robią, detektywie. Zdaniem autorów tak wyglądają policyjne procedury.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004832.belarusian: Яны не здзекуюцца з вас, дэтэктыве. Вось як аўтары ўяўляюць сабе паліцэйскую працэдуру.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004839.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004839.english: Of *course* Mullen didn't do it. That's the whole premise of the book! Anyway, Mullen returns to the seaside bar where Spillane was murdered, and meets a *beautiful*, *mysterious* woman named Deanna Deneuve.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004839.polish: *Oczywiście*, że to nie Mullen był winowajcą. O to chodzi w książce! W każdym razie Mullen wraca do nadmorskiego baru, gdzie zamordowano Spillane'a, i spotyka tam *piękną*, *tajemniczą* kobietę, niejaką Deannę Deneuve.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004839.belarusian: *Вядома*, што Муллен гэтага не рабіў. У гэтым жа і ёсць увесь сэнс кнігі! Ва ўсякім разе, Муллен вяртаецца ў прыморскі бар, дзе забілі Спілэйна, і сустракае *прыгожую*, *таямнічую* жанчыну па імені Дзіяна Дэнёў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000700000484C.english: I feel like I've read this before. (Close the book.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000484C.polish: Mam wrażenie, jakbym już to kiedyś czytał. (Zamknij książkę).
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000484C.belarusian: Адчуванне, нібы я гэта ўжо чытаў. (Закрыць кнігу.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004853.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004853.english: And not just any dame -- she's truly one-in-a-million, a knock-out whose *mind* is as dangerous as her *curves*. But she's got a *secret*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004853.polish: I to nie byle jaka – to kobieta jedna na milion, piękność, której *umysł* jest równie niebezpieczny co *krągłości*. Skrywa jednak pewną *tajemnicę*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004853.belarusian: І не абы-якая — яна сапраўды адна на мільён, ашаламляльная красуня, чый *розум* настолькі ж небяспечны, як і яе *формы*. Але яна хавае *таямніцу*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000700000485A.belarusian: Мужык, а ў каго яе няма?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004860.english: Sounds like my kind of woman.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004860.polish: To chyba kobieta w sam raz dla mnie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004860.belarusian: Гучыць як жанчына ў маім гусце.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004868.english: Are you s-s-sure about that? Something about her gives you a *bad* feeling. What kind of *secret* is she hiding?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004868.polish: J-j-jesteś tego pewien? Jest w niej coś, co budzi twoje *złe* przeczucia. Jaka jest ta *tajemnica*, którą skrywa?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004868.belarusian: Ты ў-ў-пэўнены ў гэтым? Нешта ў ёй выклікае ў цябе *кепскае* прадчуванне. Якую *таямніцу* яна хавае?

Dialogue Text/0x010000700000486F.english: Your secrets are unknown even unto you, so does that make you a rich man or a beggar?
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000486F.polish: Twoje tajemnice są nieznane nawet tobie. Czyni cię to bogaczem czy żebrakiem?
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000486F.belarusian: Твае таямніцы невядомыя нават табе, дык кім гэта цябе робіць — багачом ці жабраком?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004876.english: You couldn't handle a woman like that. Look at yourself. You couldn't even handle your --
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004876.polish: Nie poradziłbyś sobie z taką kobietą. Spójrz tylko na siebie. Nie radziłeś sobie nawet z...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004876.belarusian: Табе не справіцца з такой жанчынай. Паглядзі на сябе. Ты нават не здолеў справіцца са сваёй...

Dialogue Text/0x010000700000487D.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000487D.english: Deneuve reveals that she was Spillane's lover, and that he was mixed up with a local amphetamine smuggling operation. As soon as Mullen begins pulling at strings, the whole conspiracy begins to unravel...
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000487D.polish: Deneuve zdradza, że była kochanką Spillane'a i że był on zamieszany w miejscową operację przemytu amfetaminy. Kiedy tylko Mullen pociąga mocniej za ten skrawek informacji, zaczyna się odsłaniać mechanizm całego spisku...
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000487D.belarusian: Дэнёў прызнаецца, што была палюбоўніцай Спілэйна, і што ён быў замяшаны ў мясцовай кантрабандзе амфетаміну. Як толькі Муллен пачынае тузаць за нітачкі, увесь падман пачынае распадацца...

Dialogue Text/0x010000700000488B.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000488B.english: Not only is the local police captain in on the amphetamine ring, so is the son of a powerful politician, and a strung-out art collector named Torvald. Each of whom has his own reasons for wanting Spillane dead...
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000488B.polish: Do amfetaminowego gangu należy nie tylko miejscowy kapitan policji, ale też syn wpływowego polityka i pewien kolekcjoner sztuki na narkotykowym głodzie – Torvald. Każdy z nich ma swoje powody, aby pragnąć śmierci Spillane'a...
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000488B.belarusian: У амфетамінавай схеме замяшаны не толькі мясцовы капітан паліцыі, але і сын уплывовага палітыка, і знясілены калекцыянер мастацтва па імені Торвальд. Кожны з якіх мае свае прычыны жадаць смерці Спілэйна...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004892.english: Tell me about the corrupt police captain.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004892.belarusian: Раскажы мне пра карумпаванага капітана паліцыі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004898.english: I want to hear about the politician's son.

Dialogue Text/0x010000700000489E.english: What was that about an art collector?

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048A7.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048A7.english: He would certainly have the motive and the means, but the captain walks with a noticeable *limp* from an old war injury. Is it possible he was able to conceal it long enough to commit the murder?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048A7.polish: Kapitan na pewno ma i motyw, i środki niezbędne do dokonania morderstwa, lecz wyraźnie *utyka* wskutek odniesionej na wojnie rany. Czy to możliwe, aby zamaskował tę wadę na czas wystarczający do popełnienia morderstwa?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048A7.belarusian: У яго, безумоўна, былі б і матыў, і магчымасці, але капітан прыкметна *кульгае* праз старое ваеннае раненне. Ці магчыма, каб ён схаваў гэта надоўга, каб здзейсніць забойства?

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048AD.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048AD.english: Outwardly, the old police captain is a real law-and-order crypto-fascist, a barrel-chested man who's beaten his share of suspects to pulp. But he's also dirty, and increasingly paranoid that someone's going to expose his role in the drug ring...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048AD.polish: Stary kapitan policji roztacza wokół siebie aurę przywiązanego do prawa i porządku kryptofaszysty, potężnego mężczyzny, który niejednego podejrzanego sprał na krwisty befsztyk. Jest też jednak skorumpowany i coraz bardziej ogarnięty paranoją, że ktoś ujawni jego rolę w narkotykowym gangu...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048AD.belarusian: Вонкава стары капітан паліцыі — сапраўдны крыптафашыст закону і парадку, чалавек з бочкападобнымі грудзьмі, які збіў не аднаго падазраванага ў кашу. Але ён яшчэ і брудны і ўсё больш паранаіць, што нехта раскрые ягоную ролю ў наркасіндыкаце...

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048B6.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048B6.english: A typical privileged twat. In all likelihood, he's just in over his head. He does bear a personal grudge against Spillane though, a former prosecutor who nearly brought down his father's administration...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048B6.polish: Typowy dupek, któremu zbyt wiele wolno. Najprawdopodobniej po prostu wpakował się bezmyślnie w bagno. Żywił jednak do Spillane'a osobistą urazę – zdołał kiedyś nieomal doprowadzić jako śledczy do upadku administracji jego ojca.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048B6.belarusian: Тыповы прывілеяваны казёл. Хутчэй за ўсё, яму проста не хапіла мазгоў. Але ў яго ёсць асабісты зуб на Спілэйна — былога пракурора, які ледзь не абрынуў адміністрацыю ягонага бацькі...

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048BC.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048BC.english: The kid doesn't exactly have Dick Mullen's manly build, but he is the correct height, and while interrogating him at his home, Mullen *did* notice a certain overcoat that looks suspiciously like his own...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048BC.polish: Gnojek nie ma raczej potężnej budowy, jaka cechuje Dicka Mullena, odpowiada mu jednak wzrostem, a kiedy detektyw przesłuchiwał go w jego domu, zauważył pewien płaszcz *podejrzanie* podobny do jego własnego...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048BC.belarusian: Хлапец не тое каб мае мускулісты целасклад Дзіка Муллена, але ростам падыходзіць, і падчас допыту ў яго дома Муллен *заўважыў* пэўнае паліто, якое падазрона нагадвае ягонае ўласнае...

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048C4.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048C4.english: That said, Torvald and Spillane have a long history, and while interrogating him, Mullen discovers that Torvald was once *involved* with Deanna Deneuve. Could it be that this is all over a sordid *love triangle*?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048C4.polish: Z drugiej strony Torvald i Spillane mieli ze sobą mocno na pieńku, a ponadto Mullen odkrył podczas przesłuchania, że kolekcjoner był niegdyś *związany* z Deanną Deneuve. Czy zarzewiem tragedii mógł być ten ponury *miłosny trójkąt*?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048C4.belarusian: Тым не менш, у Торвальда са Спілэйнам доўгая гісторыя, і падчас допыту Муллен выяўляе, што Торвальд некалі *мець дачыненне* да Дзіяны Дэнёў. Ці не круціцца ўсё гэта вакол бруднага *любоўнага трыкутніка*?

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048CA.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048CA.english: Torvald the Art Collector is a strung-out mess. Frankly, it's hard to imagine him holding a pistol steady enough to actually hit someone, let alone plug them three times in the chest the way old Spillane got did...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048CA.polish: Kolekcjoner sztuki Torvald to nękany narkotykowym głodem kłębek nieszczęścia. Szczerze mówiąc, nie sposób sobie wyobrazić, że mógłby on utrzymać pistolet na tyle nieruchomo, by kogoś faktycznie trafić, nie mówiąc już o trzykrotnym strzale w klatkę piersiową, jak to zrobiono ze Spillane'em...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048CA.belarusian: Торвальд-калекцыянер — знясілены наркалыга. Шчыра кажучы, цяжка ўявіць, што ён утрымае пісталет дастаткова цвёрда, каб хоць у кагосьці патрапіць, не кажучы ўжо пра тое, каб укалаціць тры кулі ў грудзі, як гэта здарылася са старым Спілэйнам...

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048DF.english: Okay, let's get on with the story.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048E6.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048E6.english: One evening, Deanna Deneuve comes to Mullen's hostel room in tears. The two of them drink half a bottle of vodka, and soon they're seeking comfort in each other's arms...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048E6.polish: Pewnego wieczora Deanna Deneuve przychodzi do pokoju hostelowego Mullena cała zapłakana. Wypijają we dwójkę pół butelki wódki i wkrótce padają sobie w miłosne objęcia, szukając pocieszenia...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048E6.belarusian: Аднойчы вечарам Дзіяна Дэнёў прыходзіць у нумар Муллена ў хостэле ў слязах. Яны ўдвох выпіваюць паўпляшкі гарэлкі і неўзабаве шукаюць суцяшэння ў абдымках адно аднаго...

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048ED.english: How does Mullen expect to solve the murder if he's sleeping with witnesses!
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048ED.polish: Jak ten Mullen chce rozwiązać sprawę morderstwa, jeśli sypia ze świadkami?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048ED.belarusian: Як Муллен спадзяецца раскрыць забойства, калі ён спіць са сведкамі!

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048F4.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048F4.english: As the two lovers share a post-coital cigarette, Deanna Deneuve turns to Mullen and says, "By the way, Dick, there was something else I meant to tell you..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048F4.polish: Kiedy kochankowie zapalają po odbyciu stosunku papierosa, Deanna Deneuve odwraca się do Mullena i mówi: „A swoją drogą, Dick, chciałam powiedzieć ci coś jeszcze...”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048F4.belarusian: Пакуль закаханыя кураць цыгарэту пасля сэксу, Дзіяна Дэнёў паварочваецца да Муллена і кажа: "Дарэчы, Дзік, я хацела сказаць табе яшчэ сёе-тое..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048FA.english: Well, *that* testimony won't be admissible any longer.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048FA.polish: No, *to* zeznanie nie będzie już wiarygodne.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000048FA.belarusian: Ну, *гэтыя* паказанні ўжо не будуць дапушчальныя.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004908.english: Yes, comfort and pleasure. The warmth of another human's touch, the burning taste of liquor on her full, sweet lips...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004908.polish: Tak, pocieszenia i przyjemności. Ciepła dotyku drugiej osoby, palącego smaku trunku na jej pełnych, słodkich ustach...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004908.belarusian: Так, суцяшэнне і асалода. Цяпло дотыку іншага чалавека, пякучы смак выпіўкі на яе пульхных, салодкіх вуснах...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004910.english: That's just Dick Mullen's *modus operandi*. He might bend the rules, but he closes cases no one else can.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004910.polish: To po prostu *modus operandi* Dicka Mullena. Może i nagina zasady, ale za to rozwiązuje też sprawy, na których inni łamią zęby.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004910.belarusian: Гэта проста *modus operandi* Дзіка Муллена. Можа, ён і выгінае правілы, але раскрывае справы, якія больш ніхто не здольны закрыць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004926.english: The name of the true killer?

Dialogue Text/0x010000700000492D.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000492D.english: Whatever it is, Mullen never hears the words -- A blow to the base of his skull knocks him out cold instantly.
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000492D.polish: Cokolwiek to jest, Mullen tego nie słyszy – uderzenie w potylicę pozbawia go natychmiast przytomności.
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000492D.belarusian: Што б гэта ні было, Муллен гэтых слоў так і не пачуе — удар па патыліцы імгненна выбівае яго ў бяспамяцтва.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004933.english: "Always aim for the centre of mass"?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004941.english: Can't trust a dame. (Shake your head.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004949.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004949.english: When Mullen comes to, Deneuve is dead on the hostel bed next to him. To make matters worse, his clothes are covered with her blood!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004949.polish: Kiedy Mullen dochodzi do siebie, Deneuve leży obok niego na hostelowym, martwa. Co gorsza, jego ubrania są poplamione jej krwią!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004949.belarusian: Калі Муллен прыходзіць да свядомасці, Дэнёў мёртвая на ложку побач з ім. Горш за тое, ягонае адзенне залітае яе крывёю!

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004958.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004958.english: Mullen trashes his blood-stained clothes and flees the hostel, knowing it's only a matter of hours before the cops discover Deneuve's body, if they haven't been tipped off already...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004958.polish: Mullen pozbywa się splamionych krwią ubrań i ucieka z hostelu, wiedząc, że za ledwie kilka godzin policja odkryje ciało Deneuve, o ile nie została już powiadomiona...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004958.belarusian: Муллен выкідвае сваё залітае крывёю адзенне і ўцякае з хостэла, ведаючы, што праз некалькі гадзін паліцыя знойдзе цела Дэнёў, калі ім яшчэ не данеслі...

Dialogue Text/0x010000700000495F.english: Fleeing a crime scene, destroying evidence... Even if Detective Mullen *didn't* commit the murder, he should be facing *years* behind bars.
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000495F.polish: Ucieczka z miejsca zbrodni, niszczenie dowodów... Nawet jeśli detektyw Mullen *nie popełnił* tego morderstwa, powinien trafić za kraty na całe *lata*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000495F.belarusian: Уцёкі з месца злачынства, знішчэнне доказаў... Нават калі дэтэктыў Муллен *не* здзяйсняў забойства, ён павінен сесці за краты на цэлыя *гады*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004966.english: Dick Mullen won't be sent to the clink for the sake of some *legal niceties*!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004966.polish: Dick Mullen nie pójdzie do paki z powodu jakichś prawnych szczególików!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004966.belarusian: Дзіка Муллена не пасадзяць у кутузку праз нейкія *юрыдычныя тонкасці*!

Dialogue Text/0x010000700000496D.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000496D.english: So who did it, detective? Who killed Charlie Spillane and Deanna Deneuve?
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000496D.polish: No więc kto to zrobił, detektywie? Kto zabił Charliego Spillane'a i Deanne Deneuve?
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000496D.belarusian: Дык хто гэта зрабіў, дэтэктыве? Хто забіў Чарлі Спілэйна і Дзіяну Дэнёў?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004364.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004364.english: Dozens of pages scatter across the ground. The last fifth or so of the book seems to have been lost. It's possible that you could gather and reassemble the pages, but it would take way too long.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004364.polish: Na ziemi leżą dziesiątki stron. Ostatnia część książki, mniej więcej jedna piąta, rozsypała się. Możliwe, że udałoby ci się zebrać strony i je poukładać na nowo, ale zajęłoby to o wiele za długo.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004364.belarusian: Дзясяткі старонак рассыпаюцца па зямлі. Апошняя пятая частка кнігі, падобна, згубленая. Можна было б сабраць іх і скласці разам, але гэта зойме зашмат часу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004990.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004990.english: Who can you trust in this wicked, messed-up world?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004990.polish: Komu można ufać w tym podłym, upadłym świecie?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004990.belarusian: Каму можна давяраць у гэтым падлым, сапсаваным свеце?

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049A4.english: The lieutenant gives you a quizzical expression in return. You go back to the story...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049A4.polish: Porucznik odpowiada ci pytającym spojrzeniem. Ponownie skupiasz się na książce...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049A4.belarusian: Лейтэнант глядзіць на цябе са здзіўленнем. Ты вяртаешся да гісторыі...

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049AB.english: No one. Just your own two eyes.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049B3.english: Unfortunately, *your* eyes might not be up to the task. Speaking of... should you maybe consider getting corrective lenses? Your nose is like two centimetres from the page.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049B3.polish: Niestety, *twoje* oczy mogą się do tego nie nadawać. A skoro o tym mowa... Może powinieneś pomyśleć o okularach korekcyjnych? Trzymasz książkę jakieś dwa centymetry od strony.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049B3.belarusian: На жаль, *твае* вочы могуць не справіцца з такой задачай. Дарэчы... ці не варта табе падумаць пра акуляры? Твой нос дзесьці за два сантыметры ад старонкі.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049B9.polish: Mowy nie ma. Nie jestem pinglarzem.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049B9.belarusian: Ні ў якім разе. Я не даўбакулярнік.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049C9.english: Whatever you say, Detective Hyperopia. Why don't you get back to the story?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049C9.polish: Jak uważasz, detektywie Krótkowzroczność. Może tak wrócimy do fabuły?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049C9.belarusian: Як скажаце, дэтэктыў Гіперметропія. Чаму б вам не вярнуцца да гісторыі?

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049D5.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049D5.english: That's exactly what Dick Mullen says in "The Dame Who Did It."
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049D5.polish: Dokładnie to samo mówi Dick Mullen w „Damie winowajczyni”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049D5.belarusian: Менавіта гэта Дзік Муллен і кажа ў "Даме, што зрабіла гэта".

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049DD.english: No one. You gotta go with your gut.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049DD.polish: Nikomu. Trzeba ufać rodzącym się w bebechu przeczuciom.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049E5.english: Speaking of, *your* gut's seen better days. It's a cesspool of burbling acids and noxious fumes, the kind of thing the government might declare a Zone of Irredeemable Catastrophe.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049E5.polish: Nawiasem mówiąc, *twój* bebech pamięta lepsze czasy. Teraz jest tam tylko mieszanina burzących się kwasów i trujących oparów. Miejscem, które rząd mógłby ogłosić strefą nieodwołalnej katastrofy.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049E5.belarusian: Дарэчы, *твой* вантроб бачыў і лепшыя часы. Гэта сметнішча з вірлівых кіслот і атрутных выпараў — з тых, што ўрад мог бы абвясціць Зонай непапраўнай катастрофы.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049F2.english: Why is my gut in such bad shape?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049F2.polish: Czemu mój bebech jest w takim złym stanie?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049F2.belarusian: Чаму мой вантроб у такім кепскім стане?

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049F9.english: Could it be an underlying condition aggravated by years of greasy meals scarfed down between shifts? Or the litres upon litres of hard liquor guzzled on an empty stomach?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049F9.polish: Może przez jakieś dawne schorzenie pogłębione przez lata tłustego jedzenia pochłanianego naprędce między zmianami w pracy? Albo wieloma litrami wypijanych na pustych żołądek mocnych trunków?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000049F9.belarusian: Можа, гэта хранічная хвароба, абвостраная гадамі паглынання тлустай ежы паміж зменамі? Ці літрамі і літрамі моцнага трунку, заглынутымі нашча?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A00.english: No point in worrying about it just now. Why don't you get back to the story?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A00.polish: Nie ma sensu się tym teraz martwić. Może tak wrócimy do fabuły?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A00.belarusian: Няма сэнсу хвалявацца пра гэта цяпер. Чаму б табе не вярнуцца да гісторыі?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A08.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A08.english: That's exactly what Dick Mullen says in "Dauntless Dick and the Fatal Appointment."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A08.polish: Dokładnie to samo mówi Dick Mullen w „Niezłomnym Dicku i śmiertelnej wizycie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A08.belarusian: Менавіта гэта Дзік Муллен і кажа ў "Бясстрашным Дзіку і смяротным спатканні".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A24.english: "What's the matter, detective?" The lieutenant turns to you with a start.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A24.polish: „Co się stało, detektywie?” – porucznik odwraca się do ciebie gwałtownie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A24.belarusian: "У чым справа, дэтэктыве?" — лейтэнант уздрыгвае і паварочваецца да цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A2B.english: "I don't know who's writing this shit, but I get the feeling they aren't experts on homicide investigations."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A2B.polish: „Nie wiem, kto pisze te gówna, ale mam przeczucie, że nie jest ekspertem, jeśli chodzi o śledztwa w sprawie morderstw”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A2B.belarusian: "Я не ведаю, хто піша гэтае лайно, але маю адчуванне, што ў расследаванні забойстваў яны не надта разбіраюцца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A32.english: The lieutenant shrugs, resigned to the idea that his profession will rarely, if ever, be accurately represented in art and literature.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A32.polish: Porucznik wzrusza ramionami. Jest pogodzony z myślą, że jego zawód rzadko, o ile kiedykolwiek, będzie wiarygodnie przedstawiany w sztuce i literaturze.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A32.belarusian: Лейтэнант паціскае плячыма, змірыўшыся з думкай, што ягоная прафесія рэдка калі — калі ўвогуле калі-небудзь — будзе дакладна адлюстравана ў мастацтве і літаратуры.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A53.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A53.english: The heat is on! If Dick Mullen can't solve both murders before the cops catch up to him, he's going away for life...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A53.polish: Robi się gorąco! Jeśli Dick Mullen nie rozwiąże zagadki obu morderstw, zanim dopadnie go policja, trafi na całe życie za kraty...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A53.belarusian: Становіцца горача! Калі Дзік Муллен не зможа раскрыць абодва забойствы да таго, як паліцыя дабярэцца да яго, ён сядзе на ўсё жыццё...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A5A.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A5A.english: You begin furiously flipping through pages. Even as you know these books follow a series of well-worn tropes, you find yourself completely engrossed. You're turning pages so fast you don't even notice the ancient spine coming unglued...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A5A.polish: Zaczynasz gwałtownie przeglądać książkę. Choć wiesz, że ta seria jest tylko zbieraniną absolutnie sztampowych motywów, wciągnąłeś się w fabułę bez reszty. Przerzucasz strony tak szybko, że nie zauważasz, jak stary grzbiet powoli się rozkleja...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004A5A.belarusian: Ты пачынаеш ашалела гартаць старонкі. Нават ведаючы, што гэтыя кнігі выкарыстоўваюць набор заезджаных штампаў, ты ловіш сябе на тым, што цалкам захоплены. Ты перагортваеш старонкі так хутка, што нават не заўважаеш, як старажытны карэньчык пачынае расклейвацца...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AC4.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AC4.english: Can you solve the case before the cops close in?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AC4.polish: Czy zdołasz rozwiązać tę sprawę, zanim dopadnie cię policja?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AC4.belarusian: Ці зможаш ты раскрыць справу да таго, як паліцыя сцісне кола?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004ACA.english: Wait -- I've got some questions first.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004ACA.belarusian: Хвіліначку — спачатку ў мяне ёсць пара пытанняў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AD8.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004ADF.english: Why does everyone close to Dick Mullen wind up dead?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004ADF.polish: Czemu wszyscy bliscy Dickowi Mullenowi ludzie kończą jako trupy?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004ADF.belarusian: Чаму ўсе, хто блізкі да Дзіка Муллена, канчаюць смерцю?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AE5.english: Why did Dick Mullen become a detective in the first place?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AE5.polish: Czemu Dick Mullen w ogóle został detektywem?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AE5.belarusian: А чаму Дзік Муллен увогуле стаў дэтэктывам?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AEB.english: Why bother solving crimes when the world is so evil?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AEB.polish: Po co w ogóle rozwiązywać śledztwa, kiedy cały świat jest tak podły?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AEB.belarusian: Навошта наогул раскрываць злачынствы, калі свет такі злы?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AF1.english: I don't have any more questions. I've figured it all out.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AF1.polish: Nie mam więcej pytań. Już wszystko wiem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AF1.belarusian: У мяне больш няма пытанняў. Я ва ўсім разабраўся.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AFB.english: When was the last time *you* ravished a dame, detective? Besides your crusty old sock, that is.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AFB.polish: A kiedy *ty* ostatni raz wziąłeś namiętnie kobietę, detektywie? Twoja stara oblepiona skarpetka się nie liczy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004AFB.belarusian: Калі ты апошні раз спакушаў паненку, дэтэктыве? Калі не лічыць твайго закарэлага старога шкарпэтка, вядома.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B02.english: "That's probably for the best. Those books aren't exactly famed for their tight plotting."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B02.polish: „To chyba najlepsze rozwiązanie. Te książki nie słyną raczej z misternie splecionej fabuły”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B02.belarusian: "Гэта, мабыць, і да лепшага. Гэтыя кнігі не тое каб славяцца сваім закручаным сюжэтам".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B0F.english: It's much more about the dark and deadly atmossssphere.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B0F.polish: Chodzi dużo bardziej o mroczną i zabójczą atmosssssferę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B0F.belarusian: Усё гэта куды больш пра змрочную і смяротную атмасффферу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B1D.english: But also extremely *accurate*, in your case.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B1D.polish: Choć akurat w twoim wypadku wyjątkowo *trafny*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B1D.belarusian: Але ж і надзвычай *дакладны*, у тваім выпадку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B52.english: Nothing. Forget it. Go back to your story.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B52.belarusian: Нічога. Забудзь. Вяртайся да сваёй гісторыі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B5E.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B5E.english: It's a dangerous line of work, but somebody has to do it. That's why Dick Mullen never lets anyone get *too* close...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B5E.polish: To niebezpieczna robota, ale ktoś ją musi wykonywać. Dlatego właśnie Dick Mullen nigdy nie wiąże się z nikim *zbyt* mocno...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B5E.belarusian: Гэта небяспечная праца, але нехта мусіць яе рабіць. Вось чаму Дзік Муллен ніколі не падпускае нікога *занадта* блізка...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B64.english: What's the matter? Afraid you've been hacking up your friends' bodies in the night?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B64.polish: O co chodzi? Boisz się, że nocami ćwiartujesz ciała swoich przyjaciół?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B64.belarusian: У чым справа? Баішся, што па начах рассякаеш целы сваіх сяброў?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B6A.english: Have you gone over everyone? Is anybody missing?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B6A.polish: Pomyślałeś o wszystkich? Nie zaginął któryś?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B6A.belarusian: Ты пра ўсіх узгадаў? Ніхто не знік?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B7C.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B7C.english: Dick Mullen was made to crack skulls and solve cases. It's who he is. He could no more stop being a detective than a tiger could cease to be a predator in the night.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B7C.polish: Dick Mullen urodził się, aby rozbijać głowy i rozwiązywać sprawy. Taki po prostu jest. Nie mógł przestać być detektywem, tak jak tygrys nie może przestać być nocnym łowcą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B7C.belarusian: Дзік Муллен быў створаны, каб разбіваць чэрапы і закрываць справы. Вось хто ён такі. Ён настолькі ж не мог перастаць быць дэтэктывам, наколькі тыгр не можа перастаць быць начным драпежнікам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B83.english: But why is he like that?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B8A.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B8A.english: There was never a time when he wasn't a detective. He was born a detective.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B8A.polish: Nie było nigdy czasu, w którym nie był detektywem. Urodził się nim.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B8A.belarusian: Ніколі не было часу, калі ён не быў дэтэктывам. Ён нарадзіўся дэтэктывам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B92.english: Was I *not* born to be a detective?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B99.english: From nowhere, you hear the screech of sneakers on a waxed floor, and you feel the burn of rope against your hands. Are these figments of some other life?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B99.polish: Znienacka słyszysz niedobiegający znikąd pisk trampek na wypastowanej podłodze. Czujesz palącą twoją skórę na dłoniach linę. Czy to jakieś przebłyski innego życia?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004B99.belarusian: Ніадкуль ты чуеш рыпенне красовак па нацёртай падлозе і адчуваеш апёк ад вяроўкі на руках. Ці гэта пробліскі нейкага іншага жыцця?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BA0.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BA0.english: For a moment, you cease to read the story on the page and see the book for what it is, a collection of brittle, cheaply printed pages, held together by glue made from the hooves of horses...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BA0.polish: Przestajesz na chwilę śledzić fabułę i dostrzegasz książkę taką, jaka ona jest – zlepkiem kruchych, zadrukowanych tanim kosztem stronic połączonych klejem z końskich kopyt...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BA0.belarusian: На імгненне ты перастаеш сачыць за гісторыяй на старонках і бачыш кнігу такой, якая яна ёсць, — стосам ломкіх, танна надрукаваных старонак, змацаваных клеем з конскіх капытоў...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BA7.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BA7.english: You won't find the answers you're looking for here, in other words.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BA7.polish: Innymi słowy nie znajdziesz tu odpowiedzi, których potrzebujesz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BA7.belarusian: Іншымі словамі, адказаў, якія ты шукаеш, ты тут не знойдзеш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BB4.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BB4.english: Is it really so evil, detective?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BB4.polish: Czy aby na pewno jest aż tak podły, detektywie?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BB4.belarusian: Ці ён сапраўды такі злы, дэтэктыве?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BBB.english: Okay, maybe not. There are parts worth saving.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BBB.polish: No dobra, może nie. Niektóre części warto uratować.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BBB.belarusian: Добра, можа і не. Ёсць рэчы, вартыя выратавання.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BC2.english: Unfathomably evil. Death is infinitely preferable to this torment.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BC2.polish: Niewyobrażalnie podły. Śmierć jest o wiele lepsza od tej udręki.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BC2.belarusian: Непасціжна злы. Смерць куды лепшая за гэтую пакуту.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BC9.english: Good, evil, it makes no difference. These are the end times we're living in.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BC9.polish: Dobry, podły – to bez znaczenia. Żyjemy w dniach ostatecznych.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BC9.belarusian: Дабро, зло — няма розніцы. Мы жывем у апошнія часы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BD8.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BD8.english: Could be. Who knows? Only one way to find out.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BD8.polish: Może tak. Kto wie? Jest tylko jeden sposób, aby się przekonać.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BD8.belarusian: Можа быць. Хто ведае? Ёсць толькі адзін спосаб даведацца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BE1.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BE1.english: Have you been paying attention *at all*? It wasn't Mullen! It. Was. An. Imposter. Now go on, find out who *really* did it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BE1.polish: Czy ty *w ogóle* śledziłeś fabułę? To nie był Mullen! Tylko ktoś, kto się pod niego *podszył*. No, to już, dowiedz się, kto to zrobił *naprawdę*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BE1.belarusian: Ты *ўвогуле* слухаў? Гэта быў не Муллен! Гэта. Быў. Самазванец. А цяпер ідзі і высветлі, хто зрабіў гэта *насамрэч*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BF0.english: You know what? I don't even care. (Close the book.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BF0.polish: Wiesz co? W sumie to mnie to nie obchodzi. (Zamknij książkę).
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004BF0.belarusian: Ведаеш што? Мне ўвогуле пляваць. (Закрыць кнігу.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C0A.english: "Too bad, detective. If it's any consolation, the resolution is almost never very satisfying..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C0A.polish: „Przykro mi, detektywie. Nie wiem, czy cię to pocieszy, ale rozwiązanie zagadki prawie nigdy nie jest zbyt satysfakcjonujące...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C0A.belarusian: "Шкада, дэтэктыве. Калі гэта вас хоць неяк суцешыць, развязка амаль ніколі не бывае задавальняльнай..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C18.english: "And on that note, perhaps we should get back to making sense of our own case?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C18.polish: „Nawiasem mówiąc, może powinniśmy wracać do rozwiązania naszego własnego śledztwa?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C18.belarusian: "І ў сувязі з гэтым, магчыма, нам варта вярнуцца да разблытвання нашай уласнай справы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C26.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C26.english: Why? There's truly no point. You'll never know who did it, because those pages have literally been scattered to the wind.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C26.polish: Po co? Naprawdę nie ma sensu. Nigdy nie dowiesz się, kto jest winowajcą, bo strony książki zupełnie dosłownie porwał wiatr.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C26.belarusian: Навошта? У гэтым сапраўды няма сэнсу. Ты ніколі не даведаешся, хто гэта зрабіў, бо гэтыя старонкі літаральна развеяла па ветры.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C2D.english: I just want to relive the experience.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C2D.polish: Chcę po prostu przeżyć to jeszcze raz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C2D.belarusian: Я проста хачу перажыць гэты досвед зноў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C33.english: You're right. I should just quit. (Close the book.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C33.belarusian: Твая праўда. Лепей проста кінуць. (Закрыць кнігу.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C3B.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C3B.english: If you insist. But again, it's really pointless...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C3B.polish: Skoro nalegasz. Ale powtórzę – to naprawdę bezcelowe...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C3B.belarusian: Калі ты настойваеш. Але зноў жа, гэта зусім бессэнсоўна...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C4F.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C4F.english: And you'll never know what happens! Because the rest of the book is gone.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C4F.polish: I nigdy nie dowiesz się, co się stało. Bo reszta książki przepadła.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C4F.belarusian: І ты ніколі не даведаешся, што адбудзецца! Таму што рэшта кнігі знікла.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C56.english: I can surmise, can't I? If Mullen goes to jail there wouldn't be like fifty more of these books.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C56.polish: Ale mogę przyjąć jakieś założenie, nieprawdaż? Gdyby Mullen poszedł do więzienia, nie powstałoby jeszcze pięćdziesiąt czy ile tam kolejnych książek z serii.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C56.belarusian: Але ж я магу здагадацца, хіба не? Калі б Муллен сеў у турму, не было б яшчэ якіх паўсотні гэтых кніг.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C5C.english: Guess that's it, then. (Close the book.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C5C.polish: To by chyba było w takim razie na tyle. (Zamknij książkę).

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C69.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C69.english: What makes you think this isn't *the final Dick Mullen case*?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C69.polish: A skąd wniosek, że to nie jest *ostatnia sprawa Dicka Mullena*?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C69.belarusian: Чаму ты думаеш, што гэта не *апошняя справа Дзіка Муллена*?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C70.english: Isn't there already a book called "Dick Mullen and the Final Case" or something?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C70.polish: A nie ma już przypadkiem książki pod tytułem „Dick Mullen i ostatnia sprawa” czy jakoś tak?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C70.belarusian: А хіба няма ўжо кнігі пад назвай "Дзік Муллен і апошняя справа" ці неяк так?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C77.english: Okay, whatever, this is getting ridiculous. (Close the book.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C77.polish: Dobra, nieważne, to się robi absurdalne. (Zamknij książkę).
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C77.belarusian: Добра, як хочаш, гэта ўжо робіцца смешна. (Закрыць кнігу.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C7F.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C7F.english: How do you know this isn't the *final* final case?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C7F.polish: Ale skąd wiesz, że to nie *ostatnia* ostatnia sprawa?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C7F.belarusian: А адкуль ты ведаеш, што гэта не *самая* апошняя справа?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C8B.english: This could go on forever. End it now.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C8B.polish: Tak można bez końca. Ukróć to. Już.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C8B.belarusian: Гэта можа цягнуцца бясконца. Спыні гэта зараз жа.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C93.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C93.english: That's right. You never will. But then, isn't that how it is in real life, detective?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C93.polish: Zgadza się. Ale czy nie tak wygląda również prawdziwe życie, detektywie?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C93.belarusian: Менавіта так. Ніколі не даведаешся. Але хіба не так яно ў сапраўдным жыцці, дэтэктыве?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C9A.english: Last year, more than 71% of murders in Revachol went unsolved. In Revachol West, that number was closer to 85%.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C9A.polish: 71% spraw w Revacholu dotyczących morderstwa nie zostało rozwiązanych. W Zachodnim Revacholu odsetek ten był bliższy 85%.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004C9A.belarusian: У мінулым годзе больш за 71% забойстваў у Рэвашолі засталіся нераскрытымі. У Заходнім Рэвашолі гэтая лічба была бліжэй да 85%.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CAB.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CAB.english: Yes, blame a dead horse for your fat, clumsy fingers.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CAB.polish: Tak, obwiniaj martwego konia o to, że masz tłuste i niezdarne paluchy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CAB.belarusian: Так, вінаваці мёртвага каня ў сваіх тоўстых, няўклюдных пальцах.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CB6.english: You try to grab the pages as they come loose but your fingers aren't quick enough... they're gone.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CB6.polish: Próbujesz łapać odpadające strony, ale twoje palce są zbyt powolne... Na nic się to nie zdaje.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CB6.belarusian: Ты спрабуеш схапіць старонкі, калі яны выпадаюць, але твае пальцы недастаткова спрытныя... усё сышло.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CBE.english: Don't forget, it could have been the *delirium tremens*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CBE.polish: Nie zapominaj, że mogło to być też *delirium tremens*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CBE.belarusian: Не забывай, што гэта мог быць і *delirium tremens*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CC5.english: "Ah, yes. The problem with mass market paperbacks... They're not made to last..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CC5.polish: „Ach, tak. Typowe dla produkowanych masowo miękkich okładek... Trwałe to one nie są...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CC5.belarusian: "А, так. Праблема масавых кішэнных выданняў... Яны не разлічаныя на доўгі век..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CCB.english: "Perhaps this is a sign that you should get back to solving your own murder, eh, detective?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CCB.polish: „Może to znak, że powinniśmy zająć się naszą własną sprawą morderstwa, co detektywie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CCB.belarusian: "Магчыма, гэта знак, што вам варта вярнуцца да расследавання нашага ўласнага забойства, га, дэтэктыве?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CEB.english: You're no tiger, though, Harry. You're a man. It's your curse to have to choose.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CEB.polish: Ale ty nie jesteś tygrysem, Harry. Jesteś człowiekiem. Konieczność podejmowania wyborów to twoja klątwa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CEB.belarusian: Але ты не тыгр, Гары. Ты чалавек. Гэта твой праклён — мусіць рабіць выбар.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CF8.english: You're no tiger, though, detective. You're a man. It's your curse to have to choose.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CF8.polish: Ale ty nie jesteś tygrysem, detektywie. Jesteś człowiekiem. Konieczność podejmowania wyborów to twoja klątwa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004CF8.belarusian: Але ты не тыгр, дэтэктыве. Ты чалавек. Гэта твой праклён — мусіць рабіць выбар.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D08.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D16.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D16.english: Then why are you still here?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D16.belarusian: Тады чаму ты ўсё яшчэ тут?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D1D.english: Because I'm too chickenshit to do anything about it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D1D.polish: Bo za duży ze mnie tchórz, żeby coś z tym zrobić.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D1D.belarusian: Таму што я занадта баязлівы, каб хоць нешта з гэтым зрабіць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D23.english: Because I don't want to let Kim down.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D23.belarusian: Таму што не хачу падвесці Кіма.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D33.english: Because I need to solve this case. Not for anyone else's sake. For me.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D33.polish: Bo muszę rozwiązać tę sprawę. Dla siebie. Nie dla kogokolwiek innego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D33.belarusian: Таму што мне трэба раскрыць гэтую справу. Не дзеля кагосьці іншага. Дзеля сябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D46.english: The taste of a good cigarette.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D4E.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D62.english: I might. I just need to find them.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D62.polish: Może mam. Muszę ich tylko znaleźć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D62.belarusian: Можа і ёсць. Мне проста трэба іх знайсці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D69.english: I did, but I lost them.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D77.english: What's a *book* know about real pleasure? What's better than feeling your mesolimbic pathway flood your mind-crevices with *pure* dopamine?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D77.polish: A co *książka* może wiedzieć o prawdziwej przyjemności? Co jest lepsze niż zalewający twój umysł *czystą* dopaminą mezolimbiczny szlak dopaminergiczny?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D77.belarusian: Што нейкая *кніга* ведае пра сапраўдную асалоду? Што можа быць лепш, чым адчуваць, як мезалімбічны шлях залівае шчыліны твайго розуму *чыстым* дафамінам?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D80.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D80.english: You haven't been treating the lieutenant much like a friend, though, have you?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D80.polish: Ale nie traktujesz porucznika za bardzo jak przyjaciela, nieprawdaż?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D80.belarusian: Але ты не надта ставішся да лейтэнанта як да сябра, праўда?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D87.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D87.english: Just make sure you don't lose him. You'll not find another like him...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D87.polish: Tylko zadbaj o to, żeby go nie stracisz. Nie znajdziesz więcej kogoś takiego...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004D87.belarusian: Толькі глядзі не згубі яго. Другога такога ты не знойдзеш...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DA5.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DA5.english: Did you lose them? Or did they leave you? Do you even know the difference?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DA5.polish: Straciłeś ich? A może cię zostawili? Wiesz w ogóle, jaka jest różnica?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DA5.belarusian: Ты згубіў іх? Ці яны сышлі ад цябе? Ты ўвогуле ведаеш розніцу?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DAE.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DAE.english: There are worse things in the world than the pursuit of chemical pleasures. But there are better things, too...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DAE.polish: Są na świecie gorsze rzeczy niż pościg za chemicznymi przyjemnościami. Ale są i lepsze...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DAE.belarusian: У свеце ёсць рэчы і горшыя за пагоню за хімічнымі асалодамі. Але ёсць і лепшыя...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DBC.english: Why are you even still reading this garbage? You've got smokes to find!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DBC.polish: Po co ty jeszcze czytasz tego śmiecia? Musisz znaleźć fajki!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DBC.belarusian: Чаму ты ўвогуле яшчэ чытаеш гэтае смецце? Табе трэба знайсці курыва!

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DC3.english: What's a *book* know about real pleasure? What's better than feeling your mesolimbic pathway flood your mind-crevices with *pure* dopamine?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DC3.polish: A co *książka* może wiedzieć o prawdziwej przyjemności? Co jest lepsze niż zalewający twój umysł *czystą* dopaminą mezolimbiczny szlak dopaminergiczny?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DC3.belarusian: Што нейкая *кніга* ведае пра сапраўдную асалоду? Што можа быць лепш, чым адчуваць, як мезалімбічны шлях залівае шчыліны твайго розуму *чыстым* дафамінам?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DD1.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DD1.english: You don't know how you know, but you can feel this book *laughing* at you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DD1.polish: Nie wiesz, skąd to wiesz, ale czujesz, że ta książka się z ciebie *naśmiewa*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DD1.belarusian: Ты не ведаеш, адкуль гэта ведаеш, але адчуваеш, як гэтая кніга з цябе *смяецца*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DD8.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DD8.english: *Art*? You think contemplating *art* is going to save you?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DE5.english: Yeah, I do. I'm the god damn art cop, after all.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DE5.polish: Tak, tak myślę. W końcu jestem cholernym artystycznym gliną.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DE5.belarusian: Так, думаю. Я ўсё ж такі чортаў арт-коп.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DED.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DED.english: Whatever you say, *art cop*. The book has stopped laughing, but you can feel it grinning smugly at you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DED.polish: Pogadaj sobie, *artystyczny glino*. Książka przestała się śmiać, ale czujesz, że wciąż się szyderczo uśmiecha.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004DED.belarusian: Як скажаш, *арт-коп*. Кніга перастала смяяцца, але ты адчуваеш, як яна самазадаволена табе скаліцца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E18.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E18.english: You know you look like a mad man, right? Giving an inanimate object the finger like that.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E18.polish: Wiesz, że wyglądasz jak wariat, prawda? Pokazujesz nieożywionemu przedmiotowi środkowy palec.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E18.belarusian: Ты ж разумееш, што выглядаеш як вар'ят? Паказваць неадушаўлёнаму прадмету сярэдні палец вось так.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E1E.english: Hey, fuck you book! (Give the book the finger.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E1E.polish: Ej, pierdol się, książko! (Pokaż jej środkowy palec).
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E1E.belarusian: Гэй, ідзі ты ў дупу, кніга! (Паказаць кнізе сярэдні палец.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E39.english: "This book is making fun of my sincerest beliefs."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E39.polish: „Ta książka naśmiewa się z moich najszczerszych przekonań”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E39.belarusian: "Гэтая кніга насміхаецца з маіх самых шчырых перакананняў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E40.english: "Then perhaps you should stop reading it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E40.polish: „W takim razie być może powinieneś przestać ją czytać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E40.belarusian: "Тады, магчыма, вам варта спыніць яе чытаць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E47.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E47.english: But you can't stop, can you? You've got to find out what happens.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E47.polish: Ale nie możesz przestać, prawda? Musisz się dowiedzieć, co było dalej.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E47.belarusian: Але ты не можаш спыніцца, праўда? Табе ж трэба даведацца, што будзе далей.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E5A.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E5A.english: You haven't been treating the lieutenant much like a friend, though, have you?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E5A.polish: Ale nie traktujesz porucznika za bardzo jak przyjaciela, nieprawdaż?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E5A.belarusian: Але ты не надта ставішся да лейтэнанта як да сябра, праўда?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E64.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E64.english: Just make sure you don't lose him. You'll not find another like him...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E64.polish: Tylko zadbaj o to, żeby go nie stracisz. Nie znajdziesz więcej kogoś takiego...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E64.belarusian: Толькі глядзі не згубі яго. Другога такога ты не знойдзеш...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E6F.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E6F.english: It sounds like you're in for a long, hard road, detective...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E6F.polish: Zdaje się, że przed tobą długa i trudna droga, detektywie...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E6F.belarusian: Падобна на тое, што цябе чакае доўгі і цяжкі шлях, дэтэктыве...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E77.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E77.english: But then what does this book know? It's just a poorly made piece of pulp garbage, made to be consumed and discarded.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E77.polish: Ale co ta książka może wiedzieć? To tylko tandetnie sklecony literacki śmieć przeznaczony do skonsumowania i wyrzucenia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E77.belarusian: Але што гэтая кніга ведае? Гэта проста няякасна злепленае таннае смецце, створанае, каб яго спажылі і выкінулі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E82.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E82.english: What are you trying to prove, exactly? And what will change if you *do* manage to prove it?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E82.polish: Co ty w właściwie próbujesz udowodnić? I co się zmieni, jeśli ci się to *uda*?
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E82.belarusian: Што менавіта ты спрабуеш давесці? І што зменіцца, калі табе *ўдасца* гэта давесці?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E91.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E91.english: But then what does this book know? It's just a poorly made piece of pulp garbage, made to be consumed and discarded.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E91.polish: Ale co ta książka może wiedzieć? To tylko tandetnie sklecony literacki śmieć przeznaczony do skonsumowania i wyrzucenia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004E91.belarusian: Але што гэтая кніга ведае? Гэта проста няякасна злепленае таннае смецце, створанае, каб яго спажылі і выкінулі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EA4.english: Yes, yes. They're out there waiting for you, just over the next rise, up on Marvel Hill!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EA4.polish: Tak, tak. Czekają gdzieś tam na ciebie. Zaraz za następnym zakrętem. Tam, na Cudownej Górze!
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EA4.belarusian: Так, так. Яны там, чакаюць цябе, адразу за наступным узгоркам, на Дзівосным Пагорку!

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EAD.english: You haven't. But it's not too late. You share a bond that's thicker than blood.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EAD.polish: Nie traktujesz. Ale jeszcze nie jest za późno. Łączy was więź mocniejsza od krwi.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EAD.belarusian: Не ставішся. Але яшчэ не позна. Вас звязваюць путы, мацнейшыя за кроў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EB4.english: It's true in more ways than you know.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EB4.polish: To prawda. Na więcej sposobów, niż ci się wydaje.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EB4.belarusian: Гэта праўда ў большай ступені, чым ты думаеш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EBB.english: You haven't. But it's not too late. You share a bond that's thicker than blood.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EBB.polish: Nie traktujesz. Ale jeszcze nie jest za późno. Łączy was więź mocniejsza od krwi.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EBB.belarusian: Не ставішся. Але яшчэ не позна. Вас звязваюць путы, мацнейшыя за кроў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EC1.english: It's true in more ways than you know.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EC1.polish: To prawda. Na więcej sposobów, niż ci się wydaje.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000004EC1.belarusian: Гэта праўда ў большай ступені, чым ты думаеш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063FF.english: The man's a prosecutor's nightmare. Solving a murder counts for nothing if all the evidence gets thrown out in court over police misconduct.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063FF.polish: Ten człowiek to koszmar prokuratora. Rozwiązanie sprawy morderstwa nic nie znaczy, jeśli sąd odrzuca wszelkie dowody z powodu zaniedbań policji.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063FF.belarusian: Гэты чалавек — кашмар для пракурора. Раскрыццё забойства нічога не вартае, калі ўсе доказы адхіляюцца ў судзе праз парушэнні паліцыі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006409.english: I'm not sure I'm happy with this, but maybe the story will turn it around.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006409.polish: Nie wiem, czy mi się to podoba, ale może fabuła jakoś to wytłumaczy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006409.belarusian: Не ўпэўнены, што мне гэта падабаецца, але, можа, гісторыя яшчэ выправіцца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006423.english: Your partner. Kim will be there for me.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006423.belarusian: Свайму напарніку. Кім заўсёды будзе побач.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000642A.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000642A.english: Will *you* be there for *him*, though, when push comes to shove? Time will tell. In the meantime, let's get on with the story...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000642A.polish: Ale czy *ty* będziesz wspierał *jego*, jak przyjdzie co do czego? Czas pokaże. A na razie skupmy się znów na fabule...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000642A.belarusian: Але ці будзеш *ты* побач з *ім*, калі прыйдзе час? Час пакажа. А пакуль што вернемся да гісторыі...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006439.english: Uh, I'll think about it. Better get on with the story first.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006439.polish: Hmm, przemyślę to. Ale najpierw zajmę się lepiej fabułą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006439.belarusian: Э-э, я падумаю. Лепей спачатку працягнуць гісторыю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006441.english: Don't you sass me. Get on with the story.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006441.polish: Nie cwaniakuj mi tu. Skup się na fabule.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006441.belarusian: Не дзярзі мне тут. Давай далей па гісторыі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006455.english: I don't really like where this is going. (Close the book.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006455.polish: Nie podoba mi się, do czego to zmierza. (Zamknij książkę).
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006455.belarusian: Мне не надта падабаецца, куды гэта вядзе. (Закрыць кнігу.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000647E.english: Drugs. You know it's all about the drugs.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000647E.polish: Narkotyki. Wiesz, że w życiu chodzi o narkotyki.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000647E.belarusian: Наркотыкі. Ты ж ведаеш, што ўсё дзеля наркотыкаў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006483.english: The smooth taste of some ultra-high-proof booze.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006488.english: The sweet taste of a good cigarette, which I still need to find.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006488.polish: Słodki smak dobrego papierosa, którego wciąż nie mam i muszę znaleźć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006488.belarusian: Салодкі смак добрай цыгарэты, якую мне ўсё яшчэ трэба знайсці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006494.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006494.english: There are worse things in the world than the pursuit of chemical pleasures. But there are better things, too...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006494.polish: Są na świecie gorsze rzeczy niż pościg za chemicznymi przyjemnościami. Ale są i lepsze...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B00006494.belarusian: У свеце ёсць рэчы і горшыя за пагоню за хімічнымі асалодамі. Але ёсць і лепшыя...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000649B.actor: Dick Mullen and the Mistaken Identity
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000649B.english: There are worse things in the world than the pursuit of chemical pleasures. But there are better things, too...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000649B.polish: Są na świecie gorsze rzeczy niż pościg za chemicznymi przyjemnościami. Ale są i lepsze...
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B0000649B.belarusian: У свеце ёсць рэчы і горшыя за пагоню за хімічнымі асалодамі. Але ёсць і лепшыя...

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000064A7.english: What's a *book* know about real pleasure? What's better than feeling your mesolimbic pathway flood your mind-crevices with *pure* dopamine?
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000064A7.polish: A co *książka* może wiedzieć o prawdziwej przyjemności? Co jest lepsze niż zalewający twój umysł *czystą* dopaminą mezolimbiczny szlak dopaminergiczny?
