Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FE5B.english: A dull despair is creeping into her voice.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FE5B.polish: W jej głosie pojawia się przytępiona nuta rozpaczy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FE5B.belarusian: Цьмяны роспач пракрадаецца ў яе голас.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FE70.english: "...how the fuck do the rest of you get by?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FE70.polish: „...to jak, do cholery, radzi sobie reszta?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FE79.english: Does she mean that you're not a person whom other people like?
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FE79.polish: Czy ona chce powiedzieć, że nie jesteś osobą, którą lubią inni?
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FE79.belarusian: Ці мае яна на ўвазе, што ты не той чалавек, які можа падабацца іншым?

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FE80.english: "Aw, fuck. Took some convincing my ass. And those guys *liked* me -- I know it. If this is what happens to people whom people like..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FE80.polish: „Cholera. Urabiać, jasne. A ci kolesie mnie *lubili* – tego jestem pewna. Jeśli ludzie robią coś takiego komuś, kogo lubią, to...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FE80.belarusian: "Вой, бляха. Неяк уламаў, ага, расказвай. А гэтым хлопцам я *падабалася* — я ведаю. Калі вось так абыходзяцца з тымі, хто людзям падабаецца..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FE88.english: She pauses, taking it in. "Well, fuck. And those guys *liked* me -- I know it. If this is what happens to people whom people like..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FE88.polish: Przyjmuje to do wiadomości w milczeniu. „Cholera. A ci kolesie mnie *lubili* – tego jestem pewna. Jeśli ludzie robią coś takiego komuś, kogo lubią, to...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FE88.belarusian: Яна робіць паўзу, асэнсоўваючы пачутае. "Ну і бляха. А гэтым хлопцам я *падабалася* — я ведаю. Калі вось так абыходзяцца з тымі, хто людзям падабаецца..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FFD4.english: Rows and rows of poppies, most of which have lost their pink bloom, flank his steps. The man looks around, then up at the sky; sighs.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FFD4.polish: Mija kolejne rzędy maków, z których większość zdążyła już przekwitnąć. Rozgląda się, po czym z westchnieniem spogląda w niebo.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FFD4.belarusian: Шэрагі і шэрагі макаў, большасць з якіх ужо скінулі ружовыя пялёсткі, абрамляюць яго крокі. Мужчына азіраецца, потым глядзіць у неба; уздыхае.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FFDC.english: Taking out a knife, he crouches at the end of one flower bed. He scores a seedpod, very gently. Milky sap begins to ooze out. The pain comes over you again...
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FFDC.polish: Wyciąga nóż i przykuca przy krańcu jednego z klombów. Nacina bardzo delikatnie strąk, z którego zaczyna wyciekać mleczny sok. Ponownie ogarnia cię ból...
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000FFDC.belarusian: Дастаўшы нож, ён прысядае каля краю адной з клумбаў. Ён вельмі асцярожна робіць надрэз на макаўцы. Пачынае выцякаць малочны сок. Боль зноў апаноўвае цябе...

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000100D0.english: "If you didn't kill him... why hide?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000100D0.polish: „Skoro go nie zabiłaś... to po co się ukrywać?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000100D0.belarusian: "Калі ты яго не забівала... навошта хавацца?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000100E9.english: "What do you mean... La Puta Madre agent?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000100E9.belarusian: "Што ты маеш на ўвазе... агент La Puta Madre?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000100F0.english: "Yes -- you." She looks at you quizzically. "Everyone says you're his peone. His 'Human Can Opener.'"
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000100F0.polish: „Tak – to ty” – stwierdza, przyglądając ci się ze zmieszaniem. „Wszyscy mówią, że jesteś jego peonem. Jego »ludzkim otwieraczem do puszek«”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000100F0.belarusian: "Так — ты", - яна глядзіць на цябе са здзіўленнем. - "Усе кажуць, што ты яго пешка. Яго 'Чалавечы адкаркоўнік'".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010128.english: Through the sudden sharp pain in your head, you hear the lieutenant mumble something to himself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010128.polish: Wśród nagłego i ostrego bólu głowy słyszysz porucznika mamroczącego coś do siebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010128.belarusian: Скрозь раптоўны востры боль у галаве ты чуеш, як лейтэнант мармыча нешта сабе пад нос.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010130.english: "Fucking hell" and "Why me?" you hear through the white noise.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010130.polish: Przez szum docierają do twojej świadomości jego słowa: „jebana mać” i „dlaczego ja?”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010130.belarusian: "Праклятае пекла" і "Чаму я?" — чуеш ты скрозь белы шум.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010138.english: "He was still warm, but the blueish light coming through the broken window made him look as though he'd been dead for a good long while..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010138.polish: „Wciąż był ciepły, ale niebieskawe światło wpadające do środka przez rozbite okno sprawiało, że wyglądał, jakby był martwy od dłuższego czasu...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010138.belarusian: "Ён быў яшчэ цёплы, але сіняватае святло, што падала скрозь разбітае акно, рабіла яго падобным на чалавека, які памёр ужо даўным-даўно..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010140.english: Those rings around her eyes, her tired voice -- she's been staying up late listening in on the conversations criss-crossing Martinaise.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010140.polish: Te jej podkrążone oczy, zmęczony głos... Siedziała nocami do późna, podsłuchując toczone w Martinaise rozmowy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005800010140.belarusian: Гэтыя кругі пад вачыма, яе стомлены голас — яна сядзела начамі дапазна, падслухоўваючы размовы, што перасякалі Марцінэз уздоўж і ўпоперак.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580001014C.english: "Who hasn't?" She shrugs. "You know, I can still see him there, in Klaasje's room, lying on his side."
Dialogue Text/0x010000580001014C.polish: „A kto nie śledził?” – odpowiada, wzruszając ramionami. „Wciąż go widzę, w pokoju Klaasje... Leżącego na boku”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580001014C.belarusian: "А хто не сачыў?" — яна паціскае плячыма. - "Ведаеш, я дагэтуль бачу яго там, у пакоі Клаас'е, як ён ляжыць на баку".

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000102B9.english: No, wait, finally, it comes to you, a way to connect with her:
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000102B9.polish: Nie, poczekaj. W końcu przychodzi ci do głowy sposób, jak osiągnąć z nią porozumienie:
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000102B9.belarusian: Не, пачакай, нарэшце да цябе даходзіць, як знайсці з ёй агульную мову:

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000102BF.english: "I know your pain! I've been let down by women too."
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000102BF.polish: „Znam twój ból! Ja też doznawałem zawodu ze strony kobiet”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000102BF.belarusian: "Я ведаю твой боль! Мяне жанчыны таксама падводзілі".

Dialogue Text/0x01000058000102C5.english: A smirk crosses her face as she watches you stand there, mute. Then she exhales sharply, shakes her head, and pulls the trigger.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000102C5.polish: Na jej twarzy pojawia się uśmieszek, gdy patrzy na ciebie stojącego bez słowa. Robi głośny wydech, kręci głową i wciska spust.
Dialogue Text/0x01000058000102C5.belarusian: Усмешка мільгае на яе твары, пакуль яна глядзіць, як ты стаіш там, анямелы. Затым яна рэзка выдыхае, хітае галавой і спускае кручок.

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009B9.english: "She asked me to help her drag him into the shower so she could wind the shower head around his neck. To fake lividity. Then she dressed him while I went to get the Hardie boys."
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009B9.polish: „Poprosiła mnie, abym pomogła jej zaciągnąć go pod prysznic. Owinęła wąż od prysznica wokół jego szyi – chodziło o uzyskanie odpowiedniego zasinienia. Później ubrała go, a ja w tym czasie poszłam na dół po chłopaków Hardiego”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009B9.belarusian: "Яна папрасіла мяне дапамагчы зацягнуць яго ў душ, каб яна магла абматаць лейку вакол яго шыі. Каб падрабіць трупныя плямы. Потым яна апранула яго, пакуль я пайшла па хлопцаў Хардзі".

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009CE.english: "That's... bad -- that she'd be so calm..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009CE.belarusian: "Гэта... кепска — што яна была такой спакойнай..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009E3.english: "Yeah, I wasn't sure whether to admire her -- or be disturbed."
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009E3.polish: „Taa... Nie byłam pewna, czy podziwiać ją za to, czy czuć zaniepokojenie”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009E3.belarusian: "Так, я не ведала, ці захапляцца ёю — ці жахацца".

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009EB.english: "I really don't care which one of us you think was more at fault for the 'lynching.' Neither of us killed him, though."
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009EB.polish: „Naprawdę nie obchodzi mnie, która z nas według was była bardziej odpowiedzialna za ten »lincz«. Tak czy siak, to nie my go zabiłyśmy”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009EB.belarusian: "Мне сапраўды ўсё роўна, каго з нас ты лічыш больш вінаватай у 'самасудзе'. Але ніхто з нас яго не забіваў".

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009F2.english: "How can you be sure... Klaasje didn't kill him herself?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009F2.polish: „Skąd ta pewność... że Klaasje sama go nie zabiła?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009F2.belarusian: "Адкуль ты можаш быць упэўненая... што Клаас'е не забіла яго сама?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009F9.english: "The shot was made from a distance -- otherwise we would have heard it downstairs. Besides, she had good reason to not draw attention to herself."
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009F9.polish: „Strzał oddano z oddali – gdyby było inaczej, usłyszelibyśmy na dole huk. Poza tym ona miała dobry powód, aby nie zwracać na siebie uwagi”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000009F9.belarusian: "Стрэл быў зроблены здалёк — інакш мы пачулі б унізе. Да таго ж у яе была важкая прычына не прыцягваць да сябе ўвагі".

Alternate1/0x01000071000009F9.polish: „Jak już mówiłam, nie słyszeliśmy niczego na dole. Żadnych strzałów, żadnego huku”.
Alternate1/0x01000071000009F9.belarusian: "Я ж кажу вам, копам: мы ўнізе нічога не чулі. Ні стрэлу, нічога".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000A01.english: "Do you... think she might have killed the merc herself?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000A01.belarusian: "Як думаеш... ці магла яна сама забіць найміта?"

Alternate1/0x0100007100000A01.belarusian: "Як думаеш... ці магла яна сама... забіць Лелі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000A09.english: "And potentially bring attention to herself? No. Besides, the shot was made from a distance -- otherwise we would have heard it downstairs."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000A09.polish: „Miałaby ryzykować zwrócenie na siebie uwagi? Nie. Poza tym strzelono do niego z oddali – gdyby było inaczej, usłyszelibyśmy na dole huk”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000A09.belarusian: "І патэнцыйна прыцягнуць да сябе ўвагу? Не. Да таго ж стрэл быў зроблены здалёк — інакш мы пачулі б унізе".

Alternate1/0x0100007100000A09.polish: „Jak już mówiłam, nie słyszeliśmy niczego na dole. Żadnych strzałów, żadnego huku”.
Alternate1/0x0100007100000A09.belarusian: "Я ж кажу вам, копам: мы ўнізе нічога не чулі. Ні стрэлу, нічога".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000AD7.english: It's like a thousand radio stations are being blasted into your head all at once, but her words are the only ones you can make out.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000AD7.polish: To tak, jakby naraz twoją głowę bombardowano tysiącem radiostacji. Rozróżnić w tym harmidrze jesteś jednak w stanie tylko jej słowa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000AD7.belarusian: Быццам тысяча радыёстанцый адначасова грыміць у тваёй галаве, але толькі яе словы ты можаш разабраць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000AE3.english: Take out all the good parts of pyrholidon, leave all the bad parts, and make a brain-bomb. In a constant state of exploding. That's this.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000AE3.polish: Zabierz pyrholidonowi wszystko, co dobre, zostaw wszystko, co złe, i zrób z tego mózgową bombę. Taką, która eksploduje bez końca. Właśnie to teraz przeżywasz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000AE3.belarusian: Забяры з піралідону ўсё добрае, пакінь усё дрэннае і зрабі з гэтага бомбу для мазгоў. Якая знаходзіцца ў стане бесперапыннага выбуху. Вось гэта яно і ёсць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B02.english: This must be the pale emitter Fat Angus mentioned.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B02.polish: To musi być ten emiter szaroty, o którym wspominał Gruby Angus.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B02.belarusian: Гэта, мусіць, той эмітар цьмянасці, пра які згадваў Тоўсты Ангус.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B1F.english: The explosion of static you're hearing -- it's the ULAN frequency.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B1F.polish: Ta eksplozja szumów, którą słyszysz – to częstotliwość ULAN.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B1F.belarusian: Выбух перашкод, які ты чуеш, — гэта частата ULAN.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B29.english: "I saw your equations... It's the ULAN frequency!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B29.belarusian: "Я бачыў твае ўраўненні... Гэта частата ULAN!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B2F.english: "*Saw my equations*?" She snorts. "You've been sniffing through my lorry, right? I expected as much. I *am* a bit surprised you knew what you were looking at..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B2F.polish: „*Widziałeś moje równania*?” – parska. „Węszyłeś w mojej ciężarówce, tak? Spodziewałam się tego. Ale *jestem* odrobinę zaskoczona, że wiedziałeś, na co patrzysz...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B2F.belarusian: "*Бачыў мае ўраўненні*?" — хмыкае яна. - "Ты корпаўся ў маім грузавіку, так? Я так і думала. Але я *сапраўды* крыху здзіўленая, што ты зразумеў, на што глядзіш..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B3E.english: Blasted from that pale emitter Fat Angus mentioned.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B3E.polish: Nadawana z pełną mocą przez ten emiter szaroty, o którym wspominał Gruby Angus.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B3E.belarusian: Якая грыміць з таго эмітара цьмянасці, пра які згадваў Тоўсты Ангус.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B4A.english: "You're using one of those devices used to send signals through the pale on me!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B4A.polish: „Używasz na mnie jednego z tych urządzeń do przesyłania sygnałów przez szarotę!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B4A.belarusian: "Ты выкарыстоўваеш на мне адну з тых прылад для перадачы сігналаў скрозь цьмянасць!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B52.english: "Wow, check out the big brains on you." She sounds impressed. "You're not entirely wrong..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B52.polish: „O rety, ależ ty masz mózgownicę” – stwierdza z uznaniem. „Mylisz się, ale nie całkiem...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B52.belarusian: "Ого, паглядзіце на гэтага акадэміка", - у яе голасе гучыць уражанасць. - "Ты памыляешся, але не зусім..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B7C.english: She's been holed up in here for a while with no one to talk to. Keep her talking, and you just might get an opportunity to break loose.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B7C.polish: Tkwiła tu ładny kawałek czasu, nie mając z kim porozmawiać. Zadbaj o to, żeby nie przestawała gadać, a może trafi ci się okazja, żeby się uwolnić.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B7C.belarusian: Яна засела тут даволі даўно, і пагаварыць не было з кім. Трымай яе ў размове, і ў цябе з'явіцца шанец вырвацца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B84.english: "That's illegal. I'm guessing it's patented... But we're beyond that, aren't we?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B84.polish: „To nielegalne. Zgaduję, że to urządzenie jest chronione patentem... Ale w tej chwili to najmniejszy problem, prawda?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B84.belarusian: "Гэта незаконна. Мяркую, што гэта запатэнтавана... Але мы ўжо далёка за гэтай мяжой, ці не так?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B8B.english: "Oh yeah. *Way* beyond." She studies her death ray and the law officials trapped in it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B8B.polish: „O tak. *Zdecydowanie* najmniejszy” – przygląda się uważnie swojemu promieniowi śmierci i uwięzionym w nim stróżom prawa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B8B.belarusian: "О так. *Далёка* за ёй", - яна разглядае свой прамень смерці і праваахоўнікаў, злоўленых у яго.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B93.english: Hzzzzzssssss... 342455797... Tere kallis... Hzzzzzzzssss... Palun ära ole ometi nii pilves, ometi nii pilves mu tüdruk... Hzzzzzzssss... 4464544829... hzzzssss... hzzzzssss...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B93.polish: Szszszsz... 342455797... Tere kallis... Szszszsz... Palun ära ole ometi nii pilves, ometi nii pilves mu tüdruk... Szszszsz... 4464544829... szszszsz... szszszsz...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B93.belarusian: Хссссссссссс... 342455797... Tere kallis... Хссссссссссс... Palun ära ole ometi nii pilves, ometi nii pilves mu tüdruk... Хссссссссссс... 4464544829... хссс... хссс...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B9D.english: "Please, could you just turn it down... so I can... ask you something?" (Move on.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B9D.polish: „Proszę, czy możesz to wyłączyć... żebym... mógł cię o coś spytać?” (Przejdź dalej).
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000B9D.belarusian: "Калі ласка, ці не магла б ты проста прыцішыць яго... каб я мог... спытаць у цябе нешта?" (Рушыць далей.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BA3.english: "*Please*, turn it off! I can't take it anymore!" (Move on.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BA3.polish: „*Proszę*, wyłącz to! Nie zniosę tego dłużej!” (Przejdź dalej).
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BA3.belarusian: "*Калі ласка*, выключы яго! Я больш не магу!" (Рушыць далей.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BB4.english: "You're big boys, you can handle it. Stop being so damned melodramatic."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BB4.polish: „Jesteście dużymi chłopcami, zniesiecie to. Nie dramatyzuj tak, do cholery”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BB4.belarusian: "Вы дарослыя хлопчыкі, вытрымаеце. Хопіць разводзіць гэтую клятую драму".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BBB.english: "This is all... great, but let's talk... about the man who was killed."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BBB.polish: „Wszystko... pięknie, ale porozmawiajmy... o zabitym mężczyźnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BBB.belarusian: "Усё гэта... цудоўна, але давай пагаворым... пра забітага мужчыну".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BC2.english: "Yeah, let's not talk about *that* shit. You were hunting me and fell into my trap instead. That's all there is to say about it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BC2.polish: „Taa... Lepiej nie rozmawiajmy o *tym* gównie. Polowaliście na mnie, ale wpadliście w moją pułapkę. I tyle w temacie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BC2.belarusian: "Так, давай без гэтай хуйні. Вы палявалі на мяне і замест гэтага патрапілі ў маю пастку. Вось і ўсё, што можна пра гэта сказаць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BCC.english: So she thinks of you as hunters -- not cops -- and of herself merely as prey.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BCC.polish: A więc uważa was za myśliwych – nie gliniarzy – siebie zaś tylko za zwierzynę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BCC.belarusian: Значыць, яна лічыць вас паляўнічымі — а не копамі — а сябе толькі здабычай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BD8.english: "Fine. I can dial it down. I've also got a gun, by the way." She steps reluctantly out of the shadows. The pain lessens.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BD8.polish: „Dobra, mogę to trochę przykręcić. Uprzedzam, że mam też pistolet” – wychodzi niechętnie z cienia. Ból maleje.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BD8.belarusian: "Добра. Я магу прыкруціць. Дарэчы, у мяне яшчэ ёсць пісталет", - яна неахвотна выкатваецца з ценю. Боль сціхае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BDE.english: "236189281... If you're looking for a deal on mattresses... SUHSUHSUHSPEEDFRRRR... 23567... 32971047302819... O' strange light, O' light of mine.."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BDE.polish: „236189281... Jeśli szukasz materaca w dobrej cenie... NNNNNASPEEEEEEDO... 23567... 32971047302819... O, przedziwne światło, o, światło moje...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BDE.belarusian: "236189281... Калі вы шукаеце добрую зніжку на матрацы... ССССПІДЫЫЫЫЫ... 23567... 32971047302819... О дзіўнае святло, о маё святло.."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BE4.english: "Damn... this..." The lieutenant clutches his head, grimacing.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BE4.polish: „Niech to... szlag...” – porucznik ściska swoją głowę rękami i wykrzywia twarz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BE4.belarusian: "Чорт... вазьмі..." — лейтэнант сціскае галаву рукамі, скрывіўшыся ад болю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BED.english: "Goddamnit." She regards you and Kim with sudden sympathy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BED.polish: „Cholera jasna” – nagle kobieta spogląda na ciebie i Kima ze współczuciem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BED.belarusian: "Кляты чорт", - яна глядзіць на цябе і Кіма з раптоўнай спачувальнасцю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BF3.english: "Goddamnit." She regards you and Kim with sudden sympathy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BF3.polish: „Cholera jasna” – nagle kobieta spogląda na ciebie i Kima ze współczuciem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000BF3.belarusian: "Чорт бы пабраў", - яна глядзіць на цябе і Кіма з раптоўнай спачувальнасцю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000C0C.english: She's carrying a two-barrelled front-loader. Remain careful.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000C0C.belarusian: Яна трымае двухствольную дульназарадную стрэльбу. Будзь асцярожны.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100000C1B.english: "The pale? It's the end of the world."

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063B9.english: "I do it by... asking questions. And I have some for you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063B9.polish: „Radzę sobie... zadając pytania. I mam ich kilka do ciebie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063B9.belarusian: "Я спраўляюся... задаючы пытанні. І ў мяне ёсць некалькі да цябе".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063C0.english: "Wait, wasn't it... you who called me the *human can opener*? It's not personal. I... opened them up."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063C0.polish: „Zaraz, czy to nie ty... nazwałaś mnie *ludzkim otwieraczem do puszek*? To nic osobistego, po prostu... ich otworzyłem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063C0.belarusian: "Пачакай, хіба гэта не ты... назвала мяне *чалавечым адкаркоўнікам*? Нічога асабістага. Я проста... адкаркаваў іх".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063C5.english: "Like what?" She adjusts her grip on her gun. "I already told you I didn't do it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063C5.polish: „Jakie, na przykład?” – pyta, poprawiając swój chwyt na trzymanej broni. „Powiedziałam już, że tego nie zrobiłam”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063C5.belarusian: "Якія яшчэ?" — яна папраўляе хватку на ствале. - "Я ўжо казала табе, што гэта не я".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063DA.english: "Honestly, I don't know how I do it... I just stumbled in here. Can you... please explain this shit to me?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063DA.polish: „Szczerze mówiąc, nie wiem, jak sobie radzę... Po prostu natknąłem się na to miejsce. Możesz... proszę, wyjaśnić mi ten syf?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063DA.belarusian: "Шчыра кажучы, не ведаю, як я спраўляюся... Я проста набрыў сюды. Можаш... растлумачыць мне гэтую лухту?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063E1.english: "What shit?" She adjusts her grip on her gun. "I told you I didn't do it. Sounds pretty simple to me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063E1.polish: „Jaki syf?” – pyta, poprawiając swój chwyt na trzymanej broni. „Powiedziałam już, że tego nie zrobiłam. Według mnie to nic skomplikowanego”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063E1.belarusian: "Якую лухту?" — яна папраўляе хватку на ствале. - "Я сказала табе, што гэта не я. Як на мяне, усё даволі проста".

Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063E9.english: A strong moral compass. She still wants the opportunity to make a case for herself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063E9.polish: Ma silny kompas moralny. Nadal chce mieć szansę wyłożyć swoje racje.
Dialogue Text/0x0100006B000063E9.belarusian: Моцны маральны компас. Яна ўсё яшчэ хоча мець магчымасць патлумачыць свой учынак.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004423.english: "When I came into town was there... anyone with me?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004423.polish: „Czy kiedy pojawiłem się w mieście... ktoś ze mną był?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004423.belarusian: "Калі я прыехаў у горад, са мной... хтосьці быў?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004445.english: "One of the guys seemed chipper, a blond, the other had a brooding something-or-other about him... And the woman... the woman was the only one in uniform. All were carrying."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004445.polish: „Jeden z facetów, blondyn, wydawał się weselszy. Drugi był za to jakiś ponury... A kobieta... Tylko ona była w mundurze. Wszyscy mieli przy sobie broń”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004445.belarusian: "Адзін з хлопцаў здаваўся вясёлым, бландыністы такі, у другога быў нейкі змрочны выгляд... А жанчына... жанчына была адзінай у форме. Усе былі са стваламі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004453.english: She narrows her eyes. "That sound about right?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000044F3.english: "Fantastic. I've gotta get on the road -- then you can go find your friends... Unless you have anything *pressing* to ask me."
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000044F3.polish: „Fantastycznie. Na mnie już czas... Jak już sobie pójdę, będziesz mógł poszukać swoich przyjaciół... No chyba że masz do mnie jakieś *ważne* pytania”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000044F3.belarusian: "Выдатна. Мне трэба рушыць у дарогу — тады зможаш пайсці шукаць сваіх сяброў... Калі толькі ў цябе няма да мяне чагосьці *тэрміновага*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004871.english: "Hmgh... she's right. No one mentioned *hearing*... shots. I... the shot didn't come from the roof."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004871.polish: „Uch... Ona ma rację. Nikt nie wspominał, aby *słyszał*... wystrzały. Ja... strzał nie padł z dachu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004871.belarusian: "Гмг... яна мае рацыю. Ніхто не згадваў, што *чуў*... стрэлы. Я... стрэл быў не з даху".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004896.english: Hold still and try to have an apocalyptic vision.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004896.polish: Nie ruszaj się i spróbuj doznać apokaliptycznej wizji.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004896.belarusian: Стаяць нерухома і паспрабаваць убачыць апакаліптычнае бачанне.

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048A4.english: "Don't worry, Kim, I'm just trying to... have... an apocalyptic... vision..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048A4.polish: „Nic się nie martw, Kim, próbuję tylko... doznać... apokaliptycznej... wizji...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048A4.belarusian: "Не хвалюйся, Кім, я проста спрабую... убачыць... апакаліптычнае... бачанне..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048B1.english: The white noise turns into a wall of mist and grey mould, bubbling, sweeping over the city... it tears up buildings and raises sidewalks into the sky. It's Revachol -- at the end of the world.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048B1.polish: Szum zmienia się w ścianę mgły i szarej pleśni. Bąbelkuje, przewala się przez miasto. Burzy budynki i podrywa w niebo chodniki. Oto Revachol podczas końca świata.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048B1.belarusian: Белы шум ператвараецца ў сцяну туману і шэрай цвілі, што бурліць і накочваецца на горад... яна разбурае будынкі і паднімае ходнікі ў неба. Гэта Рэвашоль — на канцы свету.

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048B7.polish: Co będzie, kiedy on się *naprawdę* zacznie?

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048BD.english: What will happen to *me*? (Try to crawl back.)
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048BD.polish: Co się stanie *ze mną*? (Spróbuj odpełznąć z powrotem).

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048DF.english: "What are you doing? I told you -- it's best not to move..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048DF.polish: „Co ty wyprawiasz? Mówiłam już, że najlepiej się nie ruszać...”
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048DF.belarusian: "Што ты робіш? Я ж казала — лепш не рухацца..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048E7.english: The pain intensifies as your hands attempt to reach out into the pale chaos.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048E7.polish: Kiedy twoje dłonie próbują sięgnąć ku chaosowi szaroty, ból przybiera na sile.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048E7.belarusian: Боль узмацняецца, калі твае рукі спрабуюць дацягнуцца да цьмянага хаосу.

Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048FF.english: The visions compete for space in your brain with the hailstorm of radio signals coming from the compressor. You feel like your skull is about to shatter into smithereens.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048FF.polish: Wizje walczą o miejsce w twoim bombardowanym sygnałami radiowymi z kompresora umyśle. Czujesz się, jakby twoja czaszka miała zaraz rozpaść się na kawałeczki.
Dialogue Text/0x01000071000048FF.belarusian: Бачанні змагаюцца за месца ў тваіх мазгах з градам радыёсігналаў, што ліюцца з кампрэсара. Табе здаецца, што твой чэрап вось-вось разляціцца на шматкі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004905.english: Fragments on bone scattering, like your thoughts at this moment, sticking now to forebodings, now to a strangely familiar voice...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004905.polish: Fragmenty kości w kompletnej rozsypce. Jak twoje myśli, które na przemian czepiają się złowrogich przeczuć i dziwnie znajomego głosu...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004905.belarusian: Аскепкі костак разлятаюцца, нібы твае думкі ў гэты момант, чапляючыся то за прадчуванні, то за дзіўна знаёмы голас...

Dialogue Text/0x010000710000490B.english: "Proximity to the Pale Compressor is overloading his mind. He'll be okay once it's off, though."
Dialogue Text/0x010000710000490B.polish: „Bliskość kompresora szaroty przeciąża jego umysł. Ale dojdzie do siebie po wyłączeniu maszyny”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000710000490B.belarusian: "Блізкасць да кампрэсара цьмянасці перагружае яго розум. Але калі выключыць, ён ачуняе".

Dialogue Text/0x010000710000491D.english: ...and it hasn't even really started yet.
Dialogue Text/0x010000710000491D.belarusian: ...і гэта нават яшчэ толкам не пачалося.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004924.english: Nothing. Just slow disappearance. You look at a tree or a coal shed, then look away, and, turning back...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004924.polish: Nic. Po prostu powolne znikanie. Spojrzysz na drzewo czy szopę na węgiel, odwrócisz wzrok, a potem, kiedy popatrzysz znów...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004924.belarusian: Нічога. Проста павольнае знікненне. Ты глядзіш на дрэва ці павець для вугалю, потым адводзіш позірк, а калі паварочваешся назад...

Dialogue Text/0x010000710000492A.english: The same thing that happens to all humans. You will become vapour. Dissolve into frequencies. Then those frequencies will be forgotten.
Dialogue Text/0x010000710000492A.polish: To samo, co ze wszystkimi innymi ludźmi. Zmienisz się w obłoczek pary. Rozpadniesz na częstotliwości. Które zostaną następnie zapomniane.
Dialogue Text/0x010000710000492A.belarusian: Тое самае, што і з усімі людзьмі. Ты станеш парай. Растворышся ў частотах. А потым гэтыя частоты будуць забытыя.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004930.english: Yes, but even in this anguish you can't see its precise shape. It's *unimaginable* for a reason.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004930.polish: Tak, ale nawet w tym cierpieniu nie umiesz dostrzec tego, jak dokładnie będzie wyglądało. Nie bez powodu jest *niewyobrażalne*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004930.belarusian: Так, але нават у гэтых пакутах ты не можаш разгледзець яго дакладную форму. Ён нездарма *неўявімы*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004A26.english: "Yeah, we saw... 98713... hhhsssszzzz... completely lost his mind, or... hhhhhsssssszzzz... prenatal vitamins, because no child is a blank slate... 352628789... shameless asshole..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004A26.polish: „Tak, widzieliśmy... 98713... hhhszszszsz... Całkowicie mu odbiło albo... hhhhszszszsz... Witaminy prenatalne, bo żadne dziecko nie jest czystą kartą... 352628789... Bezwstydny dupek...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004A26.belarusian: "Так, мы бачылі... 98713... хххссссзззз... цалкам звар'яцеў, ці... хххххссссссзззз... вітаміны для цяжарных, бо ніводнае дзіця не чысты ліст... 352628789... бессаромны казёл..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004A2D.english: "He didn't deign to stop to chat ... 98713... hhhsssszzzz... completely lost his mind, or... hhhhhsssssszzzz... prenatal vitamins, because no child is a blank slate... 352628789... shameless asshole..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004A2D.polish: „Nie uznał za stosowne zatrzymać się i pogadać... 98713... hhhszszszsz... Całkowicie mu odbiło albo... hhhhszszszsz... Witaminy prenatalne, bo żadne dziecko nie jest czystą kartą... 352628789... Bezwstydny dupek...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004A2D.belarusian: "Ён не палічыў патрэбным спыніцца і пагутарыць... 98713... хххссссзззз... цалкам звар'яцеў, ці... хххххссссссзззз... вітаміны для цяжарных, бо ніводнае дзіця не чысты ліст... 352628789... бессаромны казёл..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004A3E.english: ...the shed will be gone, and you won't even remember that the tree was ever there, much less what kind of tree it was, a pine or a birch. You won't remember if a man had been hanging from it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004A3E.polish: ...szopy już nie będzie, a drzewo nie zachowa się nawet w twojej pamięci. Nie wspominając już o tym, jakie to było drzewo – sosna czy brzoza. Nie będziesz pamiętał, czy zwisał z niego człowiek.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007100004A3E.belarusian: ...павеці ўжо няма, і ты нават не памятаеш, што дрэва там калі-небудзь расло, а тым больш якое яно было — хвоя ці бяроза. Ты не ўспомніш, ці вісеў на ім чалавек.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008100000791.polish: „Aresztowaliśmy ją... Możesz uważać się za pomszczoną”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008100000791.belarusian: "Мы арыштавалі яе... лічы, што ты адпомшчаная".

Dialogue Text/0x010000810000079F.english: "It didn't help her. She was a... fugitive. We took her in."
Dialogue Text/0x010000810000079F.polish: „Nie pomogło jej to. Była... ścigana. Zamknęliśmy ją”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000810000079F.belarusian: "Ёй гэта не дапамагло. Яна была... збеглай злачынцай. Мы яе забралі".

Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007A7.english: "Oh, I wouldn't have wished that upon her... The girl was playing some dangerous games, but even with what she did to me... I wouldn't have wished *that* upon her."
Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007A7.polish: „Och, nie życzyłabym jej tego... Ta dziewczyna niebezpiecznie pogrywała, ale nawet po tym, co mi zrobiła... *tego* bym jej nie życzyła”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007A7.belarusian: "Ох, я б не пажадала ёй такога... Дзяўчо гуляла ў небяспечныя гульні, але нават з улікам таго, што яна зрабіла са мной... *гэтага* я б ёй не пажадала".

Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007AE.english: "I'm sad to hear that. The girl was playing some dangerous games, but even with what she did to me... I wouldn't have wished *that* upon her."
Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007AE.polish: „Przykro mi to słyszeć. Ta dziewczyna niebezpiecznie pogrywała, ale nawet po tym, co mi zrobiła... *tego* bym jej nie życzyła”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007AE.belarusian: "Мне сумна гэта чуць. Дзяўчо гуляла ў небяспечныя гульні, але нават з улікам таго, што яна зрабіла са мной... *гэтага* я б ёй не пажадала".

Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007B5.english: She frowns. "She had some pretty messed up people after her. She's going to come out of that meat grinder a different person... If she comes out at all."
Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007B5.polish: Marszczy czoło. „Próbowali ją dopaść nieciekawi ludzie. Wyjdzie z tej maszynki do mięsa odmieniona... Jeśli w ogóle z niej wyjdzie”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007B5.belarusian: Яна хмурыцца. "За ёй палявалі даволі жудасныя людзі. З гэтай мясарубкі яна выйдзе зусім іншым чалавекам... Калі наогул выйдзе".

Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007C4.english: She'll age even faster in prison than she was partying. A pity.
Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007C4.polish: W więzieniu zestarzeje się jeszcze szybciej niż podczas tych swoich imprez. Szkoda.
Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007C4.belarusian: У турме яна састарэе яшчэ хутчэй, чым на сваіх тусоўках. Шкада.

Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007D4.english: There was a longing in her for some sort of denouement, but it's unlikely that it was this... turning prematurely grey while being escorted from interrogation room to interrogation room...
Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007D4.polish: Pragnęła jakiegoś zwieńczenia tego wszystkiego, ale wątpię, żeby właśnie takiego – przedwczesnej siwizny i wleczenia z jednego pokoju przesłuchań do drugiego...
Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007D4.belarusian: У яе душы жыла прага нейкай развязкі, але наўрад ці такой... заўчасна пасівець, пакуль цябе цягаюць з аднаго пакоя для допытаў у іншы...

Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007DB.english: "But Klaasje couldn't have known I was here. How did you?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007DB.polish: „Ale Klaasje nie mogła wiedzieć, że tu będę. Jak mnie znaleźliście?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000081000007DB.belarusian: "Але Клаас'е не магла ведаць, што я тут. Адкуль даведаліся вы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100008100000969.english: "Look, I know this isn't very fun for you, so let's wrap this up. You have a tribunal to attend."
Dialogue Text/0x0100008100000969.polish: „Słuchaj, wiem, że to nie jest dla ciebie zbytnio zabawne, więc streszczajmy się. Zdaje się, że masz zaproszenie na trybunał”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008100000969.belarusian: "Слухай, я ведаю, што гэта не вельмі весела для цябе, таму давай закругляцца. Табе яшчэ на трыбунал ісці".

Dialogue Text/0x01000089000019E9.english: Suddenly, your entire body is paralysed. Aggressive white noise fills your skull -- a strange pain like you've never felt before. The static overcomes you.
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000019E9.polish: Nagle twoje ciało ogarnia paraliż. Agresywny biały szum wypełnia twoją czaszkę – towarzyszy mu dziwny ból, jakiego nigdy jeszcze nie czułeś. Szum cię obezwładnia.
Dialogue Text/0x01000089000019E9.belarusian: Раптам усё тваё цела паралізуе. Агрэсіўны белы шум запаўняе чэрап — дзіўны боль, якога ты ніколі раней не адчуваў. Перашкоды апаноўваюць цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000C00000132.english: The darkness takes over as you feel yourself slipping into an unknown, mute state. Oh... it's death! This is the end.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000C00000132.polish: Ogarnia cię mrok i czujesz, że wchodzisz w jakiś nieznany, milczący stan. Ach... To śmierć! Oto i koniec.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000C00000132.belarusian: Цемра ахоплівае цябе, і ты адчуваеш, як слізгаеш у нейкі невядомы, маўклівы стан. О... гэта смерць! Вось і канец.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009C9B.english: That's an awful decision. Why would you not want to shield yourself from it? It's an entirely *new* type of experience -- way worse than all the previous ones.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009C9B.polish: Okropna decyzja. Czemu miałbyś się przed tym nie chronić? To zupełnie *nowy* rodzaj doświadczenia. O wiele gorszy od wszystkich poprzednich.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009C9B.belarusian: Жудаснае рашэнне. Чаму б табе не захацець закрыцца ад гэтага? Гэта цалкам *новы* тып досведу — нашмат горшы за ўсе папярэднія.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CAA.english: You should probably check on Kim. It doesn't sound like he's doing all too well.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CAA.polish: Powinieneś chyba sprawdzić, co z Kimem. Nie brzmi to, jakby wszystko było z nim dobrze.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CAA.belarusian: Табе варта было б праверыць Кіма. Не падобна, што яму вельмі добра.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CC3.english: Just keep her talking and you'll get through this.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CC3.polish: Zadbaj tylko, żeby mówiła, a przebrniesz przez to.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CC3.belarusian: Проста прымушай яе гаварыць, і ты вытрымаеш гэта.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CCA.english: Well, it doesn't *feel* much better, but you can form sentences now. Thinking doesn't seem to hurt as much.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CCA.polish: No, nie *czujesz się* wiele lepiej, ale jesteś teraz w stanie tworzyć zdania. Myślenie nie wydaje się aż takie bolesne.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CCA.belarusian: Ну, *навобмацак* не надта лепш, але ты ўжо можаш складаць сказы. Думкі нібыта не так моцна баляць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CD1.english: There's only three metres between you and the machine. If you keep her distracted for long enough, maybe...
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CD1.polish: Od maszyny dzielą cię ledwie trzy metry. Jeśli rozproszysz ją na wystarczająco długo, może...
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CD1.belarusian: Паміж табой і машынай усяго тры метры. Калі ты адцягнеш яе ўвагу на дастаткова доўгі час, магчыма...

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CDE.english: Be careful when you make your move -- that'll be *it* for questions. Bide your time.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CDE.polish: Dobrze wylicz moment, w którym ruszysz – to będzie *koniec* pytań. Nie spiesz się zbytnio.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009CDE.belarusian: Будзь асцярожны, калі вырашыш дзейнічаць — пасля гэтага пытанняў больш *не будзе*. Чакай зручнага моманту.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D13.english: "How did you know we were coming?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D19.english: "I heard you in the passages. And I've been preparing for quite a while."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D19.polish: „Słyszałam was w przejściach. I przygotowywałam się na to od jakiegoś już czasu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D19.belarusian: "Я чула вас у пераходах. І я рыхтавалася даволі даўно".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D27.english: "So you found my shack, huh? I'm not surprised."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D27.polish: „Więc znalazłeś moją chatę, co? Nie jestem zdziwiona”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D27.belarusian: "Дык ты знайшоў маю халупу, га? Я не здзіўленая".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D2E.english: Her tone is bitter. She thinks she's been betrayed.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D2E.polish: W jej głosie słychać gorycz. Myśli, że została zdradzona.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D2E.belarusian: У яе голасе гучыць горыч. Яна думае, што яе здрадзілі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D35.english: "She didn't rat you out, by the way -- the washerwoman."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D35.polish: „Nie sypnęła cię, nawiasem mówiąc. Praczka, znaczy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D35.belarusian: "Дарэчы, яна цябе не здавала — тая прачка".

Alternate1/0x0100001600009D35.polish: „Nie sypnęła cię, nawiasem mówiąc. Isobel, praczka”.
Alternate1/0x0100001600009D35.belarusian: "Дарэчы, яна цябе не здавала — Ізабэль, прачка".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D3B.english: "Preparing for a... shoot-out? That why you're hiding ammo?
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D3B.polish: „Przygotowywałaś się na... strzelaninę? Dlatego ukryłaś amunicję?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D3B.belarusian: "Рыхтавалася да... перастрэлкі? Таму і хавала набоі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D44.english: "So nice." She smiles a little smile. "That's one knife I didn't want to find in my back."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D44.polish: „Jak miło” – odpowiada, uśmiechając się przelotnie. „Nie chciałam oberwać w plecy tym sztyletem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D44.belarusian: "Як міла", - яна ледзь прыкметна ўсміхаецца. - "Вось гэты нож у спіне мне зусім не хацелася б бачыць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D4B.english: As opposed to the other knives she's finding there now. Hardie, for one.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D4B.polish: W przeciwieństwie do innych sztyletów, które właśnie tam znajduje. Jak ten, który wbił Hardie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D4B.belarusian: У адрозненне ад іншых нажоў, якія яна знаходзіць там цяпер. Хардзі, напрыклад.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D53.polish: „Dobrze... W takim razie mam inne pytania...”

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D75.english: "I was. Before I caught you in the pale latitude compressor. I'm fine now."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D75.polish: „Tak. Ale to było, zanim złapałam was w pole kompresora szerokości szaroty. Teraz wszystko gra”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D75.belarusian: "Было такое. Пакуль я не злавіла вас у кампрэсар шыраты цьмянасці. Цяпер усё ў парадку".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D7D.english: "Not anymore, no. This could've turned out pretty bad for me if you hadn't walked right into 25 bands of ultra-high frequencies."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D7D.polish: „Nie, już nie. To spotkanie mogło skończyć się dla mnie nieciekawie, gdybyście nie wpakowali się prosto w 25 pasm ultrawysokich częstotliwości”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D7D.belarusian: "Ужо не, не. Усё магло скончыцца вельмі кепска для мяне, калі б вы не ўляцелі проста ў 25 палос ультравысокіх частот".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D84.english: That's her admitting the bullet was an emergency exit.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D84.polish: Właśnie przyznała, że kula była jej wyjściem awaryjnym.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D84.belarusian: Гэта яна прызнае, што куля была аварыйным выйсцем.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D8C.english: It was dark in the shack. The waves outside had calmed down. She looked at the loaded gun, then she cracked the barrel open and took the bullet out. Not today.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D8C.polish: W chacie było ciemno. Fale na zewnątrz ucichły. Spojrzała na załadowaną broń, po czym otworzyła lufę i wyciągnęła nabój. To nie ten dzień.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009D8C.belarusian: У халупе было цёмна. Хвалі звонку супакоіліся. Яна паглядзела на зараджаны ствол, потым адкрыла рулю і выняла кулю. Не сёння.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009DA0.english: She smiles bitterly. "Nah, she didn't crack. She's a survivor. If she told you anything, it was to save herself..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009DA0.polish: Uśmiecha się gorzko. „Nie, ona nie pękła. Ona zrobi wszystko, by przetrwać. Jeśli coś ci powiedziała, to po to, aby uratować swoją skórę...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009DA0.belarusian: Яна горка ўсміхаецца. "Не, яна не раскалолася. Яна з тых, хто выжывае. Калі яна вам нешта і сказала, дык толькі каб выратаваць сябе..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009DAA.english: "Okay, call them the Hardie boys, then."

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009DB3.english: "I did, didn't I. And now you've come for me." She scoffs. "But fuck them all the same."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009DB3.polish: „To prawda. A teraz przyszedłeś po mnie. Pff. Ale tak czy siak, chuj im w dupę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009DB3.belarusian: "Так і назвала, праўда ж. А цяпер ты прыйшоў па мяне", - насміхаецца яна. - "Але ўсё адно ідзіце яны нахуй".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009DBB.english: That did make her forgive them -- a little.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009DBB.polish: Pozwoliło jej to im przebaczyć. Odrobinę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009DBB.belarusian: Гэта прымусіла яе дараваць ім — зусім трохі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F64.english: "Police radio? You've been... following the case?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F74.english: "It's okay... We just want to... hnghhhhh..." He struggles to finish the sentence.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F74.polish: „W porządku... Chcemy tylko... aaa...” – nie jest w stanie dokończyć zdania.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F74.belarusian: "Усё добра... Мы проста хочам... гнггггх..." — ён з цяжкасцю спрабуе скончыць сказ.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F7C.english: "Wait... did she also seem high to you?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F7C.polish: „Czekaj... Nie wydawała ci się też naćpana?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F7C.belarusian: "Пачакай... табе яна таксама падалася пад кайфам?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F83.english: "Oh yeah. *Super*. But I didn't think too much of it at first -- I'd seen her party hard before."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F83.polish: „O tak. I to *bardzo*. Ale na początku nie zwracałam na to uwagi – widywałam już ją podczas ostrego balowania”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F83.belarusian: "О так. *Яшчэ як*. Але спачатку я не звярнула асаблівай увагі — я бачыла, як яна тусіць навылёт".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F8C.english: This woman has seen people O.D. Klaasje wasn't quite there yet, so why worry?
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F8C.polish: Ta kobieta widziała, jak ludzie przedawkowują. Klaasje nie była jeszcze na tym etapie, więc skąd ta troska?
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F8C.belarusian: Гэтая жанчына бачыла перадазіроўкі. Клаас'е да гэтага яшчэ не дайшла, дык навошта турбавацца?

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F9E.english: "Yeah. In cold blood. It really surprised me -- how quickly she was able to get a hold of herself once we got up there. It was like she was another person. The *party girl* was gone."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F9E.polish: „Taa... Z zimną krwią. Naprawdę zaskoczyło mnie, jak szybko wzięła się w garść, gdy trafiłyśmy do jej pokoju. Zupełnie jakby stała się kimś zupełnie innym. »Imprezowa dziewczyna« zniknęła bez śladu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009F9E.belarusian: "Так. Хладнакроўна. Гэта мяне сапраўды здзівіла — як хутка яна здолела апанаваць сябе, калі мы апынуліся наверсе. Нібыта яна стала іншым чалавекам. 'Тусовачная дзеўка' бясследна знікла".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009FA8.english: You can see it: her lips, though still white, don't seem to tremble as much anymore. She moves with focus and deliberation.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009FA8.polish: Widzisz to: jej usta, choć wciąż blade, nie drżą już aż tak bardzo. W jej ruchach widać skupienie i zamysł.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600009FA8.belarusian: Ты бачыш гэта: яе вусны, хоць усё яшчэ бледныя, ужо не так моцна дрыжаць. Яна рухаецца засяроджана і выверана.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A011.english: It's especially bad suddenly. Felt like a vein exploded.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A011.polish: Nagle jest wyjątkowo źle. Jakby pękła ci jakaś żyła.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A011.belarusian: Раптам становіцца асабліва кепска. Быццам жыла лопнула.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A020.english: "Bullshit, you're trying to..." (wince grotesquely) "throw me off. No one says that."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A020.polish: „Gówno prawda, próbujesz...” (Skrzyw się groteskowo). „...mnie zwieść. Nikt tak nie mówi”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A020.belarusian: "Хлусня, ты спрабуеш..." (гратэскава скрывіцца) "збіць мяне з панталыку. Ніхто такога не кажа".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A028.english: "Everyone in Jamrock. The cops, the criminals... Why do you think I'm holed up in here with a goddamn death ray, waiting for you?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A028.polish: „Wszyscy w Jamrock. Gliny, kryminaliści... Niby dlaczego siedzę w tej norze z tym cholernym promieniem śmierci, czekając na ciebie?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A028.belarusian: "Усе ў Джэмроку. Копы, злачынцы... Чаму, думаеш, я засела тут з гэтым клятым прамянём смерці, чакаючы цябе?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A02E.english: "Oh yes, they do. The cops, the criminals... Why do you think I'm holed up in here with a goddamn death ray, waiting for you?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A02E.polish: „A właśnie, że mówią. Gliny, kryminaliści... Niby dlaczego siedzę w tej norze z tym cholernym promieniem śmierci, czekając na ciebie?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A02E.belarusian: "А вось і кажуць. Копы, злачынцы... Чаму, думаеш, я засела тут з гэтым клятым прамянём смерці, чакаючы цябе?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A036.english: If she knows *that* about you, she must know your real name too.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A036.polish: Skoro wie o tobie *to*, musi też znać twoje prawdziwe imię.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A036.belarusian: Калі яна ведае пра цябе *гэта*, яна мусіць ведаць і тваё сапраўднае імя.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A041.english: "Tell me, what's my name? If you know... that about me, you must... know my name."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A041.polish: „Powiedz mi, jak mam na imię. Jeśli wiesz o mnie... coś takiego, to musisz... znać też moje imię”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A041.belarusian: "Скажы мне, як маё імя? Калі ты ведаеш... пра мяне такое, ты мусіш... ведаць маё імя".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A04A.english: "Harry Du Bois," she replies quickly. "One corrupt motherfucker with the disco pants and the funny tie. Agent to La Puta Madre."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A04A.polish: „Jesteś Harry Du Bois” – odpowiada szybko. „Skorumpowany skurwiel w spodniach disco i śmiesznym krawacie. Agent La Puty Madre”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A04A.belarusian: "Гары Дзю Буа", - хутка адказвае яна. - "Адзін карумпаваны вырадак у дыска-штанах і смешным гальштуку. Агент La Puta Madre".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A059.english: Don't let her scare you. She probably just made that name up on the spot.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A059.polish: Nie pozwól, żeby cię nastraszyła. Pewnie wymyśliła sobie to imię przed chwilą.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A059.belarusian: Не дазваляй ёй напалохаць цябе. Хутчэй за ўсё, яна выдумала гэтае імя на хаду.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A060.english: No, no, it can't be that. You're not Harry Du Bois. Forget you heard any of this. There's no time to deal with this now.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A060.polish: Nie, nie, to nie może być prawda. Nie jesteś Harry Du Bois. Zapomnij, że to usłyszałeś. Nie czas się teraz tym zajmować.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A060.belarusian: Не, не, гэта не можа быць праўдай. Ты не Гары Дзю Буа. Забудзь, што ты гэта чуў. Цяпер няма часу разбірацца з гэтым.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A06F.english: So she knows your name. That doesn't mean you're on the take. Criminals make up bogeyman stories about cops all the time.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A06F.polish: A więc zna twoje imię. Ale to nie znaczy jeszcze, że bierzesz w łapę. Przestępcy co i rusz wymyślają straszne historyjki o policjantach.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A06F.belarusian: Значыць, яна ведае тваё імя. Гэта не азначае, што ты бярэш хабары. Злачынцы ўвесь час выдумляюць страшылкі пра копаў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A076.english: All of this just means that you're effective. Criminals know you and are scared of you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A076.polish: To wszystko znaczy co najwyżej tyle, że jesteś skuteczny. Przestępcy cię znają i się ciebie boją.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A076.belarusian: Усё гэта проста азначае, што ты эфектыўны. Злачынцы ведаюць цябе і баяцца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A07F.english: I don't know... sounds pretty convincing to me.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A07F.polish: No nie wiem... Dla mnie to dość przekonujące.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0A1.english: "What did you *do* to this... Madre anyway?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0A1.polish: „Coś ty w ogóle zrobiła... temu Madre?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0AA.english: "You know what I did. I fucked him over." She pauses. "And now I have Harry Can-Opener in my lair. Fucking Titus..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0AA.polish: „Wiesz, co zrobiłam. Zrobiłam go w chuja” – milknie na chwilę. „No i mam teraz w swojej kryjówce Harry'ego Otwieracza Puszek. Jebany Titus...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0AA.belarusian: "Ты ведаеш, што я зрабіла. Я кінула яго", - яна робіць паўзу. - "І вось зараз у маім логаве сядзіць Гары-Адкаркоўнік. Ябаны Цітус..."

Alternate1/0x010000160000A0AA.polish: „Widzieliście moją ciężarówkę. Myślisz, że największy gracz w Jamrock lubi konkurencję?” – milknie na chwilę. „No i mam teraz w swojej kryjówce Harry'ego Otwieracza Puszek. Jebany Titus...”
Alternate1/0x010000160000A0AA.belarusian: "Ты быў у маім грузавіку. Думаеш, галоўнаму гульцу ў Джэмроку падабаецца канкурэнцыя?" — яна робіць паўзу. - "І вось зараз у маім логаве сядзіць Гары-Адкаркоўнік. Ябаны Цітус..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0C1.english: I thought we had an agreement, she thinks. *This* was not supposed to happen.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0C1.polish: Wydawało mi się, że jesteśmy umówieni – myśli. *To* się nie miało wydarzyć.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0C1.belarusian: Я думала, у нас дамова, разважае яна. *Гэтага* не павінна было здарыцца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0CC.english: Wait, one thing. Possibly small but -- she said *you* rolled into town. Was that 'you' singular or plural? She might know something...
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0CC.polish: Zaraz, jedna sprawa. Może to detal, ale... Powiedziała, że pojawiłeś się w mieście. Ale sam czy z kimś? Ona może coś wiedzieć...
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0CC.belarusian: Пачакай, адна рэч. Магчыма, дробязь, але — яна сказала: *ты* прыкаціў у горад. У адзіночным ліку ці ў множным? Яна можа нешта ведаць...

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0D5.english: "Yeah. You had your death squad with you. What happened to them, anyway?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0D5.polish: „Taa... Towarzyszył ci twój oddział śmierci. Co się z nimi właściwie stało?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0D5.belarusian: "Так. З табой быў твой эскадрон смерці. Што з імі сталася, дарэчы?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0E3.english: "I don't... know what happened to them."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0E3.polish: „Ja... nie wiem, co się z nimi stało”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0E3.belarusian: "Я не... ведаю, што з імі сталася".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0EA.english: "Sure you do, I bet they're just outside, waiting." She looks into the tunnel behind you. "I guess I'll take my chances."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0EA.polish: „Jasne, że wiesz. Pewnie czekają na zewnątrz” – zerka w głąb tunelu za tobą. „Chyba będę musiała zaryzykować”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0EA.belarusian: "Вядома, ведаеш. Б'юся аб заклад, яны проста на вуліцы, чакаюць", - яна зазірае ў тунэль за табой. - "Што ж, рызыкну".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0F1.english: She'll go out in a hail of bullets if she has to.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0F1.polish: Ruszy choćby i w gradzie kul, jeśli będzie musiała.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0F1.belarusian: Яна пойдзе насустрач свінцоваму граду, калі давядзецца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0F9.english: "Well, it wasn't this scrawny dude." She nods toward the lieutenant. "You had two guys and a lady. The guys looked pretty buff. Lady wasn't bad either."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0F9.polish: „Na pewno nie ten chuderlak” – stwierdza, wskazując skinieniem głowy porucznika. „Towarzyszyło ci dwóch facetów i kobieta. Faceci wyglądali na przypakowanych. Babeczka też była niczego sobie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A0F9.belarusian: "Ну, дакладна не гэты хударлявы дзядзька", - яна ківае на лейтэнанта. - "З табой былі два мужчыны і жанчына. Мужчыны выглядалі даволі падпампаванымі. Жанчына таксама нічога".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A111.english: Hhhhhhhhzzzzzzzzzzz.......... friction lock set.. Zzzzzzzzzzz... Don't leave me here, please Celice!
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A111.polish: Hhhhhszszszsz.… zamek tarciowy gotowy. Zzzzzzz... Celice, nie zostawiaj mnie tu, proszę!
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A111.belarusian: Хххххххххссссссссссс.......... фрыкцыйны замок усталяваны.. Ззззззззззз... Не пакідай мяне тут, калі ласка, Селіс!

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A11E.english: "Yeah, that's right, I was just... testing you. They're right outside, with guns."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A11E.polish: „Tak, zgadza się, tylko cię... sprawdzałem. Są na zewnątrz, czekają z bronią w ręku”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A11E.belarusian: "Так, менавіта, я проста... правяраў цябе. Яны проста на вуліцы, са стваламі".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A124.english: "I think I know them. They're in Martinaise..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A124.belarusian: "Здаецца, я іх ведаю. Яны ў Марцінэзе..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A130.polish: „Miałam do czynienia z gorszymi zbirami” – stwierdza, wzruszając ramionami.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A130.belarusian: "Я бачыла і горшае", - паціскае яна плячыма.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A136.english: She hasn't. She hasn't gone up against three armed people before. And she believed you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A136.polish: Nie miała. Nigdy dotąd nie mierzyła się z trójką uzbrojonych ludzi. I ci uwierzyła.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A136.belarusian: Яна не бачыла. Яна ніколі раней не выступала супраць трох узброеных людзей. І яна табе паверыла.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A13F.english: "Well, this has been a great talk, really. But I think I'm going to hit the road now."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A13F.polish: „No cóż, świetnie się rozmawiało, naprawdę. Ale chyba już się pożegnam”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A13F.belarusian: "Што ж, выдатна пагутарылі, праўда. Але я, бадай, рушу ў дарогу".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A14D.english: She means it. You better make your move soon.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A14D.polish: Mówi poważnie. Jeśli chcesz działać, musisz się spieszyć.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A14D.belarusian: Яна не жартуе. Табе варта дзейнічаць як мага хутчэй.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A158.english: Hhhhhhhzzzzzzz... L'Iramburde: starbursts and sunshine. 24 degrees centigrade...
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A158.polish: Hhhhhhszszszsz.… L'Iramburde: gwiazdy i słońce. 24 stopnie Celsjusza...
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A158.belarusian: Хххххххсссссссс... Л'Ірамбурдзе: усплёскі зорак і сонечнае святло. 24 градусы...

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A160.english: You've gotta act soon. This is getting *bad*.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A19A.english: The pain is becoming unbearable now.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A19A.polish: Ból staje się już nie do zniesienia.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A509.english: This *is* how you talk her out of it. It's the only scenario in which she lives.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A509.polish: *Właśnie tak* możesz ją odwieść. To jedyny scenariusz, w którym zachowuje życie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A509.belarusian: *Менавіта так* ты яе і адгаворыш. Гэта адзіны сцэнар, у якім яна застаецца жыць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A523.english: "Good call..." The lieutenant is still unsteady on his feet.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A523.polish: „Dobra decyzja...” – stwierdza porucznik, wciąż chwiejąc się na nogach.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A523.belarusian: "Добры выбар..." — лейтэнант усё яшчэ хістаецца на нагах.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A536.english: She stares at you, frozen, the gun still in her mouth, eyes filled with dark intensity. Then something shifts in her.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A536.polish: Wpatruje się w ciebie nieruchoma z lufą w ustach i oczami wypełnionymi mroczną determinacją. Nagle coś się w niej zmienia.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A536.belarusian: Яна глядзіць на цябе, аслупянелая, пісталет усё яшчэ ў роце, вочы гараць змрочнай інтэнсіўнасцю. Потым нешта ў ёй змяняецца.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A53C.english: Her neck and shoulders relax, and her grip on the gun loosens.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A53C.polish: Rozluźnia mięśnie szyi i ramion, a chwyt, którym trzyma broń, staje się mniej kurczowy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A53C.belarusian: Яе шыя і плечы расслабляюцца, і хватка на зброі слабее.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A543.english: "You don't have to do this. You're not cornered. I'm letting you go."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A543.polish: „Nie musisz tego robić. Nie jesteś w potrzasku. Puszczam cię wolno”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A543.belarusian: "Табе не трэба гэтага рабіць. Ты не загнаная ў кут. Я адпускаю цябе".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A54C.english: Gratitude. Doubt. She's still ready to go...
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A54C.polish: Wdzięczność. Wątpliwość. Wciąż jest gotowa to zrobić...
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A54C.belarusian: Удзячнасць. Сумнеў. Яна ўсё яшчэ гатовая сысці...

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A556.english: "Just fucking go, okay, before I change my mind!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A556.polish: „Leć już, kurwa, tak? Zanim zmienię zdanie!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A556.belarusian: "Проста валі ўжо, бляць, добра, пакуль я не перадумаў!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A55E.english: "Day of miracles..." she says, pulling the gun out of her mouth, eyes still fixed on you. Then she turns her gaze to the tunnel behind you. "I'll take it."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A55E.polish: „Dzień cudów...” – stwierdza, wpatrując się w ciebie i wyjmując broń ze swoich ust. Po chwili jej wzrok wędruje ku tunelowi za tobą. „Skorzystam z tej okazji”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A55E.belarusian: "Дзень цудаў..." — кажа яна, вымаючы пісталет з рота і ўсё яшчэ не зводзячы з цябе вачэй. Затым яна пераводзіць позірк на тунэль за тваёй спіной. - "Я скарыстаюся гэтым".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A582.english: "Yeah, I'm sure..." He has to catch his breath. "I would have done the same had I not been incapacitated..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A582.polish: „Tak, jestem pewny...” – odpowiada, z trudem łapiąc dech. „Też bym tak postąpił, gdybym nie był obezwładniony...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A582.belarusian: "Так, я ўпэўнены..." — яму трэба перавесці дыханне. - "Я зрабіў бы тое самае, каб не быў абяздзейнены..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A593.english: "What if we just let the murderer go?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A593.belarusian: "А што калі мы толькі што адпусцілі забойцу?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A59F.english: "I think she did it. But... I didn't want her to die."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A59F.polish: „Myślę, że to zrobiła. Ale... nie chciałem, żeby zginęła”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A59F.belarusian: "Я думаю, што яна гэта зрабіла. Але... я не хацеў, каб яна памерла".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5A8.english: "Really? That's... your takeaway? I'm *certain* she didn't do it." He looks around, then points to the back of the cavern. "Her tent. We should check it out."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5A8.polish: „Naprawdę? Takie... odniosłeś wrażenie? Ja jestem *pewny*, że ona tego nie zrobiła” – rozgląda się wokół, po czym wskazuje na tył jaskini. „Jej namiot. Powinniśmy go przeszukać”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5A8.belarusian: "Няўжо? Вось такая... ваша выснова? Я *ўпэўнены*, што яна гэтага не рабіла", - ён азіраецца, потым паказвае на заднюю частку пячоры. - "Яе намет. Трэба яго праверыць".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5B8.english: "Her tent. We should check it out." He points to the back of the cavern.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5B8.polish: „Jej namiot. Powinniśmy go przeszukać” – stwierdza, wskazując na tył jaskini.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5B8.belarusian: "Яе намет. Трэба яго праверыць", - ён паказвае на заднюю частку пячоры.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5BE.english: "I have a feeling... we didn't." He looks around, then points to the back of the cavern. "Her tent. We should check it out."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5BE.polish: „Mam przeczucie... że to nie ona zabiła” – rozgląda się wokół, po czym wskazuje na tył jaskini. „Jej namiot. Powinniśmy go przeszukać”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5BE.belarusian: "У мяне адчуванне... што не", - ён азіраецца, потым паказвае на заднюю частку пячоры. - "Яе намет. Трэба яго праверыць".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5C6.english: "All things considered..." The lieutenant is still reeling from the pain. "...that could've gone worse."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5C6.polish: „Biorąc wszystko pod uwagę...” – stwierdza, wciąż odczuwając ból – „...mogło pójść gorzej”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5C6.belarusian: "З улікам усяго..." — лейтэнант усё яшчэ хістаецца ад болю. - "...магло быць і горш".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5CD.english: "Glad to have been of assistance." She tosses her head back defiantly and turns down the machine. "Best of luck to you, officers -- Revachol's a bitch."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5CD.polish: „Cieszę się, że mogłam pomóc” – odrzuca wyzywająco głowę i wyłącza maszynę. „Powodzenia, panowie – Revachol daje w kość”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5CD.belarusian: "Рада была дапамагчы", - яна задзірыста адкідвае галаву і выключае машыну. - "Поспехаў вам, афіцэры — Рэвашоль яшчэ тая сука".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5DB.belarusian: "Пачакай... хіба мы не павінны кінуцца за ёй?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5EE.english: "No, I don't think she did it... She's someone else's case now."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5EE.polish: „Nie, nie sądzę, aby to ona go zabiła... Jej sprawą zajmie się ktoś inny”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5EE.belarusian: "Не, я не думаю, што гэта зрабіла яна... Цяпер яна чыясьці іншая справа".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5F5.english: It's too late now anyway. She's gone.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5F5.polish: I tak już na to za późno. Przepadła.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5F5.belarusian: Цяпер ужо ўсё адно занадта позна. Яна сышла.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5FD.english: "Now we have to come up with a really good excuse... for why we walked right into a trap like that. This isn't going to look good in the report." He looks around, then points further into the cavern.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5FD.polish: „Teraz musimy wymyślić naprawdę dobrą wymówkę na to... dlaczego weszliśmy prosto w tę pułapkę. To nie będzie dobrze wyglądało w raporcie” – rozgląda się wokoło, po czym wskazuje w głąb jaskini.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A5FD.belarusian: "Цяпер нам давядзецца прыдумаць вельмі добрае апраўданне... чаму мы вось так патрапілі ў пастку. У рапарце гэта будзе выглядаць кепска", - ён азіраецца, потым паказвае ўглыб пячоры.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A604.english: "Her tent! Maybe there's something in there."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A604.polish: „Jej namiot! Może coś w nim znajdziemy”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A60E.english: "I'm done. I'm not doing this anymore." (Conclude.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A60E.polish: „Mam dość. Nie będę tego więcej robił”. (Zakończ).
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A60E.belarusian: "З мяне досыць. Я больш не буду гэтым займацца". (Скончыць.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A615.english: "Okay... you said it. You needed to say it. Now it's been *said*," he says in a slow, measured voice. "We need to clean up."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A615.polish: „W porządku... Powiedziałeś to. Czasem człowiek musi to powiedzieć na głos. I *powiedziałeś* to” – stwierdza miarowym tonem. „Teraz musimy tu posprzątać”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A615.belarusian: "Добра... вы гэта сказалі. Вам трэба было гэта выказаць. Цяпер гэта *сказана*", - гаворыць ён павольным, узважаным голасам. - "Нам трэба тут прыбрацца".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A61C.english: "No, I'm done. I'm not a cop anymore." [End it.]
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A61C.polish: „Nie. Mam dość. Nie jestem już policjantem”. [Skończ z tym na dobre].
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A61C.belarusian: "Не, з мяне досыць. Я больш не коп". [Пакончыць з гэтым.]

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A62F.english: "Okay. Okay." (Compose yourself.) "What do we do now?" (Move on.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A62F.belarusian: "Добра. Добра". (Апанаваць сябе.) "Што мы цяпер робім?" (Рушыць далей.)

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A637.english: "Fuck." The lieutenant stands, motionless, watching the blood pool in the sand.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A637.polish: „Szlag” – porucznik stoi bez ruchu i przygląda się krwi tworzącej na piasku kałużę.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A637.belarusian: "Бляха", - лейтэнант стаіць нерухома, гледзячы, як кроў расцякаецца лужынай па пяску.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A650.english: "She killed herself. I failed to talk to her down."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A650.belarusian: "Яна забіла сябе. Мне не ўдалося яе адгаварыць".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A657.english: "Lieutenant-yefreitor Du Bois," he intones. "Control your emotions. We did our *job*. This won't be the worst thing that happens on this case... believe me. You can't let this break you."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A657.polish: „Poruczniku gefrajterze Du Bois” – wygłasza oficjalnym tonem. „Panuj nad emocjami. Wykonaliśmy nasze *zadanie*. To nie jest najgorsze, co wydarzy się podczas tego śledztwa... Możesz mi wierzyć. Nie pozwól, by cię to złamało”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A657.belarusian: "Лейтэнант-яфрэйтар Дзю Буа", - вымаўляе ён. - "Кантралюйце свае эмоцыі. Мы выканалі сваю *працу*. Гэта не самае горшае, што здарыцца на гэтай справе... паверце мне. Вы не можаце дазволіць гэтаму зламаць вас".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A66E.english: Get a hold of yourself. He needs your support now too.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A66E.polish: Weź się w garść. On też potrzebuje teraz twojego wsparcia.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A66E.belarusian: Вазьмі сябе ў рукі. Яму цяпер таксама патрэбна твая падтрымка.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A680.english: You're going to need an ocean of booze to drown this out.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A680.polish: Będziesz potrzebował oceanu gorzały, żeby zatopić to wspomnienie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A680.belarusian: Табе спатрэбіцца цэлы акіян бырла, каб заліць гэта.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A693.english: "We clean up." He looks around. "It may take days for processing to pick up her body. We need to move it somewhere..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A693.polish: „Trzeba tu posprzątać” – rozgląda się wokół. „Może minąć kilka dni, zanim ekipa koronera pojawi się tu po jej zwłoki. Musimy je gdzieś przenieść...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000A693.belarusian: "Мы прыбярэмся", - ён азіраецца. - "Могуць спатрэбіцца дні, пакуль судмедэксперты забяруць яе цела. Трэба перанесці яго куды-небудзь..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155A2.english: We should've factored this in. Damn it.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155A2.polish: Trzeba to było wziąć pod uwagę. Szlag.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155A2.belarusian: Мы павінны былі гэта ўлічыць. Чорт.

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155B5.english: So this is what she was scared to tell Titus. *This cop, this cop...*
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155B5.polish: A więc to bała się powiedzieć Titusowi. *Ten gliniarz, ten gliniarz...*
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155B5.belarusian: Дык вось пра што яна баялася сказаць Цітусу. *Гэты коп, гэты коп...*

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155C2.english: That strange distant fear is getting close now. It's a fear -- of *yourself.*
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155C2.polish: Ten dziwny, jakby odległy strach jest teraz znacznie bliżej. To strach *przed samym sobą*.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155C2.belarusian: Той дзіўны далёкі страх цяпер падыходзіць блізка. Гэта страх — *перад самім сабой*.

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155C8.english: A fear fills you. A bad kind of fear. Of *yourself*.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155C8.polish: Napełnia cię strach. Zły strach. *Przed samym sobą*.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155C8.belarusian: Цябе апаноўвае страх. Кепскі страх. Перад *самім сабой*.

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155DB.english: Did someone mention a fucked up tie? I call BULLSHIT. You're too CRAZY to be corrupt.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155DB.polish: Czy ktoś coś wspomniał o pojebanym krawacie? To PIERDOLENIE. Jesteś zbyt SZURNIĘTY, żebyś był skorumpowany.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155DB.belarusian: Хтосьці згадаў пра ябаны гальштук? Я кажу: ПІЗДЗЁЖ. Ты занадта КРЭЙЗІ, каб быць прадажным.

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155F1.english: She's not going to change her mind that easily. She still perceives you as a threat.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155F1.polish: Nie zmieni tak łatwo zdania. Wciąż uważa cię za zagrożenie.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155F1.belarusian: Яна не зменіць сваё меркаванне так проста. Яна ўсё яшчэ бачыць у табе пагрозу.

Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155FD.english: *No* idea who these people are. Literally.
Dialogue Text/0x01000006000155FD.polish: *Nie mam pojęcia*, kim są ci ludzie. Kompletnie.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015604.english: Satellite-Officer Vicquemare looks out of the window grimly, then puts his coffee down and turns to Patrol Officer Minot. "We can either take a room here in the Whirling or go home for today."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015604.polish: Funkcjonariusz satelicki Vicquemare spogląda ponuro za okno, po czym odstawia kawę i odwraca się do funkcjonariusz patrolowej Minot. „Możemy wynająć pokój tutaj, w Whirling, albo wrócić na dzisiaj do domu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015604.belarusian: Сатэліт-афіцэр Вікмар змрочна глядзіць у акно, потым ставіць кубак кавы і паварочваецца да патрульнага афіцэра Міно. "Мы можам альбо зняць пакой тут, у Whirling, альбо пайсці на сёння дадому".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015618.english: "Let's go home, Jean. Nothing's going to happen today," she responds quietly. Jean takes his blond wig off. "Call Heidelstam. He can give us a ride."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015618.polish: „Wracajmy do domu, Jean. Nic się dzisiaj nie wydarzy” – odpowiada cicho. Jean zdejmuje swoją blond perukę, mówiąc: „Zadzwoń do Heidelstama. Podwiezie nas”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015618.belarusian: "Пойдзем дадому, Жан. Сёння нічога не адбудзецца", - ціха адказвае яна. Жан здымае светлы парык. - "Патэлефануй Гайдэльштаму. Ён можа падвезці".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015636.english: Keep calm. Breathe in. After the pain recedes it's a little clearer...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015636.polish: Tylko spokojnie. Oddychaj. Kiedy ból mija, jest trochę lepiej...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015636.belarusian: Захоўвай спакой. Удыхні. Калі боль адступае, усё становіцца трохі больш выразным...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015649.english: He couldn't take it like you. It irks him -- then he gets over it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015649.polish: Nie wytrzymał tego tak dobrze jak ty. Złości go to, ale po chwili przestaje się przejmować.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015649.belarusian: Ён не вытрымаў гэтага так, як ты. Гэта яго задзяргае — але потым ён адпускае гэта.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015650.english: "I would have done the same..." He has to catch his breath. "Had I not been incapacitated..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015650.polish: „Też bym tak postąpił...” – odpowiada, z trudem łapiąc dech. „Gdybym nie był obezwładniony...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015650.belarusian: "Я зрабіў бы тое самае..." — ён пераводзіць дыханне. - "Каб не быў абяздзейнены..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001566C.english: "Our job. It went really bad. And now we need to clean it up."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001566C.polish: „To, co do nas należy. Poszło nam naprawdę źle. I musimy to teraz posprzątać”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001566C.belarusian: "Сваю працу. Усё пайшло вельмі дрэнна. І цяпер нам трэба гэта прыбраць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015676.english: He squints into the darkness, "that tent there."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015676.polish: Mruży oczy, wpatrując się w ciemność. „Tamten namiot...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600015676.belarusian: Ён прыжмурваецца ў цемру: "той намет там".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000DBD.english: "This could've turned out pretty bad for me if you hadn't walked right into 25 bands of ultra-high frequencies."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000DBD.polish: „To spotkanie mogło skończyć się dla mnie nieciekawie, gdybyście nie wpakowali się prosto w 25 pasm ultrawysokich częstotliwości”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000DBD.belarusian: "Гэта магло б скончыцца даволі кепска для мяне, калі б вы не ўляцелі проста ў 25 палос ультравысокіх частот".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000DD6.english: "We're cops. Everything is our fault, if we let it be..." He looks around.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000DD6.polish: „Jesteśmy policjantami. Wszystko jest naszą winą, jeśli pozwolimy, by tak było...” – stwierdza i rozgląda się wokoło.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000DD6.belarusian: "Мы копы. Ва ўсім вінаватыя мы, калі дазволім гэтаму быць..." — ён азіраецца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000DE9.english: She died. How can he be so... cold?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000DE9.polish: Ona nie żyje. Jak on może być taki... zimny?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000DE9.belarusian: Яна памерла. Як ён можа быць такім... халодным?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000DF5.english: This is the right thing to do -- clean up, keep a cool head.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000DF5.polish: To jest właśnie słuszne postępowanie. Posprzątać, zachować chłodną głowę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000DF5.belarusian: Гэта правільнае рашэнне — прыбрацца, захаваць халодную галаву.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000DFE.english: There is no coming back from this one. It will stay with you -- in nightmares.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000DFE.polish: Tego już cofnąć się nie da. Pozostanie z tobą na zawsze – w koszmarach.
