Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A1C3.belarusian: "Чакай, Стэбан, ты хочаш сказаць, што жандарм — гэта нейкі *камуніст з будучыні*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A1DF.english: "... and we still don't know what happened to the rest of his armour..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A1DF.polish: „...i wciąż nie wiemy, co się stało z resztą jego pancerza...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A1DF.belarusian: "...і мы дагэтуль не ведаем, што здарылася з рэштай ягонай брані..."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A1DF.polish: „...ale jak mogły go zabić jednocześnie komunizm *i* miłość?”
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A1DF.belarusian: "...але як камунізм і каханне маглі забіць яго *адначасова*?"

Alternate2/0x0100000F0000A1DF.polish: „...ale wciąż nie jestem pewny, jak *komunizm* miałby go zabić...”
Alternate2/0x0100000F0000A1DF.belarusian: "...але я ўсё адно не разумею, як яго мог забіць *камунізм*..."

Alternate3/0x0100000F0000A1DF.polish: „...ale wciąż nie jestem pewny, jak *miłość* miałaby go zabić...”
Alternate3/0x0100000F0000A1DF.belarusian: "...але я ўсё адно не разумею, як яго магло загубіць *каханне*..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A1E4.english: "... so anyway, my current theory is that she's somewhere along the coast."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A1E4.polish: „...no, w każdym razie obecnie wyznaję tezę, że przebywa ona gdzieś na wybrzeżu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A1E4.belarusian: "...карацей, мая цяперашняя версія ў тым, што яна дзесьці на ўзбярэжжы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A1E9.english: "... so anyway, I think there's still a shot. But in the meantime I'm just focussing on my casework."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A1E9.polish: „...no, w każdym razie myślę, że wciąż jest szansa. Ale na razie skupiam się na pracy nad sprawą”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A1E9.belarusian: "...карацей, думаю, шанец яшчэ ёсць. Але пакуль што я проста сканцэнтраваны на сваёй справе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A1EE.english: "... and anyway, even if you could somehow *unpeel* time, it wouldn't be the *you* you who gets rich from those investments..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A1EE.polish: „...zresztą i tak, gdyby udało się jakoś *obrać czas ze skórki*, to nie *wy* wzbogacilibyście się na tej inwestycji...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A1EE.belarusian: "...і ў кожным разе, нават калі б удалося нейкім чынам *аблупіць* час, узбагаціліся б на тых інвестыцыях зусім не *вы* цяперашнія..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A206.english: "Makes sense. It doesn't seem like there's anywhere else she could have gone."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A206.polish: „To ma sens. Chyba tylko tam mogłaby się w tej sytuacji ukryć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A206.belarusian: "Лагічна. Наўрад ці ёй было куды яшчэ падацца."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A20C.english: "Makes sense. Based on my experience, you've got to let her see that you've grown, ideologically speaking..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A20C.polish: „To ma sens. Z własnego doświadczenia wiem, że musisz pokazać jej, że się rozwinąłeś – w sensie ideologicznym...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A20C.belarusian: "Лагічна. З майго досведу, ты мусіш паказаць ёй, што ты вырас — у ідэалагічным плане..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A211.english: "But that would imply that whenever you unpeel time you leave behind some kind of *doppelgänger* in now-time..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A211.polish: „Ale wynikałoby z tego, że za każdym razem, gdy obierasz czas, pozostawiasz za sobą pewnego rodzaju *sobowtóra* w teraz-czasie...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A211.belarusian: "Але гэта значыла б, што кожны раз, калі ты абіраеш час, ты пакідаеш пасля сябе свайго роду *дапельгангера* ў цяперашнім часе..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A21B.english: "It will turn up, I'm sure. In a way, it wants to be found..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A21B.polish: „Jeszcze się znajdzie, jestem tego pewny. W pewnym sensie chce być odnaleziony...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A21B.belarusian: "Яна знойдзецца, я ўпэўнены. У пэўным сэнсе яна сама хоча, каб яе знайшлі..."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A21B.polish: „Zdaje się, że twierdzi, iż to komunizm popełnił morderstwo, ale to miłość doprowadziła go do tego punktu...”
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A21B.belarusian: "Здаецца, ён хоча сказаць, што *сапраўднае* забойства ўчыніў камунізм, але менавіта каханне давяло яго да гэтага..."

Alternate2/0x0100000F0000A21B.polish: „Zdaje się, że wciąż czegoś tu brakuje. Nie znamy jeszcze całej historii...”
Alternate2/0x0100000F0000A21B.belarusian: "Тут мусіць быць нейкі іншы элемент. Мы яшчэ не ведаем усёй гісторыі..."

Alternate3/0x0100000F0000A21B.polish: „Zdaje się, że wciąż czegoś tu brakuje. Nie znamy jeszcze całej historii...”
Alternate3/0x0100000F0000A21B.belarusian: "Тут мусіць быць нейкі іншы элемент. Мы яшчэ не ведаем усёй гісторыі..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A222.english: "Perhaps. But that thread of the story is still unresolved..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A222.polish: „Być może. Ale ten wątek opowieści wciąż pozostaje splątany”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A222.belarusian: "Магчыма. Але гэтая нітка гісторыі пакуль застаецца нерасблытанай..."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A222.polish: „Tak, w zasadzie tak. Ale jak mówiłem, to tylko hipoteza...”
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A222.belarusian: "Так, у прынцыпе, так яно і ёсць. Але, як я казаў, гэта толькі рабочая версія..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A22F.english: "Good god, have we really been talking about 'unpeeling time' for a quarter hour?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A22F.polish: „Wielkie nieba, czy my naprawdę przez cały kwadrans rozmawialiśmy o »obieraniu czasu«?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A22F.belarusian: "Божухна, мы што, сапраўды цэлыя пятнаццаць хвілін абмяркоўваем 'абіранне часу'?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A236.english: His "experience" with these matters is painfully limited, not that he realises it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A236.polish: Jego „doświadczenie” w tej kwestii jest piekielnie ograniczone. Nie żeby zdawał sobie z tego sprawę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A236.belarusian: Яго "досвед" у такіх справах пакутліва мізэрны, хоць сам ён гэтага і не ўсведамляе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A23D.english: "Steban's right. If it's going to happen, it will happen."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A23D.polish: „Steban ma rację. Jeśli to ma się stać, to się stanie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A23D.belarusian: "Стэбан мае рацыю. Калі гэтаму наканавана здарыцца, гэта здарыцца."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A244.english: "I suppose we'll have to leave it there. But listen, gendarme: We could use someone with your *breadth of expertise*. With just a little more theoretical background, I think you'll be able to make some real contributions."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A244.polish: „Na tym będziemy chyba musieli zakończyć ten temat. Ale posłuchaj, żandarmie – przydałby się nam ktoś z twoim *szerokim doświadczeniem*. Po uzupełnieniu teoretycznych podstaw, będziesz moim zdaniem wartościowym członkiem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A244.belarusian: "Мяркую, на гэтым нам давядзецца спыніцца. Але паслухай, жандарм: нам не завадзіў бы нехта з тваім *шырокім досведам*. Калі яшчэ крыху падцягнуць тэарэтычную базу, ты зможаш зрабіць рэальны ўнёсак."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A25D.english: "Yes, I would say he's got serious potential at least."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A25D.belarusian: "Так, я б сказаў, у яго як мінімум сур'ёзны патэнцыял."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A26C.english: "Besides, it's inconceivable that we'd turn down a fellow Wirrâl enthusiast..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A26C.polish: „Poza tym nie wyobrażam sobie, abyśmy mogli odrzucić kandydaturę entuzjasty Wirrâla...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A26C.belarusian: "Да таго ж немагчыма ўявіць, каб мы адмовілі аднадумцу — знаўцу Wirrâl..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A273.english: "And with that, welcome to the most ideologically advanced materialist reading group in Martinaise!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A273.polish: „Witam w najbardziej zaawansowanej ideologicznie grupie czytelniczej materialistów w Martinaise!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A273.belarusian: "І на гэтым — вітаем у самай ідэалагічна перадавой матэрыялістычнай чытацкай групе Марцінэза!"

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A273.polish: „W porządku, żandarmie” – stwierdza młody mężczyzna, ostrożnie pocierając swój policzek. „Zapracowałeś na swoje miejsce. Witaj w najbardziej zaawansowanej ideologicznie grupie czytelniczej materialistów w Martinaise!”
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A273.belarusian: "Добра, жандарм." Юнак асцярожна церці шчаку. "Ты заслужыў сваё месца. Вітаем у самай ідэалагічна перадавой матэрыялістычнай чытацкай групе Марцінэза!"

Alternate2/0x0100000F0000A273.polish: „No dobrze, maniaku” – młody mężczyzna przez chwilę masuje swoją obolałą szczękę. „Przekonajmy się, czy posługujesz się mózgiem równie sprawnie jak pięściami”.
Alternate2/0x0100000F0000A273.belarusian: "Добра, псіх." Юнак спыняецца, каб памасаваць сваю пабітую сківіцу. "Паглядзім, ці ўмееш ты карыстацца мазгамі так жа спрытна, як кулакамі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A281.english: "Here's your first assignment. It's an overview of infra-materialist theory. A little basic, as you'll see, but one has to start somewhere."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A281.polish: „Oto twoja pierwsza lektura – przegląd teorii inframaterialistycznej. To podstawy, ale trzeba od czegoś zacząć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A281.belarusian: "Вось тваё першае заданне. Гэта агляд інфраматэрыялістычнай тэорыі. Досыць базавы, як сам пабачыш, але ж трэба з нечага пачынаць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A288.english: "Guess it's time to see what this 'book' stuff is all about."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A288.polish: „No to czas się dowiedzieć, o co dokładnie chodzi w tych całych książkach”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A288.belarusian: "Здаецца, час даведацца, пра што наогул усе гэтыя 'кнігі'."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A28D.english: "I'll add it to my very extensive reading list."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A28D.polish: „Dodam ją do swojej bardzo długiej listy lektur”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A28D.belarusian: "Дадам яе да свайго надзвычай шырокага спісу чытва."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A292.polish: (Nic nie mów. Po prostu weź książkę).

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2A1.english: "It's sweet how excited you are. Come back when you're done. We'll be here pretty much every night after 22.00."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2A1.polish: „Twój entuzjazm jest uroczy. Wróć, gdy skończysz czytać. Jesteśmy tu praktycznie każdej nocy po 22:00”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2A1.belarusian: "Тваё захапленне кранае. Вяртайся, як скончыш. Мы тут практычна штовечар пасля 22:00."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2A6.english: "You're going to fit right in, I think. Come back when you're done. We'll be here pretty much every night after 22.00."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2A6.polish: „Myślę, że ta pozycja będzie do niej pasowała. Wróć, gdy skończysz czytać. Jesteśmy tu praktycznie każdej nocy po 22:00”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2A6.belarusian: "Думаю, ты выдатна ўпішашся. Вяртайся, як скончыш. Мы тут практычна штовечар пасля 22:00."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2AB.english: "Come back when you're done." He gives you a brief nod as he hands you the slim guide. "We'll be here pretty much every night after 22.00."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2AB.polish: „Wróć, gdy skończysz czytać” – kiwa głową i wręcza ci cienki przewodnik. „Jesteśmy tu praktycznie każdej nocy po 22:00”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2AB.belarusian: "Вяртайся, як скончыш." Ён коратка ківае, перадаючы табе тонкую брашуру. "Мы тут практычна штовечар пасля 22:00."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2B0.english: "Do be sure to take your time with the reading. We'll be eager to hear your thoughts."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2B0.polish: „Nie śpiesz się z czytaniem. Jesteśmy ciekawi twoich przemyśleń na ten temat”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2B0.belarusian: "Толькі не спяшайся з чытаннем. Нам будзе вельмі цікава пачуць твае думкі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2CE.english: Nope, still no words. Your confidence account is overdrawn. What are you even doing here?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2CE.polish: Nie, wciąż żadnych słów. Twoje konto pewności siebie ma manko. Co ty tu w ogóle robisz?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2CE.belarusian: Не, слоў усё яшчэ няма. Твой рахунак упэўненасці сышоў у мінус. Што ты наогул тут робіш?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2E1.english: Now you're just psyching yourself out. You've read plenty of books. Maybe try again once you've got your wits about you?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2E1.polish: Teraz to tylko podłamujesz sam siebie. Przeczytałeś masę książek. Może spróbuj jeszcze raz, jak poczujesz się trochę pewniej?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2E1.belarusian: Ты зараз сам сябе заганяеш. Ты прачытаў proцьму кніг. Можа, паспрабуеш яшчэ раз, калі збярэшся з думкамі?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2E6.english: Maybe now's a good time to call it an evening. Why don't you find a good book, clear your mind, and come back when you're refreshed?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2E6.polish: To może być dobry moment na zakończenie wieczora. Czemu nie poszukasz sobie dobrej książki? Oczyść umysł i wróć odświeżony.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2E6.belarusian: Можа, зараз добры момант завяршыць вечар? Чаму б табе не знайсці добрую кнігу, не ачысціць розум і не вярнуцца са свежымі сіламі?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2EB.english: Have you considered reading a *book*? Those tend to have *lots* of words in them...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2EB.polish: A myślałeś o przeczytaniu *książki*? One mają w sobie *dużo* słów...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A2EB.belarusian: А ты не думаў пачытаць *кнігу*? У іх звычайна бывае *шмат* слоў...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A303.english: Is it getting warm in here? There seems to be a little pool of sweat forming in the depression of your lower back.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A303.polish: Czy tu się robi ciepło? Czujesz, jak w zagłębieniu na plecach zbiera ci się pot.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A303.belarusian: Тут што, становіцца горача? Здаецца, у западзіне на паясніцы збіраецца цэлая лужынка поту.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A30A.english: Okay, you got this. You *got* this. Just... open your mouth, and say the words...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A30A.polish: Dobra, dasz radę. *Dasz radę*. Po prostu... otwórz usta i wypowiedz słowa...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A30A.belarusian: Так, ты справішся. Ты *справішся*. Проста... адкрый рот і вымаві словы...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A326.english: What are those sounds? They're like the last mumblings of a mortally wounded badger.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A326.polish: Co to za odgłosy? Brzmią jak przedśmiertny ryk rannego borsuka.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A326.belarusian: Што гэта за гукі? Яны падобныя да перадсмяротных хрыпаў смяротна параненага барсука.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A32B.english: There's nothing you can do. It's like your lips have been glued together.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A32B.polish: Nic nie możesz zrobić. Czujesz się, jakby ktoś zakleił ci usta.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A32B.belarusian: Ты нічога не можаш зрабіць. Нібы твае вусны злепленыя клеем.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A33F.english: "Everything in order, detective?" The lieutenant gives you a concerned look.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A33F.polish: „Wszystko w porządku, detektywie?” – porucznik spogląda na ciebie z niepokojem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A33F.belarusian: "Усё ў парадку, дэтэктыве?" Лейтэнант глядзіць на цябе са спагадай і непакоем.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A34D.english: The young man gives you a concerned look.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A34D.polish: Młody mężczyzna spogląda na ciebie z niepokojem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A34D.belarusian: Юнак глядзіць на цябе са спагадай і непакоем.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A35F.english: "That's a 'yes,' I take it? Can you give me an affirmative?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A35F.belarusian: "Гэта значыць 'так', я правільна разумею? Можаце пацвердзіць словамі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A374.english: What are you worried about? You've read plenty of books. Why don't you take a little pause, come back once your mind's clear?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A374.polish: Czym ty się martwisz? Przeczytałeś masę książek. Może zrób sobie chwilę przerwy i wróć, kiedy trochę oczyścisz umysł?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A374.belarusian: Пра што ты хвалюешся? Ты прачытаў proцьму кніг. Чаму б табе не зрабіць невялікую паўзу і не вярнуцца, калі галава праясніцца?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A379.english: You're intimidated by all the books these kids have read, aren't you? Maybe a trip to the bookstore would do you some good.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A379.polish: Trochę przerażają cię te wszystkie przeczytane przez nich książki, co? Może pomogłaby ci wizyta w księgarni.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A379.belarusian: Цябе палохаюць усе гэтыя кнігі, якія прачыталі гэтыя хлопцы, ці не так? Магчыма, паход у кнігарню табе дапаможа.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A380.english: What is it? Are you scared because you can't remember a single book you've read?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A380.polish: O co chodzi? Boisz się, bo nie pamiętasz ani jednej przeczytanej przez siebie książki?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A380.belarusian: У чым справа? Баішся, бо не памятаеш ніводнай прачытанай кнігі?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A39B.english: "Is everything alright? Is there something you're trying to say?"

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A39B.polish: „Wszystko w porządku?” – młody mężczyzna pyta, po czym zwraca się do porucznika: „Czy on próbuje coś powiedzieć?”
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A39B.belarusian: "Усё добра?" Юнак паварочваецца да лейтэнанта. "Ён спрабуе нешта сказаць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3A9.english: What is it? Are you scared because you can't remember a single book you've read?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3A9.polish: O co chodzi? Boisz się, bo nie pamiętasz ani jednej przeczytanej przez siebie książki?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3A9.belarusian: У чым справа? Баішся, бо не памятаеш ніводнай прачытанай кнігі?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3AF.english: You're intimidated by all the books these kids have read, aren't you? Maybe a trip to the bookstore would do you some good.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3AF.polish: Trochę przerażają cię te wszystkie przeczytane przez nich książki, co? Może pomogłaby ci wizyta w księgarni.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3AF.belarusian: Цябе палохаюць усе гэтыя кнігі, якія прачыталі гэтыя хлопцы, ці не так? Магчыма, паход у кнігарню табе дапаможа.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3B5.english: What are you worried about? You've read plenty of books. Why don't you take a little pause, come back once your mind's clear?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3B5.polish: Czym ty się martwisz? Przeczytałeś masę książek. Może zrób sobie chwilę przerwy i wróć, kiedy trochę oczyścisz umysł?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3B5.belarusian: Пра што ты хвалюешся? Ты прачытаў proцьму кніг. Чаму б табе не зрабіць невялікую паўзу і не вярнуцца, калі галава праясніцца?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3BC.english: "As in, 'No, everything is *not* in order'? Can you give me a negative, detective?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3BC.polish: „Czy to znaczy »nie, *nie* jest w porządku«? Czy możesz to potwierdzić, detektywie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3BC.belarusian: "У сэнсе: 'Не, усё *не* ў парадку'? Можаце адказаць дакладна, дэтэктыве?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3EE.english: "It seems he's lost his words. A case of momentary aphasia, it looks like..." The lieutenant does not appear overly concerned.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3EE.polish: „Zdaje się, że zaniemówił. Wygląda to na przypadek chwilowej afazji...” – porucznik nie sprawia wrażenia zbytnio przejętego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3EE.belarusian: "Здаецца, ён страціў дар мовы. Падобна на выпадак кароткачасовай афазіі..." Лейтэнант не выглядае асабліва занепакоеным.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3FB.english: It wouldn't be the first neurological episode you've experienced on this case.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3FB.polish: Nie byłby to pierwszy neurologiczny problem, jaki dotknął cię podczas pracy przy tym śledztwie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A3FB.belarusian: Гэта не першы неўралагічны прыступ, з якім ты сутыкнуўся падчас гэтай справы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A402.english: "In any case, a change of subject might help."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A402.polish: „Tak czy inaczej, zmiana tematu może pomóc”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A402.belarusian: "Ва ўсякім разе, змена тэмы можа дапамагчы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A409.english: Momentary aphasia, it seems. Just one more neurological episode for the station lazareth to look into during your next check-up.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A409.polish: Zdaje się, że to chwilowa afazja. Kolejny problem neurologiczny, którym powinien zająć się lazaret na komisariacie, kiedy pójdziesz na wizytę kontrolną.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A409.belarusian: Здаецца, кароткачасовая афазія. Проста яшчэ адзін неўралагічны прыступ, з якім варта разабрацца ў паліцэйскім лазарэце падчас наступнага медыцынскага агляду.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A410.english: "He looks like he's about to puke."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A410.polish: „Wygląda, jakby miał za chwilę puścić pawia”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A418.english: There might be a little bile gathering at the back of your throat, but it's just a taste. The source of this issue is higher up the wire...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A418.polish: Możliwe, że w gardle zbiera ci się nieco kwasów żołądkowych, ale to tylko posmak. Prawdziwa przyczyna tego stanu rzeczy znajduje się nieco wyżej...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A418.belarusian: Магчыма, у горле і падступае трохі жоўці, але гэта толькі прысмак. Крыніца гэтай праблемы знаходзіцца вышэй па дроце...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A425.english: "These things happen with him sometimes. I recommend a change of subject."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A425.polish: „Czasem mu się to zdarza. Radzę zmienić temat”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A425.belarusian: "З ім такое часам бывае. Раджу змяніць тэму."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A42E.english: "Would it help if we changed the subject?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A438.english: This isn't going to work. Maybe there's some other way you could prove yourself to them?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A438.polish: To się nie uda. Może dasz radę ich do siebie przekonać w jakiś inny sposób?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A438.belarusian: Нічога не выйдзе. Можа, ёсць іншы спосаб даказаць ім, што ты на нешта здатны?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A44D.english: It's because I don't do well in interviews.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A44D.polish: To dlatego, że nie radzę sobie za dobrze w takich wywiadach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A44D.belarusian: Гэта таму, што я кепска праходжу сумоўі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A452.english: Definitely not sweating, no sir. (Wipe the sweat away.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A452.polish: Ani trochę się nie pocę, gdzie tam. (Otrzyj pot).
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A452.belarusian: Я дакладна не пацею, не-не. (Выцерці пот.)

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A452.polish: Ani trochę się nie pocę, gdzie tam. (Wytrzyj pot w koszulę).
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A452.belarusian: Я дакладна не пацею, не-не. (Прамакнуць пот кашуляй.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A457.english: I'm not nervous, I'm a superstar.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A45C.english: Why is this happening? I thought I had my shit together!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A45C.polish: Czemu to się dzieje? Myślałem, że ogarnąłem całe to gówno!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A45C.belarusian: Чаму гэта адбываецца? Я думаў, я цалкам сабраны!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A461.english: Why am I getting so worked up? They're just a couple of kids!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A461.polish: Czemu ja się tak stresuję? To tylko jakieś dzieciaki!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A461.belarusian: Чаго я так узвіўся? Гэта ж проста парачка падлеткаў!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A470.english: Excellent work, now there's a glistening smear across your bare chest. Everyone will be able to see the evidence of your overactive sweat glands.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A470.polish: Doskonała robota, teraz na twojej piersi błyszczy się rozsmarowana smuga. Wszyscy zobaczą na własne oczy efekt działania twoich zbytnio wyczulonych gruczołów potowych.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A470.belarusian: Выдатная праца: цяпер па тваіх голых грудзях размазаная бліскучая паласа. Кожны зможа пабачыць доказ гіперактыўнасці тваіх потовых залоз.

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A470.polish: Doskonała robota, teraz na twojej koszuli na plecach widnieje ciemny odcisk dłoni. Wszyscy zobaczą na własne oczy efekt działania twoich zbytnio wyczulonych gruczołów potowych.
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A470.belarusian: Выдатная праца: цяпер на спіне тваёй кашулі цёмны адбітак рукі. Кожны зможа пабачыць доказ гіперактыўнасці тваіх потовых залоз.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A476.english: Oh, totally. A superstar breaking out in a cold sweat.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A476.polish: Och, absolutnie. Supergwiazdą zlaną zimnym potem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A476.belarusian: О, ну вядома. Суперзорка, якая абліваецца халодным потам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A47B.english: You did. You must be extremely nervous for some reason.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A47B.polish: Ogarnąłeś. Z jakiegoś powodu musisz być wyjątkowo zdenerwowany.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A47B.belarusian: Ты і быў. З нейкай прычыны ты, напэўна, страшэнна нервуешся.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A480.english: Let's be frank, they're probably way smarter than you. You bet they've read more books than you can even name...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A480.polish: Powiedzmy sobie szczerze: prawdopodobnie są od ciebie wiele mądrzejsi. Gotów jesteś się założyć, że przeczytali więcej książek, niż ty chociażby znasz...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A480.belarusian: Будзьма шчырымі: яны, хутчэй за ўсё, нашмат разумнейшыя за цябе. Заклад, яны прачыталі больш кніг, чым ты здольны нават назваць...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A485.english: No, you're terrible at them. The thought of everyone looking at you, judging you, makes you want to heave, frankly...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A485.polish: Jesteś w nich beznadziejny. Myśl, że wszyscy na ciebie patrzą i cię oceniają, przyprawia cię, prawdę mówiąc, o ciężki oddech...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A485.belarusian: Не, ты ў іх проста бяздарны. Ад адной думкі, што ўсе на цябе глядзяць і ацэньваюць, цябе, шчыра кажучы, цягне ванітаваць...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4AE.english: You've been quite studious these past few days. You should be able to handle whatever they want to throw your way.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4AE.polish: Przez ostatnich kilka dni byłeś naprawdę pilny. Powinieneś dać radę wszystkiemu, czym mogą próbować cię tu zaskoczyć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4AE.belarusian: "За апошнія некалькі дзён ты быў вельмі руплівым. Ты павінен лёгка справіцца з усім, што б яны табе ні падкінулі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4B3.english: Of course, if you're nervous it wouldn't hurt to read another book or two.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4B3.polish: Choć, oczywiście, jeśli się denerwujesz, nie zaszkodzi przeczytać jeszcze jakiejś książki czy dwóch.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4B3.belarusian: Вядома, калі ты нервуешся, не зашкодзіць прачытаць яшчэ кнігу ці дзве.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4B8.english: Of course, it wouldn't kill you to crack open a book every once in a while.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4B8.polish: Oczywiście nic by ci się nie stało, gdybyś od czasu do czasu przeczytał jakąś książkę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4B8.belarusian: Вядома, ты б не памёр, калі б час ад часу разгортваў якую-небудзь кніжку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4C3.english: The hardest part will just be working up the nerve to ask without soiling yourself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4C3.polish: Najtrudniej będzie zdobyć się na to, żeby spytać, nie paskudząc sobie przy okazji z nerwów bielizny.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4C3.belarusian: Самым цяжкім будзе набрацца смеласці спытаць і не абгадзіцца пры гэтым.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4C9.english: "Everything alright, gendarme? You look a little green about the gills..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4C9.polish: „Wszystko w porządku, żandarmie? Zrobiłeś się odrobinę zielonkawy...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4C9.belarusian: "Усё добра, жандарм? Ты выглядаеш крыху зеленаватым..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4D8.english: "Listen, there's got to be some other way I could prove myself to the group."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4D8.polish: „Słuchajcie, musi być jakiś sposób, żebym mógł udowodnić swoją wartość dla grupy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4D8.belarusian: "Слухайце, мусіць жа быць нейкі іншы спосаб даказаць сваю карысць для гуртка."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4E3.english: "'Some other way'?" He squints at you. "If you're not much of a reader, why are you so dead-set on joining this reading group?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4E3.polish: „Jakiś inny sposób?” – wpatruje się w ciebie zmrużonymi oczami. „Jeśli nie przepadasz za czytaniem, to dlaczego tak bardzo chcesz dołączyć do czytelniczej grupy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4E3.belarusian: ""Іншы спосаб"?" Ён прыжмурваецца, гледзячы на цябе. "Калі ты не аматар чытаць, чаму ты так заўзята хочаш далучыцца да гэтага чытальнага гуртка?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4EA.english: "It's important that I further my critical studies."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4EA.polish: „To bardzo ważne, żebym kontynuował swoje krytyczne analizy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4EA.belarusian: "Для мяне важна працягваць свае крытычныя даследаванні."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4EF.english: "I've come so far, please don't turn me back now."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4EF.polish: „Dotarłem już tak daleko. Proszę, nie odprawiajcie mnie teraz z kwitkiem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4EF.belarusian: "Я зайшоў так далёка, калі ласка, не праганяйце мяне цяпер."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A4EF.polish: „Wybaczcie, że błagam, ale dotarłem aż tutaj. Proszę, nie odprawiajcie mnie teraz z kwitkiem”.
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A4EF.belarusian: "Прабачце, што малю, але я прарабіў такі шлях... калі ласка, не праганяйце мяне цяпер."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4F4.english: "I'm a completionist. I've got to finish what I start."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4F4.polish: „Prawdziwego mężczyznę poznaje się po tym, jak kończy. Muszę to zrobić”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4F4.belarusian: "Я перфекцыяніст. Я павінен завяршаць тое, што пачаў."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A4F4.polish: „To dla mnie sprawa honoru. Muszę dokończyć to, co zacząłem”.
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A4F4.belarusian: "Для мяне гэта справа гонару. Я павінен скончыць тое, што пачаў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4F9.english: "Because this plasm stuff sounds totally disco. I have to get to the bottom of it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4F9.polish: „Bo cała ta plazma brzmi zupełnie jak disco. Muszę ją dokładnie zgłębić”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4F9.belarusian: "Бо ўся гэтая плазма гучыць абсалютна дыска. Я павінен дакапацца да сутнасці."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4FE.english: "Like Ignus Nilsen himself, I've come to foretell a Great Reckoning."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4FE.polish: „Bo jak sam Ignus Nilsen przybyłem przepowiedzieć wielki sąd”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A4FE.belarusian: "Як сам Ігнус Нільсэн, я прыйшоў прадказаць Вялікую Расплату."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A508.english: "I suppose we are all here to advance our studies in some form or another..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A508.polish: „Wszystkim nam chyba zależy, aby robić postępy w taki czy inny sposób...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A508.belarusian: "Мяркую, мы ўсе тут дзеля таго, каб так ці інакш паглыбляць свае веды..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A50E.english: The young man sighs. "God, it's so pitiful watching a grown man beg. I can hardly stand it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A50E.polish: Młody mężczyzna wzdycha. „Boże, widok błagającego dorosłego mężczyzny jest taki żałosny. Ledwo to znoszę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A50E.belarusian: Малады чалавек уздыхае. "Божа, як жа жаласна глядзець, калі дарослы мужчына моліць. Я ледзь гэта вытрымліваю."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A513.english: "I do have to admire a certain tenacity, even when it seems to make no sense."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A513.polish: „Podziwiam wytrwałość, nawet jeśli wydaje mi się pozbawiona sensu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A513.belarusian: "Я мушу аддаць належнае пэўнай упартасці, нават калі яна здаецца пазбаўленай сэнсу."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A513.polish: „Honor to przestarzałe pojęcia, relikt feudalnej ideologii. Niemniej jednak podziwiam twoje zaangażowanie...”
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A513.belarusian: ""Гонар" — састарэлае паняцце, рэлікт феадальнай ідэалогіі. Тым не менш, я вымушаны аддаць належнае тваёй адданасці..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A518.english: "Oh, it *is*, and it only gets *more disco* from here..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A518.polish: „Och, to *prawda* – i im dalej w las, tym robi się *bardziej disco*...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A518.belarusian: "О, так яно і *ёсць*, і далей будзе толькі *яшчэ больш дыска*..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A51D.english: "Hmmm. I thought I perceived some *eschatological* air about you..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A51D.polish: „Hmm... Tak wydawało mi się, że otacza cię pewna *eschatologiczna* aura...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A51D.belarusian: "Хм-м. Мне так і здавалася, што ад цябе вее чымсьці *эсхаталагічным*..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A526.english: "But to be perfectly frank, I just don't see it happening."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A526.polish: „Ale szczerze mówiąc, po prostu tego nie widzę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A526.belarusian: "Але, шчыра кажучы, я проста не бачу, як гэта можа атрымацца."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A547.english: "Steban, a moment..." The young man's companion beckons him into a private conference.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A547.polish: „Steban, pozwól na chwilę...” – towarzysz młodego człowieka odciąga go na bok, aby zamienić z nim słowo.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A547.belarusian: "Стэбан, хвіліначку..." Таварыш маладога чалавека кліча яго адысці на пару слоў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A54E.english: "What... really? You're saying... but there's no way... uh huh... yes, okay, I'm listening..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A54E.polish: „Co... poważnie? Twierdzisz, że... ale to nie możliwe... aha... tak, w porządku, słucham...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A54E.belarusian: "Што... сур'ёзна? Ты хочаш сказаць... але гэта немагчыма... ага... так, добра, я слухаю..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A555.english: "Alright, gendarme." He turns back to you. "Comrade Ulixes and I have conferred about it, and we've come up with an alternative way for you to convince us of your commitment to the group."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A555.polish: „W porządku, żandarmie” – stwierdza, odwracając się do ciebie. „Towarzysz Ulixes i ja przedyskutowaliśmy twoją kandydaturę i znaleźliśmy alternatywny sposób na to, byś przekonał nas o swoim oddaniu grupie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A555.belarusian: "Добра, жандарм." Ён паварочваецца да цябе. "Мы з камрадам Уліксам параіліся і прыдумалі альтэрнатыўны спосаб, як ты можаш пераканаць нас у сваёй адданасці гуртку."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A563.english: The young man gives his companion an uncertain glance. The companion nods his head vigorously.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A563.polish: Młody mężczyzna zerka niepewnie na swojego towarzysza, który żarliwie kiwa głową.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A563.belarusian: Малады чалавек няўпэўнена глядзіць на свайго таварыша. Той энергічна ківае галавой.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A578.english: "It doesn't have to be a *hard* hit." He indicates his cheek. "Just enough to leave a mark."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A578.polish: „To nie musi być *mocne* uderzenie” – stwierdza, wskazując swój policzek. „Wystarczy, że zostanie ślad”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A578.belarusian: "Гэта не абавязкова павінен быць *моцны* ўдар." Ён паказвае на сваю шчаку. "Дастаткова, каб застаўся след."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A57D.english: "The idea," his companion jumps in, "is to show Maurice and those other traitors that we're the only reading group *hard core* enough to tangle with the RCM..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A57D.polish: „Chodzi o to” – wtrąca się jego towarzysz – „aby pokazać Maurice'owi i pozostałym zdrajcom, że jesteśmy jedyną wystarczająco *hardkorową* grupą czytelniczą, by wdać się w walkę z MOR-em...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A57D.belarusian: "Ідэя ў тым," — ускоквае ягоны таварыш, — "каб паказаць Марысу і тым іншым здраднікам, што мы адзіны чытальны гурток, які настолькі *хардкорны*, каб схапіцца з RCM..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5A1.english: Now's your chance to redeem yourself for that dive you took before the gremlin child.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5A1.polish: To twoja szansa na zrehabilitowanie się po tym, co odwaliłeś przy gremlińskim bachorze.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5A1.belarusian: Вось твой шанец рэабілітавацца за тое, як ты паваліўся перад тым малым грэмлінам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5A6.english: Now's your chance to avenge yourself for your embarrassment by the harbour gates.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5A6.polish: To twoja szansa na pomszczenie kompromitacji, jaką przeżyłeś przy bramie do portu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5A6.belarusian: Вось твой шанец адпомсціць за ганьбу каля варот у порт.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5AB.english: He won't be the first unweaned punk you've shut down. You'll make mincemeat of this fool's jaw.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5AB.polish: Nie będzie pierwszym gówniarzem, którego wyłączysz z obiegu. Zrobisz ze szczęki tego durnia mięso mielone.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5AB.belarusian: Ён будзе не першым сапляком, якога ты супакоіў. Ты зробіш фарш са сківіцы гэтага дурня.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5B0.english: You've done it before, and against a *much* tougher opponent. You'll make mincemeat of this fool's jaw.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5B0.polish: Robiłeś już takie rzeczy z *o wiele* twardszymi przeciwnikami. Zrobisz ze szczęki tego durnia mięso mielone.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5B0.belarusian: Ты рабіў гэта раней, і супраць *значна* мацнейшага суперніка. Ты зробіш фарш са сківіцы гэтага дурня.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5B5.english: This is what you've been waiting for! Time to lay his little punk-ass out.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5B5.polish: Właśnie na to czekałeś! Czas położyć tego gnojka na ziemię.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5B5.belarusian: Вось чаго ты чакаў! Час высекчы гэтага сапляка.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5E2.english: "Ah, we're replaying *this* little episode. Please, do try to stay on your feet this time."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5E2.polish: „Czyli powtórka z *rozrywki*. Proszę, postaraj się tym razem utrzymać na nogach”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5E2.belarusian: "А, мы паўтараем *гэты* эпізод. Калі ласка, паспрабуйце гэтым разам утрымацца на нагах."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5E7.english: "This has certainly turned out to be a punchier case than I had anticipated."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5E7.polish: „Nie sądziłem, że w tej sprawie pięści będą tak często szły w ruch”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5E7.belarusian: "Гэтая справа выявілася куды больш рукапашнай, чым я чакаў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5EC.english: "Ah, so we're beating *another* youth only tangentially connected to the case. Spectacular."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5EC.polish: „Ach, czyli pobijemy *kolejnego* młodego człowieka tylko pośrednio związanego z tą sprawą. Cudownie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5EC.belarusian: "А, дык мы б'ём *яшчэ аднаго* юнака, які толькі ўскосна звязаны са справай. Цудоўна."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5F1.english: "Easy, detective. No need to treat this kid like he's some Son of Measurehead."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5F1.polish: „Spokojnie, detektywie. Nie traktuj tego dzieciaka, jakby był jakimś synem Miarogłowego”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5F1.belarusian: "Лягчэй, дэтэктыве. Не трэба абыходзіцца з гэтым хлопцам так, нібы ён сын Межэрхэда."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5F6.english: "Ah, so we're beating the youth now? That's an unexpected development."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5F6.polish: „Ach, czyli teraz bierzemy się za bicie młodzieży? Tego się nie spodziewałem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A5F6.belarusian: "А, дык мы цяпер б'ём моладзь? Нечаканы паварот."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A600.english: Of course, this isn't some punch-out competition. You just want to leave a harmless bruise.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A600.polish: To nie jest, rzecz jasna, żaden turniej bokserski. Chcesz nabić mu tylko niegroźnego siniaka.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A600.belarusian: Зразумела, гэта не нейкі кулачны турнір. Ты проста хочаш пакінуць бяскрыўдны сіняк.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A610.english: Just theorising here, but if you don't have as much control over your muscle groups as you'd like, perhaps you could try something you *know* is bound to fail...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A610.polish: To tylko hipoteza, ale jeśli nie masz tak dużej kontroli nad swoimi grupami mięśniowymi, jak byś sobie tego życzył, może powinieneś spróbować czegoś, o czym *wiesz*, że się nie uda...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A610.belarusian: Чыста тэарэтычна: калі ты не так добра кантралюеш свае групы цягліц, як хацелася б, можа, варта паспрабаваць тое, што, як ты *ведаеш*, дакладна праваліцца...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A61D.english: Wait, you're saying I could try to really lay this kid out, knowing I'll probably screw it up?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A61D.polish: Czekaj, mówisz mi, że mógłbym naprawdę spróbować znokautować tego dzieciaka, bo prawdopodobnie to spieprzę?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A61D.belarusian: Чакай, ты кажаш, што я магу паспрабаваць па-сапраўднаму вырубіць гэтага пацана, ведаючы, што, хутчэй за ўсё, усё запору?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A639.polish: Zakładając, że przypadkowo ci się nie powiedzie...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A639.belarusian: Калі, вядома, у цябе выпадкова не атрымаецца...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A648.english: "Kim, how bad an idea is this?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A648.polish: „Kim, jak bardzo zły jest ten pomysł?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A64D.polish: „Hej, Kim. A może tak *ty* go uderzysz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A64D.belarusian: "Гэй, Кім, а што, калі *ты* яго ўдарыш?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A652.english: Hit him, but not too hard.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A652.polish: Uderz go, ale nie za mocno.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A652.belarusian: Ударыць яго, але не надта моцна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A65C.english: "This is absurd. I don't want to hit you." (Cancel task.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A65C.polish: „To jakiś absurd. Nie chcę cię bić”. (Anuluj zadanie).
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A65C.belarusian: "Гэта абсурд. Я не хачу цябе біць." (Адмяніць заданне.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A66D.english: The lieutenant looks at you, then at the young man. He seems to be giving your question serious consideration.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A66D.polish: Porucznik spogląda na ciebie, a następnie na młodego mężczyznę. Wydaje się, że poważnie rozważa twoje pytanie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A66D.belarusian: Лейтэнант глядзіць на цябе, потым на маладога чалавека. Здаецца, ён сур'ёзна абдумвае тваё пытанне.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A67A.english: "Speaking as an officer of the RCM, it is an *extremely* bad idea to strike a civilian without cause..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A67A.polish: „Jako funkcjonariusz MOR-u uważam, że uderzenie cywila bez powodu to *ekstremalnie* zły pomysł...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A67A.belarusian: "Як афіцэр RCM, скажу, што біць цывільнага без прычыны — *надзвычай* кепская ідэя..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A67F.english: "Speaking frankly, it's a terrible idea. The RCM already has issues with *wanton brutality* and this is unlikely to ameliorate those concerns..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A67F.polish: „Szczerze mówiąc, uważam, że to fatalny pomysł. MOR ma problemy z *bezzasadną brutalnością*, a to raczej ich nie złagodzi...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A67F.belarusian: "Шчыра кажучы, гэта жудасная ідэя. RCM і без таго мае праблемы з *неапраўданай жорсткасцю*, і гэта наўрад ці выправіць сітуацыю..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A688.english: "However, if one were to strike a civilian, which again I would never recommend, one should at least follow the RCM manual's guidance on non-lethal strikes."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A688.polish: „Jednak jeśli już musisz uderzyć cywila – czego w żadnym razie nie zalecam – to powinieneś przynajmniej postępować zgodnie z wytycznymi MOR-u dotyczącymi zadawania nieśmiercionośnych ciosów”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A688.belarusian: "Аднак, калі ўжо біць цывільнага — чаго я, паўтаруся, ні ў якім разе не рэкамендую, — варта хаця б прытрымлівацца інструкцый RCM па несмяротных ударах."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A694.english: "I don't need a book to tell me how to deck a guy."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A694.polish: „Nie potrzebuję żadnych regulaminów, żeby wiedzieć, jak kogoś znokautować”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A694.belarusian: "Мне не патрэбна кніжка, каб ведаць, як камусьці заехаць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A69D.english: "It advises officers in physical altercations to rely on the open-palm strike, as opposed to the backhand, in non-lethal situations."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A69D.polish: „Funkcjonariusze biorący udział w fizycznym starciu powinni ograniczyć się do uderzeń otwartą dłonią i unikać ciosów jej odwrotną stroną”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A69D.belarusian: "У несмяротных сітуацыях пры фізічных сутычках яна раіць афіцэрам спадзявацца на ўдар адкрытай далонню, у адрозненне ад удару тыльным бокам."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6A3.english: "You see, that attitude is precisely why the field manual's guidance is so valuable..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6A3.polish: „Właśnie takie nastawienie jest powodem, dla którego oficjalne wytyczne są tak cenne...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6A3.belarusian: "Вось бачыце, менавіта праз такое стаўленне парады з палявога статута такія каштоўныя..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6AC.english: "I can't recall the exact explanation, but it has something to do with the kinetic energy stored in the elbow. Basically, you're less able to control a *backhanded* slap, and therefore more likely to cause serious injury."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6AC.polish: „Nie pamiętam dokładnego wyjaśnienia, ale ma to coś wspólnego z energią kinetyczną zgromadzoną w łokciu. Zasadniczo uderzając *backhandem* masz mniejszą kontrolę nad ciosem, a przez to istnieje większe ryzyko spowodowania poważnych obrażeń”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6AC.belarusian: "Я не памятаю дакладнага тлумачэння, але гэта неяк звязана з кінетычнай энергіяй у локці. Прасцей кажучы, аплявуху *тыльным бокам далоні* значна цяжэй кантраляваць, таму вышэйшая рызыка нанесці цяжкія траўмы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6B9.english: "Or even death, if, say, you happen to be wearing a set of armoured ceramic gauntlets."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6B9.polish: „A nawet śmierci, jeśli tak się złoży, że będziesz miał na rękach ceramiczne rękawice”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6B9.belarusian: "Ці нават прывесці да смерці, калі на вас, скажам, браніраваныя керамічныя рукавіцы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6BE.english: "At the same time, this is emphatically *your thing*, so do as you will."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6BE.polish: „Jednocześnie jest to zdecydowanie *twoja sprawa*, więc rób, jak chcesz”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6BE.belarusian: "У той жа час, гэта выключна *ваша справа*, таму рабіце як ведаеце."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6C9.english: "Well, gendarme? What are we waiting for?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6D5.english: "There's no *what if*, because I won't. This is your thing, remember?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6D5.polish: „Nie ma żadnego *co jeśli*, bo tego nie zrobię. To twoja sprawa, pamiętasz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A6D5.belarusian: "Ніякіх *а што калі*, бо я гэтага рабіць не буду. Гэта ваша справа, памятаеце?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A703.english: As with all applications of violence, the key is the appropriate amount of force exercised with absolute control on the part of the wielder.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A703.polish: Podobnie jak w przypadku każdego użycia przemocy, najważniejsze jest użycie odpowiedniej siły zastosowanej z absolutną kontrolą ze strony bijącego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A703.belarusian: Як і ва ўсіх праявах гвалту, галоўнае тут — належная сіла, прыкладзеная з абсалютным самакантролем.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A708.english: If you were trying this against an actual opponent, it would be a meagre, embarrassing effort.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A708.polish: Gdybyś spróbował zrobić to z prawdziwym przeciwnikiem, byłby to naprawdę kompromitujący cios.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A708.belarusian: Калі б ты паспрабаваў гэта супраць сапраўднага суперніка, гэта была б мізэрная, ганебная спроба.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A713.english: Fortunately, you're trying *not* to cause any real damage.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A713.polish: Szczęśliwie starasz się *nie zrobić* mu żadnej krzywdy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A713.belarusian: На шчасце, ты якраз і намагаешся *не* нанесці сапраўднай шкоды.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A735.english: Ensconced in your ceramic armour, you barely notice the moment of contact. Striking the young man's face is almost indistinguishable from swatting away a fly.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A735.polish: Zamknięty w swoim ceramicznym pancerzu ledwo wyczuwasz moment zadania ciosu. Uderzenie twarzy młodego mężczyzny jest niczym odpędzenie natrętnej muchy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A735.belarusian: Схаваўшыся ў сваёй керамічнай брані, ты ледзь заўважаеш момант удару. Пляснуць маладога чалавека па твары — амаль тое самае, што адагнаць муху.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A73A.english: At the moment of contact you feel the pads of your bare fingers brush the wiry hairs of the young man's beard, as though caressing a wad of kitchen wool.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A73A.polish: W momencie uderzenia czujesz, jak twoje odsłonięte palce ocierają się o szorstką brodę mężczyzny, jakby gładziły włosie zmiotki.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A73A.belarusian: У момант удару ты адчуваеш, як падушачкі тваіх голых пальцаў закранаюць жорсткія валасінкі барады маладога чалавека, нібы ты гладзіш кавалак металічнай вяхоткі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A73F.english: The actual moment of contact is ever-so-slightly disappointing, as the feeling is dulled by the yellow latex shell that contains your hand.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A73F.polish: Moment uderzenia jest nieco rozczarowujący – odczucie przytępiła żółta, lateksowa powłoka, w której skrywa się twoja dłoń.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A73F.belarusian: Сам момант кантакту крыху расчароўвае, бо адчуванні прытупляюцца жоўтай латэкснай абалонкай, у якую апранутая твая рука.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A744.english: At the moment of contact you feel the wool of your fingerless gloves entangling with the wiry hairs of the young man's beard. His eyes are wide as a pair of old silver coins.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A744.polish: W momencie uderzenia czujesz, jak wełna twoich bezpalczastych rękawiczek styka się z szorstką brodą mężczyzny. Jego szeroko otwarte oczy wyglądają jak stare, srebrne monety.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A744.belarusian: У момант удару ты адчуваеш, як воўна тваіх пальчатак без пальцаў чапляецца за жорсткія валасінкі барады маладога чалавека. Ягоныя вочы шырокія, як пара старых срэбраных манет.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A749.english: At the moment of contact the high-performance gripping that covers the palm of your glove causes your hand to *stick* for an instant against the young man's cheek. As your hand pulls away, his pale skin appears momentarily to follow with it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A749.polish: W momencie uderzenia przyczepna powierzchnia pokrywająca wnętrze twojej rękawiczki sprawia, że dłoń *przykleja* ci się na moment do policzka mężczyzny. Kiedy zabierasz rękę, jego skóra wydaje się przez moment podążać za nią.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A749.belarusian: У момант кантакту чапкае пакрыццё на далоні тваёй пальчаткі прымушае руку на імгненне *прыліпнуць* да шчакі маладога чалавека. Калі ты адводзіш руку, здаецца, нібы ягоная бледная скура цягнецца следам за ёй.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A758.english: The young man staggers back into the couch, eyes agog and momentarily dazed, but not seriously hurt.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A758.polish: Młody mężczyzna zatacza się do tyłu i wpada na kanapę, spojrzenie ma zaalarmowane i chwilowo oszołomione, ale nie jest poważnie ranny.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A758.belarusian: Малады чалавек хістаецца назад і падае на канапу з круглымі ад здзіўлення вачыма, на імгненне агаломшаны, але сур'ёзна не пацярпелы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A76D.english: "Not the best look for the RCM, but I suppose it could've gone worse."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A76D.polish: „Nie wgląda to dobrze dla MOR-u, ale mogło być gorzej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A76D.belarusian: "Не найлепшы ўчынак для рэпутацыі RCM, але, мяркую, магло быць і горш."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A77C.polish: „I kto jest teraz największym twardzielem wśród komunistów?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A77C.belarusian: "І хто тут цяпер самы круты камуніст?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A78E.english: "That... was *amazing*. Uli, perhaps we should tangle with the gendarmerie more often." The young man rubs his cheek.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A78E.polish: „To... było *niesamowite*. Uli, może powinniśmy spotykać się z tym żandarmem częściej” – stwierdza młody mężczyzna, pocierając policzek.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A78E.belarusian: "Гэта... было *неверагодна*. Улі, магчыма, нам варта часцей счэплівацца з жандармерыяй." Малады чалавек церці шчаку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A794.english: "No, keep it. I feel... *great*, actually..." He turns to his companion. "Perhaps we should tangle with the gendarmerie more often."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A794.polish: „Nie trzeba. Czuję się... *świetnie*...” – stwierdza i zwraca się do swojego towarzysza: „Może powinniśmy spotykać się z tym żandarmem częściej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A794.belarusian: "Не, пакінь сабе. Насамрэч я адчуваю сябе... *выдатна*..." Ён паварочваецца да свайго таварыша. "Магчыма, нам варта часцей счэплівацца з жандармерыяй."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A799.english: "I'm fine. Better than fine, actually." The young man rubs his cheek. "Perhaps we should tangle with the gendarmerie more often."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A799.polish: „Wszystko w porządku. A nawet lepiej niż w porządku” – stwierdza młody mężczyzna, pocierając policzek. „Może powinniśmy spotykać się z tym żandarmem częściej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A799.belarusian: "Я ў парадку. Нават лепш, чым у парадку." Малады чалавек церці шчаку. "Магчыма, нам варта часцей счэплівацца з жандармерыяй."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7A6.english: It doesn't hurt, yet. The rush of endorphins will keep the pain at bay for a while yet.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7A6.polish: Nie czuje bólu. Na razie. Napływ endorfin jeszcze przez chwilę będzie go tłumił.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7A6.belarusian: Пакуль не баліць. Прыліў эндарфінаў яшчэ нейкі час будзе стрымліваць боль.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7AB.english: He isn't bluffing. He appears invigorated, as though he's truly experiencing life for the first time.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7AB.polish: Nie blefuje. Wydaje się ożywiony, jakby po raz pierwszy od urodzenia naprawdę czuł, że żyje.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7AB.belarusian: Ён не блэфуе. Ён выглядае поўным сіл, нібыта ўпершыню ў жыцці па-сапраўднаму адчуў сябе жывым.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7B0.english: You've earned his respect. See how you've *marked* him?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7B0.polish: Zdobyłeś sobie jego szacunek. Widzisz, jak go *oznaczyłeś*?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7B0.belarusian: Ты заслужыў ягоную павагу. Бачыш, як ты яго *пазначыў*?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7BB.english: In the meantime, a small indigo flower begins to bloom just below his cheekbone.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7BB.polish: W międzyczasie na skórze tuż pod jego kością policzkową zaczyna zakwitać niewielki kwiat koloru indygo.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7BB.belarusian: А тым часам проста пад ягонай скулай пачынае распускацца маленькая кветка колеру індыга.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7C0.english: That would be the sweet endorphin rush. You've granted him a natural high, at least until the hurt sets in.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7C0.polish: To ten wspaniały przypływ endorfin. Zapewniłeś mu naturalny haj. Przynajmniej dopóki nie pojawi się ból.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7C0.belarusian: Гэта ўсё салодкі выкід эндарфінаў. Ты забяспечыў яму натуральны кайф — прынамсі пакуль не пачне балець.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7C5.english: A little ice on it will keep the swelling down. He'll be fine in a day or two.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7C5.polish: Odrobina lodu powstrzyma opuchliznę. Za dzień czy dwa będzie z nim już wszystko dobrze.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7C5.belarusian: Крыху лёду здыме ацёк. За дзень-два з ім усё будзе добра.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7DC.english: OH YEAH, we're gonna spin this kid like a top!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7DC.polish: O TAK, zakręcimy tym dzieciakiem jak bąkiem!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7DC.belarusian: О ТАК, мы закруцім гэтага пацана як ваўчка!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7E7.english: Wait-wait-wait, you were trying *not* to do that!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7E7.polish: Czekaj, czekaj, czekaj. Chciałeś właśnie tego *nie* robić!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A7E7.belarusian: Пачакай-пачакай-пачакай, ты ж спрабаваў гэтага *не* рабіць!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A811.english: Ensconced in your ceramic armour, you barely notice the moment of contact. But you do hear the distinct *ting* of your knuckles catching the young man's cheekbone.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A811.polish: Zamknięty w swoim ceramicznym pancerzu ledwo wyczuwasz moment zadania ciosu. Słyszysz jednak charakterystyczny dźwięk, kiedy twoje knykcie stykają się z kością policzkową młodzieńca.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A811.belarusian: Схаваўшыся ў сваёй керамічнай брані, ты ледзь заўважаеш момант удару. Але ты выразна чуеш характэрны *дзынь*, калі твае костачкі закранаюць скулу маладога чалавека.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A816.english: Even through the yellow latex shell containing your hand you can feel the force of the impact against the young man's cheekbone.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A816.polish: Nawet przez żółtą lateksową rękawiczkę czujesz siłę uderzenia o kość policzkową młodzieńca.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A816.belarusian: Нават скрозь жоўтую латэксную абалонку на тваёй руцэ ты адчуваеш сілу ўдару аб скулу маладога чалавека.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A81B.english: En route to its target your FALN glove traces a strangely pleasing black-and-white blur through the air, like some kind of ultra-sonic weasel.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A81B.polish: Rękawiczka FALN rysuje w drodze do celu dziwnie estetyczną, czarno-białą smugę, jak jakaś naddźwiękowa łasica.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A81B.belarusian: Па дарозе да цэлі твая пальчатка FALN малюе ў паветры дзіўна прыемны чорна-белы след, нібы нейкая ультрагукавая ласка.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A820.english: At the moment of contact you're reminded of a fight you once witnessed between two homeless men in an alleyway. Could it be that you've set out to recreate that moment now, right down to the smelly fingerless gloves?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A820.polish: W momencie uderzenia przypominasz sobie bójkę między dwoma bezdomnymi, jaką widziałeś kiedyś w bocznej alejce. Czyżbyś odtwarzał w tym momencie tamto zdarzenie? Pasowałyby do niego nawet te śmierdzące rękawiczki bez palców.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A820.belarusian: У момант удару табе прыгадваецца бойка паміж двума бяздомнымі ў завулку, якую ты калісьці бачыў. Няўжо ты вырашыў узнавіць той момант цяпер, аж да смярдзючых пальчатак без пальцаў?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A825.english: You feel a bright pain as your bare knuckle collides with the young man's oddly prominent cheekbone. At the moment of contact his eyes are wide as old silver coins.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A825.polish: Czujesz rozbłysk bólu, kiedy twoja odsłonięta pięść zderza się z dziwnie wystającą kością policzkową młodzieńca. Jego oczy były w tym momencie wielkie niczym stare, srebrne monety.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A825.belarusian: Ты адчуваеш рэзкі боль, калі твая голая костачка сутыкаецца з дзіўна выпіраючай скулай маладога чалавека. У момант удару ягоныя вочы шырокія, як старыя срэбраныя манеты.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A82A.english: Of course, it's not *actually* ultra-sonic, that's just an illusion produced by good branding. Still, the force you've unleashed really is tremendous.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A82A.polish: Oczywiście nie jest ona tak naprawdę naddźwiękowa – to tylko iluzja powstała dzięki zmyślnym oznaczeniom marki. Tak czy inaczej, siła, jaką zawarłeś w tym ruchu, jest naprawdę ogromna.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A82A.belarusian: Вядома, яна не *насамрэч* ультрагукавая, гэта проста ілюзія ад добрага брэндынгу. Але сіла, якую ты вызваліў, сапраўды каласальная.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A834.english: Oh god, tell us you haven't done it *again*. Are you twice the killer now?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A834.polish: Boże, tylko nam nie mów, że *znów* to zrobiłeś. Jesteś już podwójnym zabójcą?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A834.belarusian: О божа, толькі не кажы, што ты зрабіў гэта *зноў*. Ты цяпер двойчы забойца?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A839.english: Oh, no. Tell us you didn't *really* kill him.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A839.polish: O nie. Tylko nam nie mów, że *naprawdę* go zabiłeś.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A839.belarusian: О не. Толькі не кажы, што ты яго *насамрэч* забіў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A863.english: "Good god, detective! What's wrong with you?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A863.polish: „Boże! Co z tobą nie tak, detektywie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A863.belarusian: "Божа мой, дэтэктыве! Што з вамі такое?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A872.english: "Errrrck." The young man cradles his jaw and looks up, his expression blank.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A872.polish: „Eee...” – młody człowiek łapie się za szczękę i spogląda w górę pustymi oczami.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A872.belarusian: "Э-э-э-рк". Малады чалавек трымаецца за сківіцу і глядзіць угору з пустым выразам твару.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A878.english: You're both lucky you didn't shatter his cheekbone. He may want to count his teeth before he goes to bed tonight.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A878.polish: Obaj macie szczęście, że nie zmiażdżyłeś mu kości policzkowej. Zanim pójdzie dziś spać, powinien policzyć, czy ma wszystkie zęby.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A878.belarusian: Вам абодвум пашанцавала, што ты не раздробніў яму скулу. Перад сном яму не зашкодзіць пералічыць зубы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A885.english: "Let that be a lesson to you."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A88F.english: "*Sorry*? You nearly took my fucking jaw off!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A88F.polish: „*Przykro* ci? Prawie złamałeś mi pieprzoną szczękę!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A88F.belarusian: "*Прабач*? Ты мне ледзь блядскую сківіцу не знёс!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A894.english: "What lesson is that, huh? That the RCM are assholes? That they'll take your fucking jaw off?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A894.polish: „Niby jaka lekcja, co? Że w MOR-ze pracują dupki? Że chętnie złamią ci pieprzoną szczękę?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A894.belarusian: "І якім жа ўрокам, га? Што ў RCM адны казлы? Што яны табе сківіцу нахуй знясуць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A899.english: "What? You're just gonna stand there after you nearly broke my fucking jaw?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A899.polish: „I co? Będziesz tak sobie stał po tym, jak prawie złamałeś moją pieprzoną szczękę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A899.belarusian: "Што? Ты будзеш проста стаяць пасля таго, як ледзь не зламаў маю блядскую сківіцу?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8AA.english: You think you can hear a slight popping sound as he moves his mouth.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8AA.polish: Wydaje ci się, że kiedy porusza ustami, słyszysz coś jakby trzeszczenie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8AA.belarusian: Здаецца, ты чуеш лёгкае пстрыканне, калі ён рухае ротам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8B5.english: It certainly won't improve your precinct's image within the community.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8B5.polish: Na pewno nie poprawi to opinii o twoim komisariacie wśród miejscowych.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8B5.belarusian: Гэта дакладна не палепшыць імідж вашага пастарунка сярод мясцовых.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8BA.english: That's right. You don't *owe* him any explanation.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8BA.polish: Zgadza się. Nie jesteś mu *winien* żadnych wyjaśnień.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8BA.belarusian: Усё правільна. Ты яму нічога не *вінен* тлумачыць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8DA.english: "Thank god we avoided *that* fiasco, at least..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8E0.english: The young man can hardly conceal his disappointment. He was apparently looking forward to being punched by you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8E0.polish: Młody mężczyzna z trudem ukrywa swoje rozczarowanie. Najwyraźniej nie mógł się doczekać na to, że uderzysz go w twarz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8E0.belarusian: Малады чалавек ледзь хавае расчараванне. Відаць, ён з нецярпеннем чакаў, што ты яму зачэпіш.

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A8E0.polish: Młody mężczyzna wygląda na raczej zniechęconego. To jasne, że on *także* nie mógł się doczekać na to, że uderzysz go w twarz.
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000A8E0.belarusian: Са свайго боку, малады чалавек выглядае даволі збянтэжаным. Відавочна, што ён *таксама* чакаў, што ты яго ўдарыш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8ED.english: And yet you can't help but sense a slight disappointment on his part. It seems a part of him hoped you would hit the pretentious young communist...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8ED.polish: A mimo to nie jesteś w stanie nie czuć z jego strony pewnego rozczarowania. Widać jakaś jego cząstka miała nadzieję, że rąbniesz tego pretensjonalnego młodego komunistę...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8ED.belarusian: І ўсё ж ты не можаш не адчуць лёгкага расчаравання з ягонага боку. Здаецца, недзе ў глыбіні душы ён спадзяваўся, што ты ўдарыш гэтага пыхлівага маладога камуніста...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8F6.english: "Well, if you're not going to play along, I don't think we have anything further to discuss. Good evening to you, gendarme."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8F6.polish: „No cóż, jeśli nie jesteś skłonny do współpracy, to nie mamy o czym rozmawiać. Dobranoc, żandarmie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A8F6.belarusian: "Ну, калі ты не хочаш гуляць па правілах, думаю, нам больш няма чаго абмяркоўваць. Добрага вечара, жандарм."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A912.english: You'll be leading this conversation, so wherever you take it, they'll be glad to follow.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A912.polish: To ty będziesz przewodził tej dyskusji, więc jakiego nie obierzesz kierunku, chętnie podążą za tobą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A912.belarusian: Ты будзеш кіраваць гэтай дыскусіяй, таму, які б кірунак ты ні абраў, яны з радасцю пойдуць за табой.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A919.english: "I have some questions about the origins of this theory."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A919.polish: „Mam kilka pytań dotyczących pochodzenia tej teorii”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A919.belarusian: «У мяне ёсць некалькі пытанняў адносна паходжання гэтай тэорыі».

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A91E.english: "I really want to hear more about these hyper-revolutionary figures."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A91E.polish: „Bardzo chciałbym usłyszeć więcej o tych postaciach hiperrewolucyjnych”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A91E.belarusian: «Вельмі хацеў бы пачуць больш пра гэтыя гіперрэвалюцыйныя персанажы».

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A923.english: "It's the theoretical parts I'm interested in. The third-level stuff."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A923.polish: „Najbardziej interesują mnie te części teoretyczne. Trzeciego poziomu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A923.belarusian: "Найбольш цікавыя для мяне тыя часткі тэарэтычныя. Трэцяга ўзроўню."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A92E.english: "Oh, it's a great story. You should check out Nilsen's journals if you ever have the chance."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A92E.polish: „O, to wspaniała historia. Jeśli nadarzy ci się okazja, to powinieneś przeczytać dzienniki Nilsena”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A92E.belarusian: «О, гэта цудоўная гісторыя. Калі выдасца выпадка, ты мусіш прачытаць дзённікі Нільсена».

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A933.english: "Ah, yes. That's certainly one of the *least* developed parts of the theory, but also one of the most intriguing."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A933.polish: „A tak. To na pewno jeden z *najmniej* rozwiniętych elementów teorii, a jednocześnie jeden z najbardziej intrygujących”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A933.belarusian: «А так. Гэта напэўна адзін з *найменш* развітых элементаў тэорыі, а адначасова адзін з найбольш інтрыгуючых».

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A938.english: "Oh, yes. Or the *fun parts*, as we like to call them."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A938.polish: „A tak – *najzabawniejsza część*, jak lubimy ją między sobą nazywać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A938.belarusian: «А вось – *найвеселейшая частка*, як нам падабаецца яе паміж сабой называць».

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A93D.polish: Jego towarzysz kiwa głową z aprobatą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A93D.belarusian: Яго спадарожнік ківае галавой са згоды.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A942.english: His companion leans forward, ready to jump in...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A942.polish: Jego towarzysz pochyla się do przodu, gotowy, by wtrącić się do rozmowy...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A942.belarusian: Ягоны таварыш нахіляецца наперад, гатовы ўступіць у размову...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A947.english: His companion nods his head with expectation.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A94C.english: These two are full of interesting stories and rumours about Nilsen, Mazov, and their revolutionary exploits. Half an hour passes and the conversation gradually wends its way to some unexpected places...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A94C.polish: Sypią jak z rękawa ciekawymi opowieściami i plotkami o Nilsenie, Mazowie i ich rewolucyjnych dokonaniach. Przez kolejne pół godziny toczycie zahaczającą o masę nieoczekiwanych tematów rozmowę...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A94C.belarusian: Гэтыя двое поўныя цікавых гісторый і чутак пра Нільсэна, Мазава і іхнія рэвалюцыйныя подзвігі. Праходзіць паўгадзіны, і размова паступова звертвае да вельмі нечаканых тэм...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A951.english: They're impressed that you dove right in to the most advanced parts of the theory. Half an hour evaporates and the conversation is still wending its way toward new and unexpected places...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A951.polish: Imponuje im, że natychmiast pochyliłeś się nad najbardziej zaawansowanymi elementami teorii. Pół godziny minęło jak z bicza strzelił, lecz wy wciąż toczycie rozmowę poruszającą coraz to nowe i nieoczekiwane tematy...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A951.belarusian: Яны ўражаныя тым, як ты адразу нырнуў у самыя складаныя часткі тэорыі. Паўгадзіны пралятаюць незаўважна, а размова працягвае віцца да новых і нечаканых тэм...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A967.english: A cool breeze coming off the bay wraps itself around the Capeside Apartments. In a nearly forgotten part of that glorified construction site, surrounded by rusted pieces of scaffolding and walls of faded tarpaulin, a detective of the RCM debates the intricacies of an abstruse theory with a pair of university students...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A967.polish: Zimny powiew znad zatoki uderza o ściany Apartamentowca Półwysep. W nieomal zapomnianej części tego będącego właściwie placem budowy miejsca, budynku otoczonego zardzewiałym rusztowaniem i połaciami wyblakłego brezentu, detektyw z MOR-u dyskutuje z parą studentów o zawiłościach skomplikowanej teorii...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A967.belarusian: Халодны павеў з заліва б'е па сценах апарт-комплексу "Кейпсайд". У амаль што забытым кутку гэтага, па сутнасці, будоўлі, будынка, акружанага заржавелымі рыштаваннямі і паверхнямі выцвілага брэзенту, дэтэктыў з РГМ абмяркоўвае з парай студэнтаў складанасці складанай тэорыі...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A987.english: "... but if it's true that this individual possesses *so much capital* that light literally *bends* around him, then that must mean..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A987.polish: „...ale jeśli to prawda, że ta osoba posiada *tak wielki kapitał*, że dosłownie *zakrzywia* wokół siebie światło, to musi to oznaczać...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A987.belarusian: "...але калі праўда тое, што гэты чалавек валодае *такім вялікім капіталам*, што святло літаральна *заламваецца* вакол яго, тады гэта мусіць азначаць..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A993.polish: „Że *światło samo w sobie* stanowi burżuazyjną iluzję!”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9A1.english: "In 'Innocence of Capital', Puncher and Wattmann argue that communists must possess as little capital as possible, in order to keep their thinking *undiluted* by its influence..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9A1.polish: „W »Niewinności kapitału« Puncher i Wattmann twierdzą, że komuniści muszą posiadać jak najmniej kapitału, aby ich myśli pozostały *nieskażone* jego wpływem...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9A1.belarusian: "У "Праведнасці капіталу" Панчэр і Ўатмэн сцвярджаюць, што камуністы павінны валодаць як мага меншым капіталам, каб захаваць сваё мысленне *неразбаўленым* ягоным уплывам..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9A7.english: "*Or* it suggests that capital, in sufficient quantities, must exhibit its own plasm-like qualities..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9A7.polish: „*Albo* że kapitał – w odpowiednim zagęszczeniu – przejawia własne cechy podobne do plazmy...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9A7.belarusian: "*Або* гэта сведчыць пра тое, што капітал у дастатковай колькасці павінен праяўляць уласныя ўласцівасці, падобныя да плазмы..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9BC.english: Watch out. You call yourself a communist and yet you've been accumulating a *suspiciously* large share of capital in just the last few days. It's almost certainly distorting your thinking.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9BC.polish: Lepiej się pilnuj. Nazywasz siebie komunistą, lecz mimo to zgromadziłeś w ciągu ostatnich kilku dni *podejrzanie* dużo kapitału. Prawie na pewno wypacza on twój sposób myślenia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9BC.belarusian: Асцярожна. Ты называеш сябе камуністам, але за апошнія некалькі дзён назапасіў *падазрона* шмат капіталу. Гэта амаль напэўна скажае тваё мысленне.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9C2.english: You've accrued a modest account balance over the last few days, but probably not enough to warp your thinking *too* much.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9C2.polish: Zgromadziłeś przez ostatnich kilka dni skromną sumkę, jest ona jednak prawdopodobnie zbyt mała, aby *znacząco* wypaczyła twój sposób rozumowania.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9C2.belarusian: За апошнія некалькі дзён ты назапасіў сціплую суму, але яе наўрад ці дастаткова, каб *надта* моцна сказіць тваё мысленне.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9C7.english: Nothing to fear. Judging from your account balance, you should be thinking *extremely* clearly.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9C7.polish: Nie ma się czego obawiać. Sądząc po stanie twojego konta, powinieneś myśleć z *wyjątkową* jasnością.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9C7.belarusian: Няма чаго баяцца. Судзячы па тваім балансе, твае думкі мусяць быць *надзвычай* ясныя.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9D9.english: "Again, he was just a regular high-net-worth individual. There was nothing *extra-physical* about him..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9D9.polish: „Raz jeszcze powtarzam, że to była zwykła osoba o wysokiej wartości netto. Nie było w nim niczego *fizycznie nadzwyczajnego*...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9D9.belarusian: "Зноў жа, ён быў звычайнай асобай з высокім чыстым капіталам. У ім не было нічога *пазафізічнага*..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9E0.english: Now the breeze has subsided. All is still except for the last bits of steam rising from the coffee pot.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9E0.polish: Powiew ustał. Wszystko jest nieruchome poza drobinkami unoszącej się z dzbanka z kawą pary.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9E0.belarusian: Цяпер брыз сціх. Усё замірае, акрамя апошніх струменьчыкаў пары, што падымаюцца з кафейніка.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9E8.english: "... but my question is where does the RCM *recruit* all these hyper-revolutionaries to join this 'Remote Viewers Division'?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9E8.polish: „...ale mnie interesuje to, gdzie MOR *rekrutuje* tych wszystkich hiperrewolucjonistów, którzy trafiają do Wydziału Zdalnych Obserwatorów?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9E8.belarusian: "...але маё пытанне ў тым, адкуль RCM *набірае* ўсіх гэтых гіперрэвалюцыянераў у гэты "Аддзел Дыстанцыйных Назіральнікаў"?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9EF.english: "It's less that you're 'recruited' into the RVD and more like you're *called*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9EF.polish: „Do WZO nie tyle jest się *rekrutowanym*, co *wzywanym*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9EF.belarusian: "Справа не ў тым, што цябе "набіраюць" у АДН, цябе хутчэй *клічуць*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9F4.english: "And my *point* is that maybe these *hyper-revolutionary* individuals are more common than infra-materialism generally assumes..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9F4.polish: „A mi chodzi o to, że może ci *hiperrewolucjoniści* są bardziej powszechni, niż zdaje się zakładać inframaterializm...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000A9F4.belarusian: "А мая *думка* ў тым, што, магчыма, гэтыя *гіперрэвалюцыйныя* асобы сустракаюцца часцей, чым звычайна лічыць інфраматэрыялізм..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA0B.english: "Yes, only the detective here would draw a connection between a made-up division of para-psychics and the addled ramblings of a defunct communist mage..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA0B.polish: „Tak, tylko ten detektyw wpadłby na powiązanie zmyślonego wydziału dla funkcjonariuszy o parapsychicznych zdolnościach z głupkowatym bełkotem nieżyjącego komunistycznego maga...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA0B.belarusian: "Так, толькі тутэйшы дэтэктыў мог правесці сувязь паміж выдуманым аддзелам парапсіхікаў і цьмяным трызненнем памерлага камуністычнага чараўніка..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA11.english: A fortunate turn that the lieutenant isn't here. Imagine what he would have to say about this.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA11.polish: Co za szczęście, że nie ma tu porucznika. Wyobraź sobie tylko, co miałby na ten temat do powiedzenia.
