Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA11.belarusian: Як добра, што лейтэнанта тут няма. Уяві толькі, што ён сказаў бы на гэты конт.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA19.english: The young man ignores the lieutenant. "But I suppose it makes sense that some common strain of infra-materialist thought would persist in the RCM, even to this day, given its origins."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA19.polish: Młody mężczyzna ignoruje porucznika. „Ale to chyba ma sens, że jakiś powszechny odłam inframaterialistycznej myśli przetrwał w MOR-ze aż do dziś, biorąc pod uwagę początki tej organizacji”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA19.belarusian: Малады чалавек ігнаруе лейтэнанта. "Але, мяркую, цалкам лагічна, што нейкае адгалінаванне інфраматэрыялістычнай думкі захавалася ў RCM нават дагэтуль, улічваючы яе вытокі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA1E.english: The young man nods thoughtfully. "But I suppose it makes sense that some common strain of infra-materialist thought would persist in the RCM, even to this day, given its origins."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA1E.polish: Młody mężczyzna kiwa głową w zamyśleniu. „Ale to chyba ma sens, że jakiś powszechny odłam inframaterialistycznej myśli przetrwał w MOR-ze aż do dziś, biorąc pod uwagę początki tej organizacji”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA1E.belarusian: Малады чалавек задуменна ківае. "Але, мяркую, цалкам лагічна, што нейкае адгалінаванне інфраматэрыялістычнай думкі захавалася ў RCM нават дагэтуль, улічваючы яе вытокі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA29.english: "... all I'm saying is if you want to get *really extra-physical*, pyrholidon is the way to go..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA29.polish: „Chodzi mi tylko o to, że jeśli chcesz stać się *naprawdę pozafizycznym*, to najlepiej nadaje się do tego pyrholidon...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA29.belarusian: "...я толькі кажу, што калі хочаш стаць *па-сапраўднаму пазафізічным*, піралідон — найлепшы варыянт..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA4B.english: "... anyway, I think I've made my point."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA4B.polish: „...no, w każdym razie chyba powiedziałem jasno, co sądzę”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA50.english: "... or maybe I'm wrong. It could really go either way."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA50.polish: „...a może się mylę. Może być też inaczej”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA50.belarusian: "...ці, можа, я памыляюся. Можа быць і так, і гэтак."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA62.english: "... but I'm still trying to figure out how the *pale* fits into all this..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA62.polish: „...ale wciąż próbuję dojść, jakie miejsce ma w tym wszystkim *szarota*...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA62.belarusian: "...але я ўсё яшчэ спрабую зразумець, як ва ўсё гэта ўпісваецца *Цьмянасць*..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA67.english: "... so wait, you're saying that President Knezhinisky has *never opened a book*?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA67.polish: „Czyli zaraz, twierdzisz, że prezydent Knieżniński *nigdy w życiu nie przeczytał żadnej książki*?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA67.belarusian: "...чакай, то бок ты хочаш сказаць, што прэзідэнт Кнежынінскі *ніколі не адкрываў кніг*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA70.english: "The two phenomena are actually deeply intertwined." He nods. "Many infra-materialists believe that pale is actually a manifestation of nostalgia and historical inertia..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA70.polish: „Te dwa zjawiska są ze sobą ściśle powiązane” – stwierdza, kiwając głową. „Wielu inframaterialistów wierzy, że szarota jest manifestacją nostalgii i historycznej bezwładności...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA70.belarusian: "Гэтыя дзве з'явы насамрэч глыбока пераплеценыя." Ён ківае. "Шмат хто з інфраматэрыялістаў лічыць, што Цьмянасць — гэта праява настальгіі і гістарычнай інерцыі..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA76.english: "Those same theorists have hypothesised that revolution may in fact create a *counter-force* that prevents the pale from expanding."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA76.polish: „Ci sami teoretycy wysunęli hipotezę, według której rewolucja może tworzyć *przeciwną siłę*, która zapobiega rozszerzaniu się szaroty”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA76.belarusian: "Тыя ж тэарэтыкі выказвалі гіпотэзу, што рэвалюцыя можа ствараць *супрацьлеглую сілу*, якая спыняе пашырэнне Цьмянасці."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA7B.english: "No-no-no. We're saying he doesn't *need* to open them, because he absorbs all the relevant content just by staring intently at the cover. It's a widely understood second-level effect..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA7B.polish: „Nie, nie, nie. Mówimy, że nie *musiał* ich otwierać, bo absorbował całą istotną treść, wpatrując się intensywnie w okładkę. To powszechnie uznany efekt drugiego poziomu...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA7B.belarusian: "Не-не-не. Мы кажам, што яму *не трэба* іх адкрываць, бо ён засвойвае ўвесь неабходны змест, проста пільна гледзячы на вокладку. Гэта шырока вядомы эфект другога ўзроўню..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA80.english: "We've tried it ourselves, but thus far we haven't been able to absorb more than the preface and table of contents."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA80.polish: „Też tego próbowaliśmy, ale jak dotąd nie udało nam się wchłonąć w ten sposób więcej niż przedmowę i spis treści”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA80.belarusian: "Мы і самі спрабавалі, але пакуль што здолелі засвоіць толькі прадмову і змест."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA95.english: "Well, on that note, I think we can call it an evening."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA95.polish: „No cóż... I na tym możemy chyba zakończyć ten wieczór”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA95.belarusian: "Што ж, на гэтай ноце мы, думаю, можам скончыць на сёння."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA9B.english: "Yes. One of our better discussions lately, on the whole."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA9B.polish: „Tak. To była w sumie jedna z lepszych dyskusji, jakie ostatnio przeprowadziliśmy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AA9B.belarusian: "Так. Агулам кажучы, адна з лепшых нашых дыскусій за апошні час."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAB8.english: "What do you mean, 'is that it'? You've done the reading, we talked about it, what more do you expect from a reading group?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAB8.polish: „Co masz na myśli? Przeczytałeś lekturę i dyskutowaliśmy o niej – czego jeszcze oczekujesz od czytelniczej grupy?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAB8.belarusian: "Што ты маеш на ўвазе пад "і гэта ўсё"? Ты прачытаў матэрыял, мы яго абмеркавалі, чаго яшчэ ты чакаеш ад чытальнага гуртка?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAC4.english: "What if I have more questions, you know, about communism?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAC4.polish: „A jeśli mam więcej pytań? No wiecie, co do komunizmu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAC4.belarusian: "А што, калі ў мяне ёсць яшчэ пытанні, ну, пра камунізм?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AACE.english: "Well, you could always *ask*, I guess." The two young men look at each other a moment.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AACE.polish: „No cóż, zawsze możesz je po prostu *zadać*” – młodzi ludzie przez chwilę na siebie spoglądają.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AACE.belarusian: "Ну, ты заўсёды можаш *спытаць*, напэўна." Маладыя людзі на імгненне пераглядаюцца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAD3.english: "But it's getting late, so maybe pick the *most important* question?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAD3.polish: „Ale robi się już późno, więc może wybierz *najważniejsze* pytanie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAD3.belarusian: "Але ўжо позна, так што, можа, абяры *самае галоўнае* пытанне?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAD8.english: "He probably won't get a better chance, honestly."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAD8.polish: „Szczerze mówiąc, pewnie nie będzie miał na to lepszej okazji”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAD8.belarusian: "Шчыра кажучы, лепшага шанцу ў яго наўрад ці будзе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAF2.english: "I need a minute to think about it."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAF7.english: Ask the most important question about communism.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAF7.belarusian: Задаць самае галоўнае пытанне пра камунізм.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAFC.english: "I changed my mind. I don't have any questions."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AAFC.belarusian: "Я перадумаў. У мяне няма ніякіх пытанняў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB01.english: "Yeah, I'm good. No questions for me." (Cancel task.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB01.polish: „Tak, nie trzeba. Nie mam pytań”. (Anuluj zadanie).

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB26.english: "Detective, how should *I* know what questions *you* have about communism?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB26.polish: „Skąd mam wiedzieć, jakie pytania dotyczące komunizmu chcesz zadać, detektywie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB26.belarusian: "Дэтэктыве, адкуль *мне* ведаць, якія пытанні пра камунізм узніклі ў *вас*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB2B.english: "Come on. We have things to do in the morning."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB2B.polish: „Pośpiesz się. Rano mamy rzeczy do zrobienia”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB4C.english: "He says he doesn't have any questions, Steban."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB4C.polish: „Mówi, że nie ma żadnych pytań, Stebanie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB4C.belarusian: "Ён кажа, што ў яго няма пытанняў, Стэбан."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB52.english: "Are you absolutely sure? A communist can't be afraid to ask questions, just because they don't know what the answer might be."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB52.polish: „Jesteś tego absolutnie pewny? Komunista nie może bać się zadawania pytań tylko dlatego, że nie wie, jaką otrzyma odpowiedź”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB52.belarusian: "Ты абсалютна ўпэўнены? Камуніст не можа баяцца задаваць пытанні толькі таму, што не ведае, якім можа быць адказ."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB58.english: In other words, you'll forfeit their respect if you back out now.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB58.polish: Innymi słowy, jeśli się teraz wycofasz, stracisz ich szacunek.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB58.belarusian: Іншымі словамі, калі ты адступіш цяпер, ты страціш іхнюю павагу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB62.english: "See, Steban? I told you there's no such thing as a gendarme communist."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB62.polish: „Widzisz, Stebanie? Mówiłem ci, że nie ma czegoś takiego jak żandarm komunista”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB62.belarusian: "Бачыш, Стэбан? Я ж казаў табе, што жандармаў-камуністаў не бывае."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB67.english: "It seems you're right, Uli. I should've listened to you." He sighs, then turns to you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB67.polish: „Wygląda na to, że masz rację, Uli. Powinienem był cię posłuchać” – wzdycha i zwraca się do ciebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB67.belarusian: "Здаецца, твая праўда, Улі. Трэба было цябе паслухаць." Ён уздыхае, а потым паварочваецца да цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB70.english: "Now, if you'll excuse us, we have some *group business* to attend to."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB70.polish: „A teraz, jeśli pozwolisz, mamy do omówienia *sprawy grupy*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB70.belarusian: "А цяпер, калі прабачыце, у нас ёсць некаторыя *справы гуртка*, якімі трэба заняцца."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB80.english: The question you mean to ask is both very complicated and incredibly simple...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB80.polish: Pytanie, które chcesz zadać, jest jednocześnie bardzo skomplikowane i niesamowicie proste...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB80.belarusian: Пытанне, якое ты хочаш задаць, адначасова вельмі складанае і неверагодна простае...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB89.english: Alright, here we go. We're devoting all your available brain cells to coming up with a question about communism. Scratch that, to coming up with *the* question about communism, the alpha and omega of communism questions, and that question is:
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB89.polish: No dobra, to dalej. Kierujemy wszystkie dostępne komórki mózgu do pracy nad pytaniem o komunizm. A właściwie to nad *kluczowym*, a nie byle jakim, pytaniem o komunizm. Alfą i omegą pytań o komunizm. A brzmi ono...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB89.belarusian: Добра, паехалі. Мы кідаем усе даступныя мазгавыя каморкі на тое, каб прыдумаць пытанне пра камунізм. Закрэслі гэта: каб прыдумаць *тое самае* пытанне пра камунізм, альфу і амегу пытанняў пра камунізм, і гэтае пытанне:

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB91.english: Take a deep breath. Best to go one piece at a time.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB91.polish: Weź głęboki oddech. Najlepiej zajmij się tym po kolei.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB91.belarusian: Зрабі глыбокі ўдых. Лепш выкладаць па частках.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB98.english: "If communism is all based on *theories* that are impossible to prove..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB98.polish: „Jeśli komunizm jest w całości oparty o niemożliwe do udowodnienia *teorie*...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB98.belarusian: "Калі камунізм цалкам грунтуецца на *тэорыях*, якія немагчыма даказаць..."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000AB98.polish: „Jeśli cała teoria, w którą mamy wierzyć, jest całkowicie niefalsyfikowalna...”
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000AB98.belarusian: "Калі ўся тэорыя, у якую мы мусім верыць, цалкам нефальсіфікавальная..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB9D.english: "If no one can agree what real communism even *means*..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB9D.polish: „Jeśli nikt nie jest w stanie zgodzić się nawet, co właściwie *oznacza* prawdziwy komunizm...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AB9D.belarusian: "Калі ніхто не можа нават сысціся ў тым, што наогул *значыць* сапраўдны камунізм..."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000AB9D.polish: „Jeśli nie jesteśmy nawet w stanie ustalić, czy w komunizmie chodzi o plazmę, psychologię czy fasolę...”
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000AB9D.belarusian: "Калі мы не можам нават сысціся ў тым, пра што камунізм: пра плазму, псіхалогію ці фасолю..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABA2.english: "If communism keeps failing every time we try it..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABA2.polish: „Jeśli komunizm zawodzi za każdym razem, kiedy go próbujemy...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABA2.belarusian: "Калі камунізм церпіць крах кожны раз, калі мы спрабуем яго пабудаваць..."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000ABA2.polish: „Jeśli nie możemy uciec przed nadciągającą zagładą...”
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000ABA2.belarusian: "Калі мы не можам пазбегнуць надыходзячай пагібелі..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABAD.english: The young man waits patiently for you to finish.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABAD.polish: Młody mężczyzna czeka cierpliwie, aż dokończysz pytanie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABAD.belarusian: Малады чалавек цярпліва чакае, пакуль ты скончыш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABBC.english: "... and the rest of the world keeps killing us for our beliefs..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABBC.polish: „...a reszta świata zabija nas za nasze poglądy...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABBC.belarusian: "...а рэшта свету працягвае забіваць нас за нашыя перакананні..."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000ABBC.polish: „...a reszta świata spiskuje, by nas zaatakować i zmasakrować, jeśli ośmielimy się bronić naszych poglądów...”
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000ABBC.belarusian: "...а рэшта свету змаўляецца, каб уварвацца і выразаць нас, калі мы адважваемся адстойваць свае перакананні..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABC1.english: "... and whenever we *do* try it just devolves into a corrupt farce..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABC1.polish: „...a za każdym razem, kiedy *faktycznie* go próbujemy, zmienia się on w przesiąkniętą korupcją farsę...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABC1.belarusian: "...і кожны раз, калі мы *спрабуем*, усё проста скочваецца ў карумпаваны фарс..."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000ABC1.polish: „...a LRS uległa degeneracji w skorumpowany żart z republiki robotniczej...”
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000ABC1.belarusian: "...і НРС вырадзілася ў карумпаваны фарс рабочай рэспублікі..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABC6.english: "... and we keep fracturing over theoretical disagreements..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABC6.polish: „...a wciąż dzielimy się na odłamy ze względu na teoretyczne spory...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABC6.belarusian: "...і мы працягваем расколвацца праз тэарэтычныя рознагалоссі..."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000ABC6.polish: „...a marnujemy cały swój czas na kłótniach, kto jest skrycie liberałem, a kto nie...”
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000ABC6.belarusian: "...і мы марнуем увесь час на спрэчкі пра тое, хто тут таемны ліберал, а хто не..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABF2.english: The young man considers your words for a minute.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABF2.polish: Młody mężczyzna przez chwilę zastanawia się nad twoimi słowami.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ABF2.belarusian: Малады чалавек хвіліну разважае над тваімі словамі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC00.english: You're witnessing his ironic armour melt before you. This is his *true self* you're seeing now.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC00.polish: Jego stworzony z ironii pancerz rozpada się na twoich oczach. Widzisz teraz jego *prawdziwe ja*.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC00.belarusian: Ты бачыш, як ягоная іранічная браня плавіцца на тваіх вачах. Цяпер ты бачыш ягоную *сапраўдную сутнасць*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC13.english: Wait, who is he thinking about?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC1F.english: "The theorists Puncher and Wattmann -- not infra-materialists, but theorists nonetheless -- say that communism is a secular version of Perikarnassian theology, that it replaces faith in the divine with faith in humanity's future..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC1F.polish: „Teoretycy Puncher i Wattmann – nie inframaterialiści, ale jednak teoretycy – twierdzą, że komunizm jest świecką wersją perykarnaskiej teologii i zastępuje wiarę w boskość wiarą w przyszłość ludzkości...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC1F.belarusian: "Тэарэтыкі Панчэр і Ўатмэн — не інфраматэрыялісты, але тым не менш тэарэтыкі — сцвярджаюць, што камунізм — гэта свецкая версія перыкарнаскай тэалогіі, што ён замяняе веру ў боскае верай у будучыню чалавецтва..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC29.english: Hard to say. Someone dear to him.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC29.polish: Ciężko powiedzieć. O kimś dla niego ważnym.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC29.belarusian: Цяжка сказаць. Пра кагосьці дарагога яму.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC30.english: Track his gaze. He's looking out past the broken wall, toward the opposite side of the Bay...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC30.polish: Podążaj za jego spojrzeniem. Spogląda gdzieś za zniszczoną ścianę, ku przeciwległemu brzegowi zatoki...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC30.belarusian: Прасачы за ягоным позіркам. Ён глядзіць міма прабітай сцяны, у бок супрацьлеглага берага Заліва...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC48.english: Toward the skyscrapers of La Delta.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC52.english: They rise like electric obelisks in the night.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC52.polish: Wzbijają się w nocne niebo niczym elektryczne obeliski.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC52.belarusian: Яны ўзвышаюцца ў ночы, нібы электрычныя абеліскі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC57.english: Many tall buildings, belonging to a district whose name escapes you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC57.polish: Liczne wysokie budynki z dzielnicy, której nazwa ci umyka.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AC57.belarusian: Шмат высокіх будынкаў, што належаць да квартала, чыю назву ты забыўся.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ACD2.english: The young man looks at you a moment, then at his companion.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ACD2.polish: Młody mężczyzna przez chwilę przygląda się tobie, po czym spogląda na swojego towarzysza.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ACD2.belarusian: Малады чалавек імгненне глядзіць на цябе, пасля — на свайго спадарожніка.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ACDE.english: He's not accustomed to exposing his doubt like this.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ACDE.polish: Nie nawykł tak otwarcie ujawniać swoich wątpliwości.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ACDE.belarusian: Ён не прывык так адкрыта раскрываць свае сумневы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ACF0.english: "What could it hurt? Alright, let's give it another go..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ACF0.polish: „Co nam szkodzi? W porządku, spróbujmy jeszcze raz...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ACF0.belarusian: "Што нам губляць? Добра, давайце паспрабуем яшчэ раз..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ACF7.english: Before long, a modest tower begins to rise from the pile of matchboxes...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ACF7.polish: Wkrótce ze stosu pudełek zapałczanych zaczyna powstawać niewielka wieża...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ACF7.belarusian: Неўзабаве са стосіка запалкавых скрынак пачынае расці сціплая вежа...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD00.english: You place every box with the utmost delicacy and precision.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD00.polish: Każde pudełko ustawiasz z ogromną delikatnością i precyzją.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD00.belarusian: Ты ставіш кожную скрынку з найвышэйшай далікатнасцю і дакладнасцю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD27.english: "It's my fault, Steban. My hands were shaking... Nerves got the better of me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD27.polish: „To moja wina, Steban. Ręce mi drżały... Dałem się ponieść nerwom”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD27.belarusian: "Гэта мая віна, Стэбан. Рукі задрыжэлі... Нервы падвялі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD3B.english: The young man pushes back his shirt sleeves, revealing the pale flesh of his forearms.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD3B.polish: Młody mężczyzna zakasuje rękawy, odsłaniając bladą skórę swoich przedramion.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD3B.belarusian: Малады чалавек закочвае рукавы кашулі, агаляючы бледную скуру перадплеччаў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD68.english: "It's alright, Steban. That was still *very* close. One of our best performances yet."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD68.polish: „Nic się nie stało, Steban. I tak było *bardzo* blisko. To jak dotąd jedna z naszych najlepszych prób”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD68.belarusian: "Усё добра, Стэбан. Гэта ўсё адно было *вельмі* блізка. Адна з нашых найлепшых спроб".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD79.english: You've got this. Theories aside, they're only matchboxes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD79.polish: Dasz radę. Teorie teoriami, ale to tylko pudełka od zapałek.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AD79.belarusian: У цябе ўсё атрымаецца. Тэорыі тэорыямі, але гэта проста запалкавыя скрынкі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ADBE.english: There, in the middle of the floor, the winding spire quivers with an improbable energy...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ADBE.polish: Na samym środku podłogi nierówna wieża aż drży od nieprawdopodobnej energii...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ADBE.belarusian: Там, пасярод падлогі, скрыўлены шпіль трымціць ад неверагоднай энергіі...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ADC4.english: "Don't apologise. As I was saying, if it were *easy*, it wouldn't require so much plasm to work."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ADC4.polish: „Nie przepraszaj. Jak już mówiłem, gdyby to było *łatwe*, to nie wymagałoby do powodzenia tak dużej ilości plazmy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ADC4.belarusian: "Не прасі прабачэння. Як я ўжо казаў, калі б гэта было *проста*, яно б не патрабавала столькі плазмы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ADCF.english: There's no way it should stay up like that. How is the weight being distributed?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ADCF.polish: To przecież niemożliwe, żeby była w stanie ustać. Jak rozkłada się jej ciężar?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ADCF.belarusian: Яна ніяк не павінна так стаяць. Як размяркоўваецца вага?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ADEA.english: For a long moment, no one says a word. You're all three transfixed.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ADEA.polish: Przez dłuższą chwilę panuje milczenie. Wszyscy wpatrujecie się jak urzeczeni.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000ADEA.belarusian: Доўгі час ніхто не прамаўляе ні слова. Вы ўсе ўтрох застылі як зачараваныя.

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000ADEA.polish: Przez dłuższą chwilę panuje milczenie. Nawet porucznik wpatruje się jak urzeczony.
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000ADEA.belarusian: Доўгі час ніхто не прамаўляе ні слова. Нават лейтэнант застыў як зачараваны.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE10.english: "Shhh. This is the most amazing thing I've ever seen..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE10.polish: „Ćśś... To najbardziej niesamowita rzecz, jaką kiedykolwiek widziałem...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE10.belarusian: "Цс-с. Гэта самае дзівоснае відовішча, якое я калі-небудзь бачыў..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE4E.english: "My mums." The young man looks surprised. "She works in one of those skyscrapers, but it's not like you think... she's a cleaning lady..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE4E.polish: „Moja mamcia” – młody mężczyzna wygląda na zaskoczonego. „Pracuje w jednym z tych drapaczy chmur, ale to nie tak jak myślisz... Jest sprzątaczką...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE4E.belarusian: "Мая мамуля." Малады чалавек выглядае здзіўленым. "Яна працуе ў адным з тых хмарачосаў, але гэта не тое, што ты думаеш... яна прыбірачка..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE55.english: "Yes, in fact... my mums." The young man smiles sheepishly. "She works in La Delta... in one of those skyscrapers, but it's not like you think... she's a cleaning lady."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE55.polish: „Tak, rzeczywiście... o mojej mamci” – młody mężczyzna uśmiecha się z zakłopotaniem. „Pracuje w La Delcie... w jednym z tych drapaczy chmur, ale to nie tak jak myślisz... Jest sprzątaczką”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE55.belarusian: "Так, насамрэч... пра мамулю." Малады чалавек нясмела ўсміхаецца. "Яна працуе ў Ля Дэльце... у адным з тых хмарачосаў, але гэта не тое, што ты думаеш... яна прыбірачка."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE5C.english: "But how did you... oh, never mind. I guess I'm easier to read than I thought..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE5C.polish: „Ale skąd... Właściwie nieważne. Pewnie łatwiej mnie rozszyfrować, niż mi się wydaje...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE5C.belarusian: "Але як ты... а, няважна. Відаць, мяне лягчэй раскусіць, чым я думаў..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE69.english: "She's given up a lot for you."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE6E.english: "You want her to live in a better world."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE6E.belarusian: "Ты хочаш, каб яна жыла ў лепшым свеце."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE79.english: "Because I always have. Though I try not to do it too often now... it's kind of embarrassing, isn't it?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE79.polish: „Bo zawsze ją tak nazywałem. Ale teraz staram się nie robić tego zbyt często... To trochę żenujące, prawda?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE79.belarusian: "Бо я заўсёды так яе клікаў. Хаця цяпер стараюся рабіць гэта радзей... гэта неяк няёмка, ці не так?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE7E.english: "We all have to make sacrifices for the future. Maybe that's what I was trying to get at earlier..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE7E.polish: „Wszyscy ponosimy ofiary dla przyszłości. Może właśnie to próbowałem powiedzieć wcześniej...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE7E.belarusian: "Мы ўсе мусім ісці на ахвяры дзеля будучыні. Можа, менавіта да гэтага я і вёў раней..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE83.english: "I want us *all* to live in a better world. But yes... she's a part of it... I guess we're all a part of it..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE83.polish: „Chcę, abyśmy *wszyscy* żyli w lepszym świecie. Ale tak... ona jest jego częścią... Chyba wszyscy jesteśmy jego częścią...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE83.belarusian: "Я хачу, каб мы *ўсе* жылі ў лепшым свеце. Але так... яна яго частка... Мусіць, мы ўсе ягоная частка..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE8E.english: You made him self-conscious now. He's practically paralysed.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE8E.polish: Wprawiłeś go w zakłopotanie. Ogarnął go niemal paraliż.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE8E.belarusian: Цяпер ты збянтэжыў яго. Ён літаральна аслупянеў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE99.english: "Yes, that's a good way to think of it, broken, but not irreparable."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE99.polish: „Tak, to dobry sposób myślenia o świecie. Zepsuty, ale możliwy do naprawienia”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE99.belarusian: "Так, пра гэта добра думаць менавіта так: зламаны, але яго можна паправіць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE9E.english: "Yes, that's a good way to think of it... a work-in-progress."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE9E.polish: „Tak, to dobry sposób myślenia o świecie... To praca w toku”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AE9E.belarusian: "Так, пра гэта добра думаць менавіта так... незавершаная праца."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEAC.english: "I don't know if I believe it, though."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEAC.polish: „Nie wiem jednak, czy w to wierzę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEAC.belarusian: "Хаця не ведаю, ці веру я ў гэта."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEB7.english: "A thought can be a very powerful thing. That's the whole idea of infra-materialism..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEB7.polish: „Myśl może być bardzo potężną rzeczą. Na tym właśnie opiera się idea inframaterializmu...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEB7.belarusian: "Думка можа быць вельмі магутнай штукай. У гэтым і ёсць уся ідэя інфраматэрыялізму..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEBC.english: "You've got to believe in *something*. Otherwise, what are you doing?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEBC.polish: „Musisz w *coś* wierzyć. W przeciwnym razie, co właściwie robisz?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEBC.belarusian: "Ты мусіш верыць у *нешта*. Інакш навошта ты наогул усё гэта робіш?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEC5.english: His words aren't really directed at you. He's wrestling with himself now...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEC5.polish: Jego słowa nie są tak naprawdę skierowane do ciebie. Toczy wewnętrzną walkę...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEC5.belarusian: Ягоныя словы насамрэч не скіраваныя да цябе. Цяпер ён змагаецца з самім сабой...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AED8.english: "You're right... We should clean this up and get going." He gestures to the matchboxes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AED8.polish: „Masz racę... Powinniśmy to sprzątnąć i wracać do domu” – stwierdza, wskazując na pudełka zapałek.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AED8.belarusian: "Твая праўда... Трэба тут прыбраць і ісці." Ён паказвае на запалкавыя скрынкі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEE7.english: The young man appears lost inside his own thoughts...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEE7.polish: Młody mężczyzna sprawia wrażenie zagubionego we własnych myślach...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEE7.belarusian: Здаецца, малады чалавек патануў ва ўласных думках...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEEE.english: A cold wind whips at the canvas. From far below, the sounds of waves smashing themselves against the rocks. You are exposed.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEEE.polish: Zimny wiatr smaga płótno. Z dołu, z oddali, dobiega cię odgłos tłukących o kamienie fal. Czujesz się odsłonięty.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AEEE.belarusian: Халодны вецер сцябае па брызенце. Знізу, здалёк, чуваць гук хваляў, што разбіваюцца аб скалы. Ты нічым не абаронены.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF06.english: Rub your arms with your hands.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF30.english: Oh god, that's bad. Surely I can think of something better.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF30.polish: Boże, niedobrze. Na pewno mogę wymyślić coś lepszego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF30.belarusian: О божа, гэта кепска. Я дакладна магу прыдумаць нешта лепшае.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF3B.english: The young man gives you a slightly confused look, as though he's sure you asked something else and he simply misheard.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF3B.polish: Młody mężczyzna rzuca ci lekko zdezorientowane spojrzenie, jakby był pewny, że zapytałeś o coś innego i po prostu się przesłyszał.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF3B.belarusian: Малады чалавек глядзіць на цябе крыху збянтэжана, нібы ён упэўнены, што ты спытаў нешта іншае, а ён проста недачуў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF44.english: No, he heard you crystal clear.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF4B.english: Somehow it sounded even *worse* out loud.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF4B.polish: Jakimś cudem wypowiedziane głośno zabrzmiało to *jeszcze gorzej*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF51.english: You only said what everyone else was thinking. Look around -- do you see any women here?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF51.polish: Powiedziałeś tylko to, co wszyscy myśleli. Rozejrzyj się. Widzisz tu jakieś kobiety?
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF51.belarusian: Ты сказаў толькі тое, пра што думалі ўсе астатнія. Азірніся: ты бачыш тут хоць адну жанчыну?

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF59.english: "He wants to know if women are bourgeois, Steban..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF59.polish: „Chce wiedzieć, czy kobiety są burżuazją, Stebanie...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF59.belarusian: "Ён хоча ведаць, ці жанчыны буржуазныя, Стэбан..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF5E.english: "Yes, I heard him. Give me a moment." He takes a deep breath, then turns to you...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF5E.polish: „Tak, słyszałem. Daj mi chwilę” – bierze głęboki wdech i zwraca się do ciebie...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF5E.belarusian: "Так, я пачуў. Дай мне хвілінку." Ён робіць глыбокі ўдых, а потым паварочваецца да цябе...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF6B.english: "What makes you ask *that* question, above any other?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF6B.polish: „Dlaczego ze wszystkich możliwych pytań zadałeś właśnie *to*?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF6B.belarusian: "Чаму з усіх пытанняў ты задаеш менавіта *гэтае*?"

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000AF72.polish: „Bo nie radzą sobie ze mną. Jestem cholerną supergwiazdą”.
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000AF72.belarusian: "Таму што ім са мной не справіцца, я ж, чорт пабяры, суперзорка."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF77.belarusian: "Таму што гэта я не магу даць ім *раду*."

Alternate1/0x0100000F0000AF77.polish: „Bo nie radzę sobie z nimi. Jestem żałosną namiastką faceta”.
Alternate1/0x0100000F0000AF77.belarusian: "Таму што я не магу з імі справіцца. Я жаласнае падабенства мужчыны."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF7C.english: "Because they won't let me forget the life we used to have together."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF7C.polish: „Bo nie pozwalają mi zapomnieć o życiu, jakie toczyliśmy wspólnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF7C.belarusian: "Таму што яны не даюць мне забыць жыццё, якое мы калісьці падзялялі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF81.english: "I don't know! It's just what my brain told me to say."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF81.polish: „Nie wiem! Mózg kazał mi to powiedzieć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF81.belarusian: "Я не ведаю! Гэта проста тое, што мой мозг сказаў мне сказаць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF8E.english: "Maybe your problem is that you think it's their job to *handle* you..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF8E.polish: „Może twój problem polega na tym, że myślisz, iż *radzenie* sobie z tobą jest ich obowiązkiem...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF8E.belarusian: "Можа, твая праблема ў тым, што ты лічыш, нібыта іхні абавязак — *спраўляцца* з табой..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF93.english: "Maybe your problem is that you think they're *yours* to handle..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF93.polish: „Może twój problem polega na tym, że myślisz, iż są *twoje*, by sobie z nimi radzić...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF93.belarusian: "Можа, твая праблема ў тым, што ты лічыш, нібыта ты мусіш з імі *спраўляцца*..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF98.english: "Ah, gendarme. Your problem isn't ideological, it's personal..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF98.polish: „Ech, żandarmie. Twój problem nie jest ideologiczny tylko osobisty...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF98.belarusian: "Эх, жандарм. Твая праблема не ідэалагічная, а асабістая..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF9D.english: "That's because your brain is floating in ideology, gendarme. It's practically drowning in it..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF9D.polish: „To dlatego, że twój mózg jest zalany ideologią, żandarmie. Praktycznie w niej tonie...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AF9D.belarusian: "Гэта таму, што твае мазгі плаваюць у ідэалогіі, жандарм. Яны практычна тонуць у ёй..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFB0.english: Is "Ideology" some kind of high-proof liquor? Because that's the only thing your brain is floating in.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFB0.polish: Czy Ideologia to nazwa jakiegoś mocnego trunku? Bo to jedyna rzecz, w jakiej tonie twój mózg.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFB0.belarusian: Ці "Ідэалогія" — гэта нейкі моцны алкаголь? Бо гэта адзінае, у чым плаваюць твае мазгі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFB7.english: "You asked that question because you're still under the influence of ideology. That's natural. You're like a fish that's only now discovering that her whole life has been dictated by the movements of sea currents."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFB7.polish: „Zadałeś to pytanie, ponieważ wciąż jesteś pod wpływem ideologii. To naturalne. Jesteś jak ryba, która dopiero teraz odkrywa, że całe jej życie było dyktowane ruchami prądów morskich”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFB7.belarusian: "Ты задаў гэтае пытанне, таму што ўсё яшчэ знаходзішся пад уплывам ідэалогіі. Гэта натуральна. Ты нібы рыба, якая толькі цяпер даведалася, што ўсё яе жыццё вызначалася рухам марскіх плыняў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFCE.english: "That's what ideology is. It's like there are these invisible forces everywhere, pushing and tugging you this way and that, and you don't even know they're *there*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFCE.polish: „Tym jest właśnie ideologia. Wszędzie wokół pełno niewidzialnych sił, które popychają i pociągają cię to w tę, to we w tę, a ty nie wiesz nawet, że one cię *otaczają*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFCE.belarusian: "Вось што такое ідэалогія. Гэта нібы нябачныя сілы паўсюль, якія штурхаюць і цягнуць цябе туды-сюды, а ты нават не ведаеш, што яны *існуюць*."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFD5.english: "What does this have to do with communism?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFDA.english: "What does this have to do with women?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFDF.english: "Is it even *possible* to imagine a world without ideology?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFDF.polish: „Czy *da się w ogóle* wyobrazić sobie świat bez ideologii?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFEA.english: "Everything, man. That is part of the communist project, to destroy the ideological structures that reduce men and women to these hollow shells of identity."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFEA.polish: „Wszystko, człowieku. Częścią komunistycznego projektu jest zniszczenie ideologicznych struktur, które redukują mężczyzn i kobiety do tych pustych skorup tożsamości”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFEA.belarusian: "Самае наўпроставае, чалавеча. У гэтым і палягае сутнасць камуністычнага праекта — разбурыць ідэалагічныя структуры, што зводзяць мужчын і жанчын да гэтых пустых абалонак ідэнтычнасці."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFEF.english: "Of course it's possible. Just extremely difficult. You practically have to be a world-historical individual to do it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFEF.polish: „Oczywiście, że to możliwe. Tylko niesamowicie trudne. Aby to osiągnąć, trzeba być praktycznie światowo-historyczną osobowością”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFEF.belarusian: "Вядома ж, магчыма. Толькі надзвычай цяжка. Для гэтага трэба быць практычна сусветна-гістарычнай асобай."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFF9.english: "Do you know the story of Dobreva and Abadanaiz?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000AFF9.belarusian: "Ці ведаеш ты гісторыю Добравай і Абаданайза?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B00C.english: "I thought that was just some gibberish you made up for the passphrase."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B00C.polish: „Myślałem, że to tylko jakiś bzdet wymyślony na potrzeby hasła”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B00C.belarusian: "Я думаў, што гэта проста лухта, якую вы выдумалі для пароля."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B011.english: "I don't know what you're talking about. Who were they?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B011.polish: „Nie wiem, o czym mówisz. Co to za ludzie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B011.belarusian: "Я не ведаю, пра што ты. Хто яны такія?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B01C.english: "No. They were the Revolutionary Lovers, the Dual Commissars of Revolution in Insulinde."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B01C.polish: „Nie. Byli rewolucyjnymi kochankami – podwójnymi komisarzami rewolucji w Insulinde”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B01C.belarusian: "Не. Яны былі Рэвалюцыйнымі Каханкамі, Падвойнымі Камісарамі Рэвалюцыі ў Інсуліндыі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B022.english: "The so-called 'Revolutionary Lovers'. They were the Dual Commissars of Revolution in Insulinde."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B022.polish: „Tak zwani rewolucyjni kochankowie. Byli podwójnymi komisarzami rewolucji w Insulinde”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B022.belarusian: "Так званыя "Рэвалюцыйныя Каханкі". Яны былі Падвойнымі Камісарамі Рэвалюцыі ў Інсуліндыі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B027.english: "Not just lovers, they were the Dual Commissars of Revolution in Insulinde."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B027.polish: „Byli nie tylko kochankami, ale również podwójnymi komisarzami rewolucji w Insulinde”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B027.belarusian: "Не проста каханкаў — яны былі Падвойнымі Камісарамі Рэвалюцыі ў Інсуліндыі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B040.english: It's too bad they wound up equally dead on some nameless island in Ozonne...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B040.polish: Szkoda, że oboje skończyli w równym stopniu martwi na bezimiennej wyspie w Ozonne...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B040.belarusian: Шкада, што яны абодва аднолькава скончылі жыццё мёртвымі на нейкай безназоўнай выспе на Азоне...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B045.english: What became of them, though? There seems to be a blank paragraph in the history books...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B045.polish: Ale co się z nimi stało? W książkach historycznych jest w tym miejscu chyba pusty akapit...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B045.belarusian: Але што з імі сталася? Здаецца, у падручніках па гісторыі на гэтым месцы пусты абзац...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B04E.english: "It's from them we get the notion of dual-leadership, the *décomptage*, Revachol's truly great contribution to revolutionary thought. I believe it even persists in some form in the RCM, even to this day."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B04E.polish: „To od nich pochodzi koncepcja podwójnego przywództwa, *décomptage*, naprawdę wspaniały wkład Revacholu do myśli rewolucyjnej. Zdaje się, że w pewnej formie przetrwała ona do dziś nawet w MOR-ze”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B04E.belarusian: "Менавіта ад іх пайшла канцэпцыя двайнога кіраўніцтва, *décomptage*, сапраўды вялікі ўнёсак Рэвашоля ў рэвалюцыйную думку. Здаецца, яна ў нейкім выглядзе захоўваецца ў RCM нават дагэтуль."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B05E.english: "It's too bad they died like all the rest of the communards."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B05E.polish: „Wielka szkoda, że zginęli, jak reszta komunardów”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B05E.belarusian: "Шкада, што яны загінулі, як і ўсе астатнія камунары."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B063.english: "What happened to them, Dobreva and Abadanaiz?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B063.polish: „Co się z nimi stało? Z Dobrewą i Abadanaizem?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B063.belarusian: "Што з імі здарылася, з Добравай і Абаданайзам?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B068.english: "Is that true, Kim, about the décomptage?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B068.polish: „To prawda, Kim? To z tym décomptage'em?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B06D.english: "So... you're saying women are only bourgeois because of ideology?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B06D.polish: „Czyli... twierdzisz, że kobiety są burżuazyjne z powodu ideologii?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B06D.belarusian: "То бок... ты хочаш сказаць, што жанчыны буржуазныя толькі праз ідэалогію?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B072.english: "I need to take some time to think about all this..." (Conclude.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B072.polish: „Potrzebuję chwili czasu, żeby to wszystko przemyśleć...” (Zakończ).
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B072.belarusian: "Мне трэба трохі часу, каб абдумаць усё гэта..." (Скончыць.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B083.english: "They died on their own terms, like real revolutionaries. There's a lot to say for that."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B083.polish: „Zginęli na własnych zasadach jak prawdziwi rewolucjoniści. Można powiedzieć o tym wiele dobrego”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B083.belarusian: "Яны загінулі на ўласных умовах, як сапраўдныя рэвалюцыянеры. Гэта шмат чаго варта."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B08D.english: He sighs. "There's more to it than that. People still make their own choices. It's a matter of being aware what's influencing them."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B08D.polish: Wzdycha. „To nie takie proste. Ludzie wciąż podejmują własne decyzje. Chodzi o świadomość tego, co na te decyzje wpływa”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B08D.belarusian: Ён уздыхае. "Усё значна складаней. Людзі ўсё роўна робяць уласны выбар. Справа ў тым, каб усведамляць, што менавіта на іх уплывае."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B092.english: The young man nods but says nothing. He appears to be distracted by something...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B092.polish: Młody mężczyzna kiwa głową, ale milczy. Zdaje się, że coś odwróciło jego uwagę...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B092.belarusian: Малады чалавек ківае, але маўчыць. Здаецца, нешта адцягнула ягоную ўвагу...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0A7.english: "I had no idea its origins went all the way back to the Revolution itself. But it makes sense, in a way..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0A7.polish: „Nie miałem pojęcia, że jego początki sięgają samej rewolucji. Ale to ma sens, w pewnym sensie...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0A7.belarusian: "Я паняцця не меў, што яго вытокі ўзыходзяць да самой Рэвалюцыі. Але ў гэтым ёсць сэнс, у пэўным родзе..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0BA.english: He's wrestling with some question of his own.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0BA.polish: Zmaga się z jakimś własnym pytaniem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0BA.belarusian: Ён змагаецца з нейкім уласным пытаннем.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0C5.english: He's lost in his own thoughts. You wonder what silt you've stirred in the bottom of his soul.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0C5.polish: Zatopił się w rozmyślaniach. Zastanawiasz się, jaki muł z samego dna jego duszy zdołałeś przypadkiem wzburzyć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0C5.belarusian: Ён патануў ва ўласных думках. Цікава, які глей ты падняў з самога дна ягонай душы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0E3.english: Maybe in another life, but not this one. Face it, this is *the* question that's been simmering inside you all along.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0E3.polish: Może w innym życiu, ale nie w tym. Spójrz prawdzie w oczy: to właśnie jest *pytanie*, które dojrzewało w tobie przez cały ten czas.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0E3.belarusian: Можа, у іншым жыцці, але не ў гэтым. Прымі гэта: менавіта *гэтае* пытанне спела ўнутры цябе ўвесь гэты час.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0EA.english: No-no-no! This was supposed to take your mind *off* the other thing!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0EA.polish: Nie, nie, nie! To miało *odwrócić* twoją uwagę od tego drugiego!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0EA.belarusian: Не-не-не! Гэта павінна было *адцягнуць* цябе ад іншага!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0F1.english: Hang on, I thought I was really getting into the theory back there!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0F1.polish: Chwila, myślałem, że naprawdę zagłębiam się już w tej teorii!
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0F1.belarusian: Пачакай, я ж думаў, што сапраўды пачаў разбірацца ў тэорыі!

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0F6.english: Maybe I should keep this one to myself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0F6.polish: Może powinienem zachować to dla siebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B0F6.belarusian: Можа, мне варта пакінуць гэта пры сабе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B100.english: Sure, you spent some time getting lost in your theoretical labyrinths, but *this* has been the beast at the centre this whole time...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B100.polish: Jasne, spędziłeś trochę czasu, błądząc po swoim teoretycznym labiryncie, ale *to* była właśnie bestia, która czyhała na ciebie w jego wnętrzu...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B100.belarusian: Вядома, ты правёў нейкі час, блукаючы па тэарэтычных лабірынтах, але *гэта* і была тая пачвара ў самым цэнтры ўвесь гэты час...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B105.english: It's too late. You've already opened your mouth to speak...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B105.polish: Za późno. Otworzyłeś już usta i zacząłeś mówić...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B105.belarusian: Ужо позна. Ты ўжо адкрыў рот, каб сказаць...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B111.english: "That's enough for tonight. Will you still be here if I have more questions?" [Leave.]
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B111.polish: „Wystarczy na dziś. Będziecie tu, jeśli wpadną mi do głowy jeszcze jakieś pytania?” [Odejdź].
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B111.belarusian: "На сёння дастаткова. Вы яшчэ будзеце тут, калі ў мяне з'явяцца іншыя пытанні?" [Сысці.]

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B132.english: "Sure, we're here most every night." He shrugs. "Maybe we'll catch you again."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B132.polish: „Jasne, jesteśmy tu niemal każdej nocy” – odpowiada, wzruszając ramionami. „Może jeszcze się z tobą zobaczymy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B132.belarusian: "Вядома, мы тут амаль кожны вечар." Ён паціскае плячыма. "Можа, яшчэ перасячомся."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B13E.english: "Wait a minute, if you don't mind..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B143.english: "We wanted to get your opinion on something: a few little changes we we've been thinking about."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B143.polish: „Chcielibyśmy zasięgnąć twojej opinii na pewien temat: kilku małych zmian, o których ostatnio myśleliśmy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B143.belarusian: "Мы хацелі пачуць тваё меркаванне: наконт некалькіх дробных змен, пра якія мы думалі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B150.english: "Nothing *too major*, I think. We were talking, potentially, about relaxing some parts of our admissions process..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B150.polish: „Nic *zbyt poważnego*, moim zdaniem. Rozmawialiśmy o potencjalnym poluzowaniu niektórych części procesu rekrutacyjnego...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B150.belarusian: "Нічога *надта сур'ёзнага*, думаю. Мы разважалі пра магчымасць спрасціць некаторыя часткі нашага працэсу прыёму..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B156.english: "Hmm. It probably *would* help if you didn't make people go through a whole interview just to join."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B156.polish: „Hmm. Zapewne *pomogłoby*, gdybyście nie przeprowadzali całego wywiadu tylko po to, żeby pozwolić ludziom do was dołączyć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B156.belarusian: "Хм. Напэўна, гэта *сапраўды* дапамагло б, калі б вы не прымушалі людзей праходзіць цэлае сумоўе, каб проста далучыцца."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B15B.english: "Maybe you should ditch the passphrases and meet in a coffeehouse."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B15B.polish: „Może powinniście dać sobie spokój z tymi hasłami i spotykać się raczej w jakiejś kawiarni”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B15B.belarusian: "Можа, вам варта кінуць гэтыя паролі і сустракацца ў якой-небудзь кавярні."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B160.english: "Have you considered changing up the reading list?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B160.belarusian: "А вы не думалі змяніць спіс літаратуры?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B165.english: "No, you should keep it the way things are."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B165.polish: „Nie, powinniście zostawić wszystko tak, jak jest”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B165.belarusian: "Не, вам варта пакінуць усё як ёсць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B16A.english: "That's interesting. I thought people *loved* group interviews."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B16A.polish: „Interesujące. Myślałem, że ludzie *uwielbiają* takie grupowe rozmowy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B16A.belarusian: "Цікава. А я думаў, людзі *любяць* групавыя сумоўі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B16F.english: "Hmm. I thought the *cloak-and-dagger routine* made us seem more appealing."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B16F.polish: „Hmm... Myślałem, że takie *metody żywcem z powieści płaszcza i szpady* sprawią, że będziemy atrakcyjniejsi”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B16F.belarusian: "Хм. А я думаў, гэтыя *шпіёнскія гульні* робяць нас больш прывабнымі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B174.english: "I suppose we have read through most of the infra-materialist canon by this point."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B174.polish: „Zdaje się, że przeczytaliśmy już większość inframaterialistycznego kanonu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B174.belarusian: "Мяркую, да гэтага моманту мы прачыталі ўжо большую частку інфраматэрыялістычнага канона."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B179.english: "Exactly what I've been saying. On fundamental matters there can be no compromise!"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B179.polish: „Też tak uważam. W kwestiach fundamentalnych nie ma miejsca na kompromisy!”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B179.belarusian: "Вось акурат тое, пра што я і казаў. У прынцыповых пытаннях не можа быць ніякіх кампрамісаў!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B17E.english: "I thought so, too, but perhaps we overdid it, just a little..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B17E.polish: „Też tak myślałem, ale może odrobinę przesadziliśmy...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B17E.belarusian: "Я таксама так думаў, але, магчыма, мы трохі перагнулі палку..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B183.english: He sighs. "You're right. It probably wouldn't *kill* us to read more conventional historical materialism."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B183.polish: Wzdycha. „Masz rację. Pewnie nie *zabiłoby* nas czytanie dzieł dotyczących bardziej konwencjonalnego materializmu historycznego”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B183.belarusian: Ён уздыхае. "Твая праўда. Нас, напэўна, не *заб'е*, калі мы пачытаем больш звыклы гістарычны матэрыялізм."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B188.english: "I'm not saying we abandon our beliefs. I just think it would be better if our group had more than *two* regular attendees."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B188.polish: „Nie twierdzę, że powinniśmy porzucić nasze przekonania. Po prostu myślę, że byłoby lepiej, gdyby do naszej grupy należało więcej niż *dwóch* regularnie uczęszczających na spotkania członków”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B188.belarusian: "Я не кажу адмаўляцца ад нашых перакананняў. Я проста думаю, што было б лепш, каб у нашай групе было больш за *двух* рэгулярных удзельнікаў."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B192.english: "As long as we maintain the appropriate critical distance."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B192.belarusian: "Калі толькі мы будзем захоўваць належную крытычную дыстанцыю."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B197.english: "Good point. Two's not really a 'group,' is it?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B197.polish: „Ma to sens. Dwie osoby ciężko nazwać grupą, co?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B197.belarusian: "Слушная думка. Двое — гэта не зусім "гурток", ці не так?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B19C.english: "Nah, two's the best number. Three's when they start cramping your style."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B19C.polish: „Nie tam, dwa to najlepsza liczba. Trzecia osoba zaczyna już burzyć styl”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B19C.belarusian: "Не, двое — найлепшая лічба. Калі з'яўляецца трэці, стыль пачынае кульгаць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1A1.english: "Plus, all these empty chairs are a little sad, aren't they?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1A1.polish: „Do tego wszystkie te puste krzesła są przygnębiające, prawda?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1A1.belarusian: "Да таго ж усе гэтыя пустыя крэслы выглядаюць крыху сумна, праўда?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1A6.english: "Precisely my point. It's about quality, not quantity."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1A6.polish: „Z ust mi to wyjąłeś. Liczy się jakość a nie ilość”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1A6.belarusian: "Вось менавіта. Справа ў якасці, а не ў колькасці."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1AB.english: "There was another thing: We were also debating putting up some posters around town."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1AB.polish: „Jest jeszcze coś – rozważaliśmy rozwieszenie w mieście plakatów reklamowych”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1AB.belarusian: "І яшчэ адна рэч: мы таксама абмяркоўвалі расклейванне плакатаў па горадзе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1B0.english: "Though *some of us* maintain that advertising is an unacceptably bourgeois tactic."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1B0.polish: „Chociaż *niektórzy z nas* utrzymują, że reklama to nieakceptowalna burżuazyjna taktyka”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1B0.belarusian: "Хаця *некаторыя з нас* сцвярджаюць, што рэклама — гэта недапушчальная буржуазная тактыка."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1EB.english: That's what makes it so beautiful. The irony is unbeatable.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1EB.polish: Dlatego właśnie to jest takie piękne. Ironia całej tej sytuacji.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1EB.belarusian: Менавіта гэта і робіць яе такой цудоўнай. Іронія проста неперасяжная.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1FE.english: Ahem. As a noted art cop you definitely have an opinion on this.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1FE.polish: Khm. Jako uznany artystyczny glina masz w tej kwestii swoją opinię.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B1FE.belarusian: Кхм. Як знаны Арт-Коп, ты дакладна маеш сваё меркаванне на гэты конт.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B205.english: "As someone who's dabbled in murals himself, I support this plan."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B205.polish: „Jako ktoś, kto sam zajmował się w życiu muralami, popieram ten plan”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B205.belarusian: "Як чалавек, які сам крыху займаўся мураламі, я падтрымліваю гэты план."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B20A.english: "As something of an art critic myself, I support this poster plan."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B20A.polish: „Jako ktoś, kogo można nazwać krytykiem sztuki, popieram plan z plakatami”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000F0000B20A.belarusian: "Як чалавек, які сам крыху з'яўляецца мастацтвазнаўцам, я падтрымліваю гэты план з плакатамі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012BE5.english: "The Moralintern are a fact. I try not to have opinions on facts -- until they change. And," he looks at the city below, "it doesn't look like that's about to happen."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012BE5.polish: „Moralintern to fakt. Staram się nie mieć opinii na temat faktów – do chwili, aż następuje ich zmiana. A...” – spogląda na miasto poniżej – „...na to się nie zapowiada”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012BE5.belarusian: "Маралінтэрн — гэта факт. Я імкнуся не мець меркаванняў наконт фактаў — пакуль яны не зменяцца. І, — ён глядзіць на горад унізе, — не падобна, што гэта хутка адбудзецца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012BEC.english: It's more than that. There's some kind of affection in him.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012BEC.polish: Jest w tym coś więcej. W jego głosie pobrzmiewa sympatia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012BEC.belarusian: Тут нешта большае. У ім адчуваецца нейкая сімпатыя.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C08.english: The lieutenant breathes out a chestnut-scented cloud of cigarette smoke and looks at the city he's sworn to guard.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C08.polish: Porucznik wydycha pachnącą kasztanami chmurę papierosowego dymu i spogląda na miasto, którego przysiągł strzec.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C08.belarusian: Лейтэнант выдыхае воблака цыгарэтнага дыму з водарам каштанаў і глядзіць на горад, які прысягнуў абараняць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C0F.english: "Yes. I *did* -- when I was younger. In my twenties I considered myself a moralist. *A blue forget-me-not, a piece of the sky*," he quotes. "They're not all that bad."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C0F.polish: „Tak. *Byłem* – w młodości. Gdy miałem dwadzieścia lat, uważałem się za moralistę. *Niebieska niezapominajka, fragment nieba*” – cytuje. „Oni nie są tacy źli”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C0F.belarusian: "Так. *Падабаўся* — калі я быў маладзейшы. Калі мне было гадоў дваццаць, я лічыў сябе маралістам. 'Сіняя незабудка, кавалачак неба', — цытуе ён. — Яны не такія ўжо і дрэнныя".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C16.english: "But the years have changed that. I don't know *what* I believe in now...." He thinks, then changes his mind. "No. I believe in the RCM. That's enough for me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C16.polish: „Ale z czasem to się zmieniło. Nie wiem już, w *co* teraz wierzę...” – zamyśla się, po czym zmienia zdanie. „Nie. Wierzę w MOR. To mi wystarczy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C16.belarusian: "Але з гадамі гэта змянілася. Я ўжо і не ведаю, у *што* веру цяпер... — ён задумваецца, а потым перадумвае. — Не. Я веру ў РГМ. Мне гэтага дастаткова".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C1C.english: That's another leitmotiv associated with moralism.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C1C.polish: To kolejny leitmotiv powiązany z moralizmem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C1C.belarusian: Гэта яшчэ адзін лейтматыў, звязаны з маралізмам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C2B.english: "Do you?" The lieutenant arches his brow, then pulls on his cigarette. It's a slim white thing in his fingers.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C2B.polish: „Czyżby?” – porucznik unosi brew i zaciąga się dymem z cienkiego, białego papierosa spoczywającego między palcami jego dłoni.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C2B.belarusian: "Няўжо?" — лейтэнант узнімае брыво, пасля чаго зацягваецца цыгарэтай. Гэта тонкая белая палачка ў яго пальцах.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C3D.english: "On second thought -- I *don't* have an opinion. Forget about it."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C44.english: "We are stooges of the world's biggest bourgeois organization, protecting bourgeois rights."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C44.polish: „Jesteśmy sługusami największej na świecie burżuazyjnej organizacji chroniącymi prawa burżuazji właśnie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C44.belarusian: "Мы марыянеткі найбуйнейшай у свеце буржуазнай арганізацыі, якія абараняюць буржуазныя правы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C4B.english: "No. We are stooges of the world's biggest bourgeois organization -- protecting the people of Revachol. That's the hand we were dealt. Without the MI, we would be common vigilantes."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C4B.polish: „Nie. Jesteśmy sługusami największej na świecie burżuazyjnej organizacji chroniącymi mieszkańców Revacholu. Taki nasz los. Bez Moraliternu bylibyśmy zwykłymi samozwańczymi mścicielami”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C4B.belarusian: "Не. Мы марыянеткі найбуйнейшай у свеце буржуазнай арганізацыі — якія абараняюць жыхароў Рэвашоля. Такія карты нам выпалі. Без МІ мы былі б звычайнымі мсціўцамі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C51.english: Mutter silently: "Immigrants, liberal kipts, fucking... men are turning into women."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C51.polish: Zamamrocz cicho: „Imigranci, liberalne kipty, jebani... faceci zmieniają się w kobiety”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C51.belarusian: Ціха прамармытаць: "Імігранты, ліберальныя кіпты, бляха... мужыкі ператвараюцца ў баб".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C58.english: "In fact, we would need them even if you *didn't* think that way. We are in what is called the *twilight of international law*. The laws we claim to enforce come from the MI. Without them, we are simply vigilantes."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C58.polish: „Prawda jest taka, że potrzebowalibyśmy ich, nawet gdybyś tak *nie* uważał. Znajdujemy się w swego rodzaju *strefie półmroku międzynarodowego prawa*. Źródłem praw, których przestrzegania pilnujemy, jest Moralintern. Bez niego jesteśmy zwykłymi samozwańczymi mścicielami”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C58.belarusian: "Насамрэч яны былі б патрэбныя нам, нават калі б вы так *не* лічылі. Мы знаходзімся ў так званых *прыцемках міжнароднага права*. Законы, выканання якіх мы патрабуем, паходзяць ад МІ. Без іх мы проста мсціўцы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C60.english: "We are in what is called the *twilight of international law*. The laws we claim to enforce come from the MI. Without them, we are simply vigilantes."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C60.polish: „Znajdujemy się w swego rodzaju *strefie półmroku międzynarodowego prawa*. Źródłem praw, których przestrzegania pilnujemy, jest Moralintern. Bez niego jesteśmy zwykłymi samozwańczymi mścicielami”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C60.belarusian: "Мы знаходзімся ў так званых *прыцемках міжнароднага права*. Законы, выканання якіх мы патрабуем, паходзяць ад МІ. Без іх мы проста мсціўцы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C67.english: "What happens to the people we convict?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C67.polish: „Co się dzieje z ludźmi, których skażemy?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C67.belarusian: "Што адбываецца з людзьмі, якіх мы асуджаем?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C6E.english: "We don't convict. We arrest and send them to Coalition Government courts -- in Couron and La Delta. The prosecution works off our testimonies. And records -- which is why it's paramount to keep them." He taps on his coat pocket -- where he keep his notes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C6E.polish: „My nikogo nie skazujemy. Zatrzymujemy ich i wysyłamy przed oblicze sądów Rządu Koalicyjnego – w Couron i La Delta. Oskarżyciele wykorzystują nasze zeznania. Oraz sprawozdania – dlatego właśnie ich sporządzanie jest tak ważne” – oznajmia, postukując palcem w kieszeń kurtki, w której przechowuje swoje notatki.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C6E.belarusian: "Мы не асуджаем. Мы арыштоўваем і адпраўляем іх у суды Кааліцыйнага Урада — у Куроне і Ля Дэльце. Абвінавачанне абапіраецца на нашы паказанні. І запісы — таму іх вядзенне мае першараднае значэнне", — ён пастуквае па кішэні паліто, дзе трымае свае нататкі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C82.english: "Well phrased." He nods and breathes out. "I understand answering to foreign powers doesn't sit well with immigrant-bashing -- but without the MI we would be common vigilantes. That's just the way it is."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C82.polish: „Dobrze powiedziane” – kiwa głową i robi wydech. „Zdaję sobie sprawę, że odpowiadanie obcym mocarstwom niezbyt przystaje do nagonki na imigrantów, ale bez Moralinternu bylibyśmy zwykłymi samozwańczymi mścicielami. Tak to już jest”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C82.belarusian: "Добра сфармулявана, — ён ківае і выдыхае. — Я разумею, што падпарадкаванне замежным дзяржавам не надта стасуецца з нападкамі на імігрантаў, але без МІ мы былі б звычайнымі мсціўцамі. Вось так яно ёсць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C8A.english: "My kind of police officer," he nods. A light smile. Then looks at the roundabout.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C8A.polish: „I takich funkcjonariuszy policji lubię” – kiwa głową i uśmiecha się, po czym spogląda na rondo.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C8A.belarusian: "Вось такіх супрацоўнікаў паліцыі я люблю", — ён ківае. Лёгкая ўсмешка. Потым глядзіць на кальцавую развязку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012C97.polish: „Jak dla mnie bycie mścicielem jest właściwie w porządku”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CA3.english: "Maybe we should make our own law?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CAC.english: "Spoken like a revolutionary, not a cop. But hypothetical aside -- in Martinaise we already *are* vigilantes. At least the Union thinks so. I expect our job here to prove quite challenging." He looks at the roundabout.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CAC.polish: „Słowa godne rewolucjonisty, a nie gliniarza. Ale prawda jest taka, że w Martinaise i bez tego *jesteśmy* samozwańczymi mścicielami. Przynajmniej w oczach Związku. Spodziewam się, że nasza praca tutaj będzie prawdziwym wyzwaniem” – odpowiada, po czym spogląda na rondo.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CAC.belarusian: "Словы рэвалюцыянера, а не паліцыянта. Але калі адкінуць гіпотэзы — у Марцінэзе мы ўжо *і ёсць* мсціўцы. Прынамсі так лічыць Прафсаюз. Мяркую, наша праца тут будзе вельмі няпростай", — ён глядзіць на кальцавую развязку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CB3.english: "Then you will *adore* Martinaise. For many of these people -- the Union especially -- vigilantes is precisely what we are. Personally, I don't enjoy it much." He looks at the roundabout.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CB3.polish: „W takim razie *pokochasz* Martinaise. Dla wielu, którzy tu mieszkają – a zwłaszcza dla członków Związku – jesteśmy właśnie samozwańczymi mścicielami. Osobiście za tym nie przepadam” – odpowiada, po czym spogląda na rondo.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CB3.belarusian: "Тады вы будзеце ў *захапленні* ад Марцінэза. Для многіх тутэйшых людзей — асабліва для Прафсаюза — мы якраз і ёсць мсціўцамі. Асабіста мне гэта не вельмі падабаецца", — ён глядзіць на кальцавую развязку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CBA.english: He nods. "Sadly, it is what we already are to the people of Martinaise. Most of them at least, especially the Union -- vigilantes. I expect our job here to prove quite challenging." He looks at the roundabout.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CBA.polish: Kiwa głową. „Niestety, dla mieszkańców Martinaise tym właśnie jesteśmy. Przynajmniej dla większości z nich – a zwłaszcza dla członków Związku. Spodziewam się, że nasza praca tutaj będzie prawdziwym wyzwaniem” – odpowiada, spoglądając na rondo.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CBA.belarusian: Ён ківае: "На жаль, менавіта такімі мы ўжо і з'яўляемся для жыхароў Марцінэза. Прынамсі для большасці з іх, асабліва для Прафсаюза, — мсціўцамі. Мяркую, наша праца тут будзе вельмі няпростай", — ён глядзіць на кальцавую развязку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012AD6.english: The lights of the orphan district are reflected in his glasses: the red and golden orbs of the motorway sliding like pearls on a string, from East to West, as Revachol commutes back to the suburbs. Tomorrow is Tuesday. Monday is over.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012AD6.polish: Łuna osieroconej dzielnicy odbija się w jego okularach. Czerwone i złote światła autostrady przesuwają się ze wschodu na zachód niczym perły na sznurku – mieszkańcy Revacholu wracają na przedmieścia. Jutro wtorek. Poniedziałek dobiegł końca.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012AD6.belarusian: Агні асірацелага квартала адбіваюцца ў яго акулярах: чырвоныя і залатыя сферы аўтастрады коцяцца, як пацеркі на нітцы, з усходу на захад, пакуль Рэвашоль вяртаецца ў прыгарады. Заўтра аўторак. Панядзелак скончыўся.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CC8.english: The lights of the orphan district are reflected in his glasses: the red and golden orbs of the motorway sliding like pearls on a string, from East to West, as Revachol commutes back to the suburbs. Tomorrow is Tuesday. Monday is over.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CC8.polish: Łuna osieroconej dzielnicy odbija się w jego okularach. Czerwone i złote światła autostrady przesuwają się ze wschodu na zachód niczym perły na sznurku – mieszkańcy Revacholu wracają na przedmieścia. Jutro wtorek. Poniedziałek dobiegł końca.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CC8.belarusian: Агні асірацелага квартала адбіваюцца ў яго акулярах: чырвоныя і залатыя сферы аўтастрады коцяцца, як пацеркі на нітцы, з усходу на захад, пакуль Рэвашоль вяртаецца ў прыгарады. Заўтра аўторак. Панядзелак скончыўся.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CD7.english: The dying lights of the city shimmer below -- slowly, like luminous clouds, they pass on his lenses. The lieutenant looks at his slim cigarette, contemplating the next drag.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CD7.polish: W dole migoczą gasnące światła miasta – powoli, niczym świetliste obłoki, przesuwają się po szkłach okularów porucznika. Spogląda na swojego smukłego papierosa, kontemplując kolejne zaciągnięcie się jego dymem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CD7.belarusian: Згасальныя агні горада мільгацяць унізе — павольна, нібы светлавыя аблокі, яны праплываюць па яго шкельцах. Лейтэнант глядзіць на сваю тонкую цыгарэту, разважаючы пра наступную зацяжку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CDD.english: "They *really* don't like us here. And the mouth on that kid, Cuno... It's different inland. In Jamrock and the G.R.I.H." He pulls on the cigarette.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CDD.polish: „*Naprawdę* nas tutaj nie lubią. To wulgarne słownictwo tego dzieciaka o imieniu Cuno... W głębi lądu jest inaczej. W Jamrock i w P.P.W.R.” – zaciąga się dymem z papierosa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CDD.belarusian: "Яны нас тут *сапраўды* не любяць. А гэты язык малога Куна... У глыбіні вострава ўсё інакш. У Джэмроку і ў БІРП", — ён зацягваецца цыгарэтай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CE3.english: This *soldier* is the highlight of the day for me, he thinks. This little stick right here.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CE3.polish: Ten *szlug* to dla niego najmilszy moment dnia. Ten mały rulonik.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CE3.belarusian: Гэты *жаўнер* для мяне — найлепшы момант дня, думае ён. Гэтая маленькая палачка вось тут.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CEA.english: An aerostatic passes overhead -- the whiskers of its floodlights on the ground below. Kitsuragi's glasses light up as he looks to the sky. Two glowing circles.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CEA.polish: Po niebie przesuwa się aerostat, liżąc ziemię światłami jupiterów. Okulary Kitsuragiego rozbłyskują, kiedy spogląda w niebo. Dwa jasne kręgi.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CEA.belarusian: Над галавой пралятае аэрастат — вусы яго пражэктараў слізгаюць па зямлі ўнізе. Акуляры Кіцурагі ўспыхваюць, калі ён глядзіць у неба. Два свячныя кругі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CF9.english: "They really don't like us here. The Union, the teenagers too... It's different inland. In Jamrock and the G.R.I.H." He pulls on the cigarette.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CF9.polish: „Naprawdę nas tutaj nie lubią. Związek – nawet nastolatki... W głębi lądu jest inaczej. W Jamrock i w P.P.W.R.” – zaciąga się dymem z papierosa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012CF9.belarusian: "Яны нас тут сапраўды не любяць. Прафсаюз, падлеткі таксама... У глыбіні вострава ўсё інакш. У Джэмроку і ў БІРП", — ён зацягваецца цыгарэтай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D00.english: "It's our fault for leaving this place to the dogs. To the Union. To the company. Not daring to come here more often. It's like I told you -- this place is an orphan. Fallen between the cracks..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D00.polish: „To nasza wina, bo zostawiliśmy to miejsce na pastwę wilków. Związku. Firmy. Ze strachu nie zapuszczaliśmy się tu zbyt często. Tak jak ci mówiłem – to miejsce jest sierotą. Umknęło naszej uwadze...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D00.belarusian: "Гэта наша віна, бо мы пакінулі гэтае месца на волю лёсу. Прафсаюзу. Кампаніі. Не асмельваліся прыязджаць сюды часцей. Я ж казаў вам — гэтае месца асірацелае. Правалілася скрозь шчыліны..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D28.english: "It's our fault for leaving this place to the dogs. To the Union. To the company. Not daring to come here more often. This place has fallen between the cracks. The jurisdictions of our two Precincts."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D28.polish: „To nasza wina, bo zostawiliśmy to miejsce na pastwę wilków. Związku. Firmy. Ze strachu nie zapuszczaliśmy się tu zbyt często. To miejsce umknęło naszej uwadze. Zawieruszyło się między jurysdykcjami naszych dwóch komisariatów”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D28.belarusian: "Гэта наша віна, бо мы пакінулі гэтае месца на волю лёсу. Прафсаюзу. Кампаніі. Не асмельваліся прыязджаць сюды часцей. Гэтае месца правалілася скрозь шчыліны. Паміж юрысдыкцыямі двух нашых пастарункаў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D33.english: "We run this city. West of the river is RCM land." He looks at the dark silhouette of the equestrian monument cutting into the night sky.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D33.polish: „Rządzimy tym miastem. Na zachód od rzeki rozpościera się terytorium MOR-u” – spogląda na ciemny zarys pomnika z jeźdźcem odcinającego się na tle nocnego nieba.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D33.belarusian: "Мы кіруем гэтым горадам. На захад ад ракі — зямля РГМ", — ён глядзіць на цёмны сілуэт коннага манумента, што выразаецца на фоне начнога неба.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D40.english: "It's *incredibly* hard. Human beings are..." He shakes his head. "But we are in control. And it's worth it. The organization works. Our systems work. If they didn't, this city would disintegrate."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D40.polish: „To *niesamowicie* trudne. Tacy są ludzie...” – kręci głową. „Ale sprawujemy kontrolę. I warto to robić. Organizacja działa. Nasze systemy działają. Bez nich miasto rozpadłoby się na kawałki”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D40.belarusian: "Гэта *неверагодна* цяжка. Людзі... — ён круціць галавой. — Але мы ўсё кантралюем. І яно таго варта. Арганізацыя працуе. Нашы сістэмы працуюць. Калі б не яны, гэты горад бы разваліўся".

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D47.english: Night. Captain Ptolemy Pryce steps into the yard. A piebald horse waits by the motor carriage, chewing oats out of an oat-bag. Seagulls fly overhead. The sky is black. Captain Pryce wears a black suit and a standard patrol coat as he mounts the horse to head home...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D47.polish: Noc. Kapitan Ptolemy Pryce wychodzi na podwórze. Przy powozie motorowym czeka pstrokaty koń, przeżuwając owies z worka. Nad głowami przelatują mewy. Niebo jest czarne. Kapitan Pryce zakłada czarną marynarkę i płaszcz patrolowy, po czym wsiada na konia, by ruszyć do domu...
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D47.belarusian: Ноч. Капітан Пталемей Прайс выходзіць на падворак. Каля маторнай карэты чакае пярэсты конь, жуючы авёс з торбы. У небе лятаюць кірлі. Неба чорнае. Капітан Прайс апрануты ў чорны касцюм і стандартны патрульны плашч; ён садзіцца на каня, каб выправіцца дадому...

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D55.english: Rows of houses on either side, hunching over the sidewalks -- and Precinct 41 with its dome roof growing distant. Around him the streets are silent. A kid on the corner waves at the captain as he takes the turn on Perdition and Main. The horse neighs. The captain nods back.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D55.polish: Po obu stronach wyrastają rzędy domów, przygarbiają się nad chodnikami. W oddali rośnie coraz bardziej 41. komisariat i kopuła jego dachu. Ulice wokół są ciche. Dzieciak na rogu macha kapitanowi, kiedy ten skręca w Perdition i Main. Koń rży. Kapitan kiwa dzieciakowi w odpowiedzi głową.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D55.belarusian: Рады дамоў з абодвух бакоў схіляюцца над ходнікамі — і Пастарунак 41 са сваім купальным дахам аддаляецца. Вакол яго вуліцы маўчаць. Хлапчук на рагу махае капітану, калі той паварочвае на скрыжаванні Пердышэн і Галоўнай. Конь іржэ. Капітан ківае ў адказ.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D61.english: Thanks, kid, he thinks. He's grateful.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D61.polish: Dzięki, młody – myśli. Jest mu wdzięczny.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600012D61.belarusian: Дзякуй, малы, думае ён. Ён удзячны.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016562.english: "They're a union of centre-left and centre-right parties across the Reál Belt. Our Coalition Government is just one of its many projects. They also run the ICP, EPIS... most inter-governmental organizations in the world."
Dialogue Text/0x0100000600016562.polish: „To unia centrolewicowych i centroprawicowych partii z całej strefy reála. Nasz Rząd Koalicyjny to tylko jeden z jej licznych projektów. Utworzyła także MOP, EPIS... i większość międzyrządowych organizacji funkcjonujących na świecie”.
