Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003573.polish: „Ale nie tak dobre, jak pierwotna idea Stebana”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003573.belarusian: "Але не так добра, як арыгінальная ідэя Стэбана".

Dialogue Text/0x010000530000357A.english: A feeble and hopelessly mixed metaphor.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003581.english: "Actually, I think that's a mixed metaphor."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003581.polish: „Właściwie to to chyba jest dość poplątana metafora”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003588.english: "Hmph. Leave it to the gendarme to enforce bourgeois stylistic values."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003588.polish: „Ha! Oczywiście żandarm narzuca burżuazyjne wartości stylistyczne”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003588.belarusian: "Гм. Ну вядома, каму як не жандару навязваць буржуазныя стылістычныя нормы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003596.english: "It's an old construction site." He looks around. "They've been trying to restore these apartments for years, but as you can see they haven't made much progress."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003596.polish: „To stary plac budowy” – rozgląda się. „Od lat próbują odbudować te mieszkania, ale jak sam widzisz, nie poczynili zbyt dużych postępów”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003596.belarusian: "Гэта старая будоўля, — ён азіраецца. — Яны спрабуюць аднавіць гэтыя кватэры гадамі, але, як бачыш, не надта прасунуліся".

Dialogue Text/0x010000530000359D.english: "I heard these used to be luxury apartments. Million reál views, that sort of thing."
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000359D.polish: „Słyszałem, że kiedyś były tu luksusowe apartamenty. Widoki za milion reáli, te sprawy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000359D.belarusian: "Я чуў, тут раней былі элітныя кватэры. Віды на мільён рэалаў і ўсё такое".

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000035A9.english: "That could be." He nods. "It would explain some of the more ornate detailing. But we're speaking in world-historical terms here. What this place *represents*, not what it merely *was*."
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000035A9.polish: „Możliwe” – kiwa głową. „To by tłumaczyło co bardziej ozdobne detale. Ale my tu mówimy o perspektywie światowo-historycznej. O tym, co to miejsce *reprezentuje*, a nie o tym czym zaledwie *było*”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000035A9.belarusian: "Можа быць, — ён ківае. — Гэта растлумачыла б некаторыя больш вычварныя дэталі. Але мы тут разважаем у сусветна-гістарычных катэгорыях. Пра тое, што гэтае месца *ўвасабляе*, а не пра тое, чым яно проста *было*."

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000035B0.english: His friend yawns, evidently bored by literal reality.
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000035B0.polish: Jego przyjaciel ziewa najwyraźniej znudzony dosłowną rzeczywistością.
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000035B0.belarusian: Ягоны сябар пазяхае, відавочна засумаваўшы ад літаральнай рэчаіснасці.

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000035D9.english: The way they billow in the night breeze reminds you of something...
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000035D9.polish: Sposób, w jaki materiał łopocze na wietrze, coś ci przypomina...
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000035D9.belarusian: Тое, як яны калышуцца на начным ветрыку, штосьці табе нагадвае...

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000035E7.english: It reminds you of something, but you can't think of what. Oh well, let's see if the students are still going...
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000035E7.polish: Przypomina ci to coś, ale nie jesteś pewien co. No nic, zobaczmy, czy studenci wciąż działają...
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000035E7.belarusian: Гэта нешта табе нагадвае, але ты не можаш уцяміць, што менавіта. Ну добра, давай паглядзім, ці студэнты яшчэ не скончылі...

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003604.english: You've flustered the poor boy. Now he's *got* to say something.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003604.polish: Skołowałeś biednego chłopaka. Teraz *musi* coś powiedzieć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003604.belarusian: Ты збянтэжыў беднага хлопца. Цяпер ён *вымушаны* нешта сказаць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003B86.english: The higher the tower goes, the quieter the room seems to become. Aside from the occasional comment, the three of you are completely absorbed by the task.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003B86.polish: Im wyżej pnie się wieża, tym większa cisza zapada w pomieszczeniu. Pomijając rzucane czasem komentarze, jesteście całkowicie zaabsorbowani swoim zadaniem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003B86.belarusian: Чым вышэй расце вежа, тым цішэй робіцца ў пакоі. Акрамя рэдкіх заўваг, вы ўсе ўтрох цалкам паглынутыя задачай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003B91.english: It's almost exactly as Nilsen's sketch imagined, a physical manifestation of the dialectical spiral of history.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003B91.polish: Wygląda prawie tak, jak na szkicu Nilsena. Fizyczne ucieleśnienie dialektycznej spirali historii.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003B91.belarusian: Гэта амаль дакладна так, як на малюнку Нільсэна: фізічнае ўвасабленне дыялектычнай спіралі гісторыі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003BA6.english: "Well, I think we're probably finished here, detective."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003BA6.polish: „No cóż, chyba już tu skończyliśmy, detektywie”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003BAC.english: Yes, it's probably time for you to take your leave as well.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003BAC.polish: Tak, ty też raczej powinieneś już sobie iść.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003BAC.belarusian: Так, табе таксама, бадай, пара развітацца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003C9A.english: "You know," the young man looks up at you as you enter, "if you wanted to borrow my jacket, you could've just *asked*..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003C9A.polish: „Wiesz” – stwierdza młody mężczyzna, przyglądając ci się, gdy wchodzisz do środka – „skoro chciałeś pożyczyć moją marynarkę, to wystarczyło mnie *poprosić*...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003C9A.belarusian: "Ведаеш, — малады чалавек глядзіць на цябе, пакуль ты заходзіш, — калі ты хацеў пазычыць мой пінжак, мог проста *папрасіць*..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003CA6.english: "But no matter. What's on your mind?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003CA6.belarusian: "Але няважна. Пра што ты хацеў пагаварыць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003CAD.english: It looks better on you, anyway. He never had the shoulders for it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003CAD.polish: Na tobie i tak wygląda lepiej. On nie jest wystarczająco barczysty.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300003CAD.belarusian: На табе ён усё адно глядзіцца лепей. У яго ніколі не было такіх плячэй.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006206.english: "Maurice and Zuzanna will be back, I know it."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006206.polish: „Maurice i Zuzanna wrócą. Ja to wiem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006206.belarusian: "Маўрыс і Сюзанна вернуцца. Я гэта ведаю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006212.english: "Puncher and Wattmann should be required reading."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006212.polish: „Dzieło Punchera i Wattmanna powinno być lekturą obowiązkową”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006212.belarusian: "Твор Панчэра і Ватмана павінен быць абавязковай літаратурай".

Dialogue Text/0x010000530000621E.english: "The only 'class' I care about is the working class."
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000621E.polish: „Jedyna klasa, która mnie interesuje, to klasa robotnicza”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000621E.belarusian: "Адзіны клас, які мяне цікавіць, гэта рабочы клас".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006227.english: "If infra-materialism is wrong, I don't want to be right."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006227.polish: „Jeśli inframaterializm się myli, to nie chcę mieć racji”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006227.belarusian: "Калі інфраматэрыялізм памыляецца, то я не хачу мець рацыю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006230.polish: „Moje oceny w tym semestrze są beznadziejne”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006302.english: "That girl from my seminar *promised* she would stop by."

Dialogue Text/0x010000530000626D.english: "This new translation of 'Reál and Reality' is garbage."
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000626D.polish: „To nowe tłumaczenie »Reála i realiów« jest do niczego”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000626D.belarusian: "Гэты новы пераклад 'Рэала і рэчаіснасці' — поўнае смецце."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006279.english: "University is a lot better once you stop going to class."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006279.polish: „Studiowanie jest o wiele lepsze, gdy człowiek nie chodzi na wykłady”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006279.belarusian: "Ва ўніверсітэце куды лепей, калі перастаеш хадзіць на заняткі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006282.english: "I'll spit in Maurice's face when he comes crawling back."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006282.polish: „Napluję Mariuce'emu w twarz, gdy przyczołga się z powrotem na kolanach”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006282.belarusian: "Я плюну Марысу ў твар, калі ён прыпаўзе назад."

Dialogue Text/0x010000530000628B.english: "Eight cups a day is perfectly healthy."
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000628B.polish: „Osiem kubków dziennie jest w zupełności zdrowe”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000530000628B.belarusian: "Восем кубкаў на дзень — гэта цалкам нармальна для здароўя."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006292.english: "I would commit war crimes for some real Saramirizian coffee."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006292.polish: „Popełniłbym zbrodnie wojenne za prawdziwą saramiską kawę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005300006292.belarusian: "Я б учыніў ваенныя злачынствы дзеля сапраўднай сарамірызскай кавы."

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000062A0.english: "Don't worry, I'm sure your jacket will turn up."
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000062A0.polish: „Nie martw się, twoja marynarka na pewno się znajdzie”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000062A0.belarusian: "Не хвалюйся, я ўпэўнены, твая куртка знойдзецца."

Dialogue Text/0x01000053000062A7.english: "I can't believe someone just left these matchboxes here."
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000062A7.polish: „Nie mogę uwierzyć, że ktoś po prostu zostawił tu te pudełka zapałek”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000053000062A7.belarusian: "Не магу паверыць, што нехта проста пакінуў тут гэтыя запалкавыя скрынкі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000FBE1.english: "Hello, I'm Billie. Would you like something to drink? Tea, lemonade?" she asks nervously. "We're out of coffee, I was supposed to get some tomorrow..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000FBE1.polish: „Dzień dobry, jestem Billie. Podać coś do picia? Herbata? Lemoniada?” – pyta nerwowo. „Skończyła nam się kawa. Miałam kupić ją jutro...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002F0000FBE1.belarusian: "Вітаю, я Білі. Жадаеце чаго-небудзь выпіць? Гарбаты, ліманаду? - нервова пытаецца яна. - Кава ў нас скончылася, я мелася купіць яе заўтра..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700026B5E.english: "I'm not really here for the tea."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700026B6D.english: "Is this about Victor, my husband? Is he in some kind of trouble again? I can come pick him up in the station if that's what..." She stops, her eyes trying to read answers from your face.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700026B6D.polish: „Chodzi o Victora, mojego męża? Znowu ma jakieś kłopoty? Mogę odebrać go z komisariatu, jeśli to o to...” – milknie, a jej oczy próbują wyczytać odpowiedzi z twojej twarzy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700026B6D.belarusian: "Гэта наконт Віктара, майго мужа? Ён зноў ускочыў у нейкую бяду? Я магу забраць яго з пастарунка, калі гэта... - яна спыняецца, яе вочы спрабуюць прачытаць адказы на тваім твары."

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700026B7E.english: Something changes in her expression. "No, this is something much worse... Is he in a hospital? How bad is it?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700026B7E.polish: Coś zmienia się w wyrazie jej twarzy. „Nie, to coś o wiele gorszego... On trafił do szpitala? W jakim jest stanie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700026B7E.belarusian: Нешта змяняецца ў выраззе яе твару. "Не, гэта штосьці значна горшае... Ён у шпіталі? Наколькі ўсё дрэнна?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700026B91.english: "You live here with Victor, your husband, right?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700026B91.polish: „Mieszka tu pani ze swoim mężem, Victorem, prawda?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700026B91.belarusian: "Вы ж жывяце тут з Віктарам, вашым мужам, так?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000750000019D.english: "I don't think I introduced myself properly -- I'm Billie. Would you like something to drink?" She looks around the kitchen. "Tea, lemonade? We're out of coffee..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000750000019D.polish: „Chyba się nie przedstawiłam – jestem Billie. Podać coś do picia?” – pyta, rozglądając się po kuchni. „Herbata? Lemoniada? Skończyła nam się kawa...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000750000019D.belarusian: "Здаецца, я так толкам і не назвалася — я Білі. Жадаеце чаго-небудзь выпіць? - яна азіраецца па кухні. - Гарбаты, ліманаду? Кава ў нас скончылася..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000001AC.english: "It's you. From the bookstand." For a moment she seems paralysed, just looking at you. Then she forces herself out of it.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000001AC.polish: „To pan. Ze stoiska z książkami” – przez chwilę sprawia wrażenie sparaliżowanej – wpatruje się w ciebie bez ruchu – po czym z wysiłkiem otrząsa się i dochodzi do siebie.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000001AC.belarusian: "Гэта вы. Ад кніжнага стэнда, - на імгненне яна нібы паралізаваная, проста глядзіць на цябе. Потым яна змушае сябе апамятацца."

Alternate1/0x01000075000001AC.polish: „To pan. Ze stoiska z książkami” – przez chwilę sprawia wrażenie sparaliżowanej – wpatruje się w ciebie i porucznika bez ruchu – po czym dochodzi do siebie.
Alternate1/0x01000075000001AC.belarusian: "Гэта вы. Ад кніжнага стэнда, - на імгненне яна нібы паралізаваная, проста глядзіць на цябе і лейтэнанта. Потым яна апамятваецца."

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000001B9.english: She must know you're here because of her husband.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000001B9.polish: Musi wiedzieć, że jesteś tu ze względu na jej męża.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000001B9.belarusian: Яна, напэўна, ведае, што ты тут з-за яе мужа.

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000001C7.english: "It's you from the bookstand..." She just looks at you for a moment without knowing what to do.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000001C7.polish: „Pamiętam pana ze stoiska z książkami...” – przez chwilę po prostu wpatruje się w ciebie, nie wiedząc, co robić.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000001C7.belarusian: "Гэта вы ад кніжнага стэнда... - яна проста глядзіць на цябе хвіліну, не ведаючы, што рабіць."

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000001CD.english: "It's you from the bookstand... Did you come to bring my cockatoo back?" She smiles nervously, before the smile vanishes from her face.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000001CD.polish: „Pamiętam pana ze stoiska z książkami... Przyprowadził pan moją kakadu?” – uśmiecha się nerwowo, ale uśmiech szybko znika z jej twarzy.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000001CD.belarusian: "Гэта вы ад кніжнага стэнда... Вы прыйшлі вярнуць майго какаду? - яна нервова ўсміхаецца, але ўсмешка адразу знікае з яе твару."

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014A9.english: Keep it together. You don't want your body language to tell her the news.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014A9.polish: Weź się w garść. Nie chcesz, żeby twój język ciała zdradził jej złe wieści.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014A9.belarusian: Трымай сябе ў руках. Не трэба, каб мова твайго цела паведаміла ёй навіну.

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014B7.english: "Sorry, I'm rambling..." She shakes her head and tries to laugh it off. "It's just that Victor often gets into all kinds of trouble. So, how can I help you?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014B7.polish: „Przepraszam, plotę głupoty...” – kręci głową i próbuje zbyć to śmiechem. „Po prostu Victor często wpada w różne kłopoty. W czym mogę panu pomóc?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014B7.belarusian: "Прабачце, я вярзу абы-што... - яна хітае галавой і спрабуе звесці гэта ў жарт. - Проста Віктар часта трапляе ва ўсялякія непрыемнасці. Дык чым я магу вам дапамагчы?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014DE.english: "Hold on... *You're* Billie? I thought Billie was a man..."
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014DE.polish: „Zaraz... To *pani* jest Billie? Myślałem, że Billie to mężczyzna”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014DE.belarusian: "Пачакайце... *Вы* Білі? Я думаў, Білі — гэта мужчына..."

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014E4.english: "No, I'm Billie." She narrows her eyes. "Is this about my husband, Victor? I can come pick him up in the station if that's what..." She stops, her eyes trying to read answers from your face.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014E4.polish: „Nie, to ja jestem Billie” – stwierdza ze zmrużonymi oczami. „Chodzi o mojego męża Victora? Mogę odebrać go z komisariatu, jeśli to o to...” – milknie, a jej oczy próbują wyczytać odpowiedzi z twojej twarzy.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014E4.belarusian: "Не, я Білі, - яна прыжмурваецца. - Гэта наконт майго мужа, Віктара? Я магу забраць яго з пастарунка, калі гэта... - яна спыняецца, яе вочы спрабуюць прачытаць адказы на тваім твары."

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014EB.english: Keep it together. Your body language shouldn't give it away.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014EB.polish: Weź się w garść. Twój język ciała nie powinien nic zdradzać.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000014EB.belarusian: Трымай сябе ў руках. Мова твайго цела не павінна нічога выдаць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001510.english: "It's me, Victor, and the kids here," she nods. "We have two daughters, Jennie and Jolie."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001510.polish: „Mieszkamy tu ja, Victor i dzieci” – odpowiada, kiwając głową. „Mamy dwie córki: Jennie i Jolie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001510.belarusian: "Тут я, Віктар і дзеці, - ківае яна. - У нас дзве дачкі, Джэні і Жалі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001682.english: (Look around.) "And where is everybody? I don't see anyone home."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001682.polish: (Rozejrzyj się). „Gdzie są wszyscy? Nie widzę nikogo w domu”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001682.belarusian: (Азірнуцца.) "А дзе ўсе? Я нікога не бачу дома".

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016AE.english: "The girls are staying at their friend's place tonight, and Victor is... out."
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016AE.polish: „Dziewczynki zostały na noc u swojej przyjaciółki, a Victor... wyszedł”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016AE.belarusian: "Дзяўчаткі сёння начуюць у сяброўкі, а Віктар... выйшаў".

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016C9.polish: „Dlaczego pan pyta? Ma pan jakieś wieści?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016C9.belarusian: "А што, у вас ёсць нейкія навіны?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016D1.english: "As I already told you, he has a problem with drinking. And so he... disappears every now and then."
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016D1.polish: „Jak już mówiłam, on ma problem z alkoholem. I dlatego... od czasu do czasu znika”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016D1.belarusian: "Як я ўжо казала, у яго праблемы з выпіўкай. І таму ён... час ад часу знікае".

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016DE.english: "He... has a problem with drinking. And so he... disappears every now and then."
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016DE.polish: „On... ma problem z alkoholem. I dlatego... od czasu do czasu znika”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016DE.belarusian: "У яго... праблемы з выпіўкай. І таму ён... час ад часу знікае".

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016E6.english: "He's probably in the Pox, drinking with his friends. I sent him to the library a few days ago, but I guess something came up..." She smiles sourly.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016E6.polish: „Jest pewnie w Ospie i pije z kolegami. Kilka dni temu wysłałam go do biblioteki, ale po drodze pewnie coś mu wyskoczyło...” – uśmiecha się kwaśno.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016E6.belarusian: "Ён, напэўна, у Воспе, п'е з сябрамі. Я паслала яго ў бібліятэку некалькі дзён таму, але, мяркую, нешта перашкодзіла... - яна горка ўсміхаецца."

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016F4.english: "Do you remember what he was wearing when you last saw him?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016F4.polish: „Pamięta pani, co miał na sobie, kiedy go pani ostatni raz widziała?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016F4.belarusian: "Памятаеце, у што ён быў апрануты, калі вы бачылі яго апошні раз?"

Alternate1/0x01000075000016F4.polish: „Proszę mi przypomnieć. Co miał na sobie, kiedy go pani ostatni raz widziała?”
Alternate1/0x01000075000016F4.belarusian: "Нагадайце яшчэ раз, у што ён быў апрануты, калі вы бачылі яго апошні раз?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016FA.english: "To your knowledge, did he make it to the library?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000016FA.belarusian: "Наколькі вы ведаеце, ён дабраўся да бібліятэкі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001700.english: "There's something else I have to tell you..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001700.polish: „Jest jeszcze coś, co muszę pani powiedzieć...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001700.belarusian: "Ёсць яшчэ штосьці, што я мушу вам сказаць..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000750000170A.english: "No. I guess I'll find out when he decides to come back home." She looks at the front door.
Dialogue Text/0x010000750000170A.polish: „Nie. Pewnie dowiem się, jak już postanowi wrócić do domu” – stwierdza, spoglądając na drzwi wejściowe.
Dialogue Text/0x010000750000170A.belarusian: "Не. Мяркую, я даведаюся, калі ён вырашыць вярнуцца дадому, - яна глядзіць на ўваходныя дзверы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001716.english: "It shouldn't be long from now. He's never gone for more than a few days."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001716.polish: „Niedługo powinien się pojawić. Nigdy jeszcze nie znikał na dłużej niż kilka dni”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001716.belarusian: "Гэта не павінна зацягнуцца. Ён ніколі не знікае больш чым на некалькі дзён".

Dialogue Text/0x010000750000173F.english: She folds her hands across her chest.

Dialogue Text/0x010000750000180C.english: Tell her about the dead body.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001CD7.english: (Turn to Kim.) "I don't want to do this."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001CD7.polish: (Odwróć się do Kima). „Nie chcę tego robić”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001CD7.belarusian: (Павярнуцца да Кіма.) "Я не хачу гэтага рабіць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002D3F.english: "What was the name of the library?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002D46.english: "Oh, it's in Jamrock. The one at Meroe street. I don't know the official name."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002D46.polish: „Och, to biblioteka w Jamrock. Ta na ulicy Meroe. Nie znam oficjalnej nazwy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002D46.belarusian: "О, яна ў Джэмроку. Тая, што на вуліцы Мероэ. Афіцыйнай назвы я не ведаю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002D7B.english: I don't want to do this.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002D91.english: (Turn to Kim.) "It seems like there's a part of me that refuses to do this."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002D91.polish: (Odwróć się do Kima). „Jakaś część mnie nie pozwala mi tego zrobić”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002D91.belarusian: (Павярнуцца да Кіма.) "Здаецца, нейкая частка мяне адмаўляецца гэта рабіць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002D98.english: (Slap your cheek.) "Stupid... stupid... just say it..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002D98.polish: (Uderz się w policzek). „Głupi, głupi... Powiedzże to już...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002D98.belarusian: (Ударыць сябе па шчацэ.) "Дурны... дурны... проста скажы гэта..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DA5.english: (Slap your cheek.) "Stupid... stupid... just say it..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DA5.polish: (Uderz się w policzek). „Głupi, głupi... Powiedzże to już...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DA5.belarusian: (Ударыць сябе па шчацэ.) "Дурны... дурны... проста скажы гэта..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DAB.english: (Turn to Billie.) "It seems like there's a part of me that refuses to do this."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DAB.polish: (Odwróć się do Billie). „Wygląda na to, że jakaś część mnie nie pozwala mi tego zrobić”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DAB.belarusian: (Павярнуцца да Білі.) "Здаецца, нейкая частка мяне адмаўляецца гэта рабіць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DB1.english: (Turn to Billie.) "I don't want to do this."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DB1.polish: (Odwróć się do Billie). „Nie chcę tego robić”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DB1.belarusian: (Павярнуцца да Білі.) "Я не хачу гэтага рабіць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DBA.polish: „Co pan chce powiedzieć?” – wygląda na przestraszoną.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DC7.english: Too late, you ruined it, just say it now.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DC7.polish: Za późno, wszystko już zepsułeś. Powiedz to i już.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DC7.belarusian: Занадта позна, ты ўсё сапсаваў, проста скажы цяпер.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DF9.english: Too late, you ruined it, just say it now.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DF9.polish: Za późno, wszystko już zepsułeś. Powiedz to i już.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002DF9.belarusian: Занадта позна, ты ўсё сапсаваў, проста скажы цяпер.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E01.polish: „Co pan chce powiedzieć?” – wygląda na przestraszoną.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E1D.english: "We're very sorry to inform you, but your husband, Victor Méjean, was found dead this morning on the Martinaise boardwalk."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E1D.polish: „Z wielką przykrością informujemy, że pani mąż, Victor Méjean, został znaleziony martwy dziś rano na promenadzie Martinaise”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E1D.belarusian: "Нам вельмі шкада паведамляць вам, але вашага мужа, Віктара Межана, сёння раніцай знайшлі мёртвым на праменадзе Марцінэза".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E36.english: You sense that the lieutenant is ready to say something -- don't let him. Fix this yourself, you did this.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E36.polish: Czujesz, że porucznik jest gotów coś powiedzieć. Nie pozwól mu. Ty to zrobiłeś, więc sam to napraw.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E36.belarusian: Ты адчуваеш, што лейтэнант гатовы штосьці сказаць — не дазваляй яму. Выпраў гэта сам, гэта ты нарабіў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E3C.english: (Raise your palm.) "Kim, I can handle this. Let me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E3C.belarusian: (Падняць далонь.) "Кім, я сам спраўлюся. Дазволь мне".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E57.english: The lieutenant closes his mouth, but he doesn't look pleased.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E57.polish: Porucznik zamyka usta, ale nie wygląda na zadowolonego.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E57.belarusian: Лейтэнант закрывае рот, але не выглядае задаволеным.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E64.english: "Expired?" She narrows her eyes. "Like a *milk carton*?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E8C.english: "Just tell me, what happened to Victor?" She looks first at the lieutenant, then back at you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E8C.polish: „Proszę mi po prostu powiedzieć, co się stało Victorowi” – spogląda na porucznika, a później z powrotem na ciebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E8C.belarusian: "Проста скажыце мне, што здарылася з Віктарам? - яна глядзіць спачатку на лейтэнанта, потым зноў на цябе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E94.english: "Yes, I..." She chokes on something, clutching on to her neck.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E94.polish: „Tak, ja...” – krztusi się czymś i łapie rękami za szyję.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E94.belarusian: "Так, я... - яна чымсьці давіцца, схапіўшыся за шыю."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E9B.english: "I'm sorry, I just need a... I don't know what to say." She rests her hand on her forehead, eyes pale like pearls in seawater.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E9B.polish: „Przepraszam, potrzebuję tylko... Nie wiem, co powiedzieć” – kładzie dłoń na swoim czole, jej oczy są szare jak perły w morskiej wodzie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002E9B.belarusian: "Прабачце, мне проста трэба... Я не ведаю, што сказаць, - яна кладзе руку на лоб, вочы бляклыя, як жэмчуг у марской вадзе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EA2.english: "Oh." She touches her neck, eyes pale like pearls in seawater.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EA2.polish: „Och...” – dotyka dłonią swojej szyi. Jej oczy są szare jak perły w morskiej wodzie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EA2.belarusian: "О, - яна кранае сваю шыю, вочы бляклыя, як жэмчуг у марской вадзе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EA9.english: "Oh," she says again, "But he was just..." She looks at the kitchen table, where two cigarette butts are still in the tray.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EA9.polish: „Och...” – powtarza. „Ale on przecież właśnie...” – spogląda na kuchenny stół. Stoi na nim popielniczka, w której wciąż leżą dwa niedopałki papierosów.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EA9.belarusian: "О, - паўтарае яна. - Але ж ён толькі што... - яна глядзіць на кухонны стол, дзе ў попельніцы ўсё яшчэ ляжаць два недакуркі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EB6.english: "I understand that this comes as a huge shock. I want you to know that me and my partner," he points at you, "are here for you if you have any questions. We're very sorry for your loss, ma'am."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EB6.polish: „Rozumiem, że to dla pani ogromny szok. Zapewniam panią, że ja i mój partner” – wskazuje cię – „jesteśmy tu, aby odpowiedzieć na wszystkie pani pytania. Jest nam bardzo przykro z powodu pani straty”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EB6.belarusian: "Я разумею, што гэта велізарны шок. Я хачу, каб вы ведалі: я і мой напарнік, - ён паказвае на цябе, - тут, калі ў вас узнікнуць якія-небудзь пытанні. Нам вельмі шкада вашай страты, спадарыня".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EBD.english: "What happened to him? Tell me." Her neck and cheeks are covered with red blotches, her double chin is shaking.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EBD.polish: „Co mu się stało? Proszę mi powiedzieć” – na jej szyi i policzkach pojawiły się czerwone plamy, a jej podwójny podbródek drży.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EBD.belarusian: "Што з ім здарылася? Скажыце мне, - яе шыя і шчокі ўкрыліся чырвонымі плямамі, падвойны падбародак дрыжыць."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002ED0.english: "He fell and smashed his head against the bench."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002ED0.polish: „Upadł i rozbił sobie głowę o ławkę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002ED0.belarusian: "Ён упаў і разбіў галаву аб лаўку".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002ED6.english: "Trust me, ma'am, you *don't* want to know."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002ED6.polish: „Proszę mi wierzyć, *nie chce* pani tego wiedzieć”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002ED6.belarusian: "Паверце мне, спадарыня, вы *не* хочаце гэтага ведаць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EE6.english: "And you just... found him there? Lying in the cold?" She shakes her head.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EE6.polish: „I pan go po prostu... znalazł? Leżącego na zimnie?” – kręci głową.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002EE6.belarusian: "І вы проста... знайшлі яго там? Калі ён ляжаў на холадзе? - хітае яна галавой."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F0E.english: She doesn't reply. Her eyes well up with tears, as she struggles to keep it together.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F0E.polish: Nie odpowiada. Jej oczy zachodzą łzami, gdy ona z trudem walczy z rozpaczą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F0E.belarusian: Яна не адказвае. Яе вочы напаўняюцца слязьмі, яна з усіх сіл спрабуе трымаць сябе ў руках.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F1C.english: "Is there anyone we could call for you? A friend, a family member, someone who could be here for you?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F1C.polish: „Czy możemy kogoś dla pani wezwać? Przyjaciółkę, członka rodziny – kogoś, kto mógłby panią teraz tu wesprzeć?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F1C.belarusian: "Ці ёсць хто-небудзь, каму мы маглі б патэлефанаваць для вас? Сябар, сваяк, нехта, хто мог бы быць побач з вамі?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F3E.english: "Just tell me, what do I need to do next? Where is he? Can I see him?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F3E.polish: „Niech mi pan tylko powie, co muszę teraz zrobić? Gdzie on jest? Czy mogę go zobaczyć?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F3E.belarusian: "Проста скажыце мне, што мне рабіць далей? Дзе ён? Ці магу я яго пабачыць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F4B.english: "He was taken to the city morgue. The local coroner will be contacting you shortly to arrange the funeral. Here's his number in case you want to contact him earlier." He hands her a leaflet with the morgue's contact information.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F4B.polish: „Został przeniesiony do miejskiej kostnicy. Miejscowy koroner wkrótce się z panią skontaktuje, aby uzgodnić szczegóły związane z pogrzebem. Proszę, tu jest jego numer na wypadek, gdyby chciała pani skontaktować się z nim wcześniej” – wyjaśnia, wręczając kobiecie broszurę z danymi kontaktowymi kostnicy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F4B.belarusian: "Яго адвезлі ў гарадскі морг. Мясцовы патолагаанатам неўзабаве звяжацца з вамі, каб арганізаваць пахаванне. Вось яго нумар на выпадак, калі захочаце звязацца з ім раней, - ён перадае ёй улётку з кантактнай інфармацыяй морга."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F5A.english: "Is there anything else that the RCM could do for you?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F5A.polish: „Czy MOR może pani jeszcze jakoś pomóc?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F5A.belarusian: "Ці ёсць яшчэ што-небудзь, што РГМ можа зрабіць для вас?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F69.english: "No. I'll call you if something comes up, I'm still a bit..." She rubs her face, blotchy and numb.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F69.polish: „Nie. Zadzwonię, jeśli będę czegoś potrzebowała. Wciąż jestem trochę...” – pociera swoją twarz, zaczerwienioną i odrętwiałą.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F69.belarusian: "Не. Я патэлефаную вам, калі нешта спатрэбіцца, я ўсё яшчэ крыху... - яна трэ свой твар, пакрыты плямамі і анямелы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F7D.english: "What?" She stares at you with hazy eyes.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F7D.polish: „Słucham?” – pyta, wpatrując się w ciebie zamglonymi oczami.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F7D.belarusian: "Што? - глядзіць яна на цябе затуманенымі вачыма."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F85.english: "I guess what I want to know is... how did he die?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002F85.belarusian: "Мяркую, я хачу ведаць... як ён памёр?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FA4.english: "Alright, I'll call them..." She breathes in again, trying to steady herself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FA4.polish: „W porządku, zadzwonię do nich...” – znowu bierze głęboki wdech i stara się uspokoić.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FA4.belarusian: "Добра, я патэлефаную ім... - яна зноў удыхае, спрабуючы супакоіцца."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FC1.english: "You haven't even taken him away?!" There's alarm in her voice.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FC1.polish: „Nie zabraliście go stamtąd jeszcze?!” – w jej głosie słychać trwogę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FC1.belarusian: "Вы нават не забралі яго?! - у яе голасе гучыць трывога."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FCF.english: RCM? I wish Kim was here...
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FCF.polish: Z MOR-em? Szkoda, że nie ma tu Kima...
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FCF.belarusian: З РГМ? Вось бы тут быў Кім...

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FE4.english: "Alright, I'll call the RCM then," she nods to herself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FE4.polish: „W porządku, w takim razie zadzwonię do MOR-u” – kiwa głową.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FE4.belarusian: "Добра, тады я патэлефаную ў РГМ, - ківае яна сама сабе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FED.english: "No, but we will. We will take him to the city morgue."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FED.polish: „Nie, ale to zrobimy. Zabierzemy go do miejskiej kostnicy”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FED.belarusian: "Не, але мы гэта зробім. Мы завязём яго ў гарадскі морг".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FFC.english: "Sorry I couldn't do this, I have a brain condition..." (Tap on your head.)
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FFC.polish: „Przepraszam, nie mogłem tego zrobić, mam problem z mózgiem...” (Postukaj się w głowę).
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200002FFC.belarusian: "Прабачце, што я не змог гэта зрабіць, у мяне праблемы з мазгамі..." (Пастукаць па галаве.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003020.english: "I drank too much and now I can't do anything right anymore."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003020.polish: „Za dużo wypiłem i od tego czasu nie umiem nic porządnie zrobić”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003020.belarusian: "Я занадта шмат піў, і цяпер больш нічога не магу рабіць як след".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003026.english: "You know what, it doesn't matter. I'll just... leave."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003026.polish: „Wie pani co, to bez znaczenia. Po prostu... pójdę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003026.belarusian: "Ведаеце што, гэта не мае значэння. Я проста... пайду".

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000302F.english: "Yes," she says sharply, "that's what happened to Victor too."
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000302F.polish: „Tak” – stwierdza ostro. „To samo przydarzyło się Victorowi”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000302F.belarusian: "Так, - рэзка кажа яна, - з Віктарам здарылася тое самае".

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000303E.english: "It looks like he slipped on the boardwalk -- fatally, I'm afraid. It was just a very unfortunate accident, although alcohol may have played a role."
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000303E.polish: „Wygląda na to, że poślizgnął się na promenadzie – ze skutkiem śmiertelnym, niestety. To był po prostu bardzo niefortunny wypadek, chociaż mógł w nim odegrać pewną rolę alkohol”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000303E.belarusian: "Выглядае так, што ён паслізнуўся на праменадзе — на жаль, насмерць. Гэта быў проста вельмі няшчасны выпадак, хоць алкаголь мог адыграць сваю ролю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003053.english: "I can't..." She covers her mouth. "I can't believe he's still *there*, this is *madness*."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003053.polish: „Nie mogę...” – zakrywa usta dłonią. „Nie mogę uwierzyć, że wciąż *tam* jest. To jakieś *szaleństwo*”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003053.belarusian: "Я не магу... - яна закрывае рот рукой. - Я не магу паверыць, што ён усё яшчэ *там*, гэта *вар'яцтва*".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003066.polish: „Nie, miałam na myśli... Gdzie jest *jego ciało*?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003066.belarusian: "Не, я мела на ўвазе — дзе *яго цела*?!"

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003071.english: "I'll take it from here. Thank you." She points at the front door, breathing fast now. Holding herself back.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003071.polish: „Zajmę się teraz wszystkim sama. Dziękuję” – odpowiada i wskazuje drzwi wyjściowe. Jej oddech jest przyśpieszony. Powstrzymuje się.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003071.belarusian: "Далей я сама. Дзякуй, - яна паказвае на ўваходныя дзверы, цяпер часта дыхаючы. Стрымліваючы сябе."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003084.english: "Apologies, my partner," the lieutenant steps in, giving you a sideways glance, "did *not* mean to make light of the situation."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003084.polish: „Proszę wybaczyć. Mój partner” – wtrąca się porucznik, rzucając ci surowe spojrzenie – „*nie* chciał trywializować tej sytuacji”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003084.belarusian: "Прабачце, мой напарнік, - уступае лейтэнант, коса зірнуўшы на цябе, - *не* хацеў паставіцца да сітуацыі легкадумна".

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000308D.english: "Again, if there's anything we could do for you, then don't hesitate to call the RCM, ma'am."
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000308D.polish: „Raz jeszcze przypominam, że jeśli będziemy mogli coś dla pani zrobić, to proszę bez wahania dzwonić do MOR-u”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000308D.belarusian: "Яшчэ раз: калі мы можам чымсьці дапамагчы, без ваганняў тэлефануйце ў РГМ, спадарыня".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003099.english: You hear the clock ticking in the children's room.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003099.polish: Słyszysz tykający w pokoju dziecięcym zegar.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003099.belarusian: Ты чуеш, як у дзіцячым пакоі цікае гадзіннік.

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000309F.english: She just nods, distant and inconsolable. The bed springs rattle beneath her as she begins to shake.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000309F.polish: Tylko kiwa głową, zamyślona i niepocieszona. Sprężyny łóżka zaczynają pod nią trzeszczeć, gdy jej ciałem wstrząsają dreszcze.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000309F.belarusian: Яна проста ківае, адчужаная і несуцешная. Спружыны ложка парыпваюць пад ёй, калі яе пачынае трэсці.

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030BC.english: You've done this before. Just keep your focus.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030BC.polish: Robiłeś to już wcześniej. Skup się porządnie.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030BC.belarusian: Ты ўжо рабіў гэта раней. Проста захоўвай канцэнтрацыю.

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030C3.english: "Ma'am, I'm very sorry to say, but your husband, Victor Méjean, was found dead on the Martinaise boardwalk."
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030C3.polish: „Proszę pani, z przykrością muszę powiedzieć, że pani mąż, Victor Méjean, został znaleziony martwy na promenadzie Martinaise”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030C3.belarusian: "Спадарыня, мне вельмі шкада гэта казаць, але вашага мужа, Віктара Межана, знайшлі мёртвым на праменадзе Марцінэза".

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030D0.english: "Oh." She touches her neck, eyes pale like pearls in seawater.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030D0.polish: „Och...” – dotyka dłonią swojej szyi. Jej oczy są szare jak perły w morskiej wodzie.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030D0.belarusian: "О, - яна кранае сваю шыю, вочы бляклыя, як жэмчуг у марской вадзе."

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030D6.english: "Oh," she says again, "But he was just..." She looks at the kitchen table, where two cigarette butts are still in the tray.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030D6.polish: „Och...” – powtarza. „Ale on przecież właśnie...” – spogląda na kuchenny stół. Stoi na nim popielniczka, w której wciąż leżą dwa niedopałki papierosów.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030D6.belarusian: "О, - паўтарае яна. - Але ж ён толькі што... - яна глядзіць на кухонны стол, дзе ў попельніцы ўсё яшчэ ляжаць два недакуркі."

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030DC.english: "We understand this comes as a huge shock. I want you to know that me and my partner," he points at you, "are here for you if you have any questions. Take your time, ma'am."
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030DC.polish: „Rozumiemy, że to dla pani ogromny szok. Zapewniam panią, że ja i mój partner” – wskazuje cię – „jesteśmy tu, aby odpowiedzieć na wszystkie pani pytania. Proszę się nie śpieszyć”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030DC.belarusian: "Мы разумеем, што гэта велізарны шок. Я хачу, каб вы ведалі: я і мой напарнік, - ён паказвае на цябе, - тут, калі ў вас узнікнуць якія-небудзь пытанні. Не спяшайцеся, спадарыня".

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030E7.english: "What happened to him?" She turns to you. Her neck and cheeks are covered with red blotches, her double chin is shaking.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030E7.polish: „Co mu się stało?” – pyta, odwracając się do ciebie. Na jej szyi i policzkach pojawiły się czerwone plamy, a jej podwójny podbródek drży.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030E7.belarusian: "Што з ім здарылася? - яна паварочваецца да цябе. Яе шыя і шчокі ўкрыліся чырвонымі плямамі, падвойны падбародак дрыжыць."

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030FE.english: "Your husband, Victor Méjean, is dead. I'm very sorry for your loss, ma'am."
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030FE.polish: „Pani mąż, Victor Méjean, nie żyje. Moje najszczersze kondolencje, proszę pani”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000030FE.belarusian: "Ваш муж, Віктар Межан, мёртвы. Прыміце мае шчырыя спачуванні, спадарыня".

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000310E.english: "I understand that this may come as a huge shock. I want you to know that I'm here for you if you have any questions. Take your time, ma'am, I'm not going anywhere."
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000310E.polish: „Rozumiem, że to może być dla pani ogromny szok. Zapewniam panią, że jestem tu, aby odpowiedzieć na wszystkie pani pytania. Proszę się nie śpieszyć, nigdzie nie pójdę”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000310E.belarusian: "Я разумею, што гэта можа быць вялізным шокам. Я хачу, каб вы ведалі, што я тут для вас, калі ўзнікнуць якія-небудзь пытанні. Не спяшайцеся, спадарыня, я нікуды не сыходжу".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003122.english: "It's still early to say, but at first glance it seems like he slipped and hit his head."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003122.polish: „Wciąż dokładnie nie wiadomo, wygląda jednak na to, że pośliznął się i rozbił sobie głowę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003122.belarusian: "Пакуль рана казаць, але на першы погляд выглядае, што ён паслізнуўся і ўдарыўся галавой".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003128.english: "It was an accident -- he fell through a hole in the boardwalk and hit his head."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003128.polish: „Doszło do wypadku. Pośliznął się, wpadł w dziurę w promenadzie i uderzył się w głowę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003128.belarusian: "Гэта быў няшчасны выпадак — ён зваліўся ў дзірку на праменадзе і ўдарыўся галавой".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003144.english: "Alcohol may have played a role, yes."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003144.polish: „Tak, alkohol mógł odegrać w tym zdarzeniu pewną rolę”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000314D.english: "We don't know yet, but we will let you know when the results arrive."
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000314D.polish: „Jeszcze nie wiemy, poinformujemy jednak panią, kiedy otrzymamy wyniki sekcji”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000314D.belarusian: "Мы пакуль не ведаем, але паведамім вам, калі прыйдуць вынікі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003154.english: "I see..." She withdraws, trying to picture the scene. "And you just... found him there? Lying in the cold?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003154.polish: „Rozumiem...” – pogrąża się w myślach, próbując to sobie wyobrazić. „I pan go po prostu... znalazł? Leżącego na zimnie?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003154.belarusian: "Разумею... - яна адыходзіць у сябе, спрабуючы ўявіць сцэну. - І вы проста... знайшлі яго там? Калі ён ляжаў на холадзе?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000316C.english: "It's hard to say at this point."

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000317A.english: She blinks, eyes welling up with tears, as her hands start searching for something from the pockets of her dress.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000317A.polish: Mruga, a jej oczy zachodzą łzami. Jednocześnie zaczyna szukać czegoś w kieszeniach swojej sukienki.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000317A.belarusian: Яна лыпае вачыма, яе вочы напаўняюцца слязьмі, а рукі пачынаюць шукаць штосьці ў кішэнях сукенкі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000318F.english: "Here." The lieutenant takes out his handkerchief and offers it to the woman. She nods and slowly wipes away her tears.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000318F.polish: „Proszę” – porucznik wyjmuje swoją chusteczkę i podaje ją kobiecie, która kiwa głową i powoli ociera swoje łzy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000318F.belarusian: "Вось, - лейтэнант дастае сваю насоўку і працягвае жанчыне. Яна ківае і паволі выцірае слёзы."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003195.english: A small, terrified smile quivers on her face as she takes the handkerchief and wipes away the tears. She looks disoriented.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003195.polish: Na jej ustach pojawia się niewyraźny uśmiech mimo przerażenia, gdy przyjmuje chusteczkę i ociera łzy. Wygląda na zdezorientowaną.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003195.belarusian: Маленькая, напалоханая ўсмешка дрыжыць на яе твары, калі яна бярэ насоўку і выцірае слёзы. Яна выглядае дэзарыентаванай.

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000319B.english: "Here, take this." (Give her the lieutenant's handkerchief.)

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031A6.english: (No words. Just give her the lieutenant's handkerchief.)
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031A6.polish: (Nic nie mów. Daj jej po prostu chusteczkę porucznika).
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031A6.belarusian: (Без слоў. Проста даць ёй насовачку лейтэнанта.)

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031AC.english: "Yes, thank you." She smiles a small, terrified smile, then wipes away her tears. She looks disoriented.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031AC.polish: „Dziękuję” – uśmiecha się niewyraźnie mimo przerażenia, po czym ociera łzy. Wygląda na zdezorientowaną.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031AC.belarusian: "Так, дзякуй, - яна слаба, напалохана ўсміхаецца, а потым выцірае слёзы. Яна выглядае дэзарыентаванай."

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031B8.english: "Is there anyone we could call for you? A friend, a family member, someone who could be here for you?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031B8.polish: „Czy możemy kogoś dla pani wezwać? Przyjaciółkę, członka rodziny – kogoś, kto mógłby panią teraz tu wesprzeć?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031B8.belarusian: "Ці ёсць хто-небудзь, каму мы маглі б патэлефанаваць для вас? Сябар, сваяк, нехта, хто мог бы быць побач з вамі?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031BE.english: "No, no..." She breathes in. "I just need to tell my girls..." The air gets sucked out of her lungs suddenly.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031BE.polish: „Nie, nie...” – robi głęboki wdech. „Muszę tylko powiedzieć moim córkom...” – nagle uchodzi z niej całe powietrze.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031BE.belarusian: "Не, не... - удыхае яна. - Мне проста трэба сказаць маім дзяўчаткам... - Паветра раптам нібы высмактала з яе лёгкіх."

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031C5.english: "Yes, they should know. Do you want us to call them and ask them here?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031C5.polish: „Tak, powinny wiedzieć. Życzy sobie pani, żebyśmy zadzwonili i je tu ściągnęli?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031C5.belarusian: "Так, яны павінны ведаць. Хочаце, мы патэлефануем ім і папросім прыйсці сюды?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031CB.english: "No, take a day to recover. You'll be better prepared when they come home tomorrow."
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031CB.polish: „Nie, proszę wykorzystać ten dzień, żeby ochłonąć. Będzie pani lepiej przygotowana, kiedy jutro wrócą do domu”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031CB.belarusian: "Не, вазьміце дзень, каб адысці. Вы будзеце лепш падрыхтаваныя, калі яны заўтра вернуцца дадому".

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031D1.english: "No, I'll do it myself, I just..." She breathes again, holding on to her left side like she's in pain.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031D1.polish: „Nie, sama to zrobię, tylko...” – znowu robi wdech, trzymając się za lewą pierś, jakby odczuwała ból.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031D1.belarusian: "Не, я сама, я проста... - яна зноў удыхае, трымаючыся за левы бок, нібы ад болю."

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031D7.english: "Good, that's probably the right thing, thank you..." She nods, but with a wretched expression.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031D7.polish: „Dobrze, tak będzie chyba najlepiej. Dziękuję...” – kiwa głową z nieszczęśliwym wyrazem twarzy.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031D7.belarusian: "Добра, напэўна, так будзе правільна, дзякуй... - яна ківае, але з пакутным выразам твару."

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031ED.english: "Is there anyone we could call for you? A friend, a family member, someone who could be here for you?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031ED.polish: „Czy możemy kogoś dla pani wezwać? Przyjaciółkę, członka rodziny – kogoś, kto mógłby panią teraz wesprzeć?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031ED.belarusian: "Ці ёсць хто-небудзь, каму мы маглі б патэлефанаваць для вас? Сябар, сваяк, нехта, хто мог бы быць побач з вамі?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031FB.english: "My handkerchief..." She tries to smile through the tears, as she rubs her face with hands like a child.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031FB.polish: „Moja chusteczka...” – próbuje uśmiechnąć się mimo łez, pocierając twarz rękami jak dziecko.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000031FB.belarusian: "Мая насоўка... - яна спрабуе ўсміхнуцца скрозь слёзы, выціраючы твар рукамі, як дзіця."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003207.english: "Just tell me, what do I need to do next? Where is he? Can I see him?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003207.polish: „Niech mi pan tylko powie, co muszę teraz zrobić? Gdzie on jest? Czy mogę go zobaczyć?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003207.belarusian: "Проста скажыце мне, што мне рабіць далей? Дзе ён? Ці магу я яго пабачыць?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003214.english: "No, I'll call you if something comes up, I'm still..." She rubs her face, runs her fingers over cheeks that have become numb.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003214.polish: „Nie. Zadzwonię, jeśli będę czegoś potrzebowała. Wciąż jestem...” – pociera twarz i przesuwa palcami po odrętwiałych policzkach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003214.belarusian: "Не, я патэлефаную вам, калі нешта спатрэбіцца, я ўсё яшчэ... - яна трэ твар, праводзіць пальцамі па анямелых шчоках."

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000321A.english: "We've taken him to the city morgue. The local coroner will be contacting you shortly to arrange the funeral. Here's his number in case you want to contact him earlier." He hands her a leaflet with the morgue's contact information.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000321A.polish: „Przenieśliśmy go do miejskiej kostnicy. Miejscowy koroner wkrótce się z panią skontaktuje, aby uzgodnić szczegóły związane z pogrzebem. Proszę, tu jest jego numer na wypadek, gdyby chciała pani skontaktować się z nim wcześniej” – wyjaśnia, wręczając kobiecie broszurę z danymi kontaktowymi kostnicy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000321A.belarusian: "Мы адвезлі яго ў гарадскі морг. Мясцовы патолагаанатам неўзабаве звяжацца з вамі, каб арганізаваць пахаванне. Вось яго нумар на выпадак, калі захочаце звязацца з ім раней, - ён перадае ёй улётку з кантактнай інфармацыяй морга."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003220.english: "Is there anything else that the RCM could do for you?
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003220.polish: „Czy MOR może pani jeszcze jakoś pomóc?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003220.belarusian: "Ці ёсць яшчэ што-небудзь, што РГМ можа зрабіць для вас?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003229.english: "Thank you." She looks down. "Thank you for telling me. I'll call, if..." She runs out of breath.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003229.polish: „Dziękuję” – spogląda w dół. „Dziękuję za informację. Zadzwonię, jeśli...” – milknie, bo brakuje jej tchu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003229.belarusian: "Дзякуй, - яна глядзіць долу. - Дзякуй, што сказалі. Я патэлефаную, калі... - ёй перахоплівае дыханне."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003230.english: "Again, I'm very sorry, ma'am." [Set the library card by her. Leave the room.]
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003230.polish: „Jak mówiłem, bardzo mi przykro, proszę pani”. [Zostaw koło niej kartę biblioteczną. Opuść pokój].
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003230.belarusian: "Яшчэ раз, мне вельмі шкада, спадарыня". [Пакласці квіток чытача побач з ёй. Выйсці з пакоя.]

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003236.english: "We've taken him to the city morgue. The local coroner will be contacting you shortly to arrange the funeral. In the meantime, you can always call the RCM if you have any questions."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003236.polish: „Zabraliśmy go do miejskiej kostnicy. Miejscowy koroner wkrótce się z panią skontaktuje, aby uzgodnić szczegóły związane z pogrzebem. Jeśli będzie miała pani w międzyczasie jakieś pytania, może pani w każdej chwili skontaktować się z MOR-em”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003236.belarusian: "Мы адвезлі яго ў гарадскі морг. Мясцовы патолагаанатам неўзабаве звяжацца з вамі, каб арганізаваць пахаванне. Тым часам вы заўсёды можаце патэлефанаваць у РГМ, калі ўзнікнуць якія-небудзь пытанні".

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000323B.english: You know the answer to this. Oddly, you just do.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000323B.polish: Znasz odpowiedź. To dziwne, ale tak po prostu jest.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000323B.belarusian: Ты ведаеш адказ на гэта. Як ні дзіўна, проста ведаеш.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003243.english: "I see. Well, thank you for... telling me." She rubs her face, runs her fingers over cheeks that have become numb.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003243.polish: „Rozumiem. Cóż, dziękuję za... powiadomienie mnie” – pociera twarz i przesuwa palcami po odrętwiałych policzkach.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003243.belarusian: "Разумею. Што ж, дзякуй, што... сказалі, - яна трэ твар, праводзіць пальцамі па анямелых шчоках."

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000324B.english: "Thank you for telling, me officer..." She looks down.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000324B.polish: „Dziękuję za powiadomienie mnie, funkcjonariuszu...” – spogląda w dół.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000324B.belarusian: "Дзякуй, што сказалі мне, афіцэру... - яна глядзіць долу."

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000325B.english: "Jolie is sixteen and Jennie is turning eighteen next month."
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000325B.polish: „Jolie ma szesnaście lat, a Jennie w przyszłym miesiącu skończy osiemnaście”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000325B.belarusian: "Жалі шаснаццаць, а Джэні ў наступным месяцы споўніцца васямнаццаць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003262.english: "What was he supposed to do in the library?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003269.english: "Just to return a book of mine, why?" She looks at you quizzically. "Why all those questions, detective? Did he..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003269.polish: „Miał po prostu zwrócić moją książkę. Dlaczego pan pyta?” – wpatruje się w ciebie, skonfundowana. „Dlaczego zadaje mi pan te wszystkie pytania, detektywie? Czy on...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003269.belarusian: "Проста вярнуць маю кнігу, а што? - яна здзіўлена глядзіць на цябе. - Навошта ўсе гэтыя пытанні, дэтэктыве? Ён штосьці..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003270.english: "What was the name of the book?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003277.english: "Was it 'The Glinting Curve' by M. Thibault?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003277.polish: „Czy była to »Błyszcząca krzywa« autorstwa M. Thibaulta?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000327E.english: "I think it was Thibault's 'The Glinting Curve'." She tucks a strand of hair behind her ear. "It was pretty good..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000327E.polish: „To była chyba »Błyszcząca krzywa« Thibaulta” – zaczesuje palcami za ucho kosmyk włosów. „Całkiem niezła książka...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000327E.belarusian: "Здаецца, гэта была 'Ззяючая крывая' Цібо, - яна запраўляе пасму валасоў за вуха. - Даволі нядрэнная кніжка..."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003289.english: "Yes." She becomes unsettled as she says that, her forehead scrunching up into a worried expression.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003289.polish: „Tak” – odpowiada i robi się niespokojna. Na jej czole pojawiają się głębokie bruzdy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003289.belarusian: "Так, - кажучы гэта, яна робіцца неспакойнай, яе лоб бярэцца трывожнымі зморшчынамі."

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003291.english: "Um, it's just your average brown leather jacket. But he bought it as a teenager, so..."
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003291.polish: „Ee... To zwykła brązowa skórzana kurtka. Ale kupił ją, gdy był nastolatkiem, więc...”
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003291.belarusian: "Ну, звычайная брунатная скурная куртка. Але ён купіў яе яшчэ падлеткам, так што..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000920000329F.english: "No, well..." She stops. "The lining is hand-sewn. It's blue; I tried to make the thing more weatherproof since he's running around with it in the middle of winter."
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000329F.polish: „Nie. Chociaż...” – na chwilę milknie. „Podszewka jest ręcznie wszyta. Niebieska. Próbowałam ocieplić mu trochę tę kurtkę, bo biega w niej wszędzie w środku zimy”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000920000329F.belarusian: "Не, ну... - спыняецца яна. - Падшэўка падшытая ўручную. Блакітная; я спрабавала зрабіць куртку цяплейшай ад непагадзі, бо ён жа бегае ў ёй пасярод зімы".

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000032B3.english: "Yes..." She stops. "The lining is hand-sewn. It's blue; I tried to make the thing more weatherproof since he's running around with it in the middle of winter."
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000032B3.polish: „A tak...” – na chwilę milknie. „Podszewka jest ręcznie wszyta. Niebieska. Próbowałam ocieplić mu trochę tę kurtkę, bo biega w niej wszędzie w środku zimy”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000032B3.belarusian: "Так... - спыняецца яна. - Падшэўка падшытая ўручную. Блакітная; я спрабавала зрабіць куртку цяплейшай ад непагадзі, бо ён жа бегае ў ёй пасярод зімы".

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000032BC.english: "Yes, I remember, you mentioned them at the bookstand."
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000032BC.polish: „Tak, pamiętam. Wspominała pani o nich przy księgarni”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000032BC.belarusian: "Так, памятаю, вы згадвалі іх каля кніжнага стэнда".

Dialogue Text/0x01000092000032C2.english: "Mhmh, they came home later. They're good girls."
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000032C2.polish: „Mhm... Wrócą do domu później. To dobre dziewczyny”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000092000032C2.belarusian: "Мгм, яны прыйшлі дадому пазней. Яны добрыя дзяўчаткі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A07.english: The lieutenant has taken off his foggy glasses and is busy cleaning them in his handkerchief for now. You're on your own here.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A07.polish: Porucznik zdjął swoje zaparowane okulary i jest zajęty czyszczeniem ich chusteczką. Jesteś zdany tylko na siebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A07.belarusian: Лейтэнант зняў свае запацелыя акуляры і цяпер старанна выцірае іх насоўкай. Тут ты сам па сабе.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A0D.polish: Para wodna. Zebrała się po wejściu z zewnątrz.

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A19.english: He must feel vulnerable without his glasses. Is this why he's letting you take the lead?
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A19.polish: Musi czuć się odsłonięty bez okularów. Czy to dlatego pozwolił ci przejąć pałeczkę?
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200003A19.belarusian: Без акуляраў ён мусіць адчуваць сябе безабаронным. Ці не таму ён дазваляе табе весці рэй?

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000E8B.english: She looks up, too anxious to say anything.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000E8B.polish: Patrzy w górę, zbyt zaniepokojona, by cokolwiek powiedzieć.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000E8B.belarusian: Яна падымае вочы, занадта ўстрывожаная, каб хоць штосьці сказаць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000EAA.english: The lieutenant nods at the woman, then looks back at you, his voice lowered: "We should step outside and talk."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000EAA.polish: Porucznik kiwa głową w kierunku kobiety, po czym spogląda z powrotem na ciebie i przemawia ściszonym głosem: „Powinniśmy wyjść na zewnątrz i porozmawiać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000EAA.belarusian: Лейтэнант ківае жанчыне, потым глядзіць на цябе, сцішыўшы голас: "Нам варта выйсці на двор і пагаварыць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000EB2.polish: „Jak mówiłem, bardzo mi przykro, proszę pani”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000FCD.english: "How have I been?" she shakes her head. "You're not here to discuss *me* -- what is this about, officer?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000FCD.polish: „Jak się miewam?” – powtarza, kręcąc głową. „Nie przyszedł tu pan, aby rozmawiać o *mnie* – o co chodzi, funkcjonariuszu?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000FCD.belarusian: "Як я? - яна хітае галавой. - Вы прыйшлі сюды не дзеля таго, каб абмяркоўваць *мяне*. Пра што гаворка, афіцэру?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000FDF.english: "People gotta eat." She rubs her hands together, anxious. "What is this about? Why are you suddenly asking me about my cooking?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000FDF.polish: „Ludzie muszą jeść” – odpowiada, zacierając nerwowo ręce. „O co chodzi? Dlaczego nagle pyta mnie pan o to, co gotuję?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000FDF.belarusian: "Людзям трэба есці, - яна нервова трэ рукі. - Пра што гаворка? Чаму вы раптам пытаецеся пра маё гатаванне?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000FFD.english: [Set the library card by her. Leave the room.]
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000FFD.polish: Zostaw koło niej kartę biblioteczną. [Opuść pokój].
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100000FFD.belarusian: [Пакласці квіток чытача побач з ёй. Выйсці з пакоя.]

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB46.english: "I think, yes. If that's the one on Meroe."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB46.polish: „Myślę, że tak. Jeśli to ta na Meroe”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB46.belarusian: "Здаецца, так. Калі гэта тая, што на Мероэ".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB5F.english: Do something? Break something? It's a fool's hope.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB5F.polish: Coś zrobił? Coś zniszczył? Chwyta się każdej nadziei.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB5F.belarusian: Зрабіў штосьці? Зламаў штосьці? Гэта марная надзея.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB72.english: It reminded him of his teenage years.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB83.english: God, do I just say he's *dead* like that...
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB83.polish: Boże, mam ot tak powiedzieć, że *nie żyje*...?
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB83.belarusian: Божа, мне проста вось так сказаць, што ён *мёртвы*...

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB89.english: Yes. That's the most important thing. Use that word.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB89.polish: Tak. To najważniejsze. Użyj właśnie tych słów.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB89.belarusian: Так. Гэта самае галоўнае. Выкарыстай гэтае слова.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB8F.english: No euphemisms, this is what you came here for.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB8F.polish: Żadnych eufemizmów. Po to właśnie tu przyszedłeś.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB8F.belarusian: Ніякіх эўфемізмаў, дзеля гэтага ты сюды і прыйшоў.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB99.english: A great and terrible spike. The blood freezes in her veins.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB99.polish: Jakby wbić w nią wielki, straszliwy szpikulec. Krew zamarza jej w żyłach.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB99.belarusian: Вялікі і жудасны шып. Кроў застывае ў яе жылах.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DBBF.english: If you say 'Two days, maybe', it will be etched in her mind forever.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DBBF.polish: Jeśli powiesz „najpewniej około dwóch dni”, wyryjesz jej te słowa w umyśle na zawsze.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DBBF.belarusian: Калі ты скажаш: "Можа, дні два", гэта назаўжды застанецца ў яе памяці.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DBC5.english: But he was just here. Alive.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DBC5.polish: Ale dopiero co tu był. Żywy.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DBC5.belarusian: Але ж ён толькі што быў тут. Жывы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DBD8.english: "God, should I call them? Should I tell them to come home?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DBD8.polish: „Boże, powinnam do nich zadzwonić? A może powiedzieć im, gdy wrócą do domu?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DBD8.belarusian: "Божа, ці варта мне патэлефанаваць ім? Ці сказаць ім прыйсці дадому?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DBF5.english: She can't take much more. Her stomach is churning. Soon she will have to go to the bathroom and scream.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DBF5.polish: Nie wytrzyma wiele więcej. Przewraca jej się w brzuchu. Musi zaraz pójść do łazienki i zacząć krzyczeć.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DBF5.belarusian: Яна больш не вытрымае. У яе круціць у жываце. Хутка ёй давядзецца пайсці ў ванны пакой і закрычаць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC0E.english: A very good call. You must leave now, sire.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC0E.polish: Doskonale rozegrane. Powinieneś odejść, szanowny panie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC0E.belarusian: Вельмі слушнае рашэнне. Вы мусіце сысці зараз, мілорд.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC1C.english: These are her last reserves of strength. Her muscles will give in soon. Already she starts to shake.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC1C.polish: To jej ostatnie rezerwy energii. Jej mięśnie niedługo się poddadzą. Już teraz zaczyna się trząść.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC1C.belarusian: Гэта яе апошнія запасы сіл. Яе цягліцы хутка здадуцца. Яна ўжо пачынае дрыжаць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC23.english: These are her last reserves of strength. Her muscles will give in soon. Already she starts to shake.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC23.polish: To jej ostatnie rezerwy energii. Jej mięśnie niedługo się poddadzą. Już teraz zaczyna się trząść.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC23.belarusian: Гэта яе апошнія запасы сіл. Яе цягліцы хутка здадуцца. Яна ўжо пачынае дрыжаць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC63.english: She's in pain. She's in so much pain and so are you, your chest is burning.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC63.polish: Czuje ból. Ogromny ból. Ty też. Pali cię w piersi.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC63.belarusian: Ёй балюча. Ёй так балюча, і табе таксама, у грудзях усё гарыць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC6B.english: The lieutenant steps in. "We're very sorry to inform you, but your husband, Victor Méjean, was found dead this morning on the Martinaise boardwalk."
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC6B.polish: Wtrąca się porucznik. „Z wielką przykrością informujemy, że pani mąż, Victor Méjean, został znaleziony martwy dziś rano na promenadzie Martinaise”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC6B.belarusian: Лейтэнант уступае: "Нам вельмі шкада паведамляць вам, але вашага мужа, Віктара Межана, сёння раніцай знайшлі мёртвым на праменадзе Марцінэза".

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC88.belarusian: Ён толькі што быў тут. Жывы.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC90.english: You stupid... *why* did you say that?!
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC90.belarusian: Ах ты дурань... *навошта* ты гэта сказаў?!

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC98.english: "God, should I call them? Should I tell them to come home?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC98.polish: „Boże, powinnam do nich zadzwonić? A może powiedzieć im, gdy wrócą do domu?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC98.belarusian: "Божа, ці варта мне патэлефанаваць ім? Ці сказаць ім прыйсці дадому?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC9E.english: "No, no..." She breathes in. "I just need to tell my girls..." The air gets sucked out of her lungs suddenly.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC9E.polish: „Nie, nie...” – robi głęboki wdech. „Muszę tylko powiedzieć moim córkom...” – nagle uchodzi z niej całe powietrze.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DC9E.belarusian: "Не, не... - удыхае яна. - Мне проста трэба сказаць маім дзяўчаткам... - Паветра раптам нібы высмактала з яе лёгкіх."

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DCB9.english: She can't take much more. Her stomach is churning. Soon she will have to go to the bathroom and scream.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DCB9.polish: Nie wytrzyma wiele więcej. Przewraca jej się w brzuchu. Zaraz będzie musiała pójść do łazienki i zacząć krzyczeć.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DCB9.belarusian: Яна больш не вытрымае. У яе круціць у жываце. Хутка ёй давядзецца пайсці ў ванны пакой і закрычаць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DCC9.english: Yes. You're a total fucking horror show.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DCC9.polish: Tak. Jesteś jak jakiś, kurwa, upiorny żart.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DCDC.english: These are her last reserves of strength. Her muscles will give in soon. To a scream.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DCDC.polish: To jej ostatnie rezerwy energii. Jej mięśnie niedługo się poddadzą. Ustąpią miejsca krzykowi.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DCDC.belarusian: Гэта яе апошнія запасы сіл. Яе цягліцы хутка здадуцца. Перарастуць у крык.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000021CB.english: "I'll take it from here. Thank you." She points at the front door, breathing fast now. Holding herself back.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000021CB.polish: „Zajmę się teraz wszystkim sama. Dziękuję” – odpowiada i wskazuje drzwi wyjściowe. Jej oddech jest przyśpieszony. Powstrzymuje się.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000021CB.belarusian: "Далей я сама. Дзякуй, - яна паказвае на ўваходныя дзверы, цяпер часта дыхаючы. Стрымліваючы сябе."

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000021E3.english: Can't write a scene without knowing the actors. Ask more, get comfortable around her.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000021E3.polish: Nie sposób napisać scenę, nie znając jej aktorów. Zadaj więcej pytań, zapoznaj się z nią nieco.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000021E3.belarusian: Нельга напісаць сцэну, не ведаючы актораў. Распытай больш, наладзь кантакт.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000021E8.english: She's afraid -- and so are you. Man up and cut to the point.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000021E8.polish: Boi się. Ty też. Weź się w garść i przejdź do rzeczy.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000021E8.belarusian: Яна баіцца — і ты таксама. Вазьмі сябе ў рукі і перайдзі да сутнасці.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000021FB.english: It's like ripping off a bandage. The least painful way is to do it straight away, without stalling.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000021FB.polish: To jak zrywanie bandażu – najmniej boli ściągnięcie go szybko, bez zwłoki.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000021FB.belarusian: Гэта як здзіраць пластыр. Найменш балючы спосаб — зрабіць гэта адразу, не марудзячы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002206.english: How about some small talk before you break the news?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002206.polish: A może tak mała pogawędka, zanim przejdziesz do rzeczy?
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002206.belarusian: Як наконт лёгкай размовы, перш чым выкласці навіну?

Dialogue Text/0x010000210000220C.english: Definitely no small talk, this isn't the time or place.
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000220C.polish: Żadnej pogawędki, to nie czas ani miejsce na to.
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000220C.belarusian: Ніякіх лёгкіх размоў, гэта не той час і не тое месца.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000023D1.english: [Set the library card by her. Leave the room.]
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000023D1.polish: [Zostaw koło niej kartę biblioteczną. Opuść pokój].
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000023D1.belarusian: [Пакласці квіток чытача побач з ёй. Выйсці з пакоя.]

Dialogue Text/0x010000210000310C.english: She's crying, too heartbroken to notice you standing next to her.
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000310C.polish: Płacze zbyt zrozpaczona, by zauważyć, że stoisz tuż obok niej.
Dialogue Text/0x010000210000310C.belarusian: Яна плача, занадта знясіленая горам, каб заўважыць, што ты стаіш побач.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100003113.english: What are you still doing here?! She needs time to be alone now.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100003113.polish: Co ty tu jeszcze robisz?! Ona potrzebuje być teraz sama.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100003113.belarusian: Што ты тут яшчэ робіш?! Ёй цяпер трэба пабыць адной.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002DEE.english: Don't give her the lieutenant's handkerchief, it's too special.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002DEE.polish: Nie dawaj jej chusteczki porucznika. Jest zbyt wyjątkowa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002DEE.belarusian: Не аддавай ёй насовачку лейтэнанта, яна занадта асаблівая.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002F56.english: The woman wipes her face with a sleeve and manages to conjure up a small terrified smile. She looks disoriented.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002F56.polish: Kobieta ociera twarz rękawem i mimo przerażenia udaje jej się przywołać niewielki uśmiech. Wygląda na zdezorientowaną.
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002F56.belarusian: Жанчына выцірае твар рукавом і спрабуе выціснуць маленькую напалоханую ўсмешку. Яна выглядае дэзарыентаванай.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E06D.english: A former architect stands before a slice of window, a room plan in her hand. A cold wave has made the air in the building stand still and frozen, with temperatures falling down to -20°C.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E06D.polish: Dawna architektka stoi przed barierą okna, trzymając w ręce plan piętra. Fala zimna sprawiła, że powietrze w budynku stało się nieruchome, niczym zamarznięte. Temperatura sięga -20°C.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E06D.belarusian: Былая архітэктарка стаіць перад вузкай паласой акна, у ейнай руцэ план пакоя. Прыліў холаду прымусіў паветра ў будынку замерці і зледзянець, а тэмпература апусцілася да -20°C.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E090.english: ...is red from the cold. She's breathing on her fingers clasping the plan. Traces of sadness are visible in her expression.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E090.polish: ...jest czerwona od zimna. Chucha na swoje zaciśnięte na planie palce. W jej wyrazie twarzy da się dostrzec smutek.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E090.belarusian: ...чырвоны ад холаду. Яна дыхае на сціснутыя на плане пальцы. Сляды суму бачныя ў выразе ейнага твару.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E096.english: ... faint pencil lines on paper depict the same place, but a missing eastern wall connects the room with the neighbouring apartment. Ideas for arranging the furniture have been jotted down.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E096.polish: Niewyraźne linie ołówka na papierze przedstawiają to samo miejsce, lecz brakująca wschodnia ściana oddziela na nim pomieszczenie od sąsiedniego mieszkania. Widać też zapiski dotyczące pomysłów umeblowania.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E096.belarusian: ... невыразныя алоўкавыя лініі на паперы ўзнаўляюць тое самае месца, але адсутная ўсходняя сцяна злучае пакой з суседняй кватэрай. Ужо былі накіданыя ідэі па планіроўцы мэблі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E09E.english: It's clean and empty, with new tapestry embellishing the walls. A standard HB graphite pencil has fallen off a three-legged stool in the middle of the room.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E09E.polish: Jest czysto i pusto. Ściany zdobi nowa tapeta. Obok trójnogiego krzesła pośrodku pokoju leży zwykły ołówek o graficie twardości HB.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E09E.belarusian: Тут чыста і пуста, новыя габелены ўпрыгожваюць сцены. З трохногага зэдліка пасярод пакоя зваліўся звычайны графітавы HB аловак .

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E2C0.english: She had an eye for beauty.

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001505A.english: A shift in temperature. The air chills around you. Dust settles on the stony floor.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001505A.polish: Zmiana temperatury. Powietrze wokół ciebie robi się chłodne. Na kamienną podłogę opada kurz.
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001505A.belarusian: Змена тэмпературы. Паветра вакол цябе халадзее. На каменную падлогу ападае пыл.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015067.polish: Rozetrzyj sobie boki, żeby się rozgrzać.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E16F.english: You can't foreclose on an apartment with a hole in the wall.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E16F.polish: Nie można przejąć mieszkania z dziurą w ścianie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E16F.belarusian: Нельга забраць за даўгі кватэру з дзіркай у сцяне.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E17E.english: It will still be accessible through the apartment next to it. That one didn't have a door... Sadly, nothing of great value remains here.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E17E.polish: Wciąż będzie dostępne przez mieszkanie obok. To, które nie miało drzwi... Niestety, nie zostało tu nic o jakiejkolwiek sensownej wartości.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E17E.belarusian: У яе ўсё адно можна будзе патрапіць праз суседнюю кватэру. У той не было дзвярэй... На жаль, нічога асабліва каштоўнага тут не засталося.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E2DC.english: Except the stuff in the fridge.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E2E2.english: There's always a little something in the fridge.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E2E2.polish: W lodówce zawsze jest jakiś drobiazg.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E2F2.english: Put your emotions aside. Try to focus on abstract, impersonal things.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E2F2.polish: Odłóż emocje na bok. Spróbuj skupić się na rzeczach abstrakcyjnych, niezwiązanych z ludźmi.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E2F2.belarusian: Адкінь эмоцыі. Паспрабуй засяродзіцца на абстрактных, безасабовых рэчах.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E2F8.polish: Ale tu aż cuchnie od smutku!
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E2F8.belarusian: Але ж тут аж тхне смуткам!

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E0BF.english: That isn't *just* a five-pointed star -- it's an inverted white pentagram cradled in a wreath of antlers. The iconography of communism, in other words.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E0BF.polish: To nie jest *zwykła* pięcioramienna gwiazda, a odwrócony biały pentagram otoczony wieńcem poroża. Innymi słowy, ikonografia komunizmu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001E0BF.belarusian: Гэта не *проста* пяціканцовая зорка — гэта перакуленая белая пентаграма ў вянку з аленевых рагоў. Іншымі словамі, іканаграфія камунізму.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000066DD.english: The star-and-antlers was developed in the sixth decade of the last century and quickly adopted by Mazov and the communards during the Revolution...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000066DD.polish: Symbol gwiazdy i poroża powstał w szóstej dekadzie ostatniego stulecia i został szybko przyjęty przez Mazowa i komunardów podczas rewolucji...
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000066DD.belarusian: Аленевыя-рогі-з-зоркай былі створаны ў шостым дзесяцігоддзі мінулага стагоддзя і хутка пераняты Мазавым і камунарамі падчас Рэвалюцыі...

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000066E4.english: Why is the star upside down?
