Dialogue Text/0x01000070000066E4.polish: Czemu gwiazda jest do góry nogami?

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000066EA.english: What's the deal with the antlers?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000066EA.polish: O co chodzi z tym porożem?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000066EA.belarusian: А што за фішка з аленевымі рагамі?

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000066F8.english: To symbolize the toppling of the old order.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006700.english: What does it evoke in me? [Finish thought.]
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006700.polish: Co we mnie budzi ten widok? [Zakończ myśl].
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006700.belarusian: Што гэта выклікае ўва мне? [Скончыць думку.]

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006707.english: The wreath of antlers represents a natural crown. It was about building a society that could exist in accord with the natural world -- and at the same time above it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006707.polish: Wieniec poroża stanowi naturalną koronę. Chodziło o budowę społeczeństwa, które będzie mogło istnieć w zgodzie ze światem natury, a jednocześnie ponad nim.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006707.belarusian: Вянок з аленевых рагоў уяўляе сабой прыродную карону. Ішлося пра пабудову грамадства, якое магло б існаваць у згодзе з прыродным светам — і ў той жа час узвышацца над ім.

Dialogue Text/0x010000700000670E.english: Also, some social democrats were already using it.
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000670E.polish: Poza tym używali go już niektórzy socjaldemokraci.
Dialogue Text/0x010000700000670E.belarusian: Да таго ж некаторыя сацыял-дэмакраты яе ўжо выкарыстоўвалі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006730.english: Because white is the colour of peace.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006751.english: Gone. Gone is the glory. Of hope, only the scribblings of impoverished students remain. In dirty hallways...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006751.polish: To koniec. Koniec chwały. I nadziei, zostały tylko zapiski ubogich studentów. W brudnych korytarzach...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000006751.belarusian: Знікла. Знікла былая слава. Ад надзеі засталіся толькі крэмзанні збяднелых студэнтаў. У брудных калідорах...

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067C7.english: You are the Big Communism Builder now. It's you or no one.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067C7.polish: To ty jesteś teraz wielkim budowniczym komunizmu. Albo ty, albo nikt.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067C7.belarusian: Цяпер ты — Вялікі Будаўнік Камунізму. Або ты, або ніхто.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067CE.english: You see noble aims but also mountains upon mountains of corpses. They should've taken a more *measured* approach. Also, you're really smart.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067CE.polish: Widzisz szlachetny cel, ale też ogromne stosy trupów. Powinni byli podejść do tego *mniej radykalnie*. Ponadto jesteś bardzo mądry.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067CE.belarusian: Ты бачыш высакародныя мэты, але і горы, цэлыя горы трупаў. Ім варта было дзейнічаць больш *узважана*. А яшчэ ты вельмі разумны.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067D5.english: Smug superiority? Esthetic musings? The triumph of Capital is undeniable, but... maybe the guns were sort of cool? Revolutionaries had loads of guns.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067D5.polish: Przemądrzałe poczucie wyższości? Estetyczne rozmyślania? Tryumf kapitalizmu jest oczywisty, ale... może ta broń była całkiem czadowa? A rewolucjoniści mieli jej mnóstwo.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067D5.belarusian: Самазадаволеная перавага? Эстэтычныя развагі? Трыумф Капіталу бясспрэчны, але... можа, пушкі былі нічога так? У рэвалюцыянераў было процьма пушак.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067DC.english: Nothing at all yet. Right now it's just meaningless shapes on a wall.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067DC.polish: Na razie jeszcze nic. Chwilowo to tylko pozbawione znaczenia kształty na ścianie.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067DC.belarusian: Пакуль зусім нічога. Зараз гэта проста бессэнсоўныя формы на сцяне.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067E5.english: The price of idealism unrestrained by humanism. Never again.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067E5.polish: Cena idealizmu nieskrępowanego humanizmem. To się nie może nigdy powtórzyć.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067E5.belarusian: Цана ідэалізму, не абмежаванага гуманізмам. Больш ніколі.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067EC.english: Communism is the ideology of gutless intellectuals and clueless university students. They don't care about the *real* wörking man.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067EC.polish: Komunizm to ideologia tchórzliwych indywidualistów i naiwnych studenciaków. Nie obchodzi ich *prawdziwy* człöwiek pracujący.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067EC.belarusian: Камунізм — гэта ідэалогія бясхрыбетных інтэлектуалаў і недалёкіх студэнтаў універсітэта. Іх не хвалюе *сапраўдны* працöўны чалавек.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067F3.english: In other words, it doesn't mean a thing to *trüe* Revacholians.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067F3.polish: Innymi słowy, nic on nie znaczy dla *prawdziwych* revachölczyków.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067F3.belarusian: Іншымі словамі, ён нічога не значыць для *сапрäўдных* рэвашольцаў.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067FA.english: Whatever kid drew this graffito will get it one day. You just can't beat FREEDOM and hustle-jiggling all the time.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067FA.polish: Dzieciak, który narysował to graffito, kiedyś jeszcze oberwie. Nie da się wiecznie wymykać WOLNOŚCI i cwaniactwu.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000067FA.belarusian: Якое б дзіця ні намалявала гэтае графіці, калі-небудзь яно сваё атрымае. Ты проста не пераплюнеш СВАБОДУ і вечны круцёж.

Dialogue Text/0x01000008000012F6.english: "Look out, Kim: There are communists around here."

Dialogue Text/0x01000008000012FD.english: Even today, half a century after, the star-and-antlers retains the ability to evoke hope, disappointment, and fear in equal measure.
Dialogue Text/0x01000008000012FD.polish: Nawet dzisiaj, pół stulecia później, gwiazda z porożem potrafi budzić w równym stopniu nadzieję, rozczarowanie i strach.
Dialogue Text/0x01000008000012FD.belarusian: Нават сёння, праз паўстагоддзя, аленевыя-рогі-з-зоркай здольныя выклікаць надзею, расчараванне і страх у аднолькавай ступені.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000800001304.polish: „Będę miał swojego Armistice pod ręką, dziękuję”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000080000130F.english: He doesn't actually reach for his gun.
Dialogue Text/0x010000080000130F.belarusian: Але па зброю ён насамрэч не цягнецца.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015078.english: Oops, it's a fashion faux pas! [Discard the thought -- and the shoes!]
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015078.polish: Ojej, to modowe faux pas! [Odrzuć myśl. Buty też!]
Dialogue Text/0x0100000400015078.belarusian: Ой, гэта ж моднае faux pas! [Адкінуць думку — і туфлі!]

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009C2.english: Mm, the luxury of fine things. Just look at those black monk straps! After spending an entire day hustling, who's to say that you *didn't* deserve a pair of ridiculously expensive shoes on your tired feet?
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009C2.polish: Mmm, luksus drogich rzeczy. Tylko popatrz na te czarne paski! Kto twierdzi, że po całym dniu ciężkiej pracy *nie należy* ci się para absurdalnie drogich butów do wzucia na zmęczone stopy?
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009C2.belarusian: М-м, раскоша вытанчаных рэчаў. Толькі зірні на гэтыя чорныя монкі! Хто пасмее сказаць, што пасля цэлага дня ўвіхання ты *не* заслужыў надзець пару недарэчна дарагіх туфляў на свае стомленыя ногі?

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009C9.english: You're right, beautiful things do make people happy...
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009C9.polish: Masz rację, piękne rzeczy faktycznie dają ludziom szczęście...
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009C9.belarusian: Твая праўда, прыгожыя рэчы сапраўды робяць людзей шчаслівымі...

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009D0.english: Beautiful things give you a *rush*. It's power -- crafting your style, draping your flesh in silk and leather, deciding how to present yourself to the world.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009D0.polish: Piękne rzeczy dają ci *kopa*. To władza. Tworzenie własnego stylu, odziewanie się w jedwab i skórę, decydowanie, jak pokażesz się światu.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009D0.belarusian: Прыгожыя рэчы даюць табе такі *кайф*. Гэта ўлада — ствараць уласны стыль, ахінаць цела ў ядваб і скуру, вырашаць, якім паўстаць перад светам.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009D7.english: Remember, when they come to take it *away* from you -- you *worked* for those shoes. Whether you like it or not, wearing these shoes has made you more liberal -- *ultra*liberal.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009D7.polish: Pamiętaj, kiedy przyjdą ci to wszystko *zabrać*: *pracowałeś* na te buty. Czy ci się to podoba, czy nie, ich noszenie uczyniło cię większym liberałem. *Ultraliberałem*.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009D7.belarusian: Памятай, калі яны прыйдуць усё гэта *забраць*: ты *працаваў* на гэтыя туфлі. Падабаецца табе гэта ці не, але нашэнне гэтага абутку зрабіла цябе больш ліберальным — *ультра*ліберальным.

Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009FB.english: Let's hope no one saw you wearing these outrageously expensive -- and ultraliberal! -- shoes.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009FB.polish: Miejmy nadzieję, że nikt nie widział, jak nosisz te skandalicznie drogie – i ultraliberalne! – buty.
Dialogue Text/0x01000021000009FB.belarusian: Будзем спадзявацца, ніхто не бачыў, як ты надзеў гэтыя абуральна дарагія — і ультраліберальныя! — туфлі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001BB7A.english: They're either a gateway drug -- or a booster pack -- to get you *deeper* into free market ideology.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001BB7A.polish: Stanowią albo narkotyk, który wciąga w nałóg, albo właśnie taki, który jeszcze *bardziej* wpycha cię w szpony ideologii wolnorynkowej.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001BB7A.belarusian: Гэта альбо першая доза, якая зацягвае, альбо бустар-пак, які пагрузіць цябе яшчэ *глыбей* у ідэалогію свабоднага рынку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000053C.english: Take the speed. Take that glorious stuff. You have it now. You've got it! TAKE IT!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000053C.polish: Weź speed. Weź ten wspaniały towar. Masz go. Masz go! WIĘC GO WEŹ!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000053C.belarusian: Вазьмі спіды. Вазьмі гэтае цудоўнае дабро. Цяпер яны ў цябе. Яны ў цябе! ВАЗЬМІ ІХ!

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000054F.english: No. Not right now, anyway. [Discard thought.]
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000054F.polish: Nie. W każdym razie nie teraz. [Odrzuć myśl].
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000054F.belarusian: Не. Ва ўсякім разе, не цяпер. [Адкінуць думку.]

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00000558.english: Come on. Come on! A little! Just a little bit! Whaddya say, huh?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00000558.polish: No daj spokój. Tylko trochę! Odrobinę! Malutką! Co powiesz? No?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00000558.belarusian: Ды давай жа. Давай! Крышачку! Зусім крышачку! Што скажаш, га?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000055E.english: FUCKING RIGHT! PUT THAT BOTTLE IN YOUR HAND AND PARTY DOWN!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000055E.polish: TAK, KURWA! BIERZ TĘ BUTELKĘ W ŁAPSKO I KRĘCIMY IMPREZĘ!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000055E.belarusian: ВОСЬ ГЭТА ПА-НАШАМУ, БЛЯДЗЬ! БЯРЫ ГЭТУЮ БУТЭЛЬКУ Ў РУКУ І АДРЫВАЙСЯ!

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000005A9.english: I said I discard the thought! [Discard thought.]
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F000005A9.belarusian: Я сказаў, што адкідваю думку! [Адкінуць думку.]

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00000B66.english: Fuck you. You used to be cool. Why can't you just take the bottle and snort snort snort?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00000B66.polish: A pierdol się. Kiedyś byłeś czadowy. Czemu nie możesz po prostu wziąć tej butelki i się sztachać, sztachać, sztachać?
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00000B66.belarusian: Пашоў ты на хуй. Калісьці ты быў крутым. Чаму ты не можаш проста ўзяць бутэльку і нюх-нюх-нюх?

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00000B6D.english: Just a little. Then a lot. Come on, party boy! Let's get FUCKED!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00000B6D.polish: Tylko troszkę. A potem dużo. No dalej, imprezowiczu! Czas się SKOTŁOWAĆ!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00000B6D.belarusian: Зусім крышачку. А потым шмат. Давай, тусовачны хлопец! Давай УХЛАМАЕМСЯ!

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00002961.english: That's great. Tell me what circle I've got to run into this time.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00002961.polish: Wspaniale. Powiedz, w jaki krąg mam wbiec tym razem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00002961.belarusian: Выдатна. Скажы, у якое кола мне трэба ўбегчы гэтым разам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00002968.english: I will be there soon. Wherever it is!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00002968.polish: Niedługo tam będę. Gdziekolwiek to jest!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00002968.belarusian: Я хутка буду там. Дзе б гэта ні было!

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000296D.english: You better be ready when I find you, weird voice! I'm going to hurt you!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000296D.polish: Lepiej się przygotuj, dziwny głosie! Bo jak cię znajdę, to cię skrzywdzę!
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000296D.belarusian: Лепей падрыхтуйся, дзіўны голас, калі я цябе знайду! Я зраблю табе балюча!

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00002972.english: Yes... Reunion...! Listen within the circles that capture the electrical world… If you can hear me then, we will be united…
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00002972.polish: Tak... Spotkanie! Słuchaj w kręgach, które przechwytują świat elektryczny... Jeśli usłyszysz mnie wtedy, zostaniemy zjednoczeni...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00002972.belarusian: Так... Уз'яднанне...! Слухай унутры колаў, якія ўлоўліваюць электрычны свет… Калі пачуеш мяне тады, мы ўз'яднаемся…

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000297C.english: So near... Listen within the circles that capture the electrical world… If you can hear me then, we will be united…
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000297C.polish: Już tak blisko... Słuchaj w kręgach, które przechwytują świat elektryczny... Jeśli usłyszysz mnie wtedy, zostaniemy zjednoczeni...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F0000297C.belarusian: Ужо так блізка... Слухай унутры колаў, якія ўлоўліваюць электрычны свет… Калі пачуеш мяне тады, мы ўз'яднаемся…

Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00002986.english: Please do not... Just listen within the circles that capture the electrical world… If you can hear me then, we will be united…
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00002986.polish: Nie rób tego, proszę... Słuchaj tylko w kręgach, które przechwytują świat elektryczny... Jeśli usłyszysz mnie wtedy, zostaniemy zjednoczeni...
Dialogue Text/0x0100008F00002986.belarusian: Калі ласка, не трэба... Проста слухай унутры колаў, якія ўлоўліваюць электрычны свет… Калі пачуеш мяне тады, мы ўз'яднаемся…

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B0000295A.english: He sounds tired of it all.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B0000295A.belarusian: Ён гучыць так, нібыта стаміўся ад усяго гэтага.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000029E2.english: Your loss. Farewell, rain-washed wall at the end of the world.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000029E2.polish: Twoja strata. Żegnaj, zroszona deszczem ściano na końcu świata.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000B000029E2.belarusian: Твая страта. Бывай, абмытая дажджом сцяна на краі свету.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B4D9.english: Your loss. Farewell, light-drenched wall at the end of the world.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B4D9.polish: Twoja strata. Żegnaj, skąpana w świetle ściano na końcu świata.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B4D9.belarusian: Твая страта. Бывай, залітая святлом сцяна на краі свету.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B4E0.english: Your loss. Farewell, snow-flecked wall at the end of the world.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B4E0.polish: Twoja strata. Żegnaj, oblepiona śniegiem ściano na końcu świata.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B4E0.belarusian: Твая страта. Бывай, прыцярушаная снегам сцяна на краі свету.

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B4EA.english: Your loss. Farewell, wall at the end of the world, draped in shadow.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B4EA.polish: Twoja strata. Żegnaj, spowita cieniem ściano na końcu świata.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B4EA.belarusian: Твая страта. Бывай, ахутаная ценем сцяна на краі свету.

Dialogue Text/0x01000081000022E0.english: Cindy the SKULL has all the necessary materials. Talk to her?
Dialogue Text/0x01000081000022E0.polish: Cindy CZACHA ma wszystkie niezbędne materiały. Może z nią porozmawiaj?
Dialogue Text/0x01000081000022E0.belarusian: У Сіндзі ЧЭРАП ёсць усе неабходныя матэрыялы. Пагаварыць з ёй?

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000321E.polish: Jest pusta. Nie niesie żadnego przekazu.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000322A.english: Why am I looking at this wall?
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000322A.belarusian: Чаму я гляджу на гэтую сцяну?

tooltip1/0x010000160000322A.polish: W półmroku niektóre rzeczy stają się wyraźniejsze.
tooltip1/0x010000160000322A.belarusian: У прыцемках некаторыя рэчы становяцца больш выразнымі.

tooltip2/0x010000160000322A.polish: Gra w zbijaka, serio? Nie masz nawet odpowiedniej piłki.
tooltip2/0x010000160000322A.belarusian: Гульня ў выбівала, сур'ёзна? У цябе нават няма адпаведнага мяча.

tooltip3/0x010000160000322A.belarusian: У вас выключна вострая эстэтычная адчувальнасць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000326A.english: You have no clue. It's just a wall.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000326A.polish: Nie masz pojęcia. To po prostu ściana.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000326A.belarusian: Ты паняцця не маеш. Гэта проста сцяна.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003270.english: Yeah, why? It's a wall, an ordinary wall.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003270.polish: Tak, czemu? To tylko ściana. Najzwyklejsza.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003270.belarusian: Ага, чаму? Гэта сцяна, звычайная сцяна.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000327C.english: Because -- you see it, finally -- this wall is *sublime*! LOOK AT IT! The shadows, the colours...
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000327C.polish: Bo – w końcu to dostrzegasz – ta ściana jest *wyjątkowa*! Tylko na nią popatrz! Te cienie, te barwy...
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000327C.belarusian: Таму што — ты нарэшце бачыш гэта — гэтая сцяна *ўзнёслая*! ТОЛЬКІ ПАЗІРНІ НА ЯЕ! Гэтыя цені, гэтыя колеры...

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003282.english: Maybe this would be a good wall for dodge ball?
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003282.polish: Może to byłaby dobra ściana do gry w zbijaka?
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003282.belarusian: Можа, гэтая сцяна падышла б для гульні ў выбівалы?

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003288.english: So many walls all over Martinaise -- weatherworn, cracked, their paint peeling...
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003288.polish: Tyle jest ścian w całym Martinaise – zniszczonych przez żywioły, popękanych, z odłażącą farbą...
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003288.belarusian: Столькі сцен па ўсім Марцінэзе — пабітых непагаддзю, парэпаных, з аблупленай фарбай...

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003294.english: The lieutenant sighs. "Why must we stop to look at this wall every time we pass by? We have business to attend to."
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003294.polish: Porucznik wzdycha. „Dlaczego zatrzymujemy się przy tej ścianie za każdym razem, gdy przy niej przechodzimy? Mamy ważniejsze sprawy na głowie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003294.belarusian: Лейтэнант уздыхае: "Чаму мы мусім спыняцца і разглядаць гэтую сцяну кожны раз, як праходзім міма? У нас ёсць справы".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000329D.english: (Let the conceptual joy flow into your pupils and blossom into thoughts in your brain.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000329D.polish: (Pozwól konceptualnej radości wlewać się w twoje źrenice i rozkwitać w twoim mózgu myślami).
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000329D.belarusian: (Дазволіць канцэптуальнай радасці заліцца ў зрэнкі і расцвісці думкамі ў мазгах.)

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000032E2.english: "Kim! I *must* paint this wall, add even MORE beauty to it."
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000032E2.polish: „Kim! Ja *muszę* pomalować tę ścianę. Dodać do niej *jeszcze* więcej piękna”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000032E2.belarusian: "Кім! Я *мушу* памаляваць гэтую сцяну, дадаць ёй яшчэ БОЛЬШ прыгажосці".

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000032E8.english: Yes, I must paint this wall, ADD to it! (Get task.)
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000032E8.polish: Tak, muszę pomalować tę ścianę, wzbogacić ją! (Przyjmij zadanie).
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000032E8.belarusian: Так, я мушу памаляваць гэтую сцяну, ДАДАЦЬ ёй хараства! (Узяць заданне.)

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000032EE.english: No. There is nothing to add to perfection. (Back off.)
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000032EE.polish: Nie. Do ideału nie da się dodać niczego więcej. (Odpuść).
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000032EE.belarusian: Не. Да дасканаласці няма чаго дадаць. (Адступіць.)

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003331.english: Look the wall over again, carefully. Think about what you could paint there...
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003331.polish: Przyjrzyj się ścianie jeszcze raz, uważnie. Pomyśl, co mógłbyś tutaj namalować...
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003331.belarusian: Агледзець сцяну яшчэ раз, уважліва. Падумаць, што тут можна намаляваць...

Alternate1/0x0100001600003331.belarusian: "Я перадумаў. Я *ўсё ж такі* памалюю гэтую сцяну".

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000335D.english: This is a wall on the side of an apartment building.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000335D.belarusian: Гэта сцяна на тарцы шматкватэрнага дома.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003364.english: Just an ordinary wall. Nothing to see here.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003364.polish: To tylko zwykła ściana. Nie ma tu czego oglądać.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003364.belarusian: Проста звычайная сцяна. Няма на што глядзець.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000338C.english: Absolutely. Now you just need the materials.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000338C.belarusian: Безумоўна. Цяпер табе патрэбныя толькі матэрыялы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003399.english: Cindy the SKULL has what I need.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003399.polish: Cindy CZACHA ma to, czego potrzebuję.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003399.belarusian: У Сіндзі ЧЭРАП ёсць тое, што мне трэба.

Alternate1/0x0100001600003399.polish: Mam już ciężki olej napędowy, a Cindy CZACHA ma pędzel...
Alternate1/0x0100001600003399.belarusian: У мяне ўжо ёсць дызельнае паліва, а ў Сіндзі ЧЭРАП ёсць пэндзаль...

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000339F.english: I'm sure I'll find them. And then I'll return to this wall.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000339F.polish: Na pewno je znajdę. A wtedy wrócę do tej ściany.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000339F.belarusian: Упэўнены, я знайду іх. І тады вярнуся да гэтай сцяны.

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033C8.english: "I must talk to Cindy. Get the necessary *materials* from her."
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033C8.polish: „Muszę porozmawiać z Cindy. Wziąć od niej potrzebne *materiały*”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033C8.belarusian: "Мне трэба пагаварыць з Сіндзі. Узяць у яе неабходныя *матэрыялы*".

Alternate1/0x01000016000033C8.polish: „Mam już farbę. Muszę tylko zdobyć pędzel od Cindy CZACHY”.
Alternate1/0x01000016000033C8.belarusian: "У мяне ўжо ёсць фарба. Трэба толькі дастаць пэндзаль у Сіндзі ЧЭРАП".

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033CE.english: "I'm sure I'll find the materials. Then we can come back to this magnificent wall."
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033CE.polish: „Na pewno znajdę materiały. Możemy wtedy wrócić do tej wspaniałej ściany”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033CE.belarusian: "Упэўнены, я знайду матэрыялы. І тады мы зможам вярнуцца да гэтай цудоўнай сцяны".

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033D4.english: He sighs, then adds in a resigned tone: "If you must."
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033D4.polish: Wzdycha, po czym dodaje z rezygnacją: „Skoro musisz”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033D4.belarusian: Ён уздыхае, а пасля дадае пакорлівым тонам: "Калі вам ужо так трэба".

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033DA.english: "I suppose we'll have to pass by it again at some point anyway," he says in a tone of resignation.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033DA.polish: „Pewnie znowu będziemy musieli przy niej w końcu przejść” – stwierdza z rezygnacją w głosie.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033DA.belarusian: "Мяркую, мы ў любым выпадку неяк яшчэ будзем праходзіць міма", — кажа ён з пакорай у голасе.

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033E0.english: Yes, great thinking, go talk to her. The wall will be waiting.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033E0.polish: Tak, doskonała myśl, porozmawiaj z nią. Ściana poczeka.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033E0.belarusian: Так, выдатная думка, ідзі пагавары з ёй. Сцяна пачакае.

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033E6.english: Yes, do that. The wall will be waiting.

Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033FD.english: "First, I know you're tired, Kim, but take another look at this wall. Draw *nourishment* from its beauty."
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033FD.polish: „Przede wszystkim spójrz jeszcze raz na tę ścianę, Kim. Wiem, że jesteś zmęczony, ale *posil się* jej pięknem”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000016000033FD.belarusian: "Па-першае, я ведаю, што ты стаміўся, Кім, але зірні яшчэ раз на гэтую сцяну. *Пасілкуйся* яе прыгажосцю".

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003403.english: "Mhm, sure." The lieutenant looks up at the wall reluctantly, then back at you.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003403.polish: „Mhm, jasne” – porucznik niechętnie spogląda na ścianę, po czym przenosi wzrok z powrotem na ciebie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003403.belarusian: "Мгм, вядома". Лейтэнант нехаця глядзіць на сцяну, а пасля зноў на цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000340A.english: Your hands shake as they reach for the wall...
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000340A.polish: Ręce ci się trzęsą, kiedy wyciągasz je ku ścianie...
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000340A.belarusian: Твае рукі дрыжаць, калі ты цягнешся да сцяны...

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000341B.english: There it is -- the most beautiful of walls. Stop and admire it for a moment.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000341B.polish: Oto i ona – najpiękniejsza ze ścian. Zatrzymaj się i poświęć chwilę na jej podziwianie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000341B.belarusian: Вось і яна — найпрыгажэйшая са сцен. Спыніся і палюбуйся ёй хвілінку.

Alternate1/0x010000160000341B.polish: Pastelowe kolory ściany wydają się bardziej świetliste wśród padającego śniegu.
Alternate1/0x010000160000341B.belarusian: Пастэльныя колеры сцяны здаюцца яшчэ больш зіхатлівымі сярод снегападу.

Alternate2/0x010000160000341B.polish: Deszcz zaciemnia powierzchnię najpiękniejszej ze wszystkich ścian, nie ujmuje to jednak ani trochę jej pięknu.
Alternate2/0x010000160000341B.belarusian: Дождж робіць паверхню найпрыгажэйшай з усіх сцен цямнейшай, але аніколькі не прымяншае яе прыгажосці.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003436.english: Because this is no ordinary wall. It is *sublime*! LOOK AT IT! The shadows, the colours...
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003436.polish: Bo to nie jest zwykła ściana. Jest *niesamowita*! Tylko na nią popatrz! Te cienie, te barwy...
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003436.belarusian: Таму што гэта не звычайная сцяна. Яна *ўзнёслая*! ТОЛЬКІ ПАЗІРНІ НА ЯЕ! Гэтыя цені, гэтыя колеры...

Dialogue Text/0x010000160000346B.english: Cindy the SKULL has a paintbrush and paint. Talk to her.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000346B.polish: Cindy CZACHA ma pędzel i farbę. Porozmawiaj z nią.
Dialogue Text/0x010000160000346B.belarusian: У Сіндзі ЧЭРАП ёсць пэндзаль і фарба. Пагавары з ёй.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003471.english: You already have the heavy fuel oil to use as paint, and Cindy the SKULL has a paintbrush. This is completely doable.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003471.polish: Masz już ciężki olej napędowy do wykorzystania jako farbę, a Cindy CZACHA ma pędzel. To jest absolutnie do zrobienia.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003471.belarusian: У цябе ўжо ёсць дызельнае паліва замест фарбы, а ў Сіндзі ЧЭРАП ёсць пэндзаль. Гэта цалкам рэальна зрабіць.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003499.english: All the other walls on all the other houses must make a pilgrimage in adoration of this, the uncontested pinnacle of wall-craft. Colour peeled from the very face of god.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003499.polish: Wszystkie inne ściany wszystkich innych domów z pewnością odbywają pielgrzymki, by podziwiać tę – niekwestionowany szczyt osiągnięć murarskich. Jej kolor musi być barwą twarzy samego boga.
Dialogue Text/0x0100001600003499.belarusian: Усе іншыя сцены ўсіх іншых дамоў мусяць здзяйсняць паломніцтва, каб пакланіцца гэтаму бясспрэчнаму вяршыннаму дасягненню сцянабудавання. Колер, садраны з самога аблічча бога.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB09.english: You already have the heavy fuel oil to use as paint -- it's red! -- and Cindy the SKULL has a paintbrush. This is on.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB09.polish: Masz już ciężki olej napędowy do wykorzystania jako farbę – czerwoną! – a Cindy CZACHA ma pędzel. Zróbmy to.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001DB09.belarusian: У цябе ўжо ёсць дызельнае паліва, якое можна выкарыстаць замест фарбы — яно чырвонае! — а ў Сіндзі ЧЭРАП ёсць пэндзаль. Пачынаем.

Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002900.english: A stone like any other, lying in a whorl of sleet and mud. Maybe there's something under it?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002900.polish: Kamień jak każdy inny. Leży na kupie śniegu i błota. Może coś pod nim jest?
Dialogue Text/0x0100004000002900.belarusian: Звычайны камень, што ляжыць у віры са слякоты і бруду. Можа, пад ім нешта ёсць?

Dialogue Text/0x010000400000291C.english: There's a key beneath it, rusty from the dirt.
Dialogue Text/0x010000400000291C.polish: Pod spodem leży zardzewiały od błota klucz.
Dialogue Text/0x010000400000291C.belarusian: Пад ім ляжыць ключ, заржавелы ад бруду.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F148.english: "This must be for the front door. Pity it doesn't have the apartment number on it. This building has many apartments and the man can be in any of them..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F148.polish: „To musi być klucz do drzwi wejściowych. Szkoda, że nie ma na nim numeru mieszkania. W tym budynku jest wiele apartamentów, a ten mężczyzna może mieszkać w każdym z nich...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F148.belarusian: "Гэта, мусіць, ад уваходных дзвярэй. Шкада, што на ім няма нумара кватэры. У гэтым будынку шмат кватэр, і той чалавек можа быць у любой з іх..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F14D.english: Looks like it could belong to the building's front door.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F14D.polish: Zdaje się, że może otwierać drzwi wejściowe budynku.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F14D.belarusian: Падобна, што ён ад уваходных дзвярэй будынка.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001638C.english: "How are we going to find the right one?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016771.english: "This must be for the front door. Let's see if it works."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016771.polish: „To musi być klucz do drzwi wejściowych. Sprawdźmy, czy zadziała”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016771.belarusian: "Гэта, мусіць, ад уваходных дзвярэй. Давайце праверым, ці падыдзе ён."

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001677B.english: "We'll just have to go in and see."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001677B.polish: „Będziemy musieli wejść do środka i się przekonać”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D05F.english: "Why are you whispering? It sounds like you're *already* in trouble."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D05F.polish: „Czemu szepczesz? Brzmi to, jakbyś *już* miał kłopoty”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D05F.belarusian: "Чаму ты шэпчаш? Гучыць так, нібы ў цябе *ўжо* непрыемнасці".

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D078.english: "There's no trouble, I'm just speaking in a *lowered voice*," he says sotto voce.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D078.polish: „Nie mam żadnych kłopotów. Po prostu mówię *cicho*” – stwierdza sotto voce.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D078.belarusian: "Ніякіх непрыемнасцяў няма, я проста гавару *пацішэлым голасам*", — кажа ён sotto voce.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D089.english: "Actually, the police *really* needs to talk to you."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D089.polish: „Prawdę mówiąc, policja *naprawdę* musi z tobą porozmawiać”.

Alternate1/0x010000570000D089.polish: „Prawdę mówiąc, żandarmeria *naprawdę* musi z tobą porozmawiać”.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D090.english: "I don't want to be seen talking to the *gendarmerie*, if that's okay. I just want to finish my cigarette."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D090.polish: „Nie chcę, aby widziano, jak rozmawiam z *żandarmerią*. Chcę po prostu dokończyć mojego papierosa”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D090.belarusian: "Я б не хацеў, каб мяне бачылі за размовай з *жандармерыяй*, калі ласка. Я проста хачу дакурыць сваю папяросу".

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0A6.english: "We will remove the body as soon as possible. Now tell us, where were you last Sunday?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0A6.polish: „Usuniemy zwłoki tak szybko, jak to tylko możliwe. Proszę powiedzieć, gdzie był pan w zeszłą niedzielę?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0A6.belarusian: "Мы прыбяром цела як мага хутчэй. А зараз скажыце, дзе вы былі ў мінулую нядзелю?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0B8.english: "Looks like you've got a good view of the Whirling's backyard. Can you tell me anything about the hanging?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0B8.polish: „Zdaje się, że masz stąd dobry widok na podwórze Whirling. Możesz mi coś powiedzieć o wieszaniu?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0B8.belarusian: "Здаецца, адсюль выдатна відаць задні двор Whirling. Можаш расказаць што-небудзь пра павешанага?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0C2.english: "Oh..." He waves lazily with his cigarette. "You already asked me that, didn't you?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0C2.polish: „Och...” – macha leniwie dłonią z papierosem. „Już mnie o to pytaliście, prawda?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0C2.belarusian: "Ох..." Ён ляніва махае папяросай. "Вы ж у мяне гэта ўжо пыталіся, ці не так?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0C9.english: Wait, is someone else investigating the lynching?
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0C9.polish: Chwila. Ktoś inny też zajmuje się sprawą linczu?
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0C9.belarusian: Чакай, нехта яшчэ расследуе гэты самасуд?

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0DD.english: "No, not you." He gestures idly. "Some more *muscular* type."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0DD.polish: „Nie, nie ty” – odpowiada, gestykulując leniwie. „Jakiś bardziej *muskularny* facet”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0DD.belarusian: "Не, не вы". Ён ляніва жэстыкулюе. "Нейкі больш *мускулісты* тып".

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0EA.english: "And when did you speak to this more *muscular* gentleman?" The lieutenant takes out his little blue notebook and writes something down.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0EA.polish: „Kiedy rozmawiał pan z tym bardziej *muskularnym* dżentelmenem?” – pyta porucznik, wyjmując swój notatnik i zapisując w nim coś.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0EA.belarusian: "І калі вы размаўлялі з гэтым больш *мускулістым* джэнтльменам?" Лейтэнант дастае свой маленькі блакітны нататнік і нешта запісвае.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0F8.english: He's deflecting. He's young, with a sharp memory. He hasn't had time to drown it in booze and chemicals.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0F8.polish: Unika odpowiedzi. Jest młody, ma dobrą pamięć. Nie miał czasu utopić jej w alkoholu i chemii.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000D0F8.belarusian: Ён ухіляецца ад адказу. Ён малады, з вострай памяццю. Ён яшчэ не паспеў утапіць яе ў пойле і хімікатах.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EDC7.english: It's the God of Cigarettes and Youth -- ask him if he's got anything to spare.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EDC7.polish: To bóg papierosów i młodości. Spytaj, czy nie może się nimi podzielić.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EDC7.belarusian: Гэта Бог Папярос і Маладосці — папрасі ў яго закурыць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EDDD.english: By god, this young man has the body of a *decathlete*. His lithe form was practically made for vaulting over the high bar!
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EDDD.polish: Boże, ten młody człowiek ma ciało *dziesięcioboisty*. Jego gibkie kształty są niczym stworzone do skoku wzwyż!
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EDDD.belarusian: Божа, ды ў гэтага хлопца цела *дзесяціборца*. Ягоная гнуткая фігура практычна створаная для скачкоў праз планку!

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EDE2.english: There's something about the way he carries himself... Something enviable, mysterious, attractive...
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EDE2.polish: Jest coś niezwykłego w jego sposobie bycia. Coś godnego zazdrości, tajemniczego, atrakcyjnego...
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EDE2.belarusian: Ёсць нешта асаблівае ў тым, як ён трымаецца... Нешта вартае зайздрасці, таямнічае, прывабнае...

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EDF8.english: "Hold on... Can I at least have a cigarette?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EDFF.english: "Apologies, but this is my last one." He takes another drag and shivers.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EDFF.polish: „Przykro mi, ale to mój ostatni” – odpowiada, po czym zaciąga się dymem i wzdryga.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EDFF.belarusian: "Прабачце, але гэта мая апошняя". Ён робіць яшчэ адну зацяжку і дрыжыць ад холаду.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE06.english: "No problem. We'll talk more next time." [Leave.]
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE06.polish: „Nie ma sprawy. Porozmawiamy więcej następnym razem”. [Odejdź].

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE0F.english: Like a nervous cat, he keeps stealing looks at the neighbouring windows.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE0F.polish: Niczym nerwowy kot stale rzuca spojrzenia w okna sąsiadów.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE0F.belarusian: Як спалоханы кот, ён увесь час коса пазірае на суседнія вокны.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE1A.english: "I can *tell* that you finally got him down. Thank you -- it was quite a disturbing sight, even by Martinaise standards."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE1A.polish: „Mogę *powiedzieć*, że wreszcie zdjęliście go z tego drzewa. Dziękuję – to był niepokojący widok, nawet jak na standardy panujące w Martinaise”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE1A.belarusian: "Я магу *сказаць*, што вы нарэшце знялі яго адтуль. Дзякуй — гэта было даволі вусцішнае відовішча нават па мерках Марцінэза".

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE27.polish: „Czym zajmował się pan w zeszłą niedzielę?”

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE5B.english: "You didn't answer the question. What were you doing last Sunday?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE5B.polish: „Nie odpowiedział pan na pytanie. Czym zajmował się pan w zeszłą niedzielę?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE5B.belarusian: "Вы не адказалі на пытанне. Што вы рабілі ў мінулую нядзелю?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE63.english: "You still haven't answered my question. What were you doing last Sunday?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE63.polish: „Wciąż nie odpowiedziałeś na moje pytanie. Co robiłeś w ostatnią niedzielę?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE63.belarusian: "Ты ўсё яшчэ не адказаў на маё пытанне. Што ты рабіў у мінулую нядзелю?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE6A.english: He sighs. "I had a friend over."

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE87.english: Makes sense. Friends are nice on Sunday. You don't have to work, you can just spend time with pals, watching rugby and drinking beer.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE87.polish: Ma to sens. Przyjaciele w niedzielę to miła rzecz. Nie trzeba pracować i można spędzać czas ze znajomkami, oglądać rugby i pić piwo.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE87.belarusian: Лагічна. Сябры ў нядзелю — гэта цудоўна. Працаваць не трэба, можна проста бавіць час з прыяцелямі, глядзець рэгбі і піць піва.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE9C.english: He doesn't reply, gesturing 'no' with his cigarette. Under the dull and darkening sky the neighbouring windows stand silent.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE9C.polish: Nie odpowiada, wykonuje tylko przeczący gest dłonią z papierosem. Sąsiednie okna milczą pod ciemniejącym niebem.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EE9C.belarusian: Ён не адказвае, адмаўляючы жэстам рукі з папяросай. Пад цьмяным небам, якое ўсё больш цямнее, суседнія вокны маўчаць.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EEB2.english: "My name? My name is Martin Martinaise."

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EEBF.english: That's definitely not his real name.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EEBF.polish: To ewidentnie nie jest jego prawdziwe imię.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EEBF.belarusian: Гэта дакладна не ягонае сапраўднае імя.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EECD.english: "You're not actually called Martin Martinaise, are you?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EECD.polish: „Nie nazywasz się tak naprawdę Martin Martinaise, prawda?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EECD.belarusian: "Цябе ж насамрэч завуць не Марцін Марцінэз, так?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EEDC.english: "No, of course not. Could you please lower your voice?" He scans the courtyard. It's silent like the bottom of a well, every sound captured and reflected back.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EEDC.polish: „Nie, oczywiście, że nie. Czy możesz mówić trochę ciszej?” – prosi, przeczesując wzrokiem dziedziniec. Panuje tu cisza jak na dnie studni – każdy dźwięk jest przechwytywany i wzmacniany.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EEDC.belarusian: "Не, вядома, не. Можаце гаварыць крыху цішэй?" Ён азірае двор. Тут ціха, нібы на дне калодзежа — кожны гук улоўліваецца і рэхам адбіваецца назад.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EEFE.english: "And I *really* need to finish this cigarette," he replies with a subtle smile.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EEFE.polish: „A ja *naprawdę* muszę dokończyć tego papierosa” – odpowiada z delikatnym uśmieszkiem.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EEFE.belarusian: "А мне *сапраўды* трэба дакурыць гэтую папяросу", — адказвае ён з ледзь заўважнай усмешкай.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF14.english: "I couldn't tell you," he says, exhaling a little puff of smoke. "We don't usually see much of the *gendarmerie* around here."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF14.polish: „Trudno powiedzieć” – stwierdza, wypuszczając z ust obłoczek dymu. „Rzadko widujemy tu *żandarmerię*”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF14.belarusian: "Не магу сказаць", — гаворыць ён, выпускаючы лёгкі клубок дыму. — "Мы тут не часта бачым *жандармерыю* ".

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF1C.english: "Occasionally." He takes another drag, filling his lungs with nicotine. "Why?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF1C.polish: „Czasami” – znowu zaciąga się dymem, wypełniając płuca nikotyną. „Dlaczego pytasz?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF1C.belarusian: "Часам". Ён робіць яшчэ адну зацяжку, напаўняючы лёгкія нікацінам. "А што?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF29.english: "Nothing. You should give up smoking, son. It's not good for your health."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF29.polish: „Tak po prostu. Powinieneś rzucić palenie, synu. Nie służy zdrowiu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF29.belarusian: "Нічога такога. Кідаў бы ты курыць, сынок. Гэта шкодна для здароўя".

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF30.english: "No, I just like to look good." A light breeze pulls back a flap of shirt.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF30.polish: „Nie, po prostu lubię dobrze wyglądać” – delikatny powiew wiatru rozchyla poły jego koszuli.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF30.belarusian: "Не, я проста люблю добра выглядаць". Лёгкі ветрык адхінае полу кашулі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF38.english: "You're right, it's horrible for the skin. Very ageing." He takes another drag, before shaking off the ash.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF38.polish: „Racja, palenie paskudnie działa na cerę. Strasznie postarza” – znowu zaciąga się dymem z papierosa, po czym strząsa popiół.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF38.belarusian: "Вы маеце рацыю, гэта жахліва для скуры. Вельмі старыць". Ён робіць яшчэ адну зацяжку, перш чым страсянуць попел.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF44.english: "A shame. Young man like you, with a body like yours, you'd be a credit to any track team."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF44.polish: „Szkoda. Młody człowiek taki jak ty, z takim ciałem, byłby chlubą każdego klubu”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF44.belarusian: "Шкада. Такі малады чалавек з такім целам стаў бы гонарам для любой лёгкаатлетычнай каманды".

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF5E.english: "Trust me, I'm *not* a team player," he says with a honeyed smile.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF5E.polish: „Zapewniam, że *nie* jestem graczem zespołowym” – odpowiada ze słodkim uśmiechem.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF5E.belarusian: "Паверце, я *не* камандны гулец", — кажа ён з салодкай усмешкай.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF6C.english: "No, we won't." He takes one last drag of his cigarette, before stubbing it out on the balcony.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF6C.polish: „Nie, nie porozmawiamy” – zaciąga się po raz ostatni dymem, po czym gasi niedopałek o poręcz balkonu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF6C.belarusian: "Не, не пагаворым". Ён робіць апошнюю зацяжку і тушыць папяросу аб парэнчы балкона.

Alternate1/0x010000570000EF6C.polish: „Nie, nie porozmawiamy” – zaciąga się po raz ostatni dymem, po czym gasi z sykiem niedopałek w śniegu zalegającym na poręczy balkonu.
Alternate1/0x010000570000EF6C.belarusian: "Не, не пагаворым". Ён робіць апошнюю зацяжку і з ціхім шыпеннем тушыць папяросу аб заснежаныя парэнчы балкона.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF96.english: This isn't the place or time for questions: Who knows who might be watching from the distance, hidden behind the curtains.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF96.polish: To nie miejsce ani czas na pytania. Kto wie, kto może przyglądać wam się z daleka, kryjąc twarz za zasłonką?
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF96.belarusian: Цяпер не месца і не час для распытванняў: хто ведае, хто можа назіраць здалёк, схаваўшыся за фіранкамі.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF9D.english: For a moment the man on the balcony seems almost vulnerable. Something moves in the depths of his feline eyes: compassion, and a hint of understanding.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF9D.polish: Przez chwilę mężczyzna na balkonie sprawia wrażenie niemal bezbronnego. W jego kocich oczach nagle coś się pojawia – to współczucie i odrobina zrozumienia.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EF9D.belarusian: На імгненне мужчына на балконе здаецца амаль безабаронным. Нешта варушыцца ў глыбіні ягоных каціных вачэй: спачуванне і цень разумення.

Alternate1/0x010000570000EF9D.polish: Przez chwilę mężczyzna na balkonie sprawia wrażenie niemal bezbronnego. W jego kocich oczach nagle coś się pojawia – to współczucie i odrobina zrozumienia. Na jego włosach i ramionach gromadzą się płatki śniegu, białe drobinki na tle fioletowego materiału upiętego na jego smukłym ciele.
Alternate1/0x010000570000EF9D.belarusian: На імгненне мужчына на балконе здаецца амаль безабаронным. Нешта варушыцца ў глыбіні ягоных каціных вачэй: спачуванне і цень разумення. Снег асядае на ягоных валасах і плячах, бялеючы на фоне пурпуровай тканіны, што вольна спадае з ягонага стройнага цела.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EFB2.english: "Good luck with the investigation." He walks away.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EFB2.polish: „Powodzenia w śledztwie” – rzuca, po czym odchodzi.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EFC1.english: Martin Martinaise? Good local name. Let's go with that.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EFC1.polish: Martin Martinaise? Porządne, miejscowe nazwisko. Niech i będzie.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EFC1.belarusian: Марцін Марцінэз? Добрае мясцовае імя. Няхай будзе так.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EFD5.english: Not that he has to worry about getting old yet -- he's sparkling with youth, a radiant demi-god.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EFD5.polish: Nie żeby musiał się już martwić starzeniem się. Aż kipi młodością niczym świetlisty półbóg.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000EFD5.belarusian: Не тое каб яму ўжо трэба было турбавацца пра старасць — ён зіхаціць маладосцю, прамяністы паўбог.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F064.english: "He's gone." The lieutenant puts away his notebook and turns to you.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F064.polish: „Zniknął” – porucznik chowa swój notatnik i odwraca się w twoim kierunku.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F064.belarusian: "Ён сышоў". Лейтэнант хавае нататнік і паварочваецца да цябе.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F070.english: "We should run after him, see where he went!"
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F070.polish: „Powinniśmy za nim biec, zobaczyć, gdzie się udał!”
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F070.belarusian: "Трэба бегчы за ім, паглядзець, куды ён пайшоў!"

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F078.english: "No point in running. Tenements like these often have multiple exits. If he doesn't want to talk to us, then he'll know how to hide himself."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F078.polish: „Pościg jest bezcelowy. Kamienice tego typu często mają wiele wyjść. Jeśli nie chce z nami rozmawiać, to bez trudu się przed nami ukryje”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F078.belarusian: "Няма сэнсу бегчы. У такіх прыбытковых дамах часта шмат выхадаў. Калі ён не хоча з намі гаварыць, то знойдзе спосаб схавацца".

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F085.english: "You're right, he probably didn't have anything important to say anyway."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F085.polish: „Masz rację. Pewnie i tak nie miał nic ważnego do powiedzenia”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F085.belarusian: "Твая праўда, наўрад ці ён мог сказаць нешта важнае".

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F093.english: "He could be a witness, him or his *Sunday friend*. Either way we need to look into that *muscular type* who's asking about our case..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F093.polish: „On może być świadkiem – on albo jego *niedzielny przyjaciel*. Tak czy inaczej, musimy dowiedzieć się więcej o tym *muskularnym facecie*, który wypytywał o naszą sprawę...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F093.belarusian: "Ён можа быць сведкам — ён альбо ягоны *нядзельны сябра*. Так ці інакш, нам варта даведацца больш пра таго *мускулістага тыпа*, які распытваў пра нашу справу..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0AE.english: "He could be a witness, him or his *Sunday friend*. It's worth looking into..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0AE.polish: „On może być świadkiem – on albo jego *niedzielny przyjaciel*. Warto się temu przyjrzeć...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0AE.belarusian: "Ён можа быць сведкам — ён альбо ягоны *нядзельны сябра*. Варта праверыць..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0B4.english: "He could be a witness. And either way we need to look into that *muscular type* who's asking about our case..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0B4.polish: „On może być świadkiem. Poza tym, tak czy inaczej, musimy dowiedzieć się więcej o tym *muskularnym facecie*, który wypytywał o naszą sprawę...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0B4.belarusian: "Ён можа быць сведкам. І ў любым выпадку нам трэба высветліць усё пра таго *мускулістага тыпа*, які распытваў пра нашу справу..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0BA.english: "He could be a witness. We shouldn't rule out the possibility..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0BA.polish: „On może być świadkiem. Nie powinniśmy wykluczać tej możliwości...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0BA.belarusian: "Ён можа быць сведкам. Не варта выключаць такую магчымасць..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0D2.english: "There has to be a way of getting inside the building. Once we've found the way in, we can ask around for his apartment."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0D2.polish: „Musi być jakiś sposób na dostanie się do budynku. Jak już wejdziemy do środka, popytamy o jego mieszkanie”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0D2.belarusian: "Павінен быць спосаб патрапіць усярэдзіну дома. Калі знойдзем уваход, зможам распытаць пра ягоную кватэру".

Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0D7.english: "He did leave us a sign, did you see that? He wanted to draw our attention to that stone right over there." The lieutenant nods towards a small rock on a soggy patch of grass.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0D7.polish: „Na odchodnym dał nam znak, zauważyłeś? Chciał zwrócić naszą uwagę na tamten kamień” – porucznik wskazuje kiwnięciem głowy mały kamień leżący na niewielkim skrawku wilgotnego trawnika.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570000F0D7.belarusian: "Ён пакінуў нам знак, вы бачылі? Ён хацеў звярнуць нашу ўвагу на вунь той камень". Лейтэнант ківае ў бок невялікага каменя на мокрай лапіне травы.

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000157A2.english: "What's your friend's real name? Did he see something?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000157A2.polish: „Jak się naprawdę nazywa twój przyjaciel? Widział coś?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000157A2.belarusian: "Як сапраўднае імя твайго сябра? Ён нешта бачыў?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000057000157AC.english: "If we find a way inside the building, we can ask around for his apartment."
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000157AC.polish: „Jeśli znajdziemy sposób na dostanie się do budynku, to będziemy mogli popytać o jego mieszkanie”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000057000157AC.belarusian: "Калі знойдзем уваход у будынак, зможам распытаць пра ягоную кватэру".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016782.english: Time to bring out your secret charm: tears and begging! Show him your *emotional* side, throw yourself before his very feet like a dog!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016782.polish: Czas użyć twojej tajnej broni: łez i błagań! Pokaż mu swoją *emocjonalność*, rzuć mu się do stóp niczym pies!
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700016782.belarusian: Час выкарыстаць сваю таемную зброю: слёзы і маленні! Пакажы яму свой *эмацыйны* бок, кінься да яго ног, як сабака!

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023AEF.english: "Is it really that important?" he asks you, adjusting his shirt.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023AEF.polish: „Czy to naprawdę takie ważne?” – pyta, poprawiając swoją koszulę.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023AEF.belarusian: "Гэта сапраўды настолькі важна?" — пытаецца ён, папраўляючы кашулю.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002EFA.english: "No trouble from me, I just want to know what's going on here."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002EFA.polish: „Nie zamierzam ci ich przysparzać. Chcę tylko wiedzieć, co się tu dzieje”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002EFA.belarusian: "Ад мяне ніякіх непрыемнасцяў, я проста хачу даведацца, што тут адбываецца".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F00.english: "Too late, young man. Trouble's found you."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F00.polish: „Za późno, młody człowieku. Kłopoty znalazły ciebie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F00.belarusian: "Занадта позна, малады чалавек. Непрыемнасці самі цябе знайшлі".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F10.english: "Sorry, I don't have time for this. I just want to finish my cigarette and be gone."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F10.polish: „Przepraszam, ale nie mam na to czasu. Chcę tylko dokończyć papierosa i już mnie nie ma”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F10.belarusian: "Прабачце, у мяне няма на гэта часу. Я проста хачу дакурыць папяросу і пайсці".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F23.english: "Can't you just like, toss that one down?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F23.polish: „Nie możesz po prostu go rzucić na ziemię?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F23.belarusian: "А ты не можаш проста скінуць яе ўніз?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F31.english: "I'm not sure that's a good idea."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F31.polish: „Nie sądzę, aby to był dobry pomysł”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F38.english: "Absolution? I don't know that brand, but I'm pretty sure you can get Astras at the Frittte."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F38.polish: „Rozgrzeszenia? Nie znam tej marki, ale we Frittte na pewno sprzedają Astry”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F38.belarusian: "Адпушчэнне? Не ведаю такой маркі, але я амаль упэўнены, што ў Frittte можна купіць Астру".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F46.english: "You're right, that was obviously a bad idea. Forget I said anything."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F46.polish: „Masz rację, to był zdecydowanie zły pomysł. Zapomnij, że o tym wspominałem”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F46.belarusian: "Ты маеш рацыю, гэта відавочна была дрэнная ідэя. Забудзь, што я нешта казаў".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F4E.english: There's no way you'd catch that cigarette anyway.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F4E.polish: I tak nie miałbyś szans złapać tego papierosa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F4E.belarusian: Ты б усё адно ніяк не злавіў гэтую папяросу.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F62.english: Yes, really. Don't even try. You'll just embarrass yourself.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F62.polish: Tak, naprawdę. Nawet nie próbuj. Tylko się ośmieszysz.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F62.belarusian: Так, сапраўды. Нават не спрабуй. Толькі зганьбішся.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F6A.english: "As you wish." He takes another drag.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F6A.polish: „Jak sobie życzysz” – znowu zaciąga się papierosowym dymem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F6A.belarusian: "Як пажадаеце". Ён робіць яшчэ адну зацяжку.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F88.english: Ah, there it goes -- *wasted*! You would have gotten at least a few good drags out of it.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F88.polish: No i już. *Zmarnowany*! A było w nim jeszcze dobrych kilka buchów.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000002F88.belarusian: Вось і ўсё — *змарнаваў*! А можна было б зрабіць хаця б пару добрых зацяжак.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023C6F.english: "Not looking for any trouble, officer..." he says in a quiet voice. Despite the cold, his shirt hangs unbuttoned on his frame.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023C6F.polish: „Nie szukam kłopotów, żandarmie...” – oznajmia cichym głosem. Mimo niskiej temperatury jego koszula jest rozpięta.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023C6F.belarusian: "Я не шукаю непрыемнасцяў, афіцэр..." — ціха кажа ён. Нягледзячы на холад, кашуля на ім вісіць расшпіленай.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023C79.english: "You hiding something? Speak up, this is the police."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023C79.polish: „Ukrywasz coś? Mów głośniej, rozmawiasz z policją”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023C79.belarusian: "Ты нешта хаваеш? Гавары гучней, гэта паліцыя".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023C85.english: It's the voice of someone who has something to *hide* my liege.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023C85.polish: To głos kogoś, kto ma coś do *ukrycia*, miłościwy panie.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023C85.belarusian: Гэта голас чалавека, які мае што *схаваць*, мой спадару.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CBD.english: The God Himself has denied you absolution.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CBD.belarusian: Сам Бог адмовіў табе ў адпушчэнні грахоў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CCB.english: "I get it. Nothing wrong with looking good."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CCB.polish: „Rozumiem. Nie ma nic złego w wyglądaniu dobrze”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CCB.belarusian: "Разумею. Няма нічога благога ў тым, каб добра выглядаць".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CD2.english: He gives you a honeyed smile, before shaking off the cigarette ash.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CD2.polish: Uśmiecha się do ciebie słodko, po czym strząsa popiół z papierosa.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CD2.belarusian: Ён дорыць табе салодкую ўсмешку, перш чым страсянуць попел з папяросы.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CDD.english: "I'd even go so far as to say that the view is a little *too good*, my dear gendarme. Do you have an estimate of when the body will be taken away?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CDD.polish: „Powiedziałbym nawet, że ten widok jest odrobinę *zbyt dobry*, drogi żandarmie. Wiadomo już, kiedy zwłoki zostaną zdjęte z drzewa?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CDD.belarusian: "Я б нават сказаў, што адсюль адкрываецца *занадта* добры від, дарагі жандар. Вы прыкладна ведаеце, калі прыбяруць цела?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CEF.english: A downy blanket of white to cover up the miserable poverty of the scene.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CEF.polish: Puchaty, biały dywan zasłaniający przerażającą biedę okolicy.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CEF.belarusian: Пуховая белая коўдра, што хавае жаласную галечу гэтага двара.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CFF.english: "No, not you two." He gestures idly. "Some more *muscular* type."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CFF.polish: „Nie, nie wasza dwójka” – odpowiada, gestykulując leniwie. „Jakiś bardziej *muskularny* facet”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023CFF.belarusian: "Не, не вы ўдваіх". Ён ляніва жэстыкулюе. "Нейкі больш *мускулісты* тып".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023D10.english: "Alright, but make it quick. Once I finish this cigarette I have to run."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023D10.polish: „W porządku, ale nie przeciągajmy. Muszę lecieć, jak tylko skończę tego papierosa”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023D10.belarusian: "Добра, але хутка. Як толькі дакуру гэтую папяросу, мне трэба бегчы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023E93.english: You see a young man on a balcony nursing a cigarette. His eyes have been following you for a while.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023E93.polish: Na balkonie widzisz młodego mężczyznę z zapalonym papierosem. Wodzi za tobą oczami od jakiegoś już czasu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023E93.belarusian: На балконе ты бачыш маладога чалавека з запаленай папяросай. Ён ужо пэўны час сочыць за табой позіркам.

Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023EA6.english: "There won't *be* a next time." He takes a last drag of his cigarette, before stubbing it out in the balcony snow. "I really need to get going."
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023EA6.polish: „Nie *będzie* następnego razu” – zaciąga się po raz ostatni dymem, po czym gasi niedopałek o śnieg zgromadzony na balkonie. „Naprawdę muszę już iść”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100005700023EA6.belarusian: "Наступнага разу *не будзе*". Ён робіць апошнюю зацяжку, а потым тушыць папяросу аб снег на балконе. "Мне сапраўды трэба ісці".

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059D4.english: "Last week? I don't know, look..." He looks around the courtyard again. Snow blankets the old patio chairs and dead house plants, and all the neighbouring windows are black.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059D4.polish: „W zeszłym tygodniu? Sam nie wiem...” – znowu rozgląda się po dziedzińcu. Śnieg pokrywa stare meble tarasowe i martwe rośliny doniczkowe, a wszystkie sąsiednie okna są pogrążone w ciemności.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059D4.belarusian: "На мінулым тыдні? Не ведаю, паглядзіце самі..." Ён зноў азірае двор. Снег пакрывае старыя крэслы на тэрасе і мёртвыя пакаёвыя расліны, а ўсе суседнія вокны цёмныя.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059DC.english: "Last week? I don't know, look..." He looks around the courtyard again. Rain patters on the window sills and dead house plants, too late to do them any good.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059DC.polish: „W zeszłym tygodniu? Sam nie wiem...” – znowu rozgląda się po dziedzińcu. Krople deszczu bębnią w parapety okien i doniczki z martwymi roślinami – zbyt późno, by jakkolwiek im pomóc.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059DC.belarusian: "На мінулым тыдні? Не ведаю, паглядзіце самі..." Ён зноў азірае двор. Дождж грукае па падваконніках і мёртвых пакаёвых раслінах — занадта позна, каб хоць нечым ім дапамагчы.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059E3.english: "Last week? I don't know, look..." He looks around the courtyard again. Old patio chairs and dead house plants litter the scene.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059E3.polish: „W zeszłym tygodniu? Sam nie wiem...” – znowu rozgląda się po dziedzińcu. Stare meble tarasowe i martwe rośliny doniczkowe urozmaicają widok.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059E3.belarusian: "На мінулым тыдні? Не ведаю, паглядзіце самі..." Ён зноў азірае двор. Навокал валяюцца старыя крэслы для тэрасы і мёртвыя пакаёвыя расліны.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059EA.english: It'll take more than rain to bring this place back to life.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059EA.polish: Deszcz nie wystarczy, by na nowo tchnąć w to miejsce życie.
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059EA.belarusian: Спатрэбіцца нешта большае, чым дождж, каб вярнуць гэтае месца да жыцця.

Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059F3.english: He's an actor declaiming a soliloquy. See how you hang on his every word?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059F3.polish: Jest niczym deklamujący monolog aktor. Widzisz, jak spijasz słowa z jego ust?
Dialogue Text/0x01000070000059F3.belarusian: Ён акцёр, які дэкламуе маналог. Бачыш, як ты ловіш кожнае ягонае слова?

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A14.english: He doesn't reply, gesturing 'no' with his cigarette. Under the grey sky the neighbouring windows are streaked with rain.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A14.polish: Nie odpowiada, wykonuje tylko przeczący gest dłonią z papierosem. Sąsiednie okna spływają deszczem pod szarym niebem.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A14.belarusian: Ён не адказвае, адмаўляючы жэстам рукі з папяросай. Пад шэрым небам шыбы суседніх вокнаў залітыя дажджом.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A23.english: He doesn't reply, gesturing 'no' with his cigarette. Under the grey sky snow continues to pile on the neighbouring window sills.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A23.polish: Nie odpowiada, wykonuje tylko przeczący gest dłonią z papierosem. Pod szarym niebem śnieg piętrzy się na parapetach sąsiednich okien.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A23.belarusian: Ён не адказвае, адмаўляючы жэстам рукі з папяросай. Пад шэрым небам снег працягвае сыпацца на суседнія падваконнікі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A38.english: He doesn't reply, gesturing 'no' with his cigarette. In the neighbouring windows you can see faint reflections of his silhouette, all from different angles.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A38.polish: Nie odpowiada, wykonuje tylko przeczący gest dłonią z papierosem. W szybach sąsiednich okien widzisz jego niewyraźne odbicia uchwycone z najróżniejszych kątów.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A38.belarusian: Ён не адказвае, адмаўляючы жэстам рукі з папяросай. У шыбах суседніх вокнаў відаць бляклыя адбіткі ягонага сілуэта з самых розных ракурсаў.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A3F.english: Someone hides behind a curtain: those windows have eyes and those eyes are watching, spying on you two.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A3F.polish: Ktoś ukrywa się za zasłonką. Te okna mają oczy i obserwują. Szpiegują was.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A3F.belarusian: Нехта хаваецца за фіранкай: у тых вокнаў ёсць вочы, і гэтыя вочы назіраюць, шпіёняць за вамі дваімі.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A4F.english: "Now, if you'll excuse me, I really need to get going."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A4F.polish: „Przepraszam, ale naprawdę muszę się już zbierać”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A4F.belarusian: "А цяпер прабачце, мне сапраўды пара ісці".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A5B.english: "Hey, listen..." (Lower your voice.) "I am just trying to make things okay again. Can we meet again somewhere else?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A5B.polish: „Hej, posłuchaj...” (Ścisz głos). „Próbuję tylko wszystko tu ponaprawiać. Możemy się spotkać gdzie indziej?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007000005A5B.belarusian: "Гэй, паслухай..." (Знізіць голас.) "Я проста спрабую ўсё выправіць. Можам сустрэцца дзе-небудзь у іншым месцы?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001C76.english: "I am sorry, but I really don't have the information you're looking for." His voice is soft and deliberate. With a flick of his wrist, he sends the cigarette butt sailing over the rail...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001C76.polish: „Przepraszam, ale naprawdę nie mam informacji, których szukasz, żandarmie” – jego głos jest miękki, a słowa przemyślane. Szybkim ruchem nadgarstka posyła niedopałek papierosa za balustradę balkonu...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001C76.belarusian: "Мне вельмі шкада, але я праўда не маю інфармацыі, якую вы шукаеце". Ягоны голас мяккі і разважлівы. Лоўкім рухам запясця ён пускае недакурак ляцець цераз парэнчы...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001C7C.english: But hold on, what's that? For a split second his hand lingers... as though gesturing towards a stone placed right next to the front door...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001C7C.polish: Ale chwila... Co to było? Przez ułamek sekundy jego dłoń zawisła w powietrzu... Jakby wskazywała kamień leżący tuż przy frontowych drzwiach...
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001C7C.belarusian: Але пачакай, што гэта? На долю секунды ягоная рука затрымліваецца... нібы паказваючы на камень проста каля ўваходных дзвярэй...

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001C95.english: "Please don't go! I'll stop drinking, I'll... take the trash out, just... please don't leave me."
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001C95.polish: „Proszę, nie odchodź! Przestanę pić i... wyrzucę śmieci, tylko... nie zostawiaj mnie, proszę”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001C95.belarusian: "Калі ласка, не сыходзь! Я кіну піць, я... вынесу смецце, толькі... калі ласка, не кідай мяне".

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001C9C.english: "What do you want from me? Do you want me to *cry*?! Huh?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001C9C.polish: „Czego ty ode mnie chcesz? Żebym się *rozpłakał*?! Hm?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001C9C.belarusian: "Чаго ты ад мяне хочаш? Хочаш, каб я *расплакаўся*?! Га?"

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001CBA.english: "Listen, I really have to go." With a flick of his wrist he sends the extinguished cigarette sailing over the rail.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001CBA.polish: „Naprawdę muszę się już zbierać” – szybkim ruchem nadgarstka posyła zgaszony niedopałek papierosa za balustradę balkonu.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001CBA.belarusian: "Слухайце, мне сапраўды пара". Лоўкім рухам запясця ён перакідае патушаны бычок праз парэнчы балкона.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001CC0.english: "No, for god's sake, I don't want you to cry!" He takes a quick step back and looks around, clearly disturbed.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001CC0.polish: „Nie, na litość boską, nie chcę, abyś płakał, żandarmie!” – cofa się o krok i rozgląda wokoło, wyraźnie zaniepokojony.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001CC0.belarusian: "Не, дзеля ўсяго святога, я не хачу, каб вы плакалі!" Ён хутка адступае на крок назад і азіраецца, відавочна ўстрывожаны.

Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001CC8.english: "*Trash*?" The young man shakes his head in confusion.
Dialogue Text/0x0100007500001CC8.polish: „*Śmieci*?” – młody człowiek kręci głową, wyraźnie zdezorientowany.

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000037EC.english: "I need to get inside this apartment building. Can you help me?"
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000037EC.polish: „Muszę dostać się do tego apartamentowca. Możesz mi pomóc?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000037EC.belarusian: "Мне трэба патрапіць у гэты жылы дом. Можаш дапамагчы?"

Dialogue Text/0x01000075000037F2.english: "Help you? No, sorry, gendarme..." He shakes his charming head. "I have to run."
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000037F2.polish: „Czy mogę pomóc? Przykro mi, żandarmie, ale nie...” – odpowiada, kręcąc swoją czarującą głową. „Muszę się już zbierać”.
Dialogue Text/0x01000075000037F2.belarusian: "Дапамагчы вам? Не, прабачце, жандар..." Ён круціць сваёй чароўнай галавой. "Мне трэба бегчы".

Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000117.english: Don't let him go! This could be your witness -- the balcony has a great view of the whole thing.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000117.polish: Nie pozwól mu odejść! To może być twój świadek. Z balkonu był wspaniały widok na wszystko.
Dialogue Text/0x0100009200000117.belarusian: Не адпускай яго! Ён можа быць тваім сведкам — з балкона ўсё відаць як на далоні.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002CB1.english: Someone hides behind a curtain: those windows have eyes and those eyes are watching, spying on you three.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002CB1.polish: Ktoś ukrywa się za zasłonką. Te okna mają oczy i obserwują. Szpiegują was.
Dialogue Text/0x0100000500002CB1.belarusian: Нехта хаваецца за фіранкай: у тых вокнаў ёсць вочы, і гэтыя вочы назіраюць, шпіёняць за вамі трыма.

Dialogue Text/0x010000060001B8EC.english: Please don't go, I'll even stop smoking inside.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001B8EC.polish: Proszę, nie odchodź. Przestanę nawet palić w domu.
Dialogue Text/0x010000060001B8EC.belarusian: Калі ласка, не сыходзь, я нават перастану курыць у хаце.

Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002400.english: "There has to be a way of getting inside the building -- let's go check out the door near the pier again. Once we've found the way in, we can ask around for his apartment."
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002400.polish: „Musi być jakiś sposób na dostanie się do budynku – sprawdźmy jeszcze raz drzwi w pobliżu pomostu. Jak już wejdziemy do środka, popytamy o jego mieszkanie”.
Dialogue Text/0x0100002100002400.belarusian: "Павінен быць спосаб патрапіць усярэдзіну дома — давайце яшчэ раз праверым тыя дзверы каля пірса. Калі знойдзем уваход, зможам распытаць пра ягоную кватэру".

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DDD2.english: A stone like any other, lying in a whorl of sleet and mud. Maybe there's something under it?
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DDD2.polish: Kamień jak każdy inny. Leży na kupie śniegu i błota. Może coś pod nim jest?
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DDD2.belarusian: Звычайны камень, які ляжыць у мясіве са слякоты і бруду. Можа, пад ім нешта ёсць?

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DDE7.english: There's a key beneath it, rusty from the dirt.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DDE7.polish: Pod spodem leży zardzewiały od błota klucz.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DDE7.belarusian: Пад ім ляжыць ключ, заржавелы ад бруду.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DDFB.english: "This must be for the front door. Pity it doesn't have the apartment number on it. This building has hundreds of apartments."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DDFB.polish: „To musi być klucz do drzwi wejściowych. Szkoda, że nie ma na nim numeru mieszkania. W tym budynku są setki apartamentów”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DDFB.belarusian: "Гэта, мусіць, ад уваходных дзвярэй. Шкада, што на ім няма нумара кватэры. У гэтым будынку сотні кватэр."

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DE01.english: Looks like it could belong to the building's front door.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DE01.polish: Zdaje się, że może otwierać drzwi wejściowe budynku.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DE01.belarusian: Падобна, што ён ад уваходных дзвярэй будынка.

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DE0D.english: "How are we going to find the right one?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DE1B.english: "This must be for the front door. Let's see if it works."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DE1B.polish: „To musi być klucz do drzwi wejściowych. Sprawdźmy, czy zadziała”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DE1B.belarusian: "Гэта, мусіць, ад уваходных дзвярэй. Паглядзім, ці падыдзе ён."

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DE24.english: "We'll just have to go in and see."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001DE24.polish: „Będziemy musieli wejść do środka i się przekonać”.

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019F02.polish: „Hej, co to za hałas tam na dole?”

Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019F08.english: "It's been a week and now they show up?"
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019F08.polish: „Minął tydzień i dopiero teraz się pojawiają?”
Dialogue Text/0x0100000700019F08.belarusian: "Тыдзень мінуў, і яны толькі цяпер аб'явіліся?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001ABF3.english: "Of course I've thought about quitting but... for what?"
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001ABF3.polish: „Oczywiście, że myślałem o rzuceniu, ale... po co?”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001ABF3.belarusian: "Вядома, я думаў кінуць, але... дзеля чаго?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001ABF9.english: "Not everything that needs to be said, needs to be heard."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001ABF9.polish: „Nie wszystko, co musi zostać powiedziane, musi zostać usłyszane”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001ABF9.belarusian: "Не ўсё, што мусіць быць сказана, мусіць быць пачута."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC0B.english: "Scary how many people don't have *anyone* to talk to."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC0B.polish: „To straszne, jak wiele osób nie ma *nikogo*, z kim mogłyby porozmawiać”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC0B.belarusian: "Страшна, колькі людзей не маюць *нікога*, з кім пагаварыць."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC51.english: "*How* can a bar be out of vermouth?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC57.english: "Can't do it with class? Don't do it at all."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC57.polish: „Nie możesz zrobić czegoś z klasą? To nie rób tego wcale”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC57.belarusian: "Не можаш зрабіць з класам? Не рабі зусім."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC5D.english: "Could I get a refill here, please?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC63.english: "Yes, yes, I'm very attractive. Great, thank you."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC63.polish: „Tak, tak. Jestem bardzo atrakcyjny. Świetnie, dziękuję”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC63.belarusian: "Так, так, я вельмі прывабны. Выдатна, дзякуй."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC6F.english: "Okay, *you* tell me this doesn't taste like shit..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC6F.polish: „No dobra, spróbuj tego i *powiedz* mi, że nie smakuje jak gówno...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC6F.belarusian: "Добра, ну вось *ты* скажы мне, што гэта на смак не як лайно..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC75.english: "Don't even get me started on beauty..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC7B.english: "I'm practically a shrink minus the diploma."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001AC7B.belarusian: "Я практычна псіхатэрапеўт, хіба што без дыплома."

Dialogue Text/0x010000570001D98A.english: "There must be another way into the building."
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001D98A.polish: „Musi być jakiś inny sposób, aby dostać się do budynku”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000570001D98A.belarusian: "Мусіць быць іншы спосаб трапіць у будынак."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A3FB.english: "*How* can a bar be out of vermouth?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A401.english: "Can't do it with class? Don't do it at all."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A401.polish: „Nie możesz zrobić czegoś z klasą? To nie rób tego wcale”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A401.belarusian: "Не можаш зрабіць з класам? Не рабі зусім."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A407.english: "Could I get a refill here, please?"

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A410.english: "Don't even get me started on beauty..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A417.english: "I'm practically a shrink minus the diploma."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A41E.english: "Yes, yes, I'm very attractive. Great, thank you."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A41E.polish: „Tak, tak. Jestem bardzo atrakcyjny. Świetnie, dziękuję”.
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A41E.belarusian: "Так, так, я вельмі прывабны. Выдатна, дзякуй."

Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A425.english: "Okay, *you* tell me this doesn't taste like shit..."
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A425.polish: „No dobra, spróbuj tego i *powiedz* mi, że nie smakuje jak gówno...”
Dialogue Text/0x010000070001A425.belarusian: "Добра, *ты* скажы мне, што гэта на смак не як лайно..."

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001100F.english: The paintbrush in your hand is like a loaded revolver. What will it be, desperado? Quite a few things come to mind...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001100F.polish: Pędzel w twoich rękach jest niczym naładowany rewolwer. Co nim zmalujesz, desperado? Do głowy przychodzi ci niejedno...
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001100F.belarusian: Пэндзаль у тваіх руках як зараджаны рэвальвер. Што ты ім намалюеш, desperado? Даволі шмат чаго прыходзіць да галавы...

Dialogue Text/0x010000040001108F.english: Let the wall remain blank. For now. [Leave.]
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001108F.polish: Niech ściana pozostanie pusta. Przynajmniej na razie. [Odejdź].
Dialogue Text/0x010000040001108F.belarusian: Няхай сцяна застанецца пустой. Пакуль што. [Адысці.]

Dialogue Text/0x01000004000110D1.english: "WHAT SHADOW LIES THERE, BENEATH THE BRIGHT GLEAM"
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000110D1.polish: „JAKI CIEŃ CZAI SIĘ TAM, UKRYTY PRZED WIELKIM BLASKIEM?”
Dialogue Text/0x01000004000110D1.belarusian: "ЯКІ ЦЕНЬ ХАВАЕЦЦА ТАМ, ПАД ЯРКІМ ЗЗЯННЕМ"

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B538.english: (Draw a 3,500 year old pictogram of a human being.)
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B538.polish: (Namaluj piktogram sprzed 3500 lat przedstawiający postać człowieka).

Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B577.english: You've spoken. The wall will now silently repeat the message. For a decade or so, until the sea air degrades the paint, adding another layer of *detritus* to the city.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B577.polish: Przemówiłeś. Ściana będzie teraz milcząco powtarzać twój przekaz. Przez jakieś dziesięć lat, póki morskie powietrze nie zniszczy farby, tworząc kolejną warstwę miejskiego *detrytusu*.
Dialogue Text/0x010000580000B577.belarusian: Ты прамовіў. Сцяна цяпер будзе маўкліва паўтараць тваё пасланне. Дзесяць гадоў ці каля таго, пакуль марское паветра не знішчыць фарбу, дадаючы гораду яшчэ адзін пласт *дэтрыту*.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001100001655.english: The lieutenant looks at the wall in dismay:
Dialogue Text/0x0100001100001655.polish: Porucznik spogląda na ścianę z konsternacją.

Dialogue Text/0x0100001100001671.english: "You're right, you're right. Is it too late to change it?"
